items.desc: At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. Job Description Research Scientist — Audio Source Separation Description The goal of our team is to develop novel AI-powered audio processing algorithms. The twist is that our algorithms must run in real time, on physical devices, for applications such as dynamic awareness, hearing augmentation, agentic perception, voice pickup, content enhancement, and ones we haven’t even thought of yet. You will work with experts in ML, DSP, software engineering, and psychoacoustics to prototype and implement new algorithms. You will develop next-generation algorithms that isolate, extract, or suppress individual sound sources from microphone recordings, sometimes augmented by other sensor signals. Applications include voice pickup, hearing augmentation, and new audio experiences that must ultimately run in real time on physical devices. Bose has a strong history of combining creative thinking with cutting-edge audio technology. We are looking for people passionate about machine learning and audio to help shape what comes next. Responsibilities Research, prototype, train, and evaluate novel source separation and extraction algorithms for speech and other real-world sounds. Develop approaches for single- and multi-microphone recordings, including spatial cues and optional auxiliary sensors. Investigate robust separation in challenging conditions such as overlapping talkers, noise, reverberation, and motion. Evaluate perceptual quality, separation performance, generalization, latency, memory, and computational requirements. Collaborate with DSP and embedded software teams to deploy models in real-time demonstrations and product platforms; contribute to patents and conference papers. Education Graduate degree (MS or PhD) in machine learning, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent research experience. Skills Deep hands-on experience in audio source separation, target sound extraction, speech enhancement, or related neural audio processing. Comfortable tackling complex, open-ended problems where you have to experiment with and discard many ideas before finding the right solution. Strong knowledge of audio DSP, time-frequency methods, and microphone array or spatial signal processing. Experience training and evaluating audio models in PyTorch; proficiency in Python and familiarity with C/C++ is a plus. Understanding of objective and perceptual evaluation methods and the tradeoffs involved in real-time low-power inference. Experience with multimodal or sensor-conditioned separation, ONNX/TFLite, or embedded deployment is a plus. Strong communication skills; publications at conferences such as ICASSP, Interspeech, NeurIPS, or similar are welcome but not required. At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $165,400-$227,500.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary. In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves. ‎

We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured. We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences. If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team. Context And Mission The primary objective of this position is to support the development, implementation, and validation of tabulated chemistry models for high-fidelity simulations of ammonia/hydrogen combustion under gas turbine conditions. The work will combine chemical kinetics, computational fluid dynamics, and high-performance computing, contributing to simulation tools suitable for modern supercomputing architectures, including GPU-accelerated systems. The successful candidate will join the Propulsion Technologies Group within the CASE Department at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC). The group brings together researchers with multidisciplinary expertise in computational fluid dynamics, combustion, and high-performance computing, and participates in European and industrial projects addressing advanced propulsion and energy technologies. Ammonia and hydrogen are promising carbon-free fuels for gas turbine applications. Their use introduces combustion challenges related to flame stability, ignition, fuel flexibility, and pollutant formation. Accurate numerical modelling is essential to understand these processes under the elevated pressures and inlet temperatures characteristic of gas turbine operation and to support the development of efficient combustors with low pollutant emissions. Tabulated chemistry offers an efficient approach to representing complex chemical kinetics in large-scale simulations of turbulent combustion. Applying these methods to ammonia/hydrogen mixtures requires models that capture the effects of fuel composition, operating conditions, and turbulence–chemistry interactions on flame behaviour and emissions. Key Duties Generate and analyse chemical databases for ammonia/hydrogen mixtures over a range of pressures, inlet temperatures, fuel compositions, and equivalence ratios relevant to gas turbine operation.Support the development and implementation of tabulated chemistry models within the computational fluid dynamics framework Alya.Assess the ability of the models to predict flame behaviour and pollutant formation, including nitrogen oxides and unburned ammonia.Perform and analyse numerical simulations of ammonia/hydrogen combustion, investigating the influence of operating conditions and fuel composition on combustion performance.Document developments and results, and contribute to technical reports, scientific publications, and collaborative project activities. Requirements EducationDegree in Physics, Aerospace or Aeronautics Engineering with specialization in propulsion.Master's Degree in Physics, Aerospace or Aeronautics Engineering with specialization in propulsion will be highly valuable. Essential Knowledge and Professional ExperienceGeneral knowledge of fluid mechanics, combustion chemistry and programing (Python) are expected (0-4 years' experience, at a university student level with some internship experience) Additional Knowledge and Professional ExperienceComputational skills (Linux, Latex) and parallel programming for HPC are not necessary, but will be considered an asset.Fluency in English is essential, Spanish will be highly valuable. items.desc: Research Engineer for Quantum Photonics Researcher position for quantum photonics at QuTech. Job description We are looking for a researcher to join the Quantum Internet Division at QuTech. Our team is dynamic and inclusive, with each member bringing unique perspectives and expertise to innovative research in semiconductor quantum technology. The Quantum Internet division develops scalable photonic quantum technologies for networking and distributed quantum computing. Our work centers on designing, fabricating, and integrating high-performance photonic quantum devices, including waveguides, resonators, and spin-photon interfaces. We pioneer advanced nanofabrication processes to enable precise control, efficient readout, and large-scale integration of quantum photonic components, while also investigating emergent phenomena in complex photonic systems. A key driver of impact in this field is the realization of reliable, high-quality integrated photonic devices. This demands continuous refinement of fabrication workflows spanning lithography, etching, deposition, and characterization; combined with a rigorous methodological approach to ensure reproducibility and yield across process runs. As a researcher within the Quantum Internet division, you will work in the Errando Herranz lab developing photonic quantum hardware, contributing to the optimization of device designs, fabrication recipes, and characterization to accelerate our research. We offer you a unique opportunity where every day brings new challenges and where, as part of a team, you will contribute to cutting-edge research in quantum computing and semiconductor technology. Key Responsibilities Nanofabrication process development through staying up to date with developments in integrated photonic fabrication. Analysis and inspection of quantum photonic devices, establishing effective feedback and feedforward systems. Nanofabrication processing with a focus on quantum photonic devices in silicon, silicon carbide, silicon nitride, and other materials. Room temperature and cryogenic characterization of photonic integrated circuits and color center devices. Job Requirements The candidate needs to have completed (or very soon complete, with an estimated defense date) a PhD in integrated photonics or quantum photonics and be familiar with color centers. The main qualifications we are looking for are: Experience with designing, fabricating, and characterizing integrated photonics. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Familiarity with quantum integrated photonic concepts and applications is a plus. TU Delft (Delft University of Technology) Working at TU Delft means contributing to solutions that really make a difference. For over 180 years, we have been training engineers who make an impact worldwide in companies, government bodies, or as entrepreneurs. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow. These challenges are changing rapidly. That is why we focus on themes such as energy, climate, digitalisation, artificial intelligence (AI), and smart mobility every day. Our education and research are directly aligned with what society needs now and in the future. At TU Delft, our people make the difference. With their knowledge and curiosity, our staff provide a high-quality education and conduct pioneering research that extends beyond the campus. You will have the opportunity to take the initiative, work with others, and grow as a professional. Working at TU Delft means join an international community of professionals and students. Together, we create knowledge, innovations, and solutions that help move the world forward. QuTech At QuTech, we work on radically new technologies with world-changing potential. Our mission: to develop scalable prototypes of a quantum computer and a quantum internet by integrating world-class research and groundbreaking innovation. Through excellence, relevance, and leadership, we cultivate a vibrant quantum technology ecosystem. Together, we are creating the quantum future, because we believe that quantum technologies can be a game changer in many societal and economic sectors, including health, agriculture and safety. Conditions of employment As a researcher you will receive a one year contract on project bases with a salary based on Scale 10 of the CAO for Dutch Universities with a salary between (€ 3706 to € 5760 for full time 38h per week). On top of that we are also offering: A job of 38 hours per week. 8% holiday allowance and an end-of-year bonus of 8.3%. An excellent pension scheme via the ABP. The possibility to compile an individual employment package every year. Discount with health insurers. Flexible working week. Up to 41 days off per year based on a full-time contract (38 hours). items.desc: About the job Microdentify Sweden AB (https://microdentify.com/) develops cutting-edge biotechnology and AI-driven solutions for law enforcement, national security, and defense. Operating at the intersection of computational biology, artificial intelligence, and forensic intelligence, we are pioneering next-generation technologies designed to address some of the most complex challenges in security and defense. Microdentify is seeking an excellent Bioinformatician or Computational Biologist to conduct computational analyses of environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing data, using machine-learning approaches for biological and forensic applications. The position involves analyzing sequencing datasets to identify biological patterns, develop computational methods for classification and prediction, build pipelines, and develop software to deliver results. The role focuses on analyzing biological and environmental DNA profiles and developing models for forensic intelligence. Main responsibilities The successful candidate will: · Process and analyze environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing datasets. · Analyze biological community profiles generated from environmental samples. · Apply statistical and machine-learning approaches to classification and prediction problems. Develop and evaluate computational models for geographic prediction from biological data. Create Nextflow pipelines. · Analyze spatial patterns in biological communities and assess relationships between biological similarity and geographic distance. · Evaluate model performance using appropriate validation and testing procedures. Work with large reference datasets containing biological and geographic information. · Produce figures, tables, and statistical summaries of analytical results. · Document computational workflows and contributions to scientific reports, presentations, and manuscripts. · Work collaboratively with researchers in bioinformatics, molecular biology, environmental genomics, and forensic science. Develop an interface for law enforcement and defense. Qualifications Applicants should have: · An MSc or PhD degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or a closely related discipline. · Experience analyzing DNA or eDNA sequencing or other high-dimensional biological data. · Experience with Python for data analysis. Experience with machine learning and statistical modeling. · Experience working with biological community, microbiome, metagenomic, or environmental DNA data. · Ability to work with large datasets and develop reproducible computational analyses. · Good written and spoken English. Excellent grades and/or publications · Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary research team. Meritorious qualifications · High-quality publications in eDNA, metagenomics, machine learning, or forensics · Experience with feature selection and dimensionality reduction for high-dimensional sequencing data. · Experience training LLMs. About the position This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of bioinformatics, environmental genomics, machine learning, and forensic science, with an emphasis on developing computational approaches to analyze biological sequencing data and build practical predictive tools. We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with curiosity, independence, and an interest in developing computational approaches to challenging biological problems. About Microdentify Microdentify Sweden AB is a pioneering deep-tech startup operating at the frontier of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and forensic intelligence. We are developing next-generation technologies for high-stakes applications in law enforcement, national security, and defense, pushing the boundaries of what we can extract from biological data. We are assembling a select team of exceptional AI researchers and developers to tackle complex, unconventional challenges at the cutting edge of science and technology. This is a rare opportunity to work on groundbreaking, mission-critical technologies, where innovation meets real-world intelligence and discretion is paramount. Applicants should submit. items.desc: About the Role The Clinical Trials Facility at the Translational Gastroenterology and Liver Unit (TGLU) in Oxford accommodates a large portfolio of clinical trials, both commercial and academic. Commercial trials (phase 2-4) are of novel biomarkers and clinical interventions in a range of gastroenterology, pancreatic and hepatobiliary diseases. Academic studies of diagnostics, biomarkers, vaccines, multi-omics, genetics and therapeutics with a focus in autoimmune and cholestatic liver disorders, metabolic disorders and fibrosis, portal hypertension and cancer. These national and international trials are run and delivered by a vibrant team of specialist principal investigators, research nurses, practitioners, biobankers and administrators with fantastic support from our consultants, junior doctors and scientists. The work is carried out with a drive to continually improve quality of care and clinical outcomes for patients. This post will suit a qualified clinician with an interest in clinical trial setup, management and delivery. The appointee will assess patients for suitability to take part in a wide range of studies with a responsibility for projects where a research fellow is required. Professor Emma Culver is the Head for Hepatology Department at the John Radcliffe Hospital in Oxford, the Chair for the British Liver Association (BASL) for Immune Mediated Liver Disease Special Interest Group, and Chair-Elect for the Scientific Committee for the European Liver Association (EASL) and represents the Research Council for United European Gastroenterology (UEG) This role requires collaboration across large multidisciplinary teams, and cooperation with other clinical departments, external organisations and support departments (R&D, pharmacy). There is a requirement for excellent communication, documentation and research governance. As a facility, we look to support all staff in opportunities for further training and development in the clinic and research environment. The role also includes opportunities for writing grants, for novel research proposals within the group, and for individual development in research projects, presentations and publications in peer reviewed journals This post is full time ( part time will be considered and flexible working supported )and fixed term for 12 months. About You To be considered for this position; Hold a relevant medical degree: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery or equivalent Have experience of working in clinical research within the NHS Hold GMC registration Have a desire to undertake cutting-edge scientific research. Have an active interest in translational research, with respect to optimizing the use of new agents in chronic disease, by personalization of care. Have the ability to work well independently as well as part of a team. Have the ability to manage the day-to-day running of a research project. Have the ability to present research in national and international symposia and to non-specialist audiences. About the Nuffield Department of Clinical Medicine The Nuffield Department of Clinical Medicine (NDM) is one of the largest departments of the University of Oxford and is part of the Medical Sciences Division, with responsibility for a significant part of the teaching of clinical students within the Medical School. Benefits of working University employees enjoy 38 days’ paid holiday, generous pension schemes, travel discounts, and a variety of professional development opportunities. Our range of other employee benefits and discounts also includes free entry to the Botanic Gardens and University colleges, and discounts at University museums. See https://hr.admin.ox.ac.uk/staff-benefits Application Process Applications for this vacancy must be made online. You will be required to upload a CV and supporting statement as part of your application. Your supporting statement must specify how you meet each of the selection criteria, using examples of your skills and experience Only applications received before 12:00 midday on Wednesday 02/12/2026 will be accepted.

Read academic papers, journals, textbooks, attend specified training courses in order to keep abreast of developments. Carry out any other duties designated by line manager and which fall within the general ambit of the post. Good understanding of microwave networks, antennas, nonlinear active devices and wireless communication systems. Practical experience of applying the specialist skills and techniques required (including programming and software defined radios) for wireless communication systems. Experience in writing high-quality academic papers and/or technical notes and reports. Effective communication, report preparation, time management to meet deadlines. Flexibility to travel for meetings. Must be prepared to work as part of a team. Ability to contribute to method improvement where required. items.desc: The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics at the innovative Universitetsbyen invites applications for a dedicated laboratory technician. Join our inclusive laboratory and contribute meaningfully as a core member of a research team, mentored by Professor Simona Radutoiu. We are at the forefront of researching plant-bacterial symbiosis with the goal of unlocking the full potential of both plants and bacteria to foster sustainable and climate-friendly agricultural practices. Our research is funded by ambitious programs, and our team consists of dedicated scientists and students committed to advancing knowledge and achieving project goals efficiently. Our research focuses on understanding the intricate interactions between plants and bacterial communities is pivotal in current research and agricultural needs. Expected start date and duration of employment This is a fixed-term position to start on 1 February 2027 and end on 30 September 2028. Job description The laboratories within the Plant Molecular Biology section conduct analyses of experimental plants interacting with various soil bacteria or beneficial fungi, supporting research projects focused on plant genetics and plant responses to microbes. These analyses include, among other things, DNA and RNA analysis (via amplification and sequencing), the assessment of physiological responses in plants and microbes, and the microscopy of plant cells and organs. Key responsibilities will include: Preparing and conducting experiments in accordance with research hypotheses and objectives. Preparing samples from plants and microbes. Performing various analyses on samples using DNA/RNA techniques or microscopy. Maintaining and operating laboratory equipment and facilities. Tasks related to the local work environment, including the preparation of workplace instructions and chemical risk assessments, as well as the labeling of chemicals. Updating and maintaining the department’s databases. Providing support to postdocs, students, and visiting researchers. We are a large, international section with a wide variety of tasks; consequently, the actual duties may vary from those listed above. Your profile Our ideal candidate: Has completed a laboratory technician education (laborant in Danish). Has strong experience in molecular biology. Has experience with plant research and plant tissue culture. Has experience preparing and handling synthetic microbial communities (SynComs) or multi-strain microbial experiments. Is proficient in molecular biology techniques such as DNA extraction, PCR, qPCR, gel electrophoresis, and sample preparation for sequencing. Can independently design and execute research projects that require care, attention to details and careful observations. Is curious, systematic, and thrives in a collaborative, international environment. Wants to contribute to cutting-edge plant-bacterial interaction research. Can handle complex tasks and maintains overview during periods of intense activities. Can assist with data entry and laboratory database maintenance. Can manage laboratory inventory, coordinate supply orders, and handle basic purchasing tasks. Communicates effectively in English (the working language of our group). Has a driving license (min. category B) – preferred. This position is perfect for someone who enjoys both hands-on lab work and maintaining a well-functioning research environment. If you're passionate about science, enjoy working in a team, and are ready to take on a variety of tasks, we encourage you to apply! Who we are The Plant Molecular Biology section's activities focus on genetic, molecular and biochemical research in the model plant Lotus japonicus as well as several crop plants such as cassava, barley, maize, and wheat. The research seeks to elucidate and understand the mechanisms behind genetic control of signal transduction, cell differentiation, developmental processes, local adaptation and plant-microbe interactions. Key research areas include symbiotic nitrogen fixation, plant perception of microbial signaling molecules, susceptibility to pathogens and colonization by symbiotic and endophytic bacteria/fungi. What we offer The research at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG) at Aarhus University spans from basic to applied research within molecular biology. The department is organised in six research sections (Plant Molecular Biology, Bioinformatics, Neurobiology, RNA Biology and Innovation, Protein Science and Cellular Health, Intervention and Nutrition), a number of centres of excellence and various interdisciplinary centres. Here, you can: Be part of a lively and engaging research environment. Work with a large international research network. Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge plant molecular biology research. Engage in a mix of specialized research tasks and routine activities suited to your learning path. Develop project professional skills through coordinating lab logistics and vendor …

As a Junior Data Scientist at Wageningen University & Research (WUR), you will work on these challenges. You will combine spatial data, models, and data science techniques to generate insights that contribute to scientific research and practical solutions for a sustainable future. You will work on a variety of topics, including climate adaptation, biodiversity monitoring, forest inventories, and ecosystem management. Together with researchers and technical specialists, you will analyze data, apply models, and communicate research results clearly. You do not need to know everything yet. Visualizing results You will present data and model outputs in a clear and understandable way and contribute to reports and presentations. items.desc: We are recruiting an ambitious Biomedical Data Scientist or Bioinformatician for EU-funded research that employs AI methods to accelerate development and clinical translation of CAR T cell immunotherapies. The successful candidate will join the research group led by Christoph Bock at the CeMM Research Center for Molecular Medicine (Austrian Academy of Sciences) and the Institute of Artificial Intelligence (Medical University of Vienna), broadly contributing to several European consortia through data-driven biomedical research, analysis of complex datasets, support and co-mentoring of students and postdocs, computational methods development, and contributions to project and data management. Your Profile We are seeking researchers eager to contribute to cutting-edge research, with a strong commitment to scientific excellence and collaboration. We are open to candidates pursuing a classical academic career, but also to those looking for opportunities outside the PhD → postdoc → professor track, who may be interested in building the foundations for a start-up company or a career in AI-driven biomedical and translational research. We welcome early-stage candidates who have recently completed their PhD, as well as candidates with initial postdoctoral research experience who are ready for the next challenge. Final-year PhD students are encouraged to apply early; the contract will start once the PhD has been completed. Required skills PhD in bioinformatics, computational or quantitative biology, machine learning / artificial intelligence, data science, or a related field Strong programming and data analysis skills (Python and/or R) and experience analyzing complex biological or biomedical datasets Prior experience with high-throughput biology data, such as single-cell, spatial, or other multi-omics datasets, or with biomedical research Good communication skills in English and the ability to work collaboratively in an interdisciplinary, international team Desirable skills Experience with machine learning / deep learning frameworks and AI methods for biomedical data Software and data engineering skills, including workflow management tools and good software development practices Familiarity with FAIR principles and data standards, and with integrating data across multiple sites Experience with clinical or health data, including GDPR-compliant data handling Publications in the field, and experience in mentoring or co-supervising students The project This position sits at the computational center of several European research consortia that together pursue one goal: making CAR T cell immunotherapy faster to develop, better understood, and more broadly applicable. The main focus is on data science — analyzing complex multi-omics and clinical datasets produced across partner sites, developing AI methods for predicting immune cell function and therapeutic response, and establishing the data infrastructure and standards that let partners throughout Europe work together effectively, contributing expertise from fundamental biology to clinical practice. The role is correspondingly broad: deep analytical work on research questions, development of computational methods and software systems, and close interactions with biologists, clinicians, and computational colleagues across Europe. The Bock Lab (https://bocklab.org) We seek to advance biomedicine with technology-driven research, combining experimental and computational approaches to understand and program epigenetic cell states and to develop cell-based therapies for cancer and immune diseases. Main areas of research include: Bioinformatics . Computational methods are essential for data-driven biomedical research. We develop algorithms and software for large-scale data analysis, and we pursue clinical collaborations to establish medical impact. Single-cell biology . Epigenetic cell states contribute broadly to the regulation of human organs. As part of the Human Cell Atlas, we use single-cell and spatial sequencing to dissect their role in tissue homeostasis and pathogenesis. Machine learning . Huge datasets pose new analytical challenges. As part of the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, we develop methods for interpretable deep learning and artificial intelligence in biomedicine. Biotechnology . Groundbreaking discoveries are often enabled by new technology. We develop and apply innovative methods in the areas of single-cell sequencing, CRISPR screening, epigenome editing, and synthetic biology. Cell therapy . CAR T cells have shown dramatic efficacy for blood cancers and spearhead a broader shift toward personalized cell-based therapies. Ειδικότερα, οι κύριες αρμοδιότητες περιλαμβάνουν: Ανάλυση και προετοιμασία μεγάλων συνόλων δεδομένων. Ανάπτυξη και αξιολόγηση μοντέλων Μηχανικής Μάθησης (Machine Learning) και πρόβλεψης χρονοσειρών (time series forecasting). Δημιουργία χαρακτηριστικών (feature engineering) και επιλογή κατάλληλων δεικτών αξιολόγησης (evaluation metrics). Συμμετοχή στη μεταφορά των μοντέλων σε παραγωγική λειτουργία (production), σε συνεργασία με τις ομάδες Πληροφορικής και Δεδομένων. Συνεργασία με επιχειρησιακές ομάδες για την κατανόηση των αναγκών και την παρουσίαση των αποτελεσμάτων. Τεκμηρίωση κώδικα, μεθοδολογίας και αποτελεσμάτων. Απαραίτητα προσόντα: Πτυχίο σε ποσοτικό ή τεχνικό αντικείμενο (π.χ. Πληροφορική, Μαθηματικά, Στατιστική, Μηχανική, Επιχειρησιακή Έρευνα). 2+ έτη επαγγελματικής εμπειρίας στην Επιστήμη Δεδομένων (Data Science) ή τη Μηχανική Μάθηση (Machine Learning). Πολύ καλή γνώση Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) και SQL. Καλό υπόβαθρο σε Στατιστική (Statistics) και Μηχανική Μάθηση. Εμπειρία στην πρόβλεψη χρονοσειρών (time series forecasting). Κατανόηση της σωστής αξιολόγησης μοντέλων: επικύρωση (validation), υπερπροσαρμογή (overfitting), διαρροή δεδομένων (data leakage). Χρήση συστήματος διαχείρισης εκδόσεων κώδικα (Git). Καλή επικοινωνία και πολύ καλή γνώση Αγγλικών. Επιθυμητά προσόντα: Εμπειρία στο λιανεμπόριο (retail), την εφοδιαστική αλυσίδα (supply chain) ή τη διαχείριση αποθεμάτων (inventory management). Εμπειρία με αλγορίθμους ενισχυμένων δέντρων (gradient boosting), όπως XGBoost ή LightGBM. Γνώσεις βελτιστοποίησης ή Επιχειρησιακής Έρευνας (optimization / operations research). Εμπειρία με Databricks, PySpark ή περιβάλλοντα υπολογιστικού νέφους (cloud). Μεταπτυχιακές σπουδές σε σχετικό αντικείμενο. Η θέση εργασίας υπάγεται στη Διεύθυνση Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης (AI), στα Κεντρικά Γραφεία (Λεωφόρος Κηφισού 136, Περιστέρι Αττικής). Αμοιβές & Παροχές: Στο πλαίσιο της Πολιτικής Μισθολογικής Ισότητας και Διαφάνειας, οι υποψήφιοι θα ενημερώνονται εγκαίρως για την αρχική αμοιβή ή το προβλεπόμενο εύρος αποδοχών της θέσης, το οποίο καθορίζεται βάσει αντικειμενικών και ουδέτερων ως προς το φύλο κριτηρίων, καθώς και για τυχόν εφαρμοστέες συλλογικές συμβάσεις εργασίας. Η επιλογή των υποψηφίων πραγματοποιείται με γνώμονα τα απαιτούμενα προσόντα, τις επαγγελματικές δεξιότητες και την καταλληλότητά τους για τη θέση, με σεβασμό στις αρχές της Ίσης Μεταχείρισης και των Ίσων Ευκαιριών. Σε περίπτωση υποβολής αίτησης πρόσληψης στην Εταιρεία ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΕΣ ΥΠΕΡΑΓΟΡΕΣ ΣΚΛΑΒΕΝΙΤΗΣ Α.Ε.Ε., τα προσωπικά σας δεδομένα θα υποβληθούν σε επεξεργασία σύμφωνα με την "Ενημέρωση Εργαζομένων και Υποψηφίων Εργαζομένων για την επεξεργασία Προσωπικών Δεδομένων".

If this sounds like the right fit, please send your CV and a few lines about an AI agent or automation you have built. items.desc: As a Research Engineer Knowledge Graphs, you will contribute to groundbreaking research into the development of flexible data retrieval in the manufacturing industry, supported by modern chatbots. At Flanders Make, we conduct research aimed at innovation in the (manufacturing) industry of the future. In the upcoming projects, we want to develop prototype software tools that use advanced knowledge graphs. You will investigate how context in the manufacturing industry can be explicitly modelled using these knowledge graphs. Development and Implementation of AI Solutions for the Manufacturing Industry You will be working in an agile environment in which you will work together with experts from a software, mechanical or mathematical engineering background and with expertise in model-driven engineering, computational design synthesis, optimization techniques and mechatronic design. Together, you will set up software developments that, among other things, will radically speed up searches by data engineers and data scientists in manufacturing companies and arrive at proof-of-concepts. Specifically, you will: - Develop complex ontologies, using modern modelling techniques to effectively capture the knowledge of manufacturing companies; - Develop Python tools to effectively use these ontologies in applications (such as root-cause analysis) and combine them with other technologies such as LLMs; - Set up graph databases to connect the ontologies with data in a knowledge graph; - Regularly present the progress of your technical concepts and findings to various stakeholders at colleagues and partners; - Actively expand your expertise in your field but also in related topics. Creative Problem Solver with expertise in knowledge graph As research engineer knowledge graphs, you are: - Interested in applied research that bridges the gap between academia and industry; - Enthusiastic to collaborate with an interdisciplinary research team in a project-oriented environment; - Willing to constantly learn new techniques, technologies, and skills, and keep up to date with the latest academic and industry research trends; - Able to communicate your innovative algorithms to both industrial and academic stakeholders; You will bring: - Minimum 3 years of relevant industrial experience; - Knowledge and background in ontology design and knowledge graphs; - Proficient knowledge in writing code, mainly in Python; - Conceptual thinking with insight into formalizing concepts - Experience with research combined with business experience, mainly in knowledge graphs - Good communication and listening skills, customer-oriented and team player. Our Offer Make an impact where it truly matters. You translate research into solutions that deliver tangible advances in industrial technology and manufacturing processes. Work at the intersection of industry, technology and science. You combine systems thinking with hands-on prototypes, test setups and validation. Build solutions that go beyond a single project. Reusability, scalability and sustainable knowledge development are at the heart of your work. Grow alongside the best. You work within a network of companies, universities and research institutions, with the opportunity to develop and showcase your expertise. Work in an open and forward-thinking environment where initiative, professional autonomy and collaboration are highly valued. Benefit from a strong overall compensation package. The gross monthly salary range for this position is EUR 4,050 to EUR 5,300, complemented by meal vouchers, hospitalisation and group insurance, and a pension plan. Maintain a healthy work-life balance. Flexible working hours, hybrid working (possibility for 1 home work day per week). How to apply? Fill in the online application form and upload a motivation letter and resume. From our sites in Lommel, Leuven and Kortrijk, as well as our laboratories at the five Flemish universities, we foster open innovation through excellent research. Thanks to our unique position as a bridge between industry and research, our teams combine expertise at application and system level with technological and scientific knowledge. Academic partners and more than 150 companies are part of Flanders Make’s innovative circular ecosystem. Our strategy, based on industrial needs and long-term trends, ensures close alignment with industry and the challenges it faces. Through our programmed research, we create tangible impact for companies. Sustainability, climate and sustainable employability are key priorities in our research. We aim to help companies develop sustainable, green, smart and connected products and production systems, with particular attention to people and their interaction with machines. items.desc: Expert public de la météo et du climat, Météo-France est à vos côtés pour contribuer à votre sécurité au quotidien et vous aider à prendre les meilleures décisions, dans un climat qui change. Face à des épisodes météo dangereux encore plus intenses et plus fréquents sous l’effet du changement climatique, nos missions au service de votre sécurité sont cruciales. Nous mobilisons notre expertise, notre excellence scientifique et technologique pour vous permettre d’anticiper les phénomènes météorologiques et climatiques à enjeux, et de vous y adapter. Retrouvez-nous en ligne : https://meteofrance.com/carte-didentite-de-meteo-france Rejoindre Météo France, C'est Intégrer Une Organisation Multi-sites, Situés En Hexagone, En Outre-mer, Etc. L'organisation De Météo-France S'appuie Sur Des Directions Centrales Et Des Directions Interrégionales. Ci-dessous, La Présentation De La Direction Que Vous Pourriez Rejoindre La Direction de l'Enseignement Supérieur et de la Recherche (DESR) rassemble les entités de recherche de Météo-France (principalement CNRM, SAFIRE, LACy), l'Ecole Nationale de la Météorologie, et les services partagés de soutien administratif et informatique (PGA).Le CNRM est une Unité Mixte de Recherche (UMR 3589) avec la double tutelle Météo-France et CNRS. Le CNRM conduit des recherches dans le domaine de la météorologie et du climat, de l'observation, la compréhension et la modélisation des processus jusqu'à la mise au point de systèmes de prévision météorologique et de projection climatique pouvant être transférés aux services opérationnels de Météo-France. Le GMAP (Groupe de Modélisation et d'Assimilation pour la Prévision), basé à Toulouse, est l'un des 6 groupes ou centres de recherche du CNRM. Sa mission est de maintenir et développer les systèmes de prévision numérique du temps opérationnels de Météo-France et de conduire des recherches qui préparent les futures versions. Au sein du groupe GMAP, vous aurez pour objectif de développer de nouvelles applications de prévision numérique du temps exploitant les techniques d'intelligence artificielle à l'état de l'art.  Have a high degree of craftsmanship and pay close attention to detail, consistently striving for engineering excellence;

Participer aux projets de recherche et à leur valorisation, contribuer à la définition des orientations scientifiques et techniques, rédiger la documentation scientifique et technique, participer aux publications associées et présenter les résultats lors de réunions scientifiques, séminaires et démonstrations. 8. Définir et assurer une veille technologique et scientifique sur l'évolution des méthodes de vision par ordinateur et de perception embarquée, des architectures matérielles XR, des systèmes d'exploitation et des environnements de développement associés. Langages et génie logiciel : Maîtrise de C++ et/ou C# (Unity), des outils de gestion de versions (Git) et des protocoles d'échange réseau (APIs REST, WebSockets). Innate immune cells are essential for detecting bacterial pathogens and generating anti-bacterial immunity. We strive to decipher the processes that regulate anti-bacterial immune responses, and the mechanisms through which bacterial pathogens evade or manipulate the immune responses. We are seeking a forward-thinking, passionate and ambitious Postdoctoral Research Associate to explore the functional consequences of bacterial pathogen interactions with human inhibitory receptors. This post is funded by an Wellcome Trust grant awarded to Dr Alex McCarthy, which aims to provide fundamental insights into the role of inhibitory leukocyte immunoglobulin like receptors (LILRs) in bacterial infections. This will be achieved by utilising microbiological, cellular and in vivo infection models. What you would be doing You will be performing cutting edge research combining molecular, microbiological, cellular and in vivo infection-based approaches to contribute to an advanced understanding of invasive bacterial diseases. You will be based in the group of Dr Alex McCarthy in the Centre for Bacterial Resistance Biology (CBRB), and in the Section of Molecular Microbiology within the Department of Infectious Diseases (DoID) at Imperial College London. Your research will address questions on the functional properties of inhibitory receptors, their capacity to regulate anti-bacterial immune responses and their role in bacterial infection biology. You will be expected to take a lead in planning and designing the studies (with support from the PI). You will take initiative in the planning of research. You will have clear and timely communication with the Group leader and work closely with researchers within the group. As part of your development, you will attend and actively contribute to relevant workshops, lab meetings, research seminars and conferences in Imperial and the wider community. You will supervise both undergraduate and postgraduate research students. What we are looking for We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with research interests in bacterial infection biology. Applicants must demonstrate as part of their application, how they meet the essential criteria required of the post. items.desc: Wer sind wir? The Pioneer ist ein digitales Medienunternehmen neuen Typs im Herzen von Berlin. Im Fokus steht innovativer und unabhängiger Journalismus rund um Wirtschaft und Politik – immer aktuell, immer relevant. Neben Gründer & Herausgeber Gabor Steingart gehören zu unseren Hosts u.a. Ex-Vizekanzler Sigmar Gabriel und Bestsellerautorin Juli Zeh. Mit dem ersten Medienschiff der Welt haben wir ein schwimmendes Büro geschaffen, das im Regierungsviertel Berlins unterwegs ist – immer am Puls der aktuellen Geschehnisse. Was Du bei uns machst Als (Junior) Data & AI Analyst machst du Daten verständlich und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue KI-Datenprodukte. Deine Analysen helfen Redaktion, Growth & Product, Marketing und Geschäftsleitung, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du den Pioneer AI Analyst weiter: einen KI-Assistenten, der unseren Teams hilft, Daten zu analysieren, Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Muster erkennen. Du analysierst die Nutzung unserer Web- und App-Angebote, die Performance unserer Inhalte und die Abo-Entwicklung. Du erkennst Trends, bewertest Optimierungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Orientierung geben. Du ordnest Analyseergebnisse ein, erklärst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich und präsentierst den Teams fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen. Ideen in die Praxis bringen. Mit Redaktion, Marketing und Produkt setzt du Daten- und KI-Anwendungen von der Idee bis zum Rollout um. Du entwickelst Skills und Automatisierungen mit KI-Assistenten oder n8n. Workshops und Anleitungen helfen den Teams, die Anwendungen eigenständig zu nutzen. Eine gemeinsame Datensprache schaffen. Du definierst einheitliche Kennzahlen, entwickelst Self-Service-Dashboards und unterstützt die Qualitätssicherung beim Tracking mit Google Analytics. Was Du mitbringst Du stehst kurz vor oder nach deinem Studienabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Statistik, Data Science, BWL mit Datenschwerpunkt oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fach. Du bringst erste Praxiserfahrung mit – aus Beruf, Werkstudentenjob, Praktikum, Abschlussarbeit oder eigenen Projekten. Du kannst SQL schreiben und möchtest deine Kenntnisse vertiefen. Python-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus. Du nutzt KI-Assistenten und Coding-Tools für Analysen, Programmierung oder Recherche und probierst Neues aus. Du erklärst Zahlen verständlich und präsentierst Ergebnisse deinen Stakeholdern. Du erschließt dir neue Themen selbstständig und testest Ideen mit Prototypen. Erfahrungen mit BI-Tools wie QuickSight, Power BI oder Tableau sowie mit Google Analytics oder APIs sind willkommen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Warum genau wir? Wir setzen auf Initiative. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Themen, die dir wichtig sind, und treibst sie selbst voran. In einer Phase, in der The Pioneer stetig wächst, gestaltest du so aktiv mit, wie unabhängiger Journalismus in Deutschland aussieht. Ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es sonst nicht gibt: Du arbeitest an Bord unserer Medienschiffe mit Blick auf die Spree. Für den Alltag steht dir zusätzlich unser Büro im schönen Charlottenburg offen. Du bekommst direkten Zugang zu unseren Live-Formaten und Events und erlebst Gäste aus Politik und Wirtschaft live und hautnah vor Ort. Voller Einsatz braucht volle Batterien. Mit Urban Sports Club sorgen wir dafür, dass du auch außerhalb der Arbeit in Bewegung bleibst und deinen persönlichen Ausgleich findest. Was auch immer du bei uns bewegst, tust du mit einer sicheren Basis aus unbefristeter Anstellung, einer fairen Vergütung und 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr. Über uns Das Nachrichtenportal The Pioneer bildet seit Mai 2020 die gemeinsame Bühne für alle journalistischen Publikationen des Medienunternehmens Media Pioneer Publishing AG. Ausgezeichnet als “Startup of the Year” (European Publishing Awards 2020) gelten wir als eines der spannendsten Medienprojekte in Europa. Unser bekanntestes Format “The Pioneer Morning Briefing” erreicht als Newsletter und Podcast jeden Morgen bis zu 1 Mio. Menschen und ist damit “Deutschlands Morning Briefing No. 1” Neben Gründer & Herausgeber Gabor Steingart gehören zu unseren Hosts u.a. Ex-Vizekanzler Sigmar Gabriel und die Journalistinnen Chelsea Spieker und Alev Do ğ an. Viele weitere Formate sind in Planung. Als schwimmender Newsroom, Produktionsort und Bühne für Live-Journalismus dient unserer Crew das erste Medienschiff der Welt, The Pioneer One, das täglich auf der Spree oder in ganz Deutschland unterwegs ist. Unsere Mission heißt Unabhängigkeit: der Politik- und Wirtschaftsjournalismus von The Pioneer ist 100% werbefrei.

We work on applied research projects in the physical sciences to meet the current and future challenges of the industry. Description & Scope Real-world systems from industrial processes to environmental monitoring are never fully observed. Sensors fail, data arrives late, and no single measurement tells the whole story. This project explores how to intelligently combine heterogeneous, incomplete data streams while rigorously quantifying what we do not know. Using probabilistic machine learning, Bayesian inference, and uncertainty-aware neural architectures, you will build models that are honest about their own confidence producing not just predictions, but trustworthy estimates with calibrated uncertainty bounds. The result: smarter, more reliable AI for complex systems where measurement is imperfect and decisions are high-stakes. Responsibilities Develop methods to fuse incomplete sensor data and handle uncertainty. Build ML models that deliver both predictions and confidence levels. Gain hands-on experience with data fusion, uncertainty quantification, and applied AI. Requirements Studying Bachelors in Bachelors in Data Science, ML, AI or a related discipline Python Data analysis Machine learning SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law. The recruiting process and the position can be adapted to fit most disabilities, please do not hesitate to mention this when applying.

items.desc: ABOUT DESCARTES UNDERWRITING Join Descartes and contribute to our mission: Building Resilience in a World at Risk . Descartes is a corporate insurance group for worldwide companies and institutions. Descartes was born from a conviction that the growing complexity of corporate and climate risks demands a new approach to insurance. At the forefront of AI and Data analysis, Descartes utilises cutting-edge technology combined with a new generation of data sources, to model, assess and manage risks. Since 2019, Descartes has secured a leading position in parametric (re)insurance combining scientific & technological expertise with a new approach. Parametric insurance , also known as index-based insurance, indemnifies clients within days based on pre-defined payout structures when a specific triggering event occurs, the payout process is both fast and transparent. The company has been financed with over $141M by investors including Highland Europe, BlackFin, Serena, Cathay, Eurazeo and Battery Ventures. Our highly diverse and specialized team of 250+ people includes the largest modelling team in the industry featuring tech and modeling innovators, scientists in physics and climatology, as well as insurance veterans and underwriters. Model Integration: Collaborate with Underwriting and Software teams to transition successful experimental models into production-ready pricing tools. Methodological Optimization: Refine existing algorithms to improve accuracy, speed, and reliability in assessing complex climate risks. Your missions will evolve in the future as Descartes is growing fast and many exciting projects are waiting for you. It's a unique opportunity to take a closer look inside a fast-growing scale up with huge ambitions ! MINDSET Strong interest in climate change resilience and natural perils modelling (wildfires, hail, tsunamis, earthquakes, etc); Excellent team player able to turn academic insights into tangible solutions and innovate from research papers; Autonomous and comfortable taking complex technical problems of open-ended research topics in a dynamic and multi-cultural environment. Dynamic Culture : Thrive in a collaborative, fast-growing scale-up driven by our core value of diversity and openness across international teams. items.desc: About us Presto Engineering is the recognized expert in ASIC design and integrated semiconductor services with over 35 years of experience in the industry. We help innovative companies imagine and implement microelectronic solutions for tomorrow, in high-value markets such as Medical, Automotive, Industrial and Communication, while reducing risk, minimizing fixed cost structure, and accelerating time-to-market. About The Job This is a 6-month internship. Reporting directly to the local Product Engineer, the Data Scientist Level I position is responsible for developing and improving a classifier/model dedicated to detecting different abnormal behavior in the production based on the main logs and wafer map images. The intern may involve different tools to evaluate, visualize and track the improvement of the model. Your Responsibilities Analysis of the existing model : Understand the current AI architecture, its training process, and its performance on silicon production images. Dataset analysis : Explore the available image dataset, assess image quality, identify class imbalances, and evaluate the quality of annotations. Performance evaluation: Measure the model's performance using relevant metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrices. Error analysis : Identify recurring misclassifications and investigate their potential causes, such as visual similarities between classes, image noise, or variations in acquisition conditions. Model improvement: Experiment with different approaches, including data augmentation, hyperparameter optimization, transfer learning, and alternative model architectures. Robustness assessment : Evaluate the model's ability to generalize to new images and change production conditions. Performance optimization : Investigate opportunities to reduce inference time and computational requirements while maintaining classification quality. Documentation: Summarize the experiments, compare the results, and formulate recommendations for further model development and potential industrial deployment. Secondary responsibilities Quality: Respect quality process and documentation in test company policy Safety & Environment: Respect safety and environment company policy Security: Respect the Security company policy IT & Technologies: Respect IT & Technologies policy Requirements Currently pursuing a Master's degree or an engineering degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Vision, or a related field. Solid programming skills in Python. Basic understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts. Knowledge of image classification and computer vision techniques. Ability to analyze experimental results, identify model limitations, and propose improvements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a technical team. Good communication skills and the ability to document technical work clearly Technical skills Programming: Python Deep learning frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras Computer vision: OpenCV, image preprocessing, and image augmentation Data analysis: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn Model evaluation: Scikit-learn and relevant classification metrics AI methods: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), transfer learning, and potentially Vision Transformers (ViTs) Development tools: Jupyter Notebook, Git, and standard machine learning workflows Location & Travel The role will be based at our office in Meyreuil, France. How to apply Please send us your application and CV in English only by selecting the 'Apply Now'. Want to Know More? To know more about us, please visit our website to find out what it's like to work at Presto Engineering, and follow us on LinkedIn for updates.

With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger. Watch our film About The Team At Ingrid, our tech team builds and maintains an in-house optimisation engine that maximises the value of batteries in the grid. Around it, we build the models, forecasts, data pipelines and insights that our trading and business decisions rely on. We work closely together to take ideas from concept to production, and we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where everyone’s voice is valued, and everyone can make a real impact. About The Role As Algorithm Engineer at Ingrid, you’ll design and build the mathematical models behind how our batteries operate in the grid: models of battery behaviour, market prices, renewable generation and the decisions our optimisation engine makes. The work is about translating physical systems and market behaviour into mathematical form and making that form useful in practice. That means forecasting and optimisation. Depending on your background, you’ll lean towards one of them, but you’ll work across both. What matters is choosing the right approach for the problem and understanding it in depth. This role is about the models themselves: how a problem is formulated mathematically, which assumptions it rests on, what can be simplified and why the model behaves the way it does. We’re a small team, so you’ll also own the path from idea to production. You’ll write the production code, deploy it on our cloud platform (GCP), set up the tests and monitoring your models need, and make sure they run reliably on live data. We work in a fast-paced way, shipping good-enough solutions and improving them based on how they perform. Your models drive real decisions on real assets every day, and their impact on our revenue is substantial and growing. You’ll see directly how they perform in the market and use that to make them better. The HR Data Scientist will: Partner with HR Leadership and Business Analysts to identify high-value analytics opportunities and translate business questions into well-defined Data Science problems and measurable success criteria; Design, build, and validate statistical and Machine Learning models (including attrition and turnover prediction, workforce forecasting, time-to-hire, performance, and engagement analysis); Develop and maintain feature pipelines, model training, and inference workflows (using Databricks notebooks, MLflow, and Delta Lake); Build and curate Databricks Genie rooms and contribute to Genie ontology, enabling stakeholders to access workforce insights through natural-language interactions; Design Databricks Dashboards and Databricks Apps to provide HR Leaders and Managers with self-service access to workforce insights, HR KPIs, and model outputs; Collaborate with Data Engineers and Data Stewards to ensure Data quality and Compliance with privacy, ethics, and Governance requirements (including anonymization, access controls, fairness, and bias considerations); Communicate findings, model results, recommendations, and limitations clearly to non-technical HR and Business stakeholders; Monitor deployed models for drift, performance, and fairness, continuously improving them as workforce dynamics and underlying Data evolve; Identify and optimize recurring manual workflows to improve efficiency and reduce repetitive requests. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an NLP Engineer based in Ireland. As an NLP Engineer, you will develop, train, and optimize advanced language models powering intelligent conversational experiences and AI-driven products. Your focus will be on adapting language models to evolving conversational scenarios, improving response quality, and ensuring reliable and efficient model performance. You will experiment with different models, prompting strategies, and inference technologies to balance accuracy, latency, and operational costs. Develop and optimize prompts to achieve consistent and relevant outputs. Model Evaluation and Benchmarking: Maintain evaluation datasets and performance benchmarks, using automated assessments, human reviews, and other evaluation techniques to measure generated text quality. Identify regressions, investigate unsatisfactory responses, and incorporate user feedback into improvements. Support reliable deployment and integration of models into production applications. Production Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Implement logging, monitoring, and appropriate testing processes to maintain production reliability. Investigate technical issues, manage deployment failures, and support rollback procedures when necessary. Recommendation Systems: Contribute to recommendation-related capabilities and explore opportunities to apply NLP and machine learning techniques to improve product experiences. Technical Documentation: Maintain reproducible experiments, document technical decisions and results, and ensure solutions are understandable and maintainable by other engineering team members. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with engineering and product stakeholders to translate requirements into effective NLP solutions and deliver improvements to AI-powered features. Requirements Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code beyond research notebooks. Practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, including a solid understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization, model training, and text generation. Hands-on experience adapting and fine-tuning language models through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and parameter-efficient approaches such as LoRA. Strong understanding of dataset preparation, validation, quality control, and data leakage prevention. Ability to investigate model errors, identify weaknesses in training data, and develop strategies to improve model performance. Experience evaluating generated text using benchmarks, automated evaluation methods, and human review. Understanding of the strengths, limitations, and trade-offs of different language models and evaluation approaches. Practical experience working with model APIs, prompt engineering, and structured output generation. Experience developing and maintaining APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent backend framework. Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and Git, including experience deploying machine learning models on GPU infrastructure. Knowledge of model inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM or equivalent technologies. Experience implementing logging, monitoring, automated tests, and production troubleshooting procedures. Ability to investigate production failures, identify root causes, and manage safe release or rollback processes. SQL proficiency sufficient to retrieve, query, and analyze product data. items.desc: Loomis is a global leader in the cash and payments services, offering innovative solutions across cash management, valuables management, and digital payments. With a presence in 27 countries and a history spanning almost 175 years, we are committed to driving the future of the payments ecosystem through technology, sustainability, and customer-centric innovation. We're expanding our AI/ML team in Granada with engineers who own end-to-end AI solutions. You will work on problem scoping, data engineering, modeling, deployment, and production monitoring. This isn't a research-only role: you'll build and operate real systems that run on-premise, serving models in production while collaborating with a global, English-speaking team. At Loomis, you'll work on mission-critical applications in cash logistics. AI impacts physical security, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance. Our infrastructure is fully on-premise (no cloud), giving you full control and responsibility over the entire system. You'll join a team of AI engineers committed to staying current with state-of-the-art advancements while delivering reliable, maintainable solutions. You will work closely aligned with AI projects involving legal needs, such as legal RAG, contract management, and compliance monitoring, among other initiatives. This position is based in Granada, candidates must live there or be willing to relocate. Why joining Loomis? Work on cutting-edge AI solutions in a mission-critical, real-world operational context. Fully on-premise infrastructure — privacy-first approach with no cloud dependency. Collaborative, skilled team with support for continuous learning and professional growth. Competitive salary and benefits package per Loomis AB standards. Opportunities for international travel and cross-team collaboration. What you'll do Design, develop, and deploy ML and LLM-driven applications that integrate with Loomis's operational technology. Manage the full model lifecycle using MLflow Model Registry, including version control, artifact lineage, and approval gates before production release. Architect production serving strategies (batch vs. Low-latency real-time) and implement safe rollout patterns such as shadow deployments, canary releases, and rapid rollback mechanisms. Build CI/CD pipelines for ML training, versioning, and automated deployment (GitLab CI, MLflow, DVC). Implement monitoring for model performance, data drift, concept drift, and system health. Work closely with legal initiatives, supporting RAG-based contract management, legal document analysis, and compliance monitoring systems. Work directly with stakeholders across Europe (Spain, Sweden, UK, France, …) and beyond to translate business needs into technical solutions, then own the solution through its entire lifecycle. You're a fit if you have 4+ years building production ML/AI systems (Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Docker/Kubernetes). Hands-on experience with LLM applications (RAG, fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA, evaluation frameworks) and MLOps tooling (MLflow, GitLab CI). C1 English proficiency - language level will be tested. Our team is international, with frequent collaboration across Spain, the UK, France, Germany, and other global locations. A mindset of ownership: you don't just build models, you ship and operate them. Comfortable with occasional travel to client locations (ATMs, CIT vehicles, vaults) where solutions are deployed. Experience using AI in legal projects. *This role is ideal for engineers who've seen AI through its full lifecycle. Not early adopters experimenting with new frameworks, but seasoned practitioners who deliver reliable, maintainable systems in production.*

items.card: You will join a highly technical engineering team working on high-performance infrastructure that enables AI systems to process, analyse and learn from enormous volumes of complex data. Instead of building systems that process market data, trading signals and financial transactions, you will apply similar engineering principles to large-scale AI data pipelines, machine learning infrastructure and robotics datasets.
items.desc: From Quantitative Trading to the Future of AI You've built technology that powers financial markets. Now imagine applying that same engineering expertise to the systems powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. We are looking for exceptional Quant Developers, Trading Systems Engineers and Software Engineers from quantitative trading, hedge funds, proprietary trading firms and market makers who are interested in transitioning into AI. This is an opportunity to take the skills you've developed in demanding trading environments and apply them to complex engineering challenges in AI infrastructure, robotics, autonomous systems and machine learning. Previous AI or machine learning experience is not required. What matters is your engineering ability, problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and experience building sophisticated systems at scale. About the Company You will join a highly technical engineering team working on high-performance infrastructure that enables AI systems to process, analyse and learn from enormous volumes of complex data. Instead of building systems that process market data, trading signals and financial transactions, you will apply similar engineering principles to large-scale AI data pipelines, machine learning infrastructure and robotics datasets. You will tackle challenging technical problems involving distributed systems, performance optimisation, data processing and scalability. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain high-performance, production-grade software systems supporting AI infrastructure. Build scalable distributed systems capable of processing extremely large and complex datasets. Develop efficient data pipelines, APIs and backend services. Optimise system performance, reliability, scalability and resource utilisation. Work with complex data types, including video, 3D environments, LiDAR and machine learning inference outputs. Take ownership of engineering projects from architecture and implementation through to deployment. Collaborate with experienced engineers and researchers solving complex technical challenges. Apply quantitative engineering principles to new problems in AI and emerging technologies. Essential Requirements Strong software engineering experience within quantitative trading, financial markets or similarly demanding technical environments. Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript . Deep technical knowledge of at least one of C++, Rust, Java or Go . Excellent understanding of algorithms, data structures and computer science fundamentals. Experience building scalable backend services or distributed systems. Knowledge of performance optimisation, concurrency, databases and system reliability. Experience owning production systems, including testing, deployment and monitoring. Strong analytical thinking and independent problem-solving abilities. Highly Relevant Backgrounds We are particularly interested in engineers who have worked on: Algorithmic or systematic trading platforms. Market-making or electronic trading systems. High-frequency or low-latency trading infrastructure. Real-time market data processing. Quantitative research infrastructure. Pricing, execution or risk management systems. Large-scale time-series data platforms. High-throughput distributed computing systems. Experience at a hedge fund, proprietary trading firm, market maker, investment bank or technology-driven trading organisation would be particularly relevant. AI Experience Is Not Required We recognise that some of the strongest engineering talent comes from quantitative finance, where performance, precision, scalability and reliability are critical. If you have built sophisticated trading infrastructure and are genuinely interested in transitioning into AI, your technical background could be highly transferable. We are looking for engineers who are curious, technically ambitious and motivated by the opportunity to solve entirely new categories of engineering problems. Why Consider This Opportunity? Move Beyond Financial Markets: Apply your engineering expertise to technologies shaping robotics, autonomous systems and next-generation AI applications. Solve Complex Engineering Challenges: Work on large-scale distributed systems, advanced data infrastructure and demanding performance problems. Work with Exceptional Technical Talent: Collaborate with highly skilled engineers building sophisticated software platforms. Build Technology with Real-World Impact: Contribute to the infrastructure supporting the development of intelligent physical systems. Long-Term Career Growth: Develop expertise in AI infrastructure while building on your existing software engineering foundation. Competitive Compensation: Attractive base salary, meaningful equity and the opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling technology company. Ready to Move from Quant to AI? items.desc: Senior AI/ML Engineer – Audio | Munich Hear what the camera can’t. When an airbag clip clicks into place on an assembly line, the camera can’t see it because the airbag is in the way. You’ll build the system that hears it. Our client is a Munich-based Physical AI startup. Workers at major OEMs wear its smart glasses on the assembly line, and its AI assistant runs on them. Your job is to make audio a live production check: pick out the one click that matters and block out everything else, in real time, at the edge. What you’ll do Build models that detect short, critical sounds (clicks, latches, seating confirmations) on loud factory floors Filter and trim audio on the device before it reaches the model, so responses stay real-time and compute isn’t wasted on noise Hit hard recall and false-positive targets in client acceptance tests Combine audio with vision, IMU and other sensor data Optimise models for constrained edge hardware What you bring Strong PyTorch and production ML experience Hands-on work in sound event detection, acoustic anomaly detection, noise suppression or real-time audio DSP Models deployed on edge or embedded hardware (ONNX, TensorRT, quantisation) Bonus: other sensor data (IMU, sensor fusion), manufacturing or robotics, synthetic data or audio augmentation Why join Your models go onto real assembly lines within weeks. You’ll work as a peer to the Lead ML Engineer, with a direct line to the CTO. Strong equity opportunity.
