items.desc: Paradox Interactive is a premier developer and publisher of strategy and simulation games. Our portfolio includes fan-favorite titles such as Crusader Kings, Europa Universalis, and Stellaris. We create deep, immersive experiences for our players, and we are now building the internal AI capabilities that let our teams work faster and smarter. As an Experienced Data Engineer (AI Platform), you will help run and evolve the internal platform on which Paradox builds, deploys, and governs its AI solutions. You will work in close partnership with our Infrastructure team, and you will be a core owner of the platform that QA, Analytics, Engineering, and the studios rely on every day. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of data engineering, platform engineering, and applied AI. You will maintain and extend the AI development platform, operate the gateway and access layer that sits between our people, our tools, and AI models, and build the data pipelines and services that connect AI systems to company data. We are looking for an experienced data engineer, not an entry-level or mid-level one, who works independently. You will be trusted with real ownership from the start: you define the problem, make sound decisions, ship, and keep production healthy without needing close direction. You will also use AI heavily in your own daily work, as a way to move faster, raise quality, and set the example for the rest of the company. Key Responsibilities AI Platform Ownership Maintain, operate, and extend our internal AI development platform together with the Infrastructure team, including software templates, plugins, service catalog entries, and developer workflows. Administer and maintain the AI gateway and the MCP server access layer: routing, authentication, access policies, rate limits, cost and usage visibility, and onboarding of new models and servers. Develop platform features and integrations in Python and TypeScript, treating the platform as a product with real users and a roadmap. Keep the platform secure, observable, and compliant with Paradox's AI governance requirements. Data Engineering & Pipelines Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes. Ensure reliable data flow between sources (for example Snowflake, APIs, and external platforms) and AI systems. Optimize data models and query performance for AI workloads. AI Systems & Applications Build and maintain AI-driven applications, including agentic systems and LLM-based tools. Develop tool-calling frameworks with structured inputs and outputs and runtime guardrails. items.desc: This is an early-career engineering job where your work ends up in front of the leadership of a global company. You'll build AI tools for Pfizer's Office of the Chief Executive Officer (OCEO), which sets the company's strategy, looks after its communications and global health investments, and runs the CEO's own office. You'll take ideas from a first conversation to something senior colleagues rely on. You'll work directly with the people who had the ideas. Many of them aren't engineers, and you'll often be the one sitting next to them while the idea turns into something real. You'll be building with current AI models and tools from your first week, with a senior engineering lead guiding you, and you'll own solutions yourself as you get more experienced. There are two of these jobs, in a team of five, and you'd report to the Senior Director, AI Innovation and Delivery. It suits someone who likes learning in the open, wants to see what their work actually does, and is as happy helping a colleague build something as building it alone. Role Responsibilities Pair with the people who have ideas Work alongside colleagues who bring an idea in, especially if it's their first time. Help them shape it and test it, be straight about what it will take to make it production-grade, and make sure they know what they own once it's live. Next time, they should need you a bit less. Build and harden Build features, integrations and fixes from the briefs the Product Lead agrees with originators. You'll use AI coding tools, and your work gets reviewed. Some ideas you'll help build from scratch; others start as a prototype that you turn into a production-grade solution. Before writing anything new, check whether it already exists. Test and evaluate Write the tests and evaluation cases that show whether something works. Run them before release and keep them running after. Watch how solutions behave in real use, find where they get things wrong, and turn what you find into fixes or new tests. Help run what we build Take your share of the day-to-day running: keeping an eye on quality and cost, dealing with issues, applying platform updates, keeping releases tidy. If something looks off, flag it early instead of quietly working around it. Learn it, then own it Get to know the solutions the team runs, including work handed over by outside partners, well enough to change them with confidence. As you get more experienced, you'll take ownership of particular ones. Document as you go Keep how-to guides, decision notes and runbooks up to date, and write them so people outside the team can follow them too. It's what keeps a solution working after the people who built it have moved on. Role Behaviours Help people build Leave each person you work with more capable than before. A pairing session went well if they can do more on their own afterwards. Ask early Ask questions and raise problems as soon as they come up, whether it's the code, the data or getting access to it. A question on day one costs far less than a mistake found at release. Reuse first Look for a component, pattern or platform feature that already does the job. Writing something new needs a reason. Test what you ship A change isn't finished until you've shown it works on real examples. Keep that evidence where others can see it. Write it down Note what you built and why, in plain words a colleague outside the team can follow. If you're the only one who can explain it, it's not done yet. items.desc: AI Product Analyst (Fluent in Mandarin & English) Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. As an underwriting company, we assess, assume and manage risk with insight and discipline. We service and pay our claims fairly and promptly. The company is also defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb maintains executive offices in Zurich, New York, London, Paris and other locations, and employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com . Overview This role will be to work as part of the AI Business Solutions group and join our fast-paced, high-energy team responsible for transforming the way Chubb operates globally and deliver meaningful business impact across the value chain. This position offers the opportunity to leverage the entire spectrum of digital capabilities towards solving a wide variety of business problems as well as unique challenges in problem-solving. The focus is on applying a combination of industry-standard practices and innovative ideas to transform the way Chubb operates fundamentally. Required Experience in managing transformation projects in the business with the ability to work with cross functional teams to achieve the goals of the projects Sound understanding of technology, business and operations with hands on experience in delivering projects across the various functions. Strong Insurance domain knowledge with other core insurance functions such as claims, marketing, distribution, legal and operations. Understanding of Insurance sales and distribution for Consumer line of products and any experience in telemarketing domain is desirable. Industry certifications such as ACII, FCII, CIP, CPCU preferred. Master’s/Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Computer Science), Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related discipline. Creative thinker with proven skills in conceptualizing new product features, define product roadmaps, develop business cases and proposals for solutions built on digital technologies. Ability to work with cross functional global and local teams for the various projects across multiple time zones as and when required. Ability to deliver efficient and creative solutions in an incredibly fast paced environment with limited resources and minimal supervision. Builds and maintains effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Have an awareness of suitable KPIS associated with large scale projects . The ability to prioritise and manage workloads within tight timescales and budgetary constraints; An eye for detail, excellent communication skills and be able to interrogate reported information and challenge sources where inconsistencies are found. Knowledge of Property and Casualty Products, Accident and Health Products or Personal Lines Products useful. MUST be fluent in Mandarin and English We offer in return! Competitive salary & pension scheme, discretionary bonus scheme, 25 days annual leave plus ability to purchase 5 additional days, hybrid working options, Private Medical cover, Employee Share Purchase Plan, Life Assurance, Subsidised gym membership, Comprehensive Learning & development offerings, Employee Assistance program. Integrity. client focus. respect. excellence. teamwork Our core values dictate how we live and work. We’re an ethical and honest company that’s wholly committed to its clients. A business that’s engaged in mutual trust and respect for its employees and partners. A place where colleagues perform at the highest levels. And a working environment that’s collaborative and supportive. Diversity & Inclusion. At Chubb, we consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness and respect, regardless of their age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status or family circumstances. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of embedded software for our propulsion systems. You will work closely with hardware, systems, and testing teams to deliver reliable, high-performance software aligned with system requirements and industry standards. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and is eager to learn and contribute in a collaborative engineering environment. Key Responsibilities: Implement, verify and maintain embedded software modules in C/C++ for microcontrollers, based on system requirements and coding standards. Create and maintain software requirements and specifications. Create and maintain Verification and Validation Plans and related documentation. Develop code and setups for unit tests. Establish and maintain source code documentation, including Software Design Documents (SDDs) and user manuals. Support system tests and analyze test data. Maintain configuration control of source code and artifacts. Maintain and support production and testing tools (Python). Troubleshoot software failures and define and implement corrective actions T ype of contract : Full time position with 38.5 hours/week Salary: The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 2.918,34 gross per month on a full-time basis (38.5 h/week), with a planned overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications. Your profile 3-5 years of professional experience in embedded software development, preferably working with microcontroller-based systems. Practical programming experience in C or C++. Understanding of requirements-based software development. Basic understanding of electronics and physics. Experience with version control systems (Git) and familiarity with structured software development workflows. Experience developing real-time embedded applications (RTOS, Bare-Metal). Understanding of basic control systems (PID, rate limiting). Ability to independently investigate technical problems, develop solutions, and take ownership of software features. A proactive, collaborative approach and willingness to learn new technologies Ideal Skills Experience in safety-critical environments (Aerospace/ Automotive or ISO26262). Experience with Zephyr RTOS. Experience with software testing methodologies, including regression testing, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), or software-in-the-loop (SIL). Experience using oscilloscopes, power supplies, and other basic electronics testing equipment. Ability to review electrical schematics. Why us? At ENPULSION, you’ll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark. Our benefits include: 25 days of paid vacation Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining Role-dependent FlexTime and home office options Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events Learning & development budget to support your continued growth Firmenradl - Bike Leasing Program Office located at VIE Airport City with access to: FitFabrik Fitness Center Airport Health Center Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts VIE Community App for news and deals About us Meet ENPULSION - a Space Tech company based in Wien-Flughafen Austria. Founded in 2016, it has quickly become a dominant player in the Space Industry selling some of the most advanced propulsion solutions for SmallSats to a large number of worldwide satellite platform integrators. The unique, modular solution we offer brings high performance at low cost to satellite manufacturers, fostering the democratization of space and enabling the exploration and exploitation of the solar system, positioning ENPULSION at the very heart of the NewSpace Area. The teams behind this are full of talented hardworking people, plenty of whom may just be your new lunch buddy! ENPULSION strongly believes in equal opportunities for everyone. We're encouraging applicants with diverse backgrounds to apply. All applications are processed without regard to gender, nationality, race, colour, religion, age, disability status, sexual orientation or marital status.

items.desc: Job Overview ENPULSION is looking for Electrical Engineers (f/m/x) to join our Engineering team. In this role, you will play a key role in supporting and continuously improving the electronics of our Field Emission Electric Propulsion (FEEP) thrusters, including products already operating in space. You will investigate technical issues and non-conformances, work directly with customers to understand how our products perform in real missions, and contribute to identifying and implementing reliable engineering solutions. Your responsibilities will go beyond supporting existing products. You will use insights from operational experience to improve future hardware generations, maintain and expand our technical documentation, and contribute to the development of new products. You will also work closely with Systems, Software, Quality, Production, and Customer Success teams, to help ensure our products perform reliably throughout their lifecycle. Your profile Key Responsibilities Investigate product non-conformances, technical issues, and in-orbit anomalies, conducting root cause analyses and defining corrective actions. Provide technical support to customers, including troubleshooting, product inquiries, and performance analysis. Develop and maintain technical documentation, specifications, and troubleshooting guidelines. Design, modify, and improve electronic hardware, including analog, digital, power, and high-voltage circuits. Perform circuit calculations, simulations, component selection, schematic development, prototyping, testing, hardware verification and PCB design as required. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve product reliability and contribute to next-generation product development. Contribute to the development of next-generation electronics and new ENPULSION products. Your profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline. At least 3 years of professional experience in electronics development, testing, troubleshooting, or product engineering Experience with high-voltage electronics, DC/DC converters, and precision measurement circuits. Familiarity with failure analysis methodologies, non-conformance management, and corrective and preventive action processes. Knowledge of embedded systems and microcontroller-based electronics. Solid understanding of analog and digital electronics, power electronics, and power distribution systems. Experience with electronic circuit design, schematic analysis, and PCB development. Practical experience investigating electronic hardware failures and identifying root causes. Experience working with electronic products across development, testing, or operational support activities. Knowledge of circuit simulation tools such as LTspice, PSpice, or equivalent. items.desc: About Qevlar AI Qevlar is a B2B SaaS scale-up on a mission to boost the productivity of cybersecurity teams with Artificial Intelligence. We build an AI platform that transitions Security Operations Centers from reactive to proactive units through autonomous security alert investigations. In just three years, we have: Raised a total of $44m in series-A & seed rounds from EQT Ventures, Forgepoint Capital and Partech Deployed our solution with major Enterprises such as Sodexo and GlobalConnect, and leading MSSPs like Orange Cyberdefense Grown to 1,500+ clients across the US and EMEA Ended 2025 with a strong multi-million dollar ARR, and we're targeting $25M by the end of 2027 We're now looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to integrate Qevlar into our customers' security environments and turn their needs into working software. What you'll actually do You'll be the engineer our customers trust. You'll own the technical side of their onboarding: connecting Qevlar to their security stack, building what they need on top of it, and making sure they see value fast. You'll ship code that runs in production at customer sites, and what you learn in the field will shape our product roadmap. Expect demanding customers, escalations under pressure, and locked-down environments where you won't always have prod access (BYOC). If that sounds like fun, read on. Integrate Qevlar into customer environments: security stack, data sources, ticketing and alerting tools. Design and build custom features and integrations tailored to each customer's needs. Act as the trusted technical point of contact for customers: run workshops, gather requirements and turn them into clear technical specs. Troubleshoot and unblock deployments to get customers to value quickly. Bring field insights back to Product and Engineering, and help turn recurring custom work into reusable product features. What we're looking for We're seeking someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, balancing independence with collaboration, and who can bring clarity, focus, and structure. Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, or a track record of shipping production integrations inside customer environments and owning a demanding customer relationship. Strong software engineering skills and production-quality code (for example Python and backend development). Hands-on experience with API and systems integration: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data pipelines. Hands-on experience building with LLM agents: prompts, tool calls, evaluation. Solid cloud and infrastructure fundamentals (for example AWS, GCP or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes). Experience scoping and designing technical solutions from customer requirements. Proven customer-facing experience, and excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences. Ownership and autonomy in a remote setup, and comfort with ambiguity and a fast pace. Nice to have Experience in cybersecurity: SOC, SIEM, SOAR or EDR tools such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel or CrowdStrike. Startup or scale-up experience. Additional European languages, such as French. Why join us Work on meaningful problems with real-world impact in cybersecurity A high-impact role in a small, international, fast-moving team where your contributions directly shape the company and its success Shape the future of a product already making noise in AI + security circles A company culture that values autonomy and creativity Opportunity for equity and early ownership Work remotely, or join your colleagues in our office in Paris' 9th arrondissement whenever you like. If you're excited about helping security teams adopt cutting-edge AI, we'd love to hear from you. Let's build the future of cybersecurity together! items.desc: The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft (www.fraunhofer.com) is one of the world's leading organizations for application-oriented research. 74 institutes develop pioneering technologies for our economy and society – more precisely: 30 000 people from technology, science, administration and IT. They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow. CAREER IN MICROTECHNOLOGY RESEARCH – BIG OPPORTUNITIES WITH SMALL STRUCTURES! CHANGE STARTS WITH US . Do you want to change the world through science? Then the Fraunhofer Institute for Electronic Microsystems and Solid State Technologies EMFT is the perfect place to start your career! With around 190 highly qualified employees at our locations in Munich, Oberpfaffenhofen and Regensburg, we combine many years of experience with extensive expertise in microelectronics and microsystems technology. Our wide range of technologies spans from advanced semiconductor processes and MEMS technologies to innovative 3D integration and flexible electronics. These nano and microtechnologies form the foundation of our diverse fields of expertise, which include sensor technology, circuit design, system solutions with AI, analysis and testing, as well as micropumps. Through the close collaboration of our experts, not only groundbreaking innovations arise, but also synergies that enable Fraunhofer EMFT to effectively tackle the complex challenges of our time. You can look forward to an exciting task in the Circuit Design team located in our Munich office. In our team, we develop integrated RF, analog, and mixed-signal circuits in highly scaled CMOS for intelligent mobile sensor and actuator applications. Be part of change As a trainee in our Mixed-Signal IC Design program, you will participate in a comprehensive introduction to mixed-signal circuit design within a Sensor Front-End ASIC development environment, collaborating on real projects under the guidance of experienced engineers. You will gain hands-on experience in the design, simulation, layout, and verification of mixed-signal integrated circuits – for example data converters, PLLs and frequency synthesizers, bias and supply circuits, or digital calibration and control blocks – with a focus on optimizing performance, power consumption, and area efficiency. You will learn how to master the challenges specific to mixed-signal integration, such analog-digital co-simulation and co-verification and work hand in hand with RF design, layout, and test. What you contribute Master's degree in electrical engineering or related fields such as physics, mathematics or medical engineering, ideally with a focus on microelectronics, RF engineering or communications engineering Team spirit, communication skills, and ability to work independently Ideally you have additional compentencies like: Knowledge of analog and digital circuit design; basic understanding of RF and high-frequency concepts Familiarity with a hardware description language (VHDL or Verilog) and/or scripting (Python, MATLAB, Skill, TCL) Experience with design tools such as Cadence (Virtuoso, Spectre/Spectre RF) or Synopsys is advantageous If you enjoy creative work and the development of new ideas and prefer a structured and team-oriented way of working, then we look forward to receiving your application! What we offer An individually tailored trainee program that combines personal and professional development Insight into innovative technologies and state-of-the-art design methodologies We work with state-of-the-art equipment in a highly innovative key industry. You benefit from a unique network of experts and partners in research and industry. We take your needs seriously: We support the best possible work-life balance through flexible working hours and hybrid working. Your goals and interests are important to us: We support you with a mentoring program . The position is initially limited to 6 months , starting from 01.04.2027 with the aim to extend it subsequently The weekly working time is 39 hours. This position is also available on a part-time basis. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability. Our tasks are diverse and adaptable – for applicants with disabilities, we work together to find solutions that best promote their abilities. Appointment, remuneration and social security benefits based on the public-sector collective wage agreement (TVöD). items.desc: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this." You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute. If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market. Key Responsibilities: Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages. Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces What You’ll Bring: Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for A track record of finishing what others started: …

items.desc: Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available for 18 months. Do you enjoy helping other people put new research software to work? Would you like to help researchers, government agencies and companies use a new foundation model for Earth observation in their own work? The Department of Computer Science and Technology is seeking a Technical Outreach Coordinator to support the growing community of users of Tessera. Tessera is a foundation model for Earth observation developed in the Department's Energy and Environment Group. It processes satellite imagery at 10-metre resolution worldwide, with applications in environmental monitoring, climate science, biodiversity conservation, and land-use analysis. As our Community Outreach Coordinator, you will be the technical link between the Tessera team and its users in universities, government agencies, companies, and start-ups. You will write, test, and publish tutorials, worked examples, technical articles, and blogs showing how to use Tessera embeddings and tools, including the geoTessera Python and R libraries, the Tessera evaluation backend, and the Tessera Embeddings Explorer (TEE). Supporting R users is particularly important, as R is the language used by most ecologists. You will also develop and deliver workshops and training sessions, in person and online, provide first-line technical support to users, and help identify new user communities and opportunities for collaboration. You will work closely with the project's Principal Investigators and research team, and with the project's Communications Officer, who will help publicise the tutorials, workshops, and examples of user research that you produce. This is a varied role, and the role holder may be asked to carry out other duties as appropriate. The ideal candidate will be educated to degree level (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline, such as computer science, environmental science, earth sciences, geography, or data science. You will be proficient in Python and R for data analysis, and will have experience of computational work with scientific or environmental data, of contributing to open-source or research software projects, of writing technical documentation or tutorials, and of delivering training to technical or research audiences. Familiarity with geospatial data and tools, or with machine learning concepts such as embeddings and foundation models, would be an advantage. The Department offers a stimulating work environment with committed academic and research staff and a friendly and supportive professional services team. You will be encouraged and supported to develop your own skills and professional network. This is a part-time (22 hours per week), fixed-term post for 18 months in the first instance, starting in approximately January 2027. Occasional travel, mainly within the UK, may be required to deliver workshops and training at partner organisations and to attend outreach events. Candidates are invited to discuss flexible and hybrid working arrangements, which are supported in the Department. Benefits of working at the University of Cambridge include: Competitive rates of pay with automatic service-related pay progression and annual cost of living increases; Generous maternity, adoption and shared parental leave entitlement and other family friendly schemes (e.g. workplace nurseries); An auto-enrolment pension scheme, with a generous employer contribution; Travel benefits and retail discounts at over 2,000 local and national stores. Informal enquiries about the role are welcomed and should be directed to Professor S. Keshav at sk818@cam.ac.uk. Required documents include a cover letter and a curriculum vitae. If you upload any additional documents, which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. Please quote reference NR51756 on your application and in any correspondence about this vacancy. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society. The University has a responsibility to ensure that all employees are eligible to live and work in the UK. Apply online

items.desc: Vil du bruge din viden inden for data science i FE og være med til at forandre historien og beskytte demokratiet? Hvis du samtidig har evnen og lysten til at navigere i store datamængder, og indgå i et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med kollegaer, som brænder for at løse samfundskritiske opgaver, så har vi brug for dig. FE’s afdeling for data og platforme er ansvarlig for FE’s dataløsninger og satsning på AI. Vi søger nu flere dygtige kollegaer, som både kan kode og forstå de trusler, Danmark står over for. Du får udfordringer og plads til at udvikle dig FE er en arbejdsplads med store ambitioner og muligheder. Tonen er uformel og præget af holdånd, ildsjæle og et åbent sind. I afdelingen har vi et uformelt miljø med familievenlige arbejdsvilkår og gode muligheder for personlig udvikling og læring. Du vil blive data scientist i en afdeling, hvor hovedopgaven er, at FE får maksimal værdi ud af de store og meget forskelligartede data, FE har adgang til. Du får meget dygtige og dedikerede kollegaer, som gerne vil dele ud af deres erfaringer og viden, og du vil opleve stor opmærksomhed og samarbejde fra engagerede analytikere og indhentere i FE. Du skal blandt andet arbejde med at: • Bygge lynhurtige, skræddersyede søgeværktøjer over ustrukturerede data. • Konstruere dynamiske visualiseringer af operative forhold. • Bruge statistiske modeller og AI til at gennemskue skjulte mønstre i data. • Formidle tekniske analyser til områdespecialister. • Samarbejde tæt med ikke-tekniske kollegaer. Du og din baggrund er vigtig Sandsynligvis har du en uddannelse, der har rustet dig til at behandle komplekse datasæt, gerne i kombination med geopolitiske spørgsmål eller med henblik på anvendelse i efterforskninger. Derudover er du analytisk, nysgerrig, kreativ og motiveres af at løse svære problemer. Vi søger kandidater, som drives af entreprenørånd og hurtige proof of concepts på aktuelle kritiske problemer. Det er vigtigt, at du trives med at samarbejde, tage ansvar og løse opgaver selvstændigt. Det er afgørende, at du er holdspiller og god til at udveksle idéer med dine kolleger. Du er kritisk tænkende og ønsker at omsætte dine ideer til gavn for FE. Vi søger både erfarne og nyuddannede kandidater. Det er et plus, hvis du har erfaring med, eller er nysgerrig på følgende: • Python • Big data (Spark, polars) • Grafanalyse • Anvendelse af AI • Statistik og brug af ML-algoritmer Din nye arbejdsplads Du vil blive del af en helt særlig organisation, hvor vi står sammen om, at løse en vigtig opgave. Mange af dine kommende kolleger brænder for at gøre en forskel, og vi har et stærkt fagligt og socialt sammenhold. Da vi ikke kan tale særlig meget om vores arbejde med venner og familie, så skabes der et helt særligt bånd til dine kolleger. Hos os er det ikke så nemt at tage arbejdet med hjem, da vi arbejder med fortrolige oplysninger. Til gengæld tilbyder vi en høj grad af fleksibilitet i planlægningen af din arbejdstid, og når du ikke er på arbejde, har du helt fri. Vi har et stort fokus på det sociale sammenhold, som understøttes af forskellige arrangementer som for eksempel fredagsbar og brætspilscafé. Du skal sikkerhedsgodkendes og har pligt til kortvarig udsendelse til udlandet, hvis behovet opstår. Du kan læse mere om FE på vores hjemmeside www.fe-ddis.dk. Din lønpakke Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår afhænger af dine kvalifikationer og i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og den relevante faglige organisation. Den gennemsnitlige arbejdstid er 37 timer om ugen inklusiv betalt frokostpause. Til stillingen hører en pensionsordning, som FE betaler. Sådan søger du stillingen Send venligst ansøgning, CV, uddannelsesbeviser og øvrig relevant dokumentation via stillingsopslaget, senest den 3. december 2026. Undlad at vedhæfte billede af dig selv på CV og ansøgning. Vi forventer, at de indledende ansættelsessamtaler vil finde sted i uge 51 og stiler mod en ansættelse fra 1. marts 2027. Du er velkommen til at kontakte den lokale HR-partner på 23265@ddis.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller ønsker flere oplysninger. Et ansættelsesforhold i FE behandles med fortrolighed, hvilket du som ansøger skal være opmærksom på i ansøgningsprocessen. Det betyder, at ligesom vi ikke fortæller nogen, at du har søgt en stilling hos os, bedes du også lade være med at dele det med nogen. Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

items.desc: About Redcare Pharmacy: As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today. Job Description About the role: Join our Data Science team and help shape the product recommendation experience at Redcare Pharmacy. You will work at the intersection of product, data, and technology, helping customers discover relevant products across our webshop and app. About the tech stack: Our technology landscape includes Databricks, Python, Spark, Machine Learning, Experimentation & Analytics Frameworks, SQL, MLOps, Git, CI/CD, Azure. About your tasks: Improve product recommendations in our webshop and app, analysing customer behaviour and product data to make recommendation widgets more relevant and useful. Develop and refine recommendation models, engineering relevant features and applying state-of-the-art machine learning approaches. Work on end-to-end Data Science initiatives, partnering closely with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, ML Ops, and domain experts to translate product questions into hypotheses and practical improvements. Design, analyse, and interpret A/B tests to measure the impact of recommendation changes. Define success metrics and guardrails, assess statistical uncertainty, and turn results into clear recommendations for the product team. Contribute across the full project lifecycle, from data exploration and experimentation through to implementation, productionizing, monitoring, and continuous improvement, with support from your colleagues. Qualifications About you: You have practical experience developing machine learning models, including data preparation, feature engineering, modelling, and evaluation. You have strong Python and SQL skills and write clear, structured code that others can work with. You are familiar with Git and practices such as testing and reproducible development. You understand how to develop models for production, including reproducible training, reliable data pipelines, and the trade-offs between model quality, scalability, and maintainability. You have practical expertise in A/B testing and experimental design, including metric selection, statistical power, and interpreting results. You have a solid understanding of recommendation systems and relevant machine learning approaches, such as collaborative filtering, ranking models, or embeddings. You enjoy working iteratively in a cross-functional product team, translating business goals into workable solutions, delivering improvements in manageable steps, and refining models based on experiment results and production performance. Additional Information About your benefits: In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits: Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU. Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings. Vacation: 30 days paid vacation per annum (plus another day on Rosenmontag) and the option to take unpaid vacation of up to 10 days (after one year working with us). Sports: Stay healthy. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, so that you can take advantage of a huge variety of sport offers. Redcare events: We promote teambuilding through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.

items.desc: Jouw baan Gebruik jouw kennis van data science om bij te dragen aan een duurzame leefomgeving. Hoe kunnen we met data science beter begrijpen hoe onze leefomgeving verandert? En hoe dragen we met slimme data science oplossingen bij aan onderzoek naar klimaatverandering, biodiversiteitsverlies en duurzaam landgebruik? Als Junior Data Scientist bij Wageningen University & Research (WUR) werk je aan deze vraagstukken. Je combineert ruimtelijke data, modellen en data science technieken om inzichten te krijgen die bijdragen aan wetenschappelijk onderzoek en praktische oplossingen voor een duurzame toekomst. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende thema’s, zoals klimaatadaptatie, biodiversiteitsmonitoring, bosinventarisatie en ecosysteembeheer. Samen met onderzoekers en technische specialisten analyseer je data, pas je modellen toe en maak je onderzoeksresultaten inzichtelijk. Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen. We zoeken een analytisch sterke starter met een goede technische basis, nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om zich verder te ontwikkelen in het domein van data science in de fysieke leefomgeving. Jouw baan Binnen Applied Spatial Research draag je bij aan data science-toepassingen voor ruimtelijke vraagstukken. Je werkt met grote datasets en helpt onderzoeksteams om data om te zetten in betrouwbare analyses en bruikbare inzichten. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Data verwerken en analyseren. Je bewerkt, controleert en analyseert ruimtelijke datasets en maakt deze geschikt voor onderzoek. Modellen toepassen. Je gebruikt statistische methoden en machine learning om patronen te herkennen, voorspellingen te doen en onderzoeksvragen te beantwoorden. Ruimtelijke analyses uitvoeren. Je werkt met geografische data en draagt bij aan analyses van bijvoorbeeld landgebruik, bossen en ecosystemen. Dataverwerking automatiseren. Je programmeert in Python of R en helpt analyses en datastromen efficiënter en reproduceerbaar te maken. Resultaten visualiseren. Je maakt data en modeluitkomsten inzichtelijk en draagt bij aan heldere presentaties en rapportages. Samenwerken aan onderzoek. Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en draagt bij aan onderzoeksrapporten, presentaties en wetenschappelijke publicaties. Afhankelijk van je ervaring en de projecten waaraan je werkt, krijg je de ruimte om je verder te verdiepen in onderwerpen als GeoAI en geavanceerde ruimtelijke modellering. Jouw team Je komt terecht in Applied Spatial Research, een multidisciplinair team waarin kennis van ruimtelijke data, wetenschap en technologie samenkomt. Je werkt samen met onder anderen AI-onderzoekers, softwareontwikkelaars, cartografen en experts op het gebied van ruimtelijke data en datakwaliteit. Ieder brengt een eigen expertise mee. Juist door die verschillende perspectieven te combineren, ontwikkelen we nieuwe inzichten en toepassingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. We bewegen ons op het snijvlak van beleid, wetenschap en technologie. Onze projecten richten zich op ruimtelijke vraagstukken op lokaal, nationaal en internationaal niveau, met aandacht voor een duurzame en economisch verantwoorde toekomst. Binnen het team krijg je de mogelijkheid om kennis uit te wisselen, van andere disciplines te leren en je technische en inhoudelijke expertise verder te ontwikkelen. Jouw kwaliteiten Je vindt het interessant om met data complexe vraagstukken te ontrafelen. Je werkt nauwkeurig, denkt analytisch en bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technieken. Je kunt zelfstandig aan een analyse werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op wanneer een vraagstuk daarom vraagt. Daarnaast breng je mee: Een afgeronde master (MSc) in Data Science, Geoinformatica, GIS, Remote Sensing, Artificial Intelligence, Informatica, Aardwetenschappen of een vergelijkbare technische of kwantitatieve richting. Programmeervaardigheden in Python, bijvoorbeeld voor data-analyse, statistische berekeningen of het automatiseren van dataverwerking. Basiskennis van data science, statistiek en machine learning, opgedaan tijdens je opleiding, een stage, afstudeerproject of werkervaring. Interesse in ruimtelijke data en geografische analyses. Ervaring met GIS of remote sensing is een pré. Een analytische en nauwkeurige manier van werken, waarbij je kritisch kijkt naar datakwaliteit en de betrouwbaarheid van resultaten. Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels, zodat je jouw werk kunt bespreken, documenteren en presenteren. Een samenwerkingsgerichte houding en de motivatie om nieuwe kennis en technieken te leren. Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel al ervaring te hebben. Heb je bijvoorbeeld een sterke basis in programmeren en machine learning, maar wil je je verder ontwikkelen in GIS en remote sensing? Of heb je een achtergrond in geoinformatica en wil je meer leren over data science en AI? Ook dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren. We kijken naar wat je meebrengt, hoe je problemen aanpakt en welke mogelijkheden je hebt om je …

items.desc: Vill du bygga plattformarna som AI körs på? HiQ växer inom AI och söker dig som kan infrastrukturen! Alla företag kan inte skicka sin kod och sin data till molnet. Vi ser en växande efterfrågan från kunder inom bland annat industri, försvar och energi som vill köra AI i egen miljö, med full kontroll över var informationen finns. För det behövs ingenjörer som kan dimensionera, sätta upp och drifta plattformarna. Vad kan du bidra med? Vi är intresserade av erfarenhet inom exempelvis: Lokal AI: Inferens på egen hårdvara, on-prem och i hybridmiljöer. GPU-infrastruktur: Dimensionering, installation och drift. Modellservering: Öppna modeller, routing mellan modeller och prestandaoptimering. MLOps & drift: Containrar, Kubernetes, övervakning och automatisering. Kostnad & kapacitet: Uppföljning, budgetering och investeringsunderlag. Listan är inte uttömmande. Vi är nyfikna på dig som har arbetat med infrastruktur för AI eller beräkningstunga system. Vem är du? Du har en stark grund i Linux, drift och infrastruktur och har satt upp miljöer där AI-modeller körs. Kanske arbetar du med plattformar, DevOps eller HPC och vill fördjupa dig inom AI. Vi välkomnar både dig som är tidigt i karriären och dig som har lång erfarenhet. Är du senior har du tagit fram investeringsunderlag och kan förklara dina val för en IT-chef. Du behöver inte vara expert på allt. Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet, praktisk erfarenhet och viljan att utvecklas. Varför HiQ? Hos HiQ får du arbeta nära kundernas utvecklingsteam inom industri, försvar, energi och fordon och se plattformen du byggt komma till användning. Du utgår från vårt kontor i Västerås och arbetar oftast hos kund. Du blir en del av en satsning där vi samlar och utvecklar fler kompetenser inom AI, och där alla i teamet bygger, även den som leder uppdraget. Känner du igen dig, även om din profil inte matchar alla delar av annonsen? Tveka inte att söka! Vi är nyfikna på din erfarenhet, dina idéer och vad du vill bygga tillsammans med oss.

items.desc: Join our newly created European Data & Analytics HUB! - we are growing! This strategic initiative was created to enable the change of Volkswagen Financial Services (VWFS) to a data-driven company . Our goal is to empower all VWFS business units to use data effectively, efficiently, and compliantly with their business decisions. D&A originally has been set up as central HQ function located in Germany. To strengthen D&A’s international profile and to cope with the increasing demand for D&A’s services, the European D&A Hub has recently been established in Warsaw, Poland. The teams in both locations work closely aligned to deliver outstanding data products and services for international data use cases at VWFS group. AI & Data Governance & Quality — About: Our major activities in the area of AI & Data Governance & Quality are: Our aim is to help to achieve reliable, high-quality data by defining concepts, standards and processes as well as expert knowledge and providing tools. We enable several business departments to use data from various markets for numerous purposes We define DG and DQ standards and contribute to improving the speed of insights and business decisions We create transparency about the current data quality through DQ problem management and reporting for various stakeholders and support all relevant stakeholders with the exchange of expertise. We enable the company to work compliantly with AI applications, by establishing a group-wide AI Governance framework and supporting with standards. Main Tasks: Supporting operational AI Governance compliance by monitoring and validating data quality in our Enterprise Architecture tool for applications and other artefacts, including checking mandatory governance fields (e.g., AI usage flags) Reviewing and controlling AI risk assessments for software and projects, ensuring completeness and accuracy within internal processes Generating reports and dashboards on governance KPIs (e.g., completeness of AI flags, risk assessment status) and providing insights for management Supporting teams in adhering to governance requirements during the project lifecycle and acting as a point of contact for operational governance queries Automating data consolidation and reporting tasks using basic Python scripting (e.g., fetching data from APIs, processing CSV files) Performing compliance checks and assisting in the implementation of governance processes across business units. Qualifications: Successful graduation in economics, business administration, (business) informatics, (business) mathematics, or a comparable field of study; alternatively, completion of a business or technical apprenticeship with appropriate further training Strong communication skills in discussions with different stakeholders and excellent English and Polish skills, both written and spoken Analytic and agile mindset with an affinity for artificial intelligence, new technologies, data analysis, precise and structured way of working, and solid knowledge of data management Basic Python skills for data extraction, automation, and reporting (experience with APIs and data processing preferred) Knowledge of AI governance principles and regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AIRMF, ISO/IEC 42001) We offer: Employment contract Hybrid work model (3 days a week from the office) and a very good office location (Rondo ONZ 1) Medical package (full specialist package with dentistry) Health Academy Multicafeteria – everyone will find something for themselves ☺ Lunch card Life insurance Employee Pension Program Company products and services at a special price Interesting trainings Study funding Online language classes (English/German).

items.desc: Data plays an important part in most of the Institute’s research outputs and is also used across the organisation to inform decision-making. Following our recent strategy review, we are expanding our data science capacity so that we can increase the range and ambition of the quantitative work we undertake. In this role, you will work across a wide range of subjects and activities, carrying out research into some of the biggest problems facing government as well as helping the Institute make better use of its own data. You will work with research teams to identify useful data sources and analytical approaches, undertake substantive analysis and produce data visualisations. Over the coming years, we expect the Institute to make greater use of alternative types of data such as textual data and to generate new datasets using innovative techniques, and you will play a key role in this. Alongside this research work, you will help the Institute make better use of its operational data. We expect to develop more data dashboards and tools, and you will have the opportunity to contribute to this area of work. The role will also involve exploring new applications of AI and contributing technical expertise to major AI pilots undertaken by the Institute. This could include assessing the feasibility of proposed uses, developing and testing technical approaches, and helping to turn promising ideas into practical tools or ways of working. You will also contribute to the development of organisational standards for data visualisation, analytical code and reproducible analysis, and help colleagues apply them in practice. You will support the development and delivery of training that builds data and AI skills across the Institute. You will encounter a wide range of data sources and technical challenges, with opportunities to learn new approaches and broaden your technical skills. Our current technology stack is as follows: We use Python for data collation, cleaning and analysis We have a research database held in Azure SQL Database We also work extensively with data held in Excel We use GitHub Copilot as a coding agent, with access to a wide range of models, including the latest Claude models We use Git/GitHub for version control We produce most of our charts using Datawrapper We develop internal dashboards and apps using Streamlit The Data Scientist will report to the Institute’s Senior Data Scientist , forming a two-person data science function, which will work closely with teams across the organisation, including the Institute’s economics function. For more information, including job description and person specification, please read the job application pack available on our website. We encourage all applicants to read the job pack before starting their application.

items.desc: Every day, millions of people rely on transport to access the people, places and opportunities that matter most. At Arriva, we're shaping the future of passenger transport and investing in the people who will help lead it. We are one of Europe's leading passenger transport partners, helping people get to work, education, healthcare, family and the moments that matter. Operating across 11 countries, with around 35,000 colleagues and more than 1.5 billion passenger journeys each year, we're a business with the scale to make a difference and the ambition to keep moving forward. The Graduate Opportunity As a Digital & Technology Graduate, you'll gain exposure to the systems, technologies and digital solutions that help keep Arriva moving and support the future of passenger transport. Through rotations across the Digital & Technology function, you'll gain experience in different areas, work with a range of teams and build a broad understanding of how digital and technology support our business, operations and customers. Working alongside colleagues across Arriva, you'll contribute to projects that use digital solutions, technology and data to improve operational performance, customer experience and business decision-making. You'll gain an understanding of how technology works in a real operational environment and how digital solutions can make a difference to both our colleagues and customers. Throughout the programme, you'll develop your technical knowledge, commercial awareness and problem-solving skills, while gaining insight into how digital and technology can support transformation across a large international organisation. You'll also have opportunities to contribute to initiatives focused on innovation, digital transformation, continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making. People who take ownership, build positive relationships and want to make a meaningful contribution from day one. What matters most is your potential. We're looking for people who are eager to learn, motivated to grow and ready to develop their Arriva Graduate EDGE. items.desc: This is JD. Born in 1981. Built for Now. At JD, we don’t just sell sneakers and outdoor gear, we set trends, break boundaries, and build communities. Whether you're on the shop floor, behind the scenes, or driving innovation, every role here plays a part in shaping the future of our industry. We celebrate authenticity, thrive on collaboration, and never stop pushing forward, if you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and personality to a team that values them. This is your moment. This is JD. Are you in? At JD Sports, our Merchandising Data Science team builds the intelligence behind stock, pricing, and assortment decisions across our global store network and digital channels. As a Merchandising Data Scientist, your models won’t sit in a notebook - you will design, enhance, and deploy predictive and prescriptive solutions across demand forecasting, pricing & promotions, assortment planning, and replenishment that directly drive commercial performance at scale. We are looking for a high-initiative builder who spots opportunities in the data without waiting for a spec, challenges assumptions, and turns complex retail problems into scalable production tools. Alongside classical machine learning and optimisation, you will help pioneer modern agentic workflows - building intelligent systems that automate diagnostics, surface actionable insights, and accelerate merchandising decision-making alongside product, application, and engineering teams. Job Title Merchandising Data Scientist Location Bury, Greater Manchester (BL9 8RR) What You'll Be Doing: As a Merchandising Data Scientist, you'll be doing the following: Proactively identify, scope, and deliver high-impact improvements to predictive and prescriptive merchandising models (demand forecasting, pricing & promotions, assortment, allocation, and replenishment) through feature engineering and algorithmic experimentation. Design, prototype, and integrate systems that bridge classical ML models with automated analysis, exception management, and merchandising decision support. Partner with senior and lead data scientists, engineers, and commercial stakeholders to take new merchandising solutions from exploratory discovery and hypothesis testing into reliable production deployment. Take end-to-end ownership of model health in production - building automated evaluation, retraining, and drift-monitoring pipelines that detect anomalies early and protect commercial performance. Translate complex model behaviour, diagnostic metrics, and experimental findings into clear, actionable recommendations and reproducible documentation for both technical teams and merchandising leaders. What We're Looking For: Essential Commercial Data Science experience, building and improving machine learning or forecasting models within Retail Merchandising, Supply Chain, or Inventory Optimisation (e.g., demand forecasting, replenishment, assortment, allocation, or pricing). High initiative and a self-starter mindset - someone who actively investigates root causes, proposes new ideas, surfaces risks early, and drives solutions through to completion without waiting to be asked. Strong software and analytical proficiency in Python, SQL, and the modern data science stack, with a track record of writing clean, tested, reproducible code in shared Git repositories. Hands-on experience evaluating, retraining, and monitoring production-grade models, with the ability to connect statistical metrics directly to commercial KPIs. Strong collaborative communication skills, comfortable partnering with engineers, senior data scientists, and non-technical merchandising stakeholders in an agile delivery environment. Desirable Experience working with agentic AI workflows, tool-calling LLM agents, or automated analytical/decision-support pipelines. Production experience on cloud data & ML platforms (especially GCP / BigQuery / Vertex AI) and familiarity with CI/CD and MLOps workflows. Direct experience with retail merchandising processes and time-series forecasting with high SKU/store quantities. We know our colleagues work tirelessly to make JD Sports the success it is today and in turn, we offer them some amazing benefits including staff Discount On JD Group and other brands within the organisation and personal development opportunities to learn and develop at work. Thank you for your time #JD

Klaaryo nasce per risolvere proprio questo! items.desc: Wil jij als data scientist werken aan datagedreven oplossingen binnen grote Nederlandse corporates waar data een sleutelrol speelt in besluitvorming? Via Solid Professionals ga je aan de slag op een inhoudelijke opdracht bij organisaties zoals Rabobank, KPN en Eneco. Je werkt aan analyses en modellen die direct bijdragen aan betere inzichten, processen en keuzes binnen de organisatie. Wat je gaat doen Als data scientist werk je in multidisciplinaire teams aan het analyseren, modelleren en toepassen van data. Je onderzoekt complexe datasets, ontwikkelt voorspellende of verklarende modellen en vertaalt uitkomsten naar bruikbare inzichten voor de business. Afhankelijk van je ervaring neem je eigenaarschap over modelkeuzes, validatie en implementatie en fungeer je als sparringpartner voor stakeholders uit business, IT en data. De exacte invulling verschilt per opdracht, maar de kern blijft hetzelfde: data omzetten in betrouwbare en toepasbare inzichten. Wat jij meebrengt een afgeronde wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde, Artificial Intelligence of een vergelijkbare richting minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een data science- of analyticsrol ervaring met het analyseren en modelleren van datasets goede kennis van Python en SQL ervaring met statistische modellen, machine learning of voorspellende analyses ervaring met werken in Agile omgevingen is een pré je kunt analyses en inzichten helder uitleggen aan niet-technische stakeholders je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands je woont in Nederland en bent fulltime beschikbaar Wat je krijgt Via Solid Professionals werk je op één inhoudelijke opdracht bij één opdrachtgever. Je komt bij ons in dienst voor de duur van die opdracht. Dit geeft je focus en duidelijkheid, met één opdracht tegelijk en een contract dat aansluit op de duur van de opdracht. Soms is dit een tijdelijke opdracht, soms met de intentie om na afloop in dienst te treden bij de opdrachtgever via een deta vast constructie. Bij opdrachten met deta vast intentie volg je het Impact Programma. Vi söker en junior konsult till vårt team AI & Collaboration som vill hjälpa människor och organisationer att utveckla sin förmåga att arbeta med AI, Microsoft Copilot och agenter. För oss handlar det inte bara om att lära ut funktioner eller visa var man ska klicka. Vi vill hjälpa våra kunder att förstå hur AI kan förändra sättet vi arbetar på, vilka möjligheter det skapar och hur tekniken kan användas på ett tryggt, ansvarsfullt och värdeskapande sätt. Hos Exobe får du arbeta mitt i utvecklingen inom AI och digitala arbetssätt, tillsammans med kollegor som vill göra ny teknik begriplig, relevant och användbar. Om rollen En stor del av din roll blir att arbeta med Copilot Onboarding by Exobe , vår tjänst för att hjälpa organisationer och deras medarbetare att utveckla sin AI-kompetens och få nytta av Copilot och agenter i sitt arbete. Du kommer successivt att få ansvar för både innehållet och upplevelsen i vår onboarding . Du kommer att utforma och hålla digitala utbildnings- och inspirationssessioner för våra kunders medarbetare och vara med och utveckla innehållet i takt med AI-utvecklingen. Målet är inte bara att lära människor hur en funktion fungerar . Vi vill hjälpa dem att utveckla nya arbetssätt och förmågan att själva upptäcka var AI kan skapa värde i deras arbetsvardag . I rollen kommer du bland annat att: utforma och hålla utbildnings- och inspirationssessioner för våra kunders medarbetare hjälpa användare att utveckla sin AI-kompetens och hitta nya sätt att arbeta med AI omsätta möjligheter inom Copilot och agenter till konkreta och relevanta arbetssätt och scenarier skapa demos som visar hur AI kan användas i arbetsvardagen skapa presentationer, utbildningsmaterial och annat visuellt innehåll producera korta filmer, guider, frågor och svar och annat innehåll till vår onboardingportal använda AI-verktyg för att skapa, visualisera och utveckla innehåll hålla dig uppdaterad inom AI, Copilot och agenter och omsätta utvecklingen till sådant våra kunder behöver förstå och kunna använda utveckla våra utbildningssessioner och vårt innehåll utifrån nya funktioner, kundfeedback och förändrade behov delta i andra utbildningar, inspirationsinsatser och workshops hos våra kunder tillsammans med kollegor. En central del av jobbet är alltså inte bara vad vi lär ut, utan hur vi gör det . Hur skapar man en demo som får någon att tänka ”det där vill jag testa” ? Hur hjälper man någon att gå från några enstaka prompts till att faktiskt arbeta på nya sätt? Och hur gör man AI begripligt och relevant för någon som inte är lika teknikintresserad som vi? Det är sådant vi hoppas att du kommer att tycka är roligt att fundera på och utveckla tillsammans med oss. Vem är du? Vi tror att du är i början av din karriär och framför allt drivs av en vilja att lära dig, skapa och förmedla . Du tycker om människor och känner dig bekväm med att prata inför grupper. Du behöver inte vara en färdig utbildare från dag ett, men du tycker om att presentera och vill utvecklas i att fånga och engagera en publik. Samtidigt har du ett öga för hur saker presenteras. Du kanske är den som gärna lägger lite extra tid på presentationen, testar ett nytt AI-verktyg för att skapa en film eller visualisering eller funderar ett varv till på hur ett komplicerat budskap kan göras enkelt och relevant. Framför allt är du nyfiken på AI och hur den påverkar vårt sätt att arbeta . Du behöver inte vara utvecklare eller teknisk specialist. Däremot vill du förstå vad tekniken kan göra, gillar att själv testa nya verktyg och är intresserad av vad som händer när AI blir en allt naturligare del av människors arbetsvardag. Vi tror att du är pedagogisk och kommunikativ och tycker om att inspirera andra är nyfiken och gillar att lära dig nya saker tar initiativ och tycker om att testa dig fram är bekväm med, eller vill utvecklas inom, att presentera och hålla utbildningar för grupper har känsla för visuell kommunikation och hur innehåll kan paketeras för olika målgrupper är nyfiken på AI-verktyg och gärna testar hur de kan användas för exempelvis bild, video, presentationer, demos och innehåll är intresserad av både tekniken och människan och hur nya verktyg kan förändra vårt sätt att arbeta talar flytande svenska och professionell engelska – många av våra utbildningssessioner hålls på engelska. Din utbildningsbakgrund kan exempelvis vara inom kommunikation, media, pedagogik, marknadsföring, HR, beteendevetenskap, IT, digital design eller liknande . items.desc: Bouw mee aan het AI-platform achter de oplossingen van morgen AI krijgt een steeds grotere rol binnen Bank Van Breda. Daarom bouwen we aan een centraal en modulair AI-platform dat modellen, agents, kennis, data, integraties en governance samenbrengt in één betrouwbaar fundament. Als AI Engineer werk je mee aan dit platform en ons AI Engineering Framework. Je experimenteert met nieuwe technologie, zet ideeën snel om in werkende pilots en maakt succesvolle oplossingen robuust, veilig en herbruikbaar. Zo help je andere teams om sneller en betrouwbaarder AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen. Wat wordt jouw uitdaging? Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare AI-capabilities en platformdiensten rond modellen, agents, kennis, evaluatie en monitoring. Je bouwt ons AI Engineering Framework verder uit met onder meer agents, skills, templates, testing en CI/CD. Je zet nieuwe AI-concepten om in werkende pilots en maakt succesvolle oplossingen veilig, schaalbaar en herbruikbaar. Je integreert het AI-platform met Microsoft Azure, API’s, databronnen en bedrijfsapplicaties, met aandacht voor security, privacy en governance. Je experimenteert met nieuwe AI-technologieën, ondersteunt andere engineers en helpt zo onze developer experience continu verbeteren. Wat mag je van ons verwachten? Je krijgt een hands-on sleutelrol in de uitbouw van ons centrale AI-platform. Je krijgt ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te verkennen, ermee te experimenteren én ze daadwerkelijk in te zetten. Je werkt daarbij niet aan één specifieke AI-use case, maar bouwt mee aan een platform waarmee verschillende teams betrouwbare AI-oplossingen kunnen ontwikkelen en inzetten. Niet zomaar een bank. Wel jouw ideale werkplek. Bij Bank Van Breda ervaar je geen doorsnee bedrijfscultuur. Warm, bruisend en met een grote mate van collegialiteit en initiatief. In onze moderne en creatieve werkomgeving neem je als medewerker veel verantwoordelijkheid op. Autonoom werken wordt gestimuleerd, met coaching om jouw groei te ondersteunen. Flexibel werken, leuke après-werk activiteiten, en het vieren van successen maken deel uit van onze bedrijfscultuur. We waarderen jou Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen wij onze missie waarmaken. Daarom bieden we een gepaste verloning aan: Een aantrekkelijk salaris aangevuld met maaltijdcheques, fietsvergoeding en een ruim aantal vakantiedagen. Een bedrijfswagen met tankkaart of wettelijk mobiliteitsbudget. Een flexibel Flexplan waarmee je je 13de maand onder meer kan inzetten voor bikelease, pensioensparen, internet en IT-materiaal. De nieuwste iPhone met abonnement en uitgebreide hospitalisatie-, invaliditeits- en groepsverzekering vanaf je eerste werkdag. Tot 50% thuiswerk, ruime glijtijden en veel autonomie. Deel mee in ons succes via ons winstdeelnameplan en de collectieve bonus gekoppeld aan de NPS-doelstellingen. Volop ruimte om te groeien via coaching en interne en externe opleidingen. Wist je trouwens dat Bank Van Breda in 2026 opnieuw tot de beste werkgevers van het land behoort volgens Great Place To Work, met een mooie 2de plaats? Van kop tot teen. Of het scheelt niet veel. Je hebt een masterdiploma Burgerlijk Ingenieur, Informatica, Industriële Wetenschappen, Handelsingenieur of een vergelijkbare technische richting, of behaalt dit binnenkort. Je hebt een sterke basis in software engineering en affiniteit met generatieve AI, LLM's, agents en AI-platformtechnologie. Je bouwt graag zelf en hebt ervaring met .NET en/of Python, API's, cloudplatformen, containers en CI/CD. Kennis van Microsoft Azure is een sterke troef. Je begrijpt hoe identity, data-integratie, observability en schaalbaarheid samenkomen in een betrouwbaar platform. Je kan snel een prototype realiseren én weet wanneer het tijd is voor standaardisatie, hergebruik en productiebeheer. Je werkt graag samen, deelt kennis en hebt aandacht voor security, privacy, compliance en risicobeheer. Een dosis humor maakt jou compleet. Vink je niet het volledige lijstje af, maar voel je toch een onweerstaanbare kriebel om ons te contacteren? Doen! Want jij verdient meer in je job. Voor functies die vallen onder de regelgeving rond de bankierseed (wet van 22 april 2019), zal in het kader van het selectieproces gevraagd worden om een attest van de FSMA voor te leggen waaruit blijkt dat er geen beroepsverbod van toepassing is. Bank Van Breda en haar medewerkers gaan zorgvuldig om met vertrouwelijke informatie, op een correcte en ethische manier. We koesteren diversiteit en verwelkomen mensen met verschillende achtergronden, ongeacht gender, functiebeperking, afkomst, levensbeschouwing, seksuele oriëntatie of leeftijd.

items.desc: Today, more than 6 million store replenishment decisions are made daily in BESTSELLER. We're developing a new approach to replenishment, combining probabilistic demand forecasting with an economic decision engine to optimise daily orders. Optimising under uncertainty, with sparse data and tight daily deadlines, is no simple task. We're looking for an experienced Data Scientist to help us build the decision engine and turn complex optimisation challenges into practical solutions. YOUR TEAM You'll join AI Fashion Replenishment, part of AI Fashion Solutions at BESTSELLER TECH. AI Fashion Solutions is a flat organisation with no team leads. Teams make their own decisions, and we work by the principle of "you build it, you run it". You'll collaborate closely with data scientists specialising in demand forecasting and subject matter experts from our brands. AI-assisted development is an important part of how we work. We use coding agents to accelerate development, while keeping people responsible for mathematical modelling, algorithm design and solution quality. YOUR ROLE As our Data Scientist, you'll develop optimisation solutions that translate demand forecasts and stock levels into daily replenishment decisions. You'll play a central role in shaping the mathematical models and technical approaches behind our decision engine. More specifically, your responsibilities include: Developing and implementing optimisation models that turn demand forecasts and stock levels into replenishment decisions Defining Operations Research standards, including modelling approaches, solver selection, validation and benchmarking Collaborating with forecasting data scientists to develop reliable and scalable end-to-end solutions Taking solutions from proof of concept to production, including testing, monitoring and continuous improvements Using AI coding agents to accelerate development while ensuring the quality and reliability of the solutions YOUR PROFILE We're looking for an experienced Data Scientist or Operations Research specialist who enjoys solving complex mathematical problems and turning models into practical solutions. We imagine that you: Have at least three years of experience developing and deploying Operations Research solutions in production, ideally within supply chain optimization Have solid experience with optimisation under uncertainty, including stochastic, robust or chance-constrained approaches Have hands-on experience with mixed-integer programming and solvers such as Gurobi, HiGHS or Pyomo Are proficient in Python and familiar with production data pipelines, monitoring and CI/CD Can set technical standards, evaluate different modelling approaches and share your expertise with others Have experience using AI coding agents or are motivated to integrate them into your daily work Experience with retail replenishment, sparse data or technologies such as Spark, Databricks, Azure and Snowflake would be an advantage. WE ARE LOOKING FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU If you use AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude or Cursor, we'd be interested in seeing how you integrate them into your development process. You can use our Show Your Work Skill to create an artifact demonstrating your approach and include it with your application. Please upload your CV as soon as possible and no later than 16 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting once we have found the right match. If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Scrum Master & People Lead, Ivana Stavrovska at +45 92 25 20 84. About Bestseller Tech We are more than 400 people strong, located in Denmark, Spain and Rwanda. We are excited about what we do, but there’s more to us than our tech stack. We are young at heart and thrive in a flat organization. Our teams are agile and empowered with end-to-end responsibility. We want to be at the forefront of the newest technologies, and we move forward together. Every day. If you want to play a significant part in empowering our business, then welcome to BESTSELLER TECH. BESTSELLER TECH is part of the worldwide fashion company BESTSELLER. For more information, please go to www.bestseller.com.

Working closely with AI researchers, engineers, customers, and end users, you bridge domain needs and AI capabilities.
