Identify and engage relevant stakeholders and uncover underlying needs through interviews, workshops, observations, and co-creation. Collaborate with researchers, engineers, customers, end users, and colleagues or external partners with expertise in the relevant application domain to identify and prioritize AI opportunities based on potential value, technical feasibility, and fit with imec’s research capabilities. Contribute to AI opportunity discovery in technology-intensive domains such as digital twins, AI for semiconductor manufacturing, AI for chip applications, and HW/SW co-design. Facilitate opportunity discovery, ideation, Voice of the Customer, and concept validation workshops and synthesize technical and application insights to support decision-making. Structure and formalize AI use cases by defining clear requirements, specifications, constraints, data needs, relevant AI capabilities, and success criteria. Explore possible AI approaches together with technical experts and help translate these into a clear scope and direction for AI-driven R&D and prototype development. Within AI and innovation projects, work with researchers and developers to validate outcomes against the agreed requirements and success criteria at key milestones and project completion. Drive the execution of AI and innovation projects by aligning objectives, timelines, resources, risks, and dependencies, ensuring progress from concept validation to implementation. Across these activities, you will: Stay up to date with developments in AI and emerging technologies and assess their relevance for new applications and innovation opportunities. Act as a translator between AI experts and application domains, creating a shared understanding between research, engineering, and stakeholders and ensuring that promising AI technology is connected to relevant real-world challenges. We work with research teams and application domains to identify where AI can make a meaningful difference and turn those opportunities into well-defined use cases that can guide research and development. Use case validation: Following R&D trajectories and evaluating whether results address the original requirements and intended value. By combining AI understanding, domain knowledge, and strong translation skills, the team helps turn imec’s AI capabilities into impactful applications across semiconductor technology, industry, consumer electronics, automotive, and other domains. items.desc: Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset, which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors. As a Software Engineer, you will focus on turning research outputs into robust, scalable, and well-operated production systems. You will directly contribute to our engineering platform and automation efforts that accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and raise the quality bar across the ML and research lifecycle. Your future role within QRT: Collaborate closely with Research and Machine Learning engineers to transition prototypes into production-grade services, jobs, and pipelines. Design, implement, maintain and support end-to-end research-to-production workflows (data/feature pipelines, training/inference jobs, batch processes, internal tooling). Build and improve automation around packaging, configuration, and environment reproducibility. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enforce code quality, testing, security checks, and smooth deployments. Contribute to deployment and runtime operations (containers, orchestration, infrastructure integration), ensuring reliability, performance, and maintainability. Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (logs/metrics/traces) for production workloads; define operational runbooks and on-call support procedures when needed. Troubleshoot and resolve integration and production issues, ensuring optimal performance, robustness, and reliability. Create and maintain detailed documentation of system architecture, deployment processes, configurations, and support procedures. Stay updated with the latest technologies and best practices in software development, DevOps, and production operations. Your present skill set: Proficiency in Python and strong knowledge of software engineering best practices (testing, code review, design, maintainability). Strong experience in software development, system integration, and automation. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP) and their integration services. Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and security principles. Experience with DevOps practices and tools (CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes). Solid understanding of production operations: monitoring/alerting, incident troubleshooting, performance tuning, and reliability practices. Knowledge of data management and database systems. Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset. Strong written and oral communication (English and French), able to explain complex issues to non-technical users. Independent and collaborative team worker. Passionate about technology and its potential to transform industries and user experiences. Enjoys working in a collaborative environment and building relationships with team members. Organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality solutions. Flexible and adaptable, able to handle the dynamic nature of project requirements and timelines. QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees to achieve a healthy work-life balance.

items.desc: Backend Software Engineer / Developer (Python Machine Learning AWS) Remote UK to £90k Are you a data savvy Backend Software Engineer with experience of implementing ML algorithms into production? You could be progressing your career in a senior, hands-on Backend Software Engineer role as part of a friendly and supportive international team at a growing and hugely successful European car insurance tech company as they expand their UK presence. As a Backend Software Engineer you'll join a cross functional team, collaborating with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers on complex insurance underwriting and pricing systems. They'll be a range of projects with a focus on implementing Machine Learning algorithms into production systems. There's a collaborative team Agile environment where you'll participate in technical discussions and have your voice heard, there's also opportunities to mentor other more junior team members if desired. Location / WFH: The company is a big advocate of flexible working and prides itself on DEI; you can go into the London office as often or as little as desired and can work fully remotely from anywhere in England; you can also work at times that suit you. About you: You are a data savvy Backend Software Engineer with advanced Python coding skills You have experience of across the full lifecycle of ML model development including into production You're collaborative, enjoy problem solving and working with others to overcome technical challenges You have a strong knowledge of AWS You have a good knowledge of modern software engineering best practices, microservices, TDD / DDD, common Design Patterns Experience with Databricks, PostgreSQL, Amazon RedShift or MLflow would be great but not essential What's in it for you: As a Backend Software Engineer / Developer (Machine Learning AWS) you will earn a competitive package: Up to £90k salary Remote working including flexible working hours Workplace nursery scheme Enhanced maternity package 25 days holiday plus ability to buy or sell 5 days p/year + extra "duvet day" Pension, Private Medical and Dental Insurance, Life Assurance, Employee Assistance Programme Weekly Yoga and monthly Acupuncture sessions, Headspace membership Diverse, inclusive team environment with a range of support networks A range of other perks including Perkbox, cycle to work, season ticket loan Apply now to find out more about this Backend Software Engineer / Developer (Python Machine Learning AWS) opportunity.

items.card: Your tasks Build and deploy knowledge-grounded AI systems end-to-end: data ingestion, chunking, embedding pipelines, retrieval logic, re-ranking, and response generation Develop agentic applications — tool integrations, planning loops, memory management, guardrails — using frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent Implement and maintain ML pipelines for classical use cases: prediction,
items.desc: We need engineers who build AI systems that work outside of a Jupyter notebook. You’ll take architectures designed for real problems and turn them into production services — reliable, observable, and cost-efficient. Your day-to-day will involve writing Python, wiring up cloud infrastructure, and solving the unglamorous problems that make AI actually useful: data quality, latency, evaluation, and deployment. You’ll work across the generative and classical AI stack — building knowledge-grounded AI systems, integrating LLMs into applications, training and deploying traditional ML models, and keeping it all running in production on Azure, AWS, or GCP. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance, through agentic systems in manufacturing environments, to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Build and deploy knowledge-grounded AI systems end-to-end: data ingestion, chunking, embedding pipelines, retrieval logic, re-ranking, and response generation Develop agentic applications — tool integrations, planning loops, memory management, guardrails — using frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent Implement and maintain ML pipelines for classical use cases: prediction, classification, recommendation, and optimization models Deploy and optimize model serving infrastructure: API endpoints, batching, caching, GPU utilization, and cost management across cloud environments Write clean, tested, production-grade Python — not prototype code that someone else has to rewrite Build evaluation and monitoring pipelines: automated quality checks, drift detection, latency tracking, and human-in-the-loop feedback loops Work with cloud-native AI services on at least one major platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) to implement scalable solutions Collaborate with AI Architects on technical design and with data engineers on data availability and quality Requirements At least 4 years in ML engineering, with hands-on experience shipping AI/ML systems to production Strong Python skills — not just scripting, but writing maintainable, tested code for production services Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and its AI/ML services Experience with vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval systems in real-world applications Familiarity with MLOps fundamentals: model versioning, experiment tracking, CI/CD for ML, and monitoring Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with architects, data engineers, and product teams Fluency in Polish and English (both written and spoken) Residing in Poland required Nice to have Experience fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA) or working with infrastructure-as-code Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or published technical writing Job no. We are committed to equal and fair treatment of all, regardless of legally protected characteristics. items.desc: En AMS SOLUTIONS buscamos un/a Data & AI Product Engineer para incorporarse a un equipo estable de tecnología y datos que da servicio de forma transversal a distintos equipos y aplicaciones dentro de una gran organización. Buscamos personas con una visión integral del desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas alrededor del dato, capaces de abordar el ciclo de vida completo de un producto: desde la captura, modelado y transformación de la información hasta el desarrollo de servicios, aplicaciones y soluciones basadas en inteligencia artificial. Participarás en el diseño, desarrollo y evolución de soluciones end-to-end, combinando ingeniería de datos, desarrollo backend y frontend, arquitecturas orientadas a eventos e inteligencia artificial generativa y agéntica. Entrarás en un equipo donde se comparten estándares, conocimiento y criterios de ingeniería, con un enfoque cada vez más orientado a la construcción de productos inteligentes y soluciones basadas en datos e IA. Tus funciones principales: Diseñar, desarrollar y evolucionar soluciones y productos tecnológicos basados en datos, abordando su ciclo de vida completo. Diseñar y construir pipelines, procesos de ingesta, transformación y explotación de datos. Diseñar e implementar modelos de datos analíticos, incluyendo modelado dimensional (hechos y dimensiones). Desarrollar servicios backend, APIs e interfaces frontend para construir soluciones completas alrededor del dato. Diseñar e implementar arquitecturas orientadas a eventos y soluciones de procesamiento en tiempo real. Desarrollar soluciones basadas en datos e inteligencia artificial: agentes conversacionales y autónomos, flujos con modelos de lenguaje (LLM) e integración de servidores MCP. Integrar modelos, agentes y herramientas con plataformas de datos y aplicaciones corporativas. Asumir la responsabilidad técnica de las soluciones desarrolladas, desde su concepción hasta su despliegue, operación y evolución en producción. Velar por la calidad, fiabilidad, seguridad y trazabilidad de las soluciones, aplicando buenas prácticas de ingeniería. Optimizar continuamente las soluciones existentes para mejorar su rendimiento, escalabilidad y mantenibilidad. Compartir conocimiento y colaborar con perfiles técnicos y de negocio. ¿Qué buscamos?: Experiencia de al menos 3 años en desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas, productos digitales o plataformas basadas en datos. Dominio de Python y experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones y servicios. Experiencia en desarrollo backend y conocimientos de frontend. Experiencia trabajando con plataformas cloud, preferiblemente Azure. Experiencia con Databricks y/o Snowflake. Conocimientos de modelado de datos, especialmente modelado dimensional (tablas de hechos y dimensiones). Experiencia con Kafka y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos. Manejo de GitHub y control de versiones. Experiencia llevando soluciones a producción, incluyendo despliegue, monitorización y mantenimiento. Si has llegado hasta aquí, lo siguiente es para ti : Contrato indefinido desde el primer momento. Queremos que, si vienes a trabajar con nosotros, sea para que te quedes, ya que nuestros proyectos son a largo plazo, por lo que necesitamos gente comprometida (y, sobre todo, contenta y motivada). Banda salarial en base a la experiencia. Se comentará antes de la primera entrevista. Opción de teletrabajo 100%: Para nosotr@s, el espacio de trabajo no es factor determinante. Puedes trabajar desde casa o venir a nuestras oficinas en el centro de A Coruña. Conciliación: entendemos la importancia de compaginar tu vida laboral, con la familiar y/o personal. Retribución flexible (seguro médico, ticket restaurante, transporte y guardería). ¿Cómo será el proceso de selección? Nos pondremos en contacto desde el área de Talent para hablar de tus preferencias, aspiraciones y tu experiencia en el sector. Realizarás una pequeña prueba técnica en donde podrás lucir tus habilidades y competencias en el área. Coordinaríamos una entrevista con personas involucradas en el proyecto para ofrecerte un mayor conocimiento sobre el mismo. Cuando te incorpores, tendrás un onboarding diseñado a tu medida, con encuentro de bienvenida y plan de seguimiento en tus primeros meses. Si te has sentido identificad@ con todo lo anterior y te encaja lo que has leído, ¿hablamos?

items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.



ABOUT THE TEAM



Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 



ABOUT THE ROLE:


As a Data Scientist II at Faculty, you will lead the design of end-to-end analytical approaches, developing high-quality models that solve complex, multi-faceted business problems. Joining our Applied AI division, you will leverage advanced programming to turn high-level client needs into rigorous mathematical frameworks. 

This role is for an ambitious practitioner ready to own the delivery of robust, scalable model components while ensuring every solution is mathematically sound and ethically responsible. You will play a vital part in pushing our technical boundaries and mentoring others.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:


 - Designing and implementing core data science approaches for project workstreams, including the selection of optimal algorithms and validation strategies.

 - Combining deep domain expertise with advanced machine learning techniques to solve unique and complex business challenges.

 - Owning the end-to-end delivery of specific model components, ensuring they are scalable, robust, and mathematically precise.

 - Developing innovative algorithms or adapting existing frameworks to meet bespoke client requirements and technical constraints.

 - Building the software architecture required to wrap models and agentic workflows into production-grade, reliable environments.

 - Supporting Level 1 Data Scientists by providing technical guidance and conducting rigorous peer reviews on modeling tasks.

 - Managing personal delivery timelines while proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks or data limitations within projects.

 
 


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:


 - You possess expertise in statistical modeling and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, to implement complex paradigms.

 - You are disciplined in extracting valid insights from messy or incomplete datasets, ensuring solutions remain robust under uncertainty.

 - You have the ability to translate high-level, ambiguous client needs into actionable data science requirements and mathematical frameworks.

 - You promote a culture of shared best practices, ensuring all AI development is transparent, ethical, and held to high peer-reviewed standards.

 - You are a clear communicator who can manage technical discussions with customers and articulate project feasibility and delivery timelines.

 - You are highly proficient in advanced Python and harness frameworks, capable of building the architectures necessary for production-grade AI.




OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 

 1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

 2. Take Home Technical Assessment

 3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

 4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)










OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for …

Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
 The Excellerate track is designed to develop future leaders who are motivated by performance, pace, and commercial impact. You’ll rotate across Sales, Commercial Management, Strategy, Supply, Finance and more. Working on priorities that directly influence results and learning how different parts of the business connect to create value. 
 This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. 
 Our Product Engineering Unit CCI (RAN Compute & Cloud Infrastructure) is one of the main R&D units within Ericsson's Radio Access Network domain, accountable for Ericsson products including Baseband, Street Macro and Site solutions, across both SW and HW over the full lifecycle. At R&D Center Poland we develop SW system and design solutions for baseband, interconnect, security and site products, addressing telecommunication business needs from around the globe by delivering innovative software (e.g. 5G/6G functionalities) meeting the highest telecom industry quality standards. 
This is not a temporary project - you join Ericsson R&D Center Poland as a permanent member of the team. The 18-month program is how you start your long-term career with us, not how it ends. 
Rotation 1 (0-6 months) - Feature delivery 
 Learn how our products are built and delivered. As an active, contributing member of one cross-functional team you will develop, test and troubleshoot software with clear ownership of your work. By the end you understand the end-to-end feature flow and what quality ownership really means, and you deliver at least one practical AI-enabled improvement. 
Rotation 2 (6-12 months) - International rotation: system and product perspective 
 Build a broader system perspective and an international network. Through an international assignment in a system-oriented area you will work on a technical study or impact analysis, collaborate across organizations and learn how technical decisions are made beyond a single team - bringing reusable insights and contacts back to your home unit, where you continue to build your career. 
Rotation 3 (12-18 months) - Broader technical influence 
Translate your delivery experience and system insight into wider technical impact. Under a senior-technical umbrella you will drive a cross-functional technical improvement, connecting feature, system, product-care and management perspectives, and prepare for your next step in your long-term technical career within CCI. 
Beyond the 18 months 
The program is the beginning, not the finish line. You stay in your home unit as a permanent employee and continue to grow there, with a clear path towards broader technical roles. The product knowledge, international network and ownership experience you build during the rotations become the foundation for your long-term career at Ericsson. 
What you will do 
 Design, develop, test, troubleshoot and verify software within a cross-functional product team
 Take end-to-end ownership of your work, from analysis through implementation to verification
 Investigate technical issues, drive root cause analysis and turn findings into concrete software improvements
 Build deep understanding of product architecture, system behavior and software engineering practices in a complex telecom environment
 Use AI-assisted engineering tools in daily work - for code analysis, debugging, test creation and documentation
 Participate actively in code reviews, design discussions and continuous quality improvement
 Collaborate with experienced developers, system experts and teams across multiple domains and sites
 Deliver improvements with measurable impact on product quality, reliability and maintainability
 Share knowledge and contribute to engineering best practices

 Good knowledge of computer networking - TCP/IP, networking protocols and data communication concepts

items.desc:
Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro 
 ¡Te estamos buscando! Nuestra apuesta es por el talento joven y por eso queremos que formes parte de Talentum. Un programa de impulso al talento joven de Telefónica, que ofrece oportunidades a través de su extensa oferta de becas, formación y retos en equipo. 
 ¿Quieres aprender de Inteligencia artificial y Ciberseguridad? Buscamos perfiles de becario para el proyecto estratégico de Telefónica de transformación de su negocio de ciberseguridad, uno de los espacios más expuestos a la disrupción de la IA. Tu objetivo será dar soporte en los entregables de componentes y agentes de inteligencia artificial. 
 El área de Innovación en Ciberseguridad define y construye tecnologías y servicios que mejoran la posición competitiva de Telefónica en su negocio proveedor de servicios. Forma parte de la organización global CDO (Chief Digital Office), encargada de la innovación en áreas estratégicas para el grupo Telefónica. 
 Dentro de esta área impulsamos la iniciativa AI Native SOC, cuyo objetivo es transformar el SOC (Security Operations Center) tradicional hacia el paradigma AI-Native, donde datos, inteligencia artificial y analistas trabajan como un único sistema operativo capaz de aprender, adaptarse y generar valor continuo. 
 ¿Cuál será tu misión? 🎯 
 Buscamos incorporar un perfil en formación con alto potencial para desarrollarse en un área estratégica dentro de Telefónica. La persona seleccionada participará progresivamente en el desarrollo y validación de modelos de Inteligencia Artificial predictiva, generativa y agéntica, colaborando en el análisis y tratamiento de datos a gran escala para la construcción de soluciones innovadoras de IA aplicada que aporten valor al negocio — apalancándote de forma intensiva en herramientas de inteligencia artificial (Claude y similares). 
 Apoyar en el desarrollo, entrenamiento y validación de modelos de IA predictiva, generativa y agéntica. 
 Participar en tareas de análisis, preparación y procesamiento de datos a gran escala. 
 Explorar nuevas metodologías, procesos y tecnologías de IA generativa dentro del proyecto 
 Colaborar en el desarrollo e implantación de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas a diferentes casos de uso del negocio. 
 Apoyar la generación de documentación técnica y funcional de los desarrollos realizados. 
 ¿Qué capacidades buscamos en ti? 🔎 
 Programación en Python orientada al análisis de datos y al desarrollo de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial. 
 Conocimientos de SQL y tratamiento de datos. 
 Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de resolución de problemas. 
 Interés por la Inteligencia Artificial, la analítica avanzada y las nuevas tendencias tecnológicas. 
 Capacidad de aprendizaje continuo y adaptación a nuevos entornos tecnológicos. 
 Proactividad e iniciativa. 
 Trabajo en equipo y colaboración en entornos multidisciplinares. 
 ¿Qué otros aspectos valoramos? 📚 
 Formación en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicación, Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencia de Datos o titulaciones STEM afines. 
 Estar cursando o haber cursado estudios relacionados con Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning, Big Data o Analítica Avanzada. 
 Expediente académico entre los mejores de su promoción. 
 Interés genuino por la IA y ganas de usarla a diario como copiloto de trabajo. 
 Español e inglés alto. Proactividad, rigor y ganas de aprender. 
 Se valorará (no necesario): experiencia profesional previa, experiencia en emprendimiento o experiencia en ciberseguridad, cloud o IA. 
 ¿Qué ventajas tendrás por formar parte del Programa Talentum en Telefónica? 💙 
 Jornada de 25 horas semanales. 
 Ayuda al estudio de 850€ mensuales. 
 Duración de la beca mínima de 6 meses y máxima de 12 meses. 
 Modelo híbrido. 
 Podrás formar parte de un equipo dinámico y ser parte de proyectos retadores. 
 Trabajar con en un equipo con gran densidad de talento y formarse con ellos en un espacio con alto potencial de futuro (IA & Ciberseguridad) 
 Mentoría directa de la dirección y de un equipo senior multidisciplinar. 
 Exposición real a entregables de dirección, clientes y partners, y aprendizaje práctico de IA aplicada 
 … ¡Y plan formativo durante la beca! 
 Ubicación de la beca: Madrid 
 ¡Y mucho más! 
 #UnidadesGlobales 
 En Telefónica tenemos el compromiso de construir un entorno de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y sostenible, donde cada persona se sienta valorada, respetada y libre. Nuestra cultura se basa en la igualdad de oportunidades y en la inclusión, porque tenemos la responsabilidad de transformar la sociedad y hacer un mundo mejor. 
 Si quieres formar parte de un equipo innovador y contribuir a un futuro mejor, ¡te estamos esperando! 
 Cuando te unes a Telefónica 
 Te unes a casi 100 años de historia, un equipo de 106 nacionalidades presentes en más de 35 países. Te unes a un equipo que trabaja por conectar a las personas allá dónde estén, sin fronteras. Un equipo que está liderando la revolución digital …

items.desc: To be filled: 03/31/2027 Work Environment Technical Development at AUDI AG is shaping the mobility of tomorrow. Within the field of vehicle development, we work on innovative interior components while advancing the digitalization of our development processes. In close collaboration with colleagues from Design, Ergonomics, Vehicle Safety, Engineering and Product Development, we contribute to creating future-oriented mobility solutions. Artificial intelligence creates new opportunities across the development process, for example in the analysis of technical data, the evaluation of simulation results and the support of development and release processes. During your internship, you will have the opportunity to apply modern AI technologies in a real-world development environment and contribute to innovative solutions for vehicle development. You will support the identification of use cases for artificial intelligence within interior development and collaborate on the development and implementation of suitable solutions. In addition, you will contribute to knowledge sharing around AI applications, support the exchange of ideas on emerging technologies and help further develop digital ways of working and processes within the department. Job Purpose/Role You analyze existing working methods, processes, and approaches within Interior Development to identify potential applications for Artificial Intelligence You support the identification of suitable AI use cases in collaboration with development engineers and specialist departments You contribute to the technical implementation of AI use cases using appropriate models, technologies, interfaces, and development tools You develop and test initial AI-based prototypes and proofs of concept for specific use cases within Interior Development You support the development of AI-powered workflows and automations to enhance development and approval processes You analyze the current use of AI within the department and help identify further opportunities for application You contribute new ideas and perspectives on Artificial Intelligence and support knowledge sharing within the team You assist in the preparation and delivery of knowledge-sharing formats such as workshops, AI sessions, and best-practice exchanges You support colleagues in exploring and implementing AI use cases and contribute to the development of AI-related skills within the department You collaborate with specialist departments, development engineers, and other stakeholders and present your results to different target groups Key Requirements/Skills/Experience You are currently studying Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable degree program You have very good written and spoken German or English skills You have knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI You possess good programming skills, ideally in Python You have ideally gained initial practical experience in developing applications, automations, or prototypes You are familiar with the fundamentals of Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application in digital solutions and workflows You have a good understanding of software development, data processing, and automation You enjoy learning about new technologies, tools, and frameworks and can quickly familiarize yourself with them You are interested in exploring innovative technologies and developing creative solution approaches You communicate effectively with different target groups and can explain complex topics in a clear and understandable way You will agree on your internship period in close alignment with the department. The scope of the tasks allows the topics to be explored and developed as part of a thesis project. If you are interested in writing a thesis, please mention this in your cover letter. items.card: Your mission? Build reliable, secure and reusable data products that empower colleagues to explore, analyse and put trusted data to work with more autonomy and fewer hurdles. If you enjoy making pipelines run smoothly, turning repetitive tasks into automation and asking 'Could we do this better?', you’ll feel right at home in this role. What you’ll get stuck into As part of our Data & AI feature team, reporting to
items.desc: Équipe Data Type de contrat Permanent Niveau Medior (2 - 7y) Build trusted data. Unlock possibilities. Make an impact. Great data doesn’t happen by accident. It takes curious minds, thoughtful engineering and people who enjoy turning complex challenges into solutions others love to use. At Keytrade Bank, we’re looking for a Data & AI Engineer to help bring our data excellence ambition to life. Your mission? Build reliable, secure and reusable data products that empower colleagues to explore, analyse and put trusted data to work with more autonomy and fewer hurdles. If you enjoy making pipelines run smoothly, turning repetitive tasks into automation and asking 'Could we do this better?', you’ll feel right at home in this role. What you’ll get stuck into As part of our Data & AI feature team, reporting to the Data & AI Tech Lead, you’ll work alongside Data & AI Scientists, BI experts, other feature teams, IT and business stakeholders. Your work will span three connected areas: Build it. Run it. Keep making it better. Design and operate data solutions on our enterprise Data & AI platform, with Microsoft Fabric as a key technology. You’ll own pipelines and data products throughout their lifecycle from the first design to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. Think quality, security, lineage, performance and cost. Because a great pipeline doesn’t just work once, it keeps delivering. Turn data into something people can trust and use. Work with data producers, owners and consumers to understand what they need and why it matters. Create and maintain data contracts that make expectations clear: what the data means, who owns it, how fresh it should be and how changes are handled. You’ll also help make trusted data available through self-service, visualisation and reporting solutions. Less friction. More useful insight. Automate the repetitive. Focus on the interesting. Develop testing, CI/CD and controlled deployment practices. Build reusable templates and automation, and implement AI-assisted engineering to accelerate development, improve documentation and simplify day-to-day operations. What you bring You combine hands-on engineering skills with curiosity and a practical approach to problem-solving. Your skills includes: Python and SQL, alongside a solid understanding of relational databases and data modelling. Experience building and supporting production workloads on Microsoft Fabric. Experience with ETL, transformation and orchestration, using tools such as dbt, WhereScape or Airflow. An understanding of data quality, governance, security, access control and lineage. The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and collaborate with people across technical and business teams. Experience with Spark/PySpark, Linux or shell scripting is a welcome bonus. Just as importantly, you share knowledge, take ownership and care about the people using what you build. You’re willing to challenge assumptions, learn from mistakes and choose a practical solution over unnecessary complexity. Ready to turn complexity into clarity? If building dependable data products, and making them genuinely useful, sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Bring your curiosity. Bring your engineering mindset. Help us make trusted data work harder at Keytrade Bank. Offer Hybrid way of working: We are in a hybrid way of working that implements 50% tele working and 50% working from home. Agile way of working Green surroundings An inclusive workplace with nice colleagues A competitive salary package with advantages such as: Meal vouchers: €10/ working day Teleworking allowance Transport allowance Group insurance Hospitalisation insurance

items.desc: La mission de l’Institut de l’Élevage est d’améliorer la compétitivité des élevages herbivores et de leurs filières dans un contexte en perpétuelle mutation. Ses travaux apportent des solutions techniques et innovantes aux éleveurs de bovins, ovins, caprins et équins et aux acteurs des filières. Ils fournissent des éléments de réponse aux questions sociétales et aux enjeux d’actualité, au service des acteurs de l’élevage et de ses filières. Vous aimez les questions qui demandent du recul, les données qui réservent des surprises et les échanges qui font avancer une analyse ? À l’Institut de l’Élevage, nous travaillons sur les performances et la durabilité des élevages d’herbivores. Expérimentations, enquêtes, images, capteurs, observatoires : les données sont variées, les questions aussi. Notre équipe Data’Stat accompagne les spécialistes métier pour construire les études, choisir les méthodes et donner du sens aux résultats. Nous cherchons une personne expérimentée qui aime autant résoudre une question complexe que partager sa façon de faire. Vous apporterez votre regard, proposerez des méthodes et aiderez les collègues à progresser. Échanger avec les équipes métier et concevoir des études solides : plans d’expérience, échantillonnage, dimensionnement et stratégie d’analyse. Faire parler des données variées. items.title: Trainee Full Stack Mobile Engineer (iOS & Android) (m/f/d)
items.card: Responsibilities: Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining features end to end from out Flutter Web and mobile apps to the backend services and microservices that power our feedback analytics platform. Build responsive, user-friendly mobile UI components in Flutter that turn complex feedback data and AI-generated insights into clear, actionable views. Work on mobile-specific topics such as iOS and Android
items.desc: Predict42, a leading AI startup in the space of feedback analytics, is seeking a highly motivated and aspiring Trainee Full Stack Mobile Engineer to start their career with our dynamic team. This is an exceptional opportunity to gain hands-on experience across the entire stack in a cutting-edge, LLM-driven AI environment, from intuitive cross-platform user interfaces in Flutter (iOS & Android) to high-performance backend systems based on ClickHouse and serverless services on Google Cloud Platform. You'll be instrumental in supporting our core engineering efforts, learning from experienced professionals, and contributing to features that bring AI-powered insights directly to our users. You'll report to our Chief Product Owner. Responsibilities: Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining features end to end from out Flutter Web and mobile apps to the backend services and microservices that power our feedback analytics platform. Build responsive, user-friendly mobile UI components in Flutter that turn complex feedback data and AI-generated insights into clear, actionable views. Work on mobile-specific topics such as iOS and Android platform guidelines, navigation, crash analysis with Firebase Crashlytics, and app store releases. Learn to implement, consume, and optimize API endpoints that connect our mobile apps with our backend services. Contribute to data flows and interactions with high-performance databases like ClickHouse. Participate actively in the full development lifecycle, from writing clean, maintainable code to contributing to testing practices and deployment support. Work closely with experienced engineers and our product team, taking part in code reviews and technical discussions to deepen your understanding. Continuously develop your technical skills and knowledge through structured training programs, dedicated mentorship, and hands-on project assignments. Qualifications: A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Media Informatics, or a related technical field. Strong foundational programming skills and first experience in mobile development, ideally with Flutter/Dart, Swift (iOS), or Kotlin (Android). Basic backend programming skills in at least one language such as Python, Java, or C# (our backend is built with Python and FastAPI); we value solid fundamentals more than the specific language. Basic understanding of mobile app development concepts such as UI components, state management, and responsive design. Basic understanding of API concepts (e.g., RESTful) and how mobile apps and backend communicate. A strong interest in mobile and backend development, microservices architecture, and high-performance databases (e.g., ClickHouse). Strong communication and collaboration skills. German language proficiency at a minimum C1 level. Benefits: Learning Opportunities: Cutting-edge projects, mentorship, career advancement. Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary, benefits, virtual stock options. Agile Culture: Collaborative, cross-functional team in a fun working environment. Impactful Work: Innovative solutions, purpose-driven company. How to Apply Ready to build the future of AI products with us? Please submit your application directly via Indeed. Arbeitsort: Zum Teil im Homeoffice in 55122 Mainz

items.desc: SOLIDARIETÀ QUADRIFOGLIO IMPRESA SOCIALE La Cooperativa Solidarietà Quadrifoglio nasce nel 2024 dalla fusione di Solidarietà Cooperativa Sociale di Colle Val d’Elsa (Si) e Il Quadrifoglio Gruppo Cooperativo di Arcidosso (Gr) con l'obiettivo di promuovere la solidarietà sociale, l'inclusione e il benessere delle persone e delle comunità. L’operazione messa in campo dalle due imprese sociali con entrambe 30 anni di esperienza ha permesso di far nascere un'entità più forte, con un più ampio ventaglio di servizi e una presenza sempre più capillare e strategica sul territorio. Partiamo dai numeri. Solidarietà Quadrifoglio è oggi un’impresa Sociale che conta : oltre 600 lavoratori, di cui circa 320 soci e di cui 1/6 sono volontari, con un’ importante rappresentanza femminile (450 lavoratrici) 470 contratti a tempo indeterminato 135 lavoratori svantaggiati fatturato annuo di 15.500.000 euro circa patrimonio di 1.900.000 euro circa La Cooperativa offre una vasta gamma di servizi, principalmente su sei province toscane (Grosseto, Siena, Arezzo, Firenze, Prato e Pistoia) che si possono distinguere in due macro aree: Attività rivolte alla Persona: servizi socio-assistenziali (residenziali, semiresidenziali e domiciliari) a favore di anziani, minori, portatori di handicap, psichiatrici, servizi educativi presso nidi, ludoteche, servizi estivi tra i quali i campi estivi e attività pre e post scuola. Servizi all’Impresa: gestione di portinerie, attività di guardiania, e call center, front-office sanitari, pulizie civili e industriali, gestione biblioteche e canili, mense scolastiche e vigilanza scuolabus, igiene ambientale e manutenzione del verde, servizi cimiteriali servizi di comunicazione, progettazione (anche su bandi specifici) e innovazione. items.desc: Job Description In our company, the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) is accountable for performance, quality, and regulatory compliance for assigned clinical protocols and trial sites within the country. Operating under the oversight of the CRA Manager, the CRA ensures the seamless execution of clinical trials in strict accordance with ICH-GCP guidelines, local laws and regulations, company standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality standards. The CRA serves as the primary sponsor point of contact and site manager throughout the entire lifecycle of clinical trials, from site qualification, initiation, ongoing conduct, through to site close-out, safeguarding patient rights, safety, and well-being while ensuring the collection of complete, accurate, and verifiable data. Primary Responsibilities Site Management Relationship Building: Act as the primary contact and site manager across all phases of assigned clinical studies; foster proactive, continuous, and productive partnerships with investigators and site staff. Monitoring Site Visits: Conduct monitoring visits (Validation Visits, Study Initiation Visits, Interim Monitoring Visits, and Site Close-Out Visits) in compliance with the Protocol, Monitoring Plan, SOPs, and ICH-GCP. Perform rigorous Source Data Review (SDR) and Source Data Verification (SDV), ensure data generated at sites are accurate, complete, and unbiased. Issue Resolution Risk-Based Monitoring: Identify, assess and support the resolution of operational issues or compliance gaps, and protocol dev; identify and escalate significant issues via the internal Escalation Pathway. Audits Continuous Improvement: Support audit and regulatory inspection readiness activities; participate in internal process improvements. What You Must Have (Qualifications Experience) Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline. Experience: Minimum of3 to 4 years of direct site management and independent clinical trial monitoring experience within a pharmaceutical company, biotech, or Clinical Research Organization (CRO). Proven track record in conducting qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits independently. Languages: Native or fluent inPortuguese and fluent inEnglish (both written and oral), with strong capabilities to communicate technical and operational clinical trial information. Knowledge Technical Skills: In-depth knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, local clinical trial legislation, and ethical guidelines. Hands-on proficiency with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), eTMF systems, electronic Data Capture (EDC), metrics dashboards, and digital/AI-enabled clinical tools. Mobility: Valid driver’s license and flexibility to travel domestically and internationally between65% and 75% of working time. Behavioral Core Competencies Critical Thinking Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills, root-cause analysis, and solution-driven mindset to resolve complex site issues. Agility Resilience: High adaptability to shifting project priorities, digital transformations, and complex matrix environments. items.desc: I Österåker arbetar vi mot att bli länets bästa skolkommun. I arbetet mot den målbilden har vi tre ledord: kunskap, professionalism och trygghet. Kunskap innebär att fler elever ska nå målet och nå bättre skolresultat. Professionalism innebär att vi ska ha kunnig personal som också kan växa och utvecklas i sina roller. Trygghet innebär att personal och elever ska få arbetsro, uppleva skolmiljöerna som trygga och vara delaktiga i beslut som påverkar deras vardag. I Österåkers kommun arbetar vi för att ge invånarna den bästa kvaliteten på den service och de tjänster vi tillhandahåller. Hos oss är du med och gör skillnad, både för enskilda människor och för kommunen i stort. Du som arbetar hos oss kan vara säker på att få engagera dig i meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter. Vill du vara med på vår resa? Då är du varmt välkommen till Österåker. Vill du driva processutveckling och digitalisering, och använda automation och AI för att göra vår verksamhetsservice smartare och mer tillgänglig för våra invånare och våra verksamheter inom utbildning? Ditt nya jobb Som Programledare digitalisering och AI är du del av vår stab och får en nyckelroll i att förvalta och utveckla våra IT lösningar inom Utbildningsförvaltningen. Du rapporterar till förvaltningschefen och leder arbetet från idé till verklighet – tillsammans med och ofta baserat på idéer från engagerade kollegor som brinner för hög kvalitet och god service. Du kommer in i en organisation där utveckling, samarbete och kvalitet är mer än bara fina ord. Här får du både struktur och frihet, tydliga mål och utrymme att testa och implementera nya processer och arbetssätt, alltid med invånarnas och verksamhetens bästa i fokus. Du får vara med och forma hur digitalisering och AI kan göra vardagen bättre för våra verksamheter i en organisation där kultur, värdegrund och relationer är lika viktiga som tekniken. Här uppmuntras nyfikenhet, kunskapsdelning och innovation, med ett öppet klimat där vi lär oss tillsammans. Vad du kommer att göra I rollen som Programledare digitalisering och AI i Utbildningsförvaltningen leder du vårt arbete med processutveckling, automation och digitalisering och ser till att AI används på ett smart och verksamhetsnära sätt. Du blir spindeln i nätet mellan verksamhet, IT, ledning och externa partners, och säkerställer att vi går från ”bra idé” till faktisk nytta i vardagen. Arbeter innefattar bland annat att: Driva och leda program för digitalisering, automation och utnyttjande av AI inom kommunens största förvaltning Driva utveckling och dokumentation av smarta processer och rutiner Säkerställa att digitala och AI-baserade lösningar ger tydlig nytta för invånare och medarbetare Samordna projekt, resurser och aktiviteter med centrala digitaliseringsavdelningen och vid behov med övriga förvaltningar så att arbetet blir strukturerat och effektivt Stötta verksamheter i förändringsledning, införande och uppföljning Säkerställa att arbetet följer lagar, riktlinjer, informationssäkerhet och etiska principer Följa utvecklingen inom digitalisering och AI och omsätta omvärldsbevakning till konkreta initiativ Kontakt med systemlevarantörer för att säkerställa att vi nyttjar systemen på ett optimalt sätt Vem vi tror att du är Vi letar efter dig som gillar att kombinera struktur med kreativitet och som trivs i en miljö där samarbete, ansvarstagande och nyfikenhet är vardag. Du är trygg i dig själv, gillar att bygga relationer och kan prata både ”verksamhetsspråk” och ”techspråk” utan att tappa någon på vägen. Framför allt är du en person som vill göra skillnad för människor – inte bara system. Har 5 år av erfarenhet av att leda program eller större projekt inom digitalisering, IT eller verksamhetsutveckling Har god kunskap om digitala lösningar och minst grundläggande förståelse för AI och dess användning i offentlig verksamhet Är van att arbeta nära kollegor och leverantörer, lyssna in behov och omsätta dem till konkreta planer Trivs med att samarbeta med många olika funktioner och intressenter samtidigt Har god kommunikativ förmåga, både muntligt och skriftligt, och gillar att förklara det komplexa på ett enkelt sätt Ser mångfald, inkludering och respektfullt bemötande som en självklar del av ditt medarbetarskap För att lyckas i rollen behöver du någon form av utbildning inom IT och vi tror att du har ett försprång om du även har kommunal erfarenhet. The Unit brings together Research Scientists, Research Engineers, Software Engineers, and Delivery staff, and is responsible for advancing our understanding of frontier AI systems, the risks they may pose, and the mitigations needed for safe deployment. As a Research Scientist, you will play a central role in shaping and carrying out original research into the safety, reliability, and governance of advanced AI models. While Research Engineers focus on building prototypes and Software Engineers ensure robust infrastructure, Research Scientists lead on developing research questions, hypotheses, and novel methods , contributing to both scientific progress and policy-relevant insights. This role will suit someone with a strong research background in machine learning or adjacent fields, and a deep interest in applying their expertise to the emerging challenges of AI safety. Job description You will develop and deliver research projects, working with engineers and other scientists to translate ideas into experiments and insights. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work with complex data and large-scale models. Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers to translate research ideas into practical experiments. Track record of clearly communicating technical research to a range of audiences, both technical and non-technical. items.desc: Req ID: 64312 Job Function: Data & AI Posting Start Date: 17/11/2026 Posting End Date: 27/11/2026 Division: Digital Job Location: GBR-London-BTHQ One Braham Advertised Salary: Competitive, with great BT benefits! Job Req ID: Posting Date: Function: Location: Salary: About the role AI is moving quickly, and building it responsibly is critical to maintaining trust, meeting regulatory expectations and enabling innovation safely. As our Responsible AI & Ethics Specialist, you’ll help shape how BT designs, buys, deploys and governs AI across its lifecycle. You’ll turn complex regulation, standards and ethical principles into practical controls that teams can actually use, while providing specialist challenge on areas including harmful bias, discrimination, explainability, transparency, human oversight, privacy, safety and security. Working across Data & AI Governance, Legal, Privacy, Cyber Security, Risk, Procurement, Architecture, Data Science and Engineering, you’ll play an important role in strengthening BT’s Responsible AI framework and ensuring AI innovation is backed by clear accountability and defensible evidence. #digitalnov What you’ll be doing Shape and embed Responsible AI governance , supporting the continued development of BT’s Responsible AI Standard, ethical principles, control framework and operating procedures. Translate AI regulation into practical action , particularly the EU AI Act, helping teams understand risk classifications, operator responsibilities, transparency requirements and the controls and evidence required. Assess AI risks and impacts across areas including fairness, fundamental rights, bias, discrimination, explainability, human oversight, safety, robustness, security and foreseeable misuse. Apply recognised AI governance frameworks , including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and relevant ISO standards, to strengthen lifecycle risk management, assessments and controls. Provide specialist challenge and advice to product, data science, engineering and business teams so that ethical and regulatory risks are identified and addressed early in the AI lifecycle. Strengthen AI assurance and oversight , developing evidence packs, control tests, reporting, KPIs and KRIs and supporting the maintenance and attestation of BT’s AI Inventory. Review third-party and supplier AI , considering areas such as data and model provenance, transparency, intellectual property, security, monitoring and regulatory evidence. Build Responsible AI capability , developing practical guidance, training and case studies that help colleagues understand and apply responsible AI requirements in their work. Essential Skills / Experience Deep practical expertise in Responsible AI, AI ethics and AI governance , with the ability to assess AI across its lifecycle and identify and manage risks relating to areas such as fairness, harmful bias, discrimination, explainability, transparency, human oversight, safety and robustness. Strong working knowledge of the EU AI Act and AI regulatory requirements , including its risk-based structure, prohibited practices, high-risk AI, transparency obligations, general-purpose AI and the responsibilities of organisations developing, deploying or supplying AI. Demonstrable experience turning complex AI regulation, risk and ethical principles into practical governance , such as AI impact or risk assessments, lifecycle controls, decision criteria and assurance evidence, with the ability to provide credible challenge across technical and non-technical teams. Desirable Skills / Experience Knowledge of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework , including the GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE functions. Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001 and related AI risk and impact-assessment standards, including ISO/IEC 23894 and ISO/IEC 42005. Understanding of UK GDPR requirements relevant to AI, including fairness, transparency, data minimisation, automated decision-making and data protection by design. Experience partnering across functions such as Legal, Privacy, Cyber Security, Procurement, Risk, Data Science, Engineering and product teams. items.desc: Description This is a broad analytical role within Safestore’s Commercial team, using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities and support better commercial decision-making across the UK and European businesses. The team’s analysis is primarily commercially focused but often feeds into wider decisions across Operations, Property and Marketing. The role covers everything from day-to-day analysis and reporting to investigating business questions and evaluating trials, with opportunities to develop statistical and machine learning models. We are looking for a flexible all-rounder, comfortable adapting to the needs of the business. There is plenty of scope to develop your skills here if you take the initiative to learn and grow. Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities Use data and analysis to identify trends, opportunities and potential underperformance, supporting commercial decision-making and revenue optimisation. Investigate a wide range of commercial questions, bringing together relevant data and using appropriate techniques to understand what is happening, why, and what actions could be taken. Evaluate the impact of trials, initiatives and changes across the business, understanding what has worked and identifying opportunities for further improvement. Analyse customer behaviour and business performance to provide insights and recommendations that support commercial strategy. Work closely with Operations, Property and Marketing, providing analysis that informs wider business decisions and initiatives. Develop an excellent understanding of internal and external data sources and how they can be used to answer commercial and wider business questions. Apply statistical techniques where appropriate, with opportunities to evaluate and develop predictive and machine learning models across the business. Develop reporting, analytical tools and other solutions that help the Commercial team and wider business make better use of data. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders, turning analysis into practical business actions. Experience and Skills Required A STEM degree. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to take a commercial question, identify and query the relevant data, structure the analysis and turn the results into practical recommendations. A good understanding of machine learning and predictive modelling, including regression, classification and clustering. The ability to communicate findings clearly and work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Requirements Practical experience applying statistical or machine learning techniques to real-world problems, such as predictive modelling, forecasting, classification, clustering or causal inference. items.desc: Zendar is looking for a Mechatronics Engineer to join our Lindau am Bodensee office and build the hardware of our autonomous outdoor robot. The robot carries our radar-centric autonomy stack, works around the clock, docks itself and charges wirelessly. You will design, build and bring up its chassis, from the mechanics and electronics to the firmware that runs them. This is a unique opportunity to join a small team that is not bogged down by legacy designs. You will take the robot from hand-built prototypes to a product that is ready for customers. About Zendar Zendar builds physical agents: mobile robots that can go anywhere in the physical world, understand what they see and act on it. We are deploying them to automate enterprise sites, doing in the physical world what AI agents already do in software. What makes our robots special is the navigation foundation model for autonomous systems that Zendar has developed over the past 9 years. Our radar-centric autonomy stack lets mobile robots traverse any environment, from offices and warehouses to roads, in any weather and at high speeds. Our physical agents get wherever they need to go, quickly, reliably and safely. We are a small team that owns the whole stack, from sensors and perception to planning, AI and the robots in the field. We are scaling deployments rapidly, so you will see your work running on real robots at real sites and delivering value to our customers. Although AI is central to what we build, our hiring process is intentionally human: every resume is reviewed by a real person. Your Role As a Mechatronics Engineer in Lindau, you will join our robot hardware team and co-own the chassis of our outdoor robot: its mechanics, electronics and firmware. You will work hand in hand with our robot hardware engineer in Berkeley, from the first CAD model and wiring diagram to a robot that drives, docks and charges outdoors. Occasional travel to the US may be required. You will work closely with the autonomy, embedded software and systems engineering teams, and with our suppliers. Your test results will feed directly into the requirements and design of the next robot generation. Why this role is exciting: Ownership: You will co-own the chassis hardware and decide on the best balance of design tradeoffs to meet the requirements. Speed: You will see your designs built, powered up and driving within weeks, not years. Impact: Your decisions shape a robot that moves from prototype to customer deployments. What You'll Do Build the Chassis: Turn the requirements into a chassis design, and decide where off-the-shelf components fit and where a custom design pays off. Take parts from CAD to hardware with machine shops and suppliers. Make the robot robust outdoors and easy to service. Own the Electrical System and Firmware: Design and build the power distribution and wiring of the robot, from schematic to finished harness. Write, extend and debug the firmware that runs the chassis electronics, together with our embedded engineers. Specify or design custom boards where off-the-shelf electronics fall short. Bring Up and Test: Take each new robot from first power-on to driving outdoors, debugging across mechanics, electronics and firmware. Plan and run tests that show the robot meets its requirements, on the bench and in the field. Get to Product: Keep the hardware documentation up to date, so the next robot is built faster. Work with suppliers to make the chassis manufacturable, serviceable and ready for certification. items.desc: Arbeidsvoorwaarden Opleiding Technische Informatica / Mechatronica Contactpersoon Mabel Valkenburg Heb je nog vragen over deze vacature? mabel.valkenburg@improvia.nl Over Improvia Improvia is een multidisciplinair technisch dienstverlener, gericht op de volledige waardeketen. Van consultancy, engineering en realisatie tot en met beheer en service van tools, modules, installaties en complete machines. Dit wordt voor de Hightech industrie, de energiesector en de inframarkt gedaan. Daarnaast worden in huis engineeringsvraagstukken uitgewerkt, welke raakvlakken met zorgrobotica hebben. Opdrachtomschrijving De slimme rollator heeft aan de voorzijde vier ToF-sensoren, elk met een raster van 8×8 afstandsmetingen. In het verleden is een algoritme getraind waarmee de rollator onderscheid maakt tussen muren en meubels en daarop reageert door de wielen aan te sturen. Smalle ruimtes zoals deurposten en hallen bleven lastig te herkennen. Slechtzienden hebben meer nodig. Obstakels moeten betrouwbaarder en op meer plekken worden gezien. Daarom wordt gedacht aan uitbreiding van de rollator met extra sensoren. Daarnaast moet worden gekozen hoe de gebruiker wordt ondersteund. Onderzoek en ontwikkel hoe de slimme rollator met extra sensoren geschikt wordt voor slechtzienden, en onderzoek welke manier van ondersteuning het best past: bijsturen met de wielen, trilsignalen in de handvatten of een combinatie. Het eindresultaat is een werkend prototype dat obstakels detecteert en de gebruiker hierbij ondersteunt. Op te leveren delen: Overzicht van de behoeften van slechtzienden en de relevante obstakels en situaties; Onderbouwd advies over aanvullende sensoren en hun plaatsing; Prototype van de rollator met de aanvullende sensoren gemonteerd en aangesloten; Werkende obstakeldetectie op de rollator, met de bijbehorende software en trainingsdata; Optioneel: betrouwbaar uitlezen van de sensordata van beide zijden van de rollator; Onderbouwde keuze en werkende implementatie van de ondersteuning: wielen, trilsignalen of een combinatie; Testrapport met de resultaten, indien mogelijk inclusief tests met gebruikers; Eindrapport met aanbevelingen voor verdere ontwikkeling. Gewenste voorkennis: Basiskennis programmeren van embedded systemen (C of C++) en microcontrollers; Kennis van sensoren en elektronica; Kennis van of interesse in machine learning (classificatie) is een pré; Basiskennis regeltechniek is een pré; Basiskennis mechanisch ontwerp is een pré; Interesse in zorgtechnologie en in gebruiksvriendelijkheid voor mensen met een beperking. Interesse in deze opdracht? Ben jij enthousiast over robotica en wil je bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze humanoid robot Oli? Dan komen we graag met je in contact! Stuur je cv en een korte motivatie naar mabel.valkenburg@improvia.nl, onder vermelding van ‘Afstudeeropdracht Slimme Rollator’. Heb je vragen over de opdracht of wil je meer weten over de mogelijkheden? Neem dan gerust contact met ons op. We vertellen je graag meer!

 Siemens builds the systems the physical world runs on: factories, power grids, buildings, trains, hospitals. Industrial and physical AI is a major opportunity in applied AI, and one of the harder ones to get right. There is a generation of AI-powered products to build. 
 We are an applied science organization building the science behind them. The work sits at the intersection of machine learning research, real world data, and production systems running in industrial environments. 
 As Applied Scientist, you work on the science on a major capability area inside the pod. You take ambiguous problems through hypothesis, method selection, experimentation, and into models that run in production. You are hands on with the modeling, and you are accountable for the rigor and the outcome. 
 This is an individual contributor role. You will work in close partnership with engineers and product managers who turn your work into product. 
 Key responsibilities 
 Contribute to one or more scientific capability areas end to end, for example perception, computer vision, language and agents, time series, control, planning, or evaluation 
 Take problems from ambiguous product or system requirements through clear research questions, hypotheses, and success metrics 
 Contribute to applied research projects: literature review, method selection, experimentation, ablation, error analysis, and productization 
 Build and run the evaluation pipelines for the work you own: offline metrics, online experiments, robustness testing in industrial conditions 
 Work with engineers to take models into production grade pipelines: data readiness, training infrastructure, inference, observability 
 Make scientific tradeoffs in front of engineers and product managers, with evidence, and translate them into decisions the team can act on 
 Identify and de-risk scaling challenges in your area: data quality, model drift, latency, throughput, cost, safety 
 Raise the bar on experimentation rigor, reproducibility, and documentation across the team 
 Apply responsible AI practices in your work: bias detection, model risk management, human in the loop controls 
 Basic qualifications 
 2+ years in applied machine learning, AI research, or data science, with models that shipped to production and made an impact 
 Strong foundation in machine learning theory and practice across training, evaluation, and deployment 
 Demonstrated experience taking research from a paper or prototype into a model that runs reliably in production 
 Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks and toolchains 
 Strong partnership track record with engineering teams on data, training infrastructure, and inference 
 Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, product managers, and senior leaders 
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience applying ML in industrial or physical domains: manufacturing, automation, robotics, energy, mobility, infrastructure, healthcare 
 Deep expertise in one of: multimodal ML, generative AI, retrieval augmented generation, agentic workflows, time series, control, or planning 
 Scientific ML for physical systems: surrogate modeling, operator learning, physics-informed ML, geometry-aware ML, differentiable simulation, AI for semiconductor/EDA 
 Hands-on experience building evaluation pipelines, running online experiments, or instrumenting production monitoring for a model you owned 
 Publications, patents, open source contributions, or significant internal technology transfers 
 Experience working with globally distributed research, product, or engineering organizations 
 About the Team: 
 We are an early-stage engineering team solving hard technical problems at the intersection of AI, systems, and real-world interaction. We operate with high autonomy, collaborate closely across functions, and maintain high technical standards. Principal Engineers at our company are expected to lead by example, model engineering excellence, and shape both what we build and how we build it.
 Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce: 
 We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Job Description Summary 
Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen.
At GE Aerospace Technology & Operations, our customers challenge us to tackle some of the world’s most complex engineering problems that require innovative approach using new technologies. Our engineers depend on software developers to bridge data, tools, and emerging technologies, like cloud and AI, to unlock new possibilities and shape the future of flight. 
 Job Description 
 About Us 
At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. Our teams in Technology & Operations take on some of the most complex engineering problems in aviation. They use data, cloud and AI to shape the future of safe and more sustainable flight. Join us and see your future take flight.
 Your Role 
As part of our team based in Germany, you’ll connect engineers with data, tools and emerging technologies. From day one, you’ll own real projects and turn ideas into working solutions that make a measurable difference.
 Please note: this is a remote position open only to candidates who live in Germany and are allowed to work her e.
 What You Will Do 
 Develop data and AI solutions that help our engineers evaluate and adopt new technologies.
 Build proofs of concept and support strategic business projects, including data science and machine learning systems.
 Design solution architectures, write code, and present demos to stakeholders.
 Apply the Innovator Method to turn customer insights into solutions with real business value.
 Work with colleagues across functions and help ship solutions to production.
 What You Bring 
 You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Germany in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field, and you will stay enrolled for the whole internship.
 You have good academic results in a STEM subject.
 You program confidently in Python, and knowledge of C#, C++ or SQL is a plus.
 You have first hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs) or Computer Vision, for example from university projects.
 You are curious and customer-focused, and you enjoy solving problems in a team.
 You speak and write English fluently. German is a plus.
 Experience with AWS or Azure is a plus, and so is a related certification.
 You live in Germany and can work in Germany.
 What We Offer 
 Real project ownership from the start
 Mentoring from experienced engineers
 Flexible, remote working within Germany
 Competitive internship pay
 The chance of a future role with GE Aerospace
 Internship details: Ideally, the internship starts in February or March 2027 and lasts at least 6 months. This is a remote position based in Germany only.
 Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity 
GE Aerospace values diversity and is committed to an inclusive work environment. We welcome all applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity. Candidates with severe disabilities are given preference if equally qualified.
 Additional Information 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No

items.desc: Dans le cadre du projet Matching 3D , le Forem recherche un(e) consultant(e) Data Scientist / AI Engineer afin de poursuivre le développement de son moteur de matching M3D. Cette solution vise à mettre en relation les profils des chercheurs d’emploi avec les offres d’emploi et les offres de formation, puis à exposer ces services au sein du Dossier Unique basé sur Microsoft Dynamics. Le consultant interviendra sur la conception, le développement et l’évolution du moteur M3D et de ses pipelines de données : ingestion des profils, offres d’emploi et offres de formation dans Microsoft Fabric, indexation et recherche sémantique avec Azure AI Search, mise en œuvre des mécanismes de matching flou, scoring et reranking, ainsi que hiérarchisation des recommandations. La mission couvre également le déploiement et l’activation des environnements Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric et Azure AI Foundry, l’utilisation de Docker et Azure App Service, ainsi que la mise en place des chaînes CI/CD et des dispositifs de monitoring. Le consultant participera à l’exposition du moteur sous forme d’API et de connecteurs destinés au Dossier Unique et aux différents outils métiers. Une attention particulière sera portée à la qualité des données et à la validation du moteur : définition des jeux et protocoles de test, mesure de la pertinence des résultats, préparation des mises en production et collaboration étroite avec les équipes techniques et métiers du Forem. La mission comprend enfin le maintien en conditions opérationnelles, la documentation de la solution, le transfert de compétences vers les équipes internes et l’accompagnement de la trajectoire du moteur vers 2028, notamment dans le cadre du remplacement progressif des outils de matching existants BiMatch, C1C et ELISE. Profil candidat: Nous recherchons un(e) Data Scientist / AI Engineer de niveau Junior disposant d’une expérience récente dans la conception et le développement de solutions Data et Intelligence Artificielle. Le candidat devra être à l’aise avec l’écosystème Microsoft Azure et maîtriser notamment Python, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Search et Azure AI Foundry. Une capacité à travailler avec des équipes techniques et métiers et à documenter les solutions développées est également attendue.
