items.desc: 60% - 100% | Emmenbrücke | Homeoffice möglich Jetzt bewerben Die Dienststelle Steuern des Kantons Luzern setzt seit der Steuerperiode 2002 ein elektronisches Regelwerk für teilautomatisierte Veranlagungen ein. Es unterscheidet komplexe Fälle von Routinefällen und steuert den Fokus der Veranlagung gezielt auf Auffälligkeiten und relevante Abweichungen, statt Einzelziffern manuell zu prüfen. Dieses Regelwerk entwickeln wir datengetrieben mit Data Analytics und Machine Learning weiter, um die Veranlagungsprozesse spürbar effizienter und treffsicherer zu gestalten. Für diese Weiterentwicklung suchen wir eine methodisch starke Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem analytischem Denken. Deine Aufgaben Datenbasis & Wirkungsmessung: Du bereitest Veranlagungsdaten über mehrere Steuerjahre auf und machst den Effekt der Veranlagungsarbeit messbar. Modellierung & Validierung: Du entwickelst statistische Modelle zur Weiterentwicklung des Regelwerks, testest sie an unbekannten Daten und prüfst sie laufend auf Verzerrungen (Bias). Monitoring & Optimierung: Du konzipierst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, die transparent aufzeigen, wo das Regelwerk greift und wo Potenzial für Anpassungen besteht. Übersetzungsarbeit: Du bereitest deine Ergebnisse für die Fachspezialistinnen und Fachspezialisten der Veranlagung nachvollziehbar auf – und kommunizierst sie auch dann klar und sachlich, wenn Daten bestehende Annahmen widerlegen. Reproduzierbarkeit: Du dokumentierst deine Analysen und deinen Code so sauber, dass deine Arbeit jederzeit nachvollziehbar und reproduzierbar bleibt. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du verfügst über einen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Ökonometrie, Statistik, Ökonomie, Quantitativen Methoden, Mathematik oder Data Science (bei einem Bachelorabschluss mit nachweisbarem quantitativem Schwerpunkt). Methodik & Tech-Stack: Du bringst fundierte Statistikkenntnisse sowie praktische Erfahrung in der statistischen Modellierung mit R oder Python mit – etwa aus Studienprojekten oder deiner Abschlussarbeit. Denkweise: Du strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen selbstständig, untermauerst deine Aussagen konsequent mit Daten und widersprichst konstruktiv, wenn eine Hypothese nicht trägt. Pluspunkte: Erfahrungen mit Machine Learning und Modellvalidierung, eine saubere Arbeitsweise mit Versionierung (Git) sowie Grundkenntnisse in der Finanzbuchhaltung sind von Vorteil. Quereinstieg willkommen: Berufserfahrung und Vorkenntnisse im Steuerrecht setzen wir nicht voraus – wir bringen dir das nötige Fachwissen bei. Unser Angebot Sinnstiftender Einstieg: Du erhältst eine praxisnahe Einstiegsstelle direkt nach dem Studium, bei der deine Modelle im Alltag echten Impact entfalten. Einzigartige Datenbasis: Du arbeitest – unter strenger Wahrung des Steuergeheimnisses und Datenschutzes – mit umfangreichen realen Verwaltungsdaten aus vielen Jahren. Gezieltes Mentoring: Die fachliche Einarbeitung erfolgt direkt dort, wo die Fragestellungen entstehen. Den methodischen Austausch pflegst du mit Fachkolleginnen und Fachkollegen, die ähnliche Fragestellungen bearbeiten. Verlässliche Rahmenbedingungen: Wir bieten dir eine unbefristete Anstellung in einem Pensum von 60 - 100%. Flexibles Arbeiten: Mobiles Arbeiten im Homeoffice ist bei uns gelebte Praxis. Deine Bewerbung Enthält Motivationsschreiben Lebenslauf Zeugnisse oder Leistungsübersicht mit den erworbenen Kreditpunkten in Statistik, Data Science und/oder Machine Learning Ein ausgewähltes Arbeitsbeispiel (z. B. items.desc: This is an early-career engineering job where your work ends up in front of the leadership of a global company. You'll build AI tools for Pfizer's Office of the Chief Executive Officer (OCEO), which sets the company's strategy, looks after its communications and global health investments, and runs the CEO's own office. You'll take ideas from a first conversation to something senior colleagues rely on. You'll work directly with the people who had the ideas. Many of them aren't engineers, and you'll often be the one sitting next to them while the idea turns into something real. You'll be building with current AI models and tools from your first week, with a senior engineering lead guiding you, and you'll own solutions yourself as you get more experienced. There are two of these jobs, in a team of five, and you'd report to the Senior Director, AI Innovation and Delivery. It suits someone who likes learning in the open, wants to see what their work actually does, and is as happy helping a colleague build something as building it alone. Role Responsibilities Pair with the people who have ideas Work alongside colleagues who bring an idea in, especially if it's their first time. Help them shape it and test it, be straight about what it will take to make it production-grade, and make sure they know what they own once it's live. Next time, they should need you a bit less. Build and harden Build features, integrations and fixes from the briefs the Product Lead agrees with originators. You'll use AI coding tools, and your work gets reviewed. Some ideas you'll help build from scratch; others start as a prototype that you turn into a production-grade solution. Before writing anything new, check whether it already exists. Test and evaluate Write the tests and evaluation cases that show whether something works. Run them before release and keep them running after. Watch how solutions behave in real use, find where they get things wrong, and turn what you find into fixes or new tests. Help run what we build Take your share of the day-to-day running: keeping an eye on quality and cost, dealing with issues, applying platform updates, keeping releases tidy. If something looks off, flag it early instead of quietly working around it. Learn it, then own it Get to know the solutions the team runs, including work handed over by outside partners, well enough to change them with confidence. As you get more experienced, you'll take ownership of particular ones. Document as you go Keep how-to guides, decision notes and runbooks up to date, and write them so people outside the team can follow them too. It's what keeps a solution working after the people who built it have moved on. Role Behaviours Help people build Leave each person you work with more capable than before. A pairing session went well if they can do more on their own afterwards. Ask early Ask questions and raise problems as soon as they come up, whether it's the code, the data or getting access to it. A question on day one costs far less than a mistake found at release. Reuse first Look for a component, pattern or platform feature that already does the job. Writing something new needs a reason. Test what you ship A change isn't finished until you've shown it works on real examples. Keep that evidence where others can see it. Write it down Note what you built and why, in plain words a colleague outside the team can follow. If you're the only one who can explain it, it's not done yet. items.desc: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. This role is in Early Development Biometrics (EDB), a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across early clinical development at Roche. We partner across Biostatistics, Analytical Data Science, and Data Management to enable data-driven decision-making from first-in-human through proof-of-concept studies. As trusted partners in early development, we design efficient and innovative clinical trials, apply rigorous statistical methods, and implement high-quality programming and analytical solutions to accelerate timelines, de-risk development, and increase the probability of technical success. Our integrated teams operate with agility and scientific depth, supporting exploratory analyses, early regulatory engagements, and complex data-generation needs across therapeutic areas. Together, we bring scientific rigor, technical innovation, and strategic insight to shape the future of early development and deliver better outcomes for patients. The Opportunity: The Early Development ADS Programmer develops high-quality, analysis-ready datasets and outputs that enable exploratory evidence generation in early-phase clinical trials. This role supports flexible and evolving study needs by creating custom data structures, outputs, and visualizations suited to novel or non-standard endpoints. Working within defined statistical analysis plans and programming conventions, the programmer ensures traceability, reproducibility, and technical rigor across diverse data sources. With strong proficiency in statistical programming and an understanding of early development challenges, this role helps deliver timely, fit-for-purpose outputs that inform development decisions and support transition into later-phase studies. You support the development and validation of exploratory datasets and outputs for early phase clinical studies, including custom data structures and visualizations, based on protocol and analysis requirements You generate programming deliverables (e.g., datasets, summary outputs, visual displays) using validated tools and standard code libraries, with guidance from more experienced programmers You contribute to documentation and quality control practices to ensure transparency, reproducibility, and consistency in early development outputs You identify and resolve basic technical issues in code or output by performing structured checks and escalating as needed You learn and apply foundational concepts in early development programming, including flexible data design, data traceability, and fit for purpose output generation You engage in learning activities to deepen understanding of early clinical research, exploratory endpoints, and evolving data standards relevant to early phase development You work under general supervision and apply independent judgment to interpret guidance, prioritize responsibilities, and make decisions in situations that require contextual understanding Who You Are: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Life Sciences, or a related field You bring relevant experience in statistical programming, or an advanced degree with equivalent work experience You have basic proficiency in a modern programming language (e.g., SAS, R, or Python) for data manipulation and output generation You understand data integrity principles and quality control processes in a scientific setting You work effectively with structured and semi structured data in support of scientific exploration You are curious and willing to learn the unique analytical needs of early clinical development You show strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and effective written documentation practices You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace Preferred: Familiarity with handling non-standard or exploratory clinical data, such as biomarkers, - omics, or real-world data Exposure to data visualization techniques and tools (e.g., ggplot2, plotly, SAS Graph, Shiny) Awareness of early development study designs and their implications for data structure and items.desc: About the role At Tesco, our Data Science team builds scalable solutions to complex business challenges across stores, online, supply chain, marketing and Clubcard. We apply advanced machine learning, generative AI, and large language models (LLMs) to personalise customer experiences, optimise operations and drive innovation. We work across several business domains, including customer experience, online, fulfilment, distribution, commodities, store operations and technology. Team members rotate across domains to broaden their expertise and impact. We foster a culture of continuous learning, dedicating 10% of the working week to personal development. Our team benefits from academic partnerships, regular knowledge-sharing events and a collaborative, inclusive environment that values work-life balance and professional growth. You will be responsible for As a Data Scientist at Tesco, you will develop and deploy machine learning and generative AI solutions that directly impact how we serve our customers and run our business. You will be responsible for designing and implementing robust models, experimenting with new approaches, and translating business problems into data science solutions. This includes building prototypes, evaluating model performance both statistically and in terms of business impact, and scaling models into production. You will collaborate closely with Machine Learning Engineers and Software Engineers to ensure solutions are efficient, maintainable, and aligned with Tesco’s technology standards. You will also play a key role in communicating complex ideas clearly to non-technical stakeholders, contributing to internal knowledge sharing and representing Tesco in the external data science community. Staying current with developments in GenAI and LLMs will be essential, as you will help to evaluate and integrate emerging techniques into our data products. You will need We are looking for a curious and driven individual with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, and programming. You will be comfortable designing and implementing models using Python and working with large-scale data in distributed computing environments. Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, and deep learning frameworks is valued. You will translate business problems into data science solutions and communicate your findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. A scientific mindset, critical thinking, and the ability to ask the right questions are essential. You will be proactive in learning new methods, staying up to date with the latest developments, and contributing to a culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration. A higher degree in a quantitative discipline—such as Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or Physics—is preferred, though equivalent experience in a commercial setting is also valued. Strong coding practices, including version control and testing are expected. Whats in it for you? We’re all about the little helps. That’s why we make sure our Tesco colleague benefits package takes care of you – both in and out of work. Click Here to find out more! Annual bonus scheme of up to 20% of base salary. Holiday starting at 25 days plus a personal day (plus Bank holidays). Private medical insurance. 26 weeks maternity and adoption leave (12 months service required at the qualifying date) at full pay, followed by 13 weeks of Statutory Maternity Pay or Statutory Adoption Pay, we also offer 6 weeks fully paid paternity leave. Free 24/7 virtual GP service, Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and your family, free access to a range of experts to support your mental wellbeing. No two customers are the same, neither are our colleagues. At Tesco, we champion a balance that lets you thrive both in and out of work. Spend 60% of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. items.desc: Company Overview Sqilline Health builds Danny, an oncology analytics platform that works with real-world clinical data from 110+ hospitals in Bulgaria, Romania, Serbia, Croatia, Spain, and Poland. Pharma companies use our analyses to see how cancer treatments perform in real patients. We run our own LLMs on air-gapped infrastructure, so patient data never leaves our environment. About the Role We are an AI-first company. Our models read raw clinical records and turn them into structured oncology data that some of the biggest pharma companies use to see how cancer treatments perform in real patients. This role is the logic in between: disease-specific algorithms that turn records for an indication into analysis-ready variables and cohorts, and models that pull the right facts out of messy clinical text. This is a mid-level role with room to grow into owning a disease area. You work on the logic for your assigned indications, with the CDO and the data science team close by. You design the algorithm, build the training set from real corrected cases, and check the result against a gold set before it ships. The data is patient-level oncology data from hospitals in six countries, so a wrong value distorts an analysis a client acts on. Getting the algorithm right is the job. You also work AI-first. You build model-driven pipelines around your own workflows: agents do the first pass, you review and judge, and the system logs what got corrected. Every algorithm you ship leaves reusable automation behind it. What you will do Deliver analyses on real-world oncology data: cohorts, treatment patterns, outcomes across hospitals, indications, and countries. Design and implement disease-specific algorithms: the logic that turns clinical records for an indication into analysis-ready variables and cohort definitions. Grow into fine-tuning our self-hosted LLMs for clinical extraction: build training sets from corrected cases, run the fine-tunes with support, and evaluate against gold sets. Verify and validate patient-level data with model assistance: the model does the first pass, flags what it’s unsure about, and you judge the rest. Rebuild recurring delivery workflows as model-driven pipelines, so each month runs more automated than the last. Keep your work in proper repositories: versioned code, CI on GitLab, reviewable and repeatable. Work with both our stacks: self-hosted vLLM for volume work, frontier models for planning and hard cases. Measure everything. Every automated step has an accuracy number; every analysis has a quality trail. Show the team how to run and extend what you build. What we look for AI-first thinking. Your default question is “can a model do this?” before you do it by hand even once. You use LLMs daily in your own work: coding agents, prompt pipelines, evals. You take data quality personally. In clinical data, a wrong value can distort an analysis a client acts on. You ship. A working flow this week beats a framework next quarter You measure. items.desc: De job Als AI-trainer neem je de verantwoordelijkheid voor ons opleidingsaanbod. Je geeft trainingen, ontwikkelt nieuwe inhoud en bouwt mee aan de manier waarop we kennis delen met de publieke sector. Je werkt rond drie belangrijke pijlers: AI-trainingen bij klanten: Je geeft fysieke trainingen en workshops bij publieke organisaties, van eenmalige sessies tot langere opleidingstrajecten. Je vertaalt AI (MS Copilot, maar ook ander genAI-tools) naar herkenbare voorbeelden, stemt je aanpak af op de groep en helpt deelnemers om toepassingen in hun eigen werk te ontdekken. Online opleidingen en e-learning: Je ontwikkelt en geeft online trainingen voor ons e-learningaanbod. Je maakt heldere instructievideo’s, werkt praktische oefeningen uit en houdt de inhoud actueel. Kennisdeling en nieuwsbrief: Je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en vertaalt die naar toegankelijke artikels, tips en voorbeelden. Je schrijft mee aan onze nieuwsbrief en zorgt dat onze lezers weten wat nieuwe ontwikkelingen voor hun werk betekenen. Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng. Je stelt nieuwe onderwerpen en formats voor, verwerkt feedback en neemt initiatief om het opleidingsaanbod beter te maken. Je werkt zelfstandig en bent regelmatig op de baan naar klanten. Tijdens connectdagen op kantoor werk je samen met het team, wissel je ervaringen uit en bouw je verder aan het aanbod. Wie zoeken we? Je hoeft geen jaren werkervaring te hebben. We zoeken vooral iemand die sterk communiceert, graag leert en met enthousiasme voor een groep staat. Een goede basis in AI is wel vereist. Attitudes Je draagt positieve energie uit en weet een groep te enthousiasmeren. Je legt complexe onderwerpen helder en toegankelijk uit. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI, experimenteert zelf en deelt graag wat je leert. Je neemt eigenaarschap: je ziet kansen, doet voorstellen en werkt ze uit. Vaardigheden Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hebt een goede basiskennis van ChatGPT, Claude en/of Microsoft Copilot en gebruikt die tools zelf. Je beschikt over een rijbewijs en verplaatst je graag naar klanten. Ervaring met trainingen, presenteren of het begeleiden van groepen is een plus. Ervaring binnen de overheid is een grote plus, maar geen vereiste. Een goede kennis van het Frans en het Engels is een grote plus, maar geen vereiste. Ook als je aan het begin van je loopbaan staat, horen we graag van je. Laat ons vooral zien hoe je communiceert, mensen meeneemt en zelf met AI aan de slag gaat. Meer info over de vacature en Aimbtenaar?: https://www.aimbtenaar.be/ai-trainer

We work horizontally across the organization, with teams in Mechanical, Supply Chain, Collision, and International, primarily supporting in-product use cases. You'll join a small team of applied scientists and ML engineers across Europe and the US, and you'll report to the head of Applied AI/ML. This is a mid-level individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership . Success in this role means you improve business metrics across our product lines and make a real, meaningful impact on the organization. Our projects cover a wide range of problems, so we'll match your first projects to your background. You don't need experience in every area below. If you meet most of the requirements and the work interests you, please apply. What You'll Do Develop and apply machine learning models for search & ranking , recommendation engines , forecasting , classification , customer analytics , anomaly detection , and LLM-powered solutions . Partner with product , engineering , and business teams to identify opportunities where AI/ML can solve real business challenges and deliver measurable impact. Build and maintain production-grade ML systems , including feature engineering , training pipelines , deployment , monitoring , and model retraining . Evaluate model performance through offline testing , A/B testing , shadow mode , and causal analysis to ensure reliable business outcomes. Analyze data to generate actionable insights that improve customer experience , retention , operational efficiency , and business performance . Present results, recommendations, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders . Create clear documentation , share knowledge, and support teams in adopting and maintaining AI-driven solutions. Collaborate with the Applied AI/ML team to establish best practices , evaluate emerging technologies , and drive continuous innovation. What You Bring At least 3 years of applied data science or machine learning experience. At least one model that you took to production and that moved a measurable business metric. Strong Python and SQL , with production-quality code, testing habits, and version control. A solid base in statistics and machine learning, and good judgment about when a simple approach is enough. Hands-on experience in at least one of the problem areas above, such as ranking, recommendation, classification, forecasting, or churn modeling. Experience building data pipelines and deploying models on a cloud ML platform, such as Amazon SageMaker, Azure ML, or Databricks. We use AWS (including SageMaker), Airflow, and MLflow. Equivalent tools also count as experience. Comfort with large, messy transactional and behavioral data. Clear written and spoken English. Experience explaining tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. Nice to Have Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field. Search relevance or recommender systems in e-commerce or a marketplace, including learning to rank, embedding-based retrieval, or candidate generation with re-ranking. Power analysis and causal inference methods. LLMs in production and evaluation harnesses for LLM output. Real-time model serving and low-latency inference, in addition to batch scoring. Experience with experiment design and offline evaluation. Amazon SageMaker, Terraform, infrastructure as code. Retail media, sponsored placement, or advertising relevance. Automotive, automotive e-commerce, or B2B parts and supply chain, including complex product catalogs and taxonomies. Knowledge of industry standards such as ACES, PIES, or PCDB, or of OE catalogs. How We Work We value collaboration , ownership , and pragmatic problem-solving. We prioritize shared success over individual wins. We expect scientists to ship and own their work in production . We are measurement-first and evidence-driven. We encourage experimentation , continuous learning , and challenging assumptions. We leverage AI-assisted development while maintaining high standards for quality , reliability , and accountability .

items.desc: ABOUT DESCARTES UNDERWRITING Join Descartes and contribute to our mission: Building Resilience in a World at Risk . Descartes is a corporate insurance group for worldwide companies and institutions. Descartes was born from a conviction that the growing complexity of corporate and climate risks demands a new approach to insurance. At the forefront of AI and Data analysis, Descartes utilises cutting-edge technology combined with a new generation of data sources, to model, assess and manage risks. Since 2019, Descartes has secured a leading position in parametric (re)insurance combining scientific & technological expertise with a new approach. Parametric insurance , also known as index-based insurance, indemnifies clients within days based on pre-defined payout structures when a specific triggering event occurs, the payout process is both fast and transparent. The company has been financed with over $141M by investors including Highland Europe, BlackFin, Serena, Cathay, Eurazeo and Battery Ventures. Our highly diverse and specialized team of 250+ people includes the largest modelling team in the industry featuring tech and modeling innovators, scientists in physics and climatology, as well as insurance veterans and underwriters. With a global footprint and strong US presence, Descartes serves a diverse portfolio of clients in more than 60 countries, with 20+ offices spread across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin and North America. Find out more on https://descartesunderwriting.com/careers . ABOUT YOUR ROLE We are looking for a Data Science Intern to join our Underwriting team for a 6-month end-of-studies internship . Bridging applied mathematics and the business of climate risk, this hybrid role puts you at the heart of our business activities. You will contribute directly to pricing tailor-made parametric coverage for demanding global clients — all within short execution timelines. It is a highly collaborative position where you will master natural catastrophe risks by working daily with both our internal technical and commercial teams and our external network of brokers while nurturing relationships with our various clients. At the core of our company’s business activity, your missions will focus on : Data & Risk Modeling : Build and refine statistical and applied mathematics models in Python to evaluate natural perils (wildfires, floods, cyclones, earthquakes, etc.), shaping them into actionable pricing metrics. Structuring & Pricing : Analyze large datasets to structure, price, and customize parametric insurance proposals that directly address the financial and operational risks of international corporate and public sector clients. Client-facing Activities : Translate complex modeling results into clear business propositions and gather feedback to fine-tune the insurance coverage to their specific needs. Cross-Functional Collaboration : Connect Descartes’ internal engine to the external market (clients and brokers). You will partner closely with Software, Commercial, and Legal teams to transform client requirements into robust and scalable insurance solutions and product documentation. Your missions will evolve in the future as Descartes is growing fast and many exciting projects are waiting for you. It's a unique opportunity to take a closer look inside a fast-growing scale up with huge ambitions ! ABOUT YOU EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS Student from universities or engineering schools with a specialization in applied mathematics, actuarial science, climate & meteorological studies, computer science or/and data science for business; Ideally a previous professional experience (internship) in data science, insurance or climate modelling. SKILLS Proficiency in Python (e.g. pandas, numpy, scikit-learn); Highly skilled in statistics, probabilities, applied mathematics; Eye for quality and attention to detail; Fluency in English (written and verbal communication) is required ; Good command of one additional language (e.g. Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish…) is valued. MINDSET Strong interest in climate change resilience and natural perils modelling (wildfires, hail, tsunamis, earthquakes, etc); Excellent team player able to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-cultural scale-up environment; Pragmatic approach to technical problem-solving with high attention and eagerness to commercial issues while respecting deadlines. WHY JOIN DESCARTES UNDERWRITING ? Technical Excellence : Work and learn alongside top-tier scientists and engineers from world-class institutions and research labs. Real Impact : Join a company with a true purpose and directly contribute to solving global climate resilience challenges using cutting-edge data. Dynamic Culture : Thrive in a collaborative, fast-growing scale-up driven by our core value of diversity and openness across international teams. Perks & Benefits : Competitive internship stipend, meal vouchers (Swile), 60% public transport reimbursement. At Descartes Underwriting, we cherish the …

items.desc: Location: Hybrid - Birkirkara, Malta Reporting to: Head of Data & Analytics Your mission Help build and run the experimentation framework across departments, and set the standard for how tests are designed, run and read out. Build models for end user value, churn, bonusing and segmentation, and deploy them to production, working with the data engineers who own the platform and pipelines. Measure impact through A/B tests and careful analysis, so decisions are backed by evidence. Work closely with data engineering, CRM, product and commercial to understand what they need and deliver solutions that fit. Turn complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations, and help the business with ad-hoc analysis when it matters. Keep production models healthy, accurate and trusted through monitoring, drift checks and retraining. Build with AI: LLM-powered features, plus agents and AI coding tools that speed up analysis and decisions across the team. Bring creative thinking to open-ended problems, and spot where data science can add value before anyone asks. What You Bring 2+ years in data science , with models and analyses that reached production and drove real decisions. 1+ year of experience in e-entertainment (e.g. iGaming). A strong foundation in statistics and experimentation, including A/B testing and causal inference. Solid hands-on machine learning skills, and the judgement to know when a simple approach is the right one. Excellent Python and SQL . Experience with a modern data stack, ideally ours: Snowflake, dbt and Airflow. You’ll take models from notebook to production on it. Hands-on experience building with LLMs (for example Claude or similar APIs) for features, agents or analysis, and real comfort using AI to speed up your work. Clear communication, strong ownership, and the drive to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Buscamos un Data Scientist especializado en optimización de procesos industriales mediante Machine Learning, con experiencia demostrable en el diseño, entrenamiento y despliegue de modelos predictivos y prescriptivos aplicados resolviendo problemas de optimización en el ámbito industrial. El candidato trabajará dentro de los equipos de analítica avanzada y transformación digital colaborando estrechamente con ingenieros de proceso, data engineers y arquitectos cloud, en proyectos orientados a maximizar la eficiencia operativa, reducir consumos y optimizar parámetros críticos de proceso. ¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? Analizar procesos industriales e identificar variables críticas de control y optimización. Desarrollar modelos predictivos y prescriptivos (regresión, series temporales, optimización multivariable, reinforcement learning, etc.) aplicados a la mejora de rendimiento de procesos. Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos y ML en entornos Databricks / Azure Machine Learning, integrados con sistemas SCADA, historians o DCS. Realizar feature engineering sobre grandes volúmenes de datos operacionales (sensor data, tiempos de ciclo, variables de control, alarmas). Validar la calidad y consistencia de los datos procedentes de entornos OT y IT, aplicando buenas prácticas de data quality y MLOps. Colaborar con equipos de ingeniería y operaciones en la interpretación de resultados y propuestas de mejora operacional. Participar en el diseño de dashboards de control de KPIs y rendimiento de modelos en Power BI o similar. Contribuir a la creación de frameworks y librerías comunes de ML para proyectos futuros. Qué tenemos para ti? Posibilidad de modalidad remoto 100% Horario flexible y jornada de verano intensiva. Plan de formación continua. Formarás parte de un equipo consolidado y con experiencia. Retribución flexible y competitiva. Cultura abierta. Si eres una persona apasionada por la tecnología y con ganas de nuevos retos, ¡te estamos buscando! 💙💚 #SomosAltia La presente oferta de empleo está redactada teniendo en cuenta la imparcialidad y no discriminación por razón de género, raza, ideología o cualquier otro motivo. Especialmente, se tiene en cuenta el respeto a la normativa vigente relativa a la igualdad de género entre mujeres y hombres (Real Decreto-ley 6/2019). Experiencia con Databricks (PySpark, MLflow, Delta Lake). Conocimientos sólidos en modelización estadística, regresión multivariable, clustering, PCA, series temporales, optimización y simulación de procesos. Programación en Python (pandas, scikit-learn, numpy, matplotlib, etc.). Experiencia en entornos Azure: Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure ML, Azure DevOps. Familiaridad con conceptos de MLOps y CI/CD aplicados a proyectos de analítica avanzada. Capacidad para trabajar con datos de sensores, sistemas SCADA, PI System, DCS u otros sistemas de planta. Conocimientos Valorables Experiencia en procesos de refino, petroquímica, upstream, generación eléctrica o energías renovables. Conocimientos de Reinforcement Learning, Optimization Algorithms (genéticos, bayesianos, etc.). Experiencia en integración con sistemas de control industrial o mantenimiento predictivo. Experiencia en Visualización con Power BI o frameworks Python (Plotly, Dash). Certificaciones en Databricks, Azure Machine Learning o AI Engineer Associate (Microsoft). Familiaridad con prácticas de Data Governance y calidad del dato industrial. Competencias personales: Enfoque analítico y orientado a resultados. Alta capacidad de comunicación con perfiles no técnicos (ingeniería de procesos, producción). Capacidad de trabajo en equipos multidisciplinares y entornos corporativos complejos. Proactividad en la identificación de oportunidades de mejora mediante IA y ML.Curiosidad técnica y capacidad de aprendizaje continuo. #🌐Altia

items.desc: Ben jij klaar om bedrijven te helpen AI écht te benutten? Bij NOBRAINERS draait alles om mensen, niet om tools. We helpen zorgorganisaties, bedrijven en overheden om AI écht onderdeel te maken van hun werk. Geen losse experimenten, maar duurzame verandering die verschil maakt. Dat betekent werken met visie, lef en altijd mét oog voor de menselijke kant. Als collega bij NOBRAINERS stap je in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar je zelf mee kunt bouwen. We zoeken mensen die nieuwsgierig zijn, verantwoordelijkheid durven nemen en samen met ons impact willen maken in een wereld die volop in beweging is. Waar ga je je vooral mee bezighouden? Je adviseert organisaties over de inzet van AI binnen hun processen en strategie Je begeleidt klanten bij het implementeren en doorontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen Je vertaalt complexe AI-concepten naar praktische, haalbare toepassingen Je organiseert workshops en kennissessies om teams mee te nemen in de mogelijkheden van AI Je volgt de laatste trends en technologieën en vertaalt deze naar kansen voor onze klanten Hoe kom je binnen? HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van informatica, data science of vergelijkbaar Ervaring met AI, data-analyse of automatisering (ervaring met tools als Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI of vergelijkbaar is een pré) Sterke analytische vaardigheden en de capaciteit om complexe vraagstukken eenvoudig uit te leggen Een proactieve houding en de drive om organisaties te helpen vernieuwen Communicatief sterk, nieuwsgierig en altijd op zoek naar verbetering Wat krijg je ervoor terug? items.desc: Generative AI is rapidly entering the work of security professionals, but do we know what its impact will be? In this project you will help us find out. You will build and run an online experiment in which participants assess potential threats of violence with the help of GenAI. You will get hands-on experience with a real research project, from design to data collection and analysis, in a supportive team of researchers. Your job Responsibilities The Department of Sociology is seeking a research assistant for a research project on the use of generative AI in threat assessment. The position is for 3-4 days a week, from 15 January until 30 June 2027 (depending on the number of days you work). You will be responsible for the technical design and implementation of an online experiment in which participants can make use of a GenAI tool. You will carry out activities like: Building and testing the online experiment, including the integration of an LLM that participants can interact with; Setting up and maintaining the technical infrastructure needed to run the experiment; Running pilots, monitoring data collection, and solving technical problems along the way; Processing the collected data, and contributing to the analysis. Your qualities We Are Looking For a Technically Strong, Curious And Independent Person With a Hands-on Mentality, Who Enjoys Translating Research Questions Into a Working Product. We Are Looking For You, If You Have A completed or nearly completed master’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related field; Experience working with large language models; Programming skills, for example in Python; Experience with setting up and managing servers or cloud environments; Good command of English. Furthermore, Your Suitability Is Ideally Exemplified By Experience with (online) data collection or experimental research; Command of Dutch; The ability to explain technical choices clearly to non-technical audiences. The main objective of this project is to develop a centralized dashboard on the Skywise platform that unifies production line information to offer a complete, integrated, and real-time view of the operational status. items.desc: JOB TITLE: DATA SCIENTIST LOCATION: 9300 AALST, BELGIUM LANGUAGES: DUTCH WORK MODE: 100% FULLTIME (HYBRID 2- 3 DAYS ONSITE PER WEEK) CONTRACT DURATION: 01/12/2026 - 30/04/2027 JOB DESCRIPTION ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Profile for Support in the maintenance of the water quality model chain. The Client water quality model chain consists of the following models: Fertilizer Allocation Model (BAM) Nutrient Emission Model for Agriculture (NEMO) Planification and Management of Water Disposal (PEGASE) Ecological Model (ELMO) Hydromorphological Model (HYMO) The models are used by Client to substantiate the integrated water policy regarding physicochemical (nitrogen and phosphorus), ecological (macroinvertebrates), and hydromorphological water quality. The NEMO, ELMO, and HYMO models are written in Python, and the code is entirely self-managed by Client. Furthermore, all models in Python and R have pre- and post-processing scripts for processing input and output. For example, there is a validation toolbox written in Python, which uses Jupyter notebooks to validate model output. The assignment includes the following tasks to support and maintain the water quality model chain: Screening and optimizing model code with the aim of: profiling and potentially accelerating computation time, limiting dependencies, rationalizing functions and parameters, merging functions into modules, etc... This is for various tasks for the NEMO, ELMO, and HYMO models. Analyzing data streams and, based on this, creating an optimized data model One or more calls per week with the relevant colleagues of a model to follow up on the status, clarify any questions, and plan the next tasks. SKILLS Proven experience in creating a data model Proven experience in optimizing/tuning databases and queries Proven experience analyzing data flows Proven experience with scripting in Python and R At least 3 years of experience with demonstrable knowledge of the technology in question or a similar technology Proven experience with databases (SQL, Oracle) Proven experience with reporting Proven experience with scripting (Shell, perl, python) Proven experience in the optimal use of databases (e.g., Postgres)

Naast de ruim 47.000 beroepsmilitairen en 10.000 reservisten werken er ook bijna 30.000 burgers bij Defensie, samen zorgen we voor een professionele omgeving. Nu is het jouw moment om de stap te zetten. Als medewerker bij Defensie kun jij, in je eigen vakgebied, direct bijdragen aan een krachtige en toekomstbestendige defensieorganisatie. Het is tijd voor actie. Het is tijd voor Defensie. Wil je bijdragen aan de veiligheid van Nederland én werken met de nieuwste technologie? Kom ons team versterken binnen een nieuw programma bij het Commando Lucht- en Ruimtestrijdkrachten (CLRS)! Je komt te werken bij een nieuwe organisatie die bedrijfskritische oplossingen ontwikkelt waarmee datagedreven besluitvorming wordt ondersteund. Je stapt in een omgeving waar innovatie, cyberveiligheid en operationele slagkracht samenkomen, en waar jouw werk het verschil maakt voor commandanten. Dit ga je doen Als ML Ops Engineer werk je nauw samen met je collega data engineers en scientists om oplossingen te bouwen die standhouden in een complexe IT-omgeving. Je maakt van datamodellen een robuuste, betrouwbare AI-service. Je zorgt dat machine learning-modellen efficiënt, betrouwbaar en geautomatiseerd in productie kunnen worden genomen en beheerd. items.title: Data Scientist Oncology (m/w/d)
items.card: Ihre Aufgaben Wissenschaftliche Recherche, Prüfung und Aufbereitung klinischer Daten und Evidenzen aus Fachpublikationen sowie relevanten Datenbanken, insbesondere zu Sequenzierungs-, Protein- und Bildanalysedaten. Befüllung, Pflege und Qualitätssicherung einer zentralen Wissensdatenbank zur klinischen Bewertung und Klassifizierung multimodaler Biomarker. Analyse und Zusammenführung onkologischer Leitlinien,
items.desc: Unser Kunde, die Roche Diagnostics GmbH, ist mit rund 17.000 Mitarbeitenden an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland vertreten. Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich der Pharma und Diagnostik entwickelt, produziert und vertreibt unser Kunde Arzneimittel und diagnostische Tests. Das Ziel ist Krankheiten zu verhindern, zu erkennen und zu behandeln und medizinische Innovationen voranzutreiben. Am Standort Penzberg suchen wir Unterstützung im Bereich der wissenschaftlichen Datenkuratierung mit einem klaren Schwerpunkt auf Onkologie, Genomik und molekularen Biomarkern. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die wissenschaftliche Bewertung klinischer Evidenzen, die Interpretation genomischer Veränderungen sowie die Pflege und Qualitätssicherung einer zentralen onkologischen Wissensdatenbank, die als Grundlage für digitale klinische Entscheidungstools dient. Ihre Aufgaben Wissenschaftliche Recherche, Prüfung und Aufbereitung klinischer Daten und Evidenzen aus Fachpublikationen sowie relevanten Datenbanken, insbesondere zu Sequenzierungs-, Protein- und Bildanalysedaten. Befüllung, Pflege und Qualitätssicherung einer zentralen Wissensdatenbank zur klinischen Bewertung und Klassifizierung multimodaler Biomarker. Analyse und Zusammenführung onkologischer Leitlinien, wissenschaftlicher Literatur und regulatorischer Informationen zur Identifikation relevanter Genvarianten und Mutationsgruppen. Bewertung und Klassifizierung genomischer Veränderungen unter Berücksichtigung etablierter Standards wie AMP/ASCO/CAP und ACMG. Zusammenarbeit mit Pathologen bei der Annotation klinischer Probendaten sowie Pflege und Weiterentwicklung krankheitsspezifischer Klassifikationen. Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen hinsichtlich Varianteneinstufung, Datenkonsistenz und korrekter Zuordnung von Biomarkern und Varianten. Unterstützung bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung diagnostischer Panels auf Basis medizinischer Leitlinien und krankheitsspezifischer Mutationshäufigkeiten. Koordination von Datenbankänderungen, fachliche Abstimmung mit externen Dienstleistern sowie Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Softwareentwicklung und klinischen Fachbereichen. Ihre Qualifikationen Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Life Sciences, Biologie, Bioinformatik, Computer Science, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Fundierter wissenschaftlicher Schwerpunkt und nachweisbare Fachkenntnisse im Bereich Onkologie. Sehr gute Kenntnisse der Genomik, insbesondere Gene, Transkripte, Genom-Builds und Annotation genomischer Veränderungen. Kenntnisse relevanter Biomarker und genomischer Parameter wie TMB, MSI, HRD und LOH sowie einfacher und struktureller Varianten. Vertrautheit mit Variant-Klassifikationsstandards wie AMP/ASCO/CAP und ACMG sowie gängigen Krebsklassifikationen. Verständnis relevanter onkologischer Referenzdatenbanken wie COSMIC, gnomAD, Mitelman, dbNSFP und CIViC. Praktische Berufserfahrung in der Kuration klinischer Daten oder im Umfeld digitaler Gesundheitsprodukte. Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte, analytische und äußerst qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise.

items.desc: Job description: About the team: We are reinforcing our Product Data Governance & Excellenc e team at our location in Barcelona. Our team is responsible for establishing and maintaining the governance framework that ensures product data quality, consistency, and compliance across ZF Aftermarket. We define standards, monitor data quality, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and support the transformation of product data processes across ERP, PLM, Golden Record, and related business systems. Working closely with business and IT stakeholders globally, we enable trusted, governed, and scalable product data that supports operational excellence, digital transformation, and data-driven decision making throughout the organization. The Product Data AI & Automation Expert will drive continuous improvement across the Product Data Management organization by automating manual and repetitive activities, supporting data governance processes, and enabling scalable AI-driven solutions. The role focuses on improving efficiency, data quality, and process transparency while helping Governance Stewards and business stakeholders spend less time handling data and more time making business decisions. Job Description: What you can look forward to as Product Data AI & Automation Expert: Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across Product Data Governance, Golden Record, and data quality processes. Design, build, and deploy automation solutions using AI, Python, Power Automate, UiPath, Databricks, and related technologies to streamline repetitive data management activities. Develop AI-enabled solutions for data transformation, harmonization, cleansing, matching, classification, and enrichment across master and product data domains. Support ERP, PLM, Golden Record, and other transformation and migration initiatives through AI-assisted data standardization, validation, consolidation, and migration readiness activities. Apply AI/ML techniques to data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, completeness scoring, pattern mining, and governance controls within the Critical Attribute Framework. Automate cross-system comparisons, data validation, and monitoring activities to improve governance efficiency and reduce manual effort. Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and monitoring solutions (e.g., Power BI) to increase visibility, transparency, and measurability of product data processes. Partner with business and IT teams to embed automation capabilities while maintaining governance standards, controls, and ownership models. Document, standardize, and hand over automated solutions to ensure scalability, maintainability, and avoidance of single-point-of-failure risks. Monitor emerging AI, automation, and data management technologies and recommend adoption where they create measurable business value. Profile description: Your Profile as Product Data AI & Automation Expert: 3-5 years of experience designing and implementing automation solutions using Python, Power Automate, UiPath, or comparable technologies. 2+ years of hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques to data quality, master data management, matching, classification, anomaly detection, or related domains. Experience with data transformation, harmonization, cleansing, and migration activities in enterprise environments. Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Azure Synapse, or similar, as well as strong SQL skills. Good understanding of Product Data Management (PDM), Master Data Management (MDM), and data governance principles. Experience developing reporting and monitoring solutions using Power BI or similar analytics platforms. Knowledge of ERP, PLM, Golden Record, or similar enterprise data ecosystems is considered a strong advantage. Automotive, aftermarket, or manufacturing industry experience is a plus. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical solutions into clear business value. Fluent in English

items.desc: 🔹 Rol 🔹 En BILBOMÁTICA (Grupo ALTIA) estamos creciendo hacia el futuro, y queremos contar contigo. Si quieres seguir desarrollándote como AI Engineer (AWS) y evolucionar profesionalmente hacia el ámbito de la arquitectura de Inteligencia Artificial, ¡sigue leyendo! Buscamos un/a AI Engineer con experiencia en desarrollo de software y entornos cloud AWS, que disfrute afrontando retos técnicos, analizando soluciones existentes y participando directamente en su evolución y mejora. Este rol está orientado a profesionales con una sólida base en ingeniería de software, experiencia práctica en arquitecturas serverless y conocimientos de integración de servicios de Inteligencia Artificial. Buscamos una persona resolutiva, con autonomía técnica, capacidad de aprendizaje y ganas de asumir progresivamente mayores responsabilidades en el diseño de soluciones.. Valoramos especialmente la experiencia práctica, el criterio técnico y el potencial de desarrollo profesional. 🔹 Quiénes Somos 🔹 Llevamos más de 30 años creando soluciones digitales preparadas para el futuro, capaces de generar valor real y provocar cambios significativos. Somos un equipo de más de 4.000 grandes profesionales repartidos en más de 30 localizaciones de 10 países que, desde 1994, suman su energía y aplican su visión innovadora de la tecnología a proyectos realmente relevantes, para más de 1.000 organizaciones que son motores del cambio. Nos mueve un claro propósito: crecer haciendo crecer, y hacerlo, además, de forma sostenible y duradera. Tenemos claro que solo seremos importantes si juntos aportamos un impacto positivo y todos evolucionamos en el proceso.Descubre un entorno colaborativo e innovador, en el que sumamos para potenciar nuestro talento y llegar mucho más lejos. La sostenibilidad y el desarrollo del talento son dos de nuestros ejes estratégicos. No son palabras vacías: es una convicción y un compromiso firme. 🔹 El proyecto 🔹 Te incorporarás a un proyecto tecnológico de Inteligencia Artificial y Data, enfocado en la evolución y optimización de soluciones inteligentes dentro de un entorno cloud AWS. Participarás en la mejora de una plataforma de procesamiento inteligente de documentos (IDP), trabajando sobre una arquitectura serverless y servicios de Inteligencia Artificial. El objetivo será contribuir a su evolución tecnológica, reforzando aspectos como la estabilidad, el rendimiento, la mantenibilidad y la escalabilidad. ¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades? Analizar soluciones existentes, comprendiendo su código, arquitectura, integraciones y componentes técnicos. Identificar deuda técnica, posibles incidencias y oportunidades de optimización. Desarrollar, refactorizar y desplegar mejoras sobre los servicios y componentes de la plataforma. Trabajar con arquitecturas serverless y servicios de IA dentro del ecosistema AWS. Participar en la monitorización, resolución de incidencias y optimización del rendimiento de las soluciones en producción. Colaborar en la definición de mejoras arquitectónicas y asumir progresivamente responsabilidades como referente técnico. 🔹 Stack tecnológico 🔹 Cloud & Serverless: AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon SQS. Inteligencia Artificial: Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker. Desarrollo: Python (preferentemente). Arquitectura: Servicios desacoplados, arquitecturas orientadas a eventos e integración de APIs. Operación y despliegue: Monitorización, debugging, Git y CI/CD. 🔹 Lo que ofrecemos 🔹 ⚡Proyecto de alto impacto 👫 Un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo 🚀 Plan de Carrera 📘 Plan de Formación 💸 Retribución Flexible 🔹 Requisitos Mínimos 🔹 Experiencia sólida en desarrollo de software, preferiblemente con Python. Experiencia práctica trabajando con AWS, especialmente en entornos serverless con servicios como Lambda, S3 y SQS. Conocimientos de integración de servicios o soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial mediante APIs. Buscamos, sobre todo, una persona con buenas bases técnicas, iniciativa y ganas de seguir creciendo. Si tienes experiencia desarrollando soluciones sobre AWS y te interesa especializarte en Inteligencia Artificial, nos encantará conocerte. La presente oferta de empleo está redactada teniendo en cuenta la imparcialidad y no discriminación por razón de género, raza, ideología o cualquier otro motivo. Especialmente, se tiene en cuenta el respeto a la normativa vigente relativa a la igualdad de género entre mujeres y hombres (Real Decreto-ley 6/2019). #🌐Bilbomática

items.desc: Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers. De uitdaging Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken. Je werk bestaat onder meer uit: Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen. Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining. Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning. Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden. Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap. Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als ontwikkelaar, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met AI en machine learning. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras. Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI. Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn. Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow. Je kunt onderbouwen welk model of welke tool in welke situatie het beste werkt, en je maakt je nieuwe tools snel eigen. Je volgt generatieve AI op de voet, van prompt via context naar harness engineering, en weet hoe je oplossingen met LLM’s evalueert, monitort en verbetert. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling. Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je gemaakte assignment, ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Raoel via raoel.fatehmahomed@linkit.nl of via +31638859892. Over ons LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende …

items.desc:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.
 When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human . This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.
 The work combines research and production engineering:
 The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers .
 The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.
 Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.
 Key responsibilities
 Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals
 Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour
 Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies
 Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find
 Work with the teams whose agents, environments, and evaluations we run on, so that false positives get fixed quickly without weakening protection
 Contribute to the team's direction, including what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest
 Minimum qualifications
 Ability to organise and prioritise several parallel streams of work, and to communicate clearly with the teams that work affects
 Ability to critically review code and experiment results, including work produced by AI agents
 Sincere interest in developing safe and beneficial AI systems
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience leading ambiguous technical projects and setting direction for other engineers or researchers
 Experience evaluating large language models, developing classifiers, or operating high-scale production systems where requirements change quickly
 Experience building detection systems where true positives are rare and false positives are costly, such as abuse, fraud, spam, or intrusion detection
 Experience running low-latency, high-availability services that other systems depend on, including being on call for them
 Experience fine-tuning language models, or working with probes and other methods that read model internals
 Experience with LLM inference or serving infrastructure, or with integrating new components into training infrastructure
 Background in security, such as sandboxing or detection and response
 Familiarity with research on AI control, scalable oversight, agent safety, or reinforcement learning

items.card: ABOUT THE ROLE Perplexity is growing fast, and every new employee, laptop, SaaS app and integration expands what we have to protect. We want enterprise security that's strong by default, mostly automated, and invisible to people doing their jobs. We're looking for an Enterprise Security Engineer to own the security of how Perplexity works internally: our identities, devices, SaaS applications and corporate access.
items.desc:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Perplexity is growing fast, and every new employee, laptop, SaaS app and integration expands what we have to protect. We want enterprise security that's strong by default, mostly automated, and invisible to people doing their jobs.



We're looking for an Enterprise Security Engineer to own the security of how Perplexity works internally: our identities, devices, SaaS applications and corporate access. You'll sit on the Security Engineering team and work closely with IT, building controls and automation together so the secure path is also the easy one.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own identity security: SSO and MFA policy, conditional access and device trust, privileged and admin access, service accounts, and break-glass procedures.

 - Harden our SaaS stack. Manage OAuth app and integration risk, admin roles, sharing and retention settings, and audit logging across our core collaboration and productivity tools.

 - Define and enforce endpoint security baselines with IT, across EDR, device management, disk encryption, OS and browser policy, and software allowlisting.

 - Build access governance that scales: just-in-time and request-based access, regular access reviews, and joiner/mover/leaver automation that removes access promptly and reliably.

 - Write detections for corporate threats such as account takeover, OAuth abuse, data exfiltration, insider risk and malicious extensions, and respond when they fire.

 - Automate everything you can. Write code and infrastructure-as-code to configure systems, remediate drift, and replace manual tickets with self-service workflows.

 - Secure corporate network access and email, including zero-trust remote access, phishing protection and domain security.

 - Partner with IT, People, Legal and GRC on new tools and vendors, security reviews, and evidence for compliance programs.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years in security engineering, with significant time on corporate or enterprise security, identity, or endpoint security.

 - Hands-on depth with at least one major identity provider (such as Okta or Entra ID), including SSO, SCIM, MFA and conditional access policy.

 - Experience securing SaaS environments such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Slack, and developer tools, including OAuth and third-party app risk.

 - Experience with endpoint security and device management across macOS (and ideally Windows and Linux), including EDR, MDM and configuration baselines.

 - Proficiency in at least one programming language (such as Python or Go) and comfort building automation against vendor APIs. Experience with infrastructure-as-code is a plus.

 - Experience writing detections and investigating incidents with a SIEM or log platform.

 - Good judgment about trade-offs between security and productivity, and the ability to roll out controls without slowing the company down.

 - Bonus: experience at a fast-growing company where you built enterprise security from an early stage.

 - Bonus: experience securing AI tools and agents in the workplace, such as agent access to SaaS data, browser agents, and AI app governance.

items.title: Cryogenic Materials Engineer (EN-MME-MM-2026-175-GRAP)
items.card: you will contribute to materials characterisation and qualification activities supporting a wide range of CERN projects and technologies. Your responsibilities will include supporting, planning and executing studies on materials and components, covering materials procurement, fabrication and assembly qualification, as well as overseeing quality control activities for the construction of particle accelerators.
items.desc:
As an Experienced Project Graduate, you will contribute to materials characterisation and qualification activities supporting a wide range of CERN projects and technologies.
 Your responsibilities will include supporting, planning and executing studies on materials and components, covering materials procurement, fabrication and assembly qualification, as well as overseeing quality control activities for the construction of particle accelerators.
 Working within the Materials & Metrology team, you will investigate the microstructure, chemical composition, properties and failure mechanisms of metallic and other engineering materials using the section's advanced characterisation capabilities, including light microscopy, Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), microanalysis, X-ray diffraction (XRD), hardness testing and instrumented indentation.
 You will also perform mechanical testing at both ambient and cryogenic temperatures, including fracture toughness assessments, and conduct failure analyses when required.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Investigate the behaviour, properties and failure mechanisms of engineering materials and components.
 Characterise materials using advanced analytical techniques, including light and electron microscopy (SEM), Energy Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDS), Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD), Focused Ion Beam (FIB), X-ray diffraction (XRD), automated image analysis and instrumented indentation, including nanoindentation and atomic force microscopy (AFM).
 Plan and perform mechanical testing at room and cryogenic temperatures, and help in the development of dedicated test facilities, experimental procedures, and data analysis protocols.
 Lead the execution of failure analyses of materials and components, combining microstructural and mechanical characterisation with non-destructive examination methods, including visual inspection (VT), penetrant testing (PT), ultrasonic testing (UT), radiographic testing (RT) and computed tomography (CT).
 Develop testing strategies and communicate results by defining appropriate test programmes, improving characterisation methodologies and presenting findings to CERN project teams, industrial partners and research institutes.
 Your profile: 
 Experience in materials engineering, with a strong background in performing experimental materials characterisation and mechanical testing at cryogenic temperatures.
 Experience working in a multidisciplinary materials laboratory equipped for metallurgical analysis and mechanical testing.
 Would be considered as an asset: 
 Experience in advanced mechanical testing in liquid helium (fracture toughness, fatigue), including experimental implementation and evaluation of test results.
 Experience in interpretation of NDT results (RT, PT, CT, UT) applied to assess material soundness.
 Skills: 
 Hands-on experience in mechanical testing of structural materials in liquid helium.
 Ability to integrate complementary materials characterisation methods (SEM/EDS, XRD, EBSD) to address complex technical materials challenges.
 Ability to process and interpret experimental data using scientific software and scripting tools.
 Strong organisational skills to coordinate experimental campaigns.
 Clear technical communication and reporting skills.
 Analytical thinking and effective problem-solving abilities.
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 You have a professional background in Materials / Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and have either: a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

Job closing date: 06.12.2026 at 23:59 CET. 
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

items.desc:
About the Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) 
 The Swiss Data Science Center (SDSC) is a strategic focus area of the ETH domain, with EPFL and ETH Zurich as founding partners, developing into a National Research Infrastructure in 2025. Its mission is to support academic labs, hospitals, industry and public sector stakeholders, including cantonal and federal administrations, through their entire data science journey, from the collection and management of data to machine learning, AI, and industrialization. With a large multidisciplinary team of professionals across three locations (Lausanne, Zurich, Villigen), the SDSC provides expertise and services to various domains, such as health and biomedical sciences, energy and sustainability, climate and environment, and large-scale scientific infrastructures. More: www.datascience.ch 
 Your mission 
 You will provide machine learning engineering expertise in the context of several SDSC partnerships in the French part of Switzerland. In this role, you will meet partners (companies, public sector entities, NGOs) to understand their needs and help them define a high-impact project with the SDSC. Together with the SDSC data scientists, you will be responsible for the societal and/or industrial impact of your projects thanks to your machine learning engineering expertise.
 Main duties and responsibilities include 
 Elaborate solutions that convert data science prototypes into impact in the context of an industry/public sector/NGO collaboration, with particular focus on the engineering side and in view of meeting production requirements
 Create original solutions with business partners, from solution design to industrialization
 Share expertise in machine learning engineering (and related fields) with fellow data scientists/machine learning engineers
 Presenting to a non-technical audience will also be part of your activities.
 Your profile 
 The ideal candidate has:
 Master degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or similar field
 Good knowledge of machine learning concepts
 Demonstrated expertise in machine learning engineering, particularly in an industrial context
 Ability to present to various audiences
 Open to collaborative work and team spirit
 Highly appreciated: experience as a full-stack engineer, experience as a (data) architect, experience deploying LLM-based solutions in industrial contexts
 Fluent in English; knowledge of French highly appreciated
 We offer 
 Do you see yourself helping Switzerland become more data-driven? Are you passionate about data science and with experience in machine learning? Are you keen to share what you know and get exposed to several projects in various domains? Are you eager to be part of a diverse and adaptable team with equal growth opportunities of its members at its core? If your answer to these questions is yes, you should consider joining us. Together, we can help move the Swiss landscape to the next level of data science.
 During your time at the Swiss Data Science Center, you will benefit from the following opportunities:
 Develop your soft skills and meet with key stakeholders in several industries
 Interact with and learn from fellow data scientists
 Discover new data science applications in various industries
 Exchange on advanced machine learning topics with our academic experts
 We actively promote a healthy work-life balance in the workplace. We are looking for candidates willing to contribute to an inclusive environment and eager to continuously learn.
 Informations

 Activity Rate : 100.00 
 Contract Type: CDD
 Duration: 1 year, renewable 
 Reference: 2604 
 Contact
 We look forward to receiving your online application including application letter, CV and diploma(s). Applications via email or postal services will not be considered. For further information about the Swiss Data Science Center please visit our website: www.datascience.ch 
 Questions regarding the position should be directed to hrdatascience@datascience.ch with the job n° reference.
