 Start your journey towards a rewarding career! 
 We’re looking for curious, motivated graduates with strong people skills who want to grow, learn, and make a difference. If you hold a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience, apply for our 18-month Graduate Programme starting on 1 September 2027. 
 You’ll gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of reinsurance, rotate into different local teams, and receive tailored training to build your expertise. This is your opportunity to shape your career, help protect societies from the world’s most threatening hazards, and contribute to making the world more resilient. 
 By the end of the programme, you’ll have built the skills, foundations and network to pursue a wide range of career opportunities within Swiss Re. 
 About the Role 
 AI is changing how finance works, and you can help shape how that happens at Swiss Re. In this role, you'll join Global Finance Operations & Transformation (GFO&T) at a key moment in Finance's AI transformation. You'll help turn new technology into practical solutions that make our global finance operations faster, smarter and more reliable. You'll work with finance experts, actuaries, data specialists and technology teams, and see first-hand how a global reinsurer uses AI to make better decisions. 
 Find opportunities to use AI, automation and analytics across global finance operations such as reporting, closing and analysis 
 Help design, test and roll out AI-powered tools and prototypes, from first idea to real business use 
 Turn complex financial and actuarial data into clear insights that help stakeholders make decisions 
 Keep up with the latest AI trends and share ideas on how GFO&T can use them responsibly 
 Help colleagues across Finance adopt new tools and ways of working, so that change sticks 
 About the Team 
 You'll be part of a team that sits where finance and technology meet, with a shared goal of building the finance function of the future. We are a diverse, collaborative group of finance professionals, actuaries, data experts and change-makers. We like to experiment, learn quickly and share what we find. Ideas are welcome from everyone, whatever their seniority, and our leaders give graduates real responsibility from day one, with the guidance and support to succeed. 
 Our work has visible impact across Swiss Re. It helps the business get insights faster, work more efficiently and decide with more confidence. You'll also learn from colleagues who are passionate about using AI to make a real difference. Through your rotation(s), you'll have the opportunity to work in other area(s) and build a strong network. 
 About You 
 You have a can-do attitude and a real enthusiasm for AI and what it can achieve. You're curious, proactive and happy to roll up your sleeves to solve problems, even when the path isn't clearly mapped out. You communicate clearly, enjoy working with others and can explain technical ideas to non-technical colleagues. Above all, you're excited to be part of a transformation and to keep learning as technology changes.

 University degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) in Actuarial Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Finance, or a related quantitative field, with up to 3 years of professional experience 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex information 
 A genuine interest in AI, with a good understanding of current trends such as generative AI, large language models and automation 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence working across different stakeholders 
 Strong written and spoken English skills 
 Nice to Have: 
 Hands-on experience with programming or data tools such as Python, SQL, R or Power BI 
 Experience building or experimenting with AI or machine learning solutions, for example through university projects, hackathons or personal projects 
 Understanding of financial or actuarial concepts in insurance, such as financial reporting or IFRS 17 
 Previous internship or relevant experience in insurance, financial services or a digital transformation setting 
 The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process.

items.desc: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: Join AMD's University Program team in Dublin and help universities across France and Europe use AMD technologies in teaching and research. You will work directly with faculty, researchers, and students, combining hands-on technical support with training, demonstrations, and collaborative projects. You will work across AI, GPU Computing, and High-Performance Computing (HPC), helping academic partners adopt AMD hardware and software technologies in teaching and research. The role offers the opportunity to build long-term relationships with leading universities and research institutions, develop technical content and educational resources, and contribute to initiatives that strengthen engagement between AMD and the academic community. Fluency in French and professional fluency in English are important for working with partners across the region. You are adaptable, collaborative, organized, and comfortable working independently while working closely with geographically distributed teams. You enjoy learning new technologies and are excited about enabling innovation through teaching, research, and technical collaboration. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Build technical relationships with faculty, researchers, and students, with a particular focus on France. Help academic partners adopt AMD technologies for teaching and research in AI, GPU Computing, HPC, and related areas. Develop and deliver technical training, workshops, laboratory exercises, demonstrations, design examples, and other educational resources. Collaborate with academic partners on research, teaching, curriculum development, and student-focused programs. Respond to technical questions and help resolve software, hardware, and development-environment issues. Contribute to the evaluation and development of systems and technical solutions for academic use. Collaborate with AMD engineering, software, research, and marketing teams to support academic initiatives. Represent AMD at universities, conferences, workshops, hackathons, and other academic events. Establish and grow long-term engagement plans with key academic partners across the region. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Professional fluency in French and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Familiarity with AI, GPU programming, High-Performance Computing, parallel computing, or related technologies. Experience with AMD GPU software, programming environments, hardware development tools, or computer architecture concepts. Experience developing and delivering technical training, workshops, tutorials, or educational content. Experience with software development, debugging, testing, and technical problem-solving. Experience working in an academic research or teaching environment, or in applications engineering, developer relations, technical customer support, or related technical roles. Strong presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently. Willingness to travel regularly throughout France and Europe ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.  We Are 
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 
 You Are 
 You are an engineer who knows how to read RTL, debug a timing path, and work through a problem methodically. When a design constraint conflicts with a performance target, you dig in, ask the right questions, and find the tradeoff. You are comfortable learning new tools and flows quickly, and you do not need perfect information to make progress. 
 At Synopsys, you will work on Interface IP used in smartphones, automotive systems, and AI accelerators. The team is experienced, and they will teach you, but you need to show up ready to contribute. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Design and implement digital logic for Interface IP subsystems supporting MIPI DSI, MIPI CSI, UCIe, and other high-speed protocols 
 Run synthesis, place and route, and timing closure using industry-standard ASIC implementation tools 
 Debug design issues across RTL, gate-level netlist, and physical implementation stages 
 Develop and optimize implementation scripts using TCL, Python, or Perl to automate flows 
 Collaborate with verification engineers to ensure implementation matches functional intent and meets coverage goals 
 Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical documentation 
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Your implementation work will directly affect performance, power, and area of Interface IP used in millions of devices worldwide 
 You will help close timing on subsystems enabling high-speed data transfer in AI platforms and automotive systems 
 The scripts and flows you develop will improve efficiency for the implementation team 
 Your collaboration with verification will catch issues earlier, reducing costly respins 
 You will contribute to IP meeting the requirements of leading semiconductor companies 
 The technical foundation you build will prepare you for larger, more complex designs as you grow 
 What You'll Need 
 BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field 
 Strong foundation in digital logic design, timing analysis, and ASIC design fundamentals 
 Ability to read and understand RTL code 
 Problem-solving skills that go beyond textbook exercises 
 English communication skills sufficient for technical discussions and documentation 
 Exposure to Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL is a strong plus 
 Familiarity with Python, Perl, or TCL scripting is helpful 
 Who You Are 
 You make progress with available information and refine as you learn more 
 When debugging, you form a hypothesis, test it, and adjust based on results 
 You work independently but know when to ask for help 
 You use design reviews as learning opportunities 
 You can explain technical tradeoffs clearly in writing and conversation 
 You communicate early when deadlines are at risk 
 The Team You'll Be Part Of 
 You will join the Interface IP team, a global group building subsystem solutions for MIPI DSI, MIPI CSI, UCIe, and other high-speed interfaces. The team works closely with verification, architecture, and customer-facing teams to deliver IP that meets performance and quality standards required by leading semiconductor companies. 
 Rewards and Benefits 
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 
 At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Starting from business questions and real-world challenges, you identify and shape high-value AI opportunities and translate them into concrete, technically grounded, and validated AI use cases. Working closely with AI researchers, engineers, customers, and end users, you bridge domain needs and AI capabilities. You help determine where AI can create value, whether an opportunity is technically meaningful, and what is required to turn it into a successful R&D trajectory. More specifically, you will: Starting from a business request, analyze complex problems, processes, and workflows to identify potential AI opportunities and use cases. Identify and engage relevant stakeholders and uncover underlying needs through interviews, workshops, observations, and co-creation. Collaborate with researchers, engineers, customers, end users, and colleagues or external partners with expertise in the relevant application domain to identify and prioritize AI opportunities based on potential value, technical feasibility, and fit with imec’s research capabilities. Contribute to AI opportunity discovery in technology-intensive domains such as digital twins, AI for semiconductor manufacturing, AI for chip applications, and HW/SW co-design. Facilitate opportunity discovery, ideation, Voice of the Customer, and concept validation workshops and synthesize technical and application insights to support decision-making. Structure and formalize AI use cases by defining clear requirements, specifications, constraints, data needs, relevant AI capabilities, and success criteria. Explore possible AI approaches together with technical experts and help translate these into a clear scope and direction for AI-driven R&D and prototype development. Within AI and innovation projects, work with researchers and developers to validate outcomes against the agreed requirements and success criteria at key milestones and project completion. Drive the execution of AI and innovation projects by aligning objectives, timelines, resources, risks, and dependencies, ensuring progress from concept validation to implementation. Across these activities, you will: Stay up to date with developments in AI and emerging technologies and assess their relevance for new applications and innovation opportunities. Act as a translator between AI experts and application domains, creating a shared understanding between research, engineering, and stakeholders and ensuring that promising AI technology is connected to relevant real-world challenges. The Team You will join the AI Use Cases team, part of imec’s ISSA expertise centre (Innovative Systems, Software and Applications). Our role is to bridge AI research and real-world application. We work with research teams and application domains to identify where AI can make a meaningful difference and turn those opportunities into well-defined use cases that can guide research and development. The team focuses on: AI opportunity discovery: Identifying and prioritizing relevant AI opportunities through structured exploration, technology awareness, and problem framing. Use case definition: Translating domain challenges into clear requirements, specifications, data needs, constraints, and success criteria. Research and application alignment: Creating a common understanding between AI researchers, engineers, domain experts, and stakeholders. Use case validation: Following R&D trajectories and evaluating whether results address the original requirements and intended value. By combining AI understanding, domain knowledge, and strong translation skills, the team helps turn imec’s AI capabilities into impactful applications across semiconductor technology, industry, consumer electronics, automotive, and other domains. What we do for you We offer you the opportunity to join one of the world’s premier research centers in nanotechnology at its headquarters in Leuven, Belgium. With your talent, passion and expertise, you’ll become part of a team that makes the impossible possible. Together, we shape the technology that will determine the society of tomorrow. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and proud of our open, multicultural, and informal working environment with ample possibilities to take initiative and show responsibility. items.desc: Company Description Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help create the unknown! Ubisoft Bordeaux Founded in 2017 by a handful of Ubisoft experts, our studio now counts over 400 talents from 20 different nationalities. Our teams contribute to some of Ubisoft’s biggest franchises: leading the production of Assassin’s Creed Mirage in 2023, working on Assassin’s Creed Shadows and the Claws of Awaji expansion, as well as unannounced projects. Beyond our AAA productions, we also drive technological innovation within the group through our expertise in the Anvil game engine and Ubisoft’s Online Services. We have also established a dedicated R&D division, La Forge, which brings together Ubisoft engineers and academic researchers to collaborate on prototypes that support game development, particularly in the field of AI. Job Description Neural rendering is an emerging field at the intersection of computer graphics and machine learning. It explores how neural networks can be used to represent, compress, and reproduce complex visual phenomena that are difficult to capture with traditional techniques [1]. While neural methods have demonstrated impressive quality in offline rendering and research prototypes, their integration into real-time systems remains challenging. Open questions include performance optimization on modern GPUs, balancing neural representations with analytic models, and ensuring controllability for artists and technical directors. Neural methods have shown impressive results to represent high-quality material appearance [2, 3]. Recently, we proposed a hybrid approach [4] that combines traditional microfacet BRDF with neural correction that better fits game engine constraints. Recent work [5] showed that diffusion models can help generate richer materials. But challenge remains, both with real-time neural rendering system and data creation pipelines that are to build. The goal of this internship is to investigate neural appearance techniques in the context of real-time graphics. During the internship, the student will survey recent advances in the field, identify key limitations in existing methods, and implement experimental prototypes. The work is exploratory in nature, with emphasis on deriving insights that can inform future research and potential integration into real-time rendering systems. References [1] Neural Shading (SIGGRAPH Course 2025) https://github.com/shader-slang/neural-shading-s25 [2] T. Zeltner et al., “Real-Time Neural Appearance Models”. SIGGRAPH (2024). [3] A. Weidlish. “Bridging the Gap Between Offline and Real Time with Neural Materials”. Siggraph Courses (2025) [4] De Oliveira et al., “Hybrid Neural-Microfacet BRDF Model for Real-Time Rendering”. EGSR (2026) [5] Yu et al. “Toward Richer Material Generation via Procedural Data Enhancement” SIGGRAPH (2026) Qualifications You are in the final year of an engineering degree or pursuing a research master in computer science or a related field. Ability to read and understand research papers Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python Good understanding of computer graphics, in particular rendering and shading Basic knowledge of machine learning and neural networks Interest in real-time rendering and the application of machine learning to graphics Knowledge of BRDFs, physically based rendering, or material models is a plus Good communication skills in English, written and spoken. Additional Information Contract : 6 months internship from March 2027 to September 2027. An internship agreement provided by your school is mandatory. Location : Bordeaux Supervision Antoine Houdard (R&D Scientist) Georges Nader (R&D Scientist)

items.desc: SAYENS est une Société d'Accélération du Transfert de Technologies (SATT), créée fin 2013 par plusieurs établissements de recherche publique grâce au Programme Investissements d'Avenir (PIA). SAYENS a pour vocation de simplifier, accélérer et faciliter le transfert de technologies et de connaissances de la recherche publique vers les entreprises de toute taille. Premier acteur de proximité et de confiance, soutenue par l'engagement collectif de ses établissements de recherche actionnaires, SAYENS a accès aux compétences et innovations des 6500 chercheurs issus des 140 laboratoires de recherche publique, répartis sur la Bourgogne Franche-Comté, la Lorraine et le Sud Champagne-Ardenne (Troyes). Elle s'appuie sur des équipes professionnelles dédiées pour détecter et évaluer les innovations et les accompagner jusqu'au transfert vers l'entreprise (maturation de technologies, licensing, création de start-up,…). « Dans le cadre de sa politique diversité, SAYENS étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap » Description du poste Dans le cadre de son projet de maturation riAna, SAYENS recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) spécialisé(e) en Intelligence Artificielle. La fonction consiste à développer un système d’analyse de l’activité cérébrale par intelligence artificielle, destiné à l’aide au diagnostic des troubles de la mémoire. Dans un premier temps, il s’agira d’adapter les modèles existants d’apprentissage automatique, reposant notamment sur la géométrie riemannienne, à de nouveaux dispositifs simplifiés d’acquisition EEG. Dans un second temps, le travail portera sur l’intégration de modèles préalablement entraînés au sein d’une chaîne de traitement en temps réel, permettant l’acquisition continue des signaux EEG, leur prétraitement et leur classification automatisée. Enfin, ces développements devront être réunis au sein d’un démonstrateur fonctionnel et cohérent, représentatif du futur produit. Une évaluation de la stabilité, de la robustesse et des performances globales du système dans des scénarios représentatifs des futurs usages sera effectuée. Le recueil de données cérébrales sera principalement réalisé via la technologie LabStreamingLayer (LSL). L’ingénieur(e) maturation veillera à l’approvisionnement des consommables en tenant à jour les stocks et en anticipant les commandes (et délais de livraisons) nécessaires afin de ne pas affecter l’activité. L’ingénieur(e) maturation devra consigner de manière journalière ses travaux et résultats dans un cahier de laboratoire signé par lui-même et contresigné régulièrement par un de ses responsables. Ce cahier sera soumis à confidentialité. L’ingénieur(e) maturation présentera ses résultats et développements chaque semaine à au moins l’un de ses responsables à l’aide de supports de présentations, et rédigera les comptes-rendus de réunions associés. L’ingénieur(e) maturation devra participer à la rédaction de rapports réguliers rendant compte de l’avancement du projet. Profil recherché Votre formation: De formation BAC+5 : Ingénieur en Intelligence Artificielle Votre expérience: Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 1 à 5 ans dans le domaine. Compétences requises: Python / Apprentissage automatique (machine learning) / Traitement du signal / Traitement des données en temps réel et gestion de flux / EEG Maîtrise de la rédaction de rapports techniques en français et en anglais. Qualités personnelles: Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'autonomie et d'adaptation. Vous avez une forte capacité à travailler en équipe et êtes diplomate. Vous avez le sens de l'organisation et savez gérer les priorités. Vous êtes curieux et avez un intérêt particulier pour la recherche et l'innovation.

items.desc: Data Scientist - Credit AI At a glance Do you thrive on transforming stakeholder challenges into actionable AI solutions? Are you a creative thinker who can break down complex problems into clear, explainable steps, while inspiring others with your enthusiasm? Do you have a strong technical background, along with experience in data science and generative AI solutions? If so, we want you to join our team! At ABN AMRO, our strategy is to offer a personalized banking experience in the digital age. We provide a comprehensive digital banking platform while maintaining strong personal connections with our clients, supporting them at crucial moments in their lives. We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our Credit Analytics team, which is an integral part of the Financing Solutions (FS) product unit responsible for delivering lending products across all client segments. As the engine room of lending, FS offers advice, monitors credit status, and provides tailored credit solutions, handling credit exposures exceeding one million euros. Your job As a Data Scientist, your role will involve contributing to AI projects to identify, develop and implement data-driven opportunities and solutions. Examples include developing generative AI solutions like a lending assistant to assist lenders in creating credit proposals, a credit risk monitoring system based on transactions and AI remediation solutions to automatically extract information from unstructured data. You will be part of the Intelligent Lending program, one of the six focus areas of the AI Strategy of the bank aiming to improve the lending journey by developing new (gen) AI solutions. Responsibilities Translate functional and technical requirements into applications using AI, generative AI, or traditional data science techniques. Play a pivotal role in developing AI applications for diverse credit process needs. Utilize state-of-the-art AI and data science techniques, with the insight to choose between simple and advanced methods. Establish the Data Science/Advanced Analytics lifecycle: ideation, data preparation, feature engineering, modelling, monitoring, etc. Transform raw data into functional data solutions in collaboration with the data/machine learning engineering team. Communicate results effectively and educate stakeholders/end-users to foster cooperation and enable business implementation/adoption. Engage in team knowledge-sharing sessions and initiate activities that enhance team efficiency. Working environment You will be part of the AA&AI team within Credit Analytics. We collaborate closely with dedicated machine learning and AI engineers in our agile team, capable of creating end-to-end solutions in the AA&AI domain. Our team values collaboration, learning and development, and we make time for activities such as quarterly hackathons, monthly knowledge sessions and team lunches outside the office. With diverse backgrounds and nationalities, English is our working language. You will have the autonomy to direct your daily activities and propose ideas you wish to pursue. Remote work is possible, with an expectation to be in the Amsterdam office twice a week to collaborate with the team. Your profile The ideal candidate is expected to: Hold a master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Econometrics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related STEM field. Have 1–3 years of relevant experience in an AI or Data Science role. Be proficient in major programming languages, preferably Python, and SQL; experience with Azure Databricks is a plus. Have knowledge of statistics and machine learning algorithms/packages (e.g., Scikit-learn, XGBoost),model explainability (e.g., SHAP) and applying Gen AI. Possess strong problem-solving skills and the ability to strategize for optimal solutions. Be goal-oriented, organized, and a team player. Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills. We are offering We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you. Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually. Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work. Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000. An annual public transport pass …

items.desc: AI & Automation Specialist Vill du identifiera möjligheter med AI och själv bygga lösningar som effektiviserar verkliga verksamheter? Fibio söker en tekniskt driven och självgående AI & Automation Specialist som kombinerar verksamhetsförståelse med praktisk teknisk utveckling. Du kommer att sätta dig in i våra befintliga arbetsprocesser, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter med AI och automation, presentera lösningsförslag och, efter godkännande från närmaste chef, själv utveckla och implementera lösningarna. Om oss Fibio är en svensk mobiloperatör som erbjuder kommunikationstjänster till privatpersoner och företag. Tillsammans med övriga bolag inom koncernen arbetar vi inom telekom, försäljning, kundservice och digitala tjänster. Vi är en entreprenörsdriven företagsgrupp med korta beslutsvägar och fokus på tillväxt, innovation och effektivisering. Vi satsar nu på AI och automation för att minska manuellt arbete, förbättra interna processer och utveckla smartare arbetssätt. Om rollen Det här är en självständig, operativ och teknisk roll där du ansvarar för att identifiera, föreslå och genomföra förbättringar med AI och automation. Du arbetar nära företagsledningen och medarbetare i våra verksamheter för att förstå hur vi arbetar och var tekniken kan skapa störst nytta. Arbetet följer fem steg: Förstå verksamheten: Lära dig våra system, rutiner och arbetsprocesser genom dialog med medarbetare och ansvariga. Identifiera möjligheter: Analysera vilka arbetsmoment som kan automatiseras eller effektiviseras med AI. Presentera förslag: Beskriva lösning, teknikval, förväntad affärsnytta, tidsåtgång och eventuella kostnader. Utveckla efter godkännande: Självständigt bygga, konfigurera, integrera och testa godkända lösningar. Implementera och följa upp: Driftsätta, dokumentera och säkerställa att lösningarna fungerar i verksamheten. Cirka 90 % av rollen är praktiskt tekniskt arbete. Du ska själv kunna bygga och implementera lösningar, inte enbart planera eller koordinera arbetet. Dina arbetsuppgifter Kartlägga och analysera verksamhetens befintliga processer. Identifiera möjligheter till effektivisering med AI och automation. Presentera konkreta lösningsförslag för företagsledningen. Utveckla AI-agenter, AI-assistenter och automatiserade arbetsflöden. Bygga systemintegrationer genom API: er, webhooks och andra integrationsmetoder. Automatisera arbetsmoment inom ekonomi, administration, kundservice och försäljning. Integrera AI med befintliga affärssystem och externa plattformar. Testa, felsöka, dokumentera och vidareutveckla lösningar. Säkerställa stabila, säkra och användbara automatiseringar. Vi söker dig som Har relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, systemutveckling, programmering, AI, automation eller närliggande tekniskt område. Har dokumenterad praktisk erfarenhet av att självständigt bygga AI-lösningar eller automatiserade arbetsflöden. Har förståelse för API: er, systemintegrationer och dataflöden. Har erfarenhet av AI-verktyg, automationsplattformar och programmering eller low-code/no-code-utveckling. Snabbt kan sätta dig in i nya system och förstå verksamhetens behov. Kan analysera problem och föreslå genomförbara tekniska lösningar. Kan förklara tekniska förslag på ett begripligt sätt. Är självgående, strukturerad, analytisk och lösningsorienterad. Relevant utbildning är ett grundkrav. Vi lägger dessutom stor vikt vid praktisk kompetens och dokumenterade resultat. Du ska kunna visa exempel på lösningar du själv har utvecklat och implementerat. Meriterande erfarenheter OpenAI API, Claude eller andra AI-modeller. n8n, Make, Zapier eller liknande verktyg. AI-agenter och automatiserade arbetsflöden. Integrationer med CRM-, ERP-, ekonomi- eller kundservicesystem. Processkartläggning och verksamhetsutveckling. Teknisk projektledning. Du behöver inte behärska alla verktyg. Det viktigaste är att du har god teknisk förståelse, snabbt kan lära dig nya system och kan omsätta verksamhetsbehov till fungerande lösningar. Vad vi erbjuder En självständig och tekniskt utvecklande roll med stort ansvar. Möjlighet att påverka hur AI används inom hela företagsgruppen. Nära samarbete med företagsledningen och korta beslutsvägar. Frihet att identifiera förbättringsområden och presentera egna initiativ. Praktiskt arbete med varierande AI- och automationsprojekt. Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter i en växande företagsgrupp. Anställningsvillkor Omfattning: Heltid. Arbetstider: Måndag–fredag, 08.00–17.00. Placering: Helsingborg. Arbetsform: På plats på vårt kontor i Helsingborg. Ansökan Vi vill förstå både din tekniska kompetens och din problemlösningsförmåga. Beskriv gärna ett projekt där du själv har identifierat ett problem, föreslagit en teknisk lösning och därefter utvecklat och implementerat den. Berätta vilka tekniker du använde och vilka resultat lösningen skapade. Vi söker dig som kan förstå hur en verksamhet fungerar, upptäcka möjligheterna med AI och själv bygga lösningarna som gör skillnad.

items.desc: Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll. Din roll Vi etablerar nu Digital Transformation Office inom Aeronautics, där kan du få möjligheten att driva betydelsefull förändring genom AI, automation och avancerad Teknik. AI skapar nya möjligheter, men det verkliga värdet uppstår först när tekniken används, förstås och litas på av människorna i verksamheten. Som AI Implementation Specialist får du en nyckelroll i att bygga kompetens, engagemang och trygghet i hur vi använder AI. Som AI Implementation Specialist kommer du bland annat att driva införandet och breddanvändningen av AI inom Saab Aeronautics. Du bygger kompetens, skapar engagemang och hjälper verksamheten att omsätta AI-möjligheter till praktisk nytta, på ett säkert och ansvarsfullt sätt. Tillsammans med affärsområden, verksamhetsledare, produktorganisationer och tekniska team inom vår IT organisation arbetar du med allt från inspiration och utbildning till konkreta användningsfall och införande. Samt bidrar till arbete med att ta fram och underhålla riktlinjer och policys för hur AI ska användas inom Saab. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Driva AI-adoption i verksamheten och stödja införandet av AI-lösningar och verktyg i det dagliga arbetet Planera och genomföra kompetenshöjande insatser, awareness-sessioner och workshops för olika målgrupper, från chefer till specialister Organisera och leda hackathons och andra innovationsaktiviteter som gör AI konkret och lyfter fram nya användningsfall Tillsammans med Enterprise Architect ta fram riktlinjer, policys och bästa praxis för säker, etisk och regelrätt användning av AI Identifiera, testa och utvärdera AI-användningsfall tillsammans med verksamheten och stödja vägen från prototyp till införande Följa upp användning och effekt av AI-initiativ samt dela lärdomar och framgångsexempel Bygga ett nätverk av AI-ambassadörer och champions i verksamheten Hålla dig uppdaterad om utvecklingen inom AI och bedöma vad den innebär för Saab Din profil Vi söker dig som har god samarbetsförmåga, är skicklig på att bygga relationer och har hög emotionell intelligens. Du är nyfiken, handlingskraftig och kombinerar teknisk förståelse med ett tydligt fokus på verksamhetsnytta. Vi ser gärna att du har: Kandidat- eller masterexamen inom datavetenskap, ingenjörsvetenskap, AI/data science eller motsvarande område. Praktisk erfarenhet av att implementera eller införa AI-lösningar, exempelvis generativ AI, maskininlärning eller automation, i en verksamhet. God förståelse för hur AI-lösningar fungerar samt deras möjligheter och begränsningar. Erfarenhet av att driva kompetensutveckling, utbildning eller förändringsarbete kopplat till ny teknik. Dokumenterad förmåga att samarbeta mellan verksamhet och teknik samt att översätta affärsbehov till AI-användningsfall. Förståelse för säkerhet, styrning (governance) och regelefterlevnad inom AI-relaterade projekt, inklusive datahantering och ansvarsfull AI. Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. God vana att facilitera, presentera och inspirera. Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av att arrangera hackathons, innovationsutmaningar eller liknande aktiviteter. Erfarenhet av att ta fram AI-riktlinjer, policys eller ramverk för styrning i en större organisation. Erfarenhet av AI-införande i komplexa och reglerade miljöer inom exempelvis teknik-, tillverknings- eller försvarsindustrin. Erfarenhet av att leverera helhetslösningar inom AI och automation, inklusive analys, design, utveckling, implementering och skalning. Erfarenhet av att bygga och leda communities eller nätverk. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här. items.desc: Do you want to question, change, and steer our company into the future? Are you passionate about technology and ready to make a difference? Then you will thrive at SEB. At SEB, we believe in fresh thinking, new working methods, and innovation to create a fairer and more sustainable world. Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success, while we place a strong emphasis on sustainability and digitalization as we shape the future of SEB. With the Tech Trainee programme and as an employee, we'll help you develop new skills and take on more responsibility to create a positive impact. You will become a crucial key player in shaping the future of the bank. Your tech trainee position and your team You will join a small, senior engineering team that works closely together to solve highly complex challenges spanning multiple teams and areas. As a junior engineer, you will learn by working hands-on with experienced colleagues and contribute to turning modern technology, including the most advanced AI tools available at SEB, into practical improvements and real business value. The role suits someone who is curious, enjoys breaking down and solving complex problems, and wants to grow their technical skills while helping others work in smarter and more modern ways. Your approach to complex challenges is structured, but at the same time you don’t hesitate to throw yourself at them with the attitude of “how hard can it be?”. In this role, you will: Use modern AI tools and engineering approaches, with guidance from experienced colleagues, to explore and solve technical and organizational challenges. Help identify opportunities for innovation and turn ideas into practical improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery. Collaborate with engineers, managers, and other stakeholders in work that crosses team and organizational boundaries. Share what you learn, contribute new perspectives, and support the useful and responsible adoption of AI-enabled ways of working. Develop your understanding of architecture, prioritization, and technical decision-making in a complex environment. About the role This project will develop and apply advanced artificial intelligence algorithms to map an imaging biomarker of tumour hypoxia from oxygen-enhanced MRI (OE-MRI). The clinical motivation of the project is the need to optimise radiotherapy treatment administered to patients with head and neck cancer. In particular, patients with head and neck squamous cell cancer (HNSCC) can develop treatment resistance in the presence of hypoxia. This will enable the translation of OE-MRI from research to clinical practice. The post is funded until 31st December 2028 in the first instance. items.desc: Ready to engineer the future of Formula 1 performance? Welcome to the Red Bull Engineering Academy (RBEA); a two-year, high-octane, rotational graduate programme within Red Bull Powertrains, designed to shape the world’s most ambitious engineering talent into future technical leaders. In a world of fierce technical competition, the Red Bull Engineering Academy is Red Bull Powertrains' elite pathway to shape world-class engineering talent from within. We believe in structured, global, and high-impact development, transforming engineers who will not only keep up with the pace of F1 but set it! Why Join RBEA? The Red Bull Powertrains Engineering Academy gives elite graduates the chance to work at the forefront of performance engineering, collaborating with some of the most innovative minds in motorsport. Expect to be thrown into real-world challenges that will test your intellect, creativity and resilience, all while rotating through critical departments within Red Bull Powertrains. As part of this scheme, each graduate will follow a series of rotations designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of power unit development. In Test Engineering , you’ll be challenged to combine hands-on testing with the practical and pragmatic design and development of fixtures and rigs across ICE and ERS specialisms. Within Durability & Performance , you’ll help strike a balance between durability, performance, and trackside operational requirements to ensure the power unit keeps the Red Bull teams battling at the front of the grid. The Performance & Control rotation will immerse you in full-cycle performance deployment and development, working alongside experts focused on maximising power unit performance from concept to track. Finally, in Data Insights , you’ll need an analytical mindset to successfully rotate between data science, engineering software, and cutting-edge advanced measurement specialisms to drive innovation and precision in the power units. These rotations will equip you with a multidisciplinary foundation as you carve out a career within Red Bull Powertrains and contribute to Red Bull’s relentless pursuit of innovation and competitive advantage in Formula One. What You’ll Experience: Fast-Track Development: Tackle complex projects, innovate at speed and own your engineering impact World-Class Mentoring: Learn from pioneers of F1 power unit engineering Professional Growth: Build leadership, project management and technical excellence, on and off the track A Career with Traction: Graduate into a full-time, high-impact engineering role within the Red Bull Technology Group To be considered for the RBEA: Bachelor’s Honours Degree in Engineering, Mathematics or Physics (minimum 2:1) A demonstrable passion for engineering through personal projects, competitions, or practical experience A solid understanding of engineering principles and the ability to apply mathematical methods to solve real-world problems Familiarity with specialist modelling and analysis tools such as CAD, FEA, CFD, or system modelling Experience with handling and analysing data from simulations or physical tests, and the ability to confidently prepare and present high-quality technical documentation Positive, can-do attitude and willingness to continually expand your professional knowledge and develop technical skills Excellent communication skills and experience working in a team environment Curiosity, creativity and the courage to challenge convention allied to a relentless desire to push performance boundaries Skills You’ll Master: Using theoretical engineering knowledge to drive real-world innovation Leading complicated design and development projects with ownership and accountability Managing tightly controlled resources in high-pressure environments Effectively communicating advanced technical work to team-mates with clarity and confidence Embedding safety, ethics and sustainability into every engineering solution This isn’t just a graduate programme. It’s a launchpad. A proving ground. A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! At Red Bull Powertrains, we believe that success isn’t just about speed, it’s about the team behind the victory. We trust, support, and challenge each other, always pushing for better. If you love solving complex problems, thinking fast, and making a real impact, this is the place for you. Alongside a competitive salary, you’ll enjoy: Bonus scheme Private healthcare A pension scheme On-site gym Free daily food allowance And many more! Most importantly, you’ll play a key role in powering championship-winning cars. If you're ready to be part of something extraordinary, apply now and help shape the future of F1.

You'll work with large datasets, market information and pricing models to provide insights that support decision-making across power and renewable energy portfolios. This is a unique opportunity for graduates who enjoy combining mathematics, technology and commercial thinking. You'll gain exposure to real market dynamics, contribute to strategic projects and develop an understanding of how quantitative analysis supports trading, sales and portfolio optimisation activities. WHAT WILL YOU DO Develop and enhance pricing models used to evaluate power and renewable certificate products across the SEFE Group. Analyse market data, pricing trends and risk factors to support commercial decision-making and portfolio optimisation. Work closely with stakeholders across trading, sales, finance and technology to deliver analytical solutions to business challenges. Contribute to the development of new products and commercial opportunities that support the energy transition. Help maintain and improve pricing systems and analytical tools used across the business. Identify market, commercial and regulatory risks through quantitative analysis and data interpretation. Produce portfolio analysis and performance insights to help improve profitability and risk management outcomes. Use technologies such as SQL and Python to automate processes, analyse data and improve decision-making capabilities. Contribute ideas and innovative approaches that help drive business performance and support growth in new markets. WHAT WILL YOU BRING We're looking for analytical and intellectually curious graduates who enjoy working with data, solving complex problems and translating insights into commercial value. You'll ideally have: A Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or due to be completed before the programme starts) in Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex information, identify meaningful trends and generate actionable insights. Experience using data analysis tools, programming languages or statistical methods through university studies, projects or internships, with exposure to SQL, Python, Excel or similar analytical tools. Strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately and effectively with complex datasets. The confidence to communicate technical findings and data-driven insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Commercial curiosity and an interest in understanding how quantitative analysis supports business performance and decision-making. An interest in energy markets, renewable energy and the commercial opportunities and challenges created by the energy transition. A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and enthusiasm for tackling new challenges and continuously developing new skills. Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted. ABOUT US SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions that ensure reliable and affordable supply. Our activities span the entire energy value chain – from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. With decades of trading expertise and a growing LNG portfolio, SEFE is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to industrial customers, providing more than 200 TWh of gas and power each year. We supply over 50,000 clients, from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations. By investing in clean energies, we support our customers on their decarbonisation journey and contribute to the energy transition. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany. Securing energy – now and for the future. OUR BENEFITS In return we offer a competitive salary supported by a comprehensive range of financial, lifestyle and wellness benefits with the flexibility to follow a hybrid working model. Bonus earning potential Non-contributory pension with 10% employer contribution 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and volunteering days Buy / sell holidays Life assurance Medical and dental insurance (family cover) Range of optional flexible benefits We are committed to supporting your career growth with opportunities to develop both your knowledge and experience through a blended approach to learning. Join SEFE and help us secure energy supply across Europe and shape a better, more sustainable tomorrow.

items.desc: We are hiring 2026 and 2027 Graduate Software Engineers into engineering teams around the world. As a global platform company we offer a wide range of software engineering challenges, in both open source products and commercial business systems. We have teams that work in a variety of languages, typically Python, Golang, Rust, C/C++, JavaScript and of course... Bash. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code. If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. We will work with you to identify teams and projects that would be interesting and a good fit for your skills and motivations. The process is highly competitive, it will require effort and excellence to succeed if you apply here. Most of our engineering teams work from home. We try to align a single team in a single time zone - EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa), APAC (Asia Pacific and Indian Ocean), and AMER (North, South and Central Americas). Even though you work from home, we try to ensure you always have colleagues alongside to coach and mentor you, and for the companionship of shared problem solving and pair programming. Larger projects have multiple teams and might span the globe. We work with the open source community and specialize in building teams that work well in the 'fishbowl' of open source engineering. This is full time work, five days a week, often solving hard problems with significant responsibility. We don't generally work weekends and nights and we do enjoy good holidays but we also expect productive and intense engagement Monday to Friday. We bring all our engineering teams together in person twice a year for a deep 'sprint' with other teams to stimulate discussion and enable a wide range of career development paths. This is a fantastic way to demonstrate and develop your skill in software, learn about a wide range of technologies, make a meaningful impact to open source, and see some very interesting new cities that you might never otherwise get to visit. If you find the open source stack amazing, and you have been a consistent high-performing student in your school and university, then this will be a challenging and exciting start to your career. Location: This is a Globally remote role. The role entails Shaping the roadmap for your product at global sprints every six months Focusing on design and user experience, even for developer tooling and command line apps Writing high quality, resilient and performant code, potentially serving millions of demanding daily users Working towards mastery of key programming languages and Linux system knowledge Engaging with users and the open source community through code reviews and issue trackers Responding to customer issues as a priority, develop an understanding of enterprise requirements Developing skills and awareness of security in software design and implementation What we are looking for in you Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics or another STEM discipline with programming courses Confidence to get started and deliver high quality code in one of Python, Rust, C/C++, Golang, JavaScript or Java Experience with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results Result-oriented and organized, with the drive to meet commitments Personal projects in technology and software engineering beyond the curriculum Professional written and spoken English Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability Personal responsibility and accountability Thoughtfulness, self-awareness and the ability to reflect and develop Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long Nice-to-have skills Upstream open source contributions Packaging and Linux distribution contributions - Debian, Fedora, Arch, Nix or another Leadership and organization skills Presentation and writing skills Business and commercial interests What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. items.desc: About Qevlar AI Qevlar is a B2B SaaS scale-up on a mission to boost the productivity of cybersecurity teams with Artificial Intelligence. We build an AI platform that transitions Security Operations Centers from reactive to proactive units through autonomous security alert investigations. In just three years, we have: Raised a total of $44m in series-A & seed rounds from EQT Ventures, Forgepoint Capital and Partech Deployed our solution with major Enterprises such as Sodexo and GlobalConnect, and leading MSSPs like Orange Cyberdefense Grown to 1,500+ clients across the US and EMEA Ended 2025 with a strong multi-million dollar ARR, and we're targeting $25M by the end of 2027 We're looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to secure the platform behind an AI product that security teams rely on, reporting directly to our IT & Security Director. The scope is largely greenfield: real influence on architecture and security design, across GCP, Azure and AWS, and AI security challenges few engineers have tackled yet. What you'll actually do Cloud security: harden our GCP, Azure and AWS environments (IAM, VPC design, segmentation, encryption, logging), isolate environments and tenants, and monitor for misconfigurations. Secure CI/CD: harden our pipelines (protected branches, least-privilege runners, signed artifacts, keyless auth) and build SAST, SCA, DAST, secret, container and IaC scanning into every pull request. IaC and IAM: manage infrastructure in Terraform with least privilege, workload identity and short-lived credentials; centralise and rotate secrets. Production lockdown: move to just-in-time, approved and fully logged access, with break-glass procedures. Detection and response: centralise audit logs from all three clouds, define detection rules, run vulnerability management with SLAs, and lead the technical response on security incidents. Compliance and AI security: implement SOC 2 controls with Vanta and secure our AI/LLM components (data isolation, prompt injection, model and API access). What we're looking for 3+ years in DevOps, SRE, cloud or security engineering, including 1+ year focused on security You've secured a production cloud environment hands-on, not only audited one (GCP primary, with working knowledge of Azure and AWS) CI/CD hardening (GitHub Actions) with integrated security scanning Terraform in production Kubernetes security: GKE/AKS hardening, image scanning, RBAC Secrets management, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls and evidence Strong Python, Go or Bash A pragmatic, risk-based mindset: you persuade developers rather than block them Fluent English Nice to have: AI/LLM security (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), just-in-time access tooling, supply chain security (SBOM, signing, SLSA), offensive security or bug bounty, cloud incident response, GDPR, NIS2 and EU AI Act. Why join us Work on meaningful problems with real-world impact in cybersecurity A high-impact role in a small, international, fast-moving team where your contributions directly shape the company and its success Shape the future of a product already making noise in AI + security circles A company culture that values autonomy and creativity Opportunity for equity and early ownership We’re flexible on location: you can either work from home or join your colleagues in our beautiful office in Paris’ 9th arrondissement. If you’re excited about helping security teams adopt cutting-edge AI, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s build the future of cybersecurity together! items.desc: Role starts between March and June 2027. It cannot start earlier. This is an opportunity to work for an agricultural robotics startup that is passionate about the environment - ARRevolution. Our novel farming system increases yield, reduces seasonal labour, decreases agrochemicals and synthetic fertiliser, while regenerating biodiversity and the soil. This system presents landscape level change while providing healthier food and environment for us all. We are looking for a software engineer who shares this environmental passion. The company office and workshop is situated on a working arable farm. Our platforms operate in real farm environments, uneven terrain, variable weather and changing crop conditions to deliver precision operations such as drilling, weeding, spraying, monitoring, harvesting and more. The Role The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the software engineering team, you will own a significant portion of the front end user experience, design, develop and deploy robot user interfaces along with integrating the frontend of the robot interface to the backend. You will work with low-level real-time control and sensor integration through perception, navigation, mission planning, and up to operator interfaces, fleet coordination, data pipelines, and cloud connectivity. The role is hands-on, field-oriented, and spans the full development lifecycle in unstructured outdoor environments. Your Role / Key Responsibilities Design frontend user friendly interfaces based on web technologies. Collaborate with inhouse software and partner with software engineers to integrate the frontend with low level robot functionality. Responsible for testing and data collection, involves robot telemetry, AI training data and test data. Ensure seamless connectivity between robots, edge compute, and cloud systems, including intermittent connectivity, over-the-air updates, and remote diagnostics. Write clean, modular, well-tested code; contribute to CI/CD, automated testing, system validation, and engineering standards for safety and reliability. Performing full stack testing of the robot end to end from the user input to the robot field operations Research and learning about existing agricultural tools and methods Work flexibility - engaging with any task required to move the project forward The successful candidate will demonstrate the following essential skills: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience. Strong proficiency in C++ and Python (or similar systems languages); experience writing production-quality, real-time or near-real-time software. Demonstrated full-stack capability: from lower-level systems/embedded software through backend services and preferably frontend or operator interfaces. Hands-on experience developing and deploying software on mobile robots, autonomous vehicles, or outdoor platforms (ideally field, agricultural, or off-road). Solid understanding of localisation, navigation, sensor fusion, control systems, and real-world robustness challenges in unstructured outdoor environments. Experience with Linux-based development, Git, testing practices, and modern software engineering workflows. Comfort debugging complex system issues across software, sensors, and hardware; willingness to participate in field testing and travel to farms as needed. Clear communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. Nice-to-Haves / What Makes You Stand Out Experience with embedded Linux, real-time systems, CAN bus, or vehicle control interfaces. Computer vision / OpenCV, GNSS/RTK integration, LiDAR or multi-camera pipelines. Backend (APIs, databases, message queues) and frontend (web or mobile) development experience. Cloud/IoT integration, edge computing, or intermittent-connectivity systems. Prior work on agricultural equipment, precision farming, outdoor autonomy, or safety-critical mobile robotics. Familiarity with simulation tools, continuous integration for robotics, or bringing prototypes to production deployment. Experience with alternative robotics middleware or custom autonomy stacks. Training and deploying AI models in production. Why Join Us Direct impact on sustainable field agriculture and solving real labour and environmental challenges on working farms. Rare opportunity to own and shape a complete software stack from robot core to farmer-facing tools in one of the toughest real-world domains. Fast iteration cycles with regular field testing and clear line-of-sight from code to operational robots. Collaborative, multidisciplinary environment with high ownership and growth potential. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Employee benefits 25 days paid holiday Free parking Company pension Flexible and condensed working hours Salary - dependant on qualifications and experience Pay: £40,000.00-£52,000.00 per year Benefits: Company events Company pension …

 Verändere die Welt von morgen: Du unterstützt Entwicklungs- und Engineering-Teams in der fertigungsnahen Hardwareentwicklung sowohl vor Ort als auch remote dabei, neue KI-Tools und innovative Arbeitsweisen entlang des gesamten Produktentstehungsprozesses erfolgreich einzuführen, um nachhaltig Veränderungen im Arbeitsalltag zu verankern

 Abschließend dokumentierst du Fortschritte strukturiert und gibst dem Global Lead regelmäßig fundiertes Feedback, um den Erfolg der Transformationsmaßnahmen sichtbar zu machen

items.desc: Jouw uitdaging AI verandert hoe organisaties werken, en Hero loopt daarin voorop. Met ruim 2.000 professionals die wij dagelijks aan het werk hebben, zijn er processen in recruitment, contracts, sales en marketing die slimmer, sneller en beter kunnen. Jij gaat die slag helpen maken. Als AI Developer Trainee word je opgeleid in ons AI-team in Wognum. Geen startersbaantje waarbij je in het diepe gegooid wordt en daarna aan je lot overgelaten. Je werkt mee aan échte projecten, bouwt AI-oplossingen die de hele Hero-organisatie vooruithelpen, en leert van mensen die dagelijks met de nieuwste tools werken. Claude Code, Cursor, agents, automatiseringen. En als morgen iets beters bestaat, werk je daarmee. Hero groeit jaarlijks met 30 tot 40 procent. Die groei vraagt intelligente systemen en mensen die die systemen bouwen. Jij bent de bouwer van morgen. Meewerken aan AI-toepassingen die Hero-processen versnellen, van recruitment tot marketing tot contracts AI-oplossingen bouwen met moderne tools zoals Claude Code, Cursor en vergelijkbare AI-native ontwikkelomgevingen Automatiseringen opzetten en testen die collega’s tijd besparen en slimmer laten werken Sparren met het AI-team over welke problemen in de organisatie het beste via AI opgelost kunnen worden Ideeën omzetten in werkende prototypes, bijsturen op basis van feedback en live zetten Bijdragen aan DevOps: van idee naar productie, zodat oplossingen ook écht gebruikt worden Dit ben jij HBO werk- en denkniveau, richting informatica, software development, data science of vergelijkbaar Affiniteit met AI en de wil om er dagelijks mee te bouwen, niet alleen mee te experimenteren Basiskennis van programmeren, of de bereidheid die kennis snel op te doen Leergierig, nieuwsgierig en scherp genoeg om nieuwe tools en technieken razendsnel op te pikken Teamspeler met eigenaarschap: jij pakt iets op en zorgt dat het klaar komt Fulltime beschikbaar en aanwezig op ons kantoor in Wognum Geen uitgebreide werkervaring vereist, maar drive en een concrete interesse in AI wel Onze beloning! Salaris tussen €3.250 en €5.000 bruto per maand, gebaseerd op niveau en groei Bonusregeling op basis van prestaties Pensioenopbouw Elke dag een compleet verzorgde lunch Sportabonnement vergoed Ruimte voor opleiding en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, inclusief begeleiding door het AI-team Teamuitjes en VrijMiBo’s Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Junior AI Developer, Medior en verder Wat maakt Hero uniek? Hero is een recruitment bureau met een missie: het grootste, mooiste en beste bedrijf van de flexmarkt worden. Dat zijn geen woorden op een muur. Dat is hoe wij elke dag werken. Met ruim 2.000 professionals die wij bemiddelen, en vestigingen in Hoorn, Alkmaar, Schiphol en Wognum, bouwen wij aan iets wat er in de flexmarkt nog niet eerder was. In Wognum zit het technische hart van Hero. Het AI-team is klein, ambitieus en groeit elke maand. Precies het soort omgeving waar iemand als jij echt het verschil maakt, en waar je sneller groeit dan in een groot anoniem bedrijf. We zijn een familiebedrijf. Eigenaarschap, plezier en vakmanschap zijn geen HR-kreten bij ons. Ze bepalen hoe wij elke dag samenwerken. Elke fout is een leermoment. Elke goede oplossing wordt gevierd. Klaar voor The Perfect Match tussen jou en Hero?

items.desc: Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way. The Role: A Data Scientist represents an evolution from the business or data analyst role. The formal training is similar, with a solid foundation typically in computer science and applications, modelling, statistics, analytics and maths. What sets the data scientist apart is a strong business acumen, coupled with the ability to communicate findings in a way that can influence how an organisation approaches a business challenge. Good data scientists will not just address business problems, they will pick the right problems that have the most value to the organisation. Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviours you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will: Be placed under the guidance of a full time data scientist in Logitech, assisting them to deliver actionable insights to the supply chain organisation. Deliver insights in various forms such as predictive models, POC applications or possibly ad hoc analyses of data. Your job scope will also involve some amount of presentations, potential pitches to management and also co-workers. You will work in a global team spanning at least 2 time zones. Key Qualifications: For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviours to our team: Strong programming skills in R or Python. Fluency in SQL. Strong foundation in statistics. Passion for problem solving and exploring new technologies. Creative, open-minded and proactive. Eager to learn, ask questions and challenge. In addition, preferable skills and behaviours include: Familiarity with Github. Knowledge of container technologies such as docker. Experience with visualisation software such as Tableau. Education: Completed MSc in Data Science, Computer Science or a related technical field or equivalent industry expertise. At Logitech, we empower collaboration and foster play through a flexible hybrid work model that supports productivity and connection from anywhere. Our strength lies in our people and our inclusive culture, where diversity is valued and differences celebrated. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay! If you believe you’re a great fit, we encourage you to apply. We’d love to meet you! We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. Logitech is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Learn more about our Commitment: Equal Opportunity & Non-Discrimination If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at +1-510-713-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Are you a creative thinker who can break down complex problems into clear, explainable steps, while inspiring others with your enthusiasm? Do you have a strong technical background, along with experience in data science and generative AI solutions? If so, we want you to join our team! At ABN AMRO, our strategy is to offer a personalized banking experience in the digital age. We provide a comprehensive digital banking platform while maintaining strong personal connections with our clients, supporting them at crucial moments in their lives. We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our Credit Analytics team, which is an integral part of the Financing Solutions (FS) product unit responsible for delivering lending products across all client segments. As the engine room of lending, FS offers advice, monitors credit status, and provides tailored credit solutions, handling credit exposures exceeding one million euros. Your job As a Data Scientist, your role will involve contributing to AI projects to identify, develop and implement data-driven opportunities and solutions. Examples include developing generative AI solutions like a lending assistant to assist lenders in creating credit proposals, a credit risk monitoring system based on transactions and AI remediation solutions to automatically extract information from unstructured data. You will be part of the Intelligent Lending program, one of the six focus areas of the AI Strategy of the bank aiming to improve the lending journey by developing new (gen) AI solutions. Responsibilities Translate functional and technical requirements into applications using AI, generative AI, or traditional data science techniques. Play a pivotal role in developing AI applications for diverse credit process needs. Utilize state-of-the-art AI and data science techniques, with the insight to choose between simple and advanced methods. Establish the Data Science/Advanced Analytics lifecycle: ideation, data preparation, feature engineering, modelling, monitoring, etc. Transform raw data into functional data solutions in collaboration with the data/machine learning engineering team. Communicate results effectively and educate stakeholders/end-users to foster cooperation and enable business implementation/adoption. Engage in team knowledge-sharing sessions and initiate activities that enhance team efficiency. Working environment You will be part of the AA&AI team within Credit Analytics. We collaborate closely with dedicated machine learning and AI engineers in our agile team, capable of creating end-to-end solutions in the AA&AI domain. Our team values collaboration, learning and development, and we make time for activities such as quarterly hackathons, monthly knowledge sessions and team lunches outside the office. With diverse backgrounds and nationalities, English is our working language. You will have the autonomy to direct your daily activities and propose ideas you wish to pursue. Remote work is possible, with an expectation to be in the Amsterdam office twice a week to collaborate with the team. Your profile The ideal candidate is expected to: Hold a master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Econometrics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related STEM field. Have 1–3 years of relevant experience in an AI or Data Science role. Be proficient in major programming languages, preferably Python, and SQL; experience with Azure Databricks is a plus. Have knowledge of statistics and machine learning algorithms/packages (e.g., Scikit-learn, XGBoost),model explainability (e.g., SHAP) and applying Gen AI. Possess strong problem-solving skills and the ability to strategize for optimal solutions. Be goal-oriented, organized, and a team player. Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. items.desc: Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je meebouwen aan een datagedreven organisatie? Bij Quatra zoeken we een Junior Data Analyst die cijfers vertaalt naar heldere inzichten en mee inzet op automatisering en innovatieve (AI-)toepassingen. Je maakt deel uit van een team van 9 collega’s en ondersteunt verschillende afdelingen met gerichte analyses en rapportering. Zo draag je actief bij aan de verdere optimalisatie van onze datawerking! Als Junior Data Analyst bij Quatra ben je verantwoordelijk voor: Je verzamelt, structureert en analyseert data uit verschillende bronnen. Je vertaalt businessvragen naar concrete inzichten via rapporten en dashboards met behulp van diverse BI-tools. Je bewaakt de datakwaliteit en detecteert afwijkingen. Je optimaliseert en automatiseert rapportering en terugkerende analyses. Je zorgt voor de integratie met operationele systemen zoals Odoo ERP, waarbij je de brug maakt tussen data en businessinzichten. Je ontwikkelt data-oplossingen met SQL en Python(of een andere scripttaal), en werkt mee aan data pipelines en de verdere uitbouw van de data-architectuur. Je verkent nieuwe databronnen en test AI-tools op hun meerwaarde voor Quatra. Waarom kiezen voor Quatra? Werken in een duurzaam en toekomstgericht bedrijf dat volop inzet op innovatie en groei. Een leerrijke startersrol met groeikansen in data, BI en AI. On-the-job coaching voor een vliegende start en voortdurende ondersteuning om te groeien in jouw rol. Nauwe samenwerking tussen business en IT in een open en informele werksfeer. Een marktconform salaris met extralegale voordelen, waaronder hospitalisatieverzekering en groepsverzekering. Toegang tot Benefits at Work met aantrekkelijke personeelskortingen bij tal van bekende merken. 12 ADV-dagen bovenop je wettelijke vakantiedagen, zodat werk en privé mooi in balans blijven. Toegang tot een Flex Income Plan, waarmee je jouw koopkracht verhoogt. Wat verwachten we van jou? Je beschikt over een Bachelor- of Masterdiploma (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) in een relevante richting. Je hebt een eerste ervaring met data-analyse of bent een gemotiveerde starter. Je hebt een analytische, oplossingsgerichte mindset en oog voor detail. Je werkt gestructureerd en communiceert helder. Je hebt interesse in AI, automatisering en nieuwe technologieën. Je hebt basiskennis van SQL en minstens één programmeer- of scripttaal (bij voorkeur Python). Je hebt al gewerkt met een BI-tool (via een stage, project of eerste job). Kennis van ERP-systemen (zoals Odoo) en/of operationele bedrijfsprocessen (logistiek, productie, planning) is een troef. Je begrijpt de impact van je werk op verschillende afdelingen en werkt graag samen in team. Klaar om jouw talent in te zetten voor een snelgroeiende en duurzame onderneming? Aarzel dan niet en stuur jouw CV en motivatie naar jobs.be@quatra.com ! We kijken er naar uit jou binnen ons bedrijf en team te mogen verwelkomen. Over Quatra Quatra is een internationale en snelgroeiende groep, gespecialiseerd in de inzameling en recyclage van gebruikte frituurolie. Met activiteiten in meer dan 10 landen dragen we elke dag bij aan de circulaire economie en duurzame energieoplossingen. Onze cultuur wordt gekenmerkt door ondernemerschap, professionaliteit en korte beslissingslijnen.
