items.desc: Who We Are FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations. At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you. Are you ready to make your impact? About The Role FTI Data & Technology Transformation is a multi-disciplined team that focuses on using digital solutions coupled with deep subject matter expertise to deliver transformational outcomes for our clients. We have a strong track record of helping companies drive EBITDA and ROIC value from digital and data. We also serve as an R&D function for the company, developing internal tools, solutions and proof-of-concepts to put us ahead of the market. Our team is based across London and Dublin. Our team has three capability areas – Data, Technology and Transformation Services: Data Services: Data Strategy, Architecture, Engineering and Enrichment Predictive Analytics and AI Business Intelligence and Data Visualisation Technology Services Technology Strategy IT Op Model and Governance IT Cost Optimization (Opex, Capex, Sourcing) IT Merger, Integration and Carve Out Transformation Services Value Creation Assessment and Realisation Target Operating Model Process Engineering and Automation Transformation Office and Turnaround Finance Function Transformation Data, Technology and Operating Model Assessments and Improvements Interim Finance Modelling Support Finance Reporting. What You’ll Do Our team of professionals provide data and analytics solutions coupled with deep subject matter expertise to deliver transformational outcomes for our clients across our capability areas. Day-to-day tasks will vary by day, but you can expect to: Utilise strong analytical skills to provide solutions for both technical and business-related issues. Collaborate with various stakeholders to define and refine data requirements and strategies. Participate in identifying and delivering business improvements to exceed client expectations by demonstrating strong problem solving and implementation capabilities. Contribute to problem solving and delivering robust analysis and updates that benefit the clients’ business objectives. How You’ll Grow We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. items.desc: Bristol, London, Newcastle-upon-Tyne, York Job Summary This role is in the core Spatial Data Science team, a group of data scientists and engineers that is part of the Environment Science and Analysis division. The division provides cross-cutting analytical support to a wide range of Defra’s environmental policy areas, and the spatial data science team uses innovative approaches to provide insight into complex spatial problems across Defra. As a team, our work feeds into critical environmental policy areas, including but not limited to developing modelling and analysis to understand the implications of new policy on land use, developing new geographical indicators, such as the access to green and blue space statistics, providing ad hoc spatial analysis, and working with external partners on research. Working with both Defra and cross-government policy teams, our work is often fast-paced and provides opportunities to engage with a range of teams and disciplines. We are always looking for opportunities to improve the impact of our analysis. We champion the use of geography and spatial data science across government, promoting good practice and developing innovative ways of working with large and complex spatial data. items.desc: La Direction Générale de la Sécurité Extérieure, DGSE, recrute un Applied AI Engineer, LLM Infra(H/F). Le poste est situé à Paris. La nationalité française est obligatoire. Domaine métier Sciences et Technologies Votre environnement de travail Intégré au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire, vous participez au développement de produits d’IA Générative multi-agents basés sur différents Large Language Models (LLM) pour répondre aux besoins de l’ensemble des agents. Vous sélectionnez, adaptez, évaluez et déployez des LLMs en collaboration avec les autres Applied AI Engineers, Fullstack, Data Engineers, et SRE de l’équipe. Les applications déployées permettront à nos analystes en renseignement d’exploiter plus rapidement de grandes quantités de données et d’en extraire des informations pertinentes pour le renseignement opérationnel. Leurs métiers ainsi que ceux de la direction technique et de l’innovation s’en verront transformés. L’équipe dispose d’un excellent environnement pour adapter ces modèles aux besoins de la DGSE : accès à d’importants volumes de données pour l’apprentissage et mise à disposition d’infrastructures informatiques dédiées (clusters GPU d’entrainement et d’inférence), partenariats avec des laboratoires de recherche et startups. L’équipe mène aussi des activités de recherche afin de maintenir une connaissance de l’état de l’art sur les thématiques d’intérêt, ainsi que sur les technologies, approches et outils et propose de nouveaux cas d’usage pouvant avoir un fort impact sur le métier. Vos missions Vous serez en charge des activités suivantes : participer à l’interconnexion des produits aux sources de données internes, aux autres outils et fonctionnalités (MCP Server, …), participer au stream GenAI Enablement en mettant à disposition des APIs et bibliothèques permettant de rendre accessible l’IA Générative au plus grand nombre, apporter une expertise aux initiatives locales et spécialisées sur un besoin, prendre part à la spécification, à l’implémentation et au maintien en condition opérationnelle des produits, services ou procédés que l’équipe développe et maintient, prendre part à la spécification, à l’implémentation et au maintien en condition opérationnelle du socle MLOps (Langfuse, MLFlow, DVC, …) intervenir sur les phases de mise en production d’un LLM (évaluation, fine-tune, déploiement, suivi des performances du modèle), s’informer des avancées scientifiques dans le domaine d’intérêt de l’équipe, mais aussi et surtout proposer des approches novatrices permettant de répondre aux besoins du Service Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau bac+5 ou doctorat avec une spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, data science ou apprentissage automatique. Vous avez un profil junior, confirmé ou senior. Vous possédez les compétences et qualités suivantes : vous êtes apte au travail en équipe, vous êtes curieux de nature, autonome et proactif, vous avez un bon relationnel et une capacité à adapter votre discours à vos interlocuteurs, vous maîtrisez Python, vous disposez de bonnes compétences en sécurité, APIs, vous avez de bonnes connaissances en Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, vous êtes passionné par les nouvelles technologies, vous avez une forte appétence pour les LLM. Les plus de l’offre Technologies à la pointe Missions uniques Absence de routine L’IA générative transforme nos métiers, nos usages, nos pratiques. Nos adversaires adoptent et tirent parti de ces nouveaux outils. Rejoignez-nous et participez à cette révolution d’ampleur en donnant un sens à votre métier !. Le poste est soumis à l’obtention d’une habilitation. L’accès au téléphone et à Internet pour un usage personnel est réglementé. items.desc: Opis stanowiska Projektowanie, budowa i rozwój modeli Machine Learning, w szczególności modeli predykcyjnych, odpowiadających na konkretne potrzeby biznesowe. Prowadzenie analiz eksploracyjnych i statystycznych wspierających podejmowanie decyzji biznesowych. Dobór zmiennych, tworzenie cech (feature engineering) oraz przygotowanie danych do modelowania. Dobór odpowiednich metod i algorytmów ML oraz ocena jakości i stabilności modeli z wykorzystaniem właściwych metryk. Monitorowanie modeli działających produkcyjnie, w tym identyfikowanie zmian jakości oraz potrzeby ponownego trenowania modeli. Analiza i wyjaśnianie działania modeli oraz ich wpływu na procesy i wyniki biznesowe. Udział w rozwoju procesu MLOps oraz operacjonalizacji modeli, obejmującego wersjonowanie, testowanie, wdrażanie, monitorowanie i odświeżanie modeli. Współpraca z architektami BI i innymi zespołami przy rozwoju środowiska analitycznego i procesów zasilania modeli. Prezentowanie wyników analiz i działania modeli zarówno osobom technicznym, jak i odbiorcom biznesowym. Nasze oczekiwania Minimum 2 lata praktycznego doświadczenia zawodowego w obszarze Data Science / Machine Learning. Wykształcenie wyższe, preferowane kierunki: informatyka, matematyka, statystyka, ekonometria, Data Science lub kierunki pokrewne. Bardzo dobra znajomość Pythona oraz bibliotek wykorzystywanych w Data Science i Machine Learning, np. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn. Praktyczna znajomość SQL. Dobra znajomość podstawowych metod i algorytmów Machine Learning oraz umiejętność doboru metody do problemu biznesowego. Znajomość zagadnień związanych z przygotowaniem danych i feature engineeringiem. Umiejętność właściwej oceny jakości modeli oraz doboru metryk, zależnie od rodzaju problemu. Znajomość zagadnień związanych z walidacją modeli, w tym cross-validation, overfittingiem, data leakage oraz doborem zbiorów treningowych i testowych. Rozumienie pełnego cyklu życia modelu ML, od przygotowania danych i eksperymentowania, poprzez wdrożenie, aż po monitoring i odświeżanie modelu. items.desc: Über fintegra fintegra ist ein TaxTech-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Nürnberg und Branchenpionier im digitalen Steuer- und Vermögensreporting. Unser Kernprodukt WAVE (Wertpapiere Automatisiert VErbuchen) ist eine vollautomatisierte Wertpapierbuchhaltung für betriebliche Depots. Wir verarbeiten Daten von über 80 Banken, betreuen über 1.000 Depotinhaber und arbeiten für mehr als 500 Steuerberatungskanzleien. Rund 50 Kolleg:innen entwickeln das Geschäft gemeinsam weiter. In unserer internen KI-Abteilung fin:labs automatisieren wir Verarbeitungsprozesse mit KI und machen sie für eine wachsende Zahl betreuter Depots skalierbar. Deine Aufgaben Du teilst deine Zeit etwa zur Hälfte auf Entwicklung und Enablement auf. Entwicklung (ca. 50 %) • Du optimierst unsere internen KI-Skills weiter, die die Teams im Tagesgeschäft entlasten. • Du konfigurierst Agenten und entwickelst sie weiter. • Du modellierst und evaluierst, wo ein weiterer Einsatz von KI sinnvoll ist, und stimmst dich dazu mit den Fachteams ab. Enablement (ca. 50 %) • Du schulst Kolleg:innen im Umgang mit KI und begleitest die Teams im Alltag. • Du pflegst die Schulungsunterlagen und gleichst sie mit den aktuellen Richtlinien ab. • Du sammelst Anforderungen und Ideen der Teams und machst daraus neue Werkzeuge. Das bringst du mit Voraussetzungen • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL, VWL oder einem vergleichbaren Fach • Ausgeprägtes Interesse an KI und Automatisierung • Verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit vertraulichen Daten • Freude daran, KI in der Praxis einzusetzen und komplexe Themen verständlich zu erklären Wünschenswert • Erste Berufserfahrung in der KI-Entwicklung • Erfahrung mit Claude, MCP, GoHighLevel oder Datenbanken • Grundkenntnisse in einer Programmiersprache • Kenntnisse im Steuer- und Finanzbereich sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Das lernst du bei uns schnell. Das bieten wir Bei uns gestaltest du mit, statt in festgefahrene Strukturen hineinzuwachsen. • Enormes Entwicklungspotenzial: fintegra wächst, und du prägst den Aufbau von Beginn an mit. • Gestaltungsspielraum im Mittelstand: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und setzt sie um. • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, denn fin:labs ist ihre Stabsstelle für KI sowie ein kollegiales Team mit flachen Hierachien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.[CR1] • Eine Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Wochenstunden bei einem TaxTech-Branchenpionier. • Hoher Remote Anteil, auch wenn du nicht in der Region Nürnberg wohnst. • Wohnst du in der Region Nürnberg, freuen wir uns darauf, dich einmal pro Woche persönlich in unserem Office zu sehen. Denn wir sind überzeugt, dass der direkte Austausch im Team wertvoll ist. • 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr. Wir freuen uns schon, dich kennenzulernen - Gerne virtuell wenn du nicht aus der Umgebung kommst und persönlich, falls du aus der Region bist!

items.desc: Depuis plus de 40 ans, Dassault Systèmes conçoit les technologies au service d’une transformation industrielle durable. Grâce à nos univers virtuels 3D, nous permettons à nos clients d’imaginer, de concevoir et de produire des solutions plus performantes, plus responsables et plus innovantes. Le contexte Préparer un modèle éléments finis prend souvent plus de temps aux ingénieurs calcul que la simulation elle-même. Notre équipe veut réduire ce temps. Au sein de la R&D SIMULIA, nous développons sur la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE les technologies qui automatisent la création et la mise à jour des modèles éléments finis pour la simulation de structures. Nos clients sont surtout de grands acteurs de l’automobile et de l’aéronautique. Dans le cadre de la stratégie Gen7, nous intégrons l’intelligence artificielle au cœur de nos applications de simulation, avec le compagnon virtuel LEO et des expériences génératives et prédictives. Vous rejoindrez une équipe à taille humaine et suivrez chaque fonctionnalité de bout en bout, du besoin client jusqu’au code en production. Poste en CDI, basé à Vélizy Villacoublay. Vos missions Comprendre et spécifier Analyser les besoins clients avec les Product Managers et les équipes avant-vente Rédiger les spécifications des fonctionnalités et des composants à développer Concevoir et développer Développer en C++ des composants complets : modèle de données, infrastructure, algorithmes, interface utilisateur Intégrer des solutions génératives et prédictives pour améliorer la productivité des ingénieurs calcul Contribuer au développement du compagnon virtuel LEO Livrer et faire évoluer Tester et valider vos développements sur des modèles clients réels Piloter des projets menés avec d’autres équipes R&D, y compris en sous-traitance interne Maintenir et améliorer le code existant Vos Qualifications Diplômé·e d’un Bac+5 ou plus, école d’ingénieur ou master en informatique, mécanique / calcul des structures, simulation numérique ou intelligence artificielle, vous disposez d’une première expérience en développement logiciel, idéalement en C++ (stage ou apprentissage inclus). Vous manifestez un intérêt pour la mécanique et le calcul, Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Vous appréciez autant le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités que l’évolution d’une base de code existante. Rigoureux·se et autonome, vous aimez apprendre, prendre des initiatives et collaborer avec des interlocuteur·rices aux expertises variées. Une connaissance des LLM, des agents ou du machine learning, ainsi que la pratique d’un logiciel de calcul de structures (idéalement Abaqus) ou de CAO (CATIA, SolidWorks), seront appréciées. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc. Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.desc: Job Description Graduate - Structured Quant (m/f/d) WHAT'S YOUR POSSIBLE? Take on a role where your ideas, expertise and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future. As a Structured Quant Graduate, you'll use data, analysis and modelling to help solve complex commercial challenges within the energy market. You'll work with large datasets, market information and pricing models to provide insights that support decision-making across power and renewable energy portfolios. This is a unique opportunity for graduates who enjoy combining mathematics, technology and commercial thinking. You'll gain exposure to real market dynamics, contribute to strategic projects and develop an understanding of how quantitative analysis supports trading, sales and portfolio optimisation activities. What Will You Do Develop and enhance pricing models used to evaluate power and renewable certificate products across the SEFE Group. Analyse market data, pricing trends and risk factors to support commercial decision-making and portfolio optimisation. Work closely with stakeholders across trading, sales, finance and technology to deliver analytical solutions to business challenges. Contribute to the development of new products and commercial opportunities that support the energy transition. Help maintain and improve pricing systems and analytical tools used across the business. Identify market, commercial and regulatory risks through quantitative analysis and data interpretation. Produce portfolio analysis and performance insights to help improve profitability and risk management outcomes. Use technologies such as SQL and Python to automate processes, analyse data and improve decision-making capabilities. Contribute ideas and innovative approaches that help drive business performance and support growth in new markets. What Will You Bring We're looking for analytical and intellectually curious graduates who enjoy working with data, solving complex problems and translating insights into commercial value. You'll Ideally Have A Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or due to be completed before the programme starts) in Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex information, identify meaningful trends and generate actionable insights. Experience using data analysis tools, programming languages or statistical methods through university studies, projects or internships, with exposure to SQL, Python, Excel or similar analytical tools. Strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately and effectively with complex datasets. The confidence to communicate technical findings and data-driven insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Commercial curiosity and an interest in understanding how quantitative analysis supports business performance and decision-making. An interest in energy markets, renewable energy and the commercial opportunities and challenges created by the energy transition. A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and enthusiasm for tackling new challenges and continuously developing new skills. Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted. About Us SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions that ensure reliable and affordable supply. Our activities span the entire energy value chain – from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. With decades of trading expertise and a growing LNG portfolio, SEFE is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to industrial customers, providing more than 200 TWh of gas and power each year. We supply over 50,000 clients, from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations. By investing in clean energies, we support our customers on their decarbonisation journey and contribute to the energy transition. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany. Securing energy – now and for the future. Our Benefits In return we offer a competitive salary supported by a comprehensive range of financial, lifestyle and wellness benefits with the flexibility to follow a hybrid working model. Bonus earning potential Non-contributory pension with 10% employer contribution 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and volunteering days Buy / sell holidays Life assurance Medical and dental insurance (family cover) Range of optional flexible benefits We are committed to supporting your career growth with opportunities to develop both your knowledge and experience through a blended approach to learning. Join SEFE and help us secure energy supply across Europe and shape a better, more sustainable tomorrow. items.desc: A las empresas industriales les piden cada vez más datos ambientales (clientes, licitaciones, auditores, bancos), y cada petición pregunta lo mismo en otro formato. Mappa es la suite de IA que conecta los datos que la empresa ya tiene, los ordena y calcula su huella sobre una metodología certificada: reporta una vez, responde a todo. POR QUÉ ESTE PUESTO, AHORA Sobre ese core, cada cliente se crea con IA y sin programar sus propias herramientas, como un portal para sus proveedores o la huella de cada oferta. En los próximos 12 meses vas a construir esos agentes y esas herramientas, y a conectar Mappa con el ERP y los documentos de cada empresa para que cada dato entre una sola vez. También trabajarás en el agente auditor, que revisará el inventario de emisiones antes que el auditor externo. Buscamos dos personas, de junior a perfiles con experiencia. QUÉ HABRÁS CONSEGUIDO • A los 6 meses, una herramienta o un agente tuyo está en producción con clientes. • A los 6 meses, has conectado de principio a fin los datos de un cliente nuevo. • A los 12 meses, el agente auditor funciona con clientes reales. • A los 12 meses, eres referente en una parte del producto y decides qué se construye. CÓMO TRABAJAMOS • Personas primero: cada incorporación tiene nombre y apellidos. • Criterio: una solución pequeña que entiendes a fondo vale más que una grande que no sabes explicar. • IA abierta y pagada por la empresa: úsala cuanto quieras, siempre que entiendas tu resultado. • Iniciativa y honestidad: aprendes rápido, propones pensando en el cliente y dices «no lo sé» cuando no lo sabes. • Cerca, estés donde estés: tenemos oficina en Barcelona y nos gusta compartirla; si vives en otra ciudad, trabajas en remoto y nos vemos cuando toca. QUÉ BUSCAMOS • Has llevado algo a producción con usuarios reales, en un trabajo o en un proyecto propio. • Programas a diario con IA y sabes cuándo no fiarte de lo que genera. • Te importa el problema del cliente tanto como el código. • Pides ayuda cuando te atascas. Hablas castellano y lees inglés técnico. • Te mueve que la industria tenga sus datos ambientales en orden. Hoy trabajamos con TypeScript, React y Next.js, PostgreSQL y Claude Code; no esperamos que lo domines todo. QUÉ OFRECEMOS • De 22.000 a 45.000 € brutos al año según experiencia, a jornada completa. • Barcelona o remoto, con horario flexible. Incorporación inmediata. • La empresa paga la IA que uses. • Un equipo pequeño que decide rápido: lo que construyas lo usarán clientes en semanas. PROCESO Respondemos a todas las candidaturas, y tras cada fase te contestamos en una semana. • Fase 1: llamada de 20 minutos con Víctor, nuestro CPTO. • Fase 2: reto técnico modular. Eliges una pieza del producto y hasta dónde llegas, y la enseñas en una demo. • Fase 3: entrevista con Jordi, nuestro CEO, sobre motivación y encaje. • Fase 4: conversación con el equipo. Usamos IA para organizar las candidaturas; cada decisión la toma una persona. Seleccionamos sin distinción de género, origen, discapacidad ni otra circunstancia personal. CÓMO APLICAR Aplica aquí mismo, en LinkedIn. También puedes inscribirte en la web, https://footprintmappa.com/careers/software-engineer, o escribirnos a hola@fmappa.com con tu CV y, si quieres, tres o cuatro líneas sobre algo que hayas llevado a producción. En la web tienes la información sobre protección de datos.

By combining advanced data analytics, AI, and proprietary market intelligence, Kingo helps manufacturers and industrial companies identify new market opportunities, discover qualified buyers and suppliers, and make smarter commercial decisions. Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models in production. Communicate findings and model results clearly to technical and business stakeholders. Contribute to documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of existing data science practices. Strong practical knowledge of machine learning algorithms, statistical modelling, and predictive analytics. Proficiency in Python and SQL . Experience working with existing production models and understanding unfamiliar codebases. Strong knowledge of feature engineering, model validation, and performance metrics. Good understanding of statistics, hypothesis testing, and experimental design. Experience with common data science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit learn, or equivalent tools. Ability to quickly learn new business domains and independently deliver meaningful results. Strong communication skills and confidence working in collaborative engineering and product teams. Nice to have Experience with churn prediction, propensity modelling, customer lifetime value, or subscription analytics. Experience building recommendation engines, personalization models, or customer segmentation solutions. Familiarity with Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, or similar analytical databases. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. Knowledge of model deployment, monitoring, MLOps, and workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow. Experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and uplift modelling. Familiarity with NLP, Large Language Models, or content classification. Experience using Git, automated testing, and collaborative software development practices. Previous experience working in digital media, subscription businesses, or consumer technology. Why join You will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful data science projects within a large international technology environment. Work with experienced data science and engineering teams. Apply machine learning to real products and customer experiences. Work with large datasets and established production models. Contribute to solutions that influence customer engagement, retention, and business performance. Gain experience across predictive modelling, personalization, and applied AI. Work 100% remote

items.desc: Do you want to question, change, and steer our company into the future? Are you passionate about technology and ready to make a difference? Then you will thrive at SEB. At SEB, we believe in fresh thinking, new working methods, and innovation to create a fairer and more sustainable world. Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success, while we place a strong emphasis on sustainability and digitalization as we shape the future of SEB. With the Tech Trainee programme and as an employee, we'll help you develop new skills and take on more responsibility to create a positive impact. You will become a crucial key player in shaping the future of the bank. Your tech trainee position and your team As a Tech Trainee in the Tech Trading Equities department, you will join our Equities Business Intelligence team and help shape the future of our Markets Data Warehouse. You will develop your data engineering skills while contributing to our data journey, with AI as an important tool. Working with modern tools and services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), you will help build reliable, high-quality BI solutions that support business-critical decisions in one of the bank’s most dynamic environments: trading. You will be involved throughout the development lifecycle, from understanding requirements to development, testing and deployment, in close collaboration with business stakeholders. Our cross-functional team of eight brings together GCP developers and colleagues who maintain commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions. Together, we are responsible for a handful of systems that are essential to equity trading. This role gives you the opportunity to connect technology with business needs and contribute to solutions that make a real difference. Simultaneously by working in the role you are being recruited to, you will participate in SEB's Tech Trainee Programme for six months. It will give you the opportunity to develop an extensive network within the bank, gain a deep understanding of the financial industry and our global tech organization, and be professionally and personally challenged. As part of the programme, you can expect to: contribute to meaningful projects, work on tech tracks, gain communication and leadership skills, and participate in a hackathon and a business challenge. Key traits to thrive in this role and programme We’re looking for young talents who are curious, motivated, and ready to question the status quo. To thrive in this role and in the Tech Trainee programme, you need to have: Graduated within the past two years, or will graduate before the programme starts on 1st September 2027 – from a relevant academic degree or a two-year vocational education in IT or tech Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership Great communication skills and to be able to work in English For this role, we’re looking for someone with: A curious mindset and a willingness to learn and explore new technologies. The initiative to take on challenges, ask questions and collaborate with others. Basic programming skills in Python, gained through studies or personal projects. An interest in data engineering and cloud technologies. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Terraform, GitHub or JavaScript is an advantage, but not a requirement. Previous experience (part-time work, own projetcs etc.) and involvement during your studies are advantageous but what matters most is your potential and passion . In our recruitment, SEB behaviours are something we consider when choosing whom to hire. These behaviours include creating value, acting long-term, and building positive relationships. What We Offer A six-month trainee programme, designed for professional and personal development A full-time employment in the role you have been hired for, after completing the programme successfully Agile and modern ways of working A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views Networking and collaboration opportunities A real business challenge to solve with other participants in the Tech Trainee programme, where you can create value and make a difference for SEB Extensive training and learning opportunities Do you want to be a part of SEB? It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity are crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from. The application period for the Tech Trainee programme is open until 10 th January 2027 23:59 CET. Please write your CV in English. The Tech Trainee programme will start on 1st September 2027. Our recruitment process We want to get to know you, and for you to get to know us. The recruitment process includes: Psychometric tests Interviews – digitally and on-site A case exercise …

items.desc: Horse Powertrain is launching the second edition of Horse Powering Talent, its Graduate Program at the Madrid headquarters, for 2026–2027. The program offers recent graduates the opportunity to gain practical experience in an international automotive company, contributing to projects related to digitalization, data analytics, artificial intelligence and business improvement. The eight-month program combines hands-on experience in real business projects with technical and soft skills training, as well as an Individual Development Plan supported by a mentor and a career coach. Project Tasks Understanding DataHub's metadata model, Data Products, Data Contracts, and access management capabilities. Defining the governance metadata required for automated policy enforcement. Designing the Governance-as-Code architecture. Developing integrations with DataHub APIs and GCP services. Building Terraform templates and automation workflows. Developing AI-powered components for policy interpretation and access recommendation. Implementing automated generation of IAM, Policy Tags, Column-Level Security, and Row-Level Security configurations. Implementing governance drift detection capabilities. Performing testing and validation of generated security controls. Measuring project outcomes and KPI achievement. Producing project documentation, architecture diagrams, and final recommendations for future adoption and expansion. Requirements We are looking for recent graduates with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity (with interest in Data Governance). Candidates should have a C1 level of English or higher and an interest in sustainable mobility, innovation, artificial intelligence and data analytics, together with a strong motivation to learn and develop professionally. Program details Location: Horse Powertrain headquarters, Madrid. Expected start date: 20 November 2026. Duration: 8 months. Monthly compensation: €1,500. Working hours: 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., including a one-hour lunch break. If you have recently graduated and are looking to develop your skills through practical projects in an international business environment, Horse Powering Talent offers an opportunity to start your career at Horse Powertrain!

Since 1968, our team of engineers, business analysts, software architects, designers and consultants provide tailor-made and standardized solutions to support the digital transformation of major public administrations and private companies in Switzerland. Our activity spans across multiples fields of leading-edge technologies such as AI, Machine & Deep learning, BI/BD, RPA, Blockchain, IoT and CyberSecurity. In this 6-month internship starting in Spring 2027, you'll build an AI-powered, real-time Technology Radar of our technology landscape. Your tasks Collect and analyze technology stack data from active projects in real time. Use AI to classify and tag the technologies detected across projects automatically. Benchmark our technology choices against mature and emerging market trends with AI. Develop a dynamic Technology Radar visualization that shows our current technology landscape at a glance. Support strategic decisions by highlighting opportunities for innovation and gaps between technology investments and business goals. Help detect vulnerabilities early and encourage regular minor upgrades, so large technology gaps and long-term risks don't build up. Work with Azure, DevOps and CI/CD pipelines to keep the radar connected to live project data. If you take on challenges with curiosity, motivation and drive, you've come to the right place! Let our motto inspire you: We make it work! Välillä saat asiakkaan ongelman eteesi aamulla ja päivän aikana pitäisi jo pystyä näyttämään, millainen ratkaisu siihen voisi toimia. Toisinaan taas sukellat syvemmälle tuotekehitykseen tai kehität olemassa olevaa asiakasratkaisua eteenpäin. Työsi jakautuu käytännössä innovaatiokehitykseen, rakentamamme Mylly.AI-tekoälyalustan tuotekehitykseen sekä asiakasprojektien kehitystyöhön. Innovaatiopäivät ja hackathonit ovat työn erityispiirre, mutta eivät koko työ: merkittävä osa arjesta on perinteistä ohjelmistokehitystä ja ratkaisujen viemistä kokeiluista kohti tuotantoa. Mitä työssä tehdään? Valmista speksiä ei aina ole. Sinun pitää pystyä hahmottamaan asiakkaan ongelmaa, rajaamaan olennaista ja löytämään nopeasti järkevä tekninen tapa päästä eteenpäin. Nopeus ei kuitenkaan tarkoita sitä, että laadulla ei olisi väliä. Päinvastoin: odotamme sinun tunnistavan, milloin teet tietoisen oikopolun ja mitä täytyy korjata ennen kuin ratkaisu voidaan viedä pilottiin tai tuotantoon. Työssä tarvitaan full stack -ajattelua. Käytännön teknologioitamme ovat muun muassa Java, Spring Boot, React ja TypeScript, mutta meille tärkeämpää kuin yhden pinon täydellinen hallinta on teknisen osaamisesi leveys. Sinun pitäisi pystyä ottamaan haltuun myös vierasta teknologiaa ja ymmärtämään ratkaisua kokonaisuutena – integraatioista ja tietoturvasta ylläpidettävyyteen asti. Tekoäly on tässä työssä myös kehittäjän työkalu. Odotamme, että osaat hyödyntää AI-avusteisia kehitystyökaluja sujuvasti ja harkiten: tiedät, mitä kannattaa antaa mallille, mitä tehdä itse ja ennen kaikkea huomaat, jos mallin tuottama ratkaisu on menossa väärään suuntaan. Mitä odotamme sinulta? Sinulla on useamman vuoden kokemus ohjelmistokehityksestä ja riittävästi teknistä varmuutta tehdä itsenäisiä ratkaisuja myös silloin, kun tehtävänanto on vielä puutteellinen. Toivomme sinulta erityisesti: Kykyä löytää innovatiivisia teknologian ratkaisumalleja. Tunnet AI-teknologiat ja niiden rajoitteet ja osaa yhdistellä kekseliäästi erilaisia teknologioita ratkaisemaan asiakasongelman tehokkaasti ja tuotantolaatuisesti. Vahvaa ohjelmistokehitysosaamista ja kokonaisarkkitehtuurin ymmärrystä. Teknologioista Java, Spring Boot, React ja TypeScript ovat vahvoja plussia. Nopeaa ja harkittua ongelmanratkaisukykyä. Pystyt hahmottamaan olennaisen, rajaamaan ongelman ja tekemään perusteltuja teknisiä valintoja. Kokemusta AI-avusteisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä. Käytät tekoälytyökaluja luontevasti, mutta ymmärrät ja arvioit kriittisesti niiden tuottamaa koodia. Laaja-alaista teknistä osaamista ja oppimiskykyä. Uusien teknologioiden ja vieraiden koodipohjien haltuunotto ei pelota. Oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä viedä asioita loppuun. Tartut ongelmiin itsenäisesti ja huolehdit, että asiat etenevät myös silloin, kun monta asiaa on työn alla samanaikaisesti. Yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Keskustelet ratkaisuista avoimesti, osaat antaa ja vastaanottaa palautetta sekä toimia asiakkaiden kanssa nopeatempoisissa työpajoissa. Vahvaa englanninkielen taitoa ja vähintään keskustelutasoista suomenkielen taitoa. Hyvästä suomenkielen taidosta on merkittävää etua tehtävässä. Millaista työ Evolverilla on? Olemme pieni asiantuntijayritys, jossa tehdään teknisesti vaativia ja kiinnostavia asioita ilman tarpeetonta jäykistelyä. Meillä pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, millaisia ratkaisuja rakennetaan ja miten niitä toteutetaan, ja oma kädenjälkesi näkyy. Saat vastuuta ja mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi monipuolisten haasteiden parissa, mutta et jää yksin: meillä arvostetaan avoimuutta, yhdessä tekemistä ja osaamisen jakamista. Kokeneiden kollegoiden kanssa pääset ratkomaan ongelmia, vaihtamaan ajatuksia ja oppimaan jatkuvasti uutta. Työ on kokoaikainen ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tapaamme kuitenkin säännöllisesti toimistollamme Helsingissä ja työskentelemme tarvittaessa asiakkaidemme luona, joten tehtävä edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä pääkaupunkiseudulla säännöllisesti. Palkkahaarukka tehtävässä on 4500–6500 €/kk osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta riippuen. Toivomme, että pystyt aloittamaan mahdollisimman pian. Kiinnostuitko? Hae tehtävää kotisivuillamme 29.11 mennessä.

items.desc: Als Data Scientist verbind je data, statistiek, AI en technologie om organisaties slimmer te laten werken. Je analyseert complexe datasets, ontwikkelt voorspellende modellen en realiseert AI-oplossingen die data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten en concrete businessresultaten. Daarbij werk je met machine learning, predictive analytics en Generative AI (Gen AI) om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen voor uiteenlopende businessvraagstukken. Je analyseert complexe datasets en ontdekt patronen, trends en verbanden die organisaties helpen om beter onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen. Je ontwikkelt, traint en optimaliseert machine learning-modellen en statistische modellen om voorspellingen te doen en complexe vraagstukken op te lossen. Je werkt met Python, SQL en moderne data science-tools om data te analyseren, modellen te ontwikkelen en resultaten te valideren. Je ontwikkelt AI-oplossingen en past technieken zoals predictive analytics, natural language processing (NLP) en Generative AI (Gen AI) toe op uiteenlopende businessvraagstukken. Je onderzoekt de mogelijkheden van Gen AI en ontwikkelt toepassingen voor onder andere kennisontsluiting, tekstanalyse en het slimmer en efficiënter inrichten van bedrijfsprocessen. Je ontsluit, verwerkt en transformeert data uit verschillende bronnen en maakt datasets geschikt voor analyses en modelontwikkeling. Je experimenteert met algoritmes en machine learning-technieken en vertaalt nieuwe inzichten en succesvolle experimenten naar praktische toepassingen. Je werkt met cloudgebaseerde data- en AI-platformen, zoals Microsoft Azure, Azure Machine Learning en Databricks. Je evalueert de prestaties van modellen en verbetert de nauwkeurigheid, betrouwbaarheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten. Je werkt samen met Data Engineers, businessprofessionals en IT-specialisten om data science- en AI-oplossingen succesvol in de praktijk te brengen. Dit ben jij Onze factbuilders combineren verwondering, creativiteit en een gezonde dosis eigenzinnigheid. Je beschikt over WO werk- en denkniveau en jaren werkervaring. Je hebt een positieve en proactieve instelling in combinatie met een groot relativeringsvermogen. Het is uiteindelijk maar werk ;) Je investeert in het team met passie en plezier, en krijgt daar veel voor terug. Je kan goed zelfstandig werken, maar weet ook om hulp te vragen waar nodig. Jij kan ook goed samenwerken en communiceren, zodat jij bij opdrachtgevers de juiste mensen weet te vinden. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, het draait niet alleen maar om eentjes en nulletjes. Dit krijg je ervoor terug Onbeperkt verlof. Hybride werken. Flexibiliteit. Wil je bijvoorbeeld 32 of 36 uur werken? Dat kan allemaal. Een goed salaris, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en senioriteit. Een ruime mobiliteitsregeling met mogelijkheden voor een leaseauto, NS Business Card en meer. Een sportieve omgeving. Wil je een marathon lopen of een toernooi voor het hele team organiseren? Leuk, wij vergoeden het voor je! Ruimte om je zowel persoonlijk als inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen met diverse trainingen, volledig in lijn met jouw ambities. Passie en plezier. Naast hard werken vieren we successen met borrels, uitjes en sportieve activiteiten, zoals ons jaarlijkse skiweekend in Oostenrijk :) We zijn een scale-uporganisatie. Je staat met ons aan de basis van de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Jouw ideeën doen ertoe. Dit zijn wij Wij zijn Forfacts, een sterk groeiende consultancy organisatie. Wij geloven in een eenvoudige wereld zonder bureaucratie en helpen organisaties met verandering, procesverbetering en datagedreven werken. Ons uiteindelijke doel? Eenvoud. Hoe doen we dat? We creëren inzicht, vanuit vrijheid en met realisme. Kijk voor meer informatie op www.forfacts.nl

items.desc: AI Engineer – Generative AI Location: London Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 basic DOE Working pattern: Hybrid working A well-established global consultancy is expanding its artificial intelligence team and is keen to speak with an AI Engineer who enjoys both building technology and solving real business challenges. The team helps organisations across multiple industries move from AI ideas to production-ready tools. You will be client-facing, blending engineering expertise with data science to create practical solutions built around generative AI. Projects span all the major cloud providers, so you will adapt to whatever platform each customer already uses. This role would suit someone who likes to understand a problem first-hand, spend time with the people affected, and see a solution through from early scoping to live deployment. Key Responsibilities of the AI Engineer Spend time with client teams to understand their day-to-day processes and spot where automation and AI could save time or improve outcomes. Prioritise potential use cases by weighing up business benefit, technical practicality, data readiness and risk. Analyse and prepare client data, and build the pipelines required to support testing and development. Create early-stage prototypes at pace and refine them based on user feedback, mainly using Python. Use machine learning and statistical techniques where they add value, presenting findings honestly, including any uncertainty. Put robust quality measures in place, such as testing frameworks, model evaluation, release pipelines and monitoring. Support clients in rolling solutions out safely, with clear governance, human oversight and long-term ownership. Assist with bids, client presentations and sharing best practice across the wider team. The ideal experience for the AI Engineer We’re looking for a technically strong engineer with good commercial instincts, someone who can take a loosely defined brief and turn it into something that works, while explaining their approach in plain English to non-technical audiences. You will ideally bring: A solid software development background, including clean coding practices, API work, version control and testing. Practical experience developing products using large language models, such as retrieval-based solutions, prompt design and tool integration. Confidence analysing and cleaning data with Python and SQL. Exposure to machine learning projects, with a good understanding of how to validate models properly. Experience measuring the performance of AI tools and deciding when they are ready for real-world use. Familiarity with deploying applications in the cloud, including security, automated release processes and monitoring. Excellent stakeholder skills and an interest in the business and change side of projects, not just the code. Bonus areas: forecasting, optimisation, computer vision, multi-agent systems or running AI tools in production. If you are an AI Engineer with practical generative AI and data experience, apply now for a confidential chat. If you don’t have an up-to-date CV, don’t worry. Click quick apply and I will help you.

items.desc: Wat ga je doen BKWI is een dynamische organisatie van ongeveer 100 professionals, gevestigd in het centrum van Utrecht. Samen bouwen we aan cruciale diensten binnen de werk- en inkomenssector van de Nederlandse overheid. De software die wij ontwikkelen ondersteunt dagelijks duizenden mensen, en jij kunt daar een belangrijke rol in spelen. BWKI heeft de ambitie en visie om AI te willen inzetten voor onze bedrijfsprocessen. Geen prototypes of experimenten, maar concrete oplossingen die betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en uitlegbaar moeten zijn. Wat je gaat doen Als Applicatiespecialist AI werk je aan concrete oplossingen voor generatieve AI, (test)automatisering en intelligente ondersteuning. Je maakt voortdurend technische afwegingen in samenwerking met collega ontwikkelaars. In je dagelijks werk hou je je onder andere bezig met: Helpen ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van productieklare AI-oplossingen; Ontwikkelen van betrouwbare workflows voor AI-toepassingen; Samenwerken met Product Owners, architecten, software engineers en AI-specialisten; Coachen van niet technische collega’s en bijdragen aan technische standaarden binnen het AI-domein. Waar werk je aan? Voorbeelden van onderwerpen waar je mee bezig kunt zijn: Generatieve AI-oplossingen (chats en code agents) voor medewerkers; AI als tool voor effectieve kennisontsluiting en -deling; Integratie van AI-functionaliteit binnen bestaande bedrijfskritische systemen; Monitoring, evaluatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de output; Veilige en uitlegbare AI-toepassingen binnen de kaders van de EU AI Act, AVG en DPIA. Waarom dit interessant is? Veel organisaties experimenteren nog met AI. Voor BKWI gaat de uitdaging een stap verder: hoe bouw je AI-oplossingen die betrouwbaar genoeg zijn voor dagelijks gebruik binnen processen die direct impact hebben op mensen? Dat vraagt om meer dan alleen kennis van modellen. Het vraagt om sterke software engineering, schaalbare architecturen en doordachte productontwikkeling. Je krijgt de ruimte om samen met je collega’s technische keuzes te maken, nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en mee te bouwen aan het AI-fundament van BKWI. Wat we van je verwachten Must-haves: MBO+ ICT met minstens 2 jaar ervaring of HBO in Informatica of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring met en interesse in AI en de bereidheid je hierin verder te ontwikkelen. Programmeervaardigheden (o.a. Java, Python). Kennis van software engineering principes zoals clean code, SOLID, testautomatisering en code reviews. Aanspreekpunt voor vragen rondom AI tooling en functionele vraagstukken. Kennis van en ervaring met Agile werken. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Wat kun je van ons verwachten Werken bij BKWI, betekent werken in een organisatie met zo’n 100 collega’s. De lijnen zijn kort, samenwerken is vanzelfsprekend en iedereen kan bij elkaar binnenlopen. Successen en ervaringen delen en vieren we graag met elkaar. Voordat je in dienst treedt moet je een recente Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) overleggen. Tijdens de selectieprocedure krijg je meer informatie over de aanvraag van de VOG. BKWI biedt jou het volgende mooie pakket arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een salaris van € 3.505 tot € 5.066 per maand (bij 38 uur), behorende bij schaal 7 van de CAO-UWV; 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (bij 38 uur) met de mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding; vakantiegeld 8% bruto per jaar (bij 38 uur); 13e maand van 8,33% bruto per jaar (bij 38 uur); goede pensioenvoorziening; fiscaal aantrekkelijk keuzeplan, inzetbaar voor o.a. sport, fiets of studiekosten; werkplek die uitstekend te bereiken is met het OV in het centrum van Utrecht; volledige reiskostenvergoeding woon-werk met een OV-pas; goede thuiswerkfaciliteiten, een thuiswerkvergoeding en een internetvergoeding van € 30,- netto per maand; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Werken aan moderne AI-technologie binnen een maatschappelijk relevante omgeving. Iets meer over ons BKWI, wat een afkorting is voor Bureau Keteninformatisering Werk en Inkomen, is een herkenbaar en afzonderlijk organisatieonderdeel van UWV. Wij bestaan sinds begin 2002 en werken in opdracht van het ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid. BKWI zorgt ervoor dat deze gegevens vanuit verschillende overheidsinstanties op het juiste moment digitaal beschikbaar zijn via één druk op de (BSN-)knop. Dit gebeurt dus op een snelle, makkelijke en bovenal veilige manier. Wij werken primair voor de SVB, UWV en gemeenten, maar waar mogelijk helpen we ook andere overheidsorganisaties binnen het SZW-domein. BKWI is niet bij iedereen bekend. Logisch omdat het – vanuit de burger gezien – op de achtergrond opereert. Onze inspanningen vergemakkelijkt de samenwerking tussen overheidsorganisaties, waardoor je als burger minder met onnodige bureaucratie wordt geconfronteerd. Hoewel je vanuit een relatief kleine organisatie met zo’n 110 collega’s werkt, heb je impact op het werk van ruim 35.000 ambtenaren en draag je bij aan minder bureaucratie voor miljoenen Nederlanders. Iets voor jou? Herken je …

items.desc: Internship - Agile Procurement: Data, AI & Project Execution “Exploring how AI and data analysis can drive efficiency, turn complex problems into intelligent solutions and enhance ways of working - that’s why I enjoy my internship!” The internship Are you passionate about data analytics, AI, procurement and business transformation? Join HEINEKEN’s Global Agile Procurement team, a high-profile internal consulting and project execution team. You’ll help turn data into insights, experiment with AI-powered solutions and support strategic projects across our four global regions - while gaining first-hand experience in a dynamic international organization. As an intern, you will become an integral part of the Agile Procurement team. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful assignments, experiment with new ideas and contribute to projects that make a real difference. Your work will include: Data analytics & business intelligence - develop and enhance Power BI dashboards, analyse and model financial and operational data, and build smart Excel-based tools and reporting. AI & digital innovation - identify, test and help implement practical AI and automation use cases, including Copilot agents and solutions using Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform and Azure AI. Project execution & collaboration - support Agile Managers with project planning, progress tracking, reporting and improved ways of working, while collaborating with procurement professionals and business stakeholders across functions, countries and regions. Your new team and workplace The Global Agile Procurement team sits within Global Indirect Procurement and operates as an internal consulting and project execution team. We lead strategic, high-impact initiatives across HEINEKEN’s four global regions - from cost efficiencies and process improvement to new ways of working and digital innovation. You’ll join a hands-on, international team where analytical thinking, creativity and execution come together, with the freedom to contribute ideas and the coaching to help you grow. During your internship, you’ll have every opportunity to get to know HEINEKEN as an organization, not just within your own team, but across departments. We trust and empower you to work with an entrepreneurial mindset. At HEINEKEN, we love bringing the outside world in and welcome fresh, new ideas with open arms. Of course, we’ll make sure you get the guidance that suits you. What a Day In The Internship Could Look Like Your day could start by reviewing a Power BI dashboard or analysing data to spot an insight for one of our projects. Later, you might join an Agile Manager in a project meeting with colleagues from another function or region, helping turn analysis into actions and a clear story for stakeholders. In the afternoon, you could test a Copilot agent, improve an Excel-based tool or prepare a progress update for a strategic initiative. The mix changes from day to day - combining independent work, collaboration, problem solving and plenty of opportunities to learn from people across HEINEKEN. The unique you! We believe everyone has unique talents, which is why we’re looking for you! Energy, drive and the ambition to grow are what make the difference at HEINEKEN. In addition, you bring: You’re currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Engineering, Data Science, AI or Business. You have a strong analytical mindset, are comfortable with numbers, modelling and data analytics, and are curious about applying AI in a business environment. You are digitally savvy and comfortable with tools such as Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint and Copilot. Experience with SQL, another programming language, machine learning or AI projects is a plus. You are proactive, eager to learn and comfortable working in English in an international environment. Even if you feel you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply. An internship is the perfect opportunity to learn and grow! Conditions of HEINEKEN You are enrolled at an educational institution for the entire duration of your internship and can provide proof of enrollment for the current academic year during your onboarding. In the case of non-EU nationality, you must be registered as an intern with a Dutch educational institution. In case of EU nationality, you may also be registered as an intern at educational institutions outside the EU. You reside in the Netherlands for the entire duration of your internship. Please note that HEINEKEN does not provide housing. You are in possession of a valid citizen service number (BSN). Our Internship Conditions During your time as an intern at HEINEKEN, you’ll work in a dynamic environment where growing and learning are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we brew your future step by step. In addition, we offer you: A full-time practice-oriented internship, starting on February 1, 2027 The duration of the internship is 6 months Your home office will be located at The …

Our software pays 1 in 6 UK employees, supports over 12,000 schools, and is relied on by 91 of the top 100 UK accountancy firms. We're a Great Place to Work® certified employer, recognised for our commitment to well-being, inclusion and development - and we're growing fast. Are you passionate about AI, automation, analytics and transforming how product organisations operate? IRIS Software Group is looking for a AI Operations Analyst to join our growing Product Operations function. This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of Product, AI, data and operational excellence, helping shape how one of the UK's leading software businesses uses AI to drive smarter decisions, greater efficiency and stronger commercial outcomes. The Opportunity This is not a traditional analyst role. You'll be responsible for turning manual reporting into intelligent, automated insight. Working closely with the Senior Manager, Product Operations, you'll use AI, automation and analytics to improve the tools, processes and reporting that support Product teams across IRIS's Accountancy, Payroll, HCM and Education divisions. You'll Help Answer Critical Business Questions Including Are our product investments generating the outcomes we expected? Are customers adopting new capabilities? Where should we continue investing, and where should we stop? How can AI remove operational friction across Product teams? How do we create a single trusted source of truth for reporting and decision-making? What You'll Be Doing As Our AI Operations Analyst, You'll Drive Product Analytics & Decision Support Build and maintain trusted reporting across Product, Commercial, Finance and Leadership teams. Analyse product telemetry, customer feedback, roadmap delivery data and commercial performance to generate actionable insights. Develop dashboards and reporting that support portfolio reviews, roadmap planning and business decision-making. Measure whether product investments are delivering their intended outcomes. Lead AI & Automation Initiatives Identify opportunities to deploy AI tools that improve Product team productivity. Build reusable AI workflows, prompts and automations. Create low-code and no-code automations that eliminate manual effort. Develop AI-powered solutions for reporting, process management and operational workflows. Help establish self-service AI capabilities that scale across the organisation. Generate Business Insight Synthesise large volumes of qualitative and quantitative data, including customer feedback, support tickets, research findings and commercial information. Create insight reports that help product leaders identify emerging trends, opportunities and risks. Support OKR tracking, portfolio performance measurement and operational reporting. Partner Across the Business Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Commercial, Finance, IT and Security teams. Help solve operational challenges through data, analytics and automation. Turn complex information into clear, meaningful insights for stakeholders at all levels. About You We're looking for someone who combines analytical thinking with a genuine enthusiasm for emerging AI technologies. You'll likely have experience in a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Product Operations or AI-focused role and be excited by the opportunity to shape how AI is used within a large-scale software organisation. You'll Bring Experience working with data, reporting and business analysis. Strong analytical skills across both structured and unstructured datasets. Hands-on experience with generative AI tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude or ChatGPT. Experience creating automations and process improvements. Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts into business value. Curiosity, initiative and a desire to continually learn and experiment with new technologies. A pragmatic, outcome-focused approach to problem solving. Desirable Experience Product Operations or Product Management environments. Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar BI platforms. Power Automate, Zapier, n8n or comparable automation platforms. Python and/or SQL. Jira, Confluence, Aha!, Pendo, Notion or Figma. Experience supporting OKR tracking or management reporting. B2B SaaS environments. Why Join IRIS? IRIS supports over 120,000 customers across the UK and internationally, providing mission-critical software to businesses, schools and organisations. This role offers the opportunity to influence how AI is embedded across Product Operations and help shape the future of a data-driven product organisation. You'll join a business that is investing heavily in AI, automation and modern product practices, while benefiting from the support, flexibility and development …

items.desc: HoriZn is pioneering a breakthrough battery technology designed for the high-power markets of the future, supporting the global shift to electrification. Our water-based batteries deliver market-leading performance through a novel polymer separator, combined with zinc halide electroactive species and carbon-based porous electrodes. To accelerate commercialisation, HoriZn operates a fully integrated product development model - from advanced materials through to cells, modules and packs - underpinned by in-house battery management systems. As an Applied Data Scientist, you'll be at the heart of how we develop better products, faster. You'll build and own the data foundations that power our development process: extracting and harmonising raw experimental data, engineering meaningful features, and crafting visual outputs that turn complex analysis into clear, confident decisions. Beyond solid data practice, we're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, drives step-change improvements in development cycles, and delivers data-led solutions that customers love. You will work within the Applications team, collaborating closely across engineering, product, application testing and commercial functions to translate innovation into deliverable products. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth, entrepreneurial business at a pivotal stage. While experience in battery technologies is advantageous, we actively welcome candidates from adjacent fields - bringing fresh perspectives to complex engineering challenges. In return, we offer a world-class environment to develop deep expertise in next-generation energy storage. Key responsibilities Accountable for continuously evaluating and challenging existing data methodologies, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement and driving step-change gains in the speed and efficiency of product development cycles. Responsible for automating the extraction of experimental electrochemical data and the generation of derived features, statistical analyses, summary tables, and default visualisations from raw inputs across different experiment types. Accountable for developing the tools, frameworks, and standards that embed consistent data quality into analytical workflows, ensuring outputs are reproducible and reliable. Responsible for building the strategy to automate pipelines to parse raw electrochemical data from lab instruments, including the design of ETL processes to clean, validate, and store data at scale, ensuring data infrastructure is robust, well-documented, and fit for purpose across current and future experimental programmes. Collaborate closely with the Technology teams to translate experimental intent into clearly defined data requirements, ensuring analytical workflows are aligned with scientific objectives. Further, communicate analytical outputs clearly and compellingly to non-technical stakeholders, including leadership and investors, to support evidence-based decision-making. Implement scripts/tools on an ad hoc basis as business needs arise. Responsible for improving business efficiency through optimisation. Collaboration with the broader business to understand areas when tools/scripts could be used to improve workflows. Contribute across data science, data engineering, and analytical functions with the flexibility to adapt to evolving business and technical needs. Lead and collaborate on greenfield projects, proactively bringing forward ideas and taking ownership of their execution. Are you the ideal candidate? You will have/be: Degree in quantitative fields such as Computer Science, Physical Sciences, Engineering, or equivalent experience; alternatively, have demonstrable experience in a similar role from a related field of expertise. Demonstrable proficiency in object-oriented programming for data analysis and pipeline development; experience with Python would be advantageous. Strong data visualisation skills and ability to communicate insights clearly and compellingly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership and investors. Experience with version control, including collaborative workflows; experience with Git would be advantageous. Experience developing and applying statistical methods and/or machine learning models to derive actionable insights from complex experimental datasets. Demonstrable track record translating experimental or business objectives into well-defined data requirements, working effectively across scientific and technical teams. Demonstrable track record of delivery of projects with challenging deadlines in a dynamic environment will be viewed as advantageous. Demonstrable track record of building and maintaining data pipelines and familiarity with SQL and structured datadatabase storage would be viewed as advantageous. Willingness to learn fundamentals from relevant fields, e.g. electrochemistry and/or familiarity with battery-related datasets across multiple scales and data types will …

items.desc: WHAT'S YOUR POSSIBLE? Take on a role where your ideas, expertise and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future. As a Structured Quant Graduate, you'll use data, analysis and modelling to help solve complex commercial challenges within the energy market. You'll work with large datasets, market information and pricing models to provide insights that support decision-making across power and renewable energy portfolios. This is a unique opportunity for graduates who enjoy combining mathematics, technology and commercial thinking. You'll gain exposure to real market dynamics, contribute to strategic projects and develop an understanding of how quantitative analysis supports trading, sales and portfolio optimisation activities. What Will You Do Develop and enhance pricing models used to evaluate power and renewable certificate products across the SEFE Group. Analyse market data, pricing trends and risk factors to support commercial decision-making and portfolio optimisation. Work closely with stakeholders across trading, sales, finance and technology to deliver analytical solutions to business challenges. Contribute to the development of new products and commercial opportunities that support the energy transition. Help maintain and improve pricing systems and analytical tools used across the business. Identify market, commercial and regulatory risks through quantitative analysis and data interpretation. Produce portfolio analysis and performance insights to help improve profitability and risk management outcomes. Use technologies such as SQL and Python to automate processes, analyse data and improve decision-making capabilities. Contribute ideas and innovative approaches that help drive business performance and support growth in new markets. What Will You Bring We're looking for analytical and intellectually curious graduates who enjoy working with data, solving complex problems and translating insights into commercial value. You'll ideally have: A Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or due to be completed before the programme starts) in Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex information, identify meaningful trends and generate actionable insights. Experience using data analysis tools, programming languages or statistical methods through university studies, projects or internships, with exposure to SQL, Python, Excel or similar analytical tools. Strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately and effectively with complex datasets. The confidence to communicate technical findings and data-driven insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Commercial curiosity and an interest in understanding how quantitative analysis supports business performance and decision-making. An interest in energy markets, renewable energy and the commercial opportunities and challenges created by the energy transition. A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and enthusiasm for tackling new challenges and continuously developing new skills. Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted. About Us SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions that ensure reliable and affordable supply. Our activities span the entire energy value chain – from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. With decades of trading expertise and a growing LNG portfolio, SEFE is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to industrial customers, providing more than 200 TWh of gas and power each year. We supply over 50,000 clients, from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations. By investing in clean energies, we support our customers on their decarbonisation journey and contribute to the energy transition. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany. Securing energy – now and for the future. Our Benefits In return we offer a competitive salary supported by a comprehensive range of financial, lifestyle and wellness benefits with the flexibility to follow a hybrid working model. Bonus earning potential Non-contributory pension with 10% employer contribution 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and volunteering days Buy / sell holidays Life assurance Medical and dental insurance (family cover) Range of optional flexible benefits We are committed to supporting your career growth with opportunities to develop both your knowledge and experience through a blended approach to learning. Join SEFE and help us secure energy supply across Europe and shape a better, more sustainable tomorrow.

items.desc: Wat hebben uitgebreide geautomatiseerde testsets vaak gemeen? Ze kunnen deels hetzelfde controleren. Tijdens deze hbo-afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je welke mogelijkheden AI biedt om zulke overlap te herkennen. Meer details Match criteria Opleidingsniveau HBO bachelor Stage type Afstudeerstage Functieomschrijving Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst. Binnen de afdeling Douane van de directie IV worden regressietests gebruikt om te controleren of softwarewijzigingen geen ongewenste effecten veroorzaken. Verschillende ontwikkelteams hebben hiervoor uitgebreide geautomatiseerde testsets ontwikkeld. Mogelijk bevatten deze tests overlap of controleren ze dezelfde functionaliteit. Dat kan leiden tot onnodig testwerk. Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je welke mogelijkheden AI biedt om dergelijke overlap zichtbaar te maken. Je richt je daarbij op de functionele bedoeling van tests en niet alleen op de technische uitvoering. Je onderzoekt in hoeverre een AI-oplossing regressietests van verschillende teams op conceptueel niveau kan analyseren. Binnen de Belastingdienst kun je hiervoor gebruikmaken van Copilot Chat. De Hoofdvraag Is Welke mogelijkheden biedt AI om overlap in regressietests te herkennen en daarmee het testlandschap efficiënter in te richten? Wat ga je doen? Je verdiept je in regressietesten en testautomatisering. Je inventariseert bestaande geautomatiseerde testsets en identificeert mogelijke overlap. Je onderzoekt welke AI-technieken mogelijk geschikt zijn. Je vergelijkt mogelijke AI-toepassingen met de huidige manier van testen. Je brengt mogelijke voordelen, beperkingen en voorwaarden in beeld. Je toetst jouw bevindingen met testexperts en ontwikkelteams. Je stelt een adviesrapport en implementatieplan op voor mogelijke vervolgstappen. Wil jij onderzoeken hoe AI de toekomst van softwaretesten kan ondersteunen én bijdragen aan de digitale dienstverlening van Nederland? Dan is deze afstudeeropdracht iets voor jou. Een bijzondere baan, omdat... je inzicht krijgt in een complex IT-landschap en moderne testprocessen. je werkt aan een vraagstuk dat direct waarde heeft voor ontwikkelteams en management. je onderzoek, analyse en advisering combineert in één afstudeeropdracht. je ruimte krijgt om eigen ideeën te onderzoeken. je samenwerkt met ervaren professionals die hun kennis graag delen. je kunt deelnemen aan bijeenkomsten van vakgroepen, waaronder de vakgroep AI. je professionele begeleiding krijgt bij het behalen van jouw leerdoelen. je in Apeldoorn werkt en in overleg gedeeltelijk vanuit huis kunt werken. Functievereisten Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld hbo-ICT, Software Engineering, Data Science of Artificial Intelligence. Je kunt onderzoeksvragen vertalen naar een concrete aanpak met onderbouwde adviezen. Je kunt gegevens analyseren en inzichten helder presenteren. Je hebt kennis van softwareontwikkeling en interesse in testen, testautomatisering of AI. Je hebt voldoende studiepunten behaald om aan je afstudeerstage te starten. Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands. Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden €800 Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd 40 uur Bijzonderheden Deze stagevacature wordt gesloten zodra een geschikte student is geselecteerd. Wacht dus niet te lang met reageren. De stagiair en de onderwijsinstelling moeten de in de stageovereenkomst vastgestelde geheimhoudingsplicht in acht nemen.
