items.desc: Konsert Strategy & IP is a leading consultancy at the intersection of business strategy, technology and intellectual property. Founded in Gothenburg in 2006, we work with some of the world's largest technology-intensive companies, close to the leaders who decide where to compete and how to win through technology and IP. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group. Like every consultancy, we are adapting to an environment that AI is reshaping. Much of the research, analysis and preparation that used to fill a project team's weeks can now be done by machines. Our clients face the same shift from the other side. Their strategy, technology and IP functions are under a clear mandate to work faster and leaner with AI. But today's landscape of point tools depends on the user to supply the context, and without it the tools speed up the doing without improving the thinking. What clients still need is sound judgment, grounded in the right context. That is where the real value of AI lies: not in faster work, but in better, more reliable and more impactful decisions. So rather than defend the old consultancy model, we are rebuilding ours around that: consultants who work inside our clients' organizations, supported by an AI platform that holds the client's context. That platform is Sapivia. We are now growing our in-house tech team, to make sure we have the capabilities under our own roof to take Sapivia to the next level. What we are building: Sapivia Sapivia is Konsert's AI platform. At its core is the context layer: a client-specific knowledge graph that holds the context every decision depends on. How the business, its technology and its intellectual property connect, what depends on what, and the reasoning behind the decisions already made. We have built that picture for clients by hand for twenty years; Sapivia captures it, keeps it alive and makes it available to people and AI alike. Our consultants build the context layer together with the client. The client's own people, Konsert's forward-deployed strategists and the AI tools the client already uses can then reason and act on the same picture, one that grows richer over time. Sapivia is already in use with clients, starting in IP, where the need is sharpest. But the same picture answers the questions every technology company has to ask: which technologies matter, where to compete and how to turn knowledge into advantage. That is where we are taking it next. The Konsert tech core team We are building a small tech core team: a handful of engineers with complementary skills. The team is led by a Tech Lead and sits in Gothenburg, next to the consultants who deploy Sapivia with clients. Build work happens in close collaboration with those consultants, several of whom spend part of their time in the team, so the domain expertise and the client's reality are in the room when we build. We work in an agile way with shared ownership: everyone is close to the users, effort goes where it is needed, and the team ships several times a week and owns the result together. Development runs in close alignment with Konsert's leadership team, with short paths to user input and quick decisions. The tech core team has a central voice in how Sapivia is shaped. Around this core, we scale with external developers and the Rouse Group's technology organization. Questions we are working on right now Giving AI the right context is only the start. Turning that context into decisions that large companies can rely on raises questions that few teams have answered yet. These are some of the ones we are working on now. They are open questions, not tickets, and you will help answer them. How do we assure the quality of AI responses at scale, when the right answer is often a matter of judgment? How do we best combine deep domain knowledge with what the models already know? How do we make a rich, connected body of knowledge feel simple and intuitive to work with? How do we give large organizations precise control over who sees what, across regions, teams and many users? How do we shorten the path from prototype to production code, while keeping the freedom to experiment? The role: Applied AI engineer You bring the applied AI competence to the core team. Sapivia's AI features run on the client-specific knowledge graph as their context layer, and the hard problems are in the harness around the models: retrieval, context management, tools, guardrails, evaluation and feedback loops. You take LLM-based features from first prompt to production, set up the evaluation that assures their quality, and help the team decide where AI creates value and where it does not. You work closely with the consultants whose judgment the system is meant to support. What You Bring Several years (likely 5+) of professional experience as a software engineer Experience building and shipping LLM-based features in a real product, including prompt design and systematic evaluation Experience with retrieval over …

A passion for innovation and the desire to work on projects that will improve the digital experience for millions of our guests. Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Sviluppare algoritmi e modelli predittivi a supporto delle attività di osservazione, monitoraggio e troubleshooting. Esperienza con algoritmi di Machine Learning (supervisionati e non supervisionati, classificazione, clustering, anomaly detection). Prevede la gestione sicura di credenziali e strumenti, il riconoscimento di minacce come il phishing e la segnalazione di eventuali incidenti. È prevista formazione per supportare queste attività. Technological challenges Crediamo che la tecnologia abbia un grande potenziale per migliorare il nostro futuro, per questo ricerchiamo talenti che siano motivati a costruire oggi il mondo di domani. Con il nostro portfolio clienti e i diversi progetti di R&D attivi, in ALTEN avrai modo di lavorare su progetti all'avanguardia. La nostra Technical Direction ti accompagnerà e indirizzerà durante il tuo percorso. Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi e di confrontarti con esperti del settore per ampliare sempre più le tue conoscenze. Potrai unire le tue passioni e metterti in gioco professionalmente. Accetti la sfida? Il successo di un gruppo si fonda sulla cooperazione e condivisione reciproca del sapere e degli interessi. Fulfilling Opportunities In ALTEN troverai corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze sia tecnologiche, sia linguistiche! Tramite ALTEN Academy potrai ottenere certificazioni con alcuni dei più importanti schemi internazionali come IREB®, ISTQB® e altri. Attraverso Aula Streaming, invece, avrai accesso a corsi di formazione più trasversali relativi a soft skills e potrai scegliere tra 12 corsi di lingua straniera. Sustainable commitment Crediamo che la tecnologia sia a supporto dello sviluppo sociale e della tutela ambientale. Oltre a collaborare a progetti che mirano alla sostenibilità, ci impegniamo a sostenere le cause che più abbiamo a cuore, avendo collaborato e collaborando, tra gli altri, con AISM, AIRC, LILT, Save the Children, Treedom, This Unique. Valorizziamo l'unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutte le nostre persone abbiano pari opportunità all'interno della nostra azienda, fornendo loro gli strumenti per esprimere al massimo il proprio potenziale. Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all'inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti di crescita …

items.desc: Being part of LOEWE gives you the opportunity to learn new things every day and work with people who are passionate about what they do, in a fast-moving and ambitious company. If you are interested in process improvement, data analysis and artificial intelligence, this is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience within the Raw Material Development department. You will support initiatives to improve raw material receipt processes, reduce invoice errors and optimize information flows between suppliers and internal teams, contributing to greater efficiency and continuous improvement. Your role will be: Analyse and monitor errors in the receipt of physical raw materials at the warehouse and propose improvements to optimize the process. Investigate recurring errors in stalled invoices and identify opportunities to reduce their number and resolution time. Support the development and training of an AI tool to analyse stalled invoices, helping to identify errors and speed up problem resolution. Manage incoming orders and coordinate outbound material orders. Review and verify order information in the system to ensure data accuracy. Propose improvements to information flows between suppliers and internal teams, helping to develop guidelines to ensure accurate information from the outset. Participate in the creation and analysis of KPI dashboards to monitor performance and identify improvement opportunities. Support the development of a calculator to estimate raw material sample prices and average production costs based on material characteristics. Prepare and update follow-up documents and monitor ongoing tasks and improvement initiatives. Collaborate with the Raw Material Research team, the Development Warehouse, Project Managers and the LG & Accessories department. What you need for the role: Currently enrolled in a vocational training programme or university degree, preferably in Business Administration or a related field. An interest in fashion, culture, administration and process improvement. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work. Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different teams. An adaptable and proactive attitude, with a willingness to learn. Critical thinking and a strong sense of commitment. Comfortable using Microsoft Office applications. Intermediate Excel skills. A high level of Spanish and an intermediate level of English are mandatory. Additional languages will be considered a plus. No previous professional experience is required. About us: Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise. At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

items.desc: Herzog & de Meuron is an international architectural practice based in Basel, Switzerland. Established in 1978, the practice is led by the two founders together with the Partners and the CEO. Today, an international team of over 500 collaborators is engaged in a wide range of projects across Europe, the Americas and Asia. The main office in Basel works in tandem with studios in Berlin and Munich, Paris, London, Hong Kong, New York, and San Francisco. We are looking for a Data Engineer & AI Specialist (100%) to join our Data and Automation team within Digital Practice in Basel, Switzerland. Your Key Tasks: Design, build, and take ownership of data pipelines, platforms, and integrations from concept through ongoing improvement. Develop robust data models and improve data quality, consistency, and accessibility across the practice. Build API-based connections and apply AI, agents, and MCP where they offer practical value for data processing and automation. Help shape our data maturity roadmap, establish pragmatic standards and governance, and drive their adoption across teams. Evaluate emerging technologies and translate complex requirements into sustainable, maintainable data solutions. As a Data Engineer & AI Specialist in our Data and Automation team, you will help advance data maturity across Herzog & de Meuron. You will shape how information is structured, connected, and made accessible across projects and business systems, building reliable foundations for analytics, automation, and AI. Our team works across business systems, project information, design data, and emerging AI applications. You will have the opportunity to take technical ownership, influence standards, and develop practical solutions with colleagues from across an international architectural practice. We welcome fresh perspectives and curiosity beyond the architecture industry. Your Profile: A degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Professional experience in data engineering, data integration, data platforms, or related technical fields. Experience working with complex data structures and connecting information across systems and disciplines. An architectural background is not required. Strong understanding of SQL, relational databases, data modelling, and the design of complex, reliable data structures. Experience with Microsoft Azure, cloud-based data services, and the design of data pipelines and integrations. Experience with APIs and system integration to connect applications and enable reliable data exchange. Interest in applying AI to data processing, automation, data quality, and accessible information, including emerging approaches such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, or with architectural tools and data sources such as Revit or Rhino, is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking and the ability to bring clarity and structure to complex information. A practical, curious mindset and the ability to turn ideas into reliable solutions. Ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical colleagues across an interdisciplinary, international practice. Interest in emerging AI technologies and a willingness to explore new approaches critically and hands-on. Fluency in English is required; German is an advantage. We offer: An international, creative, and challenging work environment. The opportunity to work on high-profile projects around the globe. An outward-facing position working in collaboration with world-class clients and institutions. We look forward to getting to know you. Your application should include a cover letter, a complete resume, portfolio, diplomas, certificates, and your expected annual gross salary in CHF. Please also indicate your willingness to relocate to Basel, Switzerland, if you are not already based in the area. All application documents should be submitted in PDF format, not exceeding 10 MB in total, through our online application form on our website, quoting reference number B26-20.

items.desc: Als AI Transformatiespecialist Financial Service Center (FSC) geef je vorm aan ons nieuwe FSC. Samen met je manager richt je het werk in het FSC slimmer in waarbij je zelf de toepassingen die dat mogelijk maken bouwt. Het FSC moet veel efficiënter en moderner, en er valt veel te winnen. Jij bent een van de eersten die deze nieuwe manier van werken vormgeeft en laat landen. dit ga je doen HEMA wil met AI een stuk productiever worden. Dat lukt alleen als teams hun werk écht anders gaan doen: andere processen, andere rollen en meer automatisering. Het FSC is een groot team met veel transactionele processen met vaste regels en complexe workflows. Denk aan facturen verwerken, afstemmen en controleren, de periode afsluiten en hier op rapporteren. Jij gaat zorgen dat we hier grote verbeterstappen gaan maken. Samen met jouw manager stel je een plan op en leg je prioriteiten vast voor echte impact. Je brengt in kaart waar in de processen, data en systemen tijd en geld naartoe moeten gaan. Daarna richt je het werk slimmer in en bouw je zelf, met tools als Claude, Copilot, Lovable en Power Automate – en eventuele Finance-specifieke tools. Denk aan documentverwerking (bijvoorbeeld van facturen), matching en afwijkingsanalyse, geautomatiseerde controles, hulp bij de periode-afsluiting en rapportage. Jij bepaalt samen met je MT+1 wat er gebouwd wordt. Je bouwt dus niet wat anderen toevallig vragen. Voor complexere oplossingen werk je samen met de AI Solution Engineers en het AI-platformteam van Digital, en je bouwt altijd volgens onze standaarden voor privacy en security. Bouwen is maar de helft. Je helpt collega's de nieuwe manier van werken eigen te maken, samen met de AI Adoptiespecialist, en je laat AI Champions in het FSC groeien. Je meet de impact in tijd, kosten en gebruik, en je houdt de roadmap scherp. Je werkt met de AI Business Consultants en AI Solution Engineers van het centrale AI-team en deelt wat je leert met de andere AI Transformatiespecialisten. dit bieden wij Bij HEMA werk je in een omgeving waar mensen écht samenwerken. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, wordt goed begeleid en krijgt feedback waar je écht iets aan hebt. Of je nu net begint of al ervaring hebt: bij ons ben je welkom. Daarnaast krijg je bij HEMA: 💸 Een goed salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring. 🌴 30 vakantiedagen (obv 40 uur) en 8% vakantiegeld, zodat je op tijd bij kunt tanken. 🎯 Een variabele beloning tot 14% van je jaarsalaris – afhankelijk van het gezamenlijke resultaat. 💸 Een netto onkostenvergoeding per maand 🎄 Een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 4% over jouw jaarsalaris 🛍️ 15% personeelskorting op al je HEMA-favorieten – van tompoucen tot handdoeken en notitieboeken. 🧓 Een goede pensioenregeling, zodat je ook later goed zit. 🚗 Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer (vanaf 10 km enkele reis tot max. 30 km) 🎡 Toegang tot het 'benefits at work'-platform, met korting op topmerken, dagjes uit en andere extra's die het leven leuker maken. dit breng je mee Jij bent innovatief en hands-on. Je geeft zelf richting en gaat aan de slag, in plaats van alleen te praten of kleine stappen te zetten. Je bouwt niet alleen: je zorgt dat collega's het ook echt gebruiken. Je legt AI simpel uit. Verder breng je mee: Praktijkervaring in Finance operations, controlling, accountancy of finance-transformatie, bijvoorbeeld bij een Big4-kantoor of een shared service center. items.desc: Company Description Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help create the unknown! Ubisoft Bordeaux Founded in 2017 by a handful of Ubisoft experts, our studio now counts over 400 talents from 20 different nationalities. Our teams contribute to some of Ubisoft’s biggest franchises: leading the production of Assassin’s Creed Mirage in 2023, working on Assassin’s Creed Shadows and the Claws of Awaji expansion, as well as unannounced projects. Beyond our AAA productions, we also drive technological innovation within the group through our expertise in the Anvil game engine and Ubisoft’s Online Services. We have also established a dedicated R&D division, La Forge, which brings together Ubisoft engineers and academic researchers to collaborate on prototypes that support game development, particularly in the field of AI. Job Description Neural rendering is an emerging field at the intersection of computer graphics and machine learning. It explores how neural networks can be used to represent, compress, and reproduce complex visual phenomena that are difficult to capture with traditional techniques [1]. While neural methods have demonstrated impressive quality in offline rendering and research prototypes, their integration into real-time systems remains challenging. Open questions include performance optimization on modern GPUs, balancing neural representations with analytic models, and ensuring controllability for artists and technical directors. Neural methods have shown impressive results to represent high-quality material appearance [2, 3]. Recently, we proposed a hybrid approach [4] that combines traditional microfacet BRDF with neural correction that better fits game engine constraints. Recent work [5] showed that diffusion models can help generate richer materials. But challenge remains, both with real-time neural rendering system and data creation pipelines that are to build. The goal of this internship is to investigate neural appearance techniques in the context of real-time graphics. During the internship, the student will survey recent advances in the field, identify key limitations in existing methods, and implement experimental prototypes. The work is exploratory in nature, with emphasis on deriving insights that can inform future research and potential integration into real-time rendering systems. References [1] Neural Shading (SIGGRAPH Course 2025) https://github.com/shader-slang/neural-shading-s25 [2] T. Zeltner et al., “Real-Time Neural Appearance Models”. SIGGRAPH (2024). [3] A. Weidlish. “Bridging the Gap Between Offline and Real Time with Neural Materials”. Siggraph Courses (2025) [4] De Oliveira et al., “Hybrid Neural-Microfacet BRDF Model for Real-Time Rendering”. EGSR (2026) [5] Yu et al. “Toward Richer Material Generation via Procedural Data Enhancement” SIGGRAPH (2026) Qualifications You are in the final year of an engineering degree or pursuing a research master in computer science or a related field. Ability to read and understand research papers Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python Good understanding of computer graphics, in particular rendering and shading Basic knowledge of machine learning and neural networks Interest in real-time rendering and the application of machine learning to graphics Knowledge of BRDFs, physically based rendering, or material models is a plus Good communication skills in English, written and spoken. Additional Information Contract : 6 months internship from March 2027 to September 2027. An internship agreement provided by your school is mandatory. Location : Bordeaux Supervision Antoine Houdard (R&D Scientist) Georges Nader (R&D Scientist)

Ottime capacità comunicative e standing professionale per interfacciarsi con team tecnici. La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 28.000 EUR e 35.000 EUR. items.desc: Karolinska genomför just nu en strategisk förflyttning för att bygga framtidens sjukvårdslogistik. Vi söker nu en erfaren analytiker som ska utveckla och ta vår datadrivna förmåga inom Logistikutveckling och Supply Chain Management till nästa nivå. I denna roll får du en unik möjlighet att kombinera verksamhetsnära logistikanalys med Business Intelligence, statistisk analys, AI, maskininlärning och optimering. Du erbjuds En central roll där du ansvarar för hela analyskedjan: från att formulera verksamhetsproblem och kvalitetssäkra data till att införa och följa upp skarpa analys- och AI-lösningar. Ett tydligt uppdrag att omsätta data till bättre beslut, effektivare processer och mätbara förbättringar inom sortimentstyrning, lager, försörjning, förråd samt transport. Ett varierat tekniskt arbete där du driver utveckling inom fyra kompletterande områden: historisk-, prediktiv- och preskriptiv analys samt generativ AI och automatisering. Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig. Om tjänsten Som senior dataanalytiker ligger ditt primära fokus på att bygga lösningar som kan användas i den operativa och taktiska styrningen av verksamheten, snarare än att enbart ta fram rapporter. Rollen syftar till att utveckla analysen för att svara på vad som har hänt, vad som förväntas hända, vilka åtgärder som ger bäst resultat samt hur generativ AI kan automatisera och förenkla informationsbearbetning och avgränsade arbetsmoment. I Ditt Ansvar Ingår Följande Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Bearbeta och analysera data från ekonomi-, avtal, inköp, lager- samt transportsystem. Kombinera data från flertalet källor för att utveckla ändamålsenliga data- och analysmodeller. Identifiera och hantera kvalitetsbrister i data gällande bland annat lagersaldon, artikeldata, ledtider, beställningar och förbrukningshistorik. Definiera och visualisera viktiga nyckeltal (KPI) kopplade till servicenivå, materialtillgänglighet, lageromsättning, kapacitetsutnyttjande, kapitalbindning, risk för brist- och restnoteringar, inkurans, leveransprecision, ledtidsvariation samt produktivitet. Skapa prognosmodeller som rör förbrukning, efterfrågan, lagerbehov, ledtider och kapacitet. Genomföra scenarioanalyser samt ta fram beslutsunderlag för säkerhetslager, beställningspunkter, lagerdimensionering, kapacitet och resursfördelning. Utveckla prototyper och piloter utifrån ett tydligt definierat verksamhetsbehov och nuläge, med en mätbar förväntad effekt. Utvärdera modellernas precision, osäkerhet, risk, användbarhet och förvaltningskostnad. Planera och säkerställa övergången från utvecklad prototyp till en produktionssatt och fullt förvaltad lösning. Utveckla dashboards, visualiseringar och återkommande beslutsstöd i plattformar som Tableau eller motsvarande BI-verktyg. Vi söker dig som För att bli lyckosam i uppdraget är du starkt verksamhetsorienterad och drivs av att koppla analys och teknik till välgrundade beslut och mätbar nytta. Du har en analytisk ådra och är ständigt nyfiken i ditt sökande efter orsaker, samband och möjliga åtgärder. Som person stämmer du in på följande egenskaper: Pragmatisk: Du förstår vikten av att välja den enklaste lösningen som ändå ger tillräcklig kvalitet och effekt. Pedagogisk: Du kan kommunicera på ett tydligt sätt och har förmågan att göra komplexa data och modeller begripliga och användbara för mottagaren. Iterativ: Du trivs med att testa idéer tidigt och iterera fram lösningen för att hela tiden förbättra den tillsammans med användarna. Självständig och samarbetsorienterad: Du tar eget initiativ för att driva arbetet framåt och är en duktig brobyggare som skapar förankring mellan verksamheten och IT. Praktisk vana av att omsätta verksamhetsproblem till analyser, modeller och konkreta rekommendationer. En examen på civil- eller masternivå (alternativt annan relevant akademisk examen på motsvarande nivå) inom industriell ekonomi, Supply Chain Management, data- och systemvetenskap, statistik eller matematik. items.desc: En Thinkia construimos sistemas de IA para empresas. También estamos cambiando nuestra forma de desarrollar software: usamos agentes de código, especificaciones y pruebas para pasar de una necesidad a una solución que podamos revisar, desplegar y mantener. Buscamos a alguien que quiera trabajar en ese cambio desde la ingeniería. Que disfrute construyendo herramientas para otros desarrolladores y sepa desenvolverse cuando el sistema existente tiene años, poca documentación y mucho negocio detrás, en nuestras oficinas de Madrid o de Avila. El trabajo Tu foco será construir y mejorar nuestras plataformas de desarrollo con IA. Son las herramientas con las que conectamos la definición de una tarea, el trabajo de los agentes, las pruebas y la revisión humana. También trabajarás con equipos de cliente para ponerlas en uso. Hay entornos con Oracle y PL/SQL, aplicaciones que llevan años funcionando y prácticas de ingeniería que habrá que mejorar. Ese trabajo servirá para descubrir qué necesita la plataforma y comprobar si lo que construimos resulta útil. El centro de este puesto es mejorar cómo se desarrolla y mantiene el software. Trabajarás tanto en la plataforma como en su aplicación con equipos reales. Qué harás Desarrollar flujos que conecten especificación, código, pruebas y despliegue, con revisiones humanas y un registro de lo que ha ocurrido. Construir las APIs y las interfaces que usarán los equipos de producto e ingeniería. Trabajar en la ejecución de agentes: contexto, recuperación de tareas tras fallos, acceso a modelos, observabilidad y costes. Conectar la plataforma con repositorios, CI/CD, herramientas de tareas y sistemas de identidad. Crear herramientas para entender código y bases de datos existentes, y convertir ese conocimiento en documentación útil para el equipo. Preparar contexto, instrucciones y conexiones MCP para que los agentes puedan trabajar sobre cada sistema. Ayudar a los equipos de cliente a incorporar Git, pruebas automatizadas y flujos de trabajo con IA donde haga falta. No esperamos que llegues con todas las respuestas. Sí que sepas investigar, explicar tus decisiones y comprobar que lo que has construido funciona. Qué buscamos Experiencia desarrollando y manteniendo software en producción. Como referencia, pensamos en alguien con unos cuatro años o más, aunque nos importa más lo que hayas hecho y la responsabilidad que puedas asumir. Una buena base de ingeniería: SQL, APIs, Git, pruebas automatizadas y CI/CD. Uso habitual de herramientas como Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot u otros agentes de código. Queremos entender cómo las utilizas y cómo revisas su trabajo. Capacidad para orientarte en sistemas que no has escrito y trabajar con código legacy. Facilidad para trabajar con equipos de cliente, explicar decisiones y acompañar cambios en su forma de desarrollar. Inglés suficiente para leer documentación y participar en reuniones. Nos vendrá especialmente bien que hayas trabajado en productos SaaS, plataformas multi-tenant, Oracle o PL/SQL. También valoramos experiencia con motores de workflow, herramientas para agentes, grafos de conocimiento o modernización de aplicaciones. El portugués y la experiencia en seguros o servicios financieros suman. Con qué trabajarás Utilizamos Python, TypeScript, React y SQL; PostgreSQL y Oracle; y herramientas como Temporal, LiteLLM y Langfuse para ejecutar y observar los flujos de agentes. La plataforma incluye Keycloak y OpenBao, y trabajamos con Git, Docker, CI/CD y Playwright en AWS y Azure. Usamos Claude, modelos de OpenAI y modelos abiertos según el caso. No necesitas conocer todas estas herramientas: buscamos fundamentos sólidos y capacidad para aprender. items.desc: This is an outstanding opportunity for a Research Associate in Machine learning and/or Statistics, with a background in Statistics, Machine Learning, or related fields, to work within the Prediction Modelling group within the Division of Informatics, Imaging and Data Science at the University of Manchester under the supervision of Prof Matthew Sperrin and Dr Glen Martin. The candidate will support the aims of the CONNECT Study funded by Wellcome Trust. CONNECT is recruiting individuals with psychosis, and using smart phone apps to collect passive and active data using a prospective observational cohort study design. We are then using these data to develop and validate a personalised risk prediction algorithm for relapse. As part of this project, we want to maximise engagement and information obtained from digital remote monitoring by asking the right questions, at the right frequency and time; such ‘adaptive sampling’ (also known as active feature acquisition in the machine learning literature) is the focus of this post. The post will examine methods for adaptive sampling and investigate how to embed such methods within the CONNECT study risk prediction model. This position offers an ideal opportunity for an enthusiastic, well-motivated individual to work as part of a sociable multi-disciplinary team consisting of members with clinical, epidemiological, machine learning, data engineering and software engineering expertise. The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical, prediction modelling, communication and team working skills, and will be able to work with minimal supervision. Experience of prediction modelling and working with health data are essential for the position. Please note that the interviews for this post are expected to be held sometime in week of 25th Jan 2027. items.desc: Connect+ is een enthousiast bedrijf dat gepassioneerd is door ondernemers . Connect+ ondersteunt vakmannen in het uitbouwen van hun zaak door het netwerk te leggen tussen merken in elektro, IT, mobile en winkels, zowel off- als online. De samenkomst van de verschillende bedrijven en brands binnen Connect+ vormt ons uniek karakter in de markt. De persoonlijke aanpak en het lokale karakter van onze winkels onderscheiden ons van de ketens. We ondersteunen ons netwerk van zelfstandige retailers met o.a. ICT, data en slimme processen. Een groot deel van onze software bouwen we zelf en daarnaast werken we met onder andere Odoo, Microsoft Azure/Fabric en verschillende integraties met partners en leveranciers. We zetten stevige stappen vooruit; tegen 2028 vervangen we onze legacy-systemen volledig en ARTIFICIËLE INTELLIGENTIE krijgt daarin een centrale plaats. AI wordt vandaag al ingezet binnen ICT en zal steeds meer deel uitmaken van de manier waarop we binnen Connect+ werken. Er beweegt dus veel. En jij bouwt mee! Als SOFTWARE DEVELOPER MET FOCUS OP AI maak je deel uit van ons Team Software Development. Samen met je collega’s bouw en onderhoud je onze eigen applicaties. Je ontwikkelt NIEUWE FUNCTIONALITEITEN , analyseert en verhelpt bugs en bouwt INTEGRATIES tussen onze software, Odoo en externe partners. Na je inwerkperiode neem je zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid over onderdelen van onze applicaties. AI IS GEEN EXTRAATJE, maar een wezenlijk onderdeel van je job. Je gebruikt AI-tools dagelijks om sneller en beter code te schrijven, testen, reviewen en documenteren. Tegelijk bouw je zelf AI-functionaliteiten die processen binnen Connect+ en bij onze winkels slimmer en efficiënter maken. Denk aan het automatiseren van repetitieve taken, het verwerken van documenten en productdata of het intelligent ondersteunen van gebruikers. Je experimenteert met en bouwt oplossingen op basis van TAALMODELLEN EN AI-DIENSTEN VIA API’S . Prompt design, het koppelen van eigen data en het kritisch evalueren van AI-resultaten maken daarbij deel uit van je werk. Je kent niet alleen de mogelijkheden van AI, maar begrijpt ook de beperkingen ervan. KWALITEIT EN VERANTWOORDELIJKHEID staan centraal. Je werkt volgens onze ITSM-processen, waakt over GDPR en informatiebeveiliging en blijft verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van je code, ook wanneer die met behulp van AI is gegenereerd. Samen met je collega’s denk je actief mee over architectuur, codekwaliteit en testen. Wij zoeken een ervaren developer met een bachelor- of masterdiploma in informatica , of gelijkwaardige ervaring, en minstens 5 jaar ervaring als developer . Je hebt ervaring met . NET en Python, werkt vlot met databanken zoals PostgreSQL of SQL Server en hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen en aanroepen van REST API’s. Git, code reviews, testen en documentatie maken vanzelfsprekend deel uit van je manier van werken. Kennis van ERP-systemen, Azure en CI/CD is een mooie plus. Daarnaast heb je aantoonbare ervaring met AI . Je gebruikt AI-tools in je ontwikkelproces en hebt al toepassingen gebouwd met taalmodellen of andere AI-diensten. Je hebt een kritische blik en weet waar AI sterk in is, waar fouten kunnen ontstaan en hoe je resultaten betrouwbaar controleert. Je bent NIEUWSGIERIG en volgt de evolutie van AI actief op. Nieuwe technologie uitproberen geeft je energie en je deelt je kennis graag met je collega’s. Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels ; kennis van het Frans is een pluspunt. Je vindt bij Connect+ een collegiale werkomgeving in Zeebrugge waar expertise, samenwerking en een hands-onmentaliteit centraal staan. Je komt bovendien terecht op een bijzonder moment: je helpt mee de technologische fundamenten te leggen waarop Connect+ de komende jaren verder bouwt. Uiteraard wordt je marktconform verloond en wordt dit aangevuld met maaltijdcheques, mobiliteitsbudget, groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering en andere specifieke voordelen. Wil jij niet alleen software ontwikkelen, maar ook mee bepalen hoe we AI écht bruikbaar maken binnen onze organisatie? Neem een kijkje op www.connect-plus.be en stuur je interesse naar hr@connect-plus.be . We laten snel van ons horen.

items.desc:
ABOUT BLACK FOREST LABS

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

 


WHY THIS ROLE

We develop AI models and run the infrastructure on which those models are trained, deployed, and served to customers. Securing that infrastructure comes with real challenges: researchers need flexible access to significant compute resources, production systems need strong isolation and reliability, and model assets and customer data need protection throughout their lifecycle.

Our research and production infrastructure teams design, build, and operate these systems. We're looking for an experienced, hands-on security engineer to partner with them as we grow: someone who can dig into the details, do the engineering, and work alongside those teams to improve our defensive posture.

This is an engineering role: you'll spend time reading code, understanding systems, debugging problems, and shipping changes.

 


WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

These are the areas this role draws from; you're not expected to cover
them all at once:

 - Infrastructure architecture and isolation. Understand how our research and production environments fit together, identify consequential attack paths, and work with infrastructure teams to improve network boundaries, workload isolation, and access controls.

 - Identity and access. Improve how people, services, and workloads authenticate and obtain access to infrastructure. Reduce unnecessary privileges, strengthen secrets management, and develop practical approaches to short-lived credentials and privileged access.

 - Cloud and compute security. Strengthen security across cloud infrastructure, compute clusters, containers, storage, and orchestration systems. Help establish reusable patterns that engineers can adopt without unnecessary friction.

 - Model and customer-data protection. Work with research and engineering teams to protect model artifacts, training and inference pipelines, and sensitive data. Understand where trust boundaries matter and develop ways to verify that they hold.

 - Security in engineering workflows. Improve the security of infrastructure-as-code, build and deployment pipelines, and software artifacts. Build tooling and guardrails that help engineering teams prevent, detect, and fix problems without making security a bottleneck.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong experience securing production cloud infrastructure, with a solid understanding of identity, networking, operating systems, and distributed systems.

 - Hands-on engineering ability. You can write and review code, work with infrastructure-as-code, debug unfamiliar systems, and implement the improvements you recommend.

 - Good security judgment. You can distinguish meaningful risks from theoretical ones, make sensible tradeoffs, and explain why a particular security improvement matters.

 - Experience working closely with infrastructure or platform engineers, including designing changes that are practical to deploy and operate.

 - Experience in using LLMs and agents for security work, along with a clear-eyed view of where they help, where they don't, and how they themselves can be attacked.

 - Comfort working with real autonomy, finding your way through complex systems, and turning loosely defined problems into concrete improvements.

Experience with GPU clusters, ML infrastructure, multi-tenant services, Kubernetes, and software supply-chain security would be particularly relevant, but none is a prerequisite. We're more interested in people who have solved difficult security problems in real systems than in candidates who can check every box on a technology list.

 


HOW WE WORK TOGETHER

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

 - Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

 - Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

 - Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

 - Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. …

items.desc: Category: Research Location: Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, DK Job title: Advanced Laboratory Technician – In vivo Research Department: Global Research Location: Måløv, Denmark Your impact begins here You will support in building the experimental foundation of a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, established to generate and validate innovative therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. As one of two Advanced Laboratory Technicians in In vivo Research, you will turn scientific questions into well-executed rodent studies and shape the team’s capabilities from the start. Your work helps bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline. What you will bring You are a trained laboratory technician, hold a relevant technical qualification, or bring equivalent practical experience. Strong hands-on experience in rodent research, including mouse and rat handling, dosing and sampling. Relevant training and authorisation for the animal procedures you will undertake, as applicable. A careful, organised approach to experimental work, documentation and data quality. The ability to work independently within agreed study plans and to coordinate with colleagues. Curiosity, practical problem-solving skills and an interest in learning new methods. Confidence in sharing observations, suggesting improvements and asking questions. The ability to communicate and document your work in English. Useful, but not essential: Metabolic phenotyping, including food intake, body composition, glucose regulation or indirect calorimetry. Behavioural testing and neuroscience-related experimental methods. Rodent surgery and postoperative care. Tissue dissection, sample processing and ex vivo methods. In vitro assays supporting pharmacological or mechanistic studies. Establishing new laboratory methods or workflows. You are not expected to bring experience in every technique. We welcome complementary profiles. What you will do Working closely with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians, you will contribute to studies that test new ideas and help set up how the team works in the lab. More specifically, you will: Plan, coordinate and perform mouse and rat pharmacology experiments, including dosing, observations, sampling and relevant physiological measurements. Perform metabolic phenotyping and contribute to behavioural studies, according to your expertise and training. Collect and process biological samples for ex vivo and laboratory analyses. Contribute to developing, optimising and troubleshooting experimental methods. Record, quality-check and organise experimental data, and flag observations that may affect interpretation or later studies. Bring practical expertise to study planning and to discussions of results. Help establish laboratory workflows, maintain equipment and coordinate materials and study activities, working to relevant procedures, animal welfare requirements and the principles of replacement, reduction and refinement. Depending on your experience, you may also contribute to rodent surgery, specialised neuroscience methods or in vitro assays. Training will support the introduction of additional techniques. Who you will work with You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, part of Research & Development, working alongside scientists and laboratory colleagues with expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Scientific and technical colleagues plan experiments together, deliver them together and interpret the observations together, so your view counts at every step. The team is headed by Christoffer Clemmensen. You will also work with animal facility staff and laboratory specialists across the organisation. Today we are 1,000+ people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 8 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. TEAM Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to scale any product we build. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech. Today, our Creative team makes 10K+ ads a month, mostly by hand. We are rebuilding that process with AI to multiply both our output and our hit rate. The challenge is to build tools that produce at massive scale, with quality that holds up. ROLE You build the AI tools that let our creative team scale ads production without losing what makes them great. You sit with the people who use your tools every day, understand how they work and ship fast. AI brings speed and scale; taste and context stay human and your tools free our creatives to focus on exactly that. Your scope covers tooling for video and playable ads production: * Work hand in hand with Creative Strategists, AI Content Producers and Marketing Developers to turn their recurring tasks into tools * Track how your tools are used and what they change in production volume and ad performance, then iterate * Keep watching new AI models (image, video, agents) and bring the useful ones into our pipeline PROFILE * You graduated from a top engineering program, or you have up to 3 years of experience building internal tools, ideally with AI * You are a strong and versatile engineer who ships quickly and is happy to touch any part of the stack * You are at ease with LLMs, agentic workflows and generative AI for image and video * You enjoy working directly with end users and measure success by how much your tools are used * You keep a close eye on new AI models * You speak and write English fluently * Experience with Unity, game engines or ad tech is a plus BENEFITS * Swile Lunch voucher * Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo) * Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family * Wellness activities in our Paris office * Remote days on Fridays

items.desc: Deine Aufgaben Dein Herz schlägt für die IT, du bist dir aber noch nicht sicher, in welche Richtung du dich entwickeln möchtest? Wir hätten eine Lösung: In unserem Traineeprogramm zum Data Engineer durchläufst du alle Stufen vom Einsteiger bis zum Data Expert. Du lernst an der Seite erfahrener Kollegen, skalierbare, leistungsfähige und zugleich kosteneffiziente Datenplattformen aufzubauen, die es unseren Kunden ermöglichen, ihre Daten bestmöglich zu nutzen und so echte Mehrwerte zu stiften. Als Data Engineer ist dein Job vielfältig und herausfordernd: Einerseits bist du Lösungsarchitekt und konzipierst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden – vom Start-Up bis zum DAX-Konzern – moderne Datenplattformen nach aktuellen Best-Practices. Andererseits bist du Entwickler, indem du deine Ideen hands-on durch eigenen Code Wirklichkeit werden lässt. In unseren Projekten nutzen wir insbesondere Technologien des Modern Data Stack. Bedeutet für dich, dass du innerhalb kürzester Zeit verschiedenste Lösungen rund um Tools wie dbt, Snowflake, Databricks in allen Hyperscalern wie AWS, Azure oder GCP kennenlernen und in deiner täglichen Arbeit einsetzen wirst. Ein Auszug aus deinem zukünftigen Alltag: Du arbeitest in funktionsübergreifenden Teams – gemeinsam mit Data Engineers, Data Analysts und Business People, von uns und unseren Kunden Du entwirfst und entwickelst robuste und skalierende Datenlösungen entsprechend kundenseitiger Projekterfordernisse Du erstellst, optimierst und orchestrierst ELT-Prozesse, um Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen in einem Data Warehouse zu konsolidieren Du hältst mit uns gemeinsam Ausschau nach neuen Technologien und Trends Du hast jeden Tag ein Team hinter dir, welches dich bei allen noch so komplexen Herausforderungen entlang deiner Projekte unterstützt Dein Profil Für dieses Jobprofil, offenbar der “sexiest job of the 21st century", suchen wir nach einer Person, die bereits über erste Erfahrung in der Programmierung und/oder in der Arbeit mit der Cloud verfügt. Wir suchen nach einer aufgeschlossenen Persönlichkeit, die Lust darauf hat, das Wachstum unseres jungen Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Mit Neugier und Offenheit für neue Themen, Spaß an der Arbeit mit Daten und einem Coder-Mindset bist du die Person, die zu uns passt. Perfekt wird es, wenn du auch folgende Punkte mitbringst… Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für das Thema „Daten“ und möchtest Tag für Tag in einem hochmotivierten Team neue Dinge dazulernen Du trägst das „Tüftler-Gen“ in dir und machst dich selbstständig auf die Suche nach der besten Lösung für deine aktuelle Herausforderung Du hast idealerweise bereits erste Erfahrungen in SQL und relationalen Datenbanken und/oder Programmiersprachen wie Python, Java, R und Co. sammeln können Du hast ggf. bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit einer Cloud wie AWS, Azure oder GCP gehabt Möglicherweise hast du auch schon kleinere Projekte in deinem vorherigen Job gemanaged und fühlst dich bereit, auch Data Analytics-Projekte eigenverantwortlich zu leiten Wenn du bereits erste Erfahrungen mit unserem Tech-Stack gesammelt hast - umso besser. Falls nicht helfen wir dir bei der Einarbeitung Du hast fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C2-Niveau) Warum wir? Aktuell sind wir 10 Mitarbeiter*innen. Bedeutet, dass du früh an Board bist und die Gelegenheit bekommst, aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Wachstums teilzuhaben. Was wir dir noch bieten? Du wirst fester Bestandteil eines super motivierten Teams im Herzen von Oldenburg Frisches Obst und Getränkeflat sind cool, besser sind ein attraktives Gehalt mit echten Aufstiegschancen. Wir bieten dir beides! Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice sind fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur Wir freuen uns darauf, dich bei unseren regelmäßigen Workations und vielen weiteren Unternehmungen dabei zu haben Wir statten dich mit vollem Equipment aus - für Büro und zu Hause. Neues MacBook, moderne Monitore und alle Tools, die du benötigst Wir lieben es, uns nach langen Bürotagen auszupowern. Du auch? Deine Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio geht auf uns Wir planen ein festes Budget für deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung ein. Du bestimmst, wo du dich verbessern möchtest - und wir unterstützen dich dabei

items.desc: Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. Department overview: At PlayStation, Data Science plays a critical role in shaping how we invest in, retain, and delight our global player base. The CLV team focuses on understanding player behaviour and driving more effective engagement across the player lifecycle — from acquisition and onboarding through to retention, monetisation, and long-term value. As a Data Scientist , you will develop models and insights that help drive more personalised player experiences and inform commercial and product decisions at scale. You will work in cross-functional teams to translate player behaviour into actionable strategies that drive measurable improvements in player engagement and value. This role is ideal for an individual who is comfortable owning problems end-to-end — from framing and modelling through to delivering impact — and partnering with stakeholders to support data-informed decision-making. What you’ll be doing: Own the development and delivery of machine learning models for use cases such as churn prediction, purchase propensity, store recommendations, customer lifetime value. Translate business problems into modelling approaches, selecting appropriate methods and features to deliver measurable impact. Work with large-scale behavioural and transactional data to uncover patterns and opportunities for player growth and engagement. Collaborate within cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and commercial stakeholders, to ensure solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs. Partner with stakeholders across commercial, finance, and lifecycle teams to support decision-making with data-driven insights. Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences. Develop and expand your understanding of more advanced modelling approaches (e.g. deep learning and sequence-based methods) as part of solving increasingly complex problems. What we are looking for: You're curious, analytical, and a strong problem-solver, with a structured approach to tackling business problems. You bring strong foundations in modelling and data manipulation, and are motivated by applying these to impactful, commercial problems. Experience building predictive models (e.g. churn, propensity, segmentation, or value modelling) in a commercial setting. Ability to independently take a problem from definition through to solution and delivery, demonstrating initiative and ownership. Proficiency in Python and SQL, and familiarity with common data science and ML libraries. Solid understanding of machine learning techniques (e.g. regression, tree-based models, clustering) and when to apply them, including how to refine and tune them for real-world problems. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly articulate insights and work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. Awareness of modern machine learning approaches (e.g. embeddings, sequence models, deep learning) and interest in applying them to real-world problems. Experience working with large datasets to generate actionable insights. A strong academic background, typically a Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative or technical field (e.g. Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science). Nice to Have: Familiarity with production environments, MLOps, or data pipelines. Experience working with large-scale data using PySpark or equivalent distributed data processing tools. Experience in gaming, e-commerce, or subscription-based products. items.desc: About us We're an independent European digital product studio with a strong track record of delivering market-defining strategies and products for enterprises and governments. With about 200 talented people across three countries, premium AI capabilities and a diverse portfolio of international clients, we define, design and ship high-quality digital products, strategies and software. From global cloud-based platforms and large-scale apps to medical devices, banking software and augmented reality experiences. In a nutshell: if it lives and breathes digital, it’s what we do best. Become a part of our team At In The Pocket, you join a multidisciplinary team of designers, engineers, strategists and data specialists who care about the work as much as the people they work with. We work in small, autonomous teams that stay close to our clients and their users, and we give everyone the space to take ownership, speak up and grow. You’ll learn from colleagues across our studios, ship products that reach thousands or even millions of people and help shape what digital can do for leading organisations in Europe. What you’ll do We are looking for an AI Engineer to join In The Pocket. Foundation models have made a lot of things possible that weren't possible a few years ago. Your mission as an AI Engineer is to harness that power and turn it into a capable, reliable and trustworthy product that makes people happy and businesses grow. Design and build AI-powered features on top of foundation models: agents, multimodal retrieval systems, assistants, document analysis, advanced search capabilities. Guide concepts all the way from early idea, to prototype, to production deployment. Build evaluation into the work from the start, proving a system works instead of hoping it does. Facilitate important design decisions such as when a human needs to stay in the loop or when a step can run unsupervised. Design for security and data protection from day one, especially in regulated environments. Work directly with clients: understand what they actually need, ask the awkward questions early, turn a vague ambition into something concrete. Share what you learn with the rest of the AI practice, whether that's a demo, an internal session or a written-up experiment, and pick up what your colleagues have learnt. Who you are You’re a passionate engineer that wants to create elegant solutions for complex problems. You either have a Master's in Computer Science, AI or a related field, or you have a proven track record as an AI engineer. You have a deep knowledge of and hands-on experience with designing, creating and operating LLM-based solutions. You understand the capabilities, limitations and risks of using large language models, and you know how to build a reliable product on top of them (prompt engineering, context engineering, harness engineering,…). You have a deep understanding of concepts such as agents and tools, and you have experience with important industry standards such as MCP, agentskills, A2A. You have experience with retrieval and reranking, embeddings, chunking strategies and vector databases. You’re well aware of common software engineering best practices (CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code,…), and you apply them naturally. You know what secure software looks like and you apply the same standard to AI-generated code as to your own. Familiar with OWASP, and aware of the risks that are specific to LLM systems (prompt injection, data leaking through retrieval, permissions that are too broad). Pragmatic. You are comfortable choosing a simple solution that ships over an elegant one that doesn't, and you can explain the trade-off you made. You work with AI-native tooling and have opinions about it: coding agents, sandboxed execution, MCP, skills and subagents. You enjoy explaining what you know, to colleagues and to clients, rather than keeping it to yourself. You can explain a technical trade-off to someone who isn't technical. You’re fluent in English, and proficient in Dutch or French. What we offer Joining In The Pocket means becoming part of a team that shapes the future of our clients’ businesses across Europe. Here’s what you can look forward to: You’ll start with a permanent contract in a role that comes with responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and the value you bring. Our benefits package has you covered with hospitalisation and group insurance, meal vouchers, a phone subscription, and more. You’ll have a mobility budget that lets you decide how to get around, your way. Life at In The Pocket isn’t just about work, we host team events throughout the year to celebrate, connect, and have fun together. Learning never stops here, so after six months, you’ll receive a dedicated learning and development budget to keep growing your skills and exploring new horizons. items.desc: Deine Aufgaben Uni durchgespielt aber vor lauter Theorie wenig Praxis mitgenommen? Wir hätten eine Lösung: In unserem Traineeprogramm zum Analytics Engineer durchläufst du alle Stufen vom Einsteiger bis zum Data Expert. Du lernst an der Seite erfahrener Kollegen, wie du Rohdaten in echte Erkenntnisse verwandelst und auch komplexeste Datenmodelle verständlich visualisierst. Als Analytics Engineer fühlst du dich im Sweet-Spot zwischen Tech und Business am wohlsten. Genauso gerne, wie du den Austausch mit unseren Kunden suchst, liebst du es, eigenständig komplexe Datensätze zu transformieren und visualisieren. Entsprechend ist dein Job vielfältig: Du erarbeitest in Workshops die technischen Anforderungen der Datenlösung, transformierst Rohdaten aus verschiedenen Systemen zu echten Informationen und erstellst Reports, bei denen keine Fragen offen bleiben. Und all das so, dass die Zahlen und Fakten am Ende verlässlich und korrekt sind – nach unseren internen Best Practices. Ein Auszug aus deinem zukünftigen Alltag: Im Austausch mit unseren Kunden nimmst du verschiedenste Businessanforderungen auf und entwickelst Ideen, mit Hilfe von Daten Antworten auf offene Fragen zu finden Du nutzt unsere internen Best-Practices, um verlässliche und hochqualitative ELT-Pipelines aufzubauen Du verwandelst ungeordnete Rohdaten mit Hilfe moderner Tools wie dbt in transformierte, anwendbare Strukturen Du setzt auf einen pragmatischen Ansatz, um Visualisierungen und Dashboards zu erstellen, die es allen Nutzern ermöglichen, echte Erkenntnisse aus den Daten zu ziehen Du arbeitest in funktionsübergreifenden Teams - gemeinsam mit Data Engineers, Data Analysts und Business People Du bist stets auf der Suche nach neuen Technologien und Methoden Im gemeinsamen Austausch mit deinen Teamkollegen bekommst du auch die größte Herausforderung erfolgreich gemeistert Dein Profil Du hast also Interesse am “hottest new tech job"? Wir suchen nach einer aufgeschlossenen Persönlichkeit, die Lust darauf hat, das Wachstum unseres jungen Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Mit Neugier und Offenheit für neue Themen, Spaß an der Arbeit mit Zahlen und einem analytischen Mindset bist du die Person, die zu uns passt. Perfekt wird es, wenn du auch folgende Punkte mitbringst… Ganz wichtig: Du hast keine Angst vor (d)einem Computer. Bestenfalls kannst du uns überzeugen, dass du "irgendwie IT-affin" bist Du trägst das „Tüftler-Gen“ in dir und machst dich intrinsisch motiviert stets auf die Suche nach den besten Lösungen für verschiedenste Fragen Du hast bereits mit relationalen Datenbanken oder sogar (Cloud) Data Warehouses gearbeitet und hast entsprechend erste Erfahrung in der Nutzung von SQL (ausgesprochen: ˈsiːkwəl) zur Transformation von Daten Du hast möglicherweise bereits erste hands-on Expertise in der Anwendung eines Business Intelligence-Tools wie z.B. Power BI, Tableau, Qlik und und und gesammelt… Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrung in der Erhebung analytischer Anforderungen gesammelt und weißt, wie man die richtigen Fragen stellt Wenn du bereits erste Erfahrungen mit unserem Tech-Stack gesammelt hast - umso besser. Falls nicht, helfen wir dir bei der Einarbeitung Du hast fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C2-Niveau) Warum wir? Aktuell sind wir 10 Mitarbeiter*innen. Bedeutet, dass du früh an Board bist und die Gelegenheit bekommst, aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Wachstums teilzunehmen. Was wir dir noch bieten? Du wirst fester Bestandteil eines super motivierten Teams im Herzen von Oldenburg Frisches Obst und Getränkeflat sind cool, besser sind ein attraktives Gehalt mit echten Aufstiegschancen. Wir bieten dir beides! Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice sind fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur Wir freuen uns darauf, dich bei unseren regelmäßigen Workations genauso wie bei unseren Bürofeiern dabei zu haben Wir statten dich mit vollem Equipment aus - für Büro und zu Hause. Neues MacBook, moderne Monitore und alle Tools, die du benötigst Wir lieben es, uns nach langen Bürotagen auszupowern. Du auch? Deine Mitgliedschaft im Fitnessstudio geht auf uns Wir planen ein festes Budget für deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung ein. Du bestimmst, wo du dich verbessern möchtest - und wir unterstützen dich dabei

Vielfalt: Von der Unterstützung unserer Projektteams, u.a. bei der Kommunikation mit dem Management unserer Kunden bis hin zur agilen Umsetzung von datengetriebenen Strategien in konkrete Anwendungsfälle, nimmst du eine aktive Rolle ein. Innovation: Nutzung aktueller Trends sowie neuester Technologien im Bereich AI Strategy (z. B. Data Economics, Data Monetization, Data Ecosystems, AI Use Cases & Industrialisierung). Internationale Zusammenarbeit: Du engagierst dich in unseren interdisziplinären Projektteams bei der Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen und Projekte für unsere Kunden. Dein Skillset: Fortgeschrittenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Naturwissenschaften, Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Datenbezug oder in vergleichbaren Studiengängen Erste berufliche Erfahrungen durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten, idealerweise in einem der folgenden Bereiche wünschenswert: AI & Data Strategy, Data Governance, Data Architecture, Data Science oder digitale Geschäftsmodelle Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung und Spaß an der Entwicklung von Lösungen für strategische Fragestellungen rund um Data & AI Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift Deine Chance: Echte Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenpakete innerhalb unserer Projekte, die du selbständig bearbeitest Persönliche:r Mentor:in in deinem Team, der/die dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht und dich mit umfassendem Know-how unterstützt Ein chancenreiches und internationales Umfeld, das dir einmalige Einblicke in die Arbeit des weltweit größten Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmens bietet Work-Life-Balance in einem innovativen Unternehmensumfeld, das dir Gesundheitstage, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events und vieles mehr bietet Bereichsübergreifendes Networking im Deloitte Student Network mit exklusiven Vorträgen und regelmäßigem Austausch beim Praktikant:innen-Stammtisch Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke Deine Verfügbarkeit: Als Praktikant:in bist du ab Februar 2026 für mindestens 4 Monaten, idealerweise auch von 6 Monaten, verfügbar. items.desc: Jobbeschreibung Wir suchen KI-Automatisierungsingenieure (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt: Prozessautomatisierung & digitale Lösungen Deine Mission bei uns: Du liebst es, digitale Prozesse zu optimieren und effiziente IT-Lösungen zu entwickeln? Als KI-Automatisierungsingenieur (m/w/d) gestaltest du bei uns die digitale Zukunft aktiv mit. Dein Fokus: Automatisierung, Integration und die Entwicklung smarter Workflows für unsere verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche – gerne auch mit Unterstützung von Künstlicher Intelligenz. Deine Aufgaben: Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer (SaaS-)Anwendungen im Unternehmen Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software Dokumentation und Konzeption digitaler Geschäftsprozesse Planung und Einführung neuer Software- und IT-Lösungen Entwicklung von Schnittstellen zur Verbindung von Standardlösungen Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben mit Tools wie Make, Zapier oder durch API-Integrationen Fehleranalyse, Störungsbeseitigung und kontinuierliche Prozessoptimierung Tools & Technologien im Fokus: Make & Zapier: Diese Low-Code-Plattformen ermöglichen dir, komplexe Workflows zu automatisieren, Systeme miteinander zu verbinden und datengetriebene Prozesse effizient umzusetzen. Du entwickelst automatisierte Abläufe zur Optimierung interner Geschäftsprozesse und sorgst für eine reibungslose Datenintegration zwischen verschiedenen Anwendungen. HubSpot: Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung und Optimierung von Marketing-, Vertriebs- und Serviceprozessen. Du implementierst Automatisierungen für Lead-Management, CRM-Prozesse und analysierst die Effektivität der Workflows. Airtable: Flexible Datenbanklösung zur Organisation und Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen. Du konzipierst smarte Datenstrukturen, verbindest Airtable mit anderen Systemen und automatisierst Berichte sowie Dateneingaben. API-Integrationen: Aufbau und Verwaltung von API-Schnittstellen zur nahtlosen Verbindung unterschiedlicher Softwarelösungen. Du entwickelst individuelle Schnittstellenlösungen, um bestehende Tools optimal zu integrieren und Arbeitsabläufe zu vereinfachen. Künstliche Intelligenz: Implementierung und Nutzung von KI-basierten Lösungen zur Automatisierung komplexer Aufgaben. Dazu gehört die Integration von Machine-Learning-Modellen oder die Nutzung bestehender KI-Tools zur Prozessoptimierung. Gehalt: 3800 Euro pro Monat (brutto) Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglich in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden. Wir bieten: Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme. Die Übernahmequote liegt aktuell bei über 95%. Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig, Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen. Leistungsgerechte Vergütung & Karrierechancen : Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren und benötigen weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte. Stellenanforderungen Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Erfahrung in der Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen und im Umgang mit API-Schnittstellen ist wünschenswert, aber nicht erforderlich Kenntnisse in Tools wie Make, Zapier, HubSpot, Airtable und weiteren Automatisierungslösungen sind wünschenswert, aber nicht erforderlich Begeisterung für innovative Technologien, insbesondere Künstliche Intelligenz und deren Anwendung im Unternehmensumfeld Analytisches Denken, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Prozesse zu verstehen und zu optimieren Art der Stelle: Vollzeit, Festanstellung

items.desc: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. items.desc: ¡Hola! Somos Autonex, un equipo joven de Barcelona que lleva 4 años construyendo agentes de IA. Hoy trabajamos con cadenas de gimnasios de toda España y estamos dando un paso muy bonito: pasar de ofrecer "un agente de IA" a acompañar a nuestros clientes en sus resultados de negocio. Más que una herramienta, queremos ser un socio para ellos. Para seguir creciendo buscamos a alguien que se sume al equipo comercial, aprenda con nosotros y crezca a nuestro lado. Cómo es el día a día Gran parte del trabajo es hablar con gente: llamar a responsables de marketing, operaciones y CEOs de cadenas de gimnasios, entender cómo funciona su negocio y ver si podemos ayudarles. Al principio impone un poco, pero es de las cosas que más se aprenden y más enganchan. Llamadas, acompañadas de mensajes por LinkedIn y email. Preparar a quién vas a contactar y entender su negocio antes de hablar con ellos. Conseguir reuniones y entrar en demos junto a los fundadores. Aportar ideas: si algo se puede hacer mejor, queremos escucharte. Habrá días buenos y días en los que no salga nada, y eso forma parte del aprendizaje. Somos un equipo, así que muchas cosas las vamos construyendo juntos. Lo que nos importa No buscamos experiencia, buscamos actitud. Encajarás muy bien si: Te ilusiona construir algo desde etapas iniciales y ver cómo crece. Te gusta hablar con gente, aunque a veces te dé un poco de respeto. Eres proactivo/a: si ves algo que se puede mejorar, te animas a proponerlo. Tienes humildad para aprender, preguntar y equivocarte. Te atrae el mundo del emprendimiento o te ves montando algo algún día. Quieres dar un 101% Además, te pedimos español nativo y curiosidad por la IA (no hace falta perfil técnico, de hecho, no lo buscamos para este rol). Para que encaje bien en los dos sentidos Este es un rol comercial y de mucho trato con clientes. Si buscas unas prácticas en un lugar más cómodo en finanzas, administración o marketing backoffice, seguramente encontrarás algo que te encaje mejor que esto. Qué te llevas Aprender a vender al lado de los fundadores y participar en las decisiones comerciales. Ver por dentro cómo se construye una startup de IA: clientes, producto y estrategia. Ayuda al estudio de 5 €/h + comisiones desde el primer mes. Recorrido: si todo va bien, podrás participar en todo el ciclo de venta (reuniones, propuestas y cierre) y quedarte fijo en el equipo. Un equipo cercano, con buen ambiente y muchas ganas. Horario de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a 14:00, en nuestra oficina de Sant Andreu (Barcelona). Trabajamos de forma presencial porque estando juntos se aprende muchísimo más rápido. ¿Te apetece? Escríbenos a admin@autonexhub.es con tu CV y, si te animas, un audio o vídeo cortito presentándote: quién eres, algo de lo que estés orgulloso/a y por qué te gustaría unirte. ¡Nos encantará conocerte!

items.desc: Vi leter etter deg som er genuint opptatt av å lage gode produkter og ønsker å gjøre dette sammen med engasjerte og delingsglade likesinnede! Greit å vite før du leser videre: Er du dyktig skal det ikke være komplisert å søke jobb hos oss. Alt vi trenger er en CV, deretter velger du din foretrukne møteplass for fagsamtale der vi blir kjent. Enten det er Teams, kaffebar, lunsj eller på kontoret hos oss. Vi respekter din travle hverdag og sender ikke med oppgaver utenfor selve intervjuet. Om rollen din i Bouvet: Bouvet er det største norskeide IT-konsulentselskapet og har et av de fremste .NET miljøene i landet med flere hundre utviklere totalt. I Oslo er vi en kompetent gjeng på i overkant av 80 konsulenter som kjennetegnes av nysgjerrighet, raushet og faglig integritet. Vi pleier å si at vi ønsker å vokse forsiktig. Vi tror på gode matcher og langsiktighet. Vi jobber daglig med de største kundene og viktige og samfunnsnyttige løsninger og har et av landets aller beste og mest anerkjente Microsoft fagmiljø. Hos oss vil du mest sannsynlig inngå i et tverrfaglig team bestående av team/prosjektleder, arkitekt, interaksjonsdesigner, grafisk designer og utviklere. Vi vektlegger at våre utviklere i tillegg til å utvikle og sette opp løsningene, også har forretningsforståelse. På denne måten vil du kunne delta i rådgivende rolle. Det vil også være en fordel om du forstår hvordan KI kan gi mer verdi både for kunden og i utviklingsprosessen. Faglig vil du ofte være i nærheten av C# (.NET), KI-verktøy, Azure og web, uten at det er en begrensning. Vi er alltid nysgjerrige på nye teknologier. Vi liker å løfte produkter for å skape merverdi og gode opplevelser for brukerne hos våre kunder. Bruk av KI som teknisk verktøystøtte gir økt effektivitet og skaper nye muligheter. Om deg: Vi ser etter deg som: Har minimum 4 års relevant erfaring som utvikler, arkitekt eller techlead og har jobbet med: .NET-utvikling (C#) - frontend/backend eller fullstack-utvikling fra et eller flere prosjekter Trives med å forstå helheten i komplekse utfordringer og kan konkretisere og formidle dette for kollegaer og kunden Deler av vår kundeportefølje krever sikkerhetsklarering, så det er et krav at du kan bli sikkerhetsklarert Er nysgjerrig, med et ønske om å styrke vår felles kompetanse og til å utvikle konsepter og verktøy Har gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig (minst B2 nivå) Vi setter også stor pris på om du: Har kompetanse og erfaring med bruk av KI verktøy i utviklingsfasen Har erfaring med eller god kjennskap til databasesystemer, smidig utviklingsmetodikk og skyløsninger eller har kjennskap til disse og ønsker å lære mer om det. Det er også en fordel med kjennskap (eller interesse for å bli bedre) innen: Design Patterns Docker, kubernetes og andre systemer og verktøy for containerisering Vi tilbyr: Solid norskeid og regionalt styrt organisasjon med kort vei til beslutninger og mulighet til å påvirke hverdagen En arbeidsgiver som jobber hardt for å skaffe spennende kunder og oppdrag både i privat og offentlig sektor En hverdag tilpasset et hektisk familieliv med mye fleksibilitet. Et av de beste fagmiljøene i Norge Utviklingsmulighetene er gode – du får de utfordringene du vil ha, og kolleger og ledere støtter deg underveis. Vi legger vekt på faglig utvikling for den enkelte, støttende samarbeid og kompetansedeling. Mulighet for eierskap i egen bedrift gjennom aksjeprogram Konkurransedyktige betingelser med attraktiv overskuddsdeling Kjenner du deg igjen i noe av dette? Håper vi ses til en smidig ansettelsesprosess slik vil selv ville hatt den!
