items.title: Produktový manažer pro automatizaci a AI v reklamním systému Sklik
items.card: Budete se podílet na rozvoji výkonnostní inzerce ve Skliku, tedy oblasti, která tvoří největší část jeho obratu. Na starosti budete mít chytrou kampaň : od toho, jak ji inzerent založí a co za něj systém automatizuje, až po modely, které za něj vybírají cílení a soutěží v aukci. Vaším cílem bude, aby inzerenti s menší námahou dosahovali lepších výsledků. Sklik je reklamní systém Seznamu. Inzerují přes něj tisíce
items.desc: Budete se podílet na rozvoji výkonnostní inzerce ve Skliku, tedy oblasti, která tvoří největší část jeho obratu. Na starosti budete mít chytrou kampaň : od toho, jak ji inzerent založí a co za něj systém automatizuje, až po modely, které za něj vybírají cílení a soutěží v aukci. Vaším cílem bude, aby inzerenti s menší námahou dosahovali lepších výsledků. Sklik je reklamní systém Seznamu. Inzerují přes něj tisíce českých firem, od malých e-shopů po velké agentury, a reklamy se zobrazují ve Vyhledávání a na nejčtenějších webech českého internetu. Co budete dělat Určovat vizi, priority a roadmapu chytré kampaně a obhajovat je před vedením. Rozvíjet chytrou kampaň , ve které systém za inzerenta automaticky vybírá cílení podle jeho strategie a cíle. Zadávat problémy výzkumnému týmu, který staví modely strojového učení pro automatický výběr cílení a aukci, a s datovými analytiky navrhovat a vyhodnocovat experimenty. Mluvit s inzerenty, agenturami a obchodem a převádět jejich potřeby do jasného zadání pro vývoj. Automatizovat zakládání, správu a optimalizaci kampaní tak, aby Sklik obstál vedle Google Ads a Mety. Hlídat konverzní data a měření, na kterých automatizace stojí. Používat AI a agenty ve vlastní práci, od prototypů po analýzy. V týmu je to běžná praxe. Co budete potřebovat Máte za sebou produkt nebo velkou funkci, kterou jste dotáhli od discovery přes spuštění až po vyhodnocení, a umíte ukázat, co vaše rozhodnutí změnila. Obvykle to znamená zhruba 5 a více let v produktovém managementu. Rozumíte výkonnostní reklamě z praxe, ať jako inzerent, z agentury, nebo ze strany reklamní platformy. Víte, jak funguje aukce a co znamená CPC (cena za proklik), CPA (cena za konverzi) a PNO. Pracovali jste na produktu, kde rozhoduje algoritmus nebo strojové učení, a umíte s datovými vědci domluvit, co má model řešit a jak poznáte, že funguje. Umět aktivně pracovat s AI nástroji v produktové práci (prototypy, analýzy, agenti). Data čtete sami. Navrhnete a vyhodnotíte A/B test a jednoduchý dotaz v SQL si napíšete. Mluvíte česky nebo slovensky na úrovni C2, protože každý den řešíte věci s českými inzerenty, agenturami a obchodem. Oceníme Zkušenost z digitální reklamy, adtechu nebo datově řízeného B2B SaaS. Zkušenost s Google Ads (Performance Max, Smart Bidding), Meta Advantage+ nebo podobnou automatizovanou platformou, z pohledu uživatele i produktu. Zkušenost s e-commerce inzercí, produktovými feedy nebo retargetingem. Aktivní práci s AI nástroji v produktové práci (prototypy, analýzy, agenti) Na co se můžete těšit Vlastníte chytrou kampaň, jeden z klíčových produktů výkonnostní inzerce, na které stojí největší část obratu Skliku. Vaše rozhodnutí se během dní projeví ve výsledcích tisíců inzerentů. Pracujete s vlastními daty a vlastním inventářem. Reklamy běží ve Vyhledávání a na obsahových službách Seznamu, takže nejste závislí na cizí platformě. Výzkum, vývoj i datová analytika jsou přímo ve firmě. Model, který potřebujete, proberete s lidmi, kteří ho staví. AI a automatizaci používáme nejen v produktu, ale i ve způsobu, jakým pracujeme. Jak probíhá výběrko Úvodní telefonát s recruiterem. Krátce si popovídáme o vašich zkušenostech s produkty a výkonnostní reklamou a o tom, co od nové role očekáváte. První setkání (cca 30 minut online). Seznámíte se s vedoucím produktového týmu reklamních systémů a recruiterem. Projdeme jeden produkt, který jste dotáhli od nápadu po vyhodnocení, vaši zkušenost s produkty postavenými na strojovém učení a vzájemná očekávání. Praktický úkol. Dostanete ukázkové příklady úloh, které v týmu skutečně řešíme, zabere vám nejvýše jedno odpoledne. Budeme se zajímat o to, jak k nim přistoupíte, jaké hypotézy postavíte a jak navrhnete měření úspěchu. Druhé kolo osobně (cca 90 minut). Představíte své řešení vedoucímu produktového týmu a řediteli reklamních systémů. Zajímá nás nejen výsledek, ale i to, jak jste nad zadáním přemýšleli a jak obhájíte svá rozhodnutí. Nástup je možný nejdříve od února 2027.

items.desc: Job Description As part of Mantu’s growth, we are looking for a new team member within our Strategy & Transformation team. Reporting to the Head of Transformation, you will be part of a multicultural team with people based in various countries. You will play a key role in driving the adoption and value creation of artificial intelligence tools and practices across the Group. Your missions Lead the end-to-end deployment of new artificial intelligence tools, including planning, milestone definition, and follow-up until adoption is achieved Coordinate workstream leaders and involved entities to ensure seamless rollout Design and implement internal communication strategies for each deployment Explore partnerships with digital learning providers to support AI upskilling Deploy differentiated training paths by role, from foundational to advanced certification Track training completion and skills progression across the Group Manage a network of transformation leaders across brands and corporate functions to relay AI transformation Coordinate entities’ roadmaps and quarterly objectives related to AI transformation Organize and animate the community through regular sessions and best practice sharing Organize internal hackathons to accelerate the creation of concrete AI use cases Identify and unlock complex cross-functional processes for AI application Build momentum and visibility around the transformation program Track productivity gains and savings generated by AI tools Consolidate results at Group level and report monthly to leadership [doc2] Your profile Experience in project management, artificial intelligence, and change management Experience with generative AI tools Academic background: Master’s degree in management, engineering, or a related field English and French fluent Experience in strategy consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy/transformation teams (minimum 2 years) Experience running change or adoption programs across multiple countries or entities with measurable results Experience in training and learning design is a plus Experience in internal communication and influencing is a plus You demonstrate strong analytical skills and the ability to build and defend value measurement models You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and are comfortable presenting to executives and training end users You demonstrate the ability to drive progress across teams without formal authority What We Offer An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.) At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support. Mantu is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics. Who are we? Mantu is an independent international consulting player, founded in 2007. Bringing together expert and complementary brands, Mantu stands out for the breadth of its spectrum, responding to all business transformation challenges. Its activities are divided into four practices: Leadership & Advocacy, Technology, Brand Strategy & Experiences and Total Talent Management. A wide range of skills, all serving a single mission: connecting and powering companies with leading teams and technology to succeed faster and sustainably. From its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland, Mantu relies on a community of 12,000 talented people in more than 60 countries on 5 continents and has a turnover of 1billion euros.

items.desc: Role Title: Business Analyst (Swedish Language) Role Type : Full-time Location : Remote Role Overview: We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: 1. Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) 2. In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed. Requirements: 1. Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Swedish) 2. Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills 3. Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. 4. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities. 5. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 6. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. 7. Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. 8. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications: 1. Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. 2. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) 3. Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. 4. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: 1. Work in a fully remote environment. 2. items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As an electro-optical sensing expert, you will shape how we assess, process and use satellite imagery. You will build image-processing and quality-assessment pipelines, advise AI research engineers on sensor behaviour and physical limits, and manage technical work with data providers and satellite operators. You will also contribute to mission and constellation planning, weighing payload, coverage and processing trade-offs. Your work will help turn multi-modal satellite imagery into reliable, actionable intelligence for decision-makers and operators. AI expertise is not required.
 The day-to-day 
 Build and maintain optical image-processing pipelines for radiometric calibration, denoising, destriping, artefact handling, band co-registration, pan-sharpening, super-resolution, orthorectification, mosaicking and map generation
 Define automated image-quality checks for signal-to-noise ratio, modulation transfer function, geolocation accuracy, cloud and haze, and determine whether scenes are fit for purpose
 Manage acquired datasets from tasking and ordering through ingestion, cataloguing, metadata, cloud storage and scalable batch processing
 Assess data providers and satellite operators through technical reviews and pilot acquisitions, examine specifications and support procurement discussions
 Support mission and constellation planning by assessing ground sample distance, swath, revisit, payload selection, coverage, downlink and on-board versus ground processing, and prepare data for AI teams
 You should apply if you 
 Apply knowledge of optical or infrared remote sensing, including optics, detectors, modulation transfer function, signal-to-noise ratio, radiometry, spectral response and noise sources
 Have implemented and validated classical image-processing methods, including calibration, restoration, co-registration, pan-sharpening, orthorectification and mosaicking, and can explain their trade-offs
 Use geospatial tools and formats such as GDAL, rasterio, OpenCV, QGIS, GeoTIFF or COG, RPCs, digital elevation models and map projections
 Build automated, reproducible processing pipelines in Python, C++ or Rust, including in cloud environments
 Apply space systems engineering knowledge to mission and constellation design, and hold a relevant degree with industry or mission experience
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 Have worked on a flown mission or operational ground segment, or understand commercial Earth-observation data, tasking APIs, delivery pipelines, pricing and licensing
 Apply knowledge of infrared or thermal imaging, SAR, hyperspectral data, sensor harmonisation, photogrammetry, atmospheric correction or machine learning
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

items.desc:
Mission
 The Laboratory of Photonics and Quantum Measurements (LPQM) at the Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) is seeking a nanofabrication engineer to develop advanced processes and techniques for next-generation photonic integrated circuits and lasers. This role will involve collaborating with Bühler Group on a 2-year industry research project, which has the potential for startup commercialization. 
 The researcher will be responsible for developing advanced thin film deposition and ion beam trimming techniques on various material platforms, such as SiN, LTOI and LNOI. He/she will lead the collaboration with the Bühler Group on in-house fabrication of wafer-scale integrated photonic circuits, ensuring optimal operation and reproducibility in the cleanroom facilities (CMi). The candidate will design, fabricate, and characterize PICs for the project, as well as develop and improve existing processes and explore new material platforms and tools available from Bühler. He/she will also regularly travel to the R&D facilities in Germany to assist in optimising the recipes. He/she will prepare quarterly reports and facilitate effective technical exchanges between LPQM and the Bühler Group. High-level publications are expected at the end of the project in collaboration with the industrial partner. The position also offers the potential for technology transfer to a startup. 
 Main duties and responsibilities
 Cleanroom work in CMi/Labwork (60%): 
 Fabricate photonics chips using advanced semiconductor processing (etching, lithography, thin film depositions) 
 Perform statistical analysis of in-line metrology of the fabrication process, develop measurements to ensure reproducibility 
 Explore new material deposition techniques, etching techniques, cladding oxides, wafer platforms 
 Test and learn to operate new tools 
 Characterize the photonic chip performance 
 Travelling to Bühler Group in Darmstadt and Leibniz (20%): 
 Assist in the process development and master the tools available at Bühler 
 Document progress and report back to the team
 Design photonic chips and process flows (10%): 
 Modify existing designs to test the tool capabilities 
 Design new PIC devices to demonstrate the capabilities of the developed processes, using new techniques, tools and materials 
 Documentation and coordination (10%): 
 Quarterly report preparation 
 Technical reports on each new process, as defined in the project tasks 
 Technical meeting organisation and reporting on a need to go basis 
 Publication of new results in high impact journals 
 Profile
 Qualification/experience: 
 PhD in engineering or sciences with micro-nanofabrication of PICs as the theme of the thesis 
 3-5 years equivalent experience in thin film process development, instrument operation, and/or the fabrication industry 
 Extensive cleanroom experience 
 Technical skills: 
 Ability to rigorously follow processes 
 Ability to operate instruments with a high level of patience and attention to detail 
 Willingness to maintain highly organized data records 
 Interpersonal skills: 
 Ability to work independently, with a high level of responsibility 
 Strong communication skills towards the other lab members, CMi staff and collaborators 
 Willingness to work in a multi-national team 
 Willingness to travel 
 Computer/software skills: 
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office 
 Familiarity with K-layout, COMSOL, Lumerical 
 Languages: 
 Working proficiency in English, German and/or French is a plus 
 We offer
 A young, dynamic, flexible and highly motivated R&D environment 
 A productive team of high scientific and industrial impacts 
 Excellent laboratory conditions at Center of MicroNanoTechnology at EPFL 
 Opportunity to work on technology development with potential continuation in industry 
 Potential for technology transfer to a startup 
 Information
 Contract Start Date : as soon as possible. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis. 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. 
 Activity Rate : 100% 
 Contract Type: CDD 
 Duration: 1 year renewable 
 Reference: 2546 
 Contact
 For complementary information, please contact Prof. Tobias Kippenberg per e-mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch

items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 Contexte 
 Au sein d’une équipe d’automatisation développant des outils pour la modélisation SPICE en microélectronique, vous contribuerez au développement de nouvelles solutions d’intelligence artificielle appliquées à la modélisation technologique.
 Les modèles SPICE de transistors constituent un élément fondamental de la conception des circuits intégrés. Ils permettent de représenter le comportement électrique des transistors à partir de données de mesure et de simulation afin de prédire avec précision les performances des futurs circuits. La construction et la calibration de ces modèles nécessitent aujourd’hui l’exploitation de volumes importants de données ainsi que l’ajustement d’un grand nombre de paramètres.
 Dans le cadre de la poursuite de travaux autour de l’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle pour la modélisation SPICE, ce stage vise à développer des approches de machine learning capables d’assister les ingénieurs dans l’analyse des données, la génération de modèles et l’amélioration des méthodologies de modélisation des transistors.
 À propos de vos missions 
 Découvrir les principes de la modélisation SPICE des transistors et leur rôle dans la conception des circuits intégrés.
 Analyser des jeux de données issus de mesures électriques ou de simulations SPICE.
 Développer des approches de machine learning pour l’analyse, la prédiction ou l’assistance à la génération de modèles SPICE.
 Évaluer les performances et la robustesse des solutions proposées sur des cas représentatifs.
 Collaborer avec les experts modélisation afin de valider la pertinence des approches développées.
 Présenter les résultats du projet et proposer des recommandations pour leur intégration dans les flows existants.
 À propos de vous 
 Vous êtes étudiant en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou en Master 2.
 Vous possédez de solides bases en machine learning, intelligence artificielle ou science des données.
 Vous maîtrisez Python et avez idéalement une première expérience avec des frameworks tels que PyTorch ou TensorFlow.
 Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre développement logiciel, analyse de données et modélisation scientifique.
 Vous faites preuve de curiosité, d’autonomie et d’esprit d’initiative.
 Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse et d’un goût pour la résolution de problèmes complexes.
 Une connaissance du domaine de la microélectronique, de la modélisation SPICE ou des semi-conducteurs constitue un plus.
 Vous disposez d’un bon niveau d’anglais technique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
 ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025. 
 Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.
 Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.
 Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. La diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sont des valeurs fondamentales qui façonnent notre culture d’entreprise.
 Pour découvrir toutes nos opportunités, rendez-vous sur st.com/careers.

items.title: Stage M2 Data Scientist / Machine Learning appliqué aux propriétés moléculaires (F/H)
items.card: Vos missions Préparer et fiabiliser les données moléculaires, en traitant les doublons, les incohérences et le déséquilibre des classes. Comparer et améliorer les modèles existants, notamment les approches fondées sur les descripteurs RDKit et les graphes moléculaires avec Chemprop. Évaluer la généralisation à de nouvelles molécules, avec des protocoles de validation limitant les fuites entre structures proches.
items.desc: Type de contrat : Stage de fin d'études, 6 mois Date de début : Mars 2027 Localisation : Orléans, au Lab'O Village by CA - 1 avenue du Champ de Mars Candidatures jusqu'au : 31 janvier 2027 À propos de MS4ALL Face au coût colossal de dépollution des polluants dans l'environnement et à l'enjeu de trouver des alternatives aux PFAS dans l'industrie (polluants éternels), MS4ALL conçoit une plateforme basée sur la simulation moléculaire qui accélère l'innovation. Nous sommes une deeptech basée à Orléans, fondée en 2023 et issue du laboratoire GREMI. Nous avons conçu MS4Nature , une plateforme SaaS qui permet à la filière eau d'évaluer les traitements sur les polluants rapidement, d'anticiper les polluants émergents et de mieux comprendre leur dégradation. En parallèle, nous développons une plateforme d’éco-conception pour les industriels afin d’accélérer la conception de matériaux sans PFAS. Portée par 20 ans d’expertise scientifique du CNRS, MS4ALL développe des modèles d'IA pour bâtir les futurs jumeaux numériques de procédés industriels. Votre sujet de stage Comment prédire la propriété d'une molécule et déterminer quand cette prédiction est fiable ? Vous contribuerez à améliorer nos modèles de prédiction de propriétés moléculaires : toxicité , biodégradabilité et comportement environnemental. Le stage démarre sur un cas déjà outillé, la toxicité orale aiguë, avec des méthodes transposables aux autres propriétés. Vous vous appuierez sur des jeux de données et des premiers modèles déjà constitués, associant descripteurs moléculaires, machine learning classique et réseaux de neurones sur graphes. Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Franck Mbiaya, ingénieur-docteur senior en IA, avec le CTO, les scientifiques et les développeurs de MS4ALL. Vos missions Préparer et fiabiliser les données moléculaires, en traitant les doublons, les incohérences et le déséquilibre des classes. Comparer et améliorer les modèles existants, notamment les approches fondées sur les descripteurs RDKit et les graphes moléculaires avec Chemprop. Évaluer la généralisation à de nouvelles molécules, avec des protocoles de validation limitant les fuites entre structures proches. Étudier la confiance des prédictions et le domaine d'applicabilité des modèles, avec une attention particulière aux erreurs critiques, comme la sous-estimation d'un danger. Produire un pipeline reproductible et documenté, réutilisable d'une propriété à l'autre, accompagné d'un benchmark et de recommandations pour son intégration dans MS4Nature. Suivre l'état de l'art du domaine et en tirer des pistes testables Le périmètre expérimental sera défini avec votre encadrant, selon votre profil et l'avancée du projet. Technologies clés Données moléculaires : SMILES, structures moléculaires, descripteurs RDKit. Programmation & Data : Python, pandas, NumPy, Jupyter. Machine learning : scikit-learn, PyTorch. Graphes moléculaires : Chemprop, réseaux de neurones sur graphes. Environnement technique : Git, Linux, calcul HPC. Profil recherché Vous préparez un Master 2 ou une dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs en intelligence artificielle, data science, informatique ou mathématiques appliquées. Nous recherchons surtout une bonne maîtrise de Python , des bases solides en apprentissage supervisé et en statistiques, ainsi qu'une première expérience de projet ML, académique, personnelle ou professionnelle. Vous savez analyser les résultats d'un modèle, questionner la qualité des données et expliquer vos choix. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et lisez de la documentation scientifique en anglais. Atouts appréciés PyTorch, GNN, RDKit, Chemprop, estimation d'incertitude, chimio-informatique. La curiosité pour la chimie et les applications scientifiques compte également. Ce que vous trouverez chez nous Un sujet de recherche appliquée lié aux enjeux environnementaux. Un accompagnement par un spécialiste IA et des échanges directs avec l'équipe scientifique. Des données et des modèles existants pour démarrer vos expérimentations. La possibilité de suivre vos travaux jusqu'à leur préparation pour un produit logiciel Un environnement stimulant au sein de l'écosystème innovation du Lab'O Des temps conviviaux inter-entreprises (ping-pong, animations sportives) Pour postuler : Envoyez votre CV, vos dates de disponibilité et quelques lignes sur un projet ML que vous avez réalisé à contact@ms4all.eu, objet « Stage M2 IA - Prénom Nom ». Type d'emploi : Stage Rémunération : à partir de 630,00€ par mois Formation: Bac +4 (Maîtrise) (Requis) Lieu du poste : En présentiel

items.desc: About Boltz Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible. Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes. We focus on two things: Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners. Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment. The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich. You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto. About the role As a Research Engineer (Agents), you will build and own the agent harnesses behind research at Boltz. You will design them for our scientific and research use cases, including agentic research pipelines and researcher tooling, and scale them to run on our cluster. You will be part of Research Engineering and work with researchers across our teams. This role is ideal for a strong systems engineer who has built agent systems, has sharp intuitions for the capabilities and limitations of current frontier LLMs, both open- and closed-source, and is rigorous about the correctness of agent output. You do not need an ML research background. What you’ll do Design and build agent harnesses for research: tool use, orchestration, and context and state management. Work with researchers to build agentic pipelines and tooling for their work, and make them reusable across teams. Scale these harnesses to support large agent swarms on our cluster. Build observability, verification and cost control for large agent runs. Evaluate agent setups rigorously, and keep our harnesses current as frontier LLMs evolve. About you Minimum Requirements Strong software engineering experience, including distributed systems or infrastructure that runs many long-running jobs in parallel and handles failures. Experience building agent systems or harnesses (tool use, orchestration, context and state management, evaluation) that you can discuss in depth. Good judgment about the capabilities and failure modes of frontier LLMs, and about keeping agent-produced work correct and maintainable. A track record of building tools that were widely adopted by researchers or engineers. Preferred Requirements Experience developing open-source agent harnesses (e.g. Pi, Codex, DSH) or extending existing ones (e.g. Claude Code). Understanding of LLM architectures, and experience fine-tuning LLMs with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (e.g. RLHF, RLVR, GRPO). Background in NLP or information retrieval, such as search, ranking, embeddings, vector search or retrieval-augmented generation. We're Hiring: AI Automation & Development Specialist Location: Hoddesdon, Hertfordshire Company: Bathroom Spare Parts Job Type: Full-time, office-based Can you build with AI? Prove it. At Bathroom Spare Parts, we're looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, automation and technology. We're a growing, family-run business with over 30 years of experience, supplying bathroom spare parts to customers across the UK and internationally. We handle hundreds of customer enquiries and orders every day, manage thousands of products and work with a wide range of suppliers and manufacturers. We believe AI can transform the way our business operates, and we're looking for someone to help us make that happen. We don't want your CV. We want to see what you can build. What will you be doing? You'll work alongside our management and marketing teams to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automate repetitive tasks and develop AI-powered tools that make a measurable difference. You'll be expected to take ideas from concept through to a working solution, test them and continuously improve them. What are we looking for? We're interested in what you can do, not which qualifications you have. Ideally, you'll have experience with some of the following: AI development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI, Cursor or similar AI agents, LLMs and workflow automation n8n, Make, Zapier or equivalent platforms APIs and connecting different software systems Python, JavaScript or other programming languages Databases, SQL and data processing Building web applications, internal tools and automations You don't need to know every platform, but you must be able to demonstrate that you've built something functional. We're looking for someone who's curious, technically capable, resourceful and excited by solving problems. We don't want someone who tells us what AI might be able to do. We want someone who can actually make it happen. How to Apply – The AI Challenge Forget sending us your CV or a traditional cover letter. Instead, we want you to build something using AI that's relevant to Bathroom Spare Parts . Visit our website: www.bathroomspareparts.co.uk Take a look at our business, understand what we do and create an AI-powered solution that could improve our operations or customer experience. Your challenge Build a working prototype that demonstrates how AI could solve a genuine problem for our business. We particularly welcome original ideas. We're not interested in a presentation explaining what you could build. We want to see something you've actually created. What to submit Please send us: A link to your working prototype that we can test, or a short screen recording showing it working. A brief explanation of the business problem it solves. A short explanation of how you built it , including the AI tools and technologies used. What you would improve next if you had access to our internal systems. Your solution doesn't need to be perfect or commercially ready. We're more interested in your thinking, problem-solving ability and technical skills. Please use public information, sample data or fictional customer records only. Do not attempt to access our internal systems or use real customer information. We don't expect you to spend days building something. A focused prototype is perfectly acceptable. What happens next? We'll review submissions based on creativity, functionality, technical ability and the potential value to our business. Successful applicants will be invited to demonstrate their solution, explain how it works and discuss how they would help us introduce AI across the company. No CV required. No lengthy application forms. Show us what you can build. items.desc: Beschrijving van de vacature Jouw functie Connectiviteit is essentieel. Binnen Atlas Copco is het uitgegroeid tot een van onze snelst groeiende strategische domeinen. Na tien jaar investeren beschikken we over meer dan 300.000 connected machines en 100.000 gebruikers wereldwijd. Hun data vormt de basis voor SMARTLINK en ondersteunt onze sales-, service- en operationele processen. Achter SMARTLINK bevindt zich ons IoT-platform: de cloud-agnostische, event-driven backbone die data van onze connected equipment verwerkt, het model van elk connected asset beheert en data beschikbaar maakt voor het portal, onze mobiele applicaties en een groeiend aantal interne gebruikers. Als Test Engineer (IoT Platform) maak je deel uit van ons 14-koppige platformteam. Je werkt samen met developers, architecten en product owners en neemt ownership over de kwaliteit van het platform zelf. Je werkt op het niveau van services, API's, messages en data en zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen betrouwbaar blijven werken op de schaal van een wereldwijde connected fleet. Testautomatisering is in deze rol een volwaardig onderdeel van software engineering. Onze tests worden ontwikkeld in C# en .NET , met onder andere xUnit, Testcontainers, .NET Aspire, Azure DevOps en Xray . Tijdens je eerste maanden werk je bovendien mee aan een belangrijke platformmigratie waarbij twee generaties tijdelijk naast elkaar bestaan. Jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden Je test domain services, API's, schemas, integraties, message- en event flows en de achterliggende dataopslag. Je valideert data over de volledige keten, van event streams en time-series data tot aggregaties en de informatie die uiteindelijk aan gebruikers en systemen wordt aangeboden. Je bouwt het gedeelde testframework verder uit en automatiseert test suites als quality gates binnen CI/CD, met technologieën zoals C#, .NET, xUnit en Testcontainers. Je maakt testability onderdeel van het ontwerp door vroegtijdig behoeften rond testdata, stubs, simulators, contract testing en observability te identificeren en mee op te nemen in de backlog. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van het platform op schaal, inclusief performance- en loadtesting, service contracts en integraties met het portal, mobiele applicaties en interne consumers. Je ondersteunt platformmigraties en domain transitions met onder andere dual-source comparisons en backward compatibility testing, analyseert defects over service boundaries heen en gebruikt AI-tools in je dagelijkse werk. Jouw vaardigheden en ervaring Je hebt een stevige basis in testing methodologies, QA practices en defect analysis, waaronder functional, regression en risk-based testing. Je hebt ervaring met het rechtstreeks testen van services en API's en voelt je thuis in REST, messaging, schemas en contracts. Je schrijft zelf kwalitatieve testcode die leesbaar, reviewed en geïntegreerd is in CI/CD. We werken met C#/.NET en xUnit; ervaring met een andere statisch getypeerde programmeertaal is ook relevant. Je hebt hands-on ervaring met SQL en kan beoordelen of data, verwerking en aggregaties inhoudelijk correct zijn. Je begrijpt distributed en service-based architectures en concepten zoals asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, retries en idempotency. Je beschikt over sterke troubleshooting- en root cause analysis skills en zoekt door tot je begrijpt waarom iets foutloopt. Je hebt ervaring met Agile/Scrum, durft tijdens refinement aan te geven wanneer iets niet testbaar is en kan AI-tooling doeltreffend gebruiken én de output kritisch valideren. We moedigen je aan om te solliciteren, ook als je niet aan alle vereisten voldoet. We waarderen uiteenlopende ervaringen en perspectieven en zijn benieuwd wat jij meebrengt naar de functie. Jouw beloning en arbeidsvoorwaarden Bij Atlas Copco Group zetten we ons in voor een eerlijke en gelijkwaardige beloning. De beloning wordt bepaald op basis van de functie en de bijbehorende verantwoordelijkheden, zonder onderscheid naar gender, ras, etniciteit, religie, fysieke mogelijkheden, seksuele geaardheid, burgerlijke staat of enig ander beschermd kenmerk. Ons beloningsaanbod is lokaal relevant, competitief en afgestemd op de verwachtingen van huidig en toekomstig talent. Het uiteindelijke beloningspakket wordt bepaald op basis van objectieve, genderneutrale criteria, waaronder maar niet beperkt tot de kwalificaties, ervaring en vaardigheden die tijdens het wervingsproces worden aangetoond. Naast het basissalaris krijg je een uitgebreid onboarding programma, inclusief persoonlijke begeleiding door een peter of meter. Als lid van de Atlas Copco Group krijg je toegang tot wereldwijde carrièremogelijkheden. Wij bieden een interessant pakket secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder hospitalisatieverzekering, groepsverzekering, maaltijdcheques en een cafetariaplan voor auto- en fietslease. Naast beloning geloven we dat een waardevolle loopbaan draait om kansen om te leren, te groeien, bij te dragen en je te ontwikkelen in een …

items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Centre de Recherche et d'Enseignement des Géosciences de l'Environnement Type de Contrat Chercheur en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 13545 AIX EN PROVENCE Durée du contrat 24 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration salaire brut : entre 3131.32 et 3569.85 € Date limite de candidature : mercredi 9 décembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Le chercheur/chercheuse postdoctoral mènera des recherches sur la chronologie et l'évolution des dépôts glaciaires récents sur Mars, contribuant ainsi à un projet multidisciplinaire visant à reconstituer l'histoire climatique et glaciaire récente de la planète. Mars abrite, dans ses latitudes moyennes (25–40° N/S), de vastes dépôts glaciaires recouverts de débris, qui conservent la trace des variations climatiques passées induites par les changements des paramètres orbitaux de la planète. Cependant, déterminer leur formation et leur évolution reste un défi, car les techniques conventionnelles de comptage des cratères sont affectées par la dégradation rapide et le resurfaçage des terrains glaciaires. Le candidat/candidate retenu développera et mettra en œuvre des approches innovantes d’apprentissage automatique pour détecter les cratères d’impact à la surface de Mars et établir des contraintes chronologiques fiables concernant la formation, le déplacement et la disparition de ces glaciers. En combinant la détection automatisée des cratères, l’imagerie orbitale haute résolution, la cartographie géomorphologique et les analyses de la distribution de taille et de fréquence des cratères (CSFD), le chercheur/chercheuse contribuera à reconstituer la chronologie des épisodes glaciaires récents et fournira des contraintes chronologiques essentielles pour la modélisation du climat et de la dynamique glaciaire. L'Activité Le chercheur/chercheuse se concentrera principalement sur la chronologie et la caractérisation géomorphologique des dépôts glaciaires. Les principales activités comprendront : Développement d’un système d’apprentissage automatique pour la détection des cratères : adapter et réentraîner un algorithme existant de détection des cratères basé sur l’apprentissage profond afin d’identifier les cratères d’impact sur des images orbitales martiennes à haute résolution (HiRISE, CTX et CaSSIS). Des modèles spécifiques seront développés et validés pour les nappes d’éjectas et les surfaces glaciaires, en accordant une attention particulière à la détection des petits cratères (dont le diamètre varie de quelques dizaines de mètres à moins d’un kilomètre). Cartographie géomorphologique et analyse d’images : cartographier et caractériser les cratères d’impact, leurs dépôts d’éjectas et les caractéristiques glaciaires associées à l’aide d’images orbitales et d’outils SIG. Identifier et documenter les relations stratigraphiques entre les éjectas d’impact et les dépôts glaciaires. Chronologie basée sur les cratères : réaliser des analyses de la distribution de fréquence des tailles de cratères afin d’estimer les âges absolus des modèles et les âges de rétention des cratères. Cela impliquera l’analyse d’environ 500 cratères d’impact sélectionnés, abritant ou non des dépôts glaciaires, ainsi que le regroupement des surfaces glaciaires en fonction de leur répartition géographique et de leur morphologie afin d’améliorer la robustesse statistique. Reconstitution de l’évolution glaciaire : intégrer les résultats chronologiques aux observations géomorphologiques afin de cerner la chronologie de l’accumulation de glace, du mouvement glaciaire et de l’ablation. Identifier les grandes tendances temporelles et spatiales pouvant être comparées aux simulations des modèles climatiques et et utilisées pour affiner la modélisation de la dynamique glaciaire. Diffusion scientifique : rédiger et publier des articles scientifiques dans des revues internationales à comité de lecture, contribuer à des ensembles de données accessibles au public et présenter les résultats lors de conférences internationales et de réunions de projet. Ce poste impliquera une étroite collaboration avec des chercheurs du CEREGE, du Laboratoire de planétologie et de géosciences (LPG), du Laboratoire de météorologie dynamique (LMD), de l’université de Cambridge et de l’université de Sheffield. Votre Profil Compétences Programmation et apprentissage automatique : Bonnes compétences en programmation, notamment en Python, et expérience des méthodes d’apprentissage automatique ou d’apprentissage profond pour l’analyse d’images. Une expérience des réseaux neuronaux convolutifs (CNN), de la détection d’objets et des frameworks tels que PyTorch ou TensorFlow serait un atout. Télédétection et traitement d’images : Expérience dans l’analyse d’images satellitaires ou d’images orbitales planétaires, de préférence à haute résolution spatiale. Analyse géospatiale : bonne maîtrise des logiciels SIG (par exemple, QGIS ou ArcGIS) et du traitement des données spatiales. …

items.desc: Job Description: Skywise is a leading digital services company, wholly owned by Airbus. We deliver a first-of-its-kind offer that seamlessly integrates Planning & Operations Control, Flight, Technical, and Ground Operations. By providing interoperable digital solutions for end to-end operations, Skywise combines aircraft manufacturer expertise and digital know how to transform operational complexity into predictable and profitable performance, ensuring resilient and more sustainable operations. As a Skywise Aeronautical Analyst, you’ll be responsible for maintaining safety critical records in Skywise aeronautical database which supports a variety of products for pilots and companies in the aviation industry based on the 28-day AIRAC cycle. Record types include aerodromes, runways, waypoints, coordinates, altitudes, airways, and airspace, etc. You will use visual comparison, as well as a variety of software, to compare state published text and images with database records and update the database as required. Responsibilities: Support and deputise leadership responsibilities within the team and demonstrate company values. Support leadership with internal and external audit processes. Contribute data or parts of a presentation to the internal team, department, or customer. Compare text and images in new aeronautical publications with existing records in the Skywise database. Maintain a working knowledge of the requirements of product standards and customer requirements (ARINC 424, Customer data quality requirements) and how these drive tool and process requirements Update standard and tailored records in the database in accordance with structured Skywise production processes, as well as aviation regulations and customer requirements. Investigate and reply to customer queries, requests/errors/issues via the Customer Support Portal. Using instructions and overarching guidelines, raise queries with aeronautical publication providers to clarify documents and resolve issues. Apply prioritisation of tool and process requirements according to agile principles. Support Quality improvements by leading Root Cause Analysis, Multi-Functional Team meetings, and NCR management. Lead and coordinate internal and customer projects through research, estimates, providing feedback on findings, and other duties as required. Double-check the work of other analysts for accuracy and adherence to the process. Provide constructive feedback on improvements. Lead continuous improvement of tools and processes (Agile, SAFE). Support the lifecycle of a product backlog, providing technical input to support requirements gathering, refinement and entry into service. Take ownership of documentation relating to tool development required for Do330 requirements (Mapping files and TORs) Contribute to regular agile ceremonies (standups, PI Planning, Iteration reviews) and support product demos. Take an active role in resolving issues related to tools and IT. Actively support or lead the cycle Closedown process. items.desc: Description Algomarketing delivers marketing programmes and specialist talent for strategic marketing teams. We are a global team of marketing experts across 30 countries in Asia Pacific, the Americas, Africa and Europe, with deep experience in enterprise B2B marketing, technology and SaaS. We use a data-driven approach to help marketing teams gain deeper insights, execute faster and streamline operations. Visit our website to learn more. We are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Production Content Assistant to help ensure external-facing digital content is accurate, complete and ready for launch across multiple international markets. You will review copy guides and content documentation to make sure all required disclaimers, claims and terms and conditions have been captured correctly in the spreadsheets and feeds used to publish onsite content. This involves comparing local-market documentation against a primary English reference, identifying where markets have different requirements, and adding any missing information through a clear process. This is an operational content-production role rather than a copywriting or translation role. You do not need to speak multiple languages; the focus is on spotting differences in disclaimer counts, structure and requirements, then documenting them accurately. Alongside the global disclaimer work, which has busy periods of three to five weeks around major launches, you will support regional onsite content throughout the year. This may include seasonal campaign pages, content audits, storefront and category updates, and longer-form articles. This is an entry-level, full-time role for someone who enjoys structured work, has excellent attention to detail and would like to develop experience in digital content production. Key Responsibilities Ensure required disclaimers, claims and terms and conditions are accurately captured in core content documentation. Check that legal and compliance copy is correct and consistent across EMEA markets before content goes live. Flag anything that appears inaccurate, incomplete or outdated to the relevant content team. Compare local-market copy documents against the primary English reference, line by line. Identify where markets have additional or different disclaimer requirements, using counts and structure rather than language skills. Log discrepancies clearly so they can be tracked and resolved. Add missing disclaimer and claim requirements into relevant spreadsheets, following the agreed process. Keep documentation clean, accurate and well organised, with changes tracked. Work to launch deadlines, prioritising markets and content areas as directed. Support regional onsite pages throughout the year, including campaign pages, audits, storefront reviews and category updates. Produce approximately one new content-hub article per month using onsite content tools. Help build and update a limited number of pages for seasonal campaigns. Manage global disclaimer work during launch periods, typically lasting three to five weeks. Q1: One major campaign, plus support on storefront reviews or category updates as needed. Q2: Preparation for a summer launch and one campaign. Q3: Global disclaimers and detailed accuracy checks for the summer launch. Q4: Seasonal retail campaigns. Throughout the year: Approximately one content-hub article per month. Follow detailed processes while using judgement when something does not match. Escalate questions early and work closely with content producers, localisation and legal stakeholders. Suggest practical process improvements and help document ways of working as they evolve. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise BA/BS degree, or equivalent practical experience. 0–2 years of experience in content, production, operations, quality assurance or administration. Internships and graduate experience are welcome. Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Confident using spreadsheets and working with structured content. Able to compare source documents and identify discrepancies quickly and reliably. Interest in digital content production, e-commerce or technology. Experience with a CMS or building web pages is a plus. Fluent English; additional languages are not required. Highly detail-oriented and methodical. Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving processes. Proactive, curious and confident asking questions. Good judgement about when something needs to be escalated. Reliable and organised under launch deadlines. About Algomarketing® At Algomarketing, we revolutionize industry standards by propelling world-leading brands to new heights with rapid insights, accelerated executions, and seamless operations. Our team leverages cutting-edge technologies like machine learning, natural language processing, and robotic process automation to transform marketing and sales landscapes. We are a global marketing & sales operations and technology consultancy with a presence in 27 countries across 6 continents. …

items.desc: Project Engineer Reference 2027-FIX-09 Deadline 30/11/2026 Division Engineering Institution ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges. Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage. Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. One of the goals of our gender equality plan is to reach parity within the Consortium’s different divisions and offices, and several actions have been taken to encourage applications from women mostly in scientific, engineer and technical job positions. Located close to Barcelona in a natural park and well connected by car and public transportation, with excellent connectivity to the world and an employer who understands the importance of life-work balance. Facing an upgrade to ALBA II, a 4th generation facility, which will increase dramatically brightness and coherent flux, ALBA is in a phase of growth and dynamics. Being a part of the ALBA team will promote your career and will give you the opportunities to explore new territories. For more information, you can take a look on our history watching this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gHMqiH4qBAo Tasks The position offers a unique opportunity for professional development by working in the Projects Office Group at the Transversal section of the engineering division with the following main tasks: Be responsible for the design and implementation (from conceptual to detailed design) of synchrotron equipment and instrumentation devices/systems. Develop multidisciplinary instrumentation design projects, including coordination and monitoring across all project phases—from drafting technical specifications (based on scientific requirements), design reviews, manufacturing and assembly, quality control, and commissioning— working closely with other groups at the ALBA Synchrotron. Produce conceptual and detailed 3D designs, as well as manufacturing and installation drawings using advanced CAD tools, alongside all associated manufacturing and installation documentation and performance/acceptance test reports. Develop and monitor project plans, including time, cost, and resource estimation. Draft or review, together with scientific and engineering staff, technical specifications for public tenders for equipment procurement. Perform or supervise calculations and simulations using Finite Element Analysis (FEA). Manage and track the procurement of materials or equipment from external suppliers. Contribute to project risk assessment analyses. Agree upon and draft technical specifications for auxiliary facilities (gases, power, etc.) required by the project. items.desc: About Boltz Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible. Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes. We focus on two things: Foundation models. Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners. Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment. The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich. You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto. About the role Our partners trust us with their most valuable secrets: unpublished targets, novel molecules and years of proprietary assay data. Your job is to make sure that trust is well placed, everywhere our platform runs: our own cloud, dedicated single-tenant environments, and partners' own AWS and Google Cloud accounts. You will be a founding engineer on our security team, part of the Platform team in Core Engineering, shaping the security program with our CTO, who leads it today. You will work with every engineering team at Boltz, and you will sit across the table from the security leaders of the world's largest pharma companies. We want security to be the reason a partner says yes faster, not the reason a deal stalls. This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who would rather fix a control in code than write a document about it, and who can explain risk clearly to a pharma CISO. What you'll do Make secure the default: build guardrails into our Terraform, Kubernetes and CI/CD so every new cluster, environment and partner deployment inherits the right boundaries from day one. Protect what matters most: keep partner data isolated across tenants and deployments, protect our model weights, and make sure the agents acting on scientists' behalf can only do what they should. Make the secure path the easy path: identity, secrets, service-to-service authentication and supply-chain controls that engineers actually want to use. See and stop threats: logging, detection and incident response across AWS and GCP, with exercises that keep us sharp. Find weaknesses first: threat-model new features before they ship, run penetration tests, and attack our own agents and APIs before anyone else does. Turn trust into an advantage: lead security reviews with partners' security teams, translate their requirements into engineering work early, and run our SOC 2 Type II program and the frameworks partners ask for next (e.g. ISO 27001) with evidence generated by our systems, not by screenshots. Secure the company: identity, device management, access reviews and security awareness for a small, highly technical team. This role is not a compliance-only (GRC) or SOC analyst role. Most of your time goes into engineering; compliance should be a by-product of controls that actually work. About you Minimum Requirements 4+ years of security engineering experience in cloud-native SaaS or infrastructure companies. Deep, hands-on cloud security experience on AWS or Google Cloud: IAM and multi-account or multi-project organizations, network security, encryption and key management, audit logging and threat detection. Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and enough hands-on engineering to ship security improvements yourself. Application security experience: threat modeling, secure code review, authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth/OIDC, MFA), web and API vulnerabilities. Experience owning a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 program through an external audit, or building the controls one depends on. Practical incident response experience. Low ego, high ownership, and pragmatic trade-offs between risk and speed; clear with engineers, leadership and partners' security teams alike. Preferred Requirements Kubernetes and container security (network policy, admission control, workload identity, image signing). Security for ML or LLM systems: agent tool access, prompt …

items.desc: Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Internal and external candidates will be considered for this vacancy. For the purposes of this vacancy, internal candidates are defined as staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded or ungraded contract, including Junior Professional Officers (JPOs), UN Volunteers with at least twelve (12) months of continuous service in IOM, staff on Special Leave Without Pay (SLWOP), and staff members on secondment/loan released by the Organization, unless otherwise specified in their contract. Organizational Context and Scope Since 2004 the Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) is the International Organization for International Organization for Migration’s (IOM) main operational tool for tracking and monitoring the movements and the evolving needs of displaced populations. items.desc: About TALO TALO is driven by a clear mission: to eradicate fuel poverty in new homes by delivering homes where occupants need never face energy bills again. Achieving this requires challenging conventional thinking in how homes are designed, manufactured and delivered. We believe meaningful progress comes from questioning the status quo, applying engineering precision, and working in true collaboration with colleagues, clients, supply chain partners and wider stakeholders. Everyone at TALO contributes to this mission, helping to end the reality of fuel poverty while redefining how homes are built in the UK. The Role This role exists to give TALO in-house timber superstructure design expertise: taking a coordinated building design and turning it into an accurate, buildable, factory-ready timber superstructure model and the production information that goes with it. The ideal candidate has experience of timber structure or framing design and modelling and lives and breathes timber structures, understands panel build-ups, connections and load paths inside out, and can model and detail the structure with confidence. This role is the technical bridge between design, engineering and the factory: owning the timber superstructure design intent, preparing well-coordinated models and information for engineering review, and making sure superstructure requirements are communicated clearly into foundation design. items.desc: ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for an AI Voice Agent Data & Conversation Design Specialist to support the development and optimization of our AI Voice Agent solutions for the Portuguese market. In this role, you will be responsible for the language data and conversational design layer of our AI Voice Agents. You will translate business requirements and real customer interactions into structured dialogue flows, conversational scripts, intent and entity tags, and communication strategies. Working closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams, you will analyze conversation performance and continuously improve how our AI Agents understand, communicate with, and respond to Portuguese-speaking customers. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. AI Conversation Flow and Script Design Design and develop conversational flows, branching logic, and dialogue scripts for AI Voice Agents in European Portuguese. Create and optimize communication strategies, including wording, tone, pacing, turn-taking, and conversational behavior, to ensure natural and effective customer interactions. Translate business scenarios and operational requirements into structured conversation logic and executable scripts. 2. Language Data Localization and Annotation Localize and adapt conversational scripts, intent and entity tags, and language datasets for the Portuguese market. Expand training datasets by developing alternative expressions, paraphrases, colloquial variations, and region-specific language patterns. Ensure linguistic accuracy, consistency, and naturalness across different customer interaction scenarios. 3. Conversation Data Analysis and Performance Optimization Analyze call logs, ASR and NLU results, intent recognition rates, conversation drop-off points, and other performance indicators. Identify conversation failures, language-related issues, and opportunities for improvement. Translate data insights into actionable recommendations for script optimization, tagging improvements, and conversational strategy adjustments. Support A/B testing and monitor relevant performance indicators, including customer engagement, conversion, and call containment rates. 4. Project Coordination and Delivery Management Coordinate assigned tasks, project timelines, and deliverables to ensure timely completion. Work closely with internal product, engineering, and delivery teams to support project execution. Track progress, identify potential issues, and communicate updates to relevant stakeholders. 5. External Resource and Contributor Management Coordinate external language contributors, freelancers, and part-time evaluators when required. Manage task allocation, review deliverables, and ensure quality standards and deadlines are met. 6. Testing and Quality Assurance Conduct pre-launch testing and acceptance checks for AI Voice Agent projects. Perform conversation sampling and quality inspections before and after deployment. Identify issues in language quality, conversation logic, and system behavior, and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them. REQUIREMENTS Native-level European Portuguese and fluent English are required. Mandarin Chinese and/or Spanish language skills would be a strong advantage. Based in Lisbon, Portugal, with the legal right to work locally. At least one year of relevant experience in marketing, collections, customer service, or contact center operations within the Portuguese financial services sector, including banking, lending, insurance, or other financial institutions. Experience working with financial services companies, particularly in customer engagement, outbound calling, collections, or customer service operations. Experience in SaaS, Conversational AI, Voicebot, or AI-related projects would be a strong advantage, particularly hands-on experience with conversation scripts, workflow design, language data, or AI performance analysis. Good analytical skills and practical experience with Excel or Google Sheets. Familiarity with SQL, BI tools, or data visualization tools would be an advantage. Strong language structuring, writing, and communication skills, with the ability to turn business requirements into clear and effective conversational content. Good logical thinking, project coordination, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities. Experience in contact center operations, telemarketing, copywriting, or customer service quality management would be preferred. PREFERRED INDUSTRY BACKGROUND Experience with Conversational AI, Voice AI, or enterprise AI companies such as Parloa, Cognigy.AI, VozAI, PolyAI, WIZ, AIRudder, or comparable organizations would be a strong advantage. Experience in Portuguese banks, insurance companies, lending institutions, or contact center service providers would also be highly relevant. Candidates with comparable experience from other organizations are equally encouraged to apply.

items.desc: Role Overview The intern will work on two objectives for Health Research AI and product management leadership. Gold-standard dataset development. Build clinician-annotated reference datasets for evaluating Ovid.com agentic outputs, including data extraction, quality appraisal, and certainty assessment. This work draws on clinical trial methodology, biostatistics, and evidence-based medicine. Workflow mapping and consolidation planning. Map the Ovid Guidelines AI (OGAI) workflow and the Ovid.com agentic workflow, identify synergies and redundancies, and plan the replacement or supplementation of OGAI workflow components with the more mature Ovid.com agentic workflow to reduce technical debt. This work draws on systems engineering. The gold-standard datasets also serve as the validation reference for the consolidation plan. Key Responsibilities Gold-standard dataset development (clinical trials, biostatistics, evidence-based medicine) Define the scope of each reference set: clinical questions, guideline topics, and study designs (randomized trials, observational studies, systematic reviews and meta-analyses). Write annotation guidelines for PICO elements, study design, outcomes, and effect estimates (e.g., hazard ratios, risk ratios, confidence intervals, and derived measures such as ARR and NNT), with each value linked to its source paragraph or table. Produce reference ratings for risk of bias, quality appraisal, and certainty of evidence (Cochrane RoB 2, ROBINS-I, Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, AMSTAR 2, GRADE). Establish dual annotation and adjudication procedures with clinician reviewers, and report inter-annotator agreement. Version and document each dataset for benchmarking and regression testing of OGAI and Ovid.com outputs. Workflow mapping and consolidation planning (systems engineering) Map the OGAI workflow end to end: inputs, agents and prompts, intermediate states, outputs, dependencies, and failure points across ingestion, data extraction, pooling, quality appraisal, GRADE certainty assessment, and guideline synthesis. Map the Ovid.com agentic workflow to the same level of detail, including retrieval, article classification, data extraction, quality appraisal, and verification. Produce a component-level crosswalk of the two workflows that identifies shared functions, synergies, redundancies, and gaps. Assess each OGAI component for replacement by, or supplementation with, the corresponding Ovid.com agentic component, with technical and clinical rationale. Define the target-state architecture, including shared schemas, data contracts, and interfaces. Run side-by-side evaluations of OGAI and Ovid.com outputs against the gold-standard datasets to inform consolidation decisions. Develop a phased plan for replacing or supplementing OGAI components, with sequencing, dependencies, risks, and validation checkpoints. Qualifications Clinical research and biostatistics Current enrollment in a medical degree program. Working knowledge of clinical trial design, biostatistics (effect measures, confidence intervals, meta-analysis), and evidence-based medicine frameworks (GRADE, PRISMA, Cochrane risk-of-bias tools). Preferred: experience with data extraction or critical appraisal for systematic reviews. Systems engineering Ability to document multi-stage workflows as process and data-flow maps, interface specifications, and dependency analyses. Proficiency in Python (FastAPI, agentic pipeline design, XML and PDF parsing, pytest) and TypeScript/JavaScript (React/Next.js). Preferred: experience building LLM-based or agentic extraction and verification pipelines for medical literature. Our Interview Practices To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.
