items.desc: Do you already spend more time on prompts, skills and evals than on boilerplate code? Do you want to build agents that do real engineering work, where being wrong is expensive and experts check the output? Antegris is a Zurich engineering company. The position is about further developing AI agents that are used on microchip design end to end: reading a specification, producing the artefacts, running the tools that check them, and handing the result to a person to approve. One thing up front: you must be located in Switzerland. This role is based at our office in Zurich. We cannot consider candidates living outside Switzerland, and we are not offering full remote. How you make a difference You specify, build, test and ship the agents: how they are prompted, what skills they have, which tools they may call, and how their output is reviewed. In addition, you curate the skills, prompts and rules behind them, so that the people using them get a version they can trust: reviewed, versioned and easy to roll back. You write the evals, so that every change shows whether it makes the agents better or just different. You connect the systems the agents work with, through MCP and through adapters you write, and you keep each tool's output in a form the next agent can use. Moreover, you run models on our own hardware when the data cannot leave the building, and you evaluate new models against the work our users actually do. You work with the engineers who use the agents every day, and turn what you learn from them into better skills and defaults. What you have to offer You have several years of hands-on software engineering experience, for example in C++, Python, TypeScript, Go or Rust, including APIs and CI/CD pipelines. In addition, you have practical experience building with LLMs and agents beyond the chat window: skills, prompts, tools, MCP servers or agent workflows that other people actually use. You measure what you build. You have opinions about evaluating non-deterministic systems, and you have changed your mind because of a number you produced. Moreover, you bring a security mindset for agents: secrets, dependencies, permissions, sandboxing, and data that must not move. You are located in Switzerland and have the right to work here. You have a very good spoken and written command of English. German is a plus. You do not need to know chip design. Curiosity about how things are engineered is essential; the domain we will teach you, alongside engineers who have taped out silicon. You don't need to tick every box. If you bring a strong engineering foundation and have built something real with AI agents, we would like to hear from you. We care more about how you think and how you learn than about a perfect keyword match. How to apply Send us an email at info@antegris.com with three things: your CV, a short motivation letter, and your salary expectation. (Short really does mean short. We would rather read something honest and imperfect than something an AI wrote for you. Tell us what you have built and why you want to build this.)

items.desc: Job Details: Job Description: Join Intel and build a better tomorrow. Intel is in the midst of an exciting transformation, with a vision to create and extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth. So join us-and help us create the next generation of technologies that will shape the future for decades to come. Intel's Data Center Group builds the processors, accelerators, platforms, and software that run the world's data centers, clouds, and AI infrastructure. Its mission is to make Intel the foundation for AI at scale, from Intel Xeon processors with built-in AI acceleration to the open software stacks that run on them. That means working out where emerging AI workloads will stress tomorrow's systems, building first-of-a-kind software and benchmarks that show what Intel platforms can do, and demonstrating new usages before the rest of the industry. The Data Center Group works with leading thinkers in academia and industry and partners closely with cloud providers, open-source communities and customers. Join AI Software Ecosystem Engineering team to help accelerate the deployment and optimization of Agentic AI systems and solutions. Modern AI agents do much more than generate tokens. In a single task an agent plans, calls tools, runs code in sandboxes, searches and retrieves information, and checks its own results. Much of that time is spent on CPUs, not GPUs. We study how agentic workloads actually use heterogeneous CPU-GPU systems, and we build the infrastructure that makes them faster, cheaper and more efficient: hardware-aware agent runtimes, smart routing of model calls and tool calls, faster sandboxes, and distributed pipelines for agentic inference and training. We test our ideas with careful, reproducible measurement on real systems, and we publish our findings both inside Intel and at top external venues. We are looking for an Intern with experience in AI systems, agentic AI and ML infrastructure who can contribute to our projects in one or more of our focus areas. The successful candidate will be working on systems and infrastructure for agentic AI on heterogeneous CPU-GPU platforms. In this position you will have the opportunity to work on: - Speeding up the CPU side of agent workloads (tool execution, retrieval, embedding and reranking, small-model inference) with Intel AMX and other built-in accelerators. - Designing adaptive routers that decide where each model call and tool call should run, based on load, deadlines, cost and quality. - Building scalable orchestration and execution pipelines for agentic inference and for reinforcement-learning-based agent training, where thousands of rollouts run at the same time in sandboxed environments. - Making sandboxes faster to create and run for code-executing agents. You will develop new CPU-GPU benchmarks and characterization methods that show where an agent's time and compute actually go. This includes CPU utilization, contention and queueing behavior that today's GPU-centric benchmarks miss. You will also re-engineer agentic task workflows, such as Terminal-Bench and SWE-bench-style coding and terminal tasks, so they can make full use of Intel accelerators. You will build and evaluate systems and proofs-of-concept on real hardware and clusters, with an emphasis on honest, statistically sound measurement, so that the approaches can be deployed in real-world settings. Experience would be obtained through a combination of prior education level classes, and current level school classes, projects, research, and relevant previous job and/or internship experience. Vous sélectionnez et évaluez les performances d’algorithmes en rédigeant un rapport technique pour restituer vos observations et mesures. items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE 

Productions is the 'done for you' managed services wing of ElevenLabs made for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts to unlock human-edited dubs, audiobooks, and more in 15+ languages directly on the ElevenLabs platform.

 


HERE ARE A FEW RECENT PROJECTS PRODUCTIONS HAS HELPED BRING TO LIFE:

 - Dubbing for some of the world's biggest creators (DudePerfect, Lex Fridman, Andrew Huberman), media businesses (Headspace) and broadcasters (Mediaset)

 - Audiobook production for leading publishers and digital storytelling platforms

 - Voice creation, sound design, and other audio engineering services for ElevenLabs' largest customers

 - You can learn more about Productions here: https://elevenlabs.io/productions
   
   


JOINING US IN MARKETPLACE OPERATIONS, YOU WILL DRIVE THE SUCCESS OF OUR OPERATIONS ORG, INCLUDING:

 - Own end-to-end processes across hiring, training, turnaround times, pricing, quality control, producer engagement and more

 - Expand our hiring engine to ensure we always have the capacity we need to meet our (growing!) demand

 - Improve our quality control and monitoring systems to ensure the dubs, audiobooks, and other content we deliver sound natural and professional-grade

 - Build your own data pipelines and dashboards to inform decision making at scale

 - Find new efficiency levers through process (e.g. new onboarding flow), automation (e.g. Python scripts) or collaboration with Engineering (e.g. new dispatch or pricing function)

 - Work with the rest of the Productions org (Engineering, Production Managers, Content Ops, Sales) to make Productions the greatest audio marketplace on the planet!




REQUIREMENTS

 - Ops fluency - you have experience managing and scaling complex Ops processes, e.g. in a marketplace or logistics environment

 - Problem solving  – you’re talented at breaking down complex problems into atomic pieces, then formulating the right plan to tackle each

 - Data & analytics - you’re comfortable running your own queries, small scripts and crunching data

 - Pace - you enjoy operating in an early‑stage, high‑growth environment, including implementing new ideas and iterating quickly

 - Team collaboration - you’re skilled at collaborating across various functions and driving the best …

ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

 - Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

 - Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

 - Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

 - Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

 - Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

items.desc:
Overview 
 When Microsoft experiences a significant service outage, customers expect more than service restoration. They want to understand what happened, why it happened, what Microsoft has done to address it, and what measures have been implemented to prevent recurrence.
 The Incident Communications and Coordination (ICC) team is responsible for developing Microsoft's customer-facing Post Incident Reports (PIRs), one of the most important deliverables produced following major service incidents. These reports are a critical component of Microsoft's commitment to transparency, accountability, and customer trust.
 We are seeking a Mission Critical Incident Analysis Engineer to lead the investigation, development, and publication of customer-facing PIRs for high-impact Microsoft 365 service incidents. This role combines service engineering, incident analysis, stakeholder management, investigative research, and technical communication.
 Success in this role requires someone who is naturally curious, highly analytical, comfortable engaging senior engineering teams, and capable of transforming complex technical investigations into clear and trustworthy customer communications.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 Responsibilities 
 You will develop a foundational understanding of service and/or system design, interactions between technology layers and components, functions of infrastructure and dependencies at scale. 
 You may contribute to the identification and recommendation of optimal configurations of technology components. 
 You will participate in reviews with the engineering teams that develop and/or manage services and share learnings and recommendations across engineering teams working on related services within their organization. 
 You will actively seek to develop an understanding of key learnings, insights and best practices that can be applied to improve development and operations of the system, platform, or product components and features. 
 You will develop foundational technical knowledge, judgment, and decision making in crisis situations to contribute to mitigation plans and assist with resolving, reducing, or mitigating the impact of a crisis by engaging with necessary teams and escalating to appropriate stakeholders as instructed. 
 You will learn about and begin to contribute to root cause analyses based on incidences/crises with guidance from other engineers and learn about communicating customer impact and other relevant information with key stakeholders, leadership, and customers. You will contribute to projects and programs as instructed to improve crisis response and learn about how to increase service stability. 
 You will embody our culture and values . 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Associates Degree or Trade Certification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field OR equivalent experience. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Bachelors in Computer Science or Information Technology or industry equivalent experience 
 Critical Thinking and Critical Question skills.
 Must have excellent written English language skills and a healthy desire to improve the environment.

items.desc: Notre client dans le secteur Énergie et ressources naturelles recherche un/une Ingénieur(e) DevSecOps IA H/F Description de la mission : Contexte Un grand groupe international du secteur de l?énergie construit une plateforme IA interne sous la forme d?un catalogue fédéré. Les entités du groupe pourront y concevoir, valider, publier et héberger leurs serveurs MCP ainsi que leurs actifs IA, notamment des skills, plugins et hooks. L?architecture cible combine des services managés AWS ? Agent Registry comme référentiel, AgentCore Gateway pour les appels d?outils et AgentCore Runtime pour l?hébergement ? avec deux composants développés en interne : un portail et un hub. L?objectif à l?horizon 2027 est d?amener progressivement les entités à exposer les API de leurs applications via des MCP consommés par des agents. La mission s?inscrit dans une squad de 6 personnes : un Product Owner, deux ingénieurs plateforme IA, deux ingénieurs DevSecOps IA et un AI Enablement Engineer. Deux postes DevSecOps IA sont ouverts. La personne travaillera avec les équipes Digital Enablers, DevSecOps et Cyber, le programme transverse sur les identités non humaines, les AI Champions et les équipes sécurité des entités. Mission Contribuer à la construction et à la sécurisation de la plateforme IA interne, administrer les outils de développement, encadrer l?usage des assistants de code et mettre en place les contrôles de sécurité pour les pipelines de publication et le dépôt d?actifs IA. Principales responsabilités Administrer le socle des équipes de développement : GitHub Enterprise Cloud et Server, JFrog Artifactory et Xray, et SonarQube. Définir et faire appliquer les règles d?usage de GitHub Copilot et Claude Code : politiques, paramètres gérés, instructions et hooks. Concevoir et implémenter les contrôles et scans du pipeline de publication et du dépôt d?actifs IA. Sécuriser la surface d?attaque IA, notamment au moyen de SBOM pour l?IA, de garde-fous sur les données (egress, PII et secrets) et de la gestion des identités non humaines. Contribuer à la construction et à la maintenance de la partie IA du portail et du hub. Co-construire les règles de sécurité avec les équipes et veiller à leur application sans freiner la livraison ; expliquer les risques tout en permettant l?avancement des projets. Environnement technique Plateforme IA : MCP, agents, LLM, skills, plugins, hooks Cloud et services : AWS, Agent Registry, AgentCore Gateway, AgentCore Runtime Développement et CI/CD : GitHub Enterprise Cloud et Server, GitHub Actions, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code Sécurité et qualité : JFrog Artifactory, JFrog Xray, SonarQube, SAST, SCA, détection de secrets, SBOM Automatisation et systèmes : Python, Linux Identité et conformité : identités non humaines, SSO, SAML, SCIM, Okta, DORA, AI Act, ISO 27001 Profil recherché Expérience 8 à 10 ans d?expérience ou plus en DevOps ou DevSecOps. Expérience concrète du déploiement ou de la gouvernance de GitHub Copilot et/ou Claude Code à l?échelle d?une organisation, au-delà d?un usage individuel. Expérience d?AWS en production. Pratique de la sécurité des serveurs MCP et de l?évaluation de LLM et d?agents. Compétences techniques Expertise en administration de GitHub Enterprise et en pipelines GitHub Actions, notamment les quality gates. Administration de SonarQube et de JFrog Artifactory / Xray ; maîtrise des outils SAST, SCA et de détection de secrets. Python et Linux pour l?automatisation. Compétences personnelles Capacité à co-construire des règles de sécurité avec les équipes et à les faire appliquer sans devenir un frein. Capacité à expliquer les risques sans bloquer la livraison. Capacité à apprendre rapidement dans un écosystème IA en évolution rapide. Langues Anglais courant, à l?oral comme à l?écrit. Compétences / Qualités indispensables : DevSecOps, Administration GitHub Enterprise et GitHub Actions, Gouvernance de GitHub Copilot et Claude Code, Sécurité des serveurs MCP et des agents IA, AWS en production, SAST, SCA et sécurité des pipelines Compétences / Qualités qui seraient un + : SBOM (CycloneDX, SPDX), SSO / SAML, SCIM, Okta, DORA, AI Act, ISO 27001 Informations concernant le télétravail : Oui ? 2 jours/semaine Profil candidat: DevSecOps Administration GitHub Enterprise et GitHub Actions Gouvernance de GitHub Copilot et Claude Code Sécurité des serveurs MCP et des agents IA AWS en production SAST, SCA et sécurité des pipelines

items.desc: We are seeking a hands-on IT Operations Generalist to serve as the ultimate judge of quality for our AI-driven root-cause analysis engines. In this role, you will evaluate whether AI-generated diagnostics and troubleshooting guidance deliver genuine, actionable value to system administrators facing real-world network and infrastructure outages. You will sit directly within the Product team, bridging the gap between deep IT operations reality and cutting-edge AI engineering. Rather than managing timelines, your primary focus will be practical validation: inspecting telemetry from real customer alarms, establishing ground-truth diagnoses, and building automated, break-fix lab environments to stress-test new AI models before they reach production. If you have spent years managing mid-sized IT environments, know what a true root-cause diagnosis looks like under pressure, and enjoy breaking infrastructure on purpose, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-assisted IT monitoring. YOUR TASKS Daily AI Diagnostic Evaluation & Telemetry Audit Review AI-generated incident analyses daily, leveraging real product telemetry and raw customer alarm streams. Evaluate diagnostic accuracy: determine whether the identified root cause is correct, whether symptom alarms are grouped logically, and whether recommended remediation steps are practical and effective. Maintain rigorous standards for quality, identifying hallucinations, redundant alert advice, and unhelpful diagnostic loops. Eng ineering Feedback Loop & Quality Metrics Identify recurring AI failure modes (e.g., repeating alarm text without diagnosis, missing dependency links,generic fixes) and translate them into actionable engineering tickets and prompt/model requirements. Develop, track, and report baseline quality metrics for AI accuracy, relevance, and actionability. Help design systems to capture and integrate real customer feedback and resolution outcomes as our AI beta program expands. Lab Environment Construction & Fault Injection Design, deploy, and maintain realistic hybrid lab environments (virtualized and cloud-based) that simulate real-world enterprise IT infrastructures. Safely engineer and execute fault-injection scenarios—reproducing real outages such as storage failures, expired SSL certificates, saturated links, DNS misconfigurations, and cascading service dependencies. Ensure lab scenarios are fully repeatable and documented for reliable regression testing. Test Scenario Library & Regression Testing Build and curate a comprehensive benchmark library of golden test cases with verified ground-truth answers. Execute automated and manual regression test suites against candidate AI models prior to every release, ensuring zero degradation in diagnostic precision. YOUR PROFILE Must-Have Technical Experience System Administration Foundation: 5+ years of hands-on experience as an IT Generalist, Systems Administrator, or Infrastructure Engineer in a mid-sized enterprise environment. OS & Infrastructure Mastery: Deep proficiency with Windows Server administration combined with practical working knowledge of Linux distributions. Networking Essentials: Strong understanding of core networking protocols and infrastructure services,including DNS, DHCP, VLANs, subnet routing, SNMP, and SSH. Cloud Platform Experience: Hands-on operational experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS,Azure, or GCP). Automation & Lab Building Skills Command-Line & Scripting: Strong command-line fluency in PowerShell and Bash, with sufficient scripting ability (Python strongly preferred) to automate lab deployment, state resetting, and fault injection. Virtualization & Lab Automation: Proven experience building test environments using hypervisors (Hyper-V,VMware ESXi, Proxmox) or Cloud VMs. Troubleshooting Judgment & Soft Skills Root-Cause Intuition: Superior technical troubleshooting judgment—the ability to look at an alert storm and immediately separate primary root causes from secondary symptoms. Technical Communication: Exceptional written communication skills for authoring clear, concise bug reports,lab reproduction steps, and diagnostic reviews. Pragmatic Mindset: Driven by real-world utility rather than theoretical perfection; passionate about making tools genuinely helpful for sysadmins. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Monitoring Tool Experience: Prior hands-on experience configuring, managing, or querying enterprise monitoring platforms—such as PRTG Network Monitor, SolarWinds, Datadog, LogicMonitor, or open-source solutions (Zabbix, Nagios/Icinga, Prometheus/Grafana, Checkmk). AI Tooling Awareness: Basic familiarity with prompt engineering concepts, LLM benchmarking, or evaluation frameworks. items.desc: Data & AI Intern - Intelligent Operations Description - Before applying please note that, to be eligible for this position, you must be currently enrolled at a university in Spain , remain enrolled until the end of the internship, and be eligible to sign an internship agreement with your university. You must also be available to start the internship in February 2027 and continue participating in the program until June–July 2027 . We are looking for a motivated student to help us explore how data, analytics and AI can transform the way we run business operations and make decisions . Today, many business reviews still require significant manual effort to collect information from different sources, consolidate data, understand performance and identify the insights that require attention. The objective of this project is to explore a different approach: connecting data, analytics and AI to build the foundations for Intelligent Operations . What you will work on You will work on a real business use case, starting with the automation and augmentation of business reviews. Together with the team, you will: Connect and integrate data from multiple business and operational sources. Structure and prepare data so it can be reliably used for analytics and AI. Develop analytics to understand performance, trends and key business drivers. Explore how AI can automatically identify relevant trends, deviations and areas requiring attention. items.desc: La Direction des Systèmes d'Information de VINCI Energies (VESI) accompagne les 2200 entreprises de VINCI Energies à travers le monde. Partenaire stratégique des métiers, nous concevons, déployons et exploitons des solutions numériques sécurisées, performantes et innovantes qui facilitent le quotidien des collaborateurs et soutiennent le développement des activités. Nous accompagnons également les entreprises dans leur transformation digitale. Nos équipes interviennent sur l'ensemble des enjeux IT : infrastructures, réseaux, cybersécurité, applications métiers, environnement de travail numérique mais également sur des domaines tels que les ERP, la Business Intelligence, la digitalisation, la mobilité, l'IA, la RPA, les plateformes technologiques, la conduite du changement et le Numérique Responsable. Notre mission est de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des métiers afin de proposer des solutions adaptées, fiables et créatrices de valeur. Notre ADN : Confiance, Esprit d’entreprendre, Solidarité, Autonomie, Responsabilité. Venez vivre et partager nos valeurs avec nous ! Au sein de la direction IT Infrastructure, vous rejoignez l’équipe Service Quality, composée de 2 personnes. L’équipe contribue à la qualité et à la continuité des services IT. Elle coordonne les pratiques ITIL, pilote des instances de gouvernance et accompagne les équipes opérationnelles dans l’amélioration des incidents, demandes, problèmes, changements, niveaux de service et connaissances. Vos missions en tant que Chef de projets : Gestion des incidents, demandes et escalades Suivre les incidents majeurs et les escalades IT Managers depuis leur signalement jusqu’à leur clôture. Coordonner les interlocuteurs N1, N2, responsables applicatifs et équipes transverses, en veillant à la qualité des informations et des plans d’action. Préparer les communications, points de situation, relances et éléments de reporting associés. Gestion des problèmes et PIR Qualifier les demandes d’analyse et préparer les dossiers de décision pour le comité de gestion des problèmes. Collecter les éléments factuels : description, impact, cause racine, contournement, solution et plan d’action. Suivre les problèmes ouverts avec les coordinateurs jusqu’à résolution. Initier et suivre les Post-Incident Reports : accompagnement des rédacteurs, contrôle qualité, relances, circuit de validation et publication. Préparer et animer progressivement la gouvernance Service Quality, puis rédiger les comptes rendus. Gestion des changements Contrôler la conformité ITIL des mises en production et changements déclarés dans EasyVista. Préparer les supports, extractions et indicateurs du Change Advisory Board. Participer à l’animation des Change Advisory Board, formaliser les décisions, actions et comptes rendus. Suivre les changements hors processus, en attente de validation ou de clôture, et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du processus. Participer à l’évolution des processus Vous disposez d’une première expérience en stage ou alternance dans un environnement IT, PMO, support, qualité ou gestion de projet. Vous marquez un intérêt pour ITIL, l’amélioration continue, l’analyse de données et la coordination transverse. Vous souhaitez intervenir sur des projets SI à fort impact, en lien direct avec les enjeux métiers. Dans ce cadre, vous êtes capable de comprendre des environnements complexes, de vous adapter rapidement et de produire des résultats concrets. Un niveau courant en français et en anglais est indispensable. Une bonne maturité dans l’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle à des fins professionnelles est requise. Les expériences, pratiques et cas d’usage de l’IA feront partie des échanges tout au long du processus de recrutement. items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire de Biologie et Modélisation de la Cellule Type de Contrat Chercheur en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 69364 LYON 07 Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est de 2 300€ brut mensuel Date limite de candidature : mardi 8 décembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions La dégradation des plastiques dans l'environnement libère de petites molécules, notamment des oligomères de styrène issus du polystyrène, dont les effets sur les organismes vivants restent encore mal compris. Contrairement aux microplastiques, ces molécules peuvent s'incorporer directement dans les membranes biologiques et modifier leurs propriétés physiques. Ce projet de thèse vise à comprendre les mécanismes moléculaires responsables de l'insertion, du transport et de l'accumulation des oligomères de styrène dans les membranes bactériennes. Une attention particulière sera portée à l'influence de la composition lipidique, notamment aux différences entre les membranes de bactéries à Gram positif et à Gram négatif. Pour répondre à ces questions, le projet combinera des simulations de dynamique moléculaire à gros grains, principalement avec le champ de force Martini 3, et des simulations atomistiques. Les résultats permettront de caractériser les interactions entre les oligomères et les lipides, ainsi que leurs conséquences sur l'organisation et les propriétés des membranes. Cette thèse s'inscrit dans le projet ANR SOULMATE, qui associe modélisation moléculaire, biophysique expérimentale et microbiologie afin de mieux comprendre les effets de la pollution plastique à l'échelle moléculaire. Le doctorant aura pour mission d'étudier, par des simulations de dynamique moléculaire multi-échelle, les interactions entre les oligomères de styrène issus de la dégradation des plastiques et les membranes bactériennes. Il cherchera à comprendre les mécanismes d'insertion, de transport et d'accumulation de ces molécules, ainsi que leurs effets sur l'organisation et les propriétés physiques des membranes. Les résultats seront confrontés aux données expérimentales des partenaires du projet ANR SOULMATE. L'Activité Construire et valider des modèles moléculaires de membranes bactériennes de différentes compositions lipidiques. Développer et optimiser les paramètres des oligomères de styrène avec le champ de force Martini 3. Réaliser des simulations de dynamique moléculaire à gros grains et atomistiques. Étudier les mécanismes d'insertion et de transport des oligomères à l'aide de calculs d'énergie libre et de méthodes d'échantillonnage avancé. Analyser les effets des oligomères sur l'organisation, la structure et la dynamique des membranes. Comparer les résultats des simulations avec les données expérimentales des partenaires du projet SOULMATE. Participer aux réunions scientifiques, présenter les résultats lors de conférences et contribuer à la rédaction de publications scientifiques. Votre Profil Compétences Master 2 ou diplôme équivalent en modélisation moléculaire, biophysique, biochimie, biologie computationnelle, sciences pharmaceutiques ou domaine connexe. Expérience en simulations de dynamique moléculaire, idéalement avec GROMACS et des modèles à gros grains tels que Martini. Compétences en programmation scientifique (Python), analyse de données et utilisation d'environnements Linux. Des connaissances en biophysique des membranes, modélisation multi-échelle ou développement de paramètres moléculaires seraient appréciées. Des connaissances en apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et son application à l'analyse de données scientifiques constitueraient un atout supplémentaire. Autonomie, rigueur scientifique, curiosité et capacité à travailler dans une équipe interdisciplinaire. Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais scientifique, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. La maîtrise du français n'est pas obligatoire. Votre Environnement de Travail Ce projet de thèse s'inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR SOULMATE (ANR-26-CE34-0455), consacré à l'étude des interactions entre les oligomères de styrène issus de la pollution plastique et les membranes bactériennes. Le projet réunit trois équipes de l'ENS de Lyon, combinant modélisation moléculaire, biophysique expérimentale et microbiologie. Le doctorant intégrera l'équipe DAMM (Dynamics and Control of Biological Assemblies and Macromolecular Machines) du Laboratoire de Biologie et Modélisation de la Cellule (LBMC, UMR 5239), sous la direction de Paulo Cesar Telles de Souza et la codirection de Guillaume Launay. L'équipe développe et applique des méthodes de modélisation moléculaire multi-échelle, notamment le champ de force Martini, pour étudier les interactions et la dynamique des systèmes biologiques. Le LBMC est une unité mixte de recherche du CNRS et de l'ENS de Lyon, consacrée à la compréhension des mécanismes moléculaires et cellulaires du vivant. Le doctorant disposera d'un espace de travail au Centre Blaise …

items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 17, 2026, 12:13AM Le contexte Nos équipes conçoivent et développent pour Orange des services grand public utilisés chaque jour par des millions de Français: nous développons notamment les pages Orange.fr et Sosh.fr. Les usages de recherche ont déjà changé. Les moteurs classiques restent essentiels, mais les assistants IA sont devenus une porte d’entrée majeure vers nos contenus et nos offres. Pour rester visibles, nos services doivent repenser la manière dont ils exposent leurs données. Votre mission Vous êtes l’architecte qui rend nos services nativement exposés et optimisés, pour les humains comme pour les machines. Vous intervenez auprès de plusieurs équipes de développement agiles, aux côtés des product owners et des développeurs, pour : concevoir et faire évoluer les architectures afin qu’elles soient optimisées dès leur conception pour le référencement naturel (SEO), payant (SEA) et génératif (GEO et GEA) ; définir comment nos contenus et données sont structurés et exposés : données structurées, API, flux, standards émergents (MCP, llms.txt…) ; explorer des approches nouvelles, comme des agents capables de dialoguer avec les IA grand public pour mieux valoriser nos services ; mesurer l’impact sur l’audience et le chiffre d’affaires, et arbitrer entre visibilité, performance et protection de nos actifs ; diffuser les bonnes pratiques et faire monter les équipes en compétence ; assurer une veille active sur un écosystème qui évolue chaque mois. Votre profil: Une solide expérience en architecture logicielle web et une vraie culture du SEO technique (performance, indexation, rendu, données structurées). De premières expériences d’intégration de l’IA générative (LLM, agents) dans des services en production, et l’envie de construire des réponses là où il n’existe pas encore de manuel. Le sens du business : vous savez relier un choix technique à un enjeu d’audience ou de revenu, interagir tant avec des partenaires marketing (product owners, data analysts, …) qu’avec des experts techniques. La capacité à embarquer plusieurs équipes pluridisciplinaires, avec pédagogie et conviction. Une expérience en SEA, en analytics ou sur des services à fort trafic est un vrai plus. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un sujet stratégique et pionnier : vous posez les fondations de la visibilité de nos services pour les années à venir. Un terrain de jeu à très grande échelle. Une vraie liberté pour expérimenter, proposer et décider. Des équipes passionnées, une culture d’entraide et de partage. La recherche se réinvente en ce moment même. Venez la réinventer avec nous : candidatez ! Au sein de la Direction Technique d’Orange France, la Direction Plateformes de Services (PFS) conçoit, produit et exploite des services utilisés chaque jour par des millions de clients : Portails web, TV, Mail, identité numérique, cybersécurité, Maison Protégée, Orange Money et bien d’autres. Avec un chiffre d’affaires annuel d’environ 1 Md€, les services développés par PFS conjuguent innovation, qualité de service et sécurité. En particulier, le domaine ACTES (Applications & Contents for Trusted Services) imagine, développe et exploite des services et des expériences Orange et Sosh à forte audience et forte valeur pour le grand public et le marché B2B, en particulier sur les fonctions d’accueil, de gestion de contenus, et d’authentification des clients. Réunissant des expertises variées au sein d’équipes agiles, ACTES innove aussi dans le cloud, la publicité numérique et les services personnalisés. Date de début souhaitée : Feb 01, 2027, 12:00AM Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent. Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation. Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante : n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

Our institute develops safe-by-design concepts for responsible ELM innovation. To lead a community-driven initiative in ELMs, we seek a Researcher in Regulatory Affairs of biotechnology/biomedical products (f/m/d) to perform research on the needs, challenges, expectations and best practices for the development of safe and sustainable ELM-based technologies in the future, and to elaborate guidelines for researchers and developers of ELMs. The scientist will coordinate and work together with a knowledge-exchange network with experts from relevant stakeholders with interest in ELM research, innovation and regulation (academic institutions, industry, consultants, regulatory agencies). items.desc: Arbeidsvoorwaarden Opleiding Technische Informatica / Mechatronica Contactpersoon Mabel Valkenburg Heb je nog vragen over deze vacature? mabel.valkenburg@improvia.nl Over Improvia Improvia is een multidisciplinair technisch dienstverlener, gericht op de volledige waardeketen. Van consultancy, engineering en realisatie tot en met beheer en service van tools, modules, installaties en complete machines. Dit wordt voor de Hightech industrie, de energiesector en de inframarkt gedaan. Daarnaast worden in huis engineeringsvraagstukken uitgewerkt, welke raakvlakken met zorgrobotica hebben. Opdrachtomschrijving De EZ-Wheel transportrobot navigeert autonoom met een SLAM-stack en Nav2, kan liften gebruiken en rijdt in zorginstellingen waar dagelijks medewerkers, bewoners en bezoekers lopen. De robot ziet zijn omgeving nu via lidar. Een lidar meet afstand, maar weet niet of een obstakel een kast, een rolcontainer of een mens is. In deze opdracht dient een geschikte camera voor de EZ-Wheel geselecteerd en een ROS2-module ontwikkeld te worden waarmee Ultralytics YOLO personen detecteert, hun afstand en positie bepaalt en deze informatie beschikbaar maakt voor Nav2. De camera is een aanvullende sensor en geen veiligheidsfunctie. De bestaande veiligheidsketen (veiligheidslidar, noodstoppen en veilige aandrijvingen) blijft leidend en wordt niet aangepast of vervangen door camerabeelden. De module wordt toegevoegd aan een bestaand ROS2-systeem dat al in gebruik is. Een zorgvuldig softwareontwerp is daarom net zo belangrijk als de detectie zelf: de module moet modulair, testbaar en losgekoppeld zijn, zodat ze de bestaande navigatie niet verstoort. Op te leveren delen: Programma van eisen voor de persoonsdetectie, inclusief veiligheidseisen. Cameravergelijking met onderbouwde selectie en testresultaten van de kandidaten. Gemonteerde en gekalibreerde camera op de EZ-Wheel, met montagetekening en bedradingsschema. Werkende ROS2-package met Ultralytics YOLO: detectie, tracking en positiebepaling van personen, met een duidelijke ROS2-interface. Integratie met Nav2 waarbij personen als obstakels worden meegenomen, inclusief configuratie. Benchmarkrapport met framerate, latency, belasting en stroomverbruik van de geteste modellen en instellingen. Advies over de Ultralytics-licentie (AGPL-3.0 of Enterprise) en de opties als de voorwaarden niet passen. Testrapport met detectiekwaliteit, afstandsnauwkeurigheid en gedrag bij camera-uitval, uit simulatie en praktijktests. Installatie- en gebruikershandleiding voor de module. Eindrapport met aanbevelingen voor sociaal ontwijkgedrag in Nav2 en uitbreiding naar meerdere camera’s. Gewenste voorkennis: Basiskennis programmeren (Python, bij voorkeur ook C++) en Linux. Een goed begrip van softwarearchitectuur en softwareontwerp. De module wordt ingepast in een bestaande, werkende ROS2-stack naast de ez-Way-software. Dat vraagt dat je eerst de bestaande architectuur doorgrondt en je eigen software daarop laat aansluiten via heldere interfaces, zonder bestaande onderdelen te verstoren. Kennis van ROS2 (nodes, topics, coördinatentransformaties) is een sterke pré; kennis van Nav2 is een pré. Interesse in computer vision en machine learning; ervaring met YOLO, OpenCV of PyTorch is een pré. Affiniteit met sensoren, camera’s en embedded rekenplatformen. Analytisch en nauwkeurig ingesteld: meten, vergelijken en onderbouwen. Interesse in zorgtechnologie en veilige mens-robot interactie. Interesse in deze opdracht? Ben jij enthousiast over robotica en wil je bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze humanoid robot Oli? Dan komen we graag met je in contact! Stuur je cv en een korte motivatie naar mabel.valkenburg@improvia.nl, onder vermelding van ‘Afstudeeropdracht EZ Wheels’. Heb je vragen over de opdracht of wil je meer weten over de mogelijkheden? Neem dan gerust contact met ons op. We vertellen je graag meer!

items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION The Germans Trias i Pujol Research Institute (IGTP) is seeking a motivated junior health economics researcher to join CAREPATH (Collaborative Action and Research for Engagement, Persistence and Adherence in Treatment & Health), an innovative European research project funded through the Innovative Health Initiative (IHI), a public-private partnership supported by the European Union's Horizon Europe programme and industry partners. CAREPATH brings together international partners to address one of the major challenges in chronic disease management: improving treatment adherence and persistence among patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases. The successful candidate will become part of a multidisciplinary research team, playing an active role in assessing the potential health and economic impact of innovative strategies to improve treatment adherence and persistence. The position will focus on health data analysis, epidemiological modelling, and the simulation of intervention scenarios, integrating evidence and solutions developed across the project to explore their potential impact on patient outcomes. The candidate will also contribute to health economic evaluations, including cost-effectiveness and budget impact analyses, helping to generate evidence to support healthcare decision-making. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to impactful European research, collaborate with international experts, and develop expertise at the intersection of health economics, epidemiology, and healthcare innovation, within the dynamic research environment of IGTP. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES The selected candidate will contribute to the CAREPATH project, with a particular focus on health data analysis, epidemiological modelling, and the simulation and evaluation of innovative interventions aimed at improving treatment adherence and persistence. The main responsibilities will include: Develop and evaluate scenarios to assess the potential impact of strategies and interventions on treatment adherence and persistence. Analyze and interpret epidemiological and healthcare data, adapt existing analytical models, and contribute to the estimation of relevant parameters, including relative risks. Contribute to the assessment of the economic impact of interventions. Contribute to the preparation of technical reports, project deliverables, scientific publications, and presentations. Participate in consortium meetings and coordinate with other project partners. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE Required qualifications: University degree in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related field. Knowledge of quantitative data analysis and statistical methods. Good command of written and spoken English. Desirable qualifications and experience: Master's degree in health economics, Health Technology Assessment (HTA), Public Health, or a related discipline. Previous experience in the healthcare sector. Basic programming skills and experience with statistical software (e.g., R, Python, or similar). Experience in health economic modelling, scenario simulations, cost-effectiveness analysis, or budget impact analysis. Experience working with real-world healthcare data or large health databases (e.g., SIDIAP). Knowledge of chronic diseases, particularly obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases. Previous experience in European or international collaborative research projects. WHAT WE OFFER Type of contract and working hours: Part-time employment contract (8 hours per week), linked to the CAREPATH research project, with an estimated duration of 38 months. Date of incorporation: February 2027. Gross remuneration: 5894,13 gross per year (distributed in 12 payments) European research project: Opportunity to actively contribute to CAREPATH, an innovative Horizon Europe-funded project aimed at improving treatment adherence and persistence in patients with chronic diseases, while collaborating with leading research institutions and international partners across Europe. The successful candidate will be able to choose between a fully remote working arrangement (100% remote) and a hybrid working model, with the possibility of attending the workplace in person if desired. The candidate will have the flexibility to arrange their eight working hours per week according to their preferences, in coordination with the research team and project needs. Workplace: Office facilities located at Hospital Universitari Germans Trias i Pujol, within the Can Ruti Campus in Badalona (Barcelona), providing direct access to a dynamic healthcare and research environment. items.desc: Do you want to contribute to better health for all? The Institute of Environmental Medicine (IMM) is a department at Karolinska Institutet and an interdisciplinary research institution within the broad field of environmental medicine. IMM conducts cutting edge research within the areas of environmental and occupational medicine, toxicology, physiology, epidemiology, and biostatistics with the aim to clarify how environmental and lifestyle factors affect our health and which role genes have. IMM also serves as a scientific advisor to public authorities within the area of environmental medicine and IMM scientists participate in national and international expert groups. Almost every important climate action also brings health gains: cleaner air, green and walkable cities, sustainable food and a healthcare system that can withstand heatwaves. At the Institute of Environmental Medicine (IMM), Petter Ljungman's research group leads several newly launched initiatives on climate and health, including the Formas centre SPIRA – Climate Transitions through Health and the strategic research area ClimTrio together with KTH and Stockholm University. We are now looking for an experienced research coordinator to be the research group leader's closest colleague: someone who keeps the whole picture together, makes sure the right things happen at the right time, and that our research reaches the people who can use it. Your mission You will work closely with the research group leader and be responsible for coordinating and monitoring the operational work across a portfolio of linked research initiatives: SPIRA – Climate Transitions through Health (Formas research centre, 2026–2030): KI, KTH and Stockholm University with the National Board of Health and Welfare, the Public Health Agency of Sweden, Region Stockholm, Pep Kommun, Lif, the Youth 2030 Movement and UNICEF. ClimTrio – Stockholm Centre for Climate Transitions (strategic research area, 2027–2031): SU, KTH and KI, with KI leading the climate and health theme. CASCADES (Formas, 2026–2030): health effects of compound and sequential climate events, using national registers, with Örebro University and KTH. AENEAS (Swedish Research Council, four years): a clinical study at Danderyd Hospital in which patients with atrial fibrillation wear smartwatches to test whether environmental noise triggers episodes. KEEN – Karolinska External Exposome Network: a KI-wide network of researchers from seven departments built around IMM's national exposure database EXPO, with an annual conference and methods workshop, seed funding for pilot projects and mobility support for junior researchers. New projects and funding applications to Swedish and European funders. You will hold the overview of the portfolio, make sure deadlines, reports and decisions do not fall between the cracks, and prepare the groundwork so that the group leader can set the right priorities. You will work closely with project leads at the partner universities, the ClimTrio secretariat at Stockholm University and IMM's administration. Your duties include: Portfolio overview and decision support: a single plan of milestones, reports, application deadlines and commitments across projects; regular check-ins with the group leader and well-prepared decision material. Project management: planning and tracking milestones and deliverables across several parallel projects, including risk and change management. Agreements, ethics and data: coordinating collaboration agreements and fund transfers between universities, ethics applications and applications for register data, together with KI's legal and data protection functions. Recruitment and onboarding: supporting the recruitment of postdocs, doctoral students and researchers hired within the projects, and onboarding new staff. Finance and reporting: budget monitoring with IMM's finance officers, follow-up of partner and in-kind contributions, and input to reports to Formas, the Swedish Research Council and other funders. Governance and meetings: organising steering group, scientific advisory board, consortium meetings and workshops: invitations, agendas, minutes and follow-up of decisions. Communication: website, newsletters, social media, popular-science texts and policy briefs, in collaboration with KI's Communications Office; media contacts. Partnerships: contact person for agencies, the region, municipalities and organisations, and support for new funding applications, for example to EU framework programmes. items.desc: Are you interested in working with research administration, with the support of competent and friendly colleagues in an international environment? Are you looking for an employer that invests in sustainable employeeship and offers safe, favourable working conditions? We welcome you to apply for a research administrator position at Uppsala University. The Department of Public Health and Caring Sciences is a department within the Faculty of Medicine at Uppsala University. The department currently has about 200 employees, and an additional 150 researchers are affiliated with the department. The activities consist of 11 research groups, and education is conducted at all levels. Uppsala Health Economics (UHE) is a specialized unit of health economists, at the Department of Public Health and Caring Sciences, at Uppsala University. Our team has expertise in applying health economic methods to health-related questions, including trial-based and model-based economic evaluations and using register data to evaluate the impact of health services on health and economic outcomes. Our health economists lead several projects across different fields including Mental Health, Child Health, Public Health, Precision Medicine and Innovation in Healthcare. Our approach is grounded in collaboration, working closely with clinicians to reach the best outcomes. We work with both national and international partners. engage in commissioned work for healthcare providers, municipalities, and independent foundations. We are now recruiting a Research Administrator (70%) with a focus on communication, coordination, data management, reporting, and structured research administrative support to strengthen UHE’s expanding activities. Duties The work includes communication, coordination, and structured research support. Examples of duties: Manage contracts, documentation, and project administration. Oversee data management procedures and organisation of research data. Administrative payment handling: process invoices, specify purpose, and allocate costs to the correct project. Coordinate and compile UHE’s annual report (content and layout). Responsible for UHE’s website, blog, and LinkedIn posts. Prepare and distribute newsletters. Prepare presentations and other communication materials. Draft and edit Swedish and English summaries for reports, web pages, and publications. Provide research and data support to the team within agreed time frames. Support planning and logistics for seminars, workshops, and meetings. Act as the public face of UHE at events and serve as an ambassador for the research group, the department, and the university. Requirements To be eligible, the applicant must have: A relevant university degree or equivalent experience. Excellent oral and written communication skills in Swedish and English. Documented experience in communication, administration, or research support. Strong organisational skills and the ability to work in a structured and independent manner. We are looking for someone who is service-oriented, proactive, and enjoys working in a research environment with varied tasks and rapid shifts. You have strong collaborative skills and contribute to a positive and professional work atmosphere. Additional qualifications It is considered an advantage if you have: Experience in communication work within academia, the private sector, public agencies, or research projects. Experience with web publishing, newsletters, social media, or science communication. Experience in project administration, data organisation, or document management. Basic knowledge of government regulations such as GDPR and personal data processing, the Public Access to Information and Secrecy Act, and related legislation. Skills in layout/communication tools (e.g., PowerPoint, Canva, Adobe applications). Experience in financial administration or invoice handling. An interest in health economics, public health, or medical research. Application Your application should include a CV and copies of degrees and transcripts. Please also describe your experience with similar work tasks and your motivation for wanting to work with us. Selection Process Selection will be based on the qualification requirements, previous experience in similar roles, and personal suitability. items.desc: BAS 26/95 Contract type: Open Ended Appointment Location: Cambridge, Antarctica, and polar regions Salary: E S2 £52,907–£58,198 per annum Closing date: 31/12/2026 Interview date: w/c 18/01/2027 (please reach out if you are deployed in Antarctic during this window) Overview The British Antarctic Survey is seeking a talented field-going Oceanographer with strong technical skills to support world-leading observational research on ice-ocean interactions beneath polar ice shelves and glaciers. You’ll be joining our group of observational and modelling specialists who are working to understand ocean-driven melting of the Antarctic Ice Sheet and its influence on global sea-level rise. You will be responsible for the deployment, operation and maintenance of cutting-edge polar observing systems, including oceanographic instruments and moorings deployed through hot water drilled boreholes and ApRES radar systems; you will also contribute towards scientific data analysis, interpretation and publication. The role combines the practical design, deployment and operation of polar field systems with scientific data analysis. The role will require the post-holder to regularly participate in polar fieldwork lasting up to three months, and an offer of employment is subject to medical clearance. Our perfect candidate could either be an experienced oceanographic scientist with a strong technical background and knowledge of ocean instrumentation, or an experienced instrument or field engineer/technician with a strong knowledge of, and interest in, marine (polar) science. The successful candidate will contribute to major national and international projects and will play a key role in maintaining BAS’s capability in under-ice observations. You will work closely with scientists, engineers and operations staff, and will receive training in specialist BAS capabilities where required (e.g. hot water drilling and polar field operations). We would like to hear from you if you can demonstrate relevant experience, strong practical skills, an ability to work in harsh and remote environments, and a willingness to develop expertise across new techniques and field systems. Informal enquiries about this post are very welcome and should be addressed to Peter Davis (petvis@bas.ac.uk), Pierre Dutrieux (pitr1@bas.ac.uk) and Keith Makinson (kmak@bas.ac.uk). The post will commence on March 1st, or at an agreed later date. Purpose Lead the design, deployment, and operation of cutting-edge polar observing systems, including borehole-deployed sub-ice shelf oceanographic moorings and ApRES radar systems. Regularly participate in remote polar fieldwork, lead defined field activities, and collaborate closely with our hot water drilling field engineers and scientists. Support the advancement of BAS’s polar oceanographic research into ice-ocean interactions through the scientific analysis, interpretation and publication of field observations. Duties Prepare for and undertake oceanographic and hot water drilling field campaigns in polar environments. Lead the design, deployment, operation and maintenance of oceanographic, geophysical and radar instrumentation. Lead defined field activities, support hot water drilling operations, and interface between science and drilling activities. Contribute to scientific analysis, interpretation, publications, future research proposals and programme development. Collaborate with BAS scientists, engineers and international collaborators to deliver field programmes. Support development of future observational capabilities and provide technical guidance to less experienced staff. Skills, Qualifications, and Experience Essential Degree or equivalent qualification in Oceanography, Environmental Science, Earth Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience in deploying, operating and maintaining scientific instrumentation in field, marine or operational environments. Willingness and ability to undertake extended polar field deployments and to work in harsh environments on a regular basis. Experience in independently planning and delivering scientific, technical or field activities. Practical mechanical field skills and a basic electrical/electronic understanding relevant to scientific systems. Understanding of oceanographic processes and experience interpreting environmental observations and datasets. Ability to work independently and exercise sound technical judgement. Good written and verbal communication skills. Desirable Understanding of ice-ocean interaction processes in polar environments. Experience with CTDs, ocean moorings, ApRES radar systems or related observational technologies. Experience of hot water drilling, borehole instrumentation, or observations in ice-covered environments. Experience of working at the interface between science, instrumentation and field operations. items.desc: Job Details Section Human Genetics & Genomic Medicine Location: Southampton General Hospital Salary £43,994 to £47,279 per annum, subject to bi-annual review due to exchange rate Full Time Fixed Term until 31/12/2029 Closing Date: Sunday 22 November 2026 Interview Date To be confirmed Reference 3554426AF Post title upon appointment will be MSCA Doctoral Network Research Fellow . Join the University of Southampton as a Doctoral Candidate within DECODES: Deciphering the Splicing Code in Human Disease, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network funded through Horizon Europe. You will undertake interdisciplinary doctoral research at the interface of rare disease genomics, RNA biology and computational analysis, while benefiting from advanced training, transferable-skills development and collaboration across an international network spanning academia, clinical research and industry. The role Your project will investigate how long-read DNA sequencing, RNA sequencing and methylation profiling can improve diagnosis for people with unresolved rare diseases. You will also explore artificial intelligence and machine-learning approaches for integrating multi-omic datasets and identifying disease-causing variants and potential RNA therapeutic targets. Working within DECODES, you will contribute to high-quality, reproducible research and communicate findings through network activities, publications and conferences. You will participate in structured coursework, specialist research training, transferable-skills development and industrial secondments. The role requires engagement with collaborators across Europe and willingness to travel and relocate internationally for planned research secondments. About you You should normally hold a Master's degree, or equivalent, in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, Biotechnology, Biomedicine, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics or a closely related life-sciences discipline. You will have foundational knowledge of molecular biology and laboratory workflows, basic analytical or quantitative skills, and strong written and spoken English at a minimum B2 level, supported by IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge or an equivalent qualification. Applicants may be of any nationality but must meet MSCA Doctoral Network eligibility conditions. At the time of recruitment (i.e. first date of employment), you must not have resided or carried out your main activity (work, studies, etc…) in the UK for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to recruitment under this project. Compulsory national service and/or short stays such as holidays are not taken into account. At the time of recruitment, you must not yet have been awarded your doctoral degree. What we can offer you We offer an ambitious doctoral project within an international and interdisciplinary research environment, supported by expertise across computational genomics, RNA biology, structural biology, disease modelling, clinical research and therapeutic development. You will receive a 36-month employment contract under the applicable MSCA Doctoral Candidate rules and University regulations, together with access to network-wide training and secondment opportunities. The University of Southampton aims to create an environment where everyone can thrive and fosters inclusion, respect and equality of opportunity. CAST works to research and map the evolving frontier of AI capabilities and behaviours in order to inform critical security decisions that reduce loss-of-control risks from frontier AI. The team focuses on preventing harms from high-impact cybersecurity capabilities and highly capable autonomous AI systems. As a Cyber Security Researcher, you will play a key role in building environments, challenges, and evaluation infrastructure to benchmark the cyber capabilities of AI systems. You will help design rigorous and realistic tests that measure how well frontier AI models perform on real-world cybersecurity tasks, supporting AISIs work to better understand the risks posed by advanced AI systems and inform safety standards and policy decisions. This role is well suited to someone with strong practical cybersecurity skills, good Python capability, and an interest in applying those skills to high-impact work at the intersection of cyber security and AI safety. You will work closely with research engineers, infrastructure engineers, and machine learning researchers across AISI, and will contribute to the development of first-of-its-kind evaluation infrastructure within government. Job description You will work as part of a highly collaborative team to design and build cyber capability evaluations for frontier AI systems. In practice, this will mean: Designing cyber ranges and CTF-style challenges to benchmark AI system performance on cyber security tasks Building evaluation environments and scaffolding to test frontier models in realistic cyber scenarios Equipping evaluation environments with relevant tools, such as network packet capture utilities, penetration testing frameworks, and reverse engineering or disassembly tools Designing metrics and supporting the interpretation of results from cyber capability evaluations Working alongside engineers to ensure evaluation environments and infrastructure are robust, reliable, and scalable Contributing to the continuous improvement of automated grading, scoring, and evaluation methodologies Helping integrate new cyber ranges and security testing environments into AISIs evaluation pipeline Writing reports, papers, blogs, and other outputs to communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders Keeping up to date with relevant developments in cyber security research and practice Contributing to AISIs broader understanding of AI cyber risks and the implications of increasingly capable frontier AI systems Person specification Essential Criteria: Strong Python skills, including experience writing scripts for automation or security tooling Practical experience in at least one of the following areas of cyber security: Penetration testing Cyber range design Competing in or designing CTFs Developing automated security testing tools Bug bounties, vulnerability research, or exploit discovery and patching Experience designing, building, or operating technical environments for cyber security testing, experimentation, or evaluation Ability to contribute to the design of realistic cyber capability items.title: AI Engineer
items.card: The role As AI Engineer in the ArdenAI team, you build and maintain Ardena’s own AI tools: assistants, document processing and automations that colleagues use every day. You work with the AI Implementation Lead, who decides with the business what to build and designs the solution, and with the AI Specialist, who runs our AI platform day to day. You also support our AI Specialist – Quality with solutions for QA
items.desc: About Ardena Ardena is a CDMO and CRO that helps pharmaceutical and biotech companies take complex molecules from development to market. Our 700+ colleagues cover drug substance and drug product development, GMP manufacturing, bioanalysis, clinical logistics, fill and finish, and CMC regulatory support, across five sites: Oss and Assen (the Netherlands), Ghent (Belgium), Pamplona (Spain) and Somerset, New Jersey (US). Ardena is a fast-growing company with real ambition in AI. With ArdenAI, we build our own AI tools and roll out enterprise AI across the business, from dossier drafting and proposal writing to quality investigations and lab data, safely and in line with GxP. Every colleague works with Claude Enterprise, connected to Microsoft 365. There is a lot still to build, and we would like you to be part of that journey. To grow our ArdenAI team, we are looking for an AI Engineer in the Netherlands. The role As AI Engineer in the ArdenAI team, you build and maintain Ardena’s own AI tools: assistants, document processing and automations that colleagues use every day. You work with the AI Implementation Lead, who decides with the business what to build and designs the solution, and with the AI Specialist, who runs our AI platform day to day. You also support our AI Specialist – Quality with solutions for QA processes. You report to the Head of AI and work with colleagues at all five sites. The role suits an engineer early in their career who wants to grow fast in applied AI, as well as a more experienced engineer. What You Will Do Building AI tools Build, test and improve AI tools and automations, such as assistants, document processing and agent workflows. Write the prompts, instructions and data sources that make our tools give reliable answers. Build skills, plugins and connectors for Claude and our other AI platforms. Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code to deliver quickly. Quality and maintenance Test solutions against the agreed requirements before they go live. Maintain tools in use, monitor them and fix issues. Document what you build so it can be supported, changed and, where needed, validated with QA. Work securely and protect data in line with our IT and AI rules. Working with the business Work with colleagues to understand their process and what they need. Show early versions and improve them based on feedback. Share knowledge and reusable building blocks with the team. What We Are Looking For A degree in computer science, data science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Programming experience, preferably in Python or TypeScript. Hands-on experience building with large language models (for example prompting, retrieval or agents), at work or in your own projects. Familiarity with APIs and cloud platforms; experience with Microsoft 365 or Azure is a plus. Professional English. Dutch is an advantage. How You Work Hands-on and pragmatic: you ship working tools and keep improving them. Curious and quick to learn, because new models arrive every few months. Accurate: you know that answers in a regulated environment have to be right. A team player who explains things clearly to non-technical colleagues. Nice to have A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE/FDSE) certification, or experience working as an engineer embedded with business users. Experience with Claude, the Anthropic API or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience with document processing or OCR. Git, automated testing and CI/CD. Experience in pharma, life sciences or another GxP-regulated environment. What We Offer A role with real impact in a learning organization, with time and budget to keep up with the latest AI tools An ambitious ArdenAI team and colleagues at five international sites An open culture with short lines of communication Attractive employment conditions and flexible working hours Meaningful work that helps bring medicines to patients, guided by our WE CARE values: Communicative, Accountable, Reliable, Excellent How To Apply Ready to apply? Please click on the application button. A link to something you built with AI, such as a GitHub repository, a demo or a short write-up, is very welcome. Only candidates eligible to work in the EU will be considered for the position. Unfortunately, given the high volume of applications we receive for our vacancies, these professionals (not entitled to work in the European Union) will not be given a status update. Agency calls will not be appreciated.
