items.desc: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. AVEVA is looking for a Software Developer Graduate (Core AI) to join our R&D team in September 2027. Job Title: Software Developer Graduate (Core AI) Employment Type: Full-time Date: September 2027 Location: Cambridge, UK / Hybrid (50% in office) Graduate Programme Overview: The programme is designed to accelerate learning through real business projects, exposure to senior stakeholders, and structured development opportunities. Graduates will gain broad experience while building the skills required for a successful long-term career at AVEVA through their development programme. You will have the opportunity to take part in monthly skills sessions and work across regions and functions on a Capstone Business Project, delivering real impact. R&D at AVEVA: Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration, and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems and do impactful work, join us! As part of our Core AI team , you will have the opportunity to work in Agentic AI with the latest technologies and you'll work on the process of software development using modern languages like Agile to help full-time work in designing, coding, testing, documenting, and supporting our software products. You will collaborate with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, and deploy reliable and scalable solutions while gaining hands-on experience with modern software engineering and cloud technologies. As a Software Developer Graduate, you will: Recognise, articulate, and make technical decisions / trade-offs around multiple dimensions (scaling, reliability, performance, maintenance, etc.) that have an impact on your team Design, develop, test, and debug software applications C# and .NET Deliver software on-time and constantly work to make accurate estimates and deliver on those estimates Provide technical support of products including direct customer support and escalated issues Document product behaviour and implementation details Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from design through deployment and support. Collaborate with team members on how to approach and prioritize development efforts Understand and proactively follow team processes, documentation, best practices, and code style guides Give insightful feedback on pull requests, engineering designs, and features Expand your working knowledge of your respective technical domain We’re looking for: A degree in Engineering, e.g. Chemical, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering; Computer Science; Math; Physics or a related field Basic software product or application development understanding Familiarity with software design patterns (objected oriented design), Computer Science fundamentals, principles and methodologies, as well as knowledge of operating system internals. Good debugging and problem-solving skills. The ability to clearly communicate complex ideas both verbally and in written form. An eagerness to accept and expand upon skills and knowledge based on feedback Someone who seeks advice on how to approach and prioritize development efforts. Exposure to one or more of the following technologies: C# / .NET REST APIs Git and CI/CD practices Agile development methodologies UK Benefits include: Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program. It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive. Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/ Hybrid working We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process. Hiring process Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process. items.desc: Description - Before applying please note that, to be eligible for this position, you must be currently enrolled at a university in Spain , remain enrolled until the end of the internship, and be eligible to sign an internship agreement with your university. You must also be available to start the internship in February 2027 and continue participating in the program until June–July 2027 . We are looking for a motivated student to help us explore how data, analytics and AI can transform the way we run business operations and make decisions . Today, many business reviews still require significant manual effort to collect information from different sources, consolidate data, understand performance and identify the insights that require attention. The objective of this project is to explore a different approach: connecting data, analytics and AI to build the foundations for Intelligent Operations . What You Will Work On You will work on a real business use case, starting with the automation and augmentation of business reviews. Together With The Team, You Will Connect and integrate data from multiple business and operational sources. Structure and prepare data so it can be reliably used for analytics and AI. Develop analytics to understand performance, trends and key business drivers. Explore how AI can automatically identify relevant trends, deviations and areas requiring attention. Use Generative AI to generate insights and help users interact naturally with business data. Prototype automated and AI-assisted business reviews. Explore how these capabilities could evolve towards more proactive Intelligent Operations, where data and AI help identify issues and opportunities and support faster decision-making. The project will combine data engineering, analytics, Generative AI and business understanding , with an emphasis on experimentation and building tangible prototypes. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a student in Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, Data Science or a related field , with: Knowledge of Python and SQL. Experience or interest in data analytics and data modelling. Familiarity with Power BI or similar visualization tools. Interest in Generative AI, LLMs and AI agents. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Curiosity to understand the business context behind the data. An experimental mindset and willingness to turn ideas into working prototypes. Good communication and collaboration skills. What You Will Learn This internship provides the opportunity to work at the intersection of business, data and AI , applying emerging technologies to real operational challenges. You will gain hands-on experience across the journey from data integration and analytics to AI-generated insights and automation , while exploring how AI can fundamentally change the way business operations are managed. Experience Our Benefits Paid internship within a global, technology driven company. Join an international work environment, with opportunities for learning, professional development, and networking across teams. Flexible working schedule, with options for part-time agreements (4 hours/day) or full-time (8 hours/day). The length of the internship ranges from 4 to 12 months. Access to our intern community, including career development workshops, learning sessions, and social activities that help you grow professionally and connect with other interns. Mentor assigned. Opportunity to join the HP Graduate Program following the placement. Lunch at reduced prices at our canteen. Access to our on‑site sports center, including: Gym facilities Squash, tennis, and basketball courts 25+ organized sports and wellness activities, such as HIIT training, squash, basketball, and yoga Participation in the NextGen Employee Network, offering regular events and opportunities to connect with other early‑career professionals. On‑site medical services, including access to a doctor, nutrition support, physiotherapy, and general healthcare. Free printing access and hands‑on workshops using the latest HP technologies — from large‑format prints to 3D‑printed models. Easy commuting: Free parking available or excellent access via nearby train services. Women Network initiatives: Networking events, STEM promotion, business acumen talks, work–life balance sessions, and future‑skills development. Sounds like you? Please apply and let’s talk! items.desc: Vill du utveckla moderna datalösningar som skapar verkligt värde för våra kunder? Efter att ha blivit utsedda till Microsoft EMEA Partner of the Year fortsätter vi nu att stärka vår satsning inom Analytics & AI. Som Data Scientist hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med på den fortsatta resan och tillsammans med våra kunder utveckla framtidens datadrivna lösningar, där data, AI och ny teknik omsätts till verkligt värde. Här får du arbeta brett med AI och Data Science och hjälpa våra kunder förstå var och hur AI faktiskt kan skapa värde. Du kommer in i ett område under utveckling där du får stora möjligheter att påverka, fördjupa din kompetens och tillsammans med kollegor utveckla vårt erbjudande. Låter detta som din nästa utmaning? Missa inte chansen att skicka in din ansökan! Din roll I rollen som Data Scientist arbetar du i gränslandet mellan data science, AI-utveckling och lösningsarkitektur. Du kommer att möta kunder som har ett verksamhetsproblem, en stor mängd data eller en idé om vad de vill åstadkomma. Din uppgift blir att förstå behovet, identifiera vilka delar som kan lösas med hjälp av AI och omsätta det till en fungerande teknisk lösning. Det kan exempelvis handla om att utveckla beslutsstöd baserade på språkmodeller, genomföra avvikelseanalyser eller automatisera verksamhetsprocesser. Du kan även arbeta med prediktiv dataanalys där data används för att skapa prognoser och ge kunder bättre förståelse för vad som kan hända framöver. Du kommer även kunna arbeta med datamodellering och analys samt hjälpa kunder att skapa rätt tekniska förutsättningar och arkitektur för sina AI-lösningar. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Utveckla och implementera lösningar inom AI och maskininlärning. Arbeta med språkmodeller och generativ AI, exempelvis för beslutsstöd, textanalys och automatiserade flöden. Utveckla modeller för prediktiv analys, prognoser och avvikelseanalys. Arbeta med datamodellering och analysera större datamängder. Utforska och utveckla lösningar med agentbaserad AI och agentorkestrering. Hjälpa kunder att identifiera vilka delar av ett verksamhetsproblem som lämpar sig för AI. Bidra med rådgivning kring AI-arkitektur och hur olika komponenter kan sättas samman till en fungerande lösning. Arbeta tillsammans med Data Engineers, arkitekter och andra specialister för att skapa kompletta lösningar. Ha en nära dialog med kunden och översätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar. Anders Wennerström, Konsultchef på Atea, kommer att vara din närmste chef i rollen. Du kommer ingå ett team på femton drivna och ansvarstagande kollegor som jobbar tätt tillsammans och alltid ställer upp för varandra. Du kommer även jobba tätt med andra team inom området på Atea. Inom teamet är det högt i tak och prestigelöst och vi har en bred kunskap som består av både juniora och seniora personer. Vem är du? AI-området utvecklas snabbt och därför tror vi att din nyfikenhet är minst lika viktig som det du redan kan. Du tycker om att fördjupa dig, testa nya tekniker och hålla dig uppdaterad om utvecklingen inom AI, Data Science och maskininlärning. Samtidigt är du en problemlösare som kan lyfta blicken från tekniken. Du vill förstå kundens verkliga utmaning och vågar också ifrågasätta om AI verkligen är rätt lösning. Du trivs med att samarbeta och dela kunskap med andra, samtidigt som du kan driva ditt eget arbete framåt. Eftersom rollen är konsultnära uppskattar du också dialogen med kund och möjligheten att tillsammans ta en idé hela vägen till verklig nytta. För att lyckas i rollen: Vi tror att du har några års erfarenhet inom Data Science, AI-utveckling, maskininlärning eller motsvarande område. Du har en stabil teknisk grund, men tycker också om att förstå verksamheten bakom tekniken. Vi ser gärna att du har: Mycket goda kunskaper i Python Goda kunskaper i SQL Erfarenhet av maskininlärning och statistisk modellering Erfarenhet av att arbeta i Microsoft- och Azure-miljöer Erfarenhet av generativ AI och stora språkmodeller Förmåga att förstå ett kundbehov och omsätta det till en lämplig teknisk lösning Förmåga att kommunicera komplex teknik på ett tydligt och enkelt sätt Innehar B-körkort Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande områden: Microsoft Foundry Microsoft Fabric Agentbaserade AI-lösningar och agentorkestrering MLOps Erfarenhet av relevanta Python-ramverk, exempelvis Scikit-learn, XGBoost och LangChain Tidsserieanalys och prognosmodeller Ramverk för djupinlärning, exempelvis PyTorch eller TensorFlow Docker och Kubernetes Red Hat OpenShift och lösningar i lokala IT-miljöer Goda programmeringkunskaper i R, C++ eller andra relevanta Relevanta certifieringar inom Microsoft: Azure, Foundry, Fabric eller inom RedHat OpenShift Om Atea Visste du att Atea är den ledande leverantören av it-infrastruktur i Norden och Baltikum? items.desc: Heb jij de basis van AI engineering goed onder de knie en wil je nu eigenaar worden van oplossingen die bij klanten in productie draaien? Dan zoeken wij jou voor ons kantoor in Arnhem. Als medior AI engineer bouw je met Large Language Models (LLMs), computer vision of de optimalisatie van bedrijfsprocessen, denk je mee met de klant en help je junior collega's op weg. Over Datacation Datacation is de data- en AI-partner waar inhoud, kwaliteit en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Met ongeveer 60 collega's helpen we organisaties om data structureel in te zetten voor betere besluitvorming, van strategie tot implementatie. We werken vanuit Amsterdam, Eindhoven en ons nieuwe kantoor in Arnhem, in drie AI-domeinen: LLMs en tekstanalyse, computer vision en optimalisatie en forecasting. Veel van onze mensen zijn engineer en consultant tegelijk. We zitten dicht op de klant en blijven betrokken van idee tot implementatie. Jouw rol Als medior AI engineer werk je grotendeels zelfstandig aan AI-oplossingen voor onze klanten en draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Businessvragen van klanten vertalen naar een concrete, haalbare AI-oplossing. Oplossingen end-to-end ontwerpen en bouwen, van data en software engineering tot het AI-model. Keuzes in modellen, technieken en architectuur onderbouwen en uitleggen aan technische en niet-technische collega's en klanten. Oplossingen in productie brengen en daar ook voor blijven zorgen, met evaluatie, monitoring en kwaliteitsbewaking. Junior collega's begeleiden, bijvoorbeeld met code reviews en sparren, en kennis delen binnen Datacation. Wat vragen we van jou? Herken je jezelf in een groot deel van dit profiel? Dan willen we je graag leren kennen. Een afgeronde universitaire MSc opleiding in een richting zoals Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence of Data Science. Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring als AI engineer, data scientist, data engineer of software engineer. Sterke kennis van Python en een goede beheersing van SQL. Diepgaande kennis van AI-technieken in minstens één van onze drie AI-domeinen, en ervaring met het in productie brengen en monitoren van oplossingen. Ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals Azure, AWS of Databricks. Je kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen aan klanten en collega's, en je vindt het leuk om anderen op weg te helpen. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift. Handig om te hebben, maar niet verplicht: ervaring met CI/CD en MLOps, met frameworks en tools zoals LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV of optimalisatiesolvers, en met werken in een consultancy- of projectomgeving. Wat mag je van ons verwachten? Veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid in afwisselende projecten, waarin je klanten direct helpt en kennismaakt met veel verschillende sectoren in de samenleving. Een groeipad richting senior, met ruimte om te kiezen voor meer technische diepgang, of klantadvies. Ruimte voor opleidingen, certificeringen en experimenteren met nieuwe technologieën. Invloed op onze werkwijze en technologiekeuzes, en een stem in hoe we ons team in Arnhem verder opbouwen. Samenwerking met collega's uit Amsterdam en Eindhoven, zodat je leert van de expertise van heel Datacation. Verschillende teamuitjes per jaar, met als hoogtepunt de jaarlijkse gezamenlijke wintersport. Solliciteren Solliciteer zeker als je zin hebt om langs te komen, ook als je niet aan alle eisen voldoet. Wil je eerst meer horen? Mail naar m.vanvreeswijk@datacation.nl voor een koffie of een belletje met een toekomstige collega.

items.desc: En tant que stagiaire au CEA, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un environnement de recherche de renommée mondiale. Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Vous aurez accès à des équipements de pointe et à des ressources de recherche de premier ordre pour mener à bien vos missions. Éventuellement, les travaux menés donneront lieu à une publication scientifique. Contexte : Les missions du stage mêleront développement logiciel en Python, analyse environnementale via méthode ACV (couvrant les impacts de fabrication, d'inférence tout au long de la durée de vie du matériel, et de fin de vie), optionnellement implémentation d'algorithmes d'IA embarqué et mesure de la consommation énergétique, et rédaction d'une publication scientifique. Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? items.desc: In a world where products and software can be replicated overnight, intellectual property is one of the last durable moats. Stilta builds agentic AI for intellectual property, giving legal and IP teams software that can reason across massive document sets, surface evidence, and produce litigation-grade work faster and more reliably. We recently raised a $10.5M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Y Combinator and founder/operators from companies including OpenAI, Legora, and Lovable. We already work with major IP firms and Fortune 500 companies, and we're at the very beginning of defining what great AI-native software for intellectual property looks like. About the role You'll be one of the first hires outside the founding team - four ex-QuantumBlack engineers, now building Stilta. Your decisions will shape the product for years. You'll own the AI core of the product: multi-agent reasoning pipelines, retrieval over hundreds of millions of patents and scientific literature, and the evaluation systems that prove the output holds up for practitioners at top IP firms and Fortune 500 IP teams. These are problems without established patterns. You're building agentic software that patent lawyers actually trust to do substantive work - and you'll define what this category of product looks like. What you will do Build and improve the multi-agent architecture powering invalidity search, infringement analysis, freedom to operate research, and more Own the full lifecycle of features - from talking to customers about what they need to watching them use it in production Push code to production daily. Your code reaches users in hours or days, not weeks Build retrieval, reasoning, and evaluation systems that run autonomously over millions of documents with reliable source-backed results Set the standards for how we build, evaluate, and ship AI systems as the team scales What we are looking for Exceptional matters more than experienced - we care about what you can do, not how long you've been doing it Strong engineering fundamentals and opinionated about product You write software with and for AI agents, and have shipped agentic systems to production before - you know how to make LLMs reliable through context engineering, retrieval, and evals You can take an AI capability from sketch to production single-handedly - write the specs, design the evals, wire the agent pipeline, deploy it Comfortable across Python and TypeScript, and you've worked with enough infrastructure - vector databases, distributed compute, cloud orchestration - that none of it slows you down Experience navigating enterprise requirements - SOC 2, data residency, access controls - is a plus What we can offer Competitive Salary + Equity Unlimited Claude Code - experiment with AI-assisted workflows, prototypes, and automations from day one A front row seat - you will be shaping the foundation of our business Stilta are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or background. Selection for this role will be based solely on suitability for the position and does not discriminate on any protected characteristic.

items.desc:
WHO WE ARE

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08328-6 cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics https://www.oxcan.org/news/prior-labs-and-oxford-cancer-analytics-partner-to-advance-liquid-biopsy-and-clinical-decision-making-in-lung-disease to preventing train failures with Hitachi https://siliconangle.com/2025/12/01/prior-labs-debuts-tabular-ai-foundation-model-scales-10-million-rows/. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ https://priorlabs.ai/about with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-hutter-9190b24b/, Noah Hollmann https://www.linkedin.com/in/noah-hollmann-668b9010b/, and Sauraj Gambhir https://www.linkedin.com/in/sauraj-g/, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP https://priorlabs.ai/blog-posts/priorlabs-sap as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.



The role

We're hiring our first dedicated Security Engineer to protect our technology and our customers' data. You'll work across the systems behind TabPFN, from cloud infrastructure and software to enterprise deployments.

You'll work with engineers to understand risks, design secure systems and build the tools to protect them. The role spans cloud and product security, incident response, and technical work with customers and auditors.

We're looking for a strong infrastructure engineer who wants to focus on security. Your experience could come from platform engineering, SRE, backend development or a security role.

What you'll do

- Review system designs and code, identify security risks, and help engineers address them throughout development.

- Build security controls and automation for our cloud infrastructure, software and deployment pipelines.

- Improve identity and access management for people and services, including permissions, secrets and access changes.

- Assess vulnerabilities, coordinate penetration tests and work with engineering teams to prioritise and deliver fixes.

- Develop detection and recovery capabilities, investigate incidents and lead the technical response with engineering teams.

- Support customer security reviews and the technical controls for SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Our Operations team coordinates the audit programme.

What we're looking for

- Hands-on experience building and running cloud infrastructure, including GCP or AWS, IAM, CI/CD and containers.

- Experience writing and maintaining infrastructure as code and automation in a team.

- An interest in security that you've put into practice through work, personal projects, CTFs or relevant training.

- Sound judgment about which risks need attention first, and an interest in the breadth of the role, including audits and customer conversations.

- The ability to explain a risk clearly and work with other engineers to address it.

- Practical use of AI tools to improve engineering workflows.

- Based in Berlin or Freiburg, or willing to relocate. We consider remote work within the EU by exception.

What sets you apart

- Experience in cloud or application security, penetration testing, or acting as your team's security contact.

- Work on container and software supply-chain security.

- Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits, or taking responsibility for security at a smaller company.

 




LIFE AT PRIOR LABS

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.




OUR COMMITMENTS

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. items.desc:
Mission 
 LPHE-RM and LPAP are looking for a highly motivated PhD Student in FCC-ee Energy Calibration Studies and Polariz ation on Colliding Beams . 
 The École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) is one of Europe's most dynamic university campuses and ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide. EPFL employs 6,000 people supporting its three core missions: education, research, and innovation. The campus offers an exceptional working environment at the heart of a community of 16,000 people, including more than 10,000 students and 3,500 researchers from 120 countries.
 The EPFL Laboratory of Particle Accelerator Physics (LPAP) together with the Laboratory of High Energy Physics RM (LPHE-RM) are seeking a highly motivated PhD student to contribute to beam dynamics studies and the development of advanced simulation tools for the Future Circular Collider (FCC-ee) high precision physics program, CERN's proposed next-generation electron–positron collider.
 This PhD project will focus on spin dynamics, beam polarization and high-precision beam energy calibration at FCC-ee. The research will investigate and develop advanced energy measurement techniques, with particular emphasis on Resonant DePolarization (RDP) and the novel Near-Resonance Polarization Modulation (NRPM) method. The student will study spin dynamics and polarization preservation under realistic machine conditions, taking into account machine imperfections, synchrotron radiation and beam–beam interactions.
 An additional research direction will explore the feasibility and potential benefits of transverse polarization in colliding beams, investigating its preservation under collision conditions and its possible applications to FCC-ee. The project will involve the development, application and benchmarking of spin-tracking and beam dynamics simulation tools, contributing to the validation and optimization of polarization and energy calibration strategies for FCC-ee. The evaluation of the uncertainties related to the center of mass energy of colliding beams is a fundamental part of these studies. An important component will be the validation of simulation models against experimental observations at existing accelerator facilities where possible.
 The successful candidate will work within the international FCC-ee and CHART collaboration, interacting with researchers at EPFL, CERN and PSI. The research will contribute directly to addressing key open questions for the FCC-ee future developments.
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 As a PhD student, you will be expected to: 
 Study the performance and limitations of high-precision beam energy calibration methods, including Resonance DePolarization and N ear R esonance P olarization M odulation methods , under realistic operational conditions. 
 Study and quantify the different biases to the center of mass energy evaluation in realistic conditions 
 Develop and apply numerical simulation tools for spin tracking, beam polarization and beam–beam interaction studies. 
 Contribute to the benchmarking and validation of simulation tools against experimental observations at existing accelerator facilities where and if possible . 
 Disseminate research results through scientific publications, international conferences, workshops and technical reports. 
 Participate in EPFL teaching activities and contribute to the supervision of students. 
 Profile 
 MSc degree (or equivalent) in Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering or a closely related field. 
 Strong interest in accelerator physics, beam dynamics and computational physics. 
 Knowledge of classical and/or numerical mechanics, electromagnetism and particle dynamics. 
 Experience with numerical modelling, simulations and scientific programming. 
 Good programming skills . 
 Familiarity with accelerator physics, particle tracking codes or computational modelling is an asset. 
 Knowledge of spin dynamics, plasma physics, collective effects or beam–beam interactions is an advantage. 
 Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within an international research team. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, motivation and scientific curiosity. 
 Excellent written and spoken English. 
 Previous experience in accelerator physics is an advantage but is not a strict requirement for candidates with a strong background in computational physics, applied mathematics or related fields. 
 We offer 
 A stimulating and international research environment at CERN and EPFL , in close collaboration with the international FCC-ee community. 
 The opportunity to contribute to the development of one of the most ambitious future particle accelerator projects. 
 Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art accelerator simulation and modelling tools. 
 Opportunities to participate in experimental benchmarking activities at leading accelerator facilities, including SLSII . 
 Close interaction with internationally recognised experts in accelerator physics and beam …

At Nokia’s Digital Office (DO), we are transforming how IT enables the company to operate, innovate, and grow. Duration: 12 months
Start date (tentative): December, 2026
Location: Hybrid in Amadora, Portugal

items.desc: About Oper Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency. The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment. A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium. Your Mission We are looking for a Business Analyst (DACH) to join our Customer Success team. You will start with one of our flagship Austrian customers, owning the delivery work that turns their business needs into a configured, live Oper platform. As we continue to grow in DACH, you will expand into a broader portfolio of German-speaking lenders, becoming the trusted delivery partner who guides them from kickoff to value. This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys structuring messy problems, sitting in a workshop with bankers and product owners, and translating what they hear into something concrete the engineering team can build and the customer can run. It is also a role for someone who is AI-native , who uses modern AI tooling as a core part of how they think, write, and ship. Tasks Your Responsibilities Capture and structure customer requirements You will be the bridge between what the customer wants and what Oper delivers. Run discovery workshops with business and IT stakeholders at our DACH customers Capture functional and business requirements in clear, well-structured documentation Map requirements to Oper's product : identify what works out-of-the-box, what needs configuration, and what genuinely needs engineering Translate business needs into user stories and functional specifications the squad can act on Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle Analyze integration points Our customers run on complex banking stacks. You will figure out how Oper plugs in cleanly. Review technical API documentation from core banking systems, CRMs, and online banking platforms Work with Oper engineering to identify and define integration points Document data flows, contracts, and edge cases so nothing surprises us at go-live Make smart, pragmatic recommendations on what to integrate now vs. later Configure workflows and deliver value You will own the hands-on configuration work that makes Oper work for each customer. Configure mortgage products, business rules, and customer journeys inside the Oper platform Validate that configurations match the agreed scope and pass acceptance testing Lead training sessions for end users and customer champions Stay close to the customer through go-live and early adoption, then hand over cleanly to the Customer Success team Work AI-native We expect you to use modern AI tooling as a real lever, not a curiosity. Use AI tools to scaffold documentation, draft specs, summarize workshops, and accelerate analysis, automate processes,… Identify where AI compounds your work and where it does not, and design your workflow accordingly Help us push the bar on what an AI-native delivery function looks like at Oper Requirements Your Profile We are looking for someone with a consulting background who is ready to go deep on a product and an industry and love technology: 2 to 3 years of experience in consulting (Big-4, boutique strategy/tech, or implementation consulting). Fluent in German and English You love structuring problems : messy customer conversations come out of your hands as clean documents, frameworks, and next steps You genuinely enjoy customer and end-user interaction : workshops energize you rather than drain you Technical affinity : you are comfortable reading API documentation, understanding integration patterns, and configuring software. You do not need to code, but you should not be afraid of anything technical either. AI-native : you can name the tools, the workflows, and the concrete recent examples where AI gave you real leverage. You see AI as a default part of how you work. Action-oriented, with a knack for getting things done in ambiguous situations Comfortable in a fast-growing, evolving SaaS environment Languages Fluent …

items.desc: Eluv recherche un formateur ou une formatrice indépendant(e) pour animer la formation « [Sur mesure] Déployer et exploiter une IA locale souveraine : Ollama, Open WebUI, RAG et outillage Python ». Dates : 5j + inter session, en 2027, dates à choisir pendant audit Lieu : en présentiel à Losgnes (77) Programme de la formation : Objectifs pédagogiques Expliquer le fonctionnement et les limites d'un LLM afin de qualifier ce qui peut lui être confié Formuler et fiabiliser des prompts produisant des sorties exploitables sur les cas d'usage du service Installer, dimensionner et administrer une plateforme d'IA locale Ollama + Open WebUI sur matériel GPU Mesurer la tenue en charge de la plateforme et justifier les réglages retenus par des mesures Sécuriser, sauvegarder et faire évoluer la plateforme en exploitation interne Construire des bases de connaissances RAG et en évaluer la qualité de réponse au moyen d'un jeu de questions de référence Lire, exécuter, corriger et adapter un script Python produit par l'IA Transformer un script en outil Open WebUI afin de fiabiliser les traitements que l'IA ne sait pas faire Programme détaillé Session 1 - J1 matin : comprendre un LLM et faire tourner sa première IA locale Tokens, fenêtre de contexte, température et top_p. Génération probabiliste et hallucinations. Panorama des modèles ouverts et de leurs formats. Ce que change une IA locale : souveraineté des données, coût, latence, limites. Travaux pratiques : Installation d'Ollama sur le poste de chaque participant. Téléchargement et lancement d'un petit modèle. Premiers échanges en ligne de commande puis via l'API REST. Mise en défaut volontaire du modèle : question hors contexte, date, calcul, information absente, et relevé des symptômes. Variation de la température et de la taille de contexte, observation des effets. Livrable : Une IA locale fonctionnelle sur chaque poste et une fiche « limites observées » rédigée par l'équipe. Session 1 - J1 après-midi : formuler une demande qui produit le bon résultat Anatomie d'un prompt : rôle, contexte, instruction, exemples, format de sortie attendu. Apprentissage par l'exemple (few-shot). Contraindre la sortie : tableau, JSON, gabarit. Distinction entre prompt système et prompt utilisateur. Méthode d'itération mesurée. Travaux pratiques : Amélioration pas à pas de 5 prompts sur les cas prioritaires du service : synthèse de compte rendu, reformulation, traduction, extraction d'informations d'un relevé fictif, classification. Comparaison avant/après sur un même jeu d'entrées. Formalisation du gabarit de fiche-prompt et amorçage de la bibliothèque du service. Livrable : Une bibliothèque de prompts testés et documentés, réutilisable par les utilisateurs finaux. Session 1 - J2 matin : dimensionner et mettre en service la tour VRAM disponible et taille de modèle. Quantization et arbitrage entre qualité et mémoire. Coût mémoire de la fenêtre de contexte. Critères de choix d'un modèle francophone. Licences des modèles ouverts et conséquences pour un usage interne. Travaux pratiques : Sur la tour : vérification des pilotes NVIDIA et de CUDA, installation de Docker et du runtime NVIDIA, installation d'Ollama. Téléchargement de 3 modèles. Banc d'essai comparatif sur un même jeu de questions en français : qualité des réponses, débit en tokens par seconde, VRAM occupée. Livrable : La tour opérationnelle et un tableau comparatif des 3 modèles avec les critères de choix. Session 1 - J2 après-midi : déployer Open WebUI Rôle et architecture d'Open WebUI : interface, backend, base de données, raccordement au moteur d'inférence. Modes d'authentification, rôles et groupes. Localisation et persistance des données. Travaux pratiques : Déploiement par docker compose : variables d'environnement, persistance des volumes, raccordement à Ollama. Création des comptes et des groupes (administration, pilote, test). Paramétrage des modèles exposés aux utilisateurs. Test d'accès depuis un poste du réseau interne. Livrable : L'interface accessible depuis les postes et un fichier compose commenté, versionné par l'équipe. Session 1 - J3 matin : tenir la charge Requêtes en parallèle et file d'attente. Paramètres déterminants : nombre de requêtes simultanées, maintien du modèle en mémoire, longueur de contexte. Ollama ou vLLM : différences de traitement par lots et cas où le changement de moteur se justifie. Métriques à suivre : temps de première réponse, débit, centile 95. Travaux pratiques : Scénario de charge simulant 15 utilisateurs à partir d'un script fourni et commenté. Mesure des temps de réponse. Variation d'un réglage à la fois et relevé de l'effet. Essai du second moteur si les mesures le justifient. Consolidation des résultats dans un tableau de décision. Livrable : Le choix du moteur et les réglages retenus, justifiés par des mesures reproductibles. Session 1 - J3 après-midi : administrer et sécuriser Modèles personnalisés et prompts système persistants. Périmètre d'une sauvegarde : volumes, base, …

items.desc: Le groupe Vizea, spécialisé dans l’ingénierie Développement Durable depuis 2006, accompagne les acteurs de la construction de la ville et les entreprises pour permettre la transition écologique de notre société. Fort de ses 60 collaborateurs, Vizea poursuit son développement et recherche un.e Stagiaire pour son agence Grand Ouest à Nantes , avec un intérêt pour les outils numériques, la programmation et l’intelligence artificielle. Vous pourrez contribuer à des missions variées comme: le réseau points-nœuds cyclable d’Ille-et-Vilaine, schéma directeur cyclable de Saint-Brieuc, accompagnement environnemental de ZAC de Rennes et Nantes Métropole, et synthèse environnementale d’un projet d’aménagement de 450 ha pour Tours Métropole. Notre force : une approche pluridisciplinaire croisant mobilité, urbanisme, climat, énergie et biodiversité, de la stratégie jusqu’aux projets opérationnels. Notre approche transversale nous confère une vision globale avec une réelle position de force pour initier un changement durable. Vizea est implantée nationalement avec des agences à Bordeaux, Lyon, Nantes, et son siège à Paris. Notre structure s’organise autour de 5 métiers : Bâtiment, Urbanisme, Territoire, Mobilité et Transition Environnementale des Entreprises. Vizea c’est aussi : Une société à taille humaine et indépendante Une solidarité et une bienveillance au sein de notre équipe Une expertise consolidée par nos échanges et nos formations internes Une politique RSE forte promouvant l’éthique et l’équité Les missions confiées Au sein de l’équipe nantaise, sous la responsabilité d’un responsable d’entité, vous participerez aux études et à l’évolution de nos méthodes et outils. Vous aurez également en charge les missions suivantes : Mobilité durable Diagnostics de mobilité, analyse des pratiques de déplacement, des réseaux et de l’accessibilité; Schémas directeurs cyclables, stratégies de mobilités actives et études de faisabilité; Cartographies, analyses SIG et préconisations d’aménagement en faveur de la marche et du vélo; Réaliser des analyses de données, des cartographies et des supports d’aide à la décision, notamment à l’aide d’outils SIG; Aménagement et urbanisme durables Études environnementales de quartiers, de ZAC et d’opérations d’aménagement; Diagnostics territoriaux : climat, biodiversité, sobriété foncière, eau, mobilité et espaces publics; Évaluation de scénarios d’aménagement, synthèses environnementales et recommandations aux maîtres d’ouvrage. SIG, Data et intelligence artificielle Automatisation de traitements géographiques et de données territoriales avec Python, QGIS ou PyQGIS; Développement de scripts, d’indicateurs et d’outils d’analyse ou de comparaison de scénarios; Expérimentation d’usages pertinents de l’IA : analyse documentaire, exploitation de données, aide à la production de livrables et capitalisation des méthodes. Missions transversales : visites de terrain, réunions, concertation, veille technique et partage des outils avec les équipes. Le profil recherché Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou de Master en Mobilité, transports, urbanisme, aménagement, géographie, environnement ou développement durable Vous disposez idéalement : Intérêt pour les mobilités actives et l’aménagement durable ; bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de rédaction; Maîtrise appréciée de QGIS et goût pour l’exploitation de données territoriales; Connaissances en Python ou forte motivation pour progresser ; curiosité pour les applications concrètes de l’IA; Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’équipe et goût pour l’expérimentation et la résolution de problèmes. Une première expérience en automatisation, scripts ou outils d’IA est un atout, sans être indispensable. Vous vous reconnaissez dans nos valeurs : Engagement, Responsabilité, Équité, Intégrité et Partage. items.card: THE ROLE You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there. As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer
items.desc: ABOUT NAXON Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones. Why now : rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site. Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM). THE ROLE You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there. As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination WHAT YOU BRING Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos Strong in SLAM, localisation, state estimation and motion planning Expert in ROS2, C++ and Python, and a heavy user of AI coding agents Hands on with quadrupeds, wheeled robots or drones and their sensors on real hardware MSc / PhD plus 2 to 4 years in industry, or equivalent proven experience WHY JOIN NAXON The challenge: one map shared across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, task allocation across a live site, and an edge/cloud split over networks that drop Full ownership of your area, from architecture to what runs at the customer , and a clear path into leading it Real robots at real customer sites, from research to working reliably in real world conditions Hands-on work with cutting-edge robotics, hardware and AI Competitive salary and equity (VSOP / ESOP) as a founding team member Backing from EWOR and robotics mentors who have built, scaled and exited companies A supportive and inclusive team that values ownership and creativity

items.desc: Position Overview: As we continue to expand and evolve our Supply-Chain-focused Data Integration Platform, we're looking for Python Software Engineer with a strong affinity for AI/ML to join our Product & Engineering team. We launched Pathfinder, which brings AI into the world of EDI and Data Integration – it’s already live in production and proven stable. What we need now is a skilled software engineer to expand its scope with clean, production-grade code. In this role, you’ll build additional AI agents within this established framework, taking them from blueprint to production. These agents leverage both LLMs and hybrid AI/ML systems. Our mission is to connect people, data and intelligence (human & artificial) to optimise processes across the supply chain, always choosing the right tool for the right challenge. Ready to make an impact? You’ll get to take ownership of: Developing Pathfinder, a multi-agent AI system built on protocol-driven, microservice-oriented architecture – where specialised agents are dynamically orchestrated to assist users in navigating the complexities of data integration, automating routine tasks and proactively solving problems to make them significantly more productive. Defining and implementing scalable microservices that drive data mapping, transformation, and intelligent integration. Developing and maintaining RESTful APIs to ensure seamless communication between services and systems. Creating and optimising event-driven data pipelines to enable real-time processing, automation, and decision-making across our products. Evaluating, selecting, and implementing the best-fit tools and technologies to solve complex engineering and data challenges effectively. Collaborating directly with key customers and internal stakeholders to validate solution performance and ensure product impact and usability. What You’ll Bring: 3+ years of professional software engineering with Python as your primary language, and a track record of building and running production-grade software – including being the person who fixed it when it broke. Python craft: strictly typed, well-structured code that goes well beyond scripting or notebooks. You model your data at every boundary – Pydantic, attrs or similar – and you're comfortable working within an established framework. A production mindset: you think about maintainability, testing, telemetry, and debugging, and you’re comfortable handling production issues and contributing to root cause analysis (RCA). Deep, practical async Python: you have built services on asyncio and you know what it buys you and what it doesn't – async generators, cancellation, and why a single blocking call inside a coroutine stalls everything around it. Micro-services and event-driven architectures on top of that. A feel for what goes wrong across a network boundary: timeouts, bounded retries with backoff, idempotency. You read an outbound call with no deadline on it as a defect rather than a detail. Proficiency in designing and consuming RESTful APIs. An affinity for AI/ML: curiosity about or hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic systems is a strong plus, though neither is required – we care more that you engineer well than that you already know this stack. Deep ML specialism is not needed. Strong communication skills in English. Nice to have: Supply chain or logistics domain knowledge – the cherry on top, not a requirement. Willingness to dig into the Java codebase of our core product to understand what functionality is already available, even before it’s exposed via an API. Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Enterprise) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi). Familiarity with cloud AI services (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML). A note on timing: we’re screening for this role at a relaxed pace, with an eye toward filling it as part of our early-2027 hiring pipeline. The process may move slower than you’re used to. Ready to make an impact? You’ll get to take ownership
items.desc: Remote Germany, Netherland Full-time Permanent employee Position Overview: As we continue to expand and evolve our Supply-Chain-focused Data Integration Platform, we're looking for Python Software Engineer with a strong affinity for AI/ML to join our Product & Engineering team. We launched Pathfinder, which brings AI into the world of EDI and Data Integration – it’s already live in production and proven stable. What we need now is a skilled software engineer to expand its scope with clean, production-grade code. In this role, you’ll build additional AI agents within this established framework, taking them from blueprint to production. These agents leverage both LLMs and hybrid AI/ML systems. Our mission is to connect people, data and intelligence (human & artificial) to optimise processes across the supply chain, always choosing the right tool for the right challenge. Ready to make an impact? You’ll get to take ownership of: Developing Pathfinder, a multi-agent AI system built on protocol-driven, microservice-oriented architecture – where specialised agents are dynamically orchestrated to assist users in navigating the complexities of data integration, automating routine tasks and proactively solving problems to make them significantly more productive. Defining and implementing scalable microservices that drive data mapping, transformation, and intelligent integration. Developing and maintaining RESTful APIs to ensure seamless communication between services and systems. Creating and optimising event-driven data pipelines to enable real-time processing, automation, and decision-making across our products. Evaluating, selecting, and implementing the best-fit tools and technologies to solve complex engineering and data challenges effectively. Collaborating directly with key customers and internal stakeholders to validate solution performance and ensure product impact and usability. What You’ll Bring: 3+ years of professional software engineering with Python as your primary language, and a track record of building and running production-grade software – including being the person who fixed it when it broke. Python craft: strictly typed, well-structured code that goes well beyond scripting or notebooks. You model your data at every boundary – Pydantic, attrs or similar – and you're comfortable working within an established framework. A production mindset: you think about maintainability, testing, telemetry, and debugging, and you’re comfortable handling production issues and contributing to root cause analysis (RCA). Deep, practical async Python: you have built services on asyncio and you know what it buys you and what it doesn't – async generators, cancellation, and why a single blocking call inside a coroutine stalls everything around it. Micro-services and event-driven architectures on top of that. A feel for what goes wrong across a network boundary: timeouts, bounded retries with backoff, idempotency. You read an outbound call with no deadline on it as a defect rather than a detail. Proficiency in designing and consuming RESTful APIs. An affinity for AI/ML: curiosity about or hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic systems is a strong plus, though neither is required – we care more that you engineer well than that you already know this stack. Deep ML specialism is not needed. Strong communication skills in English. Nice to have: Supply chain or logistics domain knowledge – the cherry on top, not a requirement. Willingness to dig into the Java codebase of our core product to understand what functionality is already available, even before it’s exposed via an API. Experience with CI/CD (GitHub Enterprise) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi). Familiarity with cloud AI services (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML). You can look forward to: Opportunity to work flexibly from home Modern offices in Germany and the Netherlands A personal Learning & Development budget Up to 30 days of remote work per year from any EU country Company Pension plan 30 vacation days a year 2 additional paid days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve Location-specific benefits packages (your recruiter will be happy to provide more details during your first chat) Company-sponsored business travel This is a vacancy with monthly visits to our HQ in Tutzing or Amsterdam. A note on timing: we’re screening for this role at a relaxed pace, with an eye toward filling it as part of our early-2027 hiring pipeline. The process may move slower than you’re used to. If you feel like you don’t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply! Lobster is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where empathy and respect guide our interactions. About us Lobster is the go-to data integration platform for complex, multi-party supply chains. items.desc: Är du en kreativ och digitalt nyfiken kommunikatör som vill kombinera kommunikation, innehållsproduktion och AI? Då kan rollen som Kommunikatör med AI-profil hos Botkyrkabyggen vara nästa steg för dig. Här får du en viktig roll i att utveckla vår kommunikation, stärka dialogen med våra hyresgäster och skapa engagerande innehåll i våra digitala kanaler. Du får också möjlighet att bidra till hur vi använder AI och digitala verktyg för att utveckla och effektivisera kommunikationsarbetet. Tjänsten är placerad på vår kommunikationsavdelning, med placering på vårt huvudkontor i Tumba. Du rapporterar till Kommunikationschefen. Om oss Botkyrkabyggen är ett av landets större allmännyttiga bostadsföretag med cirka 10 800 hyresbostäder och 160 medarbetare. Vi är en stabil och långsiktig fastighetsägare med ett starkt samhällsengagemang som samarbetar med hyresgäster, kommunen och andra lokala aktörer. Vi ser på fastigheter inte bara som byggnader – utan som en viktig del i att bygga ett starkare och mer inkluderande Botkyrka, där människor vill bo, arbeta och utvecklas. Vårt uppdrag är att, på ett affärsmässigt sätt, förvalta och utveckla trygga, hållbara och attraktiva bostäder och lokaler i Botkyrka. Tillsammans skapar vi hem där alla vill bo och vi förvaltar med omtanke. Hos oss ska alla känna sig välkomna och respekterade, oavsett bakgrund. Ansvarsområden Som kommunikatör med AI-profil har du en operativ och utvecklande roll där du bidrar till att stärka relationen till våra hyresgäster genom tydlig och målgruppsanpassad kommunikation. Du ansvarar för att skapa relevant och engagerande innehåll som lyfter vår verksamhet och våra bostadsområden. En viktig del av rollen är att utveckla och använda AI-stödda arbetssätt för att höja kvaliteten, öka träffsäkerheten och effektivisera kommunikationsarbetet. Du bidrar med idéer och digital kompetens och är med och utvecklar kommunikationsavdelningens arbetssätt. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Som kommunikatör med AI-profil arbetar du brett med innehållsproduktion och kommunikation i våra olika kanaler. Du producerar och publicerar innehåll för webbplats, nyhetsbrev, sociala medier, intranät och andra kanaler, i form av text, bild och film. Du deltar vid hyresgästmöten, genomför intervjuer och tar fram innehåll som lyfter verksamheten, våra områden och våra hyresgäster. Du planerar och koordinerar även aktiviteter och evenemang samt producerar informationsmaterial till hyresgäster, exempelvis aviseringar och innehåll på Mina sidor. Du förväntas ha ett nära samarbete med förvaltningsavdelningen. I tjänsten ingår pressberedskap enligt schema kvällar och helger och visst övrigt arbete på kvällar och helger i våra bostadsområden. Du identifierar möjligheter att använda AI och andra digitala verktyg för att utveckla innehållsproduktion och effektivisera kommunikationsprocesser. Du deltar också i kommunikationsavdelningens löpande arbete och gemensamma leveranser. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har en högskoleutbildning inom journalistik eller medie- och kommunikationsvetenskap. Du har minst ett års arbetslivserfarenhet inom kommunikationsområdet eller journalistik och dokumenterad erfarenhet av att använda AI-verktyg i det dagliga kommunikationsarbetet, exempelvis genom avancerad prompting, textproduktion och idéarbete. Du har mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i skrift och kan anpassa budskap och innehåll efter olika målgrupper. För att lyckas i rollen är du en kreativ och kommunikativ person som har lätt för att skapa relationer och tycker om att arbeta nära människor. Du är digitalt nyfiken och har ett genuint intresse för hur AI och nya verktyg kan utveckla kommunikationsarbetet. Du är självgående och ansvarstagande, samtidigt som du trivs med att samarbeta och bidra till gemensamma leveranser. Du arbetar strukturerat och har god affärsförståelse. Det är meriterande om du har B-körkort, dokumenterad erfarenhet av att planera och genomföra kommunikationskampanjer riktade mot kunder eller boende samt vidareutbildning inom AI. Vi erbjuder Vi erbjuder ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdsförsäkring, 38 timmars arbetsvecka samt viss möjlighet till distansarbete. Arbetstiden är huvudsakligen förlagd till dagtid på vardagar. Botkyrkabyggen är en rökfri arbetsplats. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning. Ansökan Du är välkommen att skicka din ansökan senast den 7 december 2026. Dina ansökningshandlingar ska innehålla CV och ett personligt brev. Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande. För mer information kontakta Cina Gerdin, Kommunikationschef, via mejl: cina.gerdin@botkyrkabyggen.se eller besök vår hemsida, https://www.botkyrkabyggen.se/. Facklig företrädare för Unionen är Jan Viljanen tel. 08-530 693 37.

With the Tech Trainee programme and as an employee,
items.desc: Do you want to question, change, and steer our company into the future? Are you passionate about technology and ready to make a difference? Then you will thrive at SEB. At SEB, we believe in fresh thinking, new working methods, and innovation to create a fairer and more sustainable world. Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success, while we place a strong emphasis on sustainability and digitalization as we shape the future of SEB. With the Tech Trainee programme and as an employee, we'll help you develop new skills and take on more responsibility to create a positive impact. You will become a crucial key player in shaping the future of the bank. Your tech trainee position and your team How could AI change the way product teams work and learn? If you enjoy questions without ready-made answers, this is your opportunity to turn curiosity into insights that shape our next steps. In this research-focused role, you will explore how agentic AI could influence software development in SEB’s retail banking and financing context, from ways of working to tools, capabilities and learning needs. Drawing on internal research opportunities and publicly available research and examples, you will combine an understanding of software development with an interest in how organizations work. In your role, you will: Turn broad questions about AI and software development into a structured research approach, with clear questions and hypotheses to investigate. Investigate organizational approaches, tools, capabilities and internal learning needs connected to agentic AI. Independently benchmark our findings against publicly available research and examples, distinguishing evidence from assumptions. Bring findings together and explain their implications clearly to stakeholders with different perspectives and backgrounds. The detailed assignment will be refined as we approach the programme start in September 2027. Simultaneously by working in the role you are being recruited to, you will participate in SEB's Tech Trainee Programme for six months. It will give you the opportunity to develop an extensive network within the bank, gain a deep understanding of the financial industry and our global tech organization, and be professionally and personally challenged. As part of the programme, you can expect to: contribute to meaningful projects, work on tech tracks, gain communication and leadership skills, and participate in a hackathon and a business challenge. Key traits to thrive in this role and programme We’re looking for young talents who are curious, motivated, and ready to question the status quo. To thrive in this role and in the Tech Trainee programme, you need to have: Graduated within the past two years, or will graduate before the programme starts on 1st September 2027 – from a relevant academic degree or a two-year vocational education in IT or tech Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership Great communication skills and to be able to work in English We also believe you have: A strong academic foundation in computer science or a related field, with an understanding of software development. A genuine interest in AI, particularly agentic AI, and how it could change software development and the organizations around it. A structured approach to research: your academic work shows how you approach unfamiliar questions and communicate findings, with contributions to white papers or similar being a plus. The initiative to seek information independently, ask questions and engage with different stakeholders. The ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and remain open to evidence that challenges your assumptions. You do not need to arrive with all the answers. We are interested in how you approach a question, what you want to investigate, and your willingness to test and revisit your assumptions. What matters most is your potential and passion . In our recruitment, SEB behaviors are something we consider when choosing whom to hire. These behaviors include creating value, acting long-term, and building positive relationships. What we offer A six-month trainee programme, designed for professional and personal development A full-time employment in the role you have been hired for, after completing the programme successfully Agile and modern ways of working A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views Networking and collaboration opportunities A real business challenge to solve with other participants in the Tech Trainee programme, where you can create value and make a difference for SEB Extensive training and learning opportunities Do you want to be a part of SEB? It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity are crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what …

Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success, while we place a strong emphasis on sustainability and digitalization as we shape the future of SEB. With the Tech Trainee programme and as an employee, we'll help you develop new skills and take on more responsibility to create a positive impact. You will become a crucial key player in shaping the future of the bank. Your tech trainee position and your team Build technology that makes a difference. As a full stack developer in our Pension & Insurance team within Business and Retail Banking, you’ll work across frontend, backend and third-party integrations, using the latest technologies. You’ll explore AI-assisted development with us as we begin our journey into agentic engineering. Our diverse range of applications gives you opportunities to broaden your skills, tackle varied technical challenges and build solutions that shape how customers interact with SEB. Simultaneously by working in the role you are being recruited to, you will participate in SEB's Tech Trainee Programme for six months. It will give you the opportunity to develop an extensive network within the bank, gain a deep understanding of the financial industry and our global tech organization, and be professionally and personally challenged. As part of the programme, you can expect to: contribute to meaningful projects, work on tech tracks, gain communication and leadership skills, and participate in a hackathon and a business challenge. Key traits to thrive in this role and programme We’re looking for young talents who are curious, motivated, and ready to question the status quo. To thrive in this role and in the Tech Trainee programme, you need to have: Graduated within the past two years, or will graduate before the programme starts on 1st September 2027 – from a relevant academic degree or a two-year vocational education in IT or tech Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership Great communication skills and to be able to work in English We also believe you are/have: A curious mindset and a strong drive to learn, experiment and grow as a developer. An interest in AI-assisted development and a desire to explore agentic engineering together with us. An enthusiasm for full stack development, from user interfaces to backend services and integrations. An openness to working across different applications and technologies, seeing variety as an opportunity to broaden your skills. A collaborative mindset, with a willingness to ask questions, share ideas and learn from others. Some hands-on experience with .NET and Angular, gained through studies, personal projects or work. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus, but not a requirement. Previous experience (part-time work, own projects etc.) and involvement during your studies are advantageous but what matters most is your potential and passion . In our recruitment, SEB behaviors are something we consider when choosing whom to hire. These behaviors include creating value, acting long-term, and building positive relationships. What we offer: A six-month trainee programme, designed for professional and personal development A full-time employment in the role you have been hired for, after completing the programme successfully Agile and modern ways of working A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views Networking and collaboration opportunities A real business challenge to solve with other participants in the Tech Trainee programme, where you can create value and make a difference for SEB Extensive training and learning opportunities Do you want to be a part of SEB? It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity are crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from. The application period for the Tech Trainee programme is open until 10 th January 2027 23:59 CET. Please write your CV in English. The Tech Trainee programme will start on 1 st September 2027. Our recruitment process We want to get to know you, and for you to get to know us. The recruitment process includes: Psychometric tests Interviews – digitally and on-site A case exercise and presentation SEB Day – an event to learn more about SEB and the programme, with insights from former trainees Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of …

items.desc: Creative Economy Data Program, Office of the Deputy Director General (CCES), Copyright, Creative Economy and IP Governance Sector Grade - P3 Contract Duration - 2 years (maximum cumulative length of 5 years) * Duty Station : CH-Geneva Publication Date : 16-Nov-2026 Application Deadline : 16-Dec-2026, 4:59:00 PM IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING APPLICATION DEADLINE : please note that the deadline for applications is indicated in local time as per the time zone of the applicant’s location. This post is a limited-term fixed-term post. 1. Organizational Context a. Organizational Setting The position is located in the Creative Economy Data Program, Office of the Deputy Director General, Copyright, Creative Economy and IP Governance Sector. The Program aims to strengthen global understanding of the modern creative economy by improving how data are collected, analyzed and applied in policymaking. It supports Member States in developing national capacity to measure the economic, social and cultural impact of the creative industries and to use these measures for development purposes. Its work covers the WIPO Creative Economy Data Model (CEDM), estimates of the contribution of the creative industries to GDP and employment, country studies, capacity building and technical statistical support. b. Purpose Statement The incumbent contributes to advancing WIPO’s strategic objectives in the creative economy by strengthening the evidence base for policy and decision-making. Through the development and implementation of the Creative Economy Data Model (CEDM), innovative data and AI approaches, and collaboration with Member States and partners, the incumbent supports WIPO’s efforts to improve the measurement, understanding and policy relevance of the creative economy. c. Reporting Lines The incumbent works under the supervision of the Creative Economy Data Program Director. 2. Duties and Responsibilities The incumbent will perform the following principal duties: a. Contribute to the design, development and implementation of the Creative Economy Data Model (CEDM) and related creative economy measurement in Member States, including the effects of current and emerging digital economy trends and technologies on the creative economy. b. Contribute to the development and refinement of conceptual frameworks, methodologies and indicators for measuring the creative economy, including mapping industry, product and occupation classifications to creative domains, and developing new indicators using big data, microdata and other non-traditional sources. c. Develop practical tools, measurement frameworks and guides to translate CEDM outputs and other creative economy data into evidence-based policy recommendations and provide technical advice to member states on assessing the economic, social, and cultural contribution of the creative industries and strengthening national data collection and analysis. d. Conduct analytical studies on the creative economy in Member States, including its contribution to GDP, employment and trade, and contribute to the preparation of country studies, policy reports, flagship reports and related outputs. e. Review and validate data inputs from Member States and other providers, applying quality controls and audit procedures, including good practice in composite indicator construction; and contribute to maintaining databases, processing code, R packages and other elements of the Program's data infrastructure, ensuring automation, reproducibility and quality assurance. f. Implement the data workflow, from collection, to the automated production of country briefs. Identify and apply AI tools to data collection, the classification of creative activities and occupations, the extraction of data, and data validation. g. Coordinate and review the work of consultants and external experts, reviewing deliverables and ensuring technical accuracy; maintain effective working relations with governments, international and non-governmental organizations, academia, creators, creative industries and private data stakeholders; develop data partnerships; and collaborate with other WIPO Sectors to provide creative economy data and analysis, including for National IP Strategies. h. Represent the Program at technical meetings and conferences, prepare technical documentation and presentations, and promote WIPO's creative economy initiatives. i. Perform other related duties as required. 3. Requirements Education (Essential) First-level university degree in economics, statistics, data science, or a related field, with strong quantitative training. Education (Desirable) Advanced university degree and/or PhD in economics, statistics, data science or a related field. Experience (Essential) At least six years of professional experience in economics and data analysis, including the production of statistics or indicators. Experience in developing and implementing indicators or statistical estimates for the creative, digital, innovation or …
