About us SMB Accountancy Group (smbaccountancygroup.com) is a growing family of Merseyside accountancy practices. We acquire established local firms, keep their names, teams and clients, and give them a modern back office so each one keeps growing. There are five practices in the group today, with offices in Liverpool, Bootle, Southport and the Wirral, and we are actively acquiring across the North West. The group shares its directors and shareholders with Node UK (node.uk), which runs managed open source business software and AI on its own UK infrastructure. Our IT is built on that work: one Microsoft 365 and Entra ID platform for every practice, laptops managed with Intune, and AI agents that help us support, automate and improve how the firms run. In this role you will work closely with the Node UK engineering team, so you will see cutting-edge infrastructure, software development and AI work up close. The role You will be the person our staff call when something needs fixing, and the person on the ground as each practice moves onto the group's common platform. It is a hands-on role with plenty of variety: Getting staff up and running on new laptops, including first sign-in and multi-factor authentication Day-to-day support for Windows, Microsoft 365, printers and line-of-business software such as Sage, mostly remotely and sometimes on site Helping move the remaining practices onto the group platform: surveying each office, moving file shares and email, replacing equipment, and testing everything afterwards Setting up and changing kit in the offices: printers, screens, meeting rooms and network equipment Reviewing and approving requests for new software Working with staff to find the frustrations and inefficiencies in their day, and turning them into clear proposals for automation or AI that we can take to the board Helping roll out AI tools across the firms, and training staff to use them well With spare time, supporting Node UK's platform and customers alongside the engineering team You will not be on your own. Network design, security and the platform's architecture sit with our senior engineers and directors, and you will work directly with them and learn as you go. About you We are looking for potential and drive more than a long CV. You might be a recent graduate who already tinkers with technology at home, or have a year or two in IT support and want more than closing tickets. What matters is that you are curious, take ownership, and teach yourself what you do not yet know. You will need: A solid grounding in Windows 10 and 11 and Microsoft 365 from a support point of view Basic networking: IP addressing, subnets, DHCP, DNS and how to work out why something cannot connect A friendly, patient manner with busy, non-technical people, and the ability to explain things simply Clear written English: we document our work, and our AI tools work from what we write A genuine interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way people work A full UK driving licence and your own car, for travel between our offices It would be good to have, but we will teach you: Intune, Autopilot and Entra ID PowerShell or Python scripting A home lab, side projects, or certifications such as CompTIA A+ or Network+, or Microsoft's MD-102 or MS-900 What we offer £28,000 to £32,000 a year depending on experience, with a pay review at the end of your probation period Real progression: we expect pay and responsibility to grow as you do, with bonuses as the group grows Paid training and courses, including certifications, data protection and AI Mentoring from the directors and the Node UK engineering team A modern setup: the tools, laptop and AI agents to do the job properly Based at our head office in Speke, Liverpool, with time at Node UK in Aigburth and visits to the practices. Once you have settled in, the role can become more hybrid. Start date: Wednesday 6 January 2027, flexible for the right person Our attitude to this hire is simple. We want the person with the most potential: someone with a passion to grow their career, who brings ideas, and who wants to help us make the most of the positive changes AI will bring over the coming years. To apply, send your CV and a short note telling us about something technical you have built, fixed or taught yourself. Supported by KTH Innovation in Stockholm for venture development and commercialisation, with ongoing outreach across Stockholm and European nightlife scenes. What You Will Build & Co-Own Predictive Demand & Margin Engines: Design, validate, and implement the math behind our Spatial Yield Forecasting (matching artist sound profiles against local listener density and competing events), automated ad-spend Net Margin risk guards, and ticket-velocity estimation for promoters. Marketplace Incentives, Routing & Pricing: Model constrained tour routing optimization, 100% face-value waitlist clearing, friend-price referral rewards, affiliate incentives, Stripe Connect Smart Splits economics, and transparent tiered B2B pricing. Product Strategy & B2B Decision Tools: Translate complex data, closed-loop attribution (listening -> ticket -> door/bar revenue), and multi-party payment workflows into intuitive decision tools and dashboards for organisers, venues, labels, and artists. Commercial & Incubator Readiness: Build data-backed business cases, unit economics, and investor materials as the founding team scales through KTH Innovation, Nordic incubator tracks (such as SSE Business Lab), and pre-seed/seed fundraising. Technical Stack: Python (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, optimization) for modeling, and SQL / React / Next.js / TypeScript for shipping interactive B2B tools. Who You Are Studying or graduated from a quantitative engineering, mathematics, CS, or economics program (e.g. KTH IndEk, Teknisk Fysik, Applied Math, or equivalent) — or an experienced product manager, data scientist, quantitative analyst, or marketplace/pricing builder in Stockholm who loves solving complex optimization and unit-economics problems. Passionate about the intersection of technology, quantitative modeling, product design, and marketplace economics. Comfortable prototyping in Python (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn) and querying/building with SQL or TypeScript while thinking critically about unit economics and user incentives. Strong plus for hands-on experience in one or more of: scikit-learn / demand forecasting (or PyTorch), spatial demand & constrained routing optimization, dynamic pricing / referral & waitlist incentives, or A/B experimentation & attribution modeling. Genuinely interested in music, nightlife, or live events, and eager to co-own a company from the ground up. What We Offer Substantial Co-founder Equity: True founding ownership in Solpace (equity-based founding role at pre-seed stage; no corporate bureaucracy). Direct Analytical & Product Mandate: Own our marketplace economics, quantitative forecasting engines, and B2B product strategy from day one. Flexible Setup: Works alongside studies, thesis, or current commitments in Stockholm (hybrid at KTH Teknikringen / Sveavägen), transitioning into full-time as we scale. Interested? Skip the formal cover letter. Apply with a short note and a link to a model, optimization problem, or product you have built—plus one thought on how you would stress-test our Yield Forecasting & spatial catchment assumptions.

items.desc: Solpace is an independent, Stockholm-born music technology startup supported by KTH Innovation. We exist to return financial power, direct fan ownership, and creative autonomy to the artists, clubs, and dancers who live the culture—replacing corporate streaming pennies, 30% store cuts, pay-to-reach social algorithms, and ticketing monopolies. We give artists 0% commission with instant multi-party Smart Splits (even inside DJ sets), geographic tour routing, booking intelligence, and automated promo video & Meta/CRM campaigns—while equipping clubs and promoters with data-driven booking, automated campaign tools, and offline-resilient event infrastructure. We are looking for a Commercial Co-founder & Head of Growth (GTM) to lead our Go-To-Market across clubs, promoters, and independent labels in Europe, shape our pricing and business model, and drive angel/VC fundraising alongside our founder (KTH IndEk Computer Engineering & ML, CS at SU). What We Have Built So Far Core platform under active development in a clean TypeScript/Python monorepo (React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js/Express, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector, SQLite, Redis, BullMQ, MeiliSearch, Stripe Connect, Docker, Caddy). Live public website with interactive B2B/B2C product demos and waitlist at solpace.org. Supported by KTH Innovation in Stockholm, with ongoing outreach across Stockholm and European electronic music scenes. Track: Technical Co-founder — Systems, Audio AI & Live Infrastructure Profile : KTH Computer Science (Datateknik), Machine Learning (ML), Engineering Physics (TFYS), IndEk Data/ML, or an experienced fullstack/backend/ML builder in Stockholm. High-Concurrency Ticketing & Financial Integrity : Race-condition-free inventory locking under spike drops, BullMQ queues, idempotent webhooks, and Stripe Connect Smart Splits ledgers. Offline-Resilient Edge & Door Terminals : Local-first sync (React Native, SQLite) and rotating, scalper-proof cryptographic QR verification in zero-signal basement clubs, scaling toward mesh & satellite fallback. Audio AI, Custom RecSys, Lucy & LLM Fine-Tuning : Build our core AI & RecSys stack—fine-tuning open-weight LLMs and custom PyTorch, TensorFlow & scikit-learn models, evolving Lucy (our zero-privilege AI event concierge combining 0-token DSP heuristics with multimodal GenAI), scaling Python/FastAPI & serverless GPU pipelines for sonic/visual vector search and media processing, and training sequential, deep ranking, and graph recommendation models. Real-Time Community & Distribution : Clock-synced pre-release listening lounges, role-moderated event chat rooms, predictive demand pipelines, automated promo video rendering, and Meta Graph API / AI CRM workflows. Track: Co-founder — Product, Quant & Business Architecture Profile : KTH Industrial Engineering & Management (IndEk — Applied Math, Product Development, or CS), Engineering Physics (Teknisk Fysik), or Applied Mathematics. Predictive Demand & Margin Engines : Spatial Yield Forecasting, automated ad-spend Net Margin risk guards, and ticket-velocity estimation for promoters. Marketplace Incentives, Routing & Pricing : Constrained tour routing optimization, 100% face-value waitlist clearing, friend-price referral rewards, Smart Splits economics, and B2B pricing tiers — Python (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn), SQL, TypeScript. Product & Decision Tools : Translating complex data, closed-loop attribution (listening -> ticket -> door/bar revenue), and payment flows into intuitive tools for organisers, venues, labels, and artists. Track: Commercial Co-founder & Head of Growth (GTM) Profile : Stockholm School of Economics (SSE / Handels) or KTH Industrial Engineering & Management (IndEk), or an entrepreneurial B2B builder. Creator & Label Wedge : Onboard artists, DJs, and labels with 0% commission on music and DJ-set track sales, instant Smart Splits, fan-density tour routing, booking intelligence, and automated promo video & Meta/CRM tools. items.desc: Overview TensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure platform headquartered in Dublin. We run frontier open-weight large language models on our own NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in European datacentres, under EU jurisdiction. Customers reach them through a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing they send is retained after the request completes. We serve regulated enterprises in finance, healthcare and government as well as developers and AI platforms. We help them adopt AI without compromising on data privacy, compliance or performance. We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing team. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will build a reliable picture of how TensorX performs, from revenue and token usage through to GPU capacity and operating costs. You will define the core metrics the business runs on and explain what drives changes in revenue and usage so the management team can plan and invest with confidence. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role with real scope to grow both your technical and commercial skills. The Finance Director will set your priorities, and you will work closely with our technical and commercial teams every day. Our technical team will also help you learn our systems and review your GPU and infrastructure analysis. Much of your data will come from our databases and metrics systems (PostgreSQL, Prometheus and Grafana), and you will help establish the BI tools that the wider business needs. You will handle commercially sensitive usage and billing data in line with our information security controls and customer data commitments. This means token counts, request volumes and spend, but never the content that customers send. TensorX is a founder-backed, execution-led business where people take ownership and work across functions. We are an AI-native team. Tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our daily workflow and materially accelerate how we build and operate systems. We value curious people who ask good questions and move easily between technical detail and commercial context. Responsibilities KPIs & management reporting - Define and maintain the core KPIs with the management team and produce the monthly management reports, ensuring the numbers mean the same thing to everyone who uses them. Revenue & customer analysis - Analyse customer usage, signups, token consumption, pricing, revenue and profitability. Explain how changes in customer demand, model usage and token volumes affect revenue. Financial & operational analysis - Bring together financial, infrastructure and commercial data to show how the business performs. Build the analysis behind forecasts, financial plans and decisions on infrastructure investment and financing. Infrastructure costs & capacity - Analyse GPU capacity, utilisation, electricity costs (including European energy prices) and other operating costs. Feed the results into capacity planning and show where we can run more efficiently. GPU & inference performance - Analyse GPU utilisation, inference performance and workload efficiency. Track goodput per GPU, which is the number of requests each GPU answers inside the latency target. Run benchmarks with the GPU Performance Team's method and report how the results change over time. Work with engineers to investigate performance issues and measure the effect of each fix. Dashboards & automation - Help establish our BI tools and build reliable dashboards that act as a single source of truth for the business. Combine data from different systems and automate recurring analysis so that routine reports run without manual work. Business alerts - Build alerts on key business metrics, using the monitoring that our technical team already runs. Make sure we hear about a sudden change in revenue, usage or capacity before it becomes a problem. Investigation & problem solving - Take technical, operational and commercial questions from across the business and find the answers in the data. Explain what you find in plain terms and suggest practical improvements. What Success Looks Like Within your first 12 months you will have: Agreed the core KPIs with the management team and made your monthly report their trusted source of numbers Worked with the technical team to build one view of GPU utilisation and inference performance that the whole company uses Given the business clear evidence of what drives revenue and why usage growth and revenue growth can differ Made capacity, electricity and operating costs reliable inputs to capacity planning and the financial model Helped establish our BI tools, automated most recurring reporting and set up alerts on key business metrics Shared findings that led to a technical improvement, a commercial decision or a change to a planning assumption Skills & Experience 3+ years of experience in data analysis, technical analytics, business intelligence or a similar role The ability to work independently and own reporting from end to end Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills. You …

You will become part of our Infrastructure Development team, consisting of dedicated engineers and specialists working closely with software, hardware, and infrastructure. We value collaboration, innovation, and emotional safety, creating an environment where ideas can be challenged, shared, and developed together. We care about the work we do and the people behind it. Venue & Organiser Arsenal : Bring our active web app and interactive demos into venue meetings (Yield Forecasting, margin-guarded campaigns, rotating QR tickets, offline door scanner, cashless bar POS, Slutna sällskap compliance) and co-shape workflows with pilot partners. items.desc:
The SWE Developer Productivity organization builds the tools and libraries software engineers at Apple rely on to test their code. The SDP Testing Foundations team owns the Python libraries and services that connect tests to real and virtual devices at scale, powering both at-desk and CI workflows across nearly every Apple platform. We're building the infrastructure that lets us rapidly and reliably deploy hardware, and consolidating years of separate tooling into one coherent architecture on top of it. We're looking for a Python engineer who wants to help design that architecture and deliver it at scale across Apple.
Your goal is to accelerate how quickly new devices reach our testing infrastructure. You'll design a device abstraction that models the many kinds of devices and transports we support (physical hardware, remote devices, VMs) and the different ways tests connect to and drive them. This way, a test written once runs anywhere: an engineer can move their test from prototype hardware to a simulator to a VM without changing their test or worrying about the implementation details.
Building it is half the job; getting it adopted is the other half. You'll work with the engineering teams already on our existing tooling to move them onto the new architecture and retire the older, narrower libraries it replaces, with as little disruption to their day-to-day testing as possible. That means you're equally comfortable writing Python and talking through a migration plan with a team that depends on the libraries you're changing.
Proven experience in Software Development in Python
Experience designing or maintaining APIs/abstractions used by other engineering teams
Experience working within an established codebase — reading unfamiliar code, understanding its constraints, and changing it safely
Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable collaborating across time zones
Experience bringing up test or automation support for new hardware platforms
Experience leading a migration or deprecation of a widely-used system with minimal user impact
Experience with test automation, CI systems, or device fleet infrastructure
Familiarity with iOS and/or macOS platforms
Approachable and collaborative, interested in both teaching and learning from teammates

About the job

 Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.
 Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.

· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.
· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.
· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.
· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.
· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.

items.desc:
About the job 
 Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.
 As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.
 You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.
 This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.
 The team and culture 
 You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers.
 Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.
 Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.
 What we’re looking for 
 · Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers.
· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.
· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.
· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.
· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.
· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.
 While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.

items.desc:
Wer wir sind 
 Helsing ist ein KI-Unternehmen für Verteidigung. Unsere Mission ist der Schutz von Demokratien. Wir streben eine technologische Führungsrolle an, damit offene Gesellschaften weiterhin souveräne Entscheidungen treffen und ihre ethischen Standards kontrollieren können. 
 Wir glauben, dass wir als Demokratien eine besondere Verantwortung haben, über die Entwicklung und den Einsatz von leistungsstarken Technologien wie KI nachzudenken. Wir nehmen diese Verantwortung ernst. 
 Wir sind ein ehrgeiziges und engagiertes Team von Ingenieuren, KI-Spezialisten und Programmmanagern mit Kundenkontakt. Wir suchen engagierte Mitarbeiter für unsere europäischen Teams, die ihre Fähigkeiten einsetzen, um die komplexesten und bedeutendsten Probleme zu lösen. Wir pflegen eine offene und transparente Kultur, die gesunde Debatten über den Einsatz von Technologie in der Verteidigung, ihre Vorteile und ihre ethischen Implikationen begrüßt. 
 Die Rolle 
 Als Produktionsmitarbeiter (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine zentrale Funktion in der Fertigung unserer hochmodernen Verteidigungssysteme. Du bist verantwortlich für die präzise Montage komplexer Baugruppen für Flugkörper und Drohnen. Deine Arbeit gewährleistet, dass unsere Hardware höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards entspricht und im Einsatz zuverlässig funktioniert. Du arbeitest als Teil eines engagierten Teams an der physischen Umsetzung unserer Mission und trägst durch deine handwerkliche Sorgfalt direkt zur technologischen Leistungsfähigkeit unserer Produkte bei. 
 Dein Alltag 
 Du führst komplexe Montagearbeiten an Flugkörpern und Drohnen durch und stellst sicher, dass alle Komponenten exakt nach Vorgabe verbaut werden. 
 Du arbeitest routiniert nach technischen Zeichnungen, Arbeitsplänen und Stücklisten, um Fehler in der Fertigung proaktiv zu vermeiden. 
 Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Einhaltung unserer strengen Qualitätsprozesse und führst begleitende Qualitätskontrollen durch. 
 Du rotierst nach entsprechender Einarbeitung flexibel zwischen verschiedenen Aufgabenbereichen und Arbeitsstationen, um einen reibungslosen Produktionsfluss zu gewährleisten. 
 Du dokumentierst deine Arbeitsschritte sorgfältig, um die lückenlose Nachverfolgbarkeit unserer Produktion sicherzustellen. 
 Du solltest dich bewerben , wenn du folgendes mitbringst 
 Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z.B. als Industriemechaniker, Mechatroniker) oder mehrjährige Erfahrung in der industriellen Montage. 
 Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und bist sicher im Lesen von technischen Zeichnungen und Arbeitsplänen. 
 Du zeichnest dich durch eine präzise und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise aus, auch bei komplexen Aufgabenstellungen. 
 Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind ein zusätzlicher Vorteil. 
 Du bist bereit, im 2-Schicht-System zu arbeiten und dich in neue Fertigungsprozesse einzuarbeiten. 
 Hinweis: Wir arbeiten an einer Schnittstelle, an der Frauen sowie andere Minderheitengruppen systematisch unterrepräsentiert sind. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn Du nicht alle aufgelisteten Qualifikationen erfüllen kannst; Fähigkeiten und Einfluss können nicht in wenigen Aufzählungspunkten zusammengefasst werden. 
 Komm zu Helsing 
 Deine Arbeit bei Helsing zählt. Du leistest einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit demokratischer Länder und trägst dazu bei, dass hohe ethische Standards eingehalten werden. 
 Unsere Produkte erfüllen höchste Anforderungen an Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit. Deshalb ist sorgfältiges, verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten bei uns besonders wichtig. 
 Helsing ist Teil einer zukunftsorientierten Branche, die sich dynamisch weiterentwickelt. Wir wachsen schnell und wurden bereits für mehrere bedeutende Aufträge ausgewählt. 
 Bei uns zählt jede Meinung: Wir fördern eine offene, respektvolle Arbeitskultur und setzen auf eigenverantwortliches Handeln, Teamgeist und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. 
 Was wir bieten 
 Start: Startdatum der Tätigkeit im Februar, März oder April 2027 möglich (Assessment Center finden im Januar 2027 statt) 
 Eine attraktive Vergütung und betriebliche Altersvorsorge
 Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
 Gesundheit: Zuschüsse zu Sportangeboten
 Empfehlungsprämien für erfolgreiche Einstellungen
 Helsing ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir setzen uns für gleiche Beschäftigungschancen ein, unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand, Behinderung oder Geschlechtsidentität. Bitte übermittle keine personenbezogenen Daten zu ethnischer oder rassischer Herkunft, politischen Ansichten, religiösen oder weltanschaulichen Überzeugungen, Gewerkschaftszugehörigkeit, Gesundheit oder sexueller Orientierung. 
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here .

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a SIP Expert to own the telephony layer that connects ElevenAgents voice agents to the phone network. SIP traffic is moving from early adoption to large enterprise call volumes, so the hard problems are now reliability and latency at scale.

Your general responsibilities will include:

 - Owning SIP end to end, from design doc to implementation, testing and ongoing operation, for a product used by enterprises at scale.

 - Making call flows such as warm transfers dependable, and simplifying how our call services communicate with each other.

 - Diagnosing and fixing load-related failures such as resource exhaustion and dropped connections.

 - Collaborating with support, infrastructure and other teams to turn customer needs into shipped features.

Specific responsibilities might include:

 - Making our SIP edge and routing layer production-ready for large enterprise traffic.

 - Designing and shipping lightweight, lower-latency call-handling services.

 - Supporting carrier and SIP trunk integrations for enterprise customers.

You will join a small team of five, reporting directly to the team lead, with a high degree of ownership and very little bureaucracy.




REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or open source contributions.

We do require:

 - Experience building and operating large-scale SIP/VoIP systems in production, including debugging load-related failures such as port exhaustion, dropped connections and state shared across services

 - Hands-on experience running LiveKit (or comparable real-time media infrastructure) at scale, with comfort in WebSockets, WebRTC and RTP

 - Strong backend engineering in Go or a comparable systems language, and a record of owning projects from design document through launch and maintenance

 - Based in Europe or a nearby time zone, with at least 2 to 3 hours of daily overlap with CET

Bonus: Hands-on experience with Kamailio (or OpenSIPS/FreeSWITCH), or carrier and SIP trunk interconnects.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or nearby time zones, with the ability to operate in GMT to …

Within the HSE Unit, we have the QARE Service. Quality and Aging Research for Cable (QARE) service is a quality control service for cables and a research program on cable ageing assessment at CERN accelerators. The activity involves the development of the most appropriate cable testing techniques to perform quality control on cables procured for CERN, and establish aging requirements on cables operating in the CERN accelerators environment.
 QARE service ensures quality control and conducts Site Acceptance Tests. In addition, the QARE team develops and performs mechanical and chemical tests for the ageing and radiation-hardness qualification of cables. You will carry out mechanical and chemical testing, manage cable samples throughout irradiation and laboratory testing campaigns, and prepare reports from the obtained results.
 Your responsibilities 
 Develop mechanical and chemical test procedures.
 Test and qualify cables against CERN requirements.
 Analyse mechanical and chemical results.
 Define representative samples and exposure locations.
 Organise and monitor irradiation campaigns.
 Follow-up measurement accuracy.
 Install, track, retrieve and manage cable samples.
 Document results and support quality-control activities.

 Experience in polymer or cable-material characterisation.
 Knowledge of mechanical, chemical and thermal testing.
 Understanding of material ageing and radiation effects.
 Experience with laboratory testing and data analysis.
 Familiarity with calibration, traceability and quality control.
 Ability to write test procedures and technical reports.
 Irradiation testing or dosimetry experience is an advantage.
 Skills 
 Excellent knowledge of materials characterisation.
 Good knowledge of polymer and cable material characterisation.
 Tensile, elongation, and hardness testing.
 FTIR spectroscopy, DSC, and TGA.
 Material ageing and radiation degradation.
 Quality control and qualification process.
 Writing procedures and test reports.
 Python and Microsoft Excel for data analysis.
 Laboratory data-acquisition software.
 Some experience in chemical or mechanical laboratories.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Materials Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .

 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
 Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 About the job 
 We need someone who is equally comfortable writing C and JavaScript. The Bare team builds and maintains the runtime itself along with a growing ecosystem of native modules (bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto, and many more). You would be writing native addons that bridge platform APIs into JavaScript, debugging across multiple operating systems, and helping keep the runtime small and correct. 
 This is a hands-on systems role. You will work independently, own modules end to end, and ship code that runs on phones, laptops, servers, and constrained devices. 
 Native module development 
 Design, implement, and ship bare-* native modules (e.g., bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto) end to end, including code, and tests 
 Write C native addons that bridge platform APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem, crypto) into JavaScript 
 Maintain and extend existing native modules based on product team requests and the bare-node compatibility list 
 Cross-platform builds and CI 
 Set up and maintain cross-platform builds for macOS, Linux, Android (NDK), and iOS (Xcode)

items.desc:
Huawei Heisenberg Research Center (Munich) is responsible for advanced technology research, architectural development, design and strategic engineering of our products.
 Huawei Ohm Research Center (Nuremberg) is responsible for Advanced Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning. 
 Huawei Digital Power is a business unit within Huawei that provides Enterprise & Industry customers, products and solutions like clean power generation, transportation electrification, site power facilities, data center facilities, and embedded power. Huawei Digital Power is committed to integrate Digital and Power Electronics technologies to provide customers with high-quality, energy-efficient, green, and low-carbon power electronics products, facilitating their business success 
 The Power Conversion Technology Laboratory within Huawei’s Ohms Research Center in Nuremberg is responsible for Advanced Digital Power Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning, and plays an important role in the Huawei Digital Power business in the design and development of power converters and control systems for applications such as PV Solar & Battery Energy Storage Field, Data Centers, Electric Vehicle, and Embedded Power Supply. 
 Join us as an: 
 Expert - Medium Voltage Power Conversion Systems (m/f/d) 
 to contribute to the development of our Huawei Power Conversion Technology Laboratory, which plays an important role in designs and develops power converters and control systems for applications such as Photo Voltaic (PV), Data Center and Critical Power (DCCP), Electric Vehicle (EV), Board Mounted Power Supply (BMP) power ranges from several Watts to Mega Watts, and the most challenging things are high efficiency high density, cost effective and low static power consumption. 
 Your mission 
 You will be the technical authority in formulating requirements for R&D activities for Medium Voltage Power Conversion Systems 
 You will lead and execute the research and development of novel next generation MV architectures and converter structures for high power Solar PV, BESS, Data Center and EV charging applications 
 You will take ownership of the design, subsequent verification and validation of MV converter concepts in the R&D laboratories 
 You will closely collaborate with external R&D Institutes and Universities in developing novel converter and control algorithms for MV power electronic applications relevant to Huawei Digital Power 
 You will generate novel ideas and protect them with IPR fillings 
 You will lead and mentor cross discipline R&D Engineers 
 Your areas of expertise : 
 You hold a PhD or Master's degree in the field of power electronics, electrical and electronic engineering or in a similar engineering discipline 
 You shall possess several years of proven experience in Medium Voltage, high power electronics and system experience in product design or prototype development in an industrial context 
 You have a deep expertise in MV power electronic converter topologies, modulation, control and algorithm development, more focusing on system and Megawatt level power hardware design 
 You have a good working knowledge of MV standards and practical insulation coordination experience is desirable 
 You have a proven experience with new technology development initiatives, innovation and technical leadership 
 High level of self-reliance and an autonomous target-oriented work style, “can do” attitude, eager to learn new things and ready to think outside the box 
 You may have occasional travel related to ongoing projects, seminars, conferences etc. 
 You are fluent in written and spoken English, willing to learn German or additional languages are a plus 
 By applying to this position, you agree with our Recruitment Privacy Statement. You can read in full our privacy policy here .
 Your rewards of working here 
 Our culture is characterized by innovative power and team spirit as well as the intensive exchange of knowledge and experience within our global network.
 To keep your development ongoing, you will find a broad range of training opportunities. Many online and face-to-face training programs incl. language courses in German and Mandarin.
 Our diverse and welcoming environment is shaped by different backgrounds and around 40 individual nationalities.
 Self-responsible work in a competent, motivated and constantly growing team.
 Please send your application and CV (incl. cover letter and reference letters) in English.
 Huawei is a leading global information and communications technology (ICT) solutions provider. Our ICT solutions, products and services are used in more than 170 countries and regions, serving over one-third of the world's population. With 208,000 employees, Huawei is committed to develop the future information society and build a Better Connected World.

items.desc:
Nekünk a mobilitás jövője. Neked a szakmád csúcsa. 
 A BMW csoportnál minden az elhivatottsággal kezdődik, amely képes egy szakmát hivatássá változtatni. Elhivatottságunk késztet bennünket arra, hogy folyamatosan újra értelmezzük a mobilitást, és innovatív ötleteket vigyünk az utakra. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés alakít egy csapatot erős egységgé, ahol minden ötletet és véleményt értékelünk. Csak ha a szakértelem, a professzionális folyamatok és a munka élvezete egyesül, akkor alakíthatjuk együtt a jövőt. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan elhivatottak, mint mi. A szakértelmed, a készségeid, a motivációd és az egyéniséged visznek minket előre. Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen logisztikai konténer menedzsment specialistája , kulcsfontosságú szerepet töltesz be abban, hogy forradalmasítsuk azt, ahogyan az autózásról gondolkodunk. 
 Mi vár rád?
 Munkakörnyezet – A BMW Group Gyár Debrecen területén elhelyezkedő Kommunikációs Központban, korszerű, digitalizált, „open office” jellegű munkakörnyezetben fogsz dolgozni a többi irodai munkavállalóval és közvetlen csapattársaiddal együtt. A Kommunikációs Központ teakonyhákkal, kávézókkal, ergonomikus munkaállomásokkal felszerelt modern iroda, ahol egy vállalati étkezde is helyet kap. 
 Csapat – konténer menedzsment csapatunk tagjaként nemzetközi környezetben dolgozol. Helyben egy kb. 3 fős csapathoz csatlakozol, miközben szoros kapcsolatban vagy a debreceni gyár logisztikai részlegével. 
 Nemzetközi együttműködés – egy nemzetközi csapat tagja leszel, ahol más BMW Group szervezeti egységekkel is szorosan együtt dolgozol. 
 Beszállítói ügyek kezelése – a beszállítói újrahasználható csomagoló anyagokkal kapcsolatos kérdéseket és problémákat kezeled, hogy az anyagellátás zavartalanul működjön. 
 Konténeres számlák menedzselése – egy meghatározott beszállítói kör csomagoló anyagokkal kapcsolatos számláit intézed, illetve rendszeres havi egyeztetéseket tartasz. 
 Eltérések elemzése – azonosítod a nyilvántartási vagy könyvelési eltérések okait, majd a partnerekkel együttműködve hosszútávú megoldásokat dolgozol ki. 
 Éves konténerleltár koordinálása – megszervezed és koordinálod az éves leltárt az illetékes partnerekkel közösen. 
 Folyamatok fejlesztése – részt veszel a csomagoló anyagok kezelésének fejlesztésében és optimalizálásában, például a leltár vagy a pool management területén. 
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Végzettség – gazdasági, üzleti informatikai vagy hasonló területen szerzett diplomával rendelkezel, vagy több éves logisztikai tapasztalatod van. 
 Szakmai tapasztalat – átlátod az ellátási lánc folyamatait és értelmezni tudod azok egymásra gyakorolt hatását. 
 Informatikai ismeretek – magabiztosan használod az MS Office programokat, különösen az Excelt. 
 Analitikus gondolkodásmód – magabiztosan elemzed az adatokat és folyamatokat, valamint a problémák okainak feltárását. 
 Kommunikáció és csapatmunka – jól tudsz együttműködni különböző területekkel és partnerekkel. 
 Munkastílus – strukturáltan, önállóan és felelősségteljesen végzed a feladataidat. 
 Nyelvtudás és jogosítvány – magabiztos angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel, a magyar és német nyelv előnyt jelent, valamint rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal. 
 Mit kínálunk?
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll:
 Bérfejlesztés – évente, teljesítményértékelés alapján . 
 Bónusz – vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónuszok. 
 Cafeteria – éves cafeteria-keretösszeg havi folyósítással. 
 Támogatott munkába járás – ingyenes, a műszakbeosztáshoz igazított, közvetlen busz- és vasútjáratok a régió nagyvárosaiból. Gépkocsi használat esetén a törvényben előírt mértékű költségtérítés. 
 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások – magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészségközpontban. 
 Magán egészségbiztosítás – próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást. 
 Baleset és életbiztosítás – munkaidőben és azon kívül is bekövetkező eseményekre csoportos baleset és életbiztosítás. 
 Kedvezményes étkezés – napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében. 
 Munkavállalói autóbérlési program. 
 Tudj meg többet juttatásainkról ezen a linken : https://www.bmwgroup.jobs/hu/hu/about-us/our-benefits.html.

items.card: You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on developing machine learning and AI solutions to predict and optimize energy consumption in residential heating systems. You will work across the full AI lifecycle, from data collection and feature engineering to model development, validation, and deployment. You will also explore Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI Agents to develop
items.desc:
Your contribution to something big: 
 You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on developing machine learning and AI solutions to predict and optimize energy consumption in residential heating systems. You will work across the full AI lifecycle, from data collection and feature engineering to model development, validation, and deployment. You will also explore Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI Agents to develop intelligent applications and automate engineering workflows, collaborating closely with R&D, thermal simulation, controls, and software teams. Your main responsibilities will be: 
 Machine Learning Development: Design, develop, and validate machine learning models to predict residential heating system energy consumption, including hourly consumption, peak loads, and longer-term energy demand. 
 Data Engineering & Feature Development: Work with sensor data, weather information, building characteristics, occupancy data, and other relevant sources to prepare datasets and develop meaningful features. 
 Data Quality & Analysis: Clean and analyse complex sensor and IoT datasets, identifying missing or inconsistent data and addressing seasonal effects and changes in operating conditions. 
 Modeling & Forecasting: Develop and compare different approaches, including regression, time-series forecasting, gradient boosting, neural networks, physics-informed models, and hybrid solutions. 
 Generative AI & AI Agents: Explore and develop AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents to support data analysis, knowledge extraction, intelligent automation, and engineering workflows. 
 Model Validation & Optimization: Evaluate and continuously improve ML and AI solutions through experimentation, error analysis, performance evaluation, and robustness testing. 
 ML/AI Deployment & Monitoring: Support the integration of ML and AI solutions into production environments, contributing to monitoring, model performance evaluation, and continuous improvement. 
 Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with thermal modelling, HVAC, controls, and software engineers to translate complex engineering challenges into data science and AI solutions. 
 Technical Guidance & Documentation: Support junior team members and document modelling approaches, AI architectures, results, assumptions, and technical trade-offs.
What distinguishes you: 
 Experience: Around 3 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. 
 Machine Learning: Good knowledge of machine learning, statistical methods, and predictive modelling, including regression, classification, and time-series forecasting. 
 Generative AI & LLMs: Knowledge or practical experience with LLMs, Generative AI applications, prompt engineering, and RAG. 
 AI Agents : Understanding AI agent architectures and the integration of LLMs with external tools, APIs, and data sources is a plus. 
 Programming: Strong Python skills and experience with tools such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or AI development frameworks. 
 Data Analysis: Experience working with complex datasets, including data cleaning, feature engineering, and analysis. Experience with sensor or IoT data is a plus. 
 ML/AI Deployment: Understanding of model deployment, monitoring, and MLOps/LLMOps concepts. 
 Technical Knowledge: Experience with time-series forecasting, physics-informed ML, HVAC/thermal systems, or IoT applications is considered an advantage. 
 Problem Solving & Collaboration: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, good communication skills, and ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering and software teams. 
 Working Style: Proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of assigned activities and supporting junior team members.

items.desc:
Main Responsibilities
 Responsible for planning, coordination, execution, evaluation, and documentation of validation activities for eAxle systems, subsystems, and components.
 Analyze product and system requirements and derive appropriate validation activities and test specifications.
 Define and maintain the validation scope and validation plan throughout the development project.
 Plan and coordinate functional, performance, environmental, durability, and reliability testing.
 Coordinate test execution with internal test benches, laboratories, external partners, and suppliers.
 Ensure required test samples, hardware/software configurations, measurement equipment, and test conditions are available.
 Evaluate measurement data and validation results against defined requirements and acceptance criteria.
 Identify deviations, failure modes, and technical risks and initiate appropriate problem-solving activities.
 Support root-cause analysis of eAxle system, transmission, hardware, software, and component-related failures.
 Prepare validation reports and ensure traceability between requirements, test specifications, test results, and conclusions.
 Support SAR, risk assessment, and product release activities with appropriate validation evidence.
 Monitor validation timing, costs, laboratory capacity, and project milestones.
 Communicate validation status, open points, risks, and recommendations to project stakeholders.
 Cooperate closely with system, mechanical, transmission, electrical/electronic, software, test-bench, laboratory, quality, and project-management functions.
 Contribute to continuous improvement of validation methods, test procedures, standards, and lessons learned.
Requirements
 BSc/MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable technical field.
 Experience in automotive product development, testing, or validation.
 Good understanding of validation and verification processes, including DV/PV activities.
 Understanding of electric drivetrain/eAxle systems and their mechanical, electrical, software, and system interfaces.
 Knowledge of functional, environmental, durability, and reliability testing.
 Experience with measurement-data evaluation and engineering analysis tools.
 Knowledge of structured problem-solving and quality methods such as FMEA, DRBFM, and 8D is an advantage.
 Ability to independently plan, coordinate, evaluate, and document validation activities.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams.
 Good command of English.
 Preferred Experience
 Experience in eAxle, transmission, electric drivetrain, or powertrain validation.
 Experience with test-bench and laboratory testing.
 Experience with tools such as FAMOS, MDA, and EVA, or comparable measurement-data analysis tools.
 Knowledge of automotive development and release processes.
 Experience with requirements-based validation and requirements traceability.
 Understanding of product safety and functional-safety-related validation interfaces.

 Descripción del área : 
 El área de Riesgos y Seguros del Grupo Telefónica es la unidad responsable de la financiación de riesgos asegurables del Grupo y del apoyo a las Operadoras en la comercialización de productos de seguro para sus clientes y empleados. El área gestiona una compañía de seguros No Vida (TELEFONICA SEGUROS), una cautiva de reaseguro (NOVA CASIOPEA RE) y un Grupo Corredurías (TELEFONICA CORREDURIA DE SEGUROS), a través de las cuales implementa su estrategia y política.
 Misión : 
 Proyecto formativo basado en los conocimientos adquiridos durante el grado/máster y su aplicación práctica en el Departamento de Inversiones del Área de Seguros. Desarrollar habilidades en la gestión de una cartera de inversiones, valoración y control de los activos. Fomentar la generación de ideas y la visión de la persona candidata, así como la comunicación con el resto de departamentos de la compañía y las relaciones con proveedores y otras entidades financieras.
 ¿Como sera tu dia a dia? 
 Participar en el cálculo del VaR y, en general, en la gestión del riesgo de las inversiones.
 Ayudar en el control y organización de la documentación soporte de las operaciones.
 Participar en el análisis de las operaciones realizadas y comprobación de los datos financieros.
 Dar apoyo en el control de cumplimiento de las políticas internas de la compañía.
 Colaborar en el análisis y valoración de nuevas inversiones.
 Participar en la elaboración de reportes internos de seguimiento y estado de las inversiones. 
 Cooperar en las tareas de control general sobre la cartera (periodificaciones, gastos, dividendos...).
 Apoyar en las tareas de reporting mensual y trimestral tanto internas (Telefónica) como externas (reguladores, auditores...).
 Participar en los cierres mensuales.

 Grado en ADE/Ciencias Economicas o Actuariales y Financieras o similar.

 Conocimientos financieros, estadísticos y contables.
 Conocimientos de los principales activos financieros (bonos, pagarés, acciones…)

 Jornada de 25 horas semanales.
 Ayuda al estudio.
 Beca con duración minima de 6 meses y máxima de 12 meses.
 Modelo híbrido.
 Trabajar en un equipo dinámico con proyectos retadores.

items.desc:
TELEFÓNICA EDUCACIÓN DIGITAL, S.L.U. ofrece soluciones integrales de aprendizaje para la Educación y Formación, con más de 20 años de experiencia en el mercado nacional e internacional. Desarrolla procesos de aprendizaje de alto impacto en personas y organizaciones. 
 En un mundo cada vez más incierto, uno de los mayores regalos que se le puede hacer a una persona es su formación. La formación es uno de los activos más valiosos que se pueden ofrecer para el futuro: amplía opciones, genera confianza y permite afrontar los cambios con mayor seguridad. En este sentido, el propósito de Telefónica Educación Digital es claro y profundamente relevante: ofrecer este regalo a cada uno de nuestros usuarios. Pocos propósitos tienen un valor mayor o un impacto más duradero que ayudar a las personas a construir su futuro. 
 Puesto: Responsable de Seguridad de la Información - Talent Pool 
 Vacante no activa. Cuando estemos en búsqueda activa, valoraremos las candidaturas. 
 Nuestro reto actual es adaptarnos a los requerimientos normativos de seguridad y reforzar la protección de nuestras plataformas educativas y servicios en la nube. Buscamos un/a Responsable de Seguridad de Sistemas de Información con ganas de asumir un rol clave, crecer con nosotros y ayudarnos a consolidar una cultura de seguridad sólida y eficaz.
 Funciones 
 Liderar la implantación y mantenimiento del ENS y la ISO 27001 en la compañía.
 Diseñar y supervisar los controles de seguridad: accesos, cifrado y continuidad de negocio.
 Gestionar alertas e incidentes de seguridad, proponiendo soluciones ágiles y efectivas, incluyendo la participación en guardias pasivas para atender incidencias críticas en caso de caídas de servidores u otros eventos relevantes.
 Revisar y coordinar medidas de seguridad en servidores Linux, Windows y en plataformas cloud: AWS, Azure o similares.
 Colaborar en la configuración y supervisión del WAF —Web Application Firewall— y controles perimetrales.
 Elaborar políticas, procedimientos y documentación de seguridad.
 Gestionar las herramientas de monitorización y desarrollar automatismos y reglas para garantizar la seguridad de nuestros entornos.
 Impulsar la concienciación en ciberseguridad entre empleados y trabajar en conjunto con el equipo de seguridad de Telefónica de España.
 Asistir a los subcomités de ciberseguridad con el resto de las empresas del grupo Telefónica y hacer seguimiento de las tareas.
 Conocimientos técnicos e informáticos 
 2–4 años de experiencia en seguridad informática y/o compliance tecnológico.
 Conocimientos en:
 ENS e ISO 27001.
 Administración de infraestructuras, especialmente servidores Linux.
 Redes, firewalls, VPN, IDS/IPS.
 Principios de seguridad en cloud. AWS se valorará muy positivamente.
 WAF y medidas de seguridad en aplicaciones web.
 Conceptos y herramientas DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD y automatización de despliegues.
 Será un plus si tienes certificaciones relacionadas con la ciberseguridad, como ISO 27001, CompTIA Security+, CEH, CCNA Security o LPIC.
 Competencias 
 Actitud proactiva.
 Capacidad de análisis.
 Pasión por la ciberseguridad.
 Ventajas de formar parte de nuestro equipo 
 Modelo híbrido de trabajo: Cuidamos la flexibilidad, posicionándonos como referente en nuevas formas de trabajo, horarios, jornadas y medidas de conciliación. 
 22 días de vacaciones + 4 días TED. 
 Disponibilidad de activar el plan de pensiones con las correspondientes aportaciones del participe y de la empresa. 
 Seguro de vida y seguro médico privado (100% a cargo de la empresa). 
 Cheque TED de 11€/día 
 Contarás con descuentos exclusivos por ser empleado de Telefónica en diferentes productos y servicios. 
 Acceso gratuito a formación de idiomas (Inglés, Alemán y Portugués) así como a diversos cursos de la plataforma E-learning. 
 Gimnasio gratuito en nuestras instalaciones (Distrito Telefónica). 
 A la hora de rellenar el formulario, no es necesario completarlo todo, solo los campos obligatorios. Sí necesitamos tu CV y contestación a las preguntas planteadas. ¡Gracias!
 ¿POR QUÉ TELEFÓNICA? 
 El futuro de Telefónica está en tus manos. 
 Trabajar en Telefónica es ser parte de una empresa centenaria que aspira a ser una operadora europea de referencia mundial. Una compañía con un propósito claro: ser la mejor vía de acceso de ciudadanos, empresas e instituciones a las tecnologías digitales que están transformando el mundo. 
 Un reto que requiere de los mejores profesionales, de las mejores personas. 
 Nuestra forma de trabajar se basa en tres actitudes que nos definen: 
 Damos lo mejor de nosotros mismos . Creemos en el poder de la simplicidad y en centrarnos en lo que realmente genera impacto. Generamos confianza cuando entendemos al cliente y entregamos lo que marca la diferencia. La excelencia es nuestro estándar para lograr impacto hoy y a largo plazo. 
 Cuestionamos nuestros propios límites . Innovamos y somos transformadores cuando asumimos riesgos inteligentes. Promovemos el debate …

 Telefónica España

 .

 ¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS? 
 Personas con muchas ganas de darlo todo y marcar la diferencia. Apasionadas de la innovación y las tecnologías punteras. 
 Con esta oportunidad podrás adentrarte en el apasionante universo tecnológico y ser parte del cambio: un mundo más conectado, más humano, y lleno de historias que transforman vidas. 
 Recuerda adjuntar tu CV actualizado en formato PDF. 
 QUEREMOS GENTE COMO TÚ... 
 Que le atraigan los retos en ventas de grandes clientes, con conocimientos de las principales tecnologías que aplican a la cadena de valor del segmento y a los procesos de fabricación. Que le atraigan los retos con gran talento comercial y demostrada experiencia en negociaciones de alto impacto. Con orientación a hacer crecer el negocio de nuestros grandes clientes impulsando su transformación digital dentro del ámbito TIC. 
 QUE RETOS ENFRENTARÁS EN EL DÍA A DÍA: 
 Liderarás el End to End, de la propuesta de valor de Telefónica, con conocimiento de los partners más relevantes, además de la venta en una cartera de clientes, desde la identificación de la oportunidad hasta la firma de acuerdo, coordinando a todas las áreas responsables dentro del proceso de venta, representando a la compañía y defendiendo oportunidades de negocio en foro de alta dirección. Liderarás y coordinarás equipos de alto rendimiento, optimizando modelos de trabajo y buscando continuamente la eficacia en su implantación. 
 Formarás parte de un equipo de comerciales de alto valor y serás clave en negociaciones de alto impacto, colaborando en el diseño de la estrategia para el desarrollo de negocio y elaborando propuestas personalizadas, manejando datos técnicos y presupuestarios. Tendrás una visión completa del negocio, de la competencia, y te convertirás en un profesional de alto valor y alto impacto para nuestra compañía 
 Accederás a un amplio programa formativo para conocer en profundidad el portfolio de productos para el área de Empresas, y ayudarte a desarrollar las habilidades de venta consultiva y metodología comercial. Con grandes posibilidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional. 
 Entrarás a formar parte de la Carrera Comercial, con posibilidades de evolución profesional y salarial. 
 ¿TE IDENTIFICAS? ¡ES EL MOMENTO DE DAR EL SALTO! 
FORMACIÓN VALORADA: 
 Grado en Informática, Telecomunicaciones, ADE o similares. 
 Recomendado: Inglés B2 
 CONOCIMIENTOS Y HABILIDADES QUE SUMAN: 
 Se valorarán los siguientes conocimientos: 
 Perfil comercial consultivo, especializado en el análisis y construcción de soluciones adaptadas a las necesidades de clientes, identificando aquellos productos y servicios digitales del portfolio de Telefónica que mejor se adecúen en cada caso. 
 Conocimientos de finanzas para elaborar business cases y entender el TCO asociado a propuestas de soluciones digitales. 
 Recomendable dominio de Excel. 
 Se valorarán los siguientes conocimientos específicos de la línea de servicios de Ciberseguridad: 
 Conocimientos de seguridad de sistemas y redes de comunicaciones. 
 Certificaciones y/o conocimientos para el desarrollo de soluciones de red y seguridad con tecnologías como Palo Alto, Check Point, Forcepoint, CrowdStrike, Fortinet, Aruba o Radware. 
 Conocimientos para posicionar desde la venta consultiva soluciones de Firewalling, Proxy, Filtrado de Contenidos, WAF, IPS, IDS y DLP. 
 Conocimientos sobre antivirus, malware, adware, spyware y riskware. 
 Seguridad de sistemas operativos Windows Server, Linux y Unix. 
 Correlación de eventos. 
 EXPERIENCIA DESEADA: 
 Se valorará la siguiente experiencia: 
 Haber desarrollado la venta o la implantación de sistemas de gestión de continuidad de negocio. Implantación de sistemas de gestión de la seguridad de la información (SGSI) Elaboración e implantación de Planes Directores de Seguridad. Detección y Respuesta a incidentes de seguridad. 
 Experiencia en la interacción con diferentes proveedores del mundo de la ciberseguridad, tanto hardware como software, así como los nuevos players del sector. 
 Experiencia de 5 años o más en áreas Comerciales, Marketing, Desarrollo de Negocio, y/o en áreas de responsabilidad de ciberseguridad 
 Experiencia demostrada en trabajos con equipos multidisciplinares, diversos e inclusivos. 
 Telefónica define una cultura de alto impacto y un modelo común de liderazgo que nos permite convertir la estrategia en acción, basado en tres actitudes clave : 
 Dar lo mejor de nosotros. 
 Cuestionar nuestros límites. 
 Crecer juntos. 
 Y en seis capacidades que marcan la diferencia en el día a día: 
 Foco en el cliente. 
 Excelencia en la ejecución. 
 Innovación digital. 
 Claridad y valentía. 
 Impulso de la responsabilidad.

items.desc:
Especialista en Estrategia Corporativa 
 Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro. 
 ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué hace posible que millones de personas estén conectadas al mismo tiempo, desde cualquier lugar del mundo, sin que nada falle? En Telefónica, lo hacemos posible. 
 Somos una compañía global de telecomunicaciones y tecnología que conecta a personas, empresas y comunidades a través de redes de nueva generación y soluciones digitales avanzadas como cloud, inteligencia artificial, IoT y ciberseguridad. 
 Con una historia de más de 100 años, trabajamos cada día para que la innovación esté al servicio de la sociedad, impulsando una transformación digital responsable, sostenible y con impacto real. 
 Aquí no solo diseñamos infraestructuras: diseñamos el futuro. Buscamos personas curiosas, entusiastas y apasionadas por lo que hacen, que no se conforman y que quieren ayudar a crear la Telefónica del mañana. 
 Si te apasiona la tecnología que transforma vidas, este es tu sitio. 
 ¿Cuál será tu misión? 🎯 
 Formarás parte del Departamento de Estrategia Corporativa , participando en proyectos clave para la definición y ejecución de la estrategia del Grupo. 
 Tu misión será apoyar en el análisis, diseño y desarrollo de iniciativas estratégicas de alto impacto, contribuyendo a la toma de decisiones de la alta dirección. 
 Trabajarás en un entorno dinámico y transversal, colaborando con equipos globales y locales en operaciones corporativas (M&A), proyectos de transformación, desarrollo de nuevos negocios y análisis de tendencias de mercado. Asimismo, contribuirás a la elaboración de planes estratégicos, identificación de oportunidades de crecimiento y generación de valor para la compañía. 
 ¿Qué buscamos en ti? 🔎 
 Grado universitario en área STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering o Mathematics – e.g. Ingeniería enTelecomunicaciones, Industrial) o Grado en Administración de Empresas/Economía 
 Mas de 2 años de experiencia laboral, preferiblemente en Consultoría Estratégica o de negocio en Big Four o área de estrategia de un corporate 
 Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint 
 Domingo de Inglés (alto-bilingüe). 
 Alta capacidad analítica y atención al detalle. 
 Habilidades de comunicación y síntesis, orientadas a distintos niveles, incluida la alta dirección. 
 Proactividad, responsabilidad y adaptación a entornos exigentes.

items.desc:
Var gör människor det de älskar att göra, och får göra det som de gör bäst? 
 På Swisslog såklart! Våra medarbetare är hjärtat i ett världsledande robotföretag som använder teknologins kraft för att forma framtidens intralogistik. Resultatet? Vi omvandlar prestanda och effektivitet hos våra kunder runt hela jorden och ger dem den avgörande fördelen på deras marknader.
 Gör skillnad 
 Bakgrund: 
 Ett conveyorsystem består av många olika maskiner. De vanligast förekommande är de raka banorna, som antingen har rullar eller kedjor som framdrift. Dessa finns i olika längder – för att passa kundens installation. Varje bansida har ett eget artikelnummer och passar bara banelement som har just den längden. Detta gör att det finns ett stort antal olika bansidor och att man måste beställa hem bansidor i rätta längder och antal till varje unik kundorder. Då dessa idag dessutom tillverkas i Kina så är det lång ledtid på materialet och eventuella ändringar kan innebära att nya bansidor måste beställas hem.
 Vad du tar med dig för att lyckas 
 Problemställning: 
 Ta fram ett förslag på en lösning som minimerar problemet med långa ledtider, till billigare eller samma totalkostnad.
 Analysen innefattar att titta på alternativa konstruktionslösningar (t ex för att minimera antalet artikelnummer eller för att anpassa till annan tillverkningsmetod), produktionsteknisk lösning och en kostnadsanalys.

items.desc:
Mitarbeiter:in Bilddigitalisierung (m/w/d) 
 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Mitarbeiter:in Bilddigitalisierung (m/w/d)
 50%-60%, Zürich, unbefristet 
 print 
 Drucken 
 Die ETH-Bibliothek fördert Wissen, unterstützt Forschung und Lehre und macht als vertrauenswürdige Institution die Welt von gestern, heute und morgen besser begreifbar. Für die Gruppe DigiCenter suchen wir per 1. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine:n Mitarbeiter:in im Bereich Bild-digitalisierung.
 Stellenbeschreibung
 Das DigiCenter der ETH-Bibliothek ist verantwortlich für die Retrodigitalisierung von Beständen der ETH-Bibliothek und der ETH. Als Mitarbeiter:in Bilddigitalisierung nimmst du folgende Aufgaben wahr:
 Reproduktion von Bildmaterial (z. B. Negative, Aufsichtvorlagen, Dias) an Kamera-Installationen
 Durchführen von Qualitätskontrollen nach vorgegebenen Parametern
 Prüfen von Standards und optimieren von Prozessen bei Aufträgen und Projekten in Rücksprache mit den Verantwortlichen
 Unterstützung bei der Betreuung von studentischen Aushilfen an den Kameras
 Profil
 Ausbildung als Fotograf:in und fundiertes technisches Fachwissen in diesem Bereich
 Erfahrung mit Photoshop und Capture One
 Kenntnisse in der Reprofotografie
 Gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
 Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Geschick in der vorausschauenden Planung der Aufgaben
 Grosses Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie eine hohe Konzentrationsfähigkeit und Ausdauer, auch bei gleichförmigen Aufgaben
 Arbeitsort
 Arbeitsort
 Wir bieten
 Mitarbeit in einem engagierten und kollegialen Team
 Einen attraktiven Arbeitsplatz an der ETH Zürich im Zentrum von Zürich
 Kulturelle Vielfalt sowie zahlreiche Vergünstigungen , wie z.B. ÖV-Abonnemente und Car Sharing, ein breites Sportangebot des ASVZ , Kinderbetreuung sowie attraktive Vorsorgeleistungen 
 chevron_right 
 Arbeiten, Lehren und Forschen an der ETH Zürich 
 Diversität und Nachhaltigkeit sind uns wichtig
 Im Einklang mit unseren Werten unterstützt die ETH Zürich eine inklusive Kultur. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit, schätzen Vielfalt und pflegen ein Arbeits- und Lernumfeld, in dem die Rechte und die Würde aller Mitarbeitenden und Studierenden respektiert werden. Auf unserer Webseite zur Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt erfahren Sie, wie wir ein faires und offenes Umfeld sicherstellen, in dem sich alle entwickeln und entfalten können. Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns ein zentraler Wert – wir arbeiten konsequent an einer klimaneutralen Zukunft. 
 Neugierig? Sind wir auch.
 Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung mit den folgenden Unterlagen:
 Motivationsschreiben

 In der Abteilung Facility Services der ETH Zürich schaffen wir die optimale Voraussetzung für Lehre, Forschung und Technologietransfer. Wir unterhalten die Gebäude und stellen die Energie- und Medienversorgung sowie das technische und infrastrukturelle Gebäudemanagement aller von der ETH Zürich genutzten Räume sicher.
 Du bist handwerklich geschickt, denkst lösungsorientiert und behältst auch in turbulenten Momenten den Überblick? Dann gestalte mit uns die Zukunft des infrastrukturellen Gebäudemanagements an der ETH Zürich!
 Für den Standort Zentrum suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine:n Hauswart:in (m/w/d) im Gebäudebereich ET. 
 Stellenbeschreibung
 In dieser vielseitigen Position unterstützt du die Leitung des infrastrukturellen Gebäudemanagements im operativen Alltag und trägst wesentlich dazu bei, dass unsere Gebäude reibungslos, effizient und nutzerorientiert betrieben werden.
 Du führst selbstständig Unterhalts-, Reparatur- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten aus und sorgst dafür, dass Gebäude, Anlagen und Einrichtungen jederzeit in einwandfreiem Zustand sind. Dabei erkennst du Optimierungspotenziale und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein.
 Du organisierst und begleitest Auf- und Abbauten für Veranstaltungen, berätst Nutzer:innen vor Ort und unterstützt bei der Bedienung von Multimedia- und Präsentationstechnik.
 Die Umsetzung des Entsorgungskonzepts sowie die Sicherstellung einer hohen Reinigungsqualität gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich. Dies gewährleistest du sowohl durch eigene Einsätze als auch durch die Koordination externer Dienstleister.
 Als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen Technik, Dienstleistern und Nutzenden sorgst du für eine hohe Servicequalität und Kundenzufriedenheit. Darüber hinaus leistest du Pikettdienste und übernimmst Aufgaben im Schichtbetrieb, wie das Öffnen und Schliessen von Gebäuden.

Zudem wirkst du bei der Budgetierung mit und unterstützt bei der Erstellung und Pflege des Instandhaltungsplans.

items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 A propos de vos missions 
 Conception & Études: Analyser les cahiers des charges, dimensionner les réseaux mécaniques et thermiques (chauffage, ventilation, climatisation, tuyauterie industrielle) et valider les plans d'exécution
 Suivi de chantier & Installation: Superviser les travaux d'installation sur site, coordonner les entreprises sous-traitantes et garantir le respect des plannings et budgets
 Coordination transverse: Assurer l'interface entre les équipes civiles, électriques (génie électrique/HVAC) pour éviter les conflits spatiaux ( clash detection via BIM/Revit)
 Tests & Mise en service (Commissioning): Organiser et superviser les essais, les réceptions techniques et la levée des réserves avant la livraison finale.
 Conformité & HSE: Veiller au strict respect des normes de sécurité, des codes du bâtiment et des réglementations environnementales ou énergétiques en vigueur
 A propos de vous 
 Diplôme d'ingénieur (Bac +5) en génie mécanique, génie climatique ou Facilities Engineering, avec 2 ans minimum sur un poste similaire en bureau d'études, en entreprise générale de construction ou chez un industriel
 Maîtrise des systèmes HVAC, compresseurs, pompes, réseaux de fluides et traitement d'air, connaissance des outils de conception assistée par ordinateur et BIM, connaissance des normes locales et internationales de construction et de sécurité
 Rigueur, leadership sur le terrain, adaptabilité, esprit d'équipe et capacités de négociation avec les sous-traitants
 ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025. 
 Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.
 Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.
 Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. La diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sont des valeurs fondamentales qui façonnent notre culture d’entreprise.
 Pour découvrir toutes nos opportunités, rendez-vous sur st.com/careers.
