items.desc: Company Description We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Job Description The Pricing Analyst is the quantitative engine behind the pricing function — answering "how much" and "what if" by building the financial, revenue, and ROI models that operationalize pricing strategy. As a key partner to commercial, product, and strategy teams, you will help shape how Sportradar's products and services are valued and monetised. You will work across large, multi-product revenue and operational datasets, using modern AI and analytics tooling to turn data into pricing decisions at speed, while setting the standard for modelling rigour across the team. Through deep analytical expertise and an understanding of the sports betting ecosystem, you will directly influence revenue growth, profitability and decisions across the business. THE CHALLENGE Build and maintain financial revenue and ROI models that translate pricing strategy into commercial decisions. Analyze large, multi-product revenue and operational datasets to surface pricing, margin, and profitability insights. Apply AI and advanced analytics tooling to accelerate modeling, scenario analysis, and data exploration. Own and maintain global pricing structures and price lists across Sportradar's products, content, and commercial offerings. Develop scenario modeling and pricing impact analysis to evaluate commercial opportunities and support strategic pricing decisions. Support content and product valuation, including ROI assessment for content acquisition and new products. Provide business case, revenue, and ROI modeling support for new commercial initiatives, product launches, and strategic investments across Sportradar's betting and sports data portfolio. Partner with the Revenue Strategy team to ensure models reflect strategy and policy. ABOUT YOU Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative field. 3+ years in financial modeling, pricing analytics, data analysis, or commercial finance. Demonstrated experience in financial revenue modeling and ROI modeling. Strong AI skills — practical use of advanced analytics tools to accelerate analysis, modeling, and insight generation. Proven ability to analyse large revenue and operational datasets and translate them into actionable recommendations. Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; proficiency in SQL and analytics/BI tools (Python or R a strong plus). Professional experience in the sports betting/gaming industry is strongly preferred, with experience in betting products, sportsbook technology, sports data solutions or B2B data/SaaS environments is considered a significant advantage. Key Success Metrics Pricing model adoption and commercial impact Speed and quality of pricing recommendations Accuracy of content valuation OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Two Hiring Team Interviews : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! items.desc: Job Description: Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Software Simulation Engineer (d/f/m) As part of the Future Capabilities Simulation team in Germany, you are not just developing simulators —you are developing the platforms of the future. Our mission is centered on pushing the boundaries of what is possible in aerospace simulation, beyond usual R&D. We focus on "Next-Gen" capabilities, exploring how emerging technologies can redefine training and engineering environments. items.desc: About the role We are looking for a curious, thorough and commercially minded CRO Specialist to join our CX & CRO Management team under Ecommerce Operations. Your starting question will be: "What is stopping someone from buying today?" Working with a high degree of autonomy, you will independently identify conversion issues and improvement opportunities across a portfolio of ecommerce retailers, using judgement to determine the appropriate depth of investigation and engaging the teams responsible for delivering changes. The role combines independent day-to-day monitoring with deep-dive analysis across complex and varied business questions. You will balance timely action on emerging issues with a prioritised programme of short- and medium-term improvements, receiving general direction on new priorities rather than detailed oversight of day-to-day work. Using GA4, Shopify Analytics, ESW's internal BI data and behavioural tools, you will explore international shopper behaviour across fashion, luxury, consumer goods and digital goods. You will turn evidence into practical recommendations for Customer Success Managers and retailer partners. What you'll do Conversion monitoring and ownership Independently monitor conversion and funnel progression by retailer, geography, device and traffic source, using consistent metric definitions and meaningful comparisons to identify where attention is required. Detect unusual changes, pinpoint the affected funnel stage and independently assess tracking and data quality before investigating shopper behaviour. Exercise judgement to determine the appropriate action within agreed operating practices. Own the triage of conversion losses, coordinate cross-functional investigation and track recovery with minimal day-to-day supervision. Maintain accountability for performance follow-up while technical and operational teams own implementation. Deep-dive analysis and conversion improvements Independently combine funnel data, behavioural evidence and commercial context to understand why shoppers abandon their journey, evaluating alternative explanations before reaching a conclusion. Analyse complex and varied patterns across markets, brand categories and traffic profiles, accounting for shopper intent, localisation and local expectations. Develop evidence-based hypotheses and independently prioritise improvements by conversion impact, commercial value, effort and confidence. Quantify opportunities where the evidence supports it and recommend the appropriate course of action. Recommend changes and A/B tests for CX roadmaps, using professional judgement to shape the analysis and test approach. Evaluate outcomes against suitable baselines, accounting for traffic shifts, seasonality and data limitations. Communication and ways of working Proactively share concise performance updates, findings and recommendations with Customer Success Managers and retailer partners, tailoring the level of detail to the audience and confidently explaining the rationale behind recommendations. Independently manage priorities across the assigned retailer portfolio, escalating material risks or dependencies when appropriate. Build stakeholder alignment and share reusable learnings that contribute to broader team goals. Work autonomously with data and technical teams to resolve access, tracking gaps and reporting needs. Develop AI-assisted workflows to reduce repetitive work, validating outputs before use and sharing effective practices with the wider team. What we're looking for Must have 3+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital analytics, conversion rate optimisation or a similar data-focused role . An investigative mindset and the ability to work fully independently, with the rigour to evaluate identifiable factors, test alternative explanations and determine an appropriate course of action. Strong hands-on GA4 expertise in ecommerce funnels and segmentation. Ability to interpret international shopper behaviour in the context of local markets, brand positioning and acquisition channels. Commercial judgement to balance potential value, investigation depth and timely action, making sound decisions with minimal day-to-day instruction. Clear writing and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. A collaborative and accountable approach to independently managing work across retailers, following through on agreed actions and providing informal guidance or mentoring to junior colleagues when appropriate. Nice to have Working knowledge of Shopify Analytics, BI platforms and behavioural analytics tools. Able to apply professional knowledge creatively to solve unfamiliar problems. Strong Excel or Google Sheets and reporting skills, with experience in AI-assisted analysis or automation. Sound understanding of data quality, experiment evaluation and attribution limits. About ESW Our purpose is simple: to create moments that matter between people and the brands they cherish. We …

items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. Overview At eBay, we protect buyer and seller trust while ensuring our marketplace complies with applicable laws, regulations, and platform policies. Policy violations involving fake and intellectual property, banned and limited items, and product safety compliance may build customer harm along with legal, regulatory, and reputational risk. We are committed to addressing these risks through accurate, consistent, and defensible enforcement. We are looking for a Policy Compliance Specialist to help validate that enforcement outcomes align with policy intent and that policies are applied consistently across the marketplace. In this role, you will support sampling, calibration, quality assurance, escalations, enforcement validation, and trend identification. You will develop expertise across multiple marketplace policy areas, surface systemic issues, recommend improvements to guidance, workflows, tooling, training, and model performance, and partner with Legal, Risk, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Global Customer Experience Operations, and other teams. Responsibilities include: Policy Compliance and Enforcement Validation Review sampled enforcement outcomes to confirm alignment with policy intent, legal requirements, and platform standards. Validate consistent application of marketplace policies—including counterfeit and intellectual property, prohibited and restricted items and emerging policy areas—across listings, sellers, categories, and enforcement channels. Identify false positives, false negatives, inconsistent decisions, edge cases, and recurring quality gaps requiring clarification or correction. Model and Tooling Enablement Support model tuning by reviewing AI-assisted detection and enforcement outputs and providing structured feedback on accuracy and policy alignment. Provide marketplace examples, unusual scenarios, and decision rationale to improve prompts, detection logic, workflows, and decision frameworks. Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Operations to identify where enforcement systems need clearer policy interpretation, signals, or feedback loops. Validate that new or updated enforcement solutions produce outcomes consistent with policy expectations. Job Requirements 4+ years of experience in trust and safety, platform governance, policy compliance, marketplace risk, regulatory compliance, investigations, quality assurance, or a related field. Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply diverse policy frameworks to real-world marketplace data, including enforcement decisions, edge case review, sampling, QA, and calibration in scaled operations environments. Strong judgment, attention to detail, and decision-making skills when evaluating ambiguous, sensitive, regulated, or high-risk listings and seller behavior across different policy areas. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex policy decisions clearly and translate findings into practical operational guidance. Comfort working in fast-paced, evolving environments with AI-enabled enforcement systems, model outputs, feedback loops, changing regulations, and emerging marketplace risks. Education BS/BA degree in a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience. Experience in ecommerce, marketplace policy, trust and safety, compliance operations, investigations, or quality assurance preferred. Experience with analytics, reporting, policy documentation, or operational guidance development preferred. Additional Details eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. items.desc: Stiamo cercando una persona da inserire nel Research & Technology Office , a diretto riporto del CTO di Gruppo , con l’obiettivo di rafforzare il team dedicato alla ricerca, alla sperimentazione e allo sviluppo delle tecnologie che costituiranno la base delle future generazioni di display. Cerchiamo preferibilmente un giovane ingegnere o una giovane ingegnera con formazione elettronica, microelettronica o affine , con interesse non tanto a un’attività di progettazione elettronica tradizionale, quanto a un ruolo multidisciplinare dove elettronica, ottica, optoelettronica, LED, materiali e sistemi di visualizzazione si incontrano. Principali attività La persona sarà progressivamente coinvolta nelle attività di Engineering e R&T, tra cui: test e caratterizzazione optoelettronica in laboratorio di display, LED, moduli e componenti ottici; misure di luminanza, uniformità, contrasto, cromaticità, coordinate colore ed efficienza luminosa ed energetica ; valutazione delle prestazioni di LED, backlight, sistemi ottici e display LED/LCD ; studio e ottimizzazione della gestione della luce all’interno del display , con analisi di diffusori, guide di luce, filtri, vetri protettivi e altri componenti ottici; analisi sperimentale di nuove tecnologie e nuovi componenti, con realizzazione di setup di laboratorio, prototipi e prove comparative ; caratterizzazione e confronto di differenti soluzioni tecnologiche attraverso misure strumentali; attività di failure analysis e troubleshooting su problematiche elettroniche, ottiche e optoelettroniche; supporto allo sviluppo di display ad alta efficienza energetica , ricercando il miglior compromesso tra prestazioni ottiche, consumi, affidabilità e costo; collaborazione alla realizzazione e alla validazione di proof of concept e prototipi ; analisi tecnica delle nuove tecnologie di display, LED, microelettronica, sensoristica e componentistica optoelettronica; collaborazione con Engineering/D&D nelle prime fasi di nuovi progetti e tender, quando è necessario valutare la fattibilità tecnica di soluzioni non standard ; interazione con fornitori tecnologici, università e partner di ricerca per la valutazione di nuovi materiali, componenti e tecnologie. Formazione Preferibilmente: Laurea triennale o magistrale in Elettronica o Microelettronica ; valutabili anche percorsi in optoelettronica, fotonica, fisica applicata o discipline affini , se accompagnati da una buona base elettronica e sperimentale. L’esperienza lavorativa non è un requisito indispensabile. Valutiamo quindi con interesse anche una neolaureata o un neolaureato , purché abbia una forte curiosità tecnica e una reale propensione per le attività sperimentali. La persona che stiamo cercando Più che un profilo già completamente formato, cerchiamo una persona con potenziale tecnico, curiosità e capacità di affrontare problemi nuovi . La persona candidata ideale è chi ama capire come funzionano realmente le cose, effettuare una misura, interpretarne il risultato, formulare un’ipotesi e verificarla sperimentalmente. Deve trovarsi a proprio agio sia davanti a uno strumento di laboratorio sia nell’analisi di un problema tecnico, con interesse ad approfondire ambiti diversi dalla propria specializzazione iniziale. Sono particolarmente apprezzati: curiosità verso nuove tecnologie; approccio pratico e sperimentale; capacità analitica e problem solving; predisposizione alle attività di laboratorio; interesse per elettronica, ottica e tecnologie LED/display ; capacità di lavorare in un ambiente multidisciplinare; buona conoscenza dell’inglese tecnico; desiderio di crescere professionalmente assumendo progressivamente autonomia. Perché il ruolo è interessante Non cerchiamo una figura destinata a svolgere attività ripetitive o esclusivamente esecutive. La persona entrerà in un ufficio che lavora sulle tecnologie future dell’azienda , con la possibilità di seguire un’idea dal primo studio e dalle prime misure di laboratorio fino alla realizzazione di un prototipo e, successivamente, al suo possibile trasferimento all’interno di un prodotto. Per una giovane ingegnera o un giovane ingegnere rappresenta quindi un’opportunità per costruire una competenza trasversale difficilmente ottenibile in un ruolo esclusivamente elettronico, ottico o di progettazione prodotto.

items.desc: Job Description Agilent is a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies; we are passionate about bringing great science to life. Our commitment to quality and innovation supports cutting-edge life science research, patient diagnostics, and ensures the safety of water, food, and pharmaceuticals. As scientists and clinicians pursue small, everyday advances and life-changing discoveries, we provide trusted answers to their most critical questions and challenges. We can’t wait for you to join us as we continue our mission to improve the world around us. Information about Agilent is available at www.agilent.com. Every day, Agilent Field Service Engineers help our customers to solve issues that enable scientists to make discoveries that enhance the quality of life. Through our work, we deliver insights and provide support that keep laboratories running smoothly and more efficiently. Join our dynamic organization to be a part of this rewarding and exciting work! You will be responsible for supporting our clients with on-site installation, implementation, maintenance and delivery of customer training on our liquid chromatography coupled with mass spectrometry (LC/LCMS). Your main responsibilities will be: Respond to customer needs by providing repair, installation, upgrade and preventive maintenance activities Contact customers in a timely manner and schedules service efficiently Connect with manager and sales team to understand and meet customer needs and expectations Maintain Agilent’s customer service reputation by aligning with all corporate policies and procedures Complete administrative paperwork and computer reports promptly and accurately Provide feedback to the Product Specialists, manufacturing or OEM vendors concerning performance anomalies encountered - use the complaint handling system as required Address customer requests for service and communicate proactively before, during and after service For this role, you will be working remotely combined with travel to customer sites (a company car will be available to you). Qualifications We are looking for an individual with the following background: University degree in Chemistry , Biochemistry , Biotechnology or similar. Hands-on experience with liquid chromatography solutions (LC/LCMS), either in a technical support role , either as an end user of these solutions. Full proficiency in Italian and good level of English. A valid driving license. On a personal level, you are proactive , outgoing and customer oriented . You enjoy working both autonomously and as part of a team , to solve various types of problems . You have great communications and interpersonal skills to interact with many internal and external partners. What we offer: Permanent Contract Outstanding company culture Career development opportunities Company pension scheme, yearly company bonus, company car, private health care, stock purchase plan, medical & life insurance A position within an international organization with exciting opportunities We will make sure you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field! items.desc: AzimutIBenetti è il più grande gruppo di yachting privato al mondo, leader nelle imbarcazioni da diporto di lusso. Nelle nostre creazioni, stile e qualità si intrecciano per creare emozioni uniche. L'eccellenza nasce dalla passione per il prodotto e per le nuove tecnologie e dal desiderio di superare sempre noi stessi. Riscopriamo ogni giorno la bellezza del "savoir faire" italiano, dove nessun dettaglio è lasciato al caso e la persona è al centro dell'intero processo produttivo. Far parte del Gruppo significa condividere la storia, i valori e la tradizione del Made In Italy. Siamo presenti in Italia con le nostre sedi di Avigliana, Livorno, Viareggio, Fano e Savona e all'estero con sedi a Fort Lauderdale (USA) e Itajaí (Brasile). Posizione: Per la Divisione Benetti, presso la sede di Livorno, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Addetto/a ai Trattamenti Interni e Pitturazioni. La figura ricercata opererà quotidianamente a bordo e in cantiere, il suo obiettivo è garantire la corretta esecuzione dei cicli di stuccatura e verniciatura (interna ed esterna) e supervisionare l'applicazione dei trattamenti interni (materiali antivibranti, isolamento termo-acustico e isolamento strutturale tagliafuoco). Dovrà assicurarsi che le lavorazioni procedano nei tempi previsti, prevenendo difetti, garantendo gli standard del cantiere e ottenendo le certificazioni necessarie. Attività: Ambito Trattamenti Interni (Damping, Isolamento e Tagliafuoco): Preparare, gestire e presenziare alle ispezioni ufficiali (Survey) con gli ispettori degli Enti di Classifica (es. RINA, Lloyd's Register, ABS, ecc.) e delle Autorità di Bandiera per l'accettazione e la certificazione dei trattamenti isolanti e delle compartimentazioni tagliafuoco (Structural Fire Protection - es. classe A30, A60). Verificare che le superfici in alluminio/acciaio/VTR siano adeguatamente preparate e primerizzate prima dell'applicazione dei materiali. Supervisionare l'incollaggio e la stesura delle piastre o dei composti antivibranti, verificandone l'adesione, lo spessore e la copertura secondo i piani acustici (Insulation Plan). Verificare la corretta installazione dei materiali isolanti (es. lana di roccia certificata) nel rigoroso rispetto degli schemi approvati per l'isolamento termico, acustico e di resistenza al fuoco. Ambito Verniciatura e Stuccatura (Exteriors & Interiors): Presidiare le aree di lavoro per verificare la corretta esecuzione di lavaggio, carteggiatura, stuccatura, applicazione primer e finiture. Misurare i parametri ambientali (temperatura, umidità, Dew Point), controllare gli spessori applicati dopo applicazione(DFT). Ispezionare la stuccatura e l'assenza di difetti prima del passaggio alle mani di pittura successive, valutando il livello estetico finale. Attività Trasversali: Rilevare immediatamente difetti e concordare subito con i capisquadra le azioni di ripristino. Verificare che il personale esterno rispetti le procedure tecniche, i disegni approvati e le normative di sicurezza. Compilare check-list e redigere la documentazione necessaria per il rilascio (handover) delle aree agli enti certificatori. Requisiti: Requisiti: Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata). Questo requisito è indispensabile per interfacciarsi fluentemente con i Surveyor internazionali (Enti di Classifica, Bandiera, Rappresentanti dell'Armatore) e per la corretta comprensione dei manuali e delle specifiche tecniche. Ottima capacità di lettura dei piani di coibentazione (Insulation e Fire Plan) e familiarità con le rigorose normative relative ai materiali tagliafuoco e alla sicurezza in mare (SOLAS/MCA). Competenza pratica sui materiali isolanti (lane minerali, prodotti viscoelastici) e sui cicli di pitturazione marina. Capacità di utilizzare spessimetri, igrometri, pettini per vernice. Forte propensione al lavoro sul campo, abitudine a muoversi in spazi confinati e sui ponteggi. Dinamismo, occhio per il dettaglio, fermezza e ottime doti relazionali, fondamentali per gestire le ispezioni ufficiali con autorevolezza e precisione. Titoli Preferenziali (Non obbligatori) Corsi o attestati specifici rilasciati da enti certificatori o produttori di materiali marini. Attestati in ambito ispezioni vernici (es. moduli base FROSIO o NACE). Altre informazioni: Cosa Offriamo Per questa posizione offriamo una retribuzione all'interno del range: 26.000€ - 33.000€ Considereremo come prioritarie le candidature di profili appartenenti alle categorie protette ex Artt. 1 e 18 L. 68/99 e/o le candidature di persone disoccupate o lavoratori percettori di interventi di sostegno al reddito residenti in Toscana. #Benetti

items.desc: DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS 2 December 2026-23:59-GMT+01:00 Central European Time (Rome) ABOUT THE SCHOOL MEALS ACCELERATOR School Meals Accelerator (the Accelerator) is the fifth and newest initiative under the School Meals Coalition, operating as an independent initiative while being hosted by the World Food Programme (WFP). It is designed to support governments to scale and strengthen their national school meal programmes and turn their ambitions into real impact. Acting as a network catalyst and convenor, the Accelerator mobilizes resources and expertise from the right partners to deliver strategic technical assistance where it matters most. The Accelerator’s mission: unlock the full potential of national school meal programs by improving design, scaling investment, and fostering collaboration across education, health, and food systems. It embraces a systems-thinking approach, adapts to country priorities, and thrives in deep collaboration among global, regional, and local actors. The Accelerator’s ambition: to help low- and lower-middle-income countries reach an additional 100 million children by 2030, making school meals a cornerstone of human capital development and a global standard of care. The Accelerator operates in conditions of high complexity. Because it operates as a network facilitator rather than a traditional organization, its work spans multiple countries, organisations and institutional logics, and seeks to support system-level change rather than the delivery of predefined solutions. For this reason, the Accelerator has adopted a systemic leadership approach, which accepts that pathways to change are non-linear, and progress depends on learning, adaptation and collaboration across boundaries. Working in this way places ongoing demands on those involved and requires leaders who are able to work productively with uncertainty, difference and incomplete authority while maintaining accountability for results. Joining the Accelerator team therefore means being part of a first-of-its-kind development enterprise: a systems-focused effort to drive lasting, country-led change that requires a willingness to learn, adapt and be shaped by the work as it evolves. items.desc: Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer to join our Information Security team and support the design, review, and continuous improvement of our network security environment. The role will act as a security-focused counterpart to the Infrastructure and Network teams, ensuring that network changes, connectivity requirements, firewall rules, and security solutions are implemented in accordance with the organization’s security architecture, policies, and risk requirements. The Network Security Engineer will have responsibility for reviewing and supporting our network security stack (NGFW, Zero Trust etc.), as well as assessing and approving network-related requests and changes submitted to InfoSec approval. The role combines hands-on technical security expertise and cross-functional collaboration. Your responsibilities: Review network diagrams, traffic flows, and solution designs for new or modified infrastructure. items.desc: Software Tester Why this role matters The global food chain has to feed a growing population with safe protein, high hygiene standards, less waste and better use of resources. Poultry processing depends increasingly on connected machinery, real-time control and reliable software. When that software performs well, production lines can run with the precision, traceability and consistency that modern food supply requires. How we contribute At Meyn, we design, build and install complete processing lines and turnkey factories for the poultry industry in more than 100 countries. From our headquarters in Oostzaan, we combine heavy mechatronics, industrial automation and IT into systems that process at high speed with millimetre precision. Our R&D and engineering work covers PLC architectures, EtherCAT networks, computer vision, sensor fusion, OT/IT integration and predictive maintenance at R&D level. It is no-nonsense engineering on steel, with impact. Your contribution as Software Tester As Software Tester, you help safeguard the quality of Meyn’s commercial software products and services. You start with functional and technical designs, assess their testability, then model, execute and maintain tests in Tricentis Suite. Over time, you build a broader grip on integration testing, end-to-end testing and first root-cause analysis. You work with the Chief Engineer QA & Platform, product managers, information analysts and development teams, and your work directly supports trust in Meyn equipment and solutions. What you'll actually be doing: Review functional and technical designs for testability before software reaches the test phase. Model, execute and maintain different test types and test scenarios in Tricentis Suite. Report test results, register bugs and track their resolution with the relevant teams. Perform a first analysis of possible root causes and possible solutions for defects. Specify the test data needed in Tricentis Suite and support test installations. Coordinate with testers in your own team and other teams on integration and end-to-end testing. What we ask of you At least 2 years of experience as an IT Test Engineer. At least 1 year of experience with Tricentis Suite, Tosca Fundamentals AS1 and AS2 completed successfully. Completed education in test engineering, such as TMap and/or ISTQB. At least 1 year of experience with Linux and at least 2 years of experience with GIT. Knowledge of networks and strong English language skills, both spoken and written. Availability to work on site and build with out Technicians in Oostzaan at least 4 days per week. What you get in return A broad salary range of €4,100 to €6,600 gross per month (based on education and experience), because the role offers enough complexity and room to accommodate both mid-level and senior professionals. Flexible working hours: the option to start between 7:00 and 9:30 AM. An attractive pension scheme. Generous leave policy: 33 days in total, consisting of 25 vacation days and 8 ADV (reduced working hours) days. Growth and development opportunities: plenty of room for personal development and career progression. Hybrid working options: the possibility to work from home one day a week. Travel allowance: €0.25 per kilometer. About Meyn For over 65 years, Meyn has been a trusted global leader in poultry processing solutions. As an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), we design and build our own machines and systems, which are used by customers worldwide. By joining Meyn, you become part of a team driven by innovation, collaboration, and a continuous pursuit of excellence. Apply now and join a team that drives success. Interested? Apply using the application button. If you have any questions about this vacancy, please contact Maik Litjens, Corporate Recruiter, via mlitjens@meyn.com.

Denk daarbij aan een kennisbank met verzekeringsinformatie. Je werkt aan oplossingen die direct gebruikt worden door collega's en daarmee bijdragen aan een betere dienstverlening voor onze leden. Daarbij kijk je verder dan het verwachte pad en heb je oog voor risico's, uitzonderingen en edge cases. Je deelt bevindingen met het team en draagt bij aan het continu verbeteren van de kwaliteit van onze producten. Samen met betrokken collega's werk je aan oplossingen die dagelijks gebruikt worden binnen VGZ. We helpen elkaar verder, delen kennis en zoeken continu naar manieren om slimmer te werken. Daarbij zetten we ook AI-oplossingen in die bijdragen aan softwareontwikkeling, testen en onze dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Athena is een onder eigen beheer gebouwde kennisbank van VGZ voor algemene verzekeringskennis van de zorgverzekering én de Wet langdurige zorg. Je draagt bij aan het ontwerpen en realiseren van nieuwe IT-oplossingen. Je komt hierbij terecht in een warm en betrokken team waar samenwerking centraal staat. Wij vieren successen samen en helpen elkaar waar nodig. We werken als team samen met andere multidisciplinaire teams en zitten met twee andere teams in één afdeling. Ook werken we nauw samen met de interne klant, die ook de inhoud van de kennisbank beheert. Binnen VGZ hebben we een testgilde waarin jouw bijdrage erg gewaardeerd wordt. Als organisatie hechten we veel waarde aan kwaliteit en veiligheid en daarom werken we volgens robuuste processen, waar het mogelijk is om hierover mee te denken. Van de gezondste werkgever mag je meer verwachten. Iedere dag zet jij je in voor een gezonder Nederland en vernieuwing van de zorg. Dit doe je in een omgeving waar gezond werkgeverschap voorop staat. Dit breng jij mee Als onze nieuwe Tester zet jij je in voor een gezonder Nederland en de vernieuwing van de zorg. items.desc: Manufacturing team · On site in Groningen · Full time The role Arc makes jewellery-like precision hardware, a unity of art and function. That approach has made Arc one of the fastest growing companies in the Netherlands (Deloitte Technology Fast 50, rank 16). Quality is non-negotiable, and what people see, feel and hold is the surface. We want to stay at the cutting edge of process technology, in art and in engineering. To get there we are building a greenfield factory in Groningen and bringing production back from China to the EU. You own Arc's finishing technology from day one: the processes, the recipes and the coatings we deploy next. Working directly with Product Design, Mechanical Engineering, and Automation and Robotics, you set the technical direction and turn bold cosmetic and functional ideas into production that can be automated. What you are accountable for Finishing recipes: created and locked in across peening, polishing, anodising, dyeing, sealing and PVD, on aluminium and titanium alloys New finishes with Product Design: your own ideas, and ambitious colour, gloss and texture concepts turned into repeatable production windows. Experimentation and R&D are core to the role Yield and uptime: finding and removing defects, yield loss and unit to unit variation, with quality and inspection procedures that hold the standard A safe lab: safety SOPs, DOEs, the closed-loop DI and ZLD water treatment, and periodic PVD upkeep What you will do Commission a greenfield line: specify, commission and help build the equipment you want to use, from supplier outreach to DFM sign off, FAT, SAT and ramp up Work hands-on, every day: little about this role is theoretical. You run new recipes, tests and tuning on the shop floor and turn them into practical processes others can execute Join chemistry and automation: work with Robotics and Mechanical Engineering to take an idea all the way to mass production Practical terms Location: on site in Groningen. You live in the Netherlands or are ready to relocate Team: Manufacturing, working daily with Product Design, Mechanical Engineering, and Automation and Robotics Contract: full time How we hire Apply with your CV and three short questions. It takes about 15 minutes. Screening email: five written questions about your career, your strengths and your last managers. Practical exercise at home, about 90 minutes. AI tools are allowed, as long as you understand every part of your answer, can derive it yourself, and stand behind it as your own best work. Career interview with the hiring manager, 70 minutes. You start by walking us through your exercise, then we go through your career job by job. Culture interview and references with former managers, only with your consent. Then an offer. A live case study may come before this step. You hear back from us at every step, usually within two working days. What you bring 4+ years of hands-on industrial experience in at least one of these, and a working knowledge of the others: Aluminium anodising: etching, anodising, dyeing and sealing PVD coating Wet lab work, including acid-base and complexometric titrations A BSc or MSc in Surface, Chemical, Process or Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, or equivalent A rigorous safety mindset around acids, alkalis and hydrogen A builder mindset: you wear several hats, audit CAD and P&IDs, and make fast, autonomous decisions Fluent English Useful, but not essential A strong sense for product design, and a tendency towards perfectionism A background in colour science Electrolytic plasma polishing (EPP) or plasma electrolytic oxidation (PEO) Hardware mass production, including OEE and yield optimisation Quality management systems, QA and automated QC, especially optical and surface metrology Hybrid or duplex wet-to-dry coating workflows Dutch regulatory frameworks such as the Bal, PGS 15, the Arbowet and REACH Dutch We hire on trajectory more than on years. items.desc: At Telenor Procurement, we are looking for a Supply Chain Risk & Information Security Specialist to strengthen how we identify, assess and manage risks across our global supply chain and procurement operations. This role combines supply chain risk management, information security and compliance, with a primary focus on strengthening supply chain resilience and supporting effective risk management. We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in risk management who can analyze complex risks, understand their potential business impact and work with stakeholders to develop practical mitigation measures. You do not need to be a technical expert in every area. What matters most is your ability to apply sound risk management principles, ask the right questions and translate risk insights into meaningful actions. What you'll work on Supply chain risk management: Identify, assess and monitor supply chain risks, including geopolitical developments, supplier disruptions, critical dependencies, concentration risks and other emerging threats. Including regular analysis of supplier and supply chain risk exposures, identify vulnerabilities and emerging trends, and support business continuity, disruption scenario assessments, resilience planning and crisis management. Supply chain risk mitigation and monitoring: Work with Procurement, suppliers and relevant risk owners to develop mitigation measures, establish action plans and monitor their effectiveness to keep risks within acceptable levels. Enterprise Risk Management: Manage Enterprise Risk Management which includes identifying and assessing risks relevant to Telenor Procurement as an entity, ensure thorough mitigation planning with Risk Owners, ensuring implementation of mitigations as per plan and periodic risk reporting to Management and BoD. Information security risk: Own governance and implementation of Information Security Management System (ISMS) and security best practices in the organization. Including security risk assessments, monitoring relevant security risks and coordinating mitigation activities with security specialists and other stakeholders within and outside organization. Compliance and governance: lead enterprise compliance management, evaluate adherence to relevant policies, standards and regulatory requirements, including follow-up of identified gaps with policy owners and managers. Continuous improvement: Contribute to strengthening risk management processes, digital tools, data analytics and the use of AI to improve efficiency and risk visibility. What we're looking for Typically 3+ years of relevant experience in enterprise risk management, supply chain risk management or related discipline. Good understanding of risk management principles and methodologies , including risk identification, assessment, risk appetite, mitigation and monitoring. Familiarity with COSO ERM or ISO 31000 is an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify underlying risk drivers, assess potential business impacts and recommend practical mitigation measures. Understanding of supply chain risks, supplier dependencies, business continuity and operational resilience. Knowledge of information security risks, security governance and compliance principles. Familiarity with ISO 27001 is an advantage, but deep technical expertise is not required. Ability to work across different risk domains, collaborate with relevant specialists, and communicate risk insights clearly to stakeholders including risk report writing for executive forums like BoD. Confidence in using data, digital tools and technology to support risk analysis, monitoring and reporting. Professional education such as CRMA, CRMP, CIA, CISA, or a university degree in risk management, business, procurement, supply chain, information security or a related field. Relevant experience may compensate for formal education. Who you are You are analytical, structured and curious, with an interest in understanding how risks affect business performance and supply chain resilience. You enjoy investigating complex issues, looking beyond immediate findings to understand underlying causes and identifying practical solutions. You are comfortable working across different disciplines, asking the right questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating with stakeholders to make informed decisions. You take ownership of your work, follow through on actions and enjoy using technology and new ways of working to make risk management more effective. What We Offer Opportunity to create an impact, strengthen risk management and supply chain resilience across Telenor's global operations. Exposure working with experienced professionals across Procurement, Risk, Compliance and Security in a collaborative, multicultural environment Opportunity to develop and grow professionally through diverse risk challenges, cross-functional projects and learning opportunities. Operational Effectiveness & Compliance Uphold the highest ethical standards, scientific integrity, and compliance in all activities. items.desc: OUR STORY: TechInsights to platforma informacyjna dla branży półprzewodników. Swiatowy liderem w dziedzinie analizy półprzewodników i zaawansowanych technologii. Ponad 650 firm i 150 000 użytkowników uzyskuje dostęp do platformy TechInsights, największej na świecie zintegrowanej kolekcji inżynierii odwrotnej (reverse engineering), demontażu (teardown) i analiz rynkowych w branży półprzewodników. Zbiór obejmuje szczegółowe analizy obwodów, obrazowanie, przebiegi procesów technologicznych półprzewodników, demontaże urządzeń, ilustracje, informacje o kosztach i cenach, prognozy, analizy rynkowe oraz komentarze ekspertów. Wśród klientów TechInsights są największe firmy technologiczne, które dzięki analizom TechInsights podejmują decyzje biznesowe, projektowe i produktowe szybciej i z większą pewnością. Więcej informacji znajdziesz na stronie www.techinsights.com. THE OPPORTUNITY: Analityk Circuit, odpowiedzialny będzie za przeprowadzenia ekstrakcji i analizy działania najnowocześniejszych systemów bezprzewodowych, pamięci i innych systemów on-a-Chip. Przeprowadzi analizę układów analogowych oraz cyfrowych ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem innowacji technicznych. Korzystając z wewnętrznych narzędzi, Junior Analityk „odczyta” elementy aktywne i pasywne znajdujące się w układzie scalonym i wykorzysta je do budowania elektrycznego schematu połączeń elementów. Przeprowadzi analizę layoutu i pomagać będzie w tworzeniu i korygowaniu cyfrowej reprezentacji połączeń wewnątrz układowych. Uczestniczyć będzie w ekstrakcji cyfrowych komórek standardowych oraz szacowaniu pokrycia przez nie layoutu i wykorzystania ich w układzie. Będzie asystował podczas wszystkich etapów tworzenia raportu, tj.: przetwarzania obrazu, rozpoznawania elementów i innych części projektu w celu przedstawienia wyników w raportach zgodnie z wymaganiami klientów. WHAT YOU’LL DO Wykonywanie ekstrakcji obwodów dla urządzeń i systemów bezprzewodowych, pamięci i systemów na chipie Korzystając z narzędzi wewnętrznych rozpoznawanie elementów aktywnych i pasywnych na layoucie Konstruowanie struktury schematu przedstawiającego obwód i organizowanie tych schematów w hierarchii i reprezentacji wizualnej Badanie i analiza małych bloków układu scalonego (z dodatkową pomocą, jeśli jest to konieczne) Analiza pracy i funkcji wyekstrahowanych struktur Budowanie schematów, nazywanie sygnałów i bloków (z dodatkową pomocą, jeśli jest to konieczne) Wsparcie w organizacji schematów i budowanie hierarchii Identyfikacja i korygowanie problemów z połączeniami elementów związane z jakością obrazu lub GDS Wspieranie i przygotowywanie obróbki zdjęć layoutu Wsparcie w przygotowywaniu końcowych raportów z analizowanych układów Wsparcie w identyfikowaniu i naprawianiu błędów przy użyciu dostępnych narzędzi WHAT YOU’LL BRING Wykształcenie wyższe w dziedzinie elektrotechniki (preferencja dla specjalizacji mikroelektronika) lub studenci ostatnich lat Umiejętności interpersonalne Umiejętność pracy w zespole jak również przy samodzielnych projektach. Inicjatywa, aktywne identyfikowanie ryzyka dotyczącego zakresu lub harmonogramu zakończenia projektu Dobra znajomość języka angielskiego W ramach procesu rekrutacji na to stanowisko będziesz zobowiązany do przesłania najnowszych informacji o obywatelstwie i/lub stałym miejscu zamieszkania. Informacje te zostaną wykorzystane w celu przestrzegania amerykańskich przepisów i regulacji dotyczących kontroli eksportu. WHY WORK WITH US Stabilne warunki zatrudnienia umowa o prace lub umowa zlecenie (studenci) Wynagrodzenie miesięczne brutto: 6,300 – 8,500 PLN Ciekawe projekty międzynarodowe Elastyczne godziny pracy, opcja pracy hybrydowej Pakiet benefitów (ubezpieczenie zdrowotne, na życie, karta sportowa) Lekcje jęz. angielskiego Nielimitowane dni urlopu Technology knows no bounds, and neither does TechInsights. items.desc: Join the GSK’s R&D Global Clinical Study Delivery Graduate Programme – Poland 2027: Help us get ahead of disease together Education required: BSc degree from an accredited college/university, preferably in medical or biological science or discipline associated with clinical studies (for example life sciences or pharmacy). Graduation by August 2027 Language requirement: Written and spoken fluency in English and Polish Other requirements: Willingness to be geographically mobile (domestic) throughout rotations Location : Warsaw/Poznan Expected Start date: September 2027 Application deadline: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and this role will close once we have received enough applications. We recommend you apply as soon as possible. Assessment Centre Date : January/February 2027 Are you a talented and driven student or graduate eager to make an impact on billions of lives? Apply for the Global Clinical Study Delivery Graduate programme at GSK today! GSK is a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Getting ahead means preventing disease as well as treating it, and we aim to impact the health of 2.5 billion people around the world in the next 10 years. Our success absolutely depends on our people. We want GSK to be a place where people feel inspired, encouraged, and challenged to be the best they can be. A place where they can be themselves – feeling welcome, valued and included. Where they can keep growing and look after their wellbeing. So, if you share our ambitions, join us at this exciting moment in our journey to get ahead together. With over 300 years of innovation, we’re a science-led global healthcare company that discovers, develops and manufactures innovative medicines and vaccines. Join us and help millions of people do more, feel better, live longer. Are you ready to use your skills to deliver high-quality clinical trials? If so, you could be suited to this role! Together we can design, plan and deliver clinical trials across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering medicines and vaccines to our patients. Ahead together with tailored training and career development We’ll tailor your training and development to suit your talents and ambition, as well as our business needs, setting you up for success in your chosen niche. The skills you learn on our Graduate programme can be used across many areas of our business and, potentially, many countries. There’s no limit to how far you can go with us – it’s up to you to prove yourself. Over the next two years, the Graduate Programme will challenge and support you to grow both professionally and personally. You will have fascinating rotations to explore study management for Specialty Medicines (Rx) and Vaccines (Vx) projects for potential opportunities in Global Clinical Study Delivery team. If you are a graduate with the passion to take accountability for designing, planning and executing the delivery of global Phase I to IV clinical trials to ensure it is delivered on time, to a high quality, within budget and all in line with company standards and scientific requirements, then this is a role for you! You will have the opportunity to operate as a Study Manager (SM) and contribute to deliver the clinical study to time, cost and quality, ensuring inspection readiness by taking an oversight over project conduction. You will have a broader impact on the business, by driving continuous improvement initiatives within their remit of expertise, sharing best practices across business, with a focus on increasing operational delivery efficiency. You will also build close collaborations with other SMs, Global Study Managers (GSMs), Global Study Leads (GSLs) and Study Delivery Specialists (SDSs) to share best practices, experience and support process improvement. You will have had the opportunity to develop key skills in study management along with gaining experience of working with functional subject matter experts to help you succeed as a SM. What will you do? Manage study execution of trial(s) in line with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) from start-up through close-out in accordance with study budget and timelines with the focus on setting up, maintaining and ensuring completeness of internal systems/databases/tracking tools and project plans Work in collaboration with the GSM, GSL and SDS to provide end to end operational and administrative support for study delivery activities Monitor study conduct and progress, identify, resolve and escalate risks/issues which may impact delivery of the study to the necessary quality, timeline and budget objectives Interact, collaborate and communicate with other study team members across different functions to ensure all issues, risks and successes with study delivery are reviewed and/or shared as they occur Support the Clinical Team in quality and data oversight to ensure inspection/audit readiness, including clinical documentation …

items.desc: Do obszaru Systemów Gier na Automatach poszukujemy Test Automation Engineera , który będzie rozwijał automatyzację testów i współodpowiadał za jakość rozwiązań obejmujących aplikacje webowe, API, integracje, systemy centralne oraz oprogramowanie współpracujące z urządzeniami. Szukamy osoby, która potrafi dobrać właściwy poziom testów, projektuje rozwiązania testowe możliwe do utrzymania i traktuje automatyzację jako integralną część procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania. Rola nie ogranicza się do wykonywania testów, obejmuje aktywny udział w analizie wymagań, identyfikowaniu ryzyk i zapewnianiu jakości ukończonego przyrostu produktu. Zakres obowiązków Projektowanie, rozwijanie i utrzymywanie automatycznych testów aplikacji webowych, API oraz integracji pomiędzy systemami. Budowa i rozwój frameworków oraz bibliotek wspierających automatyzację testów. Automatyzacja testów regresyjnych, integracyjnych, end-to-end i kontraktowych. Integracja testów automatycznych z pipeline’ami CI/CD oraz analiza wyników ich wykonania. Przygotowywanie i generowanie danych testowych oraz tworzenie mocków, stubów i symulatorów zależności zewnętrznych. Analiza wymagań i kryteriów akceptacji pod kątem testowalności, ryzyk i przypadków brzegowych. Diagnozowanie przyczyn niepowodzeń testów oraz współpraca z developerami przy analizie defektów. Monitorowanie jakości i stabilności zestawów testowych oraz eliminowanie testów niestabilnych. Współtworzenie standardów testowania, strategii automatyzacji i podejścia do jakości w zespole Poszukiwane kompetencje Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w testowaniu oprogramowania, w tym praktyczne doświadczenie w automatyzacji testów. Bardzo dobra znajomość co najmniej jednego języka programowania wykorzystywanego w automatyzacji testów, np. Java, TypeScript lub Python. Doświadczenie z narzędziami do automatyzacji testów aplikacji webowych i API, np. Playwright, REST Assured lub Postman/Newman. Dobra znajomość HTTP, REST, JSON oraz zasad testowania integracji pomiędzy systemami. Doświadczenie w projektowaniu testów na różnych poziomach oraz świadomym doborze zakresu automatyzacji. Praktyczna znajomość Git i CI/CD oraz uruchamiania testów automatycznych w procesie budowania i wdrażania oprogramowania. Umiejętność pracy z bazami danych i weryfikowania danych za pomocą SQL, preferowana znajomość PostgreSQL. Umiejętność analizy logów, danych diagnostycznych i komunikacji pomiędzy usługami. Znajomość dobrych praktyk tworzenia czytelnego, modularnego i utrzymywalnego kodu testowego. Praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy w Scrumie, w zespole regularnie dostarczającym ukończone przyrosty produktu. Sposób pracy Pracujemy w Scrumie, w interdyscyplinarnym zespole odpowiedzialnym za dostarczanie działających przyrostów produktu. Oczekujemy praktycznego doświadczenia w dojrzałym Scrumie: planowania realnego zakresu Sprintu, współodpowiedzialności za jego realizację oraz regularnego dostarczania ukończonych przyrostów spełniających Definition of Done w każdym Sprincie. Wymagamy aktywnego udziału w Planowaniu Sprintu, Daily, Przeglądzie Sprintu i Retrospektywie oraz bieżącego zgłaszania ryzyk i przeszkód wpływających na realizację Celu Sprintu. AI w codziennej pracy Oczekujemy świadomego wykorzystywania narzędzi AI jako elementu warsztatu testera. AI ma zwiększać efektywność, jakość i zakres testowania, ale nie zastępuje odpowiedzialności za poprawność scenariuszy, kodu testowego i interpretację wyników. Generowanie i rozszerzanie scenariuszy testowych, przypadków brzegowych oraz danych testowych. Tworzenie, analiza i refaktoryzacja kodu automatyzacji testów. Analiza logów, wyników testów i potencjalnych przyczyn defektów. Identyfikowanie luk w pokryciu testami oraz wspieranie analizy ryzyka. Tworzenie dokumentacji testowej i automatyzacja powtarzalnych czynności. Wymagamy umiejętności weryfikowania poprawności, bezpieczeństwa i jakości rezultatów przygotowanych z wykorzystaniem AI. Mile widziane Doświadczenie w testowaniu systemów rozproszonych, mikroserwisów i architektury event-driven. Znajomość narzędzi do testów wydajnościowych, np. k6, JMeter lub Gatling. Our two business lines—expense management and accounts payable—help finance teams work more efficiently and stay in control of company spending. Our expense management platform makes submitting, approving, and reimbursing expenses easy, while our accounts payable solution uses AI to automate invoice processing and approval workflows. Behind our products is an international team of more than 250 colleagues. When your suite is green, every service the squad owns can go to production with confidence. Using AI and agents to automate testing is the top priority, and you’ll shape how testing is done across the whole company, not just in your own squad. What the person will do Own the squad’s test suite, so that a green suite means all services in the squad’s ownership can be released to production with confidence. Share good testing practice with other squads. Requirements Strong test automation experience: building frameworks, infrastructure and pipelines, and integrating them into CI/CD. Experience with BDD-style acceptance testing using Gherkin. Hands-on use of AI and agents to automate testing. Good C#/.NET and Angular capability , enough to fix bugs and contribute to features in the product code, not only to write tests. A collaborative, developer-minded way of working, with strong communication skills and the ability to influence practices beyond your own squad. items.desc: Location Remote from Poland Experience Senior Hi there! If you’re seeking a high-impact role within an ambitious and fast-growing software house, you might have just found your perfect match! Our client operates a high-scale, AI-powered Intelligent Observability Platform serving complex, enterprise digital environments. We are hiring a Platform Security Engineer to harden and secure service-to-service communication across large-scale Kubernetes clusters. You will focus on cloud-native network security, network policies, identity isolation, and eBPF-based tooling (Cilium) to safeguard multi-tenant data pipelines. Working hours: due to collaboration with US teams, occasional meetings may take place between 17:00–21:00 CET/CEST . Flexibility to join key project and stakeholder meetings is expected. Recruitment stages: 1. Initial HR screening (max 20 min.) A short conversation about your experience, expectations, and availability. 2. Technical verification (45-60 min.) An interview with our Senior Engineer covering your technical fit. During the call, you will talk about the project, the team, and ways of working. ‍ 3. Meeting with the Client (30-60 min.) What will be your responsibilities? Design, deploy, and operate secure, scalable multi-cluster and multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure, leading fleet-wide rollouts and incremental migrations. Architect and manage Kubernetes networking and CNI layers using Cilium and eBPF, writing and troubleshooting CiliumNetworkPolicy rules and analyzing kernel-level datapath enforcement in production. Implement and enforce Zero-Trust security architecture and service-to-service authentication/authorization across distributed microservices using OAuth2/OIDC, JWTs, and SPIFFE/SPIRE. Configure, maintain, and integrate identity and access management (IAM) platforms such as Keycloak or Okta (including realms, client credentials, token exchange, and JWKS validation). Key Responsibilities: Deliver client sustainability reporting projects (GRESB, TCFD, GRI, CDP) Manage and model environmental data to meet deadlines Maintain environmental data platforms and ensure data accuracy Support client user access and coordinate with delivery teams Analyze energy, waste, and water data for internal and external reporting Required Skills & Experience: 4-5 years in similar analyst role Strong understanding of GRESB reporting requirements Advanced Microsoft Excel and data management proficiency Excellent communication and problem-solving skills Ability to manage multiple priorities in deadline-driven environment High attention to detail with process-driven approach Preferred Qualifications: Experience with carbon emissions reporting Project management background Background or interest in building engineering systems What we offer: Competitive Rewards & Benefits: Permanent contract, private healthcare, cafeteria system, life insurance, and employee assistance program Flexible Work Environment: Hybrid model in premium Warsaw Spire workspace with state-of-the-art facilities and metro access, or possibility to work remotely Career Development & Growth: Robust development opportunities with 80% employee participation in structured programs, AI upskilling, and professional training Stability & Recognition: 78% employee recommendation rate, recognized for 18 consecutive years as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies Inclusive & Supportive Culture: Strong commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion across multiple employee resource groups and initiatives Global Perspective: 60 nationalities and 40 languages represented, offering rich cultural exchange and collaboration opportunities If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth: JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. About JLL – We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities. Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally. Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

items.desc: Location: Warszawa Other locations: Primary Location Only Salary: Competitive Date: 18 Nov 2026 Job description Requisition ID: 1760542 Audyt to dziś znacznie więcej niż analiza sprawozdań finansowych. To praca na styku biznesu, finansów, danych i nowych technologii. Dołączając do naszego zespołu, będziesz pracować dla największych firm działających w Polsce, od międzynarodowych grup kapitałowych po dynamicznie rozwijające się polskie przedsiębiorstwa. Poznasz ich biznes od środka, będziesz prowadzić projekty i zespoły oraz uczestniczyć w kluczowych rozmowach z klientami. EY.AI – technologia w codziennej pracy W EY sztuczna inteligencja nie jest przyszłością. Już dziś jest częścią naszej pracy. AI, analiza danych i nowoczesne narzędzia cyfrowe wspierają nasze zespoły w analizie informacji finansowych, identyfikowaniu ryzyk, pracy z regulacjami i dużymi zbiorami danych. Dzięki technologii możesz koncentrować się na tym, co najważniejsze: rozumieniu biznesu, wyciąganiu wniosków, profesjonalnym osądzie i rozmowie z klientem. Będziesz również mieć możliwość testowania nowych rozwiązań i współtworzenia sposobu, w jaki technologia zmienia zawód audytora. Twoja rola prowadzenie projektów audytowych i zarządzanie kilkuosobowym zespołem; poznawanie modeli biznesowych i procesów największych przedsiębiorstw; wykorzystywanie AI, analizy danych i narzędzi EY w codziennej pracy; bezpośrednia współpraca z klientami i ich zespołami finansowymi; koordynowanie projektów realizowanych wspólnie z zespołami EY w innych krajach; wspieranie biegłych rewidentów w kluczowych dyskusjach z zarządami. Szukamy osoby która: ma minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w firmie audytorsko-doradczej; zna polskie i międzynarodowe standardy rachunkowości; potrafi prowadzić zespół i budować relacje z klientami; zna język angielski i dobrze czuje się w międzynarodowym środowisku; interesuje się AI i chce wykorzystywać nowe technologie w pracy; chce dalej rozwijać kompetencje i brać coraz większą odpowiedzialność. Rozpoczęte kwalifikacje Biegłego Rewidenta lub ACCA będą dodatkowym atutem. Co oferujemy międzynarodowe projekty i możliwość pracy dla największych firm oraz liderów rynku; dostęp do AI, analityki danych i technologii zmieniających sposób prowadzenia audytu; różnorodność projektów i realną przestrzeń do zdobywania doświadczenia w nowych obszarach; wsparcie merytoryczne i finansowe w zdobyciu uznanych kwalifikacji i certyfikatów, w tym kwalifikacji Biegłego Rewidenta lub ACCA; EY Badges – globalną certyfikację Twoich kompetencji i możliwość zdobycia tytułu MBA renomowanej uczelni Hult International School of Business; Career Counselor – profesjonalnego, indywidualnego doradcę w zakresie budowania i rozwoju kariery; platformę psychoedukacyjną – pakiet bezpłatnych konsultacji ze specjalistami z szerokiego zakresu zdrowia psychicznego i rozwoju osobistego oraz dostęp do aktywności edukacyjnych; program benefitów oferujący m.in. prywatną opiekę zdrowotną z dodatkowymi badaniami profilaktycznymi, ubezpieczenie na życie, bilety, sporty zespołowe, platformę do nauki języków obcych, karty sportowe i wiele innych, dostępnych online i offline. Dołącz do EY i rozwijaj audyt przyszłości razem z nami. Etapy rekrutacji Aplikuj. Jeśli robisz to po raz pierwszy, załóż profil i dodaj CV. Porozmawiajmy. Czekają eksperci ds. pozyskiwania talentów oraz osoby z Twojego przyszłego zespołu. O EY Polska Jesteśmy globalną firmą doradczo-technologiczną. Robimy różnicę - transformujemy i zmieniamy usługi, produkty, organizacje, a nawet reguły gry. Biznesowo i technologicznie, wykorzystując sztuczną inteligencję i prawdziwe talenty. Pomagamy organizacjom rozwiązywać złożone problemy, podejmować lepsze decyzje i wdrażać zmiany na lepsze. Dajemy pewność – danych, opinii, standardów, technologii i bezpieczeństwa. Codziennie podejmujemy wyzwania, analizujemy możliwości, promptujemy, badamy, współpracujemy, zadajemy dobre pytania, planujemy, modelujemy, kodujemy, próbujemy nowych rzeczy, wyciągamy wnioski – tworzymy rozwiązania, które są kluczowe dla klientów. Tutaj tworzą się przyjaźnie, relacje i wspomnienia na całe życie. Tutaj robisz trudne i ważne rzeczy, z wspierającymi i najlepszymi ludźmi. Zatrudniamy ponad 390 000 wyjątkowych osób w ponad 150 krajach na świecie. W Polsce jest nas ponad 7000 – pracujemy w Warszawie, Gdańsku, Katowicach, Krakowie, Łodzi, Poznaniu, Rzeszowie i Wrocławiu oraz w centrum usług Global Delivery Services w Warszawie i Wrocławiu. Dbamy o środowisko – nie tylko biznesowe. W ramach realizacji założonego planu zmniejszyliśmy globalną emisję gazów cieplarnianych o 40% w stosunku do roku bazowego 2019. EY jest pracodawcą równych szans – doceniamy i promujemy różnorodność wiedzy, doświadczeń i perspektyw naszej społeczności. Tworzymy środowisko oparte na szacunku, otwartości i współpracy, w którym każdy może się rozwijać i mieć realny wpływ. Prowadzimy program „Poziom Wyżej bez Barier”, który wspiera pracowników z niepełnosprawnościami w realizacji …

items.desc: Job ID 64144 Brand HSBC Job Type Full Time Date Posted 17 November 2026 Min Salary PLN 255100 Max Salary PLN 300000 Some careers shine brighter than others. If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. Your career opportunity Regional CIO Europe is part of HCIB Technology Europe within HSBC Service Delivery and provides full life-cycle software manufacturing, deployment and support services to HSBC businesses across Continental Europe. As Agile Lead, you’ll develop and mature our Service Management practice while overseeing our Application Production Support capability across multiple markets. The role sits at the intersection of technical delivery and service leadership and supports a landscape transitioning to cloud-based platforms including GCP, AWS and a migration to Azure for Israel. What you’ll do Oversee, coach and develop the L1 and L2 Application Production Support team ensuring clear ownership, coverage and operational discipline. Own production support delivery across multiple markets including Israel, Czech Republic, France, Bermuda, CIIOM, Italy, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Spain and KYC. Provide SME consultancy on production readiness, stability, supportability and operational risk across supported applications. Maintain support processes and runbooks in line with the cloud migration roadmap across GCP, AWS and Azure including effective hybrid support. Establish and evolve the Service Management and Production Support operating model and standardise ways of working across the region. Embed an end-to-end service lifecycle framework including continual service improvement and measurable service outcomes. Coordinate the community of IT Service Managers and IT Service Owners across worldwide markets ensuring consistent governance, reporting and accountability What you need to have to succeed in this role Demonstrate proven experience overseeing L1/L2 production support teams in a multi-market, multi-stakeholder environment. Apply strong Service Management capability with solid ITIL knowledge supported by ITIL certification or equivalent demonstrable experience. Use service management tools confidently across incident, problem and change workflows including service catalogue and CMDB concepts and reporting. Bring strong technical depth to engage credibly with engineers and application teams on production issues, stability and resilience in hybrid and cloud environments including GCP, AWS and Azure. Show experience operating in changing priorities, technologies and operating models including cloud migration in-flight. Apply a strong understanding of risk models, controls and mitigation in a production environment. Demonstrate experience working in Agile delivery environments including Scrum and Kanban. Communicate clearly and concisely to stakeholders at all levels both face-to-face and virtually. What we offer The pay range for this role is 21 258 PLN – 25 000 PLN (monthly, gross). Additional car allowance in the amount of 4,786 PLN (monthly, gross). Variable pay is discretionary, but influenced by Group performance, business/function performance and individual performance. items.desc: Location Remote from Poland Experience Expert Hi there! If you’re seeking a high-impact role within an ambitious and fast-growing software house, you might have just found your perfect match! Our client operates a high-scale, AI-powered Intelligent Observability Platform serving complex, enterprise digital environments. We are hiring a Platform Security Architect to harden and secure service-to-service communication across large-scale Kubernetes clusters. You will focus on cloud-native network security, network policies, identity isolation, and eBPF-based tooling (Cilium) to safeguard multi-tenant data pipelines. Working hours: due to collaboration with US teams, occasional meetings may take place between 17:00–21:00 CET/CEST . Flexibility to join key project and stakeholder meetings is expected. ‍ ‍ Steps in the recruitment process: 1. Initial HR screening (max 20 min.) ‍ A short conversation about your experience, expectations and availability ‍ 2.. Technical verification (45-60 min.) An interview with our Senior Engineer covering your technical fit. During the call, you will talk about the project, the team, and ways of working. 3. Meeting with the Client (30-60 min.) ‍ ‍ What will be your responsibilities? Design, deploy, and operate secure, scalable multi-cluster and multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure, leading fleet-wide rollouts and incremental migrations. Architect and manage Kubernetes networking and CNI layers using Cilium and eBPF, writing and troubleshooting CiliumNetworkPolicy rules and analyzing kernel-level datapath enforcement in production. Implement and enforce Zero-Trust security architecture and service-to-service authentication/authorization across distributed microservices using OAuth2/OIDC, JWTs, and SPIFFE/SPIRE. Configure, maintain, and integrate identity and access management (IAM) platforms such as Keycloak or Okta (including realms, client credentials, token exchange, and JWKS validation). Manage Kubernetes security primitives (RBAC, ServiceAccounts, admission webhooks) and debug complex production network policy issues. Requirements Willingness to participate in pre-scheduled evening alignment calls (17:00–21:00 CET) with US teams Experience operating infrastructure across multi-cluster, multi-region Kubernetes environments; comfort with fleet-wide rollout strategies and incremental migrations Deep understanding of CNI plugins, pod networking, ServiceAccounts, RBAC, and admission webhooks, experience debugging network policy behavior in production clusters Strong experience with OAuth2/OIDC (client credentials, token exchange, JWKS validation, audience-bound JWTs), and practical knowledge of zero-trust principles Practice in deploying and operating Cilium as a CNI, writing CiliumNetworkPolicy, and understanding how eBPF programs enforce policy in the kernel datapath Hands-on experience with Keycloak/Okta/Spifee for service identity and access management, configuring realms, Proficiency in Go or Java for building control-plane components, policy renderers, and SDK tooling for backend engineering. 190 - 260 PLN netto per month - B2B gross per month - Employment Contract

items.desc: Data Platform Engineer (GCP & FinOPS) - Automation and Innovation Department Develop reusable data processing and testing solutions on GCP using BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow/Dataproc and Cloud Composer. Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines integrating databases, Kafka/MQ, APIs and files. Implement automated testing, data quality checks, monitoring and security controls. Develop and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and CI/CD. Collaborate with analysts, data scientists and engineering teams to deliver reliable and well-documented data solutions. Monitor, troubleshoot and optimise data pipelines for performance, scalability, reliability and cost. Develop technical FinOps capabilities, including GCP billing data integration, cost allocation, monitoring and anomaly detection. Cooperate with an external provider delivering the initial FinOps solution and take ownership of its further technical development. W realizacji zadań pomoże Ci At least 3 years of experience as a Data Engineer in a data-driven environment. Hands-on experience with GCP data services, including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, IAP, Dataflow/Dataproc and Cloud Composer. Experience with modern data platform patterns and cloud transformation or migration projects. Experience implementing or operating a FinOps solution on GCP. Knowledge of the FinOps Framework, BigQuery reservations and capacity management. Strong SQL and Apache Spark skills, including large-scale batch and streaming processing. Proficiency in Python and/or Scala or Java. Hands-on experience with Terraform, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD. Experience with Linux, Docker or Kubernetes. Understanding of data ingestion, transformation, orchestration and data quality principles. Knowledge of GCP cost management, including Cloud Billing export, resource labels, budgets, cost allocation and workload optimisation. Very good command of English and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly. Nice to have: Experience with data governance, metadata management and data quality tools. Experience with Looker or other GCP data and analytics services. GCP or FinOps certification. Join T-Mobile’s data transformation program and help us build reliable and scalable solutions on our GCP data platform. You will work on reusable data processing frameworks, ingestion pipelines, automation and platform capabilities supporting data and AI use cases. You will also develop technical FinOps solutions that improve cost transparency and help engineering teams optimise platform usage. Cooperate with modern cloud technologies and make a real impact on the reliability, efficiency and future development of our data platform.
