items.desc: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview The Custody Cash and FX Team plays a mission-critical role in ensuring seamless daily trade and transaction execution for our global custody clients. The team is responsible for monitoring end-to-end internal cash and foreign exchange (FX) flows, actively overseeing proprietary operational platforms, and resolving settlement exceptions. Working in close collaboration with key internal stakeholders, the team ensures that all client transactions settle accurately, securely, and within established market cut-offs. Desirable experience Experience supporting databases within banking, payments, financial services or another regulated industry. Experience with PostgreSQL extensions and advanced PostgreSQL performance-management techniques. Experience with database migration and modernisation programmes. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise. Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force. At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

items.desc: About the role We are looking for a curious, thorough and commercially minded CRO Specialist to join our CX & CRO Management team under Ecommerce Operations. Your starting question will be: "What is stopping someone from buying today?" Working with a high degree of autonomy, you will independently identify conversion issues and improvement opportunities across a portfolio of ecommerce retailers, using judgement to determine the appropriate depth of investigation and engaging the teams responsible for delivering changes. The role combines independent day-to-day monitoring with deep-dive analysis across complex and varied business questions. You will balance timely action on emerging issues with a prioritised programme of short- and medium-term improvements, receiving general direction on new priorities rather than detailed oversight of day-to-day work. Using GA4, Shopify Analytics, ESW's internal BI data and behavioural tools, you will explore international shopper behaviour across fashion, luxury, consumer goods and digital goods. You will turn evidence into practical recommendations for Customer Success Managers and retailer partners. What you'll do Conversion monitoring and ownership Independently monitor conversion and funnel progression by retailer, geography, device and traffic source, using consistent metric definitions and meaningful comparisons to identify where attention is required. Detect unusual changes, pinpoint the affected funnel stage and independently assess tracking and data quality before investigating shopper behaviour. Exercise judgement to determine the appropriate action within agreed operating practices. Own the triage of conversion losses, coordinate cross-functional investigation and track recovery with minimal day-to-day supervision. Maintain accountability for performance follow-up while technical and operational teams own implementation. Deep-dive analysis and conversion improvements Independently combine funnel data, behavioural evidence and commercial context to understand why shoppers abandon their journey, evaluating alternative explanations before reaching a conclusion. Analyse complex and varied patterns across markets, brand categories and traffic profiles, accounting for shopper intent, localisation and local expectations. Develop evidence-based hypotheses and independently prioritise improvements by conversion impact, commercial value, effort and confidence. Quantify opportunities where the evidence supports it and recommend the appropriate course of action. Recommend changes and A/B tests for CX roadmaps, using professional judgement to shape the analysis and test approach. Evaluate outcomes against suitable baselines, accounting for traffic shifts, seasonality and data limitations. Communication and ways of working Proactively share concise performance updates, findings and recommendations with Customer Success Managers and retailer partners, tailoring the level of detail to the audience and confidently explaining the rationale behind recommendations. Independently manage priorities across the assigned retailer portfolio, escalating material risks or dependencies when appropriate. Build stakeholder alignment and share reusable learnings that contribute to broader team goals. Work autonomously with data and technical teams to resolve access, tracking gaps and reporting needs. Develop AI-assisted workflows to reduce repetitive work, validating outputs before use and sharing effective practices with the wider team. What we're looking for Must have Fluent English communication. We don't require a certification, but you must be able to lead meetings in English. 3+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital analytics, conversion rate optimisation or a similar data-focused role . An investigative mindset and the ability to work fully independently, with the rigour to evaluate identifiable factors, test alternative explanations and determine an appropriate course of action. Strong hands-on GA4 expertise in ecommerce funnels and segmentation. Ability to interpret international shopper behaviour in the context of local markets, brand positioning and acquisition channels. Commercial judgement to balance potential value, investigation depth and timely action, making sound decisions with minimal day-to-day instruction. Clear writing and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. A collaborative and accountable approach to independently managing work across retailers, following through on agreed actions and providing informal guidance or mentoring to junior colleagues when appropriate. Nice to have Working knowledge of Shopify Analytics, BI platforms and behavioural analytics tools. Able to apply professional knowledge creatively to solve unfamiliar problems. Strong Excel or Google Sheets and reporting skills, with experience in AI-assisted analysis or automation. Sound understanding of data quality, experiment evaluation and attribution limits. …

items.title: Research Technician in molecular aging and somatic mutations
items.card: Your mission As a Research Technician, you will provide integral experimental and organizational support to the research team. Your duties will focus on routine laboratory maintenance and execution of core molecular biology, tissue sectioning, immunostainings and cell culture assays. Key responsibilities include: Routine wet-lab support, including buffer/reagent preparation. Molecular biology and biochemistry
items.desc: Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research? The research group led by Professor Maria Eriksson at the Department of Medicine, Huddinge (MedH), is seeking a research technician. The research in the group combines patient samples, animal models, and state-of-the-art genomic technologies, including single-cell approaches, to uncover disease-relevant mechanisms and advance our understanding of how somatic mutations contribute to ageing and age-related disease. The research group is part of the Integrative Cardiovascular, Cancer and Ageing Research Unit (ICCA), which brings together clinical and basic research in cardiology, vascular biology, tumour genetics, cancer biology, and ageing. This interdisciplinary setting provides excellent opportunities for translational research and scientific collaboration across traditionally separate but increasingly interconnected fields. We offer a dynamic and collaborative research environment and are committed to supporting the development of the next generation of scientists. Your mission As a Research Technician, you will provide integral experimental and organizational support to the research team. Your duties will focus on routine laboratory maintenance and execution of core molecular biology, tissue sectioning, immunostainings and cell culture assays. Key responsibilities include: Routine wet-lab support, including buffer/reagent preparation. Molecular biology and biochemistry techniques, such as DNA/RNA extraction, purification, quantification, PCR/RT-qPCR, and preparation of DNA and RNA samples for downstream genotyping, gene expression analsysis and sequencing. Cell culture maintenance, including routine expansion of mammalian cell lines, immunocytochemistry. Tissue embedding, sectioning and immunohistochemistry and immunofluoresence stainings. The position is a fixed-term appointment for one year. Your profile We are looking for a candidate with a relevant background in molecular biology, biochemistry, biotechnology, or a related life science field. You should have prior hands-on experience working in a laboratory setting, with practical knowledge of nucleic acid handling and cell culture techniques. Experience with tissue sectioning, immunofluorescence, mammalian cell culture, or fluorescence microscopy would be considered an asset. As a person, you are highly structured, reliable, and meticulous with documentation and lab safety and organizational tasks. You enjoy working both independently and collaboratively within an international scientific team. Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken) are required, as English is the working language in the laboratory. Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability. What do we offer? A creative and inspiring environment with wide-ranging expertise and interests. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. Our vision is to pursue the development of knowledge about life and to promote a better health for all. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. Karolinska Institutet is also a state university, which entitles you to several good benefits through our collective agreement. And you get to practice freely in our modern wellness facilities, where trained staff are on site. items.desc: Vi söker nu en integrationsutvecklare till ett uppdrag hos en myndighet inom kollektivtrafik i Stockholm. Detta är ett konsultuppdrag. Stationeringsort är Stockholm. Arbetsbeskrivning Uppdraget sker i ett kompetenscenter för integration som implementerar, förvaltar och driftar integrationer för hela organisationen. Du ingår i ett av de agila utvecklingsteamen, med produktägare, tech lead och teamcoach, och arbetar med såväl nyutveckling som drift och förbättring av befintliga integrationer. Integrationerna byggs på MuleSoft, främst i en AWS-baserad molnmiljö och i mindre utsträckning on-premise. Därtill byggs strömmande integrationer med MQTT på HiveMQ och filintegrationer hanteras i GoAnywhere MFT. Arbetet kan utföras både på distans och på plats på kundens kontor på Kungsholmen, efter behov och överenskommelse. Beredskap ingår i uppdraget och övertid samt arbete på obekväm arbetstid kan förekomma. Arbetsuppgifter Ta fram design och utveckla integrationslösningar i olika typer av projekt. Stödja utvecklingsprojekt i arbetet mot integrationslösningarna. Dokumentera implementationsarbete och delta i dokumentation av processer. Stödja andra utvecklare i utvecklingsarbete på integrationsplattformarna. Delta i drift och förbättringsarbete av befintliga integrationer. Krav (OBS, obligatoriska) Högskoleexamen inom ett datorrelaterat område. Minst 7 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av integrationsutveckling, varav minst 4 år i rollen som integrationsutvecklare. Minst 5 års erfarenhet av design och utveckling av integrationer i MuleSoft. Erfarenheten ska ha erhållits inom de senaste 7 åren. Minst 3 års erfarenhet av utveckling av strömmande integrationer med MQTT som protokoll. Meriter Minst 2 års erfarenhet av integrationsdesign och utveckling i GoAnywhere MFT. Minst 3 års erfarenhet av arbete inom offentlig sektor. Minst 3 års erfarenhet av infrastrukturautomatisering och konfigurationshantering med Terraform och Ansible. Minst 1 års erfarenhet av Kafka. Du är ordningsam och strukturerad, självgående och vet när det är läge att be om hjälp. Du kommunicerar enkelt och tydligt med fokus på mottagarens behov och verkar för transparens och goda relationer. Du har hög integritet och god förmåga att sätta dig in i verksamhetens förutsättningar. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift, eftersom det är teamets arbetsspråk. Om oss Centios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt. Våra medarbetare erbjuds villkor som är anpassade för individen. Det innebär att arbetstider, arbetsomfattning, arbetsplats och kompetensutveckling så långt som möjligt anpassas utifrån medarbetarens behov. Bland våra medarbetare hittar du engagerade personer som brinner för samhällsutveckling. Vi jobbar i små grupper där du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter samtidigt som du får ta del av andras kunskap och erfarenhet. För oss är det viktigt med välmående och att hitta en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid. Därför har vi en nollvision mot stress och sätter trivsel och hälsa främst. Läs gärna mer om oss på centio.se. Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

items.desc: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. Your future team Are you passionate about developing advanced vehicle technology while bringing people, technical solutions and teams together? At Volvo Group, you will have the opportunity to combine hands-on involvement in ADAS function development with a key role in supporting agile collaboration and successful engineering deliveries. You will join the Driver Support Functions team within Volvo Trucks Technology & Industrial Division in Gothenburg. We develop Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) throughout the entire product life cycle, from early concepts and requirements to software development, verification, vehicle integration and product maintenance. Our work includes functions such as Intelligent Speed Assist, glare-free lighting, driver distraction, drowsiness warnings and pilot assistance. We work in agile teams, collaborating across engineering disciplines to develop reliable driver support functions for Volvo Group's global truck portfolio. We are now looking for an ADAS Function Developer & Scrum Master who combines a strong technical foundation with a holistic perspective and a genuine interest in enabling team collaboration. This is a role for someone who enjoys understanding the technology, connecting different parts of the development process and helping teams move forward together. What you will do In this combined role, you will contribute to the development and delivery of ADAS functions while supporting the team's agile ways of working. You will connect technical development with coordination and collaboration, helping ensure that functions progress from requirements to verified solutions. Your responsibilities will include: Develop ADAS functions and contribute to end-to-end function development. Translate customer, regulatory and system requirements into use cases, software designs and testable solutions. Coordinate function development activities and support alignment between software, systems and verification teams. Take on Scrum Master responsibilities, facilitating agile ceremonies, supporting planning and helping the team identify and remove impediments. Identify and help resolve technical and organizational dependencies, bringing the right people together to overcome obstacles and keep function development moving forward. Maintain a holistic view of function deliveries, development roadmaps and dependencies across teams. Plan and support verification through simulation, SIL, HIL, test rigs and vehicle testing, analyzing results and resolving issues. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration, promote continuous improvement and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team. Who are you? You are a technically grounded engineer who enjoys seeing the bigger picture. You understand how complex vehicle functions are developed and delivered, and you are motivated by both solving technical challenges and helping people work effectively together. You are someone who naturally connects the dots, sees dependencies before they become obstacles and takes initiative to bring clarity and alignment when development challenges arise. You bring structure to complex situations, communicate clearly across technical disciplines and enjoy facilitating discussions, building alignment and supporting a collaborative team environment. We believe that you have: A university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related field. Several years of experience in automotive embedded systems, function development or another safety-critical software domain. Hands-on experience in software development using C++ Experience working across the development life cycle, from requirements and design to implementation, integration and verification. A solid understanding of software architecture, interfaces and system behavior. Experience working in agile development teams and an interest in taking on Scrum Master responsibilities. Strong communication, coordination and problem-solving skills. Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Additional experience that is valuable: Previous experience as a Scrum Master or in facilitating agile development teams. Experience with Adaptive AUTOSAR or model-based development using MATLAB/Simulink. Software quality practices such as clean code, code reviews, static analysis, CI/CD, test automation, ASPICE or MISRA C++. items.desc: Job Description Want to be part of transforming road freight? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, autonomous and electric technologies. We build the technology that hauls freight efficiently, and we put it to work for the world's leading manufacturers, retailers, logistics providers and defense organizations, all working toward a future where moving goods costs less for our customers, and less for the planet. Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a U.S. public road. In June 2026, Einride became a publicly listed company on Nasdaq, a milestone that reflects a decade of turning what once looked like science fiction into everyday reality. Today, our technology moves freight across North America, Europe, and the Middle East for some of the world's biggest shippers. You will: In this role, you will manage and automate our core business applications—including Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, and device management—while overseeing our GCP infrastructure (primarily via Terraform), limited on-prem servers, and Meraki/Linux-based VPN networks. You will also serve as a technical escalation point for advanced user support and maintain clear documentation for both end users and the IT team. Manage GCP and on-prem infrastructure, and troubleshoot Meraki networks (office and charging stations) alongside our Linux-based VPN. Administer core business tools and build custom integrations and automations between them. Stockholm Office Expansion: Partner with the IT Manager to spec technical requirements and execute the full setup of the new Stockholm office, from networking to conference room AV. Act as an advanced escalation point across Linux, macOS, and Windows (including backup coverage for the Stockholm IT technician) and write internal and end-user documentation. We expect you to: Be a self-directed problem-solver who is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving environment and genuinely enjoys helping people. You don’t need to tick every box—we are happy to train you on specific tools—as long as you are fluent in English, bring strong communication skills, and want to move away from manual GUI workflows toward structured configuration. Solid command-line skills, including SSH, permissions, logs, and package management. Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, Wi-Fi), with hands-on exposure to Meraki or similar managed network gear. Experience with Terraform (or similar IaC tools) and cloud platforms like GCP, AWS, or Azure is a major plus. Ideally, you have some coding experience (e.g., Python or Go) and have administered device management tools (such as Intune or Jamf) or on-prem servers and hypervisors (like Proxmox or vSphere). The ability to clearly explain technical concepts in both spoken and written English. This is a full-time role based in Stockholm, with occasional travel to Einride sites across Sweden. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually. Please note that as part of our standard recruitment process, we conduct a background control on the final candidate for this role. This may include verification of education, employment history, any relevant professional certifications or other information that may be of our interest. Company Description Born autonomous. Born electric. Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement. We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.

items.desc: We are looking for a Medior Java Developer with a strong interest in cloud technologies, DevOps and production operations. In this role, you will be part of a collaborative engineering team responsible for developing, maintaining and operating cloud-based backend services within the automotive and connected vehicle industry. You will work across the entire software lifecycle, combining hands-on development with deployment, infrastructure management, monitoring and operational support. The position is particularly suited to someone who enjoys understanding how systems behave in production and continuously finding ways to improve reliability, performance and efficiency. You will have the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies and contribute to services operating in a global environment. Key ResponsibilitiesDesign, develop and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot. Build, deploy and operate cloud-native applications within AWS. Work with containerized environments using Docker, Kubernetes and AWS Fargate. Monitor production environments and investigate technical issues. Troubleshoot incidents and contribute to restoring services when disruptions occur. Improve system observability through logging, monitoring, metrics and alerting. Identify opportunities to automate operational processes and repetitive tasks. Support and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions to prevent recurring issues. Work closely with developers, architects, QA engineers and other technical stakeholders. Take ownership of technical challenges and ensure problems are followed through to resolution. Required Skills and Experience We are looking for a developer who combines solid software engineering skills with an interest in infrastructure and operational excellence. You should have experience with several of the following technologies and practices: Java development and Spring Boot. AWS cloud services, preferably including AWS Fargate. Kubernetes and container orchestration. Docker and container-based application environments. PostgreSQL and relational databases. DevOps methodologies and CI/CD pipelines. Cloud-native architecture and distributed systems. Monitoring, logging and observability solutions. Troubleshooting and resolving production incidents. Automation and scripting. Git and modern software development workflows. You should also be comfortable participating in an on-call escalation rotation, including occasional support outside normal business hours, once you have gained sufficient knowledge of the systems. About You You are a curious and solution-oriented software engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of development and operations. You take responsibility for the systems you work with and understand the importance of building software that is not only functional but also reliable and maintainable in production. You are proactive when identifying problems, communicate clearly during incidents and enjoy collaborating with colleagues to find effective solutions. We value individuals who: Take ownership and follow tasks through to completion. Have a practical and analytical approach to problem-solving. Enjoy learning new technologies and improving existing solutions. Communicate effectively and work well in a team. Are comfortable working in an environment where development and operations go hand in hand. Continuously look for opportunities to improve processes, performance and system reliability. Core Competencies Technical Skills: Java Spring Boot AWS AWS Fargate Kubernetes Docker PostgreSQL DevOps CI/CD Git Cloud-native technologies Monitoring and observability Language Requirements: English - Fluent / Professional working proficiency Additional Information This is a long-term assignment based in Gothenburg, offering a hybrid working arrangement with approximately 50% remote work. The successful candidate will join a technically focused team working with modern cloud technologies in an international environment.

items.card: About the Role You like understanding how software behaves in production. When a service is slow or a failure keeps coming back, you want to trace the cause, change the system, and check that the fix holds up. At Tandem, you’ll improve the reliability of the services clinicians use every day. You’ll write code, build tests and tooling, and work with service owners to make failures easier to find and recover from.
items.desc: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role You like understanding how software behaves in production. When a service is slow or a failure keeps coming back, you want to trace the cause, change the system, and check that the fix holds up. At Tandem, you’ll improve the reliability of the services clinicians use every day. You’ll write code, build tests and tooling, and work with service owners to make failures easier to find and recover from. Your work will cover how services behave under load, how they handle problems in their dependencies, and what engineers can see when something goes wrong. You might investigate a slow workflow, build a realistic load test, or change an alert that keeps paging without giving anyone useful information. You’ll take improvements from investigation through implementation and production, working alongside product, platform, and infrastructure engineers. What You Will Do Investigate failures and performance problems across services, queues, databases, and external dependencies, then implement fixes with the teams that own them. Improve metrics, logs, and tracing so engineers can understand what users experience and locate the cause of a problem. Build dashboards and actionable alerts around service objectives, and tune alerts that create noise without helping responders. Write load and recovery tests to find capacity limits and check how services behave when dependencies slow down or fail. Automate recurring operational tasks and improve runbooks so response relies less on manual steps or individual knowledge. Take part in incident response with service owners, and follow through on fixes and tests that prevent repeat failures. Work with CI/CD engineers on release-health checks that help teams spot regressions and decide whether to continue or roll back a rollout. Measure whether changes improve service behaviour and reduce recurring operational work. What You Bring Experience building or operating production services and improving how they perform and recover from failures. Strong software engineering skills and the ability to write maintainable code, test it, and follow changes through to production. Experience using metrics, logs, and traces to investigate problems across several components. An understanding of distributed-system failure modes, including timeouts, retries, concurrency, and resource limits. The ability to explain what you know during an incident, make uncertainty clear, and work through a problem with other engineers. Judgement about which improvements will help most, and the persistence to carry them through with the teams involved. Bonus Points Experience with service objectives, error budgets, or improving alert quality. Experience with load testing, failure testing, or automating recovery. Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud platforms, PostgreSQL, or services that depend on external AI or speech providers. Experience in healthcare or another environment where data protection and availability are central to the work. Location We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture. How to Apply We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English. Our interview process consists of 4 stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition Technical interviews with one of our engineers Interview with the Platform Team Lead System Design Interview at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch and a Product focused System Design interview to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action. Follow-up interview with our CTO & Co-Founder Benefits Competitive salary & company stock options 30 days/year of paid vacation 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy Mental health support through our partner Mindler Pension program Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties) An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering. items.desc: Vill du utveckla tekniska lösningar som hjälper meteorologer att analysera och visualisera vädret? På SMHI får du kombinera din erfarenhet av systemutveckling med nära samarbete med användarna, och samtidigt bidra till utvecklingen av verksamhetskritiska system. Om SMHI och IT Utveckling SMHIs verksamhet handlar om att samla in väder-, vatten- och klimatrelaterade data som vi analyserar och visualiserar för att skapa underlag för beslutsfattare och medborgare. Vår vision är ett livskraftigt och säkrare samhälle - genom tillförlitlig kunskap inom väder, vatten och klimat. Enheten IT Utveckling består av cirka 60 medarbetare som arbetar i utvecklingsteam. Dessa team ansvarar för hela kedjan – från idé till drift. Vi bygger verksamhetskritiska system som används dygnet runt och hanterar stora mängder data som är viktiga för både samhället och SMHIs verksamhet. Om teamen Som systemutvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett team med bred kompetens, där ni jobbar enligt agila principer och tillsammans tar ansvar för att omsätta krav till tekniska lösningar. Arbetet omfattar hela utvecklingsprocessen, där teamen har stor frihet att välja teknik utifrån uppdragets behov, samt fullt ut ansvarar för kvalitet, leverans och drift av system. Hos oss finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas över tid, både som teknisk specialist, exempelvis inom systemarkitektur eller frontend, och inom ledarskap i rollen som teamcoach. Vi värdesätter en god arbetsmiljö med balans mellan arbete och fritid för att bidra till medarbetarnas livskvalitet. Den tanken präglar även våra team där vi stöttar varandra och delar med oss av kunskap i det dagliga arbetet. Om tjänsten För denna tjänst kommer du i första hand att ingå i det team som arbetar med att utveckla och förvalta system för visualisering av vädret för exempelvis våra prognosmeteorologer. Visualiseringarna avser både observationsdata och prognosdata. Det innebär att du kommer att samarbeta mycket tillsammans med både prognosmeteorologer, det egna teamet och övriga team på SMHI. Om dig Vi söker dig som har flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet av Linux och av C/C++, samt av något ytterligare språk t ex Python eller Java. I din roll som systemutvecklare behöver du ha vana av att ha ett säkerhetstänk tidigt i utvecklingsprocessen. items.desc: Sapere Aude – dare to know – is our motto. Our students and employees develop important knowledge that enrich both the individual and the community. Our academic environment is characterised by curiosity, courage and openness, with a close connection between people, professional roles, disciplines and research. Gender equality, diversity and a democratic approach form the foundation of our organisation. Located in Värmland, a scenic region with a rich cultural life, we are committed to promoting sustainable development in close collaboration with the wider community. Karlstad University has a total of approximately 1,400 employees and 18,700 students spread across two inspiring campus environments in Karlstad and Arvika. More information at: kau.se/en/work-with-us Description The Department of Engineering and Chemical Sciences belongs to the Faculty of Health, Science and Technology. The department has approximately 60 staff members and offers courses within four engineering programmes, teacher education, and bachelor programmes. The department also conducts research in a variety of areas and is home to the research environment Pro2BE (Processes and Products for a Circular Bioeconomy), which focuses on finding sustainable solutions for process technology and product applications in the forest industry. We are now seeking a part-time Research Project Assistant for a 12-month position within the Pro2BE research environment. Read more about Pro2BE here: https://www.kau.se/en/pro2be Värmland’s pulp mills and waste-to-energy plants emit quantities biogenic CO₂ every year. In this project, the plan is to capture CO₂ in the laboratory using regional flue-gas compositions and convert it into sustainable aviation fuel precursors- We also plan to model the full route in Aspen Plus, including techno-economic and life-cycle assessments for a future Nordic pilot plant. The project runs for 24 months and is funded by COWI fonden. We collaborate with COWI Sweden AB and a local pulp mill, meaning that you will work closely with industry. We offer: A vibrant workplace with students, staff and visitors from all over the world. A personal university with collaboration across borders. Colleagues from building technology, chemical engineering, chemistry, and environmental and energy systems. Duties As a project assistant, you carry out much of the laboratory work in the project. Your main duties are to: Conducting searches in article databases and reviewing and categorizing relevant literature Handling, analyzing, and cataloging collected literature in a database Performing TGA experiments Learn to use new tools and work with computational modelling for biogenic CO2 conversion to SAF Write reports, contribute to scientific work dissemination You will be expected to collaborate with the project team and carry out data collection in an industrial setting. You will engage with the surrounding community for mutual exchange and work to ensure that the knowledge and expertise available at the university benefit society. To contribute to a positive work environment and further the department’s activities, we expect you to be a present and active part of the day-to-day operations and workplace community. The work is based at the Department of Engineering and Chemical Sciences at Karlstad University. Qualifications To be eligible for employment, the applicant is required to hold a Bachelor’s or master's equivalent degree in a science-related program. Considerable weight will be given to: documented laboratory experience in CO₂-related research or separation science, chemistry-related lab work, and, practical science experiment and data collection skills. Preference weight will be given to: Experience working in similar projects Furthermore, you are careful, safety-conscious and structured, with the ability to work independently, document results accurately, and collaborate well with academic and industrial colleague. Good proficiency in English is required. Proficiency in Swedish is a valuable qualification. Terms This is a part-time, 50 %, fixed-term position for 12 months with the possibility of an extension. The employment rate can be adjusted by mutual agreement. Start date is January 15 or at the earliest convenience as agreed by both parties. Application Submit the application via the University’s web-based recruitment tool, Varbi. Applicants are responsible for submitting a complete application in accordance with the advertisement, for providing translations of any documents written in a language other than Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or English, and for ensuring that the documentation allows for objective and qualitative assessments. A complete application should be submitted by the application deadline. An incomplete application may jeopardize a fair assessment of qualifications. items.desc: Last date to apply: 08 December 2026 At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world-class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we're shaping the future, and we want you to be part of it. We are now looking for a Junior Controller to join Gardena Division , part of Husqvarna Group, and strengthen our Finance team's operational and analytical capabilities as we continue to grow. About the role In this role, you will be part of a stable and experienced Finance team that plays a key role in the operational success of our business. This role mixes hands-on controlling with financial analysis, process improvement, and management reporting. You will work closely with the Nordics Hub Business Controller, Sales, and other stakeholders across the organization. As you settle into the role, you will gradually take full responsibility for operational controlling across the Nordic markets. Your main responsibilities include: Controlling, month-end close, forecast and budget for the Nordics (Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland). Support accounts receivable (AR) control in close collaboration with Sales and internal stakeholders to keep AR healthy and help evaluate credit limits. Support the monthly cost allocation, calculate, and follow up on customer bonuses. Support sales teams with financial input and questionnaires. Identify inefficiencies and drive improvements across finance workflows, using modern tools, Excel add-ins, and AI applications. Help with various accounting and controlling tasks across the P&L and Balance Sheet. You will report to our Regional Controlling Manager. About you You're a structured and thorough finance professional with a good eye for detail. Planning your work comes naturally and staying flexible when priorities change does too. With clear communication, you feel comfortable sharing your thoughts, whether that's asking questions, bringing ideas or raising something that's caught your attention. Finding smarter ways of working motivates you, and working independently suits you just as well as being part of a team. In addition, you bring: A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or business administration. Around 1–3 years of experience in a controlling, accounting or finance role, with a strong grasp of end-to-end accounting principles, P&L and Balance Sheet. Strong Excel skills and openness to using modern automation and AI tools. Experience with a passion for financial analysis, generating data-driven insights, monitoring data quality, and summarizing and presenting financial data. Strong communication and organizational skills. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Location This role is based in Huskvarna, Sweden. We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive. Your Application Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we find the right person. For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Johan Odelfelt at johan.odelfelt@husqvarnagroup.com Processing of personal data When you submit your application, we will process your personal data. items.title: Product Owner (Next Project)
items.card: About the role: Our customers build things for a living, and so do we. Next Project is Aceve’s project management platform for the construction industry, and as Product Owner you own delivery quality for your area of it. The Product Manager sets direction and priorities, and you turn them into a ready backlog, a predictable release flow, and clear information for customers and colleagues. You work daily with
items.desc: At Aceve, we back the builders of society. Founded in the Nordics and growing across Europe, we build digital tools for the people who construct and maintain our physical world - giving electricians, plumbers, and contractors back their time, clarity, and confidence. With over 900 employees across 8 countries, leading brands in 7 customer markets, and more than €100M in revenue, we're on an ambitious growth journey, and we're just getting started. We're an AI-first company, and we work with grit, openness, and a good dose of joy. About the role: Our customers build things for a living, and so do we. Next Project is Aceve’s project management platform for the construction industry, and as Product Owner you own delivery quality for your area of it. The Product Manager sets direction and priorities, and you turn them into a ready backlog, a predictable release flow, and clear information for customers and colleagues. You work daily with developers, QA, and UX, and just as closely with Support, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales, who count on you as the product expert. You get real autonomy here, and real accountability for what ships. What will you do: This is your area to lead. You won’t always get a perfect brief, so you’ll ask why first, make the call on what’s ready, and say early when something won’t fit. Break initiatives into clear, testable stories with acceptance criteria, edge cases, and dependencies. Run refinement from a prepared, prioritised list. Prioritise within the roadmap and the team’s real capacity. Say early when the two don’t match. Be the daily contact for developers, QA, and UX on the why and the what, alongside the Tech Lead. Own release scope, and accept delivered work against the acceptance criteria. Triage the bugs and product issues Support escalates, and make sure the right ones get fixed. Keep documentation and release information accurate, and bring customer feedback into the roadmap. Use AI every day to draft, check, and automate. Validate the result before it ships. We believe you have: 3+ years as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar in a SaaS delivery environment. A degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on experience with a backlog tool such as Jira. Experience from construction, skilled trades, or another project-driven industry, or a real interest in how those customers work. Strong analytical skills, and writing clear enough that others can act on it without a meeting. Curiosity about how customers actually work, and the habit of bringing evidence, not opinion, into priorities. Fluency in Swedish and English. Bonus Points For: Experience from construction, skilled trades, or another project-driven industry, or a real interest in how those customers work. Experience building small AI-supported tools or automations for specs, documentation or testing. Experience working with teams across countries. Why Aceve The impact is easy to see. Our customers build the homes, schools and hospitals the rest of us live in. Every hour our software hands back is an hour they spend doing what they're brilliant at — building society, literally. AI isn't a side project here. The tools, the investment and the permission to redesign how the work gets done — starting with your own. Autonomy and accountability, both. You lead your area. You make the calls. You live with them. We think that's the fun part. The pace is fast, and it's the good kind — the kind that comes from being part of a high-growth journey and scaling something real Not ticking every box? No worries! We value potential and drive, so apply anyway or connect with us- you might be just what we're looking for in our growing organisation! Join Aceve and take your expertise to the next level, together we are redefining what’s possible in craft and construction solutions! Aceve is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our selection process is conducted continuously and without discrimination, ensuring an equal opportunity for all candidates.

items.desc: The Global Fund aims to accelerate the end of AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria as epidemics, while increasing access to quality-assured health products and services at affordable and sustainable prices. Within the Secretariat, Supply Operations plays a central role in sourcing, procurement, quality assurance and supply chain matters, including strategy formulation and implementation, policy development, innovation, sustainability, new product introduction and country capacity building. The In-Country Supply Chain (ICSC) team leads the Global Fund's work to strengthen national health supply chains, particularly in countries with under-developed supply chain infrastructure and management systems, so that health products procured through Global Fund grants reach people reliably, efficiently and sustainably. The Specialist, New Product Introduction & Integration, ICSC leads the Global Fund’s work to strengthen country supply chain readiness for the introduction, scale-up and sustainable integration of new health products, technologies and innovations across national health systems. Under the supervision of the Manager, In-Country Supply Chain Strategy, Policy & Initiatives, the Specialist works across planning, digital, governance, monitoring and service delivery domains to ensure that countries can effectively plan for, adopt, deploy and institutionalize innovations from introduction through scale-up and routine implementation in an integrated manner. The role supports Country Teams and national stakeholders to translate innovation opportunities into scalable, sustainable and country-owned solutions by addressing the policy, regulatory, market, financing, digital, operational, workforce and governance requirements for successful adoption. It contributes to relevant strategic initiatives and catalytic investments and works closely with internal teams, technical partners and country stakeholders to move innovations from global recommendation and early introduction to routine use. The position requires strong expertise in new product introduction, implementation planning and health supply chains, combined with the ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives in diverse country contexts. The remit is product agnostic and may cover medicines, diagnostics, prevention products, devices, digital tools and other health technologies or delivery innovations. Key Responsibilities The main responsibilities of the Specialist, New Product Introduction & Integration, ICSC include: 1. Lead the new product introduction ICSC strategy and portfolio approach Provide coherent technical leadership for product-agnostic introduction and scale-up, by: Supporting countries and Country Teams to develop costed, risk-informed and sequenced NPI roadmaps, including accountabilities, milestones, readiness actions and scale-up pathways. Developing and maintaining an ICSC approach, readiness framework, tools and guidance for the introduction, scale-up and institutionalization of new health products, technologies and innovations. Monitoring relevant innovation pipelines and translating emerging opportunities into clear implications for country supply chains, health systems and Global Fund investments. Promoting a portfolio approach that captures cross-product lessons, avoids fragmented introduction efforts and strengthens reusable country and NPI capabilities. 2. Support ICSC country readiness assessments and introduction planning Enable countries to move from policy intent to implementation, by: Leading or supporting country readiness assessments covering policy and regulatory requirements, demand, supply chain, financing, digital systems, service delivery, workforce, governance and stakeholder coordination. Advising on public, private and mixed-channel delivery approaches, taking account of quality, access, affordability, regulation, reporting and equity. Ensuring introduction plans are country-owned, aligned with national strategies and designed for progressive transition into routine systems. Advising on sustainable transition arrangements, including the financing of enabling systems, technical support and ongoing operational costs. 3. Drive supply chain preparedness and operational integration Ensure that national supply chains can reliably support introduction and scale-up, by: Generating market intelligence on channel capacity, provider readiness, access barriers and risks that may affect product uptake or availability. Supporting development of fit-for-purpose supply and distribution strategies, including channel selection, launch phasing, safety stock, replenishment and transition from legacy products where relevant. Identifying operational bottlenecks, dependencies and risks and ensuring that practical mitigation measures are built into introduction and scale-up plans. Supporting integration of new products into routine planning, operating procedures, logistics systems, performance management and institutional accountabilities. …

The role works closely with the Public Financial Management and Health Finance teams within the Finance department, the Grant Management Division and external partners, and contributes to the delivery of related Catalytic Investments. Supporting deployment and further development of supply chain costing tools and models, and their use by countries, Country Teams and partners to inform budgeting, outsourcing decisions and network optimization. Identifying and quantifying optimization opportunities (network design, delivery frequency, channel choices, integration of vertical supply chains) and translating them into actionable recommendations and investment cases. Contributing costing and efficiency analysis to grant design, funding request review and reprogramming decisions. 3. items.desc: The Global Fund aims to accelerate the end of AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria as epidemics, while increasing access to quality-assured health products and services at affordable and sustainable prices. Within the Secretariat, Supply Operations plays a central role in sourcing, procurement, quality assurance and supply chain matters, including strategy formulation and implementation, policy development, innovation, sustainability, new product introduction and country capacity building. The In-Country Supply Chain (ICSC) team leads the Global Fund's work to strengthen national health supply chains, particularly in countries with under-developed supply chain infrastructure and management systems, so that health products procured through Global Fund grants reach people reliably, efficiently and sustainably. The Specialist, ICSC Digital Public Goods accelerates supply chain digitalization through shared digital public goods (DPGs). Under the supervision of the Manager, In-Country Supply Chain Strategy, Policy and Initiatives, the Specialist leads the ICSC team's work on campaign management tools for insecticide-treated net (ITN) and other health campaigns (including DIGIT HCM), supply chain costing models and tools, traceability, and quantification and analytics tools. This role complements the ICSC team's existing digitalization role, which supports the implementation of core systems financed in grants (eLMIS, ERP and WMS installation and scale-up). The Specialist, Digital Public Goods focuses instead on the shared, reusable digital assets that sit above and alongside core systems: open, standards-based tools that multiple countries can adopt, adapt and sustain, reducing duplication and cost across the portfolio. The position requires strong expertise in digital health and supply chain information systems, digital public goods and open-source ecosystems, data standards and interoperability, and the management of technology deployments in low-resource settings. Key Responsibilities The main responsibilities of the Specialist, ICSC Digital Public Goods include: 1. Lead the strategy and stewardship of shared digital public goods Ensure a coherent portfolio approach to shared digital assets for supply chains, by: Developing and maintaining the ICSC strategy for shared digital public goods, including selection criteria, governance, total cost of ownership and sustainability considerations. Coordinating with global DPG ecosystems, product owners and funders to shape roadmaps that reflect country and Global Fund needs. Advising on data governance, hosting, licensing and country ownership arrangements for shared tools. Ensuring complementarity with the core systems workstream (eLMIS, ERP, WMS) so that shared tools integrate with, rather than duplicate, national systems. These shared digital public goods can cover some of the key areas outlined below, but are not limited to only these thematic areas. 1A. Campaign digitalization Improve the efficiency, accountability and coverage of mass campaigns, by: Providing Global Fund support for ITN campaign digitalization, including deployment of campaign management platforms such as DIGIT HCM for micro-planning, household registration, distribution tracking, stock management and real-time monitoring. Supporting countries and Country Teams in platform selection, implementation planning, geospatial and supply chain integration, and capacity building for national teams. Working with partners (including the Alliance for Malaria Prevention, Malaria Consortium, eGov Foundation and other implementers) to align approaches, share learning and expand cross-campaign use of digital tools. Tracking and reporting the results of campaign digitalization, including commodity accountability, wastage reduction and coverage equity. 1B. Supply chain costing models and analytics tools Equip countries and the Secretariat with shared analytical tools, by: Leading the development, maintenance and country deployment of supply chain costing models and tools, in close coordination with the ICSC financing and optimization workstream. Building analytics capability on top of grant-funded systems, including dashboards and cross-country benchmarking datasets. 1C. Traceability of health products Strengthen end-to-end visibility and product security, by: Supporting countries in developing pragmatic traceability roadmaps for health products, including adoption of GS1 and related data standards, verification approaches and phased track-and-trace implementation. Coordinating traceability work with sourcing, procurement, quality assurance, regulatory partners and manufacturers to ensure coherence from global supply through to in-country distribution. Collaborate across the business: Work closely with colleagues in Product Development, Regulatory, Technical and other functions, alongside external research partners, to support the delivery of scientific and innovation projects. What we're looking for We're looking for someone who is scientifically curious, analytical and enthusiastic about using evidence to make a difference . You'll enjoy exploring new research, asking questions and working collaboratively to turn scientific knowledge into practical outcomes. A good foundation in scientific research methods, including an understanding of literature searching, critical appraisal and interpreting scientific information. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate evidence, interpret scientific data and draw meaningful conclusions. An interest in health, nutrition and wellness, particularly the application of scientific evidence to product innovation and improving health outcomes. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific information into clear, accessible messages. Good organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities across different projects. Confidence using Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint. A proactive, collaborative approach, with curiosity, enthusiasm and a willingness to learn and develop new skills. By partnering with us, clients future-proof their operations, unlock actionable insights, and stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving world. Your Mission We are looking for a Product Owner to own Datatonic's portfolio of AI solutions, our repeatable offers we build once and sell many times, such as our GenMedia workbenches and Gaming QA agents. In this role, you will define these solutions, take them to market, own their roadmaps, and make sure our internal sales team and our partners can sell them. You will own each solution end to end, what it is and who it is for, how we take it to market, what we build next, and how it reaches buyers through our sellers and through Google. Enablement and evangelism: equipping our sellers to sell each solution, and making our solutions known to Google's field teams. Product evangelism: Work with our internal Partnerships team to promote our solutions externally, and align with Google’s roadmap and co-sell programmes. Client engagement: Join selected client conversations where a hero solution is in play. Margin and value realisation: Track GM delivered on every solution, compare it against the estimate, and fix the offer, price or asset where margin leaks. Make sure each solution reports measured client outcomes we can use as proof. What You’ll Bring Someone who combines product thinking and commercial judgement, and who gets things done through others: Product ownership in a services setting: experience owning offerings, accelerators or products inside a consultancy, SI or product-led services firm, including roadmap, packaging and retirement decisions. Go-to-market and commercial skill: experience with competitive analysis, positioning and pricing; you understand how professional services are scoped, priced and delivered at margin. Research and analytical skill: comfortable running market research and analysing pipeline, bookings and delivery data yourself, then making a clear recommendation from it. Enablement and storytelling: you can turn a solution into a clear narrative and demo, and give sellers and delivery teams the confidence to use them. AI and data fluency: understanding of agentic AI and platforms to judge what is feasible and explain it to buyers. Range across buyers: able to shape offers for very different buyers and industries, from marketing and media to gaming. items.desc: Company Description We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Job Description The Pricing Analyst is the quantitative engine behind the pricing function — answering "how much" and "what if" by building the financial, revenue, and ROI models that operationalize pricing strategy. As a key partner to commercial, product, and strategy teams, you will help shape how Sportradar's products and services are valued and monetised. You will work across large, multi-product revenue and operational datasets, using modern AI and analytics tooling to turn data into pricing decisions at speed, while setting the standard for modelling rigour across the team. Through deep analytical expertise and an understanding of the sports betting ecosystem, you will directly influence revenue growth, profitability and decisions across the business. THE CHALLENGE Build and maintain financial revenue and ROI models that translate pricing strategy into commercial decisions. Analyze large, multi-product revenue and operational datasets to surface pricing, margin, and profitability insights. Apply AI and advanced analytics tooling to accelerate modeling, scenario analysis, and data exploration. Own and maintain global pricing structures and price lists across Sportradar's products, content, and commercial offerings. Develop scenario modeling and pricing impact analysis to evaluate commercial opportunities and support strategic pricing decisions. Support content and product valuation, including ROI assessment for content acquisition and new products. Provide business case, revenue, and ROI modeling support for new commercial initiatives, product launches, and strategic investments across Sportradar's betting and sports data portfolio. Partner with the Revenue Strategy team to ensure models reflect strategy and policy. ABOUT YOU Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative field. 3+ years in financial modeling, pricing analytics, data analysis, or commercial finance. Demonstrated experience in financial revenue modeling and ROI modeling. Strong AI skills — practical use of advanced analytics tools to accelerate analysis, modeling, and insight generation. Proven ability to analyse large revenue and operational datasets and translate them into actionable recommendations. Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; proficiency in SQL and analytics/BI tools (Python or R a strong plus). Professional experience in the sports betting/gaming industry is strongly preferred, with experience in betting products, sportsbook technology, sports data solutions or B2B data/SaaS environments is considered a significant advantage. Key Success Metrics Pricing model adoption and commercial impact Speed and quality of pricing recommendations Accuracy of content valuation OUR OFFER: A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Two Hiring Team Interviews : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! Additional Information The minimum monthly salary for this position is according to the Collective Bargaining Agreement. This is an exciting opportunity to join Humber Teaching NHS Foundation Trust as we expand and transform our neurodevelopmental services as part of an innovative all-age, needs-led model of care. The service is moving beyond traditional diagnosis-led pathways to provide earlier intervention, improved support, and better outcomes for autistic people and individuals with ADHD. We are looking for an enthusiastic and skilled registered professional to join the Neurodevelopmental Team as a Non-Medical Prescriber. This role offers the opportunity to work within a highly specialist multidisciplinary team, delivering high-quality services, supporting service development, and shaping the future of neurodevelopmental services across Hull and East Riding. You will play a key role in providing person-centred reviews, prescribing support, and treatment for children, young people, and/or adults diagnosed with ADHD, ensuring individuals receive a positive and accessible experience throughout the pathway. As a Band 7 Non-Medical Prescriber within our Neurodevelopmental Service, you will lead ADHD prescribing clinics, carrying out medication reviews, initiating and monitoring treatment, and providing specialist advice to children, young people, and/or adults, as well as their families and carers. You will have excellent communication skills, be confident in making autonomous clinical decisions, and be passionate about improving outcomes for people with ADHD and other neurodevelopmental needs. The Medicines Manufacturing Centre (MMC) is a brand-new, purpose-built NHS pharmaceutical production facility located at the Northumbria Innovation and Manufacturing Hub in Seaton Delaval, Northumberland. items.desc: The Gloucestershire Hospitals Tackling Tobacco Dependency programme (based on the Ottawa model) is the systematic implementation at scale of the treatment of tobacco dependency in secondary care and the provision of ongoing support for people, as delivered by community stop cessation services or community pharmacies. All at Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust are committed towards the Tackling Tobacco Dependency programme in our hospitals. This was the first step in developing a wider Healthy Hospitals Programme implementing the other prevention measures from the NHS Long Term Plan that are relevant to Trusts. The Tackling Tobacco Dependency programme has increased the support we offer to people who are admitted to, or attend, our Hospitals. The programme also provides more support to staff who wish to quit and help us to have smoke-free hospitals and grounds. The Tackling Tobacco Dependency programme recognises smoking as an addiction (tobacco dependency) and that it is a chronic, relapsing clinical condition that prematurely kills at least half of people who smoke. Smoking is seen as a medical condition that can be treated, rather than as a lifestyle choice. We are looking for a Tobacco Treatment Advisor to join our team to support our patients to make healthier choices and contribute towards the smokefree agenda. Additional working pattern details: Ideally seeking 2 candidates to job share Expected interview date: 08/12/2026 Specifically, the post holder will: Support the day-to-day running of the onsite tobacco treatment service to ensure safe, well-organised and evidenced-based care is offered routinely to all identified smokers and provided to all that access the service. Work with people to change their behaviour to improve their health to include patients and staff. Work autonomously in line with the Trust’s Smoke Free policy, the NHS Long Term plan, NICE guidance and NCSCT best practice guidance. Provide support in a range of settings as required for the delivery of smoking cessation service. Promote the general health and wellbeing of people who use the service through offering healthy lifestyle advice and support. Act as a Tobacco-Free Champion promoting the smoke-free message through their day-to-day work. Record and report all activities and results. Deliver training on treating tobacco dependency and ‘Very Brief Advice’ to staff groups across the Trust. Support the delivery of the service key performance and reporting indicators for tobacco dependency. Provide advice and support to ward staff, including reinforcing the training provided to inpatient teams to reduce harm from tobacco and the promotion of smoke-free settings. items.desc: Vacancy No VN662 Basis Permanent Full Time / Part Time Full Time Entity Rokstone Group Ltd Location City London Job Details Role Summary We are looking for an analytical and numerate Underwriting and Data Assistant to support Rokstone Klik and North American Casualty in London. Working alongside experienced underwriters and the Head of Pricing, you will support the underwriting, pricing and data analysis of complex US casualty risks, from construction, energy and manufacturing to emerging risks such as autonomous vehicles, digital platforms and technology-enabled mobility. The role combines risk and exposure analysis, loss data, pricing, portfolio monitoring and underwriting processing, giving you hands-on experience of how data and pricing inform risk selection and live underwriting decisions. It offers a strong foundation for a career in underwriting, pricing or insurance data. Role Accountabilities Submission workflow: log, clear and triage new broker submissions, keeping underwriting systems and workflow records complete and accurate. Broker liaison: obtain outstanding information from brokers, including underlying policies, loss runs and exposure schedules. Underwriting support: prepare risk summaries, pre-populate pricing and exposure models, and support binding, documentation and bordereaux checks. Data preparation: collect, clean and structure submission, exposure and claims data from Excel and PDF sources, including loss runs, telematics and third-party data. Quality assurance and analysis: sense check data and model outputs, identify loss drivers, trends, errors and gaps, and escalate them appropriately. Pricing support: help the Head of Pricing build, test and maintain pricing models and tools. Process improvement: help automate repetitive processing using Python, SQL and AI tools, and document what you build. Market exposure: attend broker and client meetings at Lloyd’s and in our offices, and keep up with developments in future mobility, the digital economy and US liability trends. Collaboration: act as a link between pricing and underwriting so that insight from each side informs the other. Any additional duties as assigned. Role Requirements Analytical mindset: you don’t just input data; you understand what it represents and notice when something looks “off”. Technical skills: practical experience of Python, R or SQL (through study, projects or work) and strong Excel, including handling large datasets. Attention to detail: a high level of accuracy is non-negotiable, as this data feeds underwriting and pricing decisions. Proactive work ethic: a real part of the role is processing; you’ll do it well, stay on top of fluctuating volumes and look for ways to improve and automate it. Communication: confident and clear with brokers, clients and colleagues, and inquisitive enough to ask questions and learn by observation. Skills and Abilities A strong degree (2:1 or above, or equivalent) in a numerate subject such as mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, data science, physics, economics, engineering or computer science. Confidence working with large volumes of commercial and operational data. A proactive attitude with a willingness to learn and develop. Experience within fresh produce, FMCG, food manufacturing or a supply chain environment. Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) or similar ERP systems. Experience working with financial reporting, commercial analysis, order processing or procurement data. Experience supporting retail customer accounts or supplier relationships. items.desc: Welcome to CANAL+ Group! Series, films, documentaries, programs, sports... We're dedicated to creating the best content and an immersive experience for our millions of subscribers: emotions and sensations guaranteed! How about getting behind the screen? You're bound to find your place among our 7,600 enthusiasts worldwide! To keep abreast of our latest news, don't hesitate to follow us on LinkedIn et X! STUDIOCANAL, the in-house studio of CANAL+, is Europe’s leading film and television studio. Through its in-house operations and network of 23 production companies across Europe and the US, STUDIOCANAL finances, produces and distributes around half of the group’s 200 films and 80 series each year. STUDIOCANAL owns one of the world’s most prestigious film libraries, including the largest catalogue of European films, with nearly 10,000 titles from 60 countries spanning a century of cinema. Since 2020, the studio has invested €25 million in the 4K restoration of 1,000 films, including Breathless, The Graduate, Terminator 2, and Love Actually. Building on the global success of Paddington, STUDIOCANAL is scaling its franchise model through three new labels: STUDIOCANAL Stories, focused on adapting literary hits for film and TV; STUDIOCANAL Kids & Family, dedicated to building children’s entertainment franchises, and STUDIOCANAL ON STAGE, specialising in adapting films for live theatre. Role Overview: We're looking for a Junior Designer to join our team, supporting campaigns for both our International and UK markets. This is a digital-first role with a growing print element, ideal for someone with strong graphic design fundamentals, a sharp eye for layout and a real passion for motion. You'll work from briefs across theatrical and Home Entertainment campaigns, learn from senior designers and gain exposure to stakeholders at all levels, while taking increasing ownership of your own work. Main Duties: Take briefs from internal clients and develop high-quality design concepts across film and Home Entertainment campaigns, with a focus on digital and social assets and a growing share of print. Create motion graphics and basic animation for social, digital and promotional use, from concept through to final delivery. Work closely with the International and UK marketing teams to understand territory needs and adapt campaigns accordingly. Maintain brand consistency across all marketing materials, including newer formats such as social and motion. Produce clean, well-crafted layouts across a range of formats, adapting key art and campaign assets for multiple platforms and territories. Support the team in delivering to deadlines during high-volume market periods, while learning to manage your own workload across multiple concurrent projects. Bringing conceptual thinking to a brief rather than just executing it Maintain consistency and craft standard regardless of project size or turnaround time. Knowledge of print processes and finishing is a plus, with room to develop. A strong visual sense and graphic design foundation, with the judgement to know when a concept isn't working. Motion graphics and basic animation/video editing experience (e.g. After Effects, Premiere Pro), with a good understanding of digital and social formats (Instagram, Tik Tok etc). Curious and forward-thinking about new creative tools and technology, with a practical mindset for using them thoughtfully to improve the quality and efficiency of your work. Good communication skills, with the ability to work from a brief, explain creative decisions and collaborate well within a small team. Eagerness to learn and develop, with the ability to think about a campaign's objectives, not just its deliverables. What we’ll be looking for at portfolio stage: 1–3 years' experience as an in-house or agency designer, or a strong junior portfolio. Film & TV design experience is a strong plus, but not a requirement. Strong graphic design and layout skills, with an eye for typography and detail. Motion graphics work demonstrating creativity and technical skill. Range across formats: digital, social and motion, with some print or packaging work.
