items.desc: Job Description Purpose of the Role Acer Academy is a special school for pupils aged 11-16 with a diagnosis of Autism and/or Social, Emotional and Mental Health (SEMH) needs. The academy is part of Kings Academy Trust and is committed to providing a high-quality, inclusive and personalised education for all learners. We have high aspirations for our children and young people and aim to provide a broad, balanced and relevant curriculum that supports individual, personal and academic achievement. Our goal is to ensure that every pupil has the opportunity to learn, develop and succeed, preparing them for adulthood and enabling them to become active, valued members of their local community. At Acer Academy, we believe that strong, positive relationships and a safe, nurturing environment are fundamental to pupil success. We are committed to supporting pupils’ physical and emotional wellbeing as the foundation for learning, fostering confidence, independence, and a sense of belonging. Through a personalised approach, we aim to meet each pupil’s individual needs while promoting enjoyment, engagement and achievement for all. As a Higher Level Teaching Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting pupils’ academic, social and emotional development and in contributing to high-quality teaching and learning across the academy. Working under the direction of teaching and senior staff, you will: Plan, prepare and deliver learning activities across a broad and adapted curriculum Teach individuals, small groups and whole classes during short-term teacher absence Support pupils to overcome barriers to learning and develop independence Monitor, assess and contribute to pupil progress, using this information to adapt learning Model and promote a consistent, trauma-informed and relational approach to behaviour and engagement Support and guide other support staff, contributing to effective classroom practice Help prepare pupils for successful transition into adulthood and greater independence Take responsibility for agreed areas of provision or curriculum support within the academy This role requires flexibility, resilience and a strong commitment to inclusion. It offers the opportunity to take on increased responsibility, contribute to improving outcomes for pupils, and make a meaningful difference in the lives of young people.

The successful candidate will have a strong foundation in geotechnical engineering, with particular emphasis on ground investigation interpretation,
items.desc: We are seeking a motivated and technically capable Geotechnical Engineer to join our Manchester-based ground engineering team. The role will involve supporting a range of UK infrastructure, building and civil engineering projects, undertaking geotechnical calculations and numerical analyses, preparing technical reports, and contributing to the development of practical engineering solutions. The successful candidate will have a strong foundation in geotechnical engineering, with particular emphasis on ground investigation interpretation, soil parameter assessment and geotechnical design. The candidate will work closely with senior engineers and team lead, with opportunities to develop their technical and design capabilities. Key Responsibilities 1. Ground Investigation and Interpretation Review ground investigation data, including borehole logs, laboratory testing and in-situ test results. Assist in developing ground models and selecting representative geotechnical design parameters. Contribute to the preparation and review of Ground Investigation Reports (GIRs) and Geotechnical Design Reports (GDRs). Support the preparation of ground investigation specifications and schedules of geotechnical testing. 2. Earthworks and Geotechnical Engineering Assist with earthworks design, including slope stability, settlement assessments and ground improvement solutions. Support the preparation of earthworks specifications and technical documentation. Review ground conditions and assess geotechnical risks associated with construction activities. 3. Site Attendance, Technical Support and Project Delivery Attend project sites and provide geotechnical engineering support during ground investigation, earthworks and construction activities. Undertake site inspections to assess ground conditions, construction progress and compliance with geotechnical design requirements. Supervise or monitor ground investigation activities, including borehole drilling, trial pits, in-situ testing and sampling, as required. Assist with earthworks inspections, formation assessments, ground improvement verification and geotechnical testing. Review site investigation findings and construction observations. 4. Geotechnical Design and Modelling Undertake geotechnical design calculations and assessments for foundations, retaining structures, excavations, slopes and earthworks. Develop and undertake modelling using geotechnical software packages, including appropriate soil constitutive models, ground conditions, construction stages and loading scenarios. Interpret modelling outputs, including ground movements, settlements, stresses, structural forces and factors of safety. Prepare calculation notes, modelling summaries and technical design reports. Essential Requirements Bachelor's degree in Geology, Geotechnical Engineering, Civil Engineering or a closely related discipline. Good understanding of soil mechanics, geotechnical engineering principles and soil parameter interpretation. Experience preparing GI specifications, interpretative reports or geotechnical design reports. Familiarity with UK geotechnical design standards, including Eurocode 7. Relevant experience working on UK geotechnical or civil engineering projects. Good written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to undertake site visits. Desirable Requirements Basic experience using PLAXIS 2D and/or 3D for geotechnical numerical modelling. Experience in retaining wall design, deep excavations, foundations or soil–structure interaction analysis. Familiarity with other geotechnical analysis software, such as Oasys or RS2. Master's degree in Geotechnical Engineering or a related discipline. Working towards professional chartership (CGeol, CEng or equivalent). items.desc: Company Description We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business. Job Description The BI Analyst, Market Intelligence will sit within the Market Intelligence team in the Commercial Protection Unit (CPU). The analyst will help the team turn the information it gathers into structured, reliable data and build Power BI dashboards to track the market and Sportradar’s commercial position. The role works closely with Market Intelligence and Intelligence Analysts. Inputs include analyst notes, research reports, company filings, news and spreadsheets. The analyst will organise these into clean datasets that support reporting and decision-making across Sportradar. This is a 10-month fixed-term position. Initial priorities include dashboards covering market sizing, clients, competitors and products, with further reporting that might be added as the team’s needs develop. THE CHALLENGE: Build and maintain Power BI dashboards on the market, clients, competitors and products, and develop new ones as the team’s needs change. Turn analyst notes, reports, filings, news and spreadsheets into clean, consistent datasets. Combine data from different sources, reconciling conflicting figures and flagging gaps. Set up a simple, well-structured data model that new dashboards can build on. Set up a repeatable process for adding new intelligence so dashboards stay current, with scheduled refreshes where possible. Use Power Query and DAX to prepare data and create the measures each dashboard needs. Run regular data quality checks, such as removing duplicates and keeping company names consistent. Work with Market Intelligence Analysts to understand what they need and turn it into clear metrics and visuals. Document data sources, definitions and dashboard logic so the work can be handed over at the end of the contract. Support ad hoc data and reporting requests from the team. YOUR PROFILE: At least 1 year’s experience in data analysis, reporting or business intelligence. Hands-on experience building dashboards in Power BI, including Power Query and basic DAX. Understanding of basic data modelling in Power BI (relationships, fact and dimension tables). Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, data cleaning). Experience cleaning and organising messy data into usable datasets. Good eye for clear, simple dashboard design. Good attention to detail and a structured approach to data quality. Able to turn business questions into clear metrics and visuals. Able to explain data clearly to non-technical colleagues. Comfortable handling changing priorities and several requests at once. You enjoy solving problems, working collaboratively across teams, and finding better ways to do things, ensuring quality and consistency are built into every stage of the process. You will: Have practical CAD experience and the ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and product requirements accurately. Demonstrate strong technical drawing and CAD-modelling skills, with exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality documentation. Be proactive, adaptable, and willing to travel when required to support individual projects and business needs. items.desc: Ready to make your mark? Start your career at Perch Group as a Graduate Portfolio Performance Analyst. At Perch Group, our vision is clear: to lead the UK debt purchase and collection industry by harnessing cutting-edge technology to drive ethical, efficient, and data-driven debt resolution. Our annual mission is to empower hundreds of thousands of customers to positively engage with and resolve their outstanding debts. We do this through an empathetic and customer-centric approach that is at the heart of our success. What are we looking for? The Graduate Portfolio Performance Analyst role is a brand-new position within the Investment function, where you’ll use data and analysis to monitor portfolio acquisitions, develop analytical tools, KPIs and dashboards, and ultimately help drive portfolio performance. You’ll support the Head of Portfolio Performance in identifying root causes of inefficiencies and providing insights across gross collections, cost optimisation and customer journeys, highlighting early warning signs and helping stakeholders take action. You’ll work closely with teams across Pricing, Decision Science, Finance, Analytics, Implementation and Operations, giving you broad exposure across the business and regular interaction with senior management. We’re looking for someone who is highly analytical, commercially minded and self-motivated, with the ability to turn insight into impact and communicate confidently at all levels. As a new role in an ambitious and growing business, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to make your mark. So, what will your day-to-day look like? You’ll work as part of the Investment Director’s team, supporting the Head of Portfolio Performance across several areas, including but not limited to: [35%] Support in the execution, optimisation, analysis and monitoring of Perch’s regular intake of forward flow debt sales to drive optimal performance and to ensure any deviations in file quality or performance are tracked and fed back to the business. [25%] Building analytical tools, developing dashboards and interacting with natural language AI tools, to query, track and monitor Perch Capital’s onboarding journey and strategies, across a range of KPI’s and SLA’s, both in aggregate across all portfolios acquired and tailored analysis for specific, strategic clients and cohorts of acquired debts (such as ‘Paying’ accounts), vs modelling assumptions. This includes the operational readiness to achieve projected targets (both recoveries & timings) of future placements of accounts to other entities within the Perch Group family, including Perch Verify (the Group’s in-house field connect service) and TMLS (the Group’s in-house law firm). [25%] Conduct investigative in-depth analysis and ‘hand-holding’ of key strategic portfolios from a performance perspective, reviewing Perch’s systems and processes, tracking the flow of accounts through strategies, down to an account level if required, in order to quickly identify the root cause of any discrepancies in performance and feeding this information back to key stakeholders. This spans both gross collections and modelled costs. [10%] Working with Pricing, Decision Science, Finance and Analytics to identify and target any emerging trends of divergence vs underwriting and/or ERC assumptions, followed by granular deep dives into Perch processes to establish if root cause is driven by any operational or system failure or inefficiency and feeding back insights to improve alignment across the business and improve future forecasting accuracy. [5%] Supporting the Head of Portfolio Performance in the running and managing of a number of key internal stakeholder meetings, where portfolio performance is discussed and early warning signs are raised, to be supported by analysis and MI, spanning a range of key milestones in the collections journey. [Square brackets] intended to give approximate indication as to time allocation for a typical week and may vary on a day-to-day basis. Does this sound like you? Strong academic background within a quantitative discipline, e.g. STEM fields(s), Economics, Finance; and/or Up to 1 years’ relevant work experience of demonstratable experience in analysis within financial services (exposure to debt purchasing and/or credit related sectors is desirable). Proven ability to manage multiple high value workstreams in parallel, delivering to tight deadlines. Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to consolidate and interpret complex information from multiple sources Analytical mindset with the ability to understand and analyse large data sets to identify errors or gaps in a process (an audit or equivalent background would be highly suited to this role). Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge and escalate where appropriate. Excellent numerical, written and verbal communication skills. We’re hiring: Junior–Mid Software Developer Finset is looking for someone to join our development team in an AI-first engineering role. You’ll start with software testing and technical support, working across different parts of the system. As you get to know the codebase, you’ll help with improvements and new development too. This isn’t a role where you’ll spend most of your day writing code from scratch. You’ll use AI to help investigate issues, write tests and implement changes. You still need to know how to code. The job is to understand the problem, give AI a clear brief, review what it produces and prove that the change works. What you’ll do: - Test new features and fixes, including edge cases and what happens when something fails. - Reproduce bugs and trace them through the browser, API and codebase to find out where they start. - Use AI to explore the code, build tests and prepare fixes for the team to review. - Check changes against what was actually asked for, look for unintended side effects and explain what you verified. - Help across the development team as priorities change, taking on more varied engineering work as you build confidence. What we’re looking for - Coding fundamentals. You can read and debug JavaScript or TypeScript, make changes yourself when needed and explain the code you submit. - A practical understanding of APIs. You’re comfortable with HTTP requests and responses, JSON, authentication and status codes. You know how to inspect a failed request and start working out why it failed. - Good testing and debugging habits. You’re comfortable with Git, browser developer tools and a tool like Postman. Basic SQL is useful. - Good judgement with AI. You don’t assume the first answer is right. You know when to check the source, run another test or ask the team for help. Interested? Send us your CV and a short example of a bug you investigated or a change you tested. Tell us what you found and how you knew it was fixed. If you used AI, tell us what it helped with and what you checked yourself. Pay: £32,000.00-£40,000.00 per year Benefits: Casual dress Company pension Work Location: In person

items.desc: Fuse is an AI-first energy company on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.We’ve raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We’re building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. As part of this mission, we are looking for a Data Protection Officer to join our team. As we scale our customer base, move into data centres and expand across jurisdictions, you will build the data protection function from the ground up. This is an opportunity to join an ambitious startup at the forefront of the energy transition and set the standard for how a new kind of energy company handles personal data. You will perform your DPO duties independently, reporting directly to the highest level of management on data protection matters, with appropriate resources and support. You will advise and monitor compliance, while accountability for compliance remains with Fuse. Responsibilities Own data subject rights: Build and run a clear, scalable process for handling data subject rights requests, including data subject access requests (DSARs), as our customer base grows, including high volumes of requests. Lead cross-border data transfers: Assess whether personal data is involved and identify applicable transfer requirements as we expand into data centres and new jurisdictions. Put appropriate safeguards, including data transfer agreements, in place, and carry out and document relevant transfer risk assessments. Assess privacy risks: Analyse personal data processing and associated privacy risks, including the processing of special category data. Work with relevant teams to design and maintain secure ways of handling personal data across the business, including information about vulnerable customers and customers with specific needs, including through welfare visits. Sharpen our policies: Review and improve our internal policies, standard terms and conditions, privacy policy and GDPR documentation so they are accurate, compliant and easy for customers to understand. Embed with the business: Give crisp, practical advice to Legal, Operations, Product and Engineering, including on new products, AI tools, personal data breach response and contracts that touch personal data. Help teams move fast with confidence. Build scalable infrastructure: Create the registers, templates, playbooks and training that make data protection work day to day, and use technology to automate the routine. Monitor compliance: Monitor compliance with applicable data protection laws and internal policies, including through audits; advise on and monitor data protection impact assessments (DPIAs); and act as a contact point for individuals and the ICO, cooperating with the ICO as required. Deliver the full DPO remit: Carry out all DPO functions under applicable data protection laws and provide data protection advice and support across the business as its needs evolve. Understand commercial and operational objectives, identify privacy risks and proactively propose practical, proportionate solutions that meet applicable data protection requirements and help teams achieve those objectives. Requirements Proven experience building data protection processes from scratch (or advising on how to), rather than running an established programme in a large enterprise Strong working knowledge of UK GDPR and other applicable data protection laws, including DSAR handling, special category data, DPIAs and international data transfers Hands-on experience with data transfer agreements and documented privacy and transfer risk assessments A tech-forward mindset, with the confidence to modernise policies and make privacy practical for customers Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple projects Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Enthusiasm for renewable energy, decentralisation, and technology-driven change Benefits Competitive salary and eligibility for equity Biannual bonus scheme Fully expensed tech to match your needs Private health insurance Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

items.desc: At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals! As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People. At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights. Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today! Your Role: We are looking for an experienced Operational Excellence professional with a strong understanding of Quality Control operations to drive operational performance, efficiency and strategic improvement across our global manufacturing network. This is not a hands-on laboratory or analytical testing role . The position focuses on translating laboratory operations into measurable business outcomes, connecting QC performance with manufacturing capacity, supply chain requirements, cost efficiency and long-term operational planning. You will work at both strategic and tactical levels, partnering with QC leadership, manufacturing operations and global cross-functional teams to identify performance gaps, develop improvement strategies and implement sustainable operational solutions. The successful candidate will bring a strong combination of QC operational knowledge, Lean/Operational Excellence expertise, data-driven decision-making and business acumen , with the ability to influence stakeholders and deliver measurable improvements across multiple sites. Your Responsibilities: Drive Global QC Operational Excellence Strategy Lead and implement complex, cross-functional Operational Excellence initiatives across the global QC laboratory network, ensuring alignment with manufacturing and business priorities. Develop and standardize QC capacity planning, resource optimization and scheduling models aligned with manufacturing demand and long-range production plans. Identify operational constraints, inefficiencies and opportunities to improve laboratory productivity, testing capacity, turnaround times and overall network performance. Translate QC Performance into Business Impact Use operational KPIs, performance analytics and financial data to identify improvement opportunities, support business decisions and measure results. items.desc: W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma wartość tylko wtedy, gdy realnie wspiera działanie organizacji i jej kluczowe procesy. AI nie jest wyjątkiem – dlatego zamiast kolejnego pilotażu „dla pokazu” budujemy rozwiązania, z których codziennie korzystają inżynierowie serwisowi. Nasz zespół Managed Services odpowiada za utrzymanie i rozwój środowisk IT oraz OT naszych klientów, dbając o stabilność, bezpieczeństwo i ciągłość działania systemów. Pracujemy w środowiskach o wysokich wymaganiach dostępności i niezawodności, blisko Service Managerów i użytkowników. Teraz otwieramy w tym zespole nowe stanowisko: AI Engineer , który pokaże, gdzie AI naprawdę skraca czas rozwiązywania incydentów, a następnie zbuduje to i utrzyma. Praca w modelu hybrydowym. Współpracujesz z zespołem AI Etteplan (m.in. z Finlandią) oraz zespołem Industrial Software Solutions. Dlaczego warto? To rzadka okazja, żeby pracować z generatywną AI na prawdziwych danych serwisowych (tickety, runbooki, monitoring, logi), a nie na przykładach z tutoriali. Budujesz na gotowych modelach (Azure OpenAI lub porównywalnych) i własnych narzędziach, widzisz efekt u użytkowników i odpowiadasz za jego jakość. Pierwsze 3 miesiące to praca wewnętrzna na danych Etteplan – bez presji kontaktu z klientem, za to z czasem na zrozumienie serwisów i wypracowanie pierwszych wyników. Potem wdrożenia u klientów, także w przemyśle i OT. Docelowo zespół AI w Managed Services ma urosnąć do 2–3 osób, a Ty będziesz tym, który go zaczyna. Nie wymagamy określonego stażu ani dyplomu. Wymagamy czegoś, co działa – i umiejętności opowiedzenia, jak to zrobiłeś/-aś. W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za: analizę serwisu razem z Service Managerem: jakie mamy dane, gdzie AI da realny efekt, co jest wykonalne i bezpieczne, budowę asystentów opartych na gotowych modelach: wyszukiwanie w ticketach i runbookach (RAG), sugestie rozwiązań dla L1/L2, automatyczne raporty i podsumowania, klasyfikację zgłoszeń, integracje z narzędziami serwisowymi (ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, Datadog, Teams) – przez API i skrypty, konfigurację i utrzymanie gotowych agentów (np. Azure SRE Agent) tam, gdzie klient pracuje w Azure, pomiar efektu: metryki bazowe, jakość odpowiedzi, koszty użycia modeli, raportowanie wyników do Service Managera, utrzymanie zbudowanych rozwiązań: aktualizację bazy wiedzy, monitoring jakości, reagowanie na spadek trafności, współpracę z zespołem AI Etteplan (reużycie istniejących komponentów) i zespołem Sharq, po fazie wewnętrznej: udział w rozmowach z klientami o wdrożeniu AI w ich serwisie, w tym w obszarze OT. Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli: zbudował(a)ś co najmniej jedno działające rozwiązanie na modelu językowym przez API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic lub open-source) – chatbota, asystenta, automatyzację lub RAG; może to być projekt komercyjny, wewnętrzny lub własny z repozytorium, rozumiesz, jak działa RAG: podział dokumentów, embeddingi, wyszukiwanie, odpowiedź ze wskazaniem źródła – i wiesz, dlaczego model halucynuje oraz jak to ograniczać, piszesz czytelny kod w Pythonie i potrafisz uruchomić oraz zdebugować cudzy, umiesz podłączyć się do REST API (uwierzytelnianie, pobranie i przetworzenie danych), znasz SQL na poziomie podstawowym i potrafisz łączyć dane z kilku źródeł, samodzielnie rozpoznajesz problem, proponujesz rozwiązanie i tłumaczysz je osobie nietechnicznej, dokumentujesz swoją pracę, komunikujesz się po polsku i po angielsku na poziomie B2 (dokumentacja, zespół AI w Finlandii, klienci), potrafisz powiedzieć „tego nie da się zrobić sensownie” i zaproponować coś prostszego. Doświadczenie na poziomie 1–4 lat w AI lub programowaniu jest dla nas wskazówką, nie barierą – juniorów z mocnym portfolio GenAI zapraszamy tak samo. items.desc: Qui sommes nous ? 🏠 Crédit Agricole Personal Finance & Mobility, filiale à 100 % du Groupe Crédit Agricole, est un leader du financement personnel et un acteur majeur de la mobilité durable en Europe. Présent dans 22 pays, le groupe accompagne chaque jour les particuliers dans la réalisation de leurs projets grâce à une large gamme de solutions de financement, de paiement, d’assurance et de mobilité. À travers ses activités il contribue également à la transition énergétique dans les domaines de l’habitat, de la consommation et des déplacements. Rejoindre Crédit Agricole Personal Finance & Mobility, c’est intégrer un environnement riche en métiers et en expertises au sein d’un groupe engagé, innovant et reconnu pour la qualité de vie au travail. Et parce que les talents de demain se construisent aujourd’hui, nous vous donnons les moyens d’apprendre, d’oser, de contribuer et de grandir avec nous ! Découvrez notre univers Vous rejoindrez l’équipe Modélisation Crédit au sein de la direction Crédit Groupe dont la mission est de développer ou accompagner les entités internationales dans le développement des modèles de scoring sur toute la chaîne crédit (octroi, prévention, recouvrement, contentieux, score jeune, score fraude) , mettre à disposition des outils d’automatisation et contribuer à l’optimisation des systèmes d’octroi (scorecards et règles métiers), réaliser une veille technologique existants (open Banking, intelligence artificielle, intelligence augmentée,etc) pour challenger les process existants et animer la communauté internationale des Data Scientist Credit CA PFM (échanges réguliers sur des sujets innovants, newsletters, Hackathon, etc). Concrètement, que ferez-vous ? Vous serez intégré à l’équipe modélisation crédit composée de data scientists Travaux de R&D autour des problématiques crédit Proposer et mettre en pratique les modèles statistiques (régressions…) ou de data science (machine learning…) pour résoudre les problématiques métier Crédit (Octroi, Fraude, Prevention, Recouvrement) ou Valeur Résiduelle Traiter les données, structurées ou non structurées Analyse statistique des résultats et optimisation du modèle Restituer les résultats (rapports, présentations…) Dans le cadre de ces travaux, le candidat devra s’impliquer fortement dans la compréhension de l’activité Crédit, et être force de proposition. Le profil que nous recherchons Niveau D’études Préparé ☒Bac +5 Formation Mathématiques appliquées, Statistiques, Data science Outils Informatiques Python, R, Git La connaissance de Dataiku, de Data Vizualisation (Qlik, Tableau), de SAS serait un plus Compétences Recherchées Modèles statistiques, Machine learning, Série temporelle, Econométrie Esprit d'équipe, aisance relationnelle Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse Rigueur et Curiosité Langues Anglais professionnel Durée Souhaitée 6 mois Ce qui compte pour nous Vous apporterez votre énergie, vos idées et votre regard neuf. items.desc: Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability. Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services. Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. Contexte Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ? Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu. Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing. Volet recherche (environ 3 mois) Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes. Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données. Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing. Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science. Volet produit (environ 3 mois) Transformer la méthode en un module Python testé, compatible avec nos outils de modélisation bayésienne (le MMM en premier). Construire les sorties destinées aux métiers : une vue « ce qui a fait bouger l'estimation » et une alerte de mise à jour. Les valider avec des consultants sur des cas réels, puis les documenter et les transmettre à l'équipe produit. Livrables attendus Un article soumis à une revue ou une conférence à comité de lecture. Un module Python testé et documenté, intégré à nos outils de modélisation. Un guide court pour les consultants : comment lire et expliquer une attribution. Profil Étudiant ou étudiante en dernière année de master ou d'école d'ingénieurs, en statistique, science des données ou probabilités. Statistique bayésienne (prior, posterior, MCMC), et idéalement séries temporelles ou modèles à espace d'états. Bonne maîtrise de Python (NumPy, une librairie de programmation probabiliste comme PyMC ou NumPyro), Git, tests unitaires. Intérêt pour l'application de la statistique au marketing et pour l'explication des résultats à des non-spécialistes. Aucune connaissance préalable en marketing n'est requise. Rédaction claire en anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu , que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte. Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même. En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations. Your role and impact We are looking for a full-stack, AI-native software engineer to join our group. This role will be based in our Edinburgh office and managed remotely from San Francisco. The successful candidate will bring strong curiosity, excellent interpersonal skills and an interest in modeling interdependent systems. Most of our existing services are written in TypeScript, with a technology stack that includes Prisma ORM, Postgres, Fastify and React. We therefore prefer candidates who already have experience working with full-stack TypeScript/Node.js. However, we are happy to consider candidates who are proficient in other typed languages - especially if they have experience in other relevant areas (see below). Your Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgment and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Collaborating With Enterprise Resilience Colleagues, You Will Use coding agents to develop secure, scalable software in support of business goals. Develop scheduled jobs, data feeds and automation to support day-to-day resilience planning. Develop software that models BlackRock's business dependencies and simulates disruptions. Help develop agentic AI tools that let stakeholders easily interact with their data. Fix bugs, help colleagues, build relationships with stakeholders and develop a keen understanding of business resilience. Required Your experience Bachelor's degree in a scientific or engineering discipline, or equivalent experience. Professional full-stack software engineering experience. Exceptional problem solving skills: able to evaluate evidence objectively, think critically, and propose rational solutions. Strong AI agent management skills. A good understanding of the strengths and weaknesses of AI coding agents. Comfortable prompting, managing and verifying the work of agents. Refined creative instincts. Leverages AI to generate polished user interfaces aligned with a design system. Excellent written communication. Uses AI as a technical resource, not as a ghostwriter. Experience using relational databases, either via raw SQL or an ORM. Comfortable analyzing, cleaning and reshaping complex relational data. Proficient in standard aspects of web service development, including user authorization, caching, API design, database schema design, and testing. Familiar with standard development practices, such as source control and command line use. Strong relationship and stakeholder management skills. Storytelling skills: can build a narrative and keep the audience engaged. Preferred Experience modeling interdependent systems and how disruption propagates through them, for example graph-based dependency analysis or time-stepped simulation. Background in a domain that involves systemic modeling, such as industrial ecology, epidemiology, systems biology, statistical physics, supply chain management, traffic simulation or utility network modeling. Full-stack TypeScript/Node.js experience. Experience with the React front-end framework. Some product management experience (can be informal). A sustained interest in generative AI, with experience making agent skills or tools. Nice to have These aren't deal breakers, but we would love to hear if you have experience with them. Experience building games, game mods or simulation engines, especially strategy or simulation games with many interdependent entities. Experience with business continuity, operational resilience, or civil disaster preparedness. Experience working with geospatial data. Experience developing agent harnesses or building services that use generative AI. Prior experience interacting with the Salesforce platform. Hobbies or projects that demonstrate the candidate's curiosity. Hiring Manager's Note If you choose to apply for this position, thank you! We try to read all resumes, and a personally written resume that tells your story will be strongly appreciated. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. items.desc: AI & Data Engineer (part-time, 12 mesi) – Società di srchitettura (Firenze) Siamo uno studio di architettura con circa 60 professionisti, e cerchiamo un ingegnere informatico che ci aiuti a mettere ordine nei nostri dati e a valorizzarli con l’intelligenza artificiale. Il ruolo prevede responsabilità operative e un forte coinvolgimento nei progetti di digitalizzazione e innovazione tecnologica dello studio, con tre obiettivi nell’arco di 12 mesi: automatizzare e pulire l’archiviazione dei dati, creare una knowledge base comune e creare una suite di agenti per l’estrazione e l’analisi dei dati esistenti per attività centrali (amministrazione, gestione di controllo, legal) e di progetto. Cosa farai Mapperai le fonti di dati dello studio (NAS, server, Microsoft 365, piattaforme di progetto come BIM360) e aggiornerai le regole condivise di archiviazione (struttura delle cartelle, naming, backup, archiviazione dei progetti chiusi) Automatizzerai la pulizia e l’archiviazione dei dati (classificazione, deduplicazione, archiviazione) con script e flussi di lavoro documentati Creerai la knowledge base comune dello studio, con ricerca semantica e risposte che citano le fonti, e ne supporterai l’adozione da parte dei colleghi Progetterai e svilupperai agenti AI per l’estrazione e l’analisi dei dati esistenti (ad esempio contratti, preventivi, commesse, ore e costi), con verifica umana nei passaggi critici Monitorerai la sicurezza dei dati aziendali (backup, policy di accesso, GDPR), anche nell’uso di servizi AI Supporterai lo sviluppo di plug-in per l'automazione di processi in ambito BIM Chi cerchiamo 2-4 anni di esperienza attiva nella realizzazione concreta di soluzioni software e di automazione dei dati Ottima conoscenza di Python e SQL, di API e della gestione di dati non strutturati (PDF, documenti Office) Esperienza pratica con LLM e agenti AI (RAG, embedding, database vettoriali) e familiarità con Microsoft 365 e servizi di cloud computing Spirito pratico, precisione e passione per l’AI, dimostrabile con progetti concreti Laurea in ingegneria informatica o discipline affini Interesse nella architettura e gestione dei dati aziendali é un plus Cosa offriamo Contratto part-time di 12 mesi a Partita IVA (circa 20 ore a settimana, da confermare), con possibilità di proseguire la collaborazione in base ai risultati Ambiente dinamico e collaborativo Sede a Firenze (presenza in sede richiesta, con flessibilità)

items.desc: Cerchiamo un/una AI Developer che porti l’intelligenza artificiale dentro i processi dell’azienda lavorando a fianco della direzione. In Miraia lavoriamo a una tecnologia che non si accontenta di sapere se un documento c’è. Vuole sapere se è giusto. Lo legge, lo capisce e in pochi secondi ti dice se è in regola. Cerchiamo una persona che porti l’IA nei nostri processi aziendali, attraverso ricerca e sperimentazione continue. Ti confronterai direttamente con la direzione e lavorerai al fianco del team di sviluppo e dei responsabili di funzione. Non è un ruolo in cui si esegue un progetto già scritto: sarai tu a individuare dove l’intelligenza artificiale può fare la differenza, a progettare le soluzioni e a portarle in produzione. Il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto diretto e visibile, sia sul prodotto che offriamo ai clienti sia sul modo in cui lavoriamo ogni giorno. Di cosa ti occuperai Progettare, testare e migliorare prompt e flussi di lavoro basati su modelli linguistici; Sviluppare integrazioni con le API dei principali provider di AI di modelli linguistici; Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni basate su architetture RAG, integrando modelli linguistici con basi di conoscenza, documentazione aziendale e fonti dati strutturate e non strutturate; Sviluppare modelli di Machine Learning a partire da dati storici, con l'obiettivo di realizzare soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale predittiva. Formare il team di sviluppo interno; Cosa porti con te Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software e in progetti di IA applicata; Laurea in informatica, ingegneria o matematica, oppure un’esperienza tecnica equivalente e dimostrabile; Conoscenza del linguaggio di programmazione Python; Esperienza nello sviluppo di integrazione API con i principali provider di modelli linguistici; Conoscenza del linguaggio SQL e DB SQL; Conoscenza dei database vettoriali e tecnologie RAG; Conoscenza dei formati e delle strutture dati JSON; Conoscenza dei framework e librerie per Machine Learning; Conoscenza degli strumenti per l'elaborazione delle immagini e l'estrazione del testo, quali OpenCV e Tesseract; Conoscenza dei docker e principali strumenti di containerizzazione; Cosa offriamo Contratto a tempo indeterminato RAL 40-45K Sede a Torino Sud, in Corso Tazzoli Un impatto diretto sul prodotto e un dialogo quotidiano con la direzione Ti riconosci? Candidati inviando il tuo CV. Ai sensi della normativa vigente le offerte di lavoro si intendono rivolte a entrambi i sessi (D.Lgs. 198/06). I dati personali saranno trattati e conservati esclusivamente per finalità di selezione presenti e/o future, garantendo i diritti di cui agli artt. da 15 a 22 del Regolamento UE 2016/679 GDPR relativo alla protezione dei dati personali. L’informativa completa per il trattamento dei dati personali è disponibile all’indirizzo web https://www.miraia.it MIRAIA si oppone al razzismo, al sessismo e a tutte le forme di discriminazione. Crediamo che la diversità sia una ricchezza e favorisca un ambiente di lavoro migliore e un mondo migliore. Promuoviamo l’uguaglianza e l’inclusione nell’acquisizione dei talenti, nella nostra cultura aziendale e nell’elaborazione dei nostri progetti. Se ti unirai a noi, accoglieremo i tuoi valori e le tue idee.

items.desc: Vill du vara med och bygga stabila och framtidssäkrade AI-tjänster som skapar ett direkt och långsiktigt värde för verksamheten ? Nu söker vi AI-utvecklare som vill omsätta generativ AI och språkmodeller i praktiska tillämpningar hos FMV. Här får du kombinera programmering med utforskande utvecklingsarbete och samarbeta med kollegor från olika delar av verksamheten. Du får vara med och bygga förutsättningar för AI-utveckling: plattform, verktyg, metoder etc. Tillsammans utvecklar ni lösningar som bidrar till FMV:s uppdrag att stärka Försvarsmaktens och Sveriges förmåga. . Om tjänsten Som AI-utvecklare arbetar du med att utveckla och integrera AI-funktionalitet i FMV:s IT-miljö. Du bidrar i pågående AI-initiativ och utvecklar tillämpningar för bland annat dokumentbearbetning, informationssökning och användning av språkmodeller. Arbetet omfattar RAG, där språkmodeller kombineras med sökning i relevanta informationskällor. Du arbetar med systemutveckling i Python, integrationer och datahantering. Tillsammans med kollegor och verksamhetsrepresentanter undersöker du behov, prövar tekniska lösningar och utvärderar resultaten. Du bidrar också till att lösningarna kan implementeras, driftsättas och förvaltas med hänsyn till kvalitet och säker informationshantering. I rollen får du arbeta tvärfunktionellt med utvecklare och andra kompetenser inom IT och verksamhet. Det ger dig möjlighet att följa hur tekniken används och bidra till lösningar som fungerar i sitt sammanhang. Du får även vara med och utveckla arbetssätt för hur FMV tar till vara möjligheterna med AI. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm. Om dig Vi söker dig med relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller programvaruutveckling, alternativt motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling i Python och praktisk erfarenhet av generativ AI och språkmodeller, inklusive RAG, dokumentbearbetning och informationssökning. Du har arbetat med relevanta verktyg och ramverk för AI-utveckling och modellkörning. Du har även erfarenhet av system- och applikationsintegration, API, datahantering och databaser samt av att integrera AI-funktionalitet i applikationer. Du har praktisk erfarenhet av att testa och utvärdera AI-lösningar samt av implementation och driftsättning i molnbaserade eller lokala IT-miljöer (on-premise). Du är van vid versionshantering, exempelvis Git, och har förståelse för informationssäkerhet, behörighetsstyrning och säker informationshantering. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av avancerad AI-assisterad programvaruutveckling, exempelvis agentbaserade kodverktyg, automatiserad kodgenerering och AI-stödd testning. Meriterande är även erfarenhet av fullstack-utveckling, TypeScript och prototyputveckling där hypoteser och verksamhetsbehov omsätts i lösningar som kan prövas och utvärderas. Även kvalitetssäkring med dokumenterade testfall för sökrelevans, källtrogenhet och svarskvalitet är meriterande. Vi ser gärna att du har arbetat med större AI-plattformar, verktyg för RAG, dokumentbearbetning och modellhantering. Erfarenhet av containerbaserade utvecklingsmiljöer, CI/CD och DevOps/MLOps är också meriterande. Det är även meriterande om du har arbetat med privata eller hybrida AI-miljöer, i större organisationer med höga krav på säkerhet och dokumentation eller i isolerade IT-miljöer, så kallade air-gapped-system. Erfarenhet av försvarssektorn eller annan säkerhetskänslig verksamhet är ytterligare meriterande. Personliga egenskaper är av stor vikt för oss. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken och tar initiativ till att undersöka och lösa tekniska problem. Du arbetar strukturerat och tar ansvar för att driva dina uppgifter framåt. Du samarbetar väl med andra och kan förklara tekniska frågor på ett begripligt sätt. Du har också förmåga att se hur en teknisk lösning kan möta verksamhetens behov. FMV – Försvarets materielverk På FMV är du med och bidrar till att göra Sverige och världen säkrare. Vi har i uppdrag att förse det svenska försvaret med den senaste tekniken och kunskapen så att de kan försvara vårt land och våra allierade. Tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor får du vara med och utveckla och upphandla det som ibland inte existerar än. Du driver utvecklingen, hela vägen från behov till leverans. Från idé till verklighet. Du kommer att arbeta på infrastrukturstaben som ansvarar för IT, lokaler och annan verksamhetskritisk infrastruktur som möjliggör ett effektivt och säkert arbete. Hos FMV erbjuds du en trygg anställning med bra förmåner: Kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter Flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete i den mån arbetet tillåter Tjänstepension och friskvårdsbidrag Läs mer om FMV som arbetsgivare och om de förmåner vi erbjuder på vår hemsida: Arbeta på FMV. items.desc: Vos Challenges L’objectif n’est pas de reproduire autrement ce qui existe déjà mais de questionner nos façons de travailler, d’explorer ce que les nouvelles technologies rendent possible et d’imaginer de nouvelles approches pour les métiers de l’audit. Vous travaillerez en lien avec différentes parties prenantes, notamment les équipes d’audit et les équipes IT, afin de faire émerger, construire et déployer des solutions à fort impact. L’ambition est de ne pas s’arrêter à l’idée, mais d’aller jusqu’à sa mise en œuvre et son passage à l’échelle. Au sein de l'équipe Digital Audit Innovation , votre mission consiste à : Développer des cas d’usage autour de l’IA générative et des agents IA, notamment avec Microsoft Copilot Studio et Cowork. Imaginer et construire de nouvelles solutions digitales répondant à des besoins métiers concrets, en lien avec les différentes parties prenantes, notamment les équipes d’audit et les équipes IT. Conduire les solutions de l’idée à la mise en œuvre, puis accompagner leur passage à l’échelle. Automatiser des processus avec Power Automate et, selon les projets, Python ou des API. Créer des tableaux de bord et outils de pilotage avec Power BI, Power Query et DAX. Utiliser GitHub pour versionner, documenter et partager les développements et composants réutilisables. Participer au déploiement des solutions et à leur adoption par les équipes. Votre environnement technologique sera le suivant : Microsoft Power Platform : Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Power Automate et Copilot Studio pour le pilotage, l’automatisation et la création d’agents IA. Microsoft 365 & IA : Microsoft 365 Copilot, Cowork, Excel, Teams et SharePoint pour explorer de nouveaux usages, collaborer et intégrer les solutions aux pratiques des équipes. Stack GitHub & développement : Git, GitHub, repositories, branches, commits, pull requests et README ; Python, API et JSON pour développer, connecter, versionner et documenter les solutions. Votre Profil Et si ce stage était la prochaine étape de votre parcours ? Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de césure ou de fin d’études , à partir de janvier 2027 . Vous avez envie de baigner dans un environnement en évolution permanente, où les technologies, les usages et les façons de travailler se réinventent rapidement. items.desc: Kan du omsætte forretningsbehov og governancekrav til konkrete processer og digitale løsninger? Brænder du for at skabe struktur, sikre ansvarlig anvendelse af AI og arbejde med digital understøttelse af governance? Har du en teknisk forståelse og interesse for digitale platforme, eller er du stærk inden for governance, compliance og procesdesign? Så er du måske vores nye tekniske analytiker i Koncern IT’s AI-afdeling. Vi søger en kollega, der kan bygge bro mellem forretning, governance og teknologi. Vi er åbne for forskellige faglige profiler og for, hvor teknisk du er. Du kan have en stærk teknisk baggrund med erfaring i systemer, platforme og workflows, eller du kan have en mere proces- og governanceorienteret baggrund med erfaring i at omsætte krav til konkrete arbejdsgange og løsninger. Det vigtigste er, at du har interesse for samspillet mellem områderne og lyst til at være med til at udvikle vores arbejde med AI-governance. Hvem er vi? I Koncern IT (KIT) arbejder vi for et digitalt København. Vores AI-afdeling udvikler AI-løsninger, der skaber værdi for borgere og medarbejdere i hele kommunen. Vores hovedopgave er at skabe værdi for medarbejdere, borgere og virksomheder i Københavns Kommune ved at lave analyser, træne modeller og sætte komplette løsninger i produktion samt at udbrede viden om AI til hele kommunen. Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø med mere end 40 kollegaer, der arbejder med AI som deres primære arbejdsområde. Vi arbejder med opgaver, der spænder over alt fra identifikation af graffiti, outlier detection på store indkøbsdatasæt, billede- og tekst-klassificering til dokumentgenkendelse på byggesager samt tekstgenerering og sagsopsummering med store sprogmodeller og udvikling af RAG-løsninger. Derudover rådgiver vi forvaltningerne i udvikling og anskaffelse af AI-løsninger. Vi er samtidig i gang med at etablere nye rammer og processer for governance af AI-løsninger. I den forbindelse tager vi en ny platform i brug, som skal understøtte vores governancearbejde og gøre det lettere at arbejde struktureret med processer, krav og godkendelser på tværs af organisationen. Hvad skal du lave? Som teknisk analytiker bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at omsætte vores governancekrav og forretningsmæssige behov til konkrete og velfungerende processer i platformen. Du skal være med til at konfigurere og videreudvikle platformens flows, så de understøtter vores arbejdsgange og sikrer, at relevante krav og kontroller bliver indarbejdet i praksis. Dine opgaver vil afhænge af dine kompetencer og din faglige profil. Du kan fx arbejde mere teknisk med konfiguration, integrationer og automatisering eller have større fokus på governance, kravspecifikation, procesdesign og organisatorisk implementering. Uanset dit faglige tyngdepunkt kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med AI-teamet, informationssikkerhedsspecialister og digitaliseringskonsulenter i fagforvaltningerne. Du bliver en del af bindeleddet mellem forretningsmæssige behov, governance- og compliancekrav samt den tekniske understøttelse i platformen. Dine hovedopgaver bliver konfiguration og videreudvikling af governanceflows, herunder procestrin, roller, regler og godkendelser omsætning af governancekrav til konkrete workflows og arbejdsgange, der understøtter en ansvarlig udvikling, anskaffelse og anvendelse af AI-løsninger samarbejde med sikkerhedsafdelingerne om at indarbejde relevante krav til informationssikkerhed, risikovurderinger og dokumentation i platformens flows dialog med fagforvaltningerne om deres behov og arbejdsgange samt sikring af, at platformens processer fungerer i praksis dokumentation, test og kvalitetssikring af konfigurationer og processer samt løbende forbedring af platformens understøttelse af governancearbejdet udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af teknisk dokumentation for data science-løsninger, herunder sikre dokumentationen af på plads til sikkerhedsvurdering Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du har en analytisk og struktureret tilgang til opgaver og kan se sammenhængen mellem forretningsbehov, governancekrav og tekniske løsninger. Du har måske en teknisk baggrund og erfaring med systemer, platforme og digitale løsninger. Eller måske kommer du fra en mere forretningsorienteret rolle, hvor du har arbejdet med governance, compliance, kravspecifikation eller procesudvikling. Det er ikke afgørende, at du kan det hele. Vi lægger vægt på, at du har en god forståelse for dit eget fagområde, interesse for de øvrige områder og lyst til at udvikle dig i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, governance og teknologi. Vi forestiller os, at du har en analytisk og struktureret tilgang og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til konkrete løsninger har erfaring med eller interesse for digitale platforme, systemer og processer kan forstå forretningsmæssige behov og omsætte dem til krav, arbejdsgange og løsninger har forståelse for governance, roller, ansvar, kontroller og godkendelsesprocesser – eller lyst til at opbygge den …

items.desc: Vill du bygga AI-lösningar som går hela vägen till drift? HiQ växer inom AI och söker data- och AI-ingenjörer! AI blir aldrig bättre än den data som finns under. Våra kunder vill ha hjälp att bygga dataplattformar och lägga AI-funktioner ovanpå, så att prognoser, analyser och sammanfattningar når dem som fattar besluten. Vi ser en växande efterfrågan på ingenjörer som kan ta en idé från förstudie till något som fungerar i vardagen. Vad kan du bidra med? Vi är intresserade av erfarenhet inom exempelvis: Data Engineering: Dataplattformar, pipelines och datamodellering. Generativ AI: LLM, RAG och AI-baserade applikationer ovanpå verksamhetens data. Machine Learning: Prediktion, analys och modellutveckling. Drift & kvalitet: Driftsättning, utvärdering, övervakning och förvaltning. Plattformar: Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud samt verktyg som Databricks och Snowflake. Listan är inte uttömmande. Vi är nyfikna på dig som arbetar med data och AI ur ett tekniskt och praktiskt perspektiv. Vem är du? Du har byggt datapipelines i produktion och arbetar gärna i SQL och Python. Kanske har du redan satt en ML- eller LLM-funktion i drift, eller så är du dataingenjör eller utvecklare som vill ta det steget. Är du senior har du ägt en dataarkitektur från första skiss till förvaltning. Du behöver inte vara expert på allt. Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet, praktisk erfarenhet och viljan att utvecklas. Varför HiQ? Hos HiQ får du arbeta med kunder inom industri, försvar, energi och fordon som har mycket data och höga krav på att den används rätt. Du utgår från vårt kontor i Västerås och arbetar oftast hos kund. Du blir en del av en satsning där vi samlar och utvecklar fler kompetenser inom AI, och där alla i teamet bygger, även den som leder uppdraget. Känner du igen dig, även om din profil inte matchar alla delar av annonsen? Tveka inte att söka! Vi är nyfikna på din erfarenhet, dina idéer och vad du vill bygga tillsammans med oss.

Ton Rôle Sera D’assister Nos Clients Dans L’élaboration Et La Mise En Œuvre De Leur Stratégie Data, De La Phase D’idéation Jusqu’à L’implémentation. Tes Missions Pourront Inclure Cadrage / gestion des projets : interview clients et partenaires, mise en place de workshops, préparation des uses cases… Construction de roadmaps, d’analyses data-driven avec l’équipe projet et conception d’infrastructures en collaboration avec nos experts Orchestration du bon déroulement du projet, en appliquant le cas échéant les méthodes agiles (sprints planning et reviews, backlog refinement, démos…) Veille technologique et sectorielle : rester à l’affût des dernières tendances en matière de data et d’intelligence artificielle pour proposer des solutions innovantes. Le but de cet entretien est de faire votre connaissance, de nous parler de vos expériences professionnelles, vos envies et d’en savoir plus sur votre intérêt pour le conseil et Artefact (45 minutes) Étape 2 : entretien de type business case avec un senior Data Consultant. items.desc: About Us Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before. We are the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals health than ever. The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe's top 100 AI startups with a team of over 80 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London. AI is not a side project here. Jerry, our AI teammate for vets, launches this month with clinical decision support, a listening mode for live consults, and hands-free voice next. You will ship weekly to real clinics and see the impact directly. In this role, you will: Build Jerry's clinical guideline library: RAG over vet-approved guidelines using hybrid vector and keyword search in Postgres, so Jerry answers clinical questions only from approved sources and cites the exact lines it used Build Jerry's listening mode: a fast classifier that watches live consult transcripts and triggers Jerry to surface missed charges, tests, or risks in real time Build Jerry's voice mode: a hands-free, voice-first experience for ambulatory vets on the road, where everything is spoken and any change waits for the vet's approval Build long-running and scheduled Jerry tasks: turns that keep running after the vet closes the tab, and scheduled jobs that prepare drafts for the vet to approve Own what you build in production across the TypeScript server and Python AI service: deploys, monitoring, fixes, weekly releases, and a share of on-call Be a trusted reviewer on AI pull requests and write the design docs for new AI features Your background looks something like: 4+ years of professional software engineering, including at least a year shipping LLM features to real users in production TypeScript in production (Node.js backend and React) and Python in production (FastAPI or similar) Has built with LLM APIs in production: tool calling and agent loops, structured output, prompt and model iteration Deploys and owns code in production: CI/CD, Docker, a cloud platform (AWS ideally), monitoring and fixing live issues SQL and Postgres, with git fluency across branches, rebasing, pull requests, and code review RAG experience: embeddings, hybrid vector and keyword search (pgvector), reranking, citations (nice to have the first project) Voice AI experience: real-time voice agents, speech-to-text, telephony integration (nice to have) Works well with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and reviews their output critically As a person, you: Are a product engineer first you care about what ships and how it performs in front of real users, not just whether it works in a test environment Own your code end to end, from design doc to production, and do not consider a feature done until it is monitored and stable Can explain the code you wrote, including the code your AI tools wrote for you Are comfortable in a small team with a big scope, working directly alongside vets, product, and the wider engineering org Are excited to work from our London WeWork office most of the week Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic What does success look like in 6 months? Shipping to production every week and contributing to on-call Jerry's guideline library v1 is live for pilot clinics: it answers only from approved guidelines, cites exact lines, and passes the clinical team's test questions Listening mode is piloted with at least one clinic, with every suggestion tracked to show the revenue it recovers Long-running and scheduled tasks are in production and a voice-first Jerry has been tested with an ambulatory clinic

items.desc: Contexte Projet de développement et déploiement d’une plateforme d'aide à la prospection. La solution se matérialise sous la forme d’une plateforme disposant d’une interface web ainsi que d’un ensemble de modules de recherches et de traitement de données. Mission Le client souhaite confier à un consultant spécialisé le développement, l'intégration et le déploiement de la plateforme. Développement front et back ; Conception de l’architecture de la solution ; Proposition et mise en œuvre de solutions sur des problématiques techniques (montée en charge, performance, etc.) et métier (issues des tests utilisateurs) ; Synthèse et communication des éléments de décision concernant les choix technologiques, avec explication des risques et avantages ; Documentation du code et du fonctionnement de la plateforme ; Accompagnement de l’équipe dans sa montée en compétence. Le consultant exécute ses missions en concertation étroite avec le responsable du projet. L’intervenant est intégré à l’équipe de recherche/projet et réalise directement les tâches qui lui sont confiées, sous la supervision du chef de projet, lequel assure le suivi technique de ses travaux et définit les orientations opérationnelles nécessaires à leur réalisation. Il participe aux réunions d’avancement internes ainsi qu’aux points de coordination selon le calendrier établi par l’Acheteur. Les intervenants travaillent avec le responsable de projet selon une méthodologie Agile : Les activités et tâches nécessaires à la réalisation du projet sont réparties en cycles de développement (sprints) d’une durée d’une semaine à deux mois maximum. Les intervenants contribuent directement à leur exécution, conformément aux objectifs et priorités définis pour chaque sprint ; Au cours de chaque sprint, les intervenants réalisent les travaux de conception, de développement, de test et de documentation qui leur sont confiés, en vue de produire une version fonctionnelle des développements réalisés ; Les activités, tâches et livrables des sprints suivants sont définis et estimés au cours des sprints précédents, en concertation avec le responsable de projet, afin d’adapter les travaux aux besoins et à l’avancement du projet. Compétences attendues Le développement de la plateforme nécessite des connaissances solides en front (NodeJS), back (Typescript, Python), data (ETL), IA (NLP et LLM) et infrastructure (Terraform, Ansible, Docker). L’intervenant doit disposer des compétences techniques suivantes : NodeJS, React, Javascript, Typescript, Python ; SGBDR et NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, SOLR) ; Outils et bonnes pratiques d’ingénierie logicielle (versionnage, qualité du code, tests, documentation…) ; Outils et bonnes pratiques DevOps (Terraform, Ansible, Docker, CI/CD…) ; IA et data science (NLP, LLM…) ; Infrastructure cloud (OVH, AWS…). Profil candidat: Profil requis Ingénieur IA Full-Stack expérimenté, avec au minimum 5 ans d’expérience. L’intervenant doit disposer d’une expérience sur les sujets suivants : Création d’application web ; Développement d’application en micro-services ; Mise en place de module de recherche textuelle utilisant du NLP ; Gestion de bases de données ; Moissonnage de sites web ; Utilisation de données « open data » sur les entreprises en France et/ou en Europe ; Utilisation de LLMs en API ; Déploiement sur infrastructure cloud.

items.desc: You are interested in the position as Founding AI Engineer – Full‑Stack at Alago Technologies GmbH ? On Instaffo, you can apply for this and other jobs with ease. Create your profile in under 2 minutes and start the application process with just a few clicks. Requirements Please note that this position requires work authorization for Germany . Language: German - Conversational (B1-B2), English - Fluent (C1) This role suits an AI engineer who wants to join at the earliest stage and build a product that changes how an entire industry works. Must-haves Real AI engineering experience. You've built with LLMs in production (agents, multi-step pipelines, retrieval, prompt and harness work) and you understand why shipping reliable agents is the hard part. Full-stack in TypeScript and React/Next.js. You own features end to end, from the agent logic down to the interface the customer actually uses. Product sense. You reason from user pain to solution to measurable outcome, and you can talk to a non-technical customer and understand their workflow. Velocity with judgment. You turn feedback into shipped features fast and make pragmatic architecture calls, but you care about reliability, because on a live construction project wrong has consequences. Comfort without a map. Most of these problems don't have answers yet, so you read papers, prototype, and compare approaches instead of waiting for a best practice. Nice-to-haves Startup experience, ideally as an early employee with a broad remit. Domain depth in construction, manufacturing, or complex B2B workflows. Strong database instincts: schema design, query optimization, Postgres/pgvector. Construction data is deeply interconnected. Open-source work or writing you're proud of. Design sense. You can build a clean, usable interface without detailed mockups. German for customer conversations. Not required, we have native speakers for that. Activities The problem The construction industry loses $1.6 trillion a year to inefficiency, and most of it is avoidable. The knowledge that would prevent it already exists. It's just trapped in PDFs, meeting protocols, and email threads nobody can search. Every new project relearns what the last one already knew. We're building the opposite of that: software for the people who run large, complex construction projects. It reads the documents, tracks the decisions, and catches the mistakes early. The model isn't the moat. The project memory is, and it compounds: every project makes the system better, and a competitor starting today is already years of projects behind. Our software runs today on a live autobahn construction program and an S-Bahn transit program: multi-year timelines, hundreds of thousands of pages of specs, protocols, and site communications, and real consequences when we get an answer wrong. We're pre-seed, led by Realyze Ventures, whose LPs include Zech and other large European construction groups. Co-investors: D11Z, the family office behind Aleph Alpha, and the CDTM Venture Fund, backed by 300+ CDTM alumni including the founders of Personio and Alasco and DeepMind's Technical Director. 25+ live customers. What You'd Work On Two problems, both of which need state-of-the-art answers. Agent harness engineering for construction documents. One summary doesn't fit all. "Structural risk" means something different in an RFI, a cost review, and a schedule reconciliation. We build multi-agent harnesses (specialized extraction, reasoning, and evaluation stages) that route a 400-page tender document or a protocol archive into the right pipeline with the right context. Part of that is context compression : what the system should remember, forget, and surface, and at which decision point, when a project runs five years and touches 50 stakeholders. There's no clean top-k answer, so this gets solved in production, not in a library. If you've read what Anthropic and Vercel have written about agent harnesses and thought "yes, that's the hard part of shipping production agents," this is the job. Project memory as a compounding moat. We started with meeting transcripts. Now we're building a decision graph that grows with every project: not just what was decided, but why, by whom, against which alternatives, and how it played out. That graph feeds the next project. The hard part is reconstructing the "why" when it's buried in a messy German protocol. We want the person who finds that problem interesting. Stack. TypeScript, Next.js, Vercel, Supabase (Postgres + pgvector), LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, LangFuse, shadcn/ui. Every engineer gets €500/month for AI tooling: Claude Code, Cursor background agents, and whatever frontier model you want to test. No legacy. Greenfield. How We Work We ship at 80% and improve in the next iteration. Our users are on live infrastructure projects, so we learn from production. We'd rather you read the paper than reach for the nearest library. Most of what we build doesn't have a library yet. Feedback is direct …

items.desc: Hard machine learning problems on real data, solved with agentic data science and tabular foundation models. Probabl is the Tabular AI company founded by the creators of scikit-learn. We maintain scikit-learn, contribute to TabICL and build Skore, the platform where agents do data science with the maintainers' methodology built in. The job You take a customer's hardest tabular problem, find what actually works, and see it through to production with their data science team. Solve open problems. From a scoped question to a research problem nobody has industrialized yet: frame it, find what works, prove it on the customer's data. Push tabular foundation models further. Benchmark them honestly against classical approaches and adapt them when the problem calls for it. Make agentic data science rigorous. Agents that follow sound methodology, with a data scientist in control where it matters. See it through to production. Your solution runs at the customer, with their team autonomous on it. Shape the product. What you solve in the field can become a Skore feature. You A strong background in machine learning, statistics or applied mathematics: MSc or PhD, engineering school or equivalent. 5+ years solving tabular ML problems on real data, with evaluation and validation done properly. You can read a paper and turn it into something that works. You work with agents every day, and you check their work. You can explain a hard result to a customer, in French and English. A plus: tabular foundation models, open-source contributions. Why Probabl State of the art in tabular AI: scikit-learn, TabICL, Skore. Close to research: you work with Probabl Labs, who build tabular foundation models and maintain cornerstone libraries. Real data, real stakes: banks, insurers, industrial groups. Your work becomes product: your pull requests land in skore to define next gen data science. Practical Paris, hybrid, with regular days at customer sites in France mostly in Paris. Start as soon as possible. Three weeks from first call to offer.
