items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team 
 Stripe’s Professional Services team works with our most strategic users. You will work on the highest visibility projects to provide technical expertise to our customers to help accelerate their knowledge, solution design and integrations with Stripe. This role is responsible for leading strategic conversations and developing plans that will transform the payments and financial infrastructure for leading enterprises. We're building an AI-first team. Using AI to work efficiently, and to deliver faster and better outcomes for our users, will be a key part of this role.
 What you’ll do 
 Responsibilities 
 Plan and execute integration engineering end-to-end, from high-level architecture down to code implementation. This includes conducting discovery sessions with users to understand their goals, parsing out specific use cases, and guiding users to implement high complexity integrations. 
 Think on your feet and communicate technical concepts, explaining how Stripe works from both a product feature and API architecture perspective. Manage user expectations on timelines and product changes.
 Be the primary, ongoing technical point of contact for our largest users' and partners' technical teams. You will be responsible for resolving user integration issues and owning escalations for operational issues and priority requests.
 Apply AI across the engagement lifecycle to reduce manual effort, accelerate delivery, and improve the quality of what we hand to users.
 Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture and Implementation teams to drive client engagement, customer wins, and revenue on behalf of the Professional Services team
 Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to proactively identify potential enhancements and new features based on feedback you’ll gather from the field.
 Provide deep technical support and debugging, inspecting and understanding the Stripe codebase and thoroughly testing functionality to best advise users, while also building and demonstrating proof-of-concept integrations, creating user-specific test plans, and answering ad-hoc technical questions.
 In some cases, lead "Hands On Keyboard" implementations for user engagements, providing material feedback on coding practices, CI/CD, and software architecture.
 Review and optimize existing user integrations and provide recommendations to improve performance, reliability, and efficiency.
 Build tools and analytics; create dashboards, run queries, and generate custom data reports to support user business reviews and operational needs.
 Develop and share knowledge, building reusable processes to enable the larger Professional Services team.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements 
 4 years + experience in a Software Engineering / Integration Engineering role.
 Ability to write code (in programming languages like Go, Java, C/C++ etc.) and quickly debug user code snippets.
 Comfortable with various code-level debugging (Stripe code and user code) and using code as a tool for problem-solving.
 Strong generalist technical experience, including proficiency in SQL and an understanding of data structures and algorithms.
 Understanding of the payments domain and API security topics.
 Be comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
 A user first approach & empathy with our users, capable of mapping business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
 Confident and comfortable with customers, with the ability to lead strategic technical conversations.
 Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. coding assistants, LLM-based agents) to improve how you work, and a strong appetite to continue to build that experience quickly.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Enjoy the puzzle of solving open-ended problems, both individually and as a member of our team.
Willingness to learn and teach others, including mentoring newer team members.
 Collaborative, communicative, consultative; able to apply specific methodologies to ensure repeatability of engagements.
 Intellectually curious, with great problem solving skills.
 Technical writing skills to document complex integration guidance and processes.

items.desc:
Are you passionate about turning raw data into meaningful insights that drive real business decisions? Do you thrive when building dashboards, writing queries, and uncovering patterns that help teams move forward with confidence? At Amazon, Business Intelligence Engineers play a critical role in shaping how we understand our customers, our operations, and our opportunities.
In this role, you will build and deliver business intelligence solutions including data sets, queries, reports, dashboards, and analyses that answer key business questions and empower stakeholders to make informed, data-driven decisions. You will work with well-defined requirements, collaborate with cross-functional partners, and apply your technical skills in SQL, ETL, data modeling, and visualization tools to create reliable, well-documented solutions. If you are curious, resourceful, and motivated by the chance to see your work make a tangible impact, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Build small to mid-sized business intelligence solutions data sets, queries, reports, dashboards, and analyses or components of larger solutions that answer business questions with data, delivering end products on schedule.
- Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable SQL and code to query, process, and present data; automate manual processes where possible and maintain ETL pipelines to support reliable data flows.
- Create and populate data structures using schema definition languages, and use industry visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI along with statistical methods to deliver actionable insights to stakeholders.
- Partner with business teams, data scientists, and other internal customers to understand requirements, align deliverables with expectations, and refine BI solutions to meet evolving business needs.
- Troubleshoot data quality issues, research root causes, validate outputs against source data and business logic, and document solutions clearly to ensure ease of use, interpretation, and long-term maintainability.
A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing data pipelines and dashboards, ensuring the metrics your stakeholders rely on are accurate and up to date. From there, you might refine a report based on new business questions, write and optimize SQL queries against large data sets, or meet with partner teams to scope out an upcoming analysis. You will regularly validate your work against source data and participate in design and prioritization discussions with your team, building your understanding of both the technical landscape and the business context behind the numbers.
About the team
Our team is focused on enabling smarter, faster decisions across the business by delivering trustworthy data and clear, actionable intelligence. We collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and business leaders to ensure our solutions address real customer and operational needs. We value curiosity, thoughtful problem-solving, and a commitment to quality. As we continue to grow, you will have the opportunity to expand your technical skills, deepen your business knowledge, and contribute to projects that have a meaningful impact on how Amazon serves its customers.
- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
- Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in the data/BI space
- Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
- Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
- Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

items.desc:
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team is one of the most exciting examples of Apple’s long-held passion for combining art and technology. These are the people who power the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, and Apple Books. And they do it on a massive scale, meeting Apple’s high expectations with high performance to deliver a huge variety of entertainment in over 35 languages to more than 150 countries. These engineers build secure, end-to-end solutions. They develop the custom software used to process all the creative work, the tools that providers use to deliver that media, all the server-side systems, and the APIs for many Apple services.
Thanks to Apple’s unique integration of hardware, software, and services, engineers here partner to get behind a single unified vision. That vision always includes a deep commitment to strengthening Apple’s privacy policy, one of Apple’s core values. Although services are a bigger part of Apple’s business than ever before, these teams remain small, forward-thinking, and cross-functional, offering greater exposure to the array of opportunities here.
Apple Services Engineering infrastructure is BIG. Operating at our scale, across multiple geographically dispersed data centers and servicing hundreds of millions of users presents unique challenges. As an SRE at Apple, you'll need to solve these problems using data, teamwork, and your own expertise. SREs at Apple own the full infrastructure stack; from device driver performance debugging to content delivery network traffic management — our responsibilities are both broad and deep.
ASE runs the majority of its systems on Linux. We run a mix of open source, vendor licensed, and internally developed tools to perform functions such as system configuration management, provisioning, software deployment, logging, and monitoring. You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. Our team is collaborative; we work closely with the development teams we support to deliver the best results for Apple. We think critically and strive to balance the best solution with the need to get things done for each engineering challenge we face. Good ideas are heard and results are rewarded. Culturally we believe in a close partnership with our development teams and aim to design & build new services together. We're passionate about software and automation in SRE and develop a variety of tooling and infrastructure. Our services run on mixed & hybrid platforms.

items.desc:
Wer wir sind 
 Helsing ist ein Defence-AI-Unternehmen. Unsere Mission ist es, unsere Demokratien zu schützen. Wir streben technologische Führungsfähigkeit an, damit offene Gesellschaften souveräne Entscheidungen treffen und ihre ethischen Standards selbst bestimmen können.
 Als Demokratien tragen wir eine besondere Verantwortung dafür, wie wir leistungsfähige Technologien wie künstliche Intelligenz entwickeln und einsetzen. Diese Verantwortung nehmen wir ernst.
 Wir sind ein engagiertes Team aus Ingenieur:innen, KI-Spezialist:innen und Programmmanager:innen mit engem Kundenkontakt. Wir suchen Menschen, die sich mit unserer Mission identifizieren und ihre Fähigkeiten einsetzen möchten, um einige der komplexesten und wirkungsvollsten Herausforderungen zu lösen. Wir pflegen eine offene und transparente Kultur, in der ein konstruktiver Austausch über den Einsatz von Technologie im Verteidigungsbereich, ihren Nutzen und ihre ethischen Fragen willkommen ist.
 Die Rolle 
 Als Qualitätsprüfer:in im Wareneingang stellst du sicher, dass angelieferte Waren die geltenden Anforderungen erfüllen, bevor sie in unser Lager und in die Produktion gelangen. Du prüfst auch Kundenlieferungen und Lieferantenrücksendungen und arbeitest dabei eng mit Logistik, Supply Chain und Production Quality zusammen. Durch sorgfältige Prüfungen, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation und die Bearbeitung nicht konformer Materialien trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Produktion auf geeignete Materialien zurückgreifen kann und Qualitätsprozesse den internen Vorgaben sowie den geltenden Normen entsprechen.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Prüfe eingehende Waren anhand der geltenden Spezifikationen und kontrolliere, ob die erforderlichen Unterlagen vollständig sind
 Erfasse und melde nicht konforme Materialien, kennzeichne sie und stelle sicher, dass sie gemäss den geltenden Prozessen bearbeitet werden
 Unterstütze Ursachenanalysen und Korrekturmassnahmen und setze Verbesserungen im Prüfprozess mit um
 Überwache gesperrte und unter Quarantäne gestellte Materialien in deinem Bereich, einschliesslich der Schrottkontrolle
 Prüfe Kundenlieferungen und Lieferantenrücksendungen und halte die Vorgaben des internen Qualitätsmanagementsystems sowie der EN 9100 und weiterer anwendbarer Normen ein
 Das solltest du mitbringen 
 Eine abgeschlossene berufliche Ausbildung in Elektronik, Mechanik oder Mechatronik und praktische Erfahrung mit Qualitätssicherung in der Elektronik-, Maschinen- oder Anlagenbaubranche oder der Automobilindustrie
 Sichere Anwendung visueller Prüfmethoden sowie gängiger Prüf- und Messmittel
 Verständnis von technischen Zeichnungen und Prüfverfahren, um Prüfungen korrekt durchzuführen und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren
 Erfahrung in de Anwendung von MS Office und Qualitätssoftware zur Pflege von Prüf- und Qualitätsdaten
 Sichere Sprachkenntnisse auf Deutsch und Englisch und Bereitschaft, im Zweischichtsystem zu arbeiten
 Hinweis: In unserer Branche sind Frauen sowie andere Minderheitengruppen systematisch unterrepräsentiert. Wir ermutigen dich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht alle genannten Qualifikationen mitbringst. Fähigkeiten und Wirkung lassen sich nicht in wenigen Stichpunkten zusammenfassen.

 Erfahrung in der Anwendung von SAP zur Bearbeitung von Waren- oder Qualitätsprozessen

items.desc:
Wer wir sind 
 Helsing ist ein KI-Unternehmen im Verteidigungsbereich. Unsere Mission ist es, unsere Demokratien zu schützen. Wir wollen technologische Führungspositionen erreichen, damit offene Gesellschaften souveräne Entscheidungen treffen und ihre ethischen Standards selbst bestimmen können.
 Als Demokratien tragen wir eine besondere Verantwortung dafür, leistungsfähige Technologien wie KI durchdacht zu entwickeln und einzusetzen. Dieser Verantwortung nehmen wir uns an.
 Wir sind ein engagiertes Team aus Ingenieur:innen, KI-Spezialist:innen und Programmmanager:innen mit engem Kundenkontakt. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Mission teilen, unser Team in Europa verstärken und ihre Fähigkeiten für komplexe Aufgaben mit grosser Wirkung einsetzen möchten. Wir pflegen eine offene und transparente Kultur, in der ein konstruktiver Austausch über den Einsatz von Technologie im Verteidigungsbereich, ihren Nutzen und ihre ethischen Folgen willkommen ist.
 Die Rolle 
 Als Qualitätstechniker:in in der Produktion bist du Teil des Bereichs Production Quality. Du setzt Qualitätssicherungs-Gates um und prüfst entlang des Produktwertstroms, ob Produkte den geltenden Anforderungen entsprechen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktion und weiteren Qualitätsfunktionen stellst du sicher, dass Produkte die technischen Spezifikationen erfüllen und die Anforderungen an Sicherheit und Qualität einhalten. So trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Produkte zuverlässig gefertigt werden und die Erwartungen unserer Kund:innen erfüllen.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Prüfe Baugruppen, Zwischenstände und bei Bedarf Endprodukte anhand von Konstruktionszeichnungen, technischen Spezifikationen, Qualitätsstandards und geltenden Normen
 Führe Erstmusterprüfungen durch und unterstütze die Produktionsbereitschaft sowie Qualitätssicherungs-Gates, damit Abweichungen vor der Endmontage erkannt und behoben werden
 Dokumentiere Qualitätsmängel, erstelle Abweichungsberichte (NCR), kläre Zuständigkeiten und sichere verdächtiges Material; unterstütze Ursachenanalysen und Folgemassnahmen
 Prüfe die Qualität am Produktionsende, bestätige Produktpässe und stelle sicher, dass Qualitätsnachweise vollständig und regelkonform erstellt und archiviert werden
 Überwache die Kalibrierung von Messmitteln und Prüfgeräten, damit Messungen nachvollziehbar bleiben und die Prüfbereitschaft im Produktionsbereich gewährleistet ist
 Das solltest du mitbringen 
 Du verfügst über eine technische Berufsausbildung in Elektronik, Mechanik oder Mechatronik sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung, etwa in der Elektronik, im Maschinen- oder Anlagenbau, in der Automobilindustrie oder in der Luft- und Raumfahrt
 Sicher Anwendung von Sichtprüfungen (GVI/DVI) und Prüf- oder Messmittel
 Erfahrung um Umgang mit SAP
 Verständnis von technischen Zeichnungen, Prüfanweisungen und Normen
 Arbeitest eigenständig und kooperativ und gehst strukturiert und prozessorientiert vor 
 Kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und bist bereit, im Zweischichtsystem zu arbeiten
 Hinweis: In unserer Branche sind Frauen und andere gesellschaftliche Gruppen systematisch unterrepräsentiert. Wir ermutigen dich, dich auch dann zu bewerben, wenn du nicht alle aufgeführten Anforderungen erfüllst. Fähigkeiten und Wirkung lassen sich nicht in wenigen Stichpunkten zusammenfassen.
 Was wir dir bieten 
 Eine attraktive Vergütung und betriebliche Altersvorsorge
 Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
 Gesundheit: Zuschüsse zu Sportangeboten und professionelle Unterstützung für die mentale Gesundheit
 Empfehlungsprämien für erfolgreiche Einstellungen
 Dies sind die zentralen Zusatzleistungen an allen Standorten. Je nach Standort können weitere Leistungen hinzukommen. 
 Helsing ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit im Beschäftigungsverhältnis ein, unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand, Behinderung oder Geschlechtsidentität. Bitte übermittle keine personenbezogenen Daten, aus denen ethnische Herkunft, politische Meinungen, religiöse oder weltanschauliche Überzeugungen, Gewerkschaftszugehörigkeit, Gesundheitsdaten oder Angaben zur sexuellen Orientierung hervorgehen.

Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As an Specialist Export Control / ITAR, you are the central point of contact for all questions regarding export control, customs, and sanctions. You bridge regulatory compliance with operational speed, ensuring technology, software, hardware, and technical data cross borders legally without unnecessarily slowing down Engineering, Procurement, Sales, or Logistics.
 Acting with high agency, you take full ownership of daily operations—from licensing and screening to the customs interface—collaborating closely with HR, Legal, Supply Chain, and our international entities (especially in the US). You drive automation and scalable licensing architectures to enable our growth, designing the critical processes relied upon by our Executive Export Control Officer ( Ausfuhrverantwortlicher ) while formal liability remains at the management level.
 The day-to-day 
 US Export Control (ITAR / EAR) 
 Classify hardware, software, and technology under USML (ITAR) and ECCN (EAR)
 Assess re-export and transfer requirements ( de minimis , Foreign Direct Product Rule, ITAR "see-through")
 Apply for and manage TAAs, MLAs, DSP-5s, and BIS licenses alongside US teams and external counsel
 Oversee deemed exports, cross-border data transfers, and compliance with US licence provisos
 EU & German Export Control 
 Classify goods under the German Export List (AL) and the EU Dual-Use Regulation
 Prepare and submit BAFA licence applications (individual, global, general) and support KrWaffKontrG filings
 Manage sanctions screenings, embargo reviews, and end-user verifications (EUCs)
 Customs & Logistics 
 Handle import/export customs matters, including tariff classifications, preferential origin, and ATLAS
 Collaborate with forwarders and Procurement to ensure shipments strictly follow licence requirements
 Support customs simplifications and AEO certification (optional)
 Internal Compliance Program (ICP) 
 Develop and document the ICP, embedding automated controls into ERP, PLM, and HR systems
 Conduct internal audits, lead investigations, and prepare voluntary disclosures where necessary
 Deliver company-wide trainings, advise on bids/partnerships, and liaise with authorities (BAFA, Customs, DDTC, BIS)
 You should apply if you 
 Degree in Law, Business Law, Business Administration, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent practical qualification (e.g. formal customs training)
 [3–5+] years of experience in export control, customs, or trade compliance—ideally in defence, aerospace, dual-use, a specialized law firm, or a relevant authority
 Strong working knowledge of US export controls: ITAR (22 CFR 120–130) and EAR (15 CFR 730–774)
 Sound understanding of German and EU trade law: AWG/AWV, EU Dual-Use Regulation, sanctions, and basic KrWaffKontrG 
 Proven ability to turn complex legal requirements into pragmatic, scalable operational processes
 Business-fluent English (written and spoken), German language skills are a plus
 Eligibility and willingness to undergo a German security clearance ( SÜG , Ü2/Ü3)
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 Hands-on experience with DDTC and BIS filings (TAAs, DSP-5s, Commodity Jurisdictions)
 Practical familiarity with ELAN-K2 (BAFA) and ATLAS (customs)
 Knowledge of tariff classification (HS codes), rules of origin, and preferences
 Track record in setting up an ICP or securing AEO authorisations
 Experience with software, cloud compliance, and intangible technology transfers
 Relevant certifications (e.g. ECoP, AWA/IHK Export Control Officer, or US Export Compliance Officer)
 Experience in fast-paced scale-ups or high-growth environments
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

items.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the Role:

Cohere seeks a high-performing Talent Coordinator, eager to take on a new challenge here in our Talent Operations team at Cohere. You will schedule a high volume of roles as a member of a small but mighty coordination team, who partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure interviews are arranged in a timely manner and that candidates have an excellent experience interviewing at Cohere. If you consider yourself highly organised, collaborative and someone who goes above and beyond to ensure excellence, we’d love to hear from you.

In this role you will be a liaison between teams supporting hiring managers, the Talent Team, the People team, and many more. Our Talent Coordinators are a primary internal and external point of contact and are a core part of our TA function supporting the scaling of Cohere. The team is not a behind the scenes support function, they are the beating heart of the Cohere Talent team.

You will schedule a high volume of interviews diligently and efficiently, manage a world class candidate experience, build strong and strategic relationships, manage multiple calendars and own the interview process with seamless communication and ownership from start to finish.

Our ATS is Ashby and we utilise the Advanced Scheduling functionality!

Candidates must be based in Germany to be considered for this opportunity.

As a Talent Coordinator, you will:

 - Schedule a large volume of interviews, ensuring our hiring teams and candidates are supported via seamless communication

 - Manage the candidate experience and build strong relationships across the organisation

 - Partner closely with a team of Executive Assistants, Hiring Managers and Recruiters

 - Support and optimize our interview processes & increase efficiency/automate where possible

 - Provide status updates, answer questions, and ensure timely follow up for our recruiters and candidate

 - Support on TA Operations projects where required

 - Keep our internal documentation up to date, working with detail and organization to ensure scalability and operational efficiency

This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you have:

 - 2+ years of professional work experience supporting a fast paced recruitment team

 - Experience scheduling a high volume of interviews, managing multiple calendars, and supporting a large volume of interviews with hiring managers and executive teams

 - Attention to detail coupled with the ability manage a high workload at a demanding pace

 - A team player "can-do" attitude and a proven track record of partnering with all functions and levels across an enterprise

 - Possess very strong time management & communication skills

 - Track record of executing on tasks for high-touch recruitment initiatives thoughtfully and efficiently at a fast pace

 - Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with tact and discretion

 - Have a genuine passion for providing excellent candidate experiences




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace …

items.card: Responsibilities - Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines at the core of Perplexity's search infrastructure. - Develop and optimize indexing strategies that balance performance, freshness, and resource efficiency. - Work on storage formats, compaction, and update mechanisms that keep data accessible and current. - Keep pipelines reliable and predictable under high-throughput
items.desc:
AI answers are only as trustworthy as the information behind them. Perplexity grounds its answers in fresh, real-world sources, and the index is what makes that possible. We're looking for an engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of Perplexity's Search Crawler. You'll build systems that ingest, process, and organize large volumes of crawled content into efficient, queryable structures, working primarily on offline and nearline pipelines that keep data fresh, complete, and accessible to downstream retrieval. Throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical across datasets that change continuously.



Responsibilities 

 - Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines at the core of Perplexity's search infrastructure.

 - Develop and optimize indexing strategies that balance performance, freshness, and resource efficiency.

 - Work on storage formats, compaction, and update mechanisms that keep data accessible and current.

 - Keep pipelines reliable and predictable under high-throughput conditions. 

 - Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interface contracts that stay flexible as the system evolves.

 - Define and implement observability across offline and near line pipelines, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals.

 - Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations as business needs change.

 - Partner with retrieval, ranking, and ML teams to make sure indexing outputs meet their requirements.

 - Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals.
   
   

Qualifications

 - 5+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems.

 - Strong programming experience in Go, C++, or Rust.

 - Experience with high-throughput data processing systems and very large datasets.

 - Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines.

 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability.

 - Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents.

 - A systems-thinking mindset and the ability to reason about end-to-end data flows.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Core Platform builds the foundations every other team at ElevenLabs builds on: how users, workspaces and permissions work across our products. Our systems sit on the path of every request and are relied on by millions of users and by enterprise customers, so correctness, security and safe rollout matter as much as speed.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) for two focus areas. Depending on the team you join, your responsibilities might include:

Workspaces & User Management (serving external customers)

 - Building and improving the building blocks customers touch directly: API keys, login experience, analytics, admin tooling, workspace security and more

 - Working closely with Sales, FDEs and customer teams to turn enterprise and self-serve feedback into the right improvements, and helping large customers with complex organisational structures.

 - Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.

Permissions & Resources (serving ElevenLabs engineering teams)

 - Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.

 - Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.

 - Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.

In both teams you will:

 - Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.

 - Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.

 - Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.

 - Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.


REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

items.desc:
Are you a technician looking for an opportunity to contribute to the Future Circular Collider (FCC), one of the most ambitious scientific projects ever envisioned? Help develop the coating technology that will equip its vacuum chambers with a Non-Evaporable Getter thin film.
 Working alongside experienced engineers, technicians and physicists, you will contribute to the design, fabrication and coating.
 You will be involved at every stage of the process. We will provide all the necessary training and support, making this an excellent opportunity to develop specialist skills in a unique international environment.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Design & construction of mechanical parts for customised physical vapor deposition systems and associated tooling.
 Assembly of coating setups operating in Ultra High Vacuum.
 Validation of the coating technology and process (in real scale prototypes up to 12 meter long beam pipes).
 Validation of the vacuum performance of the coatings produced (in Ultra High Vacuum systems).
 Your profile: 
 Experience in machining metal parts in lathe and milling machines. CNC would be an advantage.
 Familiarity in using CAD software to design mechanical parts.
 Practical experience in assembling mechanical equipment.
 Experience in vacuum technology would be an advantage.
 Skills: 
 Working in teams.
 Curious and proactive.
 Knowledge of vacuum technology would be an advantage.
 Knowledge on welding would be an advantage.
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is a general secondary education diploma .
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
 Applicants with a Bachelor's, Master's or PhD degree are not eligible.

Job closing date: 07.12.2026 at 23:59 CET. 
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-November-2026
 This position involves:
 Work in Radiation Areas.
 Interventions in underground installations.
 A valid driving licence.
 Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job reference: TE-VSC-SCC-2026-212-GRAE
 Field of work: Mechanical Engineering
 Benchmark job: 300090 - Mechanical Technician
 Global Benefits 
 A monthly stipend of 4687 Swiss Francs per month (tax free).
 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
 Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
 Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
 A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
 Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
 On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! 
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART! 
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

items.desc:
Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 Every mobile call, video stream, and message depends on power working quietly and reliably behind the scenes. At Ericsson's Power Design team in Lindholmen, Gothenburg, that's exactly the challenge we take on. We research, develop, and maintain the power solutions that keep today's mobile networks running and help shape the telecommunications of tomorrow.
 We're looking for a junior power electronics engineer who is eager to get their hands dirty, learn fast, and grow with us. You don't need to have it all figured out. You need curiosity, a strong interest in electronics, and the drive to see an idea through from paper to a working product.
 What you will do: 
 Your journey starts at the very beginning of a product's life, with concept studies and requirements. From there you'll move into detailed design and verification, and you'll help maintain products already in the field. You'll be part of the complete design cycle for power solutions in Ericsson's Microwave Transport products, and you'll see an idea sketched on a whiteboard become a working product on the lab bench.
 On a typical day you might design an input stage or a DC-DC converter, draw schematics, track down a fault that doesn't behave as expected, or take measurements to find out what the circuit is really doing. Hands-on work is at the heart of the role.
 You won't solve problems alone. You'll collaborate daily with digital designers, firmware engineers, and thermal experts, learning from each of them and bringing your own perspective to every design decision.
 The skills you bring: 
 A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a similar field
 0 to 3 years of relevant experience. New graduates are encouraged to apply.
 A genuine interest in electronics design and practical, hands-on lab work
 Fluent spoken and written English
 Strong interpersonal and networking skills, an adaptable mindset, and creative problem-solving
 A results-oriented approach and good organizational skills
 Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

assets by ensuring they are accurate, accessible, secure, and compliant. They act as business
custodians who implement data governance policies, improve data quality, and bridge the gap
between technical teams and business users.

 Support to Business Analyst on projects, in Data Cleansing & Migration Scope and alignments with User Department;
 Gather data and capture the information into databases. This may include gathering documents from various sources;

 Data Quality (rules and standards) and Cleansing (completeness, format, consistency);
 Error solving together with multi-disciplinary teams;
 Coordination with central departments (e.g. PMD);
 First level support coordination and KPI for service level;
 Second level support - Daily operations;
 Create and update documentation (internal procedures + end user documentation);
 Ensure data compliance tasks.

 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, Management, or a comparable qualification (relevant professional experience is equally valued).
 Experience 
 Proven hands-on experience working with SAP Master Data—specifically within the Material Management (MM) module.
 Track record of successful cross-functional collaboration between business user departments and central IT.
 Experience working in agile project environments (e.g., Scrum/Kanban) is an advantage.
 Know-how 
 Solid functional understanding of SAP ERP (R/3); familiarity with SAP S/4HANA is a strong asset.
 Exposure to complementary modules (such as SD, FI, or CO) is a plus.
 Solid grasp of core Data Governance principles, data quality management tools, and database fundamentals (SQL).
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and modeling.
 Languages 
 Fluent English and Portuguese (written and verbal) for seamless daily collaboration in our international environment.
 German language skills are considered an advantageous plus, but are not mandatory.

 Methodical, structured, and quality-driven approach with a keen eye for details.

items.desc:
We are seeking a highly motivated individual to join us as a DevOps Engineer . In this role, you will build and continuously improve the infrastructure, tooling, and automated CI/CD pipelines that enable secure, reliable, and efficient software delivery. Working closely with developers and engineers, you will drive infrastructure as code, integrate automated testing and security best practices, and resolve infrastructure and deployment challenges. This position combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and a passion for automation and continuous improvement.
 Build, set up, and maintain the infrastructure and tooling required for software development.
 Design, develop, and improve automated CI/CD pipelines for development and release processes.
 Implement and enforce security best practices to ensure systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats.
 Enable and automate testing processes within the pipeline to ensure code quality and reliability.
 Identify, troubleshoot, and apply fixes to technical problems within the infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
 Work closely with software developers and engineers to ensure that development follows established processes and works as intended.
 Manage source code, automate infrastructure provisioning, and drive infrastructure as code (IaC) principles.
 Participate in project planning to share knowledge of system options, risks, and potential improvements.
 Define and communicate technical requirements for infrastructure and deployment processes
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Informatics, or equivalent.
 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer.
 Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience with AWS or Azure.
 Proficiency in building and managing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins.
 In-depth knowledge of configuration management (Ansible) and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana).
 Advanced knowledge of containers (Docker, Podman) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
 Good understanding of search technologies like OpenSearch or Elasticsearch.
 Experience managing and deploying SQL and NoSQL databases in a cloud environment.
 Working proficiency with build tools (Maven, npm) and version control (Git).
 Experience with REST API integration.
 Deep understanding of microservices architecture and continuous delivery principles.
 Experience breaking down complex requirements into technical tasks and providing estimates.
 Ability to effectively communicate technical challenges to non-technical stakeholders.
 Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.

items.desc:
Overview 
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. 
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. 
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. 
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Responsibilities 
 Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption. 
 Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs). 
 Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance. 
 Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists. 
 Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks. 
 Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training. 
 Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work. 
 Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities. 
 Embodies our culture and values . 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications : 
 High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND proven experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. 
 Background Check Requirements: 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 
 Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications: 
 Relevant experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. 
 Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC). 
 Data Center Technicians ATR-C - The typical base pay range for this role across Germany is € 53,700.00 - € 74,700.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. 
 Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/germany-corporate-pay.html 
 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration …

Overview 
 As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running. This could be anything from coordinating with supplier/vendors, recognizing safe versus unsafe work environment, having a hands-on understanding of how critical environment equipment works, performing various types of maintenance, responding to onsite incidents while coordinating with other critical facilities professionals, and using telemetry and other platforms to monitor equipment performance and operations. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services.
 As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. 
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. 
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as an operations specialist in one major area of CE operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators) and works on advanced tasks independently.
 Inspect and supervise critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions and escalate per applicable policies and standards. 
 Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
 Safely and quickly respond to and lead onsite incident response teams for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs, without supervision.
 Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.
 Under minimal oversight, perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for one or more types of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems), correct procedures.
 Have a hands-on understanding of how equipment works and how to troubleshoot equipment, systems, subsystems, and components independently within their trained discipline.
 Provides consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems.
 Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], environmental health and safety (EH&S), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable within Microsoft requirements.
 Embody our culture and values

 Eseguire manutenzione preventiva e correttiva sugli impianti, in conformità ai contratti di assistenza e alle procedure interne. 
 Far parte del team di pronto intervento, fornendo supporto in loco per guasti critici non risolvibili da remoto.

 Identificare opportunità di miglioramento e aggiornamento dei sistemi, comunicandole ai referenti appropriati. 
 Assicurare che tutte le attività siano svolte nel rispetto delle norme di salute e sicurezza. 
 Il ruolo prevede attività fisiche, talvolta in quota o in ambienti a temperatura controllata, e richiede flessibilità per lavorare su turni notturni, nei weekend e per trasferte in Italia e all’estero.
 Requisiti per il successo 
 2-5 anni di esperienza come tecnico manutentore, preferibilmente nel settore dell’automazione. 
 Solida conoscenza di meccanica, elettronica e sistemi di controllo. 
 Capacità di risolvere problemi complessi in modo strutturato e di lavorare con documentazione e reportistica. 
 Diploma tecnico o attestato professionale in un settore pertinente. 
 Conoscenza elettromeccanica dei veicoli AGV e LGV 
 Esperienza in sistemi PLC S7 e PC 
 Patente di guida valida 
 La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è definita in base al CCNL Commercio.La retribuzione annua lorda di base è compresa tra 37.000 e 42.000 euro, definita in base all’esperienza e alle competenze professionali, nel rispetto delle politiche retributive aziendali.Oltre alla retribuzione di base, il pacchetto retributivo comprende le indennità applicabili al ruolo, in conformità al contratto collettivo e alle politiche aziendali.

 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.

We’re a team of 3,000+ experts from 50 countries, serving some of the world's largest and most exciting brands. Together, we’re implementing smart and innovative approaches - including flexible robot-based and data-driven automation solutions that are transforming the supply chain. So join our team and share your unique perspective.

 Contexte 
 Rejoignez une entreprise à la pointe de l’innovation dans le domaine de l’intelligence artificielle et de la photonique. Nous développons des solutions technologiques de nouvelle génération, intégrant des algorithmes avancés et des réseaux neuronaux pour révolutionner la conception de designs photoniques.  Réaliser des essais et des expérimentations pour évaluer les performances des différentes solutions algorithmiques et des réseaux neuronaux.
 Analyser et évaluer les techniques d’encodage utilisant des images ou des graphes hétérogènes.
 Étudier et appliquer des techniques de convergence telles que les métaheuristiques, la descente de gradient et l’auto-différentiation.

 Analyser les résultats des essais et proposer des améliorations pour optimiser les performances des systèmes.

 Une opportunité unique de participer à des projets innovants dans le domaine de l’IA et de la photonique, en contribuant à la conception de solutions de pointe.
 Un environnement de travail stimulant, très collaboratif et axé sur l’innovation.

 VIE position proposal : Development of a design rule check solution for WLCSP package assembly
 Context 
 Semiconductor packaging is a fast-growing and dynamic sector. It provides increasing added value in STMicroelectronics products and has become a key differentiator in the ST portfolio.
 The PAT R&D team is at the forefront of packaging research and development. As a central organization within ST, the team supports all product groups and enables the assembly of first prototypes through the Grenoble prototyping line.
 The BEMT R&D team in Grenoble, which includes about 110 people, is responsible for the development of laminated BGA packages. The team in Toa Payoh, which includes about 10 people, is responsible for WLCSP packages.
 Mission 
 Before the package design phase, contribute to the substrate design teams for chip packages, including layout, design, and technology activities. Develop an assembly design rule check (DRC) solution in Mentor Graphics Calibre for the WLCSP platform.
 Main activities 
 The position includes the following activities:
 Understand the DRC verification solutions already implemented for the BGA and silicon platforms
 Gather and define the requirements for the WLCSP solution
 Propose and present a development solution to the WLCSP teams
 Develop the WLCSP assembly rule verification solution
 Work environment 
 The position takes place in an international environment, in collaboration with the chip computer-aided design (CAD) teams, the BGA development solution teams, and the WLCSP team in Toa Payoh. The position is based first in Grenoble and then in Toa Payoh.
 This position offers broad visibility across STMicroelectronics products during the design phase.
 Profile
 Hold an engineering degree, or an equivalent qualification, in electronics or software development. Have initial experience with Mentor Graphics Calibre, for example through an internship.
 The expected skills are:
 Initial experience with CAD software, such as Mentor Graphics Calibre, Cadence, or AutoCAD
 Good English skills for work in a multicultural environment
 Ability to work in a team and manage multiple projects

 Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 
 What You’ll Do 
 As an EMC Validation Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and executing EMC validation activities for Silicon Imaging DIEs during the post-silicon phase of product development. Your work will help ensure robust functionality and compliance with customer EMC requirements and internal validation standards.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Planning and executing EMC validation on RF/EMC lab benches
 Performing conducted and radiated immunity testing
 Carrying out ESD and RF robustness evaluations
 Investigating EMC-sensitive behaviours and supporting root-cause analysis
 Developing automated test benches and test scripts in Python
 Processing and analysing measurement data to support technical conclusions
 Documenting test methods, results, and validation findings clearly and accurately
 Working closely with hardware, software, design, and program teams
 Supporting customer-facing or third-party lab activities when required
 What We’re Looking For 
 You will bring:
 Degree in Physics, Electronic Engineering, or a related technical discipline
 Previous experience in EMC validation, ideally for semiconductor or silicon-level products
 Working knowledge of EMC test methods and standards such as IEC 61967-4, IEC 61967-8, IEC 62132-4 , IEC 62132-8 or equivalent, IEC 61000-4-2
 Practical experience using RF and EMC laboratory equipment, such as:
 Oscilloscopes
 Logic analysers
 DVMs
 EMI receivers
 RF signal generators
 RF power amplifiers
 Spectrum analysers
 Experience working with cross-functional teams including hardware, software, and program management
 Strong technical communication skills and the ability to write clear validation reports
 Python development experience for automation and post-processing
 Strong analytical skills and close attention to detail
 The ability to understand and work effectively across silicon, hardware, and software interactions
 Desirable Experience 
 It would be advantageous if you also have:
 Experience with data analysis tools in Python or applications such as SAS JMP, MATLAB, or Excel
 Background in product characterisation or silicon-level design validation
 Familiarity with schematic capture and PCB design
 Experience creating technical documentation such as datasheets or application notes
 Exposure to imaging, darkroom, or photography-related environments
 Growing area a AI tool use
 Why This Role Matters 
 This role plays a key part in ensuring imaging silicon meets demanding EMC requirements, including immunity to RF interference, ESD robustness, and performance under challenging operating conditions. It offers the opportunity to work on advanced silicon products in a highly technical and collaborative environment.
 ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
 At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 
 To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

items.desc:
About the Position 
 The PTMH – Technological Platform for Hydraulic Machines provides independent scientific services to research laboratories and industry in the field of hydraulic machinery and hydropower. These services mainly consist of experimental testing of scale models of large hydraulic machines and systems.
 Testing activities are carried out using a unique experimental facility composed of three test rigs which allow for experiments in all types of hydraulic machines, hydroelectric units, and battery-hybrid systems.
 The maintenance and upgrading of the facilities must be continuous to guarantee the quality of the measurement results, which are subject to contractual clauses.
 We are seeking a mechanical engineer to join and strenghten our engineering team. 
 Key responsabilities 
 The main responsibilities include:
 Manage projects with clients, suppliers, and internal PTMH team. Main responsibilities include preparing and conducting model tests, performing calibration of required instruments, ensuring the quality of data acquisition, writing measurement reports, and contributing to performance analyses.
 Manage the maintenance of the experimental infrastructure and ensure the proper operation and reliability of the testing platforms.
 Participate in the continuous improvement of the installations, including software, and metrological adaptations.
 Ensure the quality of services by defining and implementing processes and conducting root cause analyses when issues arise.
 Support the training of new test engineers and assist with practical laboratory sessions for EPFL students.
 Occasionally conduct test monitoring and validation activities at partner laboratories or directly at hydropower plant sites.
 Profile 
 Mechanical engineering degree EPF, HES or equivalent, with competencies in hydraulic/electric systems.
 Experience with experimental techniques and National Instruments systems.
 Curiosity and ability to design and develop innovative set-up and instrumentation to meet specific testing and measurement needs.
 Experience with LabVIEW and control system programming is considered an asset
 Fluency in French and English is required.
 We offer 
 A unique environment within an independent hydraulic research and testing center, equipped with high-quality experimental facilities.
 Access to a network of renowned experts in the fields of hydraulics and electrical engineering.
 An excellent working environment with strong teamwork.
 Opportunities for continuous professional development and training.
 Information 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. Interested applicants should upload by November 23, 2026 the following documents in one PDF:
 CV
 Cover letter
 Work certificate if available
 For any further information, please contact: Dr. Elena Vagnoni (elena.vagnoni@epfl.ch)

 Contract Type: CDD
 Duration: 1 year, renewable

 Als Linux System-Administrator:in Webhosting verantwortest du den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Linux-basierten Hosting-Plattformen. Gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team sorgst du dafür, dass Websites, Blogs und digitale Dienste für Studierende, Forschende und Mitarbeitende der ETH Zürich stabil, performant und sicher zur Verfügung stehen. Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen, baust dein Fachwissen kontinuierlich aus und bringst neue Impulse für innovative und nachhaltige Hosting-Lösungen ein.  An der ETH Zürich studieren über 20'000 Studierende auf Bachelor- und Masterstufe oder sind als Hörer:innen eingeschrieben. Der Lehrbetrieb dahinter wird über eine breite Applikationslandschaft abgewickelt.
 Für das strategische Projekt «Verifiable Credentials» suchen wir eine engagierte und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit als Product Owner / IT-Projektleitung. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du aktiv die digitale Transformation des Lehrbetriebs mit und leistest einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Einführung neuer Prozesse, Systeme und Arbeitsweisen.
 Ob du bereits umfassende Erfahrung mitbringst oder mit relevanter Praxiserfahrung den nächsten beruflichen Schritt machen möchtest: Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.
 Die Akademischen Dienste unterstützen die zentralen Prozesse rund um Studium und Lehre an der ETH Zürich. Im Bereich Digitaler Lehrbetrieb treiben wir die Digitalisierung studienbezogener Dienstleistungen voran.
 Projekthintergrund
 Gestalte die Zukunft digitaler akademischer Nachweise an der ETH Zürich!
 Mit der E-ID und der Vertrauensinfrastruktur des Bundes (swiyu) entsteht in der Schweiz ein neues digitales Ökosystem. Die ETH Zürich ist von Anfang an dabei. Wir führen Verifiable Credentials (VC) ein: digitale akademische Nachweise, die fälschungssicher und maschinenlesbar sind und sich international überprüfen lassen. Die Lösung basiert auf offenen Standards, passt zu europäischen Umsetzungen und entsteht in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Schweizer Hochschulen.
 Für den Aufbau, die Integration, Einführung und Weiterentwicklung unserer VC-Lösung suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die Produktverantwortung, IT-Projektleitung und ein gutes technisches Verständnis verbindet. Bei uns gestaltest du das VC-Ökosystem der Schweiz aktiv mit.

Dabei arbeitest du mit agilen Methoden und Scrum und nutzt regelmässiges Feedback für die Weiterentwicklung des Produkts.
 Stakeholder-Management : Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Akademischen Diensten, den Informatikdiensten, dem Digital Campus, externen IT-Dienstleistern und weiteren internen und externen Partnern. Du vertrittst das Vorhaben in relevanten Gremien und sorgst für eine zielgerichtete Kommunikation.

items.desc:
Global Counter Fraud Specialist (Hybrid) | Swiss Re 
Global Counter Fraud Specialist (Hybrid)
Regular Employment
Apply now
 Share 
 Location: 
Madrid, M, ES
 Are you an experienced fraud investigator who enjoys tackling complex cases, uncovering fraudulent activity and protecting businesses from financial loss? Join our Global Special Investigation Unit (SIU) and use your investigative expertise to make a meaningful difference across an international insurance organisation. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced fraud investigator to join our Global SIU, supporting fraud detection, investigation and prevention across Swiss Re Corporate Solutions. 
 You will lead complex and technically challenging fraud investigations across multiple regions and lines of business, developing investigation strategies, evaluating evidence and providing expert recommendations to support claims decisions. You will collaborate with claims handlers, legal teams and external specialists to achieve effective investigative outcomes. 
 Beyond your core responsibilities, you will have opportunities to contribute to initiatives involving AI, predictive analytics and emerging fraud detection technologies, as well as wider global Claims projects and operational improvements. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead and manage complex fraud investigations, assessing potentially fraudulent claims, developing investigation strategies, coordinating internal and external investigative resources, evaluating evidence and providing clear recommendations to support appropriate claims decisions. 
 Provide specialist fraud expertise and guidance to claims handlers and other stakeholders, supporting the early identification, investigation and appropriate escalation of suspected fraudulent activity. 
 Identify and analyse emerging fraud trends, reviewing claims data, investigation outcomes and intelligence to recognise patterns, vulnerabilities and opportunities to strengthen fraud prevention. 
 Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including claims, underwriting, legal, compliance, external investigators and other specialists to support effective investigations and fraud risk management. 
 Develop and deliver fraud awareness training, sharing investigative insights, emerging fraud risks and practical guidance to strengthen fraud awareness and detection capabilities across global claims teams. 
 Support the development of counter fraud strategies and procedures, contributing to consistent investigative standards, effective controls and continuous improvement across the global SIU. 
 Ensure effective investigation governance, maintaining accurate investigation records and ensuring investigations comply with applicable legal, regulatory, confidentiality and data protection requirements. 
 Utilise data analytics and emerging technologies, including AI-driven fraud detection tools, to identify suspicious claims, improve investigative efficiency and enhance fraud detection capabilities. 
 Communicate investigation findings and recommendations, producing clear, evidence-based reports to support claims decisions and inform relevant stakeholders. 
 Engage with external organisations and industry partners, including law enforcement, regulatory bodies and fraud prevention networks, to support investigations, share intelligence and represent Swiss Re at relevant industry forums. 
 About the Team 
 The Global SIU supports Swiss Re Corporate Soluti ons in identifying, investigating and preventing insurance fraud across multiple regions and lines of business. 
 You will join a small, collaborative global team of experienced fraud professionals, combining specialist investigative expertise with data analytics and emerging technologies to strengthen fraud detection and support effective claims management. 
 About You 
 You are an experienced fraud investigator with a proven ability to manage complex investigations, assess evidence and develop effective investigative strategies. You bring strong technical expertise, sound judgement and the confidence to challenge information and reach well-supported conclusions. 
 You communicate clearly, work effectively with stakeholders across different regions and are comfortable managing sensitive investigations independently. You are also open to innovative approaches and technologies that can improve fraud detection and investigation. 
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements: 
 Extensive fraud investigation experience: Significant hands-on experience leading and managing complex, technically challenging fraud investigations, ideally within commercial insurance, with a proven ability to independently manage investigations from initial referral through to conclusion. 
 Advanced technical investigative expertise: In-depth knowledge of fraud indicators, investigative methodologies, evidence gathering and analysis, with the ability to assess complex claims, identify sophisticated fraud schemes …
