items.desc:
Graduate L&H Reinsurance Consultant, you'll join our Business Transformation & Initiatives team and help shape the future of Life & Health (L&H) Reinsurance at Swiss Re. 
 Working alongside experienced colleagues and business leaders, you'll gain hands-on experience in strategic projects that improve how we operate, embrace new technologies and deliver value to our clients. You'll have the opportunity to: 
 Turn strategy into action: Help translate business priorities and challenges into practical initiatives that make a difference 
 Drive meaningful change: Support transformation projects across different areas of L&H Reinsurance, from improving processes and ways of working to introducing new technologies and AI-driven solutions 
 Solve complex problems: Analyse information, explore opportunities and develop insights and recommendations that support business decisions 
 Connect people and ideas: Collaborate with colleagues across business functions, markets and technology teams to bring initiatives to life 
 Make an impact: Contribute to the planning, delivery and measurement of initiatives, learning what it takes to turn great ideas into lasting business outcomes 
 About the Team 
 You'll be part of the L&H Transformation & Initiatives team — a global team that helps turn Swiss Re's L&H strategy into meaningful business impact. 
 We work at the intersection of strategy, business and technology, partnering with colleagues across the entire L&H value chain to solve challenges, challenge conventional thinking and deliver lasting improvements. Our work spans shaping strategic initiatives, improving how the business operates, and exploring innovative solutions, including the potential of AI. 
 We're a collaborative, international team that values curiosity, fresh perspectives and a willingness to challenge ideas constructively. We believe in learning by doing, supporting one another and giving people the opportunity to take ownership and grow. As a graduate, you'll gain exposure to different parts of the business, learn from experienced professionals and contribute to initiatives that matter. 
 About You 
 You're naturally curious, enjoy solving problems and are excited by the opportunity to learn how a global business works. You bring fresh ideas, an analytical mindset and the confidence to ask questions and challenge assumptions. You enjoy working with people, are comfortable navigating new situations and are motivated to turn ideas into action. 
 What we're looking for: 
 A university degree (Bachelor's, Master's or PhD) in business, economics, finance, mathematics, engineering, technology or a related field, with up to three years of professional experience. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex information, identify insights and communicate findings clearly. 
 Good communication and interpersonal skills, with an interest in collaborating across different teams, functions and cultures. 
 A proactive, adaptable mindset, with a willingness to learn, take initiative and contribute both independently and as part of a team. 
 Nice to Have: 
 Previous consulting experience is a plus, particularly experience creating clear, executive-ready presentations in PowerPoint. 
 Interest in business transformation, strategy, consulting, insurance or financial services. 
 Familiarity with data analysis, visualisation or digital tools, such as Excel, Power BI or AI-enabled applications. 
 Previous internship, university project or other experience involving problem-solving, project delivery or business analysis. 
 An interest in emerging technologies, innovation and how they can transform businesses. 
 Compensation & Work Model 
 The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process. 
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. 
 Recruitment Process 
 Please note: The application process will remain open until 30 November 2026 . The final stage of the selection process is an Assessment Centre, to which a limited number of shortlisted candidates will be invited. 
 We greatly appreciate every application and carefully review each one. As a result, the selection process may take some time, but please rest assured that your application is being given thorough consideration. We aim to provide an update on your application by the end of December 2026 at the latest. 
 To learn more about the programme and the recruitment process, visit our website: Graduate Programme | Swiss Re

 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient.  Key Responsibilities 
 Design, deploy and manage enterprise endpoint solutions using Microsoft SCCM (Configuration Manager) as the primary management platform, including site administration, software distribution, patch management and client health management across large enterprise environments.

 Manage enterprise software packaging and deployment, including application creation, detection methods, dependency management and deployment targeting within SCCM. 
 Administer and optimise SCCM infrastructure, including site servers, distribution points, management points and boundary configuration.

 Apply ITSM frameworks (such as ITIL) in day-to-day operations, ensuring consistent and structured handling of service requests, incidents, problems and changes within the endpoint environment. 
 Implement and maintain endpoint security using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Conditional Access policies and Zero Trust principles. 
 Create and maintain PowerShell scripts, including automation via Microsoft Graph API, for endpoint configuration, compliance remediation and administrative tasks. 
 Collaborate with the agile Endpoints team to develop and integrate new workplace features, products and services. 
 Maintain thorough documentation of configurations, processes, task sequences and known issues to support knowledge sharing and operational resilience. 
 Champion Swiss Re's healthy and transparent risk culture by actively engaging in continuous risk accountability activities. 
 About You 
 You are a hands-on endpoint engineering specialist who brings structured thinking, meticulous attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership to everything you do. You are well-versed in ITSM best practices and understand how structured service management processes underpin reliable, high-quality IT operations. You take pride in building scalable, well-documented solutions and in sharing your knowledge with those around you. You're equally comfortable working independently on complex technical challenges and collaborating closely with colleagues. You thrive in agile environments, value continuous improvement, and are genuinely excited about contributing to the evolution of enterprise endpoint management.

 Launch your investment career at one of the world's leading institutional investors. Join Swiss Re's Graduates Program and become part of the Financial Markets Program (FMP), our flagship rotational program designed to develop the next generation of investment professionals.  
 About the Swiss Re Graduates Program 
 We’re looking for curious, motivated graduates with strong people skills who want to grow, learn, and make a difference. If you hold a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience, apply for our Graduate Programme starting on 1 September 2027 (earlier start possible). 
 You’ll gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of reinsurance, rotate into different local teams, and receive tailored training to build your expertise. This is your opportunity to shape your career, help protect societies from the world’s most threatening hazards, and contribute to making the world more resilient. 
 Through a combination of structured on-the-job and off-the-job learning, you will accelerate your development while building technical and leadership skills in a world-leading reinsurance organization. 
 About the Financial Markets Program 
 Selected candidates will join an elite track: the Financial Markets Programme (FMP), which is Swiss Re Asset Management's flagship rotational program for early-career analysts who aspire to build a long-term career in investing across markets, asset classes, and real-world risks.   
 If you’re interested in investments, insurance may not be the first industry that comes to mind, but it should be. At Swiss Re, our investment work is central to how we create value and keep our promises to clients. We manage a large, sophisticated portfolio designed to generate investment income and match the different risks we take across life and health, property and casualty, specialty lines and global currencies. 
 You will rotate across several investment teams spanning public and private markets, gaining first-hand experience across the investment lifecycle. Working alongside experienced investment professionals, you will analyze markets, contribute to investment decisions and help solve real business challenges from day one. 
 Alongside your rotations, you will benefit from structured training, mentoring, exposure to senior leaders and support towards the CFA qualification. By the end of the program, you will have developed a broad understanding of institutional investing, built a strong internal network, and established the foundation for a specialized career within Swiss Re Asset Management.  
 About the Role   
 As an Investment Analyst in the FMP, you will develop a 360° view of investment management within insurance while contributing across the investment value chain. Your responsibilities will include:

 Assess portfolio performance, risk exposures and macroeconomic developments   
 Contribute to investment strategy, portfolio construction and capital allocation decisions   
 Support due diligence, investment recommendations and transaction execution   
 Prepare materials for investment committees and senior stakeholders   
 Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that improve investment processes and innovate   
 Apply data, quantitative tools and AI to enhance investment analysis   
 Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders   
 You’ll follow a development plan tailored to your strengths, with structured feedback and visibility across Swiss Re Asset Management.  
 About the Team 
 Swiss Re Asset Management invests the assets generated from our core insurance and reinsurance businesses. We deliver sustainable performance through a disciplined, long-term investment approach and a high-quality, risk-aware portfolio.  
 As part of the FMP, you will join a community of high-potential analysts embedded across investment teams. You will work in a collaborative, high-performing environment that values curiosity and continuous learning.

 We are looking for people who:  
 Have completed, or are about to complete, a bachelor’s, master's or PhD in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or another quantitative discipline

 About the Role 
 Are you aspiring to use your scientific background to increase society's resilience against natural catastrophes with the help of re/insurance? Do you want to work at the interface of science and commercial re/insurance products? 
 We enable Swiss Re to maintain and expand its leadership in natural catastrophe re/insurance, in close collaboration with underwriters and clients. You will engage in and ultimately lead projects to improve natural catastrophe (Nat Cat) risk assessment and its seamless integration into Swiss Re's underwriting processes by collaborating with a wide range of internal and external teams on natural catastrophe related topics and develop novel insurance solutions to increase resilience against natural catastrophes.

 Build, maintain and communicate Nat Cat risk views for the EMEA region, primarily extratropical windstorms and severe convective storms, but also wildfires and/or tropical cyclones

 Acquire and analyse data to quantify the impacts of natural catastrophes on buildings, facilities, and infrastructure.

 Foster a common view and narrative around atmospheric perils in the re/insurance context.

 The Cat Perils team owns Swiss Re’s global natural catastrophe risk assessment, the respective modelling and geo capabilities. On the natural catastrophe side, we advance innovative probabilistic and proprietary modelling technology for seismic, atmospheric and flood hazards. 
 As part of the global Cat Perils team, you will work alongside a diverse group of about 70 colleagues across three locations in a supportive and collaborative environment where ownership, learning, teamwork, and sharing ideas are encouraged every day.

With you we win a colleague with excellent social competences who actively contributes to our team spirit.

¿Quiénes somos? 
 Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales (TSA) es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica creadora de soluciones audiovisuales broadcast desde 1993. 
 Con sede central en España y oficina en Latinoamérica, TSA destaca por su carácter internacional ofreciendo servicios y soluciones broadcast y multimedia en cualquier parte del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones de consultoría, diseño e integración de proyectos audiovisuales broadcast end-to-end, soluciones integrales para la producción de televisión, proyectos de innovación como los basados en IA y servicios de plataformas de video DTH, IPTV, OTT, emisión de canales, etc. Nuestros proyectos y servicios se complementan además con formación, coaching y soporte con diferentes niveles de servicio. 
 También gestionamos el mayor telepuerto totalmente privado de España, mediante el cual se distribuyen más de 700 canales de televisión y radio, además de ofrecer accesos a Internet, Starlink, LAN, Voz IP y datos. 
 Nuestra experiencia se ha forjado a lo largo de los años a través del diseño, ejecución y soporte de numerosos proyectos y servicios, tanto propios como de nuestros clientes. 
 Creemos en la orientación al cliente, la innovación y la flexibilidad, y nuestro compromiso es promover soluciones tecnológicas para nuestros clientes, que se ajusten a las necesidades cambiantes de un mundo audiovisual en constante evolución.

 Experiencia en trato con proveedores para apertura de incidencias y seguimiento. 
 Capacidad de análisis para la anticipación de problemas y autonomía y decisión para la valoración de alternativas y soluciones. 
 Capacidad de organización de grupos de trabajo multidisciplinares y gestión de múltiples tareas simultáneas. 
 Orientación a la realización de tareas y consecución de hitos, con gran capacidad de autogestión y control de tiempos.

 Valorables conocimientos: 
 Configuración y administración de sistemas de producción digital, en entornos Broadcast.

 Comunicación interna. Colaborarás en la gestión del canal interno de Bluevía para facilitar una comunicación cercana y fluida. 
 Servicios Generales. Ayudarás en la gestión de facilities. 
 Relaciones Laborales y Prevención de Riesgos Laborales. Darás apoyo en la gestión de los temas relativos a RRLL y PRL y participarás en la coordinación con las áreas y servicios correspondientes (Comunicaciones, Auditorías internas y externas, etc.)

 Formación en ADE, Relaciones Laborales, Recursos Humanos o áreas afines 
 Conocimientos de leyes y áreas generalistas de RR.HH. 
 Capacidad de análisis crítico y transversal

items.desc:
Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro. 
 ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué hace posible que millones de personas estén conectadas al mismo tiempo, desde cualquier lugar del mundo, sin que nada falle? En Telefónica, lo hacemos posible. 
 Somos una compañía global de telecomunicaciones y tecnología que conecta a personas, empresas y comunidades a través de redes de nueva generación y soluciones digitales avanzadas como cloud, inteligencia artificial, IoT y ciberseguridad. 
 Con una historia de más de 100 años, trabajamos cada día para que la innovación esté al servicio de la sociedad, impulsando una transformación digital responsable, sostenible y con impacto real. 
 Aquí no solo diseñamos infraestructuras: diseñamos el futuro. Buscamos personas curiosas, entusiastas y apasionadas por lo que hacen, que no se conforman y que quieren ayudar a crear la Telefónica del mañana. 
 Si te apasiona la tecnología que transforma vidas, este es tu sitio. 
 ¿Cuál será tu misión? 🎯 
 Nuestra misión es reforzar la soberanía digital de Europa mediante el desarrollo de servicios Cloud de confianza que garanticen el control de los datos, la seguridad y la independencia tecnológica, al tiempo que impulsamos la innovación y favorecemos un ecosistema digital resiliente en toda la Unión Europea. 
 Desde la infraestructura hasta los servicios gestionados y la inteligencia artificial, estamos construyendo las bases sobre las que gobiernos, industrias y empresas ambiciosas operarán durante las próximas décadas. 
 ¿Qué competencias buscamos en ti? 🔎 
 · Formación . Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones o titulación universitaria relacionada. 
 · Dominas tu oficio 
 o Escribes código limpio, mantenible y bien probado, que otros desarrolladores disfrutan leer y mantener, 
 o Conoces APIs, bases de datos y arquitecturas de microservicios, y eres capaz de explicar los compromisos y ventajas de cada enfoque. 
 o Te manejas con soltura en Linux, fundamentos de redes (TCP/IP) y contenedores. 
 · Construyes correctamente desde el inicio 
 o Integras la seguridad desde el diseño: autenticación, autorización, gestión de secretos y cifrado forman parte de la primera versión de la solución, no son una corrección posterior. 
 o Los logs, métricas y trazas se entregan junto con la funcionalidad, no después. 
 o Cuando surge un problema, buscas la causa raíz en lugar de limitarte a corregir el síntoma. 
 · Colaboras y te comunicas eficazmente 
 o Explicas conceptos complejos de forma clara tanto a perfiles técnicos como no técnicos. 
 o Trabajas de manera abierta utilizando software de código abierto a diario y, preferiblemente, contribuyendo a la comunidad. 
 o Das y recibes feedback de forma constructiva, compartes conocimiento y acompañas las soluciones desde la idea inicial hasta su operación en producción. 
 · Conocimientos técnicos. 
 Nadie domina todas estas áreas y no esperamos que así sea. Si tienes experiencia sólida en algunas de ellas y curiosidad por aprender el resto, encajarás perfectamente. Aprendemos unos de otros. 
 · Tecnologías y áreas con las que probablemente has trabajado

 o Plataformas e Infraestructura como Código (IaC): Kubernetes (operadores), Helm, Terraform, Crossplane, GitOps y CI/CD. 
 o Fundamentos cloud: KVM, OpenStack, KubeVirt, redes y almacenamiento definidos por software, e infraestructura bare metal (Metal3). 
 o Componentes PaaS: bases de datos gestionadas, almacenamiento de objetos, colas, cachés y servicios serverless. 
 o Identidad y acceso: OAuth 2.x, OIDC, RBAC/ABAC e identidad de cargas de trabajo (Keycloak, OPA). 
 o Observabilidad y fiabilidad: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, SLOs, gestión de incidentes, planificación de capacidad y recuperación ante desastres. 
 o Seguridad cloud: KMS/HSM, computación confidencial y seguridad de la cadena de suministro (SBOMs y endurecimiento de imágenes).

 · Diseñar y desarrollar los servicios que sustentan la plataforma cloud de Telefónica (consola de usuario, APIs, SDKs, medición, observabilidad y servicios PaaS gestionados), garantizando que sean escalables, mantenibles y seguros. 
 · Trabajar con un enfoque AI-native: utilizar agentes de programación de forma habitual para el desarrollo, las pruebas y la automatización, revisando críticamente sus resultados. 
 · Colaborar con los equipos de producto, diseño e infraestructura para transformar las necesidades de los clientes en soluciones operativas en producción.

 · Monitorizar, diagnosticar y mejorar continuamente los sistemas en producción.

items.desc:
TELEFÓNICA EDUCACIÓN DIGITAL, S.L.U. ofrece soluciones integrales de aprendizaje para la Educación y Formación, con más de 20 años de experiencia en el mercado nacional e internacional. Desarrolla procesos de aprendizaje de alto impacto en personas y organizaciones. 
 En un mundo cada vez más incierto, uno de los mayores regalos que se le puede hacer a una persona es su formación. La formación es uno de los activos más valiosos que se pueden ofrecer para el futuro: amplía opciones, genera confianza y permite afrontar los cambios con mayor seguridad. En este sentido, el propósito de Telefónica Educación Digital es claro y profundamente relevante: ofrecer este regalo a cada uno de nuestros usuarios. Pocos propósitos tienen un valor mayor o un impacto más duradero que ayudar a las personas a construir su futuro. 
 Vacante: Responsable de Infraestructura, Cloud IT y Sistemas (Cloud Ops / SRE) 
 Buscamos un/a Responsable de Infraestructura hands-on. Tenemos un entorno dual, un CPD On-Premises que sostiene nuestro legacy y una nueva plataforma 100% Cloud en AWS (arquitectura distribuida, basada en contenedores y autoescalable) desplegada con Terraform. Necesitamos un perfil técnico Sénior que tome las riendas operativas de AWS y nuestros flujos CI/CD, controle el presupuesto tecnológico, aplique los controles del Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (ENS), ISO 27001 y mantenga la salud de nuestros sistemas corporativos, compartiendo operaciones con el equipo de Ciberseguridad. 
 Tu misión Serás el dueño técnico de la infraestructura. Tomarás el control de nuestro entorno AWS, optimizarás el rendimiento de nuestras plataformas web, administrarás nuestros flujos de despliegue continuo (GitLab CI/CD), liderarás la gestión administrativa del departamento IT y mantendrás operativos nuestros sistemas tradicionales, copias de seguridad y el parque informático de 60 usuarios. 
 Responsabilidades clave. 
 Cloud Ops, Contenedores & IaC: Gestión integral y despliegue de infraestructura mediante Terraform . Creación de AMIs con Packer para estrategias de despliegue azul/verde . Orquestación y operación de contenedores con Docker, Amazon ECS Fargate y ECR . 
 CI/CD y Automatización: Administración completa de nuestro GitLab CI/CD autoalojado y la gestión de sus runners para garantizar despliegues fluidos y seguros. 
 Plataformas, BBDD y Caché: Optimización del stack web principal ( Moodle, ecosistema PHP ). Administración de bases de datos de alto rendimiento ( Aurora PostgreSQL ) y gestión de capas de caché en memoria con Redis y Valkey en Amazon ElastiCache . 
 Identidades y Seguridad: Implementación técnica de los controles exigidos por el ENS y ISO 27001 . Administración del gestor de identidades Keycloak (SAML y OIDC) y configuración de seguridad perimetral ( WAF ). 
 Soporte Técnico Legacy y FinOps: Mantenimiento de Linux / Windows Server , Liferay 6.1 (Apache), .NET (SQL Server) y Redmine (Nginx). Control de licenciamiento y optimización diaria de costes en entornos AWS autoescalados (FinOps). 
 Workplace, Monitorización y Backups: Administración del parque vía Intune , gestión de planes de contingencia con Veeam Backup , y atención a alarmas de Zabbix (guardias compartidas). 
 Conocimientos Técnicos Requeridos (Imprescindible): 
 Dominio de Infraestructura como Código e inmutabilidad: Terraform (gestión del State Drift ) y Packer (creación de AMIs y despliegues azul/verde). 
 Administración de repositorios y automatización con GitLab CI/CD autoalojado (y despliegue de runners ). 
 Dominio en plataformas Moodle / PHP , bases de datos ( Aurora PostgreSQL , SQL Server) y caché ( Redis / Valkey ). 
 Administración profunda de sistemas Linux/Windows y stacks tradicionales ( Liferay 6.1, Apache, Nginx, .NET ). 
 Condiciones: 
 Participación en el sistema de guardias remuneradas 24/7 para la atención de alarmas (Zabbix). 
 Posición de alta responsabilidad técnica con impacto directo en el P&L (presupuestos IT). 
 Formación Requerida 
 Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones o similar. 
 Experiencia (imprescindible) 
 Mínimo 5 años de experiencia administrando infraestructuras críticas On-Premises y Cloud. 
 Experiencia avanzada operando en AWS (EC2, S3, NFS, ECS Fargate, ECR, ElastiCache, WAF, Multi-AZ). 
 Experiencia gestionando identidades con Keycloak (SAML/OIDC) y conocimiento técnico del ENS y ISO 27001 . 
 Experiencia en FinOps, Veeam Backup, Microsoft Intune, ITSM y Zabbix . 
 Beneficios 
 Modelo híbrido de trabajo: Cuidamos la flexibilidad, posicionándonos como referente en nuevas formas de trabajo, horarios, jornadas y medidas de conciliación. 
 22 días de vacaciones + 4 días TED. 
 Jornada intensiva de trabajo en los meses de julio y agosto. 
 Disponibilidad de activar el plan de pensiones con las correspondientes aportaciones del participe y de la empresa. 
 Seguro de vida 
 Seguro médico privado (100% a cargo de la empresa). 
 Cheque TED de 11€/día

 Experiencia en la gestión técnica de actividades en proyectos complejos (preferiblemente en ámbito internacional)
 Capacidad de análisis para detectar viabilidad tecnológica e identificación de riesgos
 Disponibilidad para viajar (menos del 25% del tiempo)
 Nivel de inglés avanzado (oral y escrito)
 Experiencia y/o conocimientos técnicos en los siguientes ámbitos:
 Capa física de tecnologías ópticas (fuentes y detectores de luz, moduladores y demoduladores, elementos ópticos pasivos, regeneración, conmutadores ópticos)
 Conocimientos de capa física de tecnologías de RF, tanto en el ámbito de los enlaces de microondas como en las comunicaciones vía satélite.

 Overview 
 In Intesa Sanpaolo la Diversity è un tema in costante evoluzione ed è il valore attraverso cui promuoviamo il rispetto e la valorizzazione delle differenze. 
 Per noi la creazione di un ambiente inclusivo, nel quale ognuno si senta valorizzato ed in grado di esprimere al meglio le proprie potenzialità, è un dovere etico e un importante requisito per la sostenibilità d’impresa: dove tutti sono inclusi e hanno possibilità di esprimere la propria identità, i team e le aziende operano meglio. 
 Per potenziare il nostro Gruppo ricerchiamo delle persone appartenenti alle Categorie Tutelate ai sensi della Legge 68/99 . 
 Quali saranno i possibili ambiti 
 Avrai l'opportunità di collaborare in team su progetti di grande rilevanza e/o attività stimolanti, dove potrai apprendere le competenze inerenti ai possibili seguenti ambiti: 
 Finanza 
 IT 
 Risk Management 
 Compliance 
 Audit 
 Legale 
 Requisiti necessari per la manifestazione di interesse 
 Laurea di I o II Livello / Master in Economia, Finanza, Statistica, Fisica, Matematica, Ingegneria, Informatica 
 Conoscenza del Pacchetto Office o di altri sistemi operativi 
 Conoscenza preferibilmente della lingua inglese 
 Appartenenza alle Categorie Tutelate (Art. 1 L. 68/99) 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 650 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 450 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov!

 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti
 prax v práci s hotovosťou
 Počet rokov praxe: 1
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš minimálne SŠ vzdelanie s maturitou,
 máš minimálne 1 rok praxe v práci s hotovosťou,
 Ťa baví komunikovať,
 si priateľský/á a vieš pracovať individuálne aj v tíme,
 máš v sebe ducha obchodníka,
 si dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.

 Per noi la creazione di un ambiente inclusivo, nel quale ognuno si senta valorizzato ed in grado di esprimere al meglio le proprie potenzialità, è un dovere etico e un importante requisito per la sostenibilità d’impresa: dove tutti sono inclusi e hanno possibilità di esprimere la propria identità, i team e le aziende operano meglio.

 Finanza 
 IT 
 Risk Management 
 Compliance 
 Audit 
 Legale

 Laurea di I o II Livello / Master in Economia, Finanza, Statistica, Fisica, Matematica, Ingegneria, Informatica 
 Conoscenza del Pacchetto Office o di altri sistemi operativi 
 Conoscenza preferibilmente della lingua inglese 
 Appartenenza alle Categorie Tutelate (Art. 1 L. 68/99) 
 Chi siamo

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 000 EUR/mesiac
 Ponúkame diskusiu o mzde začínajúcu na tejto sume. Finálna úroveň mzdy závisí od profesijnej kvalifikácie a skúseností.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Vašou úlohou na pozícii Vedúceho/Vedúcej tímu bude:
 Koordinácia obchodných a servisných aktivít s cieľom efektívneho predaja produktov a služieb klientom.
 Predaj bankových produktov, služieb a produktov tretích strán.
 Poskytovať informácie a poradenstvo klientom s cieľom maximalizovať príjmy banky.
 Vykonávať finančné sprostredkovanie produktov a služieb z portfólia dcérskych spoločností a zmluvných partnerov spoločnosti.
 Zabezpečovať plnenie úloh obchodno-finančného plánu pobočky.
 Mentoring a koučing novo-nastúpených zamestnancov a kontinuálna podpora tímu predajcov na pobočke.
 Ad-hoc reporting.
 Ak ste sa našli vo svete bankovníctva, máte skúsenosti s prácou na pobočke a chcete zúročiť a rozvíjať Vaše manažérske kompetencie, práca Vedúceho tímu je pre Vás to pravé.
Využite príležitosť na sebe pracovať a zároveň odovzávať nadobudnuté skúsenosti Vášmu novému tímu vo VÚB.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás ideálnym kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš SŠ s maturitou,
 výborný písomný a ústny prejav v slovenskom jazyku,
 silná proklientská orientácia,
 analytické myslenie,
 prirodzené obchodnícke zručnosti,
 orientácia na dosahovanie cieľov,
 vysoká flexibilita a proaktívny prístup,

items.desc:
VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 850 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 550 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 300 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1000 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Si ambiciózny/a? Máš v sebe ducha obchodníka? Rád/rada kominukuješ? Máš bankovú prax? Ak si odpovedal/a na všetky otázky áno, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku pre VÚB!
Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
Ako si šikovný/á, toľko si aj zarobíš.
A okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Na pozícii Osobný poradca/poradkyňa klienta bude Tvojou úlohou:
 starať sa o nadštandardných klientov,
 predávať všetky bankové produkty a služby z portfólia VÚB banky,
 aktívne (telefonicky i osobne) oslovovať súčasných a zároveň aj potenciálnych klientov banky zo segmentu nadštandardných klientov,
 vyhľadávať rôzne obchodné príležitosti.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás: 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti:
 minimálne 2 roky bankovej praxe
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti

 máš minimálne 2 roky bankovej praxe,
 máš ukončené minimálne SŠ vzdelanie s maturitou,

 máš v sebe ducha obchodníka,
 chceš hľadať to najvhodnejšie riešenie pre klientov,
 ste dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,

 Overview 
 Entrerai nella struttura Group Technology di Intesa Sanpaolo, nell'area dedicata allo sviluppo e all'evoluzione delle soluzioni ICT a supporto dei processi del credito. Ti occuperai della progettazione e dello sviluppo di software applicativi e componenti dati per sistemi ad alta complessità, contribuendo all'adozione di tecnologie innovative basate su Intelligenza Artificiale (LLM e agenti) come acceleratori del ciclo di sviluppo. Garantirai qualità, affidabilità e conformità delle soluzioni ai requisiti e ai vincoli del contesto bancario. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Progettare i software applicativi e le basi dati relative 
 Analizzare e definire soluzioni tecnologiche e le loro integrazioni con il parco applicativo esterno all'ambito 
 Realizzare Testing e documentazione 
 Assicurare il mantenimento della coerenza tra quanto sviluppato e gli standard / normativa aziendale con riferimento 
 Supportare il team di lavoro nella fase di delivery delle soluzioni tecnologiche e nelle fasi di maintenance in termini di problem determination 
 Utilizzare gli strumenti di change management 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 1-3 anni nello sviluppo software 
 Java, Spring Boot e TypeScript per lo sviluppo di applicazioni enterprise e servizi applicativi 
 Kafka per integrazioni asincrone e gestione di flussi dati 
 PostgreSQL e progettazione di basi dati relazionali 
 API REST, testing automatico, versionamento del codice e strumenti di change management 
 Conoscenza dei processi applicativi in ambito credito, lending o sistemi bancari 
 Inglese almeno B2 secondo scala CEFR 
 Competenze preferenziali: utilizzo di strumenti AI per supportare analisi, sviluppo, documentazione e test, conoscenza di microservizi, container, CI/CD e principi di Data Quality 
 Saranno considerate in via preferenziale le candidature di coloro che abbiano maturato significative esperienze professionali o di studio in contesti internazionali. 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 35.650 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

 As a Public Affairs Trainee at Sanofi, you will work closely with the Market Access, Public Affairs and Trade team, supporting the implementation and development of the company's Public Affairs strategy.
 Our Public Affairs team plays an important role in shaping Sanofi's position within the healthcare landscape, working at the intersection of public policy, healthcare and business strategy.  Help bring the patient perspective into Sanofi's projects, decisions and everyday activities.
 Monitor healthcare developments and identify trends, challenges and unmet patient needs.
 Gather feedback and insights from external stakeholders and share them with internal teams.
 Support the planning and delivery of Public Affairs initiatives and projects.
 Develop and adapt communication materials to support stakeholder engagement and team activities.
 Collaborate with colleagues across different teams to strengthen patient-focused approaches and improve healthcare outcomes.
 About you 
 To excel in this role you will need to have:
 A degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Marketing or a related field.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a good command of English & Portuguese.
 An interest in healthcare, patient advocacy and the pharmaceutical industry.
 The ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with different stakeholders.
 Good organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage priorities.
 A proactive, collaborative and flexible approach, with a willingness to learn and take initiative.

 Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.

 Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.

As an Automation Software developer, you will contribute in developing and delivering one of the most successful line of products in the IP router market today: the 7750 SR internet router and its further evolution in Multi Access Gateway(MAG) and Data Center world.
 The engineer will be responsible for Quality Assurance and automation-software development in Pytest/TCL based frameworks for Nokia's IP routing products. Job involves building expertise in features around L2/L3/MPLS/3gpp functionalities, Platform and QOS, hardware performance evaluation etc., with a strong emphasize on developing automation software, utilizing best coding practices in Python and similar languages.
 NIDC2026 
 More on our products:

 https://www.nokia.com/networks/ip-networks/ 
 Videos:  
 Connecting the 5G World   
 Nokia Fp5 
 Nokia Silicon Innovation with Fp5
• Automation software development/sustenance in Pytest/TCL based frameworks, utilizing best coding practices.
• Comprehending feature requirements and protocol specifications and translating them to test scenarios.
• Create/review test plans, test procedures and infrastructure for adequacy and completeness/correctness
• Augment test strategies with real-world customer deployment use cases
• Uncover hidden bugs, debug and participate in root cause analysis (RCA)
• Proactive attitude towards identifying inefficiencies, and developing tools/automation to optimize workflows
• Work with product documentation team for creating and maintaining customer documentation
Effectively, one would need to learn and participate in entire product software development cycle. Work closely with different groups within the organization including the Software and Hardware Development teams, Support team and Product Management team in order to drive the feature to completion (ready for GA release).
You have: 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Candidates with Bachelor´s in CS, EE, will be more relevant. Master’s degree is a plus.
 Good knowledge in CS fundamentals - Computer Architecture, Data Structures, Operating System concepts, Algorithm Analysis
 Exposure to Linux and programming languages (preferably scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL, shell)
 Proven aptitude for methodical problem solving, programming, good communication skills, strong attention to detail, and ability to work well in a close-knit team.
 Quick learner, self-starter, self-driven
 Nice to have: 
 Familiarity with networking test tools (IXIA, Spirent, IPerf, Wireshark, etc).
 Knowledge (and experience if possible) of CNF (Cloud-native Networking Function), VNF (Virtualized Networking Function), SDN, and related virtualization/cloud technologies (Containers, Kubernetes, OpenStack, KVM/QEMU, Xen, Vmware ESXi) is a big plus.
 Knowledge (and experience if possible) of routing protocols (OSPF, ISIS, BGP) and/or signaling protocols (RSVP, LDP, Segment Routing)
 Please submit your CV in English. Applications with CVs in other languages will not be considered.

 We provide a comprehensive private life and medical insurance plan to safeguard your well-being and that of your family.
 As part of our commitment to your health, we offer an annual medical check-up program.

 Our Employee Recognition program, "Everyday Excellence," acknowledges and rewards outstanding contributions. You can redeem awards through our online store.
 Earn a generous referral bonus of €2.000, one of the highest in the market, for referring qualified candidates to join our team.
 Enjoy 90 calendar days of paid leave for the arrival of a new child.
 Engage in social clubs and cultural activities organized by the company to foster a sense of community and well-being.
 E-Learning Platforms: Access renowned e-learning platforms such as NokiaEDU, Harvard ManageMentor, and LinkedIn Learning for technical training and personal development.
 We provide ample opportunities for career growth and development, including training programs and mentorship initiatives.

items.desc:
Voor ons World of Hearing in Mechelen en ons hoorcentrum in Willebroek zijn we vandaag op zoek naar een Audicien - Audioloog .
 Wil jij als audicien/audioloog de meest geschikte hooroplossing vinden voor onze klanten en zo hun levenskwaliteit en gezondheid verbeteren? 
Wil jij terechtkomen in een warm team, met toffe collega’s die kwaliteit vooropstellen? 
Wil jij jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en daarin gestimuleerd en ondersteund worden? 
 Ja, ja, en nog eens ja? 
Met je diploma Audiologie (BA of MA), een RIZIV nummer op zak én een stevige portie empathie sta jij te popelen om iedereen die ons hoorcentrum binnenkomt, verder te helpen. 
 Herken jij je hierin: 
 Variatie in je job maakt je gelukkig - Iedere dag en iedere klant zal verschillend zijn
 Oog voor detail, dat heb jij – En dat zal van pas komen bij het uitvoeren van verschillende geavanceerde audiometrische testen om de meeste geschikte hooroplossing voor te stellen
 Verantwoordelijkheid nemen is voor jou een evidentie – Wij kunnen op beide oren slapen, jij volgt het gehele proces op van A tot Z
 Commerciële feeling komt vanzelf – Je zet je in om te zorgen voor een uitnodigend hoorcentrum waar mensen zich welkom voelen
 Je bent een geboren netwerker – Je bouwt de nodige professionele contacten op met NKO-artsen en huisartsen.
 Nog steeds enthousiast? 
Weet dat je komt werken bij de marktleider van hooroplossingen in België, met meer dan 270 hoorcentra in België en meer dan 70 jaar expertise, die op zijn beurt behoort tot de Sonova Group, de belangrijkste fabrikant van hooroplossingen ter wereld.
 Bovendien bieden wij je: 
 Een contract van onbepaalde duur met start zo snel mogelijk.
 Je werkt voltijds of 4/5de. 
 Je werkt 1 dag per week in Willebroek en de rest van de week in een van onze World of Hearing, een plek waar innovatie en expertise samenkomen. Onder één dak vind je alles wat Lapperre te bieden heeft, van tinnitusbegeleiding en de onzichtbare Lyric-hoortoestellen tot geavanceerde metingen zoals SPIN en REM.
 Extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, 12 ADV-dagen per jaar, groepsverzekering en hospitalisatieverzekering, GSM en flex income plan (cafetaria plan). 
 Verder krijg je ook een gepersonaliseerd ontwikkelingsplan met kwalitatieve coaching en feedbackmomenten om je professionele vaardigheden te ontwikkelen.
 De garantie dat je écht een verschil kan maken voor mensen met gehoorverlies. Hoe geweldig is dat?

 #Lapperre

 Ние, в УниКредит, сме отворени за смели и иновативни идеи и предлагаме продукти и решения, които дават възможност на хората да бъдат по-успешни и по-удовлетворени. Нашата цел е да бъдем банката за бъдещето на Европа и търсим хора, които имат желание да поемат с нас в тази посока. Ключово за отношенията и процесите, които градим, е те да са най-добър пример в прилагането на принципите за многообразие и равнопоставеност и в утвърждаването на приобщаваща среда за всички.
 Бизнесът ни създава инвестиции, ресурси и нови възможности, които стимулират развитието на нашите служители, като им предоставят уникално и динамично професионално преживяване. Ще се радваме да допълните екипа ни с вашите таланти и силни страни и да изградите кариера, в която ще бъдете възнаградени подобаващо за постиженията ви.
 Ние ще ти дадем възможност да
 ● Предлагаш пълната гама от банкови продукти и услуги за физически лица;
 ● Участваш активно в кампании за продажба на продукти и услуги и използваш най-успешните търговски техники;
 ● Извършваш касови и безкасови операции при стриктно спазване на действащите вътрешно-банкови нормативни актове;
 ● Повишаваш качеството на обслужване на клиентите и проявяваш проактивност при възникващи проблеми и разрешаването им.
 В теб търсим
 ● Търговски умения, ориентираност към клиента;
 ● Добри комуникативни и презентационни умения;
 ● Познания по английски език (ще се считат като предимство);
 ● Компютърна грамотност;
 ● Икономическо образование (ще се счита за предимство);
 ● Сходен опит в банковата сфера или опит на търговска позиция (ще се счита за предимство).
 При нас ще откриеш
 ● Бонусна система, съобразена със заеманата длъжност;
 ● Коледен паричен подарък;
 ● Кредитни продукти при специални условия;
 ● Освобождаване от такси и комисиони при ползване на голяма част от услугите на банката;
 ● Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
 ● Допълнителни плащания във важни моменти от живота;
 ● Ваучери за храна;
 ● 25 дни платен годишен отпуск;
 ● Платен почивен ден за рожден ден и за доброволчество;
 ● Възможност за допълнителни дни платен годишен отпуск с натрупване на стаж в организацията;
 ● Безплатен достъп до онлайн обучителни курсове и обучения на разнообразни теми;
 ● Достъп до платформа за изучаване на чужди езици;
 ● MultiSport карта на преференциални цени;
 ● Програма „Препоръчай приятел";
 ● Отлично оборудвани фитнес зали;
 ● Кафетерия и стол с преференциални цени;
 ● Корпоративна детска градина;
 ● Зъболекарски кабинет.

items.desc:
Role Highlights: 
 Title: AIT Engineer – Optical Systems
 Department: Global Manufacturing Organization
 Reports to: Head of MAITE, Optics
 Location: Warsaw, Poland
 Type of Contract: Permanent
 Working model: On-site
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 About the role 
 ICEYE is seeking an AIT Engineer to support the assembly, integration, and testing of satellite systems, including the integration of optical payloads into the spacecraft platform.
 This is a hands-on technical role in an early-stage production environment, where systems are still evolving and processes are not yet fully defined. You will work directly with flight hardware in cleanroom conditions, supporting the assembly, integration, and testing of the satellite bus, as well as the integration and validation of optical payloads provided by external suppliers.
 You will contribute to bringing the full satellite system from design into production, ensuring that optical payloads are successfully integrated with the satellite platform (bus), and that the system can be built, tested, and scaled reliably. This includes supporting troubleshooting and continuous improvement during production ramp-up.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 What you will do 
 Execute assembly, integration, and testing (AIT) of satellite subsystems and optical payloads
 Perform optical alignment and integration activities (focus, tilt, centering, boresight) using precision equipment
 Conduct hands-on inspection, assembly, and verification of satellite hardware in cleanroom environments
 Support integration of externally supplied optical payloads into the satellite system
 Identify, contain, and drive root cause analysis of non-conformances; implement corrective actions and feedback into design and production processes
 Define and execute test and verification activities, including integration and acceptance testing at subsystem and system level
 Support optical and system-level performance validation
 Define, develop, and maintain process plans, procedures, and technical documentation, supporting implementation and continuous improvement of manufacturing and integration processes
 Contribute to AIT process definition and improvement, enabling scalable production
 Interface with optical, mechanical, and electrical engineering teams to ensure system-level integration
 Collaborate with external suppliers during payload integration and validation
 Support setup of tooling, fixtures, and test setups (GSE) required for production
 Apply system-level understanding to anticipate integration risks across subsystems and ensure successful builds
 What we’re looking for 
 Must have 
 3+ years of hands-on experience in integration, testing, or production of complex hardware systems, with relevant experience in optical systems, optomechanics, physics, or other high-precision hardware
 Hands-on experience with optical systems integration and alignment (focus, tilt, centering, boresight)
 Experience working with optical payloads or Earth Observation systems
 Familiarity with optical metrology tools (e.g. interferometers, collimators, optical benches, MTF setups)
 Good system-level understanding across multiple disciplines (optical, mechanical, electrical)
 Experience working with precision hardware in cleanroom environments
 Experience working in structured production environments (e.g. MES or similar systems)
 Strong troubleshooting skills with structured root cause analysis
 Ability to analyze and interpret test data to support integration and validation activities
 Experience developing or working with process plans and technical documentation
 Ability to work in fast-paced and evolving production environments
 Proactive, hands-on approach to problem-solving
 Strong written and spoken English communication skills
 Nice to have 
 Experience supporting environmental testing (e.g. thermal vacuum, vibration)
 Experience working with external suppliers or partners
 Experience supporting systems from prototype through production ramp-up
 Experience working in lean manufacturing or continuous improvement …

items.desc: Contexte Le Groupe Sicame développe des équipements pour les réseaux électriques et s’appuie sur la simulation numérique pour accélérer le développement et fiabiliser ses choix de conception. Analyser et prioriser les cas d’usage Cartographier les workflows existants et repérer les étapes répétitives, manuelles ou sources d’erreurs Sélectionner les cas d’usage prioritaires avec les équipes et définir les données d’entrée, résultats attendus et critères de validation 2. Explorer les agents IA et les solutions Ansys Prototyper des agents IA pour assister certaines étapes des workflows, avec validation humaine et règles d’exécution maîtrisées Évaluer les solutions d’IA d’Ansys et intégrer les outils issus de notre base IA et/ou de l’environnement Ansys 3. Automatiser les workflows et la génération de modèles Développer des scripts pour automatiser le paramétrage, la construction des modèles, les calculs et l’extraction des résultats Utiliser les serveurs MCP reliés à notre plateforme IA interne pour créer et développer les workflows Mettre en place des contrôles de traçabilité, reproductibilité et validation avec les experts métier 4. Du behöver inte vara AI-expert eller kunna alla de senaste modellerna – det viktiga är att du tycker om att lösa problem och vill hjälpa kunder att skapa värde med AI. Du tillhör vårt team i Östersund eller Sundsvall, beroende på var du bor och vilken ort som passar dig bäst. Här får du det nära och lokala sammanhanget samtidigt som du kan dra nytta av kompetens och möjligheter inom hela Sogeti. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Tillsammans med våra kunder förstå verksamheten, identifiera möjligheter med AI och omsätta behov till tekniska lösningar som skapar verkligt värde. Designa och utveckla moderna system och AI-lösningar med exempelvis .NET, C#, Azure och relevanta AI-plattformar och ramverk. Utforska och utveckla AI-assistenter och agentbaserade lösningar och ta dem från idé och experiment till lösningar som används i verksamheten. Bygga API:er, integrationer och mikrotjänster som kopplar samman generativ AI med kundernas befintliga system och verksamhetskritiska processer. Bygga och vidareutveckla AI-plattformar i både moln- och on-prem-miljöer. Bidra till robusta och säkra AI-lösningar, där kvalitet, arkitektur, styrning och ansvarsfull användning av AI är en naturlig del av utvecklingen. Din profil Vi söker dig som har en grund inom systemutveckling och vill utvecklas vidare inom AI. Du är nyfiken på hur tekniken kan användas för att lösa verkliga problem och tycker om att förstå varför något ska byggas, inte bara hur. Du har med dig: Erfarenhet av systemutveckling och goda kunskaper i .NET och C#. Erfarenhet av någon modern molnplattform, exempelvis Azure, AWS eller GCP. Erfarenhet av API-utveckling och integrationer. Förståelse för arkitektur, säkerhet och kvalitetsarbete. Förmåga att förstå verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av eller kunskap om något av följande områden: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI eller motsvarande AI-plattformar. RAG-arkitekturer, vektorsökning, kunskapsgrafer eller GraphRAG. Agentbaserade lösningar. DevOps och CI/CD. Kubernetes eller OpenShift. AI-plattformar i privata eller säkerhetskritiska miljöer. Lokala LLM:er eller Private AI-lösningar. Du behöver inte kunna allt i listan. Oavsett om du redan har arbetat med AI-lösningar eller har en utvecklarbakgrund och vill ta nästa steg inom AI vill vi gärna höra från dig. Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas: En varm och prestigelös gemenskap där du får vara dig själv. I Östersund är naturen nära, lunchaktiviteter med kollegor en del av vardagen och även hunden är välkommen. I entrén möts du av porträtt av kollegor och deras intressen, för här är människan bakom konsulten minst lika viktig. Energi och framtidstro i Sundsvall. Här möts du av ett entreprenöriellt gäng med framåtanda. Vi är nära kunder och den lokala marknaden, gillar nya idéer och skapar möjligheter tillsammans. Det ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet, enkelt att ta initiativ och naturligt att bidra och utvecklas tillsammans. Gemenskap, stöttande kollegor och chefer – med Sogetis och Capgeminis globala nätverk, karriärmöjligheter och mängder av internutbildningar. Om Sogeti Sogeti Sverige, en del av Capgemini Group, med 19 kontor och 1200 medarbetare, gör teknologi enkelt och värdeskapande. Vi är specialiserade på AI-drivna lösningar inom quality engineering & testing, data och cloud och förvandlar snabbt idéer till handling. Sogeti levererar konkreta resultat, hjälper organisationer att innovera med självförtroende och skapar värde från dag ett. Vi är agila, snabbrörliga och drar nytta av starka partnerskap. Våra lokala team arbetar sida vid sida med våra kunder och bygger nära relationer genom att förstå deras verklighet. Tillsammans med Capgemini-koncernens globala styrka och branschexpertis skapar vi skalbara resultat. Right here. Right now. | www.sogeti.se

items.desc: An Amazing Career Opportunity for a Solution Architect / Builder Location: Stockholm, Sweden Job ID: 53081 The Solution Architect/Builder owns the technical how of the squad's JTBD cluster. This role spans what was traditionally divided across software architecture, backend engineering, DevOps, and technical leadership. In an AI-native squad, you are both the architect who designs the system and the builder who ships it — leveraging Synthetic Team Members (autonomous AI agents) to write, test, deploy, and monitor code at a pace outperforming traditional ways of working. You don't manage engineers. You orchestrate systems — human and synthetic — to turn well-framed problems into production-grade solutions. Who are we? HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Identity and Access Management Solutions (IAMS): HID Global IAM products protect more than 85 million user identities. HID Global Identity and Access Management Solutions products protect more than 85 million user identities. At HID Global, we understand that no person, device, or workplace can go unprotected. This philosophy of Zero Trust drives us to create new advances in risk-based multi-factor authentication, leads us to secure user identities in converged access environments and drives the need to expand implementations with our industry-leading digital certificates and PKIaaS solution to manage them at scale. As our Solution Architect/ Builder, you’ll support HID’s success by Own the technical architecture for the squad's JTBD cluster — making design decisions that balance scalability, security, maintainability, and time-to-value. Design and build cloud-native services for HID's authentication and identity management platform — APIs, microservices, event-driven workflows, data pipelines. Translate the Outcome Owner's problem frames into technical solution designs: system diagrams, API contracts, data models, and implementation plans that the squad (and its Synthetic Team Members) can execute against. Write production code — this is not a PowerPoint architecture role. You ship. You are hands-on with the codebase daily. Delegate implementation tasks to Synthetic Team Members (AI agents) with clear, precise, and testable specifications — feature implementation, test generation, code refactoring, documentation, infrastructure-as-code, migration scripts. Review and validate AI-generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to human contributions — Synthetic Team Members are fast but require quality gates. Own the squad's technical debt ledger: make explicit, defensible trade-offs between speed and sustainability, and communicate them to the Outcome Owner in business terms. Design for security by default — in an identity and access management product, every architectural decision is a security decision. Threat modeling, zero-trust principles, and secure-by-design are baseline, not aspirational. Build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline, observability stack, and deployment automation for the squad's services — you own it from commit to production to 3 AM alert. Collaborate with the Experience Crafter to ensure the technical implementation honors the experience design — and propose technically elegant alternatives when a design is prohibitively expensive. Contribute to platform-level architectural decisions that span squads — API standards, shared services, data architecture, infrastructure patterns. Close the technical loop: instrument services, monitor SLOs, analyze incident patterns, and feed technical insights back into the squad's prioritization. Implementing features from well-specified tickets — with clear acceptance criteria, API contracts, and test expectations. Generating comprehensive test suites — unit, integration, contract, and performance tests. Refactoring and modernizing legacy codebases with structured migration plans. Writing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, CI/CD configurations). Producing technical documentation, API references, and runbooks. Conducting automated security scans, dependency audits, and code quality analysis. Debugging production issues by analyzing logs, traces, and metrics. Education/ or Experience Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. 7+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated progression from individual contributor to system-level ownership. Strong track record of designing and operating cloud-native distributed systems (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms at scale (>10K tenants, >1M end users). Deep proficiency in at least two of: Java/Kotlin, Go, Python, TypeScript — and the judgment to pick the right tool for the job. Production experience with …

Our eplix Suite brings together staffing companies, employers, insurers and pension providers to automate processes that are still manual and fragmented today. items.desc: Role: Analyst/Researcher (Automotive Green Steel) Location: Brussels (Ixelles) Deadline for applications: 18/12/2026, at midnight Job description Transport & Environment (T&E), the leading European NGO promoting cleaner transport, is offering a Brussels based position for a data analyst/researcher, starting from early 2027. The role will primarily focus on automotive green steel, but will also expand to cover other key vehicle materials like aluminum. T&E is best known for shaping EU transport policies with data and evidence. Your work will have a lasting impact and will help us to make sure transport plays its part in getting to zero emission. The successful candidate will join T&E’s Trends and Analysis team, our home for research, transport modelling and data analysis. Project work will primarily be directed by our automotive green steel team. T&E is advocating to leverage the EU automotive sector in order to accelerate green steel demand across Europe and support the development of a low-carbon steel industry. The European automotive industry accounts for roughly 20% of EU steel consumption. Today, it predominantly relies on highly polluting coal-based primary steel. Steel makes up a growing part of the automotive production emissions, accounting for an estimated 16%-27% of lifecycle emissions. Our working environment fosters learning and professional development. We value ideas and afford our colleagues the agency and autonomy to develop evidence and argument based solutions to our complex transport decarbonization challenges. We work on issues that can have a positive impact on the way we travel, on our health and on the climate. We are looking for someone who can apply appropriate quantitative analytical tools and techniques to help build up our internal analytical capacity and modelling expertise for green steel and vehicle materials. This will include assessing the reliability and relevance of evidence and giving objective evidence-based advice to shape policy and to help shape the public narrative of transport issues. Main functions of the role: Take a leading role on T&E’s analytical and research work for EU based topics, specifically serving as our in-house steel and sustainable materials analysis. Deliver market analysis and modelling of the automotive green steel lead market policies. Support T&E's watch-dog role by tracking OEM commitments and industry progress on green steel procurements. Conduct data-driven analysis on the potential environmental and economic effects of recycled-content targets for steel and aluminum. Track scrap flows from end-of-life vehicles to identify how much is recycled in a closed loop, downcycled, or exported, and assess the potential risks of displacement effects. Write reports and briefings that support T&E advocacy through rigorous analysis and research. Present research findings internally and externally while communicating complex data in a way that is both accessible and impactful. Review T&E analytical outputs to ensure a high degree of research, analysis, and argumentation. This includes quality-assuring models, challenging input data and assumptions and interpreting output data. Provide input to T&E’s policy and communication strategies. Job requirements: 2 years experience working on European industrial decarbonization, ideally steel, but can also be supply chain modelling, or automotive materials analysis, either in an industry, consulting or academic context. Experience in python and Excel (additional coding or database management experience is considered a bonus). Any examples of integrating GenAI as part of data analysis is a bonus. Excellent communication and presentation skills and an ability to write in English fluently, accurately and concisely. Other European languages are considered a strong bonus. Project management experience including strong interpersonal and team-working skills and an ability to deliver to tight deadlines. The confidence to think and act with initiative, to engage and influence policymakers of different stripes, industry representatives and other stakeholders at the highest level. How to apply: To apply, please submit your CV and motivation letter at jobs.transportenvironment.org. The deadline for applications is the 18/12/2026, at midnight. About Us: Transport & Environment is Europe’s leading clean transport think tank and campaign group. We combine the power of robust evidence and a deep understanding of the transport sector with compelling communications and impactful advocacy. T&E will commit to your professional development and invest in training from your first day with the organization. Our people work across Europe: we have offices in Brussels, Rome, Paris, Berlin, Madrid, Warsaw, and London. ️ IMPORTANT SECURITY NOTICE FOR APPLICANTS Protecting Your Personal Data against Recruitment Scams: T&E takes digital data privacy and information security seriously. Er waardevolle informatie uit halen, is een volgende stap! Daarom zoeken we een enthousiaste jobstudent die graag met data werkt, analytisch denkt en het leuk vindt om informatie om te zetten naar overzichtelijke rapporten en dashboards. Je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan een slimmer datagebruik binnen ons Training Center. Geen puur uitvoerende administratieve job, maar een opdracht waarin je zelf ideeën mag aanbrengen en mee nadenkt over hoe we onze processen kunnen verbeteren. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt een aantal concrete uitdagingen voorgeschoteld: 1. Data verwerken en rapporteren Data uit ons Learning Management System (LMS) verzamelen, analyseren en structureren. Gegevens omzetten naar bruikbare rapporten voor officiële rapportering aan overheidsinstanties en de sector. De kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van de gegevens controleren. Rapporteringen efficiënter en overzichtelijker maken. 2. Certificaten en competenties opvolgen Rapporten ontwikkelen om certificaten en opleidingen op te volgen. Automatisch of via overzichtelijke rapporten inzichtelijk maken welke certificaten binnenkort vervallen. Data gebruiken om de competentieontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei van medewerkers beter in kaart te brengen. 3. Dashboards bouwen Overzichtelijke en gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards ontwikkelen. Data visualiseren zodat informatie snel en eenvoudig geraadpleegd kan worden. Meedenken over hoe we informatie beter toegankelijk kunnen maken voor medewerkers, leidinggevenden en het Training Center. 4. Meedenken en verbeteren Zelf opportuniteiten ontdekken in onze bestaande data en rapporteringen. Creatieve oplossingen bedenken om repetitieve taken te vereenvoudigen of te automatiseren. Nieuwe ideeën voorstellen en samen met ons bekijken hoe we die kunnen realiseren. Wie ben jij? We zoeken geen student die enkel opdrachten uitvoert, maar iemand die graag zelf op ontdekking gaat en uitdagingen niet uit de weg gaat. Je herkent jezelf in volgende zaken: Je volgt een opleiding in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Toegepaste Informatica, Data Management of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt een goede kennis van Excel. Ervaring met Power BI is zeker een pluspunt. Je hebt interesse in data-analyse, rapportering en datavisualisatie. Je hebt bij voorkeur enige ervaring met de Microsoft-omgeving. Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt initiatief. Je bent analytisch ingesteld en hebt oog voor detail. Je bent creatief, denkt graag mee en durft bestaande werkwijzen in vraag te stellen. Je geeft niet op bij de eerste hindernis, maar zoekt naar oplossingen. Je bent 2 dagen/week beschikbaar om te werken. Wat zit er voor jou in? Een boeiende en concrete opdracht binnen een internationale bedrijfsomgeving. De mogelijkheid om jouw kennis van data-analyse en visualisatie in de praktijk toe te passen. Ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en eigen ideeën uit te proberen. Een directe bijdrage aan de verdere digitalisering en professionalisering van ons Training Center. Samenwerking met collega's die jouw inzichten en frisse blik waarderen. Interesse? Wil je jouw analytische vaardigheden inzetten om data om te zetten naar echte meerwaarde? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou! We hechten belang aan jouw privacy en daarom accepteren wij geen sollicitaties via mail. Wie we zijn en waar we in geloven We zijn toegewijd aan het vormgeven van de toekomstige landschap van efficiënte, veilige en duurzame transportoplossingen. Het vervullen van onze missie creëert ontelbare carrièremogelijkheden voor talenten binnen de toonaangevende merken en entiteiten van de groep. Solliciteren op deze functie biedt je de kans om je bij de Volvo Group aan te sluiten. Elke dag werk je samen met enkele van de scherpste en meest creatieve geesten in ons vakgebied om onze samenleving in een betere staat achter te laten voor de volgende generatie. We zijn gepassioneerd over wat we doen en gedijen op teamwork. We zijn bijna 100.000 mensen die wereldwijd verenigd zijn door een cultuur van zorg, inclusiviteit en empowerment. De divisie Trucks Technology & Industrial neemt teamspelers aan die klaar zijn om echte impact te maken voor onze klanten. Onze gedecentraliseerde teams werken dicht bij onze klanten, met snelheid en autonomie, om te bouwen wat zij echt nodig hebben.Sluit je bij ons aan om samen te werken aan innovatieve, …
