items.desc: WiNK è alla ricerca di un/una Full Stack Engineer da inserire nel proprio team di sviluppo per contribuire alla realizzazione di applicazioni web che integrano soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale e Generative AI. items.card: Responsabilità DevOps & CI/CD: Progettare, mantenere ed evolvere le pipeline di Continuous Integration e Continuous Delivery per garantire rilasci automatizzati, frequenti e sicuri, fornendo supporto agli sviluppatori nell'integrazione di microservizi. items.desc: La realtà Il nostro cliente è una realtà multinazionale leader nel settore sportivo. Dietro i loro prodotti, i servizi e la vasta rete retail, c'è un'infrastruttura digitale complessa e in continua evoluzione. Questa opportunità ti permetterà di entrare a far parte di un'azienda finale solida e dinamica, dove l'innovazione tecnologica ha un impatto diretto su milioni di utenti. La realtà aziendale si distingue inoltre per la forte condivisione di valori legati allo sport, al gioco di squadra e all'innovazione in ottica di sostenibilità (come, ad esempio, l'adozione di modelli di business circolare e di rental). Il Ruolo e la mission Per conto della nostra azienda cliente, stiamo ricercando un DevOps Engineer da inserire all'interno del team infrastruttura. La risorsa opererà in stretta sinergia con un Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) avendo un raggio d'azione a 360 gradi sull'intera architettura digitale del gruppo. La mission del ruolo prevede la gestione in prima persona delle attività operative (run), il mantenimento e l'evoluzione delle pipeline, e l'amministrazione degli ambienti cloud e containerizzati. Si tratta di un ruolo ad alta interazione, che prevede il confronto quotidiano e strategico con i team di sviluppo locali e le divisioni tecnologiche globali. Principali Responsabilità DevOps & CI/CD: Progettare, mantenere ed evolvere le pipeline di Continuous Integration e Continuous Delivery per garantire rilasci automatizzati, frequenti e sicuri, fornendo supporto agli sviluppatori nell'integrazione di microservizi. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud: Gestire il provisioning e le configurazioni degli ambienti cloud (sviluppo, staging, produzione) tramite approccio dichiarativo, contribuendo attivamente allo sviluppo degli stack interni. SRE & Observability: Garantire l'affidabilità dei cluster Kubernetes (K8s) e dei microservizi attraverso monitoraggio, logging, metriche e alerting, assicurando il rispetto degli SLA/SLO e l'ottimizzazione in chiave FinOps. Troubleshooting: Gestire la risoluzione di eventuali incidenti in produzione su flussi critici, occupandosi delle analisi post-mortem e dell'implementazione di azioni correttive. DevSecOps: Hardening di infrastrutture e container, gestendo gli accessi (IAM basato sul Least Privilege), la rotazione dei secret e il monitoraggio delle vulnerabilità. Allineamento Internazionale: Affiancare tecnicamente i team internazionali per assicurare la massima aderenza agli standard architetturali definiti a livello di gruppo. Cosa Cerchiamo Must Have: Solida esperienza operativa su Docker e Kubernetes (K8s) in contesti produttivi a microservizi. Esperienza pratica e consolidata con almeno uno dei principali Cloud Provider (GCP, AWS o Azure) e padronanza di Terraform per le attività di IaC. Esperienza concreta nella manutenzione di pipeline CI/CD (es. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) e conoscenza di strumenti di Observability (es. Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana). Buona competenza nell'utilizzo di linguaggi di scripting (come Python o Bash/Shell) per automatizzare task operativi. Ottima padronanza dell'Inglese (scritto e parlato), requisito tassativo e indispensabile per il lavoro quotidiano con i team globali. Nice to Have: Costituiranno requisiti preferenziali una forte competenza verticale su Google Cloud Platform (GCP), esperienza con tool di Cloud Security (es. Wiz) e Secret Management (Vault), familiarità con linguaggi di sviluppo applicativo (Java, Node.js, PHP, Python) e il possesso di certificazioni tecniche in ambito Kubernetes (CKA, CKAD, CKS) o Cloud/Terraform. Cosa Offriamo Contesto Operativo: L'ingresso in un team altamente specializzato e privo di compartimenti stagni, dove l'innovazione è la regola e le competenze del singolo si traducono in un impatto tangibile e immediato sui servizi erogati. Retribuzione: La fascia retributiva (RAL) indicativa per il ruolo è compresa tra i 40.000 € e i 45.000 €. Modalità di Lavoro: Ibrida, 2 giorni di smart working a settimana. Summary 2 giorni di smart working/settimana 35.000€ - 45.000€ On-site Permanent Lissone

items.desc: Cleafy is a SaaS security company built by fraud hunters, security engineers, data scientists, and software developers with a shared mission: shift left security. At Cleafy, we consider any digital fraud the last step of an attack. We shift left fraud management, managing the attack before it executes the fraud. We provide an AI-driven security platform that helps banks and financial institutions to detect threats in advance and to mitigate them in real time, anticipating fraud and bridging the gap between cybersecurity and fraud prevention. We are looking for a dedicated Security Compliance Specialist to join our Security & Compliance team. The successful candidate will focus on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), ensuring our company adheres to security regulations and standards. Responsibilities: Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, procedures, and standards in alignment with ISO27001, ISO 22301, SOC2, and other relevant frameworks. Conduct regular internal audits and assessments to ensure compliance with security standards and regulatory requirements. Support all activities required to achieve and maintain ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 22301 certifications and SOC 2 attestation, including internal audits, evidence collection, gap remediation and coordination with external auditors. Assist with customer audits (on-site or remote), address any security concerns or queries and answer security questionnaires. Identify, assess, and manage security risks, providing recommendations for mitigation. Maintain security and compliance documentation about the main relevant regulatory topics (e.g. new legislation, decisions and guidelines issued by the Italian Data Protection Authority.) Manage third-party risk end to end: assess vendors’ security posture through documentation reviews, security questionnaires and supporting evidence, maintain the third-party inventory, and continuously monitor the associated risks. Collaborate with various departments to ensure security and compliance requirements are met. Stay current with changes in security regulations and industry standards, particularly those relevant to the financial services industry (DORA, NIS2). Requirements 2 years of experience in a GRC role with a focus on ISO27001, SOC2, ISO 22301 and other relevant standards. Strong understanding of risk management principles and practices. Knowledge of NIS2, DORA and AI Act Regulations. Experience with security audits, compliance assessments, and certification processes. Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills. Ability to work independently, proactively, and collaboratively in a team environment. Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to maintaining high standards and work ethic. Strong ability to create clear and effective PowerPoint presentations. Fluent in spoken and written English. Plus : Relevant certifications such as ISO27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, ISO 22301 Lead Auditor Comptia +, Isaca CSX. Proficiency in Spanish. Hands-on experience with Jira and third-party risk management platforms (e.g. UpGuard). Benefits Meal vouchers (Ticket Restaurant) Welfare benefits program Smart working flexibility Up to 8 hours of paid volunteering time per month Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support work-life balance RAL: €30,000 - €40,000 Cleafy is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any kind. Our company is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Cleafy are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to ethnicity, color, gender, religion or belief, age, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

items.desc: Research & Development Engineer Bouw mee aan de autonome maritieme systemen van morgen De maritieme wereld verandert snel. Schepen en werktuigen worden slimmer, meer verbonden en steeds autonomer. Bij Royal IHC ontwikkelen we de systemen die deze stap mogelijk maakt: van perception en motion control tot robotics en assisted autonomy. Als R&D Engineer werk je aan innovatieve oplossingen voor assisted autonomy op schepen met een kleinere bemanning, remote-controlled toepassingen en autonome en slimme equipment. Je ontwikkelt nieuwe algoritmes en software, test deze in simulaties en brengt ze uiteindelijk naar de praktijk. Van eerste concept tot demonstratie in een operationele omgeving. Wat ga je doen? items.desc: Loop jij warm voor het beheer en de ontwikkeling van datacenter infrastructuur? En vind je het een mooie uitdaging dat deze infrastructuur verspreid is over meerdere locaties? Staat veiligheid en stabiliteit voor jou voorop en ben jij graag technisch aanspreekpunt? Heb jij ook nog hart voor hoger onderwijs en onderzoek? Dan zoeken wij jou. Hier ga je werken SURF is de ict-coöperatie van Nederlandse onderwijs- en onderzoeksinstellingen. Samen met hen werken we aan digitale diensten en complexe innovatievraagstukken om de kwaliteit van onderwijs en onderzoek te verhogen. Wie bij SURF werkt, werkt bij een unieke en open organisatie. Dat merk je aan alles: de structuur van de organisatie, de opzet van de projectteams, de cultuur op onze kantoren en de onderlinge sfeer. SURF biedt uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en gaat flexibel om met de werk/privé-balans. Medewerkers werken graag zelfstandig. Daarnaast krijgt iedereen de ruimte en de vrijheid om talenten zo goed en breed mogelijk in te zetten en te ontwikkelen. In dit team kom je terecht Jij bent onderdeel van het team Datacenter Operations & Networking. Dat is weer onderdeel van de afdeling Data Services binnen de unit Advanced Solutions for Research. Deze unit levert compute- en datadiensten en houdt ze toekomstbestendig door te blijven innoveren. Het team Datacenter Operations & Networking is verantwoordelijk voor het in productie nemen en beheren van servers en netwerkapparatuur in een datacenter omgeving. Ook borgt dit team samen met HPC diensten dat de systemen in functionaliteit, performance en continuïteit blijven aansluiten op de organisatie. Je werkt samen met je collega’s, binnen de afdeling en daarbuiten, in een prettige en collegiale sfeer. Dit ga je doen Jij bent mede-verantwoordelijk voor de datacenter infrastructuur van SURF. Samen met jouw collega’s houd je de datacenteromgeving veilig en operationeel voor onze klanten. Je zorgt voor minimale downtime van de datacenterapparatuur en onderhoudt actief mission-critical dataservers, netwerken en fysieke infrastructuur. Je doet operationeel beheer, installeert apparatuur, onderhoudt bestaande apparatuur en houdt deze up-to-date. Het team werkt volgens de Agile principes en het Scrum framework. Waar je je verder mee bezighoudt: Je voert dagelijkse datacenter-, server- en netwerkhardware werkzaamheden en installaties uit. Daarnaast onderhoud je servers en netwerkinfrastructuur en vervang je fysieke onderdelen; Je signaleert knelpunten en doet verbetervoorstellen; Je werkt de datacenteradministratie en documentatie bij en onderhoudt deze, inclusief rack lay-outs, PDU-beheer en asset management. Dit doe je via onze DCIM- en powermanagementtools; Je zorgt voor kennisontwikkeling en kennisoverdracht en geeft gevraagd en ongevraagd advies aan interne en externe partijen; Je leidt of neemt deel aan projecten; Je reist indien nodig naar andere datacenterlocaties (NH). Dit breng je mee Je hebt een mbo/hbo denk- en werkniveau; Je hebt uitstekende technische en communicatieve vaardigheden; Ook ben je in staat autonoom te werken; Je hebt affiniteit met datacenteromgevingen en ruim 5 jaar werkervaring binnen een datacenteromgeving in een IT/technische operations-rol; Je hebt kennis en ervaring met datacenter- en/of netwerk/server troubleshooting en hardware reparatie; Je kunt denken en handelen vanuit de bedrijfsdoelen en de toegevoegde waarde voor de klant; Je hebt een proactieve, analytische mindset; Je hebt een goede mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Mooie extra’s: Kennis van en ervaring met Agile en Scrum; Kennis van en ervaring met ITSM en ITIL; Ervaring met NVIDIA, Dell of HP hardware. Voorafgaand aan indiensttreding geldt voor deze functie dat een VOG moet worden overgelegd. Bij SURF doen we onze werving met veel plezier zelf, acquisitie stellen we daarom niet op prijs. Solliciteren bij SURF Dit mag je verwachten 1 Solliciteren Nadat je je sollicitatie hebt ingestuurd, ontvang je direct een bevestigingsmail. 2 Reactie Na de sluitingsdatum ontvang je een reactie van ons recruitmentteam. 3 Eerste gesprek We nodigen je uit op ons kantoor, want we willen je leren kennen. 4 Tweede gesprek We nodigen je nogmaals uit voor een gesprek met anderen die jou ook willen leren kennen. 5 Assessment Eventueel vragen we je om een opdracht (assessment) te doen. 6 Ben je de juiste persoon? Dan ontvang je een salarisaanbod van één van onze HR-adviseurs. 7 Welkom bij SURF! Je sluit aan bij onboardingactiviteiten met andere nieuwe collega’s. items.desc: Job Description Are you passionate about scientific research and eager to contribute to the development of innovative poultry vaccines? As a Scientist within our Global Poultry RD team, you will play an important role in research projects focused on improving animal health worldwide. We are looking for a: Scientist - Global Poultry RD Welcome to our team As a Scientist in the Poultry RD team, you will be working in a project team on one or more research projects for the development of poultry vaccines and you will report to a project leader. You will be involved in generating experimental data, test development, and the design and performance of (animal) studies. You will work with increasing independence and apply your scientific and technical expertise to experimental planning, interpretation and problem-solving. Your responsibilities Participate in one or more of our virological, bacteriological, or parasitic research and development projects for poultry vaccines. Planning, organization, execution, interpretation and reporting of lab and/or animal studies in consultation with a project leader. Contribute scientific perspectives and ideas by considering relevant literature and alternative experimental approaches that may support or strengthen ongoing project work. Execution, development, and validation of new in-vitro or in-vivo test methods (e.g. ELISA, qPCR, immunofluorescence), including troubleshooting and optimization of methods where required. Contribute to the development and/or transfer of new or improved products, production processes, laboratory methods, and techniques. Collaborate with other departments involved in the vaccine development (production, quality control and animal research department), providing scientific and technical input within the area of responsibility. Where required, interact with external collaboration partners in consultation with the project leader. Provide technical guidance and support training of trainees, new employees and less-experienced colleagues. Working according to the RD quality system and Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) compliance requirements. Interacting closely with team members within own and other departments. Your profile Minimum Bachelor’s degree (HLO) or higher in a relevant Life Sciences discipline, preferably complemented by relevant industry experience appropriate to the level of education. Scientific curiosity and a constructive, critical mindset, with the persistence to explore alternative approaches and solutions when challenges arise. Experience in laboratory techniques in the areas of virology, bacteriology, or molecular biology. Demonstrated ability to independently plan, execute, troubleshoot, interpret and report experimental work. Affinity or experience with vaccine development is preferred. Experience with the design and execution of laboratory and/or animal studies is an advantage. Good communication and documentation skills. Excellent team player with a flexible mindset and ability to guide and support less-experienced colleagues. Good command of English (speaking and writing). What we offer The opportunity to step into a new, hands‑on position where you’ll work independently, collaborate across functions and take on real leadership responsibilities. Our benefits are very competitive, and the summary below will give you an idea of what you can expect. Competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. 3% year-end payment and an annual bonus based on personal and company performance. At least 35.5 days of paid leave. Travel allowance and a solid pension scheme. A high-quality company restaurant offering fresh and healthy options daily. Excellent accessibility: the train station is located directly at our main entrance and there is ample parking available. A contribution toward your personal sports membership to support your vitality. A beautiful private park on the premises, ideal for a walk, break, or moment of relaxation. Mental well-being support through Lyra Health for you and your family members. Access to a dedicated prayer and meditation room. Extensive development opportunities thanks to the size of the site and the presence of many disciplines and global departments represented in Boxmeer. A workplace within an organization that is continuously growing and evolving. Animal Health Our Animal Health Division is a trusted global leader in veterinary medicine, dedicated to preserving and improving health, well-being, and performance of animals and the people who care for them. We are a global team of professionals working together to make a positive difference in animal care and the world’s food supply and have a deep sense of responsibility towards our customers, consumers, animals, society, and our planet. Through our commitment to The Science of Healthier Animals®, we offer veterinarians, farmers, pet owners and governments one of the widest ranges of veterinary pharmaceuticals, vaccines and health management …

About The Member Company We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we
items.desc: Netherlands Manufacturing Support 0 - 2 years Hengelo On-site Ensure that suppliers not only meet quality requirements but continue to develop themselves, and contribute to building a reliable supply chain for complex high-tech products. About The Member Company We are a global high-tech consultancy company with a team of entrepreneurial engineers, scientists, and digital experts from around the world. Together we form a fast-growing and proud community. We offer consultancy services to high-profile clients globally in diverse service areas, such as: Technology & Engineering Energy & Renewables Life sciences & Pharma Digital & IT About this vacancy A technically complex product is ultimately only as strong as the supply chain behind it. When parts or modules do not meet the correct specifications, it directly impacts quality, planning, and ultimately the final product. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you ensure not only that deviations are resolved. You look further: where does the problem originate, how reliable is the supplier's process, and what is needed to structurally elevate quality to a higher level? At TMC, you work on challenging projects in the high-tech manufacturing industry and machine building. Environments where suppliers are responsible for complex mechanical, mechatronic, and electrical parts and modules, and where quality must be assured from the first product introduction to series production. You operate at the intersection of Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Procurement. You assess suppliers and production processes, analyze risks and deviations, and collaborate with suppliers on sustainable improvements. So, you are not merely the person who determines whether something is right or wrong. You are primarily the technical partner who understands why something goes wrong and how you can work together to ensure it does not happen again. What we expect from you Depending on the project and your experience, you may be involved with tasks such as: Qualifying, assessing, and further developing national and international suppliers. Monitoring and analyzing supplier quality performance and translating results into concrete improvement actions. Investigating supplier deviations and guiding and evaluating 8D's and root cause analyses. Reviewing First Article Inspection (FAI) reports and assisting in the approval of new parts and supplier-product combinations. Conducting and following up on supplier audits as well as assessing production processes and quality assurance at suppliers. Identifying technical and quality risks within the supply chain before they impact production or customers. Leading structural improvement programs with suppliers. Providing input on manufacturability, process control, and technical feasibility of parts and products. Participating in technical reviews, design reviews, and project meetings. Analyzing measurement data, quality data, and recurring deviations. Collaborating with Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality during supplier selection and supplier development. Ensuring relevant quality requirements, specifications, and compliance within the supply chain. Building professional and sustainable relationships with suppliers. Additionally, you may visit suppliers in both domestic and international locations. By observing firsthand how a supplier produces and manages processes, you can achieve more targeted improvements together. A great Supplier Quality Engineer can be critical while maintaining collaboration. You won’t simply accept that a deviation is resolved just because a supplier has sent back a corrective action. You want to understand the actual root cause, whether the production process is sufficiently controlled, and if the chosen solution prevents the same issue from reoccurring in a few months. To do this, you must combine technical expertise with communication skills. You feel comfortable sitting at a table with engineers and purchasers but can just as easily step into a production environment to examine a machining process, measurement method, or quality problem alongside a supplier. items.desc: Why this role matters As the global population moves towards 10 billion, the food chain has to provide safe, ethical and efficient protein with as little waste as possible. Industrial poultry processing plays a major role in that supply, where hygiene, animal welfare, sustainability and precision all have to hold up at high volume. Data-driven automation helps make that possible, from reliable process control to maintenance that prevents avoidable downtime. How we contribute Meyn has worked from Oostzaan for more than 65 years and supplies poultry processing solutions in more than 100 countries. As an OEM and system integrator, we design, build and install complete turnkey factories and smart production lines. Our work combines heavy mechatronics, biomechanics, industrial automation and IT, from real-time motion control to edge AI, vision, sensor fusion and OT/IT integration. It is no-nonsense engineering on steel, with impact. Your contribution as Smart IoT Engineer As Smart IoT Engineer, you make sensor data usable where it matters: on automated processing lines and in the edge layer around them. You design, configure, test and validate smart sensors, connectivity layers and edge hardware in our test labs in Oostzaan and during field tests at international processing facilities. Your work helps Meyn speed up its innovation cycle and roll out digital services more reliably. By connecting measurement data and sensors in a standardised way, you help customers improve OEE, machine reliability and early diagnostics. What you'll actually be doing: Develop, test, validate and integrate IoT solutions, smart sensors and measurement and control systems on automated production lines. Build robust industrial communication networks between sensors, field devices, control systems and edge gateways, using protocols such as IO-Link, OPC UA, MQTT and Modbus TCP. Configure, calibrate and diagnose measurement equipment, optical vision systems, weighing systems and condition monitoring modules for accuracy and reliability. Read, structure and analyse machine and sensor data to reduce downtime, improve process efficiency and enable predictive maintenance. Set up and guide proof of concepts, pre-production tests and pilots at poultry processors worldwide, and translate shop-floor feedback into functional improvements. Document best practices, test protocols and specifications, and act as a point of reference within R&D for emerging Industry 4.0 technologies. What we ask of you A completed bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechatronics, electrical engineering, industrial automation, measurement and control technology or a comparable field, plus at least 5 years of relevant experience. Proven experience, and preferably certification, with industrial PLC platforms; Omron is strongly preferred, and Siemens or Rockwell is a plus. Deep hands-on experience with network and fieldbus standards, including IO-Link, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST / HTTP(S) and TCP/IP. Thorough knowledge of calibration, signal processing and troubleshooting in instrumentation, at ISA / CCST level. Excellent spoken and written Dutch and English, for close cooperation with test build in Oostzaan, international documentation and pilots. Experience with robotics integration on packaging or processing lines, and the ability to balance interests, reason logically during incidents and explain complex topics clearly. What you get in return A salary between €4,160.00 and €7,044.00, depending on education and work experience Flexible working hours: start between 7:00 AM and 9:30 AM An attractive pension scheme 33 days off: 25 vacation days and 8 ADV days (working time reduction days) Room to grow: ample opportunities for personal development and career growth Work from home one day a week A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer You work between Innovation - Plant Automation, R&D and customer sites, turning new automation and data systems into working field solutions. Ready to take automation and IoT systems from R&D into the field? Apply via the button. Do you have any questions about this role? Send an email to Maik Litjens: mlitjens@meyn.com.

Do you have a background in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune and Azure, and do you like taking real responsibility for a platform rather than only working tickets? Would you like to do that in a team that uses AI in its daily work, at a product company instead of a managed services provider? Are you interested in working for a growing and innovative high-tech company, where people and passion are part of our core values? We’d love to have you! Who is Xsens Xsens is a leading full-stack provider of sensors, software, and analytics that enable the digitization of movement. Xsens serves the entertainment, humanoid robotics, health & sports and automation & mobility markets. By turning complex motion data into actionable insight, we help our partners accelerate development, improve control and learning, and bring physically intelligent systems to life. We collaborate with leading global innovators including Boston Dynamics, Toyota, Siemens, Electronic Arts, Epic Games, Netflix and 20th Century Studios, alongside more than 1,000 research institutions, humanoid robotics companies and universities worldwide. You pick up escalations from our servicedesk and are the first technical contact for our partners. Much of the platform is already documented, monitored and automated, so you spend your time on real work instead of finding out how things are set up. This position is based in Enschede, the Netherlands; colleagues work from Enschede, Los Angeles and remote locations worldwide. What makes this role different AI is part of the daily work. Our IT team uses AI assistants for real operations work: troubleshooting, automation, documentation and changes. You learn to work this way from day one. A setup worth getting to know. Azure next to our own virtualisation platform, offices on three continents, a network we run ourselves, and monitoring and automation we built in-house. There is always a next challenge. Colleagues who care about technology. Xsens builds sensors and software for motion capture and robotics, so the people you support are engineers and researchers who understand technology and like to think along. One environment, not a stream of client projects. We are not a managed services provider. You get to know one platform in depth and you see the results of your own improvements. The work itself varies a lot from week to week. Key challenges: Servers and Azure: keep our Windows servers and Azure virtual machines patched, monitored and backed up, including restore tests, together with our Microsoft managed services partner. Security: follow up on alerts with our 24/7 security monitoring partner and carry out recurring checks such as access reviews and vulnerability follow-up. Identity and access: Entra ID and Active Directory: accounts, groups, licences, authentication methods and the automated joiner, mover and leaver flow from our HR system. Improvement and documentation: take part in migrations and clean-ups, automate recurring work with PowerShell, and keep the runbooks and documentation current. Microsoft 365: this is largely your own domain. You run Exchange Online, SharePoint and Teams, keep them secure and decide how we can use them better. Endpoints: manage our laptops and phones in Intune, including Autopilot, compliance, app deployment and Apple devices. Room to grow: once you have found your feet, there is plenty more to get into if it interests you: our network (firewalls, switching, Wi-Fi) across offices worldwide, our Linux servers, our own virtualisation platform, monitoring and automation. We teach you along the way. Balance: roughly 60% operations and security, 40% improvement projects. Xsens is looking for a Cloud System Engineer who thinks in controls, not tickets: you want to know why something is configured the way it is, you fix the cause rather than the symptom, and you write it down. items.desc: At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users. We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do. At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. We only hire the best. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field. About the role We’re scaling fast, and to meet growing demand from both customers and internal teams, we’re expanding our Field Application Engineering team. Today, we are seven engineers split into two focused units: one driving internal testing and system validation, the other leading customer-facing work like demos, onboarding, and training. Together, this team is responsible for one thing above all else: making sure our technical works where it actually matters. As a Field Application Engineer at Six Robotics, you sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and operators. You’ll take cutting-edge autonomy software out into the field, where constraints are real, stakes are high, and feedback is immediate. What you learn in the field directly shapes what we build next. The role requires extensive travel (approximately 150 days per year), both nationally and internationally. This is not a desk role. You will spend most of your time in the field, working side-by-side with operators, testing systems under real conditions, troubleshooting when things don’t go as planned, and making sure every deployment delivers real operational value. What you will do Own customer integrations: take part in technical pre-sales, lead onboarding, capture requirements, and ensure our swarm software is seamlessly integrated and fully operational. Turn needs into plans: create integration steps, checklists, and test procedures that guide both customers and our teams. Run field tests: plan and execute acceptance tests and trials, analyze telemetry, and feed results back into product and engineering. Troubleshoot issues: diagnose and resolve problems across hardware, firmware, networking, and software, often in time-critical situations. Deliver customer demos: plan and execute high-quality demos that communicate the value of our technology to customers and partners. Train and onboarding users: ensure operators understand how to use our systems effectively through structured training and hands-on support. Document and scale: build playbooks, runbooks, and internal best practices to support customers and future field engineers. Be the technical face in the field: act as the bridge between customers, operators, and internal teams, ensuring alignment and continuous improvement. What we are looking for We’re looking for a Field Application Engineer who is as comfortable in front of people as they are working hands-on with complex systems in the field. You are outgoing, robust, and adaptable, someone who thrives in dynamic environments where plans change and challenges arise. You bring structure to complexity, communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and take ownership from problem to solution. You’re a creative problem solver who isn’t afraid to get your hands dirty, whether that means debugging systems in the field, setting up hardware, or working through unexpected issues under pressure. At the same time, you are confident in explaining complex concepts, building customer trust, and representing Six Robotics externally. To be a strong fit for the role, we believe you: Have a strong technical foundation: ability to set up, configure, and troubleshoot complex systems across networking, hardware, and software. Are structured and reliable: capable of managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and field activities without losing clarity or momentum. Is an excellent communicator: able to explain complex technical concepts to operators, customers, and internal teams. Are hands-on and proactive: you take initiative, solve problems end-to-end, and are comfortable working directly with hardware and systems in the field. Are willing to travel extensively: able and motivated to spend around 150 days per year in the field, both …

items.desc: Job Description Tieto Tech Consulting har lenge levert data- og AI-løsninger til virksomheter i Norge og internasjonalt, med et dataingeniørmiljø på over 80 fagpersoner. Nå bygger vi et nytt, spesialisert team innenfor dette miljøet, med mandat til å rette denne kompetansen målrettet mot mellomstore norske produksjonsbedrifter og industrivirksomheter, fra prognosemodeller og kvalitetskontroll med maskinsyn til prediktivt vedlikehold og produksjonsoptimalisering. Vi jobber tett med kunden fra første kartlegging til ferdig løsning, og vi eier leveransen og risikoen selv, ikke bare spesifikasjonen. Du blir med i et lite, flatt team i tidlig fase av denne satsningen, der du får eierskap til både teknisk retning og kunderelasjon. I perioder mellom prosjekter i dette teamet vil du jobbe som konsulent på andre oppdrag i Tieto Tech Consulting, på lik linje med øvrige konsulenter hos oss. Vi ser etter deg som vil være med å bygge moderne dataplattformer, utvikle robuste datapipelines, og – der det er relevant – trene og sette maskinlæringsmodeller i produksjon, og omsette data til reell forretningsverdi for kunder i produksjonssektoren. Som Data Engineer hos Tieto Tech Consulting vil du jobbe med Plattform og infrastruktur: Designe og implementere skalerbar dataplattform og -arkitektur, utover hyllevareløsninger, med vekt på gjenbrukbare løsninger (infrastruktur som kode, maler, blueprints) som kan videreutvikles fra prosjekt til prosjekt. Datapipelines, modeller og bruk: Utvikle og vedlikeholde datapipelines og datamodeller (daglig, månedlig eller ad-hoc), sikre korrekt datainntak og etterlevelse av datastyring, og – avhengig av bakgrunn og interesse – bidra til utvikling av prognose-, klassifiserings- eller maskinsyn-modeller for industrielle bruksområder. Kundenær kartlegging og leveranse: Delta direkte i kartleggingsfasen hos kunden – forstå datagrunnlag, forretningsmål og målarkitektur – og bidra til å definere konkrete leveranser som kunden faktisk kan ta i bruk. Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter en nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert datautvikler som ønsker å jobbe med moderne dataplattformer og skape verdi gjennom data. Du kjenner deg gjerne igjen i flere av disse punktene: Du har minst to års erfaring fra en tilsvarende rolle. Du programmerer godt i Python og/eller SQL , og liker å jobbe med data. Du har erfaring med dataintegrasjon og datapipelines , gjerne i teknologier som Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake eller tilsvarende skybaserte plattformer. Du har jobbet med datamigrering , fra uthenting av data fra ulike kilder til utvikling, drift og overvåking av robuste datapipelines. Har du erfaring med maskinlæring , som prognosemodeller, computer vision eller anomalideteksjon, er det et stort pluss – men ikke en forutsetning. Du har høyere utdanning innen teknologi, matematikk, ingeniørfag eller andre relevante realfag. Mastergrad er en fordel. Relevante sertifiseringer innen Azure, Microsoft Fabric eller Databricks er positivt, men vi verdsetter også praktisk erfaring. Du kommuniserer flytende på engelsk , både muntlig og skriftlig. Du behersker norsk godt , slik at du kan samarbeide og kommunisere direkte med kundene våre. Som person tror vi du trives med bredt eierskap og liker å jobbe tett på kunden, ikke bare på koden. Du tar ansvar for å organisere eget arbeid, er en lagspiller som deler kunnskap med kolleger, og har nok forretningsforståelse til å omsette et kundebehov til noe konkret og leverbart. Du er nysgjerrig på ny teknologi, men enda viktigere: du er komfortabel i en tidlig fase der prosesser og ansvar ikke alltid er ferdig definert, og du bidrar selv til å forme dem. Vi tilbyr Vi tilbyr deg faglig utvikling, meningsfulle prosjekter, en åpen kultur og en fremragende balanse mellom jobb og fritid! Hos oss får du muligheten til å være med fra starten på en ny satsning i en voksende, viktig sektor – med kort vei fra idé til kundelevering. Vi legger vekt på faglig utvikling gjennom kurs, sertifiseringer og faggrupper, og du blir en del av et inkluderende og støttende miljø, både sosialt og profesjonelt. Vi tilbyr fleksibel hybrid arbeidsmodell, privat helseforsikring og gode treningsmuligheter, enten på vårt eget treningsrom på Fornebu eller gjennom støtte til eksternt treningssenter. Ble du inspirert? Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad! Legg ved CV eller LinkedIn-profil, så tar vi kontakt med deg. Intervjuer holdes fortløpende, så vi oppfordrer deg til å søke allerede i dag. Hvis du har spørsmål om stillingen, ta kontakt med rekrutterende leder Eirik Lyngvi, eirik.lyngvi@tieto.com Additional Information At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit …

As our Data Analytics Specialist, you’ll be a hands-on technical expert with a strong focus on Power BI, helping our global organization turn data into actionable insights. Working with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, you’ll investigate business challenges, uncover the drivers behind performance, and identify opportunities to improve decision-making. You’ll also help advance our analytics capabilities through AI and automation. What You’ll Do You’ll develop BI solutions that help our teams across Marine Operations, Commercial, and Logistics understand performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions. Combining technical expertise with analytical thinking and business understanding, you’ll translate complex questions into practical solutions. Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI dashboards, interactive and paginated reports, and data models. Translate business requirements into reliable, scalable data products, including well-structured data models and self-service reporting solutions. Analyze data to identify patterns, trends, and deviations, investigate business performance, and pinpoint opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with data engineers, IT, and business stakeholders to deploy and monitor analytics solutions, share knowledge, and support data-driven ways of working. Use AI tools and automation to streamline analytical workflows and generate deeper insights, critically evaluating their accuracy and business value. What You’ll Bring You’re a technically strong and curious person with a solid foundation in BI and data analysis. You enjoy understanding how things work, solving problems, and building reliable solutions that create business value. With a strong drive to learn and improve, you’re eager to deepen your skills in advanced analytics, programming, and AI, and turn new knowledge into practical solutions. Strong hands-on Power BI expertise, including report development, data modelling, and DAX. At least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar role, delivering analytics solutions in cross-functional teams. Proficiency in SQL, with experience in relational databases, data modelling, and data warehouse concepts. A bachelor’s degree, preferably a master’s, in engineering, statistics, technology, optimization, business, or another quantitative field. Some programming experience, for example in Python, and an interest in developing these skills further. Strong communication skills, a curious and improvement-oriented mindset, and an interest in using AI tools critically and effectively. Drive alignment with stakeholders and set partner expectations through clear written and verbal
items.desc: Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world, and we are constantly innovating how entertainment is imagined, created, and delivered to a global audience. Engineering teams within Netflix work diligently and strategically every day towards the mission, and Content Infrastructure & Solutions (CIS) teams empower engineers working on content and studio applications to be innovative and agile in supporting our massive global content production needs in an ever-growing complex software landscape. About the team Within the CIS organization, the Media Infrastructure Platform teams (MIP) are part of a media-focused engineering group that provides highly available infrastructure for media processing, storage, and assetization across all Netflix productions and licensed content. Key systems we build are a platform for massive-scale media processing ( 1 , 2 ), media storage infrastructure ( 3 , 4 ), and an asset management platform ( 5 , 6 ). We’re extending our Warsaw branch of the MIP team to own the entire search space across all MIP platforms end-to-end . So far, the search problem space spans file storage, media assets, and media annotation systems. Each of these is a centralized platform serving as the backend for dozens of studio applications used by film and TV series production teams, and beyond: use cases range from production sets to promotional images and videos to studio-related documents and ads. Our current search ecosystem indexes the entire media portfolio, across its dependencies and relations, and includes temporal and spatial annotations. We also provide seamless interconnections across indexes from non-media space systems. Additionally, the growing scale presents an ongoing technical opportunity: current indexes have hundreds of terabytes and are growing, while low-latency search remains crucial for the business. What You Will Do Design, build, and operate software solutions and tooling that enable non-platform engineering teams to operate media infrastructure at a large scale. Ensure that user data and indexes are consistent and highly available, while optimizing systems for performance, cost, and future scale growth. Drive alignment with stakeholders and set partner expectations through clear written and verbal communication. Lead cross-functional initiatives and collaborate with engineers, product managers, and Technical Program Managers across teams. Minimum Qualifications Proficiency in backend software engineering using languages such as Java, Go, Python, Scala, Kotlin, or C#, with a strong foundation in writing clean, maintainable, high-performance code. User-focused engineering approach oriented toward building centralized platforms, contracts, frameworks, or shared tooling that serve as reliable foundations for other software engineering teams. Strong understanding of production environments, with a focus on building maintainable and performant software backed by testing and observability, including participation in an on-call rotation (with flexible scheduling or coverage accommodations supported where appropriate). Track record of taking independent action, maintaining accountability, and delivering systems end-to-end in dynamic and evolving environments. Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating effectively with engineers and product managers across teams. Alignment with the Netflix Culture and the ability to contribute effectively within an open, high-freedom work environment. Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in Java. Foundational experience in building and operating large-scale distributed systems responsible for managing data persistence. Direct experience working with search technologies such as OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, or with graph-based data stores such as AWS Neptune. Experience in API design and implementation using gRPC and/or GraphQL. Experience navigating ambiguous environments and helping to shape problem definitions as well as technical solutions. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. Główne odpowiedzialności na tym stanowisku obejmują: prowadzenie inwestycji od analizy potrzeb i określenia zakresu, przez projektowanie, zakupy i wykonawstwo, aż po rozruch, odbiór, rozliczenie i przekazanie do eksploatacji; opracowywanie i weryfikowanie założeń technicznych, opisów przedmiotu zamówienia, standardów wykonania oraz kryteriów odbiorowych dla automatyki, AKPiA i instalacji elektrycznych węzłów cieplnych; planowanie zakresu, harmonogramu, budżetu, zasobów i kluczowych etapów dla równolegle prowadzonych zadań; nadzorowanie pracy projektantów i wykonawców pod kątem jakości, bezpieczeństwa, zgodności z umową, kosztów, terminów oraz kompletności dokumentacji; udział w próbach funkcjonalnych, uruchomieniach i odbiorach węzłów cieplnych oraz sieci; przygotowywanie postępowań zakupowych, analizowanie ofert i udział w negocjacjach; kontrolowanie zmian oraz rzeczowo-finansowe rozliczanie projektów; identyfikowanie ryzyk technicznych, kosztowych, terminowych i eksploatacyjnych oraz wdrażanie działań ograniczających; koordynowanie współpracy z zespołami Sprzedaży, Zakupów, Eksploatacji i BHP, a także z odbiorcami ciepła, projektantami, wykonawcami i przedstawicielami administracji; raportowanie postępu prac, ryzyk i ewentualnych odchyleń. Stanowisko nie obejmuje zarządzania bezpośrednim zespołem. Ważną częścią roli jest jednak koordynowanie pracy zespołów projektowych i wykonawczych, jasne określanie odpowiedzialności i wymagań technicznych oraz skuteczne egzekwowanie jakości, bezpieczeństwa, terminów i warunków umownych. O Tobie Szukamy osoby, która potrafi łączyć wiedzę techniczną z umiejętnością samodzielnego prowadzenia projektów inwestycyjnych. Dobrze odnajdziesz się w tej roli, jeśli bierzesz odpowiedzialność za podejmowane decyzje, potrafisz wyznaczać priorytety i konsekwentnie doprowadzasz zadania do końca. Od kandydatów na to stanowisko oczekujemy: wyższego wykształcenia technicznego, preferowane kierunki to automatyka i robotyka, elektrotechnika, energetyka, inżynieria sanitarna lub kierunki pokrewne; minimum 3 lat doświadczenia w obszarze inwestycji, projektowania, uruchamiania lub eksploatacji sieci ciepłowniczych albo węzłów cieplnych; wiedzy dotyczącej funkcjonowania węzłów cieplnych i systemów ciepłowniczych; znajomości zagadnień związanych z hydrauliką, pomiarami temperatury, ciśnienia, przepływu i energii, regulacją PID, czujnikami oraz elementami wykonawczymi; znajomości zagadnień z zakresu ochrony przeciwporażeniowej, zabezpieczeń, uziemień i pomiarów odbiorczych; umiejętności czytania i analizowania dokumentacji technicznej, w tym schematów AKPiA i elektrycznych, kosztorysów oraz dokumentacji powykonawczej; znajomości Prawa budowlanego, zasad procesu inwestycyjnego i odbiorów oraz podstawowych zasad dotyczących zamówień, urządzeń i instalacji energetycznych; świadectw kwalifikacyjnych SEP Grupy 1 i Grupy 2 w zakresie eksploatacji E; znajomości języka angielskiego na poziomie min. items.desc: About us TÜV Rheinland is a leading global independent testing service provider with 150 years of experience and more than 28 000 employees worldwide. Our independent team of experts stand for the quality and safety of people, technology, and the environment in nearly every sphere of life, as well as offering training in a broad range of fields and industries. In 2018, we created the Shared Service Centres Organization to support our business with three locations: Cologne, Germany; Katowice, Poland; and Dalian, China. As the internal service provider to TÜV Rheinland, the SSC Organization strives for excellence in everything we do. We have a passion for what we do. And we love what we do. Join our dynamically growing team of professionals and a company with long-lasting tradition, firm values, and a courageous vision for the future. Team Coordinator - Accounts Payable (w/m/d) A coordination-focused role supporting stable delivery, strong controls and continuous improvement across Accounts Payable. WHAT TASKS CAN YOU EXPECT? Team coordination, performance monitoring and delivery suport Support the AP Team Leader in coordinating daily, weekly and month-end activities, ensuring clear priorities, ownership and timely delivery across the team. Monitor workload, ageing, backlogs, service levels and operational risks; highlight deviations early and coordinate recovery actions with the responsible team members. Support the Team Leader in delivering agreed KPIs and quality targets by preparing performance insights, following up on actions and facilitating structured team reviews. Coordinate the introduction of new processes, tools and ways of working, including readiness checks, communication, training, documentation and post-implementation stabilization. Coordinate internal control activities within AP, including evidence collection, control calendars, follow-up of findings and timely completion of remediation actions. Coordinate the operational activities of the payment team and support alignment between invoice processing, payment execution and issue resolution. Identify recurring process failures, bottlenecks and handover gaps; translate them into structured improvement actions with clear owners and deadlines. Act as an escalation and coordination point for material or cross-functional issues, ensuring the right subject-matter experts take ownership and decisions are documented. Prepare concise operational updates, risk summaries and decision points for the Team Leader and relevant stakeholders. Operational oversight and subject-matter suport Provide guidance on complex or non-standard AP topics and bring together the relevant experts when issues require cross-functional resolution. Support month-end and critical operational periods through coordination, prioritization and progress monitoring rather than routine invoice posting. Review process documentation, desktop procedures and control descriptions to ensure they remain accurate, practical and aligned with the operating model. Support knowledge transfer and capability building across the team, particularly for senior accountants expected to own complex case resolution within their area. Perform selected operational activities only where required for business continuity, testing, implementation or stabilization of a new process. ROLE FOCUS: This is not a routine invoice-processing role and does not replace the ownership of senior accountants for resolving complex operational cases. The Team Coordinator enables delivery through coordination, monitoring, escalation and process improvement. WHAT SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES SHOULD YOU HAVE? Minimum 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations or a comparable SSC/BPO environment. Practical understanding of end-to-end AP processes, month-end activities, payments, internal controls and operational risk management. Previous experience in team coordination, work allocation, KPI monitoring, project coordination or process implementation is strongly preferred. Ability to turn operational data into clear priorities, actions and management-ready updates. Strong ownership, organization and follow-through, with the ability to coordinate several workstreams and stakeholders simultaneously. Confident communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to challenge constructively and clarify accountability. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on root causes and sustainable solutions rather than repeated workarounds. Very good command of German and English. University or college degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field is preferred. WHAT CAN WE OFFER TO YOU? A visible development path towards team leadership, process ownership or operational excellence roles. An opportunity to shape how AP work is coordinated, measured and improved across teams. Hands-on involvement in process implementations, internal controls, payment operations and …

Role will include management of clinical trial applications to Competent Authorities, Ethics Committees and Regulatory Agencies, and the research, review and reporting on applicable global regulations and requirements. Develop stakeholder tools, process/document regulatory risk assessments, and provide support, expertise and represent the unit with other functional units, sponsors, researchers and/or regulatory authorities. Ensure high quality, timely service delivery processes are maintained in accordance with corporate, industry and regulatory standards and guidelines. May be required to coach peers and/or provide input for staff performance reviews. Unit Management Coordinate the day to day delivery of regulatory services and processes, including compilation of regulatory filings/submissions/revisions for projects, third party vendors and clinical sites. Conduct or assist with regulatory and/or safety reviews, create regulatory-related tools, educational/training materials, and remain current on all aspects of clinical research regulatory requirements and industry best practices, communicating changes to project leaders in a timely manner. Client Services As the corporate subject specialist in regulatory affairs, provide regulatory, ethics and/or pharmacovigilance guidance and support to project stakeholders. Represent the unit at project meetings, assisting with project education/regulatory tool development, at regulatory reviews and audits, with clients ensuring expectations are managed and met, with regulatory, ethics and government representatives and, when appropriate, respond to regulatory queries on behalf of the client. Regulatory Strategy Development Identify changes in clinical research regulatory requirements and industry best practices and recommend, implement, and maintain corporate regulatory strategies, working with other experts (safety, quality assurance) when appropriate, to meet or exceed compliance requirements of evolving regulatory initiatives. Participate in specialized conferences/meetings to increase knowledge as needed. Project Support Regularly respond to registration requests and work with project teams to identify regulatory requirements. Assist in the preparation of regulatory submissions and support summaries. Ensure project/clinical site files and documents are developed, maintained, revised, archived and/or destroyed in accordance with project and regulatory requirements and that all project stakeholders are fully informed and trained on all applicable regulatory requirements. Qualifications Applicants should have a minimum of an undergraduate degree and 4-6 years of relevant experience in Clinical Research/Regulatory Affairs. items.desc: At GE Vernova, we are tackling some of the world's most challenging energy problems. Joining our team means you will work on technology that powers the world, surrounded by people who are committed to safety, innovation, and sustainability. We believe that diverse perspectives drive the best solutions; that is why we foster an inclusive environment where your voice is heard, your curiosity is encouraged, and your professional development is a priority. We offer the opportunity to take true technical ownership of complex hardware while working alongside world-class experts who are dedicated to mentoring the next generation of engineering leaders. As a Mechanical Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the design, analysis, and optimization of components across our gas power portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to deliver high-quality solutions, drive product upgrades, and ensure our designs meet rigorous performance and safety standards. This role requires a balance of technical ownership, innovative problem-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Job Description Key Responsibilities: Design & Analysis: Execute mechanical design and analysis (stress, modal, lifing) for assigned components in gas turbines. Technical Stewardship: Take ownership of mechanical hardware; perform validation testing; and evaluate designs for factors like thermal growth, manufacturing variation, and assembly stack-up to ensure optimal product behavior. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering experts, manufacturing, and sourcing teams to optimize sub-systems and components. Continuous Improvement: Support root cause analyses (RCA) to improve reliability, quality and yield. Apply Lean principles to streamline processes and drive innovation. Project Delivery: Manage milestones through formal/informal technical reviews, ensuring compliance with NPI processes and design practices. Mentorship: Foster a collaborative environment by building strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Principal and Chief Engineers. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related STEM field from an accredited institution. Technical proficiency in engineering software (ANSYS, NX) and programming languages (Python, Excel VBA) for data analysis. A "Lean" mindset, familiarity with AI-driven tools, and a passion for innovative design. Demonstrated ability to thrive in a collaborative, inclusive, and fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills, with a transparent approach to project management and problem-solving. Note: To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA. For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

items.desc: REQ-10124770 17/11/2026 Data Science Warsaw, Poland ING Hubs ING Hubs Poland is hiring! The expected salary for this position: 9600 - 18 000 PLN gross. The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations. Wholesale Banking Model Data Analyst Expert As a Wholesale Banking Model Data Analyst you will be responsible for data and portfolio related topics in one of the squads in Wholesale Banking Model Data Team. The Data Team is responsible for E2E data solutions for various IRB and IFRS9 projects, covering entire model life cycle needs. Being the main point of contact for data delivery projects for Wholesale Banking portfolios will allow you to deep dive into portfolio and model specifics across different Rating Systems in Wholesale Banking domain. You will closely cooperate with model owners and model development teams on various regulatory projects in credit risk area. You will gain knowledge about data we collect in ING Group, analyze it and prepare prototypes of new data structures that will be used further in the process. We have expertise about Rating Systems, Wholesale Banking portfolios and stakeholder needs on different model lifecycle phase. As a Wholesale Banking Model Data Analyst you will have crucial role to play in delivering high quality data to other participants of risk processes (i.e. credit risk modelers, validators and many others). We are looking for you, if you: would like to support Wholesale Banking Model Data Team with insight about data and credit risk methodologies, would like to work with other Analysts from all over the world on understanding the data, IRB/IFRS9 models and portfolio specifics, would like to define how the data process flow for Model Development / Model Monitoring / Model validation should look like, have experience in gathering and analyzing data requirements and, based on them, preparing the data, have 3 - 7 years of experience working in the area in data analytics or data science, have 3 - 7 years hands-on experience working with SQL and/or SAS (preferably SAS Enterprise Guide), are able to define problems, analyze key information and make connections, in order to find appropriate solutions. You will get extra points for: experience working in a bank, financial institution or other institution regulated by the government, knowledge about credit risk models (PD, LGD, EAD, IFRS9, IRB), working in Agile environment, and knowing how to make it a real part of your job, experience with GIT or other version control systems. Your responsibilities data analysis and data delivery for Wholesale Banking portfolios, data processing, data quality assessment, and all other tasks related to data, writing efficient SAS macros programs, finding discrepancies in the data and proposing solutions to the problems by conducting various analyses in 4GL/SQL, conducting Data Quality Tests, gathering requirements regarding modelling datasets from our stakeholders, creating documentation related to the data (Data Plans and other data documentation required for Model Life Cycle), checking with Model Owners/Model Developers/Validators whether all the assumptions in the created datasets are in line with their expectations. Information about the team: Credit Risk Model Development is an international, global team (more than 400 risk experts) located in different locations in Europe (e.g., Amsterdam, Milan, Warsaw). The key responsibility is development of robust credit risk models firmly embedded in the regulatory environment. The role naming convention in the global ING job architecture will be “Data Scientist III”. Learn more about our benefits

items.desc: BorgWarner is a global product leader in delivering innovative and sustainable mobility solutions for the vehicle market. We are a company of innovators and independent thinkers that brings together talented employees, meaningful work, and amazing technology in a unique environment. This role is a good opportunity for someone with a mechanical, mechatronics or data background who would like to develop their skills in data analytics and NVH engineering . items.desc: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One. As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other. We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation. We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do. Job Description Key Responsibilities Manage and resolve merchant and customer disputes, retrieval requests and chargeback cases in accordance with VISA/MasterCard rules and regulations. Research chargeback cases and make well-founded decisions, using all available resources and reviewing merchant and issuer correspondence. Ensure chargebacks are processed accurately and within required deadlines. Work to daily targets, ensuring cases are handled efficiently and in line with agreed productivity and quality standards. Prepare clear and professional correspondence related to disputes, retrieval requests and chargebacks. Review merchant sales drafts and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance with card scheme and other applicable regulations. Provide the Call Center team with complete and accurate information so they can communicate effectively with merchants, clarify inquiries and resolve disputes. Identify problems related to merchant disputes and department systems and propose solutions Collaborate with internal teams to ensure efficient case resolution and positive customer experience. What We're Looking For Very good command of Polish (minimum C1 level) and English (minimum B2 level). Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and other software tools; experience with AI-powered tools would be an advantage. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to interpret data and work accurately with financial data and documentation. Strong decision-making skills and the ability to identify and resolve exceptions. Effective verbal and written communication, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities and deadlines simultaneously. Proactive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Previous experience in banking, financial services, payment processing or in two or more functional areas of a Chargebacks department would be an advantage. What We Offer Full-time employment on a fixed-term contract to cover maternity leave. Hybrid working model with 3 days per week in our Warsaw office. Flexible working hours between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM (8-hour shifts). items.desc: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. The program Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS) The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V. To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce. Role ID - 2026-0157 Role Background The NATO Communications and Information Academy (NCI Academy) located in Oeiras, Portugal currently delivers NATO technical and operational training on a variety of hardware and software systems. In the light of these activities, the NCI Academy is looking to outsource the delivery of Tools for Operations Planning Functional Area Services (TOPFAS) training, as well as the development and updates of the training materials, the management of course iterations and to provide SME support to NATO and National HQ as required. The contractor shall make available personnel capable of providing the services specified in the Statement of Work (SoW). The intent is to obtain the services of TOPFAS subject matter experts who can deliver training and update training materials. The service shall involve TOPFAS training delivery, iterations management, course material development, including e-learning content and management of existing e-learning content, course update, and TOPFAS Usage Mentoring to customers from the NATO Command Structure, NATO Force Structure, NATO member MODs, and Partner Nations, as well as testing TOPFAS software and provide bug reports. Course iterations delivery shall be conducted at the NCI Academy in Oeiras, and optionally at any of the NATO or National locations. Working closely with Engineering, Innovation, Sales, and Strategic Marketing, the role requires understanding automotive components, vehicle architectures, materials, assembly processes, and customer technical requirements to identify potential product and application development opportunities. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business to run like clockwork. The Refrigeration Specialist will help ensure timely responses to alarms, high quality work order management, and adherence to refrigeration processes and compliance standards. items.desc: Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld. Det här är en unik chans att från grunden vara med och sätta riktningen för hur vi bygger vår digitala och AI-drivna verksamhet. Digitala verktyg och AI skapar nya möjligheter, men det verkliga värdet uppstår först när lösningarna hänger ihop, återanvänder gemensamma plattformar och kan skalas. Som Enterprise Architect för Digital, Data & AI kommer du bland annat att sätta principer, målbilder och referensarkitekturer för digitalisering, AI och datadrivna plattformar inom Saab Aeronautics. Du är teknikoberoende och ser till att arkitekturen hänger ihop över både IT:s och verksamhetens leveransfunktioner. Tillsammans med verksamhetsledare, produktorganisationer, IT och tekniska team samt övriga arkitekter i vår organisation bidrar du till att vi fattar kloka arkitektur- och lösningsval, och du säkerställer även att vi harmoniserar arbetssätt och arkitektur över organisatoriska gränser. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Ta fram och förvalta arkitekturprinciper, målarkitekturer, referensmönster och färdplaner för digitalisering, AI och datadrivna plattformar Harmonisera arkitektur och arbetssätt mellan IT och verksamhetens leveransfunktioner Översätta verksamhetsbehov och strategiska mål till arkitektur- och lösningsval Tillsammans med Digital Transformation Driver bedöma genomförbarhet, arkitekturell passform och teknisk risk i nya idéer och initiativ Arbeta tillsammans med AI Implementation Specialist för att ta fram riktlinjer, policys och principer för säker och ansvarsfull användning av AI Ge arkitekturstöd och beslutsunderlag till initiativ och investeringar, och säkerställa återanvändning av gemensamma plattformar och komponenter Bidra till arkitekturstyrning och arkitekturgranskningar ur ett AI- och dataperspektiv, samt till att etablera gemensamma ramverk och standarder inom Saab Vara en trovärdig samarbetspartner och coach för arkitekter, produktteam och verksamhet Din profil Vi söker dig som brinner för att skapa hållbar struktur i en snabbt föränderlig teknikvärld, motiveras av att lösa komplexa utmaningar och vill vara med och skapa något nytt och modigt. För att trivas i rollen behöver du både kunna vara strategisk och teknikdjup, du ser till helheten snarare än till en enskild plattform eller leverantör. Du har god samarbetsförmåga, är skicklig på att bygga relationer och skapar förtroende och samsyn mellan verksamhet och teknik. Du är strukturerad och systematisk, kan förklara komplexa samband på ett enkelt sätt och driver förändring genom inflytande och engagemang. Vi ser gärna att du har: Kandidat- eller masterexamen inom datavetenskap, ingenjörsvetenskap, informationssystem eller motsvarande område. Dokumenterad och lång erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete som enterprise-, IT- eller lösningsarkitekt, med god kunskap om ramverk och metoder för Enterprise Architecture (EA). Erfarenhet av digitalisering och arkitektur för datadrivna plattformar, integration och moderna, molnbaserade lösningar. God förståelse för AI-lösningar och vad som krävs för att införa dem i skarp miljö, inklusive data, plattformar och driftsättning. Dokumenterad förmåga att samarbeta mellan verksamhet och teknik samt att översätta affärsbehov till arkitektur och tekniska krav. Erfarenhet av säkerhet, styrning (governance) och regelefterlevnad inom digitala och AI-relaterade projekt. Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. God vana att facilitera och presentera. Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete i stora, komplexa och tvärfunktionella miljöer inom exempelvis teknik-, tillverknings- eller försvarsindustrin. Erfarenhet av att etablera arkitekturstyrning, principer och gemensamma arbetssätt över organisatoriska gränser. Praktisk erfarenhet av AI-, data- och analysplattformar. Erfarenhet av verksamhetsarkitektur och processmodellering, exempelvis värdeflödesanalys (Value Stream Mapping). Arkitekturcertifiering, exempelvis TOGAF, eller motsvarande. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att …
