items.desc: Who are Lifeplan? Want to make a real difference to people’s future? At Lifeplan, Sweden’s largest digital pension advisor, we help individuals make smarter decisions about one of their most important investments - their pension. Through a unique combination of advanced technology, research-driven analysis and fully independent advice, we provide tailored pension advice based on each individual’s life situation and goals. Our ambition is simple: to make it easy to do the right thing, and help people maximise the value of their pension savings over time. Lifeplan is a sister company to Benifex, a global SaaS company within employee benefits and total rewards. Lifeplan and its sister company Waizer are separate regulated entities, holding complementary permissions for insurance distribution and investment advice respectively. Lifeplan works closely with Benifex and shares its Stockholm office, giving you the opportunity to be part of a smaller, specialist company while also benefiting from the expertise, network and development opportunities of an international tech organisation. Why you should apply Take full executive responsibility for Lifeplan and lead the business through its next stage of growth and international expansion. Shape the strategy, product direction and commercial development of a purpose-driven digital business operating at the intersection of technology, pensions and financial advice. Lead a highly specialised organisation of approximately 20 people, while having access to the capabilities, international reach and client base of the wider Benifex Group. Play a central role in scaling Lifeplan beyond Sweden, developing its operating model, technology and organisation for a multi-market future. Role overview As CEO of Lifeplan and Waizer, you will have full executive accountability for both businesses. You will lead Lifeplan through its next stage of growth, with a particular focus on scaling the platform beyond Sweden while building an organisation that combines entrepreneurial pace with strong regulatory governance. You will own strategy, controllable P&L, business priorities, commercial development, governance and organisational leadership. You will also act as the primary interface with the Board, supervisory authority and wider Benifex Group, leveraging Benifex’s international footprint and capabilities as Lifeplan expands into new markets. Responsibilities Define and execute Lifeplan’s long-term strategy, owning the controllable P&L, business planning, investment priorities and delivery against growth and profitability targets. Lead Lifeplan’s international expansion, including market prioritisation, market-entry strategy and assessment of regulatory, product and commercial feasibility across new markets. Own Lifeplan’s commercial performance and identify opportunities to accelerate growth through client acquisition, strategic partnerships and Benifex’s international client base and distribution channels. Set the product vision and priorities for Lifeplan’s advisory platform, ensuring the technology, advisory models and algorithms are scalable, secure and appropriately governed as the business expands. Serve as CEO of Waizer and lead regulatory and governance responsibilities across both entities, including Board reporting, relationships with supervisory authorities, compliance, risk management and internal controls. Lead and develop Lifeplan’s management team and organisation, building strong accountability, leadership capability and an operating model that can support international growth. Drive AI-enabled transformation across the business, evolving ways of working, skills, processes and tools while ensuring responsible adoption and appropriate governance. Act as Lifeplan’s primary executive representative within Benifex, building effective collaboration across commercial, product, technology, legal, compliance, HR and finance. What we are looking for Senior leadership experience as a CEO, Managing Director, COO, CTO or General Manager or equivalent broad business leadership role, including meaningful P&L responsibility and experience building high-performing teams. A proven track record of scaling a product or service into new international markets, translating strategy into sustainable commercial growth. Leadership experience within regulated financial services, specifically MiFID and/or IDD environments, including working directly with Boards and regulators. items.desc: Location: Zurich, Zurich, CH As a Graduate, you will develop a strong natural catastrophe end-to-end modelling foundation while building the technical and interpersonal skills needed to start your career in the reinsurance industry. Through hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and experience beyond the Cat Perils EMEA & Method team, the programme will support your growth into future roles within our organisation. As a Natural Catastrophe Analyst, you will apply your scientific expertise to build, maintain and communicate the next generation of Nat Cat models & Nat Cat underwriting for Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) region. Start your journey towards a successful career! We’re looking for curious, motivated graduates with strong people skills who want to grow, learn, and make a difference. If you hold a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience, apply to our 18-month Graduate Programme starting 1 September 2027. You’ll gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of reinsurance, rotate into a different local team, and receive tailored training to build your expertise. This is your chance to shape your future, help protect societies from the world’s most threatening hazards and make the world more resilient. The Graduate Programme will equip you with the skills, foundations and network to pursue a wide range of career opportunities. About the Role Are you aspiring to use your scientific background to increase society's resilience against natural catastrophes with the help of re/insurance? Do you want to work at the interface of science and commercial re/insurance products? We enable Swiss Re to maintain and expand its leadership in natural catastrophe re/insurance, in close collaboration with underwriters and clients. You will engage in and ultimately lead projects to improve natural catastrophe (Nat Cat) risk assessment and its seamless integration into Swiss Re's underwriting processes by collaborating with a wide range of internal and external teams on natural catastrophe related topics and develop novel insurance solutions to increase resilience against natural catastrophes. Let us specify the responsibilities: Build, maintain and communicate Nat Cat risk views for the EMEA region, primarily extratropical windstorms and severe convective storms, but also wildfires and/or tropical cyclones You advance our priority projects with a business mentality and ask the right questions to make sure we apply our risk view with maximum impact for the company. Acquire and analyse data to quantify the impacts of natural catastrophes on buildings, facilities, and infrastructure. Establish yourself as an expert on natural catastrophe risk and modelling within Swiss Re and especially underwriting teams, effectively communicate risk views internally and externally. Foster a common view and narrative around atmospheric perils in the re/insurance context. About the Team We are looking forward to welcoming a new team member to the EMEA Cat Perils & Methods team that belongs to a global Cat Perils team, and the Swiss Re's Property & Casualty business unit. The Cat Perils team owns Swiss Re’s global natural catastrophe risk assessment, the respective modelling and geo capabilities. On the natural catastrophe side, we advance innovative probabilistic and proprietary modelling technology for seismic, atmospheric and flood hazards. As part of the global Cat Perils team, you will work alongside a diverse group of about 70 colleagues across three locations in a supportive and collaborative environment where ownership, learning, teamwork, and sharing ideas are encouraged every day. About You You demonstrate a high degree of initiative and an interest in interdisciplinary work. Being a fast learner who is eager to take ownership, you approach problems with curiosity and flexibility. With you we win a colleague with excellent social competences who actively contributes to our team spirit. Requirements: Successfully completed university degree in quantitative sciences like meteorology, physics, mathematics, data/computer science, or equivalent. High motivation to become a re/insurance expert and create commercial value from scientific insights. Strong digital literacy. You have experience in programming (e.g. Python, R, Matlab) and have a record in developing numerical models and/or data analysis applications. items.desc: Location: Zurich, Zurich, CH Launch your investment career at one of the world's leading institutional investors. Join Swiss Re's Graduates Program and become part of the Financial Markets Program (FMP), our flagship rotational program designed to develop the next generation of investment professionals. About the Swiss Re Graduates Program We’re looking for curious, motivated graduates with strong people skills who want to grow, learn, and make a difference. If you hold a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience, apply for our Graduate Programme starting on 1 September 2027 (earlier start possible). You’ll gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of reinsurance, rotate into different local teams, and receive tailored training to build your expertise. This is your opportunity to shape your career, help protect societies from the world’s most threatening hazards, and contribute to making the world more resilient. Through a combination of structured on-the-job and off-the-job learning, you will accelerate your development while building technical and leadership skills in a world-leading reinsurance organization. About the Financial Markets Program Selected candidates will join an elite track: the Financial Markets Programme (FMP), which is Swiss Re Asset Management's flagship rotational program for early-career analysts who aspire to build a long-term career in investing across markets, asset classes, and real-world risks. If you’re interested in investments, insurance may not be the first industry that comes to mind, but it should be. At Swiss Re, our investment work is central to how we create value and keep our promises to clients. We manage a large, sophisticated portfolio designed to generate investment income and match the different risks we take across life and health, property and casualty, specialty lines and global currencies. You will rotate across several investment teams spanning public and private markets, gaining first-hand experience across the investment lifecycle. Working alongside experienced investment professionals, you will analyze markets, contribute to investment decisions and help solve real business challenges from day one. Alongside your rotations, you will benefit from structured training, mentoring, exposure to senior leaders and support towards the CFA qualification. By the end of the program, you will have developed a broad understanding of institutional investing, built a strong internal network, and established the foundation for a specialized career within Swiss Re Asset Management. About the Role As an Investment Analyst in the FMP, you will develop a 360° view of investment management within insurance while contributing across the investment value chain. Your responsibilities will include: Rotate through 3-4 investment teams (e.g. Private Equity, Public Fixed Income, Asset Allocation, Investment Steering) for at least 18 months Analyze financial markets and investment opportunities to support investment decisions Assess portfolio performance, risk exposures and macroeconomic developments Contribute to investment strategy, portfolio construction and capital allocation decisions Support due diligence, investment recommendations and transaction execution Prepare materials for investment committees and senior stakeholders Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that improve investment processes and innovate Apply data, quantitative tools and AI to enhance investment analysis Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders You’ll follow a development plan tailored to your strengths, with structured feedback and visibility across Swiss Re Asset Management. About the Team Swiss Re Asset Management invests the assets generated from our core insurance and reinsurance businesses. We deliver sustainable performance through a disciplined, long-term investment approach and a high-quality, risk-aware portfolio. As part of the FMP, you will join a community of high-potential analysts embedded across investment teams. You will work in a collaborative, high-performing environment that values curiosity and continuous learning. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced, highly motivated Radiopharmacist or Radiopharmaceutical Scientist to join the Radiopharmacy team at The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust, Sutton. Our licensed Radiopharmacy, holding both MS 'Specials' and MIA(IMP) authorisations, manufactures and supplies a range of diagnostic and therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals to The Royal Marsden and external healthcare providers. This is a 23-month fixed term post, funded through the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NiHR). The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in accelerating the set-up of molecular radiotherapy clinical trials. The aim is an average of 150 days from contract to first patient dosed. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams across the Trust and external partners, you will help establish The Royal Marsden as a regional and national centre of excellence for radiopharmaceutical clinical trials, contributing to the development in the delivery of innovative cancer therapies that improve patient outcomes. Map and improve the trial set-up pathway (radiation risk assessment, ARSAC licensing, IMP labelling and logistics, costings), introducing revised SOPs and a trial-tracking dashboard Support trial feasibility, set-up, validation, sponsor visits, audits and monitoring Design, pilot and deliver clinical trials training materials, including a competency framework and e-learning Deliver webinars and training courses to regional and national radiopharmacy and nuclear medicine audiences Act as an authorised releasing officer and contribute to routine production and quality control Maintain the Quality Management System, including change control, CAPA and deviations Line manage a Band 5/6 technician and deputise for the Senior Radiopharmaceutical Scientist You will work closely with Nuclear Medicine, Physics, the Drug Development Unit, the Institute of Cancer Research, Sponsors and The Royal Marsden School. You will also work alongside a new Band 4 clinical trials coordinator/administrator. The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust is a world-leading cancer centre. Our role is to offer our patients the best cancer care available anywhere in the world, and to continue to make a global contribution to finding better ways of diagnosing and treating cancer. We employ over 4,500 staff in a diverse range of careers including nursing, medical, science, radiography, pharmacy, occupational therapy, finance and administrative services. We have two hospitals – one in Chelsea, London, and one in Sutton, Surrey – as well as a Medical Daycare Unit in Kingston Hospital. At The Royal Marsden, we deal with cancer every day, so we understand how valuable life is. When people entrust their lives to us, they have the right to demand the very best. That's why the pursuit of excellence lies at the heart of everything we do. At the heart of the hospital is our dedicated team. We offer a stimulating and dynamic working environment, a wide range of staff benefits, learning and development opportunities and clear career pathways. There are opportunities to work flexibly across a range of areas and specialities and we welcome flexible working requests from point of hire to support employees work life balance. We are looking for employees who aspire to excellence, share our values and can play a crucial role in our on-going achievements. For further information on this role, please see the attached detailed Job Description and Person Specification Degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry or a relevant science, plus a postgraduate qualification in Radiopharmacy, PTQA, the STP or equivalent expertise Registration, or eligibility, with the GPhC, HCPC (Clinical Scientist) or Science Council via the Joint Professional Bodies (eg; Royal College of Pharmacy) At least two years' experience in a licensed radiopharmacy or aseptic unit, including recent Band 6 experience Experience of aseptic preparation and quality assurance of radiopharmaceuticals, and of developing a service or validating a novel agent Experience in professional education, training and/or presentational skills. Excellent communication and training skills, with confidence explaining complex technical information to varied audiences Strong organisation and the ability to deliver objectives within a complex agenda Experience of clinical trials, PET or therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals, or acting as a releasing officer, would be an advantage. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. The role Forward Deployed Energy Engineers are a new role at Watershed, combining energy and advisory expertise with product-building skills and commercial instinct. You’ll operate at the cutting edge with Watershed customers to build and deploy the next generation of enterprise energy management. Energy is one of the largest costs on a big company’s P&L and one of its largest sources of emissions. Yet most enterprises have no one who owns how energy is purchased, consumed and reduced across all their sites. Watershed is building the product that changes that, and it’s the company’s biggest bet for its next chapter. We already help many of the world’s largest companies measure and cut their emissions, and our clean energy business has executed more than $100M in purchases. Now we’re building energy management from zero to one, with engagements underway with a small group of customers today and scaling in 2027. You’ll work with enterprises that spend tens of millions a year on electricity, embedded in their energy programmes. Starting from the energy data already in Watershed, you’ll find where they’re overspending, deliver the savings, prototype with AI what should become product, and help customers implement solutions, including buying clean power. The goal is an energy programme that wins backing from their CFO and facilities teams. This is a high-ownership role on a small, high-output team, with a direct line to commercial outcomes and real say in what we build. It reports directly to Watershed’s head of energy and decarbonization. Win customers who vouch for us: Earn the trust of facilities and finance leads so they would tell a peer to work with Watershed. Turn what works into product: Spot the problems that repeat across customers, prototype with AI, and work with our engineers to build an AI-led product for many. Close clean energy deals: Help customers sign deals with existing clean power products (eg EACs, fixed-price VPPAs), yourself or alongside our account teams. Make the team smarter on energy: Be the person colleagues go to on tariffs, loads and what actually cuts a bill. Are fluent with data tools (Excel, SQL or Python) and LLM tools, and can turn messy meter and bill data into something a customer acts on. Have run client work from scoping to outcome, and are as credible with a facilities manager as with a CFO. Can tell a compelling story with data, from raw numbers to insight to a recommendation someone signs off. You've originated work or supported deals, and want to get better at selling. Are energised to build a new product and service, to be on the front lines of building a new business, and to leave a legacy as part of a fast-moving team. Hands-on work with utility bill, half-hourly or building management system data. A few years in consulting or advisory. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. You’ll also help shape how the team approaches new features and experiments, contributing ideas as well as code. In this role as the Mid-Level Web Engineer, you will... We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! items.desc: Company Description MUFG Investor Services is a trusted partner to many of the world’s largest public and private funds, providing asset servicing and operational solutions built for alternatives. With over $1 trillion in client assets under administration, we offer fund administration, banking, payments, fund financing, foreign exchange overlay, corporate and regulatory services, custody, business consulting, and more. Operating from 17 locations worldwide, we help clients mitigate risk, enhance efficiency, and navigate the operational complexities of today’s investment management landscape. As a division of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s largest financial institutions with approximately $3 trillion in assets, we combine deep expertise with the strength and stability of a leading financial institution. To learn more, visit us at www.mufg-investorservices.com. #LI-Hybrid Job Description We are seeking a proactive and collaborative Application Security Engineer who speaks the language of developers, thrives in the purple team space and is an automation advocate. The successful candidate will work closely with engineering & IT teams to enhance the security of our applications, API’s and infrastructure by implementing preventative controls and identifying risks through security testing. You Will: Act as a security champion to foster the secure by design approach across the business. Support the identification and analysis of web application security vulnerabilities across the business to reduce risk. Oversee daily management of application security platforms to maintain comprehensive coverage, ensure compliance and remediation of findings. Conduct threat modelling and review application architectures to identify potential risks early in the SDLC. Implement application security controls and proactive measures to prevent security incidents. Implement and manage SAST/SCA tooling across our application repositories to identify source code risks. Scale automated DAST solutions across our applications to maximise testing coverage and provide visibility into runtime security posture. Provide security guidance and remediation advice to engineers where applicable. Carry out penetration testing on internally developed applications to identify security defects. Review and assess the security of third-party vendor applications through configuration and hardening reviews. Validate remediation of security issues by the development team and 3rd parties. Coordinate and arrange external penetration testing assessments to independently evaluate the security of our applications. Build and maintain effective collaboration with development and IT teams. #LI-Hybrid Qualifications You Have: Experienced in applications security focusing on red, blue or purple team activities. Experienced in software development or experience contributing to Open-Source projects. Experienced with DAST tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP Zap or similar. Experience with SAST/SCA tools such as Snyk, Veracode, Checkmarx or similar. Proficient in one or more of the following languages - Python, JavaScript, .NET or Java. Well-versed in analysis of open source and third-party library vulnerabilities. Well-rounded knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies. Hold a strong understanding and experience testing of both REST and GraphQL APIs. Demonstrated experience with development tools including GitLab/GitHub, Datadog, Jira, Docker, and various IDEs. Previously worked very closely with development and DevOps teams to resolve security issues. Have performed security-focused code reviews to identify code level issues. Experience in creating custom security tooling or scripts. Preferred Experience in the financial sector or another heavily audited industry. Experience with cloud services, particularly AWS services like WAF, Cognito etc. Experience working with Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes and Containers. Experience with auth mechanisms like Open ID Connect, OAuth and identity providers. Experience in creating custom CI/CD pipeline jobs to carry out security related reviews or scans. Take a look at our careers site and you’ll find everything you’d expect from a career with the fastest-growing business at one of the world’s largest financial groups. Now take another look. Because it’s how we defy expectations that really defines us. You’ll feel that difference in all kinds of ways. Our vibrant CULTURE. Connected team. Love of innovation, laser client focus, and next-level LEARNING & DEVELOPMENT. So, why settle for the ordinary? Apply now for a Brilliantly Different career. We thank all candidates for applying; however, only those proceeding to the interview stage will be contacted. We are an equal opportunity employer.

items.desc: We are seeking an enthusiastic, organised and compassionate individual to join our Patient Safety Team as a Learning from Deaths Coordinator . This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in supporting the Trust's Learning from Deaths Programme, ensuring that deaths are reviewed in a timely, effective and compassionate manner, and that learning is identified, shared and translated into meaningful improvements in patient care. Working closely with clinical teams, mortality reviewers, bereaved families and senior leaders, you will coordinate the Trust's mortality review process and support compliance with national Learning from Deaths requirements, Patient Safety Incident Response Framework (PSIRF) principles and wider quality governance programmes. Support the production of regular reports, dashboards and assurance submissions for Trust committees and external bodies. Support the identification, recording and dissemination of learning arising from mortality reviews. Maintain confidential records in accordance with information governance requirements. Provide direct line management to the Bereavement Officers. Ashford and St. Peters Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is the largest provider of acute hospital services to Surrey residents, serving a population of 410,00 people and employing approximately 4,800 staff. Our vision is to provide an outstanding experience and best outcomes for patients and the team. We are committed to providing continuous professional development and flexibility to deliver our workforce plan. We work in partnership with Royal Surrey Hospital NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. St Peter’s Hospital delivers complex medical and surgical care, maternity and emergency services. Day and Orthopaedic surgery, Ophthalmology and Outpatient services are delivered at Ashford Hospital. Additional services are delivered at Woking Community Hospital. Our Values provide us with the behaviours we respect and can commit to. items.desc: Company Description Evelyn Partners is a UK leader in wealth management, providing personalised, expert investment management and financial planning advice to support clients in embracing what’s next. Our success hinges on our people and that’s our secret for longevity. We are a team of passionate professionals and everything we do is guided by our purpose – placing the power of good advice into more hands, we go further to understand the needs of our clients and what matters most to them. We’re here to help them make significant decisions with confidence, provide strong foundations for the future and guide them towards their goals. Job Description The Financial Services division comprises the advisory and investment management services. Central to the division’s activities is the creation and oversight of its investment process which includes asset allocation and investment selection. Evelyn Partners’ investment methodology has been continually refined over a long period of time to cater for our clients’ broad range of circumstances and requirements. Accordingly, our services include personalised as well as bespoke portfolios, and centrally managed portfolios for clients with similar investment needs. We invest in a wide range of markets and investments, and different approaches may be appropriate through the economic cycle or according to client preference. As long-term stewards, the sustainability of the investments that make up our client portfolios has always been an important consideration. Our belief is that a collegiate approach to investment decision-making results in the best client outcomes. This includes three key components: - A fully integrated research function: the individuals who have responsibility for investment recommendations also provide investment and relationship management the asset allocation team which provides macro and quantitative inputs and plays the leading role in drawing together the different elements of investment recommendations And a management structure where oversight of the process is led by experienced and practicing Investment Managers from across the business. One of the key drivers of consistent investment returns is the application of a structured macro-economic view to asset allocations of all our clients’ investment portfolios. Fixed term contract: This role is a 12 months fixed term contract with the possibility of extension Job Responsibilities Asset Allocation & Investment Strategy Support senior members of the asset allocation team with ad-hoc discretionary research and investment commentary as and when required. Support generation of internal and external presentations, documents, etc. Assist investment group chairs with organising and facilitating meetings and collateral. Help respond to ad-hoc queries from Investment Manager community Model portfolios & analytics Support model portfolio construction and maintenance. Support the build out and provision of data & analytics to internal stakeholders covering asset allocation and central model portfolios. Assist with process controls, quality assurance and maintaining documentation for analytics processes. Ad hoc project work and analysis as needed. Qualifications Skills, Experience & Qualifications Degree in Finance, Economics, or quantitative subject. Have strong attention to detail and good planning/organisational skills. Knowledge of investments and investment strategies is important. Experience in an asset management or wealth management would be helpful. Advanced M365 (Excel, PowerPoint) skills. Experience of SQL/Snowflake and Python would be helpful. Experience of third-party portfolio analytics systems (Refinitiv, FactSet, Bloomberg, Morningstar etc) would be helpful. Willingness to pursue professional qualifications (CFA / FRM / CIPM). Additional Information As a colleague here at Evelyn Partners, you will have access to benefits that include: Competitive salary Private medical insurance Life assurance Pension contribution Hybrid working model (role dependant) Generous holiday package Option to purchase additional holiday Shared parental leave We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients.  At our Siemens Advanta R&D Center we are focused on a product development including software development, hardware development, mechanical design and testing for the next generation concept of Industry 4.0.
 We would like to invite you to cooperate on the development of SITOP power supplies dedicated for 24 V and other output voltages, well known throughout the world for their extreme reliability.
 With their versatile DC UPS and add-on modules, they easily handle even the most critical network conditions, such as mains disturbances and problems on the DC side.  Complete integration in Totally Integrated Automation and the TIA Portal via PROFINET also offer unique opportunities for engineering and diagnosis.
 Your task will be 
 Development of the SITOP devices supporting Profinet, OPC-UA and HTTP/S protocols
 Extensions and execution of unit and integration tests
 Continuous improvement of development process

 Up to 33 days of holiday (standard 5 weeks + up to 8 days from benefit system) 
 Bonus for joining our company up to CZK 100,000 (depends on the level of technical knowledge)

 An individual benefit budget of at least CZK 24,000 that you can turn into a combination of up to 8 extra days off, cafeteria points or pension and / or life insurance contributions 
 Relocation bonus for the costs of moving to the place of work (CZK 100,000 if you move to the Czech Republic from abroad, CZK 50,000 if you move to Brno within the Czech Republic) 
 Contribution to meals in the form of e- vouchers 
 Contribution to Multi-sport card 
 What we will appreciate from you 
 Ability to write C and/or C++ code on very good level
 Experience with web technologies
 Experience with OPC-UA protocol as advantage
 Fluent communication in English language

items.desc: Contexte et environnement TotalEnergies développe au sein du département Integrated Power Modeling (IPM) un ensemble d'applications dédiées à la conception, l'exploitation et l'optimisation des actifs renouvelables du Groupe. L'émergence récente des modèles de langage (LLM) et des systèmes multi-agents ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour assister les activités d'ingénierie, de développement logiciel et d'exploitation des plateformes numériques. Plusieurs initiatives exploitant l'intelligence artificielle générative sont actuellement explorées au sein des équipes, notamment dans les domaines de l'assistance au développement logiciel, de la gestion des connaissances, de l'automatisation de tâches et de l'analyse documentaire. Ces initiatives visent notamment à mettre en œuvre des agents IA capables d'interagir avec les utilisateurs, les outils de développement et les référentiels documentaires afin d'apporter une assistance contextualisée aux équipes. Dans ce contexte, l'équipe Software Delivery & Operations souhaite renforcer son accompagnement auprès des équipes produits afin d'identifier les usages les plus pertinents, développer des agents IA réutilisables, expérimenter de nouvelles architectures et contribuer à l'industrialisation des solutions les plus prometteuses. Le candidat participera à cette démarche d'innovation en contribuant à la conception, au développement et à l'évaluation d'agents IA appliqués aux problématiques des énergies renouvelables. Activités En tant qu' Ingénieur IA agentique - Débutant H/F , vous contribuerez à la conception, au développement et à l’évaluation d’agents d’intelligence artificielle destinés à assister les équipes d’ingénierie, de développement logiciel et d’exploitation des plateformes numériques au sein de l’équipe Software Delivery & Operations. Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront de : Identifier des cas d’usage pertinents pouvant bénéficier de l’utilisation d’agents IA ; Participer aux initiatives de développement autour de l’intelligence artificielle générative et des modèles de langage (LLM) ; Concevoir, développer et déployer des agents IA répondant à différents besoins métier ; Mettre en œuvre des agents capables d’interagir avec des outils de développement, des bases documentaires et des plateformes collaboratives ; Développer des mécanismes de recherche et d’exploitation des connaissances basés sur des architectures RAG ; Expérimenter des architectures multi-agents et évaluer la qualité des solutions développées ; Contribuer à l’industrialisation des solutions les plus prometteuses et à la diffusion des bonnes pratiques autour de l’IA générative. Cette mission vous permettra de développer une expertise recherchée dans les domaines de l’intelligence artificielle générative, des systèmes multi-agents, de l’automatisation, du cloud et de l’ingénierie logicielle, au sein d’un environnement international dédié aux énergies renouvelables Si cette offre vous intéresse alors n'attendez plus... Postulez chez TotalEnergies ! Profil du candidat Vous êtes récemment diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 en informatique, intelligence artificielle, data science ou école d’ingénieur spécialisée dans le numérique ? Vous souhaitez participer au développement de solutions innovantes au service de la transition énergétique ? Nous recherchons pour une durée de 12 mois un.e Ingénieur IA agentique - Débutant H/F à partir de janvier 2027 . Au cours de votre parcours, vous avez développé une appétence pour l’intelligence artificielle générative, le développement logiciel et les environnements cloud. Vous possédez idéalement des connaissances en Python, LLM, architectures RAG, systèmes multi-agents et développement de solutions d’automatisation. Curieux(se), autonome et doté(e) d’une véritable approche ingénierie, vous aimez concevoir et développer des agents IA répondant à des problématiques métier complexes. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et l’expérimentation de nouvelles technologies. Un anglais courant est indispensable afin d’évoluer dans un environnement international et de collaborer avec des équipes multiculturelles. Nous vous proposons un Contrat de Professionnalisation Temps Plein qualifiant de 12 mois (100% en entreprise) incluant un volet de formations (métier, linguistique, outils…). Ces formations sont dispensées en interne par des organismes sélectionnés par TotalEnergies. Ce contrat vous permettra d’acquérir une année d’expérience professionnelle tout en étant formé aux spécificités de votre métier en lien avec les activités de la Compagnie. Un réel atout pour booster votre employabilité ! Informations supplémentaires Pour postuler à cette offre, vous devez impérativement posséder, à la date d’embauche, un titre de séjour valide pour la période couverte par cette offre (minimum 13 mois). Attention, la conclusion de ce contrat de professionnalisation ne permet pas la délivrance d’un titre de séjour (article R.52221-6 du Code du travail). Ce poste ne s'adresse pas aux personnes …

items.desc: Job Description What you'll bring You're starting your ML engineering career with foundational technical skills and genuine curiosity about how production ML systems are built. Developing skills in ML engineering — model training, evaluation, and data handling, with familiarity in Python and cloud platform usage Familiarity with AI/LLM workflows: prompt design, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns, model evaluation, and integrating AI services into applications A practical approach to AI — you use AI tools in daily work, prototype solutions, and take responsibility for the quality of AI-generated outputs Understanding of APIs, distributed systems basics, and CI/CD practices A degree in informatics, computer science, natural sciences, information systems, or a comparable field Fluency in English is required for this role Strong interest in business applications and Finance domain processes We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face. What You'll Build You'll contribute to AI-enabled features and agents within SAP's Autonomous Finance portfolio. Design and develop AI-enabled solutions for payables and receivables management — invoice processing, payments, and bank statement handling Build and prototype agentic workflows using semantic retrieval and agentic orchestration Prepare training datasets, run experiments, and document results to support model development Build and improve evaluation pipelines to measure ML system quality and performance Develop and maintain ML services and APIs with a focus on observability, maintainability, and reliability Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and quality assurance processes Where you belong You'll join the Cloud ERP Core Finance team in Budapest — a growing group within SAP's Autonomous Suite board area. The team supports S/4HANA Public Cloud customers across payables, receivables, invoice processing, and bank statement management, and is expanding into AI agent development. You'll work alongside experienced engineers with mentorship built into how the team operates. The team collaborates globally across Brno, Shanghai, Walldorf, and Galway, and a hybrid working arrangement is available. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer based in Ireland. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning solutions, with a particular focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and intelligent AI-powered applications. You will take ownership of the ML development lifecycle, from initial research and experimentation to model training, fine-tuning, integration, and production deployment. Working closely with backend engineers and product teams, you will transform complex machine learning concepts into scalable, practical, and user-focused features. You will apply your understanding of machine learning and deep learning fundamentals to build efficient, reliable, and high-impact AI systems. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern LLM frameworks, emerging AI technologies, and production-grade ML infrastructure. You will join an engineering-focused environment that values technical excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation. Arabic language proficiency is essential for this position. Accountabilities Machine Learning Development: Design, develop, and implement machine learning solutions from initial concept and experimentation through to production deployment. LLM Training and Fine-Tuning: Train, fine-tune, and integrate Large Language Models, applying practical knowledge of transformer architectures and modern model adaptation techniques. AI Feature Development: Build and integrate intelligent, AI-powered features into real-world applications, ensuring they deliver practical value and an effective user experience. Production Deployment: Deploy, scale, and monitor LLM-powered functionalities in production environments, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability. Model Optimization: Explore opportunities to improve model performance, efficiency, and inference capabilities through appropriate optimization techniques. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers, software developers, and product teams to translate business and product requirements into effective machine learning solutions. Software Engineering: Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-structured Python code while following sound software engineering principles and best practices. Data Management: Work with machine learning datasets and data processing tools to prepare, manipulate, and manage data for model training and evaluation. Technical Documentation: Produce clear technical documentation covering model architectures, implementation approaches, experiments, and deployment processes. Research and Innovation: Stay up to date with developments in machine learning research, LLM capabilities, emerging AI frameworks, and MLOps practices, identifying opportunities to improve existing solutions. Requirements Arabic Language: Professional Arabic language proficiency is mandatory. Professional Experience: At least 1 year of non-internship professional experience in machine learning engineering or a closely related field. Machine Learning Fundamentals: Strong theoretical understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts, including the underlying principles of algorithms, architectures, and model behavior. LLM Expertise: Practical experience training and fine-tuning Large Language Models, with a solid understanding of transformer architectures and their applications. Python Development: Strong production-level Python programming skills and experience developing reliable, scalable software solutions. Software Engineering Fundamentals: Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Object-Oriented Design (OOD), and Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA). LLM Frameworks: Familiarity with modern machine learning and LLM integration frameworks, such as Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI APIs, and LangChain. Data Processing: Experience working with machine learning data pipelines and data manipulation libraries such as Pandas and NumPy. Research and Documentation: Strong analytical and research capabilities, combined with excellent technical writing and documentation skills. Communication and Collaboration: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams. Problem-Solving: A structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting, experimentation, and developing solutions to complex technical challenges. Continuous Learning: Genuine interest in emerging AI technologies, machine learning research, and the ongoing evolution of LLM capabilities. Nice-to-Have Skills Experience deploying and maintaining LLM-powered features in production environments. Knowledge of parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA, QLoRA, and PEFT. Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and vector databases such as Pinecone and Weaviate. …

Key Responsibilities
items.desc: Junior Applied AI Engineer (m/f/d) Location: Munich Area, Germany | Hybrid Working The Opportunity We are looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help build and implement intelligent technology solutions that address complex business challenges. This is an opportunity to work across AI engineering, software development and applied machine learning, taking innovative ideas from initial concept through to production. You will play a key role in developing intelligent automation systems, AI-powered applications and scalable technical solutions that deliver measurable business value. Working closely with technical teams and senior business stakeholders, you will help identify opportunities where AI can make a meaningful difference, translating business requirements into robust, production-ready solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and implement scalable AI applications, intelligent automation systems and agent-based workflows. Build and integrate modern AI architectures, including LLM-powered applications, autonomous agents and MCP-based integrations. Assess complex business requirements and determine the most appropriate technical approach, whether through traditional machine learning, predictive modelling or advanced AI solutions. Take ownership of the full development lifecycle, from initial architecture and prototyping through to API development, deployment and ongoing optimisation. Develop production-ready applications using Python and modern software engineering practices. Build and maintain integrations between AI solutions, internal platforms and existing business systems. Work closely with software engineers, data teams and senior business stakeholders to identify opportunities and deliver impactful AI products. Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks and methodologies to improve existing solutions and drive technical innovation. Contribute to engineering best practices, technical architecture decisions and knowledge sharing across the wider team. Your Background & Experience Education & Experience Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant STEM discipline. Professional experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science or Software Engineering. Experience building and deploying technical solutions in fast-paced, technology-driven environments. AI & Machine Learning Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) and modern agentic architectures. Practical experience with frameworks such as LangChain and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. Good knowledge of traditional machine learning libraries, including scikit-learn and XGBoost. Understanding of predictive modelling, neural networks and intelligent automation techniques. Software Engineering & Infrastructure Strong Python development skills, with an emphasis on writing clean, maintainable and scalable code. Experience developing and integrating APIs, ideally using FastAPI. Familiarity with containerisation technologies such as Docker. Experience working with Git, modern development workflows and cloud-based infrastructure. Ability to take applications from development and testing through to production deployment. Mindset & Communication A strong engineering mindset, with the ability to balance technical complexity against practical business requirements. Commercial awareness and an understanding of how technology can improve operational efficiency and business performance. Comfortable taking ownership of projects and working independently in an execution-focused environment. Confident communicating technical concepts to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent in English If you're interested in this opportunity, submit your application. If your experience aligns with what we're looking for, we'll be in touch to arrange an initial conversation and discuss the role in more detail.

items.desc: Ми — компанія Farmak , лідер українського фармацевтичного ринку з 100-річною історією. Ми створюємо сучасні, якісні та доступні лікарські засоби, яким довіряють мільйони пацієнтів у понад 60 країнах світу. Наша команда об'єднує 3000 професіоналів, і зараз ми шукаємо нових колег, готових розвиватися разом з нами. Шукаємо Junior AI Engineer у сектор інновацій та штучного інтелекту. Ціль посади - розроблення програмних рішень із використанням технологій штучного інтелекту, створення AI-агентів, інтеграція мовних моделей (LLM) та розроблення інструментів для взаємодії з корпоративними системами й базами даних. Основні обов'язки: Розроблення та впровадження AI-рішень для автоматизації бізнес-процесів. Створення AI-агентів та мультиагентних систем. Інтеграція великих мовних моделей (LLM) із корпоративними системами та базами даних. Розроблення RAG-систем для роботи з внутрішніми документами та базами знань. Створення та підтримка API, MCP-серверів і програмних інтеграцій. Дослідження нових AI-технологій, тестування моделей та оцінювання їх ефективності. Забезпечення стабільності, безпеки та якості розроблених рішень. Підготовка технічної документації та супровід впроваджених систем. Вимоги до кандидата: Вища технічна освіта. Досвід роботи від 1 років у розробленні ПЗ, системній інтеграції або AI-розробленні. Володіння Python або C#/.NET. Розуміння принципів роботи LLM та досвід інтеграції AI-сервісів через API. Знання REST API, SQL та принципів інтеграції інформаційних систем. Практичні навички роботи з Git, Docker та Linux. Англійська мова на рівні Intermediate (B1) або вище. Буде перевагою: Досвід розроблення AI-агентів, RAG-систем та MCP-серверів. Досвід роботи з векторними базами даних. Досвід розгортання локальних LLM та роботи з open-source моделями. Знання Ollama, vLLM, Hugging Face. Досвід роботи з CI/CD, моніторингом та забезпеченням інформаційної безпеки. Ми гарантуємо: Офіційну заробітну плату. Бонуси за виконання KPI. Медичне страхування за рахунок компанії. Колоритну корпоративну культуру, яка мотивує до нових звершень. Насичене спортивне життя та цікаве дозвілля. Можливості навчання та розвиток за рахунок компанії. Велику корпоративну бібліотеку з професійною та художньою літературою. Зручне розташування компанії на Подолі біля метро Т. Шевченко (Кирилівська, 74). Графік роботи: 5/2 (з 08:00-17:00(з пн-чт), з 08:00-16:00(пт)в зимовий час, з 08:00-15:00 в літній час). Надсилаючи своє резюме ви підтверджуєте достовірність наданої інформації та надаєте згоду на її обробку, перевірку та зберігання.

items.desc: Du bliver en del af vores AI-Hub, hvor du udvikler AI-løsninger på tværs af virksomheden. Du bygger også de værktøjer, vores kunderådgivere arbejder med, og hjælper kolleger på tværs af virksomheden med at opdage, hvordan AI kan gøre deres arbejde smartere, lettere og bedre. Du får en rolle med to tæt forbundne spor: Du bygger løsningerne og er med til at få dem ud at leve i organisationen. Om os Hi3G står bag 3, OiSTER og Flexii og forbinder millioner af danskere hver dag. I vores AI-Hub arbejder vi på at gøre AI til en naturlig del af hverdagen i hele virksomheden – fra kundeservice og salg til finans, IT og HR. Vi er et lille team med kort vej fra idé til løsning. Vi bygger selv – fra vores egen harness og memory-systemer til grafbaserede LLM-workflows med automatisering, human-in-the-loop og observability. Vi tror på, at miljøet, en model arbejder i, er mindst lige så vigtigt som modellen selv. Vi eksperimenterer, lærer af det, der ikke virker, og deler vores erfaringer. Nu søger vi en kollega, der vil styrke både vores udviklingskraft og AI's gennemslag i forretningen. Din rolle som AI Engineer Din rolle spænder over to områder. Du skal både udvikle vores tekniske AI-løsninger og hjælpe resten af organisationen med at se og udnytte mulighederne i AI. Udvikle og bygge Du Kommer Blandt Andet Til At Designe og bygge AI-løsninger med LLM'er – fra hurtige prototyper til robuste løsninger i drift. Bygge agenter og MCP-servere med sikker adgang til interne systemer og data, styret af brugerens identitet via fx Keycloak. Udvikle vores søge- og retrieval-lag, så agenter kan finde viden i dokumenter, wikis og SharePoint. Du kombinerer BM25 med semantisk søgning og måler kvaliteten af resultaterne. Arbejde i Java (Spring Boot, Spring AI) og TypeScript (Bun, Next.js) med LLM-API'er som Anthropic og Azure OpenAI. Designe robuste workflows med fejlhåndtering, mulighed for genoptagelse og human-in-the-loop, hvor det er nødvendigt. Udrulle og drifte løsninger på OpenShift via GitOps (ArgoCD) med fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og overvågning. Videreudvikle vores harness med prompts, skills, værktøjer og hukommelse. Du bruger også selv agenter aktivt og forbedrer kodebasen, så den fungerer godt for både mennesker og agenter (DX og AX). Bygge bro til low-code, fx Copilot Studio og Power Platform, når det giver mening – og vælge AI fra, når andre metoder er bedre. Inspirere og rådgive Du bliver også sparringspartner for kolleger på tværs af virksomheden. Du: Forstår forretningens udfordringer og omsætter dem til konkrete AI-use cases og løsningsforslag. Hjælper med at prioritere de idéer, der skaber mest værdi – og udfordrer dem, der ikke gør. Viser kollegerne, hvad AI kan, og er med til at løfte deres kompetencer og mod på at bruge teknologien. Hvem er du? Du brænder for at udvikle og skabe nyt, men du trives også med at dele din viden og gøre komplekse emner forståelige for andre. Det betyder mindre for os, om du har to eller tyve års erfaring. Vi har erfaret, at begejstring slår erfaring. Er du ny i faget, bringer du måske AI-native arbejdsvaner med, som vi andre kan lære af. Er du erfaren, bringer du en stærk sans for arkitektur og kodedesign – kompetencer, der aldrig har været vigtigere end nu. Vi har brug for begge perspektiver og tror på, at de bedste løsninger opstår, når vi lærer af hinanden. Det Vigtigste For Os Er, At Du Er begejstret for AI, bruger værktøjerne i din hverdag og elsker at prøve nye muligheder af. Eksperimenterer, lærer af det, der ikke virker, og deler dine erfaringer. Er nysgerrig på hele AI-harnessen – prompts, skills, kontekst og værktøjer – ikke kun modellen. Tænker i agent experience (AX) og vil forbedre både harnessen og kodebasen, så agenter kan arbejde bedre. Tænker strategisk og udfordrer opgaven, før du løser den – også når en agent skriver koden. Har styr på design, test og fejlfinding og tager ansvar for koden, også når en agent har skrevet den. Det har du med dig Erfaring med Java eller TypeScript – gerne begge – og med at bygge løsninger baseret på LLM'er. Erfaring med agenter og gerne MCP-servere eller lignende integrationer. Kendskab til Azure eller Kubernetes/OpenShift og til at få løsninger i drift. Evnen til at forklare teknik, så ikke-teknikere både forstår den og bliver begejstrede. Lyst til at veksle mellem fordybelse i kode og dialog med forretningen. Lyst til at dele viden i et felt, der flytter sig hver måned. Gode dansk- og engelskkundskaber i skrift og tale. Det er et plus, hvis du har erfaring med RAG og søgning (BM25, embeddings, hybrid search), Copilot Studio eller Power Platform, GitOps eller funktionel programmering. Erfaring med rådgivning eller undervisning er også en fordel. Du bliver en del af noget helt særligt Hos 3, OiSTER og Flexii bliver du en del af et hold med store ambitioner, masser af energi og en stærk tro på, at vi lykkes bedst sammen. Vi løfter i flok, spiller hinanden gode og har det sjovt imens. Vi er nysgerrige, elsker idéer, der ryster posen, …

items.card: På Sogeti tror vi att det bästa finns inom oss alla. Oavsett om du är i början av din karriär eller redan på toppen av ditt spel, kommer vi att uppmuntra dig att nå din fulla potential och bli bättre. Genom vår gemensamma passion för teknik, vår entreprenöriella kultur och vårt fokus på kontinuerligt lärande, kommer vi att ge dig allt du behöver för att göra ditt bästa arbete och bli den bästa versionen av dig
items.desc: På Sogeti tror vi att det bästa finns inom oss alla. Oavsett om du är i början av din karriär eller redan på toppen av ditt spel, kommer vi att uppmuntra dig att nå din fulla potential och bli bättre. Genom vår gemensamma passion för teknik, vår entreprenöriella kultur och vårt fokus på kontinuerligt lärande, kommer vi att ge dig allt du behöver för att göra ditt bästa arbete och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv. Din roll Som AI-utvecklare hos oss får du kombinera systemutveckling med din nyfikenhet på AI och skapa lösningar som gör nytta i kundernas verksamhet. Tillsammans med kunder och kollegor utforskar du möjligheter och omsätter idéer och experiment till konkreta lösningar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, utveckling och AI. Du har en grund inom systemutveckling och vill fortsätta lära och utvecklas. Du behöver inte vara AI-expert eller kunna alla de senaste modellerna – det viktiga är att du tycker om att lösa problem och vill hjälpa kunder att skapa värde med AI. Du tillhör vårt team i Östersund eller Sundsvall, beroende på var du bor och vilken ort som passar dig bäst. Här får du det nära och lokala sammanhanget samtidigt som du kan dra nytta av kompetens och möjligheter inom hela Sogeti. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Tillsammans med våra kunder förstå verksamheten, identifiera möjligheter med AI och omsätta behov till tekniska lösningar som skapar verkligt värde. Designa och utveckla moderna system och AI-lösningar med exempelvis .NET, C#, Azure och relevanta AI-plattformar och ramverk. Utforska och utveckla AI-assistenter och agentbaserade lösningar och ta dem från idé och experiment till lösningar som används i verksamheten. Bygga API:er, integrationer och mikrotjänster som kopplar samman generativ AI med kundernas befintliga system och verksamhetskritiska processer. Bygga och vidareutveckla AI-plattformar i både moln- och on-prem-miljöer. Bidra till robusta och säkra AI-lösningar, där kvalitet, arkitektur, styrning och ansvarsfull användning av AI är en naturlig del av utvecklingen. Din profil Vi söker dig som har en grund inom systemutveckling och vill utvecklas vidare inom AI. Du är nyfiken på hur tekniken kan användas för att lösa verkliga problem och tycker om att förstå varför något ska byggas, inte bara hur. Du har med dig: Erfarenhet av systemutveckling och goda kunskaper i .NET och C#. Erfarenhet av någon modern molnplattform, exempelvis Azure, AWS eller GCP. Erfarenhet av API-utveckling och integrationer. Förståelse för arkitektur, säkerhet och kvalitetsarbete. Förmåga att förstå verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av eller kunskap om något av följande områden: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI eller motsvarande AI-plattformar. RAG-arkitekturer, vektorsökning, kunskapsgrafer eller GraphRAG. Agentbaserade lösningar. DevOps och CI/CD. Kubernetes eller OpenShift. AI-plattformar i privata eller säkerhetskritiska miljöer. Lokala LLM:er eller Private AI-lösningar. Du behöver inte kunna allt i listan. Oavsett om du redan har arbetat med AI-lösningar eller har en utvecklarbakgrund och vill ta nästa steg inom AI vill vi gärna höra från dig. Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas: En varm och prestigelös gemenskap där du får vara dig själv. I Östersund är naturen nära, lunchaktiviteter med kollegor en del av vardagen och även hunden är välkommen. I entrén möts du av porträtt av kollegor och deras intressen, för här är människan bakom konsulten minst lika viktig. Energi och framtidstro i Sundsvall. Här möts du av ett entreprenöriellt gäng med framåtanda. Vi är nära kunder och den lokala marknaden, gillar nya idéer och skapar möjligheter tillsammans. Det ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet, enkelt att ta initiativ och naturligt att bidra och utvecklas tillsammans. Gemenskap, stöttande kollegor och chefer – med Sogetis och Capgeminis globala nätverk, karriärmöjligheter och mängder av internutbildningar. Ansökan Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov. Om Sogeti Sogeti Sverige, en del av Capgemini Group, med 19 kontor och 1200 medarbetare, gör teknologi enkelt och värdeskapande. Vi är specialiserade på AI-drivna lösningar inom quality engineering & testing, data och cloud och förvandlar snabbt idéer till handling. Sogeti levererar konkreta resultat, hjälper organisationer att innovera med självförtroende och skapar värde från dag ett. Vi är agila, snabbrörliga och drar nytta av starka partnerskap. Våra lokala team arbetar sida vid sida med våra kunder och bygger nära relationer genom att förstå deras verklighet. Tillsammans med Capgemini-koncernens globala styrka och branschexpertis skapar vi skalbara resultat. Right here. Right now. | www.sogeti.se

items.desc: Ce que nous vous proposons Rejoindre France Télévisions, c’est contribuer à faire le média de la société de demain. Le média qui offre à tous les Français une information fiable et indépendante. Qui propose et crée des programmes tous réunis par la même exigence de qualité, aussi bien pour éduquer que pour divertir. Notre point commun ? Vouloir expérimenter, imaginer des programmes, des expériences et des formats qui répondent aux nouveaux usages. Nous rejoindre, c’est prendre part à la transformation du premier média de tous les Français. Si vous avez envie de repousser les limites avec nous, alors, nous avons une offre pour vous ! Venez intégrer à partir de février 2027 , pour un stage de fin d’études d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois , l'équipe Data Science de France Télévisions, composée de six data scientists et de deux product owners. La personnalisation de l’expérience utilisateur est un enjeu central pour notre groupe. Elle permet, au travers de sa plateforme france.tv, de répondre aux attentes de son audience. Pour atteindre cet objectif, plusieurs initiatives ont été déployées, telles que des campagnes de communication ciblées, des systèmes de recommandation de contenus ou encore une adaptation dynamique de l’interface. Ces projets sont le résultat d’une collaboration transversale des équipes, illustrant l’approche data-driven de France Télévisions. Dans cette dynamique, un projet d’appétence catégorielle a été développé et industrialisé. Son objectif est d’identifier, via un calcul de score, les utilisateurs les plus engagés avec certaines typologies de contenus (Documentaires, Séries & Fiction, Cinéma, etc…). Ces scores sont mis à disposition des autres équipes pour répondre aux enjeux de personnalisation. Pour aller plus loin, France Télévisions souhaite désormais affiner cette approche en développant un modèle de scoring de l’appétence thématique, permettant d’identifier les centres d’intérêt spécifiques des utilisateurs. Ce stage s’inscrit alors dans cette démarche et vise à concevoir et implémenter ce modèle. Quelles missions vous seront confiées? Vous contribuerez à l’analyse et à la sélection des thématiques clés Vous participerez à la conception, à l’évaluation et la sélection du modèle de scoring Vous partagerez la méthodologie et les résultats auprès des différentes parties prenantes Vous prendrez également part à la conception d'un A/B test : définition des métriques et des conditions de succès Quels atouts vous propulseront? Votre maîtrise de Python/SQL et des bases en modélisation prédictive Une première expérience en machine learning (projet académique ou professionnel) Votre esprit analytique et pédagogique Votre curiosité intellectuelle Votre capacité d'autonomie et d’adaptation Votre appétence pour le monde de l’audiovisuel Quelle formation vous est demandée? Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac +5 en mathématiques/statistiques Les petits plus Un environnement de travail stimulant Une équipe dynamique, passionnée et bienveillante Une expérience enrichissante au sein d'un groupe audiovisuel majeur Tarifs préférentiels pour les loisirs, sports, spectacles avec le CSE d'entreprise Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité est une richesse, un atout pour développer notre capacité d’innovation. Nous nous engageons en faveur de l'inclusion et de l'égalité des chances, c'est la raison pour laquelle tout le monde est naturellement bienvenu chez nous ! Important: le délai de candidature expire à 23h59 du jour indiqué (fuseau GMT+2).

items.desc: Du willst wissen, was gerade alles mit KI geht, und probierst es einfach aus. Wo kleine, agile Teams enorm davon profitieren, baust du es selbst: eigene Tools, Integrationen und Anwendungen, mit dem LLM als Entwicklungspartner. Parallel hältst du die Infrastruktur am Laufen und wächst mit der Zeit in die Gesamtverantwortung für die FUTUR X-IT hinein. FUTUR X ist die Innovationseinheit des VGH-Versicherungsverbunds und für unterschiedliche Innovationsprojekte tätig. Wir suchen dich zum 01.01.2027 (Vollzeit) als KI-Entwickler & IT-Infrastruktur bei der FUTUR X GmbH in Hannover. Dein KI-Part Du entwickelst Tools, Integrationen und Anwendungen auf Basis von LLMs, in der Cloud und lokal Du kennst die Eigenheiten von LLMs im Detail (Context Window, Quantisierung, Reranker, Prompt Caching, Reasoning Effort, Multi-Token Prediction) und weißt, wann was sinnvoll ist RAG, Tool Calling und MCP setzt du ein, wo sie etwas liefern Du arbeitest agil und experimentierfreudig, ohne Dogmen Dein IT-Part Du übernimmst Netzwerk, Server und Virtualisierung (u. a. Proxmox) und denkst Monitoring und Backup immer mit IT-Sicherheit und DSGVO berücksichtigst du von Anfang an bei jeder Entscheidung VLANs, Reverse Proxies, Zone-Based Firewalls und Split-Tunnel-VPN gehören für dich zum Handwerkszeug Du betreibst Container mit Rootless Podman Arbeitsweise und Verantwortung Git und CI/CD sind deine Basis, Entscheidungen dokumentierst du in ADRs Du bist ab Tag 1 Ansprechperson des Teams für Zugänge, Geräte und Alltagsfragen Bei FX arbeiten wir sehr autonom und mit vielen Freiheiten. Verantwortung übernimmst du vom ersten Tag an. Das bringst du mit Solide Softwareentwicklung: ein bis fünf Jahre Erfahrung oder sehr viel davon im Studium. Berufseinsteiger:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen, denn die Mentalität zählt mehr als die Berufserfahrung Docker, Git und CI/CD nutzt du im Alltag Du willst LLM-Technik im Detail verstehen Server, Netzwerk und Firewall machen dir Spaß Buzzword-Selbsttest Die meisten davon solltest du kennen oder zumindest neugierig darauf sein: LLM · Docker · Git · DNS · DSGVO · RAG · CI/CD · VLAN · Reverse Proxy · Tool Calling · MCP · Proxmox · Context Window · Quantisierung · Reranker · Prompt Caching · Reasoning Effort · Split-Tunnel-VPN · Zone-Based Firewall · ADR · OAuth2 Device-Code-Flow · Rootless Podman · Multi-Token Prediction · Metal/MPS · Intel AMT/SOL Was dich erwartet Ein kleines, agiles Team mit vielen Freiheiten Eigeninitiative zählt bei uns mehr als Hierarchie Ein Entwicklungsfeld von der KI-Entwicklung bis zur Gesamt-IT Bewirb dich Du hast kein fünf Jahre altes Zeugnis? Das ist in Ordnung. Wir schauen auf deine Mentalität, auf ein paar Projekte, die du gebaut hast, und auf deinen Ehrgeiz, Neues zu lernen. Sende uns gerne eine E-Mail mit deiner Bewerbung an hajo.knoche@futur-x.com und schreib uns kurz, was du schon gebaut hast.

items.desc: Mit Data & AI schaffen wir echten Mehrwert für die DHL Group – sei dabei! Bei DHL Data & AI entfalten wir das volle Potenzial von Data und AI – und gestalten aktiv die Zukunft der DHL-Gruppe mit. Unser Anspruch: Wir entwickeln bereichsübergreifende KI-Lösungen, fördern eine datengetriebene Unternehmenskultur und treiben die Digitalisierung voran. Von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleiten wir den gesamten Prozess end-to-end. Gleichzeitig stärken wir als Impulsgeber gruppenweite Initiativen wie Data & Analytics Governance, Technologie-Inkubation, Trainings und Community-Building. Klingt spannend? Dann bewirb Dich für unser Büro in Bonn als Data Scientist AI (d/m/w) und werde Teil unserer internationalen Data & AI Community. Wer wir sind DHL Data & AI ist die globale Serviceline der DHL Group für datengetriebene Innovation. Unser Team besteht aus rund 100 hochqualifizierten Expert:innen – darunter Data Scientists, AI-Engineers, Data Engineers sowie MLOps- und DevOps-Spezialist:innen. Als Teil der DHL Group, dem weltweit führenden Post- und Logistikdienstleister, arbeiten wir in einem einzigartigen globalen Netzwerk mit Präsenz in über 220 Ländern und Territorien. Unser Blick geht dabei weit über Logistik hinaus: Gemeinsam schaffen wir Verbindungen, die Menschen, Unternehmen und Märkte bewegen – verantwortungsvoll, nachhaltig und zukunftsorientiert. Deine Aufgaben Du möchtest Deine Leidenschaft für AI und Data Science in realen Business-Impact verwandeln? Du bist neugierig und ambitioniert, denkst Dinge weiter und willst sie aktiv mitgestalten – mit dem klaren Ziel, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied durch den Einsatz von AI zu machen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen, Consulting-Teams und Business Stakeholdern zusammen, analysierst Prozesse und Herausforderungen, übersetzt diese in intelligente AI-Lösungen und überträgst sie in die Praxis – messbar, skalierbar und wirksam. Du analysierst bestehende Datenlandschaften und schaffst die Grundlage für leistungsfähige AI Anwendungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachexpert:innen. Du bringst AI-Funktionalitäten erfolgreich in den Produktivbetrieb und optimierst deren Performance, Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit laufend anhand relevanter KPIs. Du entwickelst Prototypen, Demos und praxisnahe Enablement Materialien wie leichte Benutzeroberflächen, Playbooks oder Templates. Du bereitest Workshops vor, moderierst diese und kommunizierst Ergebnisse sowie Handlungsempfehlungen verständlich und strukturiert. Du arbeitest eng mit Data Engineers, Platform Engineers und Produktmanager:innen zusammen und entwickelst Dich im Austausch mit erfahrenen AI- und ML-Expert:innen kontinuierlich weiter. Das bringst Du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium in den Bereichen Mathematik, Statistik, Physik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen bzw. technischen Fachgebiet. Zusatzkenntnisse in Wirtschaft oder Management sind von Vorteil. Begeisterung dafür, Business-Herausforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen sowie 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Data Science oder AI mit direktem Business-Bezug – idealerweise über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg. Exzellente Englischkenntnisse sowie Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2- Niveau, ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge und Trade-offs verständlich für nicht-technische Stakeholder aufzubereiten. Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie solide SQL Erfahrung und ein gutes Verständnis von Software Engineering Best Practices (z. B. Versionierung, Testing, CI/CD). Erfahrung mit Backend-Entwicklung, Datenpipelines und der produktiven Integration von ML- und LLM-Lösungen.
