items.desc: Nous recherchons un·e Développeur.euse sénior, Traitement de Données ML pour participer au développement, à l’édition et à la mise à l'échelle de notre pipeline d'actifs de données. À la jonction de l'ingénierie des données, de l’édition des données et de l'apprentissage automatique, vous serez responsable de l’entièreté du pipeline qui transforme les données brutes à l'échelle du web en ensembles de données à haut signal utilisés pour entraîner l'IA-Chercheur. Dans ce rôle, vous ne vous contenterez pas de gérer les données ; vous en concevrez la qualité. Vous élaborerez le filtrage algorithmique, développerez des mécanismes de notation basés sur des modèles et assurerez une intégrité rigoureuse des bancs d'essai pour alimenter la prochaine génération d'IA. Et à mesure que nos modèles dépasseront les paradigmes établis, vous concevrez et implémenterez de nouvelles transformations de données qui n'ont pas encore de guide d'utilisation, travaillant à la frontière de ce que peuvent être les données d'entraînement. Nous recrutons plusieurs personnes pour ce poste, et les responsabilités pourront être réparties au sein de l'équipe en fonction de l'expérience, des compétences et des intérêts de chacun·e . Responsabilités clés Travailler en partenariat avec l'équipe de Recherche pour définir, construire, automatiser, mettre à l'échelle et gérer des pipelines de données qui transforment les données brutes à l'échelle du web en ensembles de données d'entraînement pour l'IA-Chercheur. Construire et maintenir des pipelines de traitement de données, incluant la dé-duplication, la notation de qualité basée sur des modèles, le filtrage heuristique, la suppression de la toxicité, le masquage des informations personnelles identifiables (IPI (PII)), l'extraction de métadonnées et les transformations de données propriétaires, avec un versionnage et un suivi de la provenance des ensembles de données complets, en optimisant le débit et le coût à l'échelle. S'assurer que toutes les données ingérées répondent aux exigences de conformité, aux politiques internes de gouvernance des données et aux obligations légales. Développer et affiner la suite d'outils de notation et de filtrage : heuristiques, évaluateurs basés sur les grands modèles de langage (“LLM-as-a-judge”), classificateurs ML, modules d'extraction de métadonnées et flux de travail de révision avec intervention humaine ("human-in-the-loop") requis pour le traitement et l'assurance qualité des données. Instrumenter les pipelines de traitement de données avec de la surveillance de la qualité des données, des garde-fous et des alertes pour détecter les régressions avant qu'elles ne se propagent en aval. Collaborer avec l'équipe de Recherche et d'autres équipes pour comprendre l'évolution des exigences en matière de données, puis identifier et acquérir de vastes corpus de texte qui répondent à ces exigences. Cela comprend la réalisation d'analyses systématiques de couverture pour identifier les lacunes dans le corpus et le développement de stratégies d'acquisition ciblées pour y remédier, ainsi que la collaboration avec l'équipe juridique et de gouvernance pour obtenir la licence de nouvelles sources de données. Concevoir et maintenir des mécanismes stricts de détection des fuites pour se prémunir contre la contamination de l'évaluation à toutes les étapes du pipeline de traitement des données. Construire des outils et des interfaces internes qui permettent aux chercheurs d'explorer, d'interroger et de comprendre les ensembles de données disponibles avec un minimum de friction. Compétences Et Qualifications Diplôme en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe. Expérience avérée dans le traitement des ensembles de données textuelles non structurées massives (échelle du billion de jetons), avec plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans le traitement des données, l'ingénierie de l'apprentissage automatique ou le traitement du langage naturel (NLP). Expérience pratique des cadres de traitement distribué (par exemple, Spark, Ray, Flink), de la conception et de l'optimisation des pipelines à haut débit. Expérience de la mise en œuvre de la confidentialité des données (masquage des IPI), du filtrage de la sécurité du contenu (toxicité, biais) et de la prévention de la contamination de l'évaluation. Capacité démontrée à travailler avec des équipes de Recherche, d'Ingénierie et/ou Juridique/de Gouvernance, à traduire les exigences variées en travail concret de pipeline. Solide maîtrise de Python, y compris l'écriture de code de traitement de données de qualité production. Expérience des cadres d'orchestration de pipelines (par exemple, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster). Atouts Expérience dans la formation, l'affinage ("fine-tuning") ou le déploiement de modèles ML pour des tâches de qualité des données (classificateurs, évaluateurs basés sur les LLM) et familiarité avec l'optimisation de l'inférence LLM (par exemple vLLM, SGLang). Familiarité avec le déploiement conteneurisé …

items.title: Simulation Architect – Defence & Combat Systems
items.card: The role Evaluating modern combat systems and training tactical AI requires more than isolated component models or a fast software backbone — it requires architecting how operational reality is represented and connected inside a synthetic world. Beyond our core simulation platform, we are building the domain and kill-chain layer of our synthetic environment: specifically, how sensors, effectors, command and control
items.desc:
The role 
 Evaluating modern combat systems and training tactical AI requires more than isolated component models or a fast software backbone — it requires architecting how operational reality is represented and connected inside a synthetic world. Beyond our core simulation platform, we are building the domain and kill-chain layer of our synthetic environment: specifically, how sensors, effectors, command and control (C2) nodes and communication networks interact as coherent, end-to-end kill chains across Red and Blue forces. To support everything from cloud-scale operational analysis (OA) and AI training to high-fidelity system verification and validation (V&V), our synthetic environment must be fundamentally modular — allowing us to scale scenarios and swap model fidelities without breaking the kill chain.
 As a Simulation Engineer on our Simulation team, you will serve as the domain architect for this kill-chain layer. You will translate complex military operations into an abstracted, modular simulation architecture — defining the kill-chain interface control documents (ICDs), multi-fidelity model boundaries and domain integration patterns that allow heterogeneous models to plug into a single, scalable synthetic environment. Working closely with core software engineers, AI researchers and military domain specialists, you will ensure our synthetic worlds are architecturally clean, scalable across fidelity tiers and operationally credible.
 The day-to-day 
 Architect the end-to-end kill-chain structure of our synthetic environment, defining how sensing, C2 and battle management, communications and datalinks, and effectors interact across Red and Blue forces
 Design and maintain the interface control documents (ICDs), data contracts and functional boundaries between kill-chain components so models remain strictly decoupled and interchangeable
 Design multi-fidelity kill-chain contracts that allow any sub-model to be swapped seamlessly across granularity tiers — from fast lookup tables and functional power-and-effect models to physics and signal-level representations — without altering surrounding kill-chain logic
 Translate real-world military doctrines, operational concepts and multi-domain engagements into clean, abstracted simulation architectures that scale from single-engagement V&V to large-scale constructive OA campaigns
 Deconstruct, modularise and integrate existing constructive simulation frameworks and partner domain models (e.g. legacy C++ sensor, effector and behaviour models) into our modular kill-chain architecture
 Collaborate with core simulation backbone engineers to ensure domain-level kill-chain designs map cleanly onto the underlying runtime, time-management and execution infrastructure
 Define V&V and consistency criteria across fidelity tiers, ensuring that lower-fidelity abstractions remain calibrated and credible against higher-fidelity reference models
 Connect military operational stakeholders, partner engineering teams and internal AI and platform teams to align all aspects of the synthetic environment domain architecture
 You should apply if you 
 Have architected and delivered domain logic, functional interfaces and end-to-end kill chains (sensors, C2, communications, effectors) for military or aerospace simulation environments
 Design modular, multi-fidelity simulation architectures, abstracting real-world systems so that a lookup table, a functional model and a high-fidelity physics model can share a common architectural contract
 Apply deep military domain and OA understanding (Red and Blue doctrines, air and land combat systems, sensor-to-shooter workflows) to translate operational reality into formal system and interface designs
 Navigate, assess and modularise existing simulation frameworks and model codebases (e.g. C++, Python, MATLAB/Simulink) to extract domain logic and define clean integration boundaries alongside software teams
 Balance the architectural trade-offs between simulation fidelity, computational scalability and operational validity across different use cases (large-scale Monte Carlo OA, AI training, SIL/HIL V&V)
 Communicate complex architectural and operational concepts clearly across disciplines, aligning software engineers, domain modellers and defence stakeholders around shared interface standards
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to have 
 Have architected or modularised established European or German constructive simulation frameworks (e.g. AFSIM or comparable national and international air and land engagement simulators)
 Have designed interfaces that allow classical rule-based or behaviour-tree doctrines to be swapped with AI- or agent-based decision models within a kill chain

items.title: Technical Operations Analyst, Automation & Evaluations
items.card: About the Role As part of the Automation & Analytics function within RIS, you’ll partner with teams across USRO to support their data, analysis, measurement, and automation needs. You’ll build tools and workflows that help teams make informed decisions and improve how they operate. You’ll work with domain experts to turn judgment into testable criteria, then help take promising prototypes into reliable operation.
items.desc:
About the Team

At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role sits on the Risk Incubation & Systems (RIS) vertical in USRO, which investigates emerging risks, builds data and automation capabilities, and develops workflows that can scale into durable operational homes.

About the Role

As part of the Automation & Analytics function within RIS, you’ll partner with teams across USRO to support their data, analysis, measurement, and automation needs. You’ll build tools and workflows that help teams make informed decisions and improve how they operate. You’ll work with domain experts to turn judgment into testable criteria, then help take promising prototypes into reliable operation.

You will work hands-on with Trust & Safety domain experts,  investigators, operational leads, and engineers to turn ambiguous requirements into practical systems. You’ll test and document the tools and workflows you build, and agree with partner teams who will monitor and maintain them.

Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.

In This Role, You Will

 - Work with teams across USRO to define the questions they need answered and identify work that could benefit from automation.

 - Use SQL and Python to investigate operational problems and turn findings into recommendations teams can act on.

 - Build and maintain datasets and dashboards that teams can use for recurring analysis.

 - Define metrics to assess the quality and impact of USRO’s work, and measure whether changes produce the expected improvements.

 - Build scripts and API integrations to automate recurring tasks, using LLMs where they improve the workflow.

 - Evaluate automated workflows against expert-reviewed examples and existing processes to understand errors and measure their practical value.

 - Hand off workflows with clear ownership, maintenance instructions, and a feedback loop for reviewers.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

 - Have strong SQL skills and can use Python to analyze data and build tools that solve practical problems.

 - Have worked with messy (operational) data and can assess its quality and explain how gaps affect your findings.

 - Can turn a loosely defined request into a clear problem and choose a practical way to solve it.

 - Have built and maintained datasets, dashboards, scripts, or API integrations that other people use in their work.

 - Know how to define useful metrics and measure whether changes to a process or tool improve outcomes.

 - Can explain the trade-offs involved in workflow automation, including where human judgment is needed.

 - Can work with domain experts to define clear assessment criteria and work through disagreements about ambiguous cases.

 - Have experience designing evaluations or quality checks and using the results to decide when to launch a tool and how to improve it.

Nice to Have

 - Experience transferring prototypes or new workflows into reliable, scaled operations.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

items.desc:
Join the BE-CSS-IDE section and help shape how CERN stores and serves data from the High-Luminosity Large Hadron Collider (HL-LHC).
 NXCALS, the CERN accelerator archival system, holds many years of data from CERN's particle accelerators: magnet and powering signals, beam instrumentation, cryogenics, and machine protection and post-mortem data. Accelerator operators, equipment experts and beam physicists use it every day to run the machine, diagnose faults and study performance.
 Your work will focus on the needs of the HL-LHC. You will help keep NXCALS fast, reliable and scalable as particle accelerator data volumes grow and the machine moves toward the High-Luminosity LHC era. You will work on a real production system alongside experienced engineers, with plenty of opportunities to learn and take ownership.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Contribute to the development of NXCALS core components, focusing on HL-LHC use cases: ingestion pipelines (ETL), metadata services, data compaction, data extraction and APIs.
 Improve the performance and reliability of data access for LHC operations, machine protection analyses and commissioning activities.
 Work with accelerator users in the CERN Control Centre and equipment groups to understand their needs and help them build applications and analyses on NXCALS.
 Help evaluate big-data technologies (such as HDFS, Apache Ozone or ClickHouse) and their fit for future HL-LHC data requirements.
 Follow modern engineering practices in a team that values code quality, testing and automation.
 Your profile: 
 Solid experience in Java development; familiarity with the Spring ecosystem is an advantage.
 Experience with, or strong interest in, big-data technologies such as Hadoop, HDFS, HBase, ClickHouse, Apache Spark or Kafka.
 Working knowledge of Python; experience with PySpark is a plus.
 Familiarity with software quality practices, CI/CD and DevOps.
 Curiosity about particle accelerators and enthusiasm for working with diverse user communities.
 Skills: 
 Java.
 Spring ecosystem (advantage).
 Hadoop, HDFS, HBase, ClickHouse.
 Apache Spark, Kafka.
 Python, PySpark (plus).
 Software quality practices.
 CI/CD, DevOps.
 Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the basics of the other language.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 You have a professional background in Software Engineering (or a related field) and have either: a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

items.title: Software Engineer in Physics Simulation (IT-CE-PSE-2026-167-GRAP)
items.card: you will speed up software packages for Monte Carlo (MC) event generation with a focus on the Madgraph event generator suite. Current and future tasks tackled by the team are at the intersection of theoretical/computational physics and computer science. In order to profit from the latest computing hardware, adaptations or re-engineering of software in aspects such as data structures, parallelisation of the workflow
items.desc:
We are offering a position in the Physics Software Engineering section of the Computing for Experiments group in the CERN IT department (IT-CE-PSE) on Performance Software Engineering in the realm of high energy physics data simulation.
 The work on this post will be carried out in the context of the NextGen project, a collaboration between the LHC experiments and the CERN Research and Computing Departments. NextGen explores the use and impact of high-performance computing architectures in data simulation and data processing for the LHC experiments with a focus on the upcoming High Luminosity (HL-LHC) data taking phase at the CERN Large Hadron Collider.
 The simulation of particle collisions is one of the main consumers of computing resources for LHC experiments. Given the expected increase in the required statistics, accuracy and complexity for future simulation, and to stay within the forecasted computing budget, the throughput of simulation software packages needs to increase substantially.
 The successful candidate will join a team of software engineers and physicists that addresses this challenge. Together, you will speed up software packages for Monte Carlo (MC) event generation with a focus on the Madgraph event generator suite. Current and future tasks tackled by the team are at the intersection of theoretical/computational physics and computer science. In order to profit from the latest computing hardware, adaptations or re-engineering of software in aspects such as data structures, parallelisation of the workflow or task scheduling are needed. This work is guided by the requirements of experimental analyses and takes into account the latest developments in theoretical predictions.
 In case of interest, training on data science, programming languages, software engineering concepts and computing architectures is available and can be provided via various training programs.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Analyse and profile existing simulation code bases and develop strategies for improving their throughput.
 Implement latest software engineering concepts, leveraging on compute accelerators such as GPUs, modern CPU architectures and heterogeneous compute platforms.
 Interact and collaborate with experts in the theory, experimental physics and software engineering communities at CERN and world-wide.
 Supervise students on software development tasks and projects.
 Your profile: 
 Preferably a PhD in Theoretical or Particle Physics or Master's Degree with equivalent work experience with a strong background in numerical simulation.
 Proficiency in working with computing hardware accelerators and modern computing architectures, including heterogeneous compute platforms.
 A proven track record in performance software engineering for simulation applications in C++ and GPU programming languages such as CUDA or HIP.
 Knowledge of state of the art profiling tools for heterogeneous computing architectures.
 Experience with the Madgraph event generator software as a developer or user is highly valued.
 Skills: 
 Proficiency in modern C++ (up to C++23), GPU programming with CUDA and HIP, and Python for scripting, analysis and tooling is essential.
 Knowledge of hard scattering processes and the perturbative order of their matrix element calculations in Monte Carlo event generators is strongly desirable.
 Familiarity with Fortran is an advantage.
 Fluent in English.

Work with us to evolve the CERN data storage systems used at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC).

 You will be part of the EOS Storage Development and Operations team, delivering large-scale, reliable, high-performance storage services.  Experience and good knowledge of Linux, networking and storage technologies.
 Interest in distributed storage systems, data management platforms and large-scale scientific computing.
 Interest in storage performance, scalability and reliability challenges.
 Understanding of concepts such as replication, fault tolerance, caching, scheduling and data consistency.

items.desc:
En Sabadell Zurich formarás parte del equipo de Gestión de Riesgos y contribuirás a la ejecución puntual y precisa de las actividades asignadas relacionadas con los controles internos.
 Colaborarás con los especialistas en riesgos y controles, proporcionando apoyo y participando en la revisión y el cuestionamiento constructivo de las actividades de control dentro de tu ámbito de responsabilidad. Tu contribución ayudará a reforzar el entorno de control y la gestión de los riesgos operacionales, en un entorno colaborativo y orientado a negocio.
 Además, participarás en iniciativas relacionadas con:
 El apoyo a la gobernanza y evolución del marco de control, contribuyendo a la elaboración y actualización de políticas y otros documentos de gobernanza.
 El apoyo a la identificación y evaluación de riesgos y a la revisión y el cuestionamiento de los controles internos, así como al proceso periódico de aprobación (attestation).
 La realización de actividades de aseguramiento y pruebas de revisión de controles, validando los hallazgos y observaciones con las partes interesadas pertinentes y documentando los resultados.
 La colaboración en el seguimiento de las deficiencias y sus planes de remediación, apoyando la coordinación con los responsables de los controles para completar las actividades dentro de los plazos establecidos.
 La recopilación y preparación de información, datos y presentaciones, contribuyendo a la elaboración de informes de riesgos y controles para la Dirección y los órganos de gobierno.
 La participación en reuniones para aportar información, actualizaciones y apoyo sobre proyectos e iniciativas del área asignada.
 La contribución al desarrollo e impartición de formaciones y a la preparación de materiales formativos para las partes interesadas, promoviendo una cultura de riesgos disciplinada.
 Por otro lado, colaborarás con la Dirección, la primera línea de la compañía y las funciones de Riesgos, Compliance, Finanzas, Auditoría Interna, Tecnología y Operaciones, así como con los equipos de Control Interno del Grupo. Dentro de tu ámbito de responsabilidad, apoyarás la revisión del diseño, la documentación, la ejecución y las pruebas de los controles, así como el seguimiento de las acciones correctoras.
 ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? 
 Buscamos a una persona con conocimientos de control interno, gestión de riesgos o auditoría, capaz de ejecutar con rigor las actividades asignadas, analizar información y colaborar eficazmente con especialistas e interlocutores de distintas áreas. Valoramos el pensamiento crítico y la capacidad para revisar y cuestionar de forma constructiva las actividades de control dentro de su ámbito de responsabilidad.
 Experiencia y conocimientos esenciales 
 Formación universitaria en Administración y Dirección de Empresas, Economía, Derecho, Ingeniería o titulación equivalente.
 Como mínimo 5 años de experiencia en actividades de apoyo en control interno, gestión de riesgos, auditoría o funciones de aseguramiento.
 Conocimientos de riesgos y controles, principios de gestión de riesgos y gobierno corporativo, y familiaridad con marcos de control interno.
 Conocimientos de metodologías de diseño, documentación y pruebas de controles, y capacidad para realizar actividades de aseguramiento, validar hallazgos y documentar resultados.
 Capacidad para recopilar, analizar y presentar datos, preparar información de seguimiento y contribuir a la redacción de informes de riesgos y controles.
 Conocimientos básicos del entorno normativo aplicable y capacidad para apoyar a los especialistas en consultas e iniciativas relacionadas con riesgos y controles.
 Nivel alto de inglés, oral y escrito, para desenvolverse en un entorno corporativo internacional.
 Qué marcará la diferencia en tu perfil 
 Capacidad analítica, pensamiento estructurado y habilidades de interpretación y visualización de datos para comunicar los resultados con claridad.
 Capacidad de planificación, organización y priorización para cumplir plazos y apoyar la coordinación de actividades y proyectos del área.
 Comunicación efectiva y capacidad para colaborar con las partes interesadas y trasladar información de forma clara y precisa.
 Trabajo en equipo y colaboración transversal con áreas de negocio y funciones de control.
 Proactividad, visión de negocio, adaptación al cambio y mentalidad de mejora continua.
 Compromiso con los valores corporativos, responsabilidad sobre las tareas asignadas y el propio desarrollo profesional, y disposición para ayudar y apoyar al equipo.
 Valorable 
 Conocimiento del sector asegurador o financiero.

 Experiencia en gestión de riesgo operacional y metodologías de auditoría.
 Experiencia con la plataforma Polaris y/o herramientas de documentación y seguimiento de controles en entornos corporativos complejos.

items.desc:
¡Hola!
 Soy Celia, recruiter de esta posición. Me encanta el teatro musical, el karaoke y empezar series, aunque a veces me cuesta terminarlas. Podrías pensar que soy una persona dispersa pero, ¡nada más lejos de la realidad! ¡Encantada de saludarte!
 Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales.
 ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo.
 Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega!
 ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN: 
 Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. 
 En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). 
 ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. 
 Y te preguntarás: Celia, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento): 
 Buscamos un/a tramitador para integrarse en el equipo de Garantía Directa de forma temporal. Tu objetivo es la tramitación de siniestros de Daños Propios, Robo, Incendio y Lunas, siendo el claimsowner de los siniestros. 
 Formarás parte del equipo que gestiona la tramitación de siniestros, manteniendo una comunicación diaria con agentes, asegurados y partners para asegurar una atención eficaz y coordinada. 
 Te asegurarás de tramitar correctamente las garantías directas contratadas en póliza, así como de aplicar los criterios de responsabilidad establecidos. 
 Registrarás, coordinarás y gestionarás expedientes, incluyendo la comunicación con la red pericial, la negociación de indemnizaciones con agentes y asegurados, y el seguimiento de pagos e interacciones con proveedores. 
 Utilizarás herramientas como Info y NET para la gestión operativa diaria, asegurando la trazabilidad y eficiencia de los procesos. 
 Aprenderás y aplicarás los manuales del Centro, garantizando el cumplimiento de los procedimientos internos y contribuyendo a la mejora continua del servicio. 
 A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo? 
 No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos. 
 Si tienes experiencia en atención al cliente, te sentirás cómodo gestionando las interacciones diarias con nuestros asegurados, agentes y colaboradores. 
 Si cuentas con experiencia previa en Claims motor, será un valor añadido muy apreciado para este rol. 
 Si eres una persona proactiva en la resolución de expedientes, aportarás agilidad y eficacia al equipo desde el primer día. 
 Si tienes una buena capacidad de planificación y organización, podrás gestionar tus tareas de forma eficiente y autónoma. 
 Si mantienes una actitud positiva y una alta predisposición, encajarás perfectamente en nuestro entorno colaborativo. 
 Si tienes facilidad para aprender y adaptarte a nuevos procesos, te desenvolverás con soltura en el día a día. 
 Si disfrutas trabajando en equipo y aportando al logro de objetivos comunes, este es tu lugar. 
 Si eres una persona proactiva en la toma de decisiones, contribuirás activamente a la mejora continua de nuestros procesos. 
 Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar.
 En Zurich somos muy disfrutones , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales.
 #PorSerDeZurich , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores. 
 Te ofrecemos un modelo híbrido mega flexible para trabajar cómo y dónde quieras dentro de España. 
 Confiamos en la filosofía de aprender haciendo para que puedas moverte a otras áreas a nivel local o internacional gracias a nuestro programa “Talento en Movimiento”. Y para que sigas con tu desarrollo y crecimiento: clases de inglés, formación y programa …

¡Hola!

Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo.

Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). 
 ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. 
 Y te preguntarás: Mariana, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento): 
 Ha llegado el momento de dar un paso más para coger velocidad, crecer y proteger nuestra posición de líderes en nuestro negocio y para ello necesitamos disponer de un equipo de especialistas con conocimiento técnico y presencia en el mercado.

items.card: The role As a Hearing Wellness Advisor, you’ll: Be the first point of contact for customers, providing a warm and professional welcome Carry out hearing screenings and pre-clinic checks Support hearing aid maintenance, aftercare, and troubleshooting Assist Audiologists with clinic flow and customer preparation Confidently discuss hearing health, ear care products, and next steps with customers Manage administration,
items.desc:
If you enjoy working directly with customers, supporting clinical care, and being part of a service that genuinely changes lives- this Hearing Wellness Advisor role offers a rewarding entry point into a long-term audiology career. 
 You’ll play a key role in supporting customers throughout their hearing journey, while building the experience, skills, and qualifications needed to progress into clinical audiology- backed by the scale, stability, and investment of Boots Hearingcare. 
 This is a hands-on, customer-facing role with real responsibility, structured development, and a clear future pathway. 
 The clinic environment 
 You’ll work within a modern clinic, supporting both customers and Audiologists in delivering outstanding hearing care. 
 The environment includes: 
 Access to the latest hearing technology and hearing aid solutions 
 Structured diaries and appointment-based services 
 Strong clinical and operational support 
 Clear processes and high standards of care 
 The role 
 As a Hearing Wellness Advisor, you’ll: 
 Be the first point of contact for customers, providing a warm and professional welcome 
 Carry out hearing screenings and pre-clinic checks 
 Support hearing aid maintenance, aftercare, and troubleshooting 
 Assist Audiologists with clinic flow and customer preparation 
 Confidently discuss hearing health, ear care products, and next steps with customers 
 Manage administration, appointments, and customer records accurately 
 Play an active role in delivering a high-quality, customer-centric service 
 You’ll be trusted with responsibility and supported to grow your capability over time. 
 Training & career progression 
 From day one, you’ll receive structured training to build confidence and clinical understanding, including sessions at our Boots Hearingcare Academy in Llandudno. Training is delivered over several months, with all accommodation and expenses covered, and is supported by hands-on experience in store. 
 Career pathway 
 This role offers a clear progression route: Hearing Wellness Advisor → QHAD → Audiologist 
 With strong performance, you can progress onto our fully funded Qualification in Hearing Aid Dispensing (QHAD) programme, leading to a qualified Hearing Aid Audiologist role. 
 Entry requirements: 
 GCSEs (or equivalent) Grade C / 5 or above in Maths, English, and Science 
 Strong performance and customer focus 
 Ability to balance academic study with clinical practice 
 What’s in it for you 
 Salary: £30,000 per annum 
 Monthly bonus scheme 
 Boots Discount Card 
 Free hearing aids (if required as an employee) 
 Free flu vaccination (discounted for family members) 
 Pension scheme (including salary sacrifice) 
 Life assurance 
 Flexible Benefits Box – tailor your package 
 Telus wellbeing support – confidential support inside and outside work 
 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 with service, plus bank holidays 
 Long service awards recognising your contribution 
 What we’re looking for 
 A strong customer-service background (healthcare or retail ideal) 
 Confidence working with customers in a consultative environment 
 Excellent communication and organisational skills 
 Strong attention to detail and administration skills 
 A genuine interest in hearing health and progression into audiology 
 GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths, English, and Science to support future QHAD entry 
 We care. We drive innovation. We strive for excellence. We build the best team. 
 #BootsHearingcare #BootsHearingcare

items.desc:
PLC Specialist – permanent night shift
 The future of moblity for us. Professional excellence for you. 
 At the BMW Group, everything starts with passion. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Enthusiasm for joint projects turns a team into a strong unit where every opinion is valued. It is only when expertise, highly professional processes and enjoyment of work unite that we can shape the future together. All employees can and should contribute with their special skills to the unique culture of the BMW Group. We're searching for people who are as passionate as we are. Your expertise, your skill set, your motivation, and your individuality are what drive us forward.
 As a PLC Specialist at BMW Group Plant Debrecen, you will be responsible for the production-related support of all control technology scopes of our production systems in the Assembly.
 What awaits you? 
 Work environment – a highly automated production area equipped with robots, PLC controls, which our team sets up, operates, and maintains to ensure the required quality.
 Team – you will join our Maintenance team in the Assembly.
 System Optimization & Fault Elimination – you support operations in long-term fault elimination and lead projects aimed at improving system availability, safety, and efficiency.
 Project Execution – you ensure the timely delivery of production area projects (modifications, optimizations, and replacements) while managing suppliers within a standard project management framework.
 Problem Solving - you coordinate all on-site control systems and assist suppliers with emerging technical issues.
 IT System Support - you utilize various production-related IT systems in your daily routine.
 Strategic Planning - you apply electrical standards and contribute to the development of new control technologies and systems up to series production . 
 Administration - you prepare inquiry and RFP (Request for Proposal) documents to round off your scope of work.
 What should you bring along? 
 Education background - vocational/high-school degree in a relevant field (electrical, electronics); university degree would be an advantage.
 Work experience – Minimum 2 years of experiences in the commissioning of PLC controls.
 Technical knowledge - knowledge of drive, control and automation technology, PLC programming (Trainings on how to programme SW, but not developed), S7 Classic and TIA Portal, SEW and SINAMICS drive technology. Advanced knowledge of creating/editing visualizations in WinCC, network technology and bus systems (Ethernet, ProfiNet) and knowledge of Kuka robot programming.
 Language skills - communicational level of English and Hungarian is needed, German would be an advantage.
 Work schedule - willingness to work in permanent night shift (00:00-6:00).
 Soft skills - team spirit and joy to working independently or in a structured manner. Proactivity and good analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.
 What do we offer? 
 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance, which is why our benefits package includes the following elements in addition to the base salary:
 Bonus – performance-based bonus calculated based on corporate and personal results.
 Cafeteria – annual cafeteria allowance paid out monthly.
 Commuting Support – free, direct bus and train services from major cities in the region, aligned with shift schedules. Travel cost reimbursement for personal car usage is provided at the legally prescribed rate.
 Healthcare Services – high-quality healthcare services, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise options are available at the on-site health center.
 Private Health Insurance – after probation time, all associates entitled for health insurance, which contains outpatient care, laboratory- and diagnostics tests, outpatient and one-day surgery, screening tests, patient transport.
 Accident and Life Insurance – in work and out of work group accident and life insurance.
 Subsidized Meals – one daily discounted hot meal at the company cafeteria.
 Employee car rental programme .
 Learn more about our benefits via this link: BMW Group Gyár Debrecen Karrier | Rólunk | Amit kínálunk 
 Type of employment: Full-time, permanent employment.

Nekünk a mobilitás jövője. Neked a szakmád csúcsa 
 A BMW csoportnál minden az elhivatottsággal kezdődik, amely képes egy szakmát hivatássá változtatni. Elhivatottságunk késztet bennünket arra, hogy folyamatosan újra értelmezzük a mobilitást, és innovatív ötleteket vigyünk az utakra. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés alakít egy csapatot erős egységgé, ahol minden ötletet és véleményt értékelünk. Csak ha a szakértelem, a professzionális folyamatok és a munka élvezete egyesül, akkor alakíthatjuk együtt a jövőt. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan elhivatottak, mint mi. A szakértelmed, a készségeid, a motivációd és az egyéniséged visznek minket előre.
 Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen PLC Specialista munkatársa, felelős leszel a gyártó rendszereink összes vezérléstechnikai területének gyártáshoz kapcsolódó támogatásáért az Összeszerelő Üzemben.
 Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet – magasan automatizált, robotokkal, PLC rendszerekkel ellátott gyártósor, melyeket a munkatársaink állítanak be, üzemeltetnek és tartanak karban a szükséges minőség biztosítása érdekében.
 Csapat – az Összeszerelő Üzem interdiszciplináris csapatának tagja leszel.
 Rendszeroptimalizálás és hibaelhárítás – támogatod az üzemeltetést a hibák hosszú távú kiküszöbölésében, valamint a rendszer rendelkezésre állásának, biztonságának és hatékonyságának növelését célzó projektek vezetésében.
 Projektek lebonyolítása – Felelsz a termelési területen zajló átalakítások, optimalizálások, cserékre határidőre történő megvalósításáért, illetve a beszállítók koordinálásért a klasszikus projektmenedzsment keretein belül.
 Problémamegoldás – koordinálod a helyszínen az ellenőrzéssel kapcsolatos valamennyi feladatot, illetve támogatást nyújtasz a beszállítóknak a felmerülő problémák kezelésében.
 IT rendszertámogatás – mindennapi munkád során különböző, a termeléssel kapcsolatos informatikai rendszereket használod.
 Adminisztráció – elkészíted a szükséges vizsgálati dokumentumokat, amelyek kiegészítik és alátámasztják a feladatkörödet.
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Végzettség – Középfokú végzettséget szereztél kapcsolódó szakterületen (ipari villanyszerelés, elektronika); egyetemi diploma előnyt jelent.
 Munkatapasztalat – minimum 2 éves szakmai tapasztalattal rendelkezel a PLC-vezérlések üzembe helyezésében, működtetésében.
 Technikai háttér - a hajtás-, vezérlő- és automatizálási technológiákat ismered, PLC-programozási ismeretekkel rendelkezel, S7 Classic és TIA Portal, valamint a SEW és SINAMICS hajtástechnika. A WinCC-ben történő vizualizációk létrehozásának és szerkesztésének magas szintű ismerete, hálózati technológia és buszrendszerek (Ethernet, ProfiNet) ismerete, valamint a Kuka robotok programozásának ismerete.
 Nyelvtudás – angol nyelvtudásod kommunikációs szintű, a német nyelv ismerete előnyt jelent.
 Munkarend – kész vagy két, váltott műszakban dolgozni (06:00-15:00 és 15:00-24:00).
 Készségek – csapatjátékos vagy, könnyen tudsz együttműködni a kollégákkal, képes vagy önállóan és csapatban dolgozni. Proaktivitás, analitikus gondolkodásmód és jó problémamegoldó képesség jellemez.
 Mit kínálunk? 
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll:
 Bérfejlesztés – évente, teljesítményértékelés alapján . 
 Bónusz – vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónuszok.
 Cafeteria – éves cafeteria keretösszeg havi folyósítással.
 Támogatott munkába járás – ingyenes, a műszakbeosztáshoz igazított, közvetlen busz és vasút járatok a régió nagyvárosaiból. Gépkocsi használat esetén a törvényben előírt mértékű költségtérítés.
 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások – magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészség központban.
 Magán egészségbiztosítás – próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást.
 Baleset és életbiztosítás – munkaidőben és azon kívül is bekövetkező eseményekre csoportos baleset és életbiztosítás.
 Kedvezményes étkezés – napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében.

ProFuturo contribuye al cumplimiento del Objetivo de Desarrollo Sostenible 4 (ODS 4), que promueve una educación inclusiva, equitativa y de calidad para
items.desc:
Nuestra misión es garantizar una educación de calidad para millones de niños y niñas que viven en entornos vulnerables, donde las desigualdades de acceso a recursos educativos, tecnología y formación docente limitan sus oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo. 
 ProFuturo contribuye al cumplimiento del Objetivo de Desarrollo Sostenible 4 (ODS 4), que promueve una educación inclusiva, equitativa y de calidad para todas las personas. En este contexto, la transformación digital ofrece nuevas oportunidades para mejorar el acceso a la educación, enriquecer los procesos de enseñanza y aprendizaje y reforzar el desarrollo de estudiantes y docentes. 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO DE TECNOLOGÍA E INTELIGENCIA DIGITAL? 
 El área de Tecnología e Inteligencia Digital es responsable de impulsar, coordinar y asegurar la evolución tecnológica de ProFuturo, dando soporte a los diferentes proyectos y áreas de la organización. Desde el área se gestionan iniciativas relacionadas con plataformas y sistemas, arquitectura y servicios cloud, datos y visualización, inteligencia artificial, ciberseguridad y evolución de soluciones digitales, asegurando su correcta planificación, ejecución, seguimiento y mejora continua. 
 ¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA? 
 Entre las principales responsabilidades: 
 Gestión y seguimiento de proyectos tecnológicos end-to-end , participando en su definición, planificación, ejecución, seguimiento y cierre. 
 Funciones de PMO tecnológica , realizando seguimiento de planificación, hitos, dependencias, riesgos, recursos, proveedores, costes y entregables. 
 Elaboración y mantenimiento de planes de proyecto, cronogramas, cuadros de seguimiento, documentación y reporting ejecutivo , facilitando la toma de decisiones. 
 Coordinación con equipos internos, proveedores y partners tecnológicos , realizando seguimiento de compromisos, incidencias y niveles de servicio. 
 Participación en proyectos de sistemas, plataformas digitales, infraestructura, servicios cloud, bases de datos e integraciones . 
 Apoyo en iniciativas de datos, analítica y visualización , incluyendo el seguimiento y evolución de cuadros de mando, indicadores y herramientas de Business Intelligence. 
 Apoyo al seguimiento de proyectos de IA y automatización , coordinando tareas, proveedores y entregables, sin necesidad de desarrollar modelos. 
 Seguimiento operativo de servicios cloud y plataformas , revisando disponibilidad, incidencias y acciones de mejora junto con los equipos especialistas. 
 Apoyo en procesos de contratación y gestión tecnológica , incluyendo definición de necesidades, elaboración de requisitos técnicos, valoración de propuestas y seguimiento de proveedores. 
 Coordinación y seguimiento de incidencias, evolutivos y planes de mejora , ayudando a priorizar necesidades y asegurar su resolución. 
 Aplicación de metodologías Agile y de gestión de proyectos , promoviendo una forma de trabajo organizada, iterativa, colaborativa y orientada a resultados. 
 Elaboración de documentación técnica y funcional, presentaciones e informes de situación , incluyendo materiales para comités y reuniones de seguimiento. 
 Colaboración transversal con las diferentes áreas de la organización , traduciendo necesidades funcionales en iniciativas y soluciones tecnológicas. 
 TE ESPERAMOS SI CUENTAS CON 
 Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Ingeniería Industrial, Sistemas de Información o titulaciones relacionadas con tecnología. 
 Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en gestión, coordinación o seguimiento de proyectos tecnológicos. 
 Experiencia en gestión y coordinación de proyectos tecnológicos , preferiblemente en entornos con diferentes equipos, proveedores y stakeholders. 
 Conocimientos de metodologías y herramientas de gestión de proyectos y Agile : Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Planner, o similares. 
 Conocimientos de sistemas, arquitecturas tecnológicas, integraciones y APIs . 
 Conocimientos de bases de datos , especialmente entornos SQL, y comprensión de modelos y flujos de datos. 
 Experiencia o conocimientos en herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización de datos , como Tableau, Power BI o similares. 
 Conocimientos de entornos y servicios cloud , especialmente AWS, valorándose experiencia con Azure y/o Google Cloud. 
 Familiaridad con casos de uso de IA generativa y automatización ; no se requiere experiencia en desarrollo de modelos ni arquitectura avanzada de IA. 
 Conocimientos básicos de ciberseguridad : control de accesos y MFA, protección de datos, copias de seguridad, gestión de parches y nociones de vulnerabilidades y phishing. 
 Capacidad para comprender documentación técnica y mantener interlocución con perfiles técnicos, funcionales y de negocio. 
 Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación, proveedores y equipos internacionales. 
 COMPETENCIAS

¿QUÉ ES TELEFONICA TECH? 
 Telefónica Tech es la compañía líder en trasformación digital del Grupo Telefónica. Contamos con una amplia oferta de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas integradas de Ciberseguridad, Cloud, IoT, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Blockchain, con la que acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su transformación digital. 
 Somos un grupo de más de 6200 personas valientes que trabajamos a diario desde distintos puntos del mundo para alcanzar la excelencia, a través de un liderazgo basado en la transparencia y en el espírItu de equipo. Si te identificas con nuestros pilares, ¡estamos deseando conocerte! 
 www.telefonicatech.com 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO? 
 En la unidad de SIEM de Telefónica Tech trabajamos en el diseño, evolución y optimización de las capacidades de detección sobre plataformas SIEM basadas en CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM . Nuestro objetivo es maximizar la visibilidad de los entornos de cliente mediante la integración de fuentes de datos, la creación de casos de uso avanzados y la generación de métricas de valor que permitan mejorar continuamente la postura de seguridad. 
 ¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA? 
 Tu misión será gestionar y evolucionar las capacidades de detección y monitorización sobre la plataforma CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM . 
 Tu día a día: 
 Diseño, desarrollo y documentación de casos de uso de detección. 
 Integración e ingesta de nuevas fuentes de datos en CrowdStrike SIEM. 
 Evolución proactiva y optimización continua de casos de uso existentes. 
 Validación y mejora de reglas de correlación y contenido de detección. 
 Generación de informes ejecutivos y técnicos sobre el servicio. 
 Extracción, análisis y seguimiento de KPIs e indicadores de valor del servicio. 
 Identificación de oportunidades de mejora en cobertura de detección y monitorización. 
 Colaboración con equipos SOC, Threat Hunting e Incident Response para mejorar las capacidades de detección. 
 Automatización de procesos relacionados con monitorización, reporting y análisis de datos. 
 Participación en proyectos de despliegue y evolución de la plataforma.

 3 años de experiencia en tecnologías SIEM. 
 Experiencia en diseño y mantenimiento de casos de uso de detección. 
 Integración e ingesta de fuentes de datos de seguridad y sistemas. 
 Gestión y explotación de plataformas SIEM.

 Automatización de procesos y generación de informes.

 Certificaciones de ciberseguridad (Security+, CEH, GSEC o equivalentes).

 ¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS?

 Con esta oportunidad podrás adentrarte en el apasionante universo tecnológico y ser parte del cambio: un mundo más conectado, más humano, y lleno de historias que transforman vidas. 
 Recuerda adjuntar tu CV actualizado en formato PDF. 
 QUEREMOS GENTE COMO TÚ...
 Liderando la definición, implantación, evolución y gobierno técnico del sistema BMS (Building Management System) basado en Niagara Framework para la supervisión y control de las infraestructuras críticas de Telefónica de España, asegurando la integración homogénea de climatización, energía y sistemas auxiliares, la calidad de las alarmas y datos, la continuidad operativa, la ciberseguridad y la eficiencia energética.
El puesto actuará como referente técnico de Atalaya/Niagara, coordinando áreas internas, fabricantes e integradores, y garantizando una arquitectura abierta, escalable, mantenible y orientada a la operación 24x7 de centrales, CPD y emplazamientos de acceso.
 QUE RETOS ENFRENTARÁS EN EL DÍA A DÍA: 
 Definir y mantener la arquitectura funcional y técnica del BMS basado en Niagara 4: jerarquía de Supervisores y controladores, estaciones, plantillas, modelo de datos, etiquetado, históricos, gráficos, perfiles de usuario, copias de seguridad y criterios de alta disponibilidad. Elaborar y actualizar el Libro de Estilo, normativa y especificaciones técnicas para asegurar soluciones homogéneas y reutilizables en todos los emplazamientos. 
 Diseñar y validar la integración en Atalaya/Niagara de climatización, cuadros BT, transformadores, grupos electrógenos, ATS, SAIs, cuadros de fuerza de -48 V, baterías, analizadores de red y sensórica ambiental mediante BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, OPC, MQTT, API REST y pasarelas de protocolos legacy, incluida la migración progresiva desde EOC/N2R.

About the Role 
 Join Ericsson's antenna technology team to develop advanced electromagnetic structures for next-generation mobile communication systems. 
 We are seeking an RF engineer with hands-on experience in Frequency Selective Surfaces (FSS), sub-10-GHz electromagnetic design, and electromagnetic transparent structures. You will develop and optimise structures that control electromagnetic wave propagation while meeting the demanding performance requirements of modern antenna systems. 
 We welcome applications from both graduates with relevant research or demonstrator experience and experienced engineers with industrial development expertise. Technical capability and demonstrated practical experience matter more than years of service alone. 
 What You Will Do 
 Design and develop wideband electromagnetic structures for applications across cellular frequency bands between 600 MHz and 10 GHz. 
 Simulate and optimise electromagnetic performance using 3D simulation tools, investigating bandwidth, transmission, reflection, insertion loss, angular stability and polarisation effects. 
 Evaluate electromagnetic transparency and the interaction of passive structures with radiating elements, radomes and antenna arrays. 
 Investigate innovative concepts, including three-dimensional geometries, multilayer arrangements and other advanced periodic structures. 
 Validate designs through prototype development, RF measurements and simulation-to-measurement correlation. 
 Solve complex engineering challenges and collaborate with antenna, RF, mechanical and materials specialists to translate concepts into practical solutions. 
 Communicate technical results through engineering reports, design reviews and knowledge sharing. 
 What You Will Bring 
 A degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Applied Physics or a related discipline. 
 Demonstrated hands-on experience with Frequency Selective Surfaces (FSS) through industrial development, academic research, a thesis, laboratory work or a demonstrator. 
 Practical experience with RF or electromagnetic structures operating below 10 GHz, within the 600 MHz–10 GHz range. 
 Understanding of electromagnetic wave propagation, periodic structures, transmission and reflection behaviour, and electromagnetic transparency. 
 Practical experience with 3D electromagnetic simulation software, preferably Ansys HFSS or CST Studio Suite. 
 Analytical problem-solving skills and proficiency in English. 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience with wideband or multiband designs, three-dimensional structures, multilayer configurations, radomes or electromagnetic bandgap structures. 
 RF measurement experience, including vector network analysers, S-parameter characterisation and prototype validation. 
 Knowledge of Floquet modes, periodic boundary conditions, oblique incidence and equivalent-circuit modelling. 
 Experience with Python, MATLAB, simulation automation or AI-assisted electromagnetic design. 
 Familiarity with base-station antennas, passive arrays or Active Antenna Systems
 The role requires relocation to Rosenheim, Germany.

Overview 
 Location: Schiphol 
 This role involves working a 6 day shift rotation covering shifts 06:00-14:30, 14:30-12:00(midnight) and 12:00(midnight) - 06:00. 
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services.
 As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. 
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.

 Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training.
 Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.
 Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
 Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data centre facilities.

 Background Check Requirements 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is mandatory for this role. These include, but are not limited to:
 Microsoft Cloud Background Check: Must be passed upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
 Applicable certifications such as:
 CompTIA: A+, Server+, Network+
 Basic Structure Cabling (BSC)

items.desc:
What will you take care of? 
 As a Junior Electronics Application Engineer , you will join our technical team focused on Compact Hydraulics and Mobile Electronics applications. You will be actively supported by senior engineers through a structured onboarding path, bridging software, electronics, and hydraulics to deliver tailored electro-hydraulic solutions to our customers.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Help shape the future: Contribute to the design, software development, integration, and testing of intelligent electro-hydraulic systems for mobile equipment and industrial machinery. Participate from initial concept definition to laboratory and field validation.
 Experience learning & continuous growth: Benefit from continuous hands-on training on electronics, hydraulics, commissioning, and control architectures. Progressively expand your competence across software design, testing, and vehicle diagnostics.
 Drive technical excellence & testing: Support laboratory and field test benches, SIL (Software-in-the-Loop), HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop), and vehicle integration (VIL). Assist in field data acquisition, system troubleshooting, and calibration using advanced bus and diagnostic tools.
 Experience cooperation: Collaborate closely with Application Engineers, R&D, Sales teams across Bosch Rexroth Oil Control, and our international competence centers in Germany and across the globe to share best practices and technical know-how.
 Take on responsibility: Gradually manage software versions and system requests for custom and standard products, contributing to technical specifications, documentation, and customer commissioning support.
What distinguishes you? 
 Education: Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer/Software Engineering, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, or related engineering disciplines.
 Experience level: Entry-level (recent graduate) up to 2 years of professional, thesis, or internship experience in software development, electronics, embedded systems, or industrial automation.
 Software and programming skills: 
 Good academic knowledge or hands-on practice in C / C++ and/or CoDeSys (IEC 61131-3 standard). 
 Familiarity with MATLAB / Simulink for model-based design and simulation.
 Electronics and Fieldbus Communication: 
 Foundations of electronic control units (ECU), sensor/actuator interfacing, and digital/analog I/O.
 Understanding of CAN bus protocols (e.g., CAN 2.0B, J1939, CANopen). Exposure to tools such as Peak PCAN-Explorer, Vector CANalyzer, or ETAS INCA is considered a strong plus.
 Soft skills and mindset: 
 Analytical approach, structured problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
 Strong team-player attitude, curiosity, eagerness to learn, and proactive initiative.
 Languages: Fluent in Italian and English (spoken and written). Knowledge of German is a welcome plus.
 Mobility: Willingness to travel across Italy and abroad for customer support, field testing, commissioning, and technical workshops (typically around 15–25%).
 In line with our compensation policies, the gross annual salary (RAL) for this position lies within the range € 32.000 - € 36.000 for a 40-hour work week. 
 We look forward to discussing the full details of our compensation package and career development opportunities with you during the application process.

Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite.

 aktívne (telefonicky i osobne) oslovovať súčasných a zároveň aj potenciálnych klientov banky zo segmentu nadštandardných klientov,

Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu.  1500 EUR/mesiac

naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.

 Adminisztrációs, irattári feladatok elvégzésében: adatrögzítésben, szkennelésben. 
 Minőség-ellenőrzési folyamatokban való aktív részvételben. 
 Adminisztratív feladatokon keresztül a precíz és strukturált munkavégvégzés fejlesztésében. 
 Neked való mindez, ha: 
 Szívesen dolgoznál irodai munkakörnyezetben. 
 Heti 30 - 40 óra között tudsz munkát vállalni. 
 MS Office ismeretekkel rendelkezel. 
 Pontos, precíz munkavégzés jellemez. 
 Jó a monotóniatűrő képességed. 
 Érdeklődsz a dokumentumkezelési és adminisztratív területek iránt. 
 Szívesen megismernéd egy bank adminisztratív folyamatait.

 Igazi szakmai feladatokon keresztül fejlődhetsz, ebben támogatnak a munkatársak. 
 Jó eséllyel pályázhatsz majd a junior pozícióinkra . 
 Gyakornoki juttatást kapsz fizetett szabadságokkal . 
 Hivatalos szakmai gyakorlatként visszaigazoljuk a nálunk töltött idődet a felsőoktatási intézmény felé. 
 Légy te is CIB-es, hogy megtaláld a helyed!

Privredna banka Zagreb d.d. je društvo čija je vizija biti uzor i centar izvrsnosti u području financijskog poslovanja u Hrvatskoj. Temelj našeg uspješnog poslovanja su naši zaposlenici, koji aktivno sudjeluju u modernom razvoju banke i kreiranju stalnih promjena. PBZ, kao inovativna i suvremena banka i koja je usmjerena na interni razvoj, pruža okolinu u kojoj se možete razviti u smjeru u kojem želite. Univerzalni način kako ostvariti karijeru kod nas nije nepoznanica: učinkovitim radom, ostvarivanjem ciljeva, kontinuiranim razvojem kompetencija,odgovornim organizacijskim ponašanjem, prihvaćanjem različitosti, timskim doprinosom i osobnom proaktivnošću. Svi preduvjeti su tu, na Vama je samo da iskoristite. 
 Primijeni stečena znanja iz škole i s fakulteta u realnom sektoru, u jednoj od vodećih banaka u Hrvatskoj, obavljanjem stručne neplaćene prakse u PBZ-u. 
 Što te očekuje: 
 mogućnost stjecanja prvih radnih iskustava u trajanju do četiri tjedna (160 sati) u različitim organizacijskim dijelovima Banke, uzimajući u obzir tvoje sklonosti i interese te trenutačne organizacijske mogućnosti 
 iskusni, stručni i visokokvalificirani mentori 
 ugodna i poticajna radna klima 
 stjecanje novih osobnih i poslovnih kontakata 
 U prijavi očekujemo da nam pokažeš sljedeće: 
 redovit si učenik/ca ili student/ica (potvrdu o upisu s prijepisom ocjena priložiti u isto polje prijave kao i životopis) 
 imaš dobre ocjene 
 barem te jedan od profesora preporučuje za ovu praksu (priložiti u isto polje prijave kao i životopis) 
 motiviran/motivirana si za rad u određenom organizacijskom dijelu Banke 
 spreman/spremna si posvetiti se radnim zadatcima koji će ti biti dodijeljeni tijekom izvršavanja prakse. 
 Pri odabiru kandidata za praksu prednost dajemo učenicima/studentima ekonomskih usmjerenja, posebno financija i bankarstva, te studentima iz STEM područja. 
 Za sva dodatna pitanja možeš se obratiti na prakse@pbz.hr . 
 U Privrednoj banci Zagreb prepoznajemo vaš talent, pružamo vam vrhunske uvjete za profesionalni razvoj i želimo zajedno s vama stvarati nove vrijednosti. Ako ste ambiciozni i motivirani te želite napraviti izazovan iskorak u karijeri – javite nam se.

 Overview 
 Entrerai a far parte della Direzione Group Technology di Intesa Sanpaolo, inserito all'interno della Platform Forex Money Market & Collateral Management, e lavorerai come Software Engineer in un team composto sia da Project Manager che da Analisti Funzionali per partecipare a progetti di sviluppo a media/alta complessità di applicativi nell'Area Finanza. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Analizzare con gli analisti funzionali i requisiti e le necessità di business al fine di individuare architetture e soluzioni tecniche, dettagliando le specifiche tecniche e valutando gli impatti 
 Predisporre le stime e le analisi tecniche e interagire con il team di sviluppo esterno per la realizzazione del software, seguendo le diverse fasi progettuali 
 Occuparsi direttamente di una parte dello sviluppo software di prodotti custom 
 Eseguire i test con gli analisti funzionali, includendo anche i test tecnici e di performance necessari; seguire il rilascio in produzione e i relativi follow-up, nel rispetto delle normative aziendali 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 3-5 anni in progetti IT a medio o alta complessità nel settore Banking 
 Conoscenza dei principali prodotti finanziari ed esperienza nello sviluppo applicativo in ambito Finanza, maturata presso Software House o contesti analoghi 
 Laurea in Informatica/Ingegneria Informatica 
 Inglese livello B2 o superiore 
 Esperienza nella progettazione architetturale e nello sviluppo di microservizi 
 Conoscenza di shell Linux o Unix

 Esperienza con database Oracle, MongoDB e PostgreSQL 
 Costituiscono titolo preferenziale: 
 Conoscenza delle tecnologie cloud 
 Conoscenza delle metodologie di sviluppo Agile e Waterfall 
 Significative esperienze professionali o di studio in contesti internazionali

items.desc:
Group Capital Steering Analyst - Graduate | Swiss Re 
Group Capital Steering Analyst - Graduate
Graduate Programme
Apply now
 Share 
 Location: 
Zurich, Zurich, CH
 Start your journey towards a rewarding career! 
 We’re looking for curious, motivated graduates with strong people skills who want to grow, learn, and make a difference. If you hold a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD and have up to three years of professional experience, apply for our 18-month Graduate Programme starting on 1 September 2027. 
 You’ll gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced world of reinsurance, rotate into different local teams, and receive tailored training to build your expertise. This is your opportunity to shape your career, help protect societies from the world’s most threatening hazards, and contribute to making the world more resilient. 
 By the end of the programme, you’ll have built the skills, foundations and network to pursue a wide range of career opportunities within Swiss Re. 
 About the Role 
 As a Graduate in the Group Capital Steering team within Treasury, you will help manage Swiss Re’s capital position and financial flexibility. You will work at the intersection of corporate finance, capital markets, risk and insurance regulation, supporting decisions that influence how the Group allocates and deploys capital. 
 Monitor and analyze Swiss Re's capital and liquidity position, and identify key drivers and emerging trends 
 Contribute to capital planning and forecasting, including market analyses and peer comparisons 
 Perform scenario-based capital impact assessments to evaluate how changes in the economic environment, business performance and/or management actions affect the Group's capital position and financial resilience 
 Support economic steering by assessing risk-adjusted returns to inform capital allocation and sustainable value creation 
 Analyze capital implications of strategic transactions, such as acquisitions, disposals, corporate restructurings and/or large transactions 
 Develop insights and prepare decision material for senior management and governance committees 
 Collaborate across Treasury, Finance, Risk Management, Asset Management and the Business Units, building a broad network and understanding of Swiss Re from day one 
 About the Team 
 Group Capital Steering is part of Treasury and helps ensure that Swiss Re maintains a strong and efficient capital position while supporting business growth and shareholder value creation. We work on Group-wide topics with colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Risk Management, Asset Management and the Business Units, giving you broad exposure to how strategic financial decisions are made in a global reinsurance company. 
We are a collaborative team that values curiosity, rigorous thinking and open discussion. You will work closely with experienced colleagues, take ownership of meaningful analyses from an early stage and build a broad network across Swiss Re while developing your expertise in capital management and corporate finance. 
 About You 
 You are curious, analytical and collaborative, with an interest in understanding how financial and strategic decisions come together. You enjoy working with numbers, can communicate complex topics clearly and are motivated to learn in a fast-paced, international environment. 
 Essential criteria 
 University degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s or PhD) in finance, economics, actuarial science, mathematics, engineering or another relevant discipline, with up to three years of professional experience. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and interpret complex financial information. 
 Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel 
 Strong written and spoken English skills; German is an advantage 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence working across different teams and stakeholders. 
 Proactive, curious and eager to learn in a fast-paced, international environment 
 High level of integrity and professionalism when handling confidential information 
 Nice to have 
 Professional experience in finance, capital markets and/or (re)insurance 
 The base salary range for this position will be shared with you during the interview process. 
 Please note: The application process will remain open until 21 December 2026 . We greatly appreciate every application and carefully review each one. As a result, the selection process may take some time, but please rest assured that your application is being given thorough consideration. We aim to provide an update on your application by 15 January 2027 at the latest. 
 Candidates selected for the final stage will be invited to our Assessment Centre on either 17, 18 or 19 February 2027 , preceded by an informal networking dinner with Swiss Re representatives on the evening before. Please ensure you are available for both events. 
 To learn more about the programme and the recruitment process, visit our website: Graduate Programme …

items.desc:
Data Analytics Engineer | Swiss Re 
Data Analytics Engineer
Regular Employment
Apply now
 Share 
 Location: 
Bratislava, SK
 About the Role 
 As a Data Analytics Engineer in Swiss Re’s Specialty Analytics team, you will build data and analytics solutions for the Property & Casualty (P&C) domain, using modern technologies to turn complex data into reliable, reusable, and actionable insights. The role is strongly hands-on and combines software engineering, data engineering, and analytics delivery, with ownership focused on clean implementation, robust pipelines, maintainable applications, and continuous improvement of data products. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Design and build end ‑ to ‑ end analytics solutions in Palantir Foundry 
 Scalable PySpark data pipelines 
 User ‑ facing web apps using Workshop and TypeScript 
 Translate business needs into technical designs, data models, and implementable user stories 
 Improve architecture, performance, data quality, testing, automation, and developer experience 
 Own implementation quality through clean code, code reviews, documentation, and production support 
 Collaborate with product owners, architects, analysts, and fellow developers in a global, cross ‑ functional environment 
 About the Team 
 The Specialty Analytics team delivers analytics for niche lines of business including Agriculture, Aviation, Credit & Surety, Cyber, Nuclear, and Political Violence. We are part of a global P&C data initiative focused on building scalable data products, reusable engineering patterns, reliable analytical applications, and data-driven decision support. 
 About You 
 You enjoy solving complex data problems, writing maintainable code, and turning raw data into useful analytical products. You are comfortable working across data pipelines, application logic, user-facing analytics, and production support, and you take pride in building solutions that are reliable, scalable, and easy for other developers to work with. 
 We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements: 
 Hands-on experience in data engineering or analytics 
 Proficiency in Python and PySpark for scalable data transformation pipelines 
 Solid understanding of SQL, data warehousing, ELT and cloud data architecture 
 Practical software engineering skills, including using AI tools 
 Problem ‑ solving and communication skills 
 These are additional nice to have: 
 Experience building user-facing applications with JavaScript or TypeScript 
 Palantir Foundry experience 
 (Re)Insurance or financial domain knowledge 
 Experience with Generative AI and/or Natural Language Processing 
 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week. 
 For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between [EUR 2,400] and [EUR 4,100] per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​ 
 the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​ 
 the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​ 
 In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​ 
 Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.​ 
 About Swiss Re 
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience. 
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people.
