items.desc: Help bring new enteral nutrition products into commercial production. Join Fresenius Kabi’s research and development team in Bad Homburg and combine practical planning with hands-on technical support. As part of the Formulation and Process Development team, you will coordinate preparations for production, help organize production trials and support product and process development. You will work closely with development and production colleagues, while the responsible technical experts retain decision-making and approval responsibilities. Your Responsibilities Support the planning and coordination of production trials, including scheduling, participant coordination, document preparation and follow-up of agreed actions. Conduct trials from laboratory and pilot scale through to full-scale production and provide on-site technical support during production-scale activities and production runs at international sites. Evaluate product samples for physical, rheological, sensory and emulsion-stability properties. Support the preparation and review of production-related documents. Coordinate agreed operational readiness activities for first commercial production, track progress against the readiness plan and follow up required documents and checks. Coordinate information flow between R&D, Production, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Engineering, Supply Chain and Project Management; request missing input and escalate risks, delays and conflicting requirements early to the responsible senior colleagues or team lead. Develop new enteral nutrition products and processes and support external development activities within your assigned scope. Represent R&D in cross-functional task forces, contribute technical expertise and help develop and implement effective solutions under the guidance of the responsible senior colleagues. Maintain clear, up-to-date plans and records of meetings, decisions, responsibilities, deadlines and follow-up actions to support traceable execution. Carry out assigned activities in line with applicable SOPs, quality and occupational safety requirements and the Fresenius Principles, following priorities set by the Head of Formulation & Process Development and the Senior Process Engineer R&D EN. Your Qualifications Completed vocational training, a technician qualification or a bachelor’s degree in food technology, preferably dairy technology, production technology, process technology, industrial engineering or a comparable technology-related field. Understanding of food technology, production processes or a comparable technical environment; initial experience in product development, production, technical coordination, operational planning or project assistance is preferred. Knowledge of food processing equipment, particularly mixing systems, UHT systems, autoclaves and spray dryers, as well as emulsion and sterilization technologies. Understanding process engineering principles, including piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), process control and project documentation; an understanding of how formulation, processing and key process parameters interact is an advantage. Strong planning, prioritization and follow-up skills, with a structured, reliable, precise and service-oriented working style. Ability to maintain clear status overviews, identify missing inputs and communicate promptly; experience with production-related documentation and action tracking is an advantage. Good collaboration and communication skills across functions and organizational levels; experience coordinating across functions is an advantage. Good German- and English-language skills, confident use of standard digital office tools and willingness to travel internationally for cross-site development activities and production trials. Ready to make an impact? Bring your technical understanding and coordination skills to Fresenius Kabi. Apply now and help turn enteral nutrition developments into well-prepared production trials and first commercial production.

items.desc: Gemeinsam die Zukunft für eine lebenswerte Gesellschaft gestalten – so die Vision der TH Wildau! Als Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften wollen wir verantwortungsvoll und praxisorientiert gesellschaftliche Transformationen begleiten. Wir verbinden Technologie und Management und schaffen einen „Spielraum für Innovation“ und fördern Interdisziplinarität, innovative Lernumgebungen sowie Kreativität. In der Metropolregion Berlin/Brandenburg ist unser Campus bekannt als ein Ort der Begegnung, des lebenslangen Lernens und gemeinsamen Arbeitens unterschiedlicher (Fach-)Kulturen. Eine hochmoderne Ausstattung und Industriearchitektur aus dem 19. Jahrhundert symbolisieren im Äußeren das, was uns auch fachlich und menschlich wichtig ist: wir verbinden! An der TH Wildau ist im Rahmen des Projekts „TRAIL – Transfer und Innovationen für die Lausitz | Wissen teilen, Wandel gestalten“ zum 01.01.2027 folgende Stelle zu besetzen: Projektmitarbeiter*in Digitale Wissens- und Technologietransferinstrumente (w/m/d) Kennziffer 2026_TRAIL_6 Die Beschäftigung erfolgt mit 40 Wochenstunden befristet bis zum 31.12.2030. Eine Beschäftigung in Teilzeit ist grundsätzlich möglich. Über das Projekt Das Projekt TRAIL – Transfer und Innovationen für die Lausitz verfolgt das Ziel, den Wissens- und Technologietransfer zwischen Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft im Innovationskorridor Lausitz nachhaltig zu stärken. Im Rahmen des Förderprogramms „Stärkung der Transformationsdynamik und Aufbruch in den Revieren und an den Kohlekraftwerkstandorten“ (STARK) werden neue Ansätze entwickelt, um wissenschaftliche Kompetenzen, Forschungsergebnisse und technologische Entwicklungen besser zugänglich zu machen und regionale Akteur*innen stärker in Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse einzubinden. Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Projekts ist die Konzeption, Entwicklung und Integration digitaler Wissens- und Technologietransferinstrumente. Diese sollen neue Möglichkeiten der Vernetzung, Kooperation und Beteiligung schaffen, den Zugang zu wissenschaftlichen Angeboten erleichtern und die Wirkung digitaler Transferformate nachvollziehbar machen. Dazu gehören nutzer*innenzentrierte Web- und Plattformlösungen, digitale Beteiligungsangebote für Citizen-Science-Projekte, ergänzende Web- und Mobilanwendungen sowie Instrumente zur Evaluation und Wirkungsmessung. Sie arbeiten an der Schnittstelle des Fachgebietes Innovations- und Regionalforschung (Fachbereich Wirtschaft, Informatik, Recht) und des Zentrums für Forschung und Transfer. Sie übernehmen die fachliche Verantwortung für die projektweite Konzeption, Architektur und Integration der digitalen Transferinstrumente – von der methodisch fundierten Nutzer*innenforschung über die technische Umsetzung bis zur Evaluation. Turn operator and technician observations into engineered improvements, and track whether availability actually moved. Run spare-parts analysis with the Spares Coordinator and Maintenance. Set the right min/max, return failed components, and tell the vendor what is needed in engineering language. Partner with Process, Joining and Controls on reliability, procedure changes and modifications that cut downtime without creating a new quality or safety risk. Plan and execute major repairs and rebuilds. Some of that work lands on weekends or shutdowns. Plan it. Do not discover it on the day. Read the machine: mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, robot faults and PLC/HMI behavior. You do not have to own the controls code. You do have to know when the code is the problem, and when it is not. Hold the safety standard on every intervention — lockout/tagout, stored energy, machine safety — and hand the line back in a state you would let someone else run. Able to troubleshoot from the symptom back to the cause, and comfortable when the first hypothesis is wrong. Structured problem solving is how you work, not a course you once attended. Able to read mechanical drawings and electrical schematics. Skilled with hand and portable tools and general mechanical repair. Machining or welding ability is a plus. You have written a maintenance standard other people can follow: PM documents, one-point lessons, spare-parts lists. If it only exists in your head, it is not done. Proficient with Excel and with plant maintenance and MES systems. You use them to see the bad actor, not to file a report no one reads. Able to use AI tools for predictive systems and complex data analysis on equipment data. You decide what is real before a PM frequency, a spare level or a rebuild scope is changed. You keep a team effective under pressure. Manufacturing supervision experience is a plus. People management is not the job. Technical leadership is. Fluent in English and German. items.desc: COMPANY OVERVIEW ThreatLocker® is a global cybersecurity leader that stops cyberattacks before they happen. The company’s Zero Trust Platform prevents breaches from both known and unknown threats by allowing only explicitly trusted software and activity across endpoints, networks, and cloud systems. Built to deploy quickly and scale across complex environments, the platform reduces operational overhead while keeping business running uninterrupted. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, with offices in Dublin, Dubai, and Brisbane, ThreatLocker protects over 70,000 organizations worldwide. POSITION OVERVIEW ThreatLocker’s Solutions Engineers are the technical subject matter experts in supporting clientele through ThreatLocker’s product lifecycle. Solutions Engineers are responsible for, but not limited to: Supporting Sales department in lead and product demonstration calls Managing post-sales cycle to providing technical support to client through audit reviews Serve as a technical expert in providing detailed specifications for proposed solutions including time and scope involved Assist other department engineers in creating practical demonstrations of proposed solutions and demonstrating them to other members of the team Analyze current technologies used within the company to identify and mitigate potential gaps within processes and cycles Document and monitor requirements needed to institute proposed updates in relation to customer experience Work alongside sales teams to successfully monitor progress and implementation of initiatives Account for possible project challenges or constraints and proactively seek to manage challenges Create and deploy product training webinars Attend conferences, trade shows, knowledge sessions as a brand ambassador and presenter REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Minimum of five years of professional experience in IT solutions Experience within cybersecurity industry, preferred Understanding of best practices regarding system security measures Advanced understanding of business analysis techniques and processes Understanding of sales cycle Excellent verbal and written communication WORKING CONDITIONS The duties described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. If necessary, reasonable accommodation may be requested and will be evaluated for its relationship to the essential functions that must be performed. Job will generally be performed in an office environment but may require travel to visit company offices and/or property locations. While performing duties of this job, would occasionally require to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects and tools. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, depth perceptions, and the ability to adjust focus.

items.desc: Fondata nel 1956, Rodacciai si contraddistingue fin dagli esordi per la costante ricerca di nuove soluzioni tecniche e logistiche, per la soddisfazione del cliente e l’innalzamento degli standard qualitativi e di servizio. Rodacciai si presenta sul mercato con tutte le tipologie di prodotti finite in diverse composizioni e misure, dagli acciai inossidabili agli acciai automatici a quelli per saldatura e per viteria, tutti realizzati secondo diverse composizioni atte a soddisfare le differenti esigenze di lavorazione. Rodacciai si è sempre distinta per una filosofia produttiva unica: la scelta di avere, già a pochi anni dalla sua nascita, un proprio impianto di laminazione. Rodacciai può infatti attivare i cicli di laminazione seguendo le necessità produttive del momento, una flessibilità produttiva e una capacità di risposta uniche, accompagnate da un'attenzione costante alla qualità e alla certificazione di prodotti e processi. Posizione: La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione e del presidio dell'infrastruttura informatica aziendale, garantendo il corretto funzionamento dei sistemi hardware e software attraverso attività di monitoraggio e manutenzione continua. Fornirà supporto sistemistico agli utenti interni, assicurando elevati standard di disponibilità, integrità e riservatezza delle informazioni aziendali. Inoltre, contribuirà all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema tecnologico ibrido, sia Cloud sia On-Premises, promuovendo la continuità operativa tramite il monitoraggio proattivo dei sistemi, la protezione dei dati e il supporto specialistico alle diverse funzioni aziendali. Responsabilità principali Presidiare l'intero stack tecnologico (server, networking, storage) Gestire le piattaforme di virtualizzazione e i servizi in cloud, garantendo l'ottimizzazione delle risorse e il monitoraggio costante dei parametri di salute dei sistemi per prevenire disservizi Implementare e gestire i sistemi di difesa perimetrale (Firewall), la protezione degli endpoint e la sicurezza identità e degli accessi (IAM) Applicare le policy aziendali di classificazione delle informazioni e data governance, assicurando la conformità ai requisiti di sicurezza e protezione del dato Curare Testare e valutare nuove soluzioni tecnologiche finalizzate all'automazione dei processi e al miglioramento dell'efficienza operativa Fornire un supporto di help desk di primo e di secondo livello items.desc: Are you curious about how molecules, formulations and material interactions become reliable, sustainable solutions in complex printing systems? Turn chemistry and materials science into the next generation of printing technologies. Get in touch with us! Questions about this job? Jeroen Veugelers, HR, +316 – 34885207 / Jeroen.veugelers@cpp.canon Chemist / Materials Scientist 40 hours per week, hybrid in Venlo (NL) What You’ll Do Our chemists and materials scientists turn scientific insight into robust, scalable solutions for advanced printing systems. You will contribute to water-based latex or UVgel technologies and connect ink and material properties to image quality, jetting, adhesion, drying, curing and film formation. Your work combines hands-on experimentation with structured data analysis, modelling and digital knowledge capture. You’ll be responsible for: Design, prepare and characterize inks, dispersions and functional material formulations Plan experiments, interpret results and translate findings into clear hypotheses and next steps Connect material properties and process conditions to print quality, robustness and reliability Develop representative test methods and use data, statistics and models to accelerate learning Evaluate solutions for sustainability, safety, manufacturability, cost and product performance Who You’ll Work With You will work in international, multidisciplinary teams with chemists, materials scientists, physicists, process engineers, measurement specialists and system experts. Together, you will translate scientific understanding into product-relevant solutions and collaborate with universities, research institutes, suppliers and other external partners where relevant. What You Bring We’re looking for a curious, collaborative scientist who brings: A Master’s degree or PhD in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Physical Chemistry or a related discipline A strong scientific foundation and enthusiasm for experimental, hands-on R&D An analytical mindset and the ability to structure complex problems and draw evidence-based conclusions Interest in sustainable materials innovation and digital methods such as Design of Experiments, data analysis or modelling Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to communicate across disciplines What You’ll Get From Us We provide an exciting, dynamic work environment where scientific depth meets real product impact. You will have room to experiment, learn and contribute to sustainable innovation and the digital transformation of R&D. We offer excellent conditions to help you be who you want to be: A competitive salary in line with your educational background and experience (range €2800 - €5300 gross per month) 38 vacation days 13th month bonus (8.6%) until end of 2026 paid either monthly or yearly. As of 1 January 2027 the 13th-month bonus will be discontinued, which means that as of that date the 13th-month bonus will be fully converted to the (scale) salary. Hybrid working for a healthy work-life balance A huge range of training and professional development opportunities A laptop and smartphone An interesting lease (e-)bike plan Career opportunities In this role, you can deepen your expertise in ink technology, formulation science, materials characterization or printing processes, and grow towards senior scientific, technical lead or multidisciplinary R&D roles. #LI-DNI What do we stand for? We develop and manufacture high-tech printing products and workflow software for the commercial printing market as part of Canon, a global leader in imaging technologies. With around 3,300 employees across three continents and our headquarters in Venlo, the Netherlands, we innovate to create high-quality solutions that add color to the world. Guided by the philosophy of Kyosei —living and working together for the common good—our culture is built on openness, collegiality, trust and stability. We empower our people to grow, take initiative, and make an impact. With our company values collaboration, innovation and ownership, we strive to bring out the best in each other, expand boundaries and feel empowered to take ownership of our work. Further information about Canon Production Printing is available at cpp.canon .

About the role: As Enterprise Data Architect, you will define and advance the enterprise-wide data architecture direction, translating business objectives and data strategy into practical roadmaps, standards, frameworks and architectural blueprints. You will shape conceptual, logical and physical models, guide integration and data movement patterns, and help establish data as a trusted organizational asset. The role combines strategic ownership with practical implementation, including technology evaluation and proofs of concept across a Microsoft-based data environment. You will work across enterprise architecture, data governance, engineering, security, privacy, compliance and business teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, resilient and aligned with current and future needs. Other responsibilities of the role include: Lead the development, implementation and communication of the enterprise data architecture roadmap, principles, standards, patterns and frameworks, aligned with business and technology strategies; Create and maintain current-state and target-state architecture blueprints, including conceptual, logical and physical models, data sources, interfaces, data movement and analytics components; Define practical methods, tools and procedures for data quality, metadata, lifecycle, capacity, workload, redundancy, reuse, migration, retirement, backup, archiving, disaster recovery and business continuity; Guide technology selection for scalable data platforms and solutions, evaluate emerging Microsoft and AI-related capabilities, and lead proofs of concept or pilot initiatives; Establish integration and interoperability approaches for new and existing systems, resolving compatibility and multi-platform issues while promoting secure, reusable architectural patterns; Provide architectural governance and consulting across initiatives, reviewing solution quality, performance, security, privacy and scalability and ensuring alignment with applicable standards and regulations. What you can bring to the role: A degree in computer science, information systems, computer engineering or a related discipline; Demonstrated enterprise-level experience in data or information architecture, including ownership of data strategy, architecture roadmaps and enterprise-wide standards; Hands-on expertise in data modelling, database and repository design, metadata management, data mapping and profiling, enterprise data management and data lifecycle practices; Proven experience architecting and implementing business intelligence, data warehouse, master data management, data integration and OLTP solutions, including ETL/ELT processes; Practical experience with Microsoft data platforms and technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake and analytics products, together with the ability to evaluate new technologies and lead proofs of concept; Strong knowledge of data governance, security, privacy and regulatory requirements, including GDPR, and an understanding of AI foundations, AI governance and data readiness for AI. Practical knowledge of TOGAF or a comparable enterprise architecture framework is an advantage. What is being offered: Our Essence and Culture: we are driven by strong values - we act with integrity, operate with excellence, care for people and lead with courage; Safety First: safety is not just a priority - it is part of our DNA. items.desc: Modelling Data Analyst At a glance We are looking for a new team member! Are you passionate about data and programming, with a keen interest in finance and risk management? Do you excel in stakeholder management and thrive in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team environment? If so, consider joining us as a Credit Risk Modelling Data Analyst! In this role, you'll play a pivotal role in gathering requirements, integrating complex datasets, validating data quality, and ensuring comprehensive documentation to support the modelling department. Your job As an modelling data analyst, your primary responsibility will be to prepare and supply high-quality datasets to our modelling department, which develops risk models for credit risk management purposes. Your duties will include: Collaborating with stakeholders to gather and understand data requirements. Integrating and validating datasets using SQL and/or Python. Conducting data quality analyses to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data. Documenting processes and findings clearly and effectively. Engaging with various departments to ensure alignment. You will be working in a team that consists of highly motivated colleagues with international backgrounds, working in an open and informal atmosphere. Given the importance the regulatory authorities ascribe to modelling and the data underpinning it, this is a challenging and impactful role. You also play an active role in the frequent team meetings where knowledge-sharing and transparency on progress is key. Working environment The Finance & Risk Data Domain is part of Finance & Risk Business Grids (F&RBG), and plays an active role for all the Finance and Risk departments. We employ 200+ international professionals with different backgrounds who are driven to bring risk data management to a structurally higher level. Our aim is to generate reliable risk data on time. We do this by improving the risk data itself, data systems and data processes. We work with an Agile operating model. Our Finance and Risk Data Domain consists of 7 departments where the atmosphere is dynamic, open and informal. You are part of the Risk Modelling team in the F&R Common Data Products department. You will report to the Expert Lead Risk Modelling. Your profile Your ability and willingness to work with others is crucial for your success in this role. You are naturally someone who takes initiative, structures and organises work well and is keen to work with others to deliver tangible results. You are practical, have an analytical approach and good communication and presentation skills. You are a strong team player and you take responsibility for your work. In the dynamic environment in which you operate, you have the ability to get all stakeholders on board. You’ve successfully completed a higher professional education (Bsc.) or degree (Msc.) and have at least 2-5 years of relevant work experience. Preferably in a data domain, preferably in an Finance Reporting, Risk Management or Credits environment. Experience with SQL and/or Python is essential; knowledge of Databricks is a plus. Knowledge of risk management in banking or financial institutions is advantageous. Ability to analyse complex datasets. You are a strong communicator and have strong stakeholder management skills. You are capable of giving and asking for feedback. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. We are offering A challenging and high-impact environment where you will play a key role in shaping the risk modelling data function. This role offers strong visibility and the opportunity to develop your expertise within the Finance domain, while working closely with modelling teams to deliver high-quality datasets that underpin critical risk models. There are plenty of career opportunities to grow personally and professionally, which mainly depend on your own ambitions and interests. We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you. Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually. Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work. Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000. An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the …

Jij stemt die snaar af op data, gedrag, timing en branding. Jij weet dat elk moment in de klantreis meetbaar is, maar je kijkt verder dan de losse noten. Als dirigent van de strategie overzie je het geheel en weet je waar een campagne heen moet om maximaal te presteren. JOUW
items.desc: Momentum door meetbaarheid Marketing is de wetenschap achter gevoel - de snaar tussen merk en mens die precies de juiste toon aanslaat. En jij? Jij stemt die snaar af op data, gedrag, timing en branding. Jij weet dat elk moment in de klantreis meetbaar is, maar je kijkt verder dan de losse noten. Als dirigent van de strategie overzie je het geheel en weet je waar een campagne heen moet om maximaal te presteren. JOUW ROL: STRATEEG MET DIEPGANG Je bent verantwoordelijk voor performance, richting én inhoud. Jouw kennis en analytische inzichten worden vertaald naar optimale marketingstrategieën. Daarom ben jij: Data gedreven: Je analyseert gedrag, funnels en resultaten. Met analytics als basis, stuur jij op impact en groei. Een strategische sparringpartner: Je adviseert klanten en collega’s proactief. Je helpt accountmanagers bij pitches en bepaalt samen de juiste insteek. Verantwoordelijk voor succes: Jij bent de online motor van een project. Je kijkt nauwkeurig naar de performance en vertaalt dit naar strategische overwegingen richting de klant. Inhoudelijk sterk: Je bent breed onderlegd in online marketing - van ad campaigns op Google & socials tot analytics en automation. Innovatief: AI is geen gimmick voor jou. Het is deel van je werkwijze. Je test, implementeert en deelt kennis met het team. Succes in deze rol betekent: messcherpe analyses die leiden tot groei, campagnes die maximaal presteren en de zekerheid bij onze klanten dat hun marketingbudget elke dag optimaal wordt benut. DIT IS RADYUS Wij zijn geen traditioneel marketingbureau. Wij zijn tech-pioniers met Groningse nuchterheid. AI, data en creatie zijn bij ons geen buzzwords, maar dagelijkse praktijk. We dagen elkaar uit, lachen veel en delen een obsessie voor slimme marketingtrucs. Successen vieren wij, maar we durven ook te falen om morgen beter te zijn. DAT ZIJN WIJ. WIE BEN JIJ? Voor ons staat een scherpe blik en gezond verstand voorop, maar daarnaast beschik je ook over: HBO+ werk- en denkniveau Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring in online marketing Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (C1/C2) De bereidheid om minimaal 60% van je werktijd op kantoor aanwezig te zijn DE DEAL Wij nemen niet zomaar mensen aan. Hoor je erbij, dan zetten wij alles in op jouw groei en werkplezier. Daarom krijg je van ons: Een salaris dat je vaardigheden eer aandoet - want goed werk mag beloond worden. Cutting-edge marketingtools & AI-innovaties - de beste tech in jouw handen. Flexibiliteit – Je kunt vanuit huis werken, maar we verwachten je ook op vaste dagen op kantoor. Vertrouwen - Je krijgt veel autonomie en bent eigenaar van je klanten én resultaten. Trainingen, workshops en mentoring - wij geloven in jou, dus wij investeren in jou. Een team waarin jij je snel thuis voelt - divers, creatief en humor zo scherp als onze campagnes. Sla jij de juiste toon aan tussen data en gevoel? Laat van je horen. Solliciteer door je CV + motivatiebrief te sturen! Soort dienstverband: Fulltime, Parttime Salaris: €2.800,00 - €4.100,00 per maand Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling Mogelijkheid tot promotie Pensioen Reiskostenvergoeding Screeningsvragen: Ben je bereid 60% op kantoor te werken? Taal: Nederlands C1/C2 (Vereist) Werklocatie: Fysiek

items.desc: Join the Canyon team and work at the cutting edge of the bike industry, with a job as versatile and exciting as the bikes we develop. All in an open, international atmosphere where teamwork, collaboration, true innovation, and a dynamic workplace are all part of our everyday. Ready to ride with us? Stellenbeschreibung THE ROLE As a full-time User Interface Designer (m/f/d) in our Digital Experience Design team, you shape the digital rider experience across Canyon.com and the Canyon App—from initial sketch to live screen. Because there is no dealer in between, the interfaces you design are where riders choose, buy, and look after their bikes. Taking on a product-focused design role, you uncover rider needs, map user flows, test prototypes, and design every screen down to the copy on it. Embedded in an agile product squad alongside a Product Owner, Tech Lead, and Developers, you collaborate closely with business stakeholders, fellow designers, and our Senior Design System Manager—staying involved from the first idea through to measuring post-release impact. This is a full-time, fixed-term position for 1 year. YOUR JOB AS PART OF THE CANYON CREW Problem Discovery: You define problems with your squad before designing by combining rider research, behavioral data, feedback, and business stakeholder input. User Flows & Prototyping: You turn ideas into user flows, wireframes, and clickable Figma prototypes, validate them with riders, and iterate based on test results and data. Interface & Copy Design: You craft clear, accessible, mobile-first screens and sharp interface copy for Canyon.com and the Canyon App (iOS and Android) that stay true to our brand across all global markets. Design System Contribution: You build consistently with our existing design system components and co-create new components alongside our Senior Design System Manager whenever gaps arise. Developer Handover & QA: You document your designs clearly for developers, collaborate closely during the build to preserve design intent, and check every release before go-live. Design Reviews & Alignment: You present your work in design reviews, planning sessions, and stakeholder meetings—explaining your design rationale while actively giving and receiving peer feedback. HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE RACE Education & Experience: You bring at least 3 years of experience in interface or product design paired with a degree in design or a related field (equivalent practical experience counts) as your solid foundation. Live Portfolio: You showcase a strong portfolio of shipped work demonstrating how you progressed from an initial problem to a tested design. E-Commerce Experience: You ideally bring hands-on experience designing for online shops—helping customers choose and buy products—which is a strong plus we love to see in your portfolio. End-to-End Design Craft: You have proven experience across the entire design process—from user flows and prototyping to visual design, typography, accessibility, brand application, and interface copywriting. Cross-Platform & Mobile Patterns: You possess solid knowledge of current mobile patterns and experience designing for web, iOS, and Android—including developer handover, build, and testing. Figma & AI Tools: You offer expert knowledge of Figma and design systems (motion design is a plus), combined with an interest in using AI tools like Figma Make or Claude Design to accelerate workflows while keeping creative decisions human-led. Mindset & Culture: You are a curious, organized, and precise team player who welcomes feedback and shares an interest in cycling culture. HIGHLIGHTS ON YOUR CANYON TOUR The Canyon Crew & Culture: Combine energy and transparency in a global team. We promote a strong feedback culture, unique Canyon events, and inspiring crew rides. Your voice matters in creating an inclusive workplace where well-being is a priority. Feel Canyon (Product Perks): Unlock your passion for cycling! Enjoy exclusive discounts on bikes, gear, and apparel as part of our commitment to fueling your journey. Compensation & Rewards: Experience a rewarding career with a competitive market-based salary and generous paid time off. Your satisfaction is our priority. Life-Work Integration: Join us for a career that prioritizes balance through flexible and hybrid work options in a family-friendly environment. Impact & Development: Shape the future of mobility. We offer diverse career paths across operational, strategic, creative, or technical roles, where innovation and sustainability consistently challenge and inspire you.

items.desc: VIS Forsikring Gjensidig Schweigaards gate 16, 0191 Oslo Om jobben Lagre favoritt Stillingstittel Full stack dataingeniør Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 1 Arbeidsspråk Norsk Vis flere detaljer Søk senest fredag 11. desember Unik mulighet for deg som liker å jobbe med data Hei! Jeg heter Daniel Kaasa og leder Teknologi og analyse i VIS Forsikring. Vi bygger en helt ny toppmoderne dataplattform, og jeg leter etter deg som vil bygge den sammen med oss. Her får du være med fra starten og påvirke hvordan vi henter inn, strukturerer og bruker data. Du trenger ikke kunne alt fra før. Det viktigste er at du har sterke basisferdigheter, er nysgjerrig og har lyst til å lære. Hos oss får du tett oppfølging fra erfarne kolleger og en felles plan for utviklingen din. Du blir en del av teamet Teknologi og analyse og skal rapportere til meg. I starten jobber du mest sammen med tekniske kolleger. Etter hvert blir du også bedre kjent med fagmiljøene i forretningen og behovene dataene våre skal løse. Hvordan ser vi for oss at det første året ditt i VIS Forsikring kan se ut? Det første halvåret Først: Data engineering. Du henter data fra kildesystemene, setter opp datastrømmer, modellerer data og bygger historikk. Du utvikler datapipelines i Python og CI/CD i YAML, med testing og automatisering fra første commit. Sammen med teamet: Plattform Engineering. Du er med på å bygge dataplattformen i Azure og Databricks med Terraform som lnfrastructure-as-Code. Hele veien: kvalitet. Tester, datakvalitet, felles definisjoner og dokumentasjon er en del av jobben, ikke noe vi «tar etterpå». Etter hvert: Fra data til innsikt. Når grunnmuren står, bruker du dataene til avanserte analyser, dashboards og KI-chat mot data i Azure Databricks. Slik får du følge dataene hele veien fra kildesystemene til innsikt som kan brukes i forretningen. KI er en stor del av måten vi jobber på. Du vil bruke moderne KI-verktøy i hverdagen. Samtidig utforsker vi hvordan KI kan brukes mot egne data og i løsningene våre. Om 12 måneder har du Utviklet kompetansen din og tatt store faglige steg innen data engineering, plattform, datakvalitet og analyse. Tatt egne oppgaver fra idé til produksjonssatte løsninger som gir reell verdi til virksomheten. Fått god forståelse for forretningen vår og hvordan gode tekniske valg skaper verdi. Funnet ut hva du ønsker å bli ordentlig god på, og laget en plan sammen med meg for å komme dit. Teknologi/verktøy Azure · Azure Databricks · Terraform · Python · yaml · CI/CD · Claude Du trenger ikke kunne alt dette fra før av. Erfaring er en fordel, men det viktigste er at du har et godt faglig fundament og har lyst til å lære. Du trenger ikke... Masse erfaring fra før av. Vi ser etter deg med 0-5 års erfaring, og nyutdannede er like aktuelle som deg som har jobbet noen år Å være ferdig med studiene. Du kan starte på deltid etter avtale og få en tidlig start med god kompensasjon allerede nå. Å kunne våre teknologier og verktøy fra før Men du trenger... Høyere utdanning innen IT, informatikk, matematikk, statistikk, ingeniørfag eller lignende, fullført eller planlagt fullført senest i 2027. Tilsvarende kompetanse gjennom praktisk erfaring kan også være aktuelt. Sterke faglige basisferdigheter som du ønsker å bygge videre på i praktisk arbeid med data og teknologi Å ta initiativ og like å lære Å jobbe strukturert og løsningsorientert, og komme med egne forslag når du møter utfordringer Flytende i norsk både muntlig og skriftlig Dette får du Svært konkurransedyktige betingelser, samt markedets beste pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Unik mulighet til å jobbe med alle faglige disipliner i en dataplattform (plattform engineering, data engineering, data analyst, data scientist m.m). Tett oppfølgning fra erfarne og dyktige seniorer. En plattform du er med på å forme, ikke bare arve. En flat struktur og kontakt med forretningen, slik at du lærer å forstå behovene bak de tekniske løsningene Fast stilling i moderne lokaler i Schweigaards gate i Oslo, med mulighet for deltid mens du fullfører studiene. Nysgjerrig? Vi vil gjerne høre fra deg! Har du lyst til å bygge noe nytt og utvikle deg sammen med oss? Da håper vi du søker gjennom å sende CV + et kort søknadsbrev til HR@visforsikring.no. Vi ønsker deg på plass så snart som mulig og vurderer søknader fortløpende. Har du spørsmål om rollen eller hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss, kan du ta kontakt med Daniel Kaasa. Om bedriften VIS Forsikring er et kundeeid forsikringsselskap med snart 90 års historie. Vi er spesialister på topp forsikring av bygninger og forsikrer 1,2 millioner boliger mot skader som utvikler seg over tid, som fukt, råte, dyr og insekter. Nå moderniserer vi selskapet, og data er en sentral del av dette. Den nye dataplattformen skal legge til rette for bedre beslutninger, bedre analyser og nye muligheter med KI. Location: The successful candidate may be based in one of the following locations: Brazil, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, China, Japan, Taiwan, South Korea, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Philippines, the Netherlands. * We offer competitive NGO level salary and benefits, the specifics of which depend on location where the successful candidate(s) will be based. About the Department The Technology Department delivers technology and data solutions that enable the Greenpeace network to win campaigns faster and to support an effective and efficient global organisation through the strategic uplift that technology provides. We strive to support all teams with technology aligned to their needs, amplify change agents' power, and ensure our relationship with technology and data reflects our values and mission to achieve a green and peaceful future. Working directly with stakeholders to understand their needs, you will design purpose-built data systems and reports as part of a global team of data specialists. Migrating workflows and reports from legacy analytics platforms to our central data platform, and supporting regional offices through the transition Leading the creation and maintenance of reports and dashboards, alongside stakeholder consultation, business analysis, and design work. Building key performance indicators by gathering requirements from stakeholders, validating possibilities and building them as semantic metrics for future proof, durable usage Promoting the standardisation of Greenpeace data assets and handling supporter and fundraising data in line with GDPR and our data governance standards. Leading data community initiatives through case studies, training, coaching, and mentoring colleagues, as well as responding to end-user support tickets. What we’re looking for: We are seeking a collaborative, solutions-oriented individual with a global mindset who can navigate complex operational environments with diplomacy, composure, and a long-term perspective. You should bring sound judgement, clear communication skills for non-technical audiences, and technical expertise in data management, analysis, and reporting, combined with an ability to inspire others and foster an inclusive, supportive environment. Remember no one has every skill or experience needed for this role and you’ll have the opportunity to learn a lot from the team. Experience building and maintaining dbt projects in production (models, tests, incremental loads, documentation), with strong SQL. Experience with cloud data warehouses and data engineering solutions preferably BigQuery or Google Cloud Platform . Experience in Python software development focused on data engineering and APIs Experience with dashboard and reporting tools, such as Hex , Tableau and Google Data Studio . Experience with fundraising or CRM data (e.g. Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce) Ability to communicate effectively with non-technical audiences. Demonstrable commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion and ability to collaborate with cross-cultural teams. Fluent in English , both verbal and written and preferably also Spanish . items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION You're a curious, hands-on problem solver who wants to build (or pivot) your career at the intersection of automation, analytics, and delivery governance—working with a modern technology stack and real stakeholders. Join the Automation Lab Central Hub Team in CF/TCIO CDO and help scale automation safely and efficiently in our hub-and-spoke Citizen Developer model, with a single intake/portfolio view and clear decision rights. As an Automation Lab Analyst within the Finance Chief Data Office, you will help run the “engine room” of our automation program: managing intake and triage, maintaining a transparent portfolio, coordinating delivery paths, and ensuring our work is standardized, controlled, and auditable. The Central Hub provides cross-domain coordination and owns key controls, platform/stack enablement, and coaching/code review - while Citizen Developers deliver smaller in-domain automations within guardrails. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, domain Citizen Developers, technology teams, control partners, and governance forums (including the Efficiency Council, which owns prioritization, capacity, and decision rights) to progress automation work end-to-end – especially where work crosses domains or has higher risk / platform dependencies. Job Responsibilities Manage intake, triage, and portfolio hygiene for automation work using a single Jira intake and portfolio view; ensure requests are clear, complete, and ready to be actioned. Support prioritization and capacity planning by preparing inputs for the Efficiency Council (impact, complexity, dependencies, risk, and effort) and tracking decisions through execution. Coordinate cross-functional delivery and technology coordination with Firmwide and other LOB/CFs' development initiatives. Route work through the right delivery path (fast-track vs standard) based on ownership, risk, cross-domain impact, and dependencies (e.g., DBX / SEAL / FID). Own/maintain standards, templates, and ways-of-working for automation delivery; promote consistent, reusable patterns across domains. Provide enablement and guardrails for Citizen Developers (light coaching, review loops, and escalation paths); escalate higher-risk or cross-domain work back to the Central Hub. Coordinate controls, registration, release readiness, and monitoring requirements for automation solutions to ensure safe, standard, and auditable delivery. Track execution progress, remove blockers, monitor aged items, and escalate issues to domain leads / Central Hub leadership when needed. Prepare governance materials and program reporting (portfolio views, status updates, metrics, and rationale for exceptions or delays). Contribute to continuous improvement (job aids, onboarding, and community-of-practice style enablement) to scale adoption over time. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Bachelor's degree (or equivalent practical experience) in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Risk, or a related field. Practical experience with analytics/automation tooling aligned to our stack (e.g., Tableau, Alteryx, Python, SharePoint, AI tools, Jira, MS Excel, and willingness to learn platform tooling). Strong execution discipline: ability to manage multiple priorities, keep workflows moving, and drive closure in a fast-paced environment. Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable coordinating across business and technology stakeholders. High attention to detail; structured problem-solving and good judgment on when to escalate. Proficiency with MS Office (PowerPoint, Word). Comfort operating in a governance environment (working with standards, procedures, and required documentation). Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience with Jira (or similar workflow/ticketing tools) and maintaining transparent backlogs/portfolios. Familiarity with data governance, control frameworks, operational risk concepts, or audit-ready documentation. Exposure to Databricks (DBX) and/or platform enablement concepts; understanding that some enablement paths are not fully self-service and require technology execution/support. Understanding of Treasury/Finance domains (e.g., regulatory reporting, liquidity, capital, interest rate risk) and ability to translate business needs into structured delivery work. Experience working in cross-functional programs (business + product/data + technology) with multiple dependencies and stakeholders. ABOUT US J.P. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs. Benefits include …

items.title: Emulation/FPGA Hardware Engineer
items.card: The role We are building a silicon engineering platform that turns a commit of GPU/AI hardware code into an orchestrated workflow automation that proves it is ready for customer release, including an ML/AI layer that learns to predict how to get there in the fewest workloads possible. This is a large transformation project with executive sponsorship, starting from a clean-sheet design. Designing semiconductor IP
items.desc: Emulation/FPGA Hardware Engineer Wroclaw Poland Experienced Professional Posted 16 Nov 2026 502908 The role We are building a silicon engineering platform that turns a commit of GPU/AI hardware code into an orchestrated workflow automation that proves it is ready for customer release, including an ML/AI layer that learns to predict how to get there in the fewest workloads possible. This is a large transformation project with executive sponsorship, starting from a clean-sheet design. Designing semiconductor IP involves many tool flows: static analysers, theorem provers, simulation farms running tens of thousands of randomised tests every night, physical design tools that estimate future speed and power needs of silicon. These tools run on a variety of compute platforms - grid, emulator, FPGA, silicon boards. We are looking for an Emulation/FPGA Hardware Engineer to be part of this team, where we offer the opportunity to work with talented engineers in a wide range of projects related to hardware verification of GPU & AI IPs. This role requires close collaboration with other teams worldwide for debugging, development and support tasks. We are seeking an engineer with 1-2 years of industrial experience, highly motivated and capable of working as part of a team as well as individually, committed and proactive to drive hardware acceleration solutions from concept to final product. You should have good communication and teamwork skills, as well as being dedicated and committed to achieve planned goals in a timely manner. You will: Support and enable multiple Hardware Acceleration Prototyping platforms by developing infrastructure using the latest techniques. Design and maintain verification environments, which will include RTL development and support of various testbench modules. Work with industry leading Vendors, debug potential issues and work on the optimization of build flows and verification capabilities. Bring-up IP designs in third-party Emulation platforms. Provide support to HW and SW teams across Imagination to verify and validate designs using various Emulation platforms. Develop, maintain and automate build flows and tools. Research, develop and enhance new and existing verification flows to extend verification capabilities. About you Committed to making your customers, stakeholders and colleagues successful, you’re an excellent communicator, listener and collaborator who builds trusted partnerships by delivering what you say, when you say. You’re curious, solutions orientated and a world-class problem solver who constantly seeks opportunities to innovate and achieve the best possible outcome to the highest imaginable standard. You'll have: Hardware RTL design using Verilog and/or SystemVerilog. Hardware debug in simulation environment and/or real hardware devices. Knowledge of digital design and verification. Experience with industry leading Emulation (Palladium, Veloce, ZeBu) or FPGA (Protium, Primo, HAPS) Prototyping platforms highly valued. Ability to work with Unix/Linux operating systems. Scripting experience with languages such as Python, TCL, Bash/Sh. Who we are Imagination is a UK-based company that creates silicon and software IP designed to give its customers an edge in competitive global technology markets. Its GPU and AI technologies enable outstanding power, performance, and area (PPA), fast time-to-market, and lower total cost of ownership. Products based on Imagination IP are used by billions of people across the globe in their smartphones, cars, homes, and workplaces. We need your skills to help us continue to deliver technology that will impress the industry and our customers alike, ensuring that people everywhere can enjoy smarter and faster tech than ever before. So come join us if you're wanting that something more Bring your talent, curiosity and expertise and we’ll help you do the rest. You’ll be part of one of the world’s most exciting companies who are one of the leaders in semiconductor IP solutions. As a part of our team, you can help us transform, innovate, and inspire the lives of millions through our technology. Additional information If you encounter accessibility barriers in the application process or if you have access needs and require support or adjustments to participate equitably in the recruitment process, please email recruitment@imgtec.com.

items.desc: Company Description About Veolia Veolia group aims to be the benchmark company for ecological transformation. In 2022, with nearly 220,000 employees worldwide, the Group designs and provides game-changing solutions that are both useful and practical for water, waste and energy management. Through its three complementary business activities, Veolia helps to develop access to resources, preserve available resources, and replenish them. In 2021, the Veolia group supplied 79 million people with drinking water and 61 million people with wastewater service, produced nearly 48 million megawatt hours of energy and treated 48 million metric tons of waste. Veolia Environnement (Paris Euronext: VIE) generated consolidated revenue of €28.508 billion in 2021. www.veolia.com Job Description Description of the responsibilities: 1. Creating a tool to monitor the quality of data coming from SCADA, DCS and telemetry systems - with the use of Eneffco, Looker or similar platforms 2.Developing methods for real-time data quality checks: mass balance calculations, energy balance calculations, definitions of acceptable range for particular measurements - possibly with the help of AI 3.Creating alerts and/or automatic correction formulas in order to feed reliable data into digital twin systems even in case of measurement errors or transmission interruptions What challenges can the PANGEO expect during his/her assignment? Setting static "acceptable ranges" often leads to false alarms during transient operational states (e.g., plant startup, shutdown, or load shifts). The PANGEO must design dynamic thresholds that adapt to real-time process states. Distinguishing between a faulty sensor (or transmission failure) and an actual operational issue (e.g., pipe leak or pressure drop) so that valid emergency process signals are not mistakenly "corrected" or smoothed out. Qualifications Educational background: Power Engineering, It in Engineering, Statistics, AI Previous experience: First experience in energy sector, especially in districting heating and power generation Skills: 1. Knowledge of the processes of energy production (especially combined heat and power generation) and distribution (especially district heating networks) 2. Ability to work with large datasets 3. Basic programming skills and familiarity with AI 4. Analytic thinking, attention to detail, patience Languages: English, nice to have Polish Additional Information Toutes vos informations demeureront confidentielles en vertu des directives sur l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi. As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination. Jako firma włączająca (inkluzywna), Veolia przywiązuje dużą wagę do różnorodności i w równym stopniu rozpatruje wszystkie aplikacje, bez dyskryminacji.

items.desc: About the Voith Group The Voith Group is a global technology company. With its broad portfolio of systems, products, services and digital applications, Voith sets standards in the markets of energy, paper, raw materials and transport & automotive. Founded in 1867, the company today has around 22,000 employees, sales of € 5,2 billion and locations in over 60 countries worldwide and is thus one of the larger family-owned companies in Europe. Support the Voith Group | Voith Hydro as a Project Cost Controller (m/f/d) Job ID 76861| Location Bucharest A Snapshot of Your Day As a Project Controller, you will manage controlling functions for international plant construction projects, ensuring accurate planning, budgeting, and financial tracking. This includes cost analysis, forecasting, and supporting project teams with financial insights to ensure successful project delivery. How You'll Make an Impact Your task is to perform the controlling functions of information, planning, management, control and coordination in the processing of customer orders for international plant construction projects. You will proactively support the departments responsible for order processing with regard to budget planning and cost development. You will be responsible for carrying out target/actual comparisons, preparing variance analyses as well as evaluating and coordinating actual and forecast figures with the specialist departments. You will also be responsible for the ongoing maintenance and updating of forecast values for order budgets, risks and opportunities, developing proposals for measures and track the progress of implementation. You will prepare sales, earnings and cash flow planning and be responsible for monitoring the project management cockpit and commenting on the key project figures. When preparing half-year and annual financial statements and exchanging other reporting information, you will be the point of contact for corporate controlling, particularly in the context of monthly cost unit closings. In addition, special evaluations and the completion of general controlling tasks in the project team round off your field of activity. What You Bring You have a degree in business administration, engineering or a comparable qualification. You have at least five years of professional experience in the project business in an international environment. We expect you to be confident in using standard MS Office applications and have sound knowledge of SAP R/3 (CO; PS, SD and FI) and BI systems. You have a very good command of German and English as well as a strong affinity for numbers and work confidently and efficiently with large amounts of data. Personally, you are characterized by teamwork and communication skills as well as a high level of commitment, analytical thinking and an independent and structured working style. About The Team Voith Hydro is committed to delivering innovative solutions for the hydropower industry. Our international team collaborates closely to develop sustainable technologies that support the global energy transition. Who We Are Voith Hydro is part of the Voith Group, a global leader in industrial technology with over 150 years of expertise. We specialize in turbines, generators, and automation systems for hydropower plants. Our mission is to drive renewable energy development and reduce carbon emissions through cutting-edge solutions. Our Commitment to Diversity At Voith Hydro, diversity is our strength. We embrace inclusion and value the creativity that comes from multicultural teams. We celebrate individuality—regardless of ethnicity, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability—and are committed to energizing society without discrimination. What we have for you We offer you an international working environment with an open and inclusive company culture. You will combine creative thinking with performance analysis, using data to understand what works, generate new ideas and improve the effectiveness of our campaigns. We are not simply looking for someone who can manage an e-commerce business or analyze marketing data. We are looking for a creative thinker who knows how to turn ideas into advertising that sells. Experience in areas such as e-commerce, CRO, CRM or broader Growth is a plus, but your creative mindset, ability to generate strong advertising concepts and understanding of performance-driven creative strategy are what matter most . Your Responsibilities Creative Strategy & Performance Ads Develop creative concepts and advertising angles tailored to the Italian market and consumer . Identify new ways to communicate the company's value proposition, product benefits and competitive advantages. Generate compelling hooks, messages, storytelling concepts and creative formats that capture attention and drive conversions. Research Italian consumer behaviour, cultural insights, social media trends, competitors and successful advertising approaches to inspire new creatives. Develop creative hypotheses and translate them into actionable concepts for paid advertising. Create clear and effective creative briefs for internal teams, content creators, UGC creators and external partners. Explore different creative approaches, including UGC, testimonials, product demonstrations, problem-solution concepts, educational content and other performance-driven formats. Collaborate with the Creative and Paid Media teams to produce, launch and test new advertising creatives. Analyze creative performance to understand which hooks, angles, messages and formats work best, using these insights to generate new ideas and improve existing concepts. Continuously iterate on successful creatives, finding new variations and opportunities to scale their performance. Build a repeatable and scalable creative testing system that consistently generates fresh ideas and advertising assets for the Italian market. Ensure that advertising feels authentic and relevant to Italian consumers, rather than simply translating campaigns from other countries. Creative Performance & Growth Monitor creative and campaign performance to understand which concepts generate the strongest results. Use relevant KPIs such as CTR, CPA, CAC, ROAS and CVR to evaluate creative effectiveness and inform new hypotheses. Identify the relationship between creative messaging, audience response and conversion performance. Work closely with the Paid Media team to understand campaign results and turn performance insights into new creative opportunities. Prioritize creative initiatives based on their potential impact on acquisition and business growth. Test, learn, iterate and continuously improve the creative strategy based on results. E-commerce, CRO & CRM Although creativity is the main focus of the role, experience in other areas of digital growth would be a valuable advantage. Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate across the Italian e-commerce experience. Contribute ideas to optimize product pages, landing pages, promotions, bundles and value propositions. Understand how creative messaging connects with the website experience and influences conversion. Contribute to CRO initiatives and A/B testing by identifying opportunities to improve the customer journey. Support the alignment of advertising creatives with CRM campaigns and customer communications. Experience with Shopify, Klaviyo, CRO, UX …

items.desc: ¡Hola! Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición. Viajar es una de mis mayores alegrías, y lo que lo hace aún más especial es poder vivir esas experiencias con mi familia y nuestra querida gata Rosita. Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales. ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo. Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega! ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN: Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. Y te preguntarás: Mariana, ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento): Ha llegado el momento de dar un paso más para coger velocidad, crecer y proteger nuestra posición de líderes en nuestro negocio y para ello necesitamos disponer de un equipo de especialistas con conocimiento técnico y presencia en el mercado. La persona seleccionada se responsabilizará de diseñar, implantar y mantener las tarifas, así como garantizar la rentabilidad técnica de los productos de Motor. Tu día a día consistirá en: Elaboración, implantación y mantenimiento de tarifas en los segmentos de Motor. Elaboración de requerimientos funcionales de dichas tarifas para su mecanización en las aplicaciones correspondientes. Adaptación de las tarifas actuales a las nuevas oportunidades de negocio. Colaboración con el área Comercial para adecuar la tarifa a reglas de negocio y validaciones existentes. Gestionar el flujo y calidad de datos actuariales relevantes de directo para asegurar un output robusto. Análisis y seguimiento de la conversión y retención. Análisis de la competitividad de precios del mercado, para la toma de decisiones. Análisis evolución nuevo negocio y cartera (todos los indicadores técnicos de seguimiento del negocio). Elaboración de Dashboards que permitan el seguimiento de negocio. Propuesta de acciones correctoras ante desvíos en los KPIs del negocio (nueva producción y cartera) A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo? No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos. Experiencia mínima 5 años en funciones similares en Pricing. Licenciatura o titulación universitaria superior en Ciencias Actuariales, Matemáticas o Estadística o Data Scientist. Capacidad analítica. Conocimiento de los indicadores de negocio asegurador. Usuario/a avanzado en software de modelización de tarifas (suite de Willis) y bases de datos. Usuario/a avanzado de técnicas de machine learning. Usuario avanzado de programación en Python. Ingles hablado y escrito. Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y habilidad de relación con clientes internos. Autonomía en la toma de decisiones. Responsabilidad de procesos completos. Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar. En Zurich somos muy disfrutones , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales. #PorSerDeZurich , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores. Creemos en la flexibilidad. Somos disfrutones y responsables. Disfrutarás de un modelo híbrido que te permitirá organizar tu día a día con autonomía desde España, asistiendo cuando sea necesario para tomarte ese café con tus compis en tu centro de trabajo, hablar de vuestro día a día, conoceros / echarnos unas risas... Creemos en mantener la cercanía, la colaboración y la conexión con tu equipo. Confiamos en la filosofía de aprender haciendo para que puedas moverte a otras áreas a nivel local o internacional gracias a nuestro …

items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for an Aircraft Mechanic / Electrician (TMA B1/B2) has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the A330 MRTT Flight Line (FAL ADDC) Team , working on a double-shift schedule. The jobholder will carry out critical mechanical, electrical, and maintenance support tasks for the A330 MRTT program, operating directly on the flight line to ensure the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational readiness prior to customer delivery. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Perform assembly, integration, and electrical/mechanical modifications, alongside system repairs and first-level quality inspections. Execute functional tests on aircraft and components, conducting troubleshooting and fixing any derived defects. Handle aircraft ground operations (GPU, HGPU) and prepare the aircraft for flight according to the TPS (Test Procedure Specification) issued by flight operations. Conduct line and base B1/B2 maintenance and execute Service Bulletin (SB) implementations. Prepare Ground Test tasks led by the design office and provide comprehensive support to the customer during aircraft delivery. Guarantee continuous improvement across all daily operations, ensuring strict adherence to quality and safety standards. (Please note: The selected candidate must obtain National and NATO Security Clearance / HPS - Habilitación Personal de Seguridad). SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you: Education: Currently in the process of obtaining (or already holding) the Aircraft Maintenance Technician License (LMA) under EASA Part 66 regulations. Experience: Previous experience in aircraft and/or component maintenance. Solid background in manufacturing, including knowledge of tools, processes, technical documentation, manuals, blueprints, and working with maintenance templates. Soft skills: Proactive, collaborative mindset (essential for customer-facing environments), with high flexibility to adapt to changing customer needs. Strong continuous improvement profile. Languages: Advanced level in Spanish and intermediate/advanced level in English (both written & spoken) to effectively manage technical documentation. Technical knowledge: Broad knowledge of aircraft systems for integration and testing, specifically ECS, fuel systems, hydraulic systems, and electrical systems. Strong foundational knowledge in quality and safety protocols. Valuable / Nice to have: Previous experience directly supporting the A330 MRTT program or similar large military transport aircraft platforms will be highly valued. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance. Collective transport service in some sites. Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. items.desc: Company Description iad is changing the way people experience real estate. Thanks to an innovative business model, everyone benefits: buyers, sellers and agents. Our agents’ local expertise, reduced structural costs and close customer relationships bring greater transparency to the entire process. The iad group has more than 18,000 agents across Europe, ready to support clients in bringing their property projects to life. Entrepreneurship is at the heart of iad and of the people who make the company what it is. This is why people sit at the centre of our model. iad holds the HappyIndex®AtWork certification, recognising it as one of the highest-rated employers by employees at European level. Job Description ROLE PURPOSE Strengthen the technical capabilities of the Southern Europe Regional IT & Digital team by managing the technology environment in Spain and contributing to the new regional operating model. The role will ensure secure, standardised and efficient management of devices, identities, access and digital services. The role holder will be responsible for the device lifecycle, identity and access governance, compliance with security standards and participation in regional projects. They will also support the Regional IT Manager in tracking deliverables, technical testing and stakeholder coordination. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Endpoint management Manage the full endpoint lifecycle: provisioning, configuration, deployment, patching and decommissioning for Windows, macOS and mobile devices. Administer MDM platforms, particularly Microsoft Intune, including device enrolment, compliance policies, application deployment and remote wipe. Ensure endpoints comply with security standards, including encryption, operating system updates, antivirus and firewall policies. Identity and access management (IAM / IdP) Manage the user lifecycle in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID: onboarding, offboarding, role changes and group membership. Handle access requests, licence assignments and permission reviews across Microsoft 365 and business applications. Apply controls related to SSO, MFA and Conditional Access in line with corporate policies. User support and service delivery Act as the L2 technical escalation point for complex incidents that cannot be resolved by frontline support. Troubleshoot advanced issues across Microsoft 365, networking, VPN, authentication and business applications. Contribute to the internal knowledge base, enabling frontline self-service and consistent solution documentation. Projects and continuous improvement Participate actively in cross-country IT & Digital initiatives, including endpoint standardisation, migrations, platform rollouts and digital projects across Spain, Portugal and Italy. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT tasks. Support IT audits and security and compliance activities. Evaluate and test new tools, technologies and AI-powered solutions. Support the Regional IT Manager in tracking deliverables, testing and stakeholder alignment Qualifications ROLE REQUIREMENTS Education : Higher vocational training or university qualification in IT, Systems, Telecommunications or an equivalent field. Experience : 2-4 years in IT support, systems administration or a similar technical role. Endpoint management : Hands-on experience managing Windows and/or macOS devices at scale. MDM : Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune, JAMF or comparable MDM platforms. IAM / IdP : Experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA and Conditional Access. Microsoft 365 : Solid administration-level knowledge of Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive. ITSM : Experience with tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management. Languages : Native-level Spanish and business-level English. Italian, Portuguese or French would be an advantage. Ways of working : Structured, proactive, security-aware, service-oriented and documentation-focused. DESIRABLE KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE PowerShell, Bash or Python scripting applied to IT automation. Familiarity with the ITIL framework or related certifications. Networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VPN and firewall basics. Knowledge of Zero Trust security principles. Experience in international or multi-country IT environments. PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES Internal customer focus and the ability to align technical priorities with business impact. Responsible autonomy, initiative and timely escalation of risks. Strong organisation, prioritisation and disciplined follow-up of tasks and projects. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaboration within international teams and cross-functional coordination. Attention to detail, security awareness and documentation discipline. A continuous-improvement mindset, technological curiosity and learning agility. CANDIDATE PROFILE We are looking for a hands-on and solution-oriented IT professional with a solid foundation in Microsoft environment …
