items.desc: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Computer Operators at Kyndryl are key in helping revolutionize the way we operate complex computer systems. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, supervise and control intricate networks and applications, and operate distributed systems in a multi-vendor environment. As a Computer Operator you will be on the technical frontline – performing batch operations as per service agreements, analyzing first-level issues across systems, and resolving/routing issues as appropriate. You will also have the opportunity to develop support system management processes specific to customer requirements, ensuring that we provide the highest level of service to our customers. If you have a passion for technology and a desire to continually improve your skills – this is the position for you. You will work with a talented team of professionals and collaborate on exciting projects that are shaping the future of our industry. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Computer Operator, you will be interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams which makes identifying career paths with Kyndryl easy. Whether you want to delve into the intricacies of automating complex processes, drive essential systems, or ensure top-notch delivery to our customers, there is a path for you – and we’re invested in paving the way. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise •Experience with scheduling software, reporting, and logging •Proficient with Operating Systems (Windows or Mac) Preferred Technical and Professional Experience •Experience with Troubleshooting, Backup/Recovery and Basic Networking Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

items.desc: Plats Malmö, Helsingborg, Lund + 1 , Hybrid Upplägg Heltid Ansök senast Löpande rekrytering I rollen som Dataarkitekt hos Consid i syd får du möjlighet att utveckla både dina idéer och dig själv. Tillsammans med kunder och kollegor skapar du moderna dataplattformar, informationsmodeller och arkitekturer som möjliggör avancerad analys och AI. Vi värderar dina personliga egenskaper och tror att du uppskattar att arbeta nära både verksamhet och teknik för att skapa långsiktigt värde. Som person tror vi att du är kommunikativ, affärsorienterad och drivs av att lösa komplexa utmaningar. Inom Consids affärsområde Data, AI och Analys hjälper vi våra kunder att bli verkligt datadrivna genom moderna dataplattformar, avancerad analys och AI-lösningar. I syd är vi idag 20 specialister inom dataområdet och nationellt är vi 115 kollegor som samarbetar tätt över hela landet. Efterfrågan på vår kompetens fortsätter att växa och vi söker nu fler Dataarkitekter som vill vara med och forma framtidens datalösningar tillsammans med oss. Är detta något för dig? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi läser ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Din kompetens Minst 8 års erfarenhet inom data- och informationsarkitektur i såväl Cloud som On-Prem Erfarenhet av att designa moderna dataplattformar i molnmiljö Djup förståelse för datamodellering, informationsarkitektur och data governance Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake eller liknande plattformar Erfarenhet av att omsätta affärsbehov till tekniska lösningar Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift Naturlig fallenhet för att använda de senaste teknikerna inklusive AI för att rådge och stödja våra kunder Meriterande Erfarenhet av master data management och data governance-initiativ Erfarenhet av AI- och ML-relaterad arkitektur Certifieringar inom Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud Erfarenhet från konsultverksamhet Erfarenhet av större transformations- eller moderniseringsprojekt Fördelar hos Consid Centralt kontor Din arbetsplats är en mötesplats med vackra lokaler som dessutom är centralt belägna med goda förbindelser. Utvecklas Hos oss finns möjlighet att testa det som du är intresserad av och utveckla din roll i den riktning du vill. Engagerade ledare Ledare som engagerar, pushar och lyfter sina medarbetare och som dessutom jobbar nära sin team. Fantastiska kollegor Du får världens duktigaste, trevligaste och mest hjälpsamma kollegor. Vi erbjuder Consid är ett av Europas snabbast växande företag med över 1800 medarbetare på över 40 kontor. Trots vår storlek och snabba tillväxt lägger vi väldigt stort fokus på individen och den lokala kulturen. Ända sedan Consid grundades har ambitionen varit att skapa en arbetsplats som passar dig oavsett vilken fas i livet du befinner dig i. Vi är därför väldigt måna om att se varje individ och vara lyhörda för vad som är viktigt för just dig, din utveckling och din personliga situation. Som medarbetare hos oss delar du dina dagar med riktigt duktiga kollegor som mer än gärna byter erfarenheter, så väl lokalt som nationellt och internationellt. Vi gillar även att göra saker ihop och lär känna varandra genom en rad aktiviteter, så som exempelvis familjeaktiviteter, after works, träningsaktiviteter och spelkvällar. Och massor av annat kul, förstås! En typisk Considare älskar att överträffa kunders och kollegors förväntningar, men värderar också en sund balans mellan privatliv och arbetsliv. Ansök nu Frågor? Har du frågor om tjänsten? Emma Lindsten i rekryteringsteamet svarar gärna på dina frågor. Emma Lindsten Rekryterare emma.lindsten@consid.se 076 863 82 72

items.desc: Do you want to question, change, and steer our company into the future? Are you passionate about technology and ready to make a difference? Then you will thrive at SEB. At SEB, we believe in fresh thinking, new working methods, and innovation to create a fairer and more sustainable world. Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success, while we place a strong emphasis on sustainability and digitalization as we shape the future of SEB. With the Tech Trainee programme and as an employee, we'll help you develop new skills and take on more responsibility to create a positive impact. You will become a crucial key player in shaping the future of the bank. Your tech trainee position and your team Are you curious about AI and excited by how it can transform software development? As a Tech Trainee you will work as a Platform Engineer within AI and join SEB's growing Developer Experience organization and help shape how AI is used by developers across the bank. You will become part of our AI team, working with tools such as GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered capabilities that support software engineering at scale. Together with experienced engineers, product owners, and technical specialists, you will help improve developer productivity through AI, automation, integrations, and data-driven insights. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience within AI-enabled software development, developer experience, cloud technologies, and modern engineering practices while building a strong network across SEB. items.desc: About Seventy Seventy Agency is a strategic brand and marketing agency. We help companies grow by optimizing and connecting brand, growth and marketing operations. We don't stop at strategy: we build the systems, content and ways of working that make it happen. We build on many years of developing brand and marketing with companies from every corner of the world and in all types of industries, from global B2B tech companies to large industrial groups and international consumer brands. Seventy is part of a group of agencies that brings together strategy, creative work, production and managed marketing services, as well as transformation of marketing organisations and operations. Together we cover the whole chain, from brand and strategy to campaigns, content and the daily marketing work inside our clients' own teams. We are a partner that drives change and stays to keep developing with our clients. With all competences working together, the pace we drive change at is high and the solutions we provide deliver tangible results. We are now expanding our marketing operations team. We help marketing teams change how they work, from data and tools to production, localization and follow-up, powered by AI. We build solutions that empower marketing teams in their daily work. To grow the team, we're looking for new talent to join us. The role You'll join our AI team as AI Architect, working side by side with our AI Engineer. You're equals with different mandates: you design, they build. You own the architecture proposal and the decision material. The client's IT makes the final calls, and your job is to get the right solution understood and approved. Your first project is with a large client, where AI will change how the central marketing team works. What you'll do Work with the client and our consulting colleagues to pick the first AI initiatives, then design the smallest infrastructure that carries them. Design the architecture as a stack from source to user: data sources, storage, brand, connections, models, agents and interface, with governance throughout. Get the architecture understood, prepare the key decisions and secure approval from the client's IT and marketing leadership. Design how contextual data, asset data and numerical data are structured so that agents can best access and understand them. Set the framework for governance and testing: who approves what, how data is protected, how agents are tested before and after launch, and how we meet GDPR and the EU AI Act. Share your knowledge and help develop your colleagues in the team. Who you are You have several years of solution architecture or software development behind you, and you've designed systems built on large language models that went into production at a client. You've gotten solutions approved in enterprise environments: architecture boards, security reviews, identity and integrations. You know the Microsoft enterprise stack well, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Foundry, Fabric and Copilot Studio, and you know when it's right to build outside it. You understand retrieval, agents, tool use, evaluation and the major model platforms well enough to choose between them. You can sit down with a marketing director, understand what they need, and explain trade-offs without jargon. You're pragmatic about tools: you buy what already exists and build where it makes a difference. You want to grow with a team and take on more responsibility over time. You're based in Stockholm or nearby. You speak and work in English, and preferably Swedish. What we offer To be an important part of a fast growing team that helps clients transform marketing with AI. Real problems and real projects from day one with clients our agencies are already deeply engaged in. To help reshape how the client's full-time marketing teams create results. How to apply Send us your CV and a cover letter. We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and are trying to fill the position as soon as possible.

items.desc: Traineeprogram inom Precisionsmedicin Vill du vara en del av framtidens hälso- och sjukvård? Ta chansen att utvecklas och bidra med din tekniska expertis i ett område som revolutionerar sjukvården. Precisionsmedicin möjliggör skräddarsydd prevention, diagnos, behandling och uppföljning, baserat på den enskilde patientens unika förutsättningar, exempelvis genetisk profil och specifika biomarkörer. För att möta detta paradigmskifte krävs tvärvetenskapliga samarbeten och avancerade tekniska lösningar. Här spelar ingenjörer och andra tekniska experter en avgörande roll. Behovet av kompetens inom dataanalys, AI, bioteknik och systemutveckling växer snabbt, och vi söker talanger som vill vara med och driva denna utveckling framåt. Därför har Karolinska etablerat ett traineeprogram där du får arbeta i frontlinjen för medicinsk innovation, tillsammans med ledande experter och forskare. Välkommen att forma framtidens sjukvård! Om programmet Som trainee inom precisionsmedicin kommer du att få möjligheten att arbeta inom ett antal olika områden som är centrala för framtidens sjukvård. Programmet löper över 1,5 år med start 1 september 2027. Parallellt med placeringar i olika verksamheter kommer du att bidra i det centrala implementeringsarbetet och delta i ett riktat kompetensutvecklingsprogram. Vi erbjuder möjlighet att arbeta i en dynamisk miljö i gränslandet mellan medicin och teknik, där högspecialiserad sjukvård möter akademi och näringsliv. Du får jobba i team med många olika kompetenser och bakgrunder, och får möjlighet till personlig utveckling genom spännande och utmanande arbetsuppgifter och stort utrymme för egna initiativ. Traineeprogrammet ger dig starka utvecklingsmöjligheter genom mentorskap och utbildning. Traineeprogrammet är indelat i tre block med placeringar i olika verksamheter på Karolinskas två siter (Huddinge och Solna). Vi kommer tillsammans med dig bestämma vilka placeringar som passar utifrån din kompetensprofil och intresseområden. Parallellt med dina placeringar genomförs aktiviteter för kompetensutveckling och fördjupning inom relevanta områden. Du kommer även få möjlighet att genomföra strategiska projekt och affärsutveckling för att bredda din kompetens. Traineeprogrammet innebär en projektanställning. Under programmets gång utforskar vi tillsammans möjligheter för fortsatt anställning inom någon av Karolinskas verksamheter. Ansökan Vi söker dig som är en nyfiken och ambitiös person med en stark drivkraft för att förbättra hälso- och sjukvården och som är en lagspelare. Du har en civilingenjörsexamen eller masterexamen inom relevant område, exempelvis bioteknik, industriell ekonomi, data-/systemvetenskap, biomedicin, hälsoinformatik eller hälsoekonomi. Vi söker dig som är nyutexaminerad* eller med upp till 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet, och behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift. Lyssna gärna på vår pod om nya kompetensbehov i framtidens sjukvård. (öppnas i nytt fönster) Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset får du ta del av våra förmåner. Du tar examen innan programstart i september 2027. Om rekryteringsprocessen Ansökan är öppen fram till den 21 februari. Urval sker löpande och intervjuer planeras efter årsskiftet. I vår rekryteringsprocess kan vi komma att använda oss av Assessios tester MAP och Matrigma. MAP är ett personlighetstest och Matrigma är ett icke-verbalt begåvningstest och båda bygger på arbetspsykologisk forskning. Testerna används som ett komplement till dina erfarenheter och kompetenser och syftet är att göra vår urvalsprocess kvalitetssäker och transparent. I samband med din ansökan behöver du bifoga CV. Istället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig besvara urvalsfrågor samt kort motivera varför du passar för rollen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - Tillsammans är vi Karolinska! Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska. Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här. Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning. För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas. Om Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset Vi på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är stolta över att vi är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Förutom vårt särskilda ansvar för den högspecialiserade vården i Stockholmsregionen är huvuduppdraget att tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utbilda framtidens vårdanställda och bedriva världsledande forskning samtidigt som vi fortsätter vårt arbete med att utveckla vården för patientens bästa. items.desc: About the assignment We are currently looking for a Java Developer with Azure and AWS experience for an exciting consultant assignment at WirelessCar in Gothenburg. You will work closely with experienced engineers and other technical roles in an international environment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building software, working with cloud technologies, and ensuring services run reliably in production. You will join a high-performing team responsible for developing, deploying, and operating cloud-based connected vehicle services for a global automotive customer. As part of the team, you will work across the full lifecycle of the solution, from software development and deployment to monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. The role combines backend development with cloud operations, automation, and production support, offering a great opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies in a collaborative and international environment. Your main responsibilities Develop and maintain backend services and supporting components in a cloud-native environment Take an active role in operating production services, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance Monitor and troubleshoot production systems and participate in incident investigation and resolution Improve observability through logging, metrics, monitoring, and alerting Automate operational tasks and continuously improve deployment and operational processes Contribute to root cause analysis and implement preventive measures to avoid recurring incidents Collaborate closely with developers, architects, QA engineers and other stakeholders to continuously improve the service Take ownership of technical challenges from identification through resolution We are looking for We are looking for a Java developer who enjoys working across both development and operations. While you do not need to be a dedicated operations specialist, you should be comfortable taking ownership of production environments, troubleshooting issues, and driving continuous improvements. You have strong experience in software development and are comfortable working across the full application lifecycle, from development and deployment to monitoring and operational support. Required skills Software development, Java (Spring Boot) AWS cloud platform Azure cloud platform DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines Containers and cloud-native technologies Monitoring, logging, and observability Troubleshooting distributed systems and production issues Automation and scripting Git and modern software development practices Proven experience working with: Kubernetes OpenTelemetry Grafana Who you are You are curious, pragmatic, and comfortable working across both development and operations. You enjoy understanding how systems work in production and proactively identifying and addressing potential issues before they become problems. You take ownership, communicate clearly when challenges arise, and enjoy collaborating with others to solve complex problems. You are also comfortable working with operational processes and ways of working, ensuring alignment with both customer requirements and internal standards. We value individuals who are eager to learn, challenge existing ways of working, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our services. Practical information Assignment Type: Consulting Assignment Location: Gothenburg, Sweden Working Model: Hybrid, with at least 2 days in the office per week Workload: Full-time (40 hours/week) Assignment Period: 30 November 2026 – 28 November 2027 Language Requirement: English (Proficient) Applications are reviewed continuously, and the assignment may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your application! If you have any questions regarding the assignment, please contact Felicia Hellström at +46 70 797 27 29 or via email at felicia@searchr.se .

items.desc: At SEB, Technology delivers customer and business value. Our landscape spans core banking, data, AI, automation, cybersecurity and cloud, enabling secure, responsible and future-ready solutions. Join our Mainframe & IBMi department within SEB Technology in Solna, focusing on Mainframe infrastructure and storage. Our platform supports business-critical banking services where reliability, security and performance are essential. We combine operations and development with modernisation and a long-term roadmap aligned with SEB’s digital direction. About the role: Combine technical work with shaping a business-critical platform’s future. As Solution Architect, you will bridge engineering and architecture, with an intended balance of approximately 50% technical work and 50% architecture. Your focus is Mainframe infrastructure and storage, supported by a broad understanding of the surrounding technology landscape. Working with engineers, architects, stakeholders and suppliers, you will translate operational needs, business requirements and technology developments into sustainable solutions, strategies and roadmaps aligned with SEB’s architecture principles and relevant domain architecture. Develop Mainframe infrastructure and storage architecture, connecting the current environment with the target architecture and roadmap. Translate long-term mainframe strategy into practical improvements and technical initiatives. Analyse requirements, dependencies and solution options; prepare recommendations and decision material. Follow market and technology developments, engage with suppliers and assess opportunities for the platform. Present technical and architectural topics, facilitate discussions and share knowledge. Develop infrastructure and storage with specialists, considering reliability, security, performance and capacity. Take over existing responsibilities through knowledge transfer and drive them independently. Who are you? You are curious and passionate about technology, with the analytical ability to understand complex environments and a strategic mindset that balances immediate needs with long-term development. You bring a broad technical understanding and a strong foundation in Mainframe area. You do not need deep expertise in every area, but can see the whole picture, ask relevant questions and collaborate with specialists. Self-driven and accountable, you follow through, enjoy learning and welcome further training. You present ideas clearly, discuss options with suppliers and colleagues, and make complex topics understandable. You work independently while valuing collaboration and structured ways of working. We are looking for you who have the following qualifications: Relevant experience in Mainframe infrastructure and storage, with broad understanding of technologies and dependencies. Ability to translate business and technical requirements into sustainable solutions, architectural models and recommendations. Strong analytical skills to assess solutions from operational and long-term architectural perspectives. Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including presentations and supplier dialogues. Ownership of activities from analysis through implementation and follow-up. Fluency in Swedish and English, both spoken and written. You have experience of large-scale business-critical operations. Familiarity with IBM Z, z/OS, mainframe storage, networking, Sysplex and GDPS is valuable. Knowledge in capacity planning or performance management is an advantage. We welcome technically experienced architects and engineers ready to grow into architecture. What we offer: An opportunity to combine engineering and architecture and influence the long-term development of SEB’s mainframe infrastructure and storage. Collaboration with experienced colleagues in a business-critical technology environment. Extensive training and learning opportunities to strengthen both your technical and architectural capabilities. Agile and modern ways of working, with an open culture where ideas, opinions and different perspectives are welcome. A broad technology landscape and opportunities to develop your career within SEB. A hybrid work model, meaning remote work is possible up to 2 days/week. Ready to take the next step on your career journey? Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today, but no later than 18th of December . We review applications continuously. For questions, contact recruiting manager Annika.Bjorklund@seb.se. Applications are not accepted by email. Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks. items.desc: Om jobbet Vi är Göteborg! Vill du utveckla digitala lösningar som förenklar vardagen i Göteborgs Stad? Vi söker en systemutvecklare med inriktning mot BPMS till enheten Automation och digitalisering. BPMS står för Business Process Management System och används för att digitalisera och automatisera verksamhetsprocesser. Hos oss arbetar du främst i plattformen Decisions. Du blir en del av automationsteamet, där systemutvecklare och arkitekter utvecklar och förvaltar lösningar inom tjänsten Automatisera informationsflöden. Teamet arbetar med BPMS och med robotiserad processautomation, RPA, i Blue Prism. Ditt fokus är BPMS, men det finns också möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom RPA. Vi välkomnar både dig som är i början av din utvecklarbana och dig som har mer erfarenhet. Du behöver inte ha arbetat med BPMS eller Decisions tidigare. Du behöver däremot ha en grund inom programmering och systemutveckling och vilja lära dig hur tekniken kan möta verksamhetens behov. Du lär dig verktygen och arbetssätten tillsammans med erfarna kollegor. Uppgifternas komplexitet och ditt ansvar anpassas efter din erfarenhet och utvecklas över tid. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter Utveckla och införa digitala verksamhetsprocesser och automatiserade flöden i Decisions utifrån verksamhetens behov. Arbeta med systemutvecklare och arkitekter för att koppla ihop lösningarna med stadens system och plattformar. Testa, felsöka, förvalta och förbättra befintliga processer och lösningar samt bidra i supporten. Skapa och uppdatera dokumentation av processer och lösningar enligt gemensamma arbetssätt. Dela kunskap och erfarenheter med kollegor. Ha dialog med verksamhetsrepresentanter för att förstå behoven och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar. Du får befattningen systemutvecklare. Om dig Vi söker dig som har: Utbildning på högskolenivå inom IT, exempelvis systemutveckling eller informatik, eller motsvarande kunskaper inom programmering och systemutveckling som du har fått genom annan utbildning eller arbete. Grundläggande kunskaper i programmering och systemutveckling. Du kan beskriva en lösning som du själv har utvecklat, exempelvis under utbildning, praktik, arbete eller i ett eget projekt. Förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift så att du kan föra dialog med verksamheten och dokumentera processer och lösningar. Det är meriterande om du har kunskap om eller erfarenhet av: Utveckling eller förvaltning i Decisions eller andra BPMS-plattformar, exempelvis Pega, Camunda eller Appian. Processmodellering, exempelvis med BPMN 2.0. Grundläggande förståelse för hur system utbyter information, exempelvis via API:er. Arbete i agila team, exempelvis med Scrum eller Kanban, eller med arbetssätt inom DevOps. Erfarenhet av att dela teknisk kunskap, exempelvis genom dokumentation, genomgångar eller handledning. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet; hur du tar ansvar, arbetar strukturerat och driver dina uppgifter framåt. Du är nyfiken, tar initiativ och vill lära dig nya verktyg och arbetssätt. Du tar till dig återkoppling, provar dig fram och ber om stöd när det behövs. Du samarbetar med andra, lyssnar på verksamhetens behov och delar med dig av dina kunskaper. Du kan förklara dina lösningar på ett begripligt sätt och dokumenterar så att andra kan förstå och arbeta vidare med dem. Du arbetar självständigt utifrån din erfarenhet och stämmer av med kollegor när uppgiften kräver det. Om oss Intraservice levererar tjänster och digital infrastruktur som hjälper medarbetare och chefer i Göteborgs Stad att arbeta smart och effektivt. På så vis gör vi det enklare att arbeta i staden och skapar förutsättningar för en god service till göteborgarna. Vi har en central roll i stadens digitalisering och automatisering och våra kunder är Göteborgs alla förvaltningar och bolag. Vi är drygt 700 medarbetare som arbetar i centrala Göteborg. items.desc: Are you ready to redefine the financial industry? Are you looking to leave an impact on the financial lives and futures of over 2.5 million customers across the Nordics. Then Nordnet is the place for you! In brief At Nordnet, we exist to ensure the most inspiring savings experience. Through leading UX, cutting-edge financial products, and automated and inspiring customer journeys, we are building the best platform for savings and investments, enabling higher returns for our customers. Nordnet is customer-focused and product-led. We are now seeking a highly motivated Product Owner to lead our Ledger team within the Product Platform area. The ledger is the financial record of every movement of cash and securities for our customers. Our finance function, our regulators and every number a customer sees depend on it. Customers never see a ledger entry, but they rely on it every time they check a balance, place a trade or download a tax report. You will join a team of senior engineers who have spent the past year building our new cloud-native ledger. This is a product role first, and a people role close behind. We are looking for a background in financial services, and you need to be great at owning a platform, making hard trade-offs and bringing many teams and stakeholders along. The Product department consists of the Chief Product Officer, Area Product Owners, and Product Owners within the different domains. This is part of the role As Product Owner for Ledger, you own the vision, roadmap and delivery for our core financial records. You turn accounting principles and regulatory requirements into a platform that is correct by design. On a daily basis, you work as a peer to a senior, AI-first engineering team. You also work with Finance, Accounting, Compliance and the many product teams whose services write to and read from the ledger. Most of your customers are internal, they need the platform to be dependable, well documented and safe to change. The role is built to grow. Once the Ledger is established, you will also take ownership of how transactions enter our platform, the transaction stream that a large part of Nordnet depends on, together with the engineers who build it. You will help shape how our teams are organised around these products in our cloud platform. Key responsibilities: Product innovation: Drive the evolution of our investment and savings experience to deliver a modern, intuitive platform for both long-term savers and active investors. Roadmap ownership: Lead the team roadmap by defining feature scope and prioritizing deliverables in collaboration with business owners and stakeholders. Stakeholder communication: Maintain transparent communication with stakeholders regarding roadmap progress, changes, and potential blockers. Risk & compliance: Proactively identify and mitigate product risks while ensuring all features meet stringent regulatory and legal standards. Engineering collaboration: Guide the team through technical trade-offs such as consistency, event-driven design and migration, and keep momentum high. Finance partnership: Work closely with Finance and Accounting on general ledger reporting and reconciliation, so the books are always right. This is you You have deep interest within savings and investments and you also have previous working knowledge and experience from digital product development within the financial services sector. You take a “low-ego, high-impact” approach. You bring people along through clarity and trust rather than formal authority, and you are comfortable when the scope grows. You most likely have some technical or analytical experience and as a person, you are driven, creative and have great teamwork skills! You have: Financial services background: At least 3 years as Product Owner or Product Manager in financial services, fintech or payments Stakeholder leadership: You can build trust quickly and align different stakeholders around hard priorities, without formal authority. You communicate clearly in English. Platform mindset: Experience owning an internal or platform product, such as APIs, data or core services, where the customers are other teams. You think about contracts, versioning and the impact of change. Technical understanding: You are comfortable discussing technical solutions with engineers. Academic foundation: A university degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or a relevant field, or around five years of equivalent professional experience. You will become part of a journey that has only just begun towards the vision of making our customers the best investors they can be. We’re over 1000 employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen and Germany. Since November 2020, Nordnet (SAVE) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm main market with a market capitalization of SEK91bn. items.desc: About the Role Join Ericsson's antenna technology team to develop advanced electromagnetic structures for next-generation mobile communication systems. We are seeking an RF engineer with hands-on experience in Frequency Selective Surfaces (FSS), sub-10-GHz electromagnetic design, and electromagnetic transparent structures. You will develop and optimise structures that control electromagnetic wave propagation while meeting the demanding performance requirements of modern antenna systems. We welcome applications from both graduates with relevant research or demonstrator experience and experienced engineers with industrial development expertise. Technical capability and demonstrated practical experience matter more than years of service alone. What You Will Do Design and develop wideband electromagnetic structures for applications across cellular frequency bands between 600 MHz and 10 GHz. Simulate and optimise electromagnetic performance using 3D simulation tools, investigating bandwidth, transmission, reflection, insertion loss, angular stability and polarisation effects. Evaluate electromagnetic transparency and the interaction of passive structures with radiating elements, radomes and antenna arrays. Investigate innovative concepts, including three-dimensional geometries, multilayer arrangements and other advanced periodic structures. Validate designs through prototype development, RF measurements and simulation-to-measurement correlation. Solve complex engineering challenges and collaborate with antenna, RF, mechanical and materials specialists to translate concepts into practical solutions. Communicate technical results through engineering reports, design reviews and knowledge sharing. What You Will Bring A degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Applied Physics or a related discipline. Demonstrated hands-on experience with Frequency Selective Surfaces (FSS) through industrial development, academic research, a thesis, laboratory work or a demonstrator. Practical experience with RF or electromagnetic structures operating below 10 GHz, within the 600 MHz–10 GHz range. Understanding of electromagnetic wave propagation, periodic structures, transmission and reflection behaviour, and electromagnetic transparency. Practical experience with 3D electromagnetic simulation software, preferably Ansys HFSS or CST Studio Suite. Analytical problem-solving skills and proficiency in English. Nice to Have Experience with wideband or multiband designs, three-dimensional structures, multilayer configurations, radomes or electromagnetic bandgap structures. RF measurement experience, including vector network analysers, S-parameter characterisation and prototype validation. Knowledge of Floquet modes, periodic boundary conditions, oblique incidence and equivalent-circuit modelling. Experience with Python, MATLAB, simulation automation or AI-assisted electromagnetic design. items.desc: How does life emerge from molecules and cells? This is the central question that motivates us. With curiosity and passion, we investigate the entire spectrum ranging from the atom to the organism. The Biozentrum of the University of Basel is one of the world's leading life sciences institutes. With 32 groups, high-end core facilities and 500 employees, we are a dynamic and international research community that has spawned many fundamental discoveries in biology and medicine as well as several Nobel Laureates. Become part of our community! We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist/Research Associate to join our team at the Proteomics Core Facility (PCF). The PCF provides state-of-the-art proteomic techniques to support life science research at the Biozentrum and other Basel University institutes. It is tightly integrated in an internationally leading scientific surrounding. The main focus of the group is the development of new data-independent mass spectrometric workflows for sensitive, quantitative protein and post-translational modification profiling and their integration in interdisciplinary biological projects. Your position The primary responsibilities for this position will include the operation and maintenance of latest LC-MS systems (Vanquish Neo, EvoSep, timsUltra AIP, ASTRAL Zoom), the assistance and teaching of researchers performing proteomics analyses and general lab management. Duties will include supervising sample preparation, analyzing samples by quantitative and sensitive LC-MS/MS (SWATH-MS), data analysis via a suite of software tools, continuing analytical method development and reporting of results to collaborators on a regular basis, including internal presentations. Your profile The ideal candidate should have proof of proficiency in LC-MS based proteomics techniques, including planning of experiments, sample preparation, operation of LC-MS platforms, data analysis software tools and practical experience in organizing a laboratory. Prior experience with the preparation and analysis of low input samples and data-independent workflows would be advantageous. The successful candidate should be highly organized, detail-oriented and computer literate. The candidate should have good written and verbal communication skills, be able to work both independently and within a team and have a MS degree or higher in a biology or chemistry related subject with 2+ years of experience. High proficiency in spoken and written English is required. We offer you The position offers a challenging opportunity to join a growing and rapidly evolving bioanalytical field and to join a team of highly motivated scientists. Access to sports programs and fitness facilities, well-established services for balancing career and family (e.g. childcare, modern parenthood regulations and more) and numerous courses for training and development. The position is initially for 2 years, with the possibility of further extension for 4 years after positive evaluation. Salary and benefits according to University of Basel standards. Application / Contact Please apply online: https://biped.biozentrum.unibas.ch/apply/proteomics_lcms_specialist The application should include a brief personal statement, explaining how your qualifications and experience make you a good candidate for this job, together with a full, up-to-date CV and addresses of 2 references. We start reviewing applications from 4th of January 2027 until the position is filled. In all cases, you will be notified of the outcome of your application. Please note that only online applications via the application portal will be accepted. For further information, please contact Dr. Alexander Schmidt, Head of Proteomics Core Facility, +41 61 207 20 59, alex.schmidt@unibas.ch Apply

items.desc: About machineMD At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere. We’re building neurodiagnostics for the next generation with our neos device and oculometrics software. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test. The Role You’ll help us understand how neos behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers. Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice. Automation Across the System – develop automated tests for complex, distributed systems across different frameworks and technologies, covering multiple components, interfaces, and end-to-end scenarios beyond UI testing. Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others. Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time. Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment. items.desc: About biomodal Better biological insights start with better data. Genetics, epigenetics and biology, all without compromise. biomodal was founded on a simple belief: researchers shouldn't have to choose between high-quality genetic data and methylation information. Our duet platform solves this, reading both together from the same sample in a single workflow. We've launched duet +modC, duet evoC, and most recently duet mosaic, a cfDNA-optimised assay family resolving genetics, epigenetics and fragmentomics from the same molecule for liquid biopsy research. Together, these technologies are helping uncover new insight into cancer, ageing, and neurological disease. We're an early-stage company with real commercial momentum. We believe in maximising our collective skills and experience and fostering great teamwork. If you want to help bring the dynamism of biology into focus, we'd love to hear from you. The Team: You will join biomodal's R&D team, working alongside scientists, data scientists, bioinformaticians and operations colleagues. The team generates the high-quality experimental data that underpins our technology and product development. The Role: As an Associate Scientist you'll be a hands-on member of biomodal's R&D team, working across product development, from the first idea through to a robust, well-characterised product. We're looking for a scientist with strong laboratory skills who can design experiments, run them to a consistently high standard, analyse the data and use what they learn to plan next steps. You'll have the support to grow and real ownership of your work. Experimental design, execution and analysis Design experiments that address specific research questions, refining your approach with support from senior scientists. Perform experiments to a high standard using core techniques, including nucleic-acid extraction and quantification, PCR, NGS library preparation and QC, generating reproducible data that supports assay development, optimisation and characterisation. Analyse, interpret and present your results clearly, troubleshooting challenges and working with data scientists and bioinformaticians. Write clear protocols, SOPs and experimental reports. Product development Contribute to product development at every stage, from ideation and early feasibility through development and optimisation to transfer into manufacturing. Work within our product development processes and complete documentation to a high standard, so your work is traceable and others can build on it. Projects, ideas and improvement Deliver against clear project plans and milestones, meet your deadlines and flag risks early. Challenge current thinking, contribute ideas for improving our products and processes, and record inventions accurately so they can be protected. Quality and safety Work safely and to our ISO 9001 quality management system and laboratory best practice, keeping accurate, compliant records in our electronic lab notebook. The Person: We are seeking a hands-on scientist with strong laboratory skills and a data-led approach to experimental work. The successful candidate will execute experimental protocols accurately and reliably, work closely with senior scientists and cross-functional teams, and contribute ideas that improve our products and how we work. Essential A degree in a biological science or a related field (or equivalent experience). Strong, hands-on skills in molecular biology. The ability to design experiments, with appropriate controls and replication, that answer a defined question, and to adapt your plans based on the results. Careful, reliable execution of protocols, keeping accurate records in an electronic lab notebook. The ability to analyse and interpret data, and to present results clearly. Clear written and verbal communication, including writing protocols, SOPs and reports. Good organisation and time management, with a record of meeting deadlines across several experiments at once. A collaborative approach to working with senior scientists, data scientists, bioinformaticians and operations colleagues, and the ability to take on feedback. Desirable Experience with NGS and genomics workflows, ideally including low-input or cfDNA samples. Experience in working in a quality-managed laboratory (ISO 9001 or similar) or writing SOPs. Exposure to assay or product development. Benefits: Company bonus scheme 8% pension 25 days annual leave Private medical and life Insurance Cycle scheme In office perks

items.desc: Specialism DevOps, Cloud, SRE, Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Leadership, Security, AI/ML, Data Job type Permanent Location London Salary £100,000 - £150,000 per annum Some engineering roles are about maintaining what already exists. This is about working out what's possible and building it. We're working with an ambitious, well backed AI startup that's taking on some pretty complex problems for large businesses. They're using AI to rethink how organisations operate, moving beyond simple automation and building intelligent systems that can understand workflows, interact with existing technology and get things done. They're at an interesting point in their journey. The founding team has a strong technical background, the business is gaining real traction, and they're now looking to bring in a small number of exceptional engineers to help shape the next stage. The opportunity is a little different from your typical software engineering role. You'll be working directly with customers and the founding team, getting under the skin of how businesses operate and identifying where AI can make a genuine difference. You'll then take those problems away and build the solutions, whether that's developing agents, integrating disparate systems or creating entirely new ways for people to interact with technology. There's a real end to end element to this. You'll have ownership from the initial problem solving and technical design through to writing the code, deploying the solution and seeing how it works in the real world. What you learn from each deployment will also help shape the core platform, so you're not just building one off solutions. Who they're looking for First and foremost, they're looking for builders. People who enjoy getting their hands dirty, are comfortable operating without much structure and would rather work out how to solve something than explain why it can't be done. You might have been an early engineer at a startup, built something yourself, or worked in an environment where you've had to take real ownership beyond your immediate job description. Technically, you'll need to be a strong software engineer with a genuine interest in AI. Experience with LLMs, agents and modern AI tooling is important, but just as much as what you've worked with is how you approach new problems. They're interested in people who are actively experimenting and thinking about how these technologies can be put to practical use. Just as importantly, you need to enjoy working with people. You'll be in front of customers, talking through problems and making technical decisions, so being able to communicate clearly and take people on that journey is a big part of the role. Why consider it? You'll be joining a small team with a lot of ambition, at a point where the people coming in will have a genuine influence on what the company becomes. There's no huge engineering hierarchy, no waiting around for decisions to filter down and no shortage of interesting problems to get stuck into. You'll work directly with the founders, have significant ownership over what you build and help shape a product that's still evolving. For someone who enjoys the early stages of building something, it's a pretty exciting opportunity to get involved. If you're interested in being closer to the product, the customers and the decisions that shape a business, it'd be great to have a conversation. Alex Case Lead Consultant 07441344746

Purpose of Role This part-time research assistant post is expected to support a collaborative project funded by the IGD (Islands Growth Deal), between Heriot-Watt University and ICNZ (Islands Center for Net Zero). The purpose is to explore food security models (e.g., suppliers, stakeholders, logistics, resilience) and establish a new food supply chain model for the Orkney Islands, and related islands such as the Shetland Islands and Outer Hebrides. items.desc: Job Description: About AXA: AXA is a global leader in insurance and financial services, dedicated to helping customers protect what matters most to them. As the sixth-largest insurance company in the world, we provide a wide range of services, including health, car, home, and business insurance. We support millions of customers worldwide, helping them navigate life's uncertainties with confidence. AXA Health International offers global healthcare support and protection to individuals and businesses in over 200 countries, backed by more than 55 years of experience through its international hubs. Job overview: As Security Architect, you’ll be AHI’s Security Architecture Authority, responsible for embedding security into all technology development and improvements. You’ll oversee secure SDLC, secure coding, SecDevOps governance, architecture reviews, and secure design patterns. The role also leads incident management and response as the technical lead in SIRT, supporting crisis management. Collaborating closely with the CIO team, enterprise architects, project managers, and hosting teams, you'll play a key role in Security Assurance and Risk Management to maintain a strong, cohesive security posture across the organisation. Key responsibilities: Serve as the authority on security architecture, defining principles, reference architecture, secure design patterns, and standards to guide technology development and improvements. Review solution and infrastructure architectures at key decision points across cloud, data platforms, applications, integrations, and AI initiatives, providing risk-based recommendations. Maintain an up-to-date architecture risk view, including technical debt, exceptions, and remediation plans, reporting findings to the CSO. Define and embed the Secure SDLC, covering security requirements, threat modeling, secure coding, code reviews, and pipeline security controls. Govern SecDevOps practices across in-house and third-party teams, establishing standards, tooling, gates, and metrics in collaboration with CIO teams. Lead technical assurance activities such as penetration testing, configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, and cloud posture reviews to verify security controls. Oversee vulnerability management, prioritisation, remediation tracking, and emergency patching in coordination with IT control owners and hosting entities. Lead security incident management and response, supporting crisis management, incident readiness, and post-incident reviews, while providing technical input to ensure swift recovery and lessons learned. Work arrangements: At AXA we work smart, empowering our people to balance their time between home and the office in a way that works best for them, their team and our customers. You'll work at least two days a week away from home, moving three days a week from 1st December 2026. Away from home means attending the office, visiting clients or attending industry events. We know that some candidates may be discouraged from applying if they don't meet every requirement. If you’re excited by this job and the prospect of working at AXA but you’re not sure you tick every box, we’d still encourage you to apply. Your skills & experience: International security experience, preferably within health insurance, healthcare, or financial services sectors, with a strong focus on security engineering and architecture. Extensive hands-on expertise in secure software development lifecycle, threat modelling, secure design, and secure architecture practices. Proven track record in incident response planning, developing runbooks, and leading or participating in tabletop and operational incident exercises. Deep understanding of vulnerability management from an architectural perspective, with the ability to influence secure-by-default design decisions. Familiarity with regulatory and governance requirements relevant to international health and insurance, including data protection, privacy, and third-party risk management, alongside risk management frameworks like NIST. Skilled in security architecture for cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), identity and access management, network and API security, and safeguarding sensitive personal and health data. Experience delivering a Secure SDLC, including threat modelling, secure coding (OWASP), SAST/DAST/SCA, CI/CD pipeline security, and container/infrastructure-as-code security. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, CISA, or SANS, with prior experience working in small-team or start-up security environments preferred. As a precondition of employment for this role, you must be eligible and authorised to work in the United Kingdom. How to apply: To apply, click on the ‘apply now’ button, you’ll then need to log in or create a profile to submit your CV. items.desc: WHAT'S YOUR POSSIBLE? Take on a role where your ideas, analytical thinking and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future. As an Intraday Power Trading Graduate, you'll gain hands-on experience analysing power markets, developing quantitative models and creating data-driven tools that support trading decisions and risk management. You'll learn how market fundamentals, data analytics and technology combine to create trading opportunities within one of Europe's most dynamic energy markets. This is an excellent opportunity for graduates who enjoy complex problem-solving, quantitative analysis and programming. Through structured training and development, you'll gradually build towards participating in live intraday trading activities while developing specialist expertise in power markets, analytics and trading technology. WHAT WILL YOU DO Analyse complex market and operational challenges involving uncertainty, physical constraints and competing commercial priorities. Use data to investigate market developments, test hypotheses and provide actionable insights that support trading decisions. Develop quantitative models and analytical tools for forecasting, optimisation, scenario analysis and risk assessment. Evaluate and improve existing models and solutions to ensure they remain effective as market conditions evolve. Apply AI technologies responsibly to accelerate analysis, improve efficiency and support commercial decision-making while maintaining appropriate controls and governance. Monitor short-term power markets and produce timely analysis to support trading activity and position management. Build automated reporting, monitoring and decision-support tools using programming and data analysis techniques. Collaborate with Trading, Portfolio Management, Quantitative Analytics, Data Science and Technology teams to develop solutions that improve trading performance and operational efficiency. Following structured training, gradually transition into live intraday trading responsibilities as part of a shift-based trading desk rota. Review trading outcomes and identify opportunities to enhance processes, models, strategies and market insights. WHAT WILL YOU BRING We're looking for highly analytical and intellectually curious graduates who enjoy solving complex problems and applying technology to real-world commercial challenges. You'll be excited by data, quantitative analysis and energy markets, while demonstrating a strong desire to learn and develop within a fast-paced trading environment. You'll ideally have: A Bachelor's or Master's degree (completed or due to be completed before the programme starts) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex challenges, assess evidence and make decisions in uncertain or incomplete information environments. Programming experience, preferably in Python, and an interest in developing analytical models, automation solutions and decision-support tools. A strong interest in artificial intelligence and the practical application of AI technologies to business, data and trading challenges. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts into clear, actionable insights for different audiences. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across Trading, Analytics, Technology and Operations teams. Curiosity, resilience, strong organisational skills and the ability to adapt and perform effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly. A genuine interest in intraday power trading, energy markets and continuous learning, with a willingness to participate in a shift-based trading desk rota, including weekends and public holidays, following appropriate training. Applications are open until 16 December 2026. After the application deadline, no further submissions will be accepted. ABOUT US SEFE is an international energy company anchored in Europe, delivering energy solutions that ensure reliable and affordable supply. Our activities span the entire energy value chain – from origination and trading to sales, transport and storage. With decades of trading expertise and a growing LNG portfolio, SEFE is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to industrial customers, providing more than 200 TWh of gas and power each year. We supply over 50,000 clients, from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations. By investing in clean energies, we support our customers on their decarbonisation journey and contribute to the energy transition. SEFE employs over 2,000 people worldwide and is owned by the Federal Government of Germany. Securing energy – now and for the future. OUR BENEFITS In return we offer a competitive salary supported by a comprehensive range of …

This role offers the opportunity for hybrid working – some time on campus and some from home. We welcome applications from candidates interested in working part-time hours or
items.desc: About The Role Enterprise Data Architect This full-time post is available from January 2027 on a permanent basis The starting salary will be from £51,258 (pro rata for part time) on Grade G, depending on knowledge, skills and experience. This role offers the opportunity for hybrid working – some time on campus and some from home. We welcome applications from candidates interested in working part-time hours or job-sharing arrangements. The Data and Insights Team, based in the Digital Division, is recruiting an Enterprise Data Architect to help shape the University’s future data architecture and deliver our Data Strategy, an enabler of Strategy 2030. This is an opportunity to shape enterprise data architecture at a significant point in the University’s data transformation. We are building a new AWS-enabled Data Connect Platform and developing a more consistent, reusable and scalable approach to data across the institution. We need Data Architecture expertise to help us create: Clear and effective architecture across our institutional data landscape and new Data Connect Platform Principles, standards and reusable patterns that enable automation, interoperability and scalability High-quality, reusable and well-governed data assets A centre of excellence for Data Architecture that builds capability across the University What you'll be doing... Leading and developing the University’s Data Architecture capability, setting clear priorities, coordinating architectural activity and ensuring effective collaboration across the institution. Defining, maintaining and communicating the University’s target data architecture, including the principles, standards and guardrails that shape the Data Connect Platform and wider institutional data landscape. Leading end-to-end data architecture across ingestion, storage, transformation, integration and consumption, partnering with Data Engineering to translate target capabilities and reusable patterns into secure, resilient and operable engineering designs. Developing and maintaining enterprise conceptual and logical data models, helping establish common definitions, relationships and reusable structures across key institutional data domains. Architecting and assuring reusable data products, curated datasets and product-family assets, ensuring they are discoverable, secure, documented and fit for reporting, analytics, integration and AI. Maintaining an enterprise view of institutional data assets, critical data flows, dependencies and architectural risks, helping to inform technology roadmaps, governance decisions and investment priorities. Representing Data Architecture in University governance and design forums, including the Technical Design Authority, and providing authoritative advice on significant data-related decisions. About You We’re really looking for… Significant experience applying Data Architecture practice within a large, complex, multi-stakeholder environment. Experience developing data architecture standards, models, patterns, roadmaps and assurance approaches that support reporting, analytics, integration or digital transformation. Experience working across business and technical teams to understand data requirements, resolve ambiguity and translate organisational needs into effective data architecture. Experience partnering with data engineers and delivery teams to translate target architecture, standards and reusable patterns into implementable solutions through guidance, assurance and practical support. Experience establishing clear architectural responsibilities and ways of working across data, governance, engineering and delivery teams. Experience providing architectural leadership, mentoring colleagues and building Data Architecture capability across multidisciplinary teams. Please ensure you read the Job Description and Person Specification for full details of this role. Apply today with your CV and a cover letter. Further information Please contact e.mcculloch@exeter.ac.uk. If you have any further queries, please send them to UoEDigital@exeter.ac.uk and we will endeavour to get back to you as soon as possible. About The Division More about the Digital Team ! At the University of Exeter, we're embarking on an exciting journey of digital transformation that will reshape the way we educate, research and collaborate. Our commitment to embracing cutting-edge digital technologies and fostering digital skills development is at the heart of our mission. We are dedicated to working with partners who share our values to enhance our education, research and partnerships while meeting the evolving needs of our students and colleagues across our campuses. We work in an agile way and have organised the team into chapters (groups of people with the same skill sets) and squads (made up of people from the chapters who can work autonomously and to their own goals). We want to test and champion new working models in our squads that push the boundaries of inclusivity, …

items.desc: About the Business Quilter plc is a leading wealth management business, helping to enable brighter financial futures for every generation. Quilter oversees £160.5 billion in customer investments (as of September 2026). It has an adviser and customer offering spanning financial advice, investment platforms, multi-asset investment solutions, and discretionary fund management. The business is comprised of two segments: Affluent and High Net Worth. Affluent encompasses the financial planning business, Quilter Financial Planning, the Quilter Investment Platform and Quilter Investors, the multi-asset investment solutions business. High Net Worth includes the discretionary fund management business, Quilter Cheviot, together with Quilter Cheviot Financial Planning – offering a highly personalised service to private clients, charities, trustees, and professional partners. Quilter Cheviot has presence throughout the UK, Ireland and Channel Islands. At Quilter we never stand still. Our foundations are rooted in our extraordinary expertise, which is trusted by hundreds of thousands of customers, but we have great ambitions to stay one step ahead and make an even greater difference to the people and communities we serve, including our colleagues. Our business is transforming, continually modernising, and becoming even more customer centric. So, if you want to be bold in the pursuit of your ambitions, bring new ideas, and challenge and evolve what we do, it’s the perfect time to join us! About the Role Level: 5 Department: COO Location: Southampton or London Contract type: Permanent The role sits within the Chief Data Office (CDO) and reports to the Head of Data Platforms. The Data Platform Architect plays a pivotal role in enabling business value by owning and managing the data platform reference architecture to enabling the organisation. This position partners with colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation to incrementally build a usable, reliable, high-quality data capability and solutions to support the business objectives. The role requires a blend of technical expertise, business acumen, collaboration to work across multiple stakeholders. The key accountabilities for the role are as follows: Technical Oversight & Delivery Define and owns a multi-year data platform architecture roadmap which supports the business outcome, specifically to support data, reporting, advanced analytics and AI Ensures architectural coherence across Fabric, Azure, Databricks and AI environments Establish and maintain the enterprise data platform architecture, covering ingestion, storage, compute, orchestration, governance, quality, and consumption. Translate architecture principles into pragmatic, implementable guidance for engineering and delivery teams. Assess and recommend emerging data and analytics technologies and platform features to implement as part of the platform roadmap Conduct design assurance and solution reviews across platform and product squads Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with enterprise architects, cloud platform, security and data governance to design holistic services for the business and customers Work closely with platform tenant teams to understand challenges and enable new features and capabilities for the organisation Translate business needs and data strategy into architectural blueprints and solution patterns Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical teams to align on priorities and progress Operational Excellence Work across the data function with Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Modelling and Business requirement to curate a set of design patterns to enable repeatable solution delivery Define architectural principles that optimise reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency Define guardrails for resilience, compliance, and security-by-design. Drive continuous improvement in design and solution engineering About You Qualifications Degree in a technical discipline (e.g. computer science, engineering, maths, physics) or evidence of equivalent practical experience Knowledge/Experience: Proven experience providing architectural leadership and influencing cross-functional technical Teams Strong technical hand on experience in designing, building and maintaining data platform in an Azure, Databricks and Fabric ecosystem Experience designing data platforms using Medallion or Lakehouse architecture. Strong understanding of data governance: lineage, cataloguing, metadata, RBAC, data privacy. Experience with Lamda and multimodal data systems History of delivering overall strategic architecture outcomes through diverse project deliveries Solid grasp of data engineering, business intelligence, artificial intelligence and modern development /deployment techniques Skills: Strategic thinker with curious mindset and strong problem-solving skills Ability to communicate complex concepts in a clear, concise manner Ability to balance innovation with enterprise constraints Experience …

items.desc: We're looking for an enthusiastic, customer-focused IT Support Analyst to join our IT team. You'll provide first-line support to colleagues across the UK, helping them get the most from their devices, applications, and cloud services. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys practical, hands-on IT work, including configuring laptops and mobile devices, deploying software, resolving technical issues, and supporting users. You'll also have opportunities to develop your skills in Microsoft 365, endpoint management, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies. Why Should You Apply? We are a privately owned archaeological business, part of the RSK Group, a leader in integrated environmental, engineering, and technical services. We provide heritage services to the development and construction sectors in UK and across the world. With four offices in England and one in Scotland, we offer our employees: Unique knowledge and expertise. For the past 30 years, Headland has provided not only business-focused archaeology but also people-focused business. We are highly respected within our industry for our achievements in innovation, tailor-made development coaching and training, and our expertise in commercial archaeology. Strong pioneering spirit. Our corporate culture is characterised by a healthy appetite for originality and development. Stable company with excellent growth. Over the years, we have demonstrated steady, positive economic development and formed successful partnerships. You will have opportunities for professional development and career progression Good work environment. You will be surrounded by colleagues who are pleasant, professional, and enthusiastic about their work. Work with modern technologies and gain exposure to IT security and cloud services Opportunity to influence. You get to work in an open climate, close to decision makers and with the possibility of making a difference. Part of RSK group. You will have further opportunities to become involved in nationally and internationally prominent projects with exciting prospects for career development. The group has c.17000 employees and c.230 environmentally lead companies. The role The role Our IT team supports over 240 colleagues across multiple UK offices and field-based project teams. This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team, build valuable technical experience, and develop your IT career. If you enjoy solving problems, supporting people, and working with technologies such as Microsoft 365, Intune, and Entra ID, this is a great opportunity to grow your career. Main areas you’ll focus on: Deliver first-line support for hardware, software, network, and end-user issues via ticketing system, email, phone, and in person Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across Windows, macOS/iOS, and Android platforms Support Microsoft 365 applications including SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and Exchange Online Configure, deploy, and support laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals, including user profiles, device setup, and password resets Perform device builds, imaging, and Out-of-Box Experience (OOBE) setups Manage user onboarding, account creation, permissions, and access via Active Directory and Entra ID Support mobile device management platforms such as Intune, JAMF, and Samsung Knox Assist with software installation, updates, patching, and system maintenance activities Maintain accurate records and documentation within our IT Service Management (ITSM) platform Support the full IT asset management lifecycle, from procurement and deployment to reconciliation, withdrawal, and sustainable disposal Monitor device compliance, security controls, and adherence to IT policies Escalate complex issues appropriately and collaborate with senior IT colleagues and third-party suppliers Deliver excellent customer service by keeping users informed throughout the resolution process Support business continuity, backup, disaster recovery, and change management activities Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance IT support services across the organisation Essential skills We recognise that no candidate will meet every requirement listed below. If you have a solid foundation in IT support, a positive attitude, and a willingness to learn, we encourage you to apply.
