items.desc: Redhill Surrey Based -Fixed Term Contract 12 months About Indra Group UK & Ireland Indra is a leading global technology and consulting company, and a trusted technological partner for the core business operations of its clients worldwide. It stands at the forefront of key sectors including Transport, Defence, Air Traffic Management and Space, alongside advanced Information Technology services delivered through Minsait, and cutting-edge capabilities in Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, and Cyberdefence via IndraMind. The company’s business model is built around a comprehensive portfolio of proprietary products, combining strong innovation with a high-value focus for customers. With more than 2,500 projects implemented across 50 countries and over 100 cities, Indra is a global benchmark in innovative transportation and mobility solutions. It is recognised as one of the world’s top three companies in public transportation management systems. Indra’s technology supports the daily journeys of over 78 million people, helping to reduce more than 10 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually, and helping save nearly 3,000 lives through improved traffic management and road safety. Indra Group is paving the way to a more secure and better-connected future through innovative solutions, trusted relationships and the very best talent. Sustainability sits at the heart of its strategy and culture, driving efforts to address current and future social and environmental challenges. In the 2024 financial year, Indra achieved revenues of €5.5 billion, over 60,000 professionals, maintained a local presence in 46 countries, and operated across more than 140 countries worldwide. As the technological partner for its customers’ key operations, Indra is at the core of their business, and Indra’s four values guide everything we do: Innovation - Our capacity for innovation, cutting-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enables us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology. Trust - We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society. Connection - We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers’ needs, supporting them on the path to a better future. Foresight - We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow. About the Project Transport for London (TfL) has awarded Indra a long-term contract to operate, develop, enhance and expand ticketing and access control systems across London’s transport network through to 2034, with extension options to 2039. This programme covers the maintenance, operation and evolution of a large-scale, complex ecosystem, including turnstiles, validators, ticket machines, sales terminals, back-office systems, payment gateways, IT infrastructure and cybersecurity that supports over 8.6 million daily journeys. Therefore, Indra will become TfL’s strategic technology partner to guarantee the operation and evolution of the world’s largest and most sophisticated ticketing system. Following a transition period of approximately two years, Indra will serve as the sole provider across the network that includes more than 8,500 buses, nearly 400 Underground stations, around 300 rail stations (Overground, DLR, Elizabeth Line and suburban services), 4,000 Oyster Card outlets, seven customer service centres, and 24 river boat boarding points. items.desc: Lloyd’s is the world’s leading insurance and reinsurance marketplace, bringing together the world’s leading risk takers to advance global progress. Our strategy is focused on delivering strong underwriting performance, operating an efficient and flexible marketplace, and maximising the capital advantage of the Lloyd’s market — while continuing to build a Lloyd’s we are proud of. How we deliver this, matters. We take the risk, make things happen, and own the outcome — working together across our global network to turn insight into impact. Lloyd’s are recruiting for an MI Analyst, Member Capital. This is an opportunity to work with the data at the heart of the Lloyd’s market. You’ll turn complex capital and reserving information into clear, useful insight, helping us understand performance, strengthen our oversight and make better-informed decisions. If you enjoy solving data problems, improving how information flows and finding the story within complex datasets, you’ll have plenty of scope to make an impact here. What you’ll be doing You’ll work across syndicate and member capital, combining data analysis, management information and continuous improvement. You’ll: Analyse large and complex datasets, identifying trends, outliers and insights that matter. Help develop and improve management information using tools including Excel, Power Query and Power BI. Support the processing, validation and audit of capital data submitted through Lloyd’s systems. Build and maintain reporting that tracks capital returns and business forecast submissions. Develop validation tools and improve how data moves into and out of capital models. Carry out analysis on member capitalisation and syndicate benchmark capital. Help answer data and capital-related queries from across the Lloyd’s market. Support the ongoing development of systems used by market participants to assess capital requirements. Maintain clear documentation, controls and audit information so our processes remain robust. Collaborate with colleagues across actuarial, risk, catastrophe and syndicate performance teams. It’s analytical work with a clear purpose: helping Lloyd’s maintain strong oversight while making our marketplace more efficient and effective. What you’ll bring We’re interested in what you can do and your potential to develop, not whether you tick every box. You’ll ideally bring: Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large datasets. Advanced Excel skills, including experience with Power Query. Experience with analytical or data tools such as SQL Server, R or Databricks, or a good foundation and the appetite to develop further. The ability to translate detailed analysis into clear information for different audiences. Excellent attention to detail and a logical approach to solving problems. Confidence managing your own priorities and delivering accurate work to deadlines. The ability to collaborate with people across different disciplines and communicate clearly. You’ll be of graduate calibre, ideally with a mathematical, analytical or finance-based background. Other relevant professional qualifications are welcome. Being inclusive at Lloyd’s is integral to how we work — and how we deliver impact. We aim to build a diverse, inclusive environment that reflects the global markets we serve, where everyone is treated with dignity and respect and supported to reach their full potential. We take the risk by challenging traditional thinking and being proactive about inclusion. That means being open and positive about workplace adjustments, prioritising health and wellbeing, and investing in diversity and inclusion training so everyone feels able to contribute and succeed. We make things happen by turning our commitment into action. Through employee networks, mentoring, volunteering opportunities and sustained investment in professional development, we create an environment where inclusion is experienced day‑to‑day — not just talked about. We own the outcome by focusing on impact. By bringing together diverse perspectives and the best minds in the industry, we work collaboratively with underwriters and brokers to create innovative, responsive solutions that share risk and solve complex problems across global markets. items.desc: The Advanced Clinical Practitioner bridges the professional and clinical boundaries between nursing and medical care, enabling them to take on the role and responsibilities formerly undertaken by medical staff. The ACP practises both autonomously and in partnership with the multidisciplinary team under the clinical supervision provided by a Paediatric Consultant and/or Middle Grades, whilst emulating the four pillars of advanced practice. It goes without saying you will be supported in the progression of your career as part of a forward-thinking team with strong clinical leadership. You will be supported by the established team of clinical practitioners, consultants and nurses so will always have a point of contact to bounce ideas off as well as agree the changes necessary to drive the service forward. We are working across boundaries with the ICB to design services that are innovative, responsive and child centred and inclusive. Our team is aiming for outstanding with CQC and you can be part of this exciting journey. No matter how much we try, it’s impossible to cram everything in just one advert, so we really welcome you to get in touch and have a chat with us to find out a lot more about joining us. The Advanced Paediatric Clinical Practitioner (ACP) is competent at undertaking advanced autonomous clinical practice working across traditional boundaries using assessment, decision making and diagnostic skills. By case managing patients, including independently ordering and interpreting investigations and prescribing, the ACP will safely and effectively provide care for paediatric patients and their families admitted to the Paediatric Assessment Unit. The ACP, although clinical approximately 80% of the time, also has a senior clinical leadership role within the Directorate, striving to constantly improve nursing care on the wards through developing new initiatives, undertaking audit and an active role in education, mentorship and supervision. The post holder will work closely with the Matron and Directorate Manager, Paediatrics and the senior paediatric team to ensure both the Directorate's local governance agenda and the national agenda for nursing and children is fully met. You will be working closely with our ACP lead to support continuous improvement, design pathways and ensure children and young people are recieving optimised health outcomes in line with our Trusts vision and values. We have 10000 fantastic people working hard to deliver quality services to our patients. Whatever your role, you help look after 370,000 people in our local area & give specialist care to 1.5 million people across Lancashire & Cumbria. Working with us gives you the knowledge and sense of pride that every activity you do genuinely does make a difference to support our patients & staff, ensuring we keep thriving & delivering outstanding healthcare right across our local towns. You'll have access to varied development opportunities, learn new skills, meet fab people & do things you'd never have done. You'll make an impact, be challenged to think differently, be bold & help innovate to keep improving things. Everything we do centres around patient care and enhancing their experience which means your role is pivotal and something really to be proud of. You will use clinical experience to make independent judgement’s to assess, investigate, diagnose, plan, implement, manage and evaluate clinical nursing and medical care and management of paediatric patients. The ACP will take a lead in the Paediatric Assessment Unit (PAU), which includes the identification, on-going assessment, treatment and discharge of PAU patients. Work within the multidisciplinary team to deliver advanced clinical nursing and medical practice, clinical leadership and provides clinical supervision/support and structured teaching and mentorship for multidisciplinary professionals (including medical staff) to facilitate ongoing education, training and development. Participation in audit, research and development initiating the implementation, evaluation and development of multidisciplinary guidelines and protocols, incorporating current best evidence in consultation with medical and nursing staff for the care of paediatric patients. You will promote the concept of clinical governance and work within agreed Trust/Unit protocols and guidelines. To practice autonomously with a high level of accountability at an advanced clinical level in the direct delivery of high quality care, making critical clinical decisions based on advanced clinical skills assessment. Plan and manage complete episodes of care, working in partnership with others and delegating and referring as appropriate to optimise health outcomes and resource use, as well as providing direct support to patients and clients To provide clear leadership and direction to support both the medical and nursing teams acting as a role model for the Trust, presenting a positive image to patients and staff. …

items.desc: This post is of a Locum Consultant in Gynae-oncology surgery who will work as a sub-specialist Gynae-oncology surgeon for a fixed term period of 6 months before being made permanent following satisfactory progression. The post holder will join the existing team of five consultants based at the Department of Gynae-oncology, Royal Surrey Foundation Trust, Guildford. The main aim of this post is to support succession planning for the department and to sustain activity across the department. This Consultant appointment is an exciting further step forward in the growth and development of the department, and we look forward to appointing a suitable candidate who will be able to collaborate well with colleagues, and draw on the established strengths of the department to consolidate the department’s performance as a whole, whilst also taking the initiative and opportunities to develop new areas of clinical interest and research. There is an academic element to this post and the appointee will be joint appointment with the University of Surrey and will contribute to the newly established School of Medicine. We are seeking an enthusiastic and innovative Consultant Gynaecological Oncology Surgeon with special interest and expertise in the management of vulval and ovarian cancer , and a leadership role in the development of the Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy (HIPEC) pathway for selected advanced ovarian cancer patients. The post is open to Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists (RCOG) accredited subspecialists in Gynaecological Oncology, or to subspecialty trainees in Gynaecological Oncology within 6 months of completing their training, pending successful completion of their RCOG Gynae-oncology subspecialty training programme. Candidates who wish to work a different number of programmed activities to that specified in the current job plan will be considered for this post, with negotiation on the content of the job plan on an individual basis. Core duties will involve performing elective Gynae-oncology surgery, undertaking specialist Gynae-oncology clinics, on-call activity and attending weekly regional Gynae-oncology MDTs. The appointee will also be expected to have IT skills and be able to manage the departmental database. The consultant will participate in departmental meetings, contribute to training, risk management and incident and policy reviews. It is expected that the post holder will have knowledge of root cause analysis, and participate in clinical governance. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96pMboIYdo Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. The post-holder will provide consultant-level care for patients with suspected and confirmed Gynaecological malignancies, in line with local and national cancer pathways. They will take part in elective operating theatre lists, including buddy operating arrangements, with three fixed sessions scheduled on 1 in 4 Mondays and 1 in 2 Thursdays, and will undertake additional theatre sessions as agreed in the job plan. As a minimum 5 additional 3 session lists would be expected to be covered over a 6-months period. For more details please refer tot he attached job description

items.desc: About us Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made. STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI. The role You own how we reach the commercial leaders at Europe’s largest manufacturers, and whether they reply. You plan and run the campaigns, make the calls, write the sequences, build the materials that get someone into a room, and keep the pipeline numbers our CRO takes to the board. You do all of it with AI tooling that lets one person cover what used to take a team, and you work directly with the CEO, CRO and CMO on what to try next. Tasks Run campaigns end to end. Plan, launch, and optimise outreach campaigns. Write, test, measure, iterate. Own outbound. Run cold calling, email sequences, and LinkedIn programmes targeting commercial leaders at Europe’s largest manufacturers, armed with the AI-recommended warm intro paths and account intelligence. Drive our paid channels. Organise, launch, and optimise paid campaigns, from targeting and creative through to spend decisions and attribution. Build materials that win meetings. Produce client documents, demos, and interactive presentations from our library of high-end content, using our templates and AI tooling. Fast turnaround, senior-team standard. Keep the engine clean. Log your activity, keep pipeline data spotless in HubSpot, and produce the weekly pipeline, coverage, and forecast numbers the CRO uses to manage the number and brief the board. Make our commercial engine sharper every week. New plays, new automations, new content for the library. What you build compounds. Use AI as a force multiplier. We are an AI-first company. You will use our AI tooling and automations to do the work of a team several times your size. Who this is for Most people who do well here have one to three years behind them in growth, sales development or commercial execution at a B2B software company, or a strategy background and a clear preference for doing the work over advising on it. You have run outreach yourself and can tell us the numbers: how many you sent, what came back, and what you changed when it didn’t work. You write well under constraint. Most of this job is persuading a busy executive in four sentences, and you know the difference between a cold email that lands and one that gets deleted unread. You reach for automation before you reach for repetition. HubSpot, Sales Navigator, sequencing tools and modern AI tooling are things you have used already, or will teach yourself over a weekend. You measure yourself on meetings booked and pipeline created. You are comfortable hearing that your campaign didn’t work, and quick to change it. This probably isn’t for you if you want a defined remit, a marketing role one step removed from the phone, or a job where someone else owns the number. What we offer Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company A highly competitive salary Direct access to Fortune 500 executives from your first months, at a level most people wait a decade for Work alongside former MBB consultants and Fortune 500 executives who will teach you directly — our team is small enough that this happens in person, not through a training curriculum Private healthcare Pension scheme 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays Work from abroad — up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time Hybrid office policy, with visa sponsorship available A company committed to social and environmental responsibility — we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes Practicalities London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office The process First round with our Talent Lead — 30 minutes Hiring Manager interviews with CRO – 30 minutes Stakeholder interview with CMO – 30 minutes Final interview with CEO – 30 minutes Any questions before you apply, email me at peninnah.onchere@stratos.tech.

Promoting a positive image of Coventry City Council through professional conduct and excellent customer service. All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK. Is willing to learn and develop new technical skills. Takes pride in producing work to a high standard. Has a positive attitude and strong commitment to health and safety. Works well as part of a team. Has good communication and organisational skills. Can accurately complete records and documentation. Is reliable, motivated and keen to contribute to the success of the service. Why join us? This is an excellent opportunity to develop valuable technical skills within a professional fleet maintenance environment. You'll work alongside experienced technicians, gain hands-on experience with a wide range of vehicles and equipment, and play an important role in supporting services that make a difference to the people of Coventry. If you're looking to build a career in vehicle maintenance and enjoy working in a practical, hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you. items.desc: Archivist Whitechapel Gallery, London £34,500 per annum | Permanent | Full time, 36.25 hours per week We are looking for an Archivist to join us at Whitechapel Gallery. Someone who loves caring for collections and sharing the pleasure of a good discovery. Someone who is curious about people and their stories and enjoys helping others explore them. Whitechapel Gallery has been part of East London since 1901. Our archive holds the stories of the artists, exhibitions and communities who have helped make the Gallery what it is today. Some will be familiar. Others are waiting for someone to take a closer look. As our Archivist, you will care for this history and help people feel welcome to explore it. From supporting someone’s first visit to helping a researcher find a missing piece, you will bring patience, knowledge and a friendly approach. We would love to hear from you if you enjoy looking after collections and helping people find their own connections with the past. About the role You will join our Participation team and report to the Director of Participation. You will work closely with colleagues across the Gallery, as well as artists, researchers and local communities. Your responsibilities will include: Caring for our physical and digital collections, including storage, handling and preservation. Cataloguing archive materials and maintaining records using AtoM. Developing our approach to digital preservation and digitisation. Supporting researchers, answering enquiries and managing access to the Reading Room. Working with colleagues and artists to develop archive activities and opportunities for public engagement. Helping departments identify and retain records of lasting historical value. Developing plans for Archive Service Accreditation. Managing the archive budget, loans and image reproduction requests. You’ll also help shape how we care for the collection during the Gallery’s future capital project. Working with us You will be part of a Gallery that brings artists, audiences and communities together. Our work is rooted in East London, with connections across the world. We care about whose stories are shared and who feels able to take part. In this role, you will have space to contribute your knowledge and ideas. You will work with colleagues who bring different experiences and perspectives. Your work will support research and learning, inform our programme and help people find their own connections with the Gallery’s history. We offer: 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing with service. Pension Enhanced family leave. An Employee Assistance Programme, including a 24-hour helpline and up to six counselling sessions. Training and development opportunities, including an annual £200 travel grant. A Cycle to Work scheme. Staff discounts in our bookshop and café, subject to availability. Curator-led exhibition tours and opportunities to enjoy our programme. Some evening and weekend work will be required. This is compensated through time off in lieu. To apply: Please complete the application form and diversity monitoring form, and return to recruitment@whitechapelgallery.org by 10:00am on Monday, 30 November 2026. Interviews will take place on Monday, 14 December 2026 and Tuesday, 15 December 2026. We believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our work and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, communities and experiences. items.desc: The University of Wolverhampton is developing its advanced manufacturing, materials and engineering capability through a growing portfolio of research, knowledge exchange and industry-focused activity. Knowledge Exchange Trainer The University of Wolverhampton is developing its advanced manufacturing, materials and engineering capability through a growing portfolio of research, knowledge exchange and industry-focused activity. Building on the capabilities established through the Elite Centre for Manufacturing Skills (ECMS), the University is developing plans to establish the UK Centre for Green Electric Materials and Manufacturing (GEMM) as part of the Wolverhampton Green Innovation Corridor (GIC). The ECMS/GEMM team is responsible for supporting and delivering a growing portfolio of externally funded programmes, including the Supply Chain Transition (SCT) programme, LIPF FORGE and Henry Royce Institute activity. These programmes bring together the University, industry, regional partners and funding bodies to support innovation, advanced manufacturing, research and economic growth. The Springfield facility provides advanced manufacturing and materials capability spanning material and feedstock characterisation, additive and subtractive manufacturing, non-destructive evaluation and destructive testing. These capabilities support externally funded research and innovation programmes, collaborative R&D, industry engagement, commercial activity and the University's wider research and knowledge exchange objectives. The Knowledge Exchange Trainer will provide dedicated knowledge exchange, practical training and applied manufacturing delivery capacity within the ECMS/GEMM team. The role will support externally funded programmes, commercial projects, research collaborations and continuing professional development (CPD) through industry-focused training, technical demonstrations, knowledge transfer and practical project activities. Combining specialist manufacturing expertise with practical training and knowledge exchange, the post holder will also undertake manufacturing, materials processing, testing and characterisation activities to support agreed programme, project and commercial outputs. Purpose The Knowledge Exchange Trainer will support the delivery of the University's advanced manufacturing, research and innovation activities through practical training, continuing professional development (CPD), technical demonstrations and knowledge exchange with industry partners, academic colleagues, researchers and other stakeholders. The Knowledge Exchange Trainer will develop and deliver practical training and knowledge transfer activities using the University's specialist manufacturing, materials processing, testing and characterisation facilities. This will include supporting the development of independent equipment competence, transferring specialist manufacturing knowledge and contributing to agreed outputs across externally funded programmes, commercial projects and collaborative research activities. The role will also involve undertaking hands-on manufacturing, materials processing, testing, characterisation and associated technical activities to support funded programme delivery, commercial projects and research requirements. The post holder will operate specialist equipment independently where appropriately trained and competent, contributing directly to agreed technical outputs, project milestones and deliverables. Working as an embedded member of the ECMS/GEMM team, the post holder will contribute to equipment utilisation, the development of new manufacturing capabilities, safe working practices and the continued growth and sustainability of the University's advanced manufacturing activities. items.desc: Bring more to life Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Molecular Devices, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. Join Molecular Devices and help drive scientific discovery for life science customers in academia, biotech, pharma, and government. Our automated and AI-enabled technology empowers researchers to tackle complex questions and gain deep insights, accelerating the development of safer, more effective therapeutics. As part of our team—rooted in collaboration, authenticity, and innovation—you’ll ultimately contribute to ground breaking science that enhances lives globally and shapes a healthier future for all. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. We are seeking a highly motivated Regional Controller EMEA to join our European Finance team leading our European Controllership function. Reporting to the European Finance Director, you will be responsible for four European legal entities, ensuring compliance with both local and US GAAP across statutory and management accounting. This position has four reports and involves close partnership with the European FP&A team, the business operations and the US corporate team. As part of the European finance leadership, you will play a key role in engaging and developing the wider finance team and driving process improvement initiatives across the region. The role is based on-site at our Winnersh Offices in Wokingham, UK and may require travel to our Austrian and US sites. In this role, you will have the opportunity to: Lead the monthly, quarterly and annual management reporting cycles for the European legal entities ensuring full compliance to US GAAP and accounting policies and collaborating closely with the European Finance team in UK and the US Corporate. Lead the preparation of annual statutory accounts for the European legal entities in accordance with local GAAP and oversee accurate tax filings including VAT, Corporate income tax and withholding taxes. Maintain a strong control environment ensuring clean balance sheets, effective design and operation of controls and timely compliance with all deadlines. Support the FP&A team with forecasting and budgeting for both local entities and the wider European business. Act as the primary point of contact for external partners, auditors, and regulatory authorities, managing audit requests and fostering collaborations across functions. Lead, motivate and develop a high performing European finance team with strong collaboration with the US Corporate team. Champion a culture of continuous improvement , designing and implementing efficient standardised processes to enhance accuracy and effectiveness. The essential requirements of the job include: ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent accounting qualification with minimum 5 years post qualification experience Multi-GAAP expertise , the role covers UK, Austrian, German and French entities, reporting into a US GAAP parent. Proven track record in dynamic, fast-paced global environments with strict compliance to deadlines and controls. Specific expertise in a US Corporate environment preferable Experience of leading and developing engaged and motivated teams Excellent communication skills , adept at engaging diverse internal and external stakeholders Advanced proficiency in finance systems and excel . Experience with Oracle financials preferred but not essential. Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team. 
 We are looking for a Test Professional 
 You’ll make a difference by: 
 We are seeking an experienced Software Test Engineer with 2+ years of hands-on experience in software testing. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, the ability to understand business and system requirements, and experience in designing, documenting, and executing comprehensive test cases. The candidate should be comfortable working in Linux environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality software delivery. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Analyze and understand business, functional, and system requirements. 
 Review requirements and provide feedback to ensure testability and completeness. 
 Create detailed test specifications, test scenarios, test cases, and test data. 
 Develop and maintain test documentation, including test plans and test reports. 
 Execute manual and/or automated test cases and document test results. 
 Identify, log, track, and verify defects through closure. 
 Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing. 
 Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to resolve issues and improve product quality. 
 Participate in requirement reviews, sprint planning, and other Agile ceremonies. 
 Ensure software releases meet quality standards and business expectations. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 2-4 years of experience in software testing and quality assurance. 
 Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). 
 Proven experience in requirement analysis and understanding complex system workflows. 
 Experience in writing clear and comprehensive test specifications and test cases. 
 Strong experience in test execution, defect management, and reporting. 
 Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments, including basic command-line operations and log analysis. 
 Experience with defect tracking and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, ALM, Azure DevOps). 
 Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. 
 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 Hands-on experience of AI tools and Copilot 
 Preferred Skills 
 Exposure to test automation tools and frameworks. 
 Knowledge of SQL and database testing. 
 Experience with JIRA, Polarion, Sharepoint and video recording tools. 
 Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 
 Experience in distributed or enterprise-scale applications. 
 Your success is grounded in: 
 2-4 years of experience is required. 
 Great Communication skills. 
 Analytical and problem-solving skills 
 Ability to work independently in a global and multicultural environment. 
 Commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement. 
 Join us and be yourself! 
 We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. 
This role is based in Pune , where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.

items.desc: This opportunity offers an AI and machine learning specialist the chance to develop intelligent digital health tools that help occupational health professionals identify workforce health risks earlier and improve care. The role combines practical software development with applied research and collaboration with occupational health specialists. College / Directorate College of Engineering, Design & Physical Sciences Full Time / Part Time Full Time Posted Date 16/11/2026 Closing Date 07/12/2026 Ref No 5266 Documents Job Description (Word , 85.71kb) KTP Associate - AI Software Developer – 17133 College/Department: College of Engineering, Design and Physical Sciences/Department of Computer Science – Brunel University of London (BUL) / Kinseed Limited Location: Boundary House, Cricket Field Road, Uxbridge, Middlesex, UB8 1QG Salary: Up to £45,000 per annum, dependent on experience Hours: Full-time Contract Type: Fixed term 24 months The Role This opportunity offers an AI and machine learning specialist the chance to develop intelligent digital health tools that help occupational health professionals identify workforce health risks earlier and improve care. The role combines practical software development with applied research and collaboration with occupational health specialists. Based primarily at Kinseed, you will develop predictive models and agentic AI workflows for its MediWork platform, designing and evaluating solutions for health surveillance triage, summarisation, workflow automation and practitioner-supervised decision support, with emphasis on explainability and cost-effectiveness. Collaborating with Kinseed engineers, occupational health practitioners and Brunel researchers, you will translate AI research into validated, scalable features using efficient language models, retrieval-augmented generation, model optimisation and robust validation, alongside project management and knowledge transfer. This 24-month Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) between Brunel University London and Kinseed Limited offers professional development, advanced training and industry-academic collaboration. The Company Kinseed Limited is a UK digital technology company supporting over 60 NHS organisations and occupational health providers. Its cloud-based MediWork platform supports referrals, case management, health surveillance and workforce health services. Kinseed aims to make occupational health more proactive and data-driven, offering the chance to develop impactful AI products alongside technical leaders and customers. The University Brunel University London was established in 1966 and is a leading multidisciplinary research-intensive technology university delivering economic, social and cultural benefits. For more information, visit: https://www.brunel.ac.uk/about/our-history/home Led by Brunel’s Department of Computer Science, the KTP draws on expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning and applied research to develop explainable, efficient and trustworthy AI for workforce health. Academic supervision will be provided by Dr. David Bell and Dr. Weibo Liu. The candidate Applicants must hold an MSc in Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in machine learning and software development. A PhD in AI or machine learning is advantageous. Candidates need experience designing, coding, testing and evaluating machine learning workflows, strong Python and AI/ML library skills, familiarity with version control, and the ability to analyse data and produce clear technical documentation. Experience in agentic or generative AI, small language models, retrieval-augmented generation, model optimisation or explainable AI is advantageous. Experience analysing health data is desirable. The Associate must work effectively across university and industry teams, communicate clearly, manage multidisciplinary activities and deliver projects independently and systematically. Benefits The position offers these benefits: A £4,000 personal development budget and access to Innovate UK sponsored KTP training courses, including management and leadership development. 10% of working time allocated to development activities throughout the project. Access to BUL’s resources. The potential for a permanent role with Kinseed after the project, helping develop and scale MediWork’s AI capabilities. This would depend on performance, business needs and career aspirations; a permanent position is not guaranteed. Closing date for applications : 7 December 2026 For further details, visit: https://careers.brunel.ac.uk For technical issues, email: hrsystems@brunel.ac.uk Brunel University London has a strong commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion. Our aim is to promote and achieve a fully inclusive workforce to reflect our community.

items.desc: Vous souhaitez enrichir vos compétences dans le domaine du nucléaire et acquérir de l’expérience professionnelle grâce à un expert dans votre domaine ? N’hésitez plus et rejoignez le CEA ! L’objectif de ce stage est donc d’améliorer et d’étendre l’algorithme de traitement d’images BYG-drop, développé au laboratoire, pour des conditions plus variées et complexes. Dans un premier temps, le stagiaire se familiarisera avec cet outil, qui repose sur le logiciel de rendu 3D Blender et sur deux réseaux de neurones appartenant à des familles différentes, GAN et CNN. Sur la base de cet algorithme et d’une base de données d’images expérimentales déjà constituée, le stagiaire pourra améliorer la méthode en entraînant un réseau de neurones YOLO plus récent, fondé sur une approche de segmentation. Ce dernier permettra notamment la détection et la caractérisation d’objet de forme non-sphérique et complexe. En fonction des besoins du stage et du profil du candidat, la base de données d’images expérimentales pourra être complétée. Une fois l’apprentissage supervisé réalisé, les performances du réseau seront évaluées et comparées à celles d’autres méthodes de traitement d’images. Enfin, la méthode développée pourra être appliquée à différents écoulements polyphasiques, notamment pour la caractérisation de bulles dans des réacteurs nucléaires ou de gouttes dans des procédés de retraitement du combustible usé. Vous intègrerez les équipes de l’Institut des Sciences et technologies pour une Economie Circulaire des énergies bas carbone – ISEC. Moyens / Méthodes / Logiciels Python, CNN, YOLO, segmentation, computer vision, blender, git Profil du candidat PARLONS DE VOUS ! Vous préparez un Bac+5 en traitement d'images et intelligence artificielle. Vous êtes doté (e) d’une grande capacité de traitement d'images, traitement de données et d'intelligence artificielle. Vous faites preuve de curiosité, de rigueur et d’une bonne capacité d’adaptation. Un niveau d'anglais courant est obligatoire. Postulez ! PARLONS DE NOUS : Intégrer le CEA c'est : S’inscrire dans un cadre de recherche, de développement et d’innovation possédant une culture, un patrimoine et des installations uniques avec un esprit de responsabilité et de durabilité. Se voir offrir des perspectives de carrière et un éventail de possibilités considérable avec notamment plus de 60 familles de métier ; le CEA permet ainsi d’envisager un parcours riche et varié. Le CEA est un acteur engagé dans l’accueil, l’insertion et le maintien dans l’emploi des salariés en situation de handicap. Ainsi, si vous le souhaitez, vous pouvez également joindre tous documents justifiants de votre situation de handicap (RQTH, carte mobilité inclusion, pension d’invalidité, etc). items.desc: Tu as envie de mettre tes compétences et ton énergie au service du renouvellement des générations agricoles ? Rejoins l'équipe d'Eloi ! Au sein de l'équipe technique, et en lien avec la direction, le marketing, les opérations terrain et les partenariats, tu contribueras à trois axes structurants pour Eloi : 1. Développement de notre plateforme eloi.eu — la 1ère plateforme de recherche de fermes en France Notre plateforme eloi.eu est au cœur de notre mission : elle permet de diffuser les annonces de fermes à reprendre ou des recherches d’associés, et de mettre en relation les porteurs de projet agricoles avec les agriculteurs cédants. Améliorer et faire évoluer la plateforme en continu. Comprendre les besoins et les difficultés des porteurs de projet et des cédants, en lien avec les directrices commerciales. Concevoir et expérimenter des algorithmes de recommandation pour proposer la bonne ferme au bon porteur de projet (matching cédants ↔ repreneurs). Construire des systèmes de notation / scoring (qualité d'une candidature, pertinence d'un profil, probabilité de transmission) pour fluidifier le parcours des cédants et des porteurs de projet. Identifier des solutions, prototyper, tester et analyser les retours. Déployer de nouvelles features à grande échelle et suivre leur adoption. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des parcours utilisateurs et du SEO. 2. Structuration de la data & pilotage "data-driven" Devenir la première plateforme de recherche de fermes suppose d'objectiver chaque décision business, tech et produit grâce à la donnée. Tu travailleras avec Amélie, la Directrice Technique, pour : Contribuer à construire/opérer un modèle de données fiable Mettre à disposition des tableaux de bord qui permettent aux équipes de piloter leur activité et challenger les besoins/demandes des équipes en priorisant grâce à la donnée Faire émerger des insights via l'IA : détection d'anomalies, segmentation automatique, prédiction de conversion, analyses sémantiques sur les candidatures et annonces. Identifier les leviers business, produit ou tech à prioriser. 3. Amélioration des process internes — automatisation & IA Pour que l'équipe Eloi soit toujours plus efficace et agile, nous avons besoin d' optimiser nos process internes par l'IA et l'automatisation , afin que chacun puisse se concentrer sur les tâches à forte valeur ajoutée. Aller au contact des équipes métiers pour comprendre les process existants et identifier les leviers d'amélioration (gain de temps, qualité, fiabilité). Concevoir et déployer des assistants IA métier (évaluation de candidatures, génération de contenus, qualification de leads, synthèse automatique d'entretiens, etc.). Proposer et mettre en place des optimisations : automatisation, prompts LLM, intégration d'API IA, no-code / low-code… Travailler au quotidien dans notre CRM interne Salesforce, à partir duquel nous pilotons l'ensemble de nos données. Construire et maintenir des automatisations no-code (Zapier, n8n…) et améliorer nos workflows autour de Salesforce. Concevoir des workflows robustes, documentés et faciles à maintenir. Tester, déployer et suivre l'adoption des améliorations auprès des équipes. Tu es étudiant·e en césure ou dernière année d'une école d'ingénieur ou équivalent, avec un profil généraliste, débrouillard·e et curieux·se, et une forte appétence pour le produit, la tech et l'IA ! Tu as envie de construire des choses concrètes avec : algorithmes de recommandation, scoring, optimisation de process, assistants LLM, agents… Tu es force de proposition : tu aimes sortir du cadre, explorer de nouveaux outils techniques, imaginer des solutions innovantes et expérimenter. Tu sais analyser un problème, structurer un raisonnement et proposer des solutions concrètes. Tu es organisé·e, rigoureux·se et autonome ; tu sais prioriser et mener un projet de bout en bout. Tu communiques très bien, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, et tu sais vulgariser les sujets tech. Tu as une approche pragmatique et orientée impact : ton objectif est d'aller vite, de manière efficace, pour maximiser l'impact d'Eloi. Bonus : tu as déjà expérimenté des projets IA / data, des outils no-code, des automatisations ou de l'UX/UI. 2 tours d'entretien : Entretien initial avec Amélie, directrice technique Étude de cas suivie d'un débrief de 30 min Autres informations : Stage de 6 mois à Lyon ou à Paris Début du stage : Janvier/Février 2027

We denken echter niet zo graag in hokjes en nauwe rollen. We zetten je dus graag ook breder in en geven je ruimte om je te ontwikkelen. Je hebt zelf de regie in handen zodat je kunt doen waar je goed in bent. Binnen de dynamische omgeving van Deal Advisory, opereer jij moeiteloos. MPC, RAG, document analyse); Experimenteren met LLM‑modellen en agentic workflows om nieuwe ideeën snel te valideren; Werken met Python, C# en waarnodig TypeScript (pre) om schaalbare applicaties te bouwen; Automatiseren van taken voor onze corporate finance teams. items.desc: Functieomschrijving Wil jij ervaren hoe het is om AI niet alleen technisch te begrijpen, maar ook écht werkend te maken binnen een organisatie? Heb jij interesse in AI, data, technologie én consultancy? Dan is deze stage binnen ons Data & AI-team misschien wel jouw volgende stap! Vanaf februari 2027 zoeken wij een stagiair(e) Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Data Science die gedurende 3 tot 12 maanden meewerkt aan interne AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H. Met deze stage krijg je de kans om jouw technische vaardigheden te combineren met consultancyvaardigheden: van het bouwen of onderzoeken van AI-oplossingen tot het ophalen van behoeften bij stakeholders en het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen onze organisatie. Wat ga je doen? Tijdens deze leerzame stage ga je aan de slag met interne AI-oplossingen en innovatieprojecten. Afhankelijk van de behoefte vanuit de business werk je zelfstandig aan projecten binnen het team. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld bijdragen aan: het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van AI-tools die interne processen efficiënter maken; het in kaart brengen van processen binnen interne teams en onderzoeken waar AI kan helpen/ondersteunen; het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen IG&H, bijvoorbeeld door mee te denken over trainingen, communicatie of praktische toepassingen van tools zoals Copilot; het doen van onderzoek naar nieuwe AI-producten, toepassingen of proposities; het vertalen van technische mogelijkheden naar concrete businesswaarde; samenwerken met andere collega’s binnen Data & AI. Over het team Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Ons Data & AI-team bestaat uit ruim 40 data-experts, waaronder Data Scientists, Data Engineers en Consultants. Samen realiseren zij innovatieve data-, analytics- en AI-oplossingen voor klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health. Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen. Voor professionals die impact willen maken is dit een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Hier bouw je niet alleen mee aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan de verdere groei van het Data & AI-team zelf. Wat wij verwachten van jou: We zoeken een leergierig en analytisch sterk persoon die energie krijgt van AI, data science en consultancy. Je vindt het leuk om technologie te begrijpen, maar minstens zo belangrijk: je wilt ontdekken hoe je technologie toepasbaar maakt voor mensen en organisaties. Je brengt mee: Je volgt bij voorkeur een masteropleiding in de richting van Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Econometrie, Natuurkunde, Wiskunde, Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische/kwantitatieve studie; Je hebt ervaring met Python; Je vindt het leuk om met stakeholders in gesprek te gaan en behoeften goed uit te vragen; Je kunt technische onderwerpen helder uitleggen aan mensen met verschillende achtergronden; Je bent sociaal, nieuwsgierig en proactief; Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels; Je bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Ervaring met SQL, API’s, Azure of AI-tools zoals Copilot is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Belangrijker vinden we dat je nieuwsgierig bent, snel leert en zin hebt om jezelf inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen. Wat wij jou bieden: Bij IG&H krijg je de kans om in korte tijd veel te leren binnen een ambitieus en betrokken Data & AI-team. Je werkt aan een eigen project, krijgt goede begeleiding en maakt kennis met de praktijk van consultancy en technologie. Verder bieden wij jou: Een stage binnen een Great Place to Work met een prettige sfeer en enthousiaste collega’s; De kans om mee te werken aan concrete AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H; Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s binnen het Data & AI-team; Begeleiding door een buddy en mentor vanuit de organisatie; Veel ruimte om jouw technische én consultancyvaardigheden te ontwikkelen; Een inspirerend kantoor in Utrecht; De mogelijkheid om na enige tijd in overleg deels thuis te werken; Teamactiviteiten, borrels en een open, ondernemende werksfeer; Een contract van 3 tot 12 maanden en een vergoeding tussen de € 700 en € 900,- bruto per maand. Waarom IG&H? Met meer dan 650 getalenteerde collega’s hebben we een unieke cultuur gecreëerd die zowel high caring als high daring is. We dagen elkaar uit om grenzen te verleggen, maar doen dat altijd vanuit vertrouwen, samenwerking en plezier. Als deze stage bij je past, dan is IG&H een mooie plek om je verder te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt de kans om veel te leren in korte tijd, je eigen ideeën in te brengen en te ontdekken hoe het is om te werken binnen …

Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Venez découvrir le site de Moirans, Un site à taille humaine avec un très bel environnement. Venir travailler à Moirans c'est : une ambiance conviviale et chaleureuse, des projets intéressants en ingénierie, les montagnes à proximité. La division Systèmes Critiques développe des détecteurs de rayons X destinés à l’imagerie médicale. Afin d'améliorer la qualité des images produites, les équipes travaillent sur l’analyse avancée du contenu des radiographies en s’appuyant sur des méthodes innovantes de traitement d’image. Dans ce cadre, des travaux de recherche récents ont permis de développer de nouvelles méthodes de caractérisation des images radiographiques reposant sur leur décomposition à l’aide d’un dictionnaire optimisé. Des bases de données d’images sont aujourd’hui disponibles et doivent permettre d’évaluer ces approches sur un large panel de situations. L’objectif du stage sera d’appliquer ces méthodes aux bases d’images existantes afin d’en mesurer les performances, de mieux comprendre leurs limites et d’identifier les pistes d’amélioration possibles. Une ouverture vers l’utilisation de techniques d’ intelligence artificielle et de Deep Learning pour accélérer certains calculs pourra également être étudiée. Vous Serez Amené à Prendre en main les bases de données d’images radiographiques disponibles ; Étudier les méthodes d’analyse développées dans le cadre des travaux de recherche précédents ; Appliquer ces méthodes sur différents jeux de données et évaluer leurs performances ; Analyser les résultats afin d’identifier les points forts, les limites et les axes d’amélioration ; Explorer l’apport potentiel de l’IA et des réseaux de neurones pour accélérer certains traitements ; Présenter et documenter les résultats obtenus. Votre profil Vous recherchez un stage de fin d’études de 6 mois minimum ? Vous préparez un diplôme d’ Ingénieur Bac+5 ou un Master 2 spécialisé en traitement d’image , vision par ordinateur , intelligence artificielle ou mathématiques appliquées . Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des problématiques de traitement d’image et maîtrisez la programmation scientifique en Python , Matlab ou équivalent. Des connaissances en Deep Learning ou en réseaux de neurones seraient appréciées. Votre curiosité scientifique, votre rigueur et votre capacité d’analyse sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnait ? Alors ce stage est fait pour vous ! Le mot de l’équipe Vous aurez l’opportunité de travailler sur un sujet concret et exigeant, à la frontière entre l’imagerie médicale et l’intelligence artificielle. Ce stage constitue une excellente opportunité pour approfondir vos compétences en traitement d’image et peut s’inscrire dans une perspective de poursuite en thèse CIFRE , dans la continuité des travaux de recherche déjà engagés par l’équipe. Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: About The Job For over 100 years, Danone has been supporting people worldwide with its 146 delicious brands. Located in over 120 countries with more than 89,000 employees across production sites, warehouses, headquarters, and R&D center, Danone continually develops iconic products. Certified as Bcorp and Happy Trainees, Danone strives to be a better company for the world, its consumers, and its employees. YOUR MISSIONS AT DANONE This internship will take place in Rueil Malmaison, at our headquarters starting from January 11th 2027. Xuanhao Hu, Senior Data Scientist in the Data Science team will guide you through your day to day tasks and help you grow in your role. Around half of your time is spent on the missions below; the other half is self-directed Help build an internal AI agent from first sketch to a tool a colleague can actually use. You will not be handed a finished spec we will frame the problem together, and you will see how a product goes from an idea to something that ships. Design the interface with us user journeys, information architecture, interaction and UI design, Figma prototypes, and the details that make an interface feel finished — states, edge cases, and a clean handoff to whoever builds it. Use AI coding harnesses as your daily tools Codex, Hermes, PI, DeepSeek or an equivalent, every day, as your main way of building. We care less about prompting tricks than about the habit of reviewing what the agent produced and checking that it actually works. Learn to measure what you build with our help, define what success means for the agent (task completion, time saved, error rate, user confidence) and run simple evaluations instead of guessing. Nobody expects you to design the measurement framework alone. Prototype in code and write it down build small front-end prototypes (React or plain JavaScript), write a little Python when it helps, use Git/GitHub, and keep notes so the next person can pick up where you stopped. Use the other half of your time your own way half of this internship is yours to explore. Dig into Danone's internal GitHub repositories and FMCG-related projects, follow your own research, and turn what you find into small proof-of-concepts for our industry — Finance, Marketing, Manufacturing, R&I, or anywhere else you spot an opportunity. Come back with a demo, a short write-up, or an idea for what we should build next. The Benefits Of This Internship Up to 2 days/week of remote work Full reimbursement of Navigo pass/TCL subscription "Vendredi je grandis" program development every Friday afternoon covering career, soft skills, and hard skills. INTERNSHIP Compensation from €1,300 (Bachelor's +4 and gap year) to €1,500 (Bachelor's +5) gross/month. APPRENTICESHIP Your compensation will depend on our salary scale based on your age and level of study. Benefits company restaurant, gym, bike parking About you For this position, we are looking for someone Available from January 11, 2027 for a duration of 6 months At the level of Bac+5 (or equivalent) in design, engineering, business or a hybrid path — we care more about the mix of design sensitivity and technical curiosity than about the label on your diploma. Who feels comfortable working in English, both written and spoken, in an international environment. French is a plus, not a requirement. Who has already played with an AI coding harness — Codex, Hermes, PI, DeepSeek, Cursor or similar — even on a school project, a hackathon or something personal. We do not expect mastery we expect you to enjoy it, and to pick up the habit of checking the agent's output instead of trusting it. With some design or product training — coursework, a previous internship, or personal projects — and an eye for UI/UX you can sketch a user journey, build a first prototype in Figma, and explain your choices. Design systems, accessibility and engineering handoff are things you will learn here, with us. Comfortable with numbers able to read a chart, define a simple metric and work in a spreadsheet. Basic Python or SQL is a plus — we will teach you how we evaluate an AI agent's output. Who has written a little code and wants to write more HTML/CSS, some JavaScript or Python, and Git basics. You do not need to be an engineer — you need to be able to build and debug a small prototype with our help. No prior professional experience required. This is an internship and it is meant to be a place to learn you will work alongside a Senior Data Scientist, ask questions freely, and show unfinished work without being judged on it. Nice to have, not required 3D or spatial interfaces, voice interfaces, hackathon or side-project portfolios. items.desc: En Thinkia construimos sistemas de IA que se integran en el trabajo diario de las empresas. Buscamos a alguien que pueda sentarse con un equipo, entender cómo funciona un proceso y desarrollar una solución que llegue a producción, en nuestras oficinas de Madrid o de Avila. Puede ser un flujo de facturas que necesita extraer datos, comprobarlos y enviarlos al ERP. O un proceso interno que combina documentos, reglas de negocio y varios sistemas. La IA es parte de la solución; también lo son las integraciones, las pruebas y saber qué hacer cuando algo falla. El trabajo Trabajarás directamente con equipos de negocio y tecnología de grandes empresas de sectores regulados e industriales. Participarás desde las primeras conversaciones hasta el despliegue y el traspaso al equipo que vaya a operar la solución. Usarás la plataforma de agentes de Thinkia y contribuirás a mejorarla con lo que aprendas en los proyectos. Tu foco será automatizar procesos de negocio con IA y conseguir que funcionen de forma fiable en el entorno del cliente. Qué harás Entender los pasos de un proceso, sus excepciones y qué necesita el cliente para darlo por bien resuelto. Construir flujos que combinen reglas, llamadas a modelos y agentes, con validaciones y revisión humana cuando haga falta. Automatizar procesos documentales, desde la recepción y extracción de datos hasta su validación e integración con otros sistemas. Conectar las soluciones con ERPs como SAP, bases de datos Oracle y APIs internas, mediante APIs o servidores MCP según el caso. Desplegar los flujos en el entorno del cliente y resolver cuestiones de identidad, permisos, secretos y conectividad. Preparar pruebas y evaluaciones, revisar trazas y medir calidad, tiempos y costes. Hacer demos, recoger feedback y ayudar al equipo del cliente a utilizar y mantener lo que has construido. Queremos a alguien que pueda avanzar con autonomía y que sepa cuándo necesita aclarar una regla de negocio, pedir ayuda o simplificar una solución. Qué buscamos Experiencia desarrollando software en producción, con Python como lenguaje principal. Como referencia, pensamos en alguien con unos cuatro años o más, aunque valoraremos la experiencia concreta y la responsabilidad que puedas asumir. Haber construido aplicaciones con LLMs que hayan pasado del prototipo al uso real. Nos interesa que puedas explicar qué funcionó, qué falló y cómo lo evaluaste. Una buena base de APIs, integración de sistemas, SQL, pruebas, Git y CI/CD. Experiencia desplegando y operando servicios con Docker. Capacidad para hablar con cliente, entender un proceso y explicar decisiones técnicas con claridad. Inglés suficiente para leer documentación y participar en reuniones. Valoramos especialmente experiencia con workflows durables, extracción documental, evaluaciones de LLMs e integraciones empresariales. Haber trabajado con SAP, procesos financieros, MCP o en consultoría también ayuda. Con qué trabajarás Python es nuestro lenguaje principal para este puesto. Utilizamos Temporal para la ejecución de flujos, LiteLLM para el acceso a modelos y Langfuse para observabilidad y evaluaciones. Según el proyecto, también trabajarás con MCP, extracción documental, RAG y bases vectoriales como Milvus. La plataforma utiliza Docker, Keycloak, OpenBao y Backstage, y desplegamos en AWS y Azure. Trabajamos con Claude, modelos de OpenAI y modelos abiertos o locales según las necesidades del cliente. No necesitas haber utilizado todo este stack. Sí necesitamos que entiendas los fundamentos y puedas aprender las herramientas que requiera el proyecto. Qué encontrarás en Thinkia Participación en proyectos de IA que llegan a producción, desde la definición del proceso hasta su puesta en marcha. Una plataforma propia de agentes y un equipo que ya trabaja en estos despliegues. Contacto directo con las personas que usarán tus soluciones y visibilidad sobre sus resultados. Formación y certificación en IA generativa. Cómo será el proceso Revisión de candidatura. Revisamos tu experiencia y los proyectos que quieras compartir para comprobar el encaje inicial con el puesto. Prueba práctica breve, antes de la entrevista. Si vemos encaje, te enviaremos un caso ficticio de automatización, con datos de ejemplo y un alcance acotado. La dedicación máxima será de 60 minutos; no esperamos que sigas trabajando una vez agotado ese tiempo. Podrás usar las herramientas de IA que prefieras y entregarás solo el código, sin README, vídeo ni memoria. Antes de empezar conocerás las condiciones del puesto y los criterios de evaluación. Conversación técnica de 45–60 minutos. Si la prueba encaja con lo que buscamos, hablaremos contigo sobre la solución, tus decisiones y tu experiencia. También tendrás espacio para conocer al equipo y preguntar por el trabajo. Conversación final. Resolveremos las dudas que queden sobre las responsabilidades y las condiciones. En la prueba valoraremos cómo entiendes el proceso, cómo separas las reglas de negocio del trabajo del modelo, cómo …

items.desc: Internship contract | Belval | 6 Months Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: How will you contribute? In social human-robot interaction, robots communicate with users through speech, gestures, and facial expressions. However, users may still find it difficult to understand what the robot has perceived, why it has provided a particular instruction, or what it intends to do next. This internship, conducted as a collaboration between the VISINT and HUMOD groups, explores the integration of Mixed Reality (MR) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve communication and collaboration between humans and social robots. The goal of this internship is to explore how a system composed of a social robot, a Mixed Reality interface, and an agentic AI layer can support a human operator during a task. The system will build on existing work using AI-based methods for providing instructions and assistance to human operators. The agentic AI layer will use information from the interaction and the surrounding environment to decide what information should be presented to the user through the robot and the Mixed Reality interface. During the internship, you will learn to design and implement such a system and connect the Mixed Reality application to the robotic platform. Your internship will focus on enhancing the interaction by providing visual cues, highlighting relevant objects, displaying instructions and spatial annotations, and showing when the system requires confirmation or additional information. The system will be evaluated to study how these additional visual elements can improve understandability, trust calibration, situation awareness, and cognitive workload. During the internship, the trainee will: Develop foundational knowledge in social human-robot interaction, Mixed Reality, agentic AI, and human factors. Acquire hands-on design and development skills by creating a Mixed Reality application connected to a robotic platform and an AI backend. Gain practical experience in the integration of diverse technologies ranging from robotics and AI to Mixed Reality. Learn user experience evaluation methodologies and explore measurement techniques for assessing understandability, trust calibration, situation awareness, cognitive workload, and task performance. Gain experience in research and innovation skills. You will join the VISINT team, led by Roderick Mc Call. Is your profile described below? Are you our future trainee? Apply now! Education Master’s student in computer science, human-computer interaction, AI, robotics, XR technologies, or related fields. Experience and skills Programming experience (preferably C#/Unity and Python). Familiarity with AR/VR development, AI/LLMs, robotics, or human-centered design. Motivation to explore AI-driven human-robot interaction and emerging Mixed Reality technologies. Prior exposure to Unity, OpenXR, ROS, or LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) is a plus but not mandatory. Language skills Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset. items.desc: Joining our DX (Digital Transformation) AI & Automation team, you will turn machine learning and Generative AI ideas into robust, production-ready solutions that reshape how Sony Europe works and makes decisions. Side by side with other data scientists and engineers, you will own AI initiatives end-to-end: discovering high-value opportunities, experimenting fast, and scaling the projects that make a visible difference to the business. This is an applied, end-to-end role for people who want to move beyond experimental demos. You will work directly with internal customers and colleagues across Sony Europe to deliver production-grade AI solutions solving real business challenges. This role is being offered on a 9-month fixed-term basis to support parental leave cover . Candidates must have the legal right to work in the country. You Will Partner with team members across DX and business functions throughout Sony to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape concrete projects. Handle the AI lifecycle: data pipelines, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and iteration, according to MLOps/LLMOps methodologies. Work closely with IT, software engineering and infrastructure teams to design scalable, compliant, production-grade inference setups and end-to-end solutions. Define and track success metrics for AI solutions, evaluate model and system performance (including user feedback), and iterate to improve business impact. Typical projects include building AI agents to assist internal teams and external customers or to automate business processes. You Will Bring University degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Engineering or similar). Professional experience as a data scientist, AI engineer, or similar role. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, deep knowledge of standard ML libraries (scikit-learn, pandas, etc.) plus experience in using agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, OpenAI Agents, or similar). Hands-on experience taking ML/AI solutions from PoC to production on cloud platforms (ideally Azure) using MLOps/LLMOps standard methodologies. Good communication and customer management skills. Excellent organisation and time-management skills, with experience prioritising and delivering multiple projects. Fluent in English. Preferred Qualifications Professional experience in applying AI/ML to customer marketing or supply-chain optimisation use cases. Professional experience in building and deploying AI Agent applications. Understanding of data privacy, regulatory constraints (e.g. EU AI Act) and responsible AI principles, and ability to design solutions with these constraints in mind. Experience delivering AI/ML into real business workflows, with first-hand exposure to challenges such as change management, user adoption, data quality and integrating with legacy systems.
