items.desc: Voor deze gerenommeerde internationale onderneming te Tienen zijn we op zoek naar een gedreven Data Engineer Jouw takenpakket bestaat uit onder andere: Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van data architectuur en pipelines Zorgen voor een efficiënte dataflow over verschillende systemen ter ondersteuning van collega's zoals data scientists, data analisten, business analisten etc. Automatiseren van data-input, transformatie en opslag workflows Data processing/orchestration (via Apache Spark & Airflow) Zorgen voor een uitstekende datakwaliteit standaard opdat alle data accuraat en compleet beschikbaar is Monitoring en optimalisatie .... Je kan moeilijke technische concepten duidelijk en eenvoudig overbrengen naar niet-technische gebruikers Wat is het aanbod? items.desc: About The Role Grade Level (for internal use): 10 The Team The GSAC Bond Pricing team delivers independent evaluated prices and analytics across government, supranational, agency, and corporate bond markets, evaluating more than 260,000 bonds intraday using a proprietary pricing platform and a broad range of market data sources. Our prices underpin some of the most critical financial-market workflows in the industry: index construction, price discovery, risk management, regulatory reporting, and NAV calculations for leading global financial institutions. You will join a collaborative, structured team where you will take meaningful ownership of defined coverage sectors, supported by dedicated training programmes and the expertise of senior colleagues, building deep fixed income expertise from day one. Responsibilities And Impact As Specialist, GSAC Bond Pricing, you will play a central role in producing and enhancing the evaluated prices that financial markets depend on, developing sector expertise, applying cutting-edge analytical tools, and contributing to the innovation of our pricing workflows: Build EMEA fixed income expertise across government, supranational, agency, and corporate bond sectors — gaining real-time exposure to how macroeconomic developments, market events, trading activity, and liquidity conditions drive valuations across a 260,000+ bond universe. Analyse market and pricing data to investigate bond price movements, valuation questions, and pricing anomalies — applying Excel, Python, and SQL to deliver accurate, high-quality evaluated prices in a time-sensitive market environment. Apply AI and generative AI tools to support market research, data analysis, and pricing investigations — developing practical skills in responsible AI application including data validation, explainability, and appropriate human oversight within financial-market workflows. Identify and deliver workflow improvements by combining AI, automation, and traditional analytical techniques to streamline repetitive processes, accelerate analysis, and enhance the efficiency and quality of pricing operations. Propose and develop new tools and analytics — contributing ideas for AI-enabled workflows, automation solutions, and analytical innovations that elevate analyst productivity, pricing quality, and the broader client experience. Collaborate across pricing, commercial, and client-facing teams to address pricing queries, communicate methodologies clearly, and contribute to strategic client and product initiatives over time. What We're Looking For Basic Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Investment, Risk, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative or financial discipline Demonstrated proficiency in data analysis using at least one of: Excel, Python, or SQL, applied to financial or quantitative problem-solving Proven ability to investigate complex problems, interpret quantitative data, and draw well-reasoned, evidence-based conclusions in an analytical context Demonstrated commitment to accuracy and quality in time-sensitive, data-intensive environments, with a track record of delivering precise outputs under deadline pressure Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams and explain analytical findings clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences Additional Preferred Qualifications Previous experience in a capital markets environment such as bond pricing, valuations, risk, trade support, market data, or investment operations Prior exposure to working within an asset manager, hedge fund, investment bank, or financial data provider Working knowledge of fixed income instruments, bond mathematics, or derivatives valuation methodologies Practical experience using AI or generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for research, analysis, coding, or workflow automation Experience managing competing priorities and maintaining accuracy in fast-paced, market-driven environments Exposure to index construction, NAV calculation, regulatory reporting, or risk management workflows within fixed income markets Additional Information Employees are required to work from the office a minimum of two days per week. We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer. About S&P Global Market Intelligence At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction. items.desc: Wat jij mag verwachten Als Data Analyst help je meebouwen aan ons centrale datamodel en de semantische laag. Je werkt met moderne tools zoals Microsoft Fabric, DBT en Power BI en krijgt de kans om je verder te ontwikkelen in datamodellering en analytics binnen een ervaren team. Je rapporteert aan de Teamlead Resource Pool Data en werkt voornamelijk op de gold layer, waar je businessnoden helpt vertalen naar consistente en gebruiksvriendelijke datamodellen. Zo ziet jouw takenpakket eruit Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en onderhouden van businessgerichte datamodellen in DBT. Je ondersteunt de verdere uitbouw van het centrale datamodel (gold layer). Je past bestaande standaarden rond modellering, naming conventions en versioning toe. Je helpt data uit verschillende bronnen integreren tot bruikbare en consistente datasets. Je draagt bij aan de kwaliteit, consistentie en herbruikbaarheid van data. Je werkt nauw samen met data engineers en andere collega's binnen het datalandschap. Je helpt businessvragen vertalen naar KPI's, measures en semantische definities. Je ondersteunt self-service analytics via duidelijke datasets en goede documentatie. Je denkt mee na over optimalisaties binnen het dataplatform. Je deelt actief kennis en bouwt stap voor stap expertise op binnen data-analyse en datamodellering. Wat wij verwachten Must-haves Eerste relevante ervaring in data-analyse, business intelligence of datamodellering Goede kennis van SQL Basiskennis van datamodellering en analytische concepten Ervaring met Power BI of een vergelijkbare BI-tool Sterke analytische vaardigheden Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een samenwerkingsgerichte houding Leergierigheid en interesse in moderne dataplatformen Nice-to-haves Ervaring met DBT Kennis van Microsoft Fabric of een vergelijkbaar dataplatform Basiskennis van dimensionele modellering (facts & dimensions) Kennis van Git Interesse in data governance en datakwaliteit Ervaring in een agile/scrum-omgeving

items.desc: Aquent is proud to partner with a pioneering global technology leader dedicated to revolutionizing how millions of individuals and businesses manage their financial lives. In this dynamic role, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of customer experience and operational efficiency on a global scale by building AI-ready data foundations, driving actionable insights, and directly influencing how customers interact with world-class products. By turning raw data into compelling strategic narratives, your work will directly optimize customer journeys and empower key decision-makers worldwide. The Opportunity We are seeking an exceptional, analytical mind to join a collaborative team operating at the heart of international market growth and operational excellence. Working alongside engineering and business stakeholders, you will help design robust, scalable data pipelines and deliver deep-dive analytics that solve complex business challenges. This role offers an exciting platform to work with groundbreaking, AI-native analytics, allowing you to innovate, experiment, and champion data-driven strategies that elevate the entire customer lifecycle. What You’ll Do Collaborate with engineering teams to build robust data foundations, develop scalable pipelines, and establish clear metric definitions for international markets. Develop data capabilities that function consistently across multiple regions while adapting to local regulatory, language, and workflow requirements. Automate recurring reporting and validation processes to boost accuracy and optimize data structures for downstream AI consumption. Create and maintain scalable, user-friendly dashboards that provide comprehensive visibility into key performance metrics across the customer journey. Deliver deep-dive analytics and conduct root cause analyses to uncover drivers of customer pain points and operational inefficiencies. Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations that optimize staffing, routing decisions, and reduce escalations. Advance AI-native analytics by leveraging Generative AI tools to automate insight generation and support anomaly detection. What You’ll Bring Solid professional experience in data analytics or data science, ideally with exposure to customer success, operations, or digital experience domains. Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and pipeline development. Hands-on experience with dashboarding and visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or similar industry standards. Familiarity with big data tools like Snowflake, Databricks, or Spark, alongside solid ETL process knowledge. Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable narratives for diverse audiences. Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic priorities and tactical execution in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, growth-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and innovation. Stand Out Qualifications Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics, automation, or experimentation support. Knowledge of statistical methods and experimentation, including A/B testing. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: 1. Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) 2. In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). items.desc: We're creating a data platform that enables cutting-edge health research at unprecedented scale. As a Data Engineer, you'll play a critical role in designing and building the secure, high-quality data pipelines that power research used by scientists and healthcare innovators around the world. This is an opportunity to work with some of the UK's most valuable health datasets, transforming complex requirements into robust, secure, and scalable data solutions. While technical excellence is important, success in this role is defined by your ability to build pipelines that are reliable, compliant, and secure when handling sensitive health data. You'll work closely with Engineering Managers, Lead Data Engineers, researchers, and domain experts to deliver data products that make a real-world impact. We're looking for a Data Engineer who can take a design or architecture document, understand the intent behind it, and confidently build a secure, scalable solution. You don't need experience with every tool in our stack. We're far more interested in engineers who understand good data engineering principles, can design secure pipelines, and can translate technical requirements into reliable solutions. At Our Future Health, our mission is to transform the prevention, detection and treatment of conditions such as dementia, cancer, diabetes, heart disease and stroke. We're looking for people to join us on our journey. If you're looking for a new challenge where you can contribute to helping future generations live in good health for longer, then we're keen to speak with you. What you'll be doing Building and maintaining data pipelines across our Azure-based platform Translating technical specifications, architecture designs, and Jira tickets into secure, scalable implementations Developing data transformation and ETL processes using Python and PySpark Working with healthcare and NHS datasets to curate trusted, research-ready data assets Reviewing and approving code through pull requests, ensuring consistency, quality, security, and adherence to engineering standards Collaborating with researchers, engineers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions Identifying risks, challenging assumptions, and asking the right questions to improve designs before implementation Producing documentation, source-to-target mappings, and supporting technical standards across the platform Contributing to best practices in data engineering, security, governance, and cloud architecture What you won't be doing Working in a siloed environment with no freedom to make decisions. Working in a place where you can't see the impact your expertise makes. Requirements To succeed in this role you will need to demonstrate some of the following skills and experience: Proven experience building production-grade data pipelines and ETL processes Excellent Python skills with experience developing scalable data solutions Experience working with PySpark or distributed data processing frameworks Experience using GitHub and modern software engineering practices Understanding of cloud-based data platforms, ideally Azure Experience working with sensitive or regulated data and knowledge of secure data handling principles Ability to review technical designs and architecture documents and translate them into practical implementations Excellent problem-solving skills and an ability to challenge requirements constructively when needed Experience conducting code reviews and maintaining engineering standards Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills Experience working with NHS or healthcare datasets Knowledge of healthcare coding systems and standards such as SNOMED CT, ICD, or READ codes Experience with Databricks Experience with Kubernetes Experience using Dagster or other workflow orchestration platforms SQL and data modelling experience Understanding of metadata management and data governance frameworks Many Data Engineering roles focus primarily on building pipelines. This role is different. Here, the greatest challenge is ensuring that every pipeline is secure, governed, auditable, and trustworthy. You'll be working with sensitive health data that has the potential to transform research outcomes, making security, quality, and engineering judgement just as important as technical delivery. If you're an engineer who enjoys solving complex data problems, questioning assumptions, and building secure systems that make a meaningful difference, we'd love to hear from you. Benefits Salary from £62,000 per annum. We are interested in applications from people with a range of experience for this role Generous Pension Scheme - We invest in your future with employer contributions of up to 12% 30 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays - Enjoy a generous holiday allowance with the flexibility to take bank holidays when it suits you Enhanced Parental Leave - Supporting you during life's biggest moments Cycle to Work Scheme - Save 25-39% on a new bike and …

Samen met je collega's moderniseer je het datalandschap, met volop ruimte om te experimenteren met predictive & generative AI, AI-agents, machine learning en procesautomatisering . Het datadomein van Liquid Food beheer je: databasebeheer, architectuur, datamodellen, documentatie, datakwaliteit, continuïteit en doorontwikkeling; Betrouwbare datapipelines ontwikkel en onderhoud je van bronsystemen naar het datawarehouse en de rapportageomgeving, voornamelijk met SQL ; Beschikbaarheid, volledigheid, juistheid en tijdigheid van data bewaak je, en structurele oorzaken van dataproblemen los je op; Semantische modellen, dashboards en rapportages bouw je, en informatiebehoeften vertaal je naar heldere KPI's en self-service; Aan businessgedreven projecten zoals tender-, pricing- en kostprijstools draag je bij, van concept tot beheer — zo sla je de brug tussen organisatie, processen en techniek; Monitoring, logging, autorisaties en versiebeheer richt je in, met aansluiting op de centrale architectuur-, privacy-, security- en datagovernancekaders; Kansen voor automatisering en voorspellende inzichten signaleer je, en continue verbetering stimuleer je via data- en procesanalyse. Job Requirements Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar, en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie; Ervaring hebt met SQL (3+ jaar), SSIS/SSDT, SSRS, SSAS en Power BI (semantische modellen en rapportage), plus dimensioneel modelleren en Data Vault-modellering ; Pré: Scrum, Microsoft Fabric, Python, Spark en Azure Data Factory; Conceptueel denkt én praktisch handelt: je overziet architectuur en datastromen en vertaalt complexe vragen naar robuuste, werkende oplossingen ; Businessgericht, kritisch en verbindend bent, de taal van business én IT spreekt, en proactief eigenaarschap neemt; Goed communiceert in Nederlands en Engels , in woord en geschrift. Je bereidt bent om eens in de anderhalve week vanuit Barneveld te werken (must)! Wat bieden wij? Een passend salaris tussen € 3.651,- tot € 5.014,- bruto per maand, een laptop van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld , een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling; Ruimte om te ondernemen : een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen; Hybride werken vanuit Rotterdam, thuis en ongeveer eens per anderhalve week vanuit Barneveld (richtlijn bij fulltime: 3 dagen kantoor, 2 dagen thuis), inclusief thuiswerkvergoeding en flexibele werktijden; Volop ruimte om te blijven ontwikkelen via de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen, e-learnings en webinars; Oog voor elkaar : een fijne werksfeer met ruimte voor plezier, een inhouse gym en een caring- en vitaliteitsbudget. Enthousiast? Herken jij jezelf in deze rol en wil je het datalandschap van Liquid Food mee vormgeven? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Nog vragen? Neem contact op met Angel Micheal Alemawor , interim corporate recruiter, via +31 6 11804991 of Aalemawor@denhartogh.com .

items.desc: Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility? Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere. BG R&D WCE Engineer – Krakow, POLAND Job Description As a BG R&D WCE Engineer, you support the deployment and sustainability of the World Class Engineering (WCE) methodology within the Business Group R&D organization. You contribute to the implementation of WCE pillars, promote the WCE culture through communication initiatives, support Cost Deployment activities, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to monitor performance and drive operational excellence across engineering functions. Key Responsibilities WCE Deployment and Promotion Support the deployment and sustainability of the World Class Engineering (WCE) methodology across the BG R&D organization. Promote the WCE mindset and culture through SharePoint and internal communication channels. Contribute to the deployment and monitoring of WCE pillar activities. Support the communication and visibility of WCE initiatives, achievements, and best practices. Cost Deployment Participate in Cost Deployment activities to increase understanding of the financial impact of operational and engineering activities. Support the functional tracking and validation of savings generated through performance improvement initiatives. Monitor and confirm forecasted savings and contribute to the reporting of results. Assist in collecting and analyzing data related to cost performance and efficiency improvements. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with WCE pillar leaders to support deployment activities and ensure alignment across functions. Foster a collaborative network between pillar leaders and stakeholders. Encourage the sharing of knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices across the organization. Engineering and Project Monitoring Support activities related to engineering applications, project management, quality, and PMO through WCE deployment and monitoring activities. Contribute to the follow-up of key performance indicators and deployment objectives. Assist in monitoring project progress and ensuring alignment with WCE standards and methodologies. Profile You are passionate about engineering excellence and structured ways of working. You enjoy working with different teams and building strong relationships across functions. You are analytical and interested in understanding the impact of engineering activities on business performance. You hold a degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, or a related field. You have an interest in manufacturing systems, engineering processes, and operational performance. You are comfortable working with data analysis, KPIs, and performance reporting. You have good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools; experience with SharePoint is an advantage. You possess strong communication and collaboration skills. You are fluent in English and able to work in an international and multicultural environment. You are fluent in English and another language is a plus Duration 12 to 24 months, beginning asap Location Krakow, Poland Contract V.I.E – As Part Of The Reinforcement Program Of Youth Employability, Business France Created The V.I.E Contract For Young European. To Be Eligible To The Program, One Must Be Between The Age Of 18 To 28 Years Old, Have a European Citizenship And Have Never Worked In The Country Where They Apply To. You Can Find More Information On The Website Of Business France https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/ At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward. Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You’ll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow’s automotive industry. Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions. With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R&D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition.

items.title: Pricing Analyst
items.card: About The Role... The Pricing Analyst supports pricing and revenue decisions by turning pricing, competitor and customer data into clear insight. Working with the Senior Analytics Manager, Pricing Manager and teams across Marketing, Finance and Operations, this role helps assess pricing performance, model the impact of changes and recommend opportunities to improve revenue, member acquisition and retention.
items.desc: Role: Pricing Analyst Location: Hybrid (Clapham Junction 3 days per week, remote 2 days per week) About Us... We're one of the UK's leading fitness businesses. With more than one million members, 265+ gyms and ambitious plans to keep growing, we're the UK's second-largest gym operator by membership and the fourth largest in Europe. Our mission is simple: to break down barriers to fitness for all. We're large enough to make a meaningful difference, but agile enough for individuals to influence how we grow. Technology, data and new ideas play a central role - and you'll have the opportunity to take ownership, challenge how things are done and see the impact of your work. Just as importantly, we're a people-first business where everyone is encouraged to be themselves. We've been named one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work and awarded Investors in People Gold, alongside a host of other awards recognising our culture and our people. About The Role... The Pricing Analyst supports pricing and revenue decisions by turning pricing, competitor and customer data into clear insight. Working with the Senior Analytics Manager, Pricing Manager and teams across Marketing, Finance and Operations, this role helps assess pricing performance, model the impact of changes and recommend opportunities to improve revenue, member acquisition and retention. Responsibilities Analyse pricing, sales, customer and market data to identify trends, risks and commercial opportunities. Assess the potential impact of pricing decisions through scenario modelling and forecasting. Evaluate completed pricing initiatives to measure their commercial impact and identify lessons. Support the design and analysis of pricing tests and experiments, including set-up, measurement and post-test recommendations. Monitor pricing performance and produce regular reporting on revenue and competitor pricing. Maintain pricing models and related reporting tools. Present findings clearly, explaining the commercial implications and recommended actions. Help improve pricing processes, data quality and analytical approaches. About You... 2-3 years of experience in an analytical role - pricing, commercial analytics, revenue management or financial analysis are all relevant backgrounds Strong SQL skills and the ability to work with large datasets independently. Solid Excel skills, including financial and scenario modelling. Experience evaluating promotions or running controlled experiments, including measurement and post-analysis. Clear communication skills - you can explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders in plain language. A commercial mindset - you understand how price, demand, volume and margin relate to each other. Need assistance? If you have a disability or condition that makes it difficult for you to complete your application online please email your cv to recruitment@thegymgroup.com or alternatively call the TGG Recruitment team on 0203 319 4838 and someone will be more than happy to support you. We also want to put it out there that we actively encourage applications from a diverse demographic and we are passionate about your culture and value alignment. We want this to be a match that works for you as much as for us! Please note that we may close the application window early if we receive high levels of interest. If you're interested in applying please do so asap! Your application may be reviewed by an AI tool to help assess your suitability based on the information you provide. Automated decision-making is never used - every application is reviewed and all decisions, including whether to progress your application, are made exclusively by a member of our recruitment team. Your data will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and UK GDPR. If you have any questions about how your information is used, please contact recruitment@thegymgroup.com .

WAT GA JE DOEN Als trainee werk je via detachering aan uiteenlopende projecten bij verschillende opdrachtgevers. Denk aan banken, verzekeraars, overheidsinstanties, energiebedrijven en uitvoeringsorganisaties. Zo leer je waar knelpunten ontstaan, hoe besluitvorming plaatsvindt en waar procesoptimalisatie het verschil maakt. Jouw uiteindelijke ambitie is het werken aan vraagstukken binnen bijvoorbeeld de bancaire sector, de publieke sector of de energiemarkt. Denk aan het verbeteren van klantprocessen, het optimaliseren van ketens of het begeleiden van teams in verandertrajecten. Waar jouw eindstation ook ligt – jij zet jouw talent in voor de toekomst van Nederland. JOUW ONTWIKKELTRAJECT Je werkt aan meerdere projecten bij verschillende opdrachtgevers, waardoor je een breed scala aan ervaringen opdoet. Je leert werken met diverse processen, methodieken en vraagstukken en ontdekt gaandeweg waar jouw talenten het beste tot hun recht komen. Door deze afwisseling ontwikkel je niet alleen vakinhoudelijke vaardigheden, maar ook inzicht in wat wel en niet bij je past. Elke opdracht draagt bij aan jouw groei. Zo bouw je stap voor stap aan jouw carrière als procesprofessional met een sterke basis én een scherpe focus. BEGELEIDING & PERSOONLIJKE ONTWIKKELING Je staat er bij ons niet alleen voor. items.desc: Intro Bei Arvana bauen wir die erste AI-native Go-to-Market-Firma in DACH. Seit 2024 sind wir auf über 5 Mio. € ARR und mehr als 30 Leute im Team gewachsen, und wir legen gerade erst richtig los. Über 200 Unternehmen wie Swisscom, monday.com, Enpal, Talkdesk und FreeNow setzen bereits auf uns. Als Founders Associate übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung für strategische Projekte, baust Prozesse mit Tools wie n8n und Claude auf und treibst sie eigenständig voran. Starten kannst du ab sofort. Aufgaben Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für die Finanzplanung, von der Budgetierung bis zum Forecast, und entwickelst skalierbare Prozesse für nachhaltiges Wachstum. Du findest Optimierungspotenziale und automatisierst operative Abläufe mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code und OpenClaw und Plattformen wie n8n, Make.com und Zapier. Du baust moderne Business-Intelligence-Strukturen auf, zum Beispiel mit Snowflake und Looker Studio, und schaffst so datengetriebene Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Du bist Sparring für unsere Gründer bei strategischen und operativen Entscheidungen und bringst eigene Perspektiven in den Wachstumsprozess ein. Du entwickelst neue Business-Ideen und Go-to-Market-Strategien und setzt sie von 0 auf 1 um. Du schaffst Klarheit in komplexen Themen durch saubere Analysen, strukturierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen und klare Umsetzungspläne. Qualifikation Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch sicher und überzeugend, denn unsere Kunden sitzen in DACH. Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du hast deinen Bachelor oder Master abgeschlossen und 1 bis 3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in schnellen Umfeldern wie Startups, Consulting oder VC gesammelt. Führung: Du hast erste Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeitende oder Praktikanten zu führen, und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran. Unternehmergeist: Du interessierst dich für den Aufbau von Unternehmen und willst ständig Neues lernen. Arbeitsweise: Du bist zielstrebig, proaktiv und übernimmst Verantwortung. Anspruch: Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an dich und andere und motivierst dein Umfeld mit einer Can-do-Mentalität. Englisch: Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Englisch. Benefits Coaching & Karriere: Ab Tag 1 lernst du in 1:1-Coachings von erfahrenen Leuten. Und weil wir so schnell wachsen, entstehen laufend neue Fach- und Führungsrollen. Nicht mehr kochen: Jeden Abend ab 19 Uhr bestellen wir Essen fürs Team. 3+2 Hybrid Work: Drei Tage arbeitest du mit dem Team im Office, bis zu zwei Tage remote. Top Lage & Ausstattung: Unser modernes Office liegt in Berlin-Mitte, zwischen Hackeschem Markt und Alexanderplatz. Du arbeitest mit erstklassiger technischer Ausstattung, inklusive MacBook. Deutschlandticket inklusive: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Ticket. Strategy-Offsites: Regelmäßig nehmen wir uns als ganzes Team raus und arbeiten gemeinsam an der Strategie und Zukunft von Arvana. Kostenlos trainieren: Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du ohne Zusatzkosten. Bereit mit uns die deutsche B2B-Software Branche zu entwickeln? Sneak Peek: So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab Kurzes Kennenlernen Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns schnell bei dir. In einem 20-minütigen Call lernen wir uns kennen und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob wir zusammenpassen. Personal Fit Im zweiten Gespräch, das ca. 30 bis 45 Minuten dauert, lernen wir dich richtig kennen und erfahren, was dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig zeigen wir dir, wie wir bei Arvana arbeiten, und beantworten all deine Fragen. Case Study vor Ort & Meet the Team Vorab bekommst du eine Case Study aus unserem Alltag, die du zu Hause vorbereitest und dann bei uns im Office in der Rosenstraße 17 vorstellst. Dabei lernst du unsere Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und kannst mit dem Team quatschen. In ca. 90 Minuten nehmen wir dich mit in unsere Prozesse, unsere Mission und unseren Business-Plan. Danach melden wir uns innerhalb von 2 Tagen bei dir.

Who we are ivee is building the platform that helps everyone actually adopt AI, the layer between powerful models and the people who need to use them. We have an AI Learning App that sits inside your AI tools, helping you get better at AI as you work. Our consulting and upskilling services sit on top, so teams get the tech and the hands-on support to make it stick. Our north star is simple: no-one should get left behind as AI changes the way we work. Our clients include Lucky Saint, Red Bull, and Deliveroo. We have been named the UK Government's primary AI upskilling events partner and have trained over 1,000 teams. We recently closed a $1M seed round backed by Steven Bartlett and partners at Microsoft AI, Balderton Capital, and Dawn Capital. We move fast, operate with high ownership, and are led by co-founders Amelia Miller (Cambridge Fellow) and Lydia Miller (ex-Deloitte Ventures), both recently named Forbes 30 Under 30. items.desc: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d) Build an AI-native company with us. Über NXT NXT Applied ist eine AI Operations Company aus Düsseldorf. Wir bauen und betreiben KI-Systeme für regulierte Branchen in DACH, und machen damit Banken, Versicherungen, MedTech-Companies & Co. zukunftssicher. Gegründet im März 2026 sind wir mittlerweile ein Team aus über 10 Leuten und schnell wachsend. Wir arbeiten KI-nativ in jeder Rolle, mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, Raum für persönliches Wachstum und Kreativität. Die Rolle Als Forward Deployed Engineer arbeitest Du direkt in unseren Kundenprojekten, genau dort, wo NXT Core, unsere Betriebsschicht für KI-Agenten in regulierten Umgebungen, auf den Betrieb des Kunden trifft. Du nimmst ein Workflow-Design und machst daraus ein laufendes, auditierbares KI-System in einer Bank, einer Versicherung oder im Gesundheitswesen - mit echten Fällen, echten Daten und echten Konsequenzen. Du verantwortest das Deployment von der Architekturentscheidung bis zum Incident um 21 Uhr. Das ist weder Support noch Konfiguration: Der Wert entsteht in der Lücke zwischen „läuft in der Demo“ und „trägt den Prozess“. NXT Core entsteht dabei nicht im Labor, sondern in diesen Projekten – was Du baust, läuft vom ersten Tag an in Produktion. Woran Du arbeitest Deployment in Produktion: Du übersetzt Workflow-Designs in laufende Systeme auf NXT Core und passt die Architektur an die reale Umgebung des Kunden an: Kernsysteme, Dokumentenablagen, Sammelpostfächer, Legacy-Abläufe. Du verantwortest die Integrationen (APIs, Dateischnittstellen, ERP-Anbindungen, Identity, Datenflüsse), baust das System in Staging auf, härtest es und nimmst es live. Agenten mit klaren Leitplanken: Du entscheidest, was ein Agent eigenständig entscheiden darf und wo Regeln, Validierungen oder eine menschliche Freigabe greifen. Du baust die Kontrollen ein, die das System für Aufsicht und interne Revision nachvollziehbar und erklärbar machen. Arbeit beim Kunden: Du sitzt in der Realität des Kunden – am Schreibtisch der Sachbearbeitung, im IT-Meeting, im Lenkungsausschuss. Du gewinnst das Vertrauen der Menschen, die die Fälle bearbeiten, und der Führungskraft, die den Vertrag unterschrieben hat, und bringst das, was Du im Betrieb lernst, schnell zurück ins Systemdesign. Zuverlässigkeit & Governance: Du verantwortest Observability, Logging, Retries, Idempotenz und Fehlerbehandlung. Du baust Bereitschaft und Incident-Prozesse für ein reguliertes Umfeld auf und sorgst dafür, dass sich das System auch um 23 Uhr debuggen lässt. NXT Core weiterbauen: Du erkennst, was wiederverwendbar ist, und bringst es zurück in den Core. Jedes Deployment soll das nächste schneller machen – Einzellösungen, die sich nicht auszahlen, baust Du nicht. Anforderungen kommen bei uns selten sauber definiert an. Wir sind früh: Das hier ist Aufbauarbeit – finanziert, bewusst gewählt und bereits in Produktion, aber Aufbauarbeit. Wir suchen jemanden, der genau das reizvoll findet. Dein Team Du bist Teil eines kleinen, sehr erfahrenen Teams aus Engineers, Delivery und Geschäftsführung. Im Alltag arbeitest Du eng mit Matthias (Gründer & Geschäftsführer), unserem Core-Team und den Fach- und IT-Teams unserer Kund:innen. Du passt zu uns, wenn … Du einen starken Backend-Hintergrund hast: Python, Go oder TypeScript, mindestens eine Sprache in der Tiefe. Du hast verteilte Systeme, APIs und workflow-basierte Architekturen selbst entworfen. Du Produktionsinstinkt mitbringst: Idempotenz, Retries, Logging, Monitoring, Bereitschaft und Incident-Handling sind für Dich Alltag, nicht Theorie. Du LLM-basierte Systeme und tool-basierte Agenten-Architekturen bereits selbst gebaut hast oder nachweislich schnell in neue Infrastruktur hineinfindest. Du Dich beim Kunden wohlfühlst: in laufenden Projekten, in unaufgeräumten Umgebungen, mit unvollständigen Anforderungen. Du Coding Agents als selbstverständlichen Teil Deiner Arbeit siehst. Du fließend Deutsch und Englisch sprichst – die Rolle arbeitet direkt mit Kund:innen in DACH. Du regelmäßig bei unseren Kund:innen vor Ort sein kannst. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Workflow-Engines, Dokumentenverständnis, Case-Management-Systemen, ERP- oder Kernbank-Integrationen oder in regulierten Branchen. Rahmendaten Vollzeit, unbefristet Standort Düsseldorf; München oder Berlin ist möglich mit regelmäßiger Präsenz bei unseren Kund:innen in NRW Hybrid, mit regelmäßigen Tagen vor Ort bei Kund:innen in DACH Start, sobald es Deine Kündigungsfrist erlaubt Festgehalt plus leistungsabhängigen Bonus, jährliches Gehaltsgespräch Stack: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, Celery und Go im Backend, TypeScript und React im Frontend, Claude Arbeit in einem kleinen, senioren Team ohne Investorendruck, das selbstständig und KI-nativ arbeitet Die Perspektive, mit dem Unternehmen zu wachsen und NXT Core und Delivery mitzuprägen So bewirbst Du Dich Bewirb Dich über diese Anzeige oder schreib Matthias direkt – er liest jede Bewerbung selbst. Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder den …

items.desc: Data Platform Engineer Utrecht | tot €105k OTE | Bouw self-service data platform infrastructuur voor de migratie van Synapse naar Databricks Krijg je energie van het bouwen van self-service data platform infrastructuur waar data teams dagelijks op vertrouwen? Vind je het mooi om een migratie van Azure Synapse richting Databricks mee vorm te geven en de platform architectuur opnieuw in te richten? Onze klant is een van de grootste logistieke en eCommerce bezorgers ter wereld. In Utrecht werken ruim 180 engineers aan software, data en platform producten. Daarnaast werken er ook teams intern aan groene energie oplossingen voor duurzaamheid, dus er is een breed scala aan data vraagstukken om aan te werken. De organisatie zit midden in een grote migratie van Azure Synapse richting Databricks, wat betekent dat er een hoop services gebouwd moeten worden en de platformarchitectuur opnieuw wordt ingericht. Dat maakt dit een goed moment om in te stappen in een modern data platform dat je zowel bouwt als laat groeien. Jouw rol: Als Data Platform Engineer bouw je de data platform infrastructuur voor data producten die in Synapse en Databricks draaien. Je helpt teams met het inrichten van dataservices en zorgt ervoor dat hun data omgeving self-service gaat draaien. Dit doe je samen met 4 data engineers, een Product Owner en 2 ML/data scientisten, en jij wordt de hoofdverantwoordelijke voor de data infrastructuur. De tooling bouw je in Azure met Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, ADF, Kafka, Python. Uitgerold met Terraform en Helm. De focus ligt op het opzetten van self-service, het automatiseren van processen en het begeleiden van teams in de migratie van Synapse naar Databricks. Wat vragen we: - 5+ jaar werkervaring als Data, Software of Platform Engineer - 3+ jaar ervaring met cloud en data platform engineering, bij voorkeur op Azure - 2+ jaar ervaring met Infrastructure as Code en scripting, zoals Terraform of Python - Ervaring met data tooling zoals Azure Synapse, Databricks, ADF of Kafka - Ervaring met containerisation tooling zoals Docker en Kubernetes, AKS is een pré - Ervaring met Golang development is een pré - Native of volledige beheersing van het Nederlands (B2 minimum) en goede beheersing van Engels Arbeidsvoorwaarden: - Compensatie tot 105k OTE op basis van 40 uur - 27 vakantiedagen - Pensioenregeling van 29% - 15% korting op aandelen - 3 thuiswerkdagen en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken vanuit Utrecht en thuis - 12 maanden contract, daarna vast Meer weten? Mail me op D.Zwinkels@doghouse.nl of solliciteer direct.

. 
 Overview 
 Entrerai in una struttura AI dedicata allo sviluppo di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale che siano allineati con i valori aziendali, i principi etici di Intesa Sanpaolo e la regolamentazione europea sull'Intelligenza Artificiale (Ai Act), per indirizzare problemi e casi d'uso del mondo reale con soluzioni che garantiscano equità, interpretabilità, privacy, sicurezza e robustezza. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Supportare lo sviluppo di progetti end-to-end su temi di Responsible AI come la mitigazione di inequità, la spiegabilità, la protezione dei dati, che favoriscano l'interazione tra uomo e AI. 
 Sviluppare nuovi modelli, algoritmi e metodi che incorporino i principi di Responsible AI nella progettazione e messa in esercizio dei sistemi di AI, compatibili sia per sistemi che fanno uso di tecniche di Machine Learning, sia per sistemi che fanno uso di modelli di GPAI. 
 Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di data science e di data ethics per la realizzazione di sistemi conformi alle richieste di business e alla normativa sull'intelligenza Artificiale. 
 Comunicare e diffondere le migliori pratiche sull'implementazione della Responsible AI e dei rischi derivanti dall'utilizzo dell'AI a stakeholder interni ed esterni. 
 Rimanere aggiornato sullo stato dell'arte in ambito Responsible AI e nei campi correlati. 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 • Conoscenza di Framework condivisi di AI Governance. 
 • Conoscenza delle principali tecniche di modellizzazione statistiche, di machine learning e deep learning. 
 • Conoscenza delle tecniche per utilizzare efficacemente con Modelli di GPAI (RAG, Prompting, fine tuning, ...) e dei rischi associati. 
 • Conoscenza delle principali tecniche di fairness, spiegabilità e guardrailing per Generative AI. 
 • Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e in team. 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

items.desc:
Role Highlights 
 Title : Planner Satellite Manufacturing - MAITE
 Location: Athens, Greece
 Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation
 Reports to: Director of MAITE
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: Office
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Please note we can only accept applications in English 
 Why this role matters: 
 The mission of this role is to be the single planning point for the whole MAITE (Manufacturing, Assembly, Integration, Test and Execution) organisation in Greece: AIT Engineering, Production, Stock & Logistics, Procurement, Quality, and the Cleanroom & Lab. You will build and own one integrated schedule, from the master schedule down to daily work orders, that turns satellite demand into executable work across all of them.
 You will work with the global planning team, which sets the master plan and component MRP, and turn it into a detailed, executable plan for the site. Unlike traditional satellite builds, LEO constellations demand industrial-scale throughput, modular design adaptability, and tight integration between production, engineering and supply chain.
 Much of the value sits in the interfaces: sequencing a calibration campaign or a cleanroom intervention so it does not stop a build, holding a slot for a quality inspection, or flagging a long-lead component early enough for procurement to act.
 The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, works comfortably across departments, and improves the planning tools and workflows they inherit where off-the-shelf solutions fall short. You are the reliable source of truth for the site plan: when the plan and the floor disagree, you know first and say so.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.
 As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.
 ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. The company has more than 1000 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Build, maintain and optimise a single integrated schedule covering AIT Engineering, Production, Stock & Logistics, Procurement, Quality and the Cleanroom & Lab, from the master schedule down to daily work orders, against technical constraints, material availability, labour and facility capacity.
 Translate the master plan and component MRP from the global planning team into a sequenced plan for each department, agreeing dates and capacity with the department owners rather than directing their work. Hold slots for cleanroom interventions, calibration campaigns, quality inspections and rework loops so that planned work lands where it costs least, and keep those slots when priorities move.
 Run the daily and weekly planning cadence. Coordinate daily schedules with the site team leads, report actual people availability into the capacity plan, publish status, and raise deviations early and factually rather than sitting on them, then drive them to a decision.
 Feed the planning cycle. Keep plan versus actuals, milestone status and people availability current and flowing to the global planning team on cadence, so the plan above the site reflects floor reality.
 Produce and maintain the artefacts the organisation runs on: master schedule, critical path analysis, capacity plans, sprints and the visual management boards used in daily meetings.
 Integrate new product introduction and engineering changes into the plan, including prototype and qualification builds, without disrupting series production. Keep the plan and work order BOMs aligned with the current approved configuration, coordinating with Configuration Management, who own the governed baseline.
 Schedule planned downtime deliberately, including preventive maintenance, instrument calibration campaigns and cleanroom interventions, so that they land where they cost least.
 Embed quality hold points, inspection windows and rework loops into the schedule rather than …

items.desc: About Us At Framna, we partner with ambitious brands to create digital products that make a meaningful impact. We work across the full product journey, from strategy and UX to engineering and long-term growth, combining technical expertise with a strong product mindset. Together with our partners, we build solutions that users rely on every day. Our culture is built on trust, ownership, and fearless collaboration. We challenge ideas, support each other, and keep learning-openly sharing feedback, staying flexible in how we work, and approaching each other with empathy. Because the best products are created by teams that move forward together. About the Role This role sits at the intersection of Applied AI Engineering and practical AI Research, with a very strong emphasis on prompt engineering, experimentation, and model evaluation. While strong programming skills are required, your primary focus won't be building traditional business logic or infrastructure. Instead, you will concentrate on experimenting with off-the-shelf Large Language Models, designing and optimizing prompts, and systematically evaluating the quality of the outputs. Your core responsibilities will include selecting the right models and methods, designing experiments, analyzing errors, and iteratively improving the accuracy of AI solutions used for document processing and data extraction. You will be working on an AI-powered SaaS platform that automates every stage of the KYB process. Preferred Skills & Qualifications At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or similar including at least 2 years developing and maintaining LLM-based solutions in production. Hands-on experience evaluating LLMs: building ground-truth datasets, choosing metrics that fit the task (e.g. precision, recall, field-level accuracy), conducting deep-dive error analysis, and proving with data that a change genuinely improves the system rather than fixing one case and breaking others. Strong proficiency in Python and practical experience integrating and working programmatically with LLM APIs to solve real-world business problems. Proven experience designing, testing, and optimizing prompts, including working with structured outputs and mitigating hallucinations. A research-driven way of working: faced with a new problem, such as a classification or extraction task, you can set a baseline, formulate hypotheses, design structured experiments, and benchmark models and approaches on measurable outcomes. Hands-on experience extracting and classifying data from unstructured sources such as PDFs, scans, web pages and complex multi-language documents, ideally with multimodal (vision) LLMs. Strongly preferred. Solid understanding of model uncertainty, output validation, and data traceability - specifically linking extracted information back to its exact source within a document. Strong awareness of AI unit economics, latency, and throughput, with the ability to make informed model choices and optimize trade-offs (e.g., vision/image processing vs. text extraction). Proven ability to work independently at a senior level with full ownership - taking initiatives from problem identification and experimentation through to implementation and final evaluation. Strong command of Polish & English (both written and spoken). What you will find at Framna Real ownership and influence on the products you build A focus on business value over technical perfection Continuous feedback and open, honest communication Regular 1:1s and a mentoring program to support your growth Internal workshops and knowledge sharing across teams Flexible working hours (you can start between 7:00–10:00) Hybrid model with regular in-studio collaboration (Gdańsk, Wrzeszcz) High-quality equipment, including MacBook and testing devices Individual training budget English classes in small groups Plus the essentials: Private medical care (Compensa) and MultiSport Team gatherings and shared moments beyond work If you are motivated by ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and you enjoy solving real problems with a team you can rely on - you will feel good at Framna. Let’s build impactful products together.

items.desc: Mission Overview: Keystone Solutions is seeking a Functional Analyst for a consultancy mission at a client site. The client is a digital data platform organization that manages digital solutions for the port community. The project involves the Outbound Release Platform (ORP), which is essential for handling outgoing goods flows in Belgian seaports. As a Functional Analyst, you will play a crucial role in connecting business needs with IT solutions. Responsibilities: As a Functional Analyst, you will be responsible for the complete functional analysis of the ORP releases, from business needs to testable, prioritized, and business-approved requirements. These responsibilities will be carried out under Keystone Solutions' consultancy model: Analyze and elaborate on business requirements, use cases, business rules, exceptions, roles, and authorizations for the AES exit scenarios. Prepare process and sequence diagrams (AS-IS and TO-BE, BPMN/UML) and a traceability matrix from requirements to design, development items, test cases, and acceptance evidence. Develop the functional design, including the information and data model, data objects, mappings, and validation rules. Specify messages and interfaces (e.g., EDIFACT/XML, APIs) between ORP, IRP, Bulkchain, e-Balie, RX/SeaPort, and customs (AES). Prepare, write, and refine epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria, in accordance with the Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Facilitate weekly functional meetings with the business and customs (AADA), and workshops and deep dives with companies and key users from the port community. Collaborate with the UX/UI designer on user journeys, wireframes, and screen designs, and with architects and developers on the solution design. Support test design and UAT: prepare test scenarios, guide user acceptance testing, and follow up on findings. Manage open points, assumptions, decisions, and change requests in the project log, in coordination with the Product Owner and Scope Manager. Oversee the functional migration from e-Balie and RX/SeaPort to ORP, including transition and hypercare questions. Document results in Confluence and Azure DevOps to ensure they are reusable and maintainable. Why Join Keystone Solutions: As a consultant at Keystone Solutions, you will experience: Consultancy Nature: Focus on on-site work and embrace your consultant identity. Dynamic Projects: Engage with diverse challenges across various client environments. Turbo-Charged Learning: Benefit from professional development and broad learning experiences. items.desc: Nov 18, 2026 Who We Are MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. About WPP MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. We are 12,000 experts across 40+ markets, partnering with the platforms our clients run on: Adobe, AWS, Salesforce and the frontier AI labs. Most of our clients have already invested in agentic AI tooling but have yet to see the promised value gain. We’re helping clients close that gap and realize the value of their AI stack. We are looking for an Associate Consultant to join our AI Transformation work: helping marketing, CRM and content teams find the use cases that matter, build solutions with the tools they own, and move from testing AI to scaling their work with it. You will contribute to the same journey across our global client portfolio and inside MAP, where we treat ourselves as client number one. What will your day look like? In this role, you will build, measure and drive adoption of frontier AI for marketing teams at the world’s biggest brands and for MAP itself. You will sit with teams such as CRM, campaign and content to understand how their work really gets done, then build the skills, MCPs or agents that help them reach their goals. You will be at the frontier of re-designing work to fit the agentic era: you will help showcase where and how AI has an impact on time and quality and where we still need human judgement in the workflows of tomorrow. Your work will make a real difference to people's working lives, giving them time back to focus on more ambitious and creative work. You will be working in tandem with senior profiles from the team who will mentor you and hand you more ownership as you grow. Use-case & workflow discovery – Sit alongside the people who do the work, in client teams and across MAP, such as campaign managers, CRM specialists and content producers, and learn their role in the marketing lifecycle. Help them redesign workflows with state-of-the-art tools and spot where AI could change the cost or speed of a deliverable, while capturing it in use-case templates and a prioritised backlog, and contribute to AI maturity assessments. Build with teams – Recommend and build the skills, MCPs, agents and integrations that redesign how a team works, using frontier models, and test them with real users until the new workflow is theirs. Measure impact – You will build simple value models for the identified use-cases and shape the success criteria with the team as the work evolves. Demos for pitches – Create quick, tailored demos showing how AI can address client challenges, and help present them in pitches and client discussions. Drive adoption – Help client and MAP teams upskill with AI: run knowledge-sharing sessions and office hours, write the playbooks teams use after you leave, support champion networks, and keep an adoption scorecard that shows leadership what is working. Who are you going to work with? You will join the AI Solutions Consulting team at MAP, and work alongside our team of AI engineers. Day to day you will work with senior AI consultants and with colleagues across WPP Enterprise Solutions, from experience strategy to client engagement. Your clients will include some of the world's biggest brands in industries such as FMCG, automotive, energy, food service and retail. What do you bring to the table? We hire for a mindset, not a background. Demoing work you have built matters more than where you built it. What you must have A relevant degree or early experience. You have completed a degree in a relevant field such as digital innovation, strategy and technology, management, business analytics, philosophy, design or computer science, or up to 2 years' experience in consulting, marketing operations, CRM or a related role. You are AI-native. You work with the agent in the middle, and you regularly build things with LLM’s: a workflow you automated, a skill others use, a tool you wired together. We will ask you to walk us through something you built, …

We ship fast, work close to the shopfloor, and we don't ship things we're not proud of. The Role As Product Engineer with a frontend focus, you'll build the product features our customers use every day, fully owning the product with a strong focus on usability and intuitive design. You'll use AI to ship a high volume of polished work and stay close to the problems of the people who use it. You'll work directly with founders, engineers and customers, and see your work in production at leading manufacturers. Nice to Have TypeScript, React or Next.js Experience shipping product features end-to-end Experience with user research, prototyping or usability testing Complex interfaces involving data grids, graphs, editors, workflows or real-time state Experience with B2B or customer-facing products Visual regression, accessibility and browser testing Our current stack includes Next.js 16.3, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix-based components, TanStack libraries, Storybook, Vitest and Playwright. items.desc: What to Expect Tesla was founded in 2003 with the goal of accelerating the transition to sustainable energy and protecting the planet Earth. Through solar energy, batteries, and electric vehicles, we are building a world of amazing abundance. At Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg, we manufacture the Model Y, and starting in 2027, we’ll produce everything from battery cells to electric vehicles. This is unique in Europe. Our international team consists of over 12,000 employees from 130 countries. We hire talent at all skill levels - prior experience in the automotive industry is not required. Would you like to help write the next chapter in Tesla’s success story and work at one of Germany’s most modern workplaces? Then this is the right place for you! We are currently recruiting a Controls Design Modeler to join our Controls Design team within Engineering. In this role, you take ownership of implementing controls designs in our 3D Revit models, resolving clashes and preparing construction drawings for execution. What You'll Do Own the controls Revit models of our Gigafactory by updating and maintaining them and delivering clash-free results Attend weekly BIM coordination meetings with all other disciplines to discuss and resolve clashes Perform regular model quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness and correct data input before submission Follow Tesla BIM standards, naming conventions and data requirements, and populate and update asset metadata in Revit according to defined templates Publish design documents to Autodesk Forma for review and approval Work with BIM managers to improve modelling consistency through standard families, templates and workflows, and develop an asset library for controls instruments and equipment in Revit and AutoCAD Create BOQs, update P&IDs with controls instruments in AutoCAD, update PLC I/O schematics, panel layouts and cable schedules, and create wiring diagrams in E-PLAN What You'll Bring A qualification as Technischer Systemkonstrukteur (technical draftsman) with at least 5 years of experience, or a bachelor’s degree, forms your foundation Bring knowledge of different controls systems, including conduit and cable tray joining methods, HVAC layouts, communication networks, wiring schematics, instrument plan diagrams and control panel layouts Experience in the instrumentation and controls field or in working with a controls fabricator supports your daily work Demonstrate proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks and E-PLAN, including cross-discipline clash detection and coordination, with Autodesk Forma as a plus Understand markups and implement engineers’ requirements inside models and schematics Manage multiple complex projects and modelling tasks simultaneously Proficiency in technical English enables you to collaborate effectively, and German language skills are preferred or you are willing to learn Benefits Not only do we offer you an attractive compensation package, but also access to a wide range of perks and benefits. For example: Our own medical center, a gym and an in-house barbershop E-bike charging stations in front of the factory, more than 500 free charging stations for electric cars, a bike leasing program, free use of the nextbike bike-sharing fleet, as well as numerous free shuttle bus routes to Grünheide and the surrounding areas You’ll receive subsidized canteen meals, a free S-membership at the Urban Sports Club (discount from M+) and you can sign up for many language courses We also offer all employees a wide range of insurance options, such as a company pension plan, as well as discounts on private insurance and legal protection insurance These and many other benefits await you. SaaS Understanding: Solid grasp of multi-tenant architectures and data isolation strategies. Why Marbill & Luna Group? We believe in empowering our people. Here, your ideas matter, and your growth is a priority. If you are looking for a challenging role where you can work with the latest technologies, automate complex problems away, and build impactful solutions, this is the perfect opportunity. Apply now and let’s make an impact together! items.desc: Job Description Work environment General Affairs (GA) at Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) plays a central role in supporting the university's strategic development and institutional priorities. The department connects policy, governance, educational innovation, stakeholder engagement, and organizational development to help realize TU/e's vision and ambitions. Working closely with university leadership, faculties, and support services, General Affairs contributes to initiatives that strengthen the quality of education, research, and societal impact while fostering collaboration across the university and with external partners. The General Affairs service is headed by the Secretary of the University and consists, among others, of the Executive Board Staff. This staff is responsible for supporting strategy and policy at the institutional level and is organized in three thematic clusters: Education, Research, and Strategic Alliances. In Strategy 2030, TU/e focuses on Challenge-Based Learning (CBL), personalized learning pathways, a strong integration of education and research, and the development of lifelong learning skills. Learning Communities play an important role in realizing these ambitions by connecting colleagues across the university, facilitating knowledge exchange, and supporting evidence-informed educational development. To further expand and strengthen this network, we are looking for a Learning Communities Coordinator . Learning Communities Coordinator The Academy for Learning & Teaching (ALT) https://www.tue.nl/en/academy-for-learning-and-teaching is TU/e’s central platform for educational development, innovation, and professional learning. ALT supports the continuous enhancement of educational quality by bringing together educators, educational leaders, support staff, and researchers to learn from one another, share expertise, and collectively shape the future of education at TU/e. ALT got an grant from the NPULS national program for the coming three years (September 2026-September 2029) to strengthen teacher development, foster communities of practice and cross-institutional collaboration, and enhance ALT’s capacity to support and scale educational innovation at TU/e. A distinctive element of ALT is its Learning Communities: university-wide communities of practice that connect colleagues around shared educational themes and challenges. Rooted in the principles of social learning and peer-to-peer knowledge exchange, these communities provide spaces for educators to collaborate, reflect on practice, and develop new insights. By bringing together expertise from across the university, learning communities support educators in the adoption of evidence-informed approaches, stimulate educational innovation, and contribute to continuous improvement of teaching and learning. Learning Communities also play an important role in strengthening a culture of quality and fostering cross-departmental collaboration. They enable dialogue while facilitating the exchange of experiences and lessons learned beyond organizational boundaries. Since the establishment of ALT, four Learning Communities have been launched around strategically relevant themes: Artificial Intelligence in Education, Challenge-Based Learning, Sustainability, and Diversity & Inclusion. As these communities continue to grow and new communities emerge, TU/e is looking for a Learning Communities Coordinator who will play a key role in strengthening, connecting, and expanding these networks across the university and develop new ones as education evolves and needs to be taken to a next level. In the role of Learning Communities coordinator you are part of the Education Cluster (0,8 fte-10 fte) within the General Affairs service and you will work closely with also other colleagues from the TU/e departments and services. The activities include: The Coordinator is responsible for initiating, facilitating, and further developing university-wide Learning Communities. Key responsibilities include: Establishing and supporting thematic Learning Communities focused on educational developments relevant to the TU/e Vision that meet the needs of program directors, educators, and broader educational innovation. Connecting existing networks, initiatives, and innovative educational practices across faculties, including departmental innovation hubs. Organizing knowledge-sharing activities, meetings, and collaborative learning initiatives. Supporting community leaders, educators, and participants in developing collaborations. Monitoring the outcomes and impact of Learning Communities and ensuring that insights, good practices, and results are widely disseminated across TU/e. Together with the professional development colleague and the program manager of ALT, you form the core team of TU/e Center for Teaching and Learning (CTL). items.desc: Norwegian Meteorological Institute Kirkegårdsvegen 60, 9009 Tromsø Om jobben Lagre favoritt Stillingstittel Forsker Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 1 Arbeidsspråk Norsk eller engelsk Søk senest mandag 30. november About the Role The Norwegian Meteorological Institute has an open position as Researcher. The position is affiliated with the Ocean and Ice Division in the Ocean Department, and is based in Tromsø. The Ocean and Ice Division develops and operates numerical models for forecasting of ocean currents, hydrography, sea level, waves and sea-ice. These models provide input to downstream services such as oil spill drift models and search-and-rescue support. The work is carried out in collaboration with national and international partners. The work involves the management of operational forecast systems, including coordination of research staff, project administration, and supervision of research activities. The candidate is expected to contribute in the development of the division's research portfolio according to the institute strategy and actively seeks external project funding. Furthermore, the successful candidate will be expected to coordinate and manage inter-institutional activities that MET Norway is partnering in. It is essential that you can work efficiently in a team environment both within MET Norway and in an inter-institutional framework. Among the tasks that the successful candidate will become involved in, is management of MET Norway's responsibilities in the Arctic Monitoring and Forecasting Centre (ARCMFC) of the Copernicus Marine Service. ARCMFC is coordinated by the Nansen Environmental and Remote Sensing Center, and also includes the Institute of Marine Research, Norway and the Danish Meteorological Institute. Met Norway's main responsibilities in ARCMFC are wave modelling, near real time forecasts for ocean circulation and sea ice, management and monitoring of communications with the service central dissemination unit at Copernicus, and monitoring of product quality. The successful candidate will act as a link between the Ocean and Ice Division, the Fram Centre in Tromsø, and ARCMFC and become involved in regional high resolution ocean and sea ice modelling for our national service, notably the application of ARCMFC results for this service. Probabilistic forecasting is of particular interest in this context. Qualifications PhD in geophysical/physical sciences, with emphasis on remote sensing techniques and/or physical oceanography. Minimum 10 years of experience after PhD as an independent scientist with a strong record of peer-review publications. International experience is a requirement Experience with management and/or technical implementations of operational forecast systems in either operational oceanography or weather prediction is expected Strong track record with success in obtaining competitive research funding is beneficial (e.g. Research Council of Norway, EU Horizon ESA ) Experience in scientific programming within a Linux environment (Fortran, Python, Git) Experience with numerical ocean and/or sea-ice models. The working language at MET Norway is Norwegian. Foreign candidates must be willing to learn basic Norwegian. Candidates must be able to work effectively in English and demonstrate fluency, written and oral We offer Salary: NOK 840.000 - 940.000 per year, depending on qualifications and experience.
