items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Network Observability and Site Reliability Engineer, you make network-platform health visible from the user journey down to the device and service dependency. Your day may include defining a Service Level Objective (SLO), improving a telemetry pipeline, correlating events across WAN and cloud connectivity, or automating an operational response that reduces recovery time. You combine networking knowledge, data engineering, and SRE practices to move the organization from reactive monitoring toward proactive reliability. Working with platform owners, automation engineers, operations, and suppliers, you establish common signals, operational context, and disciplined reliability practices. How You’ll Make an Impact Define a Network Observability architecture that combines device, flow, experience, service, incident, and business-context data across global network platforms. Establish service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error-budget concepts, and reliability scorecards for Connectivity and Secure Access capabilities. Build modern telemetry pipelines using streaming telemetry, gNMI/OpenConfig, logs, metrics, events, and vendor-neutral observability patterns where appropriate. Improve incident and problem outcomes through event correlation, topology and dependency context, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and post-incident learning. Partner with automation and Agentic NetOps roles to provide trusted signals, safe triggers, and measurable feedback loops for increasingly autonomous operations. What You Bring A university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Strong knowledge of enterprise networking together with practical experience in monitoring, observability, operations analytics, or Site Reliability Engineering. Experience with telemetry technologies and data sources such as SNMP, streaming telemetry, gNMI, OpenConfig/YANG, syslog, flow data, synthetic tests, and digital experience monitoring. Understanding of SRE concepts including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, golden signals, incident command, problem management, and toil reduction. Experience with observability ecosystems such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, or comparable enterprise platforms. Practical scripting or automation skills, ideally in Python and APIs, and experience turning operational insights into automated diagnostics or remediation workflows. Strong analytical skills, including the ability to correlate infrastructure signals with service impact, dependencies, and business criticality. Excellent collaboration and communication skills across platform teams, service owners, suppliers, operations, and major-incident stakeholders. About the Team Network Services is responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously evolving Siemens Energy’s global connectivity and network security capabilities. We are moving from a traditional service-oriented model toward platform delivery, with clear ownership, reusable standards, automation, observability, and AI-enabled operations. Our teams work across campus, wide-area, cloud, and data-center connectivity, core IP services, secure access, segmentation, and network reliability, partnering closely with Cybersecurity, Digital Workplace, Cloud, Data Center, OT, and external suppliers. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. items.desc: About Zoomguide Zoomguide is a fast-growing Portuguese startup transforming how people explore cultural heritage and tourism through technology. Our platform combines AI, interactive digital experiences, and accessibility, already serving millions of visitors. We move fast. We avoid red tape. We care about impact. The Role We're looking for a Growth & Product Engineer who combines technical skills, business curiosity, and an entrepreneurial mindset. This is not a traditional software engineering role. And it's not a traditional sales role either. You'll work directly with the founder and business team to accelerate Zoomguide's growth. You'll build AI-powered tools and automations, contribute to product development, and engage directly with customers. We're a small, high-leverage team. We want someone who takes initiative, uses AI to work smarter, and enjoys turning ideas into working solutions. Recent graduates and candidates with 1–2 years of experience are welcome. We care more about what you've built, how you think, and your ability to execute than your years of experience. If you enjoy moving between code, product decisions, and customer conversations, this role is for you. What You'll Do Build AI-Powered Growth Systems Develop tools to automate sales, marketing, and internal workflows. Build AI-assisted systems for lead generation, prospect research, qualification, and personalized outreach. Integrate CRM data, APIs, and AI models to create scalable processes. Contribute to Product Development Build and ship product features, integrations, and improvements. Translate customer needs and business opportunities into technical solutions. Contribute to product decisions and explore new applications of AI. Support Sales & Customer Success Participate in customer meetings, product demos, and commercial discussions. Help identify and develop opportunities in international markets. Support customer onboarding, technical integrations, and problem-solving. What We're Looking For Required Technical foundation in software engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field, demonstrated through education, professional experience, or relevant projects. Programming experience with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript. Ability to build applications, integrations, or automated workflows. Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar). Interest in applied AI, including LLM APIs and AI-powered automation. Product mindset, commercial curiosity, and strong communication skills. Initiative, resourcefulness, and a strong drive to learn and deliver results. Fluency in English. Strong Plus Experience with Django, SvelteKit, or modern full-stack frameworks. Experience with CRM systems, sales automation, or growth operations. Experience in B2B SaaS sales, pre-sales, or customer success. Fluency in French, German, Spanish, or Dutch. Experience building AI-powered applications or agentic workflows. Startup experience, entrepreneurial projects, or a history of building things independently. Who Thrives Here You might be a recent engineering graduate with ambitious side projects, a junior developer with a commercial mindset, or an entrepreneurial builder who enjoys both technology and business. You don't need to tick every box. What matters most is your ability to learn fast, build things, communicate, and take ownership. You'll enjoy this role if you prefer automating repetitive work, use AI to multiply your productivity, and are comfortable switching between coding and customer conversations. items.desc: Build the Intelligent Workflows of E-Commerce • Fully Remote About the company: Marbill is a fast-growing brand within the Luna Group, a global leader redefining the future of e-commerce. Marbill empowers merchants worldwide and focuses on delivering cutting-edge, AI-driven solutions and seamless automations. We are an ambitious, agile team of professionals from 20 different countries. We thrive on challenges, move quickly, and value solution-oriented thinking. We equip our team with the tools and support they need to succeed, fostering both professional and personal growth in a fully remote environment. What we offer: Fully Remote Position: Work from anywhere in the world. Flexible Working Hours: Work when you're most productive. Referral Bonuses: Get rewarded for bringing great talent on board. We are looking for a highly skilled Automations Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be the mastermind behind our operational efficiency, connecting internal systems, cutting-edge AI platforms (like Claude and ChatGPT), and third-party tools through robust APIs and MCP integrations. Instead of just maintaining infrastructure, you will develop intelligent AI agents, automate critical workflows across departments like Marketing and Risk, and build AI-powered dashboards that transform how we operate. This is a fully remote position, perfect for a developer who is self-motivated, disciplined, and ready to make a significant impact. If you're looking to boost your career and love making systems talk to each other to eliminate manual work, now is the perfect opportunity! What you'll do: Workflow Automation: Identify, automate and improve existing workflows across Marketing & Monetization and Risk & P&L, reducing manual work and improving operational efficiency. AI-Powered Visual Management: Build and improve visual management boards, dashboards and internal tools using AI platforms such as Claude and ChatGPT to make business processes, KPIs and operational insights more accessible. AI Agents & Integrations: Develop and implement AI agents that connect to our existing systems, analyse data, execute tasks and automate business processes. API & MCP Management: Maintain, troubleshoot and improve existing API connections and MCP integrations. Build new integrations between internal systems, external platforms and AI tools to enable seamless data access and automation. Continuous Innovation: Explore and implement new AI tools, technologies and automation opportunities to continuously improve how our departments operate. What you’ll bring: Automation Expertise: Proven experience as a Backend or Automation Developer with a strong focus on building custom integrations, workflows, and cron jobs in Node.js. Integration Skills: Deep expertise consuming and creating RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and handling Webhooks securely. Familiarity with workflow tools (like n8n, Make, or custom orchestration engines) is a major plus. Asynchronous Processing: Hands-on experience with Redis, message brokers (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS), and background job queues (e.g., BullMQ). Database Mastery: Solid experience with MySQL at scale (query optimization, indexing) for logging and retrieving automation states. Applied AI: Practical knowledge of triggering AI/LLM pipelines (OpenAI/Gemini) within automated workflows, including basic RAG concepts. Cloud & DevOps: Strong AWS experience, specifically with EKS and Helm, adhering to Git/CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Docker) for deploying your automations. SaaS Understanding: Solid grasp of multi-tenant architectures and data isolation strategies. Why Marbill & Luna Group? We believe in empowering our people. Here, your ideas matter, and your growth is a priority. If you are looking for a challenging role where you can work with the latest technologies, automate complex problems away, and build impactful solutions, this is the perfect opportunity. Apply now and let’s make an impact together! By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy. Notice: This is a remote position based in Romania.

items.desc: Nov 18, 2026 Who We Are MAP | WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. About WPP MAP is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. We are 12,000 experts across 40+ markets, partnering with the platforms our clients run on: Adobe, AWS, Salesforce and the frontier AI labs. Most of our clients have already invested in agentic AI tooling but have yet to see the promised value gain. We’re helping clients close that gap and realize the value of their AI stack. We are looking for an Associate Consultant to join our AI Transformation work: helping marketing, CRM and content teams find the use cases that matter, build solutions with the tools they own, and move from testing AI to scaling their work with it. You will contribute to the same journey across our global client portfolio and inside MAP, where we treat ourselves as client number one. What will your day look like? In this role, you will build, measure and drive adoption of frontier AI for marketing teams at the world’s biggest brands and for MAP itself. You will sit with teams such as CRM, campaign and content to understand how their work really gets done, then build the skills, MCPs or agents that help them reach their goals. You will be at the frontier of re-designing work to fit the agentic era: you will help showcase where and how AI has an impact on time and quality and where we still need human judgement in the workflows of tomorrow. Your work will make a real difference to people's working lives, giving them time back to focus on more ambitious and creative work. You will be working in tandem with senior profiles from the team who will mentor you and hand you more ownership as you grow. Use-case & workflow discovery – Sit alongside the people who do the work, in client teams and across MAP, such as campaign managers, CRM specialists and content producers, and learn their role in the marketing lifecycle. Help them redesign workflows with state-of-the-art tools and spot where AI could change the cost or speed of a deliverable, while capturing it in use-case templates and a prioritised backlog, and contribute to AI maturity assessments. Build with teams – Recommend and build the skills, MCPs, agents and integrations that redesign how a team works, using frontier models, and test them with real users until the new workflow is theirs. Measure impact – You will build simple value models for the identified use-cases and shape the success criteria with the team as the work evolves. Demos for pitches – Create quick, tailored demos showing how AI can address client challenges, and help present them in pitches and client discussions. Drive adoption – Help client and MAP teams upskill with AI: run knowledge-sharing sessions and office hours, write the playbooks teams use after you leave, support champion networks, and keep an adoption scorecard that shows leadership what is working. Who are you going to work with? You will join the AI Solutions Consulting team at MAP, and work alongside our team of AI engineers. Day to day you will work with senior AI consultants and with colleagues across WPP Enterprise Solutions, from experience strategy to client engagement. Your clients will include some of the world's biggest brands in industries such as FMCG, automotive, energy, food service and retail. What do you bring to the table? We hire for a mindset, not a background. Demoing work you have built matters more than where you built it. What you must have A relevant degree or early experience. You have completed a degree in a relevant field such as digital innovation, strategy and technology, management, business analytics, philosophy, design or computer science, or up to 2 years' experience in consulting, marketing operations, CRM or a related role. You are AI-native. You work with the agent in the middle, and you regularly build things with LLM’s: a workflow you automated, a skill others use, a tool you wired together. items.desc: ¿Te apasiona la Inteligencia Artificial y quieres desarrollar soluciones reales con impacto en la industria? En Tewis estamos ampliando nuestro equipo de IT y buscamos incorporar un/a AI / Machine Learning Engineer con una sólida base técnica en Inteligencia Artificial, experiencia práctica en Machine Learning aplicado a series temporales y una forma de trabajo plenamente AI-native . Buscamos personas con curiosidad, criterio técnico y ganas de aprender, crecer y construir soluciones innovadoras utilizando las tecnologías más avanzadas en IA. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Formarás parte del equipo de desarrollo software de Tewis, participando en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial orientados al análisis de datos, predicción y desarrollo de nuevas capacidades inteligentes para nuestros productos. Entre tus responsabilidades estarán: Diseñar, desarrollar y validar modelos predictivos basados en datos reales. Aplicar técnicas de Machine Learning sobre series temporales. Investigar nuevas tecnologías y enfoques relacionados con IA y IA generativa. Integrar soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial en aplicaciones y procesos existentes. Participar activamente en el desarrollo de productos con una mentalidad AI-native. Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinares para transformar datos en soluciones de valor. ¿Qué buscamos? ✅ Formación y experiencia práctica en Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning. ✅ Experiencia demostrable trabajando con series temporales . ✅ Conocimientos sólidos de Python y su ecosistema de IA. ✅ Experiencia desarrollando, entrenando y evaluando modelos de Machine Learning. ✅ Conocimientos de IA Generativa (LLMs, RAG, embeddings, búsqueda semántica, prompting, agentes, etc.). ✅ Uso habitual de herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA. ✅ Capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y criterio técnico. Nos encantará que además tengas experiencia en: Deep Learning. MLOps y ciclo de vida completo de modelos. Integración de modelos de IA en aplicaciones reales. Bases de datos SQL y NoSQL, especialmente MongoDB. Diseño y consumo de APIs. Git y trabajo colaborativo. Testing, depuración y calidad de código. Metodologías Agile / Scrum. Proyectos personales o académicos relacionados con IA. La experiencia en entornos industriales o IoT será valorada positivamente, aunque no es un requisito . En Tewis creemos que la Inteligencia Artificial no es solo un producto, sino también una forma de trabajar. Por ello buscamos profesionales que utilicen la IA como parte natural de su día a día para: Analizar y resolver problemas. Programar y generar código. Diseñar documentación. Realizar pruebas y depuración. Automatizar tareas. Mejorar continuamente su productividad. Valoraremos especialmente experiencia con herramientas como: GitHub Copilot Claude Code Cursor ChatGPT Otras plataformas avanzadas de desarrollo asistido por IA ¿Por qué unirte a Tewis? En Tewis tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos reales donde la Inteligencia Artificial aporta valor directo al negocio, participando en la evolución tecnológica de la compañía y formando parte de un equipo que apuesta firmemente por la innovación. No buscamos solamente experiencia. Buscamos talento, potencial, criterio técnico y pasión por aprender. Si te entusiasma la IA, disfrutas resolviendo problemas complejos y quieres crecer profesionalmente en un entorno tecnológico dinámico, queremos conocerte.

We pride ourselves on our agile mindset, our creative problem-solving, and our collaborative culture. Our projects are diverse and different, just like our ways of working and our people. One of our key focusses is maintaining a strong culture of pragmatic, skilled, egoless people who collaborate to get things done and have lots of fun along the way. The people we want We want curious, tenacious problem solvers who create forward momentum. We value people with a high learning capacity: people who get to the real problem, learn fast in unfamiliar territory and turn ambiguity into a useful next step. We also want kind, low-ego colleagues who are direct but constructive, generous with knowledge and good to work with. Brilliance is not a licence for poor behaviour. What good looks like after 90 days • You are independently delivering robust, complete AI features, ensuring non- deterministic failures degrade gracefully for the user. • You have implemented automated evaluation checks and programmatic guardrails that the squad relies on to deploy updates safely. • You are collaborating effectively across disciplines, consistently documenting patterns for the team, and explaining technical decisions and AI constraints clearly in reviews. • You have established a strong working cadence with product, data, and security colleagues to test systems before release and investigate any failures in use. Desirable • Familiarity with standard protocols like MCP or OpenAPI schemas for building tool connectors. • Experience using an interactive coding workflow with AI assistants while rigorously validating the generated logic. • A pragmatic approach to product value, recognising where simple rule-based logic or standard databases might solve a problem more reliably than generative models. items.desc: Sateliot is a Barcelona-based satellite company with one goal: connect everything, everywhere. Founded in 2018, we've built the first satellite constellation that lets standard commercial devices communicate directly from space. Our technology bridges the gaps that terrestrial networks will never reach, bringing affordable and secure connectivity to industries, governments, and communities across the planet. Learn more: https://sateliot.space/ About the team & this role Sateliot is building its AI capability from the ground up. This is an early role on a team that is still taking shape, which means real ownership and the chance to influence how we build, ship and operate AI at Sateliot, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook. This is not a role about training models, it's about building with them. As our AI Engineer, you take the AI use cases prioritized on the company roadmap and turn them into robust, production-grade solutions: integrations between services, internal tools, automations, agents and skills that make Sateliot's processes measurably better. It's a hands-on, purely technical position: project management is not part of the job, so your focus stays entirely on designing, building, integrating and maintaining. We're looking for a software engineer at heart ideally with an infrastructure or platform background who has moved into building and integrating AI services into enterprise-grade corporate solutions, and who cares about solid architecture rather than duct-tape fixes What you'll do Build on top of AI services: develop solutions using public model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Google Gemini and similar) and AI tools for image, video and content generation. Connect services end to end: design and implement the glue between AI services and our internal systems, APIs, webhooks, data flows, automations, agents and skills. Not necessarily web apps: whatever shape best solves each use case. Engineer for the long run: apply sound architecture and design patterns so everything you ship is reliable, secure, observable and easy to maintain and extend. Deliver the roadmap: implement the use cases prioritized on the company roadmap, taking them from first prototype to real production, and maintain them over time. Improve how Sateliot works: use AI to streamline and automate processes across the company. Document what you build: keep clear technical and product documentation so knowledge lives in the team, not in one person's head. Keep learning: stay on top of the fast-moving AI ecosystem, new models, APIs, agent frameworks, multimodal tools, so you can identify and apply the latest tooling wherever it genuinely improves our solutions. What you bring A solid software engineering background, ideally from infrastructure, platform, backend or DevOps roles. Proven experience integrating third-party APIs and services into production systems: authentication, webhooks, rate limits, retries, error handling and monitoring; the unglamorous parts done right. Hands-on experience with public AI model APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Gemini), AI coding tools and agents (e.g. Codex, Claude Code), and AI generation tools for image and video. Strong programming skills (Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js or similar). An architecture mindset: you follow good design patterns and build systems meant to last, not one-off scripts. A pragmatic, documentation-first way of working and the autonomy to own delivery end to end. Fluent level of English. Bonus if you have Experience building agents, RAG pipelines or AI-powered automations (function/tool calling, MCP, LangChain or similar, or workflow platforms like n8n, Make or Zapier). Cloud and infrastructure experience (AWS, GCP or Azure; Docker/Kubernetes; CI/CD; infrastructure as code). Experience with observability, evaluation and cost control of LLM-based systems. items.desc: NTT DATA es una consultora multinacional que ofrece soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría. Digital Technology es la unidad enfocada a acompañar a las grandes organizaciones iberoamericanas en su transformación digital, generando dividendos digitales a través de la tecnología y el diseño, con enfoque práctico y orientado al negocio. Para lograrlo, buscamos personas que compartan nuestra curiosidad permanente, pasión por la tecnología, excelencia constante y visión estratégica. Digital Architecture es la división que proporciona la estrategia tecnológica y las plataformas IT necesarias para impulsar la digitalización y transformación de nuestros clientes, ofreciendo soluciones cloud-native y siendo referentes en la construcción de arquitecturas robustas, seguras y que contemplen todas las necesidades. En Digital Architecture buscamos profesionales con experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial Generativa, ingeniería de software y desarrollo asistido por IA , que quieran participar en la evolución de cómo diseñamos, construimos y entregamos soluciones tecnológicas. Nos interesan tanto perfiles con una orientación más técnica, capaces de diseñar e implementar soluciones avanzadas de IA, como profesionales con experiencia impulsando la adopción de estas tecnologías en equipos de desarrollo. No buscamos un único tipo de perfil: contemplamos diferentes trayectorias, niveles de experiencia y especializaciones dentro de la ingeniería de IA. 🔎 ¿Qué nos gustaría encontrar? Aunque no todo es imprescindible, nos gustaría que aportaras experiencia o conocimientos en algunas de las siguientes áreas: Experiencia sólida en ingeniería de software , preferiblemente con Python, TypeScript o tecnologías equivalentes. Conocimiento práctico de IA generativa, LLMs y herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA , como Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot o similares. Familiaridad con enfoques de Spec-Driven Development (SDD) y metodologías de desarrollo basadas en especificaciones. items.card: The Role You build the agentic coding factory that lets our engineers deliver much more with the same team. People decide what to build and accept the result; agents plan, write, test and review each change; a deterministic program runs the line. A first version already works end to end. items.desc: 🌟 Impress is a European leader in clear aligners and orthodontic care, with clinics across Europe and a growing presence in the United States. Our own software runs the whole patient journey: the website and booking, the sales and presales tools, the medical record and treatment planning, the patient app and the clinics' daily operations. Tech is about 50 people in Barcelona and remote, organized in product squads (Acquisition & Activation, Treatment, Tools) and shared teams (Platform, ML, IT Support). We run on AWS in Frankfurt, Kubernetes, GitOps and event-driven services, and ship to production several times a day. We are becoming an AI-native engineering organization: agents write, test and review most of the code, while engineers decide what to build, write the specifications and accept the result. By mid-2027 every change goes through our own agentic coding factory. 📢 Why We're Cool Work with an international and multicultural team Competitive salary Teeth aligner and whitening benefits Collaborative work environment and positive culture Opportunities to grow within a fast-paced, innovative company and real start-up experience with big challenges Fresh fruits and healthy snacks at the office 🔥 The Role You build the agentic coding factory that lets our engineers deliver much more with the same team. People decide what to build and accept the result; agents plan, write, test and review each change; a deterministic program runs the line. A first version already works end to end. Your job is to make it the normal way every team works by mid-2027. 🔥 What You'll Do Build and run the factory: the orchestrator on Kubernetes, isolated workspaces per task, the reviewer agent, and the escalation and retry logic. Turn specifications into the unit of work: templates, the contract each repository declares (quality gates, setup), and the evidence a person needs to accept a feature. Ship shared skills, guardrails and agent instructions to every repository, and duty agents that triage alerts and fix routine incidents. Make it safe to run unattended: short-lived credentials per task, sandboxing, an audit trail of every agent action. Measure it: traces and cost per merged PR (Langfuse), share of PRs from agents, delivery per engineer and lead time. Coach the squads as they move to working with agents, starting with the pilot teams. 🔥 What You Bring 5+ years as a software engineer, with production experience in Python, TypeScript or Go. Hands-on experience building with LLMs: coding agents (Claude Code or similar), tool use and MCP, prompts and skills as code, evaluation of agent output. Solid platform skills: containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Git workflows at scale. A strong sense for reliability and security: you design for failure, least privilege and observability. You write clearly and like making other engineers faster. Fluent English; Spanish is a plus. 🔥 Nice To Have Built internal developer platforms or developer tooling used by many teams. Experience with model routing, token cost control or LLM observability tools. Open-source contributions in the AI or developer-tooling space. 🔥 How We Hire About 2–4 weeks from first call to offer. Talent Acquisition call, 30 minutes. Interview with the VP of Technology, 45 minutes. Practical session, about 90 minutes live or a take-home under 3 hours: a realistic task where you direct coding agents. We look at your specification, your review of the agents' output and your tests. Team interview with two future colleagues. Final conversation with the VP of Technology. items.card: responsibilities Network Development Engineers in MONA build and operate the software and network systems that manage AWS's global network. You will design, deploy, scale, and sustain management plane, out-of-band, and automation platforms. You will use AI to troubleshoot and automate network operations, and you will write the documentation that lets others run what you build. - Design, build, and operate production
items.desc:
AWS is hiring a Network Development Engineer to join our MONA team.
MONA builds and operates the management plane, out-of-band (OOB) network, and automation systems that keep AWS's global network running. We run one of the largest fleets in Networking, growing from about 545K to 985K devices by the end of 2027, and we are redesigning the control layer underneath it. That means building the next generation of management networks for AWS, designed for Resilient Network Graphs (RNG), Machine Learning, and Intent-Driven Controls. We use software and AI, not manual process, to solve problems that people, runbooks, and tickets have solved until now.
As a Network Development Engineer in Dublin, you'll work on several Senior Leadership initiatives at once. They include One Management Network, the next generation of how we build management connectivity across the fleet; faster on-site server builds; Initial Access, our new satellite-based product that supports multiple organizations in parallel and cuts the time to bring a new data center online; and support for new EC2 and security requirements. You'll join a team of network and software engineers working side by side, and you'll build and own pieces of this work from design through to launch. We want engineers who see a recurring network problem and build a product to solve it, not just a fix.
Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers in MONA build and operate the software and network systems that manage AWS's global network. You will design, deploy, scale, and sustain management plane, out-of-band, and automation platforms. You will use AI to troubleshoot and automate network operations, and you will write the documentation that lets others run what you build.
- Design, build, and operate production automation and controller software that detects, diagnoses, and remediates network faults without manual intervention.
- Use AI to automate repetitive operational work. Identify recurring network problems and turn them into reusable products, tools, and agentic workflows instead of one-off fixes, runbooks, or tickets.
- Own projects from design through to operation in areas such as device management, out-of-band connectivity, Initial Access, network deployment and scaling, technology refresh, and sustaining engineering.
- Make and implement changes on the network safely, using tooling, testing, and staged rollouts.
- Work closely with software engineering and automation teams to define the tools and controllers that let us scale to a much larger fleet with a smaller team.
- Use AI to troubleshoot network issues faster. Diagnose, mitigate, and resolve large-scale network events that affect significant AWS customers, using AI to triage, correlate alarms, and find root causes. Work with the highest-tier escalation engineers and resolvers, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions through to completion.
- Troubleshoot routing, interconnectivity, platform, performance, and configuration issues from Top of Rack to the network border. This includes low-level application behaviour, Unix systems, and modern network software tooling.
- Partner with network engineering, hardware, and infrastructure teams on designs, configuration standards, and tooling. Make sure new designs and products roll out quickly and smoothly.
- Maintain standards across the network toolset, and ensure our systems comply with those standards and policies.
- Use operational data to find the largest sources of manual work and device downtime, and prioritise engineering effort against them, including out-of-service targets.
- Deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions and processes. 
- Convert standard operating procedures and runbooks into automated, AI-driven workflows, with guardrails, validation, and human review where the risk calls for it.
- Take part in on-call, and reduce its load by cutting alarm noise and using AI and automation to handle common responses.
- Write and review design documents, operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge transfer material. Use AI to draft and update this material, and check it for accuracy before it is used.
A day in the life
Your day might start with a design review for a new controller, or a sync with the team on a workflow you're building. Mid-morning you could be debugging a stuck device in the out-of-band network, using AI to triage alarms and find the cause. Afternoons go to building: turning a recurring ticket into an automated workflow, testing it, and rolling it out in stages. You'll work with software engineers, hardware teams, and escalation resolvers, and write up what you learn so others can reuse it. Some days include on-call.
About the team
MONA sits inside AWS Network Fabric Engineering (NFE) and owns the management plane, out-of-band networks, and automation that keep AWS's global network running. You'll join a Seattle team that is part of a global group with hubs in San Jose, Sydney, and Dublin. Network and …

items.card: you will work on market-leading, cutting-edge cellular transceivers. The broad scope of responsibilities includes definition of test strategy and test plan creation derived from receiver system specification, characterization, and optimization of key RF parameters, the analysis of functional or performance issues encountered during different verification phases, and the development of scripts for test automation.
items.level: Silicon Validation Engineering ICT3 – Silicon Validation Engineering ICT4
items.desc:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas quickly become extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. 
Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic, cellular transceivers and the RF subsystems built around them. In order to expand our team's validation capability towards future Apple products, we are looking for a passionate RF engineer with strong RF transceiver system understanding, complemented by AI/ML and programming skills. The world-class cellular RF sub-systems developed in our labs are enabling Apple mobile devices to deliver uncompromised cellular network connectivity at the lowest possible battery drain, enabling long hours of an enjoyable customer experience. 
Thus, join us and leverage your passion for RF excellence and innovation, bringing your advanced education and drive to the world's most innovative company.
In the position of an experienced Receiver RF Silicon Validation Engineer, you will work on market-leading, cutting-edge cellular transceivers. The broad scope of responsibilities includes definition of test strategy and test plan creation derived from receiver system specification, characterization, and optimization of key RF parameters, the analysis of functional or performance issues encountered during different verification phases, and the development of scripts for test automation. You will work in an agentic engineering flow — scoping the problem and defining pass/fail criteria, delegating implementation and execution to AI agents, and verifying every result against the specification — applying innovative AI/ML-based methods to advance our measurement and analysis capabilities and to scale our regression environment. Your work style is very collaborative; you manage your deliveries and dependencies self-contained, and your execution enables you to meet your commitments.
Master's degree or higher (PhD.) in Electrical Engineering, Communication/ Embedded Systems, or equivalent, paired with several years of industry experience
Experience with RF transceiver system definition and architecture, including RF impairments (e.g., I/Q imbalance, DC offset, phase noise, nonlinearity) and their impact on receiver performance — ability to derive validation strategy, test plans, and pass/fail criteria from system specifications
Advanced knowledge of 3GPP standards with a focus on RF transceiver aspects and receiver RF requirements
Working knowledge of AI/ML, able to apply AI/ML methods to achieve results, with a solid grasp of the fundamentals
Good programming skills, leveraging modern AI-coding assistants to generate scripts, debug logic, and optimize code, with languages such as Python, C/C++, and MATLAB
English language proficiency is required for this position
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques and agentic engineering (delegating tasks to AI agents and verifying their output) to RF, signal-processing, or lab-automation problems is desirable
Hands-on experience (from PhD work, thesis, internships or industry) in characterizing and debugging RF cellular systems and components, including root cause analysis, and in creating test automation scripts to run in the lab and/or regression environment is beneficial
Ability to collaborate technically with a variety of teams (Design, Firmware, System, etc.) is essential
Team spirit, excellent communication skills, and the desire to accept diverse challenges are essential.

 Contract: Permanent, full-time — French Contrat à Durée Indéterminée (CDI)

 Compensation & Benefits: Qualcomm offers a competitive compensation and benefits package commensurate with skills and experience, including all benefits required under French law.
 Recruiting Status: Open — applications are welcomed immediately.
 Why Join QITC? 
 Join Qualcomm’s Interconnect Technology Center (QITC) and become a key technical communicator helping shape how cutting-edge Network-on-Chip (NoC) technologies are understood and adopted by thousands of SoC engineers worldwide.
 This role offers: 
 • Deep exposure to advanced hardware and system architectures
 • High autonomy and editorial ownership
 • Long-term technical growth in a world-class R&D environment
 • A mission-driven documentation role focused on engineering impact rather than marketing
 Role Description 
 This position is ideal for a bilingual French–English technical writer with 2–5 years of experience in microelectronics or closely related high-technology fields, such as telecommunications, AI/ML, robotics, or advanced computing.
 You will join a small, highly technical Technical Writing Team (TWT) within QITC and contribute to end-user documentation for state-of-the-art NoC technologies. Your work will directly support the deployment of innovations that will reach the public in the coming years.
 In addition to authoring technical documentation, you will contribute to the broader documentation ecosystem by:
 • Defining and enforcing terminology, naming conventions, and style guidelines
 • Proposing and improving document templates and editorial standards
 • Participating in the definition of content- and information-management workflows
 Content is authored within a strongly typed editorial workflow, producing English-language text and visual material directly in a relational, object-oriented authoring database. Publications are delivered periodically to a large internal audience of Qualcomm hardware and software designers, architects, and verification engineers.
 Technical Environment and Growth 
 QITC operates in a highly demanding, engineering-driven R&D context. As a result, you will progressively acquire deep technical expertise and develop the ability to engage with engineers on equal footing.
 You will: 
 • Build sufficient technical mastery to author documentation autonomously
 • Translate complex architectures and specifications into clear, precise documentation
 • Communicate effectively with multiple audiences, from system architects to design and verification engineers
 Over time, this position enables you to become a technical communication subject-matter expert across QITC technologies. In return, you will face continuous and stimulating intellectual challenges.
 Information Gathering & Editorial Work 
 A core part of the role is technical information analysis and synthesis. You will extract and validate information from diverse sources, including:
 • Specifications, design documents, and presentation material
 • Source code and configuration files
 • Recorded presentations and internal knowledge bases
 • Customer-support and issue-tracking systems Information is obtained through document analysis, meeting participation (often conducted in French), and one-on-one interviews with engineering Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
 Sources may be formal or informal, incomplete, evolving, or distributed across heterogeneous systems. The ability to evaluate source reliability, structure information, and restitute it clearly, consistently, concisely, and comprehensively is essential.
 Personal Qualities 
 To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate:
 • Strong technical curiosity and analytical thinking
 • Flexibility and responsiveness in a fast-moving R&D environment
 • Persistence, rigor, and close attention to detail
 • Excellent teamwork and communication skills
 This role is a strong fit if you: 
 • Enjoy understanding how complex systems work—and explaining them clearly • Like turning messy or incomplete information into structured knowledge
 • Are comfortable interacting daily with engineers
 • Are seeking a long-term technical role rather than a marketing-oriented writing position
 Required Skills 
 • Strong technical mindset and pronounced curiosity about technology
 • Ability to autonomously analyze and synthesize information from diverse sources (source code, presentations, tickets, specifications, emails)
 • Foundational knowledge in mathematics, computing, and electronics, including:
 o Boolean algebra
 o Simple equations and mathematical reasoning
 o General scientific literacy

 Du unterstützt bei der Qualifizierung neuer AI-Technologien und Agentic-AI-Ansätze für den Einsatz im Produktionsumfeld.

 Im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit arbeitest du mit Kolleg:innen aus Produktion, IT und unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen.
 Zudem unterstützt du bei der strukturierten und zielgruppengerechten Aufbereitung von Erkenntnissen und Ergebnissen in Dokumentationen, Präsentationen und Kommunikationsunterlagen.

 Studium der Wirtschaftskommunikation, Kommunikationswissenschaften, Informatik, eines MINT-Lehramts oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.
 Starkes Interesse an Artificial Intelligence, Agentic AI und der Transformation von Prozessen durch neue Technologien.
 Grundverständnis von AI-Technologien oder hohe Motivation zur Einarbeitung in AI Agents, agentische Systeme und deren praktische Anwendung.
 Analytisches und konzeptionelles Denkvermögen sowie Interesse an der Analyse von Prozessen und der Identifikation von AI-Potenzialen.
 Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.
 Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und in interdisziplinären Teams.
 Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

 As an SIU Analyst – AI & Fraud Detection, you will play a key role in developing, managing and optimising the AI-driven technology that supports fraud detection across Swiss Re Corporate Solutions. Working alongside experienced SIU investigators and our Claims Brain technology teams, you will combine technical innovation with operational insight to deliver meaningful improvements. 
 Previous experience in insurance or fraud investigation is not required. We are particularly interested in individuals who can demonstrate practical experience using AI to solve problems, improve processes and deliver measurable results.

 Develop and optimise AI fraud detection capabilities , with a primary focus on improving Claims Brain's predictive models, detection accuracy and quality of fraud alerts.

 Explore opportunities for AI innovation and automation , developing practical solutions to enhance fraud detection and SIU efficiency, including document fraud detection, continuous claims screening and automated quality assurance. 
 Collaborate with SIU investigators and technology teams to translate operational needs and investigative insights into effective AI solutions, supporting their testing and implementation. 
 Monitor and report on performance , developing clear reports and dashboards to demonstrate the effectiveness of AI capabilities and communicate progress to SIU leadership. 
 Support appropriate AI governance , maintaining documentation of model enhancements and ensuring solutions align with responsible AI, data protection and human oversight requirements. 
 Evaluate emerging AI technologies and assess their potential application within SIU and the wider claims environment

 The Global Special Investigation Unit (SIU) supports Swiss Re Corporate Solutions in identifying, investigating and preventing potentially fraudulent or exaggerated insurance claims. Operating across multiple regions and lines of business, the team combines specialist investigative expertise with advanced analytics and emerging technologies to strengthen fraud detection and support effective claims management. 
 Technology and innovation are central to our approach. Through Claims Brain and other AI-driven initiatives, we continue to develop new ways of identifying suspicious claims, improving operational efficiency and supporting informed decision-making. 
 You will join a small, collaborative global team, reporting directly to the Global Counter Fraud Lead and working alongside experienced SIU professionals. items.desc: Hamiltonian Dynamics is a growing technology company working across Defence and Cyber Security, delivering software solutions that support critical national and enterprise systems. With teams based in Gloucestershire, Manchester, and London, we are entering an exciting new phase of expansion and are looking for Software Engineers to join us. This role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful, technically challenging projects while continuing to grow your skills in a supportive, flexible environment. Requirements As a Software Engineer at Hamiltonian Dynamics, you will design, build, and maintain secure, scalable software used by high-assurance customers. You’ll work across the full software development lifecycle, collaborating closely with engineers, architects, and stakeholders to deliver robust solutions. We’re open to engineers with different backgrounds and levels of experience - what matters most is strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. What You'll Do Use AI coding tools as part of everyday development to accelerate coding, testing, debugging and problem-solving. Develop and maintain software applications, AI-enabled solutions and data pipelines using technologies suited to each project. Integrate LLMs, machine learning models and APIs into production systems. Build and manage containerised applications using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Write clean, secure and testable code, applying sound engineering judgement to AI-generated outputs. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists and DevOps teams, participating in code reviews and knowledge sharing. Skills & Experience You will have experience in one or more of the following areas but you do not need experience in everything listed: Strong software development fundamentals, with commercial experience in at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, Go, Java, C# or TypeScript). Practical experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Cline or similar. Ability to use AI effectively while understanding, reviewing and testing the code it generates. Experience building or integrating AI-enabled applications, including LLM APIs, SDKs and agentic workflows. Awareness of AI reliability, security and guardrails, including evaluating AI-generated outputs. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or similar containerisation technologies. Frontend development experience with frameworks such as React. Experience building and consuming secure RESTful APIs. Familiarity with Git, Linux environments and CI/CD practices. A collaborative approach, strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn new technologies. We value engineers who are open-minded, adaptable, and keen to learn new technologies as project needs evolve. Security & Location You must be a UK citizen and have lived in the UK for the past 10 years You must be willing to hold a high-level UK security clearance Customer sites are based in Gloucestershire or Manchester , so you must be able to travel to one of these locations Benefits Salary band: £40,000-45,000 , depending on experience (we may consider more junior or more senior outside this range for the right candidate) 10% Clearance Bonus 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays Buy or sell up to 5 days leave per year 8% employer pension contribution BUPA health cover Life cover of 4× salary EV car scheme via salary sacrifice EMI share scheme Flexible working and flexi-time 10 days per year training allowance Every employee has an individual training and career development plan. We recognise that everyone learns differently and we actively support long-term growth. Our Process We keep things straightforward and human: A 30-minute introductory chat with our recruiter, Sarah A 1-hour Microsoft Teams interview or on-site interview with two members of the team An informal conversation with two of our Founders We believe open, organic conversations are the best way for both sides to decide if the role is the right fit.

items.card: What you'll do: Vulnerability management (the core of the role) Run our vulnerability management platform across cloud, containers, endpoints, applications and dependencies. items.desc: Do you want to own vulnerability management end to end, and decide every day what is urgent and what is not? As Security Engineer at Moving Intelligence Group, you'll keep our cloud, containers and applications secure across three brands and four countries. You'll join the Group Cybersecurity team, report directly to the Group CISO and help bring three entities together into a single AWS organisation. What you'll do: Vulnerability management (the core of the role) Run our vulnerability management platform across cloud, containers, endpoints, applications and dependencies. Prioritise remediation on real impact: CVSS, actual exposure, asset criticality, known exploits and compensating controls. Coordinate fixes with infrastructure, development and IT, from scoping through validation and closure. Monitor remediation SLAs, report to the CISO and teams, and raise the alarm when targets slip. Cut the noise: handle false positives, document exceptions and keep improving scan coverage. Cloud and container security Monitor the security posture of our AWS and Kubernetes environments against our baselines. Define AWS WAF rules based on identified risks, together with the Cloud / DevOps team that runs and deploys them (Terraform). You own rule definition, log analysis and control. Support the move of three entities into one AWS organisation: harmonise controls, extend scan coverage and spot gaps introduced by the migration. Investigation and incident response Define logging and telemetry requirements: which systems, which events, retention, centralisation and integrity. Make sure that logging is actually in place, and find blind spots before an incident does. Help Cloud / DevOps tune the SIEM and SOAR: detection rules, thresholds, correlation and response playbooks. Lead post-incident investigations: timeline, root cause and impact. Drive corrective actions, turn findings into lessons teams can act on, and help maintain incident response procedures. Cross-functional work Advise development and infrastructure teams on security questions in their projects. Build and run AI agents for security work, such as vulnerability triage, alert qualification, log and configuration analysis, and remediation guidance. You decide where an agent can be trusted and where a human stays in the loop. Propose and build automation to handle the growing volume of vulnerabilities. Who you are You have 3 to 5 years in hands-on operational security, in an in-house security team, a SOC or a technical consulting role. You've run a vulnerability management programme from detection through to closure. Technical skills Cloud security, especially AWS (IAM, VPC, logging, native security services). Container and Kubernetes security (images, RBAC, network exposure, build pipeline). Strong command of CVSS, working knowledge of EPSS, and the habit of using exposure context. A good grasp of web application protection: OWASP Top 10, how a WAF works and how to read its logs. You can read Terraform and script recurring tasks in Python or similar. Hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code to speed up scripting, automation and analysis. How you work You explain technical risk to non-specialists and win their buy-in without formal authority. You make sound calls on your own, every day, about what is urgent and what isn't. You're pragmatic: you tell real risk from theoretical risk in a 200-person organisation. You're rigorous in follow-up and keep a clear trail of actions. You speak and write fluent English, our working language. French, German or Dutch is a plus. Nice to have Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and the Entra ID / Microsoft 365 security stack. Experience in a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification context. A certification such as OSCP, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA) or equivalent. Experience in a multi-entity or post-merger environment. What we offer A hands-on role with real ownership, reporting directly to the Group CISO. The chance to shape security during a major change: bringing three entities into a single AWS organisation. Room to build AI agents and automation into everyday security work. An international environment with teams in four countries and English as the working language. About Moving Intelligence Group Moving Intelligence Group brings together specialist expertise in vehicle security, connected vehicle data, fleet management and fleet data integration. We harmonise and enrich data from any OEM or telematics provider, and add our own hardware where protection or certification demands it. So fleets, vehicle owners and their service providers across Europe get one accessible and actionable view on one platform. With AI and 27 years of vehicle expertise, we improve operations, keep customers compliant and protect their assets. Job Type: Full-time Pay: 55,000.00€ - 65,000.00€ per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chambéry (73)

We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries. But we don’t stop there. At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world. Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind. Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together. Role Summary You are the face of Fenergo in Dublin. Visitors, clients, candidates and new starters meet you first, and the impression you make sets the tone for how they see the company. You run front of house with warmth and professionalism, so everyone who arrives is welcomed, directed and looked after. Behind the desk, you keep the office working day to day: the Workplace ticket queue, meeting rooms, kitchen and stationery stock, mail and deliveries, catering for meetings and events, and the walkarounds that spot problems early. You are the first point of contact for Workplace requests, solving what you can and escalating the rest to the Workplace Lead, and you help new starters settle in on day one. Success means a welcoming, tidy, well-stocked office, requests answered quickly, events and catering that run smoothly, and a front desk that is covered whenever the office is open. You work in partnership with the Workplace Lead, who provides cover at peak times and during short absences, and you can step in on routine tasks when they are away. Tell building reception about expected visitors (external and from other offices) and arrange Verkada phone access in advance. Liaise with Recruitment and PAs so you know when to expect clients, visitors and interviewees. Receive and sort mail and deliveries; book couriers (local and international) and taxis. Be the primary reception cover during core hours, so the desk is never left unattended; the Workplace Lead provides cover during peak times and short absences. Workplace Support Monitor the Atlas Workplace ticket queue, respond to requests and escalate maintenance and contractor issues to the Workplace Lead. Carry out scheduled walkarounds (e.g. 9am and 2pm) to check cleanliness, stock, safety and security, and log issues. Check and stock meeting rooms, printers, the stationery press and the kitchen, and order supplies. Set up meeting rooms, and arrange refreshments, for client and ELT meetings. Administer Ronspot desk booking: add new users and answer employee queries. Give the cleaner on-site direction and arrange extra cover for events. Raise issues with the hard services contractor and building management, and log calls with them. Handle the post and accept deliveries. Coordinate furniture and equipment moves within the office. Onboarding & Offboarding Greet clients and visitors, and issue access cards. Track the starter and leaver list; arrange shipment of laptops to global offices, deactivate leavers' access cards on their last day and arrange equipment collection. Catering, Events & Health & Safety Organise catering for meetings and events: take requests, order from approved suppliers, confirm dietary and allergen requirements, coordinate delivery and set-up, and raise POs and track invoices. Set up rooms for on-site events and help with off-site events. Support the Workplace Lead with Health & Safety tasks: fire warden and first aider lists, safety walkarounds, incident logging, and training bookings. Follow emergency procedures and help colleagues and visitors during evacuations Check first aid kits, maintain the accident book and escalate hazards to the Workplace Lead. items.desc: UX Engineer What will you be doing? Short version of whom we are searching for: You can understand the real user problem (root cause), design a relevant solution, and make it real enough to test in working code. You are more technical than a typical UX designer, but this is not a software engineering role. Role scope As a mid-level UX Engineer, you will take semi-defined product problems and turn them into tested, workable solutions. Researchers, senior designers, or product managers will usually establish a broader opportunity. From there, you will analyze the available evidence, fill knowledge gaps, understand the user’s context, define the specific problem worth solving, and build a functional prototype for testing and learning. This is not a strategic research role, but some tactical discovery is still an important part of the job . You need to know how to ask the right questions, connect with the right people, and use existing data to get to a concrete user problem. Much of the work happens in or close to the codebase, so you need enough technical skill to contribute on equal terms with other members of the team . You will organize the context and specifications, operate AI skills and agents, review outputs, and use classical UX artifacts (customer journeys, user flows, personas, jobs-to-be-done) in the formats relevant to LLM-assisted product development. Tasks and responsibilities Discovery Partner with a senior designer or researcher and support discovery under their guidance, including stakeholder interviews, user interviews, workflow analysis, prototype testing, and synthesis of existing research. Understand and contribute to UX artifacts such as customer journeys, user flows, personas, and jobs-to-be-done, and structure them in AI-readable formats. Visually map user tasks and workflows to develop a deep understanding of what happens in the user’s world and communicate that understanding to others. Our domain is complex, so visual thinking is a useful skill. If you enjoy diagramming and visual note-taking, this role will give you plenty of opportunities to do that. Delivery Use product context, research, analytics, customer input, and domain knowledge to identify the actual user problem before jumping to a solution. Design user flows, interaction patterns, layouts, and detailed UI states. Explain design decisions clearly to Product, Engineering, QA, UX colleagues, and domain experts. Build functional prototypes using approved AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Visual Studio, Claude Code). Use the Enablon and Wolters Kluwer design systems and access research through MCP to ensure solutions reflect both user needs and our internal standards. Work with engineers to test interface behavior and propose evidence-based improvements. Write clear, testable specifications covering behavior, rules, edge cases, and acceptance criteria. Check usability and accessibility in both design and implementation. Review implemented features with engineers and QA, identify UX defects, and help resolve them before release. Where appropriate, propose pull-request changes for straightforward UX improvements that are within your technical depth. What this role is not Not a pure UI production role where requirements arrive fully formed. Not a front-end engineer role focused on architecture, backend integration, or release ownership. Not a senior strategy role responsible for setting the direction of an entire product area. The team You will work in a cross-functional team with Product Managers, Product Owners, Software Engineers, domain experts, and UX colleagues. A senior designer in your product domain will provide general UX direction and guidance, but you’ll be autonomously responsible for a set of user problems (and resulting features). We value people who can make progress without waiting for every detail to be resolved. That does not mean working alone or guessing. It means making assumptions visible and connecting with others to get the missing information. Despite being a large company with mature processes, we rely on human relationships in the team a lot. This is you Roughly 3+ years of experience in UX, product design, design engineering, front-end prototyping, or a similar hybrid role. Strong evidence matters more than your past job title. A portfolio showing how you moved from an unclear problem to a tested solution. Experience working in a complex, highly regulated B2B/enterprise domain, such as legal, medical, finance, logistics, aerospace, etc., with complex workflows or data-heavy interfaces. Solid interaction and UI design skills, including experience with design systems and prototyping. Practical knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript. You should be able to build, inspect, and debug a functional prototype and identify issues at the interaction level. Experience with Storybook, GitHub, Claude Code, and design tokens. Enough discovery experience to ask useful questions, analyze …

items.desc: About Biota Trace Systems Biota Trace Systems is an environmental biotechnology company combining molecular biology, engineering and environmental science to develop innovative monitoring technologies. Our work spans environmental DNA (eDNA), molecular diagnostics, automated air and water sampling, autonomous surface vessels and emerging molecular detection technologies. The role We are looking for a capable, curious and self-motivated Molecular Scientist to join our team in Otley. This is not a conventional laboratory role. While some days will involve processing samples and delivering commercial results, much of your time will focus on developing and optimising molecular methods, troubleshooting assays and working with engineers to translate laboratory processes into automated technologies. You will also have opportunities to explore emerging engineering biology approaches, particularly CRISPR-Cas13 detection, and participate in occasional environmental fieldwork, sampling and equipment trials. We particularly value people who can take ownership of their work, organise themselves, solve problems independently and communicate their findings clearly. Key responsibilities Implement, optimise and troubleshoot molecular assays, particularly PCR and qPCR, drawing on published scientific methods. Develop and improve DNA/RNA extraction, sample preparation and NGS library preparation workflows. Investigate emerging molecular detection technologies, including CRISPR-Cas13 assays. Collaborate with engineers to adapt laboratory methods for automation and field applications. Undertake routine molecular analysis and deliver accurate results for commercial projects. Occasionally participate in environmental sampling and technology trials. Independently plan experiments, manage priorities, analyse results and produce clear technical reports. Qualifications and experience Essential BSc/MSc in a relevant biological science with substantial practical laboratory experience (typically 4–6 years), or a relevant PhD with strong hands-on molecular research experience. Practical expertise in DNA/RNA extraction, PCR, qPCR and NGS library preparation. Experience optimising and troubleshooting molecular assays, particularly qPCR. Ability to interpret scientific literature and adapt published methods for laboratory use. Strong experimental planning, analytical problem-solving, organisational and reporting skills. Confidence working independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. Desirable Environmental DNA, metabarcoding or environmental microbiology experience. Engineering biology, particularly CRISPR-Cas13 molecular detection. Oxford Nanopore sequencing knowledge or experience. Laboratory automation or automated molecular workflows. Experience working with environmental samples or field-based technologies. What we offer A varied and challenging scientific role with the opportunity to develop new molecular methods, explore emerging technologies and see your work translated into practical environmental monitoring solutions. You'll work alongside scientists and engineers in a growing company where initiative, independent thinking and problem-solving are genuinely valued. How to apply Please send your CV and a brief covering letter highlighting your relevant molecular experience, particularly examples of assay optimisation, troubleshooting and independently managed experimental work. Pay: £35,000.00-£45,000.00 per year Benefits: Free parking On-site parking Work Location: In person

From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. items.desc: Das sind wir Das sind wir Die SKOPOS GROUP kombiniert in ihren sechs spezialisierten Units die Expertise von 30 Jahren Marktforschungserfahrung mit innovativen Lösungen. Aktuell beschäftigen wir über 140 Mitarbeitende an den Standorten Hürth bei Köln, Aachen und München. Wir setzen auf individuelle Kundenlösungen, sind Marktforschende mit viel Herzblut und leben Teamwork in einer offenen, sympathischen Du-Kultur. Die SKOPOS Group entwickelt derzeit mit „Agora“ eine zentrale Insights- und Datenplattform für die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe. Ziel der Plattform ist es, die heute fragmentierte Datenlandschaft der Marktforschung zu konsolidieren und eine gemeinsame technische Grundlage für Datenintegration, Analyse, Automatisierung und KI‑gestützte Anwendungen zu schaffen. Im Projektgeschäft entstehen große Mengen wertvoller Daten – etwa aus Survey‑Plattformen wie Qualtrics oder Forsta, aus Projekt‑ und Studiensystemen sowie aus externen Datenquellen unserer Auftraggeber. Diese Daten liegen heute oft verteilt in unterschiedlichen Systemen und lassen sich nur mit hohem manuellem Aufwand zusammenführen und analysieren. Mit „Agora“ entsteht daher eine cloudbasierte Daten‑ und Arbeitsplattform, die diese Daten automatisiert integriert und als Grundlage für neue Anwendungen nutzbar macht – von automatisierten Analysen und Reporting‑Lösungen bis hin zu KI‑basierten Insights‑Produkten. Du bist Teil des jungen Teams, das den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung der SKOPOS-eigenen KI-Plattform Agora sowohl intern als auch kundenseitig vorantreibt. Hierzu suchen wir dich ab sofort in Vollzeit für unseren Standort in Aachen oder Hürth (mit der Möglichkeit zur hybriden Arbeit). Das sind Deine Aufgaben Du findest KI-native Lösungen für anspruchsvolle fachliche Fragestellungen. Dafür nutzt du bestehende KI-Modelle wie Large Language Models ebenso wie eigene Modellentwicklungen für quantitative und Textdaten (überwiegend deutsch und englisch). Deine Lösungen werden Teil unserer Daten- und KI-Plattform „Agora“ und stehen damit dem Unternehmen und unseren Kunden zur Verfügung. Dabei integrierst du KI in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe oder ersetzt sie dort, wo das echten Mehrwert schafft, und hilfst uns, den Umgang mit Daten und Insights neu zu denken. Im Rahmen agiler Entwicklungsprozesse priorisierst du Aufgaben, stimmst dich mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen ab und stellst die erfolgreiche Umsetzung deiner Projekte sicher. Du entwickelst und implementierst Produkte und Tools auf Basis von KI-Modellen, von kommerziellen LLMs bis zu selbst trainierten Modellen, und behältst dabei Kosten und Performance im Blick. Du behältst den Projektfortschritt im Blick, löst Probleme eigenverantwortlich und hältst alle Beteiligten aktiv über den Projektstand auf dem Laufenden. Das bringst Du mit Du hast Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik oder eine Ingenieur- bzw. Naturwissenschaft studiert oder eine Ausbildung zur Fachinformatiker:in abgeschlossen, und du hast bereits praktisch Software entwickelt. Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung von Machine-Learning-Modellen mit, inklusive der Evaluierung der Ergebnisqualität, ob aus Studium, Beruf oder eigenen Projekten. Moderne Technologien aus dem AI-Bereich begeistern dich, du setzt KI-Tools bereits ein und möchtest „Agentic Engineering“ in die Praxis bringen. Du hast fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Python, arbeitest sicher mit git und hast Erfahrung mit SQL. Du stimmst deine Projekte mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern ab, arbeitest aber auch selbstständig, und du kannst Strategien und Lösungen intern wie extern verständlich vermitteln. Von Vorteil sind Erfahrung mit der Betreuung von Software im produktiven Betrieb, mit Data Warehousing (z. B. Snowflake), Microsoft Azure, OpenAI-kompatiblen APIs und LangChain. Warum wir? Flexibilität. Hybrides Arbeiten mit Anteil Office / Mobile Office, flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell, Workation, Sabbaticals Abwechslungsreiches Umfeld. Von Beginn an in spannende Projekte involviert. Innovative, dynamische Arbeitsatmosphäre. Offene Du-Unternehmenskultur und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. Aktive Mitgestaltung und Teamwork. Eigene Ideen und Erfahrungen zu neuen Produkten sind willkommen. Wir wachsen gemeinsam. Entwicklung. Schritt für Schritt darfst Du Dich bei uns entwickeln. Zyklische Feedbackgespräche (Einarbeitungs-/Jahres- und Halbjahresgespräche, systematische Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, SKOPOS School, Zertifizierung z.B. Tableau oder Alteryx).
