Pourriez-vous être le Data Scientist (H/F) à temps plein à Saint-Ouen (93) que nous recherchons ? Votre futur rôle Relevez un nouveau défi et mettez à profit votre expertise en science des données et en analyse prédictive dans un domaine de pointe. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe collaborative, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation, et vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'optimisation de nos processus de gestion des pièces détachées et de la performance des opérations. Au quotidien, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des clusters régionaux et des experts en digitalisation, tout en contribuant à des initiatives stratégiques telles que le développement d'algorithmes de prévision et d'outils d'optimisation des stocks. Vous vous occuperez plus particulièrement de la construction d'outils analytiques pour prévoir les besoins en pièces détachées et optimiser les stocks, mais aussi de l'intégration de solutions d'intelligence artificielle et de machine learning dans nos processus métier. Nous ferons appel à vous pour : Collecter et consolider des ensembles de données volumineux et complexes issus d’API et de systèmes internes. Évaluer la qualité des données, détecter les anomalies et garantir leur fiabilité. Développer des tableaux de bord et des alertes d’exception pour un suivi opérationnel efficace. Participer au développement et à l’amélioration d’un algorithme interne de Smart Pricing. Créer un outil de prévision et de gestion des stocks pour maximiser le taux de service client tout en optimisant les coûts. Modéliser et améliorer continuellement des modèles de prévision statistique et de machine learning. Soutenir le développement d’un Large Language Model interne pour les activités de gestion des pièces. Réaliser des analyses transversales pour apporter de la valeur ajoutée aux sites et clusters régionaux. Votre profil Nous accordons plus d'importance à la passion et à l’état d’esprit qu'à l'expérience. C'est pourquoi nous n'attendons pas de vous que vous possédiez toutes les compétences. Nous avons plutôt dressé une liste de celles qui, selon nous, vous aideront à réussir et à vous épanouir dans ce rôle : Diplôme d’ingénieur ou équivalent en Data Science, Data Analysis ou domaine connexe. Expérience solide des outils de Data Science et des systèmes d’information complexes. Excellente maîtrise de Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, Statsmodels, etc). Solide connaissance des méthodes de prévision de la demande et des séries temporelles (ARIMA, Prophet, XGBoost, Deep Learning ou équivalents). Connaissance des technologies d’IA générative, LLM, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) et Prompt Engineering. Capacité à traduire des besoins métier en solutions analytiques et à communiquer efficacement avec des parties prenantes non techniques. Anglais courant et esprit tourné vers l’international. Autonomie, rigueur et structuration dans l’approche des projets. Compréhension technique et industrielle des processus de chaîne d'approvisionnement. Esprit critique, capacité à challenger l’existant et orientation vers les résultats. Capacité à travailler dans une organisation complexe et à collaborer avec des équipes diversifiées. Ce que vous apprécierez Rejoignez-nous pour une nouvelle expérience de vie - le secteur ferroviaire est un secteur d’avenir, vous pouvez donc vous développer et acquérir de nouvelles compétences et expériences tout au long de votre carrière. Vous pourrez également : Bénéficier de stabilité, de défis et d'une carrière à long terme sans routine quotidienne. Travailler avec des équipes passionnées par l'innovation et la durabilité. Collaborer avec des équipes transversales et des collègues qualifiés dans un environnement multiculturel. Contribuer à des projets innovants qui redéfinissent la mobilité de demain. Utiliser notre environnement de travail flexible et axé sur la collaboration. Orienter votre carrière dans la direction de votre choix à travers les fonctions et les pays. Bénéficier de notre investissement dans votre développement, par le biais de programmes d’apprentissage primés. Progresser vers des rôles de leadership ou d’expertise technique selon vos aspirations. Bénéficier d'un système de rémunération équitable et dynamique qui reconnaît vos performances et votre potentiel, ainsi que d'une couverture sociale …

items.desc: Au sein du service Contrats & Projets France, vous intégrerez l’équipe Quality Events, en charge du traitement des événements qualité et des non-conformités de fabrication affectant les produits combustibles destinés à l’industrie nucléaire. Le traitement de ces événements nécessite de collecter et d’analyser des informations techniques provenant de différents interlocuteurs, d’identifier et formaliser les causes des événements, puis de constituer des dossiers de traitement structurés et argumentés à destination notamment des clients. Dans un contexte de développement de l’utilisation de l’Intelligence Artificielle et des outils numériques au service de la Qualité, l’équipe dispose déjà de premiers outils d’assistance à la rédaction basés sur l’IA. L’objectif du stage sera d’accompagner l’équipe Quality Events dans l’amélioration, la fiabilisation et le déploiement de ces outils afin d’automatiser autant que possible certaines étapes de constitution et de rédaction des dossiers d’analyse des événements qualité, tout en garantissant la pertinence et la qualité des documents produits. À ce titre, en collaboration étroite avec les membres de l’équipe Quality Events, vous serez amené(e) à : vous familiariser avec le processus de traitement des événements qualité et des non-conformités produit ; comprendre la structure, le contenu et les exigences associés aux dossiers d’analyse des événements qualité ; analyser les pratiques actuelles de collecte d’informations, d’analyse et de rédaction des dossiers ; prendre en main, évaluer les outils d’IA déjà existants au sein de l’équipe ; identifier leurs limites et proposer des améliorations permettant d’accroître la pertinence, la fiabilité et la qualité rédactionnelle des contenus générés ; travailler sur l’optimisation des instructions données aux outils d’IA (prompt engineering), notamment pour obtenir des documents techniques structurés, factuels et adaptés aux exigences du domaine nucléaire ; développer ou contribuer au développement de nouveaux outils informatiques d’aide à l’analyse et à la rédaction ; tester les solutions sur des cas représentatifs ou des événements qualité déjà traités et comparer les résultats obtenus avec les dossiers de référence ; proposer des méthodologies permettant de fiabiliser et standardiser l’utilisation des outils par les membres de l’équipe ; contribuer à la génération, la relecture et l’amélioration de documents techniques en français et en anglais ; formaliser les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation et accompagner leur appropriation par l’équipe. Profil Vous préparez une formation de niveau Bac+4 / Bac+5, en école d’ingénieur ou cursus universitaire, avec une orientation qualité, génie industriel, mécanique, matériaux, procédés ou domaine technique équivalent. Une première sensibilisation à la qualité industrielle, à l’analyse des causes ou aux problématiques de non-conformité constitue un atout. Au-delà de votre formation, nous recherchons avant tout un profil ayant : un goût prononcé pour les outils numériques et les technologies d’Intelligence Artificielle ; de très bonnes capacités rédactionnelles, indispensables pour analyser de manière critique les contenus produits par l’IA et obtenir des documents techniques clairs, précis et structurés ; de bonnes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse ; de la curiosité et l’envie d’expérimenter de nouvelles méthodes de travail ; de la rigueur, un esprit critique et une attention particulière à la fiabilité des informations ; une capacité à comprendre des sujets techniques et à les restituer de manière claire ; un bon niveau d’anglais écrit, permettant de travailler sur des dossiers et documents techniques en anglais ; une appétence pour le développement d’outils informatiques, l’automatisation ou la programmation constitue également un plus, sans être nécessairement le cœur du profil recherché. Ce que ce stage vous apportera : Ce stage vous permettra de découvrir le fonctionnement de la Qualité Produit dans l’industrie nucléaire et de participer directement au traitement de problématiques industrielles concrètes. Vous développerez une double compétence particulièrement actuelle : comprendre et analyser une problématique qualité industrielle, puis exploiter efficacement les outils d’Intelligence Artificielle pour structurer, synthétiser et formaliser l’information technique associée. travailler au contact de différents métiers et acteurs de la qualité, de l’ingénierie et de la fabrication, dans un environnement industriel international.

items.desc: OUR STORY: 🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow ! Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies. Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector. With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants. Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen. 📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon. WHY WE NEED YOU? As Scaleway continues to expand its AI ecosystem, we are building a new AI Agentic Platform to enable customers to build, deploy and operate AI agents at scale. Our ambition is to provide a powerful and reliable platform that helps businesses automate complex workflows, develop intelligent chatbots and orchestrate multi-agent systems. As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and developing this platform, building the tools and infrastructure needed to simplify AI agent development, ensure scalability and reliability, and deliver a seamless developer experience. This is an opportunity to build a new AI product from the ground up, tackle challenging engineering problems and contribute directly to Scaleway's growing AI ecosystem. YOUR FUTURE TEAM You will join our AI Agents team, composed of several Software Engineers and an Engineering Manager, working together to build and scale Scaleway's AI Agentic Platform. You will collaborate closely with: The AI Inference team, to ensure seamless integration, performance and compatibility with Scaleway's LLM catalog The AI Agents Product Manager, to shape the product roadmap, define priorities and drive the platform's development The SRE teams, to ensure reliable deployments, scalability and operational excellence in production You will evolve in a collaborative, highly technical environment, with the opportunity to contribute to architectural decisions, influence product development and help shape the future of AI agents at Scaleway. 🗓️ YOUR DAILY ROUTINE INCLUDES: Design and develop the Scaleway AI Agentic Platform API Deploy and ensure security, reliability, availability and quality of service of the production platforms Research and develop new features, build tooling, do technical research, anticipate issues, write architectural designs and documentation 🔍 ABOUT YOU: Hardskills Senior profile with extensive experience in Software Engineering, complex systems architecture Significant experience in API or software development Go / Golang software development Deploying and operating Kubernetes Applications and Operators Working with Containers (Image creation, deployment) Understanding of LLMs and their usage and extension patterns Optimization of LLM agents and workflows Working with AI Agents harnesses and frameworks (Langchain, CrewAI, etc.) Using AI Coding agents Writing REST and gRPC APIs Designing, querying, optimizing SQL Databases (PostgreSQL) Orchestrating reliable asynchronous task workflows Experience with using cloud services Softskills Fast learner with high adaptability to new technologies Strong curiosity and willingness to dive deep into emerging AI tools Proactive mindset and readiness to take initiative Technical autonomy and ownership of your scope Clear communicator, capable of explaining complex systems simply WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ? Hybrid work: Up to 3 days remote per week Modern offices: Creative, ergonomic workspaces in prime locations with terraces and bike facilities Healthy dining: Chef-prepared meals at HQ; Swile card for regional sites Well-being: Support for gym memberships, childcare, and caregiver services Diverse culture: English is as common as French; teams span many nationalities Growth mindset: Strong internal mobility and opportunities across the Iliad Group 🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure ? ✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, AI. ✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges. ✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level …

items.card: you will turn promising AI ideas and prototypes into secure, maintainable solutions that help our Quality colleagues work smarter, and ultimately support the quality of the hearing aids that improve people's lives every day. You will be the team's engineering anchor, and with that comes real influence on what we build and how we build it. Your days will be hands-on. You will design, build and deploy AI-assisted
items.desc: Help build how AI is done right in a medical device company Imagine joining a team at the very beginning. Not to maintain something others designed, but to shape what it becomes: the code, the platform, the way of working and the people around you. That is the opportunity in our Quality AI Enabler team. We are a small team working where AI, cloud technology, software engineering, data and Quality meet. Together with our AI Business Analyst and Quality Engineering Graduate, you will turn promising AI ideas and prototypes into secure, maintainable solutions that help our Quality colleagues work smarter, and ultimately support the quality of the hearing aids that improve people's lives every day. You will be the team's engineering anchor, and with that comes real influence on what we build and how we build it. Your days will be hands-on. You will design, build and deploy AI-assisted workflows and applications in Microsoft Azure, using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, and enterprise data. You will write backend services, APIs and integrations, and you know what it takes to move a prototype into production. You probably have around 4-6 years of software development behind you, and you have already shipped something real with generative AI. But this role is about more than code. You will set the engineering practices the team grows on, create reusable patterns for future AI initiatives, and help less experienced colleagues grow through pairing, reviews and sharing what you know. You do not need a manager title to lead: you lead by example, explain technical choices in plain language, and challenge assumptions when something looks fragile. And then there are the guardrails. Hearing aids are regulated medical devices, so in our company responsible AI is not a slide in a presentation; it is part of the design. You will help define how we handle security, data access, evaluation and AI lifecycle controls, and you will learn how the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 shape what good looks like. Experience from a regulated industry is an advantage, but curiosity matters more. Few places let you build this knowledge from the ground up. We are one such place. What you bring Strong development skills in Python or another language Hands-on experience deploying solutions in Microsoft Azure Practical experience with generative AI and LLM-based applications Working knowledge of REST APIs, MCP servers or similar integrations Git, automated testing and CI/CD as daily habits A solid grasp of authentication, secrets and application security Clear communication in English It is a plus if you have worked with Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Graph, Semantic Kernel, Docker or SQL, or with AI evaluation and monitoring. You are a pragmatic builder who knows the difference between an impressive demo and a solution people can rely on. You enjoy experimenting, but you respect disciplined engineering. If you want to develop your own skills while building a team, its processes and its infrastructure from the start, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV and motivational letter as soon as possible, as we are screening applications on a continuous basis. Please note that we only accept applications through our online recruitment system. Deadline for applications: 6th December 2026. If you have any questions regarding the position, you are very welcome to write to Klaus Lagersted at KLLG@Demant.com At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

items.desc: Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from UK, based in London? We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent interpersonal skills for the position of Founding AI Engineer Hands-on AI Engineer with 4+ years building production AI agents in Python. You'll own a proprietary "AI factory" platform that turns customers' processes and expertise into production-ready AI employees, working closely with founders and customers. The salary range is £90,000+ per year depending on the candidate's experience and seniority. Benefits: Statutory benefits Meaningful equity (0.2–0.5%) Only candidates based in London will be considered. The role is on-site in London, with the option to work remotely on an ad-hoc basis some days. Responsibilities: Designing and building the AI factory: the pipeline that turns a customer's processes, files and expert decisions into working AI employees, with as much of the work as possible done by agents Building the runtime where agents operate, including orchestration, coordination between AI employees, human-in-the-loop approvals, logging, monitoring and rollback Developing imitation learning and reinforcement learning capabilities so AI employees can imitate human experts and self-improve Building testing frameworks that prove an AI employee makes the same calls a human expert would before going live Running product for the factory with the founders and customer-facing engineer, identifying repeated work and making it standard Working directly with customers to understand their operations and scope problems Requirements: 4+ years of hands-on experience building end-to-end AI agents that have been deployed to production and are actively used by end customers, with strong Python Experience with agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK or similar), Temporal and MCP Experience deploying services with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS or GCP Experience working directly with customers to scope and deliver solutions Nice to have: early-stage startup experience and knowledge of reinforcement learning or machine learning

items.desc: YOUR MISSION AT VOI As an AI Engineer at Voi, you will build and own the AI platform that our business depends on. Close to 400 colleagues use Voi’s AI platform every day, and teams across the company have already built over 300 apps on our in-house app-building platform. This is a hands-on builder role in a small, senior team where your work will have company-wide impact. You will keep our existing AI platform fast, secure, and reliable, while building the next generation of capabilities that help Voi move faster, work smarter, and continue leading in applied AI. You will: Own and improve Voi’s AI platform, including our in-house app-building platform, Claude stack and future AI capabilities. Build robust backend services and full-stack, user-facing features that make the platform reliable, scalable, and easy to use. Develop the next layer of AI infrastructure, such as agentic platforms, enterprise search, knowledge bases, knowledge graphs and open-weight model access. Strengthen security, identity and access control across the platform, including permissions, security reviews, audits and integrations with company systems. Work closely with the AI team, platform team and colleagues across Voi to understand needs, test ideas and ship useful tools quickly. Help decide what we build, buy or integrate, with a focus on control, long-term value and avoiding vendor lock-in. Explore the AI landscape and bring promising ideas into the platform when they are ready to scale. WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys building platforms that many people rely on. You combine strong backend skills with product thinking, sound judgement, and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical colleagues. We believe you bring: Strong experience building and running robust, scalable internal platforms, ideally including AI platforms. A solid backend engineering background, with experience building applications and services at scale. Hands-on experience with LLMs in production, such as agents, tool use, MCP, RAG, search or evaluation. Full-stack ability and a good sense of UX, especially when building tools for non-engineers. Good understanding of identity, authentication and access control, or a strong interest in going deeper in this area. A practical builder mindset, with the ability to turn ideas into working software and iterate quickly. Autonomy, ownership and good judgement in open-ended technical areas. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to different audiences. Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box. WHY VOI? Working at Voi is more than just a job; our People Promise includes a personal voyage where you will grow as a professional and be a part of a team and culture that builds something meaningful for society. In addition to this, you’ll have the opportunity to: Own a platform that is already critical to how Voi works and shape what comes next. Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups. Help build agentic, knowledge and open-model infrastructure from the ground up. Work in a small, senior team with high trust, fast decisions and a clear mandate. Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme. Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office. Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal. Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.

items.desc: Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world. Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space. We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture. You'll be part of the Sphera AI Center of Excellence team building and maturing the AI capabilities that Sphera and its customers depend on. You will design and ship AI agents and AI-powered features used across product families and internal functions, and act as the expert other teams come to when they want to build with AI themselves. We build on Claude and deploy on Azure AI Foundry, with Claude Code as our primary development environment. The pace is fast, prototype to production in weeks, not quarters, so you'll apply the skills you have while learning new ones constantly. If you have hands-on experience shipping LLM-based systems and enjoy unblocking other engineers, you'll do well here. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain production AI agents and AI-powered features — new builds as well as enhancements to existing solutions. Build and sustain agentic systems end to end: task decomposition, tool design, context and memory strategy, orchestration, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and fallback behavior. Build the retrieval and grounding layer — document processing, chunking, hybrid search, and citation — so agents answer from Sphera's own data. Deploy and operate AI workloads on Azure AI Foundry: model deployments, endpoints, content safety, private networking, and cost and quota management. Use Claude Code as a core engineering tool and set the patterns other teams follow when they do the same. Own evaluation: build eval suites and golden datasets, measure accuracy, latency, cost, and tool-call correctness, and gate changes on results. Implement AI guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, and PII handling, working with Platform Engineering on identity and network controls. Ship through CI/CD with versioned prompts and agent definitions, plus tracing and token/cost observability on every path. Support teams adopting shared AI services — review their designs, troubleshoot integrations, and document reusable patterns. Establish KPIs for adoption, quality, and cost-per-outcome, and use them to drive improvement and make the team's impact visible. Participate fully in the agile process — own your sprint tasks, log time worked, and keep details current. Required Skills And Experience AI Engineering 4–6 years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building with large language models in production. Hands-on experience shipping agentic systems: multi-step tool use, structured outputs, state and memory, error recovery — and the judgment to know when an agent isn't the right answer. Working command of Claude or a comparable frontier model platform, including APIs, tool use, and agent SDKs. Practical daily use of AI-assisted development tooling, Claude Code in particular. Retrieval engineering: embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, and evaluating retrieval quality on its own terms. Evaluation and observability for non-deterministic systems — offline evals, human review loops, tracing, and cost instrumentation. Software and Cloud Strong Python, plus one of TypeScript, C#, or Java. Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI — model deployment, endpoint configuration, and content safety controls. Azure fundamentals: App Service or Function Apps, Key Vault, Storage, Entra ID managed identities, and Application Insights. CI/CD with Azure DevOps — YAML pipelines, multi-stage deployments, and secret management. REST and async API design, and integration with enterprise systems of record. Databases (SQL and NoSQL) and vector stores; solid Git and code review practice. Professional Sound security judgment applied to AI — least privilege for tool access, secrets management, data exfiltration risk, and compliance-driven controls. Excellent communication, with the ability to explain AI design decisions and trade-offs to people who are not AI specialists. Experience working in an agile AIDLC (AI-driven software development lifecycle) in a fast-paced …

items.title: Software Engineer AI Agents
items.card: you will play a key role in designing and developing this platform, building the tools and infrastructure needed to simplify AI agent development, ensure scalability and reliability, and deliver a seamless developer experience. This is an opportunity to build a new AI product from the ground up, tackle challenging engineering problems and contribute directly to Scaleway's growing AI ecosystem. YOUR FUTURE TEAM You
items.desc: OUR STORY: 🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow ! Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies. Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector. With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants. Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen. 📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon. WHY WE NEED YOU? As Scaleway continues to expand its AI ecosystem, we are building a new AI Agentic Platform to enable customers to build, deploy and operate AI agents at scale. Our ambition is to provide a powerful and reliable platform that helps businesses automate complex workflows, develop intelligent chatbots and orchestrate multi-agent systems. As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and developing this platform, building the tools and infrastructure needed to simplify AI agent development, ensure scalability and reliability, and deliver a seamless developer experience. This is an opportunity to build a new AI product from the ground up, tackle challenging engineering problems and contribute directly to Scaleway's growing AI ecosystem. YOUR FUTURE TEAM You will join our AI Agents team, composed of several Software Engineers and an Engineering Manager, working together to build and scale Scaleway's AI Agentic Platform. You will collaborate closely with: The AI Inference team, to ensure seamless integration, performance and compatibility with Scaleway's LLM catalog The AI Agents Product Manager, to shape the product roadmap, define priorities and drive the platform's development The SRE teams, to ensure reliable deployments, scalability and operational excellence in production You will evolve in a collaborative, highly technical environment, with the opportunity to contribute to architectural decisions, influence product development and help shape the future of AI agents at Scaleway. 🗓️ YOUR DAILY ROUTINE INCLUDES: Design and develop the Scaleway AI Agentic Platform API Deploy and ensure security, reliability, availability and quality of service of the production platforms Research and develop new features, build tooling, do technical research, anticipate issues, write architectural designs and documentation 🔍 ABOUT YOU: Hardskills Senior profile with extensive experience in Software Engineering, complex systems architecture Significant experience in API or software development Go / Golang software development Deploying and operating Kubernetes Applications and Operators Working with Containers (Image creation, deployment) Understanding of LLMs and their usage and extension patterns Optimization of LLM agents and workflows Working with AI Agents harnesses and frameworks (Langchain, CrewAI, etc.) Using AI Coding agents Writing REST and gRPC APIs Designing, querying, optimizing SQL Databases (PostgreSQL) Orchestrating reliable asynchronous task workflows Experience with using cloud services Softskills Fast learner with high adaptability to new technologies Strong curiosity and willingness to dive deep into emerging AI tools Proactive mindset and readiness to take initiative Technical autonomy and ownership of your scope Clear communicator, capable of explaining complex systems simply WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ? Hybrid work: Up to 3 days remote per week Modern offices: Creative, ergonomic workspaces in prime locations with terraces and bike facilities Healthy dining: Chef-prepared meals at HQ; Swile card for regional sites Well-being: Support for gym memberships, childcare, and caregiver services Diverse culture: English is as common as French; teams span many nationalities Growth mindset: Strong internal mobility and opportunities across the Iliad Group 🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure ? ✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, AI. ✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges. ✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level …

As an award-winning Atlassian partner with a world-class team, we help organizations innovate and solve complex challenges for Fortune 500 companies and beyond, we want to hear from you. Opportunity! We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, AI, and customer delivery. You'll partner directly with clients to understand complex business and technical challenges, rapidly design and build solutions, and integrate modern AI capabilities into real-world applications and systems. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong application development skills with a customer-focused mindset and enjoys taking solutions from initial discovery and architecture through implementation and deployment. Solid application engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing, and deploying scalable software solutions. Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications and existing technology ecosystems. Strong experience designing and integrating APIs and distributed systems, including third-party services and enterprise platforms. Experience building solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies. Experience working with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Proficiency with TypeScript and modern application development frameworks. Experience with agent orchestration, AI workflows, tool calling, or similar agentic architectures. Strong customer-facing and consulting skills, with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Experience with solution architecture, including designing scalable systems and making technical decisions based on customer and business requirements. Ability to work closely with customer stakeholders, product teams, and engineers throughout the solution lifecycle. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. Bonus points: Experience delivering technical solutions directly within customer environments. Experience designing or implementing RAG, AI agents, or multi-agent systems. Exposure to MLOps, model deployment, and AI observability. Experience working in consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles. Experience rapidly building prototypes and proofs of concept and evolving them into production-ready solutions. Familiarity with modern data platforms, vector databases, and AI infrastructure. You'll Love: Working directly with customers to solve complex, real-world technical challenges. Building and deploying AI-powered solutions that move quickly from concept to production. Combining hands-on engineering with solution architecture and customer collaboration. Working across application engineering, cloud technologies, and modern AI systems. Exploring emerging AI technologies and finding practical ways to apply them to meaningful business problems. By joining our team, you'll be part of a winning squad that plays to each other's strengths and celebrates every success together.

Notre expertise réside principalement dans l’optimisation et la commercialisation des capacités de nos clients. Nous travaillons sur divers projets tels que la prévision et la tarification des billets , l’optimisation 3D du fret aérien ou encore la collecte automatisée des prix de la concurrence . Nos applications sont les outils privilégiés d’entreprises telles que la SNCF, United Airlines, Qatar Airways ou encore le PSG pour visualiser, analyser et optimiser leurs capacités. Dynamiques et ambitieux, nous nous attachons à préserver notre ADN technique, moteur de notre succès. L'entreprise, rentable et autofinancée pendant plus de 10 ans, vient de lever ses premiers fonds pour accélérer sa croissance. Elle est constituée en majorité d'ingénieurs et d'experts et développe un business model basé sur des solutions « software-as-a-service ». Tes missions 🚀 Chez Wiremind, l’ équipe Data développe, suit et fait évoluer les fonctionnalités de prévision et d’optimisation basées sur le machine learning, utilisées dans nos systèmes de revenue management. L’équipe se compose de Machine Learning Engineers , qui construisent et suivent les modèles de machine learning, de spécialistes MLOps , qui travaillent en profondeur sur les outils, et de Data Engineers , qui garantissent la robustesse des pipelines de données et la bonne intégration de ces modèles dans nos logiciels. Are you ready to shape the future of profitable innovative business for Bosch? 
 At Bosch Management Consulting, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our Go-to-Market Practice. This is your opportunity to apply your strategic insights and deep understanding of our business to drive market success for innovative products and solutions to create new value pools for Bosch. If you're passionate about transforming ideas into impactful market realities and are looking for a clear path to accelerate your career within a dynamic, high-impact consulting environment, then this role is for you.

You will work on high-visibility projects, collaborating with cross-functional and international teams, and directly influence our competitive positioning and revenue growth.

We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship. Kaluza Overview Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What will I be doing? You'll be joining the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. We’re a large team of both data-led and product focused Software and Production Engineers, pushing the boundaries of technology and working at an extraordinary scale. As a collective we strive for engineering greatness and by ensuring best practices across the board of the community. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal role in architecting and evolving our Internal AI Engineering Platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll be building the infrastructure—from Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows—that empower our software teams to move faster and more securely. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation. Our tech stack is very fluid, but broadly you can find yourself working with: AWS, Kubernetes, LLMs (Claude, GPT, etc.), MCP servers, LangChain/LangGraph, and modern observability tools. Key responsibilities include: AI Foundations & Tooling: Design, plan, build and evolve our AI Platform Foundations and tooling. This includes the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC) and associated infra, AI Governance layer (MCP & LLM gateways), introducing and evolving shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards. AI Tooling Eval & Deployment: Support the trials, evaluation and deployment of next-generation engineering tools keeping Kaluza at the forefront of new technologies in the fast moving AI space. Agentic SDLC: Working with different stakeholders and disciplines to build and evolve the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework and get it into the hands of our Engineering teams. Taking learnings and feedback from engineers/ stakeholders, coupled with metrics and advances from industry and apply them to improve and scale our software development capabilities safely and securely. Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience measurement. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes. For example, the volume of AI-generated contributions within PRs and their correlation to code quality and velocity. Security & Cost Optimization: Partner with security and finance teams to ensure our AI usage reinforces our security safeguards and remains cost-efficient at scale. About You Ideally you'll have/be: Systems Thinker : You possess a solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems and understand how to integrate third-party AI APIs (like Claude or OpenAI) without compromising system reliability or latency. Infrastructure as Code & Beyond : You have hands-on experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure. The EngEx Mindset : You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Familiarity with Engineering productivity tooling such as DX, LinearB or Swarmia. Security & Governance First : You understand the risks of AI (data leakage, prompt injection) and can design approval processes and security guardrails that protect the business without slowing down innovation. Data-Informed : You enjoy defining and automating metrics—like tracking AI-generated code volume or PR velocity—to prove the value of the tools …

Inetum a conclu des partenariats stratégiques avec 4 grands éditeurs mondiaux - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft et SAP et poursuit une stratégie d'acquisitions dédiée afin d'entrer dans le top 5 européen sur ces technologies et proposer la meilleure expertise à ses clients. Une expérience des solutions Agentic AI, IA générative ou intégration de LLM dans des processus d'automatisation est un réel plus. Compétences fonctionnelles : Capacité à analyser et formaliser les besoins métiers (PDD/SDD), optimisation de processus Soft skills : Autonomie, rigueur, bon relationnel, esprit d’analyse Atouts : Certification UiPath, expérience en Agile, notions en process mining, IA générative ou Agentic AI

items.desc: Rejoins une Deeptech innovante et développe tes compétences en Growth Marketing, Growth Hacking, IA, automatisation, SEO/GEO et acquisition B2B, au service de l'innovation scientifique. Pas besoin d'être expert(e) en marketing : nous recherchons avant tout un esprit curieux, créatif et entrepreneurial ! Ton profil : un esprit curieux, autonome et entreprenant ! Pas besoin d'être déjà expert en growth hacking, en développement web ou en intelligence artificielle. Ce qu'on recherche avant tout, c'est un tempérament : de la curiosité, de l'initiative, l'envie de comprendre et surtout le plaisir d'expérimenter ! Le growth hacking, le web et les outils IA ? On te formera directement sur des projets concrets ! Ta mission : transformer la curiosité des chercheurs en opportunités commerciales Ton objectif sera de faire connaître nos instruments à travers le monde, attirer les bons chercheurs et transformer leur intérêt en prospects qualifiés. Pour y parvenir, tu toucheras à de nombreux domaines : Imaginer et lancer des campagnes d'acquisition : identifier les bons chercheurs, trouver les messages qui font mouche et choisir les canaux les plus pertinents pour engager la discussion. Booster nos campagnes de mailing : affiner le ciblage, personnaliser les messages, tester de nouvelles approches et analyser les résultats pour progresser à chaque campagne. Faire évoluer notre site web : utiliser les outils d'IA pour améliorer nos pages, optimiser les parcours utilisateurs, explorer le front-end comme le back-end et renforcer notre visibilité sur les moteurs de recherche et les IA génératives ( SEO & GEO ). Construire les outils IA de demain : concevoir des prompts efficaces, développer des assistants intelligents et automatiser les tâches qui méritent de l'être. Oser les idées « out of the box » : imaginer un outil utile aux chercheurs, créer un contenu inattendu ou inventer une nouvelle manière d'identifier leurs besoins. On partage les idées, on expérimente et on garde ce qui fonctionne ! Bien plus que du marketing : comprendre et influencer l'innovation ! Ton travail ne servira pas uniquement à générer des prospects. En analysant les besoins et les réactions des chercheurs, tu nous aideras aussi à mieux comprendre notre marché et à orienter les futurs développements de notre équipe R&D. L'IA au cœur de ton quotidien ! Ici, l'intelligence artificielle n'est pas juste un sujet à la mode : c'est un outil que nous exploitons pleinement. Notre ambition ? Te permettre de développer de véritables compétences de prompt engineer, en pratiquant chaque jour, avec nous. Ta formation Tu as une formation Bac +5 en sciences ou en ingénierie ? Parfait ! Tu as moins d'années d'études, mais tu t'es formé(e) par toi-même, tu as développé de solides compétences et tu as des réalisations concrètes à nous montrer ? Ta candidature nous intéresse tout autant ! Ce qu'on recherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un qui aime transformer ses idées en actions. Un esprit vif et inventif : tu réfléchis vite, tu es curieux(se) et tu trouves des solutions là où d'autres voient des obstacles. Le goût de l'action : quand tu identifies une opportunité, tu ne te contentes pas d'en parler. Tu imagines un premier test et tu passes à l'action ! Une approche expérimentale : tu testes, tu mesures, tu analyses et tu ajustes. Tu développes ce qui fonctionne et tu sais abandonner une mauvaise idée, même quand c'était la tienne ! Une vraie autonomie : tu prends des initiatives, tu anticipes et tu fais avancer tes projets sans attendre qu'on te relance. Une curiosité pour les nouvelles technologies : tu as envie d'explorer les possibilités de l'IA, d'expérimenter de nouveaux outils et de développer tes compétences. Chez nous, on aime : Les gens d'action, les inventifs, les autonomes, les curieux et ceux qui sont exigeants avec eux-mêmes tout en prenant soin des autres. Ceux qui osent essayer, qui apprennent de leurs erreurs et qui préfèrent faire plutôt que parler. Et ceux qui ramènent des chouquettes ont déjà compris une partie de notre culture ! Tu as lancé un projet, développé un outil, automatisé une tâche, testé une idée originale ou créé quelque chose de tes propres mains ? Un projet personnel, associatif ou autodidacte compte tout autant qu'une expérience professionnelle ! items.desc: About Qevlar AI Qevlar is a B2B SaaS scale-up on a mission to boost the productivity of cybersecurity teams with Artificial Intelligence. We build an AI platform that transitions Security Operations Centers from reactive to proactive units through autonomous security alert investigations. In just three years, we have: Raised a total of $44m in series-A & seed rounds from EQT Ventures, Forgepoint Capital and Partech Deployed our solution with major Enterprises such as Sodexo and GlobalConnect, and leading MSSPs like Orange Cyberdefense Grown to 1,500+ clients across the US and EMEA Ended 2025 with a strong multi-million dollar ARR, and we're targeting $25M by the end of 2027 We're looking for an IT Engineer to build our IT function from the ground up, working directly with our IT & Security Director. Modern, cloud-only stack, no legacy to clean up, and real space to automate with AI, at a company whose product is AI for security. What you'll actually do Fleet management: provision, secure and maintain our macOS and Windows laptops through MDM, from zero-touch enrollment to patching, compliance and hardware lifecycle. Joiner/mover/leaver automation: build an HRIS-triggered flow so accounts, access and devices are ready on day one and revoked on the last day. Identity and access: run Okta as the single source of access, roll out SSO and SCIM across our SaaS tools, with role-based groups, MFA policies and automated access reviews. Helpdesk: own user support end to end, with a ticketing flow and a self-service knowledge base in Notion, plus an AI-powered IT assistant in Slack. SaaS management: keep the app inventory, control licenses and costs, and onboard new tools securely. Compliance: implement SOC 2 controls, automate evidence collection in Vanta, and roll out core IT policies with user training. What we're looking for at least 5 years in IT at a startup or scale-up on a cloud-first, SaaS-only stack Hands-on Okta administration, including SSO and SCIM for SaaS apps You've managed a mixed macOS and Windows fleet through MDM (Iru, Jamf or Intune), from procurement to deprovisioning You've built or automated joiner/mover/leaver processes from the HRIS Google Workspace administration You've contributed to a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit Scripting in Python, Bash or PowerShell, and a reflex to automate anything you do twice Ownership, clear documentation habits and a service mindset with non-technical colleagues Fluent English and French Nice to have: GRC tools, ZTNA/VPN, HRIS integrations, cloud IAM and Terraform, building internal AI agents or using MCP/LLM APIs for IT tasks. Why join us Work on meaningful problems with real-world impact in cybersecurity A high-impact role in a small, international, fast-moving team where your contributions directly shape the company and its success Shape the future of a product already making noise in AI + security circles A company culture that values autonomy and creativity Opportunity for equity and early ownership We’re flexible on location: you can either work from home or join your colleagues in our beautiful office in Paris’ 9th arrondissement. If you’re excited about helping security teams adopt cutting-edge AI, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s build the future of cybersecurity together! items.desc: Platform Associate (m/f/d): Talent, Growth, Content & AI Workflows Remote, with offices in Munich and Karlsruhe · Start January or February 2027 About us First Momentum invests in deep tech and industrial tech founders across Europe at pre-seed when there's more lab than traction. We've made 40+ investments into industries like energy, space, industrial, and semicon, and our companies went on to raise from Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, or Insight Partners. We're a team of engineers, scientists, and operators on a mission to build a different kind of VC fund. Our goal isn't the biggest fund or the loudest headlines, but to be the VC deeply technical teams need and deserve at inception. Someone who truly understands their tech, is humble and candid, and connects them with the relevant people they need at a given stage, be it a designer or a pilot customer. You won't find us at the after-party; instead, we're obsessing over good reads, fast bikes, and the latest moonshots we want to bring to life. Your tasks For us, platform is like a product with multiple customer groups: founders, LPs, Scouts, and the investment team. While we get inspired by playbooks and what other funds are doing, we treat them as what they are: past successes. For us, platform is much more similar to what our portfolio teams are doing: building products and driving growth, whether for our fund or our portcos. We come up with new ideas, identify the most impactful ones, test them, measure, iterate, or drop them and rerun the entire sprint. Your north star: helping our portfolio founders succeed through intros, hires, and any other random request. We measure ourselves on support per euro invested. Much of that support runs through the Platform team. Call it Founder's Associate , Chief of Staff , Venture Ops , GTM , or Growth . Here, it means you take on some of the most pressing problems of our portfolio companies and the fund operations. You'll work with several super-technical, highly humble founders and the investment team at once. Hiring for the portfolio: The first 10 people shape a startup more than anything else. You run multiple outbound campaigns in parallel, from sourcing and outreach to the final intro, and learn each field well enough to find the best talent. Sometimes that means building teams from zero for our incubation projects; previous ones: Telura (deep geothermal) and Starforge (fusion energy). Content and website: You turn the technical and industry expertise from First Momentum's investment team and portfolio news (funding rounds, launches, technical results) into content for LinkedIn, our blog, and our newsletter. You also own our Webflow site and how AI search finds us. European deep tech community: You grow our community of 100+ technical Venture Scouts and bring them into hiring and deals. You support in-person events like our annual meeting and help co-organize the European Spinoff Summit in Munich. Tooling and workflows: If you've done something by hand twice, you build a Claude skill or automation for it the third time. Your profile 1–2 years of hands-on work at a startup, VC, recruiting firm, or similar Sourcing or outbound experience, whether in recruiting or in sales/GTM You write well in German and English (full working proficiency in both) You can run 10+ workstreams at once without daily steering and know where the 80/20 is You're fast, friendly, and specific with founders, partners, and candidates You like building generally, also with AI tools, BUT know when not to use them and when your own judgment beats the model's You're curious about many fields and fine switching from a Head of Biology search to a blog post to a website fix in one afternoon A good eye for design What we offer Work with people building fusion reactors and foundation models You work with the teams behind 40+ deep tech companies and with our partners from day one. See Technology 5–10 years earlier You see what comes straight out of research labs long before most people meet it in a product. Your next job is already in the portfolio You'll get to know dozens of startups from the inside. If at some time you feel like moving on, you’ll have a great network to rely on, but we will also actively help. If you want, you can stay part of First Momentum after your time with us through our Venture Scout program. Some Scouts have since joined Y Combinator, built $20M-funded robotics spinouts, or moved to Anthropic's design team. More here: https://www.firstmomentum.vc/venture-scouts Room to build New tools, workflows, and formats. If it works, it stays. You'll have few meetings, coordinate mostly async, and plan your own week. Five fields in one job Recruiting, content, design, web, and AI tooling. Most people with 1–2 years of experience get to work in one of them. Remote Culture Our team is spread across Germany, Austria, the UK, and Spain. We don't hire local optimum but hire the best people wherever they are in Europe. To work together and …

Support identity and access management governance by reviewing control evidence, identifying gaps, and monitoring agreed remediation actions. Review third-party assurance reports and service dependencies to identify supplier control gaps and their implications for the business. Prepare clear assessment reports, decision papers, and management information. Escalate material risks, overdue actions, and unresolved decisions to the appropriate decision-makers. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle AI Analytics Engineer based in Ireland. We are looking for a skilled and innovative Middle AI Analytics Engineer to strengthen a growing Data & Analytics team within an international technology environment. In this fully remote role, you will help transform the way analytical teams access, process, and leverage data through AI-powered solutions. You will focus on improving self-service analytics, automating repetitive analytical workflows, and developing robust frameworks to evaluate AI performance and reliability. Working with technologies such as Python, SQL, Claude, RAG, and BI platforms, you will build practical solutions that enhance productivity and decision-making. You will also contribute to advancing AI-assisted analytics through context engineering, intelligent automation, and continuous quality monitoring. This is an excellent opportunity to work on ambitious technical projects, influence AI adoption, and grow within a collaborative, innovation-driven organization. Accountabilities Self-Service Analytics Enhancement: Improve the quality and accessibility of self-service analytics through Metabase by developing and integrating AI skills, contextual information, and intelligent workflows that help users retrieve accurate and relevant insights. Analytics Workflow Automation: Identify and automate repetitive tasks within the Data & Analytics team, developing AI-powered tools such as automated code reviewers, reusable AI skills, and other productivity-enhancing solutions. AI Quality Evaluation: Design and implement a comprehensive framework for evaluating the quality, accuracy, and reliability of AI-driven solutions used by the analytics team. Claude and Context Engineering: Design and optimize Claude skills, including their purpose, instructions, examples, and contextual information, to improve response quality and minimize hallucinations. RAG Development and Optimization: Design, implement, and improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, including source indexing, document chunking, information retrieval, and reranking strategies. AI Performance Monitoring: Develop evaluation methodologies using golden answers, automated evaluations (evals), LLM-as-a-judge techniques, regression testing, and performance monitoring to identify quality issues and detect model drift. Root Cause Analysis: Investigate AI-related performance issues, identify underlying causes, and implement improvements to ensure reliable and consistent analytical outputs. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with analytics and technical teams to identify opportunities for AI adoption, improve existing processes, and deliver scalable solutions that support business objectives. Continuous Innovation: Explore new AI capabilities, tools, and development approaches to improve analytical efficiency and encourage the adoption of intelligent automation across the organization. Requirements Practical experience in AI engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role. Strong SQL skills, with the ability to query, manipulate, and analyze structured data effectively. Proficiency in Python for developing automation solutions, analytical tools, and AI-powered applications. Hands-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Strong understanding of Claude skills and context engineering, including designing reusable skills, defining clear instructions, providing relevant examples, and optimizing prompt context to reduce hallucinations. Experience designing and improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, including document indexing, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, and reranking. Knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, including golden datasets or answers, evaluation frameworks, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, model drift monitoring, and root cause analysis. Ability to assess the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of AI-generated outputs and continuously improve AI-powered solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to investigating technical challenges. Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to exchange ideas, share feedback, and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team. A proactive and adaptable mindset, with a willingness to experiment, take ownership, and continuously develop technical expertise. Nice to have: Experience developing AI agents through LLM APIs or SDKs, including tool integration, context management, and cost optimization. Familiarity with Business Intelligence platforms and their role as data access layers for AI systems, including data models, metrics, and query structures. Experience with Metabase or Tableau is an advantage. Previous experience working with dbt for data transformation and analytics engineering. …

We began in sports, predicting outcomes in live football matches, and today we bring that same precision and ambition into the world of business. We're here to unlock value through artificial intelligence and help organisations make better, more informed decisions, faster. With more than one hundred AI and data projects delivered, our work has transformed industries and earned international recognition. But awards and numbers tell only part of the story. What truly defines us is our people. Our team comes from leading institutions such as KU, DTU, Stanford, Oxford, Harvard, Caltech, Yale, Columbia, and many more, blending expertise in physics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, operations research, computer science, chemistry, economics, biology, design and strategy. Together, we share curiosity, boldness, and a pioneering spirit. Halfspace is a part of Faculty, which forms the global spearhead for deep applied AI capabilities in Accenture. Faculty, founded in the UK and now expanding globally, has a long history of building and deploying advanced AI solutions for major industry players, including work on AI Safety with Frontier AI Labs. What You'll Be Doing As part of the AI Engineering team at Halfspace, you’ll be building innovative solutions along with the very best within the field of scalable, robust and resilient GenAI, in many cases significantly changing how our clients work. You’ll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of a fast-moving field, and the responsibility to ensure that the rapid innovation has real impact. You will split you time between client sites, where you directly interfacing with the people we build for to understand their problems in depth, and working from our offices, sharing knowledge and learning from the whole Halfspace team. You’ll be part of defining what best practice looks like, when it comes to building production-grade Generative AI solutions that deliver value in practice. You’ll work alongside engineers, scientists, and strategists from some of the world’s leading institutions, applying deep technical expertise and creative thinking to solve complex problems. From prototyping novel AI applications to operationalising solutions at scale, you’ll bridge research and engineering to turn ideas into solutions that redefine performance. Participará en todo el ciclo de vida de las soluciones, desde la identificación de oportunidades y la experimentación hasta su puesta en producción y adopción por parte del negocio. ¿Buscas aplicar la inteligencia artificial a retos reales y llevar tus soluciones más allá de la fase de prototipo? ¡Queremos conocerte! Responsabilidades: Analizar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio, y convertirlas en soluciones basadas en inteligencia artificial. Evaluar y seleccionar el enfoque técnico más adecuado para cada caso, incluyendo Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, IA generativa y sistemas agénticos . Desarrollar proyectos de IA de principio a fin: descubrimiento, experimentación, creación de prototipos, despliegue y adopción. Colaborar con los equipos de Plataforma e Ingeniería de IA, IT, Datos y negocio para diseñar e integrar soluciones escalables. Desplegar soluciones en entornos productivos y contribuir a su monitorización, reentrenamiento y gestión del ciclo de vida. Asegurar que las soluciones cumplan los requisitos de rendimiento, robustez, escalabilidad, seguridad y mantenibilidad. Contribuir a pruebas de concepto, evaluaciones técnicas y patrones reutilizables, compartiendo recomendaciones con los equipos técnicos y de negocio. Explorar y evaluar nuevas técnicas, modelos y herramientas de inteligencia artificial. Requisitos: Al menos 3 años de experiencia profesional en Inteligencia Artificial . Al menos 2 años de experiencia como Data Scientist o Machine Learning Engineer , con experiencia práctica en Machine Learning, Deep Learning y/o Computer Vision. Experiencia colaborando con equipos de plataforma, ingeniería, datos y negocio en entornos corporativos. Conocimientos prácticos de ecosistemas de LLM, técnicas avanzadas de prompt engineering y frameworks agénticos. Experiencia con LangChain, LangGraph o frameworks similares; se valorará el conocimiento de protocolos como A2A y MCP . Inglés y español. Capacidad analítica, orientación a la resolución de problemas, autonomía y habilidad para comunicar ideas técnicas a públicos diversos. Ofrecemos: Jornada completa y modalidad de trabajo híbrida en Sant Cugat. Contratación indefinida desde el primer momento. Retribución flexible, t icket restaurant, seguro médico y otros beneficios. Flexibilidad horaria. Formación continua y acceso a certificaciones. Desarrollo profesional dentro de un equipo altamente especializado. Excelente ambiente de trabajo y plan de carrera. Si te interesa la oportunidad y conocer todos los detalles, no dudes en aplicar al puesto para que podamos contactarte y hablar mejor sobre la posición, darte toda la información y resolver cualquier duda que te pueda surgir. Agap2 es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades, por ello nos comprometemos a tratar todas las candidaturas por igual en función de sus capacidades, logros y experiencia. Animamos a cualquier persona a presentar su candidatura que será tratada con igualdad de oportunidades independientemente de su raza, nacionalidad, sexo, edad, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad de género o cualquier otra característica.

We are TAKKT – an international, listed company with strong brands such as kaiserkraft, ratioform, BIGDUG, FRANKEL, Gerdmans and Runelandhs. As a leading provider in B2B omnichannel commerce, we create powerful and sustainable solutions that make working life easier and better. We are looking for motivated people who want to contribute shaping the workplaces of tomorrow. Join TAKKT Group – we are looking for motivated employees in Budapest to strengthen our team as an AI Engineer to shape new worlds of work! As an AI Engineer (Agents, LLM Platforms & Data Science) embedded in the Data Science team, you will build production-grade AI agents and own the administration, governance, and secure operation of our enterprise AI platforms. Where You Make An Impact Design, build, and operate AI agents (single- and multi-agent) including tool use/function calling, orchestration, and state/memory management Build and optimize RAG solutions (retrieval, chunking, re-ranking, citations/source grounding, document lifecycle management) Implement guardrails and security controls: prompt-injection defenses, PII/DLP handling, policy enforcement, secrets management Establish evaluation and testing for agents and GenAI components Drive LLMOps/observability: logging/tracing, monitoring, feedback loops, A/B testing, cost/token and latency optimization, rollback strategies Administer and govern enterprise AI platforms. Set up and maintain SSO/access control, role/permission models, provisioning (joiner/mover/leaver), auditing and reporting Define and enforce AI governance standards (data classification, approved use cases, retention, compliance/security requirements) together with IT/Security/Legal Integrate agents into business workflows via automation/orchestration tools: triggers, workflows, API connectors, error handling, monitoring, retries Because You Matter (example) Competitive salary and benefits package. Con i nostri comparatori italiani (tra cui MutuiOnline.it, Segugio.it, SOStariffe.it, Trovaprezzi.it e Switcho ) e internazionali (come LeLynx.fr, Rastreator.com, Pricewise.nl e Verivox.de ), offriamo chiarezza in mercati spesso complessi e poco trasparenti. Crediamo nel potere dei dati, nella trasparenza e nell'innovazione. Perché cambiare le regole, quando non funzionano al meglio, è nel nostro DNA! Posizione: In Mavriq stiamo integrando sempre più l'Intelligenza Artificiale nei nostri prodotti digitali, per semplificare la vita delle persone e generare valore per il business. Per rafforzare il nostro team di Prodotto siamo alla ricerca di un AI Product Analyst che sappia raccogliere, analizzare e formalizzare requisiti in ambito AI, e seguirne lo sviluppo fino alla completa integrazione nei nostri processi e prodotti. Cosa offriamo Crediamo che la crescita nasca dall'incontro tra curiosità e autonomia. Offriamo un ambiente ibrido e flessibile, formazione continua e spazio per sperimentare, imparare e migliorare. Lavorerai in un team con cui condividerai successi, affronterai sfide e raggiungerai risultati. A completare il quadro, una RAL indicativa compresa tra 35.000€ e 45.000€, e un pacchetto di benefit solido: assicurazione sanitaria (CCNL Commercio), buoni pasto, welfare, e accesso a piattaforme di e-learning. Dove lavorerai La nostra sede è in Via Desenzano 2, Milano (MM1 Gambara). Lavoriamo in modalità ibrida: almeno due giorni a settimana in ufficio e fino a tre in smart working. I momenti in presenza sono fondamentali per confrontarci, scambiare idee e alimentare la cultura di squadra che ci distingue. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle AI Analytics Engineer based in United Kingdom. We are looking for a skilled and innovative Middle AI Analytics Engineer to strengthen a growing Data & Analytics team within an international technology environment. In this fully remote role, you will help transform the way analytical teams access, process, and leverage data through AI-powered solutions. You will focus on improving self-service analytics, automating repetitive analytical workflows, and developing robust frameworks to evaluate AI performance and reliability. Working with technologies such as Python, SQL, Claude, RAG, and BI platforms, you will build practical solutions that enhance productivity and decision-making. You will also contribute to advancing AI-assisted analytics through context engineering, intelligent automation, and continuous quality monitoring. This is an excellent opportunity to work on ambitious technical projects, influence AI adoption, and grow within a collaborative, innovation-driven organization. Accountabilities Self-Service Analytics Enhancement: Improve the quality and accessibility of self-service analytics through Metabase by developing and integrating AI skills, contextual information, and intelligent workflows that help users retrieve accurate and relevant insights. Analytics Workflow Automation: Identify and automate repetitive tasks within the Data & Analytics team, developing AI-powered tools such as automated code reviewers, reusable AI skills, and other productivity-enhancing solutions. AI Quality Evaluation: Design and implement a comprehensive framework for evaluating the quality, accuracy, and reliability of AI-driven solutions used by the analytics team. Claude and Context Engineering: Design and optimize Claude skills, including their purpose, instructions, examples, and contextual information, to improve response quality and minimize hallucinations. RAG Development and Optimization: Design, implement, and improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, including source indexing, document chunking, information retrieval, and reranking strategies. AI Performance Monitoring: Develop evaluation methodologies using golden answers, automated evaluations (evals), LLM-as-a-judge techniques, regression testing, and performance monitoring to identify quality issues and detect model drift. Root Cause Analysis: Investigate AI-related performance issues, identify underlying causes, and implement improvements to ensure reliable and consistent analytical outputs. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with analytics and technical teams to identify opportunities for AI adoption, improve existing processes, and deliver scalable solutions that support business objectives. Continuous Innovation: Explore new AI capabilities, tools, and development approaches to improve analytical efficiency and encourage the adoption of intelligent automation across the organization. Requirements Practical experience in AI engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical role. Strong SQL skills, with the ability to query, manipulate, and analyze structured data effectively. Proficiency in Python for developing automation solutions, analytical tools, and AI-powered applications. Hands-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Strong understanding of Claude skills and context engineering, including designing reusable skills, defining clear instructions, providing relevant examples, and optimizing prompt context to reduce hallucinations. Experience designing and improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, including document indexing, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, and reranking. Knowledge of AI evaluation methodologies, including golden datasets or answers, evaluation frameworks, LLM-as-a-judge, regression testing, model drift monitoring, and root cause analysis. Ability to assess the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of AI-generated outputs and continuously improve AI-powered solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to investigating technical challenges. Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to exchange ideas, share feedback, and work effectively within a multidisciplinary team. A proactive and adaptable mindset, with a willingness to experiment, take ownership, and continuously develop technical expertise. Nice to have: Experience developing AI agents through LLM APIs or SDKs, including tool integration, context management, and cost optimization. Familiarity with Business Intelligence platforms and their role as data access layers for AI systems, including data models, metrics, and query structures. Experience with Metabase or Tableau is an advantage. Previous experience working with dbt for data transformation and analytics …
