items.desc: Noteless is a leading AI platform for clinicians in Europe. As a first mover in AI clinical documentation, we help doctors spend more time with patients and less on paperwork. Clinicians, product managers, designers and engineers work closely together, redefining the intersection between healthcare and technology. We’re expanding across 11 European markets. Now, we’re looking for an AI Engineer who wants to take ideas from early experiments all the way to production, in a field where getting it right really matters. What You'll Work On Clinical AI: Improve the accuracy and consistency of our AI-generated clinical documentation through context engineering and model optimization. Agents with clinical intelligence: Build context-aware AI agents that combine patient context, clinical reasoning and trusted medical knowledge to support clinicians in their daily workflows. Evaluations: Develop robust evaluation frameworks, datasets and experiments to systematically improve clinical quality and catch regressions across different specialties, markets and user groups. Infrastructure: Build scalable, reliable AI pipelines and services on our cloud environments, optimizing for performance, latency and cost. Safety and regulations: Build and validate AI systems with rigorous requirements for clinical accuracy, patient safety and regulatory compliance, including features intended for CE marking under the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR). Experimentation: Continuously test new models and tools, bringing the promising ones into production. You’ll report to our CTO, Mikkel Dahl Slettebø, and work closely with our product teams, clinicians using our product daily, and our medical operations team. You’ll have real ownership of features used by clinicians across Europe. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering skills and experience building production systems. Experience shipping LLM-based applications to real users in production. A solid understanding of what LLMs can and can’t do, and of techniques such as context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling and RAG. A data-driven approach to AI quality. You know how to evaluate systems, find failure modes and measure improvements. Attention to detail, a high bar for quality, and the motivation to refine AI systems to make them work reliably across clinical specialties, workflows and edge cases. Comfort with ambiguity and broad responsibility. You solve complex problems independently and make pragmatic technical decisions. Curiosity and a drive to stay updated on AI advancements. We care more about what you’ve built than about years of experience. Nice to have Experience with speech recognition, audio processing or real-time AI systems. Hands-on experience with model fine-tuning, self-hosted inference or open-weight models. Previous exposure to healthcare technology, medical devices or other regulated environments. Experience from a startup or scale-up. Why join Noteless Impact that matters: Your work gives clinicians time back and helps relieve pressure on healthcare across Europe. Hard, interesting problems: Non-deterministic systems, a very low tolerance for errors, and agents and evaluation at scale. Real ownership: Take responsibility for important product capabilities, influence technical decisions, and participate in our employee option programme. A team that ships: We’re a product and engineering team of 15 who work across the stack, use AI actively in our own development and release to production frequently. Room to grow: As Noteless scales, there will be opportunities to take on more technical and professional responsibility. Practical information Location: Storgata 5, Oslo. This is an on-site role, because we build best when we’re together, but we’re flexible when life requires it. Language: English. Start: As soon as possible. We review applications on a rolling basis, so don’t wait to apply. Process: A first conversation with our CTO, followed by a technical case discussion with the CTO and one of our engineers. --- We’re running this recruitment together with Amby. For questions about the role, contact Ida Herseth at Amby on +47 912 42 656.

You will work closely with domain experts, engineers, and technical stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can simplify complex workflows, reduce repetitive tasks, and improve engineering efficiency. The role combines software engineering, data science, AI development, and product thinking in a highly collaborative engineering environment. Main Responsibilities As an Applied AI Engineer, you will: Work closely with engineering experts to understand business challenges and identify high-value AI use cases. Translate complex and ambiguous engineering problems into actionable AI solutions. Design, develop, deploy, and maintain AI-powered applications and intelligent agents. Develop evaluation frameworks and success metrics to measure solution quality and business impact. Support governance, data access, security, compliance, and operational aspects of AI deployments. Create reusable AI development patterns and best practices. Coach and enable engineering teams to develop and adopt AI-powered solutions. Contribute to the long-term AI transformation roadmap and future engineering productivity initiatives. Solid understanding of: Machine Learning fundamentals, Model evaluation, Experimental design, Problem decomposition methodologies. items.desc: Location: Turin – Milan Smart Working: 12 d. per month Overview We are looking for a highly experienced and proactive Data Scientist to join the Artificial Intelligence team at Reale Group. As a key contributor to the team, you will apply advanced AI methodologies, ranging from traditional machine learning to Generative and Agentic AI approaches, to develop and industrialize impactful solutions in a complex business environment. You will work alongside other senior professionals, engineers, and domain experts to turn data into actionable insights and autonomous systems, supporting innovation across the insurance value chain. This is a hands-on technical role with strategic visibility and cross-functional collaboration, requiring deep expertise in AI modeling, practical application, and ethical deployment at scale. Key Responsibilities AI & Machine Learning Expertise Design, build, and deploy advanced machine learning models, from supervised learning to deep learning architectures, addressing key business challenges such as risk scoring, fraud detection, and automation. Experiment with and apply Generative AI technologies (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, prompt engineering) for use cases such as document processing, intelligent search, or synthetic content generation. Contribute to the research and prototyping of Agentic AI solutions, including autonomous agents for task orchestration, workflow automation, or adaptive reasoning in enterprise settings. Ensure robustness, scalability, and fairness in all model developments, aligning with MLOps practices and ethical AI frameworks. End-to-End Solution Development Translate business problems into data science solutions and guide the full lifecycle: from exploration and experimentation to validation, deployment, and monitoring. Collaborate closely with data engineers, software developers, and enterprise architects to integrate AI solutions into production environments, primarily on Azure. Define and implement metrics for evaluating model performance, business impact, and alignment with strategic goals. Cross-functional Collaboration & Thought Partnership Act as a trusted expert within cross-functional teams, including actuarial, claims, marketing, and IT. Support the mentoring of junior team members by sharing expertise, code reviews, and leading best practices. Partner with colleagues across international teams (e.g., Spain) to co-develop scalable AI assets and foster knowledge exchange. Qualifications Education Master’s or Ph.D. in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Experience 3+ years of experience in advanced data science roles with a strong track record of delivering AI-powered solutions in production. Practical experience in Generative AI and/or Agentic AI systems (e.g., using OpenAI APIs, LangChain, orchestration frameworks). Solid exposure to enterprise environments, preferably in insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries. Technical Skills Advanced programming skills in Python (mandatory), with knowledge of common ML and DL libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, transformers). Strong experience in model lifecycle management, evaluation techniques, and versioning (e.g., MLflow, DVC). Proficiency in cloud-based ML ecosystems, especially Microsoft Azure (Azure ML, Data Factory, Cognitive Services). Understanding of vector databases, LLM fine-tuning, and embedding-based retrieval is a strong plus. Soft Skills Fluent in English; Spanish knowledge is a plus. Strategic thinking and strong business acumen, with the ability to influence and drive adoption. Autonomy, ownership, and ability to manage complexity while working in Agile environments. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. items.desc: Rejoignez Allphins, une start-up insurtech dynamique qui redéfinit la gestion des risques dans l’industrie de la (ré)assurance grâce à une technologie innovante. En tant que stagiaire en AI Engineering, vous aurez l’opportunité de jouer un rôle clé dans notre croissance rapide et notre expansion internationale. Notre parcours a commencé en 2019, au Lloyd’s Lab, le principal accélérateur InsurTech de Londres, et à Station F, Paris, où notre équipe de data scientists, d’ingénieurs logiciels et de chefs de produit a développé les solutions révolutionnaires d’Allphins pour les réassureurs. Notre solution est une plateforme SaaS permettant aux (ré)assureurs de comprendre efficacement leurs risques beaucoup plus rapidement et avec plus de précision que jamais auparavant, favorisant une prise de décision éclairée lors de la souscription. Aujourd’hui, nous sommes une équipe internationale, rentable et en pleine croissance, avec une présence au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Allemagne, en France et en Suisse. Nous servons plus de 30 réassureurs à travers le monde dans tous les principaux secteurs commerciaux et spécialisés — y compris la propriété, l’énergie, le maritime, le risque politique, la responsabilité civile, la cybernétique, l’aviation et le terrorisme. Notre objectif est de résoudre les défis les plus pressants des (ré)assureurs pour une expansion plus rapide, avec l’ambition de devenir le leader mondial de la gestion des risques commerciaux et spécialisés. Nous valorisons la créativité, l’ingénierie pragmatique et la collaboration transparente pour offrir des produits de pointe qui répondent aux défis réels du monde professionnel. Chez Allphins, nous réinventons la manière dont les plus grands (ré)assureurs du monde comprennent le risque. Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en AI engineering prêt(e) à relever des défis techniques et à contribuer à des projets innovants au cœur de notre produit. En tant que Stagiaire AI engineering, vous rejoindrez notre équipe back-end et participerez à la conception et à l’amélioration d’outils internes utilisés par nos équipes et nos clients, tout en explorant les dernières technologies comme les LLMs, agents IA, MCP et SDK Python . Vos missions : Participer à la résolution de problématiques de montée en charge : optimisation des performances et scalabilité des systèmes. Contribuer à la conception et à l’implémentation de nouveaux formats et protocoles de communication ( MCP , API ) pour faciliter l’accès aux données et leur exploitation par des agents IA / LLMs . Aider à améliorer la qualité du produit : réduction des erreurs de calcul, gestion des régressions et fiabilisation du système. Collaborer avec les équipes produit, data science et tech pour définir les meilleures solutions techniques. Participer à la documentation technique et aux tests automatisés pour garantir la qualité et la stabilité du code. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Projets stimulants : Travaillez sur des projets innovants et stratégiques avec un impact direct pour nos clients Environnement international : Rejoignez une équipe diversifiée et talentueuse Apprentissage et développement : Opportunités de croissance professionnelle et formations continues Cadre de travail moderne : Situés au centre de Paris, dans un espace collaboratif neuf Événements d’entreprise : Participez à des off-sites et renforcez les liens d’équipe Relevez des défis stimulants, développez vos compétences et laissez votre empreinte sur nos outils et produits ! English version : At Allphins, we're redefining how the world's leading (re)insurers understand risk. We're looking for an AI Engineering Intern ready to take on technical challenges and contribute to innovative projects at the heart of our product. As an AI Engineering Intern, you'll join our back-end team and help design and improve internal tools used by our teams and our clients, while exploring cutting-edge technologies such as LLMs, AI agents, MCP, and Python SDKs. What you'll do: Help tackle scaling challenges: optimizing performance and system scalability. Contribute to the design and implementation of new communication formats and protocols (MCP, API) to make data easier to access and use for AI agents/LLMs. Help improve product quality: reducing calculation errors, managing regressions, and strengthening system reliability. Collaborate with the product, data science, and tech teams to define the best technical solutions. Contribute to technical documentation and automated testing to ensure code quality and stability. Why join us? Exciting projects: work on innovative, strategic projects with a direct impact for our clients International environment: join a diverse and talented team Learning and development: opportunities for professional growth and ongoing training Modern work environment: located in central Paris, in a brand-new collaborative space Company events: take part in off-sites and build strong team bonds Take on exciting challenges, grow your skills, and …

items.desc: Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers. For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide. We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. Come join us! About The Role Businesses running on Aircall field calls their teams can’t handle alone, such as after hours, at peak volume or across languages. AI Voice Agent answers them. It is not an IVR or a canned response bot. It is a real-time voice agent that understands context, talks naturally, executes actions mid-conversation and knows when to hand off to a human. The role sits at the intersection of real-time systems, production LLM applications and voice infrastructure, where milliseconds matter and quality is “immediately audible.” The posting stresses this is “production AI at scale,” not prototyping. What You’ll Work On Real-time speech pipeline: Live audio buffering, streaming and latency optimization, and evaluating or integrating speech providers. Conversation intelligence: Prompt construction, context management, function calling, dynamic knowledge injection and dialogue management. Actions and integrations: The action framework, covering configurable API calls, success/failure branching, auth management and the runtime execution engine. Knowledge and memory: How agents ingest, store and retrieve knowledge at runtime, and retain information across a conversation. Agent lifecycle and configuration: Working with designers so customers can create, configure, test and deploy agents easily. Evaluations and quality: Evaluation frameworks per model, post-call analytics, call quality metrics, Datadog instrumentation and the on-call rotation. What You’ll Bring Production backend experience, ideally in Python or TypeScript. All levels are welcome, with 5+ years for senior roles. Natural fluency with async code, and designing for performance and reliability. Understanding of how real-time systems differ from request/response APIs, including buffering, streaming, connection management and latency tradeoffs. Production experience with LLMs or AI/ML systems, including prompt engineering, context management, function calling and reliable AI behavior. Evaluation tooling experience. Comfort with event-driven architectures, message queues, caching and async task processing. Experience debugging distributed failures and handling partial failures gracefully. Thoughtful testing, observability, API design and code review. Clear communication, including design docs. Familiarity with AI coding tools in day-to-day work. Nice to have Voice, audio or telephony systems STT/TTS providers and models LLM evaluation frameworks and quality metrics AWS (DynamoDB, Lambda, AppSync, SQS) GraphQL API design Kubernetes and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm) Why join us? 🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities 💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall 📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit 🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset 💶 Competitive salary package & benefits DE&I Statement At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. items.desc: Dein Platz in der MAI Group Als AI Automation Consultant (all genders) in unserer neuen Einheit AI Transformation gehst Du in die Fachbereiche unserer Kunden, schaust Dir an, wie dort wirklich gearbeitet wird, und zeigst innerhalb von Tagen, was ein KI-Agent daraus machen kann - nicht auf Folien, sondern als Prototyp. Du führst Kunden vom ersten Workshop bis in den Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest Du im Tandem mit einem Agentic Software Engineer und unterstützt unseren Vertrieb fachlich, in einem von drei Feldern: Versicherungen und Banken, Energieversorger oder Handel und produzierende Unternehmen. MAI ist eine starke Gruppe mit acht Agenturen verteilt auf die Standorte Hamburg, Berlin, Paderborn, Köln, Augsburg, München, Wien - verbunden durch gemeinsame Ziele, gegenseitigen Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit über Standortgrenzen hinweg. Wo Du auch bei uns startest: Du wirst Teil Deines Teams vor Ort und gleichzeitig Teil von MAI. Deinen Standort wählst Du frei, auch vollständig remote. Besonders freuen wir uns über Verstärkung in Berlin, München oder Wien. Was Du bei uns bewegst Du nimmst Prozesse in Vertrieb, Service oder Marketing auf: mit Interviews, am Arbeitsplatz und mit Zahlen. Du leitest Build Days, an denen ein Fachbereich an einem Tag seinen eigenen Prozess zerlegt und gemeinsam mit Dir einen ersten Prototyp baut. Du bewertest Anwendungsfälle nach Nutzen, Machbarkeit und Risiko und rechnest den Business Case. Du baust einfache Prototypen selbst, mit Claude und Lovable. Du gibst eine klare Empfehlung: umsetzen oder lassen. Beides ist ein gutes Ergebnis. Du schneidest den nächsten Schritt in Arbeitspakete, die wir zum Festpreis anbieten können, und übergibst sauber an Engineering und Umsetzungsteams. Du bleibst für das Ergebnis verantwortlich, bis die Lösung läuft und gemessen ist. Was Dich ausmacht Du hast mindestens drei Jahre in Beratung, Prozessmanagement oder Projektleitung gearbeitet, mit direktem Kundenkontakt. Du stellst die Fragen, nach denen ein Prozess plötzlich klar wird. Du baust selbst mit KI-Werkzeugen und kannst uns zeigen, was dabei herausgekommen ist. Entwickler:in musst Du nicht sein. Du rechnest gern nach und lässt Dich von einer guten Geschichte nicht blenden. Du moderierst einen Raum mit zehn Menschen, von denen drei skeptisch sind. Du sagst einem Kunden auch, wenn sich sein Lieblingsthema nicht lohnt. Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau. Nice to have: Branchenwissen in Versicherung, Bank, Energie oder Handel Erfahrung mit Prozessautomatisierung, CRM, Marketing-Automation oder Serviceplattformen Erfahrung im Schreiben von Angeboten Was wir Dir bieten Freiraum, der zu Deinem Leben passt. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten – auch vollständig remote – und Workation. Verantwortung, die Wirkung schafft. Du baust eine neue Einheit mit auf und verantwortest eigene Kunden. Entwicklung, die Dich weiterbringt. Lizenzen für KI-Werkzeuge gehören zur Ausstattung. Dazu kommen Weiterbildungen, Konferenzen und Zertifizierungen. Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe. Du arbeitest im Tandem mit dem Engineering und hast UX-Research, Plattform-Teams und Vertrieb an Deiner Seite. Gemeinsame Erlebnisse, die verbinden. Firmenfeiern, Teamevents und gemeinsame Build Days. Gesundheit, die zählt. Gesundheitsangebote über das WorkLifePortal und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss. Extras, die den Alltag besser machen. JobRad, Corporate Benefits sowie kostenlose Getränke und Snacks in den MAI Offices. Deine Kontaktperson Deine Kontaktpersonen sind Lea Nesemeier und Fenja Harder. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Über uns Wir sind MAI. Wir verbinden Strategie mit Umsetzung, Technologie mit Kreativität und digitale Möglichkeiten mit echtem Business Impact. Dafür bringen wir spezialisierte Expertise zusammen, denken partnerschaftlich und handeln pragmatisch mit einem klaren Anspruch: Lösungen zu schaffen, die wirken. Du möchtest nicht nur dabei sein, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen und Wirkung schaffen? Du schätzt ehrlichen Austausch auf Augenhöhe, teilst Dein Wissen und glaubst daran, dass die besten Ergebnisse gemeinsam entstehen? Dann bring Deine Perspektive und Deine Stärken bei MAI ein und gestalte mit uns, was als Nächstes kommt.

It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over **** staff from 60 countries. Look At The BSC Experience (BSC-CNS YouTube Channel)(#) (Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!)(#) We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured. We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences. If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team. Context And Mission The Earth Sciences Department at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC-CNS) is looking for a junior research engineer to help build a growing ecosystem of AI agents that support the department's research, analysis and science communication activities. The successful candidate will take ownership of common agentic workflows and serve as a reference point for the development of new departmental AI agentic workflows. This involves bringing new workflows to production and supporting colleagues who use these tools in their day-to-day work. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with senior machine learning engineers and researchers to deploy and maintain agent-based workflows on the BSC-CNS's cutting-edge infrastructure. They will also contribute to the design, development, and deployment of new agentic workflows, gaining hands-on experience across the entire agentic AI stack — from the orchestration and integration of LLM services to deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement. This position combines deployment, development, and user support, making it an excellent opportunity to gain broad practical experience in applied AI. We welcome highly motivated early-career candidates who are passionate about agentic AI and eager to develop their skills. While extensive professional experience is not required, a solid technical foundation, curiosity, and a strong learning attitude are essential. The position offers mentoring by senior engineers, access to cutting-edge HPC and AI infrastructure, a multidisciplinary research environment, and BSC-CNS staff benefits. This provides an excellent entry point for a career in applied artificial intelligence. items.desc: Role Title: Board Game Expert (Remote) Role Type: Full-time Location : Remote Role Overview We are seeking Board Game Reasoning Experts to help train and evaluate next-generation AI models. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in board games, game mechanics, strategic reasoning, probability, and complex rule systems to create, review, and evaluate high-quality datasets that improve AI performance. You will work on challenging tasks involving game logic, decision-making, strategic planning, rule interpretation, and scenario analysis, helping frontier AI systems develop stronger reasoning capabilities. What Does Day-to-Day Look Like? 1. Create and review game-based reasoning tasks designed to evaluate AI systems. 2. Analyze board game scenarios, strategic decision trees, and rule-based systems. 3. Evaluate AI-generated responses for correctness, consistency, and reasoning quality. 4. Develop prompts, rubrics, and evaluation guidelines for board game and strategy-focused tasks. 5. Identify logical errors, rule violations, and flawed reasoning in AI outputs. 6. Contribute to benchmark creation and quality assurance processes for AI evaluation projects. 7. Collaborate with project teams to improve dataset quality and evaluation methodologies. Required Qualifications 1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Cognitive Science, Game Design, Philosophy, Economics, or a related analytical field. 2. 2+ years of professional or semi-professional experience in board game design, playtesting, tabletop game communities, or related strategy-focused environments. 3. Strong understanding of logic, probabilistic reasoning, game mechanics, and complex rule systems. 4. Background in game theory, behavioral economics, decision science, or formal logic. 5. Familiarity with modern board games, trading card games (TCGs), tabletop RPGs, strategy games, or competitive game systems. 6. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 7. Excellent written communication skills. Preferred Qualifications 1. Prior experience in data annotation, AI training, prompt engineering, QA, game design, puzzle design, or rules-based system analysis. 2. Experience creating evaluation rubrics, benchmark datasets, or quality assurance frameworks. 3. Experience with Python, SQL, or data analysis tools. 4. Experience working on RLHF, model evaluation, synthetic data generation, or LLM benchmarking projects. 5. Familiarity with recently released strategy or tabletop games and the ability to quickly learn new rule systems. Offer Details 1. items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.
 What you’ll do 
 You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities.The team is looking for a payments optimization specialist with a proven track record of designing and deploying payment infrastructure for global enterprises. You will engage with customers as a thought leader in the advanced payments stack - helping them navigate multi-PSP environments, payment orchestration, adaptive pricing, and buy-now-pay-later integrations to maximize authorization rates, reduce costs, and improve conversion at scale.
 Responsibilities 
 Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Optimized Checkout Suite, Adaptive Pricing, Managed Payments, Orchestration, and BNPL integrations to accelerate opportunities globally
 Demonstrate a deep understanding of global payment optimization - including local acquiring, intelligent routing, dynamic currency conversion, and authorization improvement strategies
 Develop expertise in designing multi-PSP and payment orchestration architectures, including how Stripe integrates alongside or replaces incumbent processors
 Advise customers on BNPL strategy, including product selection, regulatory considerations, and integration patterns across checkout and billing flows
 Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
 Create reference architectures that help customers design end-to-end payment infrastructure with Stripe at the core
 Partner closely with the Payments product sales team on Stripe's most complex OCS and Orchestration opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
 Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization
 Identify and summarize trends in payment orchestration, cost optimization, and alternative payment methods, and provide actionable insights to product stakeholders and sales
 Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
 Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
 Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
 Approximately 25% travel is anticipated
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements 
 7+ years of experience in payments, fintech, or a closely related industry in a pre-sales, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role
 Strong working knowledge of global payment methods including cards, wallets, bank-based methods, and BNPLs - including regional preferences and regulatory context
 Experience designing payment optimization architectures for large enterprises, including multi-PSP environments and orchestration layers
 Knowledge of authorization rate improvement levers: local acquiring, network tokenization, 3DS, smart retries, and the technical and commercial tradeoffs between them
 Strong knowledge of software engineering and API integration patterns
 Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
 A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
 Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in …

items.desc:
Huawei’s vision is to enrich lives through communication and intelligent innovation. 
 As a global leader in information and communications technology (ICT), Huawei drives innovation in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and smart device technologies. Through its Carrier, Enterprise, and Consumer business groups, the company delivers advanced Network Infrastructure, Cloud and AI Platforms, and industry-leading devices.
 Huawei supports 45 of the world’s top 50 telecom operators and serves one-third of the global population, with operations in over 170 countries and a workforce of more than 200,000 employees.
 Huawei Technologies Switzerland AG contributes to this innovation through cutting-edge research, with offices in Zurich and Lausanne focusing on High-Performance Computing, Computer Architecture, Computer Vision, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Neuromorphic Computing, Wireless Technologies, Networking, and related fields.
 We are a unique team of innovative, diverse individuals who have come together from multiple backgrounds to create advanced Computing Architectures for wireless and AI systems. The people who work here are generalists, and we complement each other.
 Our primary mission is driving new fundamental research and innovation to achieve breakthroughs in future computing systems.
 The passion for exploring uncharted territory makes us thrive.
 We seek a highly talented researcher to explore novel computing architectures for the next-generation wireless systems and analyze key architectural trade-offs in coordination with cross-functional domain experts.
 Responsibilities 
 Technology research. Your job will focus on designing and validating efficient system/hardware/software technologies to meet the product requirements and solve the challenges. Achieving high computational performance at as high energy efficiency as possible is an essential objective. You will explore new approaches aligned with emerging technologies, competitive performance requirements, and critical system constraints.
 Technology insight. You recognize and understand technology trends and propose novel technologies that can be used in our product to improve Performance, Power, Area, Flexibility, etc. In addition, you will participate in the discussion of strategy plan and business plan .
 Cooperate with local resources (Industry and Academy). Based on business requirements, you will be involved in cooperation with local resources, and need to be independently responsible for development and operation of cooperation projects.
 Key Qualifications 
 MSc or PhD in Computer Science.
 At least 5 years of relevant experience.
 Demonstrated expertise in SoC architecture in the area of high-performance computing systems.
 Experience in Wireless and Cellular technologies such as LTE/5G NR is preferred.
 Must have outstanding SoC and system architecture fundamentals backed with substantial experience. This means a good understanding of power and performance trade-offs, area and energy efficiency improvement, and how SoC data and control flows interact.
 Expertise in computing architecture, i.e. programmable/reconfigurable architecture, dataflow architecture, computing in/near memory, interconnect design etc.
 Sound understanding of microprocessor subsystems (microarchitecture), memory systems (cache, scratchpad, memory hierarchy, etc.) and on-chip interconnect.
 Manycore design and RISC-V experience is preferred.
 Good understanding of hardware-software interfaces and interactions. A compiler background is preferred.
 Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
 Excellent written skills for clear and concise reporting.

 Collaborate with world-class scientists and engineers in an open, curiosity-driven environment.
 Access to state-of-the-art technology and tools.
 Opportunities for professional growth and development.
 Competitive salary, and a high quality of life in Zurich, at the center of Europe.
 Last but certainly not least: be part of innovative projects that make a difference.

items.desc: Informations sur le poste Intitulé de l'offre Ingénieur Cyber IA & Data Plateform F/H - Paris Filière MGEN + Métier ou Fonction Cybersécurité - Ingénieur.e Cybersécurité confirmé Type de contrat Contrat à durée indéterminée Présentation du Site ou de la Direction MGEN est un acteur de la finance et de l’assurance, dans un environnement fortement réglementé. La Direction cybersécurité MGEN réunit une trentaine de collaborateurs autour de 4 domaines : GRC (Gouvernance, Risques & Conformité), Cyberdéfense (SOC interne 24h/24 et 7j/7), IAM (Identity & Access Management) et CIAM (Customer Identity & Access Management). Nous avons lancé une stratégie IA & Cyber pluriannuelle (2027-2029) d’une soixantaine de chantiers, avec une double ambition : sécuriser les usages de l’IA et mobiliser l’IA au service de la sécurité. Votre équipe : la Core Team IA Cyber ! Une équipe hybride et dédiée qui pilote la stratégie IA & Cyber et instruit ses chantiers : pilotage de la roadmap, développement de cas d’usage, architecture cybersécurité IA et cyberdéfense IA. En articulation avec le Lab IA du groupe MGEN, elle porte la gouvernance de la sécurisation de l’IA, accélère les solutions IA pour la cybersécurité et fait monter en compétences les experts cyber. Et si vous construisiez le socle qui permettra à l’IA d’assister les équipes cyber d’un acteur majeur de la finance et de l’assurance ? Vous serez l’un des fondateurs de notre stratégie IA & Cyber : vous concevrez la plateforme (RAG sécurité, serveurs MCP) sur laquelle s’appuieront les agents IA de tous nos domaines cybersécurité. Un réel challenge ! Rattaché au domaine cyber GRC (Gouvernance, Risques et Conformité) vous êtes le leader technique de la plateforme IA cybersécurité. Missions confiées 1. Concevoir et déployer le socle cyber Définir l’architecture cible (RAG, serveur(s) MCP, base vectorielle, orchestration) et la faire valider avec les équipes architecture et sécurité Choisir les composants : modèles d’embeddings, base vectorielle, LLM (hébergés ou open-weight selon les contraintes de confidentialité), reranking. Industrialiser le déploiement : infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environnements de test et de production Articuler la plateforme avec les capacités du Lab IA MGEN (LLMOps, garde-fous, plateforme agentique) pour mutualiser plutôt que dupliquer. 2. Alimenter et gouverner les données Construire les pipelines d’ingestion depuis les différentes sources : SharePoint, SIEM, EDR, scanners de vulnérabilités, CMDB, GED, outil de tickets, flux de CTI, analyses de risques, etc. Définir le découpage, les métadonnées, la fréquence de mise à jour et les règles de suppression et mettre en oeuvre la classification et les droits d’accès à la plateforme. 3. Développer les serveurs MCP cyber Concevoir des outils MCP documentés (consultation d’alertes, requêtes sur les vulnérabilités, recherche CTI, procédures) Mettre en place l’authentification, des scopes minimaux, la validation des entrées, les quotas, la journalisation et une validation humaine pour les actions sensibles Mettre ces briques à disposition des équipes SOC, GRC, IAM et SecOp pour qu’elles construisent et exploitent leurs propres agents. 4. Développer les cas d’usage cyber Recueillir les besoins avec les équipes cyber, prioriser selon la valeur/risque, et livrer par itérations courtes (POC, pilote, production). Identifier et mesurer les gains de chaque cas d’usage Exemples : recherche assistée dans les politiques et procédures, aide au tri et à l’investigation des alertes, synthèse d’incidents et aide à la rédaction de rapports, enrichissement CTI et corrélation avec les vulnérabilités, assistance aux audits et à la conformité (ISO 27001, DORA) etc... 5. Sécuriser, mesurer et faire évoluer la plateforme IA cyber Sécuriser la solution elle-même : prompt injection, empoisonnement du corpus, fuites entre niveaux de droits, chaîne d’approvisionnement des serveurs MCP et la soumettre à des audits de sécurité Respecter les pratiques de sécurité de l’IA : gestion des identités non humaines, sécurisation et surveillance des agents (avec les équipes IAM et SOC) Mettre en place l’évaluation : jeux de questions de référence, pertinence de la recherche, exactitude des réponses, suivi des hallucinations, des coûts et de la latence Assurer le run : supervision, gestion des incidents, documentation, veille sur l’écosystème (MCP, modèles, outils d’orchestration), garde-fous, « kill switch » et tests de retour arrière. 6. Animer et diffuser Accompagner et former les équipes utilisatrices, documenter les usages et contribuer aux formations destinées aux profils techniques de l’équipe cybersécurité. Contribuer au cadre de gouvernance de l’IA, de l'équipe et ses instances. Profil recherché Ingénieur IA ou data, cybersécurité , capable de passer seul de l’architecture à la mise en production. Todo ello sustentado en nuestro Triple Expertise: visión de negocio, conocimiento tecnológico profundo y alianzas tecnológicas (Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, GCP, entre otras). Una combinación que nos ha llevado a trabajar con clientes del IBEX-35 y Fortune 500 , contando con presencia global y más de 2.000 personas en todo el mundo. En el equipo de Inteligencia Artificial , somos más de 200 profesionales con experiencia en más de 70 clientes y más de 100 casos de uso, ofrecemos soluciones de IA adaptadas a diversas industrias, con más de 50 aceleradores tecnológicos, marcos y herramientas para acelerar la implementación de IA. Además, a través de SDG iLabs, impulsamos la innovación experimentando con las últimas tendencias en IA. Si quieres crecer en el mundo de la IA, este es el lugar. ¿Cómo será tu día a día? Estarás en primera línea del cambio de paradigma que está viviendo la IA : diseñarás soluciones de IA generativa (LLMs, RAG, agentes inteligentes y sistemas multiagente) que transforman cómo trabajan las empresas, junto con modelos de machine learning tradicional. Diseñarás soluciones de IA adaptadas al negocio : definirás arquitecturas y soluciones a medida de las necesidades y los retos de cada cliente, desde assessments e iniciativas consultivas hasta el diseño e implementación de casos de uso, plataformas y arquitecturas corporativas. Aplicarás IA Generativa, IA tradicional y machine learning : diseñarás soluciones basadas en machine learning, deep learning, modelos predictivos y otras técnicas de IA, eligiendo en cada caso la tecnología que mejor resuelve el reto. Llevarás las soluciones a producción : asegurarás su escalabilidad, rendimiento y seguridad aplicando metodologías MLOps y LLMOps (despliegue, monitorización y mejora continua), con pipelines CI/CD, contenedores (Docker, Kubernetes) y APIs con FastAPI, apoyándote en herramientas como MLflow, Airflow o Kubeflow y en los servicios gestionados de Azure, AWS y GCP Orientarás técnicamente a los equipos de desarrollo : tomarás decisiones tecnológicas y establecerás buenas prácticas para que los proyectos se entreguen con calidad. Experiencia en diseño de soluciones de IA : has trabajado tanto con machine learning tradicional como con IA generativa (LLMs, RAG, agentes), o tienes un interés real por esta última y ganas de profundizar en ella. Del prototipo a producción: experiencia llevando modelos y soluciones de IA a entornos productivos, con prácticas de MLOps y, si es posible, LLMOps. Experiencia en alguna de las principales nubes (Azure, AWS o GCP), diseñando soluciones escalables y seguras. As a AI Engineer at Roke, you’ll help build ethical, secure AI solutions that turn complex data into insight for national security teams. You’ll join a supportive, collaborative group of engineers, scientists and analysts, working on projects where your ideas can make a real difference. It is expected that you learn super fast, pick up new skills and level up your colleagues in the areas you are expert in. At this stage, everyone is an independent contributor, but over time, there is scope for building your own team, if you have leadership and management skills, and we expect you to contribute to designing interviews, finding, hiring and mentoring excellent future colleagues. We are looking for formal verification specialists who can help us accelerate our mission and who bring relevant knowledge/expertise/leadership in the field of formal methods. Since this is a tiny team, this role is foundational, in that you will have a chance to not only massively contribute to the success of the mission, but also steer which technical directions we explore. Our current focus is SMT-backed auto-active verifiers and LEAN-based frameworks for verifying Rust programs, but this scope is bound to expand over time. In particular, an ideal candidate might be a core open source contributor to an important software-focused verification library or tool, may have just finished a PhD in formal verification, or perhaps has worked as a software verification specialist/consultant, or perhaps has experience formally verifying mission-critical softwares. Requirements You have experience using, developing, inventing, tinkering with either: auto-active/SMT-based verifiers: specifically Verus is ideal; Dafny, Gobra, OpenJVM or KeY, etc are interesting interactive theorem provers: software-focussed LEAN (Aeneas, Velvet, Vail, etc), Rocq (Iris, Perennial), to a lesser extent, Isabelle, experience You have either: a PhD or research career with a primary focus of formal verification (evidenced by papers at SOSP, OSDI, OOPSLA, PLDI, CAV, ICFP, VMCAI, or CPP or similar, dissertations, etc) rich work experience using/developing formal verification tooling in industry (evidenced by projects, even better if open source) You know the soul of the verifiers: you can debug, analyse when things go wrong, devise design patterns and strategies to best leverage them You are good at writing/critiquing specifications: maybe have some anecdotes on what happens when things go wrong You have good intuition: on formal methods and their limitations, and where it may be most valuable You are good at teaching and communicating: to sharp but non-expert peers (e.g. LLM specialists), potentially more broadly via blog posts or talks You are hungry to make contributions at the frontier: open-source proof tooling, libraries, formal methods research, and/or AI tooling for formal methods (libraries, papers, patents, benchmarks, models) You are passionate about our mission of bringing formal verification to mainstream software, and accelerating this would make you proud You are or can demonstrate the potential to become a tech lead on our flagship projects, providing technical direction as a senior independent contributor, or an engineering or research manager responsible for planning and landing projects, building and a managing high performance team. Benefits Compensation: Generous salary, with equity and additional benefits Location: Budapest- Hungary OR London-UK with flexibility for team and conference travel - we're an on-site team World-class team and environment: an opportunity to build alongside deeply experienced founders, and a small, but talent-dense team, in a well-funded company that’s backed by industry leading VCs and angels including Oriol Vinyals, Zoubin Ghahramani, Jonathan Frankle and Guy Podjarny, amongst many others

items.desc: Join ICOMAT – Revolutionising the Future of Lightweight Manufacturing! iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. We deliver the lightest structures possible for aerospace, automotive, defense, and space, at a rate and cost efficiency that far exceeds existing composite production processes. We build and operate automated factories for composite materials, delivering components to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The business has three main divisions: development of automated production machines, development of software design and production tools, and operation of the factory. We work with 25+ customers and completed the largest ever Series A in composites manufacturing to fuel a significant scale-up, with growth plans that will see the business multiply in size over the next two to three years and expand operations into the UK, Europe and the US. The business has currently more than 130,000 sqm of production capacity with manufacturing facilities in the UK (Gloucester and Swindon) and the US (Dayton, Ohio); a Hardware R&D Centre in Bristol, UK; and a Software R&D Centre in Athens, Greece. We are hiring a Platform Engineer to join our in-house Software Engineering team and own the developer experience, deployment, and security infrastructure behind our factory operations platform connecting ERP, production scheduling, machine telemetry, and shop-floor execution across our manufacturing sites. What will you be doing? You will be joining as the first hire inside iCOMAT’s dedicated Platform team reporting directly to the Head of AI. This team exists to bridge the gap between iCOMAT’s internal IT and software/AI/ML teams, and establish a secure, resilient platform that provides the foundations for iCOMAT’s private and public-facing software, AI and ML systems. We expect this role to grow as iCOMAT’s software engineering and AI/ML capabilities mature. To begin with, you will be establishing the DevSecOps discipline that governs the iCOMAT SDLC and sets the right processes and system-wide foundations for future accreditation against UK and national standards such as Defence Cyber Certification and ISO 27001. This includes managing various on-prem systems that support the in-house software engineering team, as well as implementing new systems and processes as needed. As the engineering team grows, you will support the adoption of golden pathways that take applications from commit to production without manual intervention and configuration. The security and infrastructure backbone to support this will be yours to design, implement and manage, alongside support from the Head of AI and the wider software and IT teams. The end goal is to deliver the infrastructure and security backbone that supports a fully digitised, vertically integrated design and manufacturing workflow that embeds data, automation and autonomous decision making at the heart of every process. We expect the development of this platform to be a continuous and evolving effort, and we are looking for someone who wants to play a critical part in this journey and set the standard for delivering automated composite manufacturing at global scale. What does success look like? As a manufacturing business, our success is defined by the quality of the parts we produce, the repeatability of our manufacturing processes, and the reliability of the operations behind them. For this role, success will be measured alongside the wider development of the platform; starting with standard DORA metrics and vulnerability management, then progressing to comply with key certification standards, and support the rollout of ICOMAT’s business operations and manufacturing platforms across our global estate. Success beyond that means the platform scales faster than you do: new engineers are productive in days, new modules ship on paved roads you designed, and the architecture of our global estate continuously updates to keep oiCOMAT resilient to emerging threats. From a personal perspective, we value engineers who automate rather than firefight, document what they build, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and treat security as an enabler of pace rather than a brake on it. iCOMAT is setting the standard for how advanced composite structures are designed, manufactured, and industrialised at scale. Your contributions will build the infrastructure backbone for world-leading technology that will be embedded in the next generation of aerospace and defence hardware. How do you fit in? You will be the first hire inside iCOMAT's dedicated Platform team, reporting directly to the Head of AI as part of the wider AI, software and IT function. This is a small, senior team developing the software, IT and AI/ML foundations for iCOMAT's automated design and manufacturing capabilities. You will be the team's platform and …

Elle intervient dans l?aviation légère, l?aviation régionale et les applications de défense, avec pour ambition d?accélérer la transformation de l?aviation autour de la décarbonation, de la mobilité et de la souveraineté. Mission Rattaché(e) au Directeur Général Adjoint, vous contribuez à définir et financer la prochaine phase de croissance de l?entreprise. À l?interface de la stratégie, de la finance, des relations investisseurs et des enjeux industriels, vous construisez le business plan stratégique et l?argumentaire d?investissement, contribuez aux levées de fonds et aux opérations de développement, et structurez les relations investisseurs selon les standards des sociétés cotées. Vous travaillez en lien étroit avec le CFO et les équipes Finance, avec une exposition au COMEX, au conseil d?administration et aux investisseurs internationaux. Principales responsabilités Traduire les ambitions de l?entreprise en scénarios de croissance, business plans et priorités d?investissement, en reliant opportunités de marché, économie des produits, capacités industrielles et besoins en capitaux. Construire et actualiser les modèles financiers stratégiques liés à la montée en cadence industrielle, au développement commercial et à l?expansion internationale. Affiner le positionnement concurrentiel, l?argumentaire d?investissement et la valorisation de l?entreprise. Contribuer à la préparation et à l?exécution de levées de fonds privées et/ou d?une introduction en bourse (IPO), notamment en élaborant des présentations investisseurs, analyses financières, scénarios de valorisation et documents de transaction. Coordonner les due diligences avec les conseils financiers et juridiques, anticiper les questions des investisseurs et préparer les analyses nécessaires aux négociations stratégiques et financières. Développer les relations avec les actionnaires et investisseurs potentiels, notamment les fonds institutionnels, investisseurs stratégiques et acteurs internationaux des marchés de capitaux. Préparer les communications aux actionnaires, les reportings investisseurs et les supports du conseil d?administration ; structurer les processus d?information financière, les calendriers de reporting et les outils associés, notamment CRM investisseurs, suivi des échanges, data rooms et workflows. Assurer une veille sur les investisseurs, les tendances de marché, les sociétés comparables et les transactions pertinentes ; transformer les données financières, industrielles et techniques en messages clairs et convaincants. Identifier et évaluer des acquisitions, investissements stratégiques, coentreprises et autres opportunités de développement ; construire les analyses d?opportunité et modèles financiers, contribuer aux due diligences et négociations, et piloter certaines initiatives stratégiques. Intégrer l?IA à la recherche, à l?analyse financière, à la modélisation, à la veille et aux relations investisseurs, en concevant des workflows automatisés qui améliorent la rapidité, la qualité et la capacité de la fonction à accompagner la croissance. Environnement technique Finance et stratégie : modélisation financière, business planning, valorisation, marchés de capitaux, levées de fonds, M&A, IPO. Outils et technologies : IA, automatisation, technologies de données, CRM investisseurs, data rooms, workflows automatisés. Profil recherché Expérience 5 à 8 ans d?expérience dans un environnement exigeant associant stratégie, finance et exécution, par exemple en banque d?investissement, fusions-acquisitions, capital-investissement, développement stratégique ou entreprise industrielle en forte croissance. Expérience directe auprès de sociétés cotées, sur des opérations de marchés de capitaux ou en relations investisseurs, et connaissance des attentes institutionnelles, de l?information financière et des standards de reporting des sociétés cotées. Compétences techniques Solide jugement stratégique et financier, avec une capacité à relier les décisions aux enjeux économiques et à construire des modèles financiers avancés. Maîtrise concrète de l?IA, de l?automatisation et des technologies de données, avec des exemples de workflows développés ou transformés. Capacité à élaborer des supports d?investissement convaincants et à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau. Maîtrise de l?anglais. Compétences personnelles Autonomie, pragmatisme et esprit entrepreneurial. Capacité à challenger les hypothèses et à faire avancer des projets dans un contexte évolutif. Curiosité …

items.desc: At Marso, as a System Architect , you will own the overall technical architecture of the Marso robot: how mechanics, electronics, embedded software, AI, and connectivity fit together into a reliable, safe, and scalable product. You will turn product needs into system requirements and lead the technical trade-offs across teams. Responsibilities Define and maintain the robot’s system architecture: hardware, electronics, embedded software, AI, sensors, actuators, and cloud connectivity. Turn product and customer needs into system requirements, then allocate them to subsystems and teams. Lead cross-team technical trade-offs on performance, cost, power, weight, safety, and time to market. Define and govern interfaces between subsystems (electrical, mechanical, software, and communication protocols). Lead system-level safety and reliability analyses (FMEA, hazard analysis, failure modes) and contribute to compliance with applicable standards. Define the integration, verification, and validation strategy, from bench tests to field tests. Anticipate the architecture of future robot generations, including technology watch, scalability, and cost reduction. Act as the technical reference across teams and mentor engineers on system thinking. Profile 8+ years of experience in system engineering or architecture, including significant work on complex mechatronic or robotic products. Broad, cross-disciplinary technical background spanning mechanics, electronics, embedded software, and ideally AI or perception. Proven experience defining system requirements and architectures that shipped to production. Strong command of system engineering methods. Experience with safety and reliability analyses and with relevant standards. Ability to make and defend architecture decisions, and to communicate clearly with technical teams, product, and management. Nice to have: experience with mobile robotics, ROS/ROS2, sensor fusion (lidar, cameras, IMU), power and battery systems, or fleet connectivity. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background. Chez Marso, en tant que System Architect , vous serez garant·e de l’architecture technique globale du robot Marso : la façon dont la mécanique, l’électronique, le logiciel embarqué, l’IA et la connectivité s’assemblent en un produit fiable, sûr et évolutif. Vous traduirez les besoins produit en exigences système et piloterez les arbitrages techniques entre les équipes. Missions Définir et faire évoluer l’architecture système du robot : hardware, électronique, logiciel embarqué, IA, capteurs, actionneurs et connectivité cloud. Traduire les besoins produit et clients en exigences système, puis les allouer aux sous-systèmes et aux équipes. Piloter les arbitrages techniques transverses : performance, coût, consommation, masse, sécurité et délai de mise sur le marché. Définir et maintenir les interfaces entre sous-systèmes (électriques, mécaniques, logicielles et protocoles de communication). Piloter les analyses de sûreté et de fiabilité au niveau système (AMDEC, analyse de risques, modes de défaillance) et contribuer à la conformité aux normes applicables. Définir la stratégie d’intégration, de vérification et de validation, des tests sur banc aux tests terrain. Anticiper l’architecture des futures générations de robots : veille technologique, passage à l’échelle et réduction des coûts. Être la référence technique transverse et accompagner les ingénieur·es dans leur approche système. Profil 8 ans ou plus d’expérience en ingénierie ou architecture système, dont une part significative sur des produits mécatroniques ou robotiques complexes. Large culture technique pluridisciplinaire couvrant la mécanique, l’électronique, le logiciel embarqué et idéalement l’IA ou la perception. Expérience confirmée de la définition d’exigences et d’architectures système ayant abouti à une mise en production. Bonne maîtrise des méthodes d’ingénierie système. Expérience des analyses de sûreté et de fiabilité et des normes associées. Capacité à prendre et défendre des décisions d’architecture, et à communiquer clairement avec les équipes techniques, le produit et la direction. Un plus : expérience en robotique mobile, ROS/ROS2, fusion de capteurs (lidar, caméras, IMU), systèmes d’énergie et batteries, ou connectivité de flotte. Nous sommes engagés dans la construction d’une équipe diverse et inclusive. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées sont les bienvenues et nous accordons une attention particulière aux compétences, à l’impact et à la capacité à contribuer au projet. Compensation Range: €70K - €100K

items.desc: Nouvelle mission longue, basée à Lille en mode hybride, au sein d?une équipe produit organisée en Scrum. Vous participerez à la conception, au développement et à la maintenance de briques logicielles et d?architectures réseau cloud-natives destinées à transformer les infrastructures réseau en produits (« Network as a Service »). Vos responsabilités incluent le développement de produits réseau self-service (conception et maintenance d?API FastAPI/Python et de modules Infrastructure as Code Terraform), l?architecture et la sécurisation des réseaux cloud sur GCP et AWS (VPC, segmentation, exposition privée de services), l?industrialisation de la qualité logicielle et du Run (tests automatisés unitaires, d?intégration et API, maintien des pipelines CI/CD, exploitation des automates et microservices de l?équipe) et l?exploration de briques d?IA générative ou d?automatisation avancée pour faciliter l?exploitation et le support. Le périmètre technique comprend notamment SharedVPC, NCC, TransitGateway, VPC Inspection, Security Groups, Private Service Connect (PSC), PrivateLink, VPC Endpoints, Cloud Routers, DirectConnect, Partner Interconnect, CloudDNS, Route53 et Infoblox, ainsi que le développement de services d?automatisation et d?orchestration réseau. Abonnez-vous à la page NaxoTech sur LinkedIn pour découvrir nos offres régulières Profil candidat: Expérience : minimum 5 ans en tant que CloudOps, Platform Engineer ou Software Engineer orienté infrastructure, avec une forte appétence pour les problématiques réseau. Prérequis techniques indispensables : maîtrise de GCP, Terraform, Python et Git. Développement et qualité logicielle : expérience avérée dans la création d?API (FastAPI, Django ou Flask) et la mise en place de bonnes pratiques de code (Pytest, Pydantic, linters type Ruff, tests API type Bruno). Architecture Cloud & Réseau : solide compréhension des réseaux cloud (VPC, routage, DNS, HTTP, BGP) et de la conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes). Ouverture technologique : curiosité ou première expérience autour de l?IAOps (intégration de LLM/agents dans les workflows d?exploitation). Les plus : connaissance d?AWS, notions d?équipements réseau traditionnels et sécurité (VPN, IPSec), maîtrise de Go, Ansible (+ AAP) et de la stack d?observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk). Savoir-être : esprit produit, goût pour le code propre, autonomie, excellente communication et capacité à embarquer les utilisateurs. Compétences demandées : GitHub Actions : Expert; IBM Terraform : Expert; AWS : Avancé; Full Stack Python : Confirmé; GITHUB : Expert; GCP : Expert; Programmation Python : Confirmé.

items.desc: Fan inconditionnel de Microsoft, tu as envie de développer des applications from scratch sur-mesure ? Le C# est ton langage préféré et tu as aussi envie de coder dans d’autres langages ? Tu as envie d’être au sein d’une team 100% technique et de travailler dans des locaux sympas, et pas chez les clients ? Tu es au bon endroit, bienvenue chez AXOPEN ! Axo quoi ? Basée à Lyon, AXOPEN est une entreprise à taille humaine spécialisée dans le développement d’applications web sur-mesure depuis plus de 15 ans ! Notre team de 50 collaborateurs passionnés de code (développeurs et experts techniques) réalise des projets de développement pour nos clients (des grandes et petites entreprises, de tous secteurs d’activités) depuis nos locaux en petites teams, et avec des technologies variées : .NET Core/C#, Java, Spring Boot, Angular, VueJS, React, Android, etc. Notre philosophie ? Écrire du code de qualité pour concevoir des applications maintenables ! Au-delà des projets, AXOPEN c’est une véritable communauté de techs qui s’entraident et qui partagent bien plus qu’un espace de travail ensemble ! Expérimentations de nouvelles technos, bonnes pratiques de code, projets de création de bornes d’arcades, sorties de sportives, afterworks… Tout est mis en place pour que chacun puisse s’épanouir et continuer à apprendre tout en s’amusant ! Tes missions Au sein d’une équipe composée d’un lead dev et de 2 à 8 développeurs, tu participeras au développement d’applications web innovantes basées principalement sur les technologies C#/.NET Core et des frameworks JavaScript pour le front : Angular, React ou VueJS. Ton quotidien se résumera aux 5 lettres suivantes : C-O-D-E-R ! Tu pourras te perfectionner sur les technologies Microsoft, mais aussi découvrir d’autres stacks techniques comme Java/Spring Boot par exemple ! Voici un exemple des missions qui pourront t’être confiées : Participer aux phases de conception des projets et aux choix techniques Développer des projets de A à Z (écrans, fonctionnalités, API, webservices) Créer des nouvelles features sur des projets existants Participer à l’optimisation du code et des performances Participer aux phases d'intégration et de déploiement du code (Azure, AWS, Gitlab..) Point important : tu ne seras pas affecté ad vitam æternam sur un projet ! L’idée est que tu puisses changer de contexte quand tu le souhaites, et avoir de nouveaux challenges projets ou technologiques ! Si l’on se projette sur la durée, sache que tes missions évolueront en fonction de ton projet de carrière ! Et oui, que tu souhaites continuer à progresser dans le développement, ou te diriger plutôt vers l’expertise technique ou la gestion de projet, nous t’accompagnerons au fil de ton aventure chez AXOPEN pour que tu atteignes tes objectifs ! Ton profil Pour qu’on s’entende bien, c’est essentiel que tu te retrouves dans les quelques points ci-dessous : Tu as fait des études en informatique (BTS, DUT, Licence, Master) BAC+2/3 ou BAC+5 Tu es quelqu'un de curieux et autonome ! Tu es passionné par le développement, et tu as envie de continuer à apprendre. Tu aimes les challenges techniques, et ça t’agace quand tu n’arrives pas à résoudre un problème :) Tu partages nos valeurs : le partage, l’esprit d’équipe et le respect ! Dans le cadre de notre politique RSE, AXOPEN étudie et s'engage à valoriser la diversité des profils de ses collaborateurs à compétences égales. Travailler chez AXOPEN Travailler chez AXOPEN, c’est bien plus qu’un job ! C’est baigner dans un quotidien rythmé par le développement, et par des instants de partage (formations internes, veille techno, projets extra-job, activités sportives, afterworks, etc.). En intégrant AXOPEN, tu bénéficieras d'un véritable accompagnement tout au long de ta carrière , de formations internes et de certifications Udemy et d' un parrainage technique personnalisé. Tu ne seras pas en mission chez un client ! Tu passeras la quasi-totalité de ton temps chez AXOPEN, en mode projet AGILE. Nos locaux sont situés dans un quartier très vivant et accessible en plein cœur de Lyon : la Part-Dieu ! Un environnement sympathique et bienveillant, dans lequel tu pourras continuer à monter en compétences grâce aux retours des experts techniques sur ton code, et sur les bonnes pratiques à adopter ! Et point important : tu pourras (et tu devras) te déconnecter :) Nous appliquons une charte de déconnexion pour que tu puisses marquer clairement les temps entre ta vie pro et perso ! Package & autres infos La prise en charge à 100 % de ton abonnement TCL, Vélo'v et TER Des Tickets Restaurant via la carte Swile (9,50 € par jour travaillé), prise en charge à 60% Une prime d’intéressement qui récompense les efforts collectifs, calculée selon les résultats annuels. La possibilité de télétravailler jusqu’à 2 jours par semaine en toute autonomie, pour mieux équilibrer ta vie pro/perso. Des formations en continu, en présentiel et à distance Un bureau bien situé à la Part-Dieu, Lyon 6e. Des moments de détente …

items.desc: About the role Onodrim is building Europe’s largest defence and industrial platform. We acquire specialist manufacturers in critical defence and dual-use supply chains, then invest behind their growth with capital, technology and operating know-how. Forward Deployed Operators are Onodrim’s people on the ground. In this role you’ll work inside the operations that sit around production in our portfolio companies: order management, planning and scheduling, procurement and supplier management, logistics, quality, and the systems that tie them together. This is not a slide-deck job. You’ll find out why orders ship late, why planners rebuild the schedule in Excel every Monday, or why a part takes six signatures to buy. Then you’ll redesign the process with the people who run it and stay until it sticks. You’ll work alongside our Forward Deployed Operators in Production, who own the shop floor, and our Forward Deployed Engineers, who build the software that fixes what you find. Most of the biggest losses in a plant sit in the handoffs between these teams. Closing them is your job. What you’ll do Diagnose operations end to end. Run fast assessments of order-to-delivery, planning, procurement, logistics and quality processes to find where time, capacity and reliability are lost. Map how work really flows. Trace the handoffs, approvals, queues and spreadsheet workarounds between teams, and quantify where they create delays and errors. Fix planning and scheduling. Improve SOP, demand and capacity planning, and production scheduling so the plant builds the right things at the right time. Strengthen the supply side. Improve procurement workflows, supplier performance management, material availability and inventory control. Evaluate the software stack. Audit ERP, MES, planning and quality tools: what’s used, what’s bypassed and where data breaks between systems. Scope the fixes with our FDEs. Build the operating rhythm. Set up the KPIs, daily and weekly reviews, escalation paths and standard work that keep operations running predictably. Integrate new acquisitions. Bring newly acquired companies onto Onodrim’s operating standards, tooling and cadence without disrupting delivery. Coach and build capability. Train teams and supervisors on the new processes and problem-solving methods, then hand off and move on. Own outcomes. Set targets with site leadership, track impact weekly and stay accountable for lead time, on-time delivery, schedule adherence and hours saved. Requirements What you’ll bring A degree in a technical or quantitative discipline. Engineering (industrial, mechanical, manufacturing or similar), operations research, supply chain or similar. At least 5 years’ experience in operations improvement, supply chain or planning, or in implementation-focused operations consulting. A structured, hands-on problem solver who is comfortable with process mapping, root-cause analysis and messy data. Strong data skills and comfort working with large exports from ERP and planning systems. Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken. Willingness to travel extensively and spend extended periods at portfolio companies across Europe. Right to work in the UK, Switzerland or the EU. Nice to have We run our business in English, but fluency in one or more other European languages is required. German or Italian especially. Hands-on experience with ERP (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor or similar), MES or planning tools, or with SQL, Python and BI tools. Experience in defence, aerospace or another regulated, high-mix low-volume manufacturing environment. Clearance in at least one of our operating countries.

items.desc: Define the Future of Food & Beverage Marking with inPhocal We are not entering the market to follow it. We are here to change it. At inPhocal, we are revolutionizing industrial laser marking. Our patented optical technology delivers an ultra-long focus depth, enabling high-speed, high-precision marking on complex and curved surfaces without refocusing—a capability unmatched by conventional systems. Our machines are already running in production, our customer base is growing fast, and we are scaling globally. Our ambition is simple: make inPhocal the innovation leader in beverage marking and set a new standard for the industry. To make that happen, we need a System Engineer who knows the ins and outs of Food & Beverage (F&B) laser marking and coding. You’ll be the technical anchor guiding our team as we grow from an agile startup into a mature scale-up. The Opportunity Our systems are in active development across multiple stages, and we need a practical, experienced technical expert to join our Tech team. In this role, you will guide our engineering team using your hands-on background in F&B marking. You’ll help us build operational maturity by improving mechanical designs, taking ownership of compliance and laser safety, and writing clear, practical technical documentation. How You'll Make an Impact Own the system lifecycle: Define requirements, system architecture, design, testing, verification, validation, and deployment. Turn market feedback into specs: Capture real-world constraints, elicit user needs, and translate customer input into clear technical specifications for our product roadmap. Design & integrate: Apply solid engineering principles to integrate multi-component laser marking systems across optics, mechanics, and electronics. Keep machines running: Install, test, monitor, and troubleshoot systems to solve performance bottlenecks and field issues. Set up safety & documentation: Keep our user manuals, service guides, and internal technical files up to date, including CE compliance and Laser Safety standards. Bridge teams: Work directly with our technical, project management, and commercial teams to make sure customer requirements actually work on the factory floor. What You'll Bring 5+ years of practical experience in the laser marking and coding industry (ideally within F&B or packaging). Strong engineering foundation in Mechatronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering, with a clear understanding of how these domains interact. Systems thinking: The ability to see the machine as a whole, analyze trade-offs, and solve complex performance issues. Optics knowledge: A grasp of the basics of optics, with the curiosity to learn our proprietary technology. Startup to scale-up mindset: Eager to guide a young, learning team as we transition into robust, structured processes. Team player: Comfortable working independently, collaborating across disciplines, and communicating well with international colleagues. What We Offer Direct impact: Build machines using revolutionary laser technology and directly shape the success of the company. A real learning environment: Work alongside skilled engineers and physicists with plenty of room to grow internally. Compensation: A competitive base salary, pension plan, and participation in our Employee Stock Option Program (ESOP). Travel allowance and mobile phone budget. Great culture: An open, fast-paced atmosphere with team events, social gatherings, and colleagues who genuinely enjoy what they do. Clean tech: Be part of commercializing a sustainable, ink-free technology that cuts waste in global manufacturing. Ready to make your mark? Please send an email with your CV to systemengineer@odoo.inphocal.com Job Type: Full-time Work Location: In person
