items.desc: Your (space) mission As the Software Engineer at cosine you develop the software backbone behind the advanced X-ray optics technology used in future space missions, including ESA's NewAthena space telescope. Working at the intersection of software engineering, data science and optics, you build software tools, databases and data pipelines that turn complex production and measurement data into valuable insights. Together with physicists, optics engineers and fellow software developers, you contribute to the development and validation of optical systems where nanometre-level accuracy matters. Tasks & responsibilities In this role you will: Develop software tools and data analysis applications that help scientists and engineers gain insights from experimental and production data Design, maintain and enhance internal database solutions and web applications using Django and Django REST Framework Build, test and optimise data pipelines that ensure reliable and efficient processing of manufacturing, inspection and environmental datasets Develop and maintain user-friendly interfaces that support interaction with scientific software tools and data systems Collaborate closely with software engineers, scientists and technical teams to improve software quality, efficiency and usability across the High Energy Optics programme Your profile We are looking for candidates with the following qualifications: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or 5+ years of equivalent professional experience Strong Python development skills, including testing and package management, with hands-on experience in Django, Django REST Framework and scientific libraries such as NumPy and Matplotlib Experience developing full-stack applications, including databases, APIs, front-end interfaces and back-end services Familiarity with Git-based development workflows, Linux environments, SSH, virtual machines and virtual environments An analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a commitment to software quality Excellent English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within an international, multidisciplinary engineering environment What we offer At cosine, we highly value our employees, and we will support your professional and personal development. We also provide our employees with: A unique, international working environment at the intersection of physics and engineering The opportunity to deliver end-to-end solutions in autonomous project teams, in close collaboration with customers 27 days of annual leave (based on full-time employment) Annual bonus based on personal and company performance Hybrid working options, including the possibility to work partially from home Company bicycle- and fitness plan A personal development budget Initial one-year contract, with the aim of long-term collaboration About cosine Founded in 1998, cosine is a world-leading developer of space instrumentation and measurement systems, making the invisible measurable and the complex actionable. Its expertise spans High-Energy Optics, including optics developed for ESA's future NewAthena X-ray observatory, as well as remote sensing solutions for Earth Observation and planetary science. With over 25 years of experience and advanced cleanroom and assembly facilities across the Netherlands, Germany, and Italy, cosine brings deep scientific and engineering expertise to some of the most demanding missions in space and on Earth. What makes cosine a unique place to work is that your work goes end-to-end: from concept and design to building, testing, and delivering hardware that actually flies in space. You work in small, highly skilled teams where you have real ownership and impact, alongside experts in optics, physics, nanofabrication, and systems engineering. cosine is committed to providing an inclusive and equal opportunities work environment where everyone can thrive. As a proud member of the Women in Aerospace community, we recognise the importance of diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity in the workplace.

Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie odpowiedzialna za analizę istniejących rozwiązań, projektowanie procesów migracji danych oraz definiowanie wymagań i specyfikacji technicznych niezbędnych do skutecznego przeniesienia danych pomiędzy systemami. Projekt realizowany jest we współpracy z zespołem bankowym oraz zewnętrznym dostawcą rozwiązania docelowego. Środowisko technologiczne: System legacy: Informix, .NET, SOAP System docelowy: Oracle, Java, REST Integracja i komunikacja: REST, SOAP, Kafka, RabbitMQ Narzędzia analityczne: Enterprise Architect, Jira, Confluence Twoja rola w zespole: Analiza architektury, modeli danych oraz mechanizmów integracyjnych istniejącego systemu bankowego. Projektowanie procesów migracji danych z systemu legacy do systemu docelowego. Opracowywanie mapowań danych (source-to-target mapping), reguł transformacji oraz walidacji danych. Projektowanie mechanizmów uzgadniania danych (data reconciliation), zapewniających zgodność, kompletność i spójność danych pomiędzy systemami. Planowanie i projektowanie migracji próbnych (mock migrations / dry runs), w tym definiowanie kryteriów ich powodzenia oraz sposobów weryfikacji wyników. Analiza i projektowanie mechanizmów obsługi błędów migracyjnych, ponawiania przetwarzania (retry/reprocessing) oraz zapewnienia idempotentności operacji. Analiza zależności pomiędzy systemami i identyfikacja ryzyk związanych z migracją. Przygotowywanie dokumentacji analitycznej i technicznej, w tym modeli danych, diagramów UML oraz specyfikacji interfejsów. Współpraca z zespołami developerskimi, architektami, testerami oraz dostawcą zewnętrznym. Udział w projektowaniu mechanizmów integracyjnych oraz komunikacji synchronicznej i asynchronicznej. Wsparcie przygotowania scenariuszy testowych, testów migracyjnych oraz uzgadniania poprawności przeniesionych danych. Udział w warsztatach analitycznych, przeglądach rozwiązań i planowaniu kolejnych etapów migracji. Poziom wiedzy i kwalifikacje: Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w analizie systemowej, preferowane doświadczenie w sektorze bankowym lub finansowym. Praktyczne doświadczenie w projektach migracji danych lub modernizacji systemów IT. Doświadczenie w projektowaniu mechanizmów uzgadniania danych (reconciliation), w tym kontroli kompletności, spójności i poprawności migrowanych danych. Znajomość zasad organizacji i przeprowadzania migracji próbnych oraz walidacji ich wyników. Doświadczenie w analizie i projektowaniu mechanizmów obsługi błędów, ponawiania przetwarzania oraz bezpiecznego wznawiania procesów migracyjnych. Bardzo dobra znajomość relacyjnych baz danych oraz SQL, w tym umiejętność analizy złożonych struktur danych i zależności. Bardzo dobra znajomość protokołu SOAP oraz architektury i zasad projektowania API REST. Znajomość architektury systemów wykorzystujących komunikację asynchroniczną, np. Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ. Bardzo dobra znajomość notacji UML, w szczególności diagramów klas i sekwencji. Doświadczenie w przygotowywaniu specyfikacji technicznych, modeli danych i dokumentacji integracyjnej. Praktyczna znajomość Enterprise Architect, Jira oraz Confluence. Doświadczenie w pracy w metodykach zwinnych (Agile/Scrum). Umiejętność efektywnego wykorzystywania narzędzi AI w codziennej pracy analitycznej. Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie minimum B2. Wykształcenie wyższe kierunkowe (STEM). Samodzielność, analityczne podejście do rozwiązywania problemów oraz umiejętność współpracy z wieloma interesariuszami. Mile widziane Praktyczne doświadczenie z bazami danych Informix i Oracle. items.desc: Warszawa 17 listopada 2026 Anwim S.A. is one of the largest independent companies in Poland's fuel sector. It operates the MOYA network, the fastest-growing nationwide fuel station chain in Poland. Our modern facilities, offering products and services tailored to the needs of even the most demanding customers, are located in every region of Poland, along major transit routes and local roads. MOYA fuel stations are distinguished by the highest fuel quality standards, well-stocked convenience stores and an attractive food service concept. We also engage in the wholesale sale and distribution of liquid fuels throughout Poland, supported by our own fleet of fuel tankers. Our business activities also include a fuel card programme designed for fleet customers, including those refuelling abroad. Our fleet card is accepted in 18 European countries. MOYA energia is our new venture, combining our extensive experience in the fuel market with modern technology to provide drivers with fast and reliable electric vehicle charging solutions, in line with the green transition. Our goal is to build a dense nationwide network of charging stations and support businesses in transitioning their fleets towards sustainable mobility. We develop our business in a thoughtful and responsible manner. We foster an organisational culture that encourages innovation and collaboration across different business areas. Opis stanowiska Twój zakres obowiązków Independently design and develop enterprise IT architecture and complex IT solutions, ensuring architectural consistency across the organisation. Develop architectural concepts, technical documentation, and architecture models and diagrams (AS-IS, TO-BE, HLD). Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into secure, high-performance and scalable IT solutions. Design microservices architectures, distributed systems and integrations between applications and systems. Select technologies, components and architectural patterns, taking security, cost, performance and risk into account. Assess existing solutions, identify technical debt and prepare recommendations for modernising and developing the IT environment. Collaborate with development teams, analysts, architects, security specialists, IT administrators and business stakeholders. Define, develop and enforce organisation-wide architectural and technology standards, and oversee compliance with these standards across projects. Wymagania Nasze wymagania At least 10 years of professional experience in IT, including a minimum of 5 years in designing system or solution architectures. Experience in designing and developing IT architecture in an enterprise environment, taking into account business processes, system dependencies and organisational standards. Strong knowledge of architectural patterns and styles, particularly SOA, microservices, distributed systems and event-driven architecture. Experience in designing cloud solutions. Practical knowledge of system integration design using REST APIs, SOAP, gRPC, WebSocket and TCP/IP socket communication. Knowledge of asynchronous messaging and queuing systems, particularly RabbitMQ and Apache Kafka. Strong knowledge of IT security, including application, integration, data transmission and infrastructure security, as well as non-functional requirements relating to performance, availability and scalability. Ability to create and maintain architectural documentation using Enterprise Architect, including modelling in UML and ArchiMate. Knowledge of PHP, Java and C# (.NET) sufficient to analyse and review source code. Strong knowledge of containerisation and orchestration environments (Docker, Kubernetes), along with experience in designing CI/CD processes, particularly using GitLab and GitLab CI/CD. Knowledge of system monitoring and observability tools, such as Grafana and Zabbix. Practical knowledge of computer networking. Practical knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems, preferably Ubuntu. Ability to make architectural decisions independently, assess technology risks and collaborate with technical and business teams. English proficiency at a minimum of B2+ level, with C1 preferred. Optional Architecture certifications, such as TOGAF, and additional qualifications in ArchiMate and UML. Cloud solution architecture certifications, such as AWS or Microsoft Azure. Knowledge of BPMN notation and experience in business process modelling. Familiarity with AI-based solutions, including ChatGPT, Claude and large language models (LLMs) deployed on an organisation’s own infrastructure. items.desc: Turn sound waves into better diagnostics and cell therapy At AcouSort, we use acoustofluidics, a combination of sound waves and microfluidics, to handle cells and particles gently and without labels. Our technology grew out of more than 20 years of research at the Department of Biomedical Engineering at Lund University. Today it’s used in research instruments such as AcouWash and AcouTrap and will revolutionize sample processing within diagnostics, biomarker research and cell therapy manufacturing. We’re now looking for an R&D Scientist who can support taking acoustofluidics devices from simulation through validated prototype to product lunch. What you’ll do Design and optimize acoustofluidic chips and systems for blood and cell processing Model acoustic fields, fluid flow and particle behavior (COMSOL, MATLAB) Build prototypes using micro milling, 3D printing and lithography Validate performance on blood and cell samples, including plasma quality, hemolysis and cell viability Work with clinical and industrial partners, and help with grant applications and scientific communication Who you are PhD in biomedical engineering At least 5 years of hands-on experience with acoustophoresis and acoustic particle manipulation in microfluidics Expertise with both acoustic field simulation and lab work, including CAD, imaging and flow cytometry Experienced with blood samples and relevant cytometry analyses Motivated by turning research into products that reach the market We offer A key role in an ambitious team, where your work goes straight into products used by researchers, clinics and the cell therapy industry. Interested? Please send your application to jobs@acousort.com. Applications are reviewed continuously. About AcouSort AcouSort is a medical technology company developing critical components for instrumentation used in the diagnostics, analytics, and cell therapy processing markets. AcouSort’s components allow for automated refinement of biological samples such as blood or cell preparations, providing instrumentation manufacturers with a state-of-the-art ability to integrate sample processing steps that traditionally must be performed manually. AcouSort’s strategy is to use our innovative technology to revolutionize today’s healthcare by providing a solution to automate and integrate sample processing steps, allowing for a new generation of medical devices to be developed. Through collaborations with leading Life Science companies our integrated technology will eliminate manual handling steps while saving time, money, and ultimately – lives. Our core technology builds on more than 20 years of acoustofluidics research and development headed by Thomas Laurell, professor at Lund University at the Department of Biomedical Engineering and co-founder and board member of AcouSort. The company is listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market in Stockholm.

items.desc: About the role Onodrim is building Europe’s largest defence and industrial platform. We acquire specialist manufacturers in critical defence and dual-use supply chains, then invest behind their growth with capital, technology and operating know-how. Forward Deployed Operators are Onodrim’s people on the ground. In this role you’ll work inside the operations that sit around production in our portfolio companies: order management, planning and scheduling, procurement and supplier management, logistics, quality, and the systems that tie them together. This is not a slide-deck job. You’ll find out why orders ship late, why planners rebuild the schedule in Excel every Monday, or why a part takes six signatures to buy. Then you’ll redesign the process with the people who run it and stay until it sticks. You’ll work alongside our Forward Deployed Operators in Production, who own the shop floor, and our Forward Deployed Engineers, who build the software that fixes what you find. Most of the biggest losses in a plant sit in the handoffs between these teams. Closing them is your job. What you’ll do Diagnose operations end to end. Run fast assessments of order-to-delivery, planning, procurement, logistics and quality processes to find where time, capacity and reliability are lost. Map how work really flows. Trace the handoffs, approvals, queues and spreadsheet workarounds between teams, and quantify where they create delays and errors. Fix planning and scheduling. Improve SOP, demand and capacity planning, and production scheduling so the plant builds the right things at the right time. Strengthen the supply side. Improve procurement workflows, supplier performance management, material availability and inventory control. Evaluate the software stack. Audit ERP, MES, planning and quality tools: what’s used, what’s bypassed and where data breaks between systems. Scope the fixes with our FDEs. Build the operating rhythm. Set up the KPIs, daily and weekly reviews, escalation paths and standard work that keep operations running predictably. Integrate new acquisitions. Bring newly acquired companies onto Onodrim’s operating standards, tooling and cadence without disrupting delivery. Coach and build capability. Train teams and supervisors on the new processes and problem-solving methods, then hand off and move on. Own outcomes. Set targets with site leadership, track impact weekly and stay accountable for lead time, on-time delivery, schedule adherence and hours saved. Requirements What you’ll bring A degree in a technical or quantitative discipline. Engineering (industrial, mechanical, manufacturing or similar), operations research, supply chain or similar. At least 5 years’ experience in operations improvement, supply chain or planning, or in implementation-focused operations consulting. A structured, hands-on problem solver who is comfortable with process mapping, root-cause analysis and messy data. Strong data skills and comfort working with large exports from ERP and planning systems. Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken. Willingness to travel extensively and spend extended periods at portfolio companies across Europe. Right to work in the UK, Switzerland or the EU. Hands-on experience with ERP (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor or similar), MES or planning tools, or with SQL, Python and BI tools. Experience in defence, aerospace or another regulated, high-mix low-volume manufacturing environment. Clearance in at least one of our operating countries.

items.desc: Job Summary As a Product Designer and User Researcher, you will lead research with stakeholders and turn it into tested, accessible designs for a new digital service that helps them use research evidence to improve teaching. You will work with our product team so that every release is shaped by what practitioners actually need. The service is being delivered for a UK public sector organisation, so it must meet the GDS Service Standard and pass service assessments. This is a 12-month outside IR35 contract starting in January 2027, full time and moving to 2 to 3 days a week for the final two months, hybrid in central London with about one day a week on site. Responsibilities Plan and run weekly research with teachers and school leaders around the school calendar, including users with access needs and staff in schools serving disadvantaged communities. Design and prototype journeys in Figma, Figma Make, Lovable or Claude Design for conversational AI journeys. Design collaboration features that let staff save, share and plan improvements within a school or trust, working within an existing brand and design system. Own accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA and content design quality, keep a research repository, and coach colleagues to run research themselves. Pair with an incoming in-house product designer and hand over the designs, research and component library. Work in a multidisciplinary digital delivery team (product, delivery, engineering, content and policy), using agile, user-centred ways of working in line with the GDS Service Standard. Prepare design and research evidence for GDS service assessments, using the GOV.UK Design System and patterns where they fit. Design and build content structures and page templates in a content management system (CMS), for example WordPress, HubSpot, Magento or Umbraco. Your impact: Research-led, accessible designs help busy teachers find what works for their pupils quickly and use it with confidence. Qualifications Plus: Experience building a CMS, for example WordPress, HubSpot, Magento or Umbraco. Key requirements: 6+ years in product or service design with substantial hands-on user research A portfolio showing research-led design of a digital service taken to live Strong Figma and prototyping skills Practical knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA Previous experience working within government or the public sector Excellent understanding of GDS (Government Digital Service) standards, including the Service Standard, GOV.UK Design System and service assessments Experience working with multidisciplinary digital delivery teams Preferred: Experience researching and designing AI or conversational products would be advantageous. We specialise in highly regulated sectors, including government and the public sector, where services must be accurate, secure and accountable. Our network of product management, business analysis and delivery specialists comes from consulting and blue-chip backgrounds. Depending on your experience, you could be taking ownership of defined project activities, leading your own workstream or shaping and leading larger areas of delivery. items.desc: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview Role Overview Citi’s Global Commodities franchise is seeking an exceptional, market-facing Commodities Desk Strategist at the Director level to join our front-office team in London, reporting directly to the Head of Commodities Institutional Sales & Structuring. Replicating a proven, highly successful desk-strategy blueprint established across our Macro businesses, this high-visibility seat operates as an independent, commercial trade-ideation platform. The individual will bridge deep fundamental research with active front-office monetization, focusing primarily on commodities. Responsibilities: The role focuses on the creation of tactical trade ideas (tactical investor and hedging) and high-impact fundamental content to support our Corporate and Institutional Sales franchises. This role will also serve as the main point of contact and analytical lead for Alpha Capture programs across institutional clients. Recommended Qualifications: Experience: 6–12+ years of experience in Commodities Strategy, Research, or Desk Strategy within a top-tier investment bank, trading house, independent research firm, or buy-side institution. Asset Class Expertise: Strong foundation across Commodities, with deep knowledge of Metals (Base, Precious, Battery Metals, Bulks) being desirable. Trade Ideation & Structuring Track Record: Proven ability to translate fundamental supply/demand views into commercial trade ideas/structures. Alpha Capture / Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated familiarity with institutional Alpha Capture portals and front-office client engagement. Mindset: A true fundamentals-driven strategist with sharp critical thinking, commercial hunger, and an appetite for front-office trading floor proximity and monetization. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline; CFA charter or equivalent qualification is advantageous. What Citi Can Offer You By joining Citi London, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as: 27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) A discretional annual performance related bonus Private Medical Care & Life Insurance Employee Assistance Program Pension Plan Paid Parental Leave Special discounts for employees, family, and friends Access to an array of learning and development resources Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self, every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive. If you are actively working with clients, have a passion for relationships and want to be part of a successful global franchise – then apply today. This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required. Candidates applying for this role must be aware that it is a Certified Role, subject to the FCA and PRA Certification Regime. The Certification Regime is one element of the Individual Accountability Regime which came into effect on 7 March 2016. Under the Certification Regime, Citi UK regulated entities (Citi entities) must ensure that employees working in certain roles categorised as specified significant harm functions (Certified Roles) are assessed as fit and proper to carry out their role. Under the guidance provided by the FCA and PRA, firms should have regard to the following when assessing fitness and propriety: Honesty, Integrity and Reputation Financial soundness Competence and capability In order to comply with the requirements of the Certification Regime, Citi entities must take reasonable care to ensure that an employee does not perform a Certified Role without first being certified as Fit and Proper. For this reason, you will be assessed for this role against the Fit and Proper requirements, as described above. items.desc: Perch Group are looking for a Portfolio Performance Analyst. At Perch Group, our vision is clear: to lead the UK debt purchase and collection industry by harnessing cutting-edge technology to drive ethical, efficient, and data-driven debt resolution. Our annual mission is to empower hundreds of thousands of customers to positively engage with and resolve their outstanding debts. We do this through an empathetic and customer-centric approach that is at the heart of our success. Could this be the next step in your career? The Portfolio Performance Analyst role is a brand-new position within the Investment function and will be primarily responsible for conducting analysis, developing analytical tools, KPI’s and dashboards to audit and monitor all portfolio acquisitions made by the business as they progress through Perch Capital’s complex onboarding and collections processes, to ultimately drive portfolio performance. The candidate will support the Portfolio Performance Manager in identifying the root cause for any inefficiencies, providing insights across each of a) gross collections, b) cost optimisation and c) customer journeys, highlighting any early warning signs associated with performance to the relevant stakeholders in good time. A key part of this role will be the interacting with the Pricing, Decision Science, Finance, Analytics, Implementation & Operational departments within the business to then collectively act on these findings. We are looking for a highly analytical, commercially minded and self-motivated – someone who can translate insight into impact, with the ability to conduct root cause analysis and is articulate and confident in communicating with colleagues at every level of the business, including senior members and stakeholders. This is a new role that will report directly into the Portfolio Performance Manager. So, what will your day-to-day look like? The candidate will work as part of the Investment Director’s team, supporting the Portfolio Performance Manager across several areas including but not limited to: [35%] Building analytical tools, developing dashboards and interacting with natural language AI tools, to query, track and monitor Perch Capital’s onboarding journey and strategies, across a range of KPI’s and SLA’s, both in aggregate across all portfolios acquired and tailored analysis for specific, strategic clients and cohorts of acquired debts (such as ‘Paying’ accounts), vs modelling assumptions. This includes the operational readiness to achieve projected targets (both recoveries & timings) of future placements of accounts to other entities within the Perch Group family, including Perch Verify (the Group’s in-house field connect service) and TMLS (the Group’s in-house law firm). [25%] Conduct investigative in-depth analysis and ‘hand-holding’ of key strategic portfolios from a performance perspective, reviewing Perch’s systems and processes, tracking the flow of accounts through strategies, down to an account level if required, in order to quickly identify the root cause of any discrepancies in performance and feeding this information back to key stakeholders. This spans both gross collections and modelled costs. [20%] Supporting the Portfolio Performance Manager in the running and managing of a number of key internal stakeholder meetings, where portfolio performance is discussed and early warning signs are raised, to be supported by analysis and MI, spanning a range of key milestones in the collections journey. [10%] Working with Pricing, Decision Science, Finance and Analytics to identify and target any emerging trends of divergence vs underwriting and/or ERC assumptions, followed by granular deep dives into Perch processes to establish if root cause is driven by any operational or system failure or inefficiency and feeding back insights to improve alignment across the business and improve future forecasting accuracy. Does this sound like you? Strong academic background within a quantitative discipline, e.g. STEM fields(s), Economics, Finance and/or; Up to 2 years’ relevant work experience of demonstratable experience in analysis within financial services (exposure to debt purchasing and/or credit related sectors is desirable). Proven ability to manage multiple high value workstreams in parallel, delivering to tight deadlines. Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to consolidate and interpret complex information from multiple sources. Analytical mindset with the ability to understand and analyse large data sets to identify errors or gaps in a process (an audit or equivalent background would be highly suited to this role). Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge and escalate where appropriate. Knowledge of UK consumer credit, FCA regulations, and debt purchasing market dynamics desirable. Excellent numerical, written and verbal communication skills. Strong MS Office skills required where experience in Python and Power BI would be …

items.desc: Job no: 531279 Brand: Product and Technology Work type: Full time, Remote Location: London, Barcelona Categories: Digital and Technology About the Role This role sits within the squad that builds Unified Admin — the service used to onboard and configure corporate travel customers across FCTG's brands. Unified Admin is two applications in one repository: a .NET 10 API built on clean architecture with vertical-slice CQRS, and a Next.js 16 / React 19 frontend that runs its own Node server tier as a backend-for-frontend, holding the session, setting the Content-Security-Policy and proxying every API call. The service is multi-brand by design, with brand scoping enforced in the data layer, and it integrates with upstream FCTG platform services through typed clients, Azure Service Bus (transactional outbox) and Azure Functions. This is a full-stack role at Software Engineer level (band 3 of the Engineering Career Framework). A typical ticket touches the API, the PostgreSQL schema and the UI, and you are expected to carry it from reading the requirement through to a reviewed pull request and confirmed behaviour. The squad works in an AI-assisted way: tickets follow a plan, implement, verify, review and PR pipeline with approval gates, and much of the first-draft code is produced with Claude Code. You will use AI to move faster, and part of your job is to review its output critically and prove it correct, with the Engineering Lead and more senior engineers alongside you on the harder design calls. Strict CI guardrails (architecture tests, strict lint and type checks) keep that safe, but they do not replace your judgement. Key Responsibilities Deliver end to end. Take well-defined tickets from plan to merged PR with light guidance from the Engineering Lead: clarify ambiguities early with the TPM or PO, keep changes small and in scope, and hand over a reviewable change linked to the card. Build across the stack. Vertical-slice CQRS features in .NET, accessible and localised UI in React / Next.js, and PostgreSQL schema changes through EF Core (agreeing larger design changes with the Engineering Lead), including data-heavy screens, imports and exports. Integrate and keep it secure. Work with upstream FCTG services (including the Platform Services GraphQL API) and the platform messaging stack (Service Bus outbox, Azure Functions, Blob Storage), respecting multi-brand data isolation and applying security fundamentals: authentication, authorisation, input validation and no sensitive data in logs. Own quality. Testing is a developer responsibility, not something handed off at 'Ready for Test': test at the right level, cover happy, edge and failure cases, document the evidence on the card and keep CI green. Review and monitor. Review teammates' PRs with care, respond promptly to feedback on yours, monitor your changes with Datadog and own the bugs you introduce — a card isn't closed until behaviour is confirmed. AI-AUGMENTED DEVELOPMENT Use Claude Code as part of your daily workflow to plan, write, refactor, debug and document code faster, while owning the quality of what you ship, and share what works with the squad. Apply critical judgement: AI output is a starting point, not a finished solution. Review it carefully, verify behaviour with a build, a test run or a query result before calling work done, and raise anything you are unsure about with the Engineering Lead. What You'll Bring MUST HAVE 3–5 years of professional experience with solid C# and .NET (8 or later), including building REST APIs with ASP.NET Core. Relational database experience, ideally PostgreSQL, through EF Core or a similar ORM, including schema migrations. Working TypeScript and React, enough to build, test and review UI features independently; Next.js (App Router) can be picked up on the job. A habit of automated testing — xUnit or similar on the backend, Vitest or Jest on the frontend. Comfort with Git, pull-request workflows and CI pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred). Secure coding fundamentals: authentication and authorisation (for example JWT), input validation and safe handling of sensitive data. Hands-on experience with, or genuine enthusiasm for, AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Copilot or Cursor, and a willingness to work plan-first. Location : UK/Spain NICE TO HAVE GraphQL experience, consuming or building GraphQL APIs (this service consumes the federated Platform Services GraphQL API). CQRS / MediatR, clean architecture or domain-driven design, and messaging or outbox patterns. Azure experience (Service Bus, Functions, Blob Storage) and Docker. Observability tooling such as Datadog or OpenTelemetry. Playwright or other end-to-end testing, internationalisation (next-intl or similar), accessibility (WCAG) and Tailwind CSS / component-library experience. Multi-tenant or multi-brand application experience, or travel / corporate-services domain knowledge. MINDSET AND BEHAVIOURS A strong sense of ownership — you see features and fixes …

items.desc: About Us At MCS Rental Software, we’re passionate about helping rental businesses grow. With over 40 years of expertise, we provide cutting-edge rental management software, cloud solutions and responsive technical support to companies around the world. Join our mission to empower the rental industry through smart technology and outstanding service. The Opportunity We are seeking a .NET Developer to help convert our WinForms desktop application into a web application built with C#, ASP.NET MVC and Bootstrap. You will bring existing screens and features to the web, matching the behaviour customers rely on while building responsive pages and maintaining a clean MVC architecture. For each screen, you will be expected to understand the current functionality, produce a design, get feedback from the web team, then develop, test and deliver it. AI tools such as Claude Code will be provided; however, you will need to have the requisite understanding of the technologies involved. Employment Type: Fixed-term, full-time Contract Duration: 6 / 12 months, with the possibility of a permanent role Job Type: Hybrid (3 days in the office and 2 days at home) Salary: Circa £50,000 per annum, depending on experience Key Responsibilities Web migration: Convert WinForms screens and features to the web, matching existing behaviour. Web development: Build responsive pages using ASP.NET MVC, Razor, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Application architecture: Keep controllers thin and place logic in the right layer, including view models, services and data access. Database development: Write and optimise SQL Server queries and stored procedures. Code quality: Review code and work closely with QA, support and product colleagues. What We’re Looking For Strong C# and .NET development experience. ASP.NET MVC experience, including controllers, Razor views, view models, routing and validation. A sound understanding of MVC separation of concerns and what belongs in controllers, view models, services and data access. Experience with Bootstrap, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. SQL Server and T-SQL experience. Experience using Azure DevOps. A keen eye for detail, clear communication, collaborative working and ownership of your work. Desirable Experience Experience migrating WinForms or other desktop applications to the web. Experience with ASP.NET Core. Knowledge of rental, hire or ERP software and business processes. Why Work at MCS We’re proud recipients of the Culture 100 Award, which recognises organisations that excel in nurturing their workforce, rewarding their staff, and creating a supportive environment where everyone feels valued. At MCS, we pride ourselves on maintaining a vibrant, informal workplace culture based on respect and empowerment. Our dedication to our people has led to an average employee tenure of over 10 years. You’ll be part of a forward-thinking team with the freedom to innovate and the opportunity to make a real impact in the rental technology space. Pay: Up to £50,000.00 per year Benefits: Flexitime Free parking On-site parking Private medical insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Maidenhead

items.desc: We are PHOENIX Pharma , a leading integrated healthcare provider in Europe, and we’re excited to invite you to be part of our journey. With a team of approximately 48,000 dedicated professionals, we make a significant impact on healthcare across the continent. Operating in 29 countries, we supply essential pharmaceuticals and health products to pharmacies, doctors, and medical institutions through our 224 distribution centers, serving millions of people every day. Our international IT Hub in Sofia, Bulgaria, is growing, and we’re looking for talented individuals to join us in the Junior AI Developer position. You’ll be part of an international team, working in a vibrant environment that encourages the exchange of knowledge and ideas both onsite and offsite. Your Responsibilities: Design, develop and maintain AI and machine learning applications, agents, and automation solutions mainly using Python or Copilot Studio, using modern software engineering practices. Implement workflows using RAG, LLMs, vector search or prompt engineering to create reliable enterprise AI applications. Integrate AI solutions into existing business and IT landscapes. Contribute to solution quality through testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and adherence to security and development standards. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and implement AI-driven solutions. Continuously develop your technical skills and stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and frameworks. Your Profile: You hold a Bachelor and/or Master’s degree in computer science, data science, or a similar field. You are experienced in Python. You have practical experience with cloud-based AI development, preferably on Microsoft Azure. Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and AI agent frameworks. Understanding the basic principles of NLP, LLMs and Deep Learning. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team. Strong communication skills to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You are familiar with methods of agile project management. The ability to work in English is required. What We Offer: 26 days paid annual leave + 1 additional for your Birthday. Health insurance. Food vouchers. Flexible working time and options to work from home. Free parking. Sports venue pass fully covered. Learning and development. Employee discounts for company products and services. With passion about our product vision in delivering health: creating a health platform that brings together all health services—pharmacies, doctors, and medical supply stores—under one roof. We look for people with the same drive as us. If you recognize this role as a career opportunity where you can make a real difference and be part of an innovative project, we’d love to hear from you! Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

items.desc: ETANDEX est la principale entreprise indépendante de travaux spéciaux en France, forte d'une expertise technique reconnue depuis plus de 50 ans dans la réparation, la protection et le renforcement structurel d'infrastructures complexes (génie civil, bâtiments industriels, ouvrages hydrauliques). Réalisant un chiffre d'affaires de 180 millions d'euros avec un effectif de plus de 1 000 collaborateurs, ETANDEX fonde sa croissance sur une culture basée sur le savoir-faire technique, l'innovation et le sens des responsabilités. Le poste est basé au sein de la Direction des Systèmes d'Information au siège social des Ulis (91940), dans la zone d'activités de Courtabœuf. L'équipe technique, composée d'un chef de service, d'un lead développeur, de deux développeurs, d'un ingénieur DevOps, d'un ingénieur IA, d'un data analyste et de deux product owners, gère une infrastructure hybride moderne (cloud privé Kubernetes, serveurs GPU NVIDIA dédiés à l'exécution de modèles d'IA open source hébergés en interne) afin de fournir des outils métiers aux collaborateurs répartis sur l'ensemble du territoire. Description des missions Sous la responsabilité du chef de service développement, IA et intégration, le titulaire du poste conçoit, développe et assure la maintenance des applications métiers intégrant l'intelligence artificielle, pleinement insérées dans le système d'information d'ETANDEX. Les responsabilités principales s'articulent autour des axes suivants : Compréhension des métiers et cadrage : appréhender les enjeux et les processus de l'entreprise, identifier les traitements à automatiser et proposer l'application et les briques d'IA adaptées. Conception d'applications IA : assembler LLMs, modèles spécialisés, pipelines RAG, interrogation du wiki interne et serveurs MCP, notamment avec LangChain, pour livrer des assistants et des traitements automatisés. Infrastructure IA : participer, avec l'ingénieur IA et l'ingénieur DevOps, à la construction et à l'optimisation de la plateforme d'inférence interne à partir de modèles open source (LLM, embeddings, vision) : sélection et évaluation des modèles, déploiement sur les serveurs GPU NVIDIA, quantification, optimisation des performances (latence, débit, utilisation de la mémoire GPU) et arbitrage entre modèles hébergés en interne et API externes selon les usages. Développement et intégration au SI : développer les APIs (Python, C#.NET Core) et les interfaces web qui exposent ces capacités aux utilisateurs et les connectent aux données et applications existantes. Orchestration n8n : intégrer les traitements IA dans la plateforme de workflow n8n, y compris par des nœuds personnalisés en TypeScript/JavaScript. Livraison et exploitation : collaborer avec l'ingénieur DevOps pour déployer les applications et suivre leur cycle de vie. Évaluer la pertinence des réponses à partir des retours terrain et faire évoluer les applications. Profil recherché Formation : diplôme d'ingénieur en informatique ou Master universitaire (Bac+5). Expérience : une première expérience professionnelle en développement (un an ou plus) est souhaitée, avec une réalisation concrète d'application s'appuyant sur l'IA. Le poste reste ouvert aux jeunes diplômés justifiant d'une alternance solide sur ces sujets. Compétences techniques indispensables : Maîtrise de Python et de C#.NET Core, ainsi que de la conception d'APIs RESTful (FastAPI, ASP.NET Core). Pratique confirmée de l'intégration de LLMs : architectures RAG, bases vectorielles, agents et appels d'outils, avec LangChain ou un framework équivalent. Connaissance de TypeScript/JavaScript et d'un framework front-end moderne (React). Expérience du déploiement d'applications conteneurisées (Docker, Kubernetes). Maîtrise du SQL et des bases relationnelles (SQL Server, PostgreSQL). Usage régulier de GitLab et des pipelines GitLab CI. Compétences appréciées : Déploiement et optimisation de modèles open source sur GPU NVIDIA : serveurs d'inférence (vLLM, TGI, Ollama ou équivalent), quantification (AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF), environnement CUDA. Exploitation de ressources GPU sous Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator) et adaptation de modèles à des données métiers (fine-tuning, LoRA). Développement de workflows et de nœuds personnalisés sous n8n. Connaissance du protocole MCP (Model Context Protocol). Pratique de .NET Blazor ou Razor. Usage maîtrisé des outils de développement assisté par l'IA (Claude, Gemini, Copilot...). items.desc: Junior AI Engineer Dublin City Centre / Hybrid 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract (With the view to Permanent) An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Junior AI Engineer with 1-3 years experience to join a Dublin City Centre-based financial services firm on a 12-month fixed-term contract, with the potential to transition to a permanent role. You’ll join a small, collaborative data and AI team at an early stage of building a new internal AI platform. This is a hands-on role for someone looking to develop their AI engineering skills while working on real business problems. The opportunity You’ll work alongside the Head of Data and an experienced AI & Data Engineer, who will provide day-to-day guidance and mentoring. Together, you’ll design, build and test a new AI platform from scratch as well as develop practical AI solutions that improve workflows, support decision-making and increase productivity across the business. What you’ll be doing Build and test AI-powered features, including LLM-based assistants, AI agents, RAG applications and Microsoft Copilot Studio tools. Work with stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into clear, testable solutions. Create and run evaluation datasets to assess how well AI solutions perform. Identify limitations, document failure cases and compare results against simpler non-AI alternatives where appropriate. Write clean, tested Python and SQL code and submit changes for peer review. Support the data work that underpins AI solutions, including preparing, validating and quality-checking data. Take part in user sessions and demos to gather feedback and refine solutions. Follow security, privacy, data-access and AI governance requirements. Document your work clearly so colleagues can understand, run and maintain it. Stay up to date with AI developments and test new tools through small, agreed experiments. What we’re looking for A degree in a STEM-related subject, such as computer science, engineering, mathematics or physics, either completed or due to be completed before the start date. Proficient in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience working with large language models, such as using an LLM API, prompt engineering or building a basic RAG application. Strong interest in AI and GitHub portfolio Awareness of current AI trends and emerging technologies. Strong communication skills and a collaborative, curious mindset. Nice to have Experience with Git, cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure preferred), Microsoft Copilot Studio, agent frameworks or AI evaluation methods. An internship or placement in a technical, data or AI-focused role. Interest in how AI and data are applied within insurance, financial services or another regulated industry. What success looks like You’ll gradually take greater ownership of scoped tasks, delivering well-tested and well-documented work that passes peer review. You’ll be able to explain what you’ve built, how it was tested and where its limitations are. Most importantly, you’ll be developing the practical skills and judgement needed to grow into a stronger AI engineer. Why apply This is a rare chance to join a team building AI capability from the ground up. You’ll get exposure to LLMs, agents, RAG, Copilot Studio, data engineering and AI governance, while being supported by experienced colleagues in a structured learning environment.

items.desc: Data Engineer — Data & IA (F/H) — CDI — Métropole lilloise Construire des données qui servent. Explorer ce qu’elles rendent possible avec l’IA. Sight & Scale est un Data & AI Office. Nous aidons les dirigeants à décider, structurer, transformer, piloter et pérenniser ce qui compte dans leur activité, grâce à la Data et à l’IA. Nous partons de l’activité : ses chaînes de valeur, ses processus, ses décisions. La Data et l’IA viennent ensuite, comme leviers. Derrière les cinq verbes, des métiers concrets : • Décider — diagnostics, arbitrages d’investissement, stratégie Data & IA. • Structurer — gouvernance, architecture et plateformes Data, data engineering, qualité, catalogue. • Transformer — produits et solutions intégrant l’IA, RAG, agents, intégration, mise en production. • Piloter — indicateurs partagés, couches sémantiques, BI, produits Data, MLOps. • Pérenniser — coûts, réversibilité, sécurité, transmission aux équipes. Nous conseillons et nous réalisons : sur mesure, avec des solutions du marché ou avec nos propres produits, car nous sommes aussi éditeur. Sight & Scale est une entreprise IA-native. VOTRE RÔLE Vous construisez les fondations qui transforment des données dispersées en usages fiables : analyse, pilotage, automatisation, modèle ou application IA. Vos réalisations nourrissent les projets de nos clients, nos produits, nos démonstrateurs et nos partages de pratique. CE QUE VOUS CONSTRUIREZ ET APPORTEREZ Cartographier et relier — Cartographier et documenter les sources ; connecter API, fichiers, applications et bases ; organiser les mises à jour et la reprise des traitements, sans doublons ni perte d’historique. Donner un sens commun — Définir entités, relations et règles de calcul : ce qu’est une commande, un stock disponible, une marge. Tenir les référentiels et rendre ces définitions utilisables par une analyse, une application ou une IA. Rendre la fiabilité visible — Qualité, lignage, sécurité des accès : repérer une rupture de structure, une donnée trop ancienne ou un résultat incohérent ; mesurer l’impact sur les usages et savoir reprendre le traitement. Construire avec l’IA et pour l’IA — Éprouver les assistants de développement ; préparer données, documents et interfaces pour des modèles, de la recherche documentaire et des agents ; évaluer les résultats. Élargir votre contribution — Participer à un cadrage, un démonstrateur, un avis d’expertise ou une proposition ; animer un atelier ; contribuer à nos produits. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE Quatre métiers dans une seule entreprise Conseil, intégration, édition, expertise. On part toujours de la chaîne de valeur du client : vous savez pourquoi vous construisez, et pour quelle décision. Vous passez d’un problème métier à un prototype, d’un choix d’architecture à un produit, d’une réalisation à une formation, sans vous enfermer dans un seul rôle. Une entreprise qui pense et travaille avec l’IA Assistants de développement, agents, automatisation, évaluation : l’IA fait partie de notre façon de concevoir et de produire. Vous participez aux essais et aux choix, avec un poste de développement taillé pour vos traitements et des accès IA professionnels. Vous conseillez en toute indépendance Nous restons agnostiques : notre devoir de conseil passe avant toute technologie, tout partenaire et nos propres produits. Proposer plus simple, écrire un désaccord, recommander de ne pas faire : c’est attendu, et c’est un livrable à part entière. Vous apprenez avec de l’appui Vos premières semaines vous font découvrir nos outils, nos méthodes et les travaux en cours. Vous avez un référent identifié et vos premiers objectifs sont définis ensemble. Les travaux qui le demandent se préparent et se relisent à plusieurs ; votre autonomie progresse avec votre pratique. Formations, certifications ciblées et expérimentations font partie du travail, reliées à une réalisation. Ce qui a marché, ce qui a résisté, ce qu’on referait autrement : chaque projet laisse une trace que l’équipe réutilise. Une erreur s’analyse pour ne pas se répéter, pas pour chercher un coupable ; la critique porte sur le travail, jamais sur la personne. Vous signez ce que vous produisez Chaque livrable est signé, daté, sourcé : on sait qui a conçu, relu, validé, et ce que l’IA a fait. Les choix importants font l’objet d’une relecture adaptée au sujet. Votre progression tient compte de l’ensemble de votre contribution : la qualité des réalisations, ce que vous transmettez, ce que vous apportez aux produits, aux méthodes et au développement de Sight & Scale. Vous construisez l’entreprise Vous arrivez parmi les premiers : les pratiques, les outils et les offres se décident avec vous. Nous sommes aussi éditeur : une amélioration, un composant, une idée de produit se propose, s’éprouve, et entre dans nos développements si elle tient. Votre rôle peut grandir vers l’expertise, l’accompagnement technique, le produit ou le développement de l’activité. VOTRE PRATIQUE Vous avez construit des pipelines et des …

items.desc: Je experimenteert hoe de combinatie van taalmodellen en kennismodellen, zoals ontologieën en knowledge graphs, kan bijdragen aan betere AI-toepassingen. Een mogelijke toepassing is het doorzoeken en interpreteren van notariële akten. Je onderzoekt bijvoorbeeld of en in hoeverre een AI-model betere resultaten geeft wanneer het naast documenten ook gebruik kan maken van een kennismodel met relevante begrippen, relaties en regels. Wat ga je doen? Je vergelijkt verschillende benaderingen, bijvoorbeeld een reguliere LLM/RAG-oplossing met een aanpak waarbij een kennismodel wordt toegevoegd. Daarbij kijk je kritisch naar vragen als: worden resultaten betrouwbaarder, nauwkeuriger en consistenter? zijn antwoorden beter uitlegbaar, controleerbaar en herleidbaar? wanneer voegt een kennismodel daadwerkelijk waarde toe? wanneer is een eenvoudigere aanpak juist voldoende? Op basis van jouw onderzoek en aantoonbare resultaten formuleer je conclusies en aanbevelingen over de inzet van kennismodellen binnen AI-toepassingen. Ons team Het Kadaster biedt zekerheid door transparantie over eigendom en gebruik van vastgoed en ruimte. Dat is onze wettelijke taak, aangestuurd vanuit het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK). In het Data Science Team verkennen we nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het gebied van Data Science en AI en onderzoeken we wat deze voor het Kadaster kunnen betekenen. We experimenteren met nieuwe technologieën en methoden en werken eraan om veelbelovende toepassingen van onderzoek en experiment naar de praktijk te brengen. Dit gebeurt in nauwe samenwerking met andere directies binnen het Kadaster en externe partners. Meer weten over de innovaties van ons Data Science Team? Ontdek hun projecten en ontwikkelingen op Kadaster Labs. Jouw profiel Je volgt een relevante masteropleiding, bijvoorbeeld Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare opleiding. Je bent beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 en bent minimaal twee dagen per week aanwezig op ons kantoor in Apeldoorn (maandag en donderdag). Daarnaast: heb je affiniteit met kennismodellen. heb je ervaring met het toepassen van AI en taalmodellen. heb je ervaring met Python. heb je ervaring met gangbare machine learning- en AI-libraries. heb je ervaring met het opzetten, uitvoeren en evalueren van experimenten. neem je eigenaarschap over je onderzoek, werk je zelfstandig en durf je kritische vragen te stellen. En verder heb je bij voorkeur: kennis van Semantic Web-standaarden zoals RDF, OWL en SHACL. ervaring met informatie-extractie uit documenten. Wij bieden Je komt terecht binnen een prettige werkomgeving waar je alle ruimte krijgt om het geleerde in de praktijk te brengen. Bij ons krijg je de mogelijkheid om jouw talenten te ontwikkelen. Ook bieden we: goede begeleiding tijdens de stage. Jouw stagebegeleider kent het vak goed, begeleidt jou vakinhoudelijk en helpt je groeien en jouw kennis te verbreden. een laptop die je tijdens je stage kunt gebruiken. hybride werken, werken vanuit huis wordt gecombineerd met (minimaal twee dagen per week) werken op kantoor op onze locaties in Apeldoorn; locatie de Grift (centrum) en locatie de Brug (Apeldoorn-Zuid). Beide locaties zijn goed te bereiken met het openbaar vervoer. meer dan 250 trainingen in onze eigen digitale leeromgeving. Zo kun je elke dag een beetje beter worden. een stagevergoeding van € 565,- per maand (o.b.v. een 36-urige stageweek). interactieve en leuke studentensessies voor alle stagiairs. Interesse? Sollicitatie en informatie Interesse? Solliciteer direct via onderstaande button! Meer informatie over de functie of over de sollicitatieprocedure neem contact op met Lisette Velthorst (corporate recruiter) via: 06 15 95 73 15 (ook via WhatsApp mogelijk) of lisette.velthorst@kadaster.nl (mailto:lisette.velthorst@kadaster.nl) Bij het vinden van een geschikte kandidaat kan de vacature eerder worden gesloten.

Knowledge of MLOps practices and Machine Learning lifecycle management. Experience with model monitoring, performance evaluation and continuous improvement. Previous experience mentoring junior Data Scientists or Machine Learning Engineers. Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills. Good level of English, both written and spoken (B2 or higher). Why should you become part of our family? items.desc: En SDG Group llevamos más de 30 años convirtiendo datos en impacto real. Somos una consultora global 100% especializada en Data, Analytics e Inteligencia Artificial , referente del sector según Gartner, Penteo y Everest Group . Somos especialistas, y eso nos da una profundidad técnica y un conocimiento de negocio que marcan la diferencia en la transformación data-driven de nuestros clientes : más de 1.000 proyectos desarrollados anualmente, equipos altamente especializados y soluciones que llegan a producción. Todo ello sustentado en nuestro Triple Expertise: visión de negocio, conocimiento tecnológico profundo y alianzas tecnológicas (Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, GCP, entre otras). Una combinación que nos ha llevado a trabajar con clientes del IBEX-35 y Fortune 500 , contando con presencia global y más de 2.000 personas en todo el mundo. En el equipo de Inteligencia Artificial , somos más de 200 profesionales con experiencia en más de 70 clientes y más de 100 casos de uso, ofrecemos soluciones de IA adaptadas a diversas industrias, con más de 50 aceleradores tecnológicos, marcos y herramientas para acelerar la implementación de IA. Además, a través de SDG iLabs, impulsamos la innovación experimentando con las últimas tendencias en IA. Si quieres crecer en el mundo de la IA, este es el lugar. ¿Cómo será tu día a día? Estarás en primera línea del cambio de paradigma que está viviendo la IA : diseñarás soluciones de IA generativa (LLMs, RAG, agentes inteligentes y sistemas multiagente) que transforman cómo trabajan las empresas, junto con modelos de machine learning tradicional. Diseñarás soluciones de IA adaptadas al negocio : definirás arquitecturas y soluciones a medida de las necesidades y los retos de cada cliente, desde assessments e iniciativas consultivas hasta el diseño e implementación de casos de uso, plataformas y arquitecturas corporativas. Aplicarás IA Generativa, IA tradicional y machine learning : diseñarás soluciones basadas en machine learning, deep learning, modelos predictivos y otras técnicas de IA, eligiendo en cada caso la tecnología que mejor resuelve el reto. Llevarás las soluciones a producción : asegurarás su escalabilidad, rendimiento y seguridad aplicando metodologías MLOps y LLMOps (despliegue, monitorización y mejora continua), con pipelines CI/CD, contenedores (Docker, Kubernetes) y APIs con FastAPI, apoyándote en herramientas como MLflow, Airflow o Kubeflow y en los servicios gestionados de Azure, AWS y GCP Orientarás técnicamente a los equipos de desarrollo : tomarás decisiones tecnológicas y establecerás buenas prácticas para que los proyectos se entreguen con calidad. Participarás en consultoría y relación con cliente : te involucrarás en assessments, identificarás oportunidades de aplicación de IA y propondrás soluciones de alto valor, en proyectos nacionales e internacionales, con clientes de distintos sectores y con equipos transversales, adaptando tu comunicación a cada público, desde ingeniería hasta dirección. Impulsarás la innovación tecnológica : evaluarás nuevas tecnologías, frameworks y herramientas para incorporarlas a las soluciones, y colaborarás en iniciativas de visibilidad de marca (aceleradores, artículos, charlas) con autonomía para sacar adelante tus propias iniciativas internas. ¿Qué te hará triunfar en esta posición? Experiencia en diseño de soluciones de IA : has trabajado tanto con machine learning tradicional como con IA generativa (LLMs, RAG, agentes), o tienes un interés real por esta última y ganas de profundizar en ella. Del prototipo a producción: experiencia llevando modelos y soluciones de IA a entornos productivos, con prácticas de MLOps y, si es posible, LLMOps. Experiencia en alguna de las principales nubes (Azure, AWS o GCP), diseñando soluciones escalables y seguras. Visión multisector: has participado en proyectos de distintas industrias y sabes adaptar cada solución a su contexto . Capacidad para orientar a equipos técnicos y tomar decisiones tecnológicas con criterio. Comunicación a todos los niveles, desde equipos de ingeniería hasta dirección de cliente, y que puedas desenvolverte en inglés . Curiosidad constante: te entusiasma probar, aprender y compartir lo último en IA. También valoramos: Experiencia con plataformas de datos como Databricks, Snowflake o Microsoft Fabric, y con frameworks de GenAI (LangChain, bases de datos vectoriales...). Dominio de otros idiomas además del inglés. Presencia en la comunidad de IA: charlas, artículos, eventos o contribuciones open source. Experiencia en consultoría con clientes de gran cuenta. ¿Qué nos hace diferentes? Aquí no somos una empresa más... ¡somos un equipo que va a por todas! La tecnología y los datos son nuestra esencia: No solo trabajamos con lo último del mercado, sino que te formaremos para que domines las herramientas más innovadoras en proyectos punteros y de nueva construcción con alto impacto. items.desc: Description de l’entreprise Depuis 2014, Wiremind se positionne comme une entreprise tech qui transforme le monde du transport et de l’évènementiel avec une approche 360° combinant à la fois UX, software et IA. Notre expertise repose principalement sur l’optimisation et la commercialisation de la capacité de nos clients. Nous travaillons sur divers projets tels que la prévision et la tarification de billets , l ’ optimisation 3D du fret aérien ou le scraping des prix de compétiteurs . Nos applications sont l'outil privilégié de compagnies telles que la SNCF, United Airlines, Qatar Airways ou encore le PSG pour visualiser, analyser et optimiser leur capacité. Dynamiques et ambitieux, nous nous attachons à conserver notre ADN technique qui est le moteur de notre réussite. L’entreprise, rentable et autofinancée pendant plus de 10 ans, vient de lever ses premiers fonds pour accélérer sa croissance. Elle est constituée en majorité d’ingénieurs et d’experts et développe un business model basé sur des solutions « software-as-a-service ». Présentation de l’équipe et des missions 🚀 Eventori est notre solution dédiée à l'industrie du sport et du divertissement. Nous développons la solution de billetterie tout-en-un de nouvelle génération intégrant le contrôle d'accès, le front office, le CRM, la plateforme de revente et le yield management. En nous appuyant sur notre expertise en apprentissage automatique, visualisation de données, technologie et gestion du rendement, nous avons l'ambition de moderniser la billetterie et d'introduire la tarification dynamique dans ce secteur. Chez Wiremind, nos équipes tech utilisent déjà l’IA au quotidien pour automatiser et aller plus vite. Notre ambition : mettre cette puissance au service des équipes métier . Tu rejoins les équipes Go-To-Market d’Eventori, sous la responsabilité directe du responsable de l’activité, avec un accompagnement technique de notre équipe Gen AI. Tu seras le pont entre la tech et le métier : tu identifies les irritants, tu construis les automatisations et outils IA qui font gagner du temps, et tu les fais adopter. Si l’expérience est concluante, ce modèle a vocation à être étendu à d’autres équipes de Wiremind. Des Exemples De Missions Concevoir et déployer des workflows IA pour les équipes marketing, sales et customer success, en itérant en direct avec les utilisateurs métier. Monter une « content factory » : automatiser la production d’assets (visuels et contenus pour LinkedIn, vidéos produit, documentation de fonctionnalités) à destination du marketing, du sales enablement et du customer enablement. Automatiser la génération de leads : industrialiser les scripts de scraping existants (par pays, marché, sport…) et mettre en place des triggers (ex. détecter un changement de site de billetterie chez un prospect). Construire un « second cerveau commercial » qui capitalise sur nos propositions commerciales, nos réponses aux appels d’offres et notre connaissance des concurrents, pour accélérer le pricing et notre développement à l’international. Améliorer le reporting interne et faire évoluer les outils déjà en place. Réinventer la documentation client : rendre notre documentation plus accessible et interactive (onboarding guidé, parcours pas à pas…). Connecter les outils et les sources de données nécessaires (CRM, analytics, emailing…) en lien avec les équipes Platform et IT. Documenter et évangéliser : livrer des outils robustes, scalables et reprenables, présenter tes réalisations en interne et donner envie aux autres équipes de s’en emparer. Stack technique : Python, LLM et agents IA (Claude, Claude Code, MCP…), outils d’automatisation et intégrations API. La stack sera affinée avec toi selon les cas d’usage. Profil recherché 🔍 Hard Skills Tu es en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur, d’informatique, et tu cherches un stage ou une alternance. Tu utilises quotidiennement l’IA et des outils de développement no-code/low-code pour concevoir des solutions, automatiser des tâches et optimiser des processus. Tu as de bonnes bases en Python. Tu sais connecter des outils et des sources de données entre eux (API, intégrations). Tu as le réflexe de documenter et de construire des choses propres et réutilisables. Soft Skills Tu aimes construire, résoudre des problèmes et tu es orienté(e) résultat. Tu es curieux(se) du business et tu as envie de comprendre les process métier (marketing, sales, customer). Tu sais expliquer simplement ce que tu fais, de façon claire et synthétique, à des interlocuteurs non techniques. Tu es autonome et proactif(ve) : tu testes, tu prends des initiatives et tu fais avancer les sujets. Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement qui va vite et qui change souvent. Tu parles français couramment. Nice-to-have Une appétence pour les rôles d’AI Ops ou de GTM Engineer. Une veille active sur les outils IA, agents et automatisation. Une première expérience d’intégration d’outils métier (CRM, analytics, emailing). Un bon niveau d’anglais. Les avantages …

items.desc:
About the Team

Regulatory & Privacy Operations sits within User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO), part of OpenAI’s broader User Operations organization. We build and run the operational programs that protect user rights and support OpenAI’s legal, regulatory & privacy obligations across its products and developer tools.

We partner with Legal, Privacy Engineering, Product, Policy, Governance, Risk & Compliance, Support Operations, and external vendors to resolve sensitive cases and build reliable, scalable operations. Our remit spans privacy, online safety, AI regulation, and intellectual property.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Operations Analyst to own and evolve our global Privacy Operations workstream from Dublin. This individual contributor role combines hands-on management of complex privacy matters with accountability for operational health, vendor quality, and program improvement.

You will take end-to-end ownership of how privacy rights requests are received, assessed, routed, and resolved across a tiered operating model. You will partner closely with Privacy Legal, the Data Protection Officer’s office, Privacy Engineering, and operations teams to translate legal guidance into practical workflows and resolve issues that cross organizational boundaries.

Beyond keeping operations healthy, you will set priorities and deliver improvements that reduce avoidable demand, strengthen controls, and enable safe automation. We are looking for someone who independently identifies problems, makes sound decisions with incomplete information, and carries work from diagnosis through implementation and measurable results.

Privacy will be your primary remit. You will also develop sufficient familiarity with adjacent Regulatory Operations workflows to recognize intersecting risks and provide secondary support when priorities require it.

In This Role, You Will

 - Own global Privacy Operations across intake, identity verification, case handling, escalations, and closure, including access, deletion, export, correction, and opt-out requests, working within guidance agreed with Legal.

 - Independently investigate and resolve complex or sensitive privacy cases, including third-party requests, account restrictions, and complaints about personal information in AI outputs. Recognize when legal interpretation or technical investigation is needed and coordinate the right partners through resolution.

 - Own operational health across internal and vendor-supported queues. Use demand forecasts, backlog age, response and resolution times, quality, and capacity data to identify emerging risks and act before deadlines or user outcomes deteriorate.

 - Drive vendor performance through clear procedures, training, quality calibration, escalation criteria, and corrective actions. Expand delegated handling where appropriate, with the controls and evidence needed to maintain quality.

 - Build and deliver a prioritized roadmap for workflow simplification, self-service, tooling, and AI-assisted automation. Define requirements, evaluate accuracy and failure modes, establish human review and escalation safeguards, and measure impact after launch.

 - Translate privacy requirements and Legal guidance into standard operating procedures, decision trees, case documentation, and operational controls. Keep guidance current as products, policies, and requirements evolve.

 - Lead Privacy Operations readiness for product launches and policy changes. Assess likely demand, new case types, routing, capacity, and dependencies, and drive practical mitigations with cross-functional owners.

 - Investigate handling failures and recurring complaints, establish root causes and wider exposure, and deliver corrective actions with clear ownership and evidence of effectiveness.

 - Maintain reliable reporting and case records to support audit readiness, control testing, and Legal-led responses to regulatory inquiries. Communicate the risk, impact, recommendation, and decisions needed clearly to partners and leadership.

 - Set priorities across immediate casework and longer-term improvements, make explicit trade-offs, and influence partners across teams and time zones to deliver results.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

 - Have 8+ years of relevant experience in privacy operations, regulatory operations, legal operations, or a related field, with substantial hands-on ownership of privacy rights workflows in a global technology environment.

 - Have a strong working understanding of GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and privacy rights operations, and can translate counsel’s guidance into consistent, usable processes. You understand the challenges of identity verification, sensitive data handling, and complex request fulfillment.

 - Have independently owned a complex operational program, set its priorities, and delivered improvements across multiple teams, with evidence of better quality, lower risk, faster resolution, or reduced manual work.

 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world. 
 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in AI solutions, who is passionate about driving our customers’ AI transformation journey with M365 Copilot, Agents, as well as Copilot Studio, PowerPlatform and Github Copilot. This is a customer-facing role that serves as a strategic trusted advisor and technical subject matter expert, accelerating AI adoption and change management by creating business value and ROI.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals.  Drive Customer Success : Lead architectural design, engaging with business and technical decision makers to drive intent and enable sustained usage of Copilot Chat, Agents, and M365 Copilot, securing long-term customer success and renewal. 
 Leverage Agentic AI : Use Copilot prompt engineering and Agent-building expertise to drive AI at scale. 
 Explore growth opportunities: Partner with technical and sales teams to identify opportunities and develop tailored solutions to drive expansion and business value realization. 
 Accelerate Customer AI Transformation Journey : Engage in relevant communities to share expertise, contribute to IP creation, prioritize IP re-use, and learn from others to help accelerate your customer’s AI transformation journey. 
 Embrace a growth mindset: Act as the voice of the customer by proactively sharing insights, feedback, and success stories to inform internal strategy and execution. 
 Learn-it-all: Demonstrate a self-learner mindset through continuous, self-directed learning in areas such as Copilot Chat, Agents, M365 Copilot, business value realization, and adoption and change management. Build and maintain technical readiness aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU) priorities and corporate initiatives. 
 Qualifications 
 Relevant experience designing and delivering cloud or AI solutions in a customer-facing, consulting or technical role.
 Equivalent practical experience is welcome.
 Experience taking AI assistants or agents beyond a pilot, including supporting adoption and demonstrating business value.
 Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform or GitHub Copilot—or comparable enterprise AI tools.
 Ability to work with senior business and technical stakeholders to turn customer needs into practical solutions.
 Strong written and verbal communication in English.
