items.desc: Nous recherchons un Ingénieur / Développeur en Intelligence Artificielle (AI Engineer/Developer) pour rejoindre une équipe spécialisée dans l'innovation digitale et les solutions d'intelligence artificielle, basée à Bruxelles. Le consultant interviendra sur l'exploitation, le développement et l'amélioration d'une plateforme IA reposant sur des architectures hybrides, combinant les services managés Microsoft Azure et des composants Open Source hébergés sur Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). La plateforme s'appuie notamment sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), les architectures RAG, Python et les technologies d'orchestration d'agents IA. Environnement technique La plateforme IA repose sur une architecture hybride combinant : Services Microsoft Azure : Microsoft Foundry et modèles OpenAI pour les LLM et les embeddings. Azure AI Search. Azure API Management. Azure AI Content Safety. Composants Open Source et infrastructure : Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Python et LangChain pour l'orchestration des agents IA. Pipelines d'ingestion de données. MLflow sur Databricks pour l'évaluation et le suivi des modèles. OpenTelemetry pour le monitoring et le traçage. Infrastructure et déploiement : Terraform pour l'Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Helm. Azure DevOps et pipelines CI/CD. Responsabilités principales Les missions varieront selon les services IA concernés. Les principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Exploitation des services IA en production : assurer le suivi de la disponibilité, des temps de réponse et des erreurs, gérer les incidents et les demandes de service, analyser les causes des dysfonctionnements et mettre en œuvre les corrections nécessaires ou procéder à leur escalade. Suivi et contrôle de la qualité des réponses : maintenir et exécuter des jeux de données d'évaluation (Golden Sets) avec les responsables métiers, suivre la qualité des réponses, le taux de non-réponse et les retours utilisateurs, détecter et analyser les régressions de qualité. Gestion des pipelines d'ingestion : assurer les mises à jour incrémentales des données, traiter les documents en échec, surveiller la santé des index et intégrer de nouvelles sources de contenu ou de nouveaux domaines métiers dans les connecteurs existants. Gestion des intégrations des agents IA : surveiller les appels aux outils et aux systèmes métiers, gérer les erreurs et les dépassements de délais (timeouts), analyser les journaux d'actions et les exceptions générées par les agents agissant pour le compte des utilisateurs. Gestion des évolutions et des changements : assurer les mises à niveau et le retrait des versions de modèles, gérer les modifications des prompts et des configurations, ainsi que les mises à jour des dépendances et de sécurité. Chaque changement devra être validé à l'aide des jeux de données d'évaluation avant sa mise en production. Suivi des coûts d'exploitation : surveiller la consommation de tokens et les coûts par service, mettre en place des alertes en cas de dérive et proposer des optimisations. Maintenance de l'infrastructure : maintenir les configurations Terraform, les artefacts Helm et les pipelines Azure DevOps, tout en garantissant la cohérence des environnements DEV, TST, ACC et PROD. Protection des données : appliquer les règles de conservation des traces, d'effacement des données et de restriction des accès, conformément aux analyses d'impact relatives à la protection des données (DPIA) de chaque service. Documentation et reporting : maintenir les procédures d'exploitation (Runbooks) et la documentation technique, et communiquer régulièrement sur l'état de santé des services aux responsables applicatifs et à l'équipe AI CoE. Amélioration continue : réaliser des évolutions mineures, des optimisations et des corrections techniques. Les changements structurels et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités restent sous la responsabilité de l'équipe Build. Profil candidat: Compétences techniques requises : Intelligence artificielle et développement de solutions IA. Large Language Models (LLM). Architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Développement Python. Intégration et développement d'APIs. Microsoft Azure et services Azure AI. Microsoft Foundry et modèles OpenAI. Azure AI Search et Azure API Management. LangChain et orchestration d'agents IA. Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Pipelines d'ingestion et traitement de données. Apache Kafka ou autres technologies de messagerie. MLflow et Databricks. Open

items.desc: Data Scientist – Responsible Generative AI (GenAI) Utrecht, Netherlands | 36 hours per week | Hybrid | Long-term Assignment We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist – Responsible GenAI to join a leading international financial institution in Utrecht. Assignment Details Location: Utrecht, Netherlands Working arrangement: Hybrid Hours: 36 per week Start date: ASAP Contract: Until 30 June 2027 Language: English Education: HBO level or equivalent Employment: Contract assignment via an approved employment/payroll arrangement Freelance / ZZP: Not permitted Application deadline: 19 November 2026 This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of Generative AI, data science, statistical evaluation and software engineering , helping ensure that AI-powered solutions are reliable, safe and effective in real-world applications. You will develop evaluation frameworks, implement AI guardrails and build production-ready tools that support the responsible deployment of GenAI solutions across the organisation. The Role As a Data Scientist specialising in Responsible GenAI, you will focus on measuring and improving the quality, accuracy, reliability and safety of AI-powered applications. items.desc:
Enterprises are rolling Perplexity out to thousands of employees and connecting it to their most sensitive internal data. Their security teams want to know how to do that safely, and they want to hear it from someone who has done real security work.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Cybersecurity Solutions Architect to be that person. You'll be the security expert our enterprise customers work with as they deploy Perplexity: running architecture and hardening sessions with their security leads, reviewing how they're configuring identity, data access, and admin controls, and helping them get to a setup they're confident in. You'll sit on the Security team and work closely with our enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams, and you'll bring what you learn from customers back into how we build and secure the product.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead security architecture workshops and hardening reviews with enterprise customers' security and IT teams as they deploy Perplexity. This covers identity and SSO/SCIM, connectors to internal data, access controls, data retention, admin and audit settings, and managed browser and endpoint policy.

 - Act as the technical security voice in strategic enterprise deals. Answer deep security reviews and questionnaires, and represent our security posture to CISOs and security architects.

 - Build and maintain the materials customers rely on: hardening guides, reference architectures, configuration baselines, and security FAQs.

 - Help customers configure enterprise controls in their own environments, such as identity providers, MDM and device management tools like Microsoft Intune, and data source permissions. Troubleshoot when something doesn't apply as expected.

 - Turn recurring customer security requests into product feedback. Work with product and engineering to prioritize the controls enterprises need.

 - Partner with account executives and customer success on customer-specific security asks, and know when to bring in Security Engineering or Legal.

 - Track common customer concerns and gaps, and help shape how we communicate security and trust externally.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years in security engineering, security architecture, or a customer-facing security role such as solutions architect, sales engineer, or security consultant.

 - Hands-on depth in enterprise identity and access (SSO, SAML/OIDC, SCIM, conditional access) and in SaaS security configuration.

 - Working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem (Entra ID, Intune, M365, Purview) and at least one other major enterprise stack, such as Google Workspace or Okta.

 - Comfortable leading technical conversations with CISOs and security architects. Able to say no, explain trade-offs plainly, and earn trust in the room.

 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks enterprise customers ask about, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and FedRAMP, and with how they map to product controls.

 - Clear written communication. You can turn a messy customer environment into a crisp set of recommendations.

 - Bonus: experience securing AI or LLM products, agent integrations, or data connectors in enterprise environments.

 - Bonus: background in browser security, endpoint management, or data loss prevention.

items.desc:
In an increasingly connected world, the pandemic has highlighted just how essential telecom networks are to keeping society running. The Network Infrastructure group is at the heart of a revolution in connectivity, pushing boundaries to deliver more and faster network capacity to people worldwide through our ambition, innovation, and technical expertise. 
 Join the Optical Networks division, where innovation meets scale in the AI driven datacenter era. With the recent acquisition of Infinera, we’ve united two industry leaders to create an optical networking powerhouse - combining cutting-edge technology with proven leadership to redefine the future of connectivity. Infinera is now part of the Nokia Corporation and its subsidiaries. When you apply, the information you share will be handled with care and used only for recruitment purposes within the group. 
 As a Embedded SW Developer at Nokia, you will provide technical leadership in the design, architecture, and delivery of high‑quality software for next‑generation optical communication systems. You will work across multiple teams and disciplines—software, hardware, systems, and product management—to translate complex business and system requirements into robust, scalable software solutions. In our Agile environment, you will play a key role in driving technical direction, mentoring engineers, and ensuring engineering excellence across the optical networking domain.
Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance for the design and implementation of software solutions for optical networking products using C/C++, Python, and other relevant technologies. 
 Own and drive end‑to‑end technical solutions, from requirements analysis and high‑level design through implementation, validation, and long‑term maintenance. 
 Act as a key technical authority in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and feature design discussions, ensuring alignment with system architecture and long‑term platform strategy. 
 Proactively utilize AI‑assisted development tools to improve code quality, development efficiency, and engineering processes. 
 Define and promote software design standards, coding best practices, and documentation guidelines across development teams. 
 Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, cross‑system issues, including performance bottlenecks, scalability challenges, and stability problems. 
 Influence and evolve CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and automation frameworks to support reliable and efficient software delivery at scale. 
 Advocate modern version control and collaboration practices (e.g., Git workflows, code reviews) across teams. 
 Mentor senior and junior engineers, fostering technical growth, design thinking, and knowledge sharing. 
 Stay current with optical communication technologies and industry trends, and apply this knowledge to guide architectural and technical decisions.
8+ years of hands‑on experience in software development, with strong expertise in C/C++, Python, or comparable programming languages. 
 Proven experience leveraging AI‑based tools to enhance software development, debugging, and design workflows. 
 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 Strong experience in Agile/Scrum environments, including influencing technical direction across multiple teams. 
 Demonstrated ability to drive architectural decisions, resolve complex technical problems, and balance short‑term delivery with long‑term sustainability. 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, enabling effective work across globally distributed teams. 
 Strong experience in embedded systems, memory constrained systems, RTOS as FreeRTOS and Zephyr, Linux based systems 
 It would be nice if you also had 
 Strong understanding of optical communication technologies and standards, such as CMIS, C‑CMIS, OTN, and Ethernet. 
 Extensive experience with Git‑based version control and large‑scale collaborative development. 
 Hands‑on knowledge of CI/CD systems, build tooling, and test automation in complex software environments. 
 Software architecture, system design, or Agile‑related certifications.

Il veillera à l?articulation des contributions, anticipera les dépendances fonctionnelles et techniques, sécurisera les décisions et donnera une visibilité consolidée sur l?avancement des projets, en lien avec les parties prenantes métier, produit, architecture, sécurité et delivery. Mission Le/La Chef(fe) de projet Data / IA pilotera de bout en bout plusieurs projets ou cas d?usage IA menés en parallèle. Il/Elle interviendra du cadrage au passage en exploitation, en coordonnant les contributeurs et en assurant le suivi des dépendances entre les développements Data Science, l?architecture, la sécurité, l?infrastructure GCP et les systèmes on-premise. La mission se déroulera à temps plein à Montrouge, avec une présence sur site selon les règles applicables à l?équipe. Définir pour chaque projet le périmètre, les objectifs, les livrables, les critères de réussite et la gouvernance. Piloter les projets de bout en bout : cadrage, conception, architecture, développement, tests, recette, industrialisation, mise en production et passage en exploitation. Construire et suivre les plannings, jalons, plans d?action, risques, alertes, arbitrages et dépendances. Coordonner les équipes métiers, Data Scientists, architecte Data, équipes techniques et autres contributeurs nécessaires. Veiller à ce que les Data Scientists disposent des besoins, données, accès et environnements requis pour leurs développements sur GCP et/ou on-premise. Coordonner la définition, la validation et l?évolution de l?architecture avec l?architecte Data, ainsi que la mise en place des environnements, composants, flux, accès et infrastructures avec les équipes techniques. Piloter les tests et la recette, suivre les anomalies et coordonner leur correction jusqu?à validation. Identifier les blocages, organiser leur résolution et réaliser les escalades nécessaires. Produire un reporting clair, synthétique et consolidé sur l?avancement du portefeuille de projets IA. Maintenir à jour la documentation projet, les décisions, les risques, les plans d?action et les éléments nécessaires au passage en exploitation. You will use modern AI development tools to build features, automate business processes, integrate systems and solve technical challenges. You don't need to be an expert in every technology listed below. We value practical ability, problem-solving skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn. Software Development: Develop and enhance features across our ecommerce websites, internal systems and applications. AI Integrations: Explore and implement solutions using Anthropic Claude, the Claude API, prompt engineering and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Collaboration: Use GitHub for version control, documentation and collaboration. Continuous Learning: Research and experiment with new AI development tools, frameworks and technologies. Your impact: Help us build software faster, introduce practical AI solutions across the business and improve the efficiency of our digital operations. Requirements Essential: A genuine interest in AI-assisted software development and emerging technologies. Some practical experience in coding, developing applications or building technical projects. Familiarity with Claude Code , or a strong willingness to learn and use it as a primary development tool. Basic understanding of programming concepts, APIs, databases or web development. Ability to troubleshoot problems, think logically and critically review AI-generated code. Strong communication skills, initiative and enthusiasm for learning. Desirable Skills & Certifications: Experience with any of the following tools, platforms or relevant learning programmes would be advantageous, but none are mandatory : Anthropic Claude: Claude Code, prompt engineering, Claude API and Model Context Protocol (MCP). items.desc: Deux architectes Cloud AWS de niveau expert sont recherchés pour une mission freelance à Massy, auprès d?un acteur du secteur de la défense. Dans un contexte d?optimisation des coûts d?infrastructure et d?évolution du système d?information, la mission consiste à concevoir et faire évoluer des architectures hybrides associant infrastructures On-Premise et services AWS. En collaboration avec les équipes infrastructures, cybersécurité, architecture et projets, les consultants interviendront sur les activités suivantes : Concevoir les architectures répondant aux besoins métiers et définir les architectures cibles. Construire les trajectoires de migration Cloud / On-Premise pour des implantations en France et à l?international. Évaluer et challenger les solutions techniques, argumenter les choix et les présenter aux instances de validation. Intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de performance, de disponibilité et de maîtrise des coûts. Définir les standards et les patterns d?architecture, en cohérence avec les socles techniques existants. Contribuer à l?industrialisation et à l?automatisation des infrastructures. Accompagner concrètement les équipes de réalisation jusqu?à la mise en exploitation, au-delà de la seule production de dossiers d?architecture. Apporter une expertise N3, contribuer aux diagnostics complexes et aux audits techniques, puis assurer le transfert de compétences. Les livrables comprennent les conceptions générales et détaillées HLD et LLD, les dossiers d?architecture et d?arbitrage, les documents de référence, les rapports d?expertise et la documentation technique. Des sessions de transfert de compétences et un suivi régulier des activités font également partie de la prestation. Environnement technique : AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, OpenShift, ROSA, Linux, VMware, MSSQL, IIS et gestion des identités. Les architectures couvrent également le réseau et les interconnexions, la sécurité, le stockage, les machines virtuelles, les conteneurs, les services managés, l?observabilité et l?automatisation CI/CD, DevOps et GitOps. Modalités : Mission principalement à Massy, avec des déplacements ponctuels possibles sur d?autres implantations. Présence sur site pendant 1 à 2 mois avant la mise en place du télétravail, jusqu?à 2 jours par semaine. Démarrage souhaité le 04/01/2027, sous réserve de la confirmation de la commande, avec une fin prévue au plus tard le 31/12/2027. Candidatures attendues au plus tard le 24/11/2026. Profil candidat: Compétences indispensables : Profil expert disposant de plus de 7 ans d?expérience dans ce type de poste, avec une expertise de fond sur AWS et une expérience concrète des architectures hybrides Cloud / On-Premise. Capacité à concevoir des architectures cibles, définir des trajectoires de migration et garantir la cohérence, la robustesse, la sécurité et l?évolutivité des solutions. Bonne maîtrise des environnements industriels ou de grandes entreprises. Capacité à évaluer et challenger les choix techniques, à proposer des solutions pragmatiques et industrialisables et à défendre les arbitrages devant des instances de validation. Aptitude à travailler avec les équipes infrastructures, cybersécurité et projets, et à accompagner la mise en ?uvre jusqu?à l?exploitation. Capacité à rédiger des documentations techniques détaillées et à transmettre les connaissances. Français pour le suivi de la prestation et anglais de niveau C1, lu, parlé et écrit, pour les échanges internationaux et la documentation. Connaissances complémentaires attendues pour évaluer les solutions et leur intégration, sans exigence d?expertise opérationnelle simultanée sur chaque outil : conteneurisation Kubernetes, OpenShift et ROSA, Infrastructure as Code avec Terraform et Ansible, réseau VPC, routage, DNS et interconnexion, sécurité IAM, chiffrement, segmentation et gestion des secrets, stockage, observabilité et automatisation CI/CD, DevOps et GitOps. Atouts complémentaires : connaissances des autres clouds publics Azure ou GCP.

items.desc: Your creative field We are looking for a Platform Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible in a full-time, permanent position. We embrace a remote-first approach, but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations. What convinces us The availability and performance of our platform are of the utmost importance to our customers’ satisfaction. These systems form the foundation of Contabo’s most important products, which is why the smooth operation of the environment has a direct and immediate impact on the company’s success. To keep our systems running and our customers satisfied, you’ll take responsibility for the operation and further development of our hosting platform—from Proxmox/KVM virtualization to storage (ZFS, Ceph) and networking, all the way through to monitoring and observability. You’ll serve as the technical escalation point for our Platform Support team, analyze complex issues to their root cause, and ensure that problems do not recur. You’ll use Ansible and Git for automation, plan and oversee maintenance, upgrades, and migrations, and contribute to capacity and hardware planning—for example, when introducing new hardware generations or setting up new locations. You’ll be responsible for your own domain of the platform, make well-informed design decisions, and document them in a transparent manner. You’ll actively share your knowledge with the team. In doing so, you’ll work closely with Platform, Support, Dev, Network, and Security to solve problems together and drive improvements. Since our teams and data centers are spread across the globe, part of your work will also be conducted in English. Awesome Prospects Your personality, combined with: training as an IT specialist in system integration, a degree in computer science, or a comparable qualification and experience several years of professional experience (at least 5 years) in the operation or development of large-scale Linux and virtualization environments solid hands-on experience with Linux (troubleshooting, performance), Proxmox/KVM or comparable virtualization technologies, Ansible, and monitoring solutions (e.g., Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana) Ideally, experience with ZFS and/or Ceph, networking fundamentals (BGP, L3 routing, VLAN, Open vSwitch), Git/CI, and scripting in Bash or Python Self-motivation and a proactive approach: You contribute ideas, document decisions clearly, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with others A plus: Terraform, Kubernetes, Vault, PowerDNS, or experience in a hosting/cloud environment Enjoy working with other teams and working independently Very good German and English skills How to reach us If you have any questions, you can reach out to Max by email at maximilian.kasemir@contabo.de. About us Contabo - High-quality Cloud Hosting Made in Germany! As a leading infrastructure service provider in the field of cloud instances and dedicated servers, we have stood for first-class quality, reliability and favorable prices since our foundation in Munich in 2003. Meanwhile, more than 300,000 customers in over 190 countries trust our services. We specialize in providing German quality to users worldwide, focusing on the stability and security of our data centers, the optimization of internal processes, and excellent customer support. Become a part of our future-oriented company, which plays a significant role in the development of digital cloud hosting, and support us with your ideas and commitment.

We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich). As a Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired. One of your central mandates: you design and establish an on-call process, including runbooks for platform and infrastructure incidents – where no formal process exists today. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike. You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. Success in this role means: known risks are resolved, a solid on-call process is up and running, and single points of failure are measurably reduced platform-wide. The position is remote (Germany), with hybrid or on-site work optional; occasional travel for datacenter visits and team offsites is part of the role. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference. What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: €57.600,00 - €79.200,00 Location: Dresden,DEU You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We’re hiring a Northern Europe Regional Spares Planner for our AME (Applied Materials Europe) Regional Planning team to lead demand forecasting and service‑parts planning for the AME region. You will turn install‑base signals, field‑service activity, and customer and contract requirements into a data‑driven demand plan that improves service levels, inventory health, and contractual KPI performance. The role combines analytical depth, systems expertise, and cross‑functional collaboration. What You’ll Do Forecast demand: Review demand history, future business outlook, install‑base changes, warranty and service‑contract requirements, and field‑service cadence to build a quantified demand plan and improve forecast accuracy and demand variability. Plan service parts: Position the right level of parts in the right place to support business entitlements and meet internal and contractual KPIs. Manage inventory: Recommend inventory policies, model availability vs. cost, and actively manage inventory levels, excess, and obsolescence. Lead ramp and service ‑ agreement planning: Prepare inventory for new customer fab installations, ramp schedules, and Service Agreement delivery performance, in direct collaboration with the Field Service Organization. Lead special projects as needed. Resolve root causes: Perform root‑cause analyses on order delivery misses and implement corrective actions. Manage KPIs and reporting: Own internal and external planning KPIs and reporting, monitor performance, and identify areas for improvement. Align external business requests and engage the right internal resources to build a sustainable working process with a structured cadence. Handle escalations: Resolve critical escalations under high pressure by identifying the real problem statement, translating it into planning language, and delivering viable action plans. Provide short‑term solutions and mid‑ to long‑term process improvements drawn from each case. Improve processes and tools: Contribute to processes, tools, dashboards, and data‑visualization improvements. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (B.A./B.S.) or equivalent; Industrial Engineering or Supply Chain Management preferred. 3–7 years of experience in inventory, materials, supply, or demand planning, with KPI ownership. Strong service parts planning background. Proficiency with ERP/SCM systems (SAP, SPP), inventory optimization software, advanced Excel, and Tableau or Power BI. Demonstrated experience improving planning processes, dashboards, or tools. Demonstrated experience with executive communications and presentations. Problem solving: Solves complex problems, takes a new perspective on existing solutions, and exercises judgment based on analysis of multiple sources of information. Interpersonal skills: Explains difficult or sensitive information, builds consensus, and has proven experience in stakeholder management and cross‑functional collaboration across diverse teams. Project management experience and/or ASCM/APICS/IBF certifications. You combine strong hands-on data engineering expertise with a consulting mindset, translating complex client challenges into pragmatic, scalable and future-ready solutions. Working with modern Microsoft data and AI technologies, you will contribute directly to client projects from day one, while also helping shape reusable solutions, share knowledge, and strengthen our Data & AI community. What you’ll do Design, develop and implement scalable end-to-end data pipelines and data solutions using Databricks and dbt(data build tool), working effectively with multidisciplinary client and delivery teams. Support clients with their data architecture, engineering patterns and practical best practices, translating business needs into implementable technical solutions. Communicate recommendations with clarity and confidence, building stakeholder alignment and helping clients make well-informed solution choices. Contribute directly to high-quality project delivery, including engineering, testing, optimization, documentation and knowledge transfer where relevant. Help grow the Avanade Netherlands Data & AI Practice through knowledge sharing, mentoring, reusable assets, internal initiatives and contribution to the professional community. What you bring More than 5 years of hands-on, client-facing project experience in data engineering. A completed HBO or Master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience and demonstrated expertise in Data Engineering. Strong practical experience with (Azure) Databricks in production data engineering environments. Microsoft Azure / Microsoft Cloud certification relevant to data engineering, like (DP-203-600-700-750). Databricks Data Engineer certification at Associate or Professional level. Experience with complementary technologies such as Python, PySpark, SQL, Azure Data Factory, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Git and Azure DevOps. Hands-on project experience with dbt for version-controlled, testable and maintainable data transformations and data models. Solid knowledge of modern data engineering concepts such as ETL/ELT, data modeling, data quality, lakehouse/data platform patterns, orchestration and CI/CD (DevOps). Strong communication and consulting skills, including the ability to advise clients. Ability to work independently in a client environment while collaborating effectively with architects, engineers, analysts and other stakeholders. You help bridge data engineering and AI by preparing high-quality data for GenAI applications, designing scalable feature pipelines, and collaborating with data scientists to bring AI and machine learning solutions into production. Professional proficiency in Dutch Qualification Nice to have Experience and know-how about Microsoft Fabric and/or Microsoft Fabric IQ Experience supporting pre-sales, client workshops, technical proposals, coaching or community activities. Additional experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus: Data governance and security FinOps and cloud cost optimization Streaming and real-time data solutions Preparing data for GenAI and AI/ML use cases Building feature pipelines and collaborating with data scientists What success looks like You can be deployed quickly on a Data & AI engagement, take ownership of meaningful engineering work, and become a trusted client-facing consultant. Alongside client delivery, you actively strengthen the practice by sharing what you learn and helping others grow.

Därför tänker vi nytt och använder den senaste tekniken för att förenkla och förbättra, utveckla och leverera it-tjänsterna för den svenska socialförsäkringen. Välkommen till en av Sveriges största IT-avdelningar. Inom vår enhet utvecklar, implementerar och förvaltar vi AI-tjänster som skapar insikter, möjliggör datadrivna lösningar och effektiviserar processer inom Försäkringskassan. Vi arbetar även med AI-tjänster som kan erbjudas externt och samverkar med interna och externa aktörer inom AI- och dataområdet. Nu söker vi en systemutvecklare som vill bidra till utvecklingen av våra AI-tjänster och datadrivna lösningar. Hos oss får du kombinera praktisk backendutveckling med arbete inom systemdesign och lösningsarkitektur. Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och teknisk utveckling är viktiga delar av arbetet. Backendutveckling och lösningsarkitektur Som systemutvecklare utvecklar och vidareutvecklar du backend-lösningar för våra AI-tjänster och datadrivna lösningar. Du arbetar nära andra utvecklare, arkitekter och verksamhetsrepresentanter för att omsätta behov till hållbara tekniska lösningar. Arbetet omfattar backendutveckling i Java och Python samt utveckling och integration av tjänster och API. Du deltar i arbetet med systemdesign och lösningsarkitektur och bidrar till tekniska vägval. Det innebär bland annat att analysera hur olika komponenter och system samverkar och utforma lösningar med hänsyn till skalbarhet, säkerhet, förvaltning och verksamhetsnytta. items.desc: As a R&D Scientist within our LPD (Livestock, Poultry and Dairy) division you will perform a variety of scientific activities to support the development, maintenance, improvement and understanding of our products and reagent production processes. You will plan and perform experiments in the lab, analyze data and present results to (international) team colleagues. This position is based at our ISO-certified subsidiary in Bern which currently employs a total of 40 people in research and development, production, logistics, packaging, and marketing. Why this role matters: Our small R&D team develops new immunodiagnostic tests and improves existing ones for livestock, poultry and dairy producers. Your scientific work turns prototypes into commercial products that support animal health across the industry. In this role: You will perform scientific work leading to the development of commercial products. You will develop and recommend new procedures and methods. You will plan and participate in team activities. You will independently order and manage materials and equipment. You will collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues from R&D and other departments (e.g. Production, Technical Manufacturing, Marketing, Quality Control, Regulatory) to provide work support, exchange information and ensure efficient processes. You will present projects / data analysis at internal and external meetings (e.g. data reviews, project status updates, scientific seminars) You will support product registration by drafting technical reports and data packages You will actively strive to stay up to date on science and new technologies to support business objectives. As a great networker you are able to get direct and immediate access to coworkers from various departments. You like to share your knowledge as well as to learn from others and to grow in a continuous improvement culture. You take initiatives and accept responsibility above and beyond your stated job Show-and-Tell: You have strong communication skills (written and spoken). You have excellent technical writing skills. You are fluent in German & English (written and spoken) and feel comfortable in presenting in both languages. You are goal-oriented and very well organized to plan your work to be most efficient. We have so much to offer! From day one, you will get full autonomy in your work and ample support when you need it. You will join a successful team who is proud of the work they do and motivated by their unified purpose of helping others. You will work with people who are inspiring, open, and the best in their operating space. We believe in you – with a team of over 10,000 all over the globe, there are lots of opportunities for learning, personal growth, and career expansion. You’ll be part of a double-digit growth company in a quickly growing market and we are leading the way forward with innovative products, services, and a strong focus on our customers. Why IDEXX? items.desc: Biomedical Scientist/Biomedical Scientist Specialist This vacancy is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship if offered at Band 5. Please do not apply unless you have another means of establishing a right to work, or you are already employed by the NHS and would transfer to the pay point at the top of Band 5. This vacancy may close sooner than the advertised deadline if we receive a high volume of applications, so we recommend applying early. This is a fixed term/secondment for 12 months. Job Summary The work performed by the Cellular & Molecular Therapy (CMT) Laboratories in NHS Blood and Transplant (NHSBT), is central to the provision and improvement of life saving stem cell transplants. Our laboratories support over half of all haemopoietic stem cell transplants performed in England each year through a network of GMP grade laboratories in 5 specialist facilities across the country. The department provides specialist services to hospitals covering a large geographical area. We work with peripheral blood derived stem cells, umbilical cord blood and bone marrow cells, collected for patients undergoing stem cell transplantation. We have close partnerships with various transplant programmes and other groups undertaking clinical trials, groundbreaking research and service development. The successful applicant will be highly motivated, ‘team focussed’ and with good time management skills. The work will involve routine service provision, specialist cell processing, and other development activities. We would expect the successful candidate to be flexible and willing to adapt to change. Experience of working in a cell therapy laboratory, and familiarity with stem cell processing and/or flow cytometry techniques would be an advantage. Working hours will be 09:00 to 1 7:00, Monday to Friday (37.5 hours per week). You will also be required to participate in the department’s evening and weekend on call rotas, following appropriate training. You should be a HCPC registered Biomedical or Clinical Scientist with relevant post- registration experience and ideally a specialist qualification in the field of transplantation science.  Quality is crucial in the pharmaceutical industry. To stay ahead, you need new cures and faster, leaner processes.  Enable product and system development by translating market needs into actionable inputs for innovation and offering design.​ 
 Act as a liaison across internal and external stakeholders, building strong networks with global sales, vertical leadership, and industry experts to align on strategic priorities.

 This is how you'll win us over: 
 Preferably, 10+ years’ international experience in (bio)pharmaceutical manufacturing execution and the automation market in an Engineering, Business Development or Sales position with strong business mindset and technical expertise. Knowledge in emerging Digital Application Trends including Cloud Technologies and Digital Process Twins is a strong asset. 
 A University degree in Biotech, Chemical, Electrical or Computer Engineering or equivalent through experience. 
 Entrepreneurship, consultative selling approach knowing the industry and the client key issues and business drivers. 
 You are driven by KPI’s, for which you develop a strategic approach with commercial awareness. As a creative spirit you will energetically develop new ideas and take initiatives as necessary to implement them. 
 Organized methodical approach, able to set and work towards clearly defined targets, able to work effectively in an occasionally intense environment. Result & quality-oriented approach. 
 Excellent presentation skills with ability to present effectively. 
 Good team player and communicator with entrepreneurial spirit. Ability to work with and guide international working teams located at several locations. 
 Networker, being able to develop and maintain a network of key contacts within the decision-making ranks. 
 Excellent language skills in both Spanish and English, with fluency in spoken and written.

items.desc: Vacatureomschrijving PA Consulting breidt het AI Team in Utrecht uit. Daarom zoeken we AI-engineers, die graag praktisch met AI-oplossingen aan de slag gaan en ervoor willen zorgen dat AI echt waarde oplevert voor organisaties over verschillende sectoren. We zoeken zowel AI Engineers met een paar jaar ervaring, die klaar zijn voor de volgende stap in hun carrière, als ervaren AI-specialisten, die hun technische kennis willen inzetten en verder ontwikkelen in bedrijfskritische projecten voor onze klanten. We zoeken collega's met een praktische, op implementatie gerichte kijk hebben op AI en een passie voor het omzetten van ideeën en experimenten in demo's en productie klare oplossingen. Je voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar niet alles vastligt en waar innovatie wordt aangemoedigd. Je hebt een bouwers mentaliteit en een stevige basis in software engineering, waarmee je de wensen van klanten vertaalt naar praktische technische oplossingen. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams samen met data scientist, software engineers, business specialisten en leiders. In deze rol krijg je de kans om: AI-oplossingen in de praktijk te implementeren Klanten te adviseren over hoe AI-tools technisch volwassen gemaakt en opgeschaald kunnen worden De brug te slaan tussen zakelijke behoeften en technische oplossingen Je wordt onderdeel van een ambitieus en nieuwsgierig team waar leren, enthousiasme voor technologie en een sterk teamgevoel centraal staan. AI is een strategisch groeigebied voor PA, en er zal veel vraag zijn naar jouw expertise, zowel bij klantopdrachten als binnen de grotere organisatie. We verwachten dat je actief je kennis deelt en complexe technische onderwerpen helder en toegankelijk kunt uitleggen, ook aan collega’s en klanten zonder technische achtergrond. Bij PA werken we aan de volledige AI lifecycle, van ideevorming en experimenten tot volledig geïmplementeerde oplossingen, met veel aandacht voor kwaliteit, verantwoorde AI en schaalbaarheid. De projecten zijn divers, maar hebben één ding gemeen: AI is geen doel op zich, maar een middel om echte zakelijke vraagstukken van onze klanten op te lossen. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en testen van AI- en generatieve AI-oplossingen voor specifieke zakelijke behoeften Het experimenteren met en toepassen van moderne AI-technologieën, waaronder LLM’s, RAG-architecturen en agent-gebaseerde oplossingen Het integreren van AI-modellen met data, API’s en bestaande IT-landschappen, en het ontwerpen van cloud-native oplossingen bij grote cloudproviders (zoals Azure en GCP) Bijdragen aan AI-architectuur, kwaliteitsborging, evaluatie en het verantwoord gebruik van AI Kennis delen en samen leren binnen de actieve AI-community van PA Het ontwikkelen van productieklaar software met moderne engineeringpraktijken en agile werkwijzen Het ontwerpen en bouwen van robuuste datapipelines en data-engineeringarchitecturen ter ondersteuning van AI/LLM-toepassingen. Je komt terecht in een ondersteunende omgeving met zeer kundige collega’s. Er wordt niet verwacht dat je vanaf dag één alles weet, maar je krijgt wel de kans om je snel te ontwikkelen via echte projecten, coaching en leren in de praktijk. Functie-eisen We werven op verschillende niveaus. Solliciteer dus gerust, of je nu een paar jaar ervaring hebt na je afstuderen of al vele jaren werkervaring. We zijn vooral geïnteresseerd in kandidaten met: Praktijkervaring met AI, data science of software engineering in productieomgevingen Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python, Java of C#, met de focus op productisieren van software Ervaring met moderne werkwijzen voor softwareontwikkeling, waaronder DevOps en CI/CD Ervaring met het bouwen van end-to-end AI-prototypes, inclusief integratie met vectordatabases (bijv. Vertex AI, Weaviate, Pinecone of vergelijkbaar) Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van AI- en agent-gebaseerde oplossingen in Python, inclusief het gebruik van frameworks zoals LangChain of vergelijkbaar Ervaring met moderne “vibe coding”-tools zoals GitHub Copilot, Codex of Claude Code Ervaring met cloudplatforms (bijv. Azure, AWS of Google Cloud Platform) Het vermogen om over disciplines heen samen te werken en technische oplossingen begrijpelijk uit te leggen Een relevante opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science, Informatica, Engineering, Wiskunde of een verwant vakgebied Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels is een vereiste. We verwachten niet per se dat je aan alle bovenstaande criteria voldoet. Solliciteer ook als je maar aan een deel van de eisen voldoet. Het is een pré, maar geen vereiste, als je daarnaast ervaring hebt met: Front-end prototyping in React of vergelijkbare technologieën Evaluatie en observability van AI-oplossingen (bijv. RAGAS of vergelijkbaar) Stakeholdermanagement, en het uitleggen van complexe technische concepten aan een niet-technisch publiek Storytelling Wat wij bieden: Een steile leercurve in een ondersteunende cultuur waarin feedback centraal staat De kans om praktisch …

items.desc: Are you a developer who wants to build real AI solutions with your own code, not just configure off-the-shelf products? Do you enjoy taking an idea from prototype all the way to a client's production environment? Would you like to learn from experienced AI developers and grow fast in Microsoft Foundry-based development? As an AI Application Engineer in our Data & AI team, you will design and build custom AI solutions for large enterprise clients. These include search and assistants built on internal company knowledge, document processing, and agents connected to business systems. We work code-first and build the whole application: the data source, the backend, integration, security and production deployment. Our main platform is Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry), used together with Azure services. Depending on client needs, you may also work with other cloud and open-source technologies. At the start you will work on shared tasks alongside experienced AI developers. Over time you will take on larger parts of projects on your own. Practical Information: Location: Budapest, Hungary | Work Arrangement: Hybrid, with on-site client work | Employment: Full-time | Language Requirements: fluent/professional level of Hungarian and English Key Responsibilities: Develop full-stack AI-powered applications with a senior colleague, from prototype to the client's production environment Build agents, AI skills and multi-step workflows that use tools, APIs and enterprise data sources Work on RAG solutions: document preparation, chunking, embeddings, retrieval and source citation Design prompts, measure answer quality on test cases, and improve prompts and retrieval based on the results Build backend components, integrations and, where needed, a simple user interface around AI features Work in regulated, high-security environments, covering least-privilege access, data protection, logging, monitoring and running costs Write testable, documented code, build integration and functional tests, and support user acceptance testing Take part in demos and client meetings, and present what you have built Support and further develop the solutions we have delivered Job Requirements 1–3 years of professional development experience, or equivalent project work you can show (a thesis project counts too) Confident programming skills in Python or C# Hands-on experience building an LLM-based application with your own code (RAG, agent or document processing). You can explain how it works, how it connects to tools or data sources, and where it broke Software engineering fundamentals: object-oriented programming, design patterns, development methodologies and testing levels (unit, integration, functional, automated). Understanding the concepts is enough; you will get hands-on practice with us Data fundamentals: SQL, and the basic concepts of relational and NoSQL databases (e.g. Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) A focus on quality: you test your own code, add logging that helps debugging, use Git and understand API communication Ability to learn quickly and on your own, with an example of something you taught yourself in the past year and what you built with it Ability to communicate clearly in Hungarian and English, in technical discussions and in documentation Nice to have Experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI or another cloud AI platform (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) Knowledge of embeddings, vector search, tool calling or MCP Experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel or LangGraph Azure services, Docker, CI/CD TypeScript/JavaScript and building simple web interfaces Basics of identity management and security solutions A degree in mathematics, computer science or computer engineering Relevant cloud or AI certifications (Azure, AWS, Google) Your first six months Deliver self-contained tasks on a client project, with senior review Build a smaller AI use case on your own, from prototype to a demo-ready solution Learn the team's Foundry-based development patterns and independently support parts of a live solution Contribute to the team's reusable components: templates, test sets and integration patterns How we select Along with your CV, please send your GitHub profile or a half-page to one-page description of an AI solution you have built. items.desc: Chez KEYTEO , nous accompagnons nos clients dans leur transformation digitale et le développement de solutions technologiques innovantes. Dans un contexte où l’ Intelligence Artificielle Générative transforme les usages et les processus métiers, nous recherchons des AI Engineers passionnés par les Large Language Models (LLMs) et leur intégration au sein d'environnements professionnels exigeants. Notre ambition : identifier des talents capables de dépasser le stade de l'expérimentation pour concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions d'IA à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous évoluerez sur des projets variés, au croisement du Software Engineering, du Machine Learning et de la Generative AI , avec des technologies de pointe telles que OpenAI, Anthropic Claude et les frameworks d'orchestration LLM . Vos missions : En fonction de votre expertise et des projets, vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir et développer des solutions d'IA Générative reposant sur des LLMs (GPT, Claude, modèles open source), adaptées aux besoins métiers. Développer des applications intelligentes intégrant des approches de Prompt Engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) et d'AI Agents. Intégrer les modèles d'IA via des APIs (OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Azure OpenAI, etc.) au sein d'applications et de systèmes existants. Concevoir des architectures agentiques permettant l'automatisation de workflows complexes et l'interaction avec des outils et des sources de données. Prototyper, tester et industrialiser des solutions IA, du Proof of Concept (PoC) jusqu'à leur déploiement en production. Optimiser la performance, la fiabilité et les coûts des applications LLM à travers des mécanismes d'évaluation, d'observabilité et de monitoring. Collaborer avec les équipes métiers, Data et IT afin d'identifier les cas d'usage pertinents et de transformer les besoins en solutions concrètes. Contribuer aux bonnes pratiques d'AI Engineering et de LLMOps , notamment en matière de sécurité, de qualité logicielle et de gouvernance. Votre profil : Formation supérieure en informatique, intelligence artificielle, Data Science, Machine Learning ou domaine équivalent. Expérience en développement logiciel, avec une excellente maîtrise de Python et de l'intégration d'APIs. Expérience pratique dans le développement de solutions utilisant des LLMs tels que GPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic) ou des modèles open source (Llama, Mistral). Bonne compréhension des architectures RAG, du Prompt Engineering et des systèmes agentiques . Connaissances des environnements Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) , de Docker, des pipelines CI/CD et des pratiques MLOps/LLMOps. Capacité à développer des solutions robustes, sécurisées et maintenables, adaptées à des environnements de production. Esprit analytique, autonomie, curiosité technologique et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métiers. Bon niveau d'anglais professionnel ; le français constitue un atout selon les projets. Rejoindre KEYTEO, c'est intégrer une société de conseil IT à taille humaine, évoluer auprès d'acteurs majeurs du marché suisse et participer à des projets technologiques ambitieux. Nous privilégions les profils curieux, pragmatiques et passionnés, capables de transformer les innovations de l'IA en solutions concrètes. Vous développez déjà des solutions avec OpenAI, Claude ou des frameworks d'IA Générative ? Échangeons sur vos compétences et vos ambitions pour identifier ensemble les prochaines opportunités en Suisse romande.

items.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
items.card: Cosa farai • Comprensione del cliente e dei processi: lavorerai con referenti business e tecnici per analizzare i flussi di lavoro, individuare problemi e opportunità e definire requisiti, priorità e criteri di successo. • Progettazione delle soluzioni: selezionerai modelli, strumenti e approcci adeguati, valutando qualità, costi, tempi di risposta, sicurezza e vincoli di integrazione. • Sviluppo AI: realizzerai
items.desc: In Perspective AI l'integrazione strategica tra Persone, Processi e Tecnologia è il cuore del nostro lavoro: non offriamo soluzioni AI plug-and-play, ma accompagniamo le organizzazioni come partner nella trasformazione digitale, di processo e culturale. Aiutiamo le aziende a raggiungere i propri obiettivi di business progettando e implementando soluzioni basate su AI e nuove tecnologie. Con un approccio tecnologicamente agnostico, co-progettiamo ecosistemi innovativi che mettono al centro persone e processi, con l'obiettivo di rendere i nostri clienti autonomi attraverso il trasferimento di competenze e soluzioni scalabili, flessibili e sostenibili. Cerchiamo persone guidate dall'ambizione, pronte a mettersi in gioco per scalare il futuro dell'Intelligenza Artificiale insieme a noi. Il ruolo Cerchiamo un Forward Deployed AI Engineer che unisca competenze pratiche di AI engineering alla capacità di lavorare direttamente con i clienti. Seguirai i progetti dalla comprensione del problema alla realizzazione della soluzione: analizzerai processi e requisiti, contribuirai alle scelte tecniche, scriverai codice e lavorerai con il team e con il cliente per portare le applicazioni in produzione e verificarne i risultati. Il ruolo richiede curiosità tecnica, autonomia e capacità di dialogare con interlocutori diversi. Dovrai comprendere le esigenze del business, tradurle in requisiti funzionali e tecnici e guidare il cliente nelle decisioni necessarie alla progettazione e all’implementazione. Cosa farai • Comprensione del cliente e dei processi: lavorerai con referenti business e tecnici per analizzare i flussi di lavoro, individuare problemi e opportunità e definire requisiti, priorità e criteri di successo. • Progettazione delle soluzioni: selezionerai modelli, strumenti e approcci adeguati, valutando qualità, costi, tempi di risposta, sicurezza e vincoli di integrazione. • Sviluppo AI: realizzerai applicazioni basate su LLM, sistemi RAG, agenti e workflow che interagiscono con dati, strumenti e sistemi aziendali. • Prototipazione e validazione: costruirai prototipi e MVP, raccoglierai feedback dagli utenti e li tradurrai in miglioramenti della soluzione. • Valutazione e affidabilità: definirai casi di test e criteri di valutazione, analizzerai errori e limiti e monitorerai qualità, prestazioni e costi. • Integrazione e rilascio: collaborerai con il team e con i referenti del cliente per integrare le soluzioni negli ambienti esistenti, curando test, gestione degli errori e protezione dei dati. • Adozione e trasferimento di competenze: accompagnerai gli utenti nell’utilizzo delle soluzioni, documenterai le scelte principali e condividerai conoscenze e pratiche utili con il cliente e con il team. items.desc: Job Description Summary GE HealthCare est un leader mondial de la technologie médicale, du diagnostic et des solutions numériques. Le département X-ray Generation conçoit, définit et développe le sous-système qui génère la haute tension et sa modulation nécessaires à tout type d’examen radiologique, puis transforme ce signal et cette énergie en rayons X pour produire l’image médicale. Les générateurs et tubes à rayons X sont utilisés dans une large gamme d’appareils d’imagerie médicale : scanners, mammographes, systèmes d’imagerie vasculaire, de radiographie, etc. Au sein de ce département, l’équipe ISS Mécanique & Haute Tension conçoit notamment les générateurs haute tension isolés dans l’huile et les ensembles mécaniques associés. Les connaissances dont les ingénieurs ont besoin sont aujourd’hui dispersées entre de nombreux outils : gestion documentaire (MyWorkshop/3DSpace), gestion du cycle de vie produit (Windchill), CAO (Creo), sites SharePoint, Teams, bases fournisseurs et coûts. Le stage a pour but de créer un assistant IA interne qui donne un accès unique à ces informations. Job Description Ce projet nommé " Mister Moustache" vise à créer un assistant IA interne qui par exemple, à partir d’un numéro de pièce, retrouvera son fournisseur, sa matière, son coût, ses volumes, les systèmes qui l’utilisent et son historique de qualification. L'outil répondra aussi aux questions des utilisateurs sur les règles de conception, les normes applicables et les retours d’expérience, en citant systématiquement ses sources. Le projet est en phase d’évaluation (preuve de concept), dans le cadre du processus d’approbation des solutions d’IA de GE HealthCare. Missions Analyse du besoin Recueillir les cas d’usage auprès des ingénieurs, par exemple lors d’un atelier de design thinking. Constituer le jeu de 30 questions de référence avec leurs réponses attendues. Conception et développement Configurer l’agent sur la plateforme retenue (Microsoft Copilot Studio ou ChatGPT Enterprise). Connecter les sources documentaires (SharePoint, Teams). Développer, avec l’appui de l’IT, des connecteurs en lecture seule vers MyWorkshop, puis Windchill et Market Maker, avec une authentification propre à chaque utilisateur (SSO). Rédiger les instructions de l’agent : citation des sources et des révisions, avertissement Responsible AI. Évaluation Tester l’agent sur les 30 questions de référence et mesurer le taux de réponses correctes, incomplètes ou fausses. Analyser les erreurs et améliorer l’agent jusqu’à atteindre les critères de réussite. Préparation du passage en pilote Contribuer au dossier d’approbation. Préparer le déploiement auprès de l’équipe (20 à 50 ingénieurs). Documentation et transfert Rédiger un guide utilisateur. Rédiger un dossier technique de maintenance : architecture, connecteurs, authentification, procédures de dépannage. Assurer la passation à l'équipe. Livrables Un agent opérationnel en phase d’évaluation Un rapport d’évaluation sur les 30 questions de référence Un guide utilisateur Un dossier technique de maintenance Une présentation de fin de stage avec des recommandations pour la suite Profil recherché Formation ingénieur ou Master 2 en Data & IA, informatique ou systèmes d’information Expérience en IA générative : RAG (recherche documentaire augmentée), appels d’outils, conception de prompts Maîtrise de Python, des API REST et de Git Connaissance des environnements cloud Microsoft (Azure, Power Platform, Copilot Studio) ou motivation pour les apprendre rapidement Notions d’authentification d’entreprise (OAuth, SSO, Microsoft Entra ID) appréciées Intérêt pour l’ingénierie mécanique et l’industrie ; aucune expertise métier n’est exigée Rigueur et esprit d’analyse, notamment pour évaluer la fiabilité des réponses d’une IA Anglais professionnel : documentation, échanges avec les équipes IT internationales Ce que nous offrons Un projet concret, de la conception au déploiement, porté par l’équipe métier Un tutorat par deux senior architects mécanique/haute tension, avec l’appui des équipes IT Une immersion dans l’ingénierie des dispositifs médicaux au sein d’un grand groupe international Informations pratiques Entreprise : GE HealthCare, Buc (78), France Équipe : ISS (Imaging Subsystem) Mécanique & Haute Tension Type de stage : PFE - stage de fin d’études (BAC +5) - durée de 6 mois Début : à partir de janvier 2027 Qualifications : dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou Master 2, spécialité Data & IA, informatique ou systèmes d’information. Environnement international : Anglais et Français: lu, écrit et parlé A propos de nous GE Healthcare est l'un des leaders mondiaux dans le domaine des technologies médicales et des solutions numériques. Il permet aux cliniciens de prendre des décisions plus rapides et plus pertinentes à travers des équipements intelligents, des analyses de données, des applications et des services. Avec plus de 100 ans d'expérience dans le secteur de la santé et environ 47 000 employés dans le …

items.desc: Lieu : Leuven, Belgium Acteur spatial mondialement reconnu dans les domaines des télécommunications, de la navigation, de l’observation de la terre, de l’exploration et de la réalisation d’infrastructures orbitales, Thales Alenia Space est une Joint-Venture entre les groupes Thales (67%) et Leonardo (33%). Thales Alenia Space Belgium is an expert in several high-technology fields. Indeed, Thales Alenia Space Belgium is the Belgian front-runner in space electronics applications for satellites and launchers, the world leader in power conditioning and distribution for satellites and the principal supplier of electronics for Ariane 5. Thales Alenias Space Belgium, is a company located on 3 sites, one in Charleroi, one in Leuven and the other one in Hasselt (Satellite Photovoltaïc Assembly). We offer you the opportunity to work in a company universally renowned for the quality of its products, an attractive and a state-of-the-art technologic activity field, and evolution opportunities within a company in constant growth. Thales Alenia Space Belgium (TAS-B) conçoit et fabrique depuis plusieurs décennies des équipements électroniques embarqués pour l’industrie spatiale. Ses produits équipent des satellites aux applications très variées, de la météorologie à l’exploration scientifique. Dans l’industrie spatiale, chaque composant embarqué sur un satellite doit être justifié au regard de standards de qualification stricts. Les missions en orbite durent souvent 10 à 15 ans, sans possibilité d’intervention. Les équipements évoluent dans un environnement zéro défaut, soumis à de fortes contraintes thermiques, radiatives et normatives, où la rigueur de chaque analyse conditionne la fiabilité de la mission. Parmi ces analyses, le Part Stress Analysis (PSA) consiste à vérifier, composant par composant, que les contraintes électriques en opération (tension, courant, puissance, température…) restent dans les marges imposées par les normes du secteur. Cette étape est incontournable avant toute revue de qualification. Elle reste pourtant aujourd’hui très fastidieuse et coûteuse en temps, car chaque composant d’une carte électronique doit être analysé individuellement. Sujet du stage Ce stage s’inscrit dans une démarche d’exploration de l’automatisation du PSA grâce à l’intelligence artificielle. L’objectif est de développer une preuve de concept capable d’assister, voire d’automatiser, tout ou partie de cette analyse. Missions principales Comprendre le processus actuel de Part Stress Analysis et les règles de marge (derating) applicables dans le secteur spatial Étudier les données de conception disponibles (schématiques, netlists, résultats de simulation) et leur format Développer une solution d’extraction automatisée des contraintes opératoires de chaque composant à partir de ces données Mettre en place la confrontation de ces contraintes aux spécifications des fabricants (datasheets) Identifier automatiquement les cas de non-respect des règles de marge Évaluer la preuve de concept sur des cartes électroniques issues de projets réels, et analyser ses performances et ses limites Documenter les travaux et présenter les résultats aux équipes concernées Profil recherché Étudiant(e) en Master ou en école d’ingénieurs Double compétence en électronique (pour comprendre les données de conception) et en informatique / data science (pour mettre en œuvre l’automatisation par l’IA) Maîtrise de Python Intérêt pour les systèmes embarqués critiques et l’industrie spatiale Rigueur, autonomie et esprit d’analyse Bon niveau d’anglais Informations pratiques Durée : 3 mois minimum Lieu : Thales Alenia Space Belgium, Leuven Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. As a Product Install Engineer at KLA Corporation, you will be responsible for the successful installation, calibration, and qualification of KLA's cutting-edge inspection and metrology equipment at customer sites worldwide. This role is critical in ensuring our customers achieve optimal performance from our products, contributing directly to their success and KLA's reputation. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with customers and cross-functional teams in a professional manner. items.desc: Dein Platz in der MAI Group Viele KI-Vorhaben scheitern nicht am Modell, sondern an der Frage, ob man es so betreiben darf. Als (Senior) AI Consultant – Solution Architecture & Governance (all genders) in unserer neuen Einheit AI Transformation beantwortest Du sie: Du entscheidest mit Geschäftsführung, IT und Datenschutz unserer Kunden, auf welcher Plattform KI läuft, welche Regeln gelten und wie eine Lösung sicher in den Betrieb kommt. Dabei arbeitest Du mit Beratung und Engineering zusammen und hast mit MAI KIT eine eigene KI-Plattform in der EU, ein eigenes Rechenzentrum und ein 24/7-Betriebsteam hinter Dir. MAI ist eine starke Gruppe mit acht Agenturen verteilt auf die Standorte Hamburg, Berlin, Paderborn, Köln, Augsburg, München, Wien – verbunden durch gemeinsame Ziele, gegenseitigen Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit über Standortgrenzen hinweg. Wo Du auch bei uns startest: Du wirst Teil Deines Teams vor Ort und gleichzeitig Teil von MAI. Deinen Standort wählst Du frei, auch vollständig remote. Besonders freuen wir uns über Verstärkung in Berlin, München oder Wien. Was Du bei uns bewegst Du empfiehlst das Betriebsmodell: unsere Plattform, der Tenant des Kunden bei Azure oder AWS oder der Betrieb vor Ort mit Blick auf Sicherheit, Skalierung, Kosten und DSGVO. Du entwirfst und bewertest Architekturen für Agenten- und RAG-Lösungen, mit Datenflüssen, Rollen, Rechten und Protokollierung, und stellst Vor- und Nachteile nachvollziehbar dar. Du ordnest Anwendungsfälle nach EU AI Act und DSGVO ein und stimmst sie mit Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und Betriebsrat ab. Du führst Kunden durch die AI Foundation: Bestandsaufnahme, Plattformentscheidung, KI-Richtlinie und Entscheidungsvorlage für die Geschäftsführung. Du richtest sichere KI-Arbeitsumgebungen ein und übergibst sie in den Betrieb. Du begleitest Piloten, nimmst Lösungen vor dem Echtbetrieb ab und prüfst Anwendungen, die Kunden selbst mit KI gebaut haben, auf Sicherheit und Betreibbarkeit. Du baust die Vorlagen, mit denen wir diese Fragen beim nächsten Kunden schneller beantworten, und unterstützt Angebote mit Machbarkeitsbewertung und Aufwandsschätzung. Was Dich ausmacht Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in Softwarearchitektur, Cloud oder IT-Beratung gearbeitet und davon mindestens zwei KI-Lösungen in den Betrieb gebracht. Du hast selbst gebaut und baust noch. Architektur ist für Dich kein Folienthema. Du kennst Microsoft Azure aus eigener Praxis, zum Beispiel Azure OpenAI Service, AI Foundry oder Copilot Studio. Du kannst einer Geschäftsführerin in zehn Minuten erklären, welche Entscheidung sie treffen muss und warum. Du hältst dem kritischen Blick einer Datenschutzbeauftragten stand, weil Du ihre Fragen vorher gestellt hast. Du kennst EU AI Act und DSGVO aus der Anwendung, nicht nur aus der Schulung. Du sagst auch dann Nein, wenn alle anderen schon losbauen wollen. Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und gutes Englisch. Nice to have: Erfahrung in Banken, Versicherungen oder bei Energieversorgern Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 Copilot in Unternehmen Kenntnis von AWS Bedrock oder Google Vertex AI; Zertifizierungen in Azure oder AWS Erfahrung mit Open-Weight-Modellen und ihrem Betrieb vor Ort Erfahrung mit Informationssicherheits-Managementsystemen Was wir Dir bieten Freiraum, der zu Deinem Leben passt. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten – auch vollständig remote – und Workation. Verantwortung, die Wirkung schafft. Du setzt die Standards für Architektur und Governance einer neuen Einheit. Entwicklung, die Dich weiterbringt. Lizenzen für KI-Werkzeuge gehören zur Ausstattung. Dazu kommen Weiterbildungen, Konferenzen und Zertifizierungen. Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe. Beratung, Engineering, Plattform-Team und Hosting arbeiten mit Dir an denselben Kunden. Gemeinsame Erlebnisse, die verbinden. Firmenfeiern, Teamevents und gemeinsame Build Days. Gesundheit, die zählt. Gesundheitsangebote über das WorkLifePortal und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss. Extras, die den Alltag besser machen. JobRad, Corporate Benefits sowie kostenlose Getränke und Snacks in den MAI Offices. Deine Kontaktperson Deine Kontaktpersonen sind Lea Nesemeier und Fenja Harder. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Über uns Wir sind MAI. Wir verbinden Strategie mit Umsetzung, Technologie mit Kreativität und digitale Möglichkeiten mit echtem Business Impact. Dafür bringen wir spezialisierte Expertise zusammen, denken partnerschaftlich und handeln pragmatisch mit einem klaren Anspruch: Lösungen zu schaffen, die wirken. Du möchtest nicht nur dabei sein, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen und Wirkung schaffen? items.desc: At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast. Chain IQ is a global AI-powered leader in indirect procurement, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across major delivery centers and 26 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, drive scalability, and deliver substantial reductions in our clients' indirect spend. Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters, bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition. To learn more about Chain IQ, our services, and the clients we support around the world, please visit our website at https://chainiq.com/about-us/. Role purpose We are building an AI-native procurement platform where intelligent applications, autonomous agents, and business workflows operate as a single system. This role is responsible for designing and building the backend services that power those capabilities, translating procurement processes into scalable, reliable, and observable software. You will build the orchestration layer that connects AI agents, business logic, enterprise systems, APIs, and workflow automation. Rather than focusing on traditional CRUD applications, you will develop systems that coordinate long-running business processes, manage state, execute tools, integrate enterprise platforms, and enable human-in-the-loop decision making. This is a senior engineering role requiring strong backend engineering fundamentals combined with a pragmatic approach to modern AI application development. Why this role matters The backend orchestration layer is where business processes, enterprise systems, and AI capabilities come together. As the platform grows, intelligent procurement solutions will increasingly rely on coordinated workflows involving multiple agents, users, enterprise systems, and external services. This role ensures those interactions remain reliable, secure, observable, and scalable, while creating reusable platform capabilities that accelerate future product development rather than solving problems one application at a time. Responsibilities Design and develop backend services supporting intelligent procurement applications and autonomous workflows. Build agent orchestration services that coordinate AI agents, business logic, enterprise APIs, and human approvals. Develop scalable APIs and service interfaces used by web applications, automation workflows, and AI agents. Design workflow execution patterns supporting long-running processes, retries, state management, approvals, and recovery. Integrate enterprise platforms including procurement systems, ERP platforms, identity providers, collaboration tools, and external data sources. Develop reusable services for retrieval, context assembly, tool execution, memory management, and business process automation. Implement secure authentication, authorization, and policy enforcement across platform services. Ensure backend services are observable through logging, metrics, tracing, and operational telemetry. Collaborate closely with Product Engineering, Machine Learning, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, and Product Management to deliver end-to-end platform capabilities. Continuously improve engineering productivity through automation, reusable components, AI-assisted development, and contributions to the Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (ASDLC). Requirements Experience developing backend applications using modern software engineering practices. Solid understanding of distributed systems, APIs, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architectures. Ability to buil scalable cloud-native applications and microservices. Track record in integrating enterprise applications through REST APIs, messaging platforms, and event-based architectures. Software design skills with an emphasis on maintainability, resilience, and reusable architecture. Expertise in designing systems that manage workflow state, long-running processes, retries, and fault recovery. Understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, and secure software development. Comfortable working alongside AI engineers, product managers, platform engineers, and domain specialists in cross-functional teams. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery is highly desirable. Join a truly global team. We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let’s shape the future of procurement - together. Chain IQ – Create. Lead. Make an impact.
