items.desc:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

As a Senior Security Engineer you will:

 - Serve as trusted advisor to team’s leadership and partner teams by clearly articulating business risks associated with security issues

 - Lead security operation functions – including vulnerability management, SAST, DAST, detection engineering, and incident response – in CI/CD and cloud-native production environments

 - Integrate security into our applications throughout the software development lifecycle

 - Collaborate with product and development teams, driving the success of larger projects to ensure that software is built and deployed securely without compromising agility and speed

 - Driving and supporting bug bounty program, application security reviews and threat modeling, including code review and dynamic testing

 - Assess and integrate security tools to automate and scale security processes, i.e:  evaluate open-source vs vendor solutions

 - Gather and analyze security metrics to address security issues with cross-team dependencies

 - Be a problem solver who is empathetic to developer concerns and will employ constructive and flexible approach to building innovative solutions



You may be a good fit if:

 - 5+ years previous experience in Application/Product Security or Security Operations with a strong focus on security tool onboarding and optimization

 - You have an understanding of vulnerability management, network security, cloud security concepts, and industry best practices across many fields of security

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity and are able to make informed decisions with little data

 - You employ a flexible and constructive approach when solving problems

items.desc: Situé au cœur de la Normandie, le Département du Calvados, en charge des solidarités sociales et territoriales, est un acteur majeur de proximité au service des Calvadosiens. Avec ses 3 000 agents, le Département est le deuxième employeur du Calvados. Chaque année, plus de 150 personnes aux profils variés sont recrutées sur la base de leurs compétences et de leurs savoir-être. Sous la supervision d’un chef de projet informatique-développeur, le·a stagiaire contribuera aux activités suivantes, en lien avec l’infrastructure logicielle d’une IA interne au CD14 et son évolution : 1. Veille technologique et R&D Analyser les avancées technologiques dans les domaines de l’IA. Évaluer des solutions innovantes pour optimiser l’infrastructure de l’IA interne (performance, scalabilité, sécurité). Documenter les bonnes pratiques et proposer des améliorations pour la qualité des réponses de l’IA. Participer à des expérimentations sur des outils émergents (ex : workflows agentiques). 2. Développement et implémentation Contribuer au développement de cas d’usage à valeur ajoutée autour de l’IA interne, en collaboration avec les métiers du Département (ex : automatisation de tâches, analyse de données, assistance aux agents). Participer à l’industrialisation des développements : o Mise en œuvre de tests automatisés (intégration continue, déploiement continu). o Intégration de l’IA dans des environnements conteneurisés (Docker) et respect des principes DevSecOps. o Rédaction de documentation technique pour capitaliser les connaissances (Knowledge Management). Développer des interfaces utilisateurs (UX/UI) pour faciliter l’interaction avec l’IA, en appliquant les principes d’ergonomie et d’accessibilité. 3. Optimisation de l’infrastructure IA Analyser les performances de l’infrastructure logicielle de l’IA et proposer des optimisations (ex : réduction des latences, amélioration de la précision des réponses). Participer à la mise en place de workflows agentiques pour automatiser des processus métiers (ex : traitement de demandes, génération de rapports). Contribuer à la veille sur les modèles d’IA (LLM, RAG, etc.) et leur intégration dans les outils du Département. 4. Collaboration et capitalisation Travailler en équipe avec les développeurs, data scientists et métiers du Département pour aligner les développements sur les besoins opérationnels. Participer aux réunions agiles (sprints, rétrospectives) et contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus. Capitaliser les connaissances via la documentation technique et la formation des équipes. Autonomie et rigueur dans un environnement technique exigeant. Capacité à travailler en équipe et à échanger avec des profils variés (développeurs, métiers, direction). Adaptabilité et proactivité pour proposer des solutions innovantes. Sens de l’organisation et méthode pour gérer des projets complexes. Maîtrise de l’anglais technique (lecture de documentation, participation à des communautés open source). Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité (traitement de données sensibles). Niveau d’études : Bac+3 et supérieur (école d’ingénieur, master en informatique, data science, ou équivalent). Compétences en développement : o Connaissance des langages JavaScript/TypeScript et des frameworks modernes (React, Node.js, etc.). o Connaissance des bases de données SQL/NoSQL et des langages de requêtage (SQL, GraphQL). o Expérience avec les environnements Linux, les conteneurs (Docker) et les serveurs Web. o Notions en authentification Web et en sécurité des applications. Compétences en IA/ML (un plus) : o Connaissance des modèles de langage (LLM), des workflows agentiques, ou des outils d’automatisation (ex : LangChain, CrewAI). o Expérience avec des plateformes d’IA (ex : Hugging Face, LangFlow) ou des frameworks de R&D (ex : PyTorch, TensorFlow). Méthodologies : o Connaissance des méthodes agiles (Scrum, Kanban). o Expérience avec les outils de versioning (Git) et les pipelines CI/CD. Expérience souhaitée Une première expérience en développement logiciel, IA, ou infrastructure cloud (stage, projet académique, contribution open source) est un atout. Une familiarité avec les outils DevOps (GitLab CI, Jenkins) ou les plateformes cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) serait un plus. ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Outils utilisés : o Développement : JavaScript/TypeScript, Docker, Git, CI/CD. o IA : Modèles de langage, workflows agentiques, outils de R&D. o Collaboration : Méthodes agiles, outils de gestion de projet (Jira, Trello), documentation (Confluence, Markdown).

items.desc: Junior AI Engineer – Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa Chi siamo Fides S.p.A. , realtà operante nel settore della gestione del credito, è alla ricerca di un Junior AI Engineer da inserire all'interno della società Fintech del proprio gruppo , impegnata nello sviluppo di soluzioni tecnologiche innovative e progetti basati sull'Intelligenza Artificiale. La risorsa contribuirà alla progettazione e realizzazione di sistemi intelligenti capaci di supportare e automatizzare i processi aziendali, attraverso l'utilizzo di modelli linguistici (LLM), tecnologie RAG ( Retrieval-Augmented Generation ) e sistemi agentici. La ricerca è rivolta esclusivamente a profili Junior , neolaureati o professionisti nelle prime fasi della carriera, con una solida preparazione accademica, passione per l'innovazione e interesse per le applicazioni concrete dell'Intelligenza Artificiale. Di cosa ti occuperai In collaborazione con il team tecnico, avrai l'opportunità di: Sviluppare soluzioni basate su AI generativa e sistemi RAG , contribuendo all'elaborazione, indicizzazione e ricerca intelligente delle informazioni aziendali. Collaborare alla progettazione di agenti AI in grado di supportare e automatizzare workflow e processi operativi. Lavorare con modelli linguistici locali (LLM) , partecipando alle attività di configurazione, sperimentazione e ottimizzazione. Contribuire alla valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli AI , attraverso test, metriche e analisi dei risultati. Supportare l'integrazione delle soluzioni AI con i sistemi e le applicazioni aziendali. Partecipare alle attività di sviluppo, testing e miglioramento continuo delle soluzioni tecnologiche. Le attività saranno svolte con il supporto del team tecnico, in un percorso di progressiva acquisizione di autonomia e responsabilità. Il profilo che cerchiamo Requisito di formazione indispensabile: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica (LM-32), già conseguita. Competenze tecniche richieste: Buona conoscenza dei principi fondamentali del Machine Learning, delle reti neurali e dell'architettura Transformer. Familiarità con i modelli linguistici (LLM), maturata anche attraverso progetti universitari, attività di tesi, ricerca o progetti personali. Conoscenza delle architetture RAG, degli embedding e della ricerca semantica. Conoscenza delle principali tecniche di prompt engineering. Competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in C#/.NET, TypeScript o linguaggi equivalenti. Conoscenza dei database relazionali e del linguaggio SQL. Familiarità con Git e capacità di consultare documentazione tecnica in inglese. Costituiscono requisiti preferenziali Dottorato di Ricerca (PhD) in Intelligenza Artificiale, Machine Learning, Ingegneria Informatica o ambiti di ricerca strettamente correlati. Esperienza in progetti accademici, di ricerca o personali nell'ambito dell'Intelligenza Artificiale generativa. Conoscenza di Python, PyTorch e Hugging Face. Familiarità con strumenti per l'esecuzione di modelli locali come Ollama, llama.cpp o vLLM. Conoscenza di PostgreSQL, pgvector e database vettoriali. Familiarità con framework come LangChain, LlamaIndex o Semantic Kernel. Nozioni di Docker, Linux e ambienti di sviluppo AI. Conoscenza delle metodologie di valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli e ottimizzazione dei sistemi AI. Interesse per la sicurezza dei sistemi di Intelligenza Artificiale e la protezione dei dati. Non è richiesta una precedente esperienza professionale strutturata nel ruolo. Saranno valorizzate le competenze acquisite durante il percorso universitario, attraverso attività di ricerca, progetti di tesi o iniziative personali. Cerchiamo persone con curiosità tecnologica, attitudine al problem solving, capacità di lavorare in team e forte motivazione all'apprendimento. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in una realtà Fintech orientata all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale . Opportunità di partecipare a progetti concreti di AI generativa applicata ai processi aziendali. Affiancamento tecnico e possibilità di sviluppare competenze specialistiche. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e opportunità di crescita professionale. Sede di lavoro: Catania. Modalità di lavoro ibrida , con possibilità di alternare attività in presenza e da remoto. Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL): € 25.000 – € 30.000 , commisurata alle competenze e al percorso formativo del candidato. Candidati! Se hai conseguito una Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica , sei appassionato di Intelligenza Artificiale e desideri trasformare le tue conoscenze accademiche in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete, inviaci la tua candidatura! Se hai realizzato progetti universitari, di ricerca o personali legati all'AI, ti invitiamo a condividere anche un link al tuo repository GitHub, alla tua tesi o a progetti che possano valorizzare le tue competenze. Fides S.p.A. promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e valorizza le candidature nel rispetto delle pari opportunità. #JoinUS

items.desc: Company Description At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society. Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide. Our team is dynamic, innovative, and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world. Job Description Due to growth and ongoing delivery success with our clients, Turner & Townsend’s Digital Services division in Spain requires an AI & Data Engineer to join the team. As an AI & Data Engineer, you will build the data foundations and the AI solutions that help our clients, project and cost management teams work faster and deliver better outcomes. You will design and run governed databases that enable trusted reporting through Power BI, and use that data to power AI agents and task accelerators built on our enterprise platforms. You will take ownership of each solution from idea to adoption: understanding the task, preparing the data, building and testing the agent or automation, deploying it safely, measuring the time it saves, and improving it based on user feedback. You will work in a hands-on team, with colleagues based across Europe and be actively involved in shaping how AI is used across the Spanish business. Key Responsibilities Design and implement a data platform that ingests data from internal business systems, project and cost management tools, and structured documents such as cost plans and spreadsheets. Build and maintain data pipelines using ELT/ETL patterns and orchestration with data quality controls, reconciliation logic and auditability. Develop and govern master and reference data (projects, clients, locations, cost codes) to support consistent business definitions, dimensional modelling and reporting quality. Support in the design and delivery of Power BI semantic models, dashboards and reports with appropriate row-level security, performance tuning and adoption support. Work with project managers, cost managers and business leaders to identify repetitive, high-value tasks (e.g. cost reports, change control, tender analysis, risk registers, document review and progress reporting) and shape them into prioritised AI use cases with clear success measures. Design, build, test and deploy AI agents, and extend their skills with connectors and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Prepare AI-ready data of trusted company knowledge, including SharePoint, internal knowledge platforms, using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), APIs and tool integrations. Build task accelerators, including Python scripts, Power Automate flows, prompt libraries and reusable templates, using AI coding tools. Evaluate AI agent quality: build test sets, measure accuracy and reliability, design human-in-the-loop review steps, and monitor performance in production. Apply security, privacy and responsible AI by design, including Microsoft Entra ID permissions, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels, protection against prompt injections, and compliance with GDPR, the EU AI Act and client confidentiality requirements. Manage the solution lifecycle, including source control, separate development, test and production environments, release management, documentation and support handover. Track adoption, benefits (time saved, quality improvements) and running costs and report them to Digital Services leadership. Drive adoption through demos, training sessions and user guides, and collaborate with Turner & Townsend’s European AI Hub and digital communities to reuse proven assets and stay aligned with the enterprise AI strategy. Qualifications Essential Skills & Experience Approximately 5-7 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or enterprise reporting delivery. Delivery experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse Analytics, or equivalent cloud data platforms such as Databricks. Strong SQL and Python skills; experience with Spark/ PySpark notebooks is highly desirable. Solid grounding in dimensional modelling, data warehousing and lakehouse concepts, and master and reference data management. Experience integrating data from finance, ERP, project management and other operational systems through APIs, databases and flat files, including Excel-based sources. Sound understanding of data quality, testing and reconciliation controls for business-critical reporting. Hands-on use of large language model (LLM) tools and APIs, and a genuine drive to apply AI to real business processes. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Deep knowledge of the Salesforce security model (permissions, sharing, integration users) and the judgment to keep it simple. Business curiosity: you want to understand the process before you build, and you’re comfortable challenging a request. Clear communication in English, written and spoken: you can explain what you built, and why, to non-technical teams. In this role, you'll make an impact by: Architect the platform: own the platform's end-to-end cloud architecture: model access, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation, observability and cost controls. Make agentic AI real: define the reference patterns for AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use and multi-agent workflows, and prove them in production with our first business use cases. You have designed and delivered AI or ML platforms in production on AWS or Azure, personally and not only as an adviser. RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering. Hands-on full-stack engineering depth. Cloud-native engineering maturity. Practical use of AI in software development. Very good English language proficiency, Czech language is considered good-to-have but not mandatory.

items.desc: Η εταιρεία ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΕΣ ΥΠΕΡΑΓΟΡΕΣ ΣΚΛΑΒΕΝΙΤΗΣ Α.Ε.Ε. αναζητά υποψήφιους για κάλυψη Θέσης Εργασίας “ Μηχανικός Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης (AI Engineer) ” στη Διεύθυνση Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης (AI) . Περιγραφή Θέσης Εργασίας: Ο υποψήφιος που θα επιλεγεί θα έχει ως κύρια ευθύνη την ανάπτυξη εφαρμογών Παραγωγικής Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης (Generative AI) και πράκτορες Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης (AI Agents) που αξιοποιούν την εταιρική γνώση και διασυνδέονται με τα εταιρικά συστήματα, σε περιβάλλον λιανεμπορίου μεγάλης κλίμακας. Θα συμμετέχει σε όλο τον κύκλο μιας λύσης, από το πρωτότυπο (prototype) έως την παραγωγική λειτουργία (production). Ειδικότερα, οι κύριες αρμοδιότητες περιλαμβάνουν: Ανάπτυξη εφαρμογών Generative AI και AI Agents με χρήση μεγάλων γλωσσικών μοντέλων (Large Language Models – LLMs). Διασύνδεση με εταιρικά συστήματα μέσω διεπαφών προγραμματισμού (APIs) και του πρωτοκόλλου MCP (Model Context Protocol). Ανάπτυξη λύσεων αναζήτησης και απαντήσεων πάνω σε εταιρικά έγγραφα (Retrieval-Augmented Generation – RAG). Έλεγχος και αξιολόγηση της ποιότητας των απαντήσεων (evals) και εφαρμογή μηχανισμών ασφαλείας (guardrails). Συνεργασία με τις ομάδες Πληροφορικής, Δεδομένων και τις επιχειρησιακές ομάδες για τη μεταφορά των λύσεων σε παραγωγή. Τεκμηρίωση κώδικα και τεχνικών επιλογών. Απαραίτητα προσόντα: Πτυχίο σε Πληροφορική, Μηχανική Υπολογιστών ή συναφές αντικείμενο. 2+ έτη εμπειρίας στην ανάπτυξη λογισμικού (software development), κατά προτίμηση σε εφαρμογές διακομιστή (backend). Πολύ καλή γνώση Python. Εμπειρία με διεπαφές REST (REST APIs), JSON και διασυνδέσεις συστημάτων (system integrations). Πρακτική εμπειρία με διεπαφές μεγάλων γλωσσικών μοντέλων (LLM APIs), από επαγγελματικά ή προσωπικά έργα. Κατανόηση των περιορισμών των LLMs, όπως οι ανακριβείς απαντήσεις (hallucinations). Εμπειρία με βάσεις δεδομένων, SQL και σύστημα διαχείρισης εκδόσεων κώδικα (Git). Καλή επικοινωνία και πολύ καλή γνώση Αγγλικών. Επιθυμητά προσόντα: Εμπειρία με διανυσματικές αναπαραστάσεις (embeddings) και διανυσματικές βάσεις δεδομένων (vector databases). Εμπειρία με κλήση εργαλείων (tool / function calling) και πλαίσια ανάπτυξης πρακτόρων (agent frameworks), π.χ. LangGraph ή LangChain. Εμπειρία με Docker, περιβάλλοντα υπολογιστικού νέφους (cloud) ή αυτοματοποιημένη ανάπτυξη (CI/CD). Γνώση TypeScript / JavaScript. Εμπειρία στο λιανεμπόριο (retail) ή σε διασυνδέσεις με συστήματα ERP. Η θέση εργασίας υπάγεται στη Διεύθυνση Τεχνητής Νοημοσύνης (AI), στα Κεντρικά Γραφεία (Λεωφόρος Κηφισού 136, Περιστέρι Αττικής). Αμοιβές & Παροχές: Στο πλαίσιο της Πολιτικής Μισθολογικής Ισότητας και Διαφάνειας, οι υποψήφιοι θα ενημερώνονται εγκαίρως για την αρχική αμοιβή ή το προβλεπόμενο εύρος αποδοχών της θέσης, το οποίο καθορίζεται βάσει αντικειμενικών και ουδέτερων ως προς το φύλο κριτηρίων, καθώς και για τυχόν εφαρμοστέες συλλογικές συμβάσεις εργασίας. Η επιλογή των υποψηφίων πραγματοποιείται με γνώμονα τα απαιτούμενα προσόντα, τις επαγγελματικές δεξιότητες και την καταλληλότητά τους για τη θέση, με σεβασμό στις αρχές της Ίσης Μεταχείρισης και των Ίσων Ευκαιριών. Σε περίπτωση υποβολής αίτησης πρόσληψης στην Εταιρεία ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΕΣ ΥΠΕΡΑΓΟΡΕΣ ΣΚΛΑΒΕΝΙΤΗΣ Α.Ε.Ε., τα προσωπικά σας δεδομένα θα υποβληθούν σε επεξεργασία σύμφωνα με την "Ενημέρωση Εργαζομένων και Υποψηφίων Εργαζομένων για την επεξεργασία Προσωπικών Δεδομένων".

If you thrive on developing intelligent, goal-oriented AI applications, this is the role for you. Who We Are Looking For You are a pragmatic, solutions-focused developer with a robust background in
items.desc: Description & Requirements Who we are looking for We are seeking for Python Developer with experience in building AI systems. This role requires deep expertise in Python, experience or exposure to leading agent orchestration frameworks (ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, etc.), and extensive experience leveraging Google Cloud Platform’s Vertex AI suite. You will be responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing multi-step reasoning agents capable of advanced tool use, function calling, and managing diverse GenAI tasks across text and code generation domains. If you thrive on developing intelligent, goal-oriented AI applications, this is the role for you. Who We Are Looking For You are a pragmatic, solutions-focused developer with a robust background in software architecture and advanced AI concepts. You possess: Essential Python Proficiency: Exceptional expertise in Python is mandatory for ML development, API integration, and leveraging SDKs (Vertex AI SDK, OpenAI SDK). Agent Development Exposure: Experience in building and orchestrating complex AI workflows using state-of-the-art frameworks, specifically: LangChain, LangGraph, and ADK (Agent Development Kit). GenAI Task Experience: Practical experience developing solutions for core Generative AI tasks, including sophisticated function calling, code generation, classification, summarization, and prompt engineering for text generation. Grounding Techniques Knowledge: Understanding of grounding models using techniques like RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) to provide external, factual context for agents. GCP AI Ecosystem Familiarity: Strong working knowledge of key GCP GenAI and MLOps tools, including: Agent Tools: Direct experience utilizing Vertex AI Agent Builder for developing conversational and goal-oriented agents. Development Environments: A2A, Managed Compute Platform (MCP), Vertex AI Workbench/Notebooks for development. MLOps & Deployment: Vertex AI Pipelines for workflow orchestration. Model Management: Vertex AI Training for custom training, fine-tuning, and hyperparameter tuning. English proficiency EU work permit Nice-to-Have Skills While not strictly required, candidates possessing the following skills will have a distinct advantage: Graph Databases: Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and their integration into LangGraph or RAG systems to manage complex relationships and contextual memory. Low-Latency Deployment: Experience optimizing GenAI applications for low-latency, high-throughput environments (e.g., using quantization or compiling models). Security & Compliance: Familiarity with data security principles related to PII/PHI handling within GenAI pipelines and implementing filtering mechanisms (e.g., DLP). Advanced MLOps: Deep experience with running production workloads on GKE or leveraging advanced features of Cloud Run for model serving. Your future role As a Generative AI Agent Developer, your primary responsibilities will include: Agent Orchestration: Design, develop, and deploy complex, multi-step AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and ADK, ensuring efficient state management and execution paths. Tool and Function Calling: Implement robust mechanisms for agents to utilize external APIs, custom Python functions, and specialized tools (Tool Use) to achieve complex goals and interact with enterprise systems. GCP Service Integration: Leverage the full suite of Vertex AI services (Agent Builder, Pipelines, Workbench) to manage the entire agent lifecycle, from testing to scalable production deployment. Model Integration and Customization: Integrate and manage various foundational models (GCP, open source) and utilize Vertex AI Training for model customization where required. Infrastructure & Networking: Utilize general GCP infrastructure knowledge, including Compute (Agent Engine, GKE, Cloud Run) for deployment, and adhere to networking standards (VPC, Load Balancing, Cloud DNS). Performance and Reliability: Implement rigorous testing and logging to monitor agent behavior, optimize token usage, ensure reasoning accuracy, and minimize potential hallucinations. Documentation & Best Practices: Document agent architectures, development processes, and promote reusable design patterns across the engineering team.

items.desc: At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society. Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide. Our team is dynamic, innovative, and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world. Job Description Due to growth and ongoing delivery success with our clients, Turner & Townsend’s Digital Services division in Spain requires an AI & Data Engineer to join the team. As an AI & Data Engineer, you will build the data foundations and the AI solutions that help our clients, project and cost management teams work faster and deliver better outcomes. You will design and run governed databases that enable trusted reporting through Power BI, and use that data to power AI agents and task accelerators built on our enterprise platforms. You will take ownership of each solution from idea to adoption: understanding the task, preparing the data, building and testing the agent or automation, deploying it safely, measuring the time it saves, and improving it based on user feedback. You will work in a hands-on team, with colleagues based across Europe and be actively involved in shaping how AI is used across the Spanish business. Key Responsibilities Design and implement a data platform that ingests data from internal business systems, project and cost management tools, and structured documents such as cost plans and spreadsheets. Build and maintain data pipelines using ELT/ETL patterns and orchestration with data quality controls, reconciliation logic and auditability. Develop and govern master and reference data (projects, clients, locations, cost codes) to support consistent business definitions, dimensional modelling and reporting quality. Support in the design and delivery of Power BI semantic models, dashboards and reports with appropriate row-level security, performance tuning and adoption support. Work with project managers, cost managers and business leaders to identify repetitive, high-value tasks (e.g. cost reports, change control, tender analysis, risk registers, document review and progress reporting) and shape them into prioritised AI use cases with clear success measures. Design, build, test and deploy AI agents, and extend their skills with connectors and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Prepare AI-ready data of trusted company knowledge, including SharePoint, internal knowledge platforms, using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), APIs and tool integrations. Build task accelerators, including Python scripts, Power Automate flows, prompt libraries and reusable templates, using AI coding tools. Evaluate AI agent quality: build test sets, measure accuracy and reliability, design human-in-the-loop review steps, and monitor performance in production. Apply security, privacy and responsible AI by design, including Microsoft Entra ID permissions, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels, protection against prompt injections, and compliance with GDPR, the EU AI Act and client confidentiality requirements. Manage the solution lifecycle, including source control, separate development, test and production environments, release management, documentation and support handover. Track adoption, benefits (time saved, quality improvements) and running costs and report them to Digital Services leadership. Drive adoption through demos, training sessions and user guides, and collaborate with Turner & Townsend’s European AI Hub and digital communities to reuse proven assets and stay aligned with the enterprise AI strategy. Qualifications Essential Skills & Experience Approximately 5-7 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or enterprise reporting delivery. Delivery experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse Analytics, or equivalent cloud data platforms such as Databricks. Strong SQL and Python skills; experience with Spark/ PySpark notebooks is highly desirable. Solid grounding in dimensional modelling, data warehousing and lakehouse concepts, and master and reference data management. Experience integrating data from finance, ERP, project management and other operational systems through APIs, databases and flat files, including Excel-based sources. Sound understanding of data quality, testing and reconciliation controls for business-critical reporting. Hands-on use of large language model (LLM) tools and APIs, and a genuine drive to apply AI to real business processes. Awareness of secure engineering practices, including access control, audit trails and the handling of confidential and personal …

We’re looking for a Senior ASIC Verification Engineer to support the Digital Radio ASIC (DRA) team by leading verification of complex ASIC designs and digital IP. You’ll partner with design, architecture, and co-verification teams like IP/TLV/Subsystem teams, and software teams to shape verification strategy, build scalable environments, and drive functional issue resolution from specification through pre-silicon signoff.
The work may cover signal-processing datapaths, control logic, and the interfaces that carry radio data through the system. Prior experience with DRA or Ericsson-specific products is not required. You’ll bring strong ASIC verification skills,[RS1.1] knowledge of verification methodologies such as formal, sound technical judgment, and ownership of critical outcomes.
 What you’ll do 
• Analyze specifications and microarchitecture to identify features, corner cases, risks, and verification requirements.
• Lead verification strategy and planning for significant IP, subsystem, or SoC areas, defining measurable exit criteria and aligning risks and priorities with design and architecture partners.
• Influence microarchitecture and design decisions by identifying verification risks, specification gaps, and corner cases early.
• Develop verification scenarios for radio-IP behavior, including data-path operation, control/configuration, throughput, latency, and boundary conditions relevant to the design.
• Develop and maintain reusable SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, sequences, scoreboards, agents, checkers, and test infrastructure.
• Create constrained-random and directed tests for block-level and/or subsystem-level verification, including relevant data patterns, operating modes, and stress conditions for digital radio processing.
• Write and review SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and other checks to validate protocol behavior, control logic, and design properties.
• Build functional coverage models, analyze coverage results, and drive closure against agreed targets.
• Run simulations, triage failures, isolate root causes, and communicate actionable findings to designers and cross-functional partners.
• Support regression health, improve testbench quality and execution efficiency, and help maintain reliable verification workflows.
• Contribute to pre-silicon signoff by assessing verification completeness, documenting residual risks, and presenting evidence for closure.
• Where relevant to the program, support emulation, formal verification, FPGA prototyping, or post-silicon debug.
• Review verification plans, environments, assertions, and coverage models; promote reusable, maintainable verification practices.
• Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and knowledge sharing, and help improve team-wide verification methods.
 What you’ll bring 
• A degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Significant professional experience in digital design verification for ASICs or SoCs, with a track record of independently leading complex verification workstreams.
• Strong proficiency in SystemVerilog and practical experience with UVM-based verification environments.
• Experience translating specifications into verification plans, tests, checkers, and coverage models.
• Working knowledge of constrained-random verification, functional coverage, assertions, simulation, and debug workflows.
• Ability to investigate complex failures systematically and explain findings clearly to both design and verification colleagues.
• Strong understanding of digital design concepts such as finite-state machines, pipelined datapaths, clock/reset behavior, and common on-chip interfaces or protocols.
• Ability to reason about data integrity and corner cases in streaming or high-throughput datapaths; familiarity with fixed-point arithmetic or DSP concepts is an advantage.
• Scripting ability in Python, Perl, Tcl, or a similar language to automate tasks and improve verification productivity.
• Strong technical leadership, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to prioritize verification effort, make trade-offs, and drive work to closure.
• A collaborative communication style and a demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues and influence cross-functional partners. 
 Helpful experience 
• Verification of complex IP, SoC subsystems, or full-chip designs, particularly datapath-heavy or signal-processing IP.
• Familiarity with digital radio, wireless communications, DSP, baseband processing, or radio access network technology is an advantage, but not a requirement. Prior experience with DRA or Ericsson-specific products is not required.
• Experience with protocols such as AMBA AXI/AHB/APB, JESD204, PCIe, DDR, or another interface relevant to the design. 
• Formal connectivity and power verification; clock-domain crossing (CDC) and reset-domain crossing (RDC) analysis; or security-related …

items.desc: Vos missions Sujet du stage : Industrialisation et Automatisation par l'IA des chiffrages d'ouvrages pour l’énergie (H/F) Dans un contexte de transition énergétique accélérée, la réalisation d’infrastructures de génie civil liées à l’énergie (postes électriques, centrales solaires, BESS, sous-stations, lignes HT) connaît une forte augmentation. Bien que ces ouvrages partagent des géométries, contraintes normatives et modes constructifs standardisés, la préparation des réponses à appels d'offres (chiffrages, DCE, CCTP, métrés, mémoires techniques) mobilise encore un temps d'ingénierie important. L'objectif de ce stage est d'industrialiser et digitaliser la chaîne de production des études de prix et méthodes en concevant des assistants d'ingénierie augmentée (Agents IA (RAG) / scripts automatisés) dédiés à ces typologies d'ouvrages. Intégré(e) au sein de la Direction des Études / Méthodes et sous le tutorat d’un(e) ingénieur(e) référent(e), vous piloterez le développement et le déploiement d’une boîte à outils d’ingénierie automatisée articulée autour de 3 axes : 1. Cartographie et standardisation des livrables métiers : Capitaliser sur l’historique des projets d’infrastructures énergétiques (bibliothèque de prix, rendements, clauses techniques types, retours d'expérience chantiers). Modéliser les trames récurrentes de nos CCTP et Mémoires Techniques spécifiques aux ouvrages de l’énergie. 2. Conception et prototypage des agents IA d'assistance : Module Rédaction (CCTP & Mémoire Technique) : Structurer une base documentaire de référence et concevoir un assistant IA (RAG) capable de générer des propositions techniques sur-mesure (phasage, modes opératoires, sécurité, démarche bas carbone Eiffage). Module Calcul des Métrés : Mettre au point une méthodologie semi-automatisée d'extraction et de calcul des quantitatifs (béton, coffrage, terrassement, ratios d'acier) à partir des documents du marché. 3. Validation terrain et industrialisation : Tester la solution sur des affaires réelles en phase d'appel d'offres en binôme avec les ingénieurs d'études de prix. Mesurer les gains de productivité et la fiabilité des résultats. Rédiger le guide d’utilisation et former l'équipe à la prise en main de ces nouveaux outils. Votre profil Formation : Étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs (Génie Civil, BTP, Bâtiment). Compétences techniques : Solides connaissances en génie civil (béton armé, terrassement, fondations). Appétence marquée pour la digitalisation, l'innovation et les outils d'IA générative (LLM, prompting, RAG). La maîtrise de Python (manipulation de données, scripts simples) et/ou la familiarité avec le BIM (outils de métrés ou fichiers IFC) est un réel plus. Savoir-être : Rigueur analytique (sensibilité critique indispensable pour vérifier les sorties d'un modèle IA). Esprit de synthèse et très bonnes capacités rédactionnelles. Curiosité, autonomie et force de proposition. Ce que ce stage vous apporte : Une double compétence rare et très recherchée sur le marché : l'expertise Génie Civil couplée à l'ingénierie assistée par IA. Un impact direct et mesurable sur le quotidien d'une équipe opérationnelle. L'opportunité de travailler sur les projets stratégiques du secteur de l'énergie au sein d'un grand groupe de BTP. Attachés à l’égalité professionnelle, à la mixité et à la diversité, nous accueillons tous les talents et nous engageons notamment dans le recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Rejoignez une entreprise animée d'un esprit de famille unique. #Espritdefamille À propos de nous Eiffage Énergie Systèmes conçoit, réalise, exploite et maintient des systèmes et équipements en génies électrique, industriel, climatique et énergétique dans le respect des Hommes et de l'environnement. Eiffage Énergie Systèmes propose une offre sur mesure pour les marchés de l’industrie, des infrastructures et réseaux, des villes et collectivités et du tertiaire. Eiffage Énergie Systèmes, présente dans près de 50 pays, s’appuie sur l’expérience de plus de 40 000 collaborateurs et a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 8,1 milliards d’euros en 2025. Eiffage Énergie Systèmes anticipe les évolutions de ses clients en proposant des solutions innovantes et les accompagne dans leurs transitions numérique et bas carbone. Intégrer Eiffage Énergie Systèmes, c’est rejoindre une entreprise dynamique qui encourage l’initiative, valorise le potentiel créatif, développe les compétences de chacun et s’engage au quotidien en matière de responsabilité sociétale et environnementale. Être collaborateur d’Eiffage Énergie Systèmes, c’est vivre et faire vivre nos valeurs communes et une culture d’entreprise forte au sein d’un groupe dont plus de 80% des salariés sont actionnaires. Envie de rejoindre une grande entreprise qui a tous les atouts d’une petite, un Groupe à l’esprit de famille unique. #EspritDeFamille #Together #TousDifférents #BasCarbone

We support more than 3,000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, manufacturing and critical infrastructure. We invest heavily in learning, technical development and career progression, creating an environment where people are encouraged to challenge thinking, share knowledge and develop innovative solutions to real customer security challenges. The Role We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Solution Architect to join our Solution Architecture team in Germany. This is a senior customer-facing role, working closely with our Account Management, Professional Services, Managed Security Services, Product and specialist technical teams. You will engage with customers ranging from security and technology teams through to CISOs, CIOs and other senior stakeholders, helping them understand their security challenges and translating those challenges into practical, commercially viable cybersecurity solutions. The role goes beyond selecting technology. You will be expected to understand a customer's business objectives, security maturity, threat exposure, technology environment, and operating model, bringing these together to design solutions spanning technology, professional services and managed security services. You will take technical ownership of opportunities throughout the sales lifecycle, from initial discovery and qualification through solution architecture, proposal development, and customer presentation, supporting a smooth transition into successful delivery. Most importantly, you will become a trusted security advisor to our customers, helping them understand where to focus investment, improve security maturity and strengthen their overall cyber resilience. Key Responsibilities Customer Discovery & Advisory Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customers' business objectives, security challenges, existing architecture, security maturity and risk priorities. Engage confidently with stakeholders ranging from security engineers and architects through to CISO, CIO and executive leadership. Translate technical and business challenges into clear security requirements and pragmatic improvement plans. Help customers prioritise security investment based on risk, business outcomes and existing capabilities. Build trusted advisory relationships, constructively challenging customer thinking where appropriate rather than simply responding to stated technical requirements. Solution Architecture Architect cybersecurity solutions combining technology, professional services and managed security services. Develop high-level architectures, solution designs, bills of materials, licensing models and professional services scopes. Design solutions across new and existing customer environments, identifying opportunities to consolidate, optimise and improve security capabilities. Ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, commercially viable, operationally supportable and aligned with Integrity360's portfolio and delivery capabilities. Work across multiple security technologies and vendors, selecting appropriate capabilities based on customer requirements rather than relying on a single technology stack. Managed Security & Cyber Resilience Design solutions incorporating a broad range of cybersecurity capabilities, including: Managed Detection and Response (MDR) SIEM, XDR and Security Operations Endpoint Detection and Response Incident Response and Cyber Resilience Vulnerability and Exposure Management Cloud Security Identity Security Network and Infrastructure Security Email and Collaboration Security Data Security Security Testing and Assurance Threat Intelligence and Digital Risk Security Automation and Orchestration You will be expected to understand how these technologies and capabilities fit into the customer's broader security architecture and operating model, rather than treating individual security products as standalone controls. items.desc: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. About the role: We're hiring our first FDE in the UK! Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments. This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints. You will: Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment. Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure. Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems. Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption. Bridge Customers and Product: Develop a deep understanding of how enterprises use Replit and translate field insights, technical constraints, and recurring customer needs into actionable feedback for Replit’s product and engineering teams. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality experiences Ship quickly and iterate based on customer feedback and usage data Turn field patterns into templates, playbooks, and product requirements. Ship the best patterns back to the platform. Required skills and experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience building and deploying production software Strong programming skills and the ability to quickly understand and work across unfamiliar codebases, APIs, and technical environments Hands-on work with LLM applications in production: retrieval, tool calls, and evals. items.card: O pozícii Hľadáme AI Researchera , ktorý nám pomôže posúvať inteligenciu našich AI systémov v oblasti agentických workflowov, dátovej mapy, pamäte, retrievalu, evaluácií a práce s kontextom . Rola je vhodná najmä pre doktoranda alebo človeka s výskumným zázemím, ktorý nechce zostať iba pri paperi, ale vie svoje nápady testovať, prototypovať a prekladať do riešení použiteľných pre engineering. Budeš spolupracovať
items.desc: O pozícii Hľadáme AI Researchera , ktorý nám pomôže posúvať inteligenciu našich AI systémov v oblasti agentických workflowov, dátovej mapy, pamäte, retrievalu, evaluácií a práce s kontextom . Rola je vhodná najmä pre doktoranda alebo človeka s výskumným zázemím, ktorý nechce zostať iba pri paperi, ale vie svoje nápady testovať, prototypovať a prekladať do riešení použiteľných pre engineering. Budeš spolupracovať najmä s Core teamom a Datamap teamom na témach, ktoré sú kľúčové pre fungovanie personalizovaného AI asistenta: ako systém chápe používateľa, ako pracuje s jeho dátami, ako si drží kontext, ako vyhodnocuje relevantnosť informácií a ako sa rozhoduje, čo použiť, kedy a prečo. Čomu sa budeš venovať: Budeš pomáhať Core a Datamap tímom zlepšovať to, ako náš AI asistent pracuje s kontextom, pamäťou, dátami, nástrojmi a agentickými workflowmi. Rola stojí na pomedzí výskumu a produktu: budeš čítať a vyhodnocovať relevantné prístupy z AI/LLM sveta, ale hlavne ich testovať na konkrétnych problémoch nášho systému. Tvoje hlavné témy budú: LLM, RAG a retrieval — testovanie prístupov k vyhľadávaniu relevantného kontextu, rerankingu, chunkingu, embeddingom a práci s dlhším kontextom. Memory a personalizácia — skúmanie, čo si má AI asistent pamätať, kedy má pamäť použiť a ako merať, či personalizácia reálne zlepšuje odpoveď. Datamap a štruktúrované dáta — návrh spôsobov, ako prepájať používateľské objekty, atribúty a vzťahy s prirodzeným jazykom a AI odpoveďami. Agentické workflowy a tool-use — analýza toho, kedy má AI použiť nástroj, ako má prebiehať handoff medzi agentmi a kde vznikajú zlyhania. Evaluácie AI správania — návrh praktických testov a metrík pre kvalitu odpovedí, retrievalu, memory recallu, handoffov a práce s dátami. Prototypovanie — tvorba rýchlych experimentov v Pythone alebo notebookoch a príprava odporúčaní pre engineering. Výstupom tvojej práce nebudú len poznámky z paperov, ale najmä testovateľné hypotézy, prototypy, evaluačné návrhy a odporúčania, ktoré vie Core alebo Datamap tím reálne použiť. Požiadavky: Must-have dobré porozumenie moderným AI/ML princípom, najmä LLM a NLP, znalosť práce s Pythonom na úrovni výskumného prototypovania, schopnosť čítať a kriticky vyhodnocovať papers, blogy, benchmarky a technické prístupy, praktické chápanie aspoň niektorých oblastí: RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, information retrieval, agentic workflows, memory/context management, schopnosť prekladať výskumné nápady do testovateľných hypotéz, analytické myslenie a schopnosť jasne vysvetliť, čo si zistil/a a prečo na tom záleží, ochota pracovať aj na úlohách, ktoré sa postupne vyvíjajú a nemajú od začiatku úplne jasné zadanie. Nice-to-have PhD štúdium alebo výskumná skúsenosť v oblasti AI, ML, NLP, information retrieval, knowledge representation alebo príbuznej oblasti, znalosť ML algoritmov a prístupov: regression, trees & boosting, clustering, dimensionality reduction, time-series forecasting, neural networks & transformers, model evaluation a feature engineering, skúsenosť s LLM frameworkmi a nástrojmi ako LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, DSPy, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs alebo Hugging Face, skúsenosť s evaluačnými frameworkmi pre LLM aplikácie, znalosť knowledge graphs, ontológií alebo semantic search, publikácie, výskumné projekty alebo diplomovú/dizertačnú prácu v relevantnej oblasti, schopnosť pracovať s Gitom a základným engineering workflowom, dobrý cit pre product relevance – rozlíšiť, čo je technicky zaujímavé a čo je reálne užitočné pre používateľa.

Chez Trickstr, on ne cherche pas quelqu’un qui code dans son coin. On cherche un(e) ingénieur(e) confirmé(e) capable de comprendre les enjeux stratégiques de nos clients — grands groupes du CAC 40 pour l’essentiel — et de transformer ces enjeux en solutions data & IA qui tournent, qui délivrent, et qui changent la donne. 🎯 Trickstr en 30 secondes Trickstr est une société tech française spécialisée en data intelligence et IA appliquées aux enjeux stratégiques, réputationnels et décisionnels des organisations. Nous transformons des volumes massifs de données — presse, réseaux sociaux, sources institutionnelles, données propriétaires, etc. — en insights actionnables pour les directions générales et les Comex. 🚀 Ce que tu vas faire Tu travailleras sur nos missions client les plus stratégiques. Ton rôle : aller du problème métier à la solution en production, en autonomie, avec le soutien de l’équipe. Développement produit & features Concevoir et développer de nouvelles features pour nos études et pour nos outils : pipelines de données, systèmes de RAG, scoring dynamique, dashboards interactifs. Adapter et créer des datasets sur-mesure pour chaque mission client (nettoyage, enrichissement, structuration, feature engineering). Concevoir des algorithmes adaptés aux problématiques spécifiques : détection de signaux faibles, analyse de sentiment, cartographie de réseaux d’influence, modélisation prédictive. Prototyper rapidement puis industrialiser : passer du notebook au service exploité en production (APIs, jobs planifiés, intégrations). Expérience concrète avec les LLM : appels d’API (OpenAI, Anthropic…), prompt engineering, RAG, évaluation de modèles. Tu comprends les enjeux de coût, latence, qualité et biais. Solide en manipulation de données : nettoyage, normalisation, enrichissement, feature engineering. Tu ne fais pas confiance aveuglément à un modèle. Bonus appréciés : knowledge graphs (Neo4j), BDD vectorielles, Elasticsearch, Docker, GCP. Daarbij stuur je op drie dingen: sneller werken, betere antwoorden en minder repetitief werk voor de eindgebruiker. De uitdaging Generatieve AI ontwikkelt zich razendsnel. Toch willen organisaties voorspelbare en gerichte oplossingen die passen in hun informatievoorziening en processen. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals de overheid, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Je werkt met de nieuwste frontier modellen en met platformen als Databricks, AWS Bedrock en Azure Foundry. Daarmee verken en bouw je robuuste implementaties: agentic workflows, LLM-teksttransformaties en RAG. Vaak pak je oplossingen op die in het lab veelbelovend bleken, en zet jij de laatste stap naar een echt proces. Evaluatie, feedback, monitoring en kostenbeheersing zijn daarbij geen bijzaak. Juist daardoor ontstaat de kwaliteit en het vertrouwen waarmee een oplossing landt. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat wel én niet kan met AI. Je brengt pragmatische kennis in en zet door tot echte gebruikers jouw AI-output inzetten bij hun taken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij het AI&Data Engineering squad. Daar werk je met Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Samen bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot strak gemonitorde workflows met meerdere agents op Azure Foundry. Ons doel is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland worden, en daar heb jij directe invloed op. Om de twee weken komen alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag. Die dag is er tijd om te leren, kennis te delen en elkaar te spreken. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als developer of data scientist, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met GenAI toepassingen. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met het open source LLM-ecosysteem, zoals LangChain, DeepEval of DSPy. Ervaring met commerciële opties, zoals AWS AgentCore of Microsoft Agent Framework. Ervaring met serving tools, zoals FastAPI, FastMCP, serverless of containeromgevingen. Ervaring met monitoring en promptbeheer met MLflow of cloud native tools, of de drive om je daarin te verdiepen. Je begrijpt hoe LLMs en andere generatieve AI werken en je volgt de ontwikkeling van prompt naar context naar harness engineering. Je weet dat serieuze toepassingen strikte evaluatie, goede monitoring en feedbackloops vragen, en je bouwt die er vanaf het begin in. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar ben je wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling. Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen over deze rol? Neem contact op met Raoel via raoel.fatehmahomed@linkit.nl of via +31638859892. Over ons LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. The platform is already making a meaningful difference to people's everyday lives, with technology playing a central role in delivering valuable, personalised experiences. Commercial experience designing, building and deploying AI/LLM-powered applications into production. Experience integrating LLMs, APIs and retrieval systems into software products. Experience with RAG, tool calling, LLM orchestration and evaluation frameworks would be particularly relevant, alongside exposure to cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry or Google Vertex AI. items.desc:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description
You will integrate Sonar’s business-critical systems (e.g. Salesforce, Stripe, NetSuite) and build standalone solutions for specific needs. This will typically involve applying AWS event-driven architecture to solve internal user needs via a scalable and reliable end-to-end business platform.
You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of these solutions (architecture, to implementation, to ongoing monitoring and maintenance/improvements), working directly and in close partnership with business functions (e.g. Sales, Finance, Product).
Your work (reliable, scalable, performant and secure applications) and skills (ability to translate complex business needs, coupled with a strong sense of ownership, urgency and partnership) will make you a trusted partner who drives significant efficiency and process improvements for the company.

What you will do:
Design, build and maintain serverless, event-driven integrations on AWS (Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager).
 Evaluate in-house and third-party API options, based on Sonar’s specific operating context.
 Build in-house web applications when third-party applications are unsuitable or unavailable.
 Ensure non-functional requirements (e.g. security, scalability, reliability) are addressed, on an ongoing basis (e.g. monitoring UI, health-checks, alerts and notifications).
 Work with stakeholders to understand requirements (stated as well as implied), document design decisions for peer-review/challenge.
 Follow governance principles (e.g. least-privilege IAM, secret management), processes (e.g. change management approvals) and tools (e.g. CI/CD to ship changes safely).
Experience and qualifications:
5+ years of professional full-stack development experience.
 Proficiency in working with and steering AI coding tools (Codex, Claude, etc).
 Hands-on AWS experience with serverless services and event-driven design.
 Strong skills in a modern language (TypeScript preferred).
 Clear written/verbal communication and experience with business/technical stakeholders.
 Stripe/Salesforce integration will be a significant plus; Databricks experience nice to have.
 Experience running production on-call for business-critical integrations.
 Proactive, driven and attention to detail - willingness to take ownership.
In-office culture
We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 
Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.
 
We value diversity, equity, and inclusion
At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com. 
All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 
Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

 We Are 
 At Synopsys, we're shaping the future of innovation from silicon to systems. 
 Building on decades of leadership in semiconductor design and electronic systems, the addition of ANSYS brings together world-class expertise in simulation, analysis, and engineering solutions. Together, we empower customers to design, test, and optimise everything from advanced semiconductor technologies and AI-powered systems to autonomous vehicles, aerospace platforms, industrial equipment, and next-generation products. 
 By combining industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation, and digital engineering technologies, we help organisations accelerate innovation, reduce development risk, and bring breakthrough products to market faster. 
 Together, we're enabling the innovations that will define tomorrow. 
 You Are 
 You know power devices from the inside out: how they are built, packaged, and used, and more importantly, how they fail. Maybe you came up through thermo-mechanical reliability engineering, or maybe you spent years designing power devices and power electronics. Either way, you understand that simulation is not about running tools, it is about asking the right question at the right stage and trusting the answer enough to act on it. 
 Every load cycle is a temperature swing. Every swing stresses the hardware. CTE mismatch drives solder fatigue, wire bond lift-off, and delamination, and you have learned to turn mission profiles into lifetime predictions that actually hold up on the test bench. You treat electrical, thermal, and mechanical behaviour as one coupled problem because you have seen electrically optimal designs fail in the field when someone ignored the physics. 
 You can walk into a room with a customer's engineering team, quickly understand their device technology, packaging constraints, and reliability targets, then map a simulation strategy that fits their workflow. Strong opinions about application engineering come naturally to you. You push back on fragile workflows, on feature requests that miss the real problem, and on treating reliability as an afterthought. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Shape customers' simulation strategies by partnering with senior power electronics teams to understand their roadmaps, reliability goals, and constraints, then define workflows aligned with their design processes 
 Build die-to-board Multiphysics workflows that couple electrical, thermal, and structural analysis across the substrate, package, and PCB to predict hotspots, warpage, and interconnect fatigue before they reach the lab 
 Drive thermal-mechanical reliability by turning mission profiles into junction temperature cycling, predicting solder fatigue, wire bond lift-off, and delamination, and correlating the results with power cycling and test data 
 Prove value on real designs by leading technical evaluations and benchmarks that show measurable impact, not just impressive demos 
 Be the voice of the customer by challenging fragile workflows, bringing R&D feature requests grounded in real problems, and helping shape the product roadmap 
 Scale expertise by creating best practices, application notes, and training materials that help customers and colleagues get more out of the tools 
 Support field and digital marketing by contributing to technical content, customer case studies, and industry events focused on thermal-mechanical and reliability for power semiconductor applications 
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Enable customers in data centre power delivery, electric vehicle powertrains, and renewable energy systems to accelerate their product development cycles and improve performance metrics through better simulation workflows 
 Drive adoption and expansion of Ansys solutions across the power electronics segment by proving technical value in real customer design environments 
 Shape the product roadmap for power electronics simulation by channelling deep customer insight and application requirements back to engineering teams 
 Build repeatable, scalable workflows that become the standard methodology for electrothermal, thermomechanical, and reliability simulation in power module and PMIC design 
 Reduce time-to-revenue for strategic accounts by solving technical blockers, proving ROI, and ensuring customers can deploy and scale Ansys tools independently 
 Contribute to the long-term growth of the Ansys business within Synopsys by turning technical wins into commercial momentum and customer loyalty

items.desc: Cerchiamo un AI Developer / AI Engineer per sviluppare applicazioni basate su LLM, pipeline RAG e sistemi multi-agente. Seguirai le funzionalità dall’analisi dei documenti e delle fonti dati fino allo sviluppo delle API, alla valutazione della qualità e al monitoraggio in produzione. Compenso da 210 a 280 € al giorno. Attività Sviluppare applicazioni agentiche con LangGraph e LangChain , definendo lo stato dei workflow, le condizioni di routing e le modalità di chiamata ai tool. Progettare sistemi multi-agente con ruoli, passaggi di contesto e criteri di terminazione espliciti. Analizzare i documenti prima dell’ingestion , valutando formati, struttura, qualità del testo, presenza di scansioni e tabelle, metadati e permessi di accesso. Scegliere le strategie di parsing, OCR, normalizzazione e chunking in base al corpus. Realizzare pipeline RAG end-to-end , dalla generazione degli embedding e dall’indicizzazione fino al retrieval, al reranking e alla generazione di risposte con riferimenti alle fonti. Gestire aggiornamenti e rimozioni dei documenti dall’indice. Sviluppare server MCP per esporre tool e risorse a client AI, con validazione degli input, gestione degli errori e controlli di accesso. Valutare la qualità dei sistemi LLM con DeepEval o strumenti equivalenti , costruendo dataset di test e valutazioni di regressione. Misurare la rilevanza del retrieval, l’aderenza delle risposte alle fonti e il corretto utilizzo dei tool. Ottimizzare consumo di token, costi e latenza intervenendo su selezione del modello, dimensione del contesto, caching e limiti di esecuzione degli agenti. Misurare l’impatto delle modifiche sulla qualità delle risposte. Sviluppare backend Python con FastAPI e Pydantic , integrare API e servizi esterni, gestire le attività di ingestion in background e distribuire i servizi tramite Docker e pipeline CI/CD. Monitorare le applicazioni in produzione con log strutturati, metriche e tracing delle chiamate a modelli e tool. Gestire timeout, retry, rate limit e fallimenti parziali dei workflow. Requisiti Esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di applicazioni LLM in Python , con competenze di progettazione API, programmazione asincrona e testing. Esperienza con LangGraph e LangChain nello sviluppo di workflow agentici e multi-agente, inclusi tool calling e output strutturati. Esperienza nella costruzione di pipeline documentali e RAG , con conoscenza di embedding, ricerca vettoriale, ricerca ibrida e reranking. Esperienza nello sviluppo di server MCP e nell’integrazione di modelli con API, basi dati e servizi esterni. Capacità di definire metriche di qualità e implementare valutazioni ripetibili con DeepEval o librerie equivalenti. Esperienza con FastAPI, Docker, Git e CI/CD , oltre a familiarità con la gestione delle configurazioni e dei segreti nei diversi ambienti. Conoscenza delle pratiche di sicurezza per applicazioni LLM, tra cui mitigazione del prompt injection, autorizzazione per documento e per tool, e gestione dei dati sensibili. Esperienza con PostgreSQL e pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch o altri motori di ricerca vettoriale. Esperienza con code di messaggi e worker per pipeline di ingestion asincrone e rieseguibili. Familiarità con OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse o strumenti equivalenti per osservabilità e analisi dei costi. Esperienza con il deployment su AWS e con il versionamento di prompt, modelli e configurazioni di retrieval. Retribuzione: €210,00 - €280,00 al giorno Sede di lavoro: Da remoto

items.desc: Andersen is hiring a Data Scientist for a project developing a large-scale media intelligence platform and delivering AI-powered audience analytics solutions. The company is a global technology provider delivering data analytics and AI-powered solutions that help organizations better understand customer behavior, optimize marketing performance, and make informed business decisions. By transforming large volumes of data into actionable insights, it enables enterprises to improve audience engagement, measure the effectiveness of their initiatives, and enhance decision-making. The company works with a diverse range of customers, supporting them in navigating an increasingly data-driven and rapidly evolving digital landscape. The project is focused on developing a large-scale media intelligence platform that analyzes consumer engagement across TV, digital, and connected devices. It leverages real-time, consented data to deliver audience insights, content analytics, and data-driven solutions for media and advertising. Responsibilities Owning end-to-end delivery of significant data science projects — from problem scoping and approach design through to production deployment. Making sound, independently-reasoned decisions on methodology, model selection, and evaluation; documenting them clearly in technical solution documents covering problem statement, approach, metrics, and timeline. Leading solution design for your own initiatives. Breaking down complex epics into well-scoped user stories with clear acceptance criteria, adopting DataOps and MLOps best practices throughout — experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, model monitoring, and reproducibility. Building production-quality Python and PySpark code on Databricks — well-tested, documented, and reusable — and implement advanced ML and AI-powered workflows including entity resolution, probabilistic record linkage, embedding-based matching, semantic similarity, and LLM-augmented pipelines. Developing and maintaining reusable tools, libraries, and documentation that improve team efficiency and technical standards. Conducting code reviews with constructive, specific feedback that raises the bar. Mentoring junior data scientists on technical execution, code quality, and career development. Leading internal talks or workshops on ML topics. Collaborating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and operations — translating business requirements into technical specifications, partner with data engineering on scalable pipeline design, and participate in cross-functional design reviews and working groups. Requirements Hands-on experience in Data Science, including ownership of complex, multi-sprint projects for 3+ years. Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field (Master's degree preferred). Advanced proficiency in Python, including writing production-quality, well-tested, and well-documented code. Strong experience with SQL and PySpark, including processing datasets at billion-row scale. Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Workflows, Delta Lake, and job orchestration. Working knowledge of AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Strong foundation in Machine Learning, including regression, classification, clustering, model evaluation, and experimental design. Experience with MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, Airflow-based pipeline orchestration, and reproducible model deployment. Familiarity with modern AI technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM-based applications, vector databases, and semantic search. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation, user story creation, and cross-functional collaboration. Level of English – from Intermediate+ and above. Desired skills Knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, or semantic data modeling (RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent). Experience with probabilistic record linkage, identity graph approaches, and embedding-based entity matching at scale. Experience with causal inference methods, including A/B testing, synthetic control, and uplift modeling. Experience with deduplication, data enrichment, or web-to-TV linkage problems. Background in media, ad tech, or measurement specifically: TV viewership (ACR/STB data), digital audience modeling, cross-platform measurement (linear + CTV/OTT), identity resolution in privacy-constrained environments. Familiarity with the measurement/identity vendor landscape: Nielsen, Comscore, LiveRamp, The Trade Desk.
