items.desc: About Oper Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency. The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment. A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium. Now, we're looking for an AI Solutions Engineer to join our AI Squad and help shape the future of automated mortgages in Europe and beyond. Your Mission You'll join the AI Squad , the team building Herman. This is a hands-on, hybrid role spanning AI engineering, product management, and solutions architecture . You'll scope and build working AI prototypes, take them in front of real banks to pressure-test against live mortgage workflows, and work alongside the team to turn these into working Herman features. You own delivery end-to-end: from a rough use case to a shipped capability, communicating progress clearly the whole way. This is an applied role, not a research one. We want a builder who can both code and collaborate, who is comfortable in front of a client in the morning and deep in a codebase in the afternoon. Tasks What you'll do Scope and build working AI prototypes - LLMs, RAG, agentic automation, and integrations - that solve concrete origination problems. Engage directly with clients : run workshops, gather requirements, demo, and iteratively refine solutions against the real workflows of regulated banks. Define and manage AI use cases , structuring them functionally so they can scale beyond a single client. Work closely within your team to turn validated prototypes into production features. Own delivery timelines and communicate progress clearly to both clients and internal stakeholders. Work AI-native Building agentic software is the job, and we expect you to build the way you ship: AI-first. Write code AI-first: agents produce the bulk of your code under your direction, while you own the architecture, integrations, review, and quality. We measure your output in shipped value, not hand-typed lines. Build agentic workflows that do real work: scaffolding prototypes and integrations from a spec, generating and running tests, drafting evaluation harnesses, and reviewing diffs. Use modern AI tooling as the default way you build, configure, and debug, not as an occasional helper. Aim for a delivery cadence a non-AI-native engineer simply cannot match, and help us raise the bar on what an AI-native delivery function looks like at Oper. Requirements What you'll bring 4 to 6 years of experience in software development, with hands-on AI/LLM work. Strong with Python and modern AI tooling: LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, orchestration, and evaluation . Able to structure projects functionally and own delivery end-to-end , from scoping to shipped feature. Comfortable being client-facing : running workshops, gathering requirements, and translating ambiguity into working software. Comfortable working with flexible and loosely defined requirements, bringing your own structure where needed. Genuinely AI-native : agents already write most of your code and you build agentic workflows to multiply your output. You can name the tools, the workflows, and the concrete recent projects where AI gave you real leverage. Excellent communication skills. Creative and analytical mindset. Ambition to learn, experiment, and grow while staying humble and open-minded. Fluency in English; additional languages (e.g. Dutch, German) are a plus. Experience in a relevant industry (financial services) and thriving in a scale-up environment are a plus. This is an applied, client-facing, cross-functional role. We are not looking for researchers, "idea people," or internal-only engineers. items.desc: Your role ECMWF is looking to recruit a User Services Specialist (A2) in the Forecasts and Services Department. As part of the User Solutions Team, you will contribute to the ongoing development of ECMWF’s data services combining direct work with users with the design and delivery of tools, interfaces and AI-assisted capabilities that make our data easier to find, access and use. You will work closely with a wide range of users, scientists, software engineers, product owners and external contractors to understand needs, investigate complex problems and help improve the services that our users rely upon every day. A significant part of the role involves providing advanced support to users. This includes analysing queries, understanding what users are trying to achieve, troubleshooting issues and providing advice and solutions in a timely, professional manner. Some queries can be resolved directly, while more complex issues require collaboration with scientists, software engineers and other experts to identify root causes and develop effective solutions. The role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys helping users, solving technical problems and working collaboratively to improve systems, processes and services. You will bring initiative, curiosity and a proactive, hands-on approach, combining excellent communication skills with an eagerness to investigate issues in-depth and help implement practical solutions. About the User Solutions Team The User Solutions Team (currently 7 people) is part of the User Services Section and plays a central role in supporting users of ECMWF’s data services for its Member States as well as to commercial, research and public users. The Team assists users with data access, technical enquiries, troubleshooting and guidance on the effective use of ECMWF services. Your software runs on real hardware in the field, often within weeks of the first idea, and you work next to the hardware and embedded engineers who build the system around it. Deploy and optimise AI and computer vision models on edge compute such as NVIDIA Jetson, within real size, weight and power limits. Integrate sensors and payloads in software: drivers, data pipelines, time synchronisation and calibration. Connect prototypes to Quantum Systems platforms and to MOSAIC through clean interfaces: APIs, middleware and message protocols. Build simulation, test and data-logging tools so that every field test produces usable data. Join field tests and fix problems on site. Write code that line engineering can take over: structured, tested and documented. Senior level: define the software architecture of a prototype, make technology choices, review code and mentor junior engineers. What you bring to the team: Degree in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, physics or a related field. Strong C++ and/or Python, and a Linux development environment. Experience in at least one of our domains: Air, Land, Sea or Software. Interest in software that runs on hardware, outside the data centre. Willingness to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Business-fluent English. German is a strong advantage. Strong adventage: Defence experience, or a working understanding of how armed forces use unmanned systems and what is being built for them right now. ROS 2, PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, DDS, GStreamer. Processing radar, electronic warfare or signal intelligence data; software-defined radio (e.g. GNU Radio). Model optimisation with CUDA or TensorRT. Docker, CI/CD and automated testing for embedded targets. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. items.desc: DESCRIPTION Do you want to build the system that tells millions of engineers the moment something goes wrong? As a Software Development Engineer on Amazon CloudWatch Alarms, you will design and operate the service that continuously evaluates customer metrics and logs, and acts on them in real time — notifying on-call teams, scaling fleets, and recovering resources, often while the rest of a customer's infrastructure is under stress. When our customers have an incident, our alarms have to be right and on time — that is the problem you will work on every day. CloudWatch is the observability service of Amazon Web Services (AWS), used by developers, site reliability engineers (SREs), system operators, and IT managers to monitor their applications and infrastructure. CloudWatch processes quadrillions of metric observations every month and continuosly evaluates millions of alarms, with tight latency and correctness requirements. This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. Key job responsibilities Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Design, build and operate highly available distributed systems that evaluate customer alarms and trigger notifications and automated actions across AWS. Deliver new alarming capabilities — from composite alarms to anomaly detection — from design through launch in every AWS Region. Dive deep into operational issues, identify root causes, and put fixes in place that prevent them from recurring. Collaborate with partner teams across CloudWatch and AWS to turn customer requirements into designs and incremental, safe deliverables. Mentor junior engineers and share what you learn through design and code reviews. A day in the life You might start the day investigating why a customer's alarm changed state later than expected, then join a design review for a new capability that lets customers monitor thousands of resources with a single alarm. In the afternoon, you could profile the evaluation path to cut latency and cost. AI coding assistants and agents are part of how you work every day — you'll use them to explore unfamiliar code, prototype ideas, write tests, and speed up investigations, freeing up more of your time for design and hard problems. This role includes participating in an on-call rotation for the services the team owns. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we build our systems to be fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so we don't get paged for the same issue twice. About the team CloudWatch Alarms is how AWS customers learn that something needs their attention. Our customers range from startups to the largest enterprises, and teams across Amazon rely on our alarms to keep their own services healthy. Our vision is for every alarm to be timely, accurate and actionable at any scale. Over the next few years we're focused on making alarms easier to set up across large, changing environments and smarter about what truly needs a human's attention — and you will help shape that roadmap. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we've built an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers enjoy mentoring engineers at every stage, including those from non-traditional backgrounds, through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We assign projects based on what will help you grow into a well-rounded engineer, so you can take on more complex work over time. Strong software engineering background, complemented by hands-on experience in Data Engineering, with proven ability to take ownership of system design and end-to-end delivery Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write and optimize complex queries across large datasets, combined with solid data modeling and data warehouse design fundamentals Strong software engineering principles and practices, including clean code, DRY, SOLID, automated testing, CI/CD, and observability, with a focus on simple and maintainable solutions Proven system and platform design capabilities, including ownership of architectural decisions, the ability to justify technical trade-offs, and experience with greenfield development, platform scaling, or migration initiatives. items.desc: Inspiring MiPU è la software house del gruppo MiPU, dove si svolge l’attività di ricerca e sviluppo in ambito data science e software development . La nostra missione è portare predizione e cognizione nelle fabbriche e nelle città, utilizzando i dati già presenti per anticipare eventi futuri e ottimizzare le risorse umane, materiali e finanziarie. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con persone curiose e appassionate di Intelligenza Artificiale, per unirsi a noi e portare l’innovazione nelle industrie e nelle nostre città per favorire uno sviluppo sostenibile. Posizione: Obiettivo della Tesi: Il core product è una piattaforma avanzata che permette l'orchestrazione di pipeline di operazioni complesse su flussi di dati industriali. Per elevare l'esperienza utente e massimizzare l'automazione, l'azienda intende introdurre un modulo di Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa basato su Large Language Models (LLM). Il candidato/a lavorerà all'evoluzione dell'architettura software esistente, inserendo uno strato di astrazione intelligente. L'obiettivo principale è permettere all'utente finale di definire, configurare e variare le pipeline di analisi dati utilizzando il linguaggio naturale . Il fulcro della ricerca scientifica e tecnologica risiederà nel garantire il mantenimento del determinismo assoluto e della sicurezza del sistema , traducendo l'output "creativo" dell'LLM in configurazioni rigide, strutturate (es. JSON Schema) e validate prima dell'esecuzione sui dati di produzione. Attività Previste: Analisi e R&D: Studio dello stato dell'arte dei framework di orchestrazione LLM (es. LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) e delle tecniche di Structured Output e Function Calling . Progettazione Architetturale: Definizione dello strato di interfaccia tra il modulo GenAI e il backend deterministico esistente. Sviluppo Software: Implementazione di agenti software capaci di tradurre i prompt dell'utente in pipeline operative e sviluppo dei relativi sistemi di validazione ( Guardrails ). Testing e Benchmarking: Valutazione delle performance del sistema in termini di latenza, costi (token management), accuratezza delle pipeline generate e gestione delle eccezioni/allucinazioni. Stack Tecnologico di Riferimento: Backend: [Inserire linguaggio principale, es: Python / Go / Node.js] AI/LLM: OpenAI API / Azure OpenAI / Modelli Open-Source Locali (Mistral, Llama via vLLM/Ollama), Pydantic. Architettura: API REST/gRPC, Programmazione asincrona e code di messaggi. Affiancamento e Mentoring: Il tesista sarà inserito nel team di sviluppo e sarà affiancato costantemente da due figure senior: Un Senior Backend Developer (per gli aspetti di architettura software e integrazione di sistema). Un AI Engineer (per la supervisione strategica dei modelli, prompt engineering avanzato e LLMOps). Requisiti: Requisiti del Candidato: Iscrizione al corso di Laurea Magistrale in Informatica / Ingegneria Informatica. Ottime basi di programmazione backend e progettazione di API. Familiarità (anche tramite progetti personali o esami universitari) con il mondo dei Large Language Models e delle relative API. Attitudine al problem solving e precisione (trattandosi di contesti industriali critici). Altre informazioni: Cosa offriamo: Possibilità di tesi Magistrale Progetto retribuito full time (6 mesi): € 1.000 netti/mese Ambiente dinamico, giovane e in crescita Possibilità di assunzione e piano di sviluppo post-stage Formazione reale su strumenti, progetti e strategie attuali L’offerta è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77)

Une sensibilité à la software engineering est particulièrement appréciée : architecture, APIs, Git, tests, qualité du code… Compétences Collaboration Travail d'équipe Respect Ce que vous allez trouver chez nous Vous rejoindrez une équipe travaillant directement avec les métiers sur des problématiques réelles et avec un objectif simple : passer rapidement d’une idée à une solution qui crée de la valeur. Vous travaillerez sur plusieurs typologies de cas d’usage et découvrir différentes problématiques d’un groupe international spécialisé dans les semences potagères. Le stage offre également une grande liberté pour tester de nouvelles approches et technologies autour de l’IA générative et des agents IA. Vous bénéficierez d’un accompagnement sur-mesure. items.desc: Job Description Start your career where innovation meets real impact. Sapiens Accelerate is our global Early Careers Programme, designed for graduates with up to 18 months of experience, who are ready to learn, contribute, and shape the future of insurance. From day one, you'll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with experts across the business, build practical AI skills, and develop the capabilities needed to thrive in a global technology company. Role purpose: The L2 Support Engineer handles escalated, complex, and technically demanding issues that go beyond L0 scope, including data-related, AI coding, configuration, integration, and -behaviour problems specific to our AIP product. As L3/engineering is not part of this organisation, the L2 role also acts as the technical bridge to the FDE’s. Additionally working with, product/engineering/cloud team when a defect or product limitation is confirmed and owns the resolution process end-to-end from a support perspective. Job Requirements Experience: • 0–18 months technical support, application support, or a related engineering-adjacent role Skills & Competencies: • Strong analytical and root-cause troubleshooting skills • Demonstrated knowledge to enable troubleshooting Python, TypeScript, Java, and modern AI/LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain). • Knowledge of Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), Kubernetes, containerization, SQL/vector databases, and REST APIs. • Experience with ticketing and monitoring tools (Zendesk/Jira, log aggregators such as ELK/Splunk/Datadog, APM tools) • Basic understanding of REST APIs, integrations, and system architecture • Ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences • Strong ownership mentality — able to drive an issue to resolution without L3 backup • Ability to support development of L0 AI agents with creation of knowledge and other artifacts • Comfortable working with sensitive/regulated data and following change control processes • Working with AI Agents as part of support team Education: • Bachelor of Science (BSc) or Master of Science (MSc) • Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science / Analytics, Software Engineering, AI • Other highly quantitative or STEM fields (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, or Management Information Systems), Language: • Fluent in English Success metrics (KPIs): • Escalated ticket resolution time within SLA • Root-cause identification rate (vs. workaround-only resolutions) • Quality and speed of engineering handover documentation for confirmed defects • Reduction in repeat/recurring escalations • CSAT on escalated/complex cases • L0 knowledge base contribution impact • AI Usage Job Responsibilities • Own tickets conducting deep-dive technical investigation and root-cause analysis • Software Design & Architecture: Understanding how large-scale enterprise systems connect via APIs. • Data Structures & Algorithms: Maintaining clean, optimized performance under high-pressure real-world environments. • Cloud Computing & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes. • Applied AI / Machine Learning: Understanding Generative AI workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases—which are heavily used in modern FDE roles • Trouble Shooting: Reproduce complex issues in test/staging environments • Distinguish between user error, configuration issues, code errors, and genuine product defects • Manage the interface with Engineering/Product for confirmed bugs: prepare technical write-ups, reproduction steps, business impact assessments; track fixes through release and validate with the customer • Support and adjust L0 Agents: review escalations, provide troubleshooting guidance, contribute to L0 AI agent training • Own and expand the technical knowledge base (advanced troubleshooting guides, known-issue articles, workarounds) • Perform basic data corrections/queries where appropriate and within governance guidelines (e.g., SQL scripts under change control) • Support integration-related troubleshooting (APIs, file feeds, third-party connections common in insurance ecosystems: policy admin, claims, payment providers) • Participate in post-incident reviews and contribute to problem management • Ensure all actions and data changes are properly documented and auditable, in line with insurance industry compliance requirements Reporting to: Customer Support Team Lead / Manager

Unser Expansionskurs geht steil nach oben: Über 100'000 zufriedene Kunden, mehr als 7'000 Treuhand-Partner und ein starkes Team von über 150 motivierten Mitarbeitenden sprechen für sich. Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst skalierbare KI-gestützte Funktionen in unseren Produkten, die von mehr als 100.000 Kunden genutzt werden. Du arbeitest intensiv mit Large Language Models (LLMs), um Lösungen für NLP, Conversational AI und generative KI-Anwendungsfälle zu entwickeln. Du arbeitest mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um KI-gesteuerte Funktionen und Anwendungen zu entwerfen. Du treibst Innovationen voran, indem du die neuesten KI-Technologien erforschst und neue Ansätze für unsere geschäftlichen Herausforderungen vorschlägst. Hochschulabschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich mit praktischer Erfahrung als AI Engineer, ML Engineer oder Fullstack Software Engineer bei der Entwicklung skalierbarer, sicherer KI-Features (bevorzugt im SaaS-Umfeld). Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle Hochschulabschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich mit praktischer Erfahrung als AI Engineer, ML Engineer oder Fullstack Software Engineer bei der Entwicklung skalierbarer, sicherer KI-Features (bevorzugt im SaaS-Umfeld). Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Umgebungen (GCP), KI-Plattformen (Vertex AI) und modernen KI-Orchestrierungs-Frameworks (z. B. Google ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex). Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Prompt Engineering und der Bereitstellung von LLMs für reale Geschäftsanwendungen. Fortgeschrittene Python-Programmierkenntnisse, Erfahrung mit KI/ML-Bibliotheken und -Frameworks, solides Backend-Wissen (async, REST, Testing, Security) sowie Erfahrung mit Datenbanken wie MongoDB oder Redis. Darauf kannst du dich freuen Hybrid-Modell und Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen. 5 Wochen Ferien plus Option auf unbezahlten Urlaub. Yoga, Bootcamps, Massagen und legendäre Grill-Sessions. 16 Wochen Mutterschafts- und 3 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub. bexio übernimmt 63 % deiner Pensionskassenbeiträge – für mehr Netto vom Lohn.

items.card: What You'll Be Doing... Creating SDKs, APIs, prompt libraries, agent harnesses and golden paths that make AI-native engineering the easy default for our technology teams. items.desc: Role: AI Platform Engineer Location: Hybrid (Clapham Junction 3 days a week) We're The Gym Group... We're one of the UK's leading fitness businesses. With more than one million members, 265+ gyms and ambitious plans to keep growing, we're the UK's second-largest gym operator by membership and the fourth largest in Europe. Our mission is simple: to break down barriers to fitness for all. We're large enough to make a meaningful difference, but agile enough for individuals to influence how we grow. Technology, data and new ideas play a central role - and you'll have the opportunity to take ownership, challenge how things are done and see the impact of your work. Just as importantly, we're a people-first business where everyone is encouraged to be themselves. We've been named one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work and awarded Investors in People Gold, alongside a host of other awards recognising our culture and our people. What You'll Be Doing... Creating SDKs, APIs, prompt libraries, agent harnesses and golden paths that make AI-native engineering the easy default for our technology teams. Building and running the shared AI platform: model access and routing, identity, secrets, monitoring and connectors to enterprise data and collaboration systems. Building the integrations and shared context that make enterprise AI services genuinely useful to colleagues across the business, with access that respects existing permissions. Designing and implementing technical guardrails and security controls - including audit logging, data isolation and action limits for agentic use - rather than relying on policy alone. Providing cost, usage and vendor visibility, and planning for model and provider change so we are never locked in to a single dependency. Partnering with the Applied AI Engineer, Tech Leads and AI Ambassadors to turn recurring needs into reusable platform capabilities. Keeping the platform to clear reliability and recovery standards, with observability, alerting and runbooks maintained with Site Reliability Engineering. Documenting what you build and sharing ownership across the team so the platform never depends on one person. What we're looking for... Practical, hands-on experience with AI tooling in production: coding agents, enterprise AI assistants, model APIs, retrieval-augmented generation and evaluation frameworks. Proven experience building and operating production platforms in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps or site reliability, with a developer-experience focus. Strong technical skills in Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Experience building developer-facing products - SDKs, APIs, templates, golden paths - and measuring their adoption and impact. Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs and connectors with identity, secrets management and role-based access control built in. Proficiency in Python and at least one other production language. Experience managing cloud cost, capacity and vendor relationships, including FinOps principles. Need assistance? items.desc:
We Are Waiting for You 
 Hi there! 
 I am Laura, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! 
 First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich ! 
 First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier. 
 Who Are We? 
 Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units. 
 In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions. 
 If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale. 
 What Can You Expect? 
 You’ll be joining our Retail Technology AI & Data team, the engine behind Zurich’s Retail Claims, Pricing and Underwriting (UW) solutions. This is where data, AI and cloud engineering directly shape how we protect our customers every day. In this team you will: 
 Turn complex business questions from Claims, Pricing and UW into robust data and AI products. 
 Work with high‑impact use cases: from smarter pricing models and straight‑through underwriting to faster, fairer claims decisions. 
 See your work in action: what you build goes into production, supports real decisions, and improves our customers’ experience in a measurable way. 
 Collaborate closely with actuaries, data scientists, product owners and business SMEs – you won’t be “just coding in a corner”, you’ll be co‑creating solutions that change how we do insurance. 
 And you might be thinking: This sounds great, but what will my day ‑ to ‑ day look like at TDC? 
 As a Data Engineer you will have the opportunity to: 
 Participate in the design and building of the end ‑ to ‑ end Data and AI solutions: Architect scalable, secure and observable data pipelines and services, from ingestion to production, following modern SDLC best practices. 
 Own data processing at scale in the cloud: Implement high‑performance ETL/ELT in AWS or Azure, leveraging Spark / Databricks (batch and real‑time) with a strong focus on data quality, lineage and reliability. 
 Participate in the Industrialization of ML & AI with solid MLOps and CI/CD: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.) for data platforms and ML products, enabling automated testing, deployment and monitoring across environments. 
 Develop and operate cloud ‑ native microservices: Design and implement microservices and APIs that expose data and AI capabilities, deployed in secure, resilient cloud environments. 
 Definition MLOps industrialization strategies: Shape how we productionise models: versioning, feature stores, monitoring, drift detection, and model lifecycle management, in close collaboration with Data Science and Architecture teams. 
 Bridge business and technology: Translate Claims, Pricing and UW requirements into robust technical architectures, influencing design decisions and ensuring our solutions are both feasible and valuable. 
 Building AI ‑ powered products with LLMs: Design and implement AI products based on LLMs, including prompt engineering, fine‑tuning, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) and agentic workflows that augment how our business teams work. 
 What Makes You a great Fit? 
 While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you! 
 Core technologies: Advanced Python, Databricks, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes or similar, Git or similar, LLMs, Spark, Azure DevOps or Jenkins 
 Python : 2-4 years building production ‑ grade data and backend solutions. 
 Cloud Engineering : 2 years on AWS or Azure, preferably in data ‑ intensive environments. 
 Databricks : 2-4 years experienced in working with this Cloud based data and AI platform 
 CI/CD & DevOps : 2 years designing multi ‑ cloud pipelines and automated deployments (infrastructure, data and ML). 
 Microservices: 2 years designing, implementing and operating distributed services and APIs. 
 Agentic AI / LLMs : 1-2 years integrating OpenAI, Anthropic, AI agents or MCP ‑ based services into real …

items.desc: Automation Engineer RFA is investing heavily in automation and AI to improve client experience, reduce ticket volume, and free our engineers for higher-value work. As an Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain automations across our RMM, PSA, security, and cloud platforms, combining traditional scripting with AI agents, SOAR playbooks, and RPA workflows. Your work will speed up ticket resolution, shorten the time to remediate vulnerabilities, and keep client environments secure, compliant, and consistently configured at scale. You will partner with our service desk, security, and project teams to find the best automation opportunities, deliver them safely, and measure the results. Responsibilities: You will work closely with other Automation Engineers to administer our server and workstation application monitoring and management platforms. You will provide programming/scripting assistance to support system automation, using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to accelerate development while reviewing, testing, and validating all AI-generated code. You will review known vulnerability findings and work to develop and deploy automated remediations to client systems. You will build, maintain, and optimize automation policies, scripts, monitors, and self-healing remediations across our RMM platforms (NinjaOne, ConnectWise Automate, etc.) for alert remediation, patching, software deployment, and configuration drift correction. You will design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents (e.g., Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, LLM APIs) to support ticket triage, summarization, documentation, and common issue remediation. You will develop and maintain SOAR playbooks that automate security alert enrichment, triage, and incident response, integrating with EDR, SIEM, email security, and PSA ticketing. You will build RPA and workflow automations (e.g., Rewst, Microsoft Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, n8n) that integrate PSA, RMM, documentation, and line-of-business systems through APIs and webhooks. You will establish guardrails for AI and automation, including human-in-the-loop review, testing, version control, logging, and data privacy controls that protect RFA and client data. You will work closely with our other departments to identify opportunities in automating tasks and workflows and provide solutions. You will perform complex configuration, change management and testing activities to support a service-oriented architecture and integration between all applications. items.desc: AI Software Engineer - Fintech - £85k - Remote We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer specialising in AI to take up a fully remote, permanent, full-time position within our Technology team. This is a forward-deployed role in the AI Innovation Lab, whose remit covers the whole organisation: accelerating engineering work, creating new product capabilities, and applying artificial intelligence directly to business operations. You will not sit in a single product team working through a fixed backlog. Instead you will move between problems across the business, scoping a use case with the people who own it, designing the solution, writing the production code, shipping it, and remaining with it until it demonstrably works. One month that might mean a document-extraction pipeline, the next an internal tool for a non-technical team, and the month after that an LLM integrated into an existing product workflow. The constant is end-to-end ownership, from identifying the problem to delivering a measured result. You will report to the Head of AI and work with colleagues across engineering, product, operations, and commercial teams. Your work will involve identifying, scoping, and delivering AI-driven solutions to business problems. You will design and build production systems that integrate large language models into real workflows, including retrieval-augmented generation, structured data extraction, and agentic automation. You will write, test, and maintain production code, conduct code reviews, and contribute to engineering standards. You will sit directly with non-technical stakeholders to turn business needs into technical requirements, and you will choose the right tool for each problem, including recognising when the simpler non-AI solution is the better one. We are looking for five to ten years of software engineering experience together with a deep understanding of how large language models work: their architecture, capabilities, failure modes, and how they behave in production. You should be able to reason about these systems from first principles, knowing why a retrieval pipeline degrades, why a model fails on a given input, and what evaluation actually tells you. Formal credentials are welcome but not required. Curiosity, and the habit of feeding it, is essential, because part of the role is learning things nobody on the team knows yet. Solid knowledge of database design and data modelling, front-end development with React and TypeScript, or cloud infrastructure specifically on AWS would be a significant advantage. Clear written and verbal communication is important, as is the ability to sit with a non-technical colleague, understand their actual problem, and translate it into something buildable. Self-discipline and a bias towards shipping are equally valued. You will work closely with the Head of AI, who has done this job himself. The relationship is not a queue of tickets handed down. You will be expected to bring your own view of how a problem should be solved, argue for it, and change minds when you are right. We expect to learn from you as much as you learn from us. The AI Innovation Lab is young, and the person who joins it now will shape what it becomes. If you are looking for a place to stay, learn, and build a body of work, this is that role.

items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




ROLE SUMMARY



We are seeking an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineer to build customer use cases on top of the Mistral stack for our defense, government and critical-infrastructure customers. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing cybersecurity-related agentic workflows focused on cyberdefense, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients — often in sovereign, on-premises or classified environments.

You will work with some of the most security-sensitive organizations in the world: government agencies, sovereign institutions and operators of critical infrastructure. They need AI that is powerful, controllable and deployable on their terms.



Why this role: 



you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence. You will work in a tight-knit team alongside elite experts in DFIR and cyberdefense — people who are passionate about their craft — and the patterns you implement at customer sites feed directly back into Mistral's internal use cases and products. Few roles put this much frontier technology this close to missions that matter.




WHAT YOU WILL DO



Client-Facing Agentic Solutions



 - You'll individually help deploy into production use cases with considerable business impact, with defense and government cybersecurity assignments as a priority

 - You'll work on state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving a crucial technological transformation together with our customers

 - Tackle iconic customer use cases that no existing solution on the market can address — from custom configuration of cybersecurity harnesses for cloud defense, to agentic alert triage and investigation, incident response automation, detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and security log analysis at scale

 - You'll be involved in pre-sales calls to understand potential customers' needs, challenges, and aspirations, providing technical guidance on our products and explaining Mistral technologies to various stakeholders

 - You'll collaborate with our product and science teams to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback

 - Ship secure by design. Apply least-privilege access, secrets management, authN/authZ best practices, audit logging, human-in-the-loop approval for high-impact actions, and defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration in agentic systems

 - Design and run evaluations that measure technical correctness, operational value and safety, so customers can trust what is being deployed

 - Own deployment end to end — observability, reliability, cost and latency tuning — including on-premises and air-gapped setups where customers require them




OUR PRINCIPLES



 - We care about people and outputs

 - What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

 - Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week

 - We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care

 - Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

 - No politics. Low ego, high standards

 - We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it




SECURITY & COMPLIANCE CRITERIA



 - Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now).

 - Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance




ABOUT YOU



 - You are fluent in French, with strong English — this customer set works in French

items.desc: Zélit est la plateforme digitale agile pour booster vos ventes. Le bon contenu, au bon moment, pour des présentations commerciales plus performantes. Chez Zélit, nos fonctionnalités sont développées avec des agents IA. Votre rôle est de les piloter comme on pilote une équipe : vous découpez une fonctionnalité, vous confiez les tâches à plusieurs agents en parallèle, vous relisez ce qu’ils livrent et vous menez le tout jusqu’à la production. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble de notre solution, du back-office web aux applications utilisées par les commerciaux. Date de début : janvier 2027 Lieu : Paris Salaire : 55 à 70 k€ brut annuel selon profil Vos missions Concevoir et spécifier les nouvelles fonctionnalités avec l’équipe Produit Les découper en tâches confiées à des agents IA (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…), sur plusieurs sujets à la fois Relire et valider le travail des agents : architecture, sécurité, performances, régressions Tester, documenter et mettre en production, côté front comme côté back Intégrer des fonctionnalités IA dans nos produits (LLM, RAG, agents) Faire évoluer nos pratiques de développement avec l’IA et les partager avec l’équipe Profil recherché Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en conduite de projets web ou mobiles, ou en développement Des produits livrés en production, dont vous pouvez parler en détail Une pratique intensive des outils de développement IA : vous savez faire travailler plusieurs agents en même temps sans perdre la main sur le résultat La culture technique nécessaire pour juger du code que vous n’avez pas écrit : repérer une régression, une faille de sécurité, une solution trop compliquée De bonnes bases en développement web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) et la pratique d’au moins un langage côté serveur De la rigueur sur les tests et la documentation Autonomie, curiosité et esprit d’équipe Atouts appréciés Connaissance de Ruby on Rails Expérience d’intégration d’API d’IA (LLM, RAG, agents, MCP) Docker, intégration continue, déploiement Développement mobile Expérience d’un SaaS B2B L’équipe Vous rejoindrez notre équipe Développement, qui gère les corrections et les évolutions de nos produits. Nous travaillons en cycles de 15 jours, dans un vrai environnement agile : Engagement, pour définir les objectifs de l’itération Daily meetings, pour échanger sur l’avancement et solliciter l’équipe en cas de blocage Fin d’itération, pour présenter les travaux réalisés Rétrospective, pour améliorer ensemble notre organisation Contact Envoyez votre CV et/ou votre profil LinkedIn à recrutement@zelit.com . items.desc: À propos de nous Le Groupe ISAGRI (3300 collaborateurs, 365 M€ de Chiffres d'Affaires, 12 filiales à l'international) est le 1er éditeur européen de logiciels pour le monde agricole et comptable et l'acteur majeur de l'information agricole (Groupe France Agricole, Terre-net Média). Classée depuis 10 ans au Palmarès Great Place to Work®, ISAGRI fait partie des meilleures entreprises en France où il fait bon travailler. Mission Le pôle Data & IA d'Isagri accompagne les équipes produit dans l'intégration de l'IA au sein de leurs solutions. Les systèmes agentiques constituent un axe majeur de cette ambition. Au-delà de leur conception, ces systèmes doivent être exploités, maintenus et sécurisés dans la durée, dans le respect des exigences de continuité de service et de souveraineté d'Isagri. Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur IA pour accompagner les équipes de la conception jusqu'à l'exploitation de leurs cas d'usage agentiques. La Mission Accompagnement des équipes produit Qualifier les cas d’usage agentiques : faisabilité, valeur ajoutée et risques. Concevoir les architectures adaptées (RAG, agents, workflows), choisir les modèles, outils et sources de données. Accompagner le développement et l’industrialisation des solutions, en favorisant la réutilisation des briques existantes. Mettre en place des évaluations et diffuser les bonnes pratiques de conception, de qualité et d’exploitation. Exploitation et évolution des systèmes Assurer le suivi des agents en production : qualité, coûts, performances, observabilité et gestion des incidents. Piloter les mises à jour des modèles et frameworks, avec des tests de non-régression. Faire évoluer les solutions selon les besoins métier et optimiser durablement leurs coûts et performances. Continuité et reprise d’activité Définir les stratégies de continuité : modes dégradés, solutions de repli et gestion des indisponibilités. Garantir la sauvegarde des configurations et des connaissances, ainsi que la capacité de redéploiement. Organiser et tester régulièrement les dispositifs de continuité et de reprise. Souveraineté, sécurité et conformité Orienter les choix de modèles et d’hébergement selon les enjeux de souveraineté et de réversibilité. Sécuriser les agents : permissions, garde-fous, protection contre les injections de prompt et traçabilité. Veiller à la conformité RGPD et AI Act, contribuer au cadre d’industrialisation et assurer une veille technologique. Profil Le Profil Recherche 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel, ML engineering ou ingénierie de production, dont au moins une expérience concrète de mise en production et d'exploitation d'applications basées sur des LLM. Très bonne maîtrise de Python et du développement d'API. Pratique des API de LLM et d'au moins un framework agentique (LangGraph, Pydantic AI, LlamaIndex, SDK fournisseurs ou équivalents), ainsi que du protocole MCP. Pratique de l'évaluation et de l'observabilité de systèmes LLM (Langfuse, LangSmith ou équivalents). Expérience de l'exploitation en production : supervision, gestion des incidents, CI/CD, conteneurisation, infrastructure as code. Connaissance des démarches de continuité et de reprise d'activité appliquées à des services cloud. Connaissance des enjeux de souveraineté (hébergement qualifié, modèles open-weight, solutions d'inférence auto-hébergées) et du cadre réglementaire (RGPD, AI Act). EVOLUTIONS La politique RH vous garantit un accompagnement régulier pour vous faire progresser et évoluer vers de nouvelles missions en fonction de votre projet. Rejoindre notre Groupe, c'est la garantie d'une formation initiale et continue, d'un plan de carrière personnalisé et d'un management de proximité. CONDITIONS PROPOSEES Poste basé à Beauvais, à pourvoir dès que possible. Rémunération : Fixe + Variable. Dans le cadre de sa politique RH, nous étudions, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap. ISA-RECRUT1 Référence de l'offre : uquwh4vsyk

items.desc: AI Engineer – GenAI & Enterprise Integrations (Nederlandstalig) The New Wave IT | Fulltime (32–40 uur) | Locatie: Nederland, deels bij klanten Let op: voor deze functie is vloeiend Nederlands (moedertaal of C1/C2) een harde eis. Je werkt dagelijks bij Nederlandse klanten, vaak (semi-)overheid, waar alle communicatie en documentatie in het Nederlands gaat. Je woont in Nederland; we bieden geen visum- of relocatiesponsoring. Over de rol Als AI Engineer bouw en implementeer je AI-oplossingen bij onze klanten. Je ontwikkelt onder meer agents, documentverwerking en LLM-integraties, koppelt die aan bestaande systemen en zorgt dat oplossingen veilig, betrouwbaar en beheersbaar in productie draaien. Je werkt direct met klantteams, begrijpt het proces achter de vraag en kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen. De strategische verkenning met de klant doen we samen: jij draagt de technische realisatie, van eerste werkende versie tot productie en overdracht aan beheer. The New Wave IT helpt organisaties op weg naar een AI-native manier van werken. Jij bent onze eerste AI-engineer in deze rol: je bepaalt mee hoe we AI-oplossingen bouwen en helpt collega’s groeien in AI-engineering. Wat ga je doen? · LLM-toepassingen en AI-agents ontwerpen en bouwen in Python, met tool/function calling en agentic workflows. · RAG-oplossingen en documentverwerking bouwen: ingestie, chunking, embeddings, vector search en bronvermelding. · AI-oplossingen integreren met enterprise-systemen via API’s, databases en bestaande applicaties van de klant. · Werkende prototypes doorontwikkelen tot productieklare software: getest, gecontaineriseerd en via CI/CD uitgerold op Azure of AWS. · Evaluatie en kwaliteit inrichten: testsets, automatische evals, regressietests op prompts en modellen. · Zorgen voor observability, security en beheersbaarheid: logging, tracing, kosten- en latency-monitoring, guardrails en toegangsbeheer. · Technische keuzes onderbouwen richting klantteams en architecten, en de vertaalslag maken van proces naar oplossing. · Collega’s technisch begeleiden en meebouwen aan onze herbruikbare componenten en werkwijze. Wat breng je mee? Harde eisen Taal en locatie · Vloeiend Nederlands in woord en geschrift (moedertaal of C1/C2). · Woonachtig in Nederland en bereid om regelmatig bij klanten op locatie te werken. Software engineering · Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in professionele softwareontwikkeling. · Uitstekende kennis van Python. · Ervaring met API-ontwikkeling (bijv. FastAPI), REST-integraties, SQL en databases. · Ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, testing en versiebeheer (Git). AI engineering · Aantoonbare praktijkervaring met LLM’s en model-API’s (bijv. Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic). · Ervaring met RAG, embeddings en vector databases of zoekindexen (bijv. pgvector, Azure AI Search). · Ervaring met AI-agents, function/tool calling en workfloworkestratie. · Kennis van prompt engineering, evaluatie en betrouwbaarheid van AI-systemen. Cloud en productie · Ervaring met Azure en/of AWS. · Werkervaring met Docker, CI/CD en deployment. · Ervaring met security, logging en monitoring. · Aantoonbaar software- of AI-oplossingen naar productie gebracht. Samenwerking · Ervaring in enterprise-omgevingen met meerdere stakeholders. · Kan technische keuzes helder uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s en klanten. · Werkt zelfstandig bij klanten zonder intensieve technische begeleiding. Pluspunten · Ervaring met LangChain, LangGraph of vergelijkbare agentframeworks. · Ervaring met Claude of n8n; hiermee werken wij veel, maar je kunt het bij ons leren. · Infrastructure as Code (bijv. Terraform, Bicep). · Kennis van machine learning (bijv. scikit-learn), data pipelines en MLOps. · Kennis van Mendix of andere enterprise low-code-platformen. · Ervaring bij (semi-)overheidsorganisaties. Wat zoeken we nadrukkelijk niet? · Een data scientist die vooral modellen onderzoekt en weinig software in productie brengt. · Een prompt engineer zonder stevige achtergrond in software engineering. · Een AI-strateeg of adviseur zonder recente, aantoonbare bouwervaring. · Een junior developer die nog intensieve technische begeleiding nodig heeft. · Kandidaten die niet vloeiend Nederlands spreken. Wat bieden we? · Salarisindicatie: tot €6.500 bruto per maand bij 40 uur, afhankelijk van ervaring, plus 8% vakantiegeld. · Bonusregeling: jaarlijks een bonus tot maximaal 1,5 maandsalaris. · Reiskosten gedekt: je kiest zelf voor een business ov-kaart, een reiskostenvergoeding of een combinatie van beide. · Pensioen via StiPP, met een werkgeversbijdrage van 15,9%. · Onbeperkt verlof: je plant je verlof in overleg met je team en de klant. · Hybride werken: bij de klant, bij ons op kantoor en thuis. · Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling. · Een sleutelrol als eerste AI-engineer: je bepaalt mee hoe we AI-oplossingen bouwen. · Afwisselende opdrachten bij verschillende klanten, met ruimte om nieuwe technologie te verkennen.

items.desc: Spond Øvre Vollgate 11, 0158 Oslo Om jobben Lagre favoritt Stillingstittel Data Analyst Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 1 Arbeidsspråk Engelsk Vis flere detaljer Why this role matters We’re looking for an experienced Data Analyst who can hit the ground running and help shape how Spond works with data. Millions of people use Spond to run their lives together. Sports teams, clubs and volunteer groups rely on us for administration, payments and communication. We have over 4 million monthly active users, we’re a leader in the sports category on the App Store, and we’re growing fast in Norway, the UK and beyond. Growth at that scale runs on good decisions, and good decisions run on good data. Our data team is still being built, and data capability across Spond is growing quickly. Whoever takes this role will help decide how Spond works with data, from the foundations up. What you’ll be doing Building the tools people use: reports, dashboards, self-service tools and data exports that teams rely on every day, plus conversational analytics as an emerging capability. Deciding what we measure: defining metrics and balanced quality and performance indicators for internal and external use. Growing data literacy: training and capabilities that let people serve themselves and get real value from our data products. Setting the standard: shaping how data products get built, improving the developer experience with AI, and showing others how to follow our best practices. Helping product teams own their data: supporting teams as they build data products within their own domains. Improving the platform: contributing to tooling and the shared developer experience for insights work, and joining product teams for hands-on help when they need it. Who you are This is a mid-to-senior level role for someone who has already worked as an analyst and wants more ownership. We’d rather hire someone who’s excited to learn than someone who ticks every box. Bring your curiosity, take ownership of your work, and enjoy figuring things out with others. You’ll probably feel at home if you: Have 3 years as a data analyst or in a similar role, with an analytical mindset and a good sense of what makes analytics succeed. Love turning vague questions into answers that change decisions. You ask good questions, work in a structured way with data, and think creatively and pragmatically about what users need. If we had to pick one quality, this would be it. Write advanced SQL on your own and have experience with modern data platforms like Databricks or Snowflake, plus tooling such as dbt. Dann werde Teil unseres AI & Data Teams bei Accenture. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden Ende-zu-Ende: von der strategischen, KI-nativen Neuausrichtung und Zieldefinition der Organisation über die Konzeption und Entwicklung innovativer KI-Lösungen bis hin zum technischen Design und der Implementierung von KI- und Datenplattformen. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team unterstützt du Unternehmen dabei, das volle Potenzial ihrer Daten und moderner KI-Technologien auszuschöpfen – von der Identifikation relevanter Use Cases über die Entwicklung von Prototypen bis hin zur Umsetzung skalierbarer KI- und Analytics-Lösungen. items.desc: Job Description Start your career where innovation meets real impact. Sapiens Accelerate is our global Early Careers Programme, designed for graduates with up to 18 months of experience, who are ready to learn, contribute, and shape the future of insurance. From day one, you'll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with experts across the business, build practical AI skills, and develop the capabilities needed to thrive in a global technology company. The role Agentic Data Foundation is the action layer. AI agents reason over governed data products and ML insight, not raw tables. We expose data and ML as governed MCP tools, build Synapse (our insurance ontology and semantic knowledge layer) and context as a service. Our agents are read-only, bound to one customer, fully logged and approved by people. This is a building role on a greenfield platform, with short prototype cycles and direct impact on product direction. Our stack: Python for agentic workloads, MCP, LLMs (Azure OpenAI), GraphQL APIs, Azure Databricks and Unity Catalog, ontology standards (SKOS, OWL, RDF and W3C). Job Requirements You should have Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/Data Science or similar; 0–18 months of experience (internships and projects count). Python, plus hands-on LLM projects: prompting, structured output, function/tool calling and handling failures. SQL and API basics (REST or GraphQL); Git. AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily workflow. Self-directed: comfortable with ambiguity, you make decisions and you ship. Even better if you have LangChain/LangGraph or similar; MCP or other agent standards. Embeddings, vector databases and RAG in a real application; building evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs. Knowledge graphs or ontologies (RDF, OWL, SPARQL); TypeScript. Job Responsibilities What you will do Build MCP tools. Expose governed data and ML outputs as typed, policy-checked, read-only tools for agents. Prototype agents. Build multi-step, tool-using agent workflows for insurance cases such as claims triage and lapse risk. Evaluate and secure. Write evaluation harnesses for reliability, plus guardrail tests (tenant isolation, free text treated as data, every call logged). Add meaning. Help build ontology, knowledge-graph and context-service components with the Synapse team. Ship and explain. Use AI coding tools daily, document and demo every prototype. Job Benefits Why join You will design agent architectures on governed enterprise data, solve reliability and evaluation problems, and see your work in front of insurers. Fast path to AI engineer or agent architect.

items.card: THE ROLE You’ll make Palm’s AI reliable, measurable and ready for a world of agents. You’ll take AI features from experiment to production with real autonomy, and you’ll own our evaluation practice: how we measure, improve and prove the quality of every answer. Working with our AI and Product Lead, our CTO, the software team and our clinical team, you’ll turn our technical direction into solutions that are testable
items.desc: Health is the most precious thing we have. At Palm, we’re building the founding team that will make it better for everyone, starting where it matters most: the first 1000 days of life. 📍 Rome, hybrid (2 days a week in the office) 💼 Full-time, mid-senior · 5+ years 💶 €40,000 – €60,000 gross per year (RAL), based on experience THE ROLE You’ll make Palm’s AI reliable, measurable and ready for a world of agents. You’ll take AI features from experiment to production with real autonomy, and you’ll own our evaluation practice: how we measure, improve and prove the quality of every answer. Working with our AI and Product Lead, our CTO, the software team and our clinical team, you’ll turn our technical direction into solutions that are testable and maintainable. FOUR HARD PROBLEMS. YOU’LL OWN THEM. 01 · Messy clinical data . Letters, reports, photos. Turn them into structured, trustworthy data, and never lose the link to the original source. 02 · Evals are the product . Build clinical benchmarks with doctors: real questions, critical cases, red flags. Quality is measured on every release, not assumed. 03 · Built for agents. Design Palm’s capabilities so they can be used by our own products and by other AI agents, with cited sources and consent respected. 04 · A safety line you can test . Palm informs and orients, it doesn’t diagnose. Make that boundary measurable and automated, so that when something drifts we see it early. WHAT YOU’LL DO Build and evolve RAG pipelines: ingestion and structuring, chunking, indexing, retrieval and reranking where it pays off. Improve LLM-based chat and workflows, including tool use and integration with application data and services. Ground every answer in approved clinical sources and the user’s relevant data, and check that the sources really support what the system says. Combine generative models with rules, structured validation and deterministic checks. Handle missing data, conflicts and uncertainty with abstention or human review. Build evaluation datasets and pipelines for retrieval, answers, document extraction and tool use, including critical cases and regression tests. Improve data extraction from documents, keep the link to the original sources, and make uncertain information explicit. Build automated pipelines for knowledge-base updates, with versioning, source traceability, grounding checks and monitoring. Work with our doctors to define approved sources, clinical requirements and acceptance criteria, and validate how the system behaves after every update. Find where errors come from (data, retrieval, model or application logic) and track quality, latency and cost. Write tested, documented code, review PRs, and help release and monitor in production. ABOUT YOU 5+ years in AI/ML and/or software engineering, including shipping LLM and RAG solutions to production. We also consider candidates with fewer years if we think they could be a solid fit. Strong Python and solid engineering habits: Git, tests, debugging, APIs, backend integration. You know LLMs, embeddings, vector search and RAG well, and you can explain why you chose what you chose. Hands-on with agents and tool use. You design reproducible evaluations, analyse errors and show improvement against a baseline. Checking a few examples by hand isn’t evaluation to you. You understand hallucinations, prompt injection, output variance, source quality and uncertainty, and you care about data protection. You work autonomously, collaborate well and flag risks early. You have the right to work in Italy. You’re fluent in both Italian and English. Bonus points: healthcare, sensitive data or regulated software; OCR and document understanding; benchmarks built with domain experts; GCP, containers, CI/CD, AI monitoring, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph; knowledge graphs, rule engines or verifiable reasoning; a degree in CS, engineering, maths, physics or similar, ideally with a master’s or PhD in AI/ML. YOUR FIRST PRIORITIES Get to know our existing pipelines, set a quality baseline and tackle the main errors with measurable improvements. Help strengthen our evaluations and output checks, and build a sustainable process for updating the knowledge base. LONGEVITY STARTS IN THE WOMB The first 1000 days, from conception to a child’s second birthday, are the most formative window in human health. This is when the brain, the immune system and the metabolism are wired. Research on the Developmental Origins of Health and Disease (DOHaD) shows that what happens in this window shapes neurodevelopment, immunity and metabolic health, with effects that last a lifetime. In the first 1000 days you can programme the system. In adulthood, you can mostly repair it. WHAT WE’RE BUILDING Health data is the most important data people own, and the worst organised. General-purpose AI can talk about medicine, but it can’t reason over your record or show where an answer came from. Palm is the clinical memory of every person, with an AI on top …

items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Facebook, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. The people of Adyen are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
 Software Engineer (Java) - Screening Team 
 The Screening team is at the heart of this platform, providing a framework for our customers and Adyen to process transactions safely. As Adyen and our merchants scale globally, the complexity of our domain is continuously growing.
 Our team operates at the critical juncture between regulatory mandate and operational scale within Adyen. We are responsible for mastering the complexities of diverse, global regulatory frameworks, translating complex legal requirements into robust, reliable software and processes. By owning this challenging domain, we assure millions of customers that their transactions are handled through a dependable and compliant framework, allowing them to rely confidently on our platform for their financial needs worldwide.
 In this role, you will: 
 Build – Help the Screening build solutions that enable Adyen’s global growth in a compliant way. Our roadmap is diverse with solutions across backend, ML/AI and big data. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your projects, from ideation to productionizing. 
 Innovate – Our team is a pioneer in the Adyen engineering organization, as we are one of the first teams deploying GenAI-powered applications to support other functions of Adyen. This is a new development paradigm that comes with a whole set of new challenges. 
 Collaborate – We rely on good collaboration in order to deliver solutions impacting several parts of Adyen.
 Set the Team Direction – In our team, engineers actively shape the product roadmap and closely collaborate with the team leadership to ensure our solutions are compliant, complete and scalable. 
 Who You Are: 
 You have 6+ years of professional experience and are currently working as a software engineer.
 Experience working in cross-functional product teams, part of a larger organization, is a big plus. 
 Our tech stack revolves around java, so being proficient in Java is a plus.
 The team works across backend and big data. You should be able to comfortably design and productionize cross-stack solutions.
 You are able to coach other engineers and bring a mindset of learning and curiosity to the team.
 Very good understanding of industry-standard engineering practices is a must. 
 You have excellent communication skills and the ability to articulate complex technical concepts in front of different stakeholders.
 You have the ability to drive a team’s roadmap in close collaboration with the product and engineering leadership of the team. 
 Required technical qualifications 
 Demonstrated knowledge of building Java based web services (RESTful, SOAP)
 Experienced in designing performant database models in PostgreSQL or other relational database)
 Knowledgeable of various software architecture paradigms such as event-driven or message queueing systems
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application.
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

items.desc: Vos missions Great assignments await you with our key account clients in rich and varied environments We are looking for a Senior Data Quality & Controls Analyst to ensure the quality, completeness and reliability of data used across reporting activities . The role combines data control design and execution, control-result analysis, Data Quality monitoring and remediation follow-up , covering both BAU activities and the onboarding of a new business perimeter. Your missions: Secure reporting production through robust data controls . Ensure the timely delivery of complete and reliable data . Strengthen existing controls and design new controls based on data knowledge, past incidents and data community needs . Analyse control results and identify genuine Data Quality issues . Initiate, coordinate and oversee data remediation . Provide visibility on control results through Data Quality KPIs . Improve control processes and prevent recurring incidents. Support BAU activities and the onboarding of the new perimeter. Your activities: Design, prioritize and implement the data controls backlog in an Agile way. Access data across multiple databases and systems . Execute controls using SQL, Alteryx and other relevant technologies . Save and distribute control results in an agreed and standardized format. Analyse True/False controls and trigger direct remediation when required. Investigate numerical variations and other control results to determine whether they represent genuine issues. Leverage data and Asset Management knowledge to assess identified issues. Measure and report Data Quality KPIs . Initiate and oversee remediation with the relevant data owners. items.desc:
TL;DR: How people discover Lovable is being rebuilt in real time. They now find software through Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude and others, and nobody has the full playbook yet. We're looking for an SEO and AEO specialist who wants to write it for Lovable and turn that visibility into subscribers and revenue. You're technical enough to land your own code and agentic enough to build the tools you need with AI. One sprint you're fixing how lovable.dev gets crawled and rendered; the next you're shipping pages for our highest-intent searches, or an agent that tracks where Lovable shows up in AI answers. Your first instinct is always: will people and answer engines find this, and does it help us grow?
 Why Lovable? 
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
 The role 
 You'll own organic discoverability for Lovable. Answer engines come first, on top of a strong foundation in traditional search. You do the strategy, building and measurement, there's no queue between an insight and a live change.
 You'll build most of your tools, pages and agents on Lovable itself, and take what you learn straight to the product team. Millions of apps are published on Lovable and each one needs to be found too, so what works for lovable.dev should become better defaults and guides for our users.
 What we’re looking for 
 5+ years in SEO, AEO or organic growth on a user-facing web product at scale. Results you've driven count for more than years.
 Hands-on AEO. You've tracked how AI assistants mention and cite a brand, tested what moves it, and can show the results.
 Deep technical SEO. Rendering, crawling, indexing, structured data, sitemaps, canonicals and internal linking at scale. When something breaks, you find out why.
 Agentic by default. You use AI coding tools and LLM APIs to build agents, scripts and internal tools that automate audits, monitoring and reporting, without waiting on engineering.
 You land code. You know enough web fundamentals (HTML, JavaScript, React, APIs) to work in our codebase, get changes through review into production, and own them after launch. You don't need to be a senior software engineer.
 Strong with data. SQL, Search Console, log files, event tracking, and tests that tell you something real.
 Good content and product judgment. You know what makes a page worth citing and cut what isn't working.
 Motivated by the scoreboard: traffic, citations, subscribers, revenue.
 What you’ll do 
 In one sentence: you'll own how Lovable gets found across search engines and AI assistants, and build the site, systems and tools that turn that into growth.
 Set the organic roadmap. Decide where Lovable needs to show up across Google, AI Overviews and AI assistants, which topics and queries matter most, and what we leave alone.
 Own the technical health of lovable.dev. Rendering, crawling, indexing, site structure, internal links, structured data and speed are yours. Keep search traffic safe through relaunches and redesigns.
 Ship pages that win high-intent search. Use search demand, prompt data and competitor gaps to pick what to build and refresh, then ship hub pages, templates, comparisons and other page systems. Work with content and product marketing on what goes on them.
 Get Lovable cited beyond our own site. Find the forums, communities, publications and docs that AI answers lean on for our category, and work with community, PR and partnerships to earn a place there.
 Make experimentation cheap and fast. Build the setup that lets the team test page formats, technical changes and distribution ideas in days, keep a record of each test, and double down on what works.
